	public class AxisScaleChangedEventArgsHelper
	{
		internal static AxisScaleChangedEventArgs Create(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.AxisBase axis, ScaleOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptionsImage oldOptions, ScaleOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptionsImage newOptions)
		{
			if (!oldOptions.IsValidImage || !newOptions.IsValidImage)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (newOptions is ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage)
			{
				return Create(axis, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage)oldOptions, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage)newOptions);
			}
			if (newOptions is ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage)
			{
				return Create(axis, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage)oldOptions, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage)newOptions);
			}
			if (newOptions is ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage)
			{
				return Create(axis, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage)oldOptions, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage)newOptions);
			}
			return Create(axis, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.QualitativeScaleOptionsImage)oldOptions, (ScaleOptionsWrapper.QualitativeScaleOptionsImage)newOptions);
		}

		private static NumericScaleChangedEventArgs Create(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.AxisBase axis, ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage oldOptions, ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage newOptions)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode> valueChangeInfo = new ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode>(GetScaleMode(oldOptions), GetScaleMode(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo2 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetMeasureUnit(oldOptions), GetMeasureUnit(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo3 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridAlignment(oldOptions), GetGridAlignment(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo3.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo4 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridSpacing(oldOptions), GetGridSpacing(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo4.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo5 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridOffset(oldOptions), GetGridOffset(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo5.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<bool> valueChangeInfo6 = new ValueChangeInfo<bool>(GetAutoGrid(oldOptions), GetAutoGrid(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo6.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> valueChangeInfo7 = new ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction>(GetAggregateFunction(oldOptions), GetAggregateFunction(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo7.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double?> valueChangeInfo8 = new ValueChangeInfo<double?>(GetUnderflowValue(oldOptions), GetUnderflowValue(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double?> overflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double?>(GetOverflowValue(oldOptions), GetOverflowValue(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double?> intervalWidthChange = new ValueChangeInfo<double?>(GetIntervalWidth(oldOptions), GetIntervalWidth(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<int?> intervalCountChange = new ValueChangeInfo<int?>(GetIntervalCount(oldOptions), GetIntervalCount(newOptions));
			if (!(flag | valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new NumericScaleChangedEventArgs(axis, valueChangeInfo, valueChangeInfo2, valueChangeInfo3, valueChangeInfo4, valueChangeInfo7, valueChangeInfo5, valueChangeInfo6, new NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(valueChangeInfo8, overflowValueChange, intervalWidthChange, intervalCountChange));
		}

		private static DateTimeScaleChangedEventArgs Create(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.AxisBase axis, ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage oldOptions, ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage newOptions)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode> valueChangeInfo = new ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode>(GetScaleMode(oldOptions), GetScaleMode(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit> valueChangeInfo2 = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit>(GetMeasureUnit(oldOptions), GetMeasureUnit(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<int> valueChangeInfo3 = new ValueChangeInfo<int>(GetMeasureUnitMultiplier(oldOptions), GetMeasureUnitMultiplier(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo3.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.DateTimeGridAlignment> valueChangeInfo4 = new ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.DateTimeGridAlignment>(GetGridAlignment(oldOptions), GetGridAlignment(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo4.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo5 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridSpacing(oldOptions), GetGridSpacing(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo5.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo6 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridOffset(oldOptions), GetGridOffset(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo6.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<bool> valueChangeInfo7 = new ValueChangeInfo<bool>(GetAutoGrid(oldOptions), GetAutoGrid(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo7.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> valueChangeInfo8 = new ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction>(GetAggregateFunction(oldOptions), GetAggregateFunction(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> underflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?>(GetUnderflowValue(oldOptions), GetUnderflowValue(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> overflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?>(GetOverflowValue(oldOptions), GetOverflowValue(newOptions));
			if (!(flag | valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new DateTimeScaleChangedEventArgs(axis, valueChangeInfo, valueChangeInfo2, valueChangeInfo3, valueChangeInfo4, valueChangeInfo5, valueChangeInfo8, valueChangeInfo6, valueChangeInfo7, new IntervalOptionsChangeInfo<DateTime?>(underflowValueChange, overflowValueChange));
		}

		private static TimeSpanScaleChangedEventArgs Create(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.AxisBase axis, ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage oldOptions, ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage newOptions)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode> valueChangeInfo = new ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode>(GetScaleMode(oldOptions), GetScaleMode(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit> valueChangeInfo2 = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit>(GetMeasureUnit(oldOptions), GetMeasureUnit(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<int> valueChangeInfo3 = new ValueChangeInfo<int>(GetMeasureUnitMultiplier(oldOptions), GetMeasureUnitMultiplier(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo3.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.TimeSpanGridAlignment> valueChangeInfo4 = new ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.TimeSpanGridAlignment>(GetGridAlignment(oldOptions), GetGridAlignment(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo4.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo5 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridSpacing(oldOptions), GetGridSpacing(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo5.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo6 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridOffset(oldOptions), GetGridOffset(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo6.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<bool> valueChangeInfo7 = new ValueChangeInfo<bool>(GetAutoGrid(oldOptions), GetAutoGrid(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo7.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> valueChangeInfo8 = new ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction>(GetAggregateFunction(oldOptions), GetAggregateFunction(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> underflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(GetUnderflowValue(oldOptions), GetUnderflowValue(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> overflowValueChange = new ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(GetOverflowValue(oldOptions), GetOverflowValue(newOptions));
			if (!(flag | valueChangeInfo8.IsChanged))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new TimeSpanScaleChangedEventArgs(axis, valueChangeInfo, valueChangeInfo2, valueChangeInfo3, valueChangeInfo4, valueChangeInfo5, valueChangeInfo8, valueChangeInfo6, valueChangeInfo7, new IntervalOptionsChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(underflowValueChange, overflowValueChange));
		}

		private static QualitativeScaleChangedEventArgs Create(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.AxisBase axis, ScaleOptionsWrapper.QualitativeScaleOptionsImage oldOptions, ScaleOptionsWrapper.QualitativeScaleOptionsImage newOptions)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode> valueChangeInfo = new ValueChangeInfo<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode>(GetScaleMode(oldOptions), GetScaleMode(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo2 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridSpacing(oldOptions), GetGridSpacing(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo3 = new ValueChangeInfo<double>(GetGridOffset(oldOptions), GetGridOffset(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo3.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<bool> valueChangeInfo4 = new ValueChangeInfo<bool>(GetAutoGrid(oldOptions), GetAutoGrid(newOptions));
			flag |= valueChangeInfo4.IsChanged;
			ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> valueChangeInfo5 = new ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction>(GetAggregateFunction(oldOptions), GetAggregateFunction(newOptions));
			if (!(flag | valueChangeInfo5.IsChanged))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new QualitativeScaleChangedEventArgs(axis, valueChangeInfo, valueChangeInfo2, valueChangeInfo5, valueChangeInfo3, valueChangeInfo4);
		}

		private static double GetGridAlignment(ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.NumericGridAlignment ?? 1.0;
		}

		private static double GetMeasureUnit(ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.NumericMeasureUnit ?? 1.0;
		}

		private static DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.DateTimeGridAlignment GetGridAlignment(ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.DateTimeGridAlignment ?? DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.DateTimeGridAlignment.Day;
		}

		private static DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.TimeSpanGridAlignment GetGridAlignment(ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.TimeSpanGridAlignment ?? DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.TimeSpanGridAlignment.Minute;
		}

		private static DateTimeMeasureUnit GetMeasureUnit(ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.DateTimeMeasureUnit ?? DateTimeMeasureUnit.Day;
		}

		private static TimeSpanMeasureUnit GetMeasureUnit(ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.TimeSpanMeasureUnit ?? TimeSpanMeasureUnit.Day;
		}

		private static int GetMeasureUnitMultiplier(ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.DateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier ?? 1;
		}

		private static int GetMeasureUnitMultiplier(ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options?.TimeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplier ?? 1;
		}

		private static DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ScaleMode GetScaleMode(ScaleOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.ScaleMode;
		}

		private static AggregateFunction GetAggregateFunction(ScaleOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.AggregateFunction;
		}

		private static double? GetUnderflowValue(ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.UnderflowValue;
		}

		private static double? GetOverflowValue(ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.OverflowValue;
		}

		private static DateTime? GetUnderflowValue(ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.UnderflowValue;
		}

		private static DateTime? GetOverflowValue(ScaleOptionsWrapper.DateTimeScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.OverflowValue;
		}

		private static TimeSpan? GetUnderflowValue(ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.UnderflowValue;
		}

		private static TimeSpan? GetOverflowValue(ScaleOptionsWrapper.TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.OverflowValue;
		}

		private static double? GetIntervalWidth(ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.IntervalWidth;
		}

		private static int? GetIntervalCount(ScaleOptionsWrapper.NumericScaleOptionsImage options)
		{
			return options.IntervalCount;
		}

		private static bool GetAutoGrid(ScaleOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptionsImage options)
		{

		}

		{

	internal class DataPoint

	public class PreloadProvider : IPreloadSupport
	{
		IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> IPreloadSupport.GetConfiguredTree()
		{
			ChartControl chartControl = new ChartControl();
			chartControl.BeginInit();
			chartControl.DataSource = new ObservableCollection<DataPoint>
			{
				new DataPoint
				{
					Argument = "Arg",
					Value = 1.2
				}
			};
			chartControl.Titles.Add(new Title
			{
				Content = "Title"
			});
			chartControl.Legends.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Legend());
			chartControl.Diagram = new XYDiagram2D
			{
				Series = { (Series)new BarSideBySideSeries2D
				{
					DisplayName = "Stat",
					ArgumentDataMember = "Argument",
					ValueDataMember = "Value"
				} }
			};
			chartControl.EndInit();
			yield return chartControl;
			ChartControl chartControl2 = new ChartControl();
			chartControl2.BeginInit();
			chartControl2.DataSource = new ObservableCollection<DataPoint>
			{
				new DataPoint
				{
					Argument = "Arg",
					Value = 1.2
				}
			};
			chartControl2.Titles.Add(new Title
			{
				Content = "Title"
			});
			chartControl2.Legends.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Legend());
			chartControl2.Diagram = new XYDiagram2D
			{
				Series = { (Series)new SplineSeries2D
				{
					DisplayName = "Stat",
					ArgumentDataMember = "Argument",
					ValueDataMember = "Value"
				} }
			};
			chartControl2.EndInit();
			yield return chartControl2;
			ChartControl chartControl3 = new ChartControl();
			chartControl3.BeginInit();
			chartControl3.DataSource = new ObservableCollection<DataPoint>
			{
				new DataPoint
				{
					Argument = "Arg",
					Value = 1.2
				}
			};
			chartControl3.Titles.Add(new Title
			{
				Content = "Title"
			});
			chartControl3.Legends.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Legend());
			chartControl3.Diagram = new XYDiagram2D
			{
				Series = { (Series)new SplineAreaSeries2D
				{
					DisplayName = "Stat",
					ArgumentDataMember = "Argument",
					ValueDataMember = "Value"
				} }
			};
			chartControl3.EndInit();
			yield return chartControl3;
			ChartControl chartControl4 = new ChartControl();
			chartControl4.BeginInit();
			chartControl4.DataSource = new ObservableCollection<DataPoint>
			{
				new DataPoint
				{
					Argument = "Arg",
					Value = 1.2
				}
			};
			chartControl4.Titles.Add(new Title
			{

		}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Charts
{
	public enum AnimationAutoStartMode
	{
		PlayOnce,
		SetStartState,
		SetFinalState
	}
	public abstract class AnimationBase : ChartDependencyObject, IBindingPropertiesSource, ICloneable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DurationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Duration", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(AnimationBase), new PropertyMetadata(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(800.0), ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BeginTimeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BeginTime", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(AnimationBase), new PropertyMetadata(TimeSpan.Zero, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EasingFunctionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EasingFunction", typeof(IEasingFunction), typeof(AnimationBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Specifies the duration of the animation. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan Duration
		{
			get
			{
				return (TimeSpan)GetValue(DurationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DurationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the time when the animation is started. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan BeginTime
		{
			get
			{
				return (TimeSpan)GetValue(BeginTimeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BeginTimeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the easing function for the animation. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public IEasingFunction EasingFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEasingFunction)GetValue(EasingFunctionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EasingFunctionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual string AnimationName => "Animation";

		protected Timeline CreateTimeline(TimeSpan beginTime)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.From = 0.0;
			doubleAnimation.To = 1.0;
			doubleAnimation.Duration = Duration;
			doubleAnimation.BeginTime = beginTime;
			doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = ((EasingFunction != null) ? EasingFunction : GetDefaultEasingFunction());
			return doubleAnimation;
		}

		protected virtual IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			properties.Add(DurationProperty);
			properties.Add(BeginTimeProperty);
			properties.Add(EasingFunctionProperty);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			AnimationBase animationBase = (AnimationBase)Activator.CreateInstance(GetType());
			BindingPropertiesContainer<AnimationBase>.Apply(this, animationBase);
			return animationBase;
		}

		object IBindingPropertiesSource.CloneValue(object value)
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}
	}

	public abstract class Area2DAnimationBase : SeriesAnimationBase
	{
		public virtual Transform CreateAnimatedTransformation(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = Matrix.Identity
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class Area2DPredefinedAnimationBase : Area2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected abstract Transform CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress);

		public override Transform CreateAnimatedTransformation(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleX = 0.0,
					ScaleY = 0.0
				};
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(viewport, pointOfOrigin, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
		}
	}

	public abstract class Bar2DAnimationBase : SeriesPointAnimationBase
	{
		private Rect CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, bool isMinMarker, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return markerBounds;
			}
			double num = markerBounds.X - barBounds.X;
			if (axisYReverse)
			{
				isMinMarker = !isMinMarker;
			}
			double num2 = (isMinMarker ? (markerBounds.Y - barBounds.Y) : (markerBounds.Y - barBounds.Bottom));
			Rect rect = CreateAnimatedBarBounds(barBounds, viewport, isNegativeBar, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
			double y = (isMinMarker ? (rect.Y + num2) : (rect.Bottom + num2));
			return new Rect(rect.X + num, y, markerBounds.Width, markerBounds.Height);
		}

		public virtual Rect CreateAnimatedBarBounds(Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return barBounds;
		}

		public virtual Rect CreateAnimatedMinMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(markerBounds, isMinMarker: true, barBounds, viewport, isNegativeBar, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
		}

		public virtual Rect CreateAnimatedMaxMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(markerBounds, isMinMarker: false, barBounds, viewport, isNegativeBar, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
		}
	}
	public class Bar2DGrowUpAnimation : Bar2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Grow Up";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Bar2DGrowUpAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedBarBounds(Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return barBounds;
			}
			double x = barBounds.X;
			double y = (((isNegativeBar && !axisYReverse) || (!isNegativeBar && axisYReverse)) ? (barBounds.Y + barBounds.Height * (1.0 - progress)) : barBounds.Y);
			double width = barBounds.Width;
			double height = barBounds.Height * progress;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedMinMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return markerBounds;
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedMaxMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return base.CreateAnimatedMaxMarkerBounds(markerBounds, barBounds, viewport, isNegativeBar, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
		}
	}
	public class Bar2DDropInAnimation : Bar2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Drop In";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Bar2DDropInAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedBarBounds(Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return barBounds;
			}
			bool flag = (isNegativeBar && !axisYReverse) || (!isNegativeBar && axisYReverse);
			double x = barBounds.X;
			double y = (flag ? (barBounds.Y - (barBounds.Y + barBounds.Height) * (1.0 - progress)) : (barBounds.Y + ((diagramRotated ? viewport.Width : viewport.Height) - barBounds.Y) * (1.0 - progress)));
			double width = barBounds.Width;
			double height = barBounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}
	public class Bar2DBounceAnimation : Bar2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Bounce";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new BounceEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Bar2DBounceAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedBarBounds(Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return barBounds;
			}
			double x;
			double y;
			if (diagramRotated)
			{
				x = barBounds.X + (viewport.Height - barBounds.X) * (1.0 - progress);
				y = barBounds.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				x = barBounds.X;
				y = barBounds.Y + (viewport.Height - barBounds.Y) * (1.0 - progress);
			}
			double width = barBounds.Width;
			double height = barBounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}

	public class Bar2DWidenAnimation : Bar2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Widen";

		private Rect CalculateBounds(Rect bounds, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double x = bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2.0 - bounds.Width * progress / 2.0;
			double y = bounds.Y;
			double width = bounds.Width * progress;
			double height = bounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new ElasticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Bar2DWidenAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedBarBounds(Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return CalculateBounds(barBounds, progress);
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedMinMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return CalculateBounds(markerBounds, progress);
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedMaxMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect barBounds, Rect viewport, bool isNegativeBar, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return CalculateBounds(markerBounds, progress);
		}
	}

	public class BoxPlot2DSlideFromLeftAnimation : BoxPlot2DAnimationBase
	{
		private const double MarginOfSafety = 5.0;

		private Matrix matrix;

		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Slide From Left";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new BoxPlot2DSlideFromLeftAnimation();
		}

		public override Matrix CalculateTransform(BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout boxPlotLayout, double progress)
		{
			matrix.SetIdentity();
			double num = boxPlotLayout.Box.Right + 5.0;
			double offsetX = (0.0 - (1.0 - progress)) * num;
			matrix.OffsetX = offsetX;
			return matrix;
		}
	}
	public class BoxPlot2DSlideFromRightAnimation : BoxPlot2DAnimationBase

	public abstract class CircularMarkerLinearSlideAnimationBase : CircularMarkerAnimationBase
	{
		protected abstract double CalculateStartX(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport);

		protected abstract double CalculateStartY(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport);

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return markerBounds;
			}
			double num = CalculateStartX(markerBounds, viewport);
			double num2 = CalculateStartY(markerBounds, viewport);
			double x = markerBounds.X;
			double y = markerBounds.Y;
			double x2 = num + (x - num) * progress;
			double y2 = num2 + (y - num2) * progress;
			double width = markerBounds.Width;
			double height = markerBounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x2, y2, width, height);
		}
	}
	public class CircularMarkerSlideFromLeftCenterAnimation : CircularMarkerLinearSlideAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Slide From Left Center";

		protected override double CalculateStartX(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport)
		{
			return viewport.X - markerBounds.Width / 2.0 - markerBounds.Width;

		protected override double CalculateStartY(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport)

	public class CircularMarkerSlideToCenterAnimation : CircularMarkerLinearSlideAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Slide To Center";

		private double CalculateDistance(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = viewport.Width / 2.0 - markerBounds.X;
			double num2 = viewport.Height / 2.0 - markerBounds.Y;
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
		}

		protected override double CalculateStartX(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = CalculateDistance(markerBounds, viewport);
			return viewport.Width / 2.0 * (1.0 + (markerBounds.X - viewport.Width / 2.0) / num);
		}

		protected override double CalculateStartY(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = CalculateDistance(markerBounds, viewport);
			return viewport.Height / 2.0 * (1.0 + (markerBounds.Y - viewport.Height / 2.0) / num);
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new CircularMarkerSlideToCenterAnimation();
		}
	}

	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Spin Zoom in";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new PowerEase
			{
				Power = 3.0,
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override Transform CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, double progress)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = progress * 360.0,
				CenterY = pointOfOrigin.Y,
				CenterX = pointOfOrigin.X
			});
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
			{
				ScaleY = progress,
				ScaleX = progress,
				CenterY = pointOfOrigin.Y,
				CenterX = pointOfOrigin.X
			});
			return transformGroup;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new CircularAreaSpinZoomInAnimation();
		}
	}

	public class Funnel2DWidenAnimation : Funnel2DSeriesPointAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Widen";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new ElasticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Funnel2DWidenAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CalculateAnimatedBounds(Rect pointBounds, Rect viewport, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return pointBounds;
			}
			double num = pointBounds.Width / 8.0 - pointBounds.Width * progress / 8.0;
			return new Rect(pointBounds.X + num, pointBounds.Y, pointBounds.Width - num * 2.0, pointBounds.Height);
		}
	}

	public class Funnel2DFlyInAnimation : Funnel2DSeriesPointAnimationBase
	{
		private Dictionary<Rect, bool> layoutAnimationSide2 = new Dictionary<Rect, bool>();

		private bool fromLeft = true;

		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Fly In";

		public Funnel2DFlyInAnimation()
		{
			base.PointOrder = PointAnimationOrder.Inverted;
		}

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Funnel2DGrowUpAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CalculateAnimatedBounds(Rect pointBounds, Rect viewport, double progress)
		{
			if (!layoutAnimationSide2.ContainsKey(pointBounds))
			{
				layoutAnimationSide2[pointBounds] = fromLeft;
				fromLeft = !fromLeft;
			}
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return pointBounds;
			}
			Rect rect = ((!layoutAnimationSide2[pointBounds]) ? AnimationHelper.CreateSlideFromRightAnimatedBounds(pointBounds, viewport, diagramRotated: false, progress) : AnimationHelper.CreateSlideFromLeftAnimatedBounds(pointBounds, diagramRotated: false, progress));
			if (progress < 0.75)
			{
				return new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2.0, rect.Width, 2.0);
			}
			double num = (progress - 0.75) * 4.0;
			return new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2.0 * (1.0 - num), rect.Width, rect.Height * num);
		}
	}
	public abstract class IndicatorAnimationBase : AnimationBase
	{
		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateAdditionalGeometry => true;

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateClipBounds => false;

		public virtual Transform CreateAnimatedTransformation(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return Transform.Identity;
		}

		internal void PrepareSeriesStoryboard(Storyboard seriesStoryboard, Indicator indicator)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			Timeline timeline = CreateTimeline(TimeSpan.Zero);
			Storyboard.SetTarget(timeline, indicator.AnimationProgress);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(timeline, new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(AnimationProgress.ProgressProperty)));
			timeline.Freeze();
			storyboard.Children.Add(timeline);
			storyboard.BeginTime = base.BeginTime;
			seriesStoryboard.Children.Add(storyboard);
		}
	}
	public abstract class IndicatorPredefinedAnimationBase : IndicatorAnimationBase
	{
		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected abstract Transform CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress);

		public override Transform CreateAnimatedTransformation(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleX = 0.0,
					ScaleY = 0.0
				};
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(viewport, pointOfOrigin, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorSlideFromLeftAnimation : IndicatorPredefinedAnimationBase

	public abstract class Line2DAnimationBase : SeriesAnimationBase
	{
		public virtual Transform CreateAnimatedTransformation(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			return new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = Matrix.Identity
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class Line2DPredefinedAnimationBase : Line2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new QuinticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected abstract Transform CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress);

		public override Transform CreateAnimatedTransformation(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pointOfOrigin, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleX = 0.0,
					ScaleY = 0.0
				};
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateAnimatedTransformationInternal(viewport, pointOfOrigin, axisXReverse, axisYReverse, diagramRotated, progress);
		}
	}

	public abstract class Marker2DLinearSlideAnimationBase : Marker2DSlideAnimationBase
	{
		protected abstract double CalculateStartX(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, bool diagramRotated);

		protected abstract double CalculateStartY(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, bool diagramRotated);

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return markerBounds;
			}
			double num = CalculateStartX(markerBounds, viewport, diagramRotated);
			double num2 = CalculateStartY(markerBounds, viewport, diagramRotated);
			double num3 = markerBounds.X + markerBounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num4 = markerBounds.Y + markerBounds.Height / 2.0;
			double num5 = (diagramRotated ? markerBounds.Width : markerBounds.Height);
			double num6 = (diagramRotated ? markerBounds.Height : markerBounds.Width);
			double x = num + (num3 - num) * progress - num5 / 2.0;
			double y = num2 + (num4 - num2) * progress - num6 / 2.0;
			double width = markerBounds.Width;
			double height = markerBounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}
	public class Marker2DSlideFromLeftCenterAnimation : Marker2DLinearSlideAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Slide From Left Center";

		protected override double CalculateStartX(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, bool diagramRotated)
		{
			if (!diagramRotated)
			{
				return viewport.X - markerBounds.Width / 2.0;
			}
			return viewport.Height / 2.0;
		}

		protected override double CalculateStartY(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, bool diagramRotated)
		{
			if (!diagramRotated)
			{
				return viewport.Height / 2.0;
			}
			return viewport.X - markerBounds.Height / 2.0;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Marker2DSlideFromLeftCenterAnimation();
		}
	}

	public class Marker2DFadeInAnimation : Marker2DAnimationBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Mode", typeof(FadeInMode), typeof(Marker2DFadeInAnimation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(FadeInMode.Auto, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public FadeInMode Mode
		{
			get
			{
				return (FadeInMode)GetValue(ModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Fade In";

		protected internal override bool ShouldAnimateSeriesPointLayout => false;

		protected override double LabelDurationPortion => 1.0;

		protected internal override bool ShouldAnimateSeriesPointOpacity(Series series)
		{

		private double CorrectProgress(double progress)
		{
			if (!(progress < 0.5))
			{
				return 1.0 - progress;
			}
			return progress;
		}

		public override double CalculateAnimatedRadius(double radius, Rect viewport, double progress)
		{
			return radius + 0.3 * radius * CorrectProgress(progress);

		{
			return sweepAngle + 0.2 * sweepAngle * CorrectProgress(progress);

			double num2 = 0.5 * (radius + Math.Sqrt(viewport.Height * viewport.Height + viewport.Width * viewport.Width)) * (1.0 - num);
			return new System.Windows.Point(pieCenter.X + Math.Cos(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angle)) * num2, pieCenter.Y + Math.Sin(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angle)) * num2);

		}

	public class Pie2DSpinAnimation : Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DirectionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Direction", typeof(PieSweepDirection), typeof(Pie2DSpinAnimation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TurnsNumberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TurnsNumber", typeof(double), typeof(Pie2DSpinAnimation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.5, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateTurnsNumber);

		[Description("Specifies the direction in which Pie2DSpinAnimation is performed. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public PieSweepDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return (PieSweepDirection)GetValue(DirectionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DirectionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the number of turns Pie2DSpinAnimation makes. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double TurnsNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(TurnsNumberProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TurnsNumberProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Spin";

		private static bool ValidateTurnsNumber(object turnsNumber)
		{
			return (double)turnsNumber > 0.0;
		}

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new PowerEase
			{
				Power = 3.0,
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(DirectionProperty);
			properties.Add(TurnsNumberProperty);
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Pie2DSpinAnimation();
		}

		public override double CalculateAnimatedRotation(double rotation, double progress)
		{
			double num = TurnsNumber * 360.0 * (1.0 - progress);
			if (Direction != PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise)
			{
				return rotation + num;
			}
			return rotation - num;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeriesAnimationBase : AnimationBase
	{
		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateAdditionalGeometry => true;

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateClipBounds => false;

		protected internal void PrepareSeriesStoryboard(Storyboard seriesStoryboard, Series series)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			Timeline timeline = CreateTimeline(TimeSpan.Zero);
			Storyboard.SetTarget(timeline, series.SeriesProgress);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(timeline, new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(AnimationProgress.ProgressProperty)));
			timeline.Freeze();
			storyboard.Children.Add(timeline);
			storyboard.BeginTime = base.BeginTime;
			seriesStoryboard.Children.Add(storyboard);
		}
	}
	public enum PointAnimationOrder
	{
		Straight,
		Inverted,
		Random
	}
	public abstract class SeriesPointAnimationBase : AnimationBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointDelayProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointDelay", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(SeriesPointAnimationBase), new PropertyMetadata(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100.0), ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointOrderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointOrder", typeof(PointAnimationOrder), typeof(SeriesPointAnimationBase), new PropertyMetadata(PointAnimationOrder.Straight, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Specifies the delay sustained when animating the series points. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TimeSpan PointDelay
		{
			get
			{
				return (TimeSpan)GetValue(PointDelayProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointDelayProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Defines the order in which series points are animated. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public PointAnimationOrder PointOrder
		{
			get
			{
				return (PointAnimationOrder)GetValue(PointOrderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointOrderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateSeriesPointLayout => true;

		protected virtual double LabelDurationPortion => 0.5;

		private TimeSpan GetTimelineBeginTime(int pointIndex)
		{
			return TimeSpan.FromTicks(PointDelay.Ticks * pointIndex);
		}

		private Timeline CreateLabelTimeline(TimeSpan beginTime)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.From = 0.0;
			doubleAnimation.To = 1.0;
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)Math.Round((double)base.Duration.Ticks * LabelDurationPortion));
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)Math.Round((double)base.Duration.Ticks * (1.0 - LabelDurationPortion)));
			doubleAnimation.Duration = new Duration(timeSpan);
			doubleAnimation.BeginTime = beginTime + timeSpan2;
			return doubleAnimation;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPointData> GetPointDataCollection(Series series)
		{
			int count = series.Item.SeriesPointDataList.Count;
			switch (PointOrder)
			{
			case PointAnimationOrder.Straight:
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
				{
					yield return series.Item.SeriesPointDataList[k];
				}
				break;
			}
			case PointAnimationOrder.Inverted:
			{
				for (int i2 = count - 1; i2 >= 0; i2--)
				{
					yield return series.Item.SeriesPointDataList[i2];
				}
				break;
			}
			case PointAnimationOrder.Random:
			{
				NonCryptographicRandom rnd = NonCryptographicRandom.System;
				List<int> indexes = new List<int>();
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					int index = MathUtils.StrongRound(rnd.NextDouble() * (double)(count - 1));
					for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
					{
						if (index + j < count && !indexes.Contains(index + j))
						{
							indexes.Add(index + j);
							yield return series.Item.SeriesPointDataList[index + j];
							break;
						}
						if (index - j >= 0 && !indexes.Contains(index - j))
						{
							indexes.Add(index - j);
							yield return series.Item.SeriesPointDataList[index - j];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown PointAnimationOrder.");
				goto case PointAnimationOrder.Straight;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateSeriesPointOpacity(Series series)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldAnimateSeriesLabelOpacity(Series series)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal void PrepareSeriesStoryboard(Storyboard seriesStoryboard, Series series)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			Storyboard storyboard2 = new Storyboard();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (SeriesPointData item in GetPointDataCollection(series))
			{
				TimeSpan timelineBeginTime = GetTimelineBeginTime(num++);
				Timeline timeline = CreateTimeline(timelineBeginTime);
				Timeline timeline2 = CreateLabelTimeline(timelineBeginTime);
				Storyboard.SetTarget(timeline, item.PointProgress);
				Storyboard.SetTarget(timeline2, item.LabelProgress);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(timeline, new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(AnimationProgress.ProgressProperty)));
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(timeline2, new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(AnimationProgress.ProgressProperty)));
				timeline.Freeze();
				timeline2.Freeze();
				storyboard.Children.Add(timeline);
				storyboard2.Children.Add(timeline2);
			}
			storyboard.BeginTime = base.BeginTime;
			storyboard2.BeginTime = base.BeginTime;
			seriesStoryboard.Children.Add(storyboard);
			seriesStoryboard.Children.Add(storyboard2);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(PointDelayProperty);
			properties.Add(PointOrderProperty);
		}
	}

	public class Stock2DExpandAnimation : Stock2DAnimationBase
	{
		protected internal override string AnimationName => "Expand";

		protected override IEasingFunction GetDefaultEasingFunction()
		{
			return new ElasticEase
			{
				EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
			};
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Stock2DExpandAnimation();
		}

		public override Rect CreateAnimatedStockBounds(Rect stockBounds, Rect viewport, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return stockBounds;
			}
			double x = stockBounds.X;
			double y = stockBounds.Y + stockBounds.Height / 2.0 - stockBounds.Height * progress / 2.0;
			double width = stockBounds.Width;
			double height = stockBounds.Height * progress;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}

	public class EditableImageContent : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ImageSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ImageSource", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(EditableImageContent), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		[Description("Gets or sets an image displayed in an editable annotation.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public ImageSource ImageSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (ImageSource)GetValue(ImageSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ImageSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public EditableImageContent()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<EditableImageContent>(this);
			Uri uriSource = new Uri("pack://application:,,,/DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.v23.2;component/Images/ImageAnnotationDefaultPicture.png", UriKind.Absolute);
			ImageSource = new BitmapImage(uriSource);
			base.Width = 48.0;
			base.Height = 40.0;
			base.MouseDoubleClick += OnMouseDoubleClick;
		}

		private void OnMouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			SelectImage();
		}

		private ChartElement GetParentChartElement()
		{
			for (DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this); parent != null; parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(parent))
			{
				if (parent is ChartElement && !(parent is Pane) && !(parent is Diagram) && !(parent is ChartControlBase))
				{
					return (ChartElement)parent;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SelectImage()
		{
			OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.CheckFileExists = true;
			openFileDialog.AddExtension = false;
			openFileDialog.CheckPathExists = true;
			openFileDialog.Multiselect = false;
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			ImageCodecInfo[] imageEncoders = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageEncoders();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < imageEncoders.Length; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(imageEncoders[i].FilenameExtension);
				if (i < imageEncoders.Length - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(";");
				}
			}
			string arg = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.OpenFileDialogImageFiles);
			string arg2 = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.OpenFileDialogAllFiles);
			openFileDialog.Filter = string.Format("{1} ({0})|{0}|{2} (*.*)|*.*", stringBuilder.ToString(), arg, arg2);
			bool? flag = openFileDialog.ShowDialog();
			if (!flag.HasValue || !flag.Value)
			{
				return;
			}
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = null;
			try
			{
				bitmapImage = new BitmapImage(new Uri(openFileDialog.FileName));
			}
			catch
			{
				string messageBoxText = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgCantOpenImageMessage);
				string caption = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgCantOpenImageMessageBoxHeader);
				MessageBox.Show(messageBoxText, caption, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
			}
			if (bitmapImage != null)
			{
				ImageSource = bitmapImage;
				ChartElement parentChartElement = GetParentChartElement();
				double num = (double)bitmapImage.PixelHeight / (double)bitmapImage.PixelWidth;
				base.Width = double.NaN;
				base.Height = double.NaN;
				if (bitmapImage.PixelWidth >= bitmapImage.PixelHeight)
				{
					parentChartElement.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, Math.Min(150.0, bitmapImage.Width));
					parentChartElement.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, Math.Max(3.0, parentChartElement.Width * num));
				}
				else
				{
					parentChartElement.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, Math.Min(150.0, bitmapImage.Height));
					parentChartElement.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, Math.Max(3.0, parentChartElement.Height / num));
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class ChartAnchorPoint : AnnotationAnchorPoint
	{
		internal const double DefaultX = 20.0;

		internal const double DefaultY = 50.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty XProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("X", typeof(double), typeof(ChartAnchorPoint), new PropertyMetadata(20.0, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty YProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Y", typeof(double), typeof(ChartAnchorPoint), new PropertyMetadata(50.0, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Specifies the X-coordinate for the annotation anchor point.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double X
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(XProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(XProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the Y-coordinate for the annotation anchor point.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Y
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(YProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(YProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ChartAnchorPoint();
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationLayout CalculateAnnotationLayout(Annotation annotation, double angle, double connectorLength)
		{
			double num = Math.Cos(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angle)) * connectorLength - annotation.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = (0.0 - Math.Sin(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angle))) * connectorLength - annotation.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
			return new AnnotationLayout(new System.Windows.Point(X + num, Y + num2), default(Thickness), visible: true);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point ConvertToPoint()
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(X, Y);
		}
	}

		private static void AxisCoordinatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				AxisCoordinate axisCoordinate = e.OldValue as AxisCoordinate;
				AxisCoordinate axisCoordinate2 = e.NewValue as AxisCoordinate;
				if (axisCoordinate != null)
				{
					axisCoordinate.Chart = null;
				}
				if (axisCoordinate2 != null)
				{
					axisCoordinate2.Chart = paneAnchorPoint.Chart;
				}
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(axisCoordinate, axisCoordinate2, paneAnchorPoint);
				ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			string propertyName = string.Empty;
			if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs)
			{
				propertyName = ((PropertyChangedEventArgs)e).PropertyName;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new PaneAnchorPoint();
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationLayout CalculateAnnotationLayout(Annotation annotation, double angle, double connectorLength)
		{
			System.Windows.Point? point = CalculateAnchorPoint(0.0, 0.0);
			if (point.HasValue)
			{
				RelativePosition relativePosition = (RelativePosition)annotation.ActualShapePosition;
				bool flag = Diagram != null && Diagram.IsNavigationEnabled;
				bool labelMode = annotation.ActualLabelMode && !flag;
				XYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator xYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator = new XYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator(ActualPane, new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), Chart.Diagram.AnnotationsPanel.RenderSize));
				return xYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator.CalculateLayout(relativePosition.Angle, relativePosition.ConnectorLength, annotation.Angle, labelMode, annotation.DesiredSize, point.Value, ActualPane.Viewport);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point ConvertToPoint()
		{
			if (ActualPane != null && !ActualPane.RenderSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				Rect bounds = ((IDockTarget)ActualPane).GetBounds();
				System.Windows.Point? point = CalculateAnchorPoint(bounds.X, bounds.Y);
				if (point.HasValue)
				{
					return point.Value;
				}
			}
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		internal override void CompleteDeserializing(Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.CompleteDeserializing(diagram);
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = diagram as XYDiagram2D;
				if (paneIndex >= 0 && paneIndex < xYDiagram2D.Panes.Count)
				{
					Pane = xYDiagram2D.Panes[paneIndex];
				}
			}
			ActualAxisXCoordinate.CompleteDeserializing();
			ActualAxisYCoordinate.CompleteDeserializing();
		}

		internal System.Windows.Point? CalculateAnchorPoint(double offsetX, double offsetY)
		{
			if (IsValid)
			{
				Axis2D actualAxis = ActualAxisXCoordinate.ActualAxis;
				Axis2D actualAxis2 = ActualAxisYCoordinate.ActualAxis;
				object value = DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(ActualAxisXCoordinate.ActualAxisValue, actualAxis.ScaleMap, needThrowException: false);
				object value2 = DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(ActualAxisYCoordinate.ActualAxisValue, actualAxis2.ScaleMap, needThrowException: false);
				double valueInternal = actualAxis.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(value);
				double valueInternal2 = actualAxis2.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(value2);
				double num = actualAxis.CalcAxisValue(ActualPane, valueInternal);
				double num2 = actualAxis2.CalcAxisValue(ActualPane, valueInternal2);
				if (ActualPane.Rotated)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Point(num2 + offsetY, ActualPane.Viewport.Height - num + offsetX);
				}
				return new System.Windows.Point(num + offsetX, ActualPane.Viewport.Height - num2 + offsetY);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesPointAnchorPoint : AnnotationAnchorPoint
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesPointProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesPoint", typeof(SeriesPoint), typeof(SeriesPointAnchorPoint), new PropertyMetadata(ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		private int seriesIndex = -1;

		private int pointIndex = -1;

		internal override bool IsValid => SeriesPoint != null;

		[Description("Specifies the series point to which the annotation is anchored.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[DXDesignerSerializableProperty]
		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesPoint)GetValue(SeriesPointProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SeriesPointProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int SeriesIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (SeriesPoint != null && SeriesPoint.Series != null && SeriesPoint.Series.Diagram != null)
				{
					return SeriesPoint.Series.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(SeriesPoint.Series);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			set
			{
				seriesIndex = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int PointIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (SeriesPoint != null && SeriesPoint.Series != null)
				{
					return SeriesPoint.Series.Points.IndexOf(SeriesPoint);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			set
			{
				pointIndex = value;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CalculateContentOffset(System.Windows.Size desiredSize, double connectorAngle, double connectorLength)
		{
			double num = desiredSize.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = desiredSize.Height / 2.0;
			double num3 = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(connectorAngle);
			double num4 = Math.Sin(num3);
			double num5 = Math.Cos(num3);
			double x = num5 * connectorLength - num;
			double y = (0.0 - num4) * connectorLength - num2;
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new SeriesPointAnchorPoint();
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationLayout CalculateAnnotationLayout(Annotation annotation, double connectorAngle, double connectorLength)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint;
			if (seriesPoint != null)
			{
				Series series = seriesPoint.Series;
				if (series != null && series.Diagram != null && series.Diagram.Container != null)
				{
					List<SeriesPointItem> andFillPointItems = series.Item.GetAndFillPointItems(seriesPoint);
					if (andFillPointItems != null && andFillPointItems.Count > 0 && andFillPointItems[0].RefinedPoint != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Point anchorPoint = series.CalculateAnnotationPoint(seriesPoint);
						Diagram diagram = series.Diagram;
						Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)diagram, (UIElement)annotation.Chart);
						if (series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
						{
							Pane pane = (Pane)xYSeries2D.ActualPane;
							Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pane, (UIElement)annotation.Chart);
							anchorPoint = new System.Windows.Point(anchorPoint.X - relativeElementRect2.X - pane.Viewport.Left, anchorPoint.Y - relativeElementRect2.Y - pane.Viewport.Top);
							bool labelMode = annotation.ActualLabelMode && !((XYDiagram2D)diagram).IsNavigationEnabled;
							XYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator xYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator = new XYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator(pane, new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), diagram.AnnotationsPanel.RenderSize));
							return xYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator.CalculateLayout(connectorAngle, connectorLength, annotation.Angle, labelMode, annotation.DesiredSize, anchorPoint, pane.Viewport);
						}
						if (series is CircularSeriesBase2D)
						{
							anchorPoint = new System.Windows.Point(anchorPoint.X - relativeElementRect.X - diagram.ActualViewport.X, anchorPoint.Y - relativeElementRect.Y - diagram.ActualViewport.Y);
							CircularDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator circularDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator = new CircularDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), diagram.AnnotationsPanel.RenderSize));
							return circularDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator.CalculateLayout(connectorAngle, connectorLength, annotation.Angle, annotation.ActualLabelMode, annotation.DesiredSize, anchorPoint, diagram.ActualViewport);
						}
						System.Windows.Point point = CalculateContentOffset(annotation.DesiredSize, connectorAngle, connectorLength);
						double num = point.X - relativeElementRect.Left;
						double num2 = point.Y - relativeElementRect.Top;
						System.Windows.Point location = new System.Windows.Point(anchorPoint.X + num, anchorPoint.Y + num2);
						return new AnnotationLayout(location, default(Thickness), visible: true);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point ConvertToPoint()
		{
			if (SeriesPoint != null)
			{
				Series series = SeriesPoint.Series;
				if (series != null)
				{
					List<SeriesPointItem> andFillPointItems = series.Item.GetAndFillPointItems(SeriesPoint);
					if (andFillPointItems != null && andFillPointItems.Count > 0 && andFillPointItems[0].RefinedPoint != null)
					{
						return series.CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		internal override void CompleteDeserializing(Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.CompleteDeserializing(diagram);
			if (diagram != null && seriesIndex >= 0 && pointIndex >= 0 && diagram.Series.Count > seriesIndex && diagram.Series[seriesIndex].Points.Count > pointIndex)
			{
				SeriesPoint = diagram.Series[seriesIndex].Points[pointIndex];
			}
		}
	}

		private bool CanInteract
		{
			get
			{
				if ((!LabelMode || !(ActualShapePosition is RelativePosition) || (!(ActualAnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint) && !(ActualAnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint))) && Chart != null)
				{
					return !Chart.IsInDesigner;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal ChartControl Chart => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as ChartControl;

		internal bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualAnchorPoint.IsValid)
				{
					return Visible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool InteractivityEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (CanInteract)
				{
					if (!RuntimeMoving && !RuntimeAnchoring && !RuntimeRotation)
					{
						return RuntimeResizing;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool MovingEnable
		{
			get
			{
				if (CanInteract)
				{
					return RuntimeMoving;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ActualLabelMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelMode && ActualAnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint)
				{
					return ActualShapePosition is RelativePosition;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

						combinedGeometry.Geometry2.Transform = TailTransform;
					}
					return AnnotationPath.Data.Bounds;
				}
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
		}

		private static void MarginChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Annotation annotation && annotation.ActualShapePosition is FreePosition)
			{
				annotation.Chart.UpdateAnnotationsAndRaiseChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void AnnotationOptionsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Annotation annotation)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, e.NewValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, annotation);
				if (annotation.Chart != null)
				{
					annotation.Chart.UpdateAnnotationsAndRaiseChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AnchorPointChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Annotation annotation && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint = e.OldValue as PaneAnchorPoint;
				PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint2 = e.NewValue as PaneAnchorPoint;
				if (paneAnchorPoint != null)
				{
					paneAnchorPoint.Chart = null;
				}
				if (paneAnchorPoint2 != null)
				{
					paneAnchorPoint2.Chart = annotation.Chart;
				}
				AnnotationOptionsChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void ShapePositionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Annotation annotation && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				FreePosition freePosition = e.OldValue as FreePosition;
				FreePosition freePosition2 = e.NewValue as FreePosition;
				if (freePosition != null)
				{
					freePosition.Chart = null;
				}
				if (freePosition2 != null)
				{
					freePosition2.Chart = annotation.Chart;
				}
				AnnotationOptionsChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateAnnotationLayout(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Annotation { Chart: not null } annotation)
			{
				if (annotation.LabelMode)
				{
					annotation.Chart.UpdateAnnotationsAndRaiseChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					annotation.Chart.InvalidateAnnotationsPanels();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateAnnotationInteractivity(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Annotation annotation)
			{
				annotation.UpdateNavigationElements();
			}
		}

		public Annotation()
		{
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Annotation>(this);
			DXSerializer.AddCustomGetSerializablePropertiesHandler((DependencyObject)this, new CustomGetSerializablePropertiesEventHandler(CustomPropertiesSerializationUtils.SerializableControlProperties));
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
			InitDefaultElements();
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Chart != null)
			{
				if (AnchorPoint == null && sender == defaultAnchorPoint)
				{
					AnchorPoint = defaultAnchorPoint;
				}
				if (ShapePosition == null && sender == defaultShapePosition)
				{
					ShapePosition = defaultShapePosition;
				}
				if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs e2 && (e2.PropertyName == "X" || e2.PropertyName == "Y"))
				{
					Chart.InvalidateAnnotationsPanels();
				}
				else
				{
					Chart.UpdateAnnotationsAndRaiseChanged();
				}
			}
			return managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager);
		}

		void IScrollBarAnnotation.Render(DrawingContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.Width != 0.0 || bounds.Height != 0.0)
			{
				if (bounds.Width == 0.0)
				{
					bounds.Width = 4.0;
				}
				if (bounds.Height == 0.0)
				{
					bounds.Height = 4.0;
				}
				context.DrawRectangle(brush, null, bounds);
			}
		}

			return false;
		}

		{
			return false;
		}

		private void InitDefaultElements()
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, defaultAnchorPoint, this);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, defaultShapePosition, this);
		}

		private void InitTransforms()
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(shapeScaleTransform);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(shapeRotateTransform);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(shapeTranslateTransform);
			ShapeTransform = transformGroup;
			TransformGroup transformGroup2 = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup2.Children.Add(tailTranslateTransform);
			transformGroup2.Children.Add(tailScaleTransform);
			transformGroup2.Children.Add(tailRotateTransform);
			TailTransform = transformGroup2;
		}

		private void InitOriginalBounds()
		{
			if (base.Template.FindName("PART_ShapeGeometry", this) is Geometry geometry)
			{
				originalShapeBounds = geometry.Bounds;
			}
			if (base.Template.FindName("PART_TailGeometry", this) is Geometry geometry2)
			{
				originalTailBounds = geometry2.Bounds;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTailTransform(TailTransformInfo tailTransformInfo)
		{
			double centerX = tailTransformInfo.CenterX;
			double centerY = tailTransformInfo.CenterY;
			tailTranslateTransform.X = centerX;
			tailTranslateTransform.Y = centerY;
			tailScaleTransform.ScaleX = tailTransformInfo.ScaleX;
			tailScaleTransform.CenterX = centerX;
			tailScaleTransform.CenterY = centerY;
			tailRotateTransform.Angle = tailTransformInfo.Angle;
			tailRotateTransform.CenterX = centerX;
			tailRotateTransform.CenterY = centerY;
			AnchorThumbX = centerX;
			AnchorThumbY = centerY;
		}

		private void UpdateShapeTransform()
		{
			double width = base.DesiredSize.Width;
			double height = base.DesiredSize.Height;
			double num = width / originalShapeBounds.Width;
			double num2 = height / originalShapeBounds.Height;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				num3 = Math.Round(originalShapeBounds.Width * num);
			}
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num4 = Math.Round(originalShapeBounds.Height * num2);
			}
			shapeTranslateTransform.X = -0.5;
			shapeTranslateTransform.Y = -0.5;
			shapeScaleTransform.ScaleX = num3 / originalShapeBounds.Width;
			shapeScaleTransform.ScaleY = num4 / originalShapeBounds.Height;
			shapeRotateTransform.Angle = Angle;
			shapeRotateTransform.CenterX = width / 2.0;
			shapeRotateTransform.CenterY = height / 2.0;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseLeftButtonDown();
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.ChangeOwner(oldOwner, newOwner);
			if (AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint)
			{
				paneAnchorPoint.Chart = Chart;
			}
			if (ActualShapePosition is FreePosition freePosition)
			{
				freePosition.Chart = Chart;
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateLayout()
		{
			layout = ActualShapePosition.CalculateAnnotationLayout(this);
			TailTransformInfo tailTransformInfo = ActualShapePosition.CalcTailTransformInfo(layout, base.DesiredSize, ActualAnchorPoint.ConvertToPoint(), originalTailBounds.Width);
			UpdateTailTransform(tailTransformInfo);
			UpdateShapeTransform();
		}

		internal void UpdateNavigationElements()
		{
			if (InteractivityEnabled)
			{
				MoveThumbVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
				if (NavigationElementsVisible)
				{
					if (RuntimeResizing)
					{
						ResizeThumbVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
					else
					{
						ResizeThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					if (RuntimeRotation)
					{
						RotateThumbVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
					else
					{
						RotateThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
					if (RuntimeAnchoring && !(ActualAnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint))
					{
						AnchorThumbVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
					else
					{
						AnchorThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ResizeThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					RotateThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					AnchorThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MoveThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				ResizeThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				RotateThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				AnchorThumbVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessDrag(double dX, double dY)
		{
			if (!RuntimeMoving)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ActualShapePosition is FreePosition)
			{
				FreePosition freePosition = (FreePosition)ActualShapePosition;
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				if (freePosition.HorizontalAlignment != AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Left)
				{
					num = Layout.Location.X;
					freePosition.HorizontalAlignment = AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Left;
				}
				if (freePosition.VerticalAlignment != AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Top)
				{
					num2 = Layout.Location.Y;
					freePosition.VerticalAlignment = AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Top;
				}
				Margin = new Thickness(Margin.Left + num + dX, Margin.Top + num2 + dY, Margin.Right, Margin.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				RelativePosition relativePosition = ActualShapePosition as RelativePosition;
				double num3 = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(relativePosition.Angle);
				double num4 = relativePosition.ConnectorLength * Math.Cos(num3);
				double num5 = relativePosition.ConnectorLength * Math.Sin(num3);
				double num6 = num4 + dX;
				double num7 = num5 - dY;
				double connectorLength = Math.Sqrt(num6 * num6 + num7 * num7);
				double angle = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(Math.Atan2(num7, num6));
				relativePosition.ConnectorLength = connectorLength;
				relativePosition.Angle = angle;
			}
		}

		internal void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			if (Chart != null)
			{
				ActualAnchorPoint.CompleteDeserializing(Chart.Diagram);
			}
		}

		internal BitmapCursor GetCursor()
		{
			if (HoveredThumb != null)
			{
				return HoveredThumb.GetCursor();
			}
			if (MovingEnable)
			{
				return AnnotationCursors.MoveCursor;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ScrollBarAnnotationLayout CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(Axis2D axis, bool showPaneAnnotations, bool showPointAnnotations)
		{
			object obj = null;
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = null;
			PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint = ActualAnchorPoint as PaneAnchorPoint;
			if (showPaneAnnotations && paneAnchorPoint != null)
			{
				if (axis.IsValuesAxis && paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.ActualAxis == axis)
				{
					obj = DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.ActualAxisValue, axis.ScaleMap, needThrowException: false);
				}
				if (!axis.IsValuesAxis && paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.ActualAxis == axis)
				{
					obj = DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.ActualAxisValue, axis.ScaleMap, needThrowException: false);
				}
				if (paneAnchorPoint.ActualPane != null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D = paneAnchorPoint.ActualPane.Diagram;
				}
			}
			else if (showPointAnnotations && ActualAnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint { SeriesPoint: { Series: not null } seriesPoint } && seriesPoint.Series.GetActualVisible())
			{
				xYDiagram2D = seriesPoint.Series.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
				obj = ((axis is AxisX2D) ? DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(seriesPoint.Argument, axis.ScaleMap, needThrowException: false) : (axis.ScaleMap.ScaleType switch
				{
					ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime => seriesPoint.DateTimeValue, 
					ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan => seriesPoint.TimeSpanValue, 
					_ => seriesPoint.Value, 
				}));
			}
			if (obj != null && xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				double num = axis.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(obj);
				return xYDiagram2D.CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(axis, this, num, num);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeftButtonDown()
		{
			ChartControl chart = Chart;
			if (chart != null && RuntimeDeletion)
			{
				chart.ReadyForDeletionAnnotation = this;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			InitOriginalBounds();
			InitTransforms();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			annotationPath = GetTemplateChild("PART_Path") as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
		}
