	public class AnnotationCollection : ChartElementCollection<Annotation>
	{
		private double increment;

		private void SetAnnotationDefaultPosition(Annotation item)
		{
			if (item.AnchorPoint == null && item.ActualAnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint)
			{
				((ChartAnchorPoint)item.ActualAnchorPoint).SetCurrentValue(ChartAnchorPoint.XProperty, 20.0 + increment);
				((ChartAnchorPoint)item.ActualAnchorPoint).SetCurrentValue(ChartAnchorPoint.YProperty, 50.0 + increment);
			}
			if (item.ShapePosition == null && item.ActualShapePosition is FreePosition && item.ActualAnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint)
			{
				ChartAnchorPoint chartAnchorPoint = (ChartAnchorPoint)item.ActualAnchorPoint;
				item.SetCurrentValue(Annotation.MarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0 + chartAnchorPoint.X - 20.0, 0.0 + chartAnchorPoint.Y - 50.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			}
			increment = ((increment < 200.0) ? (increment + 10.0) : 0.0);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Annotation newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					SetAnnotationDefaultPosition(newItem);
				}
			}
			if (base.Owner is ChartControl chartControl)
			{
				chartControl.UpdateAnnotationsAndRaiseChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public class AnnotationLayoutPanel : ChartItemsPanelBase
	{
		private IEnumerable<Annotation> Annotations
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in Children)
				{
					if (child is Annotation)
					{
						yield return child as Annotation;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in Annotations)
			{
				annotation.Measure(availableSize);
				annotation.CalculateLayout();
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in Annotations)
			{
				if (annotation.Layout != null && annotation.Layout.Visible)
				{
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = annotation.DesiredSize;
					annotation.Arrange(new Rect(annotation.Layout.Location, desiredSize));
				}
				else
				{
					annotation.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}
	}
	public abstract class TransformToDoubleConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		protected abstract double GetScale(ScaleTransform transform);

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			double.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out result);
			if (value is TransformGroup transformGroup && transformGroup.Children.Count > 0 && transformGroup.Children[0] is ScaleTransform transform)
			{
				return result / GetScale(transform);
			}
			return result;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class TransformXToDoubleConverter : TransformToDoubleConverter
	{
		protected override double GetScale(ScaleTransform transform)
		{
			return transform.ScaleX;
		}
	}
	public class TransformYToDoubleConverter : TransformToDoubleConverter
	{
		protected override double GetScale(ScaleTransform transform)
		{
			return transform.ScaleY;
		}
	}
	public class AnnotationAnchorThumb : AnnotationThumb
	{
		private System.Windows.Point point;

		public AnnotationAnchorThumb()
		{
			base.DragDelta += OnDragDelta;
		}

		private void OnDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Annotation.ActualAnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint chartAnchorPoint)
			{
				chartAnchorPoint.X += e.HorizontalChange;
				chartAnchorPoint.Y += e.VerticalChange;
			}
			else if (base.Annotation.ActualAnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint { ActualPane: { LastMappingBounds: not null } actualPane } paneAnchorPoint)
			{
				Axis2D actualAxis = paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.ActualAxis;
				Axis2D actualAxis2 = paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.ActualAxis;
				double valueInternal = actualAxis.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.ActualAxisValue, actualAxis.ScaleMap));
				double valueInternal2 = actualAxis2.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.ActualAxisValue, actualAxis2.ScaleMap));
				double num = actualAxis.CalcAxisValue(actualPane, valueInternal);
				double num2 = actualAxis2.CalcAxisValue(actualPane, valueInternal2);
				double coordinate = num + e.HorizontalChange;
				double coordinate2 = num2 - e.VerticalChange;
				valueInternal = actualAxis.ScaleMap.Transformation.TransformBackward(actualAxis.CalcInternalValue(actualPane, coordinate));
				valueInternal2 = actualAxis2.ScaleMap.Transformation.TransformBackward(actualAxis2.CalcInternalValue(actualPane, coordinate2));
				paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = actualAxis.ScaleMap.InternalToNative(valueInternal);
				paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = actualAxis2.ScaleMap.InternalToNative(valueInternal2);
				base.Annotation.Chart.NavigationController.UpdateAnnotationDraggingCursor(point);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			point = e.GetPosition(base.Annotation.Chart);
		}
	}
	public class AnnotationRotateThumb : AnnotationThumb
	{
		public AnnotationRotateThumb()
		{
			base.DragDelta += OnDragDelta;
		}

		private void OnDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Annotation.Angle += CalculateRotationAngle();
		}

		private double CalculateRotationAngle()
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(base.Annotation.RenderSize.Width / 2.0, base.Annotation.RenderSize.Height / 2.0);
			System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(base.Annotation);
			double num = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(Math.Atan2(position.X - point.X, point.Y - position.Y));
			return num - base.Annotation.Angle;
		}

		internal override BitmapCursor GetCursor()
		{
			return AnnotationCursors.HoverRotationCursor;
		}
	}
	public enum AnnotationResizeDirection
	{
		LeftTop,
		CenterTop,
		RightTop,
		RightCenter,
		RightBottom,
		CenterBottom,
		LeftBottom,
		LeftCenter
	}
	public class AnnotationResizeThumb : AnnotationThumb
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnnotationAngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AnnotationAngle", typeof(double), typeof(AnnotationResizeThumb), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, AnnotationAnglePropertyChanged));

		private const double angleSector = 45.0;

		private AnnotationResizeDirection direction;

		private BitmapCursor currentCursor;

		[NonCategorized]
		public double AnnotationAngle
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(AnnotationAngleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnnotationAngleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[NonCategorized]
		public AnnotationResizeDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return direction;
			}
			set
			{
				direction = value;
				UpdateCursor();
			}
		}

		private static void AnnotationAnglePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AnnotationResizeThumb annotationResizeThumb)
			{
				annotationResizeThumb.UpdateCursor();
			}
		}

		public AnnotationResizeThumb()
		{
			base.DragDelta += OnDragDelta;
		}

		private void OnDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Annotation == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AdjustSize();
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			switch (Direction)
			{
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.CenterTop:
				num = 0;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.RightTop:
				num = 1;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.LeftCenter:
				num2 = 0;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.RightCenter:
				num = 1;
				num2 = 0;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.LeftBottom:
				num2 = 1;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.CenterBottom:
				num = 0;
				num2 = 1;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.RightBottom:
				num = 1;
				num2 = 1;
				break;
			}
			base.Annotation.Width = Math.Max(base.Annotation.Width + (double)num * e.HorizontalChange, base.DesiredSize.Width);
			base.Annotation.Height = Math.Max(base.Annotation.Height + (double)num2 * e.VerticalChange, base.DesiredSize.Height);
			if (base.Annotation.ActualShapePosition is FreePosition)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(base.Annotation);
				double num3 = base.Annotation.ActualWidth / 2.0;
				double num4 = base.Annotation.ActualHeight / 2.0;
				double num5 = 0.0;
				double num6 = 0.0;
				double num7 = 0.0;
				double num8 = 0.0;
				FreePosition freePosition = (FreePosition)base.Annotation.ActualShapePosition;
				if (freePosition.HorizontalAlignment != AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Left)
				{
					num5 = base.Annotation.Layout.Location.X;
					freePosition.HorizontalAlignment = AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Left;
				}
				if (freePosition.VerticalAlignment != AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Top)
				{
					num6 = base.Annotation.Layout.Location.Y;
					freePosition.VerticalAlignment = AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Top;
				}
				double num9 = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(base.Annotation.Angle);
				double num10 = (double)Math.Abs(num) * e.HorizontalChange * Math.Cos(num9) - (double)Math.Abs(num2) * e.VerticalChange * Math.Sin(num9);
				double num11 = (double)Math.Abs(num2) * e.VerticalChange * Math.Cos(num9) + (double)Math.Abs(num) * e.HorizontalChange * Math.Sin(num9);
				if (position.X < num3)
				{
					num5 += ((base.Annotation.Width == base.DesiredSize.Width) ? 0.0 : num10);
				}
				if (position.Y < num4)
				{
					num6 += ((base.Annotation.Height == base.DesiredSize.Height) ? 0.0 : num11);
				}
				base.Annotation.Margin = new Thickness(base.Annotation.Margin.Left + num5, base.Annotation.Margin.Top + num6, base.Annotation.Margin.Right + num7, base.Annotation.Margin.Bottom + num8);
				base.Annotation.CalculateLayout();
			}
		}

		private void AdjustSize()
		{
			if (base.Annotation.Width.Equals(double.NaN))
			{
				base.Annotation.Width = base.Annotation.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			if (base.Annotation.Height.Equals(double.NaN))
			{
				base.Annotation.Height = base.Annotation.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (base.Annotation.Parent is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				base.Annotation.MaxHeight = frameworkElement.ActualHeight;
				base.Annotation.MaxWidth = frameworkElement.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCursor()
		{
			double num = Math.Floor((AnnotationAngle % 360.0 + 22.5) / 45.0);
			int num2 = Enum.GetNames(typeof(AnnotationResizeDirection)).Length;
			switch ((AnnotationResizeDirection)(int)(((double)Direction + num + (double)num2) % (double)num2))
			{
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.LeftTop:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeNWSECursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.CenterTop:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeNSCursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.RightTop:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeNESWCursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.LeftCenter:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeWECursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.RightCenter:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeWECursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.LeftBottom:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeNESWCursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.CenterBottom:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeNSCursor;
				break;
			case AnnotationResizeDirection.RightBottom:
				currentCursor = AnnotationCursors.SizeNWSECursor;
				break;
			}
		}

		internal override BitmapCursor GetCursor()
		{
			return currentCursor;
		}
	}

	public class FreePosition : AnnotationShapePosition
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DockTarget", typeof(IDockTarget), typeof(FreePosition), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HorizontalAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalAlignment", typeof(AnnotationHorizontalAlignment), typeof(FreePosition), new PropertyMetadata(AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Left, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VerticalAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalAlignment", typeof(AnnotationVerticalAlignment), typeof(FreePosition), new PropertyMetadata(AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Top, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		private WeakReference chart = new WeakReference(null);

		[Description("Specifies the element (chart or pane) to which the annotation shape is docked.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		public IDockTarget DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDockTarget)GetValue(DockTargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockTargetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets how the annotation will be located horizontally.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public AnnotationHorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (AnnotationHorizontalAlignment)GetValue(HorizontalAlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HorizontalAlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets how the annotation will be located vertically.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public AnnotationVerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (AnnotationVerticalAlignment)GetValue(VerticalAlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(VerticalAlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal ChartControl Chart
		{
			get
			{
				return chart.Target as ChartControl;
			}
			set
			{
				chart = new WeakReference(value);
			}
		}

		internal IDockTarget ActualDockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				if (DockTarget == null)
				{
					return Chart;
				}
				return DockTarget;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new FreePosition();
		}

		protected internal override TailTransformInfo CalcTailTransformInfo(AnnotationLayout annotationLayout, System.Windows.Size desiredSize, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, double tailBoundsWidth)
		{
			if (annotationLayout == null)
			{
				return default(TailTransformInfo);
			}
			double num = desiredSize.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = desiredSize.Height / 2.0;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(annotationLayout.Location.X + num, annotationLayout.Location.Y + num2);
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(point.X - anchorPoint.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point.Y - anchorPoint.Y, 2.0));
			double num4 = Math.Atan2(anchorPoint.Y - point.Y, point.X - anchorPoint.X);
			double centerX = num - Math.Cos(num4) * num3;
			double centerY = num2 + Math.Sin(num4) * num3;
			return new TailTransformInfo(centerX, centerY, num3 / tailBoundsWidth, 0.0 - MathUtils.Radian2Degree(num4));
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationLayout CalculateAnnotationLayout(Annotation annotation)
		{
			Rect rect = ((ActualDockTarget != null) ? ActualDockTarget.GetBounds() : Rect.Empty);
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Thickness margin = annotation.Margin;
			return new AnnotationLayout(new System.Windows.Point(HorizontalAlignment switch
			{
				AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Center => rect.X + rect.Width / 2.0 - annotation.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0 + (margin.Left - margin.Right) / 2.0, 
				AnnotationHorizontalAlignment.Right => rect.X + rect.Width - annotation.DesiredSize.Width - margin.Right, 
				_ => rect.X + margin.Left, 
			}, VerticalAlignment switch
			{
				AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Center => rect.Y + rect.Height / 2.0 - annotation.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0 + (margin.Top - margin.Bottom) / 2.0, 
				AnnotationVerticalAlignment.Bottom => rect.Y + rect.Height - annotation.DesiredSize.Height - margin.Bottom, 
				_ => rect.Y + margin.Top, 
			}), default(Thickness), visible: true);
		}
	}
	public class RelativePosition : AnnotationShapePosition
	{
		private const double DefaultAngle = 45.0;

		private const double DefaultConnectorLength = 100.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AngleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Angle", typeof(double), typeof(RelativePosition), new PropertyMetadata(45.0, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ConnectorLengthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ConnectorLength", typeof(double), typeof(RelativePosition), new PropertyMetadata(100.0, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Specifies the angle by which an annotation is rotated around its anchor point.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(AngleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AngleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the length of the line connecting the annotation with its anchor point.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double ConnectorLength
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ConnectorLengthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ConnectorLengthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new RelativePosition();
		}

		protected internal override AnnotationLayout CalculateAnnotationLayout(Annotation annotation)
		{
			return annotation.ActualAnchorPoint.CalculateAnnotationLayout(annotation, Angle, ConnectorLength);
		}

		protected internal override TailTransformInfo CalcTailTransformInfo(AnnotationLayout annotationLayout, System.Windows.Size desiredSize, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, double tailBoundsWidth)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(0.0 - Angle);
			double centerX = desiredSize.Width / 2.0 - Math.Cos(num) * ConnectorLength;
			double centerY = desiredSize.Height / 2.0 - Math.Sin(num) * ConnectorLength;
			return new TailTransformInfo(centerX, centerY, ConnectorLength / tailBoundsWidth, 0.0 - Angle);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AnnotationLabelModeCalculator
	{
		protected struct AnnotationMeasurements
		{
			public double HalfDesiredWidth { get; }

			public double HalfDesiredHeight { get; }

			public double ActualWidth { get; }

			public double ActualHeight { get; }

			public double ContentHalfWidth { get; }

			public double ContentHalfHeight { get; }

			public AnnotationMeasurements(double halfDesiredWidth, double halfDesiredHeight, double actualWidth, double actualHeight, double contentHalfWidth, double contentHalfHeight)
			{
				this = default(AnnotationMeasurements);
				HalfDesiredWidth = halfDesiredWidth;
				HalfDesiredHeight = halfDesiredHeight;
				ActualWidth = actualWidth;
				ActualHeight = actualHeight;
				ContentHalfWidth = contentHalfWidth;
				ContentHalfHeight = contentHalfHeight;
			}
		}

		private AnnotationMeasurements CalcAnnotationMeasurements(double halfDesiredWidth, double halfDesiredHeight, double annotationAngle, double connectorLength, double sinConnectorAngle, double cosConnectorAngle)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(annotationAngle);
			double value = Math.Sin(num);
			double value2 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num2 = halfDesiredWidth * Math.Abs(value2) + halfDesiredWidth * Math.Abs(value);
			double num3 = halfDesiredHeight * Math.Abs(value) + halfDesiredHeight * Math.Abs(value2);
			double actualHeight = Math.Abs(sinConnectorAngle * connectorLength) + num3;
			double actualWidth = Math.Abs(cosConnectorAngle * connectorLength) + num2;
			return new AnnotationMeasurements(halfDesiredWidth, halfDesiredHeight, actualWidth, actualHeight, num2, num3);
		}

		protected abstract Thickness CalculateLabelModeCorrection(AnnotationMeasurements annotationMeasurements, System.Windows.Point location, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, out double x, out double y);

		public AnnotationLayout CalculateLayout(double connectorAngle, double connectorLength, double annotationAngle, bool labelMode, System.Windows.Size desiredSize, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, Rect viewport)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(connectorAngle);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(num);
			double num3 = Math.Cos(num);
			double num4 = desiredSize.Width / 2.0;
			double num5 = desiredSize.Height / 2.0;
			double num6 = num3 * connectorLength - num4;
			double num7 = (0.0 - num2) * connectorLength - num5;
			System.Windows.Point location = new System.Windows.Point(viewport.X + anchorPoint.X + num6, viewport.Y + anchorPoint.Y + num7);
			if (labelMode)
			{
				AnnotationMeasurements annotationMeasurements = CalcAnnotationMeasurements(num4, num5, annotationAngle, connectorLength, num2, num3);
				double x;
				double y;
				Thickness labelModeCorrection = CalculateLabelModeCorrection(annotationMeasurements, location, anchorPoint, out x, out y);
				bool visible = viewport.Width - labelModeCorrection.Left - labelModeCorrection.Right > 0.0 && viewport.Height - labelModeCorrection.Top - labelModeCorrection.Bottom > 0.0;
				return new AnnotationLayout(new System.Windows.Point(Math.Round(x), Math.Round(y)), labelModeCorrection, visible);
			}
			return new AnnotationLayout(new System.Windows.Point(Math.Round(location.X), Math.Round(location.Y)), default(Thickness), visible: true);
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator : AnnotationLabelModeCalculator
	{
		private Pane pane;

		private Rect panelMappingBounds;

		public XYDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator(Pane pane, Rect panelMappingBounds)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.panelMappingBounds = panelMappingBounds;
		}

		protected override Thickness CalculateLabelModeCorrection(AnnotationMeasurements annotationMeasurements, System.Windows.Point location, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, out double x, out double y)
		{
			x = location.X;
			y = location.Y;
			Rect viewport = pane.Viewport;
			double num = (pane.Rotated ? anchorPoint.Y : anchorPoint.X);
			double num2 = (pane.Rotated ? (viewport.Height - anchorPoint.X) : (viewport.Height - anchorPoint.Y));
			double top = 0.0;
			if (y - (annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfHeight - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredHeight) < 0.0)
			{
				top = viewport.Height - (viewport.Height - (annotationMeasurements.ActualHeight - viewport.Top)) * viewport.Height / num2;
				y = annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfHeight - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredHeight;
			}
			double left = 0.0;
			if (x - (annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfWidth - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredWidth) < 0.0)
			{
				left = viewport.Width - ((annotationMeasurements.ActualWidth - viewport.X) * viewport.Width - viewport.Width * viewport.Width) / (num - viewport.Width);
				x = annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfWidth - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredWidth;
			}
			double right = 0.0;
			double num3 = annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredWidth + annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfWidth;
			if (x + num3 > panelMappingBounds.Width)
			{
				right = panelMappingBounds.Width - (panelMappingBounds.Width - annotationMeasurements.ActualWidth) * panelMappingBounds.Width / (num + viewport.X);
				x = panelMappingBounds.Width - num3;
			}
			double bottom = 0.0;
			double num4 = annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredHeight + annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfHeight;
			if (y + num4 > panelMappingBounds.Height)
			{
				bottom = viewport.Height - ((annotationMeasurements.ActualHeight - (panelMappingBounds.Height - viewport.Height - viewport.Top)) * viewport.Height - viewport.Height * viewport.Height) / (num2 - viewport.Height);
				y = panelMappingBounds.Height - num4;
			}
			return new Thickness(left, top, right, bottom);
		}
	}
	public class CircularDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator : AnnotationLabelModeCalculator
	{
		private Rect panelMappingBounds;

		public CircularDiagramAnnotationLabelModeCalculator(Rect panelMappingBounds)
		{
			this.panelMappingBounds = panelMappingBounds;
		}

		protected override Thickness CalculateLabelModeCorrection(AnnotationMeasurements annotationMeasurements, System.Windows.Point location, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, out double x, out double y)
		{
			x = location.X;
			y = location.Y;
			double left = 0.0;
			double top = 0.0;
			double right = 0.0;
			double bottom = 0.0;
			if (y - (annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfHeight - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredHeight) < 0.0)
			{
				top = 0.0 - y;
				y = annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfHeight - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredHeight;
			}
			if (x - (annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfWidth - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredWidth) < 0.0)
			{
				left = 0.0 - x;
				x = annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfWidth - annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredWidth;
			}
			double num = annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredWidth + annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfWidth;
			if (x + num > panelMappingBounds.Width)
			{
				right = x + num - panelMappingBounds.Width;
				x = panelMappingBounds.Width - num;
			}
			double num2 = annotationMeasurements.HalfDesiredHeight + annotationMeasurements.ContentHalfHeight;
			if (y + num2 > panelMappingBounds.Height)
			{
				bottom = y + num2 - panelMappingBounds.Height;
				y = panelMappingBounds.Height - num2;
			}
			return new Thickness(left, top, right, bottom);
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TextBlock", Type = typeof(TextBlock))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TextBox", Type = typeof(TextBox))]
	public class EditableTextContent : Control, IEditableContent
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Text", typeof(string), typeof(EditableTextContent), new PropertyMetadata("Text", OnTextValueChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EditModeEnabledProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EditModeEnabled", typeof(bool), typeof(EditableTextContent), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MultilineProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Multiline", typeof(bool), typeof(EditableTextContent), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		private string initialText;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		[Description("Gets or sets text used in editable annotations and constant lines.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(TextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies that the annotation text can be edited.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public bool EditModeEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(EditModeEnabledProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EditModeEnabledProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether carriage return (CRLF) characters split the label’s text into multiple lines.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public bool Multiline
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(MultilineProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MultilineProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnTextValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is EditableTextContent editableTextContent)
			{
				if (editableTextContent.initialText == null)
				{
					editableTextContent.initialText = (string)e.NewValue;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)e.NewValue))
				{
					d.SetCurrentValue(TextProperty, "      ");
				}
			}
		}

		public EditableTextContent()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<EditableTextContent>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			SetCurrentValue(EditModeEnabledProperty, true);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (initialText == null)
			{
				initialText = (string)TextProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			}
			if (!EditModeEnabled && e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(EditModeEnabledProperty, true);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(EditModeEnabledProperty, false);
				SetCurrentValue(TextProperty, initialText);
				initialText = null;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Return && (!Multiline || !Keyboard.Modifiers.HasFlag(ModifierKeys.Shift)))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(EditModeEnabledProperty, false);
				initialText = Text;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TextBoxFocusSelectionBehavior : Behavior<TextBox>
	{
		private void AssociatedObject_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				base.AssociatedObject?.SelectAll();
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.AssociatedObject?.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Visibility.Collapsed);
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.GotFocus += AssociatedObject_GotFocus;
			base.AssociatedObject.LostFocus += AssociatedObject_LostFocus;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			base.AssociatedObject.GotFocus -= AssociatedObject_GotFocus;
			base.AssociatedObject.GotFocus -= AssociatedObject_LostFocus;
		}
	}

		internal double ScrollBarThickness
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollBarLayout != null && scrollBarLayout.Visible)
				{
					double num = (axis.IsVertical ? scrollBarLayout.Bounds.Width : scrollBarLayout.Bounds.Height);
					if (num >= 1.0)
					{
						return num - 1.0;
					}

				return 0.0;

		internal AxisPosition ElementPosition
		{
			get
			{
				switch (Axis2D.ActualAlignment)
				{
				case AxisAlignment.Near:
				case AxisAlignment.Zero:
				case AxisAlignment.Center:
					if (!axis.IsVertical)
					{
						return AxisPosition.Bottom;
					}
					return AxisPosition.Left;
				case AxisAlignment.Far:
					if (!axis.IsVertical)
					{
						return AxisPosition.Top;
					}
					return AxisPosition.Right;
				default:
					ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown axis alignment.");
					goto case AxisAlignment.Near;
				}
			}
		}

				OnPropertyChanged("Visibility");

		private static bool CheckLabelItem(AxisLabelItem labelItem, AxisTextItem textItem)
		{
			if (labelItem.InternalValue != textItem.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			labelItem.Visible = textItem.Visible;
			labelItem.IsOutOfRange = !textItem.Visible;
			object content = labelItem.Content;
			string text = content as string;
			object content2 = textItem.Content;
			string text2 = content2 as string;
			if (text == null || text2 == null)
			{
				return content == content2;
			}
			return text == text2;
		}

		internal Axis2DItem(AxisBase axis, AxisTitleItem titleItem)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.titleItem = titleItem;
			selectionGeometryItem = new SelectionGeometryItem(axis.SelectionInfo);
			if (axis is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				axis2D.GetBoundsDelegate = GetBoundsDelegate;
				axis2D.DecreaseSizeDelegate = DecreaseSize;
			}
		}

		private Rect CreateAxisGeometry(double axisLength)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			ITickmarksOwner tickmarksOwner = TickmarksOwner;
			if (tickmarksOwner != null && tickmarksOwner.TickmarksCrossAxis)
			{
				num = MaxTickmarksLength;
			}
			num += ActualScrollBarThickness;
			return CreateGeometryRect(0.0, num, axisLength, Thickness);
		}

		private Rect CreateGeometryRect(double x, double y, double width, double height)
		{
			if (!axis.IsVertical)
			{
				return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
			}
			return new Rect(y, x, height, width);
		}

		private Transform CreateGeometryTransform()
		{
			if (!(Axis is ITransformable transformable))
			{
				return new MatrixTransform
				{
					Matrix = Matrix.Identity
				};
			}
			return transformable.GetGeometryTransform(this);
		}

		private List<Rect> CreateMajorTickmarksGeometry(IAxisMappingCore axisMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData)
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			if (TickmarksOwner != null)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (TickmarksOwner.TickmarksCrossAxis)
				{
					int maxTickmarksLength = MaxTickmarksLength;
					if (TickmarksOwner.TickmarksVisible)
					{
						list.AddRange(CreateMajorTickmarksGeometry(axisMapping, gridAndTextData, maxTickmarksLength - TickmarksOwner.TickmarksLength));
					}
					num = maxTickmarksLength;
				}
				num += ActualScrollBarThickness + (double)Thickness;
				if (TickmarksOwner.TickmarksVisible)
				{
					list.AddRange(CreateMajorTickmarksGeometry(axisMapping, gridAndTextData, num));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<Rect> CreateMajorTickmarksGeometry(IAxisMappingCore axisMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, double offset)
		{
			return CreateTickmarksGeometry(axisMapping, gridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleTickMarkValues, TickmarksOwner.TickmarksLength, TickmarksOwner.TickmarksThickness, offset);
		}

		private List<Rect> CreateMinorTickmarksGeometry(IAxisMappingCore axisMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData)
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			if (TickmarksOwner != null)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (TickmarksOwner.TickmarksCrossAxis)
				{
					int maxTickmarksLength = MaxTickmarksLength;
					if (TickmarksOwner.TickmarksMinorVisible)
					{
						list.AddRange(CreateMinorTickmarksGeometry(axisMapping, gridAndTextData, maxTickmarksLength - TickmarksOwner.TickmarksMinorLength));
					}
					num = maxTickmarksLength;
				}
				num += ActualScrollBarThickness + (double)Thickness;
				if (TickmarksOwner.TickmarksMinorVisible)
				{
					list.AddRange(CreateMinorTickmarksGeometry(axisMapping, gridAndTextData, num));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<Rect> CreateMinorTickmarksGeometry(IAxisMappingCore axisMapping, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, double offset)
		{
			return CreateTickmarksGeometry(axisMapping, gridAndTextData.GridData.MinorItems.VisibleTickMarkValues, TickmarksOwner.TickmarksMinorLength, TickmarksOwner.TickmarksMinorThickness, offset);
		}

		private List<Rect> CreateTickmarksGeometry(IAxisMappingCore axisMapping, List<double> values, int length, int thickness, double offset)
		{
			int num = thickness / 2;
			int num2 = num + thickness % 2;
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			double axisLength = axisMapping.AxisLength;
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				double roundedClampedAxisValue = axisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(value);
				double num3 = MathUtils.Clamp(roundedClampedAxisValue - (double)num, 0.0, axisLength);
				list.Add(CreateGeometryRect(num3, offset, MathUtils.Clamp(roundedClampedAxisValue + (double)num2, 0.0, axisLength) - num3, length));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private GRealSize2D DecreaseSize(GRealSize2D layoutSize)
		{
			List<Rect> list = CalculateSelectionGeometry();
			if (list == null || list.Count < 1)
			{
				return layoutSize;
			}
			Rect rect = list[0];
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				return new GRealSize2D(layoutSize.Width - rect.Width, layoutSize.Height);
			}
			return new GRealSize2D(layoutSize.Width, layoutSize.Height - rect.Height);
		}

		private GRealRect2D GetBoundsDelegate()
		{
			if (IsAxis2D)
			{
				if (Axis2D.ActualVisible || boundsCache.IsEmpty)
				{
					List<Rect> list = CalculateSelectionGeometry();
					if (list == null || list.Count < 1)
					{
						return GRealRect2D.Empty;
					}
					Rect rect = list[0];
					boundsCache = new GRealRect2D(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
				}
				return boundsCache;
			}
			return GRealRect2D.Empty;
		}

		private AxisLabelItem GetOrCreate(AxisLabel label, AxisTextItem textItem, bool staggered, System.Windows.Media.Brush background)
		{
			return ConstantLineCollection.GetOrCreate((AxisLabelItem item) => CheckLabelItem(item, textItem), () => new AxisLabelItem(label, textItem, staggered, background), PrevLabelItems);
		}

		private void ResetLabelBounds()
		{
			boundsCache = GRealRect2D.Empty;
			LabelRect = RectExtensions.Zero;
		}

		private bool ShouldCreateLabelItems(IEnumerable<AxisTextData> textData)
		{
			if (!axis.LabelsVisible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (labelItems == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = 0;
			List<AxisTextItem> list = new List<AxisTextItem>();
			List<AxisTextItem> list2 = new List<AxisTextItem>();
			foreach (AxisTextData textDatum in textData)
			{
				num += textDatum.Count;
				list.AddRange(textDatum.PrimaryItems);
				list2.AddRange(textDatum.StaggeredItems);
			}
			if (num != labelItems.Count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			num = list.Count;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!CheckLabelItem(labelItems[i], list[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			num = list2.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				if (!CheckLabelItem(labelItems[i], list2[j]))
				{
					return true;
				}
				i++;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal double GetNormalCoord(Rect viewport)
		{
			if (axis is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				bool isVertical = axis.IsVertical;
				AxisAlignment actualAlignment = axis2D.ActualAlignment;
				switch (actualAlignment)
				{
				case AxisAlignment.Near:
					if (!isVertical)
					{
						return viewport.Bottom;
					}
					return viewport.Left;
				case AxisAlignment.Far:
					if (!isVertical)
					{
						return viewport.Top;
					}
					return viewport.Right;
				case AxisAlignment.Center:
					if (NormalCenterCoord.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(NormalCenterCoord.Value))
					{
						if (isVertical)
						{
							return GeometricUtils.StrongRound((viewport.Left + viewport.Right) / 2.0);
						}
						return viewport.Bottom - (double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound((viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom - ScrollBarThickness) / 2.0);
					}
					break;
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				if (actualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Zero && NormalZeroCoord.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(NormalZeroCoord.Value))
				{
					num = NormalZeroCoord.Value;
				}
				if (isVertical)
				{
					return viewport.Left + num;
				}
				return viewport.Bottom - num;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal double GetNormalCoordForCenterAlignment(Rect viewport)
		{
			if (axis is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				bool isVertical = axis.IsVertical;
				if (Axis2D.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Center)
				{
					if (isVertical)
					{
						return (double)(GeometricUtils.StrongRound((viewport.Left + viewport.Right) / 2.0) - axis2D.Thickness) - ScrollBarThickness;
					}
					return GeometricUtils.StrongRound((viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom - ScrollBarThickness) / 2.0);
				}
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		internal void ResetBounds()
		{
			ResetLabelBounds();
			layout = new Axis2DElementLayout(RectExtensions.Zero, new Rect[0]);
		}

		internal void SetScrollBarLayout(Axis2DElementLayout scrollBarLayout)
		{
			this.scrollBarLayout = scrollBarLayout;
		}

		internal void UpdateGeometry(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, IntervalsGridAndTextData intervalsGridAndTextData, Rect axisBounds)
		{
			MajorTickmarksGeometry = new List<Rect>();
			MinorTickmarksGeometry = new List<Rect>();
			if (intervalsGridAndTextData == null)
			{
				AxisGeometry = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				GeometryTransform = null;
				selectionGeometryItem.Geometry = new List<Rect>();
			}
			else
			{
				IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = axis.CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, axisBounds);
				AxisGeometry = CreateAxisGeometry(axisMappingCore.AxisLength);
				foreach (GridAndTextData gridAndTextDatum in intervalsGridAndTextData.GridAndTextData)
				{
					MajorTickmarksGeometry.AddRange(CreateMajorTickmarksGeometry(axisMappingCore, gridAndTextDatum));
					MinorTickmarksGeometry.AddRange(CreateMinorTickmarksGeometry(axisMappingCore, gridAndTextDatum));
				}
				GeometryTransform = CreateGeometryTransform();
				selectionGeometryItem.Geometry = CalculateSelectionGeometry();
			}
			Visibility = ((!AxisVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		internal bool UpdateLabelItems(IEnumerable<AxisTextData> textData)
		{
			if (!ShouldCreateLabelItems(textData))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AxisLabel actualLabel = axis.ActualLabel;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush background = actualLabel.Background;
			List<AxisLabelItem> list = new List<AxisLabelItem>();
			foreach (AxisTextData textDatum in textData)
			{
				foreach (AxisTextItem primaryItem in textDatum.PrimaryItems)
				{
					list.Add(GetOrCreate(actualLabel, primaryItem, staggered: false, background));
				}
				foreach (AxisTextItem staggeredItem in textDatum.StaggeredItems)
				{
					list.Add(GetOrCreate(actualLabel, staggeredItem, staggered: true, background));
				}
			}
			labelItems = list;
			LayoutWatchdog += list.Count;
			ResetLabelBounds();
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetNormalZeroCoord(double clampedValue, double nonClampedValue)
		{
			normalZeroCoord = clampedValue;
			AxisAlignment axisAlignment = Axis2D.Alignment;
			if (axisAlignment == AxisAlignment.Zero && !double.IsNaN(clampedValue - nonClampedValue) && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(clampedValue, nonClampedValue, double.Epsilon) != 0)
			{
				axisAlignment = ((!(clampedValue > nonClampedValue)) ? AxisAlignment.Far : AxisAlignment.Near);
			}
			Axis2D.UpdateActualAlignment(axisAlignment);
		}

		public List<Rect> CalculateSelectionGeometry()
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			if (InternalLayout != null)
			{
				if (Axis is CircularAxisX2D)
				{
					double num = 1.0;
					if (LabelItems != null)
					{
						foreach (AxisLabelItem labelItem in LabelItems)
						{
							if (labelItem.Layout != null)
							{
								Rect bounds = labelItem.Layout.Bounds;
								num = Math.Max(num, MathUtils.CalcDistance(new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Top), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom)));
							}
						}
					}
					Rect item = (InternalLayout.Bounds.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : new Rect(InternalLayout.Bounds.Left - num, InternalLayout.Bounds.Top - num, InternalLayout.Bounds.Width + num * 2.0, InternalLayout.Bounds.Height + num * 2.0));
					Rect item2 = (InternalLayout.Bounds.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : new Rect(InternalLayout.Bounds.Left, InternalLayout.Bounds.Top, InternalLayout.Bounds.Width, InternalLayout.Bounds.Height));
					list.Add(item);
					list.Add(item2);
				}
				else
				{
					Rect item3 = ((InternalLabelRect != RectExtensions.Zero) ? InternalLabelRect : Rect.Empty);
					item3.Union(InternalLayout.Bounds);
					item3.Inflate(VisualSelectionHelper.SelectionRectInflate, VisualSelectionHelper.SelectionRectInflate);
					list.Add(item3);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeMajorTickmarksGeometry(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeMinorTickmarksGeometry(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Axis2DPresentation>(this);
			this.axis2DItem = axis2DItem;
		}

		{
			double totalThickness = axis2DItem.TotalThickness;
			System.Windows.Size size = (axis2DItem.Axis.IsVertical ? new System.Windows.Size(totalThickness, 0.0) : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, totalThickness));
			base.MeasureOverride(size);
			return size;
		}
	}

		private static void InvalidateRender(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisRenderControl axisRenderControl)
			{
				axisRenderControl.InvalidateVisual();
			}
		}

		private void RenderRects(List<Rect> rects, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (rects == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Rect rect in rects)
			{
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(brush, null, rect);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = Brush;
			Rect axisGeometry = AxisGeometry;
			RenderRects(axisGeometry.IsEmpty ? null : new List<Rect> { axisGeometry }, brush, drawingContext);
			RenderRects(MajorTickmarksGeometry, brush, drawingContext);
			RenderRects(MinorTickmarksGeometry, brush, drawingContext);
		}
	}

		private NumericAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator NumericAggregationIntervalsCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				if (numericAggregationIntervalsCalculator == null)
				{
					numericAggregationIntervalsCalculator = new NumericAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator();
				}
				return numericAggregationIntervalsCalculator;

		internal ScaleOptionsBase ActualScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (scaleMap is AxisDateTimeMap)
				{
					return ActualDateTimeScaleOptions;
				}
				if (scaleMap is AxisNumericalMap)
				{
					return ActualNumericScaleOptions;
				}
				if (scaleMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
				{
					return ActualQualitativeScaleOptions;
				}
				if (scaleMap is AxisTimeSpanMap)
				{
					return ActualTimeSpanScaleOptions;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal IScaleOptionsBase ActualScaleOptionsWrapper
		{
			get
			{
				if (scaleMap != null)
				{
					switch (scaleMap.ScaleType)
					{
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
						return NumericScaleOptionsWrapper;
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
						return DateTimeScaleOptionsWrapper;
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
						return TimeSpanScaleOptionsWrapper;
					case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
						return QualitativeScaleOptionsWrapper;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IAxisGridMapping IAxisData.GridMapping
		{
			get
			{
				if (scaleMap is AxisDateTimeMap)
				{
					return new AxisDateTimeGridMapping((AxisDateTimeMap)scaleMap, DateTimeScaleOptions.GridAlignment, DateTimeScaleOptions.GridOffset);
				}
				if (scaleMap is AxisTimeSpanMap)
				{
					return new AxisTimeSpanGridMapping((AxisTimeSpanMap)scaleMap, TimeSpanScaleOptions.GridAlignment, TimeSpanScaleOptions.GridOffset);
				}
				if (scaleMap is AxisNumericalMap)
				{
					return new AxisNumericGridMapping((AxisNumericalMap)scaleMap, NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignment, NumericScaleOptions.GridOffset, NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignmentStartPoint);
				}
				if (scaleMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
				{
					return new AxisQualitativeGridMapping((AxisQualitativeMap)scaleMap, QualitativeScaleOptions.GridOffset);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		int IAxisData.GridSpacingFactor
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ActualScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength.HasValue)
				{
					return GridSpacingFactor;
				}
				return ActualScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength.Value;
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateMinorCount(object value)
		{
			int num = (int)value;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return num < 100;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void NumericOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisBase axisBase)
			{
				axisBase.numericOptions = (NumericOptions)e.NewValue;
				axisBase.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as NumericOptions, e.NewValue as NumericOptions, axisBase);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void GridLinesLineStylePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisBase axisBase)
			{
				LineStyle lineStyle = e.NewValue as LineStyle;
				axisBase.SetValue(ActualGridLinesLineStylePropertyKey, (lineStyle == null) ? new LineStyle() : lineStyle);
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as LineStyle, e.NewValue as LineStyle, axisBase);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void GridLinesMinorLineStylePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisBase axisBase)
			{
				LineStyle lineStyle = e.NewValue as LineStyle;
				axisBase.SetValue(ActualGridLinesMinorLineStylePropertyKey, (lineStyle == null) ? new LineStyle() : lineStyle);
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as LineStyle, e.NewValue as LineStyle, axisBase);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void LabelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisBase axisBase)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is AxisLabel axisLabel))
				{
					axisBase.actualLabel = new AxisLabel();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, axisBase.actualLabel);
				}
				else
				{
					axisBase.actualLabel = axisLabel;
				}
				axisBase.LabelPropertyChanged();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		private static void QualitativeScaleComparerPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisBase)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, e.Property.Name));
			}
		}

		public AxisBase()
		{
			BeginInit();
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
			actualRange = new AxisRange();
			actualRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualLabel = new AxisLabel();
			actualLabel.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			scaleMap = CreateScaleMap(ScaleType.Numerical, null);
			SetValue(ActualGridLinesLineStylePropertyKey, new LineStyle());
			SetValue(ActualGridLinesMinorLineStylePropertyKey, new LineStyle());
			actualDateTimeScaleOptions = new DateTimeScaleOptionsWrapper(this, (DefaultDateTimeScaleOptions != null) ? DefaultDateTimeScaleOptions : new ManualDateTimeScaleOptions());
			actualTimeSpanScaleOptions = new TimeSpanScaleOptionsWrapper(this, (DefaultTimeSpanScaleOptions != null) ? DefaultTimeSpanScaleOptions : new ManualTimeSpanScaleOptions());
			actualNumericScaleOptions = new NumericScaleOptionsWrapper(this, DefaultNumericScaleOptions);
			actualQualitativeScaleOptions = new QualitativeScaleOptionsWrapper(this, DefaultQualitativeScaleOptions);
			EndInit();
		}

		bool IAxisData.RaiseBeforeZoom(IMinMaxValues rangeInternalCoords)
		{
			if (Diagram == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			RangeInfo newRange = new RangeInfo(rangeInternalCoords.Min, rangeInternalCoords.Max, ScaleMap.InternalToNative(rangeInternalCoords.Min), ScaleMap.InternalToNative(rangeInternalCoords.Max));
			XYDiagram2DBeforeZoomEventArgs e = new XYDiagram2DBeforeZoomEventArgs(this, newRange);
			Diagram.RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		bool IAxisData.RaiseBeforeScroll(IMinMaxValues rangeInternalCoords)
		{
			if (Diagram == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			RangeInfo newRange = new RangeInfo(rangeInternalCoords.Min, rangeInternalCoords.Max, ScaleMap.InternalToNative(rangeInternalCoords.Min), ScaleMap.InternalToNative(rangeInternalCoords.Max));
			XYDiagram2DBeforeScrollEventArgs e = new XYDiagram2DBeforeScrollEventArgs(this, newRange);
			Diagram.RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		{
			UpdateIntervals();
		}

		private void CreateVisualRangeData()
		{
			visualRangeData = new VisualRangeData(this);
			visualRange = new Range();
			visualRange.SetRangeData(visualRangeData);
			visualRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
		}

		private void CreateWholeRangeData()
		{
			wholeRangeData = new WholeRangeData(this);
			wholeRange = new Range();
			wholeRange.SetRangeData(wholeRangeData);
			wholeRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return ProcessWeakEvent(sender, e);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private AxisScaleTypeMap CreateScaleMap(ScaleType scaleType, List<string> values)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return scaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.DateTime => new AxisDateTimeMap(((IAxisData)this).DateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, 1, ((IAxisData)this).DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, ((IAxisData)this).DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules), 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => new AxisTimeSpanMap(((IAxisData)this).TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, 1), 
				ScaleType.Qualitative => new AxisQualitativeMap(values), 
				_ => new AxisNumericalMap(), 
			};
		}

		private MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase GetMeasureUnitsCalculator()
		{
			if (ScaleMap == null || ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return DateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore;
			}
			if (ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				return TimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore;
			}
			return NumericMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore;
		}

		private AxisAggregationIntervalsCalculatorBase GetAggregationIntervalsCalculator()
		{
			if (ScaleMap == null || ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				if (!ActualDateTimeScaleOptions.IsIntervalScale)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DateTimeAggregationIntervalsCalculator;
			}
			if (ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				if (!ActualTimeSpanScaleOptions.IsIntervalScale)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TimeSpanAggregationIntervalsCalculator;
			}
			if (!ActualNumericScaleOptions.IsIntervalScale)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return NumericAggregationIntervalsCalculator;
		}

		private void SetActualNumericScaleOptions(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ActualNumericScaleOptions = ((e.NewValue is NumericScaleOptionsBase) ? (e.NewValue as NumericScaleOptionsBase) : DefaultNumericScaleOptions);
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new ChartUpdate(ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache, new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "NumericScaleOptions")));
			NeedUpdateLabelItems = true;
		}

		private void SetActualDateTimeScaleOptions(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsBase = ((e.NewValue is DateTimeScaleOptionsBase) ? (e.NewValue as DateTimeScaleOptionsBase) : DefaultDateTimeScaleOptions);
			ActualDateTimeScaleOptions = ((dateTimeScaleOptionsBase != null) ? dateTimeScaleOptionsBase : new ManualDateTimeScaleOptions());
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new ChartUpdate(ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache, new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "DateTimeScaleOptions")));
			NeedUpdateLabelItems = true;
		}

		private void SetActualTimeSpanScaleOptions(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase timeSpanScaleOptionsBase = ((e.NewValue is TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase) ? (e.NewValue as TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase) : DefaultTimeSpanScaleOptions);
			ActualTimeSpanScaleOptions = ((timeSpanScaleOptionsBase != null) ? timeSpanScaleOptionsBase : new ManualTimeSpanScaleOptions());
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new ChartUpdate(ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache, new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "TimeSpanScaleOptions")));
			NeedUpdateLabelItems = true;
		}

		private void SetActualQualitativeScaleOptions(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ActualQualitativeScaleOptions = ((e.NewValue is QualitativeScaleOptions) ? (e.NewValue as QualitativeScaleOptions) : DefaultQualitativeScaleOptions);
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new ChartUpdate(ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache, new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "QualitativeScaleOptions")));
			NeedUpdateLabelItems = true;
		}

		protected void SetActualDateTimeMeasureUnit(DateTimeMeasureUnit value)
		{
			if (ActualDateTimeScaleOptions is ManualDateTimeScaleOptions manualDateTimeScaleOptions)
			{
				manualDateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit = value;
			}
			else

				actualDateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleOptions = DefaultDateTimeScaleOptions;

		protected void SetActualGridAlignment(DateTimeGridAlignment value)
		{

			else
			{
				ActualDateTimeScaleOptions = DefaultDateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void TryApplyUserRange();

		protected virtual void ScaleTypeUpdated()
		{
			if (actualRange != null)
			{
				actualRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LabelPropertyChanged()
		{
			if (numericOptions != null || DateTimeOptionsImpl != null)
			{
				actualLabel.ResetTextPattern();
			}
		}

		protected virtual GRealRect2D GetLabelBounds(Pane pane)
		{
			return GRealRect2D.Empty;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateSeriesBinding)
			{
				ResetSeriesBinding();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetActualAlwaysShowZeroLevel(ChartNonVisualElement range)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void IsHighlightedChanged()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void IsSelectedChanged()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void Deserialize()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateUserValues()
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessWeakEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is NumericOptions || sender is DateTimeOptions)
			{
				UpdateLabelTextPattern();
				ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				return true;
			}
			if (sender is LineStyle)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
				return true;
			}
			if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs e2 && sender is ScaleOptionsBase)
			{
				ScaleOptionsWrapper scaleOptionsWrapper = ((sender is DateTimeScaleOptionsBase) ? actualDateTimeScaleOptions : ((sender is TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase) ? actualTimeSpanScaleOptions : ((!(sender is NumericScaleOptionsBase)) ? ((ScaleOptionsWrapper)actualQualitativeScaleOptions) : ((ScaleOptionsWrapper)actualNumericScaleOptions))));
				AggregateFunctionNative aggregateFunction = ((IScaleOptionsBase)scaleOptionsWrapper).AggregateFunction;
				scaleOptionsWrapper.UpdateActualProperty(e2.PropertyName);
				ChartElementChange changes = ChartElementChange.None;
				if (e2.PropertyName == "AggregateFunction" || e2.PropertyName == "Count" || e2.PropertyName == "Width")
				{
					CheckUpdatingSeriesBinding(aggregateFunction, scaleOptionsWrapper, out changes);
				}
				if (e2.PropertyName == "GridAlignment" || e2.PropertyName == "GridSpacing" || e2.PropertyName == "GridOffset")
				{
					NeedUpdateLabelItems = true;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, e2.PropertyName), changes);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal abstract RenderGeometryBase CreateGridLineGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double axisValue, int thickness);

		protected internal abstract RenderGeometryBase CreateInterlaceGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double nearAxisValue, double farAxisValue);

		protected internal abstract IAxisMappingCore CreateMapping(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect bounds);

		protected internal void UpdateAutoMeasureUnit()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = XYDiagram2D;
			if (xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				double axisLength = xYDiagram2D.GetAxisLength(this);
				if (UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(axisLength))
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "AutoMeasureUnit"));
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(double axisLength)
		{
			IList<ISeries> series = GetSeries();
			MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase measureUnitsCalculator = GetMeasureUnitsCalculator();
			if (measureUnitsCalculator == null || series == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return measureUnitsCalculator.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(axisLength, series);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateIntervalsWithPropertyChange()
		{
			if (UpdateIntervals())
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "IntervalOptions"));
			}
		}

		protected internal bool UpdateIntervals()
		{
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				return GetAggregationIntervalsCalculator()?.UpdateIntervals(this, Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeriesByAxis(this)) ?? false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void UpdateLabelTextPattern()
		{
			actualLabel.ResetTextPattern();
		}

		protected internal virtual void CreateMediator()
		{
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailableLabelPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (IsValuesAxis)
			{
				return new string[1] { "V" };
			}
			return new string[1] { "A" };
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailableIntervalPlaceholders()
		{
			return AxisPatternUtils.IntervalPatterns;
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailableUnderflowValuePlaceholders()
		{
			return AxisPatternUtils.UnderflowValuePatterns;
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailableOverflowValuePlaceholders()
		{
			return AxisPatternUtils.OverflowValuePatterns;
		}

		internal bool CheckUpdatingSeriesBinding(AggregateFunctionNative functionBeforeUpdate, IScaleOptionsBase actualScaleOptions, out ChartElementChange changes)
		{
			if (functionBeforeUpdate == AggregateFunctionNative.Histogram || actualScaleOptions.AggregateFunction == AggregateFunctionNative.Histogram)
			{
				changes = ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding | ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems;
				return true;
			}
			changes = ChartElementChange.None;
			return false;
		}

		internal IList<ISeries> GetSeries()
		{
			ViewController viewController = Diagram?.ViewController;
			return (viewController ?? ((INotificationOwner)this).Controller)?.GetSeriesByAxis(this);
		}

		internal void ResetSeriesBinding()
		{
			IList<ISeries> series = GetSeries();
			if (series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in series)
			{
				item?.ResetSeriesBinding();
			}
		}

		public object GetScaleValueFromInternal(double internalValue)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
			return scaleMap.InternalToNative(internalValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisElementsRenderControlBase : ChartElementBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxesSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AxesSource", typeof(IAxesSource), typeof(AxisElementsRenderControlBase));

		private readonly Dictionary<AxisBase, List<RenderGeometryBase>> geometries = new Dictionary<AxisBase, List<RenderGeometryBase>>();

		[Browsable(false)]
		public IAxesSource AxesSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (IAxesSource)GetValue(AxesSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxesSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal Dictionary<AxisBase, List<RenderGeometryBase>> Geometries => geometries;

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<AxisBase, List<RenderGeometryBase>> geometry in geometries)
			{
				foreach (RenderGeometryBase item in geometry.Value)
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						AxisBase key = geometry.Key;
						System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = GetBrush(key);
						System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = GetPen(key);
						pen?.Freeze();
						item.Render(drawingContext, brush, pen);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract List<RenderGeometryBase> CreateGeometriesForAxis(IAxesSource axesSource, AxisBase axis, Rect viewport);

		protected internal abstract System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(AxisBase axis);

		protected internal abstract System.Windows.Media.Brush GetBrush(AxisBase axis);

		internal void UpdateGeometry()
		{
			IAxesSource axesSource = AxesSource;
			if (axesSource != null)
			{
				geometries.Clear();
				foreach (AxisBase axis in axesSource.Axes)
				{
					geometries.Add(axis, CreateGeometriesForAxis(axesSource, axis, axesSource.Viewport));
				}
			}
			InvalidateVisual();
		}
	}

		IEnumerator<IAxisData> IEnumerable<IAxisData>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<SecondaryAxisX2D> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			if ((newItems != null && newItems.Count > 1) || (oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 1))
			{
				return new AxisCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), GetCollection<IAxisData>(oldItems), oldStartingIndex, GetCollection<IAxisData>(newItems), newStartingIndex);
			}
			IAxisData oldItem = ((oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 0) ? (oldItems[0] as IAxisData) : null);
			IAxisData newItem = ((newItems != null && newItems.Count > 0) ? (newItems[0] as IAxisData) : null);
			return new AxisCollectionUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), oldItem, oldStartingIndex, newItem, newStartingIndex);
		}
	}

			}
			IAxisData oldItem = ((oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 0) ? (oldItems[0] as IAxisData) : null);
			IAxisData newItem = ((newItems != null && newItems.Count > 0) ? (newItems[0] as IAxisData) : null);

	public class VisibilityInPane : ChartNonVisualElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PaneProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Pane", typeof(object), typeof(VisibilityInPane), new PropertyMetadata(PropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(VisibilityInPane), new PropertyMetadata(true, PropertyChanged));

		private int? paneIndex;

		private XYDiagram2D diagram;

		[Description("Specifies the pane (or its View Model), on which the indicator is plotted.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public object Pane
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(PaneProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(PaneProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides whether a particular axis should be visible on the pane.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(VisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(VisibleProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		private XYDiagram2D Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagram == null && ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner is Axis2D axis2D)
				{
					diagram = axis2D.Diagram2D;
				}
				return diagram;
			}
		}

		internal Pane ActualPane
		{
			get
			{
				object pane = Pane;
				if (pane is Pane || pane == null)
				{
					return (Pane)pane;
				}
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = Diagram;
				if (xYDiagram2D == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TagUtils.FindElementByTag(pane, xYDiagram2D.Panes);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int? PaneIndex
		{
			get
			{
				Pane actualPane = ActualPane;
				if (actualPane != null && Diagram != null)
				{
					return Diagram.Panes.IndexOf(actualPane);
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				paneIndex = value;
			}
		}

		private static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems);
		}

		internal void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			if (Diagram != null && paneIndex.HasValue)
			{
				if (paneIndex == -1)
				{
					Pane = Diagram.ActualDefaultPane;
				}
				int? num = paneIndex;
				int num2 = 0;
				if (num.GetValueOrDefault() >= num2 && num.HasValue && paneIndex < Diagram.Panes.Count)
				{
					Pane = Diagram.Panes[paneIndex.Value];
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class Axis2DElementsPanel : Panel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = ((!(child is IAxis2DElement { Visible: not false, Axis: var axis })) ? new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0) : ((axis != null && axis.IsVertical) ? new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Width) : availableSize));
				child.Measure(availableSize2);
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is IAxis2DElement { Axis: var axis } && (axis?.IsVertical ?? false))
				{
					child.RenderTransform = new RotateTransform
					{
						Angle = -90.0
					};
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, finalSize.Height), child.DesiredSize));
				}
				else
				{
					child.RenderTransform = new MatrixTransform
					{
						Matrix = Matrix.Identity
					};
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), child.DesiredSize));
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class AxisLabelItem : ChartNonVisualElement
	{
		internal static System.Windows.Size AxisLabelItemDefaultSize = new System.Windows.Size(20.0, 20.0);

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty AngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Angle", typeof(double), typeof(AxisLabelItem), new PropertyMetadata(0.0));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty BackgroundProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Background", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(AxisLabelItem), new PropertyMetadata(new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Yellow)));

		private readonly WeakReference label;

		private readonly AxisTextItem textItem;

		private readonly CustomAxisLabel customAxisLabel;

		private readonly int gridIndex;

		private bool visible;

		private bool isOutOfRange;

		private bool staggered;

		private Axis2DLabelItemLayout layout;

		private System.Windows.Size size = System.Windows.Size.Empty;

		private bool isMeasureValid;

		internal double Angle
		{
			get
