		internal System.Windows.Media.Brush Background
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(BackgroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(BackgroundProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		internal double InternalValue => textItem.Value;

		internal CustomAxisLabel CustomAxisLabel => customAxisLabel;

		internal bool IsCustomLabel => textItem.IsCustomLabel;

		internal bool IsIntersectionAutoLabel => textItem.IsIntersectionAutoLabel;

		internal bool Staggered
		{
			get
			{
				return staggered;
			}
			set
			{
				staggered = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOutOfRange
		{
			get
			{
				return isOutOfRange;
			}
			set
			{
				isOutOfRange = value;
			}
		}

		internal Axis2DLabelItemLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				layout = value;
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size MeasuredSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (CustomAxisLabel != null && !isMeasureValid)
				{
					return ForceCalculateSize(this);
				}
				return size;
			}
		}

		internal int GridIndex => gridIndex;

		[Description("For internal use. Gets the axis label, to which the AxisLabelItem corresponds.")]
		public AxisLabel Label => label.Target as AxisLabel;

		[Description("For internal use. Gets the content of an individual custom axis label item. This is a dependency property.")]
		public object Content => textItem.Content;

		[Description("For internal use. Returns the axis value for which the label is shown.")]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (Label != null)
				{
					IAxisData axis = Label.Axis;
					if (axis != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null)
					{
						return axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(textItem.Value);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("The object that is used to generate the axis label.")]
		public object SourceObject
		{
			get
			{
				if (CustomAxisLabel != null)
				{
					return ((FrameworkContentElement)(object)CustomAxisLabel).DataContext;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal AxisLabelItem(AxisLabel label, AxisTextItem textItem, bool staggered, System.Windows.Media.Brush background)
		{
			this.label = new WeakReference(label);
			this.textItem = textItem;
			gridIndex = textItem.GridIndex;
			visible = textItem.Visible;
			IsOutOfRange = !visible;
			customAxisLabel = textItem.CustomAxisLabel as CustomAxisLabel;
			Background = background;
			size = AxisLabelItemDefaultSize;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size ForceCalculateSize(AxisLabelItem labelItem)
		{
			AxisLabelPresentation axisLabelPresentation = new AxisLabelPresentation(new AxisLabelItem(Label, textItem, Staggered, Background));
			axisLabelPresentation.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			return axisLabelPresentation.DesiredSize;
		}

		internal void AssignLayout(IAxisLabelLayout itemLayout)
		{
			Angle = itemLayout.Angle;
			visible = itemLayout.Visible && !isOutOfRange;
			staggered = itemLayout.Offset != default(GRealPoint2D);
			layout = (visible ? ((Axis2DLabelItemLayout)itemLayout) : null);
		}

		internal void UpdateSize(System.Windows.Size newSize)
		{
			size = newSize;
			isMeasureValid = true;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class AxisLabelPresentation : ChartElementBase, ILayoutElement, IHitTestableElement
	{
		private readonly AxisLabelItem labelItem;

		private bool wasMeasureValidOnLastMeasure;

		public AxisLabelItem LabelItem => labelItem;

		public AxisLabel Label => labelItem.Label;

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => Label;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => labelItem;

		ILayout ILayoutElement.Layout => labelItem.Layout;

		internal AxisLabelPresentation(AxisLabelItem labelItem)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AxisLabelPresentation>(this);
			this.labelItem = labelItem;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (wasMeasureValidOnLastMeasure)
			{
				return labelItem.MeasuredSize;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			wasMeasureValidOnLastMeasure = base.IsMeasureValid && size.Width > 0.0 && size.Height > 0.0;
			labelItem.UpdateSize(size);
			return size;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new AxisLabelPresentationAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	public abstract class CircularAxisX2D : AxisBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty NumericScaleOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("NumericScaleOptions", typeof(NumericScaleOptionsBase), typeof(CircularAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisBase.NumericScaleOptionsPropertyChanged));

		private readonly ContinuousNumericScaleOptions defaultNumericScaleOptions = new ContinuousNumericScaleOptions();

		[Description("Provides access to the options that define the behavior of a numeric circular X-scale when its mode is manual, automatic or continuous.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public NumericScaleOptionsBase NumericScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return (NumericScaleOptionsBase)GetValue(NumericScaleOptionsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NumericScaleOptionsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal CircularDiagram2D CircularDiagram => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as CircularDiagram2D;

		private CircularDiagramRotationDirection RotationDirection
		{
			get
			{
				if (CircularDiagram == null)
				{
					return CircularDiagramRotationDirection.Clockwise;
				}
				return CircularDiagram.RotationDirection;
			}
		}

		private CircularDiagramShapeStyle ShapeStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (CircularDiagram == null)
				{
					return CircularDiagramShapeStyle.Circle;
				}
				return CircularDiagram.ShapeStyle;
			}
		}

		protected GridAndTextData GridAndTextData => ((CircularDiagram != null) ? CircularDiagram.GetGridAndTextData(this) : null)?.GridAndTextData[0];

		protected override NumericScaleOptionsBase DefaultNumericScaleOptions => defaultNumericScaleOptions;

		protected internal override AxisGroup AxisGroupType => AxisGroup.ArgumentX;

		protected internal override bool IsVertical => false;

		protected internal override bool IsValuesAxis => false;

		protected internal override bool IsReversed => false;

		protected override int GridSpacingFactor => 45;

		protected internal override RenderGeometryBase CreateGridLineGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double axisValue, int thickness)
		{
			CircularAxisXMapping circularAxisXMapping = (CircularAxisXMapping)CreateMapping(null, axisBounds);
			if (circularAxisXMapping != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point endPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5 * axisBounds.Width, 0.5 * axisBounds.Height);
				GRealPoint2D pointOnCircularAxis = circularAxisXMapping.GetPointOnCircularAxis(axisValue);
				return new LineRenderGeometry(pointOnCircularAxis.ToPoint(), endPoint);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override RenderGeometryBase CreateInterlaceGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double nearAxisValue, double farAxisValue)
		{
			CircularAxisXMapping circularAxisXMapping = (CircularAxisXMapping)CreateMapping(null, axisBounds);
			if (circularAxisXMapping != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point item = new System.Windows.Point(0.5 * axisBounds.Width, 0.5 * axisBounds.Height);
				GRealPoint2D pointOnCircularAxis = circularAxisXMapping.GetPointOnCircularAxis(nearAxisValue);
				GRealPoint2D pointOnCircularAxis2 = circularAxisXMapping.GetPointOnCircularAxis(farAxisValue);
				if (ShapeStyle == CircularDiagramShapeStyle.Circle)
				{
					SweepDirection direction = ((RotationDirection == CircularDiagramRotationDirection.Clockwise) ? SweepDirection.Clockwise : SweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
					return new PieRenderGeometry(new List<System.Windows.Point>
					{
						pointOnCircularAxis.ToPoint(),
						pointOnCircularAxis2.ToPoint(),
						item
					}, direction, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, axisBounds.Width, axisBounds.Height));
				}
				return new PolygonRenderGeometry(new List<System.Windows.Point>
				{
					pointOnCircularAxis.ToPoint(),
					pointOnCircularAxis2.ToPoint(),
					item
				}, new List<System.Windows.Point>());
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		private static object CoerceLogarithmicBase(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if ((double)value <= 1.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidLogarithmicBase));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void DateTimeMeasureUnitPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D)
			{
				radarAxisX2D.SetActualDateTimeMeasureUnit((DateTimeMeasureUnit)e.NewValue);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void DateTimeGridAlignmentPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D)

				radarAxisX2D.SetActualGridAlignment((DateTimeGridAlignment)e.NewValue);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void DateTimeOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D)
			{
				radarAxisX2D.dateTimeOptions = e.NewValue as DateTimeOptions;
				radarAxisX2D.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as DateTimeOptions, e.NewValue as DateTimeOptions, radarAxisX2D);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		[Obsolete]
		private static void RangePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is AxisRange axisRange))
				{
					radarAxisX2D.ActualRange = new AxisRange();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, radarAxisX2D.ActualRange);
				}
				else
				{
					axisRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(radarAxisX2D);
					radarAxisX2D.ActualRange = axisRange;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

		private static void LogarithmicPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D)
			{
				radarAxisX2D.ScaleMap.BuildTransformation(radarAxisX2D);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

		private static void WholeRangePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is Range range))
				{
					radarAxisX2D.ActualWholeRange = new Range();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, radarAxisX2D.ActualWholeRange);
				}
				else
				{
					range.SetRangeData(radarAxisX2D.WholeRangeData);
					radarAxisX2D.ActualWholeRange = range;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

			DateTimeGridAlignmentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DateTimeGridAlignment", typeof(DateTimeMeasurementUnit), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(DateTimeMeasurementUnit.Day, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, DateTimeGridAlignmentPropertyChanged));
			DateTimeOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DateTimeOptions", typeof(DateTimeOptions), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(DateTimeOptionsPropertyChanged));
			WholeRangeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("WholeRange", typeof(Range), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(WholeRangePropertyChanged));
			LogarithmicProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Logarithmic", typeof(bool), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, LogarithmicPropertyChanged));
			LogarithmicBaseProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LogarithmicBase", typeof(double), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(10.0, LogarithmicPropertyChanged, CoerceLogarithmicBase));
			DateTimeScaleOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DateTimeScaleOptions", typeof(DateTimeScaleOptionsBase), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisBase.DateTimeScaleOptionsPropertyChanged));
			TimeSpanScaleOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TimeSpanScaleOptions", typeof(TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisBase.TimeSpanScaleOptionsPropertyChanged));
			QualitativeScaleOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("QualitativeScaleOptions", typeof(QualitativeScaleOptions), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisBase.QualitativeScaleOptionsPropertyChanged));
			RangeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Range", typeof(AxisRange), typeof(RadarAxisX2D), new PropertyMetadata(RangePropertyChanged));

		public RadarAxisX2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<RadarAxisX2D>(this);
			BeginInit();
			base.ActualWholeRange = new Range();
			base.ActualWholeRange.SetRangeData(base.WholeRangeData);
			base.ActualWholeRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			EndInit();
		}

		protected override void TryApplyUserRange()
		{
			Range range = WholeRange;
			if (range != null && (range.MinValue != null || range.MaxValue != null))
			{
				range.ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override IAxisMappingCore CreateMapping(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect bounds)
		{
			IList<double> values = ((base.GridAndTextData != null) ? base.GridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleTickMarkValues : new List<double>());
			return new CircularAxisXMapping(this, base.CircularDiagram, Math.Min(bounds.Height / 2.0, bounds.Width / 2.0), values, looped: false);
		}
	}
	public sealed class PolarAxisX2D : CircularAxisX2D
	{
		protected internal override DateTimeOptions DateTimeOptionsImpl => null;

		protected override bool IsFixedRange => true;

		public PolarAxisX2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<PolarAxisX2D>(this);
			((IAxisData)this).WholeRange.UpdateRange(0.0, 360.0, 0.0, 360.0);
			((IAxisData)this).VisualRange.UpdateRange(0.0, 360.0, 0.0, 360.0);
		}

		protected override void TryApplyUserRange()
		{
		}

		protected internal override IAxisMappingCore CreateMapping(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect bounds)
		{
			IList<double> list = ((base.GridAndTextData != null) ? base.GridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleTickMarkValues : new List<double>());
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>(list.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(360.0 * (double)i / (double)(list.Count - 1));
			}
			return new CircularAxisXMapping(this, base.CircularDiagram, Math.Min(bounds.Height / 2.0, bounds.Width / 2.0), list2, looped: true);
		}
	}

		public CircularAxisY2D()
		{
			BeginInit();
			base.ActualWholeRange = new Range();
			base.ActualWholeRange.SetRangeData(base.WholeRangeData);
			base.ActualWholeRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			EndInit();
		}

		Transform ITransformable.GetGeometryTransform(Axis2DItem axisItem)
		{
			RotateTransform rotateTransform = new RotateTransform();
			if (CircularDiagram != null)
			{
				if (CircularDiagram.RotationDirection == CircularDiagramRotationDirection.Clockwise)
				{
					rotateTransform.Angle = CircularDiagram.StartAngle;
				}
				else
				{
					rotateTransform.Angle = 0.0 - CircularDiagram.StartAngle;
				}
				rotateTransform.CenterX = 0.5 * (double)Math.Max(TickmarksMinorLength, TickmarksLength);
				rotateTransform.CenterY = CircularDiagram.ActualViewport.Height / 4.0;
			}
			ScaleTransform value = new ScaleTransform
			{
				ScaleX = -1.0,
				ScaleY = -1.0
			};
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(rotateTransform);
			return transformGroup;
		}

		protected override void TryApplyUserRange()
		{
			Range range = WholeRange;
			if (range != null && (range.MinValue != null || range.MaxValue != null))
			{
				range.ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override RenderGeometryBase CreateGridLineGeometry(Rect viewport, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double axisValue, int thickness)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore mapping = CreateMapping(null, viewport);
			if (CircularDiagram == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CircularDiagram.ShapeStyle == CircularDiagramShapeStyle.Circle)
			{
				return CreateCircularGridLineGeometry(viewport, mapping, axisValue, thickness);
			}
			return CreatePolygonalGridLineGeometry(viewport, mapping, axisValue);
		}

		protected internal override RenderGeometryBase CreateInterlaceGeometry(Rect viewport, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double nearAxisValue, double farAxisValue)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore mapping = CreateMapping(null, viewport);
			if (CircularDiagram == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CircularDiagram.ShapeStyle == CircularDiagramShapeStyle.Circle)
			{
				return CreateCircularInterlaceGeometry(viewport, mapping, nearAxisValue, farAxisValue);
			}
			return CreatePolygonalInterlaceGeometry(viewport, mapping, nearAxisValue, farAxisValue);
		}

		protected internal override IAxisMappingCore CreateMapping(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect bounds)
		{
			return new CircularAxisYMappingCore(this, 0.5 * bounds.Height);
		}

		private List<System.Windows.Point> GetPlatformPoints(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>(points.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(points[i].ToPoint());
			}
			return list;
		}

		private RenderGeometryBase CreateCircularGridLineGeometry(Rect viewport, IAxisMappingCore mapping, double axisValue, int thickness)
		{
			double num = Render2DHelper.CorrectLinePosition(mapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(axisValue), thickness);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.5 * viewport.Width - num, 0.5 * viewport.Height - num);
			return new EllipseRenderGeometry(new Rect(point2: new System.Windows.Point(point.X + 2.0 * num, point.Y + 2.0 * num), point1: point));
		}

		private RenderGeometryBase CreatePolygonalGridLineGeometry(Rect viewport, IAxisMappingCore mapping, double axisValue)
		{
			double axisValue2 = mapping.GetAxisValue(axisValue);
			CircularAxisXMapping circularAxisXMapping = CircularDiagram.AxisXImpl.CreateMapping(null, viewport) as CircularAxisXMapping;
			return new PolylineRenderGeometry(GetPlatformPoints(circularAxisXMapping.GetMeshPoints(axisValue2)), isClosed: true);
		}

		private RenderGeometryBase CreatePolygonalInterlaceGeometry(Rect viewport, IAxisMappingCore mapping, double nearAxisValue, double farAxisValue)
		{
			double clampedAxisValue = mapping.GetClampedAxisValue(nearAxisValue);
			double clampedAxisValue2 = mapping.GetClampedAxisValue(farAxisValue);
			double radius = Math.Max(clampedAxisValue, clampedAxisValue2);
			double num = Math.Min(clampedAxisValue, clampedAxisValue2);
			CircularAxisXMapping circularAxisXMapping = CircularDiagram.AxisXImpl.CreateMapping(null, viewport) as CircularAxisXMapping;
			List<System.Windows.Point> holePoints = ((num > 0.0) ? GetPlatformPoints(circularAxisXMapping.GetMeshPoints(num)) : new List<System.Windows.Point>());
			return new PolygonRenderGeometry(GetPlatformPoints(circularAxisXMapping.GetMeshPoints(radius)), holePoints);
		}

		private RenderGeometryBase CreateCircularInterlaceGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IAxisMappingCore mapping, double nearAxisValue, double farAxisValue)
		{
			double roundedClampedAxisValue = mapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(nearAxisValue);
			double roundedClampedAxisValue2 = mapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(farAxisValue);
			double num = Math.Max(roundedClampedAxisValue, roundedClampedAxisValue2);
			System.Windows.Point point = axisBounds.CalcRelativeToLeftTopCenter();
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - num, point.Y - num);
			System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + num, point.Y + num);
			double num2 = Math.Min(roundedClampedAxisValue, roundedClampedAxisValue2);
			Rect innerBounds = ((num2 > 0.0) ? new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(point.X - num2, point.Y - num2), new System.Windows.Point(point.X + num2, point.Y + num2)) : Rect.Empty);
			return new RingRenderGeometry(new Rect(point2, point3), innerBounds);
		}
	}

	public class ConstantLineTitleItem : AxisElementTitleItem
	{
		private readonly ConstantLineItem constantLineItem;

		private bool isNotInScaleBreak;

		private ConstantLineTitle ConstantLineTitle => (ConstantLineTitle)base.Title;

		private Axis2D Axis => (Axis2D)base.Title.Axis;

		private ConstantLine ConstantLine => constantLineItem.ConstantLine;

		public ConstantLineItem ConstantLineItem => constantLineItem;

		internal bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Title.ActualVisible && ConstantLine.GetActualVisible() && CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsConstantLineVisible(ConstantLine))
				{
					return constantLineItem.IsVisibleForLayout;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsNotInScaleBreak
		{
			get
			{
				return isNotInScaleBreak;
			}
			set
			{
				isNotInScaleBreak = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("IsNotInScaleBreak");
			}
		}

		internal ConstantLineTitleItem(ConstantLineTitle constantLineTitle, ConstantLineItem constantLineItem)
			: base(constantLineTitle)
		{
			this.constantLineItem = constantLineItem;
		}

		internal Rect CalculateTitleRect(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (!Visible)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			Axis axis = Axis;
			System.Windows.Size size = base.Size;
			double offset = constantLineItem.Offset;
			double value;
			double value2;
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				value = CalculateTitleAlignmentOffset(size.Width, constraint.Width);
				value2 = constraint.Height - offset - 1.0 + CalcOppositeLineOffset(size.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				value = offset + CalcOppositeLineOffset(size.Width);
				value2 = CalculateTitleAlignmentOffset(size.Height, constraint.Height);
			}
			return new Rect(MathUtils.StrongRound(value), MathUtils.StrongRound(value2), size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		private double CalculateTitleAlignmentOffset(double titleSize, double availableSize)
		{
			ConstantLineTitleAlignment alignment = ConstantLineTitle.Alignment;
			bool isVertical = Axis.IsVertical;
			if ((!isVertical || alignment != ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Far) && (isVertical || alignment != ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near))
			{
				return 2.0;
			}
			return availableSize - titleSize - 2.0;
		}

		private double CalcOppositeLineOffset(double titleSize)
		{
			double num = (double)ConstantLine.ActualLineStyle.Thickness / 2.0;
			if (!(Axis.Reverse ^ ConstantLineTitle.ShowBelowLine))
			{
				return 1.0 - titleSize - num;
			}
			return num + 1.0;
		}

		public void UpdateLayout(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect viewport)
		{
			Axis2D axis = constantLineItem.ConstantLine.Axis;
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = axis.CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, viewport);
			double d = (constantLineItem.IsVisibleForLayout ? axisMappingCore.GetRoundedExactAxisValue(constantLineItem.ConstantLine.InternalValue) : double.NaN);
			if (!double.IsNaN(d))
			{
				IsNotInScaleBreak = true;
			}
			else
			{
				IsNotInScaleBreak = false;
			}
		}
	}

			ConstantLineTitleItem constantLineTitleItem = item as ConstantLineTitleItem;

			}
		}
	}

		private static object CoerceValueProperty(AxisBase axis, object value)
		{
			if (axis == null || ((IAxisData)axis).AxisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)axis).AxisScaleTypeMap;
			object obj = axisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (!axisScaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(obj) && !axis.Loading)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Range range && !range.locker.IsLocked)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void MinValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Range { rangeData: not null } range)
			{
				object obj = CoerceValueProperty(range.rangeData.Axis, e.NewValue);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					range.rangeData.MinValue = obj;
					range.InvalidateVisualItems();
					PropertyChanged(d, e);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void MaxValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Range { rangeData: not null } range)
			{
				object obj = CoerceValueProperty(range.rangeData.Axis, e.NewValue);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					range.rangeData.MaxValue = obj;
					range.InvalidateVisualItems();
					PropertyChanged(d, e);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AutoSideMarginsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Range range)
			{
				if (range.rangeData != null && !range.locker.IsLocked)
				{
					range.rangeData.AutoSideMargins = (((bool)e.NewValue) ? SideMarginMode.UserEnable : SideMarginMode.UserDisable);
					if (!(bool)e.NewValue)
					{
						range.rangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = range.StartSideMargin;
						range.rangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = range.EndSideMargin;
						if (!double.IsNaN(range.SideMarginsValue))
						{
							range.rangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = range.SideMarginsValue;
							range.rangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = range.SideMarginsValue;
						}
					}
				}
				range.autoSideMargins = (((bool)e.NewValue) ? SideMarginMode.UserEnable : SideMarginMode.UserDisable);
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void SideMarginSizeUnitPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Range { rangeData: not null } range && !range.locker.IsLocked)
			{
				range.rangeData.SideMarginSizeUnit = (SideMarginSizeUnitNative)e.NewValue;
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void SideMarginsValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Range range = d as Range;
			if (!double.IsNaN((double)e.NewValue))
			{
				range.autoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
			}
			if (range != null && range.rangeData != null && !range.locker.IsLocked)
			{
				range.rangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = (double)e.NewValue;
				range.rangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void StartSideMarginPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Range range = d as Range;
			if (!double.IsNaN((double)e.NewValue))
			{
				range.autoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
			}
			if (range != null && range.rangeData != null && !range.locker.IsLocked)
			{
				range.rangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void EndSideMarginPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Range range = d as Range;
			if (!double.IsNaN((double)e.NewValue))
			{
				range.autoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
			}
			if (range != null && range.rangeData != null && !range.locker.IsLocked)
			{
				range.rangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		internal static void AlwaysShowZeroLevelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Range range)
			{
				if (range.rangeData != null)
				{
					range.rangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel = (bool)e.NewValue;
				}
				else
				{
					range.alwaysShowZeroLevel = (bool)e.NewValue;
				}
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private void Lock()
		{
			locker.Lock();
		}

		private void Unlock()
		{
			locker.Unlock();
		}

		private void InvalidateVisualItems()
		{
			Axis?.Diagram?.UpdateVisualItems(isUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure: false);
		}

		internal void SetRangeData(RangeDataBase data)
		{
			rangeData = data;
			object minValue = CoerceValueProperty(rangeData.Axis, MinValue);
			object maxValue = CoerceValueProperty(rangeData.Axis, MaxValue);
			rangeData.MinValue = minValue;
			rangeData.MaxValue = maxValue;
			rangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = EndSideMargin;
			rangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = StartSideMargin;
			if (!double.IsNaN(SideMarginsValue))
			{
				rangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = SideMarginsValue;
				rangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = SideMarginsValue;
			}
			rangeData.SideMarginSizeUnit = (SideMarginSizeUnitNative)SideMarginSizeUnit;
			rangeData.AutoSideMargins = autoSideMargins;
			if (alwaysShowZeroLevel.HasValue)
			{
				rangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel = alwaysShowZeroLevel.Value;
			}
		}

		internal void ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(AxisBase axis)
		{
			object minValue = CoerceValueProperty(axis, MinValue);
			object maxValue = CoerceValueProperty(axis, MaxValue);
			rangeData.MinValue = minValue;
			rangeData.MaxValue = maxValue;
		}

		internal void UpdateMinMaxValues(AxisBase axis)
		{
			IAxisRangeData visualRangeData = axis.VisualRangeData;
			IAxisRangeData wholeRangeData = axis.WholeRangeData;
			bool flag = axis.AutoScroll && wholeRangeData.Max == visualRangeData.Max && wholeRangeData.Min != visualRangeData.Min;
			if (rangeData.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Values && !flag)
			{
				ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(axis);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateMinMaxValues()
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				UpdateMinMaxValues(Axis);
			}
		}

		internal double GetNormalizedRangeValue(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNegativeInfinity(value))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(value))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (!(rangeData.Delta > 0.0))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(1.0, (value - rangeData.MinValueInternal) / rangeData.Delta));
		}

		public void SetAuto()
		{
			Lock();
			MinValue = null;
			MaxValue = null;
			Unlock();
			rangeData.CorrectionMode = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			PropertyChanged((DependencyObject)(object)this, default(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs));
		}

		public void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			if (minValue != null || maxValue != null)
			{
				Lock();
				MinValue = minValue;
				MaxValue = maxValue;
				Unlock();
				object min = ((minValue == null) ? rangeData.MinValue : minValue);
				object max = ((maxValue == null) ? rangeData.MaxValue : maxValue);
				rangeData?.SetRange(min, max, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
				InvalidateVisualItems();
			}
		}

		private bool IsEqual(object a, object b)
		{
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(a.GetType()) && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(b.GetType()))
			{
				double num = Convert.ToDouble(a);
				double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(b);
				return num == num2;
			}
			return a.Equals(b);
		}

		private bool XtraShouldSerializeActualMinValueInternal()
		{
			if (!XtraShouldSerializeMinValue())
			{
				return rangeData.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool XtraShouldSerializeActualMaxValueInternal()
		{
			if (!XtraShouldSerializeMaxValue())
			{
				return rangeData.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool XtraShouldSerializeMinValue()
		{
			if (MinValue != null)
			{
				return IsEqual(MinValue, ActualMinValue);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool XtraShouldSerializeMaxValue()
		{
			if (MaxValue != null)
			{
				return IsEqual(MaxValue, ActualMaxValue);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class AutomaticScaleBreak : IScaleDiapason
	{
		private readonly double edge1;

		private readonly double edge2;

		public double Edge1 => edge1;

		public double Edge2 => edge2;

		bool IScaleDiapason.Visible => true;

		public AutomaticScaleBreak(double edge1, double edge2)
		{
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(edge1))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDoubleValue), "edge1");
			}
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(edge2))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectDoubleValue), "edge2");
			}
			this.edge1 = edge1;
			this.edge2 = edge2;
		}
	}
	public class ScaleBreakCollection : ChartElementCollection<ScaleBreak>, IEnumerable<IScaleBreak>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override ChartElementChange Change => base.Change | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems;

		IEnumerator<IScaleBreak> IEnumerable<IScaleBreak>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<ScaleBreak> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			return new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, (AxisBase)base.Owner);
		}
	}
	public class ScaleBreak : ChartElement, IScaleBreak, IScaleDiapason
	{
		private const bool DefaultVisible = true;

	[NonCategorized]
	public class ScaleBreaksRenderControl : ChartElementBase
	{
		private readonly List<GeometryPresentation> presentations = new List<GeometryPresentation>();

		private Pane Pane => base.DataContext as Pane;

		internal List<GeometryPresentation> Presentations => presentations;

		public ScaleBreaksRenderControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ScaleBreaksRenderControl>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			foreach (GeometryPresentation presentation in presentations)
			{
				presentation.Geometry.Render(drawingContext, null, presentation.Pen);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateGeometry()
		{
			if (Pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<BorderPresentation> list = PaneAreaPresentationCreator.CreateBorderPresentations(Pane.PaneAreas);
			presentations.Clear();
			foreach (BorderPresentation item in list)
			{
				presentations.Add(new GeometryPresentation(new PolylineRenderGeometry(item.Points, isClosed: false), item.Pen));
			}
			InvalidateVisual();
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Unfocused", GroupName = "FocusStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Pressed", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Disabled", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Focused", GroupName = "FocusStates")]
	public class AxisScrollBarThumb : Control
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsDraggingPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsDragging", typeof(bool), typeof(AxisScrollBarThumb), new PropertyMetadata(false, IsDraggingPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDraggingProperty = IsDraggingPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private System.Windows.Point origin;

		private System.Windows.Point previousPosition;

		private bool isMouseOver;

		private bool isFocused;

		private XYDiagram2DPanel diagramPanel;

		public bool IsDragging => (bool)GetValue(IsDraggingProperty);

		private UIElement ParentElement => base.Parent as UIElement;

		public event DragCompletedEventHandler DragCompleted;

		public event DragDeltaEventHandler DragDelta;

		public event DragStartedEventHandler DragStarted;

		private static void IsDraggingPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisScrollBarThumb axisScrollBarThumb)
			{
				axisScrollBarThumb.UpdateVisualState();
			}
		}

		public AxisScrollBarThumb()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AxisScrollBarThumb>(this);
		}

		private void RaiseDragCompleted(bool canceled)
		{
			if (this.DragCompleted != null)
			{
				this.DragCompleted(this, new DragCompletedEventArgs(previousPosition.X - origin.X, previousPosition.Y - origin.Y, canceled));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (IsDragging)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Pressed", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (isMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
			}
			if (isFocused && base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Focused", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unfocused", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if (diagramPanel == null || !IsDragging)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(diagramPanel);
			if (position != previousPosition)
			{
				if (this.DragDelta != null)
				{
					this.DragDelta(this, new DragDeltaEventArgs(position.X - previousPosition.X, position.Y - previousPosition.Y));
				}
				previousPosition = position;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsDragging && base.IsEnabled)
			{
				SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, false);
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
				RaiseDragCompleted(canceled: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (diagramPanel == null || e.Handled || IsDragging || !base.IsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			e.Handled = true;
			CaptureMouse();
			SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, true);
			origin = e.GetPosition(diagramPanel);
			previousPosition = origin;
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				if (this.DragStarted != null)
				{
					this.DragStarted(this, new DragStartedEventArgs(origin.X, origin.Y));
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag && IsDragging)
				{
					SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, false);
					RaiseDragCompleted(canceled: true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			UIElement parentElement = ParentElement;
			if (parentElement != null && IsDragging)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				SetValue(IsDraggingPropertyKey, false);
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
				System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(parentElement);
				if (this.DragCompleted != null)
				{
					this.DragCompleted(this, new DragCompletedEventArgs(position.X - origin.X, position.Y - origin.Y, canceled: false));
				}
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotFocus(e);
			isFocused = true;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostFocus(e);
			isFocused = false;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			isMouseOver = true;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			isMouseOver = false;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldTemplate, ControlTemplate newTemplate)
		{
			base.OnTemplateChanged(oldTemplate, newTemplate);
			diagramPanel = LayoutHelper.FindAmongParents<XYDiagram2DPanel>((DependencyObject)this, (DependencyObject)null);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			base.IsEnabledChanged += OnIsEnabledChanged;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Unfocused", GroupName = "FocusStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Pressed", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Disabled", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Focused", GroupName = "FocusStates")]
	public class AxisScrollBarThumbResizer : AxisScrollBarThumb
	{
		public AxisScrollBarThumbResizer()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AxisScrollBarThumbResizer>(this);
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarBorder : System.Windows.Controls.Border
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnnotationsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Annotations", typeof(IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout>), typeof(ScrollBarBorder), new PropertyMetadata(null, AnnotationsPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BrushProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Brush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(ScrollBarBorder), new PropertyMetadata(null, BrushPropertyChanged));

		private Orientation orientation;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualBrush { get; set; }

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("")]
		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return orientation;
			}
			set
			{
				if (orientation != value)
				{
					orientation = value;
					InvalidateVisual();
				}
			}
		}

		[Category("Appearance")]
		[Description("")]
		public double NearIndent { get; set; }

		[Category("Appearance")]
		[Description("")]
		public double FarIndent { get; set; }

		[Category("Elements")]
		[Description("")]
		public IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> Annotations
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout>)GetValue(AnnotationsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnnotationsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Appearance")]
		[Description("")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(BrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void AnnotationsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ScrollBarBorder scrollBarBorder)
			{
				scrollBarBorder.InvalidateVisual();
			}
		}

		private static void BrushPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ScrollBarBorder scrollBarBorder)
			{
				scrollBarBorder.ActualBrush = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		public ScrollBarBorder()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ScrollBarBorder>(this);
		}

		private Rect GetInnerBounds()
		{
			Thickness borderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
			Rect rect = new Rect(borderThickness.Left, borderThickness.Top, Math.Max(0.0, base.ActualWidth - borderThickness.Left - borderThickness.Right), Math.Max(0.0, base.ActualHeight - borderThickness.Top - borderThickness.Bottom));
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new Rect(rect.Left + NearIndent, rect.Top, Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width - NearIndent - FarIndent), rect.Height);
			}
			return new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top + NearIndent, rect.Width, Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height - NearIndent - FarIndent));
		}

		private Rect CalculateAnnotationBounds(Rect bounds, ScrollBarAnnotationLayout annotation)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(annotation.AxisStart, annotation.AxisEnd);
			double num2 = Math.Max(annotation.AxisStart, annotation.AxisEnd);
			double x;
			double y;
			double num3;
			double num4;
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				x = bounds.Left + num * bounds.Width;
				y = bounds.Top + annotation.BarStart * bounds.Height;
				num3 = (num2 - num) * bounds.Width;
				num4 = (annotation.BarEnd - annotation.BarStart) * bounds.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = (annotation.BarEnd - annotation.BarStart) * bounds.Width;
				num4 = (num2 - num) * bounds.Height;
				x = bounds.Right - annotation.BarStart * bounds.Width - num3;
				y = bounds.Bottom - num * bounds.Height - num4;
			}
			return new Rect(x, y, num3, num4);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext context)
		{
			base.OnRender(context);
			IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> annotations = Annotations;
			if (annotations == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect innerBounds = GetInnerBounds();
			foreach (ScrollBarAnnotationLayout item in annotations)
			{
				Rect bounds = CalculateAnnotationBounds(innerBounds, item);
				item.Render(context, ActualBrush, bounds);
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeAnnotations(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarAnnotationLayout
	{
		internal double AxisStart { get; set; }

		internal double AxisEnd { get; set; }

		internal double BarStart { get; set; }

		internal double BarEnd { get; set; }

		private IScrollBarAnnotation Annotation { get; set; }

		internal ScrollBarAnnotationLayout(IScrollBarAnnotation annotation, double axisStart, double axisEnd, double barStart, double barEnd)
		{
			Annotation = annotation;
			AxisStart = axisStart;
			AxisEnd = axisEnd;
			BarStart = barStart;
			BarEnd = barEnd;
		}

		public void Render(DrawingContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect bounds)
		{
			Annotation.Render(context, brush, bounds);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class ScrollBarItem : NotifyPropertyChangedObject, ILayoutElement
	{
		private ScrollBarOptions options;

		private Axis2DElementLayout layout;

		private bool visible;

		private Orientation orientation;

		private double minPosition;

		private double maxPosition = 1.0;

		private ICommand command;

		private IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> annotations;

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating whether the scroll bar element is visible.")]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Visible");
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether the scroll bar items are vertically or horizontally oriented.")]
		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return orientation;
			}
			set
			{
				orientation = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Orientation");
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the minimum position of the scrollbar element.")]
		public double MinPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return minPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				minPosition = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("MinPosition");
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum position of the scrollbar element.")]
		public double MaxPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return maxPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				maxPosition = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("MaxPosition");
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the command assigned to the scroll bar item.")]
		public ICommand Command
		{
			get
			{
				return command;
			}
			set
			{
				command = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Command");
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the scroll bar annotations.")]
		public IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> Annotations
		{
			get
			{
				return annotations;
			}
			set
			{
				annotations = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Annotations");
			}
		}

		internal ScrollBarOptions Options
		{
			get
			{
				return options;
			}
			set
			{
				options = value;
				Visible = options.Visible;
			}
		}

		internal Axis2DElementLayout Layout => layout;

		private AxisPosition Position
		{
			get
			{
				if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					if (options.Alignment != ScrollBarAlignment.Near)
					{
						return AxisPosition.Right;
					}
					return AxisPosition.Left;
				}
				if (options.Alignment != ScrollBarAlignment.Near)
				{
					return AxisPosition.Top;
				}
				return AxisPosition.Bottom;
			}
		}

		ILayout ILayoutElement.Layout => layout;

		internal ScrollBarItem()
		{
		}

		internal void CreateScrollBarLayout(IDictionary<AxisPosition, Axis2DItem> firstAxesItems, Rect viewport)
		{
			layout = null;
			if (options.Visible)
			{
				AxisPosition position = Position;
				double barThickness = options.BarThickness;
				Rect bounds;
				switch (position)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case AxisPosition.Left:
					bounds = new Rect(viewport.Left - barThickness + 1.0, viewport.Top, barThickness, viewport.Height);
					break;
				case AxisPosition.Top:
					bounds = new Rect(viewport.Left, viewport.Top - barThickness + 1.0, viewport.Width, barThickness);
					break;
				case AxisPosition.Right:
					bounds = new Rect(viewport.Right - 1.0, viewport.Top, barThickness, viewport.Height);
					break;
				case AxisPosition.Bottom:
					bounds = new Rect(viewport.Left, viewport.Bottom - 1.0, viewport.Width, barThickness);
					break;
				}
				layout = new Axis2DElementLayout(bounds, new Rect[0]);
				if (firstAxesItems.TryGetValue(position, out var value))
				{
					value?.SetScrollBarLayout(layout);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class ScrollBarPresentation : Control, ILayoutElement
	{
		private readonly ScrollBarItem scrollBarItem;

		public ScrollBarItem ScrollBarItem => scrollBarItem;

		ILayout ILayoutElement.Layout
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollBarItem != null)
				{
					return scrollBarItem.Layout;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		static ScrollBarPresentation()
		{
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ScrollBarPresentation), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
		}

		internal ScrollBarPresentation(ScrollBarItem scrollBarItem)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ScrollBarPresentation>(this);
			this.scrollBarItem = scrollBarItem;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (scrollBarItem != null)
			{
				ILayout layout = scrollBarItem.Layout;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
					System.Windows.Size constraint2 = new System.Windows.Size(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
					return base.MeasureOverride(constraint2);
				}
			}
			base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TitlePresenter", Type = typeof(ChartContentPresenter))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TitlePanel", Type = typeof(AxisElementTitlePanel))]
	public abstract class AxisElementTitleBase : TitleBase, IHitTestableElement
	{
		protected internal abstract Axis Axis { get; }

		protected internal abstract object HitTestableElement { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ShouldRotate { get; }

		protected internal abstract double RotateAngle { get; }

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => HitTestableElement;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => null;
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalSmallIncrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalLargeIncrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalSmallDecrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalLargeDecrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalThumbIncrease", Type = typeof(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalThumbDecrease", Type = typeof(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalThumb", Type = typeof(AxisScrollBarThumb))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalContainer", Type = typeof(Grid))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalRoot", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalBorder", Type = typeof(ScrollBarBorder))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalSmallIncrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalLargeIncrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalSmallDecrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalLargeDecrease", Type = typeof(RepeatButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalThumbIncrease", Type = typeof(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalThumbDecrease", Type = typeof(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalThumb", Type = typeof(AxisScrollBarThumb))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalContainer", Type = typeof(Grid))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalRoot", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalBorder", Type = typeof(ScrollBarBorder))]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Disabled", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[NonCategorized]
	public class AxisScrollBar : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(AxisScrollBar), new PropertyMetadata(true, VisiblePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(AxisScrollBar), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical, OrientationPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinValueProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinValue", typeof(double), typeof(AxisScrollBar), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, ValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxValueProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxValue", typeof(double), typeof(AxisScrollBar), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, ValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Command", typeof(ICommand), typeof(AxisScrollBar), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnnotationsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Annotations", typeof(IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout>), typeof(AxisScrollBar), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private readonly VerticalScrollBarLayoutCalculator verticalLayout;

		private readonly HorizontalScrollBarLayoutCalculator horizontalLayout;

		private double dragMinValue;

		private double dragMaxValue;

		private bool isMouseOver;

		private XYDiagram2D diagram;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(VisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(VisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MinValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MaxValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaxValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ICommand Command
		{
			get
			{
				return (ICommand)GetValue(CommandProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> Annotations
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout>)GetValue(AnnotationsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnnotationsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private ScrollBarLayoutCalculator LayoutCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					return verticalLayout;
				}
				return horizontalLayout;
			}
		}

		private double LargeChange => Math.Abs(MaxValue - MinValue);

		private double SmallChange
		{
			get
			{
				double num = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? base.ActualWidth : base.ActualHeight);
				double largeChange = LargeChange;
				if (largeChange + num != largeChange)
				{
					return largeChange / num;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		private static void VisiblePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisScrollBar axisScrollBar)
			{
				axisScrollBar.Visibility = ((!(bool)e.NewValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				axisScrollBar.UpdateTrackLayout();
			}
		}

		private static void OrientationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisScrollBar axisScrollBar)
			{
				axisScrollBar.OnOrientationChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisScrollBar axisScrollBar)
			{
				axisScrollBar.UpdateTrackLayout();
			}
		}

		public AxisScrollBar()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AxisScrollBar>(this);
			verticalLayout = new VerticalScrollBarLayoutCalculator(this);
			horizontalLayout = new HorizontalScrollBarLayoutCalculator(this);
			base.SizeChanged += delegate
			{
				UpdateTrackLayout();
			};
		}

		private void UpdateTrackLayout()
		{
			if (base.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				LayoutCalculator.UpdateElementsLayout();
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteCommand(NavigationType navigationType, MinMaxValues values)
		{
			ICommand command = Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				object parameter = new AxisRangePositions(navigationType, values.Min, values.Max);
				if (command.CanExecute(parameter))
				{
					command.Execute(parameter);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteCommand(NavigationType navigationType, double shift)
		{
			double num = MinValue + shift;
			double num2 = MaxValue + shift;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 1.0;
			double num5 = num2 - num;
			if (num < num3)
			{
				num = num3;
				num2 = num + num5;
			}
			else if (num2 > num4)
			{
				num2 = num4;
				num = num2 - num5;
			}
			if (num != MinValue || num2 != MaxValue || navigationType == NavigationType.ZoomThumbRelease)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(navigationType, new MinMaxValues(num, num2));
			}
		}

		private void LargeDecrement()
		{
			double trackLength = LayoutCalculator.TrackLength;
			if (trackLength > LayoutCalculator.ThumbMinSize && trackLength > 1.0)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.LargeDecrement, 0.0 - LargeChange);
			}
		}

		private void LargeIncrement()
		{
			double trackLength = LayoutCalculator.TrackLength;
			if (trackLength > LayoutCalculator.ThumbMinSize && trackLength > 1.0)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.LargeIncrement, LargeChange);
			}
		}

		internal void SmallDecrement()
		{
			ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.SmallDecrement, 0.0 - SmallChange);
		}

		internal void SmallIncrement()
		{
			ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.SmallIncrement, SmallChange);
		}

		private void OnThumbDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			StartThumbDrag();
		}

		private void OnThumbDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.ZoomThumbRelease, 0.0);
		}

		private void OnThumbDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			dragMinValue += CalculateDragDelta(e);
			ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.ThumbPosition, dragMinValue - MinValue);
		}

		private void OnThumbDecreaseDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			ThumbDecreaseDragDelta(e.HorizontalChange, e.VerticalChange);
		}

		private void OnThumbIncreaseDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			ThumbIncreaseDragDelta(e.HorizontalChange, e.VerticalChange);
		}

		private void ThumbDecreaseDragDelta(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			dragMinValue += CalculateDragDelta(horizontalChange, verticalChange);
			double num = Math.Min(MaxValue - LayoutCalculator.ThumbMinSize / LayoutCalculator.TrackLength, Math.Max(0.0, dragMinValue));
			if (num != MinValue)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.SetRange, new MinMaxValues(num, MaxValue));
			}
		}

		private void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void ThumbIncreaseDragDelta(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			dragMaxValue += CalculateDragDelta(horizontalChange, verticalChange);
			double num = Math.Max(MinValue + LayoutCalculator.ThumbMinSize / LayoutCalculator.TrackLength, Math.Min(1.0, dragMaxValue));
			if (num != MaxValue)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.SetRange, new MinMaxValues(MinValue, num));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (LayoutCalculator.Thumb != null && !LayoutCalculator.Thumb.IsDragging)
			{
				if (!base.IsEnabled)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
				}
				else if (isMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void OnOrientationChanged()
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				if (horizontalLayout.Root != null)
				{
					horizontalLayout.Root.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (verticalLayout.Root != null)
				{
					verticalLayout.Root.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (horizontalLayout.Root != null)
				{
					horizontalLayout.Root.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (verticalLayout.Root != null)
				{
					verticalLayout.Root.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			UpdateTrackLayout();
		}

		private double CalculateDragDelta(DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			return CalculateDragDelta(e.HorizontalChange, e.VerticalChange);
		}

		private double CalculateDragDelta(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			double trackLength = LayoutCalculator.TrackLength;
			if (trackLength < 1.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? horizontalChange : (0.0 - verticalChange)) / trackLength;
		}

		private void SubscribeThumbEvents(AxisScrollBarThumb thumb)
		{
			if (thumb != null)
			{
				thumb.DragStarted += OnThumbDragStarted;
				thumb.DragDelta += OnThumbDragDelta;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeThumbIncreaseEvents(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer thumbIncrease)
		{
			if (thumbIncrease != null)
			{
				thumbIncrease.DragStarted += OnThumbDragStarted;
				thumbIncrease.DragDelta += OnThumbIncreaseDragDelta;
				thumbIncrease.DragCompleted += OnThumbDragCompleted;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeThumbDecreaseEvents(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer thumbDecrease)
		{
			if (thumbDecrease != null)
			{
				thumbDecrease.DragStarted += OnThumbDragStarted;
				thumbDecrease.DragDelta += OnThumbDecreaseDragDelta;
				thumbDecrease.DragCompleted += OnThumbDragCompleted;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeLargeIncreaseEvents(RepeatButton largeIncrease)
		{
			if (largeIncrease != null)
			{
				largeIncrease.Click += delegate
				{
					LargeIncrement();
				};
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeLargeDecreaseEvents(RepeatButton largeDecrease)
		{
			if (largeDecrease != null)
			{
				largeDecrease.Click += delegate
				{
					LargeDecrement();
				};
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeSmallIncreaseEvents(RepeatButton smallIncrease)
		{
			if (smallIncrease != null)
			{
				smallIncrease.Click += delegate
				{
					SmallIncrement();
				};
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeSmallDecreaseEvents(RepeatButton smallDecrease)
		{
			if (smallDecrease != null)
			{
				smallDecrease.Click += delegate
				{
					SmallDecrement();
				};
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			SubscribeThumbEvents(horizontalLayout.Thumb);
			SubscribeThumbEvents(verticalLayout.Thumb);
			SubscribeThumbIncreaseEvents(horizontalLayout.ThumbIncrease);
			SubscribeThumbIncreaseEvents(verticalLayout.ThumbIncrease);
			SubscribeThumbDecreaseEvents(horizontalLayout.ThumbDecrease);
			SubscribeThumbDecreaseEvents(verticalLayout.ThumbDecrease);
			SubscribeLargeIncreaseEvents(horizontalLayout.LargeIncrease);
			SubscribeLargeIncreaseEvents(verticalLayout.LargeIncrease);
			SubscribeLargeDecreaseEvents(horizontalLayout.LargeDecrease);
			SubscribeLargeDecreaseEvents(verticalLayout.LargeDecrease);
			SubscribeSmallIncreaseEvents(horizontalLayout.SmallIncrease);
			SubscribeSmallIncreaseEvents(verticalLayout.SmallIncrease);
			SubscribeSmallDecreaseEvents(horizontalLayout.SmallDecrease);
			SubscribeSmallDecreaseEvents(verticalLayout.SmallDecrease);
			base.IsEnabledChanged += OnIsEnabledChanged;
		}

		internal void StartThumbDrag()
		{
			dragMinValue = MinValue;
			dragMaxValue = MaxValue;
		}

		internal void ThumbDragDelta(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			dragMinValue += CalculateDragDelta(horizontalChange, verticalChange);
			ExecuteCommand(NavigationType.ThumbPosition, dragMinValue - MinValue);
		}

		internal void DragThumbResizer(AxisScrollBarThumbResizer thumbResizer, double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			if (thumbResizer == LayoutCalculator.ThumbIncrease)
			{
				ThumbIncreaseDragDelta(horizontalChange, verticalChange);
			}
			if (thumbResizer == LayoutCalculator.ThumbDecrease)
			{
				ThumbDecreaseDragDelta(horizontalChange, verticalChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.UpdateScrollingState(isScrolling: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			isMouseOver = true;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			isMouseOver = false;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			horizontalLayout.Container = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalContainer") as Grid;
			horizontalLayout.Root = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalRoot") as FrameworkElement;
			horizontalLayout.Background = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalBorder") as ScrollBarBorder;
			verticalLayout.Container = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalContainer") as Grid;
			verticalLayout.Root = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalRoot") as FrameworkElement;
			verticalLayout.Background = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalBorder") as ScrollBarBorder;
			horizontalLayout.Thumb = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalThumb") as AxisScrollBarThumb;
			horizontalLayout.ThumbIncrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalThumbIncrease") as AxisScrollBarThumbResizer;
			horizontalLayout.ThumbDecrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalThumbDecrease") as AxisScrollBarThumbResizer;
			verticalLayout.Thumb = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalThumb") as AxisScrollBarThumb;
			verticalLayout.ThumbIncrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalThumbIncrease") as AxisScrollBarThumbResizer;
			verticalLayout.ThumbDecrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalThumbDecrease") as AxisScrollBarThumbResizer;
			horizontalLayout.LargeIncrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalLargeIncrease") as RepeatButton;
			horizontalLayout.LargeDecrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalLargeDecrease") as RepeatButton;
			horizontalLayout.SmallIncrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalSmallIncrease") as RepeatButton;
			horizontalLayout.SmallDecrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalSmallDecrease") as RepeatButton;
			verticalLayout.LargeIncrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalLargeIncrease") as RepeatButton;
			verticalLayout.LargeDecrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalLargeDecrease") as RepeatButton;
			verticalLayout.SmallIncrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalSmallIncrease") as RepeatButton;
			verticalLayout.SmallDecrease = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalSmallDecrease") as RepeatButton;
			diagram = LayoutHelper.FindAmongParents<XYDiagram2D>((DependencyObject)this, (DependencyObject)null);
			SubscribeEvents();
			OnOrientationChanged();
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeAnnotations(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarRepeatButton : RepeatButton
	{
		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ScrollBarRepeatButtonAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class ConstantLineItem : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		private Visibility visibility;

		private double offset;

		private double length;

		private DoubleCollection dashArray;

		private double dashOffset;

		private List<Rect> selectionGeometry;

		private readonly ConstantLine constantLine;

		internal bool IsVisibleForLayout => !double.IsNaN(constantLine.InternalValue);

		public ConstantLine ConstantLine => constantLine;

		public Visibility Visibility
		{
			get
			{
				return visibility;
			}
			set
			{
				visibility = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Visibility");
			}
		}

		public double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				offset = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Offset");
			}
		}

		public double Length
		{
			get
			{
				return length;
			}
			set
			{
				length = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Length");
			}
		}

		public DoubleCollection DashArray
		{
			get
			{
				return dashArray;
			}
			set
			{
				dashArray = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("DashArray");
			}
		}

		public double DashOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return dashOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				dashOffset = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("DashOffset");
			}
		}

		public List<Rect> SelectionGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return selectionGeometry;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectionGeometry != value)
				{
					selectionGeometry = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectionGeometry");
				}
			}
		}

		internal ConstantLineItem(ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			this.constantLine = constantLine;
		}

		private List<Rect> CalcSelectionGeometry()
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			int thickness = constantLine.ActualLineStyle.Thickness;
			int num = (MathUtils.isEvenNumber(thickness) ? 6 : 5);
			System.Windows.Point location = new System.Windows.Point
			{
				X = Offset - 3.0 - (double)thickness / 2.0,
				Y = 1.0
			};
			double num2 = Length - 2.0;
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(thickness + num, (num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.0);
			list.Add(new Rect(location, size));
			return list;
		}

		internal void UpdateLayout(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect viewport)
		{
			Axis2D axis = constantLine.Axis;
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = axis.CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, viewport);
			double num = (IsVisibleForLayout ? axisMappingCore.GetRoundedExactAxisValue(constantLine.InternalValue) : double.NaN);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				Offset = Render2DHelper.CorrectLinePosition(num, constantLine.ActualLineStyle.Thickness);
				Length = (constantLine.Axis.IsVertical ? viewport.Width : viewport.Height);
				SelectionGeometry = CalcSelectionGeometry();
			}
			else
			{
				Offset = 0.0;
				Length = 0.0;
				SelectionGeometry = new List<Rect>();
			}
			LineStyle actualLineStyle = constantLine.ActualLineStyle;
			System.Windows.Media.DashStyle dashStyle = actualLineStyle.DashStyle;
			if (dashStyle == null)
			{
				DashArray = CommonUtils.CloneDoubleCollection(null);
				DashOffset = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				DashArray = CommonUtils.CloneDoubleCollection(dashStyle.Dashes);
				DashOffset = dashStyle.Offset;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ConstantLinesItemsControl : ChartItemsControl<ConstantLinePresentation>
	{
		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			ConstantLinePresentation constantLinePresentation = element as ConstantLinePresentation;
			ConstantLineItem constantLineItem = item as ConstantLineItem;
			if (constantLinePresentation != null && constantLineItem != null)
			{
				constantLinePresentation.ConstantLineItem = constantLineItem;
			}
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class ConstantLinePresentation : ChartElementBase, IAxis2DElement, IHitTestableElement, IFinishInvalidation
	{
		private ConstantLineItem constantLineItem;

		AxisBase IAxis2DElement.Axis => ConstantLine?.Axis;

		bool IAxis2DElement.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				ConstantLine constantLine = ConstantLine;
				if (constantLine != null)
				{
					return CustomAxisElementsHelper.IsConstantLineVisible(constantLine);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => ConstantLine;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => null;

		public ConstantLineItem ConstantLineItem
		{
			get
			{
				return constantLineItem;
			}
			internal set
			{
				constantLineItem = value;
			}
		}

		public ConstantLine ConstantLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (constantLineItem != null)
				{
					return constantLineItem.ConstantLine;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ConstantLinePresentation()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ConstantLinePresentation>(this);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			return new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Width, 0.0), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Height, 0.0));
		}
	}
	public enum ConstantLineTitleAlignment
	{
		Near,
		Far
	}
	public class ConstantLineTitle : AxisElementTitleBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AlignmentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Alignment", typeof(ConstantLineTitleAlignment), typeof(ConstantLineTitle), new PropertyMetadata(ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowBelowLineProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowBelowLine", typeof(bool), typeof(ConstantLineTitle), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		[Description("Gets or sets the alignment of the constant line title.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ConstantLineTitleAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (ConstantLineTitleAlignment)GetValue(AlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

	public abstract class GridLinesRenderControlBase : AxisElementsRenderControlBase
	{
		protected abstract List<double> GetGridValues(AxisBase axis, AxisGridData gridData);

		protected abstract LineStyle GetLineStyle(AxisBase axis);

		protected abstract System.Windows.Media.Brush GetStroke(AxisBase axis);

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetBrush(AxisBase axis)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(AxisBase axis)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = GetStroke(axis)?.CloneCurrentValue();
			return GetLineStyle(axis).CreatePen(brush);
		}

		protected override List<RenderGeometryBase> CreateGeometriesForAxis(IAxesSource axesSource, AxisBase axis, Rect viewport)
		{
			List<RenderGeometryBase> list = new List<RenderGeometryBase>();
			int thickness = GetLineStyle(axis).Thickness;
			IntervalsGridAndTextData gridAndTextData = axesSource.GetGridAndTextData(axis);
			if (gridAndTextData != null)
			{
				IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider = axesSource as IIntervalLayoutProvider;
				foreach (GridAndTextData gridAndTextDatum in gridAndTextData.GridAndTextData)
				{
					AxisGridData gridData = gridAndTextDatum.GridData;
					foreach (double gridValue in GetGridValues(axis, gridData))
					{
						list.Add(axis.CreateGridLineGeometry(viewport, intervalLayoutProvider, gridValue, thickness));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class InterlaceRenderControl : AxisElementsRenderControlBase
	{
		protected override List<RenderGeometryBase> CreateGeometriesForAxis(IAxesSource axesSource, AxisBase axis, Rect viewport)
		{
			List<RenderGeometryBase> list = new List<RenderGeometryBase>();
			if (axis.Interlaced)
			{
				IntervalsGridAndTextData gridAndTextData = axesSource.GetGridAndTextData(axis);
				if (gridAndTextData != null)
				{
					IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider = axesSource as IIntervalLayoutProvider;
					foreach (GridAndTextData gridAndTextDatum in gridAndTextData.GridAndTextData)
					{
						IList<InterlacedData> interlacedData = gridAndTextDatum.GridData.InterlacedData;
						foreach (InterlacedData item in interlacedData)
						{
							list.Add(axis.CreateInterlaceGeometry(viewport, intervalLayoutProvider, item.Near, item.Far));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(AxisBase axis)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetBrush(AxisBase axis)
		{
			return axis.InterlacedBrush;
		}
