	[NonCategorized]
	public class StripItem : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		private const double minStripWidth = 1.0;

		private double offset;

		private double thickness;

		private double length;

		private List<Rect> selectionGeometry;

		private readonly Strip strip;

		internal Strip Strip => strip;

		internal StripPresentation Presentation { get; set; }

		public double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				offset = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Offset");
			}
		}

		public double Thickness
		{
			get
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			set
			{
				thickness = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Thickness");
			}
		}

		public double Length
		{
			get
			{
				return length;
			}
			set
			{
				length = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Length");
			}
		}

		public List<Rect> SelectionGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return selectionGeometry;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectionGeometry != value)
				{
					selectionGeometry = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectionGeometry");
				}
			}
		}

		internal StripItem(Strip strip)
		{
			this.strip = strip;
		}

		internal void UpdateLayout(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect viewport)
		{
			Axis2D axis = Strip.Axis;
			if (axis == null || !Strip.GetActualVisible())
			{
				Offset = 0.0;
				Thickness = 0.0;
				Length = 0.0;
				SelectionGeometry = new List<Rect>();
				return;
			}
			double actualValue = ((IStrip)strip).MinLimit.ActualValue;
			double actualValue2 = ((IStrip)strip).MaxLimit.ActualValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(actualValue) && !double.IsNaN(actualValue2))
			{
				IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = axis.CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, viewport);
				double bound = axisMappingCore.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(actualValue);
				double bound2 = axisMappingCore.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(actualValue2);
				Render2DHelper.CorrectBounds(ref bound, ref bound2);
				Render2DHelper.CorrectBoundsByMinDistance(ref bound, ref bound2, 1.0);
				Offset = Math.Min(bound, bound2);
				Thickness = Math.Abs(bound2 - bound);
			}
			else
			{
				Offset = 0.0;
				Thickness = 0.0;
			}
			Length = (axis.IsVertical ? viewport.Width : viewport.Height);
			double num = Length - 2.0;
			SelectionGeometry = new List<Rect>
			{
				new Rect(Offset, 1.0, Thickness, (num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0)
			};
		}
	}

			StripItem stripItem = item as StripItem;

			{
				stripPresentation.StripItem = stripItem;
				stripItem.Presentation = stripPresentation;
			}
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class AxisElementTitlePanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TitleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Title", typeof(AxisElementTitleBase), typeof(AxisElementTitlePanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, TitleChanged));

		public AxisElementTitleBase Title
		{
			get
			{
				return (AxisElementTitleBase)GetValue(TitleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TitleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void TitleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AxisElementTitlePanel element = d as AxisElementTitlePanel;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			AxisElementTitleBase title = Title;
			if (title == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (title.ShouldRotate)
			{
				availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Width);
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Measure(availableSize);
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = child.DesiredSize;
					num = Math.Max(desiredSize.Height, num);
					num2 = Math.Max(desiredSize.Width, num2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (UIElement child2 in base.Children)
				{
					child2.Measure(availableSize);
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize2 = child2.DesiredSize;
					num = Math.Max(desiredSize2.Width, num);
					num2 = Math.Max(desiredSize2.Height, num2);
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			AxisElementTitleBase title = Title;
			if (title == null)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			}
			if (title.ShouldRotate)
			{
				double width = arrangeBounds.Width;
				double height = arrangeBounds.Height;
				base.RenderTransform = new RotateTransform
				{
					Angle = title.RotateAngle
				};
				base.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5);
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = child.DesiredSize;
					double width2 = desiredSize.Width;
					double height2 = desiredSize.Height;
					child.Arrange(new Rect((width - width2) / 2.0, (height - height2) / 2.0 - 1.0, width2, height2));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.RenderTransform = new MatrixTransform
				{
					Matrix = Matrix.Identity
				};
				foreach (UIElement child2 in base.Children)
				{
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize2 = child2.DesiredSize;
					child2.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, desiredSize2.Width, desiredSize2.Height));
				}
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}
	}

	[DataAccessMetadata("All", SupportedProcessingModes = "Simple", DataSourceProperty = "DataSource")]
	public class ChartCalculatedField : ChartElement, IChartCalculatedField, ICalculatedField
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FieldNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FieldName", typeof(string), typeof(ChartCalculatedField), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ChartElementHelper.UpdateSeriesBindingWithClearDiagramCache));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FieldTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FieldType", typeof(ChartCalculatedFieldType), typeof(ChartCalculatedField), new PropertyMetadata(ChartCalculatedFieldType.None, ChartElementHelper.UpdateSeriesBindingWithClearDiagramCache));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisplayNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DisplayName", typeof(string), typeof(ChartCalculatedField), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ChartElementHelper.UpdateSeriesBindingWithClearDiagramCache));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ExpressionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Expression", typeof(string), typeof(ChartCalculatedField), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ChartElementHelper.UpdateSeriesBindingWithClearDiagramCache, CoerceExpression));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataSourceProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DataSource", typeof(object), typeof(ChartCalculatedField), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.UpdateSeriesBindingWithClearDiagramCache, CoerceDataSource));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DataMember", typeof(string), typeof(ChartCalculatedField), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ChartElementHelper.UpdateSeriesBindingWithClearDiagramCache));

		private object OwnerDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				IChartElement chartElement = ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner;
				if (chartElement is ChartControl)
				{
					return ((ChartControl)chartElement).ActualDataSource;
				}
				if (chartElement is Series3DDataSourceAdapter)
				{
					return ((Series3DDataSourceAdapter)chartElement).DataSource;
				}
				if (chartElement is SeriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter)
				{
					return ((SeriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter)chartElement).DataSource;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the calculated field’s name.")]

			}

		private static object CoerceExpression(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				CriteriaOperator.Parse((string)value, (object[])null);
				return value;
			}
			catch (CriteriaParserException ex)
			{
				CriteriaParserException ex2 = ex;
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectCalculatedFieldExpression), ex2.Line + 1, ex2.Column));
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceDataSource(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			CoerceExpression(d, ((ChartCalculatedField)d).Expression);
			return value;
		}

			: this(string.Empty)

		}

			: this(name, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public ChartCalculatedField(string name, string expression)
			: this(name, expression, null)
		{
		}

		public ChartCalculatedField(string name, string expression, object dataSource)
		{
			FieldName = name;
			DataSource = dataSource;
			Expression = expression;
		}

	public class ChartCalculatedFieldCollection : ChartElementCollection<ChartCalculatedField>, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField>, IEnumerable
	{
		IEnumerator<ICalculatedField> IEnumerable<ICalculatedField>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<ChartCalculatedField> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return (ICalculatedField)(object)enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> calculatesFieldsNames = CommonUtils.GetCalculatesFieldsNames(this);
			foreach (ChartCalculatedField newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newItem.FieldName))
				{
					string item = (newItem.FieldName = NameGenerator.UniqueName(typeof(ChartCalculatedField).Name, calculatesFieldsNames, useFirstItemIndex: false));
					calculatesFieldsNames.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected static string GetSaveFilePath(string filter, string defaultFileName, string defaultExt)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SaveFileDialogService val = new SaveFileDialogService();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultFileName))
			{
				((FileDialogServiceBase)val).DefaultFileName = defaultFileName;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultExt))
			{
				val.DefaultExt = defaultExt;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
			{
				((FileDialogServiceBase)val).Filter = filter;
			}
			if (((ISaveFileDialogService)val).ShowDialog())
			{
				return ((ISaveFileDialogService)val).GetFullFileName();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected static string GetOpenedFilePath(string filter)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			OpenFileDialogService val = new OpenFileDialogService();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
			{
				((FileDialogServiceBase)val).Filter = filter;
			}
			if (((IOpenDialogServiceBase)val).ShowDialog())
			{
				return ((IOpenFileDialogService)val).GetFullFileName();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected ChartCommandsBase()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected ChartCommandsBase(ChartControlBase chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			SetCurrentValue(ChangePaletteCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand<object>(ChangePalette, CanChangePalette));
			SetCurrentValue(PrintCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(Print, CanPrint));
			SetCurrentValue(PrintPreviewCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(PrintPreview, CanPrintPreview));
			SetCurrentValue(RibbonPrintPreviewCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(RibbonPrintPreview, CanPrintPreview));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToPdfCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToPdf, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToHtmlCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToHtml, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToMhtCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToMht, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToXlsCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToXls, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToXlsxCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToXlsx, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToRtfCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToRtf, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToDocxCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToDocx, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToBmpCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToBmp, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToGifCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToGif, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToJpegCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToJpeg, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToPngCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToPng, CanExport));
			SetCurrentValue(ExportToTiffCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(ExportToTiff, CanExport));
		}

		private string GetPathForExport(string filter)
		{
			return GetSaveFilePath(filter, "Exported DXChart", null);
		}

		private bool CanChangePalette(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(parameter is Type))
			{
				return parameter is Palette;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ChangePalette(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter is Type && Chart.ActualPalette.GetType() != parameter as Type)
			{
				Chart.SetCurrentValue(ChartControlBase.PaletteProperty, (Palette)Activator.CreateInstance(parameter as Type));
			}
			else if (parameter is Palette)
			{
				Chart.SetCurrentValue(ChartControlBase.PaletteProperty, parameter as Palette);
			}
		}

		private bool CanPrint()
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void Print()
		{
			Chart.Print();
		}

			return true;

		[Description("Gets or sets an active series in a chart.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public Series ActiveSeries
		{
			get
			{
				SeriesCollection seriesCollection = Chart.Diagram?.Series;
				if (seriesCollection != null && seriesCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					Series series = (Series)GetValue(ActiveSeriesProperty);
					if (series != null && seriesCollection.Contains(series))
					{
						return series;
					}
					Series series2 = null;
					foreach (Series item in seriesCollection)
					{
						if (item is FinancialSeries2D)
						{
							series2 = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (series2 == null)
					{
						series2 = seriesCollection[0];
					}
					SetCurrentValue(ActiveSeriesProperty, series2);
					return series2;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ActiveSeriesProperty, value);
				NotifyPropertyChanged("AvailableSeriesIndicators");
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public IEnumerable<IndicatorBarItem> AvailableSeriesIndicators
		{
			get
			{
				Series series = ActiveSeries;
				Assembly orLoadAssembly = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly("DevExpress.Charts.Designer.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", false);
				Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(orLoadAssembly, "DevExpress.Charts.Designer.Native.CommandUtils", false, (bool?)null);
				if (knownType != null && knownType.GetMethod("GetIndicatorTypes").Invoke(null, null) is List<IndicatorBarItem> source)
				{
					return source.Where((IndicatorBarItem x) => CommonUtils.IsCompatibleSeriesForIndicator(x.Type, series));
				}
				return new List<IndicatorBarItem>();
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public ChartCommandMode ActualToolbarMode
		{
			get
			{
				return actualToolbarMode;
			}
			set
			{
				ChartCommandMode chartCommandMode = value;
				if (actualToolbarMode != ChartCommandMode.None && actualToolbarMode == chartCommandMode)
				{
					chartCommandMode = ChartCommandMode.None;
				}
				if (actualToolbarMode != chartCommandMode)
				{
					actualToolbarMode = chartCommandMode;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualToolbarMode");
					ChartCommandManipulator.Instance.Update(actualToolbarMode, Chart);
				}
			}
		}

			: this(null)
		{
		}

		internal ChartCommands(ChartControl chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
			SetCurrentValue(RunDesignerCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(RunDesigner, CanRunDesigner));
			SetCurrentValue(SaveToFileCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(SaveToFile, CanSaveToFile));
			SetCurrentValue(LoadFromFileCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(LoadFromFile, CanLoadFromFile));
			SetCurrentValue(DrawTrendLineIndicatorCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(DrawTrendLineIndicator, CanDrawTrendLineIndicator));
			SetCurrentValue(DrawFibonacciArcsIndicatorCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(DrawFibonacciArcsIndicator, CanDrawFibonacciArcsIndicator));
			SetCurrentValue(DrawFibonacciFansIndicatorCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(DrawFibonacciFansIndicator, CanDrawFibonacciFansIndicator));
			SetCurrentValue(DrawFibonacciRetracementIndicatorCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(DrawFibonacciRetracementIndicator, CanDrawFibonacciRetracementIndicator));
			SetCurrentValue(AddTextAnnotationCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(AddTextAnnotation, CanAddTextAnnotation));
			SetCurrentValue(AddImageAnnotationCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(AddImageAnnotation, CanAddImageAnnotation));
			SetCurrentValue(RemoveIndicatorCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(RemoveIndicator, CanRemoveIndicator));
			SetCurrentValue(SetDateTimeAxisUnitCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand<ChartIntervalItem>(SetDateTimeAxisUnit, CanSetDateTimeAxisUnit));
			SetCurrentValue(SetDateTimeAxisPeriodCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand<ChartIntervalItem>(SetDateTimeAxisPeriod, CanSetDateTimeAxisPeriod));
			SetCurrentValue(AddIndicatorCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand<object>(AddIndicator, CanAddIndicator));
			SetCurrentValue(ShowElementPropertiesCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand<object>(ShowElementProperties, CanShowElementProperties));
			SetCurrentValue(ActiveSeriesProperty, null);
			SetCurrentValue(AddHorizontalConstantLineCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(AddHorizontalConstantLine, CanAddHorizontalConstantLine));
			SetCurrentValue(AddVerticalConstantLineCommandProperty, new DelegateCommand(AddVerticalConstantLine, CanAddVerticalConstantLine));
		}

		private MethodInfo GetCommandMethodInfo(string assemblyName, string typeName, string methodName, out object command)
		{
			Assembly orLoadAssembly = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly(assemblyName, false);
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(orLoadAssembly, typeName, false, (bool?)null);
			if (knownType != null)
			{
				command = Activator.CreateInstance(knownType, Chart);
				return knownType.GetMethod(methodName);
			}
			command = null;
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanSetDateTimeAxisUnit(ChartIntervalItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && ActiveSeries is XYSeries2D)
			{
				AxisX2D actualAxisX = ((XYSeries2D)ActiveSeries).ActualAxisX;
				if (actualAxisX.ScaleMap != null && actualAxisX.ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					return actualAxisX.ActualDateTimeScaleOptions is ManualDateTimeScaleOptions;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeAxisUnit(ChartIntervalItem item)
		{
			ManualDateTimeScaleOptions manualDateTimeScaleOptions = (ManualDateTimeScaleOptions)((XYDiagram2D)Chart.Diagram).ActualAxisX.ActualDateTimeScaleOptions;
			manualDateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit = item.MeasureUnit;
			manualDateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier = item.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
		}

		private bool CanSetDateTimeAxisPeriod(ChartIntervalItem item)
		{
			return CanSetDateTimeAxisUnit(item);
		}

		private void SetDateTimeAxisPeriod(ChartIntervalItem item)
		{
			AxisX2D actualAxisX = ((XYDiagram2D)Chart.Diagram).ActualAxisX;
			if (actualAxisX != null && actualAxisX.ActualWholeRange.ActualMaxValue is DateTime)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)actualAxisX.ActualWholeRange.ActualMaxValue;
				actualAxisX.ActualVisualRange.SetMinMaxValues(DateTimeUtilsExt.AddRange(dateTime, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)item.MeasureUnit, -item.MeasureUnitMultiplier), dateTime);
			}
		}

	public class CrosshairAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IInvokeProvider
	{
		protected CrosshairLabelsPanel CrosshairPanel => (CrosshairLabelsPanel)base.Owner;

		public CrosshairAutomationPeer(CrosshairLabelsPanel crosshairPanel)
			: base(crosshairPanel)
		{
		}

		void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
		{
		}

		private string GetActualText(CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData presentation)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(presentation.Text))
			{
				return presentation.Text;
			}
			return presentation.HeaderText;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			if (!(CrosshairPanel.DataContext is Diagram { CrosshairSeriesLabelItems: var crosshairSeriesLabelItems }))
			{
				return base.GetNameCore();
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesLabelItem item in crosshairSeriesLabelItems)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData presentationDatum in item.PresentationData)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(GetActualText(presentationDatum));
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Invoke)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Custom;
		}

		protected override bool IsContentElementCore()
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

		private static void PalettePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartControlBase chartControlBase)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as Palette, e.NewValue as Palette, chartControlBase);
				chartControlBase.UpdateActualPalette(e.NewValue as Palette);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateChartPaletteWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void CrosshairEnabledPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartControlBase chartControlBase)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "CrosshairEnabled"));
				chartControlBase.CrosshairEnabledChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void AutoLayoutPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartControlBase chartControlBase)
			{
				chartControlBase.actualAutoLayout = (bool)e.NewValue;
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(chartControlBase);
			}
		}

		private static void LegendsSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<ChartControlBase, Legend>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged(d, e, LegendsAttachedBehaviorProperty, LegendItemTemplateProperty, LegendItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DependencyProperty)null, (Func<ChartControlBase, IList>)((ChartControlBase chart) => chart.Legends), (Func<ChartControlBase, Legend>)((ChartControlBase chart) => new Legend()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<Legend>)null, d.GetValue(LegendsProperty) as ISupportInitialize, (Action<Legend, object>)TagUtils.AttachTagToChartElement, true, true, (Func<Legend, bool>)null, false);
			if (d is ChartControl chartControl)
			{
				chartControl.LegendItemsSourcePropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void LegendItemTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<ChartControlBase, Legend>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged(d, e, LegendsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		protected static void CrosshairOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartControlBase chartControlBase)
			{
				chartControlBase.CrosshairOptionsChanged(e.NewValue);
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as CrosshairOptionsBase, e.NewValue as CrosshairOptionsBase, chartControlBase);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
			}
		}

		protected static void CommandsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				((ChartCommandsBase)e.OldValue).Owner = null;
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((ChartCommandsBase)e.NewValue).Owner = d as ChartControlBase;
			}
		}

		public ChartControlBase()
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ChartControlBase>(this);
			DXSerializer.AddCustomGetSerializablePropertiesHandler((DependencyObject)this, new CustomGetSerializablePropertiesEventHandler(CustomPropertiesSerializationUtils.SerializableBaseFontProperties));
			SetValue(TitlesPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ChartTitleCollection>(this));
			SetValue(LegendsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<LegendCollection>(this));
			legendsCollectionsManager = new SplitCollectionManager<LegendBase>(Legends);
			base.LayoutUpdated += ChartControl_LayoutUpdated;
			base.SizeChanged += ChartControl_SizeChanged;
			base.SnapsToDevicePixels = true;
			UpdateActualPalette(null);
			actualAutoLayout = AutoLayout;
			HitTestController = CreateHitTestController();
			SetValue(ChartProperty, this);
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			if ((args.Change & ChartElementChange.UpdateChartPalette) != ChartElementChange.None)
			{
				return !TryUpdatePalette();
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
				AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			if (logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Remove(child);
				RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType != typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sender is CrosshairOptionsBase)
			{
				if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs)
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo(sender, ((PropertyChangedEventArgs)e).PropertyName));
				}
				else
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				}
				return true;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
			return true;
		}

		Rect IDockTarget.GetBounds()
		{

		}

		void IPrintableControl.PagePrintedCallback(IEnumerator pageBrickEnumerator, Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> brickUpdaters)
		{
			while (pageBrickEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = pageBrickEnumerator.Current;
				ImageBrick val = (ImageBrick)((current is ImageBrick) ? current : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((BrickBase)val).NoClip = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ChartControl_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
			if (inPrinting)
			{
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		private void ChartControl_LayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if (shouldInvalidate <= (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.MeasureDiagram) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(this);
				}
				InvalidateItems(shouldInvalidate);
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.Legend) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					foreach (Legend legend in Legends)
					{
						if (!legend.Visible.HasValue)
						{
							CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(legend);
						}
					}
				}
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.Titles) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					foreach (Title title in Titles)
					{
						if (!title.Visible.HasValue)
						{
							CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(title);
						}
					}
				}
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.Annotations) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					InvalidateAnnotationsPanel();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				shouldInvalidate = (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0;
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePrintSizeMode(PrintSizeMode? sizeMode)

		private PrintSizeMode CalculateActualPrintSizeMode()
		{
			if (userPrintSizeMode.HasValue)
			{
				return userPrintSizeMode.Value;
			}
			if (PrintOptions != null)
			{
				return PrintOptions.SizeMode;
			}
			return PrintSizeMode.None;
		}

		}

		private Rect CorrectBoundsByScreenSize(GRealRect2D initialBounds, GRealSize2D boundsSize)
		{
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				initialBounds = new GRealRect2D(base.ActualWidth - initialBounds.Left, initialBounds.Top, initialBounds.Width, initialBounds.Height);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = (inPrinting ? default(System.Windows.Point) : ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(this));
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				point = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - base.ActualWidth, point.Y);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point2 = CalculateLocalScreenPosition(new System.Windows.Point(initialBounds.Left, initialBounds.Top));
			System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(point2.X - 16.0, point2.Y - 16.0);
			if (point3.X < 0.0)
			{
				point.X -= point3.X;
			}
			if (point3.Y < 0.0)
			{
				point3.Y -= point.Y;
			}
			return new Rect(initialBounds.Left + point.X, initialBounds.Top + point.Y, boundsSize.Width, boundsSize.Height);
		}

		protected void HideForcedCrosshairCore()
		{
			bool crosshairForced = CrosshairForced;
			CrosshairForced = false;
			if (crosshairForced)
			{
				HideCrosshairCore();
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size empty = System.Windows.Size.Empty;
			try
			{
				isMeasuring = true;
				ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
				if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width))
				{
					constraint.Width = Math.Max(300.0, base.ActualWidth);
				}
				if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
				{
					constraint.Height = Math.Max(300.0, base.ActualHeight);
				}
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			finally
			{
				isMeasuring = false;
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateChartElementPanel()
		{
			ChartElementPanelBase element = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement frameworkElement) => frameworkElement is ChartElementPanelBase)) as ChartElementPanelBase;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
		}

		internal void AddInvalidate(InvalidateMeasureFlags flags)
		{
			shouldInvalidate |= flags;
		}

		internal void UpdateLegends()
		{
			legendsCollectionsManager.ClearTargetCollections();
			if (elementItemsControl != null)
			{
				ChartTargetLegendsCollection legends = elementItemsControl.Legends;
				if (legends != null)
				{
					legends.ShouldContainsAllLegends = IsSingleLegendsTarget;
					legendsCollectionsManager.TargetCollections.Add(legends);
				}
			}
			UpdateLegendsCollection();
			legendsCollectionsManager.UpdateCollections();
			if (elementItemsControl != null)
			{
				elementItemsControl.Update();
			}
			InvalidateChartElementPanel();
			InvalidateLegends();
		}

		internal void HideForcedCrosshair()
		{
			if (!IsCrosshairHideManually)
			{
				HideForcedCrosshairCore();
			}
		}

		internal void ForceCrosshair()
		{
			CrosshairForced = true;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Point CalculateLocalScreenPosition(System.Windows.Point controlAnchorPosition)
		{
			System.Windows.Point screenPoint = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(this);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(screenPoint.X + controlAnchorPosition.X, screenPoint.Y + controlAnchorPosition.Y);
			Rect focusedScreenRect = ChartScreenHelper.GetFocusedScreenRect(point, this);
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X - focusedScreenRect.X, point.Y - focusedScreenRect.Y);
		}

		internal GRealRect2D CalculateCrosshairLabelsConstraint(System.Windows.Point controlAnchorPosition)
		{
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				controlAnchorPosition = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - controlAnchorPosition.X, controlAnchorPosition.Y);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(this);
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				point = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - base.ActualWidth, point.Y);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + controlAnchorPosition.X, point.Y + controlAnchorPosition.Y);
			Rect screenRect = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenRect(point2);
			return new GRealRect2D(screenRect.X - point.X, screenRect.Y - point.Y, screenRect.Width, screenRect.Height);
		}

		internal void UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabelItems(IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesLabelItem> crosshairSeriesLabelItems)
		{
			if (PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesLabelItem crosshairSeriesLabelItem in crosshairSeriesLabelItems)
			{
				IAnnotationLayout layout = crosshairSeriesLabelItem.Layout;
				double num = 16.0;
				double num2 = 16.0;
				if (layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.TopRight || layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomRight)
				{
					num = 0.0 - num;
				}
				if (layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft || layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomRight)
				{
					num2 = 0.0 - num2;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = ChartScreenHelper.CorrectPointByTransform(new System.Windows.Point(layout.Bounds.Left + num, layout.Bounds.Top + num2), this);
				crosshairSeriesLabelItem.Bounds = CorrectBoundsByScreenSize(new GRealRect2D(point.X, point.Y, layout.Bounds.Width, layout.Bounds.Height), layout.Size);
				crosshairSeriesLabelItem.UpdateLayoutProperties();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateCrosshairPanelLayout()
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)crosshairPanel, (UIElement)this);
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(crosshairPanel);
			crosshairPanel.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(relativeElementRect.Width - 1.0, relativeElementRect.Height - 1.0));
			crosshairPanel.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, relativeElementRect.Width - 1.0, relativeElementRect.Height - 1.0));
			crosshairPanel.Measure(relativeElementRect.Size);
			crosshairPanel.Arrange(relativeElementRect);
		}

		internal void InvalidateCrosshairPanels()
		{
			if (CrosshairLabelsPanel != null)
			{
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(CrosshairLabelsPanel);
			}
			if (CrosshairAxisLabelsPanel != null)
			{
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(CrosshairAxisLabelsPanel);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveLegendByTag(object tag)

			Legend legendByTag = GetLegendByTag(tag);
			Legends.Remove(legendByTag);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			crosshairPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_CrosshairLabelsContainer") as FrameworkElement;
			crosshairLabelsPanel = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType<CrosshairLabelsPanel>((FrameworkElement)this, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null);
			crosshairAxisLabelsPanel = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType<CrosshairAxisLabelsPanel>((FrameworkElement)this, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null);
			elementItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("ChartElements") as ChartElementItemsControl;
			UpdateLegends();
		}

		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			base.EndInit();
			EndInitSeries();
			Loading = false;
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new OnLoadEndUpdateInfo(this), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateChartBinding | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
		}

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	[NonCategorized]
	public class ChartDataTable : Canvas
	{
		private class DataTableLegendItem
		{
			public System.Windows.Media.Color Color { get; set; }

			public string Text { get; set; }

			public LegendItemType LegendItemType { get; set; }
		}

		private enum LegendItemType
		{
			Square,
			Line
		}

		public const double TextMargin = 4.0;

		public const double LegendMarkerSize = 12.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FontFamilyProperty = TextElement.FontFamilyProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ChartDataTable), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemFonts.MessageFontFamily, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FontSizeProperty = TextElement.FontSizeProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ChartDataTable), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemFonts.MessageFontSize, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ForegroundProperty = TextElement.ForegroundProperty.AddOwner(typeof(ChartDataTable), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemColors.ControlTextBrush, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(ChartDataTable));

		private List<double> ColCoords { get; set; }

		private List<double> RowCoords { get; set; }

		private List<DataTableLegendItem> LegendItems { get; set; }

		private double RowHeight { get; set; }

		private double TextHeight { get; set; }

		private List<List<string>> TableTextData { get; set; }

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public Rect Bounds { get; private set; }

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public bool Visible { get; set; }

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public int VerticalIndent { get; set; } = 15;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public bool ShowBorder { get; set; } = true;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public bool ShowLegendMarker { get; set; } = true;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public bool ShowHorizontalLines { get; set; } = true;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public bool ShowVerticalLines { get; set; } = true;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public LineStyle LineStyle { get; set; }

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public IAxisLabelFormatter ArgumentFormatter { get; set; } = new DummyArgumentFormatter();

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush LineBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(LineBrushProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(LineBrushProperty, value);

		private static Tuple<List<double>, List<double>> CalculateRowColCoords(Rect bounds, double rowHeight, double firstColWidth, int dataColCount)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double> { 0.0 };
			double num = (bounds.Width - firstColWidth) / (double)dataColCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataColCount; i++)
			{
				double item = firstColWidth + (double)i * num;
				list.Add(item);
			}
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>();
			double num2 = bounds.Height / rowHeight;
			for (int j = 0; (double)j < num2; j++)
			{
				double item2 = (double)j * rowHeight;
				list2.Add(item2);
			}
			return new Tuple<List<double>, List<double>>(list, list2);
		}

		private static string Format(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		internal ChartDataTable()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ChartDataTable>(this);
			XYDiagram2D.SetElementType(this, XYDiagram2DElementType.ChartDataTable);
			RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, EdgeMode.Aliased);
			RenderOptions.SetBitmapScalingMode(this, BitmapScalingMode.NearestNeighbor);
			LineStyle = new LineStyle(1);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(LineBrush, LineStyle.Thickness);
			pen.DashStyle = LineStyle.DashStyle;
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		private void RenderBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreatePen();
			List<double> colCoords = ColCoords;
			List<double> rowCoords = RowCoords;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(colCoords[1], 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(Bounds.Width, 0.0);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, rowCoords[1]);
			point2 = new System.Windows.Point(Bounds.Width, rowCoords[1]);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, Bounds.Height);
			point2 = new System.Windows.Point(Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, rowCoords[1]);
			point2 = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, Bounds.Height);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(colCoords[1], 0.0);
			point2 = new System.Windows.Point(colCoords[1], Bounds.Height);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(Bounds.Width, 0.0);
			point2 = new System.Windows.Point(Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
		}

		private void RenderHorizontalLines(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreatePen();
			for (int i = 2; i < RowCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, RowCoords[i]);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(Bounds.Width, RowCoords[i]);
				dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			}
		}

		private void RenderVerticalLines(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreatePen();
			for (int i = 2; i < ColCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(ColCoords[i], 0.0);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(ColCoords[i], Bounds.Height);
				dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			}
		}

		private void RenderTableText(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (ColCoords.Count > 2)
			{
				num = ColCoords[2] - ColCoords[1];
			}
			else if (ColCoords.Count > 1)
			{
				num = Bounds.Width - ColCoords[1];
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < ColCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < RowCoords.Count; j++)
				{
					string textToFormat = TableTextData[i - 1][j];
					Typeface typeface = new Typeface(FontFamily.ToString());
					FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(textToFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, base.FlowDirection, typeface, FontSize, Foreground);
					formattedText.MaxLineCount = 1;
					double num2 = num - 8.0;
					formattedText.MaxTextWidth = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.1);
					double x = ColCoords[i] + (num - formattedText.Width) / 2.0;
					System.Windows.Point origin = new System.Windows.Point(x, RowCoords[j] + 4.0);
					dc.DrawText(formattedText, origin);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RenderLegendItems(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < LegendItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (ShowLegendMarker)
				{
					double x = 4.0;
					double num = RowCoords[i + 1] + (RowHeight - 12.0) / 2.0;
					System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(LegendItems[i].Color);
					brush.Freeze();
					Rect rectangle;
					if (LegendItems[i].LegendItemType == LegendItemType.Square)
					{
						rectangle = new Rect(x, num, 12.0, 12.0);
					}
					else
					{
						num = num + 6.0 - 1.0;
						rectangle = new Rect(x, num, 12.0, 2.0);
					}
					dc.DrawRectangle(brush, null, rectangle);
				}
				Typeface typeface = new Typeface(FontFamily.ToString());
				FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(LegendItems[i].Text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, base.FlowDirection, typeface, FontSize, Foreground);
				double num2 = 4.0;
				if (ShowLegendMarker)
				{
					num2 += 16.0;
				}
				double y = RowCoords[i + 1] + (RowHeight - TextHeight) / 2.0;
				dc.DrawText(formattedText, new System.Windows.Point(num2, y));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (RowCoords != null && ColCoords != null)
			{
				if (ShowBorder)
				{
					RenderBorder(dc);
				}
				if (ShowHorizontalLines)
				{
					RenderHorizontalLines(dc);
				}
				if (ShowVerticalLines)
				{
					RenderVerticalLines(dc);
				}
				RenderLegendItems(dc);
				RenderTableText(dc);
			}
		}

		private object GetValue(ISeriesPointValues values)
		{
			return values.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => values.DateTimeValues[0], 
				Scale.Numerical => values.NumericalValues[0], 
				Scale.TimeSpan => values.TimeSpanValues[0], 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Impossible to get value for DataTable"), 
			};
		}

		internal void CreateChartDataTableData(IList<SeriesItem> seriesItems)
		{
			Dictionary<string, List<object>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<object>>();
			LegendItems = new List<DataTableLegendItem>(seriesItems.Count);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (SeriesItem seriesItem in seriesItems)
			{
				IList<RefinedPoint> points = seriesItem.RefinedSeries.Points;
				DataTableLegendItem item = new DataTableLegendItem
				{
					Text = seriesItem.Series.DisplayName,
					Color = seriesItem.DrawOptions.Color,
					LegendItemType = ((seriesItem.Series.GetType().ToString().Contains("Line") || seriesItem.Series.GetType().ToString().Contains("Spline")) ? LegendItemType.Line : LegendItemType.Square)
				};
				LegendItems.Add(item);
				foreach (RefinedPoint item3 in points)
				{
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = item3.SeriesPoint;
					string axisLabelText = ArgumentFormatter.GetAxisLabelText(seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument);
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(axisLabelText, out var value))
					{
						List<object> list = (dictionary[axisLabelText] = new object[seriesItems.Count].ToList());
						value = list;
					}
					value[num] = GetValue(seriesPoint.Values);
				}
				num++;
			}
			List<List<string>> list3 = new List<List<string>>(dictionary.Keys.Count);
			foreach (string key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				List<object> list4 = dictionary[key];
				List<string> list5 = new List<string>(list4.Count) { key };
				foreach (object item4 in list4)
				{
					string item2 = Format(item4);
					list5.Add(item2);
				}
				list3.Add(list5);
			}
			TableTextData = list3;
		}

		internal Rect ArrangeDataTable(Rect newViewPort, System.Windows.Size paneSize, IList<SeriesItem> seriesItems)
		{
			if (TableTextData == null || TableTextData.Count == 0 || TableTextData[0].Count == 0)
			{
				return newViewPort;
			}
			string typefaceName = FontFamily.ToString();
			double fontSize = FontSize;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (SeriesItem seriesItem in seriesItems)
			{
				double width = StringMeasurer.MeasureString(seriesItem.Series.DisplayName, typefaceName, fontSize).Width;
				if (width > num)
				{
					num = width;
				}
			}
			double num2 = num + 8.0;
			if (ShowLegendMarker)
			{
				num2 += 16.0;
			}
			if (num2 > newViewPort.Width)
			{
				num2 = newViewPort.Width;
			}
			TextHeight = StringMeasurer.GetFontHeight(typefaceName, fontSize);
			RowHeight = Math.Max(TextHeight + 8.0, 12.0);
			double num3 = RowHeight * (double)(seriesItems.Count + 1);
			double num4 = num2 - newViewPort.Left;
			if (num4 <= 0.0)
			{
				num4 = 0.0;
			}
			double num5 = newViewPort.Height - num3 - (double)VerticalIndent;
			num5 = ((num5 < 0.0) ? 0.0 : num5);
			Bounds = new Rect(1.0, paneSize.Height - num3, paneSize.Width - 1.0, num3);
			Tuple<List<double>, List<double>> tuple = CalculateRowColCoords(Bounds, RowHeight, num2, TableTextData.Count);
			ColCoords = tuple.Item1;
			RowCoords = tuple.Item2;
			return new Rect(newViewPort.X + num4, newViewPort.Y, newViewPort.Width - num4, num5);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartDependencyObject : Freezable, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		[Description("Occurs every time any of the ChartDependencyObject class properties has changed its value.")]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected static void NotifyPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartDependencyObject chartDependencyObject)
			{
				chartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(e.Property));
			}
		}

		protected abstract ChartDependencyObject CreateObject();

		protected void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			ChartDependencyObject chartDependencyObject = CreateObject();
			if (chartDependencyObject == null)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("ChartDependencyObject is expected");
			}
			return chartDependencyObject;
		}
	}
	public interface ISupportPalette
	{
		Palette GetPalette();
	}

	{
		bool ShowInLegend { get; }

	}
	public abstract class ChartColorizerBase : ChartDependencyObject
	{
		public abstract System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object colorKey, Palette palette);

		public virtual System.Windows.Media.Color? GetAggregatedPointColor(object argument, List<object> values, List<SeriesPoint> points, Palette palette)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<System.Windows.Media.Color> source = from p in points
				select p.Brush into b
				where b != null
				select b.Color;
			if (!source.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (from c in source
				group c by c into g
				orderby g.Count() descending
				select g).First().Key;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartPaletteColorizerBase : ChartColorizerBase, ISupportPalette
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PaletteProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Palette", typeof(Palette), typeof(ChartPaletteColorizerBase));

		private PaletteColorizerBehavior colorizerBehavior;

		protected PaletteColorizerBehavior ColorizerBehavior => colorizerBehavior;

		[Description("Gets or sets a palette used by this class’ descendants.")]

		public Palette Palette
		{
			get
			{
				return (Palette)GetValue(PaletteProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PaletteProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected ChartPaletteColorizerBase()
		{
			colorizerBehavior = CreateColorizerBehavior();
		}

		protected abstract PaletteColorizerBehavior CreateColorizerBehavior();

		Palette ISupportPalette.GetPalette()
		{
			return Palette;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LegendSupportColorizerBase : ChartPaletteColorizerBase, ILegendItemsProvider

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowInLegendProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowInLegend", typeof(bool), typeof(LegendSupportColorizerBase), new PropertyMetadata(true));

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend text pattern used to set up text displaying in a legend.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]

		public string LegendTextPattern

				return (string)GetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty);

			{
				SetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that indicates whether to show colorizer based legend items in the legend.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowInLegendProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowInLegendProperty, value);
			}
		}

		bool ILegendItemsProvider.ShowInLegend => ShowInLegend;

		private static void OnLegendTextPatternChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			LegendSupportColorizerBase legendSupportColorizerBase = d as LegendSupportColorizerBase;
			legendSupportColorizerBase.ColorizerBehavior.LegendItemPattern = e.NewValue as string;
		}

		protected string CreateLegendItemText(params object[] contexts)
		{
			return base.ColorizerBehavior.CreateLegendItemText(contexts);
		}

		List<ColorizerLegendItem> ILegendItemsProvider.GetLegendItems(Palette palette)
		{
			return base.ColorizerBehavior.GetLegendItems(palette, null);
		}
	}

	public class KeyColorColorizer : LegendSupportColorizerBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeyProviderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("KeyProvider", typeof(IColorizerKeyProvider), typeof(KeyColorColorizer), new PropertyMetadata(OnKeyProviderChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeysProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Keys", typeof(ColorizerKeysCollection), typeof(KeyColorColorizer), new PropertyMetadata(OnKeysPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Gets or sets the key provider to the KeyColorColorizer.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public IColorizerKeyProvider KeyProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (IColorizerKeyProvider)GetValue(KeyProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeyProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the collection of keys used by the KeyColorColorizer.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public ColorizerKeysCollection Keys
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColorizerKeysCollection)GetValue(KeysProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeysProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private KeyColorizerBehavior KeyBehavior => (KeyColorizerBehavior)base.ColorizerBehavior;

		private static void OnKeysPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is KeyColorColorizer keyColorColorizer)
			{
				ColorizerKeysCollection colorizerKeysCollection = e.NewValue as ColorizerKeysCollection;
				keyColorColorizer.KeyBehavior.Keys = colorizerKeysCollection;
				keyColorColorizer.SubscribeKeyChanged(e.OldValue as ColorizerKeysCollection, colorizerKeysCollection);
			}
		}

		private static void OnKeyProviderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is KeyColorColorizer keyColorColorizer)
			{
				keyColorColorizer.KeyBehavior.KeyProvider = e.NewValue as IColorizerKeyProvider;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeKeyChanged(ColorizerKeysCollection oldValue, ColorizerKeysCollection newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CollectionChanged -= KeyCollectionChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.CollectionChanged += KeyCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void KeyCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			KeyBehavior.InvalidateKeys();
			NotifyPropertyChanged("Keys");
		}

		public KeyColorColorizer()
		{
			SetValue(KeysProperty, new ColorizerKeysCollection());
			SetValue(LegendSupportColorizerBase.LegendTextPatternProperty, "{V}");
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new KeyColorColorizer();
		}

		protected override PaletteColorizerBehavior CreateColorizerBehavior()
		{
			return new KeyColorizerBehavior();
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object colorKey, Palette palette)
		{
			return KeyBehavior.GetColor(colorKey, palette);
		}
	}
	public class ColorizerKeysCollection : ObservableCollection<object>
	{
		internal ColorizerKeysCollection Clone()
		{
			ColorizerKeysCollection colorizerKeysCollection = new ColorizerKeysCollection();
			using IEnumerator<object> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = enumerator.Current;
				colorizerKeysCollection.Add(current);
			}
			return colorizerKeysCollection;
		}
	}
	public class ObjectKeyProvider : ChartDependencyObject, IColorizerKeyProvider
	{
		object IColorizerKeyProvider.GetKey(object item)
		{
			return item;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ObjectKeyProvider();
		}
	}

		double GetValue(object obj);

		private readonly IColorizerValueProvider defaultValueProvider = new NumericColorizerValueProvider();

		private IColorizerValueProvider ActualValueProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (ValueProvider == null)

					return defaultValueProvider;

				return ValueProvider;

		{
			get
			{
				if (Background != null)
				{
					return Background;
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = null;
				if (AppearanceProvider != null)
				{
					brush = AppearanceProvider.LineBrush;
				}
				if (brush == null)
				{
					return crosshairLabelDefaultBackground;
				}
				return brush;
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualForeground
		{
			get
			{
				if (Foreground != null)
				{
					return Foreground;

				return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
			}
		}

		{

				return AppearanceProvider.FontFamily;
			}
		}

		internal double ActualFontSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (FontSize != 0.0)

					return FontSize;
				}
				return AppearanceProvider.FontSize;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!(FontStretch == FontStretches.Normal))
				{
					return FontStretch;
				}
				return AppearanceProvider.FontStretch;
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.FontStyle ActualFontStyle
		{
			get

					return FontStyle;
				}
				return AppearanceProvider.FontStyle;
			}
		}

		internal FontWeight ActualFontWeight
		{

			{
				if (!(FontWeight == FontWeights.Normal))

					return FontWeight;
				}
				return AppearanceProvider.FontWeight;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new CrosshairAxisLabelOptions();
		}

		internal FontSettings CreateFont()
		{
			return new FontSettings(ActualFontFamily, ActualFontStretch, ActualFontWeight, ActualFontStyle, ActualFontSize, ActualForeground);

	[NonCategorized]
	public class CrosshairDrawInfo
	{
		private readonly XYDiagram2D diagram;

		private readonly CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions;

		private readonly CrosshairLineElement cursorLineElement;

		private readonly List<CrosshairElementGroup> crosshairElementGroups;

		private readonly List<CrosshairPaneDrawInfo> paneElements;

		private readonly List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> cursorAxisLabelElements;

		private readonly Dictionary<CrosshairElementGroup, CrosshairLabelInfo> groupsLabelsMapping;

		private readonly List<CrosshairLegendElement> legendElements;

		private readonly List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> indicatorLegendElements;

		private readonly List<CrosshairLegendElementBase> actualLegendElements;

		internal IEnumerable<CrosshairLegendElementBase> ActualLegendElements
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (CrosshairLegendElement legendElement in legendElements)
				{
					yield return legendElement;
				}
				foreach (CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement indicatorLegendElement in indicatorLegendElements)
				{
					yield return indicatorLegendElement;
				}
				foreach (CrosshairLegendElementBase actualLegendElement in actualLegendElements)
				{
					yield return actualLegendElement;
				}
			}
		}

		public CrosshairLineElement CursorLineElement => cursorLineElement;

		public List<CrosshairElementGroup> CrosshairElementGroups => crosshairElementGroups;

		public List<CrosshairPaneDrawInfo> PaneElements => paneElements;

		public List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> CrosshairAxisLabelElements => cursorAxisLabelElements;

		public List<CrosshairLegendElement> LegendElements => legendElements;

		public List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> IndicatorLegendElements => indicatorLegendElements;

		public CrosshairDrawInfo(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.crosshairOptions = crosshairOptions;
			crosshairElementGroups = new List<CrosshairElementGroup>();
			paneElements = new List<CrosshairPaneDrawInfo>();
			cursorAxisLabelElements = new List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement>();
			cursorLineElement = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions, crosshairOptions.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapMode.NearestValue);
			groupsLabelsMapping = new Dictionary<CrosshairElementGroup, CrosshairLabelInfo>();
			legendElements = new List<CrosshairLegendElement>();
			actualLegendElements = new List<CrosshairLegendElementBase>();
			indicatorLegendElements = new List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement>();
		}

		private void AddPointInfos(Dictionary<Pane, List<CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo>> panesElementsDrawInfo, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts, FontSettings seriesLabelFont, List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> points, CrosshairElementGroup elementGroup)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase point in points)
			{
				CrosshairElementBase crosshairElementBase = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairElementBase(point, crosshairOptions, seriesLabelFont, axesFonts);
				if (elementGroup != null)
				{
					crosshairElementBase.AddToGroup(elementGroup);
				}
				Pane key = (Pane)crosshairElementBase.Pane;
				if (panesElementsDrawInfo.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value.Add(new CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo(crosshairElementBase, point.CrosshairLine, point.CrosshairAxisInfo));
					continue;
				}
				value = new List<CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo>();
				value.Add(new CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo(crosshairElementBase, point.CrosshairLine, point.CrosshairAxisInfo));
				panesElementsDrawInfo.Add(key, value);
			}
		}

		public void SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChangedHandler)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairElementGroups)
			{
				crosshairElementGroup.SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(collectionChangedHandler);
			}
		}

		public void UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChangedHandler)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairElementGroups)
			{
				crosshairElementGroup.UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(collectionChangedHandler);
			}
		}

		public void AddCrosshairPaneInfo(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairInfo, Pane pane, Dictionary<Pane, List<CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo>> panesElementsDrawInfo, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			CrosshairPaneDrawInfo crosshairPaneDrawInfo = new CrosshairPaneDrawInfo(pane, crosshairInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine, crosshairInfo.CursorValueCrossLine);
			foreach (CrosshairAxisInfo item in crosshairInfo.CursorAxesInfo)
			{
				CrosshairAxisLabelElement crosshairAxisLabelElement = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(crosshairOptions, item, axesFonts);
				crosshairPaneDrawInfo.CursorAxesInfo.Add(crosshairAxisLabelElement, item);
				cursorAxisLabelElements.Add(crosshairAxisLabelElement);
			}
			FontSettings fontSettings = diagram.CreateCrosshairSeriesLabelFont();
			foreach (CrosshairLabelInfo item2 in crosshairInfo.LabelsInfo)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairPointsGroup pointGroup in item2.PointGroups)
				{
					CrosshairGroupHeaderElement headerElement = CrosshairElementFactory.CreateGroupHeaderElement(pointGroup, fontSettings);
					CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup = new CrosshairElementGroup(headerElement);
					AddPointInfos(panesElementsDrawInfo, axesFonts, fontSettings, pointGroup.Points, crosshairElementGroup);
					crosshairElementGroups.Add(crosshairElementGroup);
					groupsLabelsMapping.Add(crosshairElementGroup, item2);
				}
			}
			AddPointInfos(panesElementsDrawInfo, axesFonts, fontSettings, crosshairInfo.LegendSeriesPoints, null);
			paneElements.Add(crosshairPaneDrawInfo);
		}

		public void AddCrosshairLegendElements(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPoint seriesLegendPoint in crosshairInfo.SeriesLegendPoints)
			{
				CrosshairLegendElement crosshairLegendElement = CrosshairLegendElementFactory.CreateCrosshairLegendElement(seriesLegendPoint, crosshairOptions, axesFonts);
				if (crosshairLegendElement != null)
				{
					legendElements.Add(crosshairLegendElement);
				}
			}
			foreach (CrosshairIndicatorPoint indicatorLegendPoint in crosshairInfo.IndicatorLegendPoints)
			{
				indicatorLegendElements.Add(CrosshairLegendElementFactory.CreateCrosshairIndicatorLegendElement(indicatorLegendPoint, crosshairOptions, axesFonts));
			}
			foreach (CrosshairLegendPoint emptyLegendPoint in crosshairInfo.EmptyLegendPoints)
			{
				actualLegendElements.Add(CrosshairLegendElementFactory.CreateCrosshairEmptyLegendElement(emptyLegendPoint, crosshairOptions, axesFonts));
			}
		}

		public CrosshairLabelInfo GetGroupLabelInfo(CrosshairElementGroup group)
		{
			CrosshairLabelInfo value = null;
			groupsLabelsMapping.TryGetValue(group, out value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class CrosshairLinesRenderControl : FrameworkElement
	{
		private class PenCacheKey
		{
			private readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

			private readonly LineStyle lineStyle;

			public PenCacheKey(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, LineStyle lineStyle)
			{
				this.brush = brush;
				this.lineStyle = lineStyle;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<System.Windows.Media.Brush, LineStyle>(brush, lineStyle);
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is PenCacheKey penCacheKey))
				{
					return base.Equals(obj);
				}
				if (penCacheKey.lineStyle == lineStyle)
				{
					return penCacheKey.brush == brush;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineItemsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData>), typeof(CrosshairLinesRenderControl));

		public ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData> LineItems
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData>)GetValue(LineItemsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineItemsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CloneBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush)
		{
			return sourceBrush?.CloneCurrentValue();
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(Dictionary<PenCacheKey, System.Windows.Media.Pen> pensCache, CrosshairLinePresentationData presentationData)
		{
			PenCacheKey key = new PenCacheKey(presentationData.Brush, presentationData.LineStyle);
			if (!pensCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return CreatePen(presentationData);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen(CrosshairLinePresentationData lineData)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = CloneBrush(lineData.Brush);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = ((lineData.LineStyle == null) ? new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, 1.0) : lineData.LineStyle.CreatePen(brush));
			pen.EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Square;
			pen.StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Square;
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			Dictionary<PenCacheKey, System.Windows.Media.Pen> pensCache = new Dictionary<PenCacheKey, System.Windows.Media.Pen>();
			foreach (CrosshairLinePresentationData lineItem in LineItems)
			{
				LineRenderer lineRenderer = new LineRenderer(new System.Windows.Point(lineItem.X1, lineItem.Y1), new System.Windows.Point(lineItem.X2, lineItem.Y2));
				lineRenderer.Render(drawingContext, GetPen(pensCache, lineItem));
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeLineItems(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class MarkerItem : DependencyObject, IWeakEventListener, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private LineStyle markerLineStyle;

		private ILegendVisible representedElement;

		private DataTemplate markerTemplate;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush markerLineBrush;

		[Description("Gets or sets the brush used to visualize the item marker.")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush MarkerBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return markerBrush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!EqualBrushes(markerBrush, value))
				{
					markerBrush = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("MarkerBrush");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualMarkerBrush");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the marker line brush of the item.")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush MarkerLineBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return markerLineBrush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!EqualBrushes(markerLineBrush, value))
				{
					markerLineBrush = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("MarkerLineBrush");
					NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualMarkerLineBrush");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the template used to visualize the item marker.")]
		public DataTemplate MarkerTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return markerTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				if (markerTemplate != value)
				{
					markerTemplate = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("MarkerTemplate");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the style of the item marker line.")]
		public LineStyle MarkerLineStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return markerLineStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (markerLineStyle != value)
				{
					CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(markerLineStyle, value, this);
					markerLineStyle = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("MarkerLineStyle");
					OnLineThicknessChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the chart element which is represented by the item.")]
		public ILegendVisible RepresentedElement
		{
			get
			{
				return representedElement;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (representedElement != value)
				{
					representedElement = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("RepresentedElement");
				}
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public double ActualLineThickness => GetActualLineThickness();

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush OpacityMask => GetOpacityMask();

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualMarkerBrush => GetActualMarkerBrush();

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualMarkerLineBrush => GetActualMarkerLineBrush();

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Thickness ActualMarkerMargin => GetActualMarkerMargin();

		[Description("Occurs every time any of the MarkerItem class properties has changed its value.")]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected MarkerItem(ILegendVisible browsableObject, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerLineBrush, LineStyle markerLineStyle)
		{
			representedElement = browsableObject;
			this.markerBrush = markerBrush;
			this.markerLineBrush = markerLineBrush;
			this.markerLineStyle = markerLineStyle;
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, markerLineStyle, this);
			markerTemplate = representedElement.LegendMarkerTemplate;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			return PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
		}

		protected virtual bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is LineStyle)
			{
				OnLineThicknessChanged();
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private bool EqualBrushes(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush1, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2)
		{
			if (brush1 == brush2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (brush1 is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush && brush2 is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush2)
			{
				return solidColorBrush.Color == solidColorBrush2.Color;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void OnLineThicknessChanged()
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualLineThickness");
		}

		protected virtual double GetActualLineThickness()
		{
			if (MarkerLineStyle == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return MarkerLineStyle.Thickness;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetOpacityMask()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetActualMarkerBrush()
		{
			return MarkerBrush;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetActualMarkerLineBrush()
		{
			return MarkerLineBrush;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness GetActualMarkerMargin()
		{
			return default(Thickness);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetIsSelected()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal void Update(MarkerItem markerItem)
		{
			RepresentedElement = markerItem.RepresentedElement;
			MarkerTemplate = RepresentedElement.LegendMarkerTemplate;
			MarkerLineStyle = markerItem.MarkerLineStyle;
			MarkerBrush = markerItem.MarkerBrush;
			MarkerLineBrush = markerItem.MarkerLineBrush;
		}
	}

			: base(browsableObject, markerBrush, markerLineBrush, markerLineStyle)
		{
		}
	}

		{
			SetValue(CrosshairOptionsBase.ShowValueLineProperty, true);
		}

		private static Model3D LoadCrosshairModel()
		{
			GeometryInfo geometryInfo = Marker3DSpherePointModel.CreateSphereMarker(8.0, 1);
			MeshGeometry3D geometry = new MeshGeometry3D
			{
				Positions = geometryInfo.Points,
				TriangleIndices = geometryInfo.TriangleIndices
			};
			MaterialGroup materialGroup = new MaterialGroup();
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(CrosshairOptionsBase.DefaultElementColor)));
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new SpecularMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(229, 229, 229)), 20.0));
			return new GeometryModel3D(geometry, materialGroup);
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Crosshair3DOptions();
		}

	public class CrosshairFreePosition : CrosshairLabelPosition
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockTargetProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DockTarget", typeof(IDockTarget), typeof(CrosshairFreePosition), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockCornerProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DockCorner", typeof(DockCorner), typeof(CrosshairFreePosition), new PropertyMetadata(DockCorner.TopLeft));

		[Description("Gets or sets an object to which a crosshair label should be docked.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		public IDockTarget DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDockTarget)GetValue(DockTargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockTargetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the corner of the crosshair label’s parent element to which the crosshair label is anchored.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DockCorner DockCorner
		{
			get
			{
				return (DockCorner)GetValue(DockCornerProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockCornerProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsMousePosition => false;

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new CrosshairFreePosition();
		}

		protected override GRealRect2D GetDockBounds()
		{
			IDockTarget dockTarget = DockTarget;
			if (dockTarget != null)
			{
				Rect bounds = dockTarget.GetBounds();
				return new GRealRect2D(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
			return GRealRect2D.Empty;
		}

		protected override DockCornerCore GetDockCorner()
		{
			return (DockCornerCore)DockCorner;
		}

	public interface ISupportCrosshairLayout
