	public class CrosshairAxisLabelsPanel : Panel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is ContentPresenter { Content: ICrosshairLabelItem content } contentPresenter)
				{
					contentPresenter.Measure(constraint);
					content.Size = contentPresenter.DesiredSize;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Width, 0.0), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Height, 0.0));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is ContentPresenter { Content: ICrosshairLabelItem content } contentPresenter)
				{
					if (content.Size != content.Bounds.Size)
					{
						contentPresenter.Arrange(new Rect(content.Bounds.X, content.Bounds.Y, content.Size.Width, content.Size.Height));
					}
					else
					{
						contentPresenter.Arrange(content.Bounds);
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairLabelsPanel : Panel
	{
		private bool popupInvalidated;

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			popupInvalidated = true;
		}

		private void CalculateCrosshairLabelsLayout()
		{
			if (base.DataContext is ISupportCrosshairLayout supportCrosshairLayout)
			{
				supportCrosshairLayout.CalculateLabelsLayout();
			}
		}

		private void CompleteCrosshairLabelsBounds()
		{
			if (base.DataContext is ISupportCrosshairLayout supportCrosshairLayout)
			{
				supportCrosshairLayout.CompleteLabelsBounds();
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePopupWindow(Popup popup)
		{
			if (popupInvalidated)
			{
				popupInvalidated = false;
				popup.IsOpen = false;
			}
			if (!popup.IsOpen)
			{
				popup.IsOpen = true;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(constraint);
				if (!(child is ContentPresenter contentPresenter))
				{
					continue;
				}
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)contentPresenter, "PART_Popup");
				if (frameworkElement is Popup popup)
				{
					UpdatePopupWindow(popup);
					AnnotationPanel element = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType<AnnotationPanel>((FrameworkElement)popup.Child, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null);
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
					popup.Child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					if (contentPresenter.Content is ICrosshairLabelItem crosshairLabelItem)
					{
						crosshairLabelItem.Size = popup.Child.DesiredSize;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(frameworkElement is Canvas canvas))
					{
						continue;
					}
					canvas.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					foreach (UIElement child2 in canvas.Children)
					{
						child2.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					}
					if (contentPresenter.Content is ICrosshairLabelItem crosshairLabelItem2)
					{
						crosshairLabelItem2.Size = ((canvas.Children.Count > 0) ? canvas.Children[0].DesiredSize : default(System.Windows.Size));
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				CalculateCrosshairLabelsLayout();
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Width, 0.0), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Height, 0.0));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is ContentPresenter contentPresenter && LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)contentPresenter, "PART_Popup") is Canvas canvas)
				{
					canvas.Arrange(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), base.DesiredSize));
				}
			}
			if (base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				CompleteCrosshairLabelsBounds();
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new CrosshairAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class AnnotationItem : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		private const double beakHeight = 32.0;

		private IAnnotationLayout layout;

		private Effect shadow = CreateDefaultShadow();

		private Visibility beakVisibility;

		private AnnotationLocation location;

		public IAnnotationLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				layout = value;
				UpdateLayoutProperties();
			}
		}

		public AnnotationLocation Location
		{
			get
			{
				return location;
			}
			set
			{
				location = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Location");
			}
		}

		public Visibility BeakVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				return beakVisibility;
			}
			set
			{
				beakVisibility = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("BeakVisibility");
			}
		}

		public Effect Shadow
		{
			get
			{
				return shadow;
			}
			set
			{
				shadow = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Shadow");
			}
		}

		public double BeakHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (beakVisibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return 32.0;
			}
		}

		protected static Effect CreateDefaultShadow()
		{
			return new DropShadowEffect
			{
				Direction = -90.0,
				BlurRadius = 16.0,
				Opacity = 0.25,
				ShadowDepth = 4.0
			};
		}

		public void UpdateLayoutProperties()
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				Location = layout.Location;
				BeakVisibility = ((!layout.ShowTail) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum AnnotationElementType
	{
		None,
		Content,
		Beak
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class AnnotationPanel : Panel
	{
		internal const double PopupContentShadowPadding = 16.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnnotationItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AnnotationItem", typeof(AnnotationItem), typeof(AnnotationPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, AnnotationItemChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ElementTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ElementType", typeof(AnnotationElementType), typeof(AnnotationPanel), new PropertyMetadata(AnnotationElementType.None));

		private System.Windows.Size maxMeasureSize = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);

		private System.Windows.Size maxArrangeSize = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);

		private Panel parentPanel;

		public AnnotationItem AnnotationItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (AnnotationItem)GetValue(AnnotationItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnnotationItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private Panel ParentPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentPanel == null)
				{
					parentPanel = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<ToolTipPanel>((DependencyObject)this, true, (DependencyObject)null);
					if (parentPanel == null)
					{
						parentPanel = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<CrosshairLabelsPanel>((DependencyObject)this, true, (DependencyObject)null);
					}
				}
				return parentPanel;
			}
		}

		public static AnnotationElementType GetElementType(UIElement element)
		{
			return (AnnotationElementType)element.GetValue(ElementTypeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetElementType(UIElement element, AnnotationElementType elementType)
		{
			element.SetValue(ElementTypeProperty, elementType);
		}

		private static void AnnotationItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AnnotationPanel element = d as AnnotationPanel;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
		}

		internal System.Windows.Point CalculatePopupOffset()
		{
			double num = -16.0;
			double num2 = 16.0;
			if (AnnotationItem != null && AnnotationItem.Layout != null)
			{
				if (AnnotationItem.Layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.TopLeft || AnnotationItem.Layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft)
				{
					num *= -1.0;
				}
				if (AnnotationItem.Layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft || AnnotationItem.Layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomRight)
				{
					num2 *= -1.0;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(num, num2);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			AnnotationItem annotationItem = AnnotationItem;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (annotationItem != null)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					switch (GetElementType(child))
					{
					case AnnotationElementType.Beak:
						child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, annotationItem.BeakHeight));
						num = Math.Max(num, child.DesiredSize.Height);
						break;
					case AnnotationElementType.Content:
					{
						double num4 = availableSize.Height - annotationItem.BeakHeight;
						if (num4 >= 0.0)
						{
							child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, num4));
						}
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, child.DesiredSize.Height);
						break;
					}
					default:
						child.Measure(availableSize);
						break;
					}
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, child.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
				if (ParentPanel != null && ParentPanel is ToolTipPanel)
				{
					ParentPanel.InvalidateArrange();
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(num3 + 32.0, num2 + num + 32.0);
			if (size.Height > maxMeasureSize.Height)
			{
				maxMeasureSize.Height = size.Height;
			}
			if (size.Width > maxMeasureSize.Width)
			{
				maxMeasureSize.Width = size.Width;
			}
			return maxMeasureSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			AnnotationItem annotationItem = AnnotationItem;
			if (annotationItem != null && annotationItem.Layout != null && !annotationItem.Layout.Bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				AnnotationLocation location = annotationItem.Layout.Location;
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					switch (GetElementType(child))
					{
					case AnnotationElementType.Beak:
					{
						double num3 = 0.0;
						double num4 = 0.0;
						if (location == AnnotationLocation.TopLeft || location == AnnotationLocation.TopRight)
						{
							num4 = base.DesiredSize.Height - 32.0 - annotationItem.BeakHeight;
						}
						num3 = ((location != AnnotationLocation.TopRight && location != AnnotationLocation.BottomRight) ? (base.DesiredSize.Width - 32.0 + annotationItem.Layout.Offset.X - child.DesiredSize.Width) : (0.0 - annotationItem.Layout.Offset.X));
						child.Arrange(new Rect(num3 + 16.0, num4 + 16.0, child.DesiredSize.Width, child.DesiredSize.Height));
						break;
					}
					case AnnotationElementType.Content:
					{
						double num = 0.0;
						double num2 = 0.0;
						switch (location)
						{
						case AnnotationLocation.BottomRight:
						case AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft:
							num2 = annotationItem.BeakHeight;
							break;
						case AnnotationLocation.TopRight:
						case AnnotationLocation.TopLeft:
							num2 = base.DesiredSize.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height - annotationItem.BeakHeight - 32.0;
							break;
						}
						if (location == AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft || location == AnnotationLocation.TopLeft)
						{
							num = base.DesiredSize.Width - child.DesiredSize.Width - 32.0;
						}
						child.Arrange(new Rect(num + 16.0, num2 + 16.0, child.DesiredSize.Width, child.DesiredSize.Height));
						break;
					}
					default:
						child.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.DesiredSize.Width, base.DesiredSize.Height));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.DesiredSize.Height > maxArrangeSize.Height)
			{
				maxArrangeSize.Height = base.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (base.DesiredSize.Width > maxArrangeSize.Width)
			{
				maxArrangeSize.Width = base.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return maxArrangeSize;
		}
	}

		private bool IsAxisLabelItemsMeasured
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
				{
					IEnumerable<AxisLabelItem> labelItems = axisItem.LabelItems;
					if (labelItems == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (AxisLabelItem item in labelItems)
					{
						if (item.MeasuredSize.IsEmpty)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		{

			}
		}

		{
			get

					viewport = value;
					if (base.Container?.ChartOptions != null)
					{
						base.Container.ChartOptions.InvalidateChartElementPanel();
					}
					InvalidateArrange();
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		RefinedPoint INativeHitTestableDiagram.FindSeriesPoint(System.Windows.Point point, XYSeries series, RefinedPointFinder pointFinder)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point2 = ((UIElement)base.Container).TranslatePoint(point, series.AdditionalGeometryHolder);
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in series.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				if (allPointItem.Layout.Bounds.Contains(point2))
				{
					return allPointItem.RefinedPoint;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void CalculateDomainGeometry()
		{
			if (ShapeStyle == CircularDiagramShapeStyle.Circle)
			{
				DomainBorderGeometry = new EllipseGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Math.Abs(ActualViewport.Width - 1.0), Math.Abs(ActualViewport.Height - 1.0)));
				DomainClipGeometry = new EllipseGeometry(new Rect(-1.0, -1.0, ActualViewport.Width + 2.0, ActualViewport.Height + 2.0));
			}
			else
			{
				mapping = new CircularDiagramMapping(this);
				DomainBorderGeometry = CreateGeometryFromPoints(mapping.AxisXMapping.GetMeshPoints(ActualViewport.Width * 0.5));
				DomainClipGeometry = CreateGeometryFromPoints(mapping.AxisXMapping.GetMeshPoints(ActualViewport.Width * 0.5 + 1.0));
			}
		}

		private Geometry CreateGeometryFromPoints(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			if (points.Count > 2)
			{
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
				{
					StartPoint = points[0].ToPoint(),
					IsClosed = true
				};
				for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
				{
					LineSegment value = new LineSegment
					{
						Point = points[i].ToPoint()
					};
					pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
				}
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool UpdateAxis(AxisBase axis, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(size.Width, size.Height);
			double num2 = (axis.IsValuesAxis ? (0.5 * num) : (Math.PI * num));
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				num2 = (axis.IsValuesAxis ? 400.0 : (Math.PI * 800.0));
			}
			return axis.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(num2);
		}

		private Thickness CalculateOuterItemsLayout(Rect viewport)
		{
			IEnumerable<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesItem item in seriesItems)
				{
					if (item.Series is CircularSeriesBase2D circularSeriesBase2D)
					{
						circularSeriesBase2D.CreateSeriesLabelsLayout(viewport);
					}
				}
			}
			Thickness offsets = new Thickness(0.0);
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator.CalculateLayout(axisItem, viewport, ContentBounds, RotationDirection, StartAngle, ref offsets);
			}
			return offsets;
		}

		private void CalculateOuterItemsLayoutAndViewport()
		{
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				axisItem.TitleIndent = 0.0;
			}
			viewport = GraphicsUtils.MakeRect(RectExtension.Center(ContentBounds), Math.Min(ContentBounds.Width, ContentBounds.Height), Math.Min(ContentBounds.Width, ContentBounds.Height));
			while (true)
			{
				Rect rect = viewport;
				CalculateOuterItemsLayout(viewport);
				if (viewport.Width <= 0.0 || viewport.Height <= 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
				Rect rect2 = RectExtensions.Zero;
				foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem2 in axisItems)
				{
					Rect labelRect = axisItem2.LabelRect;
					if (labelRect != RectExtensions.Zero)
					{
						rect2.Union(labelRect);
					}
				}
				IEnumerable<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
				if (seriesItems != null)
				{
					foreach (SeriesItem item in seriesItems)
					{
						IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> items = item.Series.ActualLabel.Items;
						if (items == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in items)
						{
							rect2 = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(rect2, item2);
						}
					}
				}
				Thickness thickness = new Thickness(MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(ContentBounds.Left - rect2.Left, 0.0)), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(ContentBounds.Top - rect2.Top, 0.0)), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(rect2.Right - ContentBounds.Right, 0.0)), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(rect2.Bottom - ContentBounds.Bottom, 0.0)));
				Thickness thickness2 = default(Thickness);
				if (base.Annotations != null && base.Annotations.Count > 0)
				{
					thickness2 = AnnotationHelper.GetMaxAnnotationsCorrection(base.Annotations);
				}
				thickness = new Thickness(Math.Max(thickness.Left, thickness2.Left), Math.Max(thickness.Top, thickness2.Top), Math.Max(thickness.Right, thickness2.Right), Math.Max(thickness.Bottom, thickness2.Bottom));
				if (Math.Round(thickness.Left) == 0.0 && Math.Round(thickness.Top) == 0.0 && Math.Round(thickness.Right) == 0.0 && Math.Round(thickness.Bottom) == 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
				double num = viewport.Left + thickness.Left;
				double num2 = viewport.Top + thickness.Top;
				viewport = new Rect(num, num2, Math.Max(viewport.Right - thickness.Right - num, 0.0), Math.Max(viewport.Bottom - thickness.Bottom - num2, 0.0));
				viewport = GraphicsUtils.MakeRect(RectExtension.Center(viewport), Math.Min(viewport.Width, viewport.Height), Math.Min(viewport.Width, viewport.Height));
			}
		}

		private IList<AxisBase> UpdateMeasureUnits(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			IList<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			if (UpdateAxis(AxisXImpl, size))
			{
				list.Add(AxisXImpl);
			}
			if (UpdateAxis(AxisYImpl, size))
			{
				list.Add(AxisYImpl);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CalculateLayout()
		{
			bool isAxisLabelItemsMeasured = IsAxisLabelItemsMeasured;
			bool flag = UpdateAxesLabelItems();
			UpdateAxisItems();
			if (isAxisLabelItemsMeasured && !flag)
			{
				CalculateOuterItemsLayoutAndViewport();
				CalculateOuterItemsLayout(Viewport);
				foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
				{
					axisItem.UpdateGeometry(null, GetGridAndTextData(axisItem.Axis), Viewport);
				}
				IList<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
				if (seriesItems != null)
				{
					List<XYSeries> list = new List<XYSeries>();
					foreach (SeriesItem item2 in seriesItems)
					{
						if (item2.Series is CircularSeriesBase2D item)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					ResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(list, ContentBounds, LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
					foreach (CircularSeriesBase2D item3 in list)
					{
						item3.CreateSeriesPointsLayout();
						item3.CreateSeriesLabelConnectorsLayout();
					}
				}
				if (gridLinesMinorControl != null)
				{
					gridLinesMinorControl.UpdateGeometry();
				}
				if (gridLinesMajorControl != null)
				{
					gridLinesMajorControl.UpdateGeometry();
				}
				if (interlaceControl != null)
				{
					interlaceControl.UpdateGeometry();
				}
				CalculateDomainGeometry();
				CircularDiagram2DPanel element = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement frameworkElement) => frameworkElement is CircularDiagram2DPanel)) as CircularDiagram2DPanel;
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag && base.Container != null)
			{
				base.Container.AddInvalidate(InvalidateMeasureFlags.MeasureDiagram);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldCreateIntervals(AxisBase axis, double axisLength)
		{
			IMinMaxValues visualRangeData = axis.VisualRangeData;
			if (axisLength > 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(visualRangeData.Min))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(visualRangeData.Max);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double GetAxisLength(AxisBase axis, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(size.Width, size.Height);
			return num * (axis.IsValuesAxis ? 0.5 : Math.PI);
		}

		private void UpdateAxisItems()
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(axisItem);
				IEnumerable<AxisLabelItem> labelItems = axisItem.LabelItems;
				if (labelItems == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (AxisLabelItem item in labelItems)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem2 in axisItems)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(axisItem2.SelectionGeometryItem);
			}
			AxisItems = observableCollection;
		}

		private Rect CalculateRelativeAxesRect(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			Rect contentBounds = ContentBounds;
			if (contentBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			point.X -= contentBounds.Left;
			point.Y -= contentBounds.Top;
			if (point.X < 0.0 || point.X > contentBounds.Width || point.Y < 0.0 || point.Y > contentBounds.Height)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			point.Y = contentBounds.Height - point.Y;
			return new Rect(point.X, point.Y, contentBounds.Width, contentBounds.Height);
		}

		internal bool UpdateAxesLabelItems()
		{
			gridAndTextDataDictionary.Clear();
			double axisLength = GetAxisLength(AxisXImpl, ContentBounds.Size);
			if (ShouldCreateIntervals(AxisXImpl, axisLength))
			{
				AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = new AxisIntervalLayout(new AxisInterval(AxisXImpl.VisualRangeData, AxisXImpl.WholeRangeData), 0, (int)axisLength);
				IntervalsGridAndTextData value = new IntervalsGridAndTextData(new AxisIntervalLayout[1] { axisIntervalLayout }, AxisXImpl, ContentBounds.Size, navigationEnabled: false, axisLength);
				gridAndTextDataDictionary.Add(AxisXImpl, value);
			}
			double axisLength2 = GetAxisLength(AxisYImpl, ContentBounds.Size);
			if (ShouldCreateIntervals(AxisYImpl, axisLength2))
			{
				AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout2 = new AxisIntervalLayout(new AxisInterval(AxisYImpl.VisualRangeData, AxisYImpl.WholeRangeData), 0, (int)axisLength2);
				IntervalsGridAndTextData value2 = new IntervalsGridAndTextData(new AxisIntervalLayout[1] { axisIntervalLayout2 }, AxisYImpl, ContentBounds.Size, navigationEnabled: false, axisLength2);
				gridAndTextDataDictionary.Add(AxisYImpl, value2);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				IntervalsGridAndTextData gridAndTextData = GetGridAndTextData(axisItem.Axis);
				if (gridAndTextData != null)
				{
					flag |= axisItem.UpdateLabelItems(GetTextData(gridAndTextData.GridAndTextData));
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private IEnumerable<AxisTextData> GetTextData(List<GridAndTextData> gridAndTextData)
		{
			foreach (GridAndTextData gridAndTextDatum in gridAndTextData)
			{
				yield return gridAndTextDatum.GetTextData();
			}
		}

		internal List<Axis2DItem> GetAxisItems()
		{
			return axisItems;
		}

		protected override void EnsureSeriesItems()
		{
			ObservableCollection<SeriesItem> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<SeriesItem>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				if (item.Series is CircularSeriesBase2D circularSeriesBase2D)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(circularSeriesBase2D.Item);
				}
			}
			int count = observableCollection.Count;
			ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems == null || seriesItems.Count != count)
			{
				SetValue(SeriesItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem>(observableCollection));
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (seriesItems[i] != observableCollection[i])
				{
					SetValue(SeriesItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem>(observableCollection));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateAxesTextPattern()
		{
			base.UpdateAxesTextPattern();
			AxisXImpl.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
			AxisYImpl.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			base.UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			ReadOnlyCollection<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem>();
			foreach (SeriesItem item in seriesItems)
			{
				SeriesLabel actualLabel = item.Series.ActualLabel;
				if (actualLabel == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> items = actualLabel.Items;
				if (items == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in items)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			SeriesLabelItems = observableCollection;
		}

		internal IntervalsGridAndTextData GetGridAndTextData(AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (!gridAndTextDataDictionary.TryGetValue(axis, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateVisualItems(bool isUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure)
		{
			axisItems.Clear();
			axisItems.Add(new Axis2DItem(AxisXImpl, null));
			axisItems.Add(new Axis2DItem(AxisYImpl, null));
			UpdateAxisItems();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateLogicalElements()
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			if (base.SeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(base.SeriesTemplate.ActualLabel);
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(item.ActualLabel);
			}
			observableCollection.Add(AxisXImpl);
			observableCollection.Add(AxisXImpl.ActualLabel);
			observableCollection.Add(AxisYImpl);
			observableCollection.Add(AxisYImpl.ActualLabel);
			Elements = observableCollection;
		}

		protected internal override bool ManipulationStart(System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			return IsManipulationNavigationEnabled;
		}

		protected internal override void CheckMeasureUnits(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(ActualViewport.Width, ActualViewport.Height);
			IEnumerable<AxisBase> axes = UpdateMeasureUnits(size);
			base.ViewController.SendDataAggregationUpdates(axes);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Elements == null)
			{
				UpdateVisualItems(isUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure: false);
				UpdateLogicalElements();
			}
			else if (AxisItems == null)
			{
				UpdateVisualItems(isUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure: false);
			}
			availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Floor(availableSize.Width), Math.Floor(availableSize.Height));
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			CalculateLayout();
			IList<AxisBase> list = UpdateMeasureUnits(availableSize);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				base.ViewController.SendDataAggregationUpdates(list);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			visualContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_VisualContent") as UIElement;
			interlaceControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_Interlace") as InterlaceRenderControl;
			gridLinesMinorControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_MinorGridLines") as MinorGridLinesRenderControl;
			gridLinesMajorControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_MajorGridLines") as MajorGridLinesRenderControl;
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(GetPaneSizeForAutoLayout(size), new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>()));
			return list;
		}

		private GRealSize2D GetPaneSizeForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new GRealSize2D(constraint.Width, constraint.Height);
		}
	}
	public sealed class PolarDiagram2D : CircularDiagram2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxisXProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AxisX", typeof(PolarAxisX2D), typeof(PolarDiagram2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisXPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxisYProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AxisY", typeof(PolarAxisY2D), typeof(PolarDiagram2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisYPropertyChanged));

		private PolarAxisX2D actualAxisX;

		private PolarAxisY2D actualAxisY;

		[Description("Gets or sets the axis that surrounds the polar diagram.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public PolarAxisX2D AxisX
		{
			get
			{
				return (PolarAxisX2D)GetValue(AxisXProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxisXProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets an axis which radiates from the center of the polar chart.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public PolarAxisY2D AxisY
		{
			get
			{
				return (PolarAxisY2D)GetValue(AxisYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxisYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override CircularAxisX2D AxisXImpl => actualAxisX;

		protected internal override CircularAxisY2D AxisYImpl => actualAxisY;

		protected internal override CompatibleViewType CompatibleViewType => CompatibleViewType.PolarView;

		[Description("Gets the actual x-axis of the PolarDiagram2D object.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public PolarAxisX2D ActualAxisX => actualAxisX;

		[Description("Gets the actual y-axis of the PolarDiagram2D object.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public PolarAxisY2D ActualAxisY => actualAxisY;

		private static void AxisXPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PolarDiagram2D polarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is PolarAxisX2D polarAxisX2D))
				{
					polarDiagram2D.actualAxisX = new PolarAxisX2D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, polarDiagram2D.actualAxisX);
				}
				else
				{
					polarDiagram2D.actualAxisX = polarAxisX2D;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		private static void AxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PolarDiagram2D polarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is PolarAxisY2D polarAxisY2D))
				{
					polarDiagram2D.actualAxisY = new PolarAxisY2D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, polarDiagram2D.actualAxisY);
				}
				else
				{
					polarDiagram2D.actualAxisY = polarAxisY2D;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		public PolarDiagram2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<PolarDiagram2D>(this);
			actualAxisX = new PolarAxisX2D();
			actualAxisX.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualAxisY = new PolarAxisY2D();
			actualAxisY.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			EndInit();
		}
	}

	public abstract class Diagram2DItemsControl : ChartItemsControl<LayoutElementPresentation>
	{
		protected static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Diagram2DItemsControl element = d as Diagram2DItemsControl;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (!ShouldCreateItemPresentation(item))
			{
				return base.IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is LayoutElementPresentation layoutElementPresentation)
			{
				layoutElementPresentation.Content = GetItemPresentation(item);
				object obj = (layoutElementPresentation.Content as DependencyObject)?.GetValue(Panel.ZIndexProperty);
				if (obj != null && obj is int)
				{
					layoutElementPresentation.SetValue(Panel.ZIndexProperty, obj);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = base.ItemsSource as ObservableCollection<object>;
			bool flag = false;
			if (observableCollection == null)
			{
				observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
				flag = true;
			}
			ObservableCollectionHelper<object> val = new ObservableCollectionHelper<object>(observableCollection, false);
			try
			{
				CreateItems(val.NewElements);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.ItemsSource = observableCollection;
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldCreateItemPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is SeriesLabelItem))
			{
				return item is SeriesLabelConnectorItem;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual ILayoutElement GetItemPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (item is SeriesLabelItem labelItem)
			{
				return new SeriesLabelPresentation(labelItem);
			}
			if (item is SeriesLabelConnectorItem connectorItem)
			{
				return new SeriesLabelConnectorPresentation(connectorItem);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract void CreateItems(HashSet<object> collection);
	}
	public class LayoutElementPresentation : ChartContentPresenter, ILayoutElement
	{
		ILayout ILayoutElement.Layout
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Content is ILayoutElement layoutElement)
				{
					return layoutElement.Layout;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class DiagramCoordinates
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<Axis2D, AxisValue> axisValueDictionary = new Dictionary<Axis2D, AxisValue>();

		private AxisX2D axisX;

		private AxisY2D axisY;

		private Pane pane;

		private ScaleType argumentScaleType;

		private ScaleType valueScaleType;

		private string qualitativeArgument;

		private double numericalArgument;

		private DateTime dateTimeArgument;

		private TimeSpan timeSpanArgument;

		private double numericalValue;

		private DateTime dateTimeValue;

		private TimeSpan timeSpanValue;

		[Description("Gets the X-axis of the diagram coordinate.")]
		public AxisX2D AxisX => axisX;

		[Description("Gets the Y-axis of the diagram coordinate.")]
		public AxisY2D AxisY => axisY;

		[Description("Gets the pane of the diagram point.")]
		public Pane Pane => pane;

		[Description("Gets the type of the argument scale.")]
		public ScaleType ArgumentScaleType => argumentScaleType;

		[Description("Gets the type of the value scale.")]
		public ScaleType ValueScaleType => valueScaleType;

		[Description("Gets the qualitative argument of the diagram point.")]
		public string QualitativeArgument => qualitativeArgument;

		[Description("Gets the numerical argument of the diagram point.")]
		public double NumericalArgument => numericalArgument;

		[Description("Gets the date-time argument of the diagram point.")]
		public DateTime DateTimeArgument => dateTimeArgument;

		[Description("Returns the diagram point’s time-span argument.")]
		public TimeSpan TimeSpanArgument => timeSpanArgument;

		[Description("Gets the numerical value of the diagram coordinate.")]
		public double NumericalValue => numericalValue;

		[Description("Gets the date-time value of the diagram coordinate.")]
		public DateTime DateTimeValue => dateTimeValue;

		[Description("Returns the diagram point’s time-span value.")]
		public TimeSpan TimeSpanValue => timeSpanValue;

		[Description("Checks whether the current object is a point outside the diagram area.")]
		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (argumentScaleType == ScaleType.Qualitative)
				{
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(qualitativeArgument);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DiagramCoordinates()
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			qualitativeArgument = string.Empty;
		}

		private void SetQualitativeArgument(string argument, double argumentInternal)
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			qualitativeArgument = argument;
			numericalArgument = argumentInternal;
		}

		private void SetNumericalArgument(double argument)
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			numericalArgument = argument;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeArgument(DateTime argument, double argumentInternal)
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			dateTimeArgument = argument;
			numericalArgument = argumentInternal;
		}

		private void SetTimeSpanArgument(TimeSpan argument, double argumentInternal)
		{
			argumentScaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			timeSpanArgument = argument;
			numericalArgument = argumentInternal;
		}

		private void SetNumericalValue(double value)
		{
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			numericalValue = value;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeValue(DateTime value, double valueInternal)
		{
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			dateTimeValue = value;
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		private void SetTimeSpanValue(TimeSpan value, double valueInternal)
		{
			valueScaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			timeSpanValue = value;
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		internal void SetAxes(AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY)
		{
			this.axisX = axisX;
			this.axisY = axisY;
		}

		internal void SetPane(Pane pane)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
		}

		internal void SetArgumentAndValue(double argumentInternal, double valueInternal)
		{
			object scaleMapNativeValue = AxisUtils.GetScaleMapNativeValue(axisY.ScaleMap, valueInternal);
			object scaleMapNativeValue2 = AxisUtils.GetScaleMapNativeValue(axisX.ScaleMap, argumentInternal);
			switch (axisX.ScaleMap.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
				SetQualitativeArgument((string)scaleMapNativeValue2, argumentInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				SetDateTimeArgument((DateTime)scaleMapNativeValue2, argumentInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				SetTimeSpanArgument((TimeSpan)scaleMapNativeValue2, argumentInternal);
				break;
			default:
				SetNumericalArgument((double)scaleMapNativeValue2);
				break;
			}
			switch (axisY.ScaleMap.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				SetDateTimeValue((DateTime)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				SetTimeSpanValue((TimeSpan)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			default:
				SetNumericalValue((double)scaleMapNativeValue);
				break;
			}
			AddAxisValue(axisX, argumentInternal);
			AddAxisValue(axisY, valueInternal);
		}

		internal void AddAxisValue(Axis2D axis, double valueInternal)
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				AxisValue axisValue = new AxisValue();
				axisValue.SetValue(axis, valueInternal);
				if (!axisValueDictionary.ContainsKey(axis))
				{
					axisValueDictionary.Add(axis, axisValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public AxisValue GetAxisValue(Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axisValueDictionary.TryGetValue(axis, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class AxisValue
	{
		private ScaleType scaleType;

		private string qualitativeValue;

		private double numericalValue;

		private DateTime dateTimeValue;

		private TimeSpan timeSpanValue;

		[Description("Gets the axis scale type.")]
		public ScaleType ScaleType => scaleType;

		[Description("Gets the axis value, if the axis scale type is qualitative.")]
		public string QualitativeValue => qualitativeValue;

		[Description("Gets the axis value, if the axis scale type is numerical.")]
		public double NumericalValue => numericalValue;

		[Description("Gets the axis value, if the axis scale type is  date-time.")]
		public DateTime DateTimeValue => dateTimeValue;

		[Description("Returns the axis value if the axis scale type is TimeSpan.")]
		public TimeSpan TimeSpanValue => timeSpanValue;

		internal object ActualValue => ScaleType switch
		{
			ScaleType.Qualitative => QualitativeValue, 
			ScaleType.Numerical => NumericalValue, 
			ScaleType.DateTime => DateTimeValue, 
			ScaleType.TimeSpan => TimeSpanValue, 
			ScaleType.Auto => throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't return actual value for the Auto scale type."), 
			_ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown scale type"), 
		};

		internal AxisValue()
		{
			scaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			qualitativeValue = string.Empty;
		}

		private void SetQualitativeValue(string value, double valueInternal)
		{
			scaleType = ScaleType.Qualitative;
			qualitativeValue = value;
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		private void SetNumericalValue(double value)
		{
			scaleType = ScaleType.Numerical;
			numericalValue = value;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeValue(DateTime value, double valueInternal)
		{
			scaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			dateTimeValue = value;
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		private void SetTimeSpanValue(TimeSpan value, double valueInternal)
		{
			scaleType = ScaleType.TimeSpan;
			timeSpanValue = value;
			numericalValue = valueInternal;
		}

		internal void SetValue(Axis2D axis, double valueInternal)
		{
			object scaleMapNativeValue = AxisUtils.GetScaleMapNativeValue(axis.ScaleMap, valueInternal);
			switch (axis.ScaleMap.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
				SetQualitativeValue((string)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				SetDateTimeValue((DateTime)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				SetTimeSpanValue((TimeSpan)scaleMapNativeValue, valueInternal);
				break;
			default:
				SetNumericalValue((double)scaleMapNativeValue);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public class CircularDiagram2DItemsControl : Diagram2DItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DiagramProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Diagram", typeof(CircularDiagram2D), typeof(CircularDiagram2DItemsControl));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxisItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AxisItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<object>), typeof(CircularDiagram2DItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(Diagram2DItemsControl.PropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DiagramContentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DiagramContent", typeof(UIElement), typeof(CircularDiagram2DItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(Diagram2DItemsControl.PropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesLabelItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesLabelItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem>), typeof(CircularDiagram2DItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(Diagram2DItemsControl.PropertyChanged));

		public CircularDiagram2D Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				return (CircularDiagram2D)GetValue(DiagramProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DiagramProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public UIElement DiagramContent
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(DiagramContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DiagramContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<object> AxisItems
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<object>)GetValue(AxisItemsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxisItemsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> SeriesLabelItems
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem>)GetValue(SeriesLabelItemsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SeriesLabelItemsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldCreateItemPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is Axis2DItem) && !(item is AxisLabelItem))
			{
				return base.ShouldCreateItemPresentation(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ILayoutElement GetItemPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (item is Axis2DItem axis2DItem && !(axis2DItem.Axis is CircularAxisX2D))
			{
				return new Axis2DPresentation(axis2DItem);
			}
			if (item is AxisLabelItem labelItem)
			{
				return new AxisLabelPresentation(labelItem);
			}
			if (item is SelectionGeometryItem selectionGeometryItem)
			{
				return new SelectionPresentation(selectionGeometryItem);
			}
			return base.GetItemPresentation(item);
		}

		protected override void CreateItems(HashSet<object> items)
		{
			if (DiagramContent != null)
			{
				items.Add(DiagramContent);
			}
			if (AxisItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object axisItem in AxisItems)
				{
					items.Add(axisItem);
				}
			}
			if (SeriesLabelItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem seriesLabelItem in SeriesLabelItems)
			{
				if (seriesLabelItem.ConnectorItem != null)
				{
					items.Add(seriesLabelItem.ConnectorItem);
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem seriesLabelItem2 in SeriesLabelItems)
			{
				items.Add(seriesLabelItem2);
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeAxisItems(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class CircularDiagram2DPanel : Panel
	{
		private struct LayoutItem : IEquatable<LayoutItem>
		{
			public readonly UIElement Element;

			public readonly System.Windows.Size Size;

			public LayoutItem(UIElement element, System.Windows.Size size)
			{
				Element = element;
				Size = size;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				LayoutItem layoutItem = (LayoutItem)obj;
				return object.Equals(this, layoutItem);
			}

			public bool Equals(LayoutItem other)
			{
				if (Element == other.Element)
				{
					return Size == other.Size;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Element.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private const double defaultWidth = 300.0;

		private const double defaultHeight = 300.0;

		private List<LayoutItem> layoutItems;

		private bool CanPerformLayout
		{
			get
			{
				CircularDiagram2D diagram = GetDiagram();
				return diagram != null;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<UIElement> LayoutElements
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in Children)
				{
					if (XYDiagram2D.GetElementType(child) == XYDiagram2DElementType.None && child is ILayoutElement)
					{
						yield return child;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private UIElement DiagramContent => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.DiagramContent);

		private void InvalidateDiagram()
		{
			CircularDiagram2D diagram = GetDiagram();
			if (diagram != null && diagram.Container != null)
			{
				diagram.Container.AddInvalidate(InvalidateMeasureFlags.MeasureDiagram);
			}
		}

		private CircularDiagram2D GetDiagram()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<CircularDiagram2DItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this)?.Diagram;
		}

		private UIElement FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType elementType)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (XYDiagram2D.GetElementType(child) == elementType)
				{
					return child;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Geometry CreateClipGeometry(Rect[] clipRects)
		{
			int num = clipRects.Length;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!clipRects[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
					{
						Rect = clipRects[i]
					});
				}
			}
			if (geometryGroup.Children.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (!CanPerformLayout)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			double width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Width);
			double height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Height);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			List<LayoutItem> list = new List<LayoutItem>();
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement in LayoutElements)
			{
				layoutElement.Measure(size);
				list.Add(new LayoutItem(layoutElement, layoutElement.DesiredSize));
			}
			if (layoutItems == null || list.Count != layoutItems.Count)
			{
				InvalidateDiagram();
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!layoutItems[i].Equals(list[i]))
					{
						InvalidateDiagram();
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			layoutItems = list;
			Rect actualViewport = GetDiagram().ActualViewport;
			DiagramContent?.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(actualViewport.Width, actualViewport.Height));
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (!CanPerformLayout)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			CircularDiagram2D diagram = GetDiagram();
			Rect actualViewport = diagram.ActualViewport;
			bool flag = actualViewport.Width == 0.0 || actualViewport.Height == 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement in LayoutElements)
			{
				Rect finalRect = RectExtensions.Zero;
				ILayout layout = ((ILayoutElement)layoutElement).Layout;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					layoutElement.Clip = CreateClipGeometry(layout.ClipRects);
					if (!flag && layout.Visible)
					{
						finalRect = (layout.Bounds.IsEmpty ? new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height) : new Rect(layout.Location, layout.Size));
					}
				}
				layoutElement.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			IEnumerable<SeriesItem> seriesItems = diagram.SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesItem item in seriesItems)
				{
					SeriesLabel actualLabel = item.Series.ActualLabel;
					if (actualLabel == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> items = actualLabel.Items;
					if (items == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in items)
					{
						item2.UpdateConnectorCoordinates();
					}
				}
			}
			DiagramContent?.Arrange(actualViewport);
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class CircularDiagram2DSeriesPanel : Panel
	{
		private CircularDiagram2D Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				DiagramSeriesItemsControl diagramSeriesItemsControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DiagramSeriesItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
				if (diagramSeriesItemsControl != null)
				{
					return diagramSeriesItemsControl.Owner as CircularDiagram2D;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			CircularDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child?.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			CircularDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child?.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), child.DesiredSize));
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public sealed class RadarDiagram2D : CircularDiagram2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxisXProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AxisX", typeof(RadarAxisX2D), typeof(RadarDiagram2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisXPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxisYProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AxisY", typeof(RadarAxisY2D), typeof(RadarDiagram2D), new PropertyMetadata(AxisYPropertyChanged));

		private RadarAxisX2D actualAxisX;

		private RadarAxisY2D actualAxisY;

		[Description("Gets or sets the axis that surrounds the radar diagram.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public RadarAxisX2D AxisX
		{
			get
			{
				return (RadarAxisX2D)GetValue(AxisXProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxisXProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets an axis which radiates from the center of the radar chart.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public RadarAxisY2D AxisY
		{
			get
			{
				return (RadarAxisY2D)GetValue(AxisYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxisYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override CircularAxisX2D AxisXImpl => actualAxisX;

		protected internal override CircularAxisY2D AxisYImpl => actualAxisY;

		protected internal override CompatibleViewType CompatibleViewType => CompatibleViewType.RadarView;

		[Description("Gets the actual x-axis of the RadarDiagram2D object.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public RadarAxisX2D ActualAxisX => actualAxisX;

		[Description("Gets the actual  y-axis of the RadarDiagram2D object.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public RadarAxisY2D ActualAxisY => actualAxisY;

		private static void AxisXPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarDiagram2D radarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is RadarAxisX2D radarAxisX2D))
				{
					radarDiagram2D.actualAxisX = new RadarAxisX2D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, radarDiagram2D.actualAxisX);
				}
				else
				{
					radarDiagram2D.actualAxisX = radarAxisX2D;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		private static void AxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RadarDiagram2D radarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is RadarAxisY2D radarAxisY2D))
				{
					radarDiagram2D.actualAxisY = new RadarAxisY2D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, radarDiagram2D.actualAxisY);
				}
				else
				{
					radarDiagram2D.actualAxisY = radarAxisY2D;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		public RadarDiagram2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<RadarDiagram2D>(this);
			actualAxisX = new RadarAxisX2D();
			actualAxisX.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualAxisY = new RadarAxisY2D();
			actualAxisY.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			EndInit();
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagram2DItemsControl : ChartItemsControl<ChartContentPresenter>

		private ChartElementBase GetPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (item is SeriesItem)
			{
				SeriesItem seriesItem = (SeriesItem)item;
				Type type = seriesItem.Series.GetType();
				if (type == typeof(PieSeries2D))
				{
					PieSeries2DPresentation pieSeries2DPresentation = new PieSeries2DPresentation(seriesItem);
					((PieSeries2D)seriesItem.Series).Presentation = pieSeries2DPresentation;
					return pieSeries2DPresentation;
				}
				if (type == typeof(FunnelSeries2D))
				{
					FunnelSeriesPresentation funnelSeriesPresentation = new FunnelSeriesPresentation(seriesItem);
					((FunnelSeries2D)seriesItem.Series).Presentation = funnelSeriesPresentation;
					return funnelSeriesPresentation;
				}
				string text = string.Concat(MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod().DeclaringType, ".", MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod().Name);
				throw new NotImplementedException("The " + text + " method can't operate with " + item.GetType().Name);
			}
			if (item is NestedDonut2DGroup)
			{
				return new NestedDonut2DGroupPresentation((NestedDonut2DGroup)item);
			}
			string text2 = string.Concat(MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod().DeclaringType, ".", MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod().Name);
			throw new NotImplementedException("The " + text2 + " method can't operate with " + item.GetType().Name);
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			ChartContentPresenter chartContentPresenter = (ChartContentPresenter)element;
			Binding binding = new Binding("DataContext")
			{
				Source = Diagram.Container
			};
			chartContentPresenter.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding);
			chartContentPresenter.Content = GetPresentation(item);
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagram2DPanel : Panel
	{
		private readonly Thickness CellMargin = new Thickness(-1.0);

		private List<Rect> groupBounds;

		private ISimpleDiagram GetDiagram()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<SimpleDiagram2DItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this)?.Diagram;
		}

		private List<Rect> CalculateBounds(DXRectangle diagramBounds)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ISimpleDiagram diagram = GetDiagram();
			List<DXRectangle> list = SimpleDiagramLayout.Calculate(diagram, diagramBounds, base.Children.Count);
			List<Rect> list2 = new List<Rect>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(list[i].Inflate(CellMargin).ToRect());
			}
			return list2;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ISimpleDiagram diagram = GetDiagram();
			if (!MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(constraint.Width + constraint.Height) || diagram == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return constraint;
			}
			groupBounds = CalculateBounds(new DXRectangle(0, 0, MathUtils.StrongRound(constraint.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound(constraint.Height)));
			for (int i = 0; i < groupBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Children[i].Measure(RectHelper.Size(groupBounds[i]));
			}
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (groupBounds != null && base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				if (groupBounds.Count != base.Children.Count || base.DesiredSize != arrangeBounds)
				{
					groupBounds = CalculateBounds(new DXRectangle(0, 0, MathUtils.StrongRound(arrangeBounds.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound(arrangeBounds.Height)));
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < groupBounds.Count; i++)
				{
					base.Children[i].Arrange(groupBounds[i]);
				}
				return arrangeBounds;
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagramItemsControl : ChartItemsControl
	{
		private SimpleDiagram3D Diagram => base.DataContext as SimpleDiagram3D;

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					Diagram.VisualContainers.Clear();
				}
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
					{
						if (e.OldStartingIndex >= Diagram.VisualContainers.Count)
						{
							break;
						}
						Diagram.VisualContainers.RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsSourceChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			base.OnItemsSourceChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void OnItemBindingGroupChanged(BindingGroup oldItemBindingGroup, BindingGroup newItemBindingGroup)
		{
			base.OnItemBindingGroupChanged(oldItemBindingGroup, newItemBindingGroup);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class ChartMirrorControl : ChartElementBase

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Series", typeof(UIElement), typeof(ChartMirrorControl), new PropertyMetadata(SeriesChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MirrorBrushProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MirrorBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(ChartMirrorControl));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsPseudo3DProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsPseudo3D", typeof(bool), typeof(ChartMirrorControl));

		public UIElement Series
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(SeriesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SeriesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush MirrorBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(MirrorBrushProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(MirrorBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush MirrorOpacityBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(MirrorOpacityBrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MirrorOpacityBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsPseudo3D
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsPseudo3DProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsPseudo3DProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private Pane Pane => base.DataContext as Pane;

		private static void SeriesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartMirrorControl chartMirrorControl)
			{
				chartMirrorControl.InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		public ChartMirrorControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ChartMirrorControl>(this);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush GetMirrorBrush(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && element.RenderSize.Width > 0.0 && element.RenderSize.Height > 0.0)
			{
				TileBrush tileBrush = RenderHelper.CreateMirrorBrush(element, IsPseudo3D, Pane);
				tileBrush.Stretch = Stretch.None;
				tileBrush.AlignmentX = AlignmentX.Left;
				tileBrush.AlignmentY = AlignmentY.Bottom;
				return tileBrush;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size((!double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width)) ? availableSize.Width : pane.DesiredSize.Width, pane.MirrorHeight);
			base.MeasureOverride(size);
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null && pane.MirrorHeight > 0.0 && finalSize.Width > 0.0 && Series != null && Series.RenderSize.Height > 0.0 && Series.RenderSize.Width > 0.0)
			{
				MirrorBrush = GetMirrorBrush(Series);
				MirrorOpacityBrush = RenderHelper.CreateOpacityBrush(pane, IsPseudo3D);
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}
	}

				if (paneAxesContainer != null)

					if (!ActualEnableAxisXNavigation || !paneAxesManager.CanZoomInAxis(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX))
					{
						if (ActualEnableAxisYNavigation)
						{
							return paneAxesManager.CanZoomInAxis(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY);
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;

				if (paneAxesContainer == null || !ActualEnableAxisXNavigation || !PaneAxesManager.CanZoomOutAxis(paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX))
				{

					return false;

				{
					if ((DomainBrush == null || (DomainBrush is SolidColorBrush && ((SolidColorBrush)DomainBrush).Color.A == 0)) && Diagram != null)
					{
						if ((Diagram.Background == null || (Diagram.Background is SolidColorBrush && ((SolidColorBrush)Diagram.Background).Color.A == 0)) && Diagram.Container != null)
						{
							return Diagram.Container.PlatformElement.Background;
						}
						return Diagram.Background;
					}
					return DomainBrush;
				}
				return base.Background;
			}
		}

				if (annotationsPanel == null)
				{
					annotationsPanel = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement element) => element is AnnotationLayoutPanel)) as AnnotationLayoutPanel;
				}
				return annotationsPanel;
			}
		}

		internal List<Tuple<Axis2D, SelectionGeometryItem>> AxesBounds => axesBounds;

		internal XYDiagram2D Diagram => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as XYDiagram2D;

		internal Rect InnerBounds
		{
			get
			{
				Thickness padding = base.Padding;
				double width = Math.Max(0.0, base.DesiredSize.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right);
				double height = Math.Max(0.0, base.DesiredSize.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom);
				return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(padding.Left, padding.Top), new System.Windows.Size(width, height));
			}
		}

		internal bool IsLastNotCollapsedPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Diagram.CheckIsLastNotCollapsedPane(this);
			}
		}

		internal Rect? LastMappingBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!lastMappingBounds.HasValue || lastMappingBounds.Value.Width != viewport.Width - 1.0 || lastMappingBounds.Value.Height != viewport.Height - 1.0)
				{
					lastMappingBounds = CalculateMappingBounds();
				}
				return lastMappingBounds;
			}
		}

		internal DomainPanel PanePanel => panePanel;

		internal Rect RangeBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!rangeBounds.HasValue)
				{
					PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = GetPaneAxesContainer();
					if (paneAxesContainer == null || !NavigationEnabled)
					{
						rangeBounds = viewport;
					}
					else
					{
						IAxisData axisData;
						IAxisData axisData2;
						if (Rotated)
						{
							axisData = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;
							axisData2 = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX;
						}
						else
						{
							axisData = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX;
							axisData2 = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;
						}
						IMinMaxValues visualRange = axisData.VisualRange;
						IMinMaxValues wholeRange = axisData.WholeRange;
						IMinMaxValues visualRange2 = axisData2.VisualRange;
						IMinMaxValues wholeRange2 = axisData2.WholeRange;
						double num = wholeRange.Delta / visualRange.Delta;
						double num2 = (axisData.Reverse ? (wholeRange.Max - visualRange.Max) : (visualRange.Min - wholeRange.Min)) / wholeRange.Delta * viewport.Width * num;
						double num3 = wholeRange2.Delta / visualRange2.Delta;
						double num4 = (axisData2.Reverse ? (visualRange2.Min - wholeRange2.Min) : (wholeRange2.Max - visualRange2.Max)) / wholeRange2.Delta * viewport.Height * num3;
						rangeBounds = new Rect(viewport.Left - num2, viewport.Top - num4, viewport.Width * num, viewport.Height * num3);
					}
				}
				return rangeBounds.Value;
			}
		}

		internal bool Rotated => Diagram?.Rotated ?? false;

		internal Rect Viewport
		{
			get
			{
				return viewport;
			}
			set
			{
				SetViewport(value);
			}
		}

		internal Transform ViewportRenderTransform
		{
			get
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(ViewportTransform);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = viewport.X,
					Y = viewport.Y
				});
				return transformGroup;
			}
		}

		internal Transform ViewportTransform
		{
			get
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				if (Rotated)
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
					{
						Angle = -90.0
					});
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleY = -1.0
					});
				}
				if (InvertViewport)
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleY = -1.0,
						CenterY = viewport.Height / 2.0
					});
				}
				return transformGroup;
			}
		}

		DXRectangle IZoomablePane.Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
				if (diagram == null)
				{
					return default(DXRectangle);
				}
				DomainPanel domainPanel = PanePanel;
				return GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(new Rect((domainPanel == null) ? default(System.Windows.Point) : FrameworkElementExtensions.GetPosition((FrameworkElement)domainPanel, (FrameworkElement)diagram.Container.PlatformElement), new System.Windows.Size(viewport.Width, viewport.Height)));
			}
		}

		static Pane()
		{
			SeriesItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("SeriesItems", typeof(ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			AxisXScrollBarItemPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("AxisXScrollBarItem", typeof(ScrollBarItem), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			AxisYScrollBarItemPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("AxisYScrollBarItem", typeof(ScrollBarItem), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			StripItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("StripItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<StripItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ConstantLineBehindItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ConstantLineBehindItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<ConstantLineItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ConstantLineInFrontItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ConstantLineInFrontItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<ConstantLineItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ConstantLineTitleItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ConstantLineTitleItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<ConstantLineTitleItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IndicatorItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IndicatorItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<IndicatorItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IndicatorLabelItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IndicatorLabelItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<IndicatorLabelItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairLinesGeometryPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("CrosshairLinesGeometry", typeof(ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			AnnotationsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Annotations", typeof(ObservableCollection<Annotation>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualTitlePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualTitle", typeof(PaneTitle), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.Update));
			LegendsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Legends", typeof(PaneTargetLegendsCollection), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			SeriesContainersPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("SeriesContainers", typeof(ObservableCollection<SeriesContainerItem>), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			EnableAxisXNavigationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EnableAxisXNavigation", typeof(bool?), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(EnableNavigationPropertyChanged));
			EnableAxisYNavigationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EnableAxisYNavigation", typeof(bool?), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(EnableNavigationPropertyChanged));
			AxisXScrollBarOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AxisXScrollBarOptions", typeof(ScrollBarOptions), typeof(Pane), new PropertyMetadata(null, ScrollBarOptionsPropertyChanged));

		private static void CollapsedPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Pane { Diagram: var diagram } pane)
			{
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					diagram.PanesCollapsingOrder.OnPaneVisibilityChanged(pane);
					diagram.RaisePaneCollapsedChangedEvent(new PaneCollapsedChangedEventArgs(pane));
				}
				pane.UpdateActualPaneTitle(pane.ActualTitle);
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateXYDiagram2DItemAndActualPanes(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void EnableNavigationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Pane { ZoomStack: { } zoomStack })
			{
				zoomStack.Clear();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void RuntimeCollapsePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Pane pane)
			{
				pane.UpdateTitle();
			}
		}

		private static void ScrollBarOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Pane pane)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as ScrollBarOptions, e.NewValue as ScrollBarOptions, pane);
				pane.UpdateScrollBarItemOptions();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void TitlePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Pane pane)
			{
				pane.UpdateActualPaneTitle(e.NewValue as PaneTitle);
			}
		}

		private static void VisibilityPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Pane pane)
			{
				pane.lastMappingBounds = null;
				pane?.Diagram?.UpdateActualPanes();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
		}

		internal static bool MirrorHeightValidation(object mirrorHeight)
		{
			return (double)mirrorHeight >= 0.0;
		}

		public Pane()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Pane>(this);
			ScrollHorizontallyCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollHorizontally((int)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollHorizontally((int)parameter));
			ScrollVerticallyCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollVertically((int)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollVertically((int)parameter));
			ScrollAxisXToCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollAxisXTo((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollAxisXTo((double)parameter));
			ScrollAxisYToCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollAxisYTo((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollAxisYTo((double)parameter));
			SetAxisXRangeCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisXRange((AxisRangePositions)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisXRange());
			SetAxisYRangeCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisYRange((AxisRangePositions)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisYRange());
			SetAxisXZoomRatioCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisXZoomRatio((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisXZoomRatio());
			SetAxisYZoomRatioCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisYZoomRatio((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisYZoomRatio());
			ZoomIntoRectangleCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ZoomIntoRectangle((Rect)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanZoomIntoRectangle());
			ZoomInCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ZoomIn((System.Windows.Point?)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanZoomIn());
			ZoomOutCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ZoomOut((System.Windows.Point?)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanZoomOut());
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
			SetValue(CrosshairLinesGeometryPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData>());
			SetValue(LegendsPropertyKey, new PaneTargetLegendsCollection(this));
			SetValue(AnnotationsPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<Annotation>(new ObservableCollection<Annotation>()));
			SetValue(SeriesContainersPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<SeriesContainerItem>());
			StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel = new StackedBarTotalLabel();
			stackedBarTotalLabel.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			ChartDataTable = new ChartDataTable();
		}

		Rect IDockTarget.GetBounds()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Diagram.Container?.PlatformElement;
			if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.RenderSize != default(System.Windows.Size))
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)this, (UIElement)frameworkElement);
				return new Rect(relativeElementRect.Left + Viewport.Left, relativeElementRect.Top + Viewport.Top, Viewport.Width, Viewport.Height);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		List<IntervalLayout> IIntervalLayoutProvider.GetIntervalLayouts(IIntervalLayoutKey intervalLayoutKey)
		{
			return GetGridAndTextData(intervalLayoutKey)?.IntervalLayouts;
		}

		void IVisualChildOwner.InvalidateVisualChild(object sender)
		{
			if (sender is XYDiagram2DPanel)
			{
				diagramPanel = null;
			}
			if (sender is IndicatorElementsPanel)
			{
				indicatorsPanel = null;
			}
			if (sender is IndicatorLabelElementsPanel)
			{
				indicatorLabelsPanel = null;
			}
			if (sender is ConstantLineTitlePanel)
			{
				constantLineTitlesPanel = null;
			}
			if (sender is LegendsPanel)
			{
				legendsPanel = null;
			}
			if (sender is AnnotationLayoutPanel)
			{
				annotationsPanel = null;
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType != typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) || !(sender is ScrollBarOptions))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UpdateScrollBarItemOptions();
			ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
			return true;
		}

		void IZoomablePane.RangeLimitsUpdated()
		{
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = GetPaneAxesContainer();
			if (paneAxesContainer != null)
			{
				if (paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX is Axis2D axis2D)
				{
					axis2D.RangeLimitsUpdated();
				}
				if (paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY is Axis2D axis2D2)
				{
					axis2D2.RangeLimitsUpdated();
				}
			}
		}
