		}

		private Rect CalculateMappingBounds()
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			if (Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed || diagram == null || diagram.Container == null || PanePanel == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (diagram.Container.PlatformElement.FindCommonVisualAncestor(PanePanel) == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)PanePanel, (UIElement)diagram.Container.PlatformElement);
			if (relativeElementRect.Width >= 1.0 && relativeElementRect.Height >= 1.0)
			{
				relativeElementRect.Width -= 1.0;
				relativeElementRect.Height -= 1.0;
			}
			return relativeElementRect;
		}

		private Thickness CalculateOuterItemsLayout(Dictionary<AxisPosition, Axis2DItem> firstAxesItems, bool storeLabelsToCache)
		{
			ScrollBarItem axisXScrollBarItem = AxisXScrollBarItem;
			ScrollBarItem axisYScrollBarItem = AxisYScrollBarItem;
			axisXScrollBarItem?.CreateScrollBarLayout(firstAxesItems, viewport);
			axisYScrollBarItem?.CreateScrollBarLayout(firstAxesItems, viewport);
			UpdateIntervalsLayout(viewport.Size);
			Thickness offsets = new Thickness(0.0);
			resolveOverlappingCache.Clear();
			bool navigationEnabled = NavigationEnabled;
			if (axesInteraction != null)
			{
				axesInteraction.ClearAndUpdate();
			}
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache axisLabelsCache = null;
				Axis2DElementsLayoutCalculator.CalculateLayout(this, axisItem, viewport, OuterBounds, navigationEnabled, ref offsets, firstAxesItems.ContainsValue(axisItem), axesInteraction, ref axisLabelsCache);
				if (axisLabelsCache != null && storeLabelsToCache)
				{
					resolveOverlappingCache.Add(axisLabelsCache);
				}
			}
			return offsets;
		}

		private Rect CorrectViewportForTitle(Rect viewport)
		{
			return PaneTitlePanel?.CorrectViewportForTitle(viewport) ?? viewport;
		}

		private DelegateCommand<object> CreateDelegateCommand(Action<object> executeMethod, Func<object, bool> canExecuteMethod)
		{
			DelegateCommand<object> delegateCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(executeMethod, canExecuteMethod, useCommandManager: false);
			commands.Add(delegateCommand);
			return delegateCommand;
		}

		private Dictionary<AxisPosition, Axis2DItem> GetFirstAxesItems()
		{
			Dictionary<AxisPosition, Axis2DItem> dictionary = new Dictionary<AxisPosition, Axis2DItem>();
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				AxisPosition elementPosition = axisItem.ElementPosition;
				if (axisItem.Axis2D.ActualVisible && !dictionary.ContainsKey(elementPosition))
				{
					dictionary.Add(elementPosition, axisItem);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private IEnumerable<AxisTextData> GetTextData(List<GridAndTextData> gridAndTextData, double? intersectionLabelValue)
		{
			foreach (GridAndTextData gridAndTextDatum in gridAndTextData)
			{
				yield return gridAndTextDatum.GetTextData(intersectionLabelValue);
			}
		}

		private DXPoint GetZoomCenterPoint(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Point point2 = point ?? new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Left + viewport.Width / 2.0, viewport.Top + viewport.Height / 2.0);
			return new DXPoint(MathUtils.StrongRound(point2.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(point2.Y));
		}

		private void CreateSeriesLabelsLayout(bool shouldCalcRegularLabel)
		{
			IEnumerable<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesItem item in seriesItems)
			{
				if ((shouldCalcRegularLabel || item.Series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || item.Series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false)) && item.Series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
				{
					xYSeries2D.CreateSeriesLabelsLayout();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetAxesScrollBar()
		{
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				axisItem.SetScrollBarLayout(null);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActualPaneTitle(PaneTitle actualValue)
		{
			PaneTitle paneTitle = Title;
			if (paneTitle == null)
			{
				paneTitle = ((Collapsed && actualValue == null) ? new PaneTitle
				{
					Visible = false
				} : ((Collapsed || actualValue == null) ? actualValue : null));
			}
			SetValue(ActualTitlePropertyKey, paneTitle);
		}

		private void UpdateAxisScrollBarCommand(ScrollBarItem scrollBarItem, ICommand command)
		{
			if (scrollBarItem != null)
			{
				XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					scrollBarItem.Command = (diagram.ActualNavigationOptions.UseScrollBars ? command : null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScrollBarItemOptions()
		{
			ScrollBarItem axisXScrollBarItem = AxisXScrollBarItem;
			if (axisXScrollBarItem != null)
			{
				axisXScrollBarItem.Options = ActualAxisXScrollBarOptions;
			}
			axisXScrollBarItem = AxisYScrollBarItem;
			if (axisXScrollBarItem != null)
			{
				axisXScrollBarItem.Options = ActualAxisYScrollBarOptions;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisScrollBarAnnotations(ScrollBarItem scrollBarItem, Axis2D axis)
		{
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout>();
			ScrollBarOptions scrollBarOptions = (axis.IsVertical ? ActualAxisYScrollBarOptions : ActualAxisXScrollBarOptions);
			list.AddRange(axis.GetScrollBarAnnotationLayouts(scrollBarOptions));
			bool flag = (scrollBarOptions.AnnotatedElements & ScrollBarAnnotationElement.PaneAnnotation) == ScrollBarAnnotationElement.PaneAnnotation;
			bool flag2 = (scrollBarOptions.AnnotatedElements & ScrollBarAnnotationElement.SeriesPointAnnotation) == ScrollBarAnnotationElement.SeriesPointAnnotation;
			if (Diagram != null && Diagram.Annotations != null && (flag || flag2))
			{
				foreach (Annotation annotation in Diagram.Annotations)
				{
					if (annotation.Visible)
					{
						ScrollBarAnnotationLayout scrollBarAnnotationLayout = annotation.CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(axis, flag, flag2);
						if (scrollBarAnnotationLayout != null)
						{
							list.Add(scrollBarAnnotationLayout);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			scrollBarItem.Annotations = list;
		}

		private bool SetViewport(Rect value)
		{
			if (viewport == value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			viewport = value;
			paneTitlePanel?.InvalidateArrange();
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldCreateIntervals(Axis axis, double axisLength)
		{
			IMinMaxValues visualRange = ((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange;
			if (axisLength > 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(visualRange.Min))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(visualRange.Max);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double GetAxisLength(IAxisData axis, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (!axis.IsVertical)
			{
				return size.Width;
			}
			return size.Height;
		}

		private Rect CalcLabelsCorrection(Rect actualRect, bool navigationEnabled)
		{
			IEnumerable<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesItem item in seriesItems)
				{
					Series series = item.Series;
					if (!navigationEnabled)
					{
						IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> items = series.ActualLabel.Items;
						if (items != null)
						{
							foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in items)
							{
								actualRect = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(actualRect, item2);
							}
						}
					}
					if (series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
					{
						ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> items2 = series.ActualFirstPoint.ActualLabel.Items;
						if (items2 != null)
						{
							foreach (SeriesLabelItem item3 in items2)
							{
								actualRect = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(actualRect, item3);
							}
						}
					}
					if (!series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
					{
						continue;
					}
					ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> items3 = series.ActualLastPoint.ActualLabel.Items;
					if (items3 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (SeriesLabelItem item4 in series.ActualLastPoint.ActualLabel.Items)
					{
						actualRect = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(actualRect, item4);
					}
				}
			}
			return actualRect;
		}

		private void UpdateScrollBarItemsOrientation()
		{
			bool flag = Diagram?.Rotated ?? false;
			ScrollBarItem axisXScrollBarItem = AxisXScrollBarItem;
			if (axisXScrollBarItem != null)
			{
				axisXScrollBarItem.Orientation = (flag ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
			}
			axisXScrollBarItem = AxisYScrollBarItem;
			if (axisXScrollBarItem != null)
			{
				axisXScrollBarItem.Orientation = ((!flag) ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
			}
		}

		private void UnionWithoutBottom(Rect actualRect, Rect rect)
		{
			if (!actualRect.IsEmpty && !rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = Math.Min(actualRect.Left, rect.Left);
				double y = Math.Min(actualRect.Top, rect.Top);
				if (rect.Width == double.PositiveInfinity || base.Width == double.PositiveInfinity)
				{
					actualRect.Width = double.PositiveInfinity;
				}
				else
				{
					double num2 = Math.Max(actualRect.Right, rect.Right);
					actualRect.Width = Math.Max(num2 - num, 0.0);
				}
				actualRect.X = num;
				actualRect.Y = y;
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateIndicatorItems()
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram == null || !diagram.IndicatorsRepository.ContainsKey(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Indicator> list = diagram.IndicatorsRepository[this];
			foreach (Indicator item in list)
			{
				if (item.Visible && item.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					XYSeries2D xYSeries = item.XYSeries;
					if (xYSeries != null && xYSeries.GetActualVisible())
					{
						item.CalculateLayout();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal Rect CorrectViewportForLegends(Rect viewport)
		{
			Rect result = viewport;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (Legends != null)
			{
				Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double>();
				foreach (LegendBase legend in Legends)
				{
					if (legend.ActualVisible && legend.ItemsCore.Count > 0)
					{
						DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition key = new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend.HorizontalPosition, legend.VerticalPosition);
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
						{
							dictionary.Add(key, 0.0);
						}
						dictionary[key] += legend.DesiredSize.Height;
					}
				}
				foreach (LegendBase legend2 in Legends)
				{
					if (legend2.ActualVisible && legend2.ItemsCore.Count > 0)
					{
						DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition key = new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend2.HorizontalPosition, legend2.VerticalPosition);
						switch (legend2.HorizontalPosition)
						{
						case HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside:
							num = Math.Max(num, legend2.DesiredSize.Width + legend2.IndentFromDiagram.Right);
							break;
						case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside:
							num2 = Math.Max(num2, legend2.DesiredSize.Width + legend2.IndentFromDiagram.Left);
							break;
						}
						switch (legend2.VerticalPosition)
						{
						case VerticalPosition.TopOutside:
							num3 = Math.Max(num3, dictionary[key] + legend2.IndentFromDiagram.Bottom);
							break;
						case VerticalPosition.BottomOutside:
							num4 = Math.Max(num4, dictionary[key] + legend2.IndentFromDiagram.Top);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				double width = Math.Max(viewport.Width - num - num2, 0.0);
				double height = Math.Max(viewport.Height - num3 - num4, 0.0);
				result = new Rect(viewport.Left + num, viewport.Top + num3, width, height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void CalculateOuterItemsLayout()
		{
			CalculateOuterItemsLayout(GetFirstAxesItems(), storeLabelsToCache: true);
		}

		internal bool CalculateOuterItemsLayoutAndViewport(bool shouldUpdateViewportCache, bool isScrolling)
		{
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				axisItem.TitleIndent = 0.0;
			}
			rangeBounds = null;
			Rect innerBounds = InnerBounds;
			Rect rect = innerBounds.Decrease(DomainMargin);
			bool navigationEnabled = NavigationEnabled;
			if (Diagram.UseViewportCache && navigationEnabled && !cachedViewport.IsEmpty)
			{
				rect = cachedViewport;
			}
			Dictionary<AxisPosition, Axis2DItem> firstAxesItems = GetFirstAxesItems();
			bool flag = false;
			while (true)
			{
				flag |= SetViewport(rect);
				UpdateIntervalsLayout(viewport.Size);
				CreateSeriesLabelsLayout(!navigationEnabled || !isScrolling);
				CreateTotalLabelsLayout();
				Thickness thickness = CalculateOuterItemsLayout(firstAxesItems, shouldUpdateViewportCache);
				if (rect.Width < 1.0 || rect.Height < 1.0)
				{
					break;
				}
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left + thickness.Left, rect.Top + thickness.Top), new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right + thickness.Right, rect.Bottom + Math.Max(thickness.Bottom, MirrorHeight)));
				foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem2 in axisItems)
				{
					Rect labelRect = axisItem2.LabelRect;
					bool flag2 = axisItem2.Axis.IsVertical && ChartDataTable.Visible;
					if (labelRect != RectExtensions.Zero)
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							UnionWithoutBottom(rect2, labelRect);
						}
						else
						{
							rect2.Union(labelRect);
						}
					}
				}
				if (navigationEnabled)
				{
					rect2 = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(rect2, AxisXScrollBarItem);
					rect2 = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(rect2, AxisYScrollBarItem);
					rect2 = CalcLabelsCorrection(rect2, navigationEnabled: true);
				}
				else
				{
					rect2 = CalcLabelsCorrection(rect2, navigationEnabled: false);
					StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(this);
					if (totalLabel != null && totalLabel.Items != null)
					{
						foreach (StackedBarTotalLabelItem item in totalLabel.Items)
						{
							rect2 = LayoutElementHelper.UnionRect(rect2, item);
						}
					}
				}
				Thickness maxAnnotationsCorrection = AnnotationHelper.GetMaxAnnotationsCorrection(Annotations);
				Thickness thickness2 = new Thickness(MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(innerBounds.Left - rect2.Left, 0.0)), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(innerBounds.Top - rect2.Top, 0.0)), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(rect2.Right - innerBounds.Right, 0.0)), MathUtils.StrongRound(Math.Max(rect2.Bottom - innerBounds.Bottom, 0.0)));
				Thickness thickness3 = new Thickness(Math.Max(maxAnnotationsCorrection.Left, thickness2.Left), Math.Max(maxAnnotationsCorrection.Top, thickness2.Top), Math.Max(maxAnnotationsCorrection.Right, thickness2.Right), Math.Max(maxAnnotationsCorrection.Bottom, thickness2.Bottom));
				if (GraphicsUtils.IsThicknessEmpty(thickness3))
				{
					UpdateAxisResolveOverlappingCache();
					break;
				}
				double num = rect.Left + thickness3.Left;
				double num2 = rect.Top + thickness3.Top;
				Rect rect3 = new Rect(num, num2, Math.Max(rect.Right - thickness3.Right - num, 0.0), Math.Max(rect.Bottom - thickness3.Bottom - num2, 0.0));
				if (rect.Size == rect3.Size)
				{
					ChartDebug.Fail("Infinite loop detected");
					break;
				}
				rect = rect3;
			}
			Rect rect4 = CorrectViewportForLegends(rect);
			rect4 = CorrectViewportForTitle(rect4);
			if (ChartDataTable != null && ChartDataTable.Visible)
			{
				rect4 = ChartDataTable.ArrangeDataTable(rect4, InnerBounds.Size, SeriesItems);
			}
			flag |= SetViewport(rect4);
			if (shouldUpdateViewportCache)
			{
				cachedViewport = rect;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal void CreateTotalLabelsLayout()
		{
			StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(this);
			if (totalLabel == null || totalLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Transform viewportRenderTransform = ViewportRenderTransform;
			Dictionary<XYSeries2D, PaneMapping> dictionary = new Dictionary<XYSeries2D, PaneMapping>();
			foreach (StackedBarTotalLabelItem item in totalLabel.Items)
			{
				if (item.PointItem.Series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(xYSeries2D, out var value))
					{
						value = new PaneMapping(this, xYSeries2D);
						dictionary.Add(xYSeries2D, value);
					}
					item.Layout = xYSeries2D.CreateTotalLabelLayout(item, value, viewportRenderTransform);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FillIndicatorsLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, Legend legend)
		{
			UpdateIndicatorItems();
			ObservableCollection<IndicatorItem> indicatorItems = IndicatorItems;
			if (indicatorItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IndicatorItem indicatorItem in IndicatorItems)
			{
				Indicator indicator = indicatorItem.Indicator;
				if (indicatorItem.ShowInLegend && indicator.ActualLegend == legend)
				{
					indicatorItem.UpdateLegendItem(legend);
					indicator.SetLegendItemIndex(legendItems.Count);
					legendItems.Add(indicatorItem.LegendItem);
				}
			}
		}

		internal List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> GetElementsForAutoLayout()
		{
			List<Axis2D> list = new List<Axis2D>();
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = GetPaneAxesContainer();
			if (paneAxesContainer != null)
			{
				foreach (IAxisData axis in paneAxesContainer.Axes)
				{
					if (axis is Axis2D item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list2 = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in list)
			{
				if (item2.Title != null && !item2.Title.Visible.HasValue)
				{
					list2.Add(item2.Title);
				}
			}
			PaneTitle title = Title;
			if (title != null && !title.Visible.HasValue)
			{
				list2.Add(title);
			}
			list.RemoveAll((Axis2D x) => x.Visible.HasValue);
			list2.AddRange(list.ConvertAll((Converter<Axis2D, ISupportVisibilityControlElement>)((Axis2D x) => x)));
			return list2;
		}

		internal GRealRect2D GetLabelBounds(Axis2D axis)
		{
			foreach (object paneItem in PaneItems)
			{
				if (paneItem is Axis2DItem && ((Axis2DItem)paneItem).Axis == axis)
				{
					Rect labelRect = ((Axis2DItem)paneItem).LabelRect;
					Rect value = LastMappingBounds.Value;
					double left = labelRect.Left - viewport.Left + value.Left;
					double top = labelRect.Top - viewport.Top + value.Top;
					return labelRect.IsEmpty ? GRealRect2D.Empty : new GRealRect2D(left, top, labelRect.Width, labelRect.Height);
				}
			}
			return GRealRect2D.Empty;
		}

		internal bool PerformZoom(System.Windows.Point position, int delta, ZoomingKind kind)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PaneAxesManager paneAxesManager = GetPaneAxesManager();
			if (paneAxesManager != null && ((delta > 0 && ActualCanZoomIn) || (delta < 0 && ActualCanZoomOut)))
			{
				DXPoint zoomCenterPoint = GetZoomCenterPoint(position);
				double zoomPercent = PaneAxesManager.GetZoomPercent(delta);
				NavigationType navigationType = PaneAxesManager.GetNavigationType(delta);
				paneAxesManager.Zoom(zoomCenterPoint, zoomPercent, kind, navigationType, zoomToCenter: false);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			UpdateScrollBarItems();
			XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			ObservableCollection<SeriesItem> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<SeriesItem>();
			if (diagram != null && diagram.Container != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in diagram.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
				{
					if (item.Series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D && xYSeries2D.ActualPane == this && xYSeries2D.GetActualVisible())
					{
						if (xYSeries2D is AreaStackedSeries2D)
						{
							observableCollection.Insert(0, xYSeries2D.Item);
						}
						else
						{
							observableCollection.Add(xYSeries2D.Item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int count = observableCollection.Count;
			ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem> seriesItems = SeriesItems;
			if (seriesItems == null || seriesItems.Count != count)
			{
				SetValue(SeriesItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem>(observableCollection));
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (seriesItems[i] != observableCollection[i])
					{
						SetValue(SeriesItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SeriesItem>(observableCollection));
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateIndicatorItems();
			UpdateCrosshairAppearance();
			UpdateAnnotations();
		}

		private bool IsAnnotationInEditMode(Annotation annotation)
		{
			if (annotation.Content is EditableTextContent editableTextContent)
			{
				return editableTextContent.EditModeEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateAnnotations()
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			ObservableCollection<Annotation> observableCollection = (ObservableCollection<Annotation>)GetValue(AnnotationsProperty);
			foreach (Annotation item in observableCollection)
			{
				if (IsAnnotationInEditMode(item))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (observableCollection == null)
			{
				observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<Annotation>();
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				observableCollection.Clear();
			}
			if (diagram != null && diagram.Container != null && diagram.Annotations != null)
			{
				foreach (Annotation annotation in diagram.Annotations)
				{
					if (annotation.ActualShapePosition is RelativePosition && ((annotation.ActualAnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint && ((PaneAnchorPoint)annotation.ActualAnchorPoint).ActualPane == this) || (annotation.ActualAnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint && ((SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.ActualAnchorPoint).SeriesPoint != null && ((SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.ActualAnchorPoint).SeriesPoint.Series is XYSeries2D && ((XYSeries2D)((SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.ActualAnchorPoint).SeriesPoint.Series).ActualPane == this)))
					{
						observableCollection.Add(annotation);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SetValue(AnnotationsPropertyKey, observableCollection);
			}
		}

		internal bool UpdateAxesLabelItems()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = GetPaneAxesContainer();
			if (paneAxesContainer != null)
			{
				IAxisData primaryAxisX = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisX;
				IAxisData primaryAxisY = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;
				axesInteraction = AxesLayoutInteractionManager.Create(axisItems.Find((Axis2DItem x) => x.Axis == primaryAxisX), axisItems.Find((Axis2DItem x) => x.Axis == primaryAxisY), this);
			}
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				if (axisItem.LayoutWatchdog <= 200 || axisItem.Axis.NeedUpdateLabelItems)
				{
					IntervalsGridAndTextData gridAndTextData = GetGridAndTextData(axisItem.Axis2D);
					if (gridAndTextData != null)
					{
						double? intersectionLabelValue = ((axesInteraction != null) ? axesInteraction.GetIntersectionInternalValue(axisItem) : ((double?)null));
						flag |= axisItem.UpdateLabelItems(GetTextData(gridAndTextData.GridAndTextData, intersectionLabelValue));
					}
					axisItem.Axis.NeedUpdateLabelItems = false;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal void UpdateAxisItems()
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in axisItems)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(axisItem);
				IEnumerable<AxisLabelItem> labelItems = axisItem.LabelItems;
				if (labelItems != null)
				{
					foreach (AxisLabelItem item in labelItems)
					{
						observableCollection.Add(item);
					}
				}
				AxisTitleItem titleItem = axisItem.TitleItem;
				if (titleItem != null)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(titleItem);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem2 in axisItems)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(axisItem2.SelectionGeometryItem);
			}
			PaneItems = observableCollection;
		}

		internal void UpdateIndicatorItems()
		{
			ObservableCollection<IndicatorItem> observableCollection = GetValue(IndicatorItemsProperty) as ObservableCollection<IndicatorItem>;
			ObservableCollection<IndicatorLabelItem> observableCollection2 = GetValue(IndicatorLabelItemsProperty) as ObservableCollection<IndicatorLabelItem>;
			bool flag = false;
			if (observableCollection == null)
			{
				observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<IndicatorItem>();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (observableCollection2 == null)
			{
				observableCollection2 = new ObservableCollection<IndicatorLabelItem>();
				flag = true;
			}
			ObservableCollectionHelper<IndicatorItem> val = new ObservableCollectionHelper<IndicatorItem>(observableCollection, false);
			try
			{
				ObservableCollectionHelper<IndicatorLabelItem> val2 = new ObservableCollectionHelper<IndicatorLabelItem>(observableCollection2, false);
				try
				{
					XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
					if (diagram != null && diagram.IndicatorsRepository.ContainsKey(this))
					{
						List<Indicator> list = diagram.IndicatorsRepository[this];
						int num = 0;
						IndicatorsPalette indicatorsPalette = ((diagram.Container?.ChartOptions == null) ? new DefaultIndicatorsPalette() : diagram.Container?.ChartOptions.IndicatorsPalette);
						foreach (Indicator item in list)
						{
							item.Item.Visible = item.GetActualVisible();
							if (!item.Visible)
							{
								continue;
							}
							item.Item.Brush = ((item.BrushInternal != null || indicatorsPalette == null) ? item.BrushInternal : new SolidColorBrush(indicatorsPalette[num]));
							num++;
							val.Add(item.Item);
							if (item.LabelItems == null || !item.Item.Label.Visible)
							{
								continue;
							}
							foreach (IndicatorLabelItem labelItem in item.LabelItems)
							{
								val2.Add(labelItem);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SetValue(IndicatorItemsPropertyKey, observableCollection);
				SetValue(IndicatorLabelItemsPropertyKey, observableCollection2);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateIntervalsGridAndTextData(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			axesGridAndTextData.Clear();
			bool navigationEnabled = Diagram != null && Diagram.IsNavigationEnabled;
			foreach (Axis2D axis in Axes)
			{
				double axisLength = GetAxisLength(axis, size);
				if (ShouldCreateIntervals(axis, axisLength))
				{
					IEnumerable<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalLayouts = AxisIntervalLayout.CreateIntervalsLayout(axis, (int)axisLength);
					IntervalsGridAndTextData value = new IntervalsGridAndTextData(intervalLayouts, axis, size, navigationEnabled, axisLength);
					axesGridAndTextData.Add(axis, value);
				}
			}
			UpdateIntervalsLayout(size);
		}

		internal void UpdateIntervalsLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			List<Tuple<Axis2D, IntervalsGridAndTextData>> list = new List<Tuple<Axis2D, IntervalsGridAndTextData>>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IIntervalLayoutKey, IntervalsGridAndTextData> axesGridAndTextDatum in axesGridAndTextData)
			{
				Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)axesGridAndTextDatum.Key;
				axesGridAndTextDatum.Value.UpdateIntervalsLayout(axis2D, size, GetAxisLength(axis2D, size));
				list.Add(new Tuple<Axis2D, IntervalsGridAndTextData>(axis2D, axesGridAndTextDatum.Value));
			}
			paneAreas = new XYDiagramPaneAreas(list);
		}

	public class DirectXSurfaceDataTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public DataTemplate DirectXSurfaceTemplate { get; set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public DataTemplate EmptyTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item == null || !Convert.ToBoolean(item))
			{
				return EmptyTemplate;
			}
			return DirectXSurfaceTemplate;
		}
	}
	public class PaneCollection : ChartElementCollection<Pane>, IEnumerable<IPane>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override ChartElementChange Change => base.Change | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateActualPanes;

		IEnumerator<IPane> IEnumerable<IPane>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<Pane> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!(base.Owner is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.OnPaneCollectionClear();
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.AddPanes(e.NewItems, e.NewStartingIndex);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.RemovePanes(e.OldItems, e.OldStartingIndex);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.RemovePanes(e.OldItems, e.OldStartingIndex);
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.PanesCollapsingOrder.AddPanes(e.NewItems, e.NewStartingIndex);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class PaneTitlePanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TitleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Title", typeof(PaneTitle), typeof(PaneTitlePanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, TitleChanged));

		private System.Windows.Size lastTitleSize;

		[NonTestableProperty]
		[NonCategorized]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public PaneTitle Title
		{
			get
			{
				return (PaneTitle)GetValue(TitleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TitleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void TitleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is PaneTitlePanel paneTitlePanel))
			{
				return;
			}
			paneTitlePanel.Children.Clear();
			if (e.NewValue is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				if (LayoutHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)uIElement, false) is PaneTitlePanel paneTitlePanel2)
				{
					paneTitlePanel2.Children.Clear();
				}
				paneTitlePanel.Children.Add(uIElement);
			}
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(paneTitlePanel);
		}

		private void InvalidateDiagram()
		{
			Pane pane = Title.Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				XYDiagram2D diagram = pane.Diagram;
				if (diagram != null && diagram.Container != null)
				{
					diagram.Container.AddInvalidate((InvalidateMeasureFlags)9);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			PaneTitle title = Title;
			if (title == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			title.Measure(availableSize);
			System.Windows.Size size = title.Size;
			if (lastTitleSize != size)
			{
				InvalidateDiagram();
				lastTitleSize = size;
			}
			if (!title.Pane.Collapsed)
			{
				return availableSize;
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			PaneTitle title = Title;
			if (title == null)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			Rect finalRect = RectExtensions.Zero;
			if (title.ActualVisible)
			{
				Pane pane = title.Pane;
				if (pane.Collapsed)
				{
					finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					Rect viewport = pane.Viewport;
					finalRect = new Rect(viewport.Left, viewport.Top - title.DesiredSize.Height, viewport.Width, title.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			title.Arrange(finalRect);
			return finalSize;
		}

		internal Rect CorrectViewportForTitle(Rect viewport)
		{
			Rect result = viewport;
			PaneTitle title = Title;
			if (title != null && title.ActualVisible)
			{
				if (ShouldRotate(result.Size))
				{
					double width = title.DesiredSize.Width;
					result = new Rect(viewport.Left + width, viewport.Top, Math.Max(viewport.Width - width, 0.0), viewport.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					double num = Math.Max(viewport.Top, title.DesiredSize.Height) - viewport.Top + title.Pane.Padding.Top;
					result = new Rect(viewport.Left, viewport.Top + num, viewport.Width, Math.Max(viewport.Height - num, 0.0));
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool ShouldRotate(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (Title != null && Title.Pane.Collapsed)
			{
				return size.Height > size.Width;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}

		protected override bool ShouldCreateItemPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is Axis2DItem) && !(item is AxisLabelItem) && !(item is AxisTitleItem) && !(item is ScrollBarItem) && !(item is StackedBarTotalLabelConnectorItem) && !(item is StackedBarTotalLabelItem))
			{
				return base.ShouldCreateItemPresentation(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override ILayoutElement GetItemPresentation(object item)
		{
			if (item is Axis2DItem axis2DItem)
			{
				return new Axis2DPresentation(axis2DItem);
			}
			if (item is AxisLabelItem labelItem)
			{
				return new AxisLabelPresentation(labelItem);
			}
			if (item is AxisTitleItem axisTitleItem)
			{
				return new AxisTitlePresentation(axisTitleItem);
			}
			if (item is ScrollBarItem scrollBarItem)
			{
				return new ScrollBarPresentation(scrollBarItem);
			}
			if (item is SelectionGeometryItem selectionGeometryItem)
			{
				return new SelectionPresentation(selectionGeometryItem);
			}
			if (item is StackedBarTotalLabelItem labelItem2)
			{
				return new StackedBarTotalLabelPresentation(labelItem2);
			}
			if (item is StackedBarTotalLabelConnectorItem connectorItem)
			{
				return new StackedBarTotalLabelConnectorPresentation(connectorItem);
			}
			return base.GetItemPresentation(item);
		}

		protected override void CreateItems(HashSet<object> items)
		{
			UIElement paneContent = PaneContent;
			if (paneContent != null)
			{
				items.Add(paneContent);
			}
			UIElement scaleBreaksContainerControl = ScaleBreaksContainerControl;
			if (scaleBreaksContainerControl != null)
			{
				items.Add(scaleBreaksContainerControl);
			}
			if (Pane != null && Pane.MirrorHeight > 0.0)
			{
				if (MirrorControl is ChartMirrorControl chartMirrorControl)
				{
					if (chartMirrorControl.GetBindingExpression(ChartMirrorControl.SeriesProperty) == null)
					{
						chartMirrorControl.SetBinding(ChartMirrorControl.SeriesProperty, new Binding
						{
							ElementName = "PART_Series"
						});
					}
					items.Add(chartMirrorControl);
				}
				if (Pseudo3DMirrorControl is ChartMirrorControl chartMirrorControl2)
				{
					if (chartMirrorControl2.GetBindingExpression(ChartMirrorControl.SeriesProperty) == null)
					{
						chartMirrorControl2.SetBinding(ChartMirrorControl.SeriesProperty, new Binding
						{
							ElementName = "PART_Pseudo3DSeries"
						});
					}
					items.Add(chartMirrorControl2);
				}
			}
			ObservableCollection<object> paneItems = PaneItems;
			if (paneItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in paneItems)
				{
					items.Add(item);
				}
			}
			UIElement pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer = Pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer;
			if (pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer != null)
			{
				items.Add(pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer);
			}
			UIElement selectionControl = SelectionControl;
			if (selectionControl != null)
			{
				items.Add(selectionControl);
			}
			UIElement crosshairContainer = CrosshairContainer;
			if (crosshairContainer != null)
			{
				items.Add(crosshairContainer);
			}
			ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> seriesLabelItems = SeriesLabelItems;
			if (seriesLabelItems != null)
			{
				ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
				foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in seriesLabelItems)
				{
					SeriesLabelConnectorItem connectorItem = item2.ConnectorItem;
					if (item2.Layout == null || item2.Layout.Visible || (connectorItem != null && connectorItem.Layout != null))
					{
						if (connectorItem != null)
						{
							items.Add(connectorItem);
						}
						observableCollection.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				foreach (object item3 in observableCollection)
				{
					items.Add(item3);
				}
			}
			ObservableCollection<StackedBarTotalLabelItem> totalLabelItems = TotalLabelItems;
			if (totalLabelItems != null)
			{
				foreach (StackedBarTotalLabelItem item4 in totalLabelItems)
				{
					StackedBarTotalLabelConnectorItem connectorItem2 = item4.ConnectorItem;
					if (connectorItem2 != null)
					{
						items.Add(connectorItem2);
					}
				}
				foreach (StackedBarTotalLabelItem item5 in totalLabelItems)
				{
					items.Add(item5);
				}
			}
			if (AxisXScrollBarItem != null)
			{
				items.Add(AxisXScrollBarItem);
			}
			if (AxisYScrollBarItem != null)
			{
				items.Add(AxisYScrollBarItem);
			}
			if (AnnotationContainer != null)
			{
				items.Add(AnnotationContainer);
			}
			if (LegendsContainer != null)
			{
				items.Add(LegendsContainer);
			}
			if (ChartDataTable != null)
			{
				items.Add(ChartDataTable);
			}
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal_Collapsed", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal_NoArrow", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver_Collapsed", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Disabled", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Disabled_Collapsed", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	public class PaneTitle : TitleBase, IHitTestableElement, IInteractiveElement, ISupportVisibilityControlElement, ICloneable, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private SelectionInfo selectionInfo;

		private bool autoLayoutVisible = true;

		private System.Windows.Size actualSize;

		private int id = -1;

		internal override bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Pane == null || !Pane.Collapsed)
				{
					if (!base.Visible.HasValue)
					{
						return autoLayoutVisible;
					}
					return base.Visible.Value;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal Pane Pane => LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Pane>((DependencyObject)this);

		internal System.Windows.Size Size => actualSize;

		internal bool CanProcessLeftButtonClick
		{
			get
			{
				Pane pane = Pane;
				if (pane != null && pane.ActualRuntimeCollapse && !pane.IsLastNotCollapsedPane)
				{
					return !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ArrowVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Pane != null)
				{
					if (!Pane.ActualRuntimeCollapse)
					{
						return Pane.Collapsed;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ArrowDisabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Pane != null)
				{
					if (!Pane.ActualRuntimeCollapse || !Pane.IsLastNotCollapsedPane)
					{
						if (!Pane.ActualRuntimeCollapse)
						{
							return Pane.Collapsed;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public new VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return base.VerticalAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				base.VerticalAlignment = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public SelectionInfo SelectionInfo => selectionInfo;

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => this;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => null;

		bool IInteractiveElement.IsHighlighted
		{
			get
			{
				return selectionInfo.IsHighlighted;
			}
			set
			{
				selectionInfo.IsHighlighted = value;
			}
		}

		bool IInteractiveElement.IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return selectionInfo.IsSelected;
			}
			set
			{
				selectionInfo.IsSelected = value;
			}
		}

		object IInteractiveElement.Content => this;

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Priority => 4;

		bool ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!base.Visible.HasValue)
				{
					autoLayoutVisible = value;
					base.Visibility = ((!autoLayoutVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
			}
		}

		GRealRect2D ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Bounds => new GRealRect2D(0.0, 0.0, Size.Width, Size.Height);

		VisibilityElementOrientation ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Orientation => VisibilityElementOrientation.Horizontal;

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				propertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		static PaneTitle()
		{
			TitleBase.VisibleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(PaneTitle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((bool?)null));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(PaneTitle);
			Control.PaddingProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, Update));
			FrameworkElement.MarginProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, Update));
			Control.BorderThicknessProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, Update));
		}

		internal static void Update(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				PaneTitle paneTitle = d as PaneTitle;
				Diagram d2 = LayoutHelper.FindAmongParents<Diagram>((DependencyObject)paneTitle, (DependencyObject)null);
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d2, e);
			}
		}

		public PaneTitle()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<PaneTitle>(this);
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			PaneTitle paneTitle = new PaneTitle();
			paneTitle.Assign(this);
			return paneTitle;
		}

		private void Assign(PaneTitle title)
		{
			if (title != null)
			{
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, TitleBase.ContentProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.TemplateProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.PaddingProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.FontFamilyProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.FontSizeProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.ForegroundProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.FontStretchProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.FontStyleProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.FontWeightProperty);
				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (ArrowVisible)
			{
				if (ArrowDisabled)
				{
					if (Pane != null && Pane.Collapsed)
					{
						VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled_Collapsed", useTransitions: true);
					}
					else
					{
						VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions: true);
					}
				}
				else if (base.IsMouseOver && CanProcessLeftButtonClick)
				{
					if (Pane != null && Pane.Collapsed)
					{
						VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver_Collapsed", useTransitions: true);
					}
					else
					{
						VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions: true);
					}
				}
				else if (Pane != null && Pane.Collapsed)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal_Collapsed", useTransitions: true);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal_NoArrow", useTransitions: true);
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.propertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.propertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (CanProcessLeftButtonClick)
			{
				Pane pane = Pane;
				pane.Collapsed = !pane.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (ActualVisible && result.Width > 0.0 && result.Height > 0.0)
			{
				actualSize = result;
				actualSize.Width += base.Margin.Left + base.Margin.Right;
				actualSize.Height += base.Margin.Top + base.Margin.Bottom;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Update();
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class PanePanel : ChartItemsPanelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCollapsedPaneProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsCollapsedPane", typeof(bool), typeof(PanePanel));

		private const double defaultSize = 300.0;

		[NonTestableProperty]
		[NonCategorized]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsCollapsedPane
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsCollapsedPaneProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsCollapsedPaneProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private PaneTitlePanel PaneTitlePanel => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.PaneTitlePanel) as PaneTitlePanel;

		private UIElement PaneItemsControl => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.PaneItemsControl);

		private UIElement FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType elementType)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (XYDiagram2D.GetElementType(child) == elementType)
				{
					return child;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			PaneTitlePanel paneTitlePanel = PaneTitlePanel;
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Width, 300.0), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Height, 300.0));
			if (IsCollapsedPane)
			{
				PaneItemsControl.Measure(default(System.Windows.Size));
				Thickness padding = paneTitlePanel.Title.Pane.Padding;
				double num = Math.Max(0.0, size.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right);
				double num2 = Math.Max(0.0, size.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom);
				if (paneTitlePanel.ShouldRotate(size))
				{
					paneTitlePanel.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(num2, num));
					return new System.Windows.Size(paneTitlePanel.DesiredSize.Height + padding.Left + padding.Right, paneTitlePanel.DesiredSize.Width + padding.Top + padding.Bottom);
				}
				paneTitlePanel.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(num, num2));
				return new System.Windows.Size(paneTitlePanel.DesiredSize.Width + padding.Left + padding.Right, paneTitlePanel.DesiredSize.Height + padding.Top + padding.Bottom);
			}
			paneTitlePanel.Measure(size);
			PaneItemsControl.Measure(size);
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			PaneTitlePanel paneTitlePanel = PaneTitlePanel;
			if (IsCollapsedPane)
			{
				Pane pane = paneTitlePanel.Title.Pane;
				Thickness padding = pane.Padding;
				double num = Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right);
				double num2 = Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom);
				if (paneTitlePanel.ShouldRotate(finalSize))
				{
					paneTitlePanel.RenderTransform = new RotateTransform
					{
						Angle = -90.0
					};
					paneTitlePanel.Arrange(new Rect(padding.Left, padding.Top + num2, num2, num));
				}
				else
				{
					paneTitlePanel.RenderTransform = new MatrixTransform
					{
						Matrix = Matrix.Identity
					};
					paneTitlePanel.Arrange(new Rect(pane.Viewport.Left, padding.Top, num, num2));
				}
				PaneItemsControl.Arrange(default(Rect));
			}
			else
			{
				paneTitlePanel.RenderTransform = new MatrixTransform
				{
					Matrix = Matrix.Identity
				};
				paneTitlePanel.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
				PaneItemsControl.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public enum XYDiagram2DElementType
	{
		None,
		DiagramContent,
		ScaleBreaksContainer,
		Mirror,
		Pseudo3DMirror,
		Pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer,
		CrosshairContainer,
		Selection,
		AnnotationContainer,
		LegendsContainer,
		PaneTitlePanel,
		PaneItemsControl,
		ChartDataTable
	}
	public class XYDiagram2DPanel : Canvas
	{
		private struct LayoutItem : IEquatable<LayoutItem>
		{
			public readonly UIElement Element;

			public readonly System.Windows.Size Size;

			public LayoutItem(UIElement element, System.Windows.Size size)
			{
				Element = element;
				Size = size;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				LayoutItem layoutItem = (LayoutItem)obj;
				return object.Equals(this, layoutItem);
			}

			public bool Equals(LayoutItem other)
			{
				if (Element == other.Element)
				{
					return Size == other.Size;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return Element.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private const int MaxAllowedSequentialMeasures = 5;

		private int measureOverrideWatchdog;

		private List<LayoutItem> layoutItems;

		private Pane Pane => LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<PaneItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this)?.Pane;

		private IEnumerable<UIElement> LayoutElements
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in Children)
				{
					if (XYDiagram2D.GetElementType(child) == XYDiagram2DElementType.None && child is ILayoutElement)
					{
						yield return child;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private ChartDataTable ChartDataTable => (ChartDataTable)FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.ChartDataTable);

		private IEnumerable<LayoutElementPresentation> ScrollBars
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in Children)
				{
					if (child is LayoutElementPresentation layoutElementPresentation && layoutElementPresentation.Content is ScrollBarPresentation)
					{
						yield return layoutElementPresentation;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private UIElement DiagramContent => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.DiagramContent);

		private UIElement ScaleBreaksContainer => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.ScaleBreaksContainer);

		private UIElement Mirror => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.Mirror);

		private UIElement Pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.Pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer);

		private UIElement Pseudo3DMirror => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.Pseudo3DMirror);

		private UIElement CrosshairContainer => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.CrosshairContainer);

		private UIElement Selection => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.Selection);

		private UIElement AnnotationContainer => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.AnnotationContainer);

		private UIElement LegendsContainer => FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType.LegendsContainer);

		private void InvalidateDiagram()
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				XYDiagram2D diagram = pane.Diagram;
				if (diagram != null && diagram.Container != null)
				{
					diagram.Container.AddInvalidate((InvalidateMeasureFlags)9);
				}
			}
		}

		private UIElement FindElementByType(XYDiagram2DElementType elementType)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (XYDiagram2D.GetElementType(child) == elementType)
				{
					return child;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Geometry CreateClipGeometry(Rect[] clipRects)
		{
			int num = clipRects.Length;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!clipRects[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
					{
						Rect = clipRects[i]
					});
				}
			}
			if (geometryGroup.Children.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesLabelItemsConnectors(ISeriesLabel label)
		{
			if (label == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItemBase> items = label.Items;
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItemBase item in items)
			{
				item.UpdateConnectorCoordinates();
			}
		}

		private bool InvalidateDiagramIfRequired(List<UIElement> elements)
		{
			List<LayoutItem> list = new List<LayoutItem>();
			foreach (UIElement element in elements)
			{
				list.Add(new LayoutItem(element, element.DesiredSize));
			}
			if (layoutItems == null || list.Count != layoutItems.Count)
			{
				InvalidateDiagram();
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!layoutItems[i].Equals(list[i]))
					{
						InvalidateDiagram();
						layoutItems = list;
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			layoutItems = list;
			return true;
		}

		private void ArrangeCore(UIElement element, Rect layoutElementRect)
		{
			element.SetValue(Canvas.LeftProperty, layoutElementRect.X);
			element.SetValue(Canvas.TopProperty, layoutElementRect.Y);
			if ((element as LayoutElementPresentation)?.Content is ScrollBarPresentation)
			{
				element.SetValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, layoutElementRect.Width);
				element.SetValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, layoutElementRect.Height);
			}
			if ((element as LayoutElementPresentation)?.Content is Axis2DPresentation)
			{
				element.SetValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, layoutElementRect.Width);
				element.SetValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, layoutElementRect.Height);
			}
			element.Arrange(layoutElementRect);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			UIElement diagramContent = DiagramContent;
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>(LayoutElements);
			foreach (UIElement item in list)
			{
				item.Measure(constraint);
			}
			if (!InvalidateDiagramIfRequired(list) && measureOverrideWatchdog++ > 5)
			{
				return constraint;
			}
			measureOverrideWatchdog = 0;
			System.Windows.Size availableSize = ((constraint.Width == 0.0 || constraint.Height == 0.0 || Pane == null) ? default(System.Windows.Size) : Pane.Viewport.Size);
			foreach (LayoutElementPresentation scrollBar in ScrollBars)
			{
				scrollBar.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			}
			if (diagramContent != null)
			{
				diagramContent.SetValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
				diagramContent.SetValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
				diagramContent.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			UIElement scaleBreaksContainer = ScaleBreaksContainer;
			if (scaleBreaksContainer != null)
			{
				scaleBreaksContainer.InvalidateArrange();
				scaleBreaksContainer.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			UIElement mirror = Mirror;
			if (mirror != null)
			{
				mirror.InvalidateArrange();
				mirror.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, constraint.Height));
			}
			Pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer?.Measure(availableSize);
			UIElement pseudo3DMirror = Pseudo3DMirror;
			if (pseudo3DMirror != null)
			{
				pseudo3DMirror.InvalidateArrange();
				pseudo3DMirror.Measure(constraint);
			}
			CrosshairContainer?.Measure(constraint);
			AnnotationContainer?.Measure(constraint);
			LegendsContainer?.Measure(constraint);
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			Rect rect = ((finalSize.Width == 0.0 || finalSize.Height == 0.0 || pane == null) ? RectExtensions.Zero : pane.Viewport);
			bool flag = rect.Width == 0.0 || rect.Height == 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement in LayoutElements)
			{
				Rect rect2 = RectExtensions.Zero;
				ILayout layout = ((ILayoutElement)layoutElement).Layout;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					layoutElement.Clip = CreateClipGeometry(layout.ClipRects);
					if (!flag && layout.Visible)
					{
						rect2 = (layout.Bounds.IsEmpty ? new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height) : new Rect(layout.Location, layout.Size));
					}
				}
				ArrangeCore(layoutElement, rect2);
				layoutElement.Visibility = ((rect2 == RectExtensions.Zero) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			}
			IEnumerable<SeriesItem> enumerable = pane?.SeriesItems;
			if (enumerable != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesItem item in enumerable)
				{
					Series series = item.Series;
					UpdateSeriesLabelItemsConnectors(series.ActualLabel);
					if (series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
					{
						UpdateSeriesLabelItemsConnectors(series.ActualFirstPoint.ActualLabel);
					}
					if (series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
					{
						UpdateSeriesLabelItemsConnectors(series.ActualLastPoint.ActualLabel);
					}
				}
			}
			StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel = ((pane != null) ? BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(pane) : null);
			if (stackedBarTotalLabel != null)
			{
				UpdateSeriesLabelItemsConnectors(stackedBarTotalLabel);
			}
			UIElement diagramContent = DiagramContent;
			if (diagramContent != null && pane?.PaneAreas != null)
			{
				diagramContent.Clip = pane.PaneAreas.ClipRegion;
				ArrangeCore(diagramContent, rect);
			}
			UIElement scaleBreaksContainer = ScaleBreaksContainer;
			if (scaleBreaksContainer != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(scaleBreaksContainer, rect);
			}
			UIElement selection = Selection;
			if (selection != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(selection, rect);
			}
			UIElement mirror = Mirror;
			if (mirror != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(mirror, flag ? RectExtensions.Zero : new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), mirror.DesiredSize));
			}
			UIElement pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer = Pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer;
			if (pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(pseudo3DBarSeriesContainer, flag ? RectExtensions.Zero : new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
			}
			UIElement pseudo3DMirror = Pseudo3DMirror;
			if (pseudo3DMirror != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(pseudo3DMirror, flag ? RectExtensions.Zero : new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, rect.Bottom), pseudo3DMirror.DesiredSize));
			}
			UIElement crosshairContainer = CrosshairContainer;
			if (crosshairContainer != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(crosshairContainer, flag ? RectExtensions.Zero : new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
			}
			UIElement annotationContainer = AnnotationContainer;
			if (annotationContainer != null)
			{
				annotationContainer.Clip = ((pane != null && pane.Diagram != null && pane.Diagram.IsNavigationEnabled) ? new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = rect
				} : null);
				ArrangeCore(annotationContainer, new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
			}
			UIElement legendsContainer = LegendsContainer;
			if (legendsContainer != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(legendsContainer, new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
			}
			ChartDataTable chartDataTable = ChartDataTable;
			if (chartDataTable != null)
			{
				ArrangeCore(chartDataTable, chartDataTable.Bounds);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram2DPanesPanel : Canvas
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<Pane, DXRectangle> paneBounds = new Dictionary<Pane, DXRectangle>();

		private XYDiagram2D Diagram => LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<XYDiagram2D>((DependencyObject)this);

		internal Dictionary<Pane, DXRectangle> PaneBounds => paneBounds;

		public Orientation Orientation => Diagram?.PaneOrientation ?? Orientation.Vertical;

		public ILayoutOptions LayoutOptions
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
				if (diagram != null && diagram.PaneLayout is IGridLayoutOptions)
				{
					return diagram.PaneLayout as IGridLayoutOptions;
				}
				return diagram;
			}
		}

		public bool GridAsLinear
		{
			get
			{
				if (LayoutOptions is GridLayout gridLayout)
				{
					return gridLayout.AsLinearLayout;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool GridAsLinearAndMatchOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				if (!GridAsLinear)
				{
					return false;
				}
				GridLayout gridLayout = (GridLayout)LayoutOptions;
				Orientation orientation = Orientation;
				if (gridLayout.ColumnDefinitions.Count != 1 || orientation != Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					if (gridLayout.RowDefinitions.Count == 1)
					{
						return orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private LayoutInfoList CalculatePanesBounds(PanesList panes, System.Windows.Size constraint, List<LayoutItem> collapsedItems)
		{
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XYDiagram2D diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				collapsedItems.Sort(delegate(LayoutItem first, LayoutItem second)
				{
					int num = diagram.PanesCollapsingOrder.IndexOf(panes[first.Index]);
					int num2 = diagram.PanesCollapsingOrder.IndexOf(panes[second.Index]);
					return (num >= 0 && num2 >= 0) ? num.CompareTo(num2) : num2.CompareTo(num);
				});
			}
			LayoutInfoList layoutInfoList = null;
			DXRectangle val = default(DXRectangle);
			((DXRectangle)(ref val))..ctor(0, 0, (int)constraint.Width, (int)constraint.Height);
			ILayoutOptions layoutOptions = LayoutOptions;
			if (!(layoutOptions is GridLayout gridLayout))
			{
				return LinearNonProportionalLayoutCalculator.Calculate(panes, layoutOptions, 0, val, val, collapsedItems);
			}
			if (gridLayout.AsLinearLayout)
			{
				return GridAsLinearLayoutCalculator.Calculate(panes, gridLayout, 0, val, val, collapsedItems);
			}
			return GridLayoutCalculator.Calculate(panes, gridLayout, 0, val, val, collapsedItems);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			//IL_011a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0198: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double defaultValue = 300.0;
			constraint = new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Width, defaultValue), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(constraint.Height, defaultValue));
			paneBounds.Clear();
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			bool gridAsLinear = GridAsLinear;
			PanesList panesList = new PanesList();
			List<LayoutItem> list = new List<LayoutItem>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Pane child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child != null && (child.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed || gridAsLinear))
				{
					panesList.Add(child);
					if (child.Collapsed)
					{
						child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(constraint.Width, constraint.Height), Math.Min(constraint.Width, constraint.Height)));
						list.Add(new LayoutItem(num, new DXRectangle(0, 0, (int)(child.DesiredSize.Width + 0.5), (int)(child.DesiredSize.Height + 0.5))));
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			LayoutInfoList layoutInfoList = CalculatePanesBounds(panesList, constraint, list);
			if (layoutInfoList == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			List<LayoutInfo> list2 = layoutInfoList.List;
			for (num = 0; num < panesList.Count; num++)
			{
				Pane pane2 = panesList[num];
				if (pane2 != null && pane2.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					DXRectangle mappingBounds = list2[num].MappingBounds;
					paneBounds.Add(pane2, mappingBounds);
					pane2.PaneLocation = new System.Windows.Point(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Top);
					pane2.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Height));
				}
			}
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			List<Pane> list = new List<Pane>();
			if (base.Children.Count == 1)
			{
				base.Children[0].Arrange(new Rect(arrangeBounds));
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Pane child in base.Children)
				{
					list.Add(child);
				}
				list.ForEach(delegate(Pane p)
				{
					if (paneBounds.TryGetValue(p, out var value))
					{
						p.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(((DXRectangle)(ref value)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref value)).Top), p.DesiredSize));
					}
				});
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}
	}

	public class XYDiagram2DSeriesPanel : Panel
	{
		private Pane Pane
		{
			get
			{
				DiagramSeriesItemsControl diagramSeriesItemsControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DiagramSeriesItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
				if (diagramSeriesItemsControl != null)
				{
					return diagramSeriesItemsControl.Owner as Pane;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child?.Measure(pane.Diagram.Rotated ? new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Width) : availableSize);
				}
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				Transform viewportTransform = pane.ViewportTransform;
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					if (child != null)
					{
						child.RenderTransform = viewportTransform;
						child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), child.DesiredSize));
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public sealed class BreadcrumbItemCollection : IEnumerable<BreadcrumbItem>, IEnumerable, INotifyPropertyChanged, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private const string CountString = "Count";

		private const string IndexerName = "Item[]";

		private readonly List<BreadcrumbItem> collection = new List<BreadcrumbItem>();

		public int Count => collection.Count;

		public BreadcrumbItem this[int index] => collection[index];

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<BreadcrumbItem> IEnumerable<BreadcrumbItem>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return collection.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return collection.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			PropertyChangedEventArgs e = new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName);
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, object item, int index)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(action, item, index);
			OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			collection.Clear();
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		internal void Add(BreadcrumbItem breadcrumbItem)
		{
			collection.Add(breadcrumbItem);
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, breadcrumbItem, Count - 1);
		}

		internal void RemoveLast()
		{
			int index = Count - 1;
			BreadcrumbItem item = collection[index];
			collection.RemoveAt(index);
			OnPropertyChanged("Count");
			OnPropertyChanged("Item[]");
			OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, item, index);
		}
	}

		private static LinearGradientBrush CreateInnerBrushTemplate()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0);

				Offset = 0.0
			});
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 172, 172, 172),
				Offset = 1.0
			});
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

	public abstract class RangeBar2DModel : PointModel
	{
		[Description("Gets the name of the RangeBar2DModel.")]
		public abstract string ModelName { get; }

		public static IEnumerable<RangeBar2DKind> GetPredefinedKinds()
		{
			return RangeBar2DKind.List;
		}

		protected abstract RangeBar2DModel CreateObjectForClone();

		protected override PointModel CreateModel()
		{
			return CreateObjectForClone();
		}
	}
	public abstract class PredefinedRangeBar2DModel : RangeBar2DModel
	{
		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => true;

		internal PredefinedRangeBar2DModel()
		{
		}

		protected void DrawRect(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect rect)
		{
			if (pen != null)
			{
				double num = 0.5 * pen.Thickness;
				rect.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			}
			context.DrawRectangle(brush, pen, rect);
		}
	}
	public abstract class CachedRangeBar2DModel : PredefinedRangeBar2DModel
	{
		private Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Brush[]> brushSet = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Brush[]>();

		private Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Pen[]> penSet = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Pen[]>();

		protected System.Windows.Media.Pen[] GetPenSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (!penSet.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (penSet.Count == 12)
				{
					penSet.Clear();
				}
				value = CreatePenSet(color);
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
				{
					value[i].Freeze();
				}
				penSet[color] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Brush[] GetBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (!brushSet.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (brushSet.Count == 12)
				{
					brushSet.Clear();
				}
				value = CreateBrushSet(color);
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
				{
					value[i].Freeze();
				}
				brushSet[color] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[0];
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Pen[] CreatePenSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Media.Pen[0];
		}
	}
	public class FlatRangeBar2DModel : CachedRangeBar2DModel
	{
		[Description("")]
		public override string ModelName => "Flat Bar";

		protected override RangeBar2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new FlatRangeBar2DModel();
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			return new FlatRangeBar2DModelControl();
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new FlatRangeBar2DModel();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(146, 146, 146), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(110, 110, 110), 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(80, 80, 80))), color);
			brush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(160, 160, 160))), color);
			brush2.Freeze();
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[3]
			{
				brush,
				brush2,
				GetBrush(color)
			};
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush[] array = GetBrushSet(presentationData.PointColor);
			Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
			double uniformRadius = Math.Min(bounds.Height, 3.0);
			RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[0], null, bounds, new CornerRadius(uniformRadius));
			if (!(bounds.Height < 2.0))
			{
				bounds.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
				uniformRadius = Math.Min(bounds.Height, 5.0);
				RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[1], null, bounds, new CornerRadius(2.0, 2.0, uniformRadius, uniformRadius));
				if (!(bounds.Height < 1.0))
				{
					bounds.Y += 1.0;
					bounds.Height -= 1.0;
					RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[2], null, bounds, new CornerRadius(2.0));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{

		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(80, 80, 80))), color);
			brush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(50, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue))), color);
			brush2.Freeze();
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[2]
			{
				brush,
				GetBrush(color)
			};
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush[] array = GetBrushSet(pointColor);
			Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
			RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[0], null, bounds, new CornerRadius(3.0));
			if (!(bounds.Height < 2.0) && !(bounds.Width < 2.0))
			{
				bounds.Inflate(-1.0, -1.0);
				RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[1], null, bounds, new CornerRadius(2.0));
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = GetPen(pointColor);
				double num = pen.Thickness * 0.5;
				bounds.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
				RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, null, GetPen(pointColor), bounds, new CornerRadius(2.0));
			}
		}
	}
