				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.470832, 1.0)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(127, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(26, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue), 1.0));
			linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrushBottom()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(67, 0, 0, 0), 1.0));
			linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen CreateBorderPen(System.Windows.Media.Color maskColor, System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(maskColor)), color);
			brush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, LineThickness);
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		private void DrawFacet(System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point[] points, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, IRenderContext context)
		{
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(startPoint, isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
				streamGeometryContext.PolyLineTo(points, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: true);
			}
			streamGeometry.Freeze();
			context.DrawGeometry(brush, null, streamGeometry);
		}

		private void DrawFacets(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, IRenderContext context)
		{
			bounds.Inflate(0.0 - LineThickness, 0.0 - LineThickness);
			double num = Math.Min(Math.Round(bounds.Width / 3.0), 4.0);
			System.Windows.Point topLeft = bounds.TopLeft;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + num, topLeft.Y + 4.0);
			System.Windows.Point topRight = bounds.TopRight;
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right - num, topRight.Y + 4.0);
			System.Windows.Point bottomRight = bounds.BottomRight;
			System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right - num, bottomRight.Y - 4.0);
			System.Windows.Point bottomLeft = bounds.BottomLeft;
			System.Windows.Point point4 = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + num, bottomLeft.Y - 4.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush[] array = GetBrushSet(pointColor);
			DrawFacet(bottomLeft, new System.Windows.Point[3] { topLeft, point, point4 }, array[0], context);
			DrawFacet(bottomRight, new System.Windows.Point[3] { topRight, point2, point3 }, array[1], context);
			DrawFacet(topLeft, new System.Windows.Point[3] { topRight, point2, point }, array[2], context);
			DrawFacet(bottomLeft, new System.Windows.Point[3] { point4, point3, bottomRight }, array[3], context);
		}

		private void DrawBorder(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, IRenderContext context)
		{
			double num = 0.5 * LineThickness;
			System.Windows.Media.Pen[] array = GetPenSet(pointColor);
			bounds.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			context.DrawLine(array[0], bounds.BottomLeft, bounds.TopLeft);
			context.DrawLine(array[1], bounds.TopRight, bounds.BottomRight);
			context.DrawLine(array[2], bounds.TopLeft, bounds.TopRight);
			context.DrawLine(array[3], bounds.BottomRight, bounds.BottomLeft);
		}

		protected override RangeBar2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new OutsetRangeBar2DModel();
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			return new OutsetRangeBar2DModelControl();
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new OutsetRangeBar2DModel();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0 / 64.0),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 77, 77, 77), 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[4]
			{
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushLeft()), color),
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushRight()), color),
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushTop()), color),
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushBottom()), color)
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Pen[] CreatePenSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreateBorderPen(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(90, 0, 0, 0), color);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen2 = CreateBorderPen(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(128, 0, 0, 0), color);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen3 = CreateBorderPen(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(114, 0, 0, 0), color);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen4 = CreateBorderPen(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(128, 0, 0, 0), color);
			return new System.Windows.Media.Pen[4] { pen, pen2, pen3, pen4 };
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			context.DrawRectangle(GetBrush(pointColor), null, bounds);
			DrawFacets(bounds, pointColor, context);
			DrawBorder(bounds, pointColor, context);
		}
	}

	public enum SolidSides
	{
		Left,
		Top,
		Right,
		Bottom,
		Front
	}
	public class Pseudo3DBarModelPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SidesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Sides", typeof(SolidSides), typeof(Pseudo3DBarModelPanel), new PropertyMetadata(SolidSides.Front));

		public static void SetSides(UIElement element, SolidSides value)
		{
			element.SetValue(SidesProperty, value);
		}

		[NonCategorized]
		public static SolidSides GetSides(UIElement element)
		{
			return (SolidSides)element.GetValue(SidesProperty);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				switch (GetSides(child))
				{
				case SolidSides.Top:
				case SolidSides.Bottom:
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, double.PositiveInfinity));
					break;
				case SolidSides.Left:
				case SolidSides.Right:
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
					break;
				default:
					child.Measure(availableSize);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size
			{
				Width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Width),
				Height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Height)
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				switch (GetSides(child))
				{
				case SolidSides.Top:
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(finalSize.Width, child.DesiredSize.Height)));
					break;
				case SolidSides.Bottom:
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, finalSize.Height - child.DesiredSize.Height), new System.Windows.Size(finalSize.Width, child.DesiredSize.Height)));
					break;
				case SolidSides.Left:
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(child.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height)));
					break;
				case SolidSides.Right:
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(finalSize.Width - child.DesiredSize.Width, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(child.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height)));
					break;
				default:
					child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
					break;
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	internal class Waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel : SymmetricWaterfall2DModel
	{
		private FillStyle actualFillStyleModel;

		protected internal override bool ActualOverlapBars => false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically)
				{
					if (actualFillStyleModel != null)
					{
						return actualFillStyleModel.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override string ModelName => "";

		public FillStyle RisingFillStyleModel { get; set; }

		public FillStyle FallingFillStyleModel { get; set; }

		public FillStyle SubtotalFillStyleModel { get; set; }

		public DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border BorderModel { get; set; }

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel();
		}

		protected override Waterfall2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel();
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("This model does not support point templates.");
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			ModelRenderBehavior.DrawRect(context, SpecialBarModelHelper.CreteBrush(pointColor, actualFillStyleModel), SpecialBarModelHelper.CreatePen(BorderModel), layout.Bounds);
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateActualFillStyle(SeriesPointData pointData)
		{
			IWaterfallPoint refinedPoint = pointData.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				if (refinedPoint.IsSubTotal)
				{
					actualFillStyleModel = SubtotalFillStyleModel;
				}
				else
				{
					actualFillStyleModel = ((refinedPoint.RelativeValue > 0.0) ? RisingFillStyleModel : FallingFillStyleModel);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override double LineThickness => LineThicknessForModel;

		protected internal override bool CanBeDrawnWithZeroSize => true;

		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => true;

			return new SimpleBoxPlot2DModel();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 95, 95, 95));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128));
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = GetBrush(pointColor);
			brush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen value;
			if (!BorderColor.HasValue)
			{
				value = GetPen(pointColor);
			}
			else if (!pens.TryGetValue(pointColor, out value))
			{
				if (pens.Count == 12)
				{
					pens.Clear();
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = new SolidColorBrush(BorderColor.Value);
				brush2.Freeze();
				value = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush2, LineThickness);
				value.Freeze();
				pens[pointColor] = value;
			}
			BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout = (BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout)layout;
			double num = value.Thickness * 0.5;
			if (!boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.AnimationInProgress)
			{
				GuidelineSet guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapPoint1.X);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapPoint2.X);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapMiddle.X - num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Box.Left - num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Box.Right + num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapPoint1.Y + num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.BottomCapPoint1.Y - num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.MedianPoint1.Y + num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Box.Top + num);
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Box.Bottom - num);
				guidelineSet.Freeze();
				context.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
			}
			context.DrawRectangle(brush, value, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Box);
			context.DrawLine(value, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapPoint1, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapPoint2);
			context.DrawLine(value, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.TopCapMiddle, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.BoxTopMiddle);
			context.DrawLine(value, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.BottomCapMiddle, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.BoxBottomMiddle);
			context.DrawLine(value, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.BottomCapPoint1, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.BottomCapPoint2);
			context.DrawLine(value, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.MedianPoint1, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.MedianPoint2);
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.X - 5.0, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.Y + 5.0);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.X + 5.0, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.Y - 5.0);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.X - 5.0, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.Y - 5.0);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.X + 5.0, boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Mean.Y + 5.0);
			context.DrawLine(value, p, p2);
			context.DrawLine(value, p3, p4);
			if (boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Outliers != null)
			{
				foreach (System.Windows.Point outlier in boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.Outliers)
				{
					context.DrawEllipse(brush, value, outlier, 5.0, 5.0);
				}
			}
			if (!boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.AnimationInProgress)
			{
				context.Pop();
			}
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetPenBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			if (BorderColor.HasValue)
			{
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(BorderColor.Value);
				solidColorBrush.Freeze();
				return solidColorBrush;
			}
			return brush;
		}
	}

	public class CandleStick2DModelPanel : Panel, IFinishInvalidation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ElementsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Elements", typeof(CandleStickElements), typeof(CandleStick2DModelPanel));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty PointLayoutProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointLayout", typeof(SeriesPointLayout), typeof(CandleStick2DModelPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, PointLayoutPropertyChanged));

		private SeriesPointLayout PointLayout => (SeriesPointLayout)GetValue(PointLayoutProperty);

		public CandleStick2DModelPanel()
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath("Layout")
			};
			SetBinding(PointLayoutProperty, binding);
		}

		public static void SetElements(UIElement element, CandleStickElements value)
		{
			element.SetValue(ElementsProperty, value);
		}

		[NonCategorized]
		public static CandleStickElements GetElements(UIElement element)
		{
			return (CandleStickElements)element.GetValue(ElementsProperty);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (PointLayout != null)
				{
					CandleStickElement candleStickElement = CandleStickElement.CreateInstance(GetElements(child), PointLayout as CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout);
					Rect rect = candleStickElement.CalculateArrangeRect(availableSize);
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(rect.Width, rect.Height));
				}
				else
				{
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size
			{
				Width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Width),
				Height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Height)
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (PointLayout != null)
				{
					CandleStickElement candleStickElement = CandleStickElement.CreateInstance(GetElements(child), PointLayout as CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout);
					Rect finalRect = candleStickElement.CalculateArrangeRect(finalSize);
					child.Arrange(finalRect);
				}
				else
				{
					child.Arrange(RectExtensions.Zero);
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private static void PointLayoutPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CandleStick2DModelPanel candleStick2DModelPanel = (CandleStick2DModelPanel)d;
			foreach (UIElement child in candleStick2DModelPanel.Children)
			{
				CandleStickElement candleStickElement = CandleStickElement.CreateInstance(GetElements(child), (CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout)e.NewValue);
				child.Visibility = ((!candleStickElement.IsVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}
	}

	public class Stock2DModelPanel : Panel, IFinishInvalidation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ElementsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Elements", typeof(StockElements), typeof(Stock2DModelPanel));

		private StockSeries2DPointLayout PointLayout
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.DataContext is SeriesPointPresentationData seriesPointPresentationData))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return seriesPointPresentationData.ActualLayout as StockSeries2DPointLayout;
			}
		}

		public static void SetElements(UIElement element, StockElements value)
		{
			element.SetValue(ElementsProperty, value);
		}

		[NonCategorized]
		public static StockElements GetElements(UIElement element)
		{
			return (StockElements)element.GetValue(ElementsProperty);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (PointLayout != null)
				{
					StockElement stockElement = StockElement.CreateInstance(GetElements(child), PointLayout);
					child.Measure(stockElement.CalculateMeasureSize(availableSize));
				}
				else
				{
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size
			{
				Width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Width),
				Height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 0.0 : availableSize.Height)
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (PointLayout != null)
				{
					StockElement stockElement = StockElement.CreateInstance(GetElements(child), PointLayout);
					child.Visibility = ((!stockElement.IsVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					child.Arrange(stockElement.CalculateArrangeRect(child, finalSize));
				}
				else
				{
					child.Arrange(RectExtensions.Zero);
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public class SimpleFunnel2DModelControl : PredefinedPie2DModelControl, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BorderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Border", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(SimpleFunnel2DModelControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, BorderChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointGeometryProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointGeometry", typeof(Geometry), typeof(SimpleFunnel2DModelControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BorderGeometryProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BorderGeometry", typeof(Geometry), typeof(SimpleFunnel2DModelControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private double opacity;

		private SolidColorBrush defaultBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);

		private SeriesBorder actualBorder;

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public SeriesBorder Border
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesBorder)GetValue(BorderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BorderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public Geometry PointGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return (Geometry)GetValue(PointGeometryProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointGeometryProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public Geometry BorderGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return (Geometry)GetValue(BorderGeometryProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BorderGeometryProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public double ActualOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				return opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				if (opacity != value)
				{
					opacity = value;
					if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
					{
						this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("ActualBorder"));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SeriesBorder ActualBorder
		{
			get
			{
				return actualBorder;
			}
			set
			{
				SetActualBorder(value);
				if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
				{
					this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("ActualBorder"));
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		private static void BorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SimpleFunnel2DModelControl simpleFunnel2DModelControl)
			{
				SeriesBorder seriesBorder = e.NewValue as SeriesBorder;
				simpleFunnel2DModelControl.ActualBorder = seriesBorder;
			}
		}

		public SimpleFunnel2DModelControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SimpleFunnel2DModelControl>(this);
		}

		private void SetActualBorder(SeriesBorder value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				actualBorder = new SeriesBorder();
				if (value.Brush != null)
				{
					actualBorder.Brush = value.Brush;
					ActualOpacity = 1.0;
				}
				else
				{
					actualBorder.Brush = defaultBrush;
					ActualOpacity = 0.2;
				}
				if (value.LineStyle != null)
				{
					actualBorder.LineStyle = new LineStyle
					{
						DashCap = value.LineStyle.DashCap,
						DashStyle = value.LineStyle.DashStyle.Clone(),
						LineJoin = value.LineStyle.LineJoin,
						MiterLimit = value.LineStyle.MiterLimit,
						Thickness = value.LineStyle.Thickness * 2
					};
				}
			}
			else
			{
				actualBorder = null;
			}
		}

		internal override void SetPointItemBinding(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			base.SetPointItemBinding(pointItem);
			if (pointItem != null)
			{
				if (pointItem.Series is FunnelSeries2D source)
				{
					SetBinding(BorderProperty, new Binding("ActualBorder")
					{
						Source = source
					});
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(BorderProperty);
			}
		}

		internal void SetGeometries(Geometry pointGeometry, Geometry borderGeometry)
		{
			PointGeometry = pointGeometry;
			BorderGeometry = borderGeometry;
		}
	}

	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Normal", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "MouseOver", GroupName = "CommonStates")]
	public abstract class ModelControl : ChartElementBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FlippedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Flipped", typeof(bool), typeof(ModelControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PresentationDataProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PresentationData", typeof(SeriesPointPresentationData), typeof(ModelControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		[Description("Specifies whether the ModelControl is flipped.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool Flipped
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(FlippedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FlippedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Gets the model’s presentation data. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public SeriesPointPresentationData PresentationData
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesPointPresentationData)GetValue(PresentationDataProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PresentationDataProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ModelControl()
		{
			SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, new Binding("PresentationData")
			{
				Source = this
			});
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: true);
		}

		internal virtual void SetPointItemBinding(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem != null)
			{
				SetBinding(PresentationDataProperty, new Binding("PresentationData")
				{
					Source = pointItem
				});
				SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, new Binding("Opacity")
				{
					Source = pointItem
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(PresentationDataProperty);
				ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			}
		}

		internal Transform GetFlippedTransform(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (Flipped)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					CenterY = size.Height / 2.0,
					ScaleY = -1.0
				};
			}
			return new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = Matrix.Identity
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class PredefinedModelControl : ModelControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointColorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointColor", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color), typeof(PredefinedModelControl), new PropertyMetadata(ColorChanged));

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Color PointColor
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)GetValue(PointColorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointColorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void ColorChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PredefinedModelControl predefinedModelControl)
			{
				predefinedModelControl.UpdateBrushes((System.Windows.Media.Color)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		public PredefinedModelControl()
		{
			SetBinding(PointColorProperty, new Binding("PresentationData.PointColor")
			{
				Source = this
			});
		}

	public abstract class HierarchicalDataAdapterBase : FrameworkElement, IEnumerable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(HierarchicalDataAdapterBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataSourceChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BreadcrumbTextProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BreadcrumbTextProvider", typeof(IBreadcrumbTextProvider), typeof(HierarchicalDataAdapterBase), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private WeakReference diagramReference = new WeakReference(null);

		protected IEnumerable ActualSeriesItemsSource { get; set; }

		internal Diagram Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (!diagramReference.IsAlive)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (Diagram)diagramReference.Target;
			}
			set
			{
				diagramReference = new WeakReference(value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or set the collection of data source objects for the Chart in the Drill Mode.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public IEnumerable DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)GetValue(DataSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DataSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the object that provides text for breadcrumb items when the Chart is in the Drill Mode.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public IBreadcrumbTextProvider BreadcrumbTextProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (IBreadcrumbTextProvider)GetValue(BreadcrumbTextProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BreadcrumbTextProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void DataSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase)
			{
				hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.Reset();
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (ActualSeriesItemsSource != null)
			{
				return ActualSeriesItemsSource.GetEnumerator();
			}
			return new ArrayList(0).GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected void Reset()
		{
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				Diagram.ResetDrillDown();
			}
			else
			{
				ResetWithoutNotification();
			}
		}

		internal string GetBreadcrumbText(object seriesSourceObj, object pointSourceObj)
		{
			IBreadcrumbTextProvider breadcrumbTextProvider = BreadcrumbTextProvider;
			if (breadcrumbTextProvider != null)
			{
				return breadcrumbTextProvider.GetText(seriesSourceObj, pointSourceObj);
			}
			if (seriesSourceObj != null && pointSourceObj == null)
			{
				return seriesSourceObj.ToString();
			}
			if (seriesSourceObj != null && pointSourceObj != null)
			{
				return $"{seriesSourceObj.ToString()}, {pointSourceObj.ToString()}";
			}
			if (pointSourceObj != null && seriesSourceObj == null)
			{
				return pointSourceObj.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal abstract bool CanDrillDown(object dataItem);

		internal abstract bool DrillDown(object item);

		internal abstract void DrillUpToTop();

		internal void ResetWithoutNotification()
		{
			ActualSeriesItemsSource = DataSource;
		}
	}
	public class HierarchicalDataAdapter : HierarchicalDataAdapterBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildrenSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChildrenSelector", typeof(IChildrenSelector), typeof(HierarchicalDataAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChildrenSelectorChanged));

		[Description("Gets or sets an object that returns a child object collection from a data object on whose representation the end user clicked.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public IChildrenSelector ChildrenSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (IChildrenSelector)GetValue(ChildrenSelectorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChildrenSelectorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void ChildrenSelectorChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HierarchicalDataAdapter hierarchicalDataAdapter)
			{
				hierarchicalDataAdapter.Reset();
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanDrillDown(object dataItem)
		{
			if (ChildrenSelector == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ChildrenSelector.SelectChildren(dataItem) != null;
		}

		internal override bool DrillDown(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = ChildrenSelector.SelectChildren(item);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.ActualSeriesItemsSource = enumerable;
			return true;
		}

		internal override void DrillUpToTop()
		{
			base.ActualSeriesItemsSource = base.DataSource;
		}
	}
	public class BollingerBands : Indicator, IAffectsAxisRange
	{
		private const int DefaultPointsCount = 20;

		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Close;

		private const double DefaultDeviationMultiplier = 2.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueLevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ValueLevel", typeof(ValueLevel), typeof(BollingerBands), new PropertyMetadata(ValueLevel.Close, ValueLevelPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointsCountProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointsCount", typeof(int), typeof(BollingerBands), new PropertyMetadata(20, PointsCountPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StandardDeviationMultiplierProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("StandardDeviationMultiplier", typeof(double), typeof(BollingerBands), new PropertyMetadata(2.0, StandardDeviationMultiplierPropertyChanged));

		private readonly BollingerBandsCalculator calculator = new BollingerBandsCalculator();

		private ValueLevelInternal valueLevel = ValueLevelInternal.Close;

		private int pointsCount = 20;

		private double standardDeviationMultiplier = 2.0;

		protected override int StartIndex => PointsCount - 1;

		protected override bool HasPoints => calculator.MovingAveragePoints.Count > 0;

		[Description("Gets or sets the value specifying which series point value should be used to calculate the indicator.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (ValueLevel)GetValue(ValueLevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueLevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the number of data points used to calculate the indicator.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(PointsCountProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointsCountProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the multiplier of the standard deviation used to plot this indicator.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double StandardDeviationMultiplier
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(StandardDeviationMultiplierProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StandardDeviationMultiplierProperty, value);
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAffectsAxisRange.AxisYData => base.XYSeries.ActualAxisY;

		private static void ValueLevelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BollingerBands bollingerBands)
			{
				bollingerBands.valueLevel = (ValueLevelInternal)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		private static void PointsCountPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BollingerBands bollingerBands)
			{
				bollingerBands.pointsCount = (int)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		private static void StandardDeviationMultiplierPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BollingerBands bollingerBands)
			{
				bollingerBands.standardDeviationMultiplier = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		public BollingerBands()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BollingerBands>(this);
		}

		MinMaxValues IAffectsAxisRange.GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			return GetFilteredMinMaxY(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Delta))
			{
				return calculator.YRange;
			}
			if (calculator.UpperBandPoints == null || calculator.LowerBandPoints == null)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			int num = -1;
			ChartDebug.Assert(calculator.UpperBandPoints.Count == calculator.LowerBandPoints.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < calculator.UpperBandPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (calculator.UpperBandPoints[i].X > visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Min)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int num3 = calculator.UpperBandPoints.Count - 1; num3 > -1; num3--)
			{
				if (calculator.UpperBandPoints[num3].X < visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Max)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1 || num2 == -1)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double y = calculator.LowerBandPoints[num].Y;
			double y2 = calculator.UpperBandPoints[num].Y;
			for (int j = num + 1; j < num2; j++)
			{
				if (calculator.LowerBandPoints[j].Y < y)
				{
					y = calculator.LowerBandPoints[j].Y;
				}
				if (calculator.UpperBandPoints[j].Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = calculator.UpperBandPoints[j].Y;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(y, y2);
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new BollingerBands();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ValueLevelProperty);
			properties.Add(PointsCountProperty);
			properties.Add(StandardDeviationMultiplierProperty);
		}

		protected override void CalculateDataInternal(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
			calculator.Calculate(context.RefinedSeries, context.RefinedPoints, pointsCount, standardDeviationMultiplier, valueLevel);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			if (calculator.Calculated)
			{
				using StreamGeometryContext context = streamGeometry.Open();
				DrawPolylineSegment(context, mapping, calculator.MovingAveragePoints);
				DrawPolylineSegment(context, mapping, calculator.UpperBandPoints);
				DrawPolylineSegment(context, mapping, calculator.LowerBandPoints);
			}
			return streamGeometry;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> CreateLinePointsByType()
		{
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>>
			{
				{
					IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average,
					calculator.MovingAveragePoints
				},
				{
					IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower,
					calculator.LowerBandPoints
				},
				{
					IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper,
					calculator.UpperBandPoints
				}
			};
		}

		protected override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return calculator.MovingAveragePoints[index].X;

	public enum ErrorBarEndStyle
	{
		Cap,
		NoCap
	}
	public enum ErrorBarDirection
	{
		Both,
		Minus,
		Plus
	}
	public abstract class ErrorBars : Indicator, IAffectsAxisRange
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty EndStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EndStyle", typeof(ErrorBarEndStyle), typeof(ErrorBars), new PropertyMetadata(ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DirectionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Direction", typeof(ErrorBarDirection), typeof(ErrorBars), new PropertyMetadata(ErrorBarDirection.Both, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		protected abstract ErrorBarsCalculator Calculator { get; }

		protected override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				ErrorBarsCalculator calculator = Calculator;
				if (calculator != null && calculator.ErrorBarDataList != null)
				{
					return calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override int StartIndex => base.XYSeries.Points.Count - Calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count;

		[Description("Gets or sets the style of the error bar end.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ErrorBarEndStyle EndStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (ErrorBarEndStyle)GetValue(EndStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EndStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the error bar direction.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ErrorBarDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return (ErrorBarDirection)GetValue(DirectionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DirectionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAffectsAxisRange.AxisYData => base.XYSeries.ActualAxisY;

		MinMaxValues IAffectsAxisRange.GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (Calculator.Calculated.HasValue && Calculator.Calculated.Value && Calculator.ErrorBarDataList != null && Calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				return GetFilteredMinMaxY(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
			}
			return MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		public MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Delta))
			{
				return Calculator.YRange;
			}
			List<ErrorBarData> errorBarDataList = Calculator.ErrorBarDataList;
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < errorBarDataList.Count; i++)
			{
				double argument = errorBarDataList[i].RefinedPoint.Argument;
				if (argument >= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Min && argument <= visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Max)
				{
					if (errorBarDataList[i].Bottom < num)
					{
						num = errorBarDataList[i].Bottom;
					}
					if (errorBarDataList[i].Top > num2)
					{
						num2 = errorBarDataList[i].Top;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < double.PositiveInfinity && num2 > double.NegativeInfinity)
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
			}
			return MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(EndStyleProperty);
			properties.Add(DirectionProperty);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			if (Calculator.Calculated.HasValue && Calculator.Calculated.Value && Calculator.ErrorBarDataList != null && Calculator.ErrorBarDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (ErrorBarData errorBarData in Calculator.ErrorBarDataList)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = errorBarData.RefinedPoint;
					Rect pointBounds = base.XYSeries.GetPointBounds(mapping, refinedPoint);
					if (pointBounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						continue;
					}
					double x = refinedPoint.Argument + base.XYSeries.GetArgumentOffset(refinedPoint);
					System.Windows.Point point = MathUtils.StrongRound(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(new GRealPoint2D(x, errorBarData.Center)));
					int num = MathUtils.StrongRound((pointBounds.Left + pointBounds.Right) / 2.0);
					if (Direction != ErrorBarDirection.Minus)
					{
						System.Windows.Point point2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(new GRealPoint2D(x, errorBarData.Top)));
						LineGeometry value = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(num, point.Y), new System.Windows.Point(num, point2.Y));
						geometryGroup.Children.Add(value);
						if (EndStyle == ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap)
						{
							LineGeometry value2 = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(pointBounds.Left, point2.Y), new System.Windows.Point(pointBounds.Right, point2.Y));
							geometryGroup.Children.Add(value2);
						}
					}
					if (Direction != ErrorBarDirection.Plus)
					{
						System.Windows.Point point3 = MathUtils.StrongRound(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(new GRealPoint2D(x, errorBarData.Bottom)));
						LineGeometry value3 = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(num, point.Y), new System.Windows.Point(num, point3.Y));
						geometryGroup.Children.Add(value3);
						if (EndStyle == ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap)
						{
							LineGeometry value4 = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(pointBounds.Left, point3.Y), new System.Windows.Point(pointBounds.Right, point3.Y));
							geometryGroup.Children.Add(value4);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateErrorBarValuesByType(index, Calculator.ErrorBarDataList, (ErrorBarDirectionCore)Direction);
		}

		protected override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return Calculator.ErrorBarDataList[index].RefinedPoint.Argument;
		}

		protected override IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series series, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new ErrorBarIndicatorPointToStringConverter(series, crosshairShowInLegend);
		}
	}

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class ParametricRegression : Indicator
	{
		private const double deltaX = 3.0;

		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;

		private const double DefaultForecastBackwardPeriods = -1.0;

		private const double DefaultForecastForwardPeriods = -1.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueLevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ValueLevel", typeof(ValueLevel), typeof(ParametricRegression), new PropertyMetadata(ValueLevel.Value, ValueLevelPropertyChanged));

		private ValueLevelInternal valueLevel;

		private double forecastBackwardPeriods = -1.0;

		private double forecastForwardPeriods = -1.0;

		protected override bool IsStraightLine => false;

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (ValueLevel)GetValue(ValueLevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueLevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double ForecastBackwardPeriods
		{
			get
			{
				return forecastBackwardPeriods;
			}
			set
			{
				forecastBackwardPeriods = ((!MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(value)) ? 0.0 : value);
			}
		}

		internal double ForecastForwardPeriods
		{
			get
			{
				return forecastForwardPeriods;
			}
			set
			{
				forecastForwardPeriods = ((!MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(value)) ? 0.0 : value);
			}
		}

		private static void ValueLevelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ParametricRegression parametricRegression)
			{
				parametricRegression.valueLevel = (ValueLevelInternal)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		protected abstract double F(double x);

		protected override void CalculateDataInternal(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			CalculateRangeLimits(mapping, out var rangeMin, out var rangeMax);
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open();
			double num = 3.0 * mapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.Delta / mapping.AxisXMapping.AxisLength;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling((rangeMax - rangeMin) / num) + 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				double num3 = rangeMin + (double)i * num;
				double value = F(num3 + 1.0);
				System.Windows.Point diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(num3, value);
				if (i == 0)
				{
					streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(diagramPoint, isFilled: false, isClosed: false);
				}
				else
				{
					streamGeometryContext.LineTo(diagramPoint, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: true);
				}
			}
			return streamGeometry;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ValueLevelProperty);
		}

		private void CalculateRangeLimits(PaneMappingBase mapping, out double rangeMin, out double rangeMax)
		{
			rangeMin = mapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.MinValueInternal;
			rangeMax = mapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.MaxValueInternal;
			IAxisRangeData visualRangeData = mapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData;
			if (ForecastBackwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double num = mapping.AxisX.ScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(visualRangeData.RefinedMin);
				num -= ForecastBackwardPeriods;
				if (num > rangeMin)
				{
					rangeMin = num;
				}
			}
			double d = F(rangeMin);
			if (!MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(d))
			{
				rangeMin = double.Epsilon;
			}
			if (ForecastForwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = mapping.AxisX.ScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(visualRangeData.RefinedMax);
				num2 += ForecastForwardPeriods;
				if (num2 < rangeMax)
				{
					rangeMax = num2;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	[NonCategorized]
	public class ExponentialRegression : ParametricRegression
	{
		private bool hasPoints;

		protected override bool HasPoints => hasPoints;

		internal double A { get; private set; }

		internal double B { get; private set; }

		internal double SqrR { get; private set; }

		public ExponentialRegression()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ExponentialRegression>(this);
		}

		internal ExponentialRegression(ValueLevel valueLevel)
			: this()
		{
			base.ValueLevel = valueLevel;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new ExponentialRegression();
		}

		protected override double F(double x)
		{
			return A * Math.Exp(x * B);
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			ExponentialRegressionCalculator exponentialRegressionCalculator = new ExponentialRegressionCalculator();
			Tuple<double, double> tuple = exponentialRegressionCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries.Points, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
			hasPoints = tuple != null;
			if (hasPoints)
			{
				A = tuple.Item1;
				B = tuple.Item2;
			}
		}
	}

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	[NonCategorized]
	public class PolynomialRegression : ParametricRegression
	{
		private const int DefaultDegree = 2;

		private int degree = 2;

		protected override bool HasPoints => Parameters != null;

		internal int Degree
		{
			get
			{
				return degree;
			}
			set
			{
				degree = ((value < 2) ? 2 : ((value > 6) ? 6 : value));
			}
		}

		internal double[] Parameters { get; private set; }

		internal double SqrR { get; private set; }

		public PolynomialRegression()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<PolynomialRegression>(this);
		}

		internal PolynomialRegression(ValueLevel valueLevel)
			: this()
		{
			base.ValueLevel = valueLevel;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new PolynomialRegression();
		}

		protected override double F(double x)
		{
			double num = Parameters[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < Parameters.Length; i++)
			{
				num += Parameters[i] * Math.Pow(x, i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			PolynomialRegressionCalculator polynomialRegressionCalculator = new PolynomialRegressionCalculator();
			Parameters = polynomialRegressionCalculator.Calculate(Degree, refinedSeries.Points, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorLabelVisibilityConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			AnimationState animationState = (AnimationState)values[0];
			if (animationState == AnimationState.BeforeFirst || animationState == AnimationState.InProgress)
			{
				return Visibility.Hidden;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

			dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value, calculator.MacdPoints[index].Y);

			if (num >= 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Signal, calculator.SignalPoints[num].Y);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series series, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new MACDIndicatorPointToStringConverter(series, crosshairShowInLegend);
		}
	}

	public class FibonacciArcs : FibonacciIndicator
	{
		private const double horizontalIndent = 1.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowLevel100Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowLevel100", typeof(bool), typeof(FibonacciArcs), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		internal List<FibonacciCircle> FibonacciCircles { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the value which determines whether to display the 100% level for the Arcs type of Fibonacci Indicators.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowLevel100
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowLevel100Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowLevel100Property, value);
			}
		}

		public FibonacciArcs()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<FibonacciArcs>(this);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			foreach (FibonacciCircle fibonacciCircle in FibonacciCircles)
			{
				EllipseGeometry value = new EllipseGeometry
				{
					Center = fibonacciCircle.ScreenCenter.ToPoint(),
					RadiusX = fibonacciCircle.ScreenRadius,
					RadiusY = fibonacciCircle.ScreenRadius
				};
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(value);
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ((IAxisData)base.XYSeries.ActualAxisX).AxisScaleTypeMap;
			FibonacciArcsCalculator fibonacciArcsCalculator = new FibonacciArcsCalculator();
			FibonacciCircles = fibonacciArcsCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, axisScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, base.Argument1, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel1, base.Argument2, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel2, GetFibonacciLevels());
			if (!fibonacciArcsCalculator.Calculated)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FibonacciCircle fibonacciCircle in FibonacciCircles)
			{
				System.Windows.Point diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(fibonacciCircle.Center);
				fibonacciCircle.ScreenCenter = diagramPoint.ToGRealPoint2D();
				fibonacciCircle.ScreenPointInCircle = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(fibonacciCircle.PointInCircle).ToGRealPoint2D();
				fibonacciCircle.ScreenRadius = MathUtils.CalcDistance(diagramPoint, fibonacciCircle.ScreenPointInCircle.ToPoint());
			}
		}

		protected internal override void CreateLabelItems()
		{
			base.CreateLabelItems();
			if (FibonacciCircles == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LabelItems = new List<IndicatorLabelItem>();
			foreach (FibonacciCircle fibonacciCircle in FibonacciCircles)
			{
				string text = Math.Round(fibonacciCircle.Level, 3).ToString();
				IndicatorLabelItem item = new IndicatorLabelItem(this, text, fibonacciCircle);
				LabelItems.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal override IndicatorLabelLayout CalculateLabelLayout(IndicatorLabelItem labelItem, System.Windows.Size labelSize, object dataForLayoutCalculation)
		{
			if (!(dataForLayoutCalculation is FibonacciCircle fibonacciCircle))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Vector vector = new Vector(0.0, fibonacciCircle.ScreenPointInCircle.Y - fibonacciCircle.ScreenCenter.Y);
			vector.Normalize();
			double num = (double)base.Item.LineStyle.Thickness / 2.0;
			num = ((!base.SeriesPane.Rotated) ? (num + labelSize.Height / 2.0) : (num + (labelSize.Width / 2.0 + 1.0)));
			System.Windows.Point location = fibonacciCircle.ScreenCenter.ToPoint() + vector * (fibonacciCircle.ScreenRadius + num);
			return new IndicatorLabelLayout(location, labelSize);
		}

		protected override IList<double> GetFibonacciLevels()
		{
			IList<double> fibonacciLevels = base.GetFibonacciLevels();
			if (ShowLevel100)
			{
				fibonacciLevels.Add(1.0);
			}
			return fibonacciLevels;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new FibonacciArcs();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ShowLevel100Property);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciFans : FibonacciIndicator
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowLevel0Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowLevel0", typeof(bool), typeof(FibonacciFans), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		private double minFibonacciLineLength;

		internal List<FibonacciLine> FibonacciLines { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the value which determines whether to display the 0% level for the Fans type of Fibonacci Indicators.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowLevel0
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowLevel0Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowLevel0Property, value);
			}
		}

		public FibonacciFans()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<FibonacciFans>(this);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			if (FibonacciLines == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			foreach (FibonacciLine fibonacciLine in FibonacciLines)
			{
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new LineGeometry
				{
					StartPoint = fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.ToPoint(),
					EndPoint = fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.ToPoint()
				});
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			if (object.Equals(base.Argument1, base.Argument2))
			{
				return;
			}
			IAxisData actualAxisX = base.XYSeries.ActualAxisX;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = actualAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			FibonacciFansCalculator fibonacciFansCalculator = new FibonacciFansCalculator();
			FibonacciLines = fibonacciFansCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, axisScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, base.Argument1, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel1, base.Argument2, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel2, GetFibonacciLevels());
			if (!fibonacciFansCalculator.Calculated)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (FibonacciLine fibonacciLine in FibonacciLines)
			{
				System.Windows.Point diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(fibonacciLine.Start);
				System.Windows.Point diagramPoint2 = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(fibonacciLine.End);
				fibonacciLine.ScreenStart = diagramPoint.ToGRealPoint2D();
				fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd = diagramPoint2.ToGRealPoint2D();
				IntersectionUtils.TruncateLine(fibonacciLine, base.SeriesPane.Viewport, base.SeriesPane.Rotated);
				double num2 = GRealPoint2D.CalculateDistance(fibonacciLine.ScreenStart, fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd);
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			minFibonacciLineLength = num;
		}

		protected internal override void CreateLabelItems()
		{
			base.CreateLabelItems();
			if (FibonacciLines == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LabelItems = new List<IndicatorLabelItem>();
			foreach (FibonacciLine fibonacciLine in FibonacciLines)
			{
				string text = Math.Round(fibonacciLine.Level, 3).ToString();
				IndicatorLabelItem item = new IndicatorLabelItem(this, text, fibonacciLine);
				LabelItems.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal override IndicatorLabelLayout CalculateLabelLayout(IndicatorLabelItem labelItem, System.Windows.Size labelSize, object dataForLayoutCalculation)
		{
			if (!(dataForLayoutCalculation is FibonacciLine fibonacciLine))
			{
				return null;
			}
			GeometricLine geometricLine = new GeometricLine(fibonacciLine.ScreenStart, fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd);
			double angleRadian = Math.Atan2(fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.Y - fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y, fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.X - fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X);
			double num = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(angleRadian);
			if (base.SeriesPane.Rotated)
			{
				num = ((!(num < -90.0)) ? (90.0 - num) : (-90.0 - num));
			}
			double clockwiseAngleInDegrees = CalculateLabelRotationAngle(num);
			Vector vector = new Vector(fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.X - fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X, fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.Y - fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y);
			vector.Normalize();
			Vector normalizedNormalVector = geometricLine.GetNormalizedNormalVector();
			double num2 = base.Item.LineStyle.Thickness;
			System.Windows.Point location = fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.ToPoint();
			location += normalizedNormalVector * (num2 + labelSize.Height / 2.0);
			location += vector * (minFibonacciLineLength * 2.0 / 3.0);
			return new IndicatorLabelLayout(location, labelSize, clockwiseAngleInDegrees, new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5));
		}

		protected override IList<double> GetFibonacciLevels()
		{
			IList<double> fibonacciLevels = base.GetFibonacciLevels();
			if (ShowLevel0)
			{
				fibonacciLevels.Add(0.0);
			}
			return fibonacciLevels;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new FibonacciFans();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ShowLevel0Property);
		}

		private double CalculateLabelRotationAngle(double angleDegreeCounterclockwise)
		{
			if (-90.0 <= angleDegreeCounterclockwise && angleDegreeCounterclockwise <= 90.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - angleDegreeCounterclockwise;
			}
			if (-180.0 <= angleDegreeCounterclockwise && angleDegreeCounterclockwise < -90.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - (180.0 - Math.Abs(angleDegreeCounterclockwise));
			}
			if (90.0 < angleDegreeCounterclockwise && angleDegreeCounterclockwise <= 180.0)
			{
				return 180.0 - Math.Abs(angleDegreeCounterclockwise);
			}
			ChartDebug.Assert(condition: false, "FibonacciFans LabelRotationAngle has not calculated. Given angle is not between -180 and 180 degrees");
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class FibonacciIndicator : FinancialIndicator, ISupportIndicatorLabel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowLevel23_6Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowLevel23_6", typeof(bool), typeof(FibonacciIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowLevel76_4Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowLevel76_4", typeof(bool), typeof(FibonacciIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Label", typeof(IndicatorLabel), typeof(FibonacciIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null, LabelChanged));

		[Description("Gets or sets the value which determines whether to display the 23.6% level for the Fibonacci Indicator of the required kind.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowLevel23_6
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowLevel23_6Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowLevel23_6Property, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the value which determines whether to display the 76.4% level for the Fibonacci Indicator of the required kind.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowLevel76_4
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowLevel76_4Property);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowLevel76_4Property, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the set of label-related properties of the Fibonacci indicator.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public IndicatorLabel Label
		{
			get
			{
				return (IndicatorLabel)GetValue(LabelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LabelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public FibonacciIndicator()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<FibonacciIndicator>(this);
		}

		protected virtual IList<double> GetFibonacciLevels()
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (ShowLevel23_6)
			{
				list.Add(0.236);
			}
			list.Add(0.382);
			list.Add(0.5);
			list.Add(0.618);
			if (ShowLevel76_4)
			{
				list.Add(0.764);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ShowLevel23_6Property);
			properties.Add(ShowLevel76_4Property);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(LabelProperty);
		}

		private static void LabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FibonacciIndicator fibonacciIndicator && e.NewValue is IndicatorLabel indicatorLabel)
			{
				indicatorLabel.ChangeOwner(((IOwnedElement)indicatorLabel).Owner, fibonacciIndicator);
				fibonacciIndicator.Item.Label = indicatorLabel;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciRetracement : FibonacciIndicator
	{
		private const int leftOrRightLabelIndent = 1;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowAdditionalLevelsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowAdditionalLevels", typeof(bool), typeof(FibonacciRetracement), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		internal List<FibonacciLine> FibonacciLines { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the value which determines whether to display additional levels for the Retracement type of Fibonacci indicators.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowAdditionalLevels
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowAdditionalLevelsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowAdditionalLevelsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public FibonacciRetracement()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<FibonacciRetracement>(this);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			foreach (FibonacciLine fibonacciLine in FibonacciLines)
			{
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new LineGeometry
				{
					StartPoint = fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.ToPoint(),
					EndPoint = fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.ToPoint()
				});
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			IAxisData actualAxisX = base.XYSeries.ActualAxisX;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = actualAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			double max = actualAxisX.VisualRange.Max;
			FibonacciRetracementCalculator fibonacciRetracementCalculator = new FibonacciRetracementCalculator();
			FibonacciLines = fibonacciRetracementCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, axisScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, base.Argument1, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel1, base.Argument2, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel2, max, GetFibonacciLevels());
			if (!fibonacciRetracementCalculator.Calculated)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FibonacciLine fibonacciLine in FibonacciLines)
			{
				System.Windows.Point start = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(fibonacciLine.Start);
				System.Windows.Point end = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(fibonacciLine.End);
				MathUtils.CorrectSmoothLine(base.Item.LineStyle.Thickness, ref start, ref end);
				fibonacciLine.ScreenStart = start.ToGRealPoint2D();
				fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd = end.ToGRealPoint2D();
			}
		}

		protected override IList<double> GetFibonacciLevels()
		{
			IList<double> fibonacciLevels = base.GetFibonacciLevels();
			fibonacciLevels.Add(0.0);
			fibonacciLevels.Add(1.0);
			if (ShowAdditionalLevels)
			{
				fibonacciLevels.Add(1.618);
				fibonacciLevels.Add(2.618);
				fibonacciLevels.Add(4.236);
			}
			return fibonacciLevels;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new FibonacciRetracement();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ShowAdditionalLevelsProperty);
		}

		protected internal override void CreateLabelItems()
		{
			base.CreateLabelItems();
			if (FibonacciLines == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LabelItems = new List<IndicatorLabelItem>();
			foreach (FibonacciLine fibonacciLine in FibonacciLines)
			{
				string text = Math.Round(fibonacciLine.Level * 100.0, 3) + "%";
				IndicatorLabelItem item = new IndicatorLabelItem(this, text, fibonacciLine);
				LabelItems.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal override IndicatorLabelLayout CalculateLabelLayout(IndicatorLabelItem labelItem, System.Windows.Size labelSize, object dataForLayoutCalculation)
		{
			if (!(dataForLayoutCalculation is FibonacciLine fibonacciLine))
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point location = fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.ToPoint();
			double num = (double)base.Item.LineStyle.Thickness / 2.0;
			if (base.SeriesPane.Rotated)
			{
				if (base.SeriesPane.Diagram.ActualAxisX.IsReversed)
				{
					location += new Vector(labelSize.Height / 2.0, labelSize.Width / 2.0 + 1.0 + num);
				}
				else
				{
					location += new Vector((0.0 - labelSize.Height) / 2.0, labelSize.Width / 2.0 + 1.0 + num);
				}
			}
			else if (base.SeriesPane.Diagram.ActualAxisX.IsReversed)
			{
				location += new Vector(labelSize.Width / 2.0 + 1.0, labelSize.Height / 2.0 + num);
			}
			else
			{
				location += new Vector((0.0 - labelSize.Width) / 2.0 - 1.0, labelSize.Height / 2.0 + num);
			}
			return new IndicatorLabelLayout(location, labelSize);
		}
	}

		{
			public IRefinedSeries RefinedSeries { get; private set; }

			public IList<RefinedPoint> RefinedPoints { get; private set; }

			public double MinArgument { get; private set; }

			public double MaxArgument { get; private set; }

			public DataCalculationContext(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, double minArgument, double maxArgument)
			{
				RefinedSeries = refinedSeries;
				RefinedPoints = refinedPoints;
				MinArgument = minArgument;
				MaxArgument = maxArgument;
			}
		}

		private class ArgumentsComparer : IComparer<GRealPoint2D>
		{
			int IComparer<GRealPoint2D>.Compare(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
			{
				if (p1.X < p2.X)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (p1.X > p2.X)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private bool CrosshairShowInLegend => CrosshairContentShowMode == CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend;

		private bool ActualCrosshairContentShowInLabel
		{
			get
			{
				switch (CrosshairContentShowMode)
				{
				case CrosshairContentShowMode.Label:
					return true;
				case CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend:
					return false;
				default:
					if (Container != null)
					{
						return Container.ToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions.ContentShowMode != CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ActualCrosshairEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Container != null && Container.ToolTipOptions.CrosshairSupported && CrosshairEnabled.HasValue)

				}
				return false;
			}
		}

				indicator.BrushInternal = indicator.Item.Brush;
				if (indicator.Item.LegendItem != null)
				{
					indicator.Item.LegendItem.MarkerLineBrush = indicator.Brush;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AnimationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Indicator indicator)

				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SeriesAnimationBase, e.NewValue as SeriesAnimationBase, indicator);
				indicator.OnAnimationChanged();
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
			}
		}

		Transform IPresentationCreator.CreateAnimationTransform(IMapping mapping)
		{
			IndicatorAnimationBase actualAnimation = GetActualAnimation();
			Transform transform = ((actualAnimation == null) ? Transform.Identity : actualAnimation.CreateAnimatedTransformation(mapping.Viewport, mapping.GetDiagramOriginPoint(), AxisXCore.IsReversed, AxisYCore.IsReversed, mapping.Rotated, AnimationProgress.ActualProgress));
			transform?.Freeze();
			return transform;
		}

		private void OnAnimationChanged()
		{
			if (isLoaded)
			{
				bool flag = DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || Item.AnimationState == AnimationState.InProgress;
				FinishAnimation();
				if (flag)
				{
					Animate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ClockGroup clockGroup)
			{
				ClockGroup clockGroup2 = ((clockGroup.Children.Count > 0) ? (clockGroup.Children[0] as ClockGroup) : null);
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = ((clockGroup2 != null && clockGroup2.Children.Count > 0) ? (clockGroup2.Children[0].Timeline as DoubleAnimation) : null);
				if (doubleAnimation != null && !AnimationHelper.ContainsAnimation(Storyboard, doubleAnimation))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			FinishAnimation();
		}

		private void StartAnimation()
		{
			Item.AnimationState = AnimationState.InProgress;
			animationProgress.Start();
		}

		private void FinishAnimation()
		{
			Item.AnimationState = AnimationState.Completed;
			animationProgress.Finish();
		}

		private void PrepareStoryboard()
		{
			GetActualAnimation()?.PrepareSeriesStoryboard(Storyboard, this);
		}

		private void AnimationProgressChanged()
		{
			IndicatorAnimationBase actualAnimation = GetActualAnimation();
			if (actualAnimation == null || actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateAdditionalGeometry)
			{
				UpdateGeometryTransformation();
			}
			if (actualAnimation == null || actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateClipBounds)
			{
				UpdateGeometryClip();
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isLoaded = true;
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || AnimationAutoStartMode == AnimationAutoStartMode.PlayOnce)
			{
				Animate();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGeometryClip()
		{
			Pane actualPane = ActualPane;
			if (actualPane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect viewport = actualPane.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, viewport.Width, viewport.Height);
			GeneralTransform inverse = actualPane.ViewportTransform.Inverse;
			if (inverse != null)
			{
				if (GetActualAnimation() is IUnwindAnimation unwindAnimation)
				{
					rect = unwindAnimation.CreateAnimatedClipBounds(rect, AnimationProgress.ActualProgress);
				}
				rect = inverse.TransformBounds(rect);
			}
			Item.AnimationClip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = rect
			};
		}

		private void UpdateGeometryTransformation()
		{
			PresentationUpdater presentationUpdater = new PresentationUpdater(this);
			Item.AnimationTransform = presentationUpdater.CreateAnimationTransform();
		}

		private bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is AnimationBase)
			{
				OnAnimationChanged();
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverter()
		{
			return CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(XYSeries, CrosshairShowInLegend);
		}

		private LegendItem GetLegendItem(int index)
		{
			return (ActualLegend?.Items)?.GetItemByIndex(index);
		}

		private int GetValueIndex(List<GRealPoint2D> points, double value)
		{
			int num = points.BinarySearch(new GRealPoint2D(value, 0.0), pointsComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected void DrawPolylineSegment(StreamGeometryContext context, PaneMappingBase mapping, List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			int startIndex = 0;
			int count = points.Count;
			GetVisibleSubStrip(mapping, points, out startIndex, out count);
			context.BeginFigure(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(points[startIndex]), isFilled: false, isClosed: false);
			System.Windows.Point[] array = new System.Windows.Point[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(points[i + startIndex]);
			}
			context.PolyLineTo(array, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: false);
		}

		{
			LabelItems = null;
		}
