		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Container?.LegendOptions;
			if (containerLegendOptions != null && Legend == null)
			{
				if (legendIndex == -1)
				{
					Legend = containerLegendOptions.Legend;
				}
				else if (legendIndex >= 0 && legendIndex < containerLegendOptions.Legends.Count)
				{
					Legend = containerLegendOptions.Legends[legendIndex];
				}
			}
		}

		internal void GetVisibleSubStrip(PaneMappingBase mapping, List<GRealPoint2D> points, out int startIndex, out int count)
		{
			double num = mapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.MinValueInternal;
			double num2 = mapping.AxisX.VisualRangeData.MaxValueInternal;
			if (num > num2)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				num = num2;
				num2 = num3;
			}
			startIndex = 0;
			count = points.Count;
			if (points.Count > 0 && !double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				int num4 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(GetValueIndex(points, num) - 1, points.Count - 1));
				int num5 = Math.Min(GetValueIndex(points, num2) + 1, points.Count - 1);
				startIndex = num4;
				count = num5 - num4 + 1;
			}
		}

		internal bool GetActualVisible()
		{
			if (Visible && XYSeries != null && XYSeries.GetActualVisible())
			{
				if (Container != null && Container.LegendOptions.LegendUseCheckBoxes)
				{
					if (CheckableInLegend)
					{
						return CheckedInLegend;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal IndicatorAnimationBase GetActualAnimation()
		{
			IndicatorAnimationBase animation = Animation;
			if (animation != null)
			{
				return animation;
			}
			if (AnimationEnabled)
			{
				return CreateDefaultAnimation();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void CalculateLayout()
		{
			PresentationUpdater presentationUpdater = new PresentationUpdater(this);
			presentationUpdater.UpdateItemPresentation(Item);
			CreateLabelItems();
			UpdateGeometryClip();
			UpdateGeometryTransformation();
		}

		internal void CalculateData(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
			linePointsByType = null;
			CalculateDataInternal(context);
		}

		internal void SetLegendItemIndex(int legendItemIndex)
		{
			this.legendItemIndex = legendItemIndex;
		}

		public void Animate()
		{
			if (storyboardStarted)
			{
				Storyboard.Stop();
			}
			if (Storyboard.Children.Count != 0)
			{
				Storyboard.Children.Clear();
			}
			PrepareStoryboard();
			StartAnimation();
			Action method = delegate
			{
				Storyboard.Begin();
				storyboardStarted = true;
			};
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(method, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorCollection : ChartElementCollection<Indicator>
	{
		private readonly List<IDataSourceIndicator> dataSourceIndicators = new List<IDataSourceIndicator>();

		protected override ChartElementChange Change => base.Change | ChartElementChange.UpdateIndicators | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems;

		internal List<IDataSourceIndicator> DataSourceIndicators => dataSourceIndicators;

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerator enumerator = e.NewItems.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current is IDataSourceIndicator)
					{
						ChartElementHelper.Update(base.Owner, new EmptyUpdateInfo(this), ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
					}
					else
					{
						ChartElementHelper.Update(base.Owner, new IndicatorUpdateInfo(current));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, Indicator item)
		{
			if (item is IDataSourceIndicator item2)
			{
				dataSourceIndicators.Add(item2);
			}
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			if (base.Items[index] is IDataSourceIndicator item)
			{
				dataSourceIndicators.Remove(item);
			}
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class IndicatorItem : NotifyPropertyChangedObject, IWeakEventListener, IPresentationItem
	{
		private System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

		private LineStyle lineStyle;

		private Indicator indicator;

		private IndicatorLabel label;

		private int actualLineThickness;

		private Geometry geometry;

		private IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> geometries;

		private Geometry animationClip;

		private Transform animationTransform;

		private bool visible;

		private AnimationState animationState;

		internal LegendItem LegendItem { get; private set; }

		internal XYSeries2D XYSeries2D => indicator.XYSeries;

		internal Indicator Indicator => indicator;

		public Geometry Geometry
		{
			get
			{
				return geometry;
			}
			set
			{
				geometry = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Geometry");
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> Geometries
		{
			get
			{
				return geometries;
			}
			set
			{
				geometries = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Geometries");
			}
		}

		public Geometry AnimationClip
		{
			get
			{
				return animationClip;
			}
			set
			{
				animationClip = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("AnimationClip");
			}
		}

		public Transform AnimationTransform
		{
			get
			{
				return animationTransform;
			}
			set
			{
				animationTransform = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("AnimationTransform");
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return brush;
			}
			set
			{
				brush = value;
				if (indicator is ISupportIndicatorLabel { Label: null })
				{
					Label.Foreground = value;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("Brush");
			}
		}

		public LineStyle LineStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return lineStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(lineStyle, value, this);
				lineStyle = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("LineStyle");
				UpdateInteractiveState();
			}
		}

		public bool ShowInLegend => indicator.ShowInLegend;

		public string LegendText => indicator.LegendText;

		public IndicatorLabel Label
		{
			get
			{
				return label;
			}
			set
			{
				label = value;
			}
		}

		public int ActualLineThickness
		{
			get
			{
				return actualLineThickness;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualLineThickness != value)
				{
					actualLineThickness = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ActualLineThickness");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (visible != value)
				{
					visible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Visible");
				}
			}
		}

		public AnimationState AnimationState
		{
			get
			{
				return animationState;
			}
			set
			{
				animationState = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("AnimationState");
			}
		}

		IPresentation IPresentationItem.Presentation
		{
			get
			{
				if (geometry == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new GeometryWrapper(geometry);
			}
			set
			{
				Geometry = ((value != null) ? ((GeometryWrapper)value).Geometry : null);
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> IPresentationItem.IntervalPresentations
		{
			get
			{
				return geometries;
			}
			set
			{
				Geometries = value;
			}
		}

		internal IndicatorItem(Indicator indicator)
		{
			this.indicator = indicator;
			brush = ((indicator.Brush != null) ? indicator.Brush : new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black));
			lineStyle = ((indicator.LineStyle != null) ? indicator.LineStyle : new LineStyle());
			Label = new IndicatorLabel();
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is LineStyle)
			{
				UpdateInteractiveState();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateInteractiveState()
		{
			IInteractiveElement interactiveElement = indicator;
			bool inInteractiveState = interactiveElement.IsSelected || interactiveElement.IsHighlighted;
			int thickness = ((LineStyle == null) ? ((int)LineStyle.ThicknessProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(LineStyle)).DefaultValue) : LineStyle.Thickness);
			ActualLineThickness = VisualSelectionHelper.GetLineThickness(thickness, inInteractiveState);
		}

		internal void UpdateLegendItem(Legend legend)
		{
			string text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(indicator.LegendText) ? indicator.DisplayName : indicator.LegendText);
			LegendItem = new DefaultLegendItem(legend, indicator, indicator, text, null, Brush, LineStyle, XYSeries2D.GetActualVisible());
		}
	}

	public class IndicatorLabelElementsPanel : ChartItemsPanelBase
	{
		private Pane Pane
		{
			get
			{
				Pane pane = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Pane>((DependencyObject)this);
				if (pane != null)
				{
					return pane;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Pane != null)
			{
				foreach (IndicatorLabelPresentation child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Measure(Pane.Diagram.Rotated ? new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Width) : availableSize);
				}
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (Pane != null)
			{
				foreach (IndicatorLabelPresentation child in base.Children)
				{
					if (child.LabelItem.Layout != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Point centerLabelLocation = child.LabelItem.Layout.CenterLabelLocation;
						RotateTransform renderTransform = new RotateTransform
						{
							Angle = child.LabelItem.Layout.ClockwiseAngleInDegrees
						};
						child.RenderTransform = renderTransform;
						child.RenderTransformOrigin = child.LabelItem.Layout.RotationOrigin;
						System.Windows.Point location = Pane.ViewportTransform.Transform(centerLabelLocation);
						location -= new Vector(child.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0, child.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0);
						child.Arrange(new Rect(location, child.DesiredSize));
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public class IndicatorElementsPanel : ChartItemsPanelBase
	{
		private Pane Pane => LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Pane>((DependencyObject)this);

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				foreach (IndicatorPresentation child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Measure(pane.Diagram.Rotated ? new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Width) : availableSize);
				}
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				Transform viewportTransform = pane.ViewportTransform;
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					if (child != null)
					{
						child.RenderTransform = viewportTransform;
						child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), child.DesiredSize));
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class ExponentialMovingAverage : MovingAverage
	{
		public ExponentialMovingAverage()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ExponentialMovingAverage>(this);
		}

		protected override void CalculateDataInternal(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
			ExponentialMovingAverageCalculator exponentialMovingAverageCalculator = new ExponentialMovingAverageCalculator();
			exponentialMovingAverageCalculator.Calculate(context.RefinedPoints, base.PointsCountCopy, base.ValueLevelCopy, base.EnvelopePercentCopy, base.ValueProvider);
			movingAverageData = exponentialMovingAverageCalculator.MovingAverageData;
			lowerEnvelopeData = exponentialMovingAverageCalculator.LowerEnvelopeData;
			upperEnvelopeData = exponentialMovingAverageCalculator.UpperEnvelopeData;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new ExponentialMovingAverage();
		}
	}
	public enum MovingAverageKind
	{
		MovingAverage,
		Envelope,
		MovingAverageAndEnvelope
	}
	public abstract class MovingAverage : Indicator
	{
		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;

		private const double DefaultEnvelopePercent = 3.0;

		private const int DefaultPointsCount = 10;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueLevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ValueLevel", typeof(ValueLevel), typeof(MovingAverage), new PropertyMetadata(ValueLevel.Value, ValueLevelPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MovingAverageKindProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MovingAverageKind", typeof(MovingAverageKind), typeof(MovingAverage), new PropertyMetadata(MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage, Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EnvelopePercentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EnvelopePercent", typeof(double), typeof(MovingAverage), new PropertyMetadata(3.0, EnvelopePercentPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateEnvelopePercentProperty);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointsCountProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointsCount", typeof(int), typeof(MovingAverage), new PropertyMetadata(10, PointsCountPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidatePointsCountProperty);

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> movingAverageData;

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> upperEnvelopeData;

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> lowerEnvelopeData;

		private ValueLevelInternal valueLevel;

		private double envelopePercent = 3.0;

		private int pointsCount = 10;

		protected override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (MovingAverageKind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
				{
					return movingAverageData.Count > 0;
				}
				return upperEnvelopeData.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating how to obtain the value of a moving average indicator’s point.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (ValueLevel)GetValue(ValueLevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueLevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Determines whether to display a Moving Average, Envelope, or both.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public MovingAverageKind MovingAverageKind
		{
			get
			{
				return (MovingAverageKind)GetValue(MovingAverageKindProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MovingAverageKindProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the percent for the Envelope kind of the Moving Average and Envelope  technical indicator.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double EnvelopePercent
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(EnvelopePercentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EnvelopePercentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the number of data points used to calculate the indicator.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int PointsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(PointsCountProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointsCountProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected ValueLevelInternal ValueLevelCopy => valueLevel;

		protected double EnvelopePercentCopy => envelopePercent;

		protected int PointsCountCopy => pointsCount;

		private static void ValueLevelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MovingAverage movingAverage)
			{
				movingAverage.valueLevel = (ValueLevelInternal)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		private static void EnvelopePercentPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MovingAverage movingAverage)
			{
				movingAverage.envelopePercent = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		private static void PointsCountPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MovingAverage movingAverage)
			{
				movingAverage.pointsCount = (int)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		public MovingAverage()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<MovingAverage>(this);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ValueLevelProperty);
			properties.Add(MovingAverageKindProperty);
			properties.Add(EnvelopePercentProperty);
			properties.Add(PointsCountProperty);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			if (movingAverageData == null || movingAverageData.Count < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext context = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				if (MovingAverageKind == MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage || MovingAverageKind == MovingAverageKind.MovingAverageAndEnvelope)
				{
					DrawPolylineSegment(context, mapping, movingAverageData);
				}
				if (MovingAverageKind == MovingAverageKind.Envelope || MovingAverageKind == MovingAverageKind.MovingAverageAndEnvelope)
				{
					DrawPolylineSegment(context, mapping, upperEnvelopeData);
					DrawPolylineSegment(context, mapping, lowerEnvelopeData);
				}
			}
			return streamGeometry;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> CreateLinePointsByType()
		{
			Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> dictionary = new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>>();
			switch (MovingAverageKind)
			{
			case MovingAverageKind.MovingAverage:
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average, movingAverageData);
				break;
			case MovingAverageKind.Envelope:
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper, upperEnvelopeData);
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower, lowerEnvelopeData);
				break;
			case MovingAverageKind.MovingAverageAndEnvelope:
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average, movingAverageData);
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper, upperEnvelopeData);
				dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower, lowerEnvelopeData);
				break;
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			if (MovingAverageKind != MovingAverageKind.Envelope)
			{
				return movingAverageData[index].X;
			}
			return upperEnvelopeData[index].X;
		}

		protected override IndicatorPointToStringConverter CreateIndicatorPointToStringConverterCore(Series series, bool crosshairShowInLegend)
		{
			return new MovingAverageIndicatorPointToStringConverter(series, crosshairShowInLegend, (MovingAverageKindInternal)MovingAverageKind);
		}

		private static bool ValidateEnvelopePercentProperty(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is double num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ValidatePointsCountProperty(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is int num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SimpleMovingAverage : MovingAverage
	{
		private const bool DefaultIgnoreEmptyValues = false;

		private const bool DefaultStartFromFristPoint = true;

		private bool ignoreEmptyValues;

		private bool startFromFirstPoint = true;

		internal bool IgnoreEmptyValues
		{
			get
			{
				return ignoreEmptyValues;
			}
			set
			{
				ignoreEmptyValues = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool StartFromFirstPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return startFromFirstPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				startFromFirstPoint = value;
			}
		}

		public SimpleMovingAverage()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SimpleMovingAverage>(this);
		}

		protected override void CalculateDataInternal(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
			SimpleMovingAverageCalculator simpleMovingAverageCalculator = new SimpleMovingAverageCalculator();
			simpleMovingAverageCalculator.IgnoreEmptyValues = IgnoreEmptyValues;
			simpleMovingAverageCalculator.StartFromFirstPoint = StartFromFirstPoint;
			simpleMovingAverageCalculator.Calculate(context.RefinedPoints, base.PointsCountCopy, base.ValueLevelCopy, base.EnvelopePercentCopy, base.ValueProvider);
			movingAverageData = simpleMovingAverageCalculator.MovingAverageData;
			lowerEnvelopeData = simpleMovingAverageCalculator.LowerEnvelopeData;
			upperEnvelopeData = simpleMovingAverageCalculator.UpperEnvelopeData;
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new SimpleMovingAverage();
		}
	}

	public class RegressionLine : Indicator
	{
		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Value;

		private const double DefaultForecastBackwardPeriods = -1.0;

		private const double DefaultForecastForwardPeriods = -1.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueLevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ValueLevel", typeof(ValueLevel), typeof(RegressionLine), new PropertyMetadata(ValueLevel.Value, ValueLevelPropertyChanged));

		private System.Windows.Point? startPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point? endPoint;

		private ValueLevelInternal valueLevel;

		private double forecastBackwardPeriods = -1.0;

		private double forecastForwardPeriods = -1.0;

		protected override bool HasPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (startPoint.HasValue)
				{
					return endPoint.HasValue;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsStraightLine => true;

		[Description("Gets or sets a value indicating how to obtain the value of a regression line’s point.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (ValueLevel)GetValue(ValueLevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueLevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal double ForecastBackwardPeriods
		{
			get
			{
				return forecastBackwardPeriods;
			}
			set
			{
				forecastBackwardPeriods = ((!MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(value)) ? 0.0 : value);
			}
		}

		internal double ForecastForwardPeriods
		{
			get
			{
				return forecastForwardPeriods;
			}
			set
			{
				forecastForwardPeriods = ((!MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(value)) ? 0.0 : value);
			}
		}

		private static void ValueLevelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RegressionLine regressionLine)
			{
				regressionLine.valueLevel = (ValueLevelInternal)e.NewValue;
			}
			Indicator.UpdateIndicatorInfo(d, e);
		}

		public RegressionLine()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<RegressionLine>(this);
		}

		public RegressionLine(ValueLevel valueLevel)
			: this()
		{
			ValueLevel = valueLevel;
		}

		protected override void CalculateDataInternal(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			RegressionLineCalculator regressionLineCalculator = new RegressionLineCalculator();
			IAxisData actualAxisX = base.XYSeries.ActualAxisX;
			IAxisData actualAxisY = base.XYSeries.ActualAxisY;
			double num = actualAxisX.VisualRange.Min;
			if (ForecastBackwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = mapping.AxisX.ScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(actualAxisX.VisualRange.RefinedMin);
				num = num2 - ForecastBackwardPeriods;
			}
			double num3 = actualAxisX.VisualRange.Max;
			if (ForecastForwardPeriods >= 0.0)
			{
				double num4 = mapping.AxisX.ScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(actualAxisX.VisualRange.RefinedMax);
				num3 = num4 + ForecastForwardPeriods;
			}
			double min = actualAxisY.VisualRange.Min;
			double max = actualAxisY.VisualRange.Max;
			Tuple<GRealPoint2D, GRealPoint2D> tuple = regressionLineCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, num, num3, (ValueLevelInternal)ValueLevel, base.ValueProvider);
			if (tuple == null || (tuple.Item1.Y < min && tuple.Item2.Y < min) || (tuple.Item1.Y > max && tuple.Item2.Y > max))
			{
				startPoint = null;
				endPoint = null;
			}
			else
			{
				startPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num, tuple.Item1.Y);
				endPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num3, tuple.Item2.Y);
			}
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ValueLevelProperty);
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new RegressionLine();
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			if (startPoint.HasValue && endPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return new LineGeometry
				{
					StartPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(startPoint.Value.X, startPoint.Value.Y),
					EndPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(endPoint.Value.X, endPoint.Value.Y)
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			double value = CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorArgument, cursorValue, startPoint.Value.X, endPoint.Value.X, startPoint.Value.Y, endPoint.Value.Y, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity: true, extrapolateToPositiveInfinity: true);
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> { 
			{
				IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value,
				value
			} };
		}

		protected override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorValue, cursorArgument, startPoint.Value.Y, endPoint.Value.Y, startPoint.Value.X, endPoint.Value.X, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity: true, extrapolateToPositiveInfinity: true);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeparatePaneIndicator : Indicator, ISeparatePaneIndicator, IAffectsAxisRange
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PaneProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Pane", typeof(object), typeof(SeparatePaneIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null, PanePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AxisYProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AxisY", typeof(object), typeof(SeparatePaneIndicator), new PropertyMetadata(null, AxisYPropertyChanged));

		private int paneIndex = -1;

		private int axisYIndex = -1;

		protected override Pane PaneCore => ActualPane;

		protected override AxisBase AxisYCore => ActualAxisY;

		[Description("Specifies the pane (or its View Model), on which the indicator is plotted.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[DXDesignerSerializableProperty]
		public object Pane
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(PaneProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PaneProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the Y-axis (or its View Model) that measures an indicator.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[DXDesignerSerializableProperty]
		public object AxisY
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(AxisYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AxisYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private XYSeries2D Series => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as XYSeries2D;

		protected internal AxisBase ActualAxisY
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = ChartElementHelper.FindOwnerByType<XYDiagram2D>(this);
				if (xYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					SecondaryAxisY2D axisYFromObject = GetAxisYFromObject(AxisYInternal, xYDiagram2D);
					if (axisYFromObject == null)
					{
						return Series.ActualAxisY;
					}
					return axisYFromObject;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Pane ActualPane
		{
			get
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = ChartElementHelper.FindOwnerByType<XYDiagram2D>(this);
				if (xYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					Pane elementFromObject = TagUtils.GetElementFromObject(PaneInternal, xYDiagram2D.Panes);
					if (elementFromObject == null)
					{
						return Series.ActualPane as Pane;
					}
					return elementFromObject;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal object AxisYInternal { get; set; }

		protected internal object PaneInternal { get; set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int PaneIndex
		{
			get
			{
				Pane actualPane = ActualPane;
				if (actualPane != null && base.XYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					return base.XYDiagram2D.Panes.IndexOf(actualPane);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			set
			{
				paneIndex = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int AxisYIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualAxisY is SecondaryAxisY2D item && base.XYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					return base.XYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesYInternal.IndexOf(item);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			set
			{
				axisYIndex = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Data")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public new object Tag
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Tag;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Tag = value;
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAffectsAxisRange.AxisYData => ActualAxisY;

		IPane ISeparatePaneIndicator.Pane => ActualPane;

		private static void PanePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
			{
				separatePaneIndicator.PaneInternal = e.NewValue;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(d, "Pane", e.OldValue as IAxisData, e.NewValue as IAxisData), ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems);
		}

		private static void AxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
			{
				separatePaneIndicator.AxisYInternal = e.NewValue;
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = ChartElementHelper.FindOwnerByType<XYDiagram2D>(separatePaneIndicator);
				if (xYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					IAxisData axisYFromObject = separatePaneIndicator.GetAxisYFromObject(e.OldValue, xYDiagram2D);
					IAxisData axisYFromObject2 = separatePaneIndicator.GetAxisYFromObject(e.NewValue, xYDiagram2D);
					ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(d, "AxisY", axisYFromObject, axisYFromObject2), ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems);
				}
			}
		}

		MinMaxValues IAffectsAxisRange.GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			return GetMinMaxValues(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);
		}

		private SecondaryAxisY2D GetAxisYFromObject(object axisObject, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			return TagUtils.GetElementFromObject(axisObject, diagram.SecondaryAxesYInternal);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(PaneProperty);
			properties.Add(AxisYProperty);
		}

		protected abstract MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering);

		protected MinMaxValues GetFilteredMinMaxY(List<GRealPoint2D> indicatorPoints, IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering, MinMaxValues minMaxYByWholeXRange)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Delta))
			{
				return minMaxYByWholeXRange;
			}
			if (indicatorPoints == null || indicatorPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < indicatorPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (indicatorPoints[i].X > visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Min)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int num3 = indicatorPoints.Count - 1; num3 > -1; num3--)
			{
				if (indicatorPoints[num3].X < visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering.Max)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1 || num2 == -1)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double y = indicatorPoints[num].Y;
			double y2 = indicatorPoints[num].Y;
			for (int j = num + 1; j < num2; j++)
			{
				if (indicatorPoints[j].Y < y)
				{
					y = indicatorPoints[j].Y;
				}
				if (indicatorPoints[j].Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = indicatorPoints[j].Y;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(y, y2);
		}

		protected internal override void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			base.CompleteDeserializing();
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.XYDiagram2D;
			if (xYDiagram2D != null)
			{
				if (paneIndex >= 0 && paneIndex < xYDiagram2D.Panes.Count)
				{
					Pane = xYDiagram2D.Panes[paneIndex];
				}
				if (axisYIndex >= 0 && axisYIndex < xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesYInternal.Count)
				{
					AxisY = xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesYInternal[axisYIndex];
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeparatePaneIndicatorWithPoints : SeparatePaneIndicator
	{
		private List<GRealPoint2D> indicatorPoints;

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> IndicatorPoints
		{
			get
			{
				return indicatorPoints;
			}
			private set
			{
				indicatorPoints = value;
			}
		}

		protected override List<GRealPoint2D> IndicatorLineStrip => IndicatorPoints;

		protected abstract List<GRealPoint2D> CalculatePoints(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints);

		protected abstract MinMaxValues GetYRange();

		protected override void CalculateDataInternal(DataCalculationContext context)
		{
			IndicatorPoints = CalculatePoints(context.RefinedSeries, context.RefinedPoints);
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering)
		{
			if (IndicatorPoints != null && IndicatorPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				return GetFilteredMinMaxY(IndicatorPoints, visualRangeOfOtherAxisForFiltering, GetYRange());
			}
			return MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}
	}

	public class DetrendedPriceOscillator : SeparatePaneIndicatorWithPoints
	{
		private const int DefaultPointsCount = 20;

		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevel = ValueLevel.Close;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueLevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ValueLevel", typeof(ValueLevel), typeof(DetrendedPriceOscillator), new PropertyMetadata(ValueLevel.Close, ValueLevelPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointsCountProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointsCount", typeof(int), typeof(DetrendedPriceOscillator), new PropertyMetadata(20, PointsCountPropertyChanged));

		private readonly DetrendedPriceOscillatorCalculator calculator = new DetrendedPriceOscillatorCalculator();

	public class TrendLine : FinancialIndicator
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ExtrapolateToInfinityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ExtrapolateToInfinity", typeof(bool), typeof(TrendLine), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity", typeof(bool), typeof(TrendLine), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		private GRealLine2D indicatorLine;

		protected override bool HasPoints => true;

		protected override bool IsStraightLine => true;

		[Description("Specifies whether the Trend Line is extrapolated to infinity.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ExtrapolateToInfinity
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ExtrapolateToInfinityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ExtrapolateToInfinityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether the Trend Line is extrapolated to negative infinity.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public TrendLine()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<TrendLine>(this);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ExtrapolateToInfinityProperty);
			properties.Add(ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinityProperty);
		}

		protected override Indicator CreateInstance()
		{
			return new TrendLine();
		}

		protected override void CalculateLayoutInternal(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			IAxisData actualAxisX = base.XYSeries.ActualAxisX;
			double max = actualAxisX.VisualRange.Max;
			double min = actualAxisX.VisualRange.Min;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = actualAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			TrendLineCalculator trendLineCalculator = new TrendLineCalculator();
			indicatorLine = trendLineCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, axisScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, base.Argument1, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel1, base.Argument2, (ValueLevelInternal)base.ValueLevel2, ExtrapolateToInfinity, max, ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity, min, base.ValueProvider);
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateGeometry(PaneMappingBase mapping)
		{
			if (base.SeriesPane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PaneMapping paneMapping = new PaneMapping(base.SeriesPane, base.XYSeries);
			return new LineGeometry
			{
				StartPoint = paneMapping.GetDiagramPoint(indicatorLine.Start),
				EndPoint = paneMapping.GetDiagramPoint(indicatorLine.End)
			};
		}

		protected override Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateCrosshairIndicatorPointValues(int index, double cursorArgument, double cursorValue)
		{
			double value = CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorArgument, cursorValue, indicatorLine.Start.X, indicatorLine.End.X, indicatorLine.Start.Y, indicatorLine.End.Y, ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity, ExtrapolateToInfinity);
			return new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> { 
			{
				IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value,
				value
			} };
		}

		protected override double GetArgumentByIndex(int index, double cursorValue, double cursorArgument)
		{
			return CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator.CalculateLineCoordinate(cursorValue, cursorArgument, indicatorLine.Start.Y, indicatorLine.End.Y, indicatorLine.Start.X, indicatorLine.End.X, ExtrapolateToNegativeInfinity, ExtrapolateToInfinity);
		}
	}
	public class Chart2DElementPanelBase : ChartElementPanelBase<Diagram>
	{
		protected override Rect LegendParentArea => base.Diagram.LegendParentArea;

		protected override IAutoLayoutSupport Control => base.Diagram.Container as IAutoLayoutSupport;
	}
	public class ChartElementPanel : Chart2DElementPanelBase
	{
	}
	public abstract class ChartElementPanelBase : Canvas
	{
	}
	public abstract class ChartElementPanelBase<TDiagram> : ChartElementPanelBase where TDiagram : Control
	{
		private readonly AutoLayoutController autoLayoutController = new AutoLayoutController();

		private TDiagram diagram;

		private List<LegendBase> legends;

		protected TDiagram Diagram => diagram;

		protected abstract Rect LegendParentArea { get; }

		protected abstract IAutoLayoutSupport Control { get; }

		private HorizontalPosition ActualLegendHorizontalPosition(LegendBase legend)
		{
			return legend?.HorizontalPosition ?? HorizontalPosition.Center;
		}

		private VerticalPosition ActualLegendVerticalPosition(LegendBase legend)
		{
			return legend?.VerticalPosition ?? VerticalPosition.Center;
		}

		private Thickness ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(LegendBase legend)
		{
			return legend?.IndentFromDiagram ?? new Thickness(0.0);
		}

		private bool LegendHasItems(LegendBase legend)
		{
			if (legend != null && legend.ItemsCore != null)
			{
				return legend.ItemsCore.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Rect CalcLegendBounds()
		{
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			double x = LegendParentArea.Left + diagram.Margin.Left + diagram.BorderThickness.Left + diagram.Padding.Left;
			double y = LegendParentArea.Top + diagram.Margin.Top + diagram.BorderThickness.Top + diagram.Padding.Top;
			return new Rect(x, y, LegendParentArea.Width, LegendParentArea.Height);
		}

		private UIElement FindControlByType(Type type)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.GetType() == type || child.GetType().IsSubclassOf(type))
				{
					return child;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<UIElement> FindControlsByType(Type type)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.GetType() == type || child.GetType().IsSubclassOf(type))
				{
					list.Add(child);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void EnsureChildrenControls()
		{
			diagram = FindControlByType(typeof(TDiagram)) as TDiagram;
			List<UIElement> list = FindControlsByType(typeof(LegendBase));
			legends = new List<LegendBase>();
			foreach (LegendBase item in list)
			{
				legends.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private double GetLegendOffset(LegendBase legend, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition key = new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend.HorizontalPosition, legend.VerticalPosition);
			if (!legendPositionOffsets.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				legendPositionOffsets.Add(key, 0.0);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void AddLegendOffset(LegendBase legend, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition key = new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend.HorizontalPosition, legend.VerticalPosition);
			double num = ((legend.IsInsidePosition && key.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center) ? legend.DesiredSize.Width : legend.DesiredSize.Height);
			legendPositionOffsets[key] += num;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size MeasureLegend(LegendBase legend, System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(legend);
			legend.Measure(availableSize);
			if ((legend.ItemsCore != null && legend.ItemsCore.Count > 0) || DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(legend))
			{
				return legend.DesiredSize;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private void MeasureLegendInsideDiagram(LegendBase legend)
		{
			Rect rect = CalcLegendBounds();
			double width = Math.Max(rect.Width - ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left - ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Right, 0.0);
			double height = Math.Max(rect.Height - ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top - ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Bottom, 0.0);
			MeasureLegend(legend, new System.Windows.Size(width, height));
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetSizeForLegendOutsideDiagram(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double height = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - diagram.Margin.Top - diagram.Margin.Bottom, 0.0);
			double width = Math.Max(availableSize.Width - diagram.Margin.Left - diagram.Margin.Right, 0.0);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		private Thickness GetDiagramMarginsForLegends(Thickness margins, System.Windows.Size legendSize, LegendBase legend, double offset)
		{
			if (legendSize.Width > 0.0)
			{
				switch (ActualLegendHorizontalPosition(legend))
				{
				case HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside:
				{
					double val2 = Math.Round(legendSize.Width + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Right);
					margins.Left = Math.Max(val2, margins.Left);
					break;
				}
				case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside:
				{
					double val = Math.Round(legendSize.Width + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left);
					margins.Right = Math.Max(val, margins.Right);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (legendSize.Height > 0.0)
			{
				switch (ActualLegendVerticalPosition(legend))
				{
				case VerticalPosition.TopOutside:
				{
					double val4 = Math.Round(legendSize.Height + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Bottom + offset);
					margins.Top = Math.Max(val4, margins.Top);
					break;
				}
				case VerticalPosition.BottomOutside:
				{
					double val3 = Math.Round(legendSize.Height + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top + offset);
					margins.Bottom = Math.Max(val3, margins.Bottom);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			return margins;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetLegendArrangeSize(LegendBase legend)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = legend.DesiredSize;
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				result = (LegendHasItems(legend) ? legend.DesiredSize : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ArrangeLegendOutsideDiagram(LegendBase legend, System.Windows.Point diagramLocation, System.Windows.Size totalSize, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			System.Windows.Size legendArrangeSize = GetLegendArrangeSize(legend);
			double x;
			switch (ActualLegendHorizontalPosition(legend))
			{
			case HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside:
				x = 0.0;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Left:
				x = diagramLocation.X;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Center:
				x = (diagramLocation.X + diagram.DesiredSize.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width - diagram.Margin.Right) / 2.0;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Right:
				x = diagramLocation.X + diagram.DesiredSize.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width - diagram.Margin.Right - diagram.Margin.Left;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside:
				x = totalSize.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown HorizontalPosition value.");
				goto case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside;
			}
			double legendOffset = GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets);
			double y;
			switch (ActualLegendVerticalPosition(legend))
			{
			case VerticalPosition.TopOutside:
				y = legendOffset;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Top:
				y = diagramLocation.Y + legendOffset;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Center:
				y = legendOffset + (diagramLocation.Y + diagram.DesiredSize.Height - diagram.Margin.Bottom - legendArrangeSize.Height) / 2.0;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Bottom:
				y = diagramLocation.Y + diagram.DesiredSize.Height - legendArrangeSize.Height - diagram.Margin.Bottom - diagram.Margin.Top - legendOffset;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.BottomOutside:
				y = totalSize.Height - legendArrangeSize.Height - legendOffset;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown VerticalPosition value.");
				goto case VerticalPosition.Top;
			}
			AddLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets);
			legend.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), legendArrangeSize));
		}

		private void ArrangeLegendInsideDiagram(LegendBase legend, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			diagram.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), diagram.DesiredSize));
			Rect rect = CalcLegendBounds();
			System.Windows.Size legendArrangeSize = GetLegendArrangeSize(legend);
			double num = ((legend.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center) ? GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets) : 0.0);
			double x;
			switch (ActualLegendHorizontalPosition(legend))
			{
			case HorizontalPosition.Left:
				x = rect.Left + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left + num;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Center:
				x = rect.Left + Math.Max((rect.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width) / 2.0, ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left);
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Right:
				x = rect.Right - legendArrangeSize.Width - ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Right - num;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown HorizontalPosition value.");
				goto case HorizontalPosition.Right;
			}
			num = ((legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.Center) ? GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets) : 0.0);
			double y;
			switch (ActualLegendVerticalPosition(legend))
			{
			case VerticalPosition.Top:
				y = rect.Top + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top + num;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Center:
				y = rect.Top + Math.Max((rect.Height - legendArrangeSize.Height) / 2.0, ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top) + num;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Bottom:
				y = rect.Bottom - legendArrangeSize.Height - ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend).Bottom - num;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown VerticalPosition value.");
				goto case VerticalPosition.Top;
			}
			AddLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets);
			legend.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), legendArrangeSize));
		}

		private System.Windows.Size ArrangeLegendWithoutDiagram(LegendBase legend, System.Windows.Size finalSize, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			System.Windows.Size legendArrangeSize = GetLegendArrangeSize(legend);
			double num = ((legend.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center) ? GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets) : 0.0);
			double x;
			switch (ActualLegendHorizontalPosition(legend))
			{
			case HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside:
				x = 0.0;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Left:
				x = num;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Center:
				x = (finalSize.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width) / 2.0;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Right:
				x = finalSize.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width - num;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside:
				x = finalSize.Width - legendArrangeSize.Width;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown HorizontalPosition value.");
				goto case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside;
			}
			num = ((legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.Center) ? GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets) : 0.0);
			double y;
			switch (ActualLegendVerticalPosition(legend))
			{
			case VerticalPosition.TopOutside:
			case VerticalPosition.Top:
				y = num;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Center:
				y = (finalSize.Height - legendArrangeSize.Height) / 2.0 + num;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Bottom:
			case VerticalPosition.BottomOutside:
				y = finalSize.Height - legendArrangeSize.Height - num;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown VerticalPosition value.");
				goto case VerticalPosition.TopOutside;
			}
			legend.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), legendArrangeSize));
			return legendArrangeSize;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetElementRenderSize(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = element.RenderSize;
			Thickness margin = element.Margin;
			return new System.Windows.Size(margin.Left + margin.Right + renderSize.Width, margin.Top + margin.Bottom + renderSize.Height);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size CalculateDiagramSize(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Thickness margins = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Size result = finalSize;
			Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double>();
			foreach (LegendBase legend in legends)
			{
				if (legend.IsOutsidePosition && legend.ItemsCore.Count > 0)
				{
					double legendOffset = GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets);
					AddLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets);
					System.Windows.Size elementRenderSize = GetElementRenderSize(legend);
					margins = GetDiagramMarginsForLegends(margins, elementRenderSize, legend, legendOffset);
					double width = Math.Max(finalSize.Width - margins.Left - margins.Right, 0.0);
					double height = Math.Max(finalSize.Height - margins.Top - margins.Bottom, 0.0);
					result = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
		{
			base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			diagram = null;
			legends = null;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			EnsureChildrenControls();
			System.Windows.Size result = availableSize;
			if (legends.Count == 0)
			{
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					diagram.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			else if (diagram == null)
			{
				foreach (LegendBase legend in legends)
				{
					MeasureLegend(legend, availableSize);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Thickness margins = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double>();
				foreach (LegendBase legend2 in legends)
				{
					double legendOffset = GetLegendOffset(legend2, legendPositionOffsets);
					AddLegendOffset(legend2, legendPositionOffsets);
					if (legend2.IsInsidePosition)
					{
						MeasureLegendInsideDiagram(legend2);
						continue;
					}
					System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = availableSize;
					if (legend2.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center)
					{
						availableSize2.Width = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize2.Width - legendOffset);
					}
					else
					{
						availableSize2.Height = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize2.Height - legendOffset);
					}
					System.Windows.Size sizeForLegendOutsideDiagram = GetSizeForLegendOutsideDiagram(availableSize2);
					sizeForLegendOutsideDiagram = MeasureLegend(legend2, sizeForLegendOutsideDiagram);
					margins = GetDiagramMarginsForLegends(margins, sizeForLegendOutsideDiagram, legend2, legendOffset);
				}
				double width = Math.Max(availableSize.Width - margins.Left - margins.Right, 0.0);
				double height = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - margins.Top - margins.Bottom, 0.0);
				diagram.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(width, height));
			}
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size renderSize = Control.RenderSize;
				if (diagram.IsVisible || renderSize.Width > 0.0 || renderSize.Height > 0.0)
				{
					autoLayoutController.CalculateLayout(Control, renderSize);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			EnsureChildrenControls();
			Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double>();
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				if (legends.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (LegendBase legend in legends)
					{
						ArrangeLegendWithoutDiagram(legend, finalSize, dictionary);
					}
				}
				return finalSize;
			}
			if (legends.Count == 0)
			{
				diagram.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize));
				return finalSize;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			System.Windows.Point diagramLocation = new System.Windows.Point(diagram.Margin.Left, diagram.Margin.Top);
			foreach (LegendBase legend2 in legends)
			{
				if (legend2.ActualVisible && legend2.IsOutsidePosition)
				{
					System.Windows.Size legendArrangeSize = GetLegendArrangeSize(legend2);
					if (legend2.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside && legendArrangeSize.Width > diagramLocation.X)
					{
						diagramLocation.X = legendArrangeSize.Width + legend2.IndentFromDiagram.Right + diagram.Margin.Left;
					}
					if (legend2.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside && legendArrangeSize.Height > diagramLocation.Y)
					{
						diagramLocation.Y = legendArrangeSize.Height + legend2.IndentFromDiagram.Bottom + diagram.Margin.Top;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (LegendBase legend3 in legends)
			{
				if (legend3.IsInsidePosition)
				{
					ArrangeLegendInsideDiagram(legend3, dictionary);
					continue;
				}
				ArrangeLegendOutsideDiagram(legend3, diagramLocation, finalSize, dictionary);
				if ((LegendHasItems(legend3) || DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(legend3)) && legend3.ActualVisible)
				{
					System.Windows.Size elementRenderSize = GetElementRenderSize(legend3);
					if (ActualLegendHorizontalPosition(legend3) == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside)
					{
						num = Math.Max(Math.Round(elementRenderSize.Width + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend3).Right), num);
					}
					if (ActualLegendVerticalPosition(legend3) == VerticalPosition.TopOutside)
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(Math.Round(dictionary[new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend3.HorizontalPosition, legend3.VerticalPosition)] + ActualLegendIndentFromDiagram(legend3).Bottom), num2);
					}
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = CalculateDiagramSize(finalSize);
			diagram.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num, num2), size));
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class GradientLegendItem : LegendItem
	{
		private object dataSource;

		[Description("")]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (dataSource != value)
				{
					dataSource = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("DataSource");
				}
			}
		}

		internal GradientLegendItem(Legend legend, ILegendVisible browsableObject, object sourceElement, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush, object dataSource)
			: base(legend, browsableObject, sourceElement, string.Empty, markerBrush, null, null, VisualSelectionType.None, isSelected: false, isEnabled: true)
		{
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
		}

		protected internal override bool Assign(LegendItemBase item)
		{
			if (item is GradientLegendItem gradientLegendItem)
			{
				DataSource = gradientLegendItem.dataSource;
				return base.Assign(item);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]

	{

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

		internal bool Visible { get; set; }

		[Description("")]

		[Description("")]

	[NonCategorized]
	public class GradientLegendItemPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GradientControlProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GradientControl", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(GradientLegendItemPanel));

		private const double defaultSize = 300.0;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public FrameworkElement GradientControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)GetValue(GradientControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GradientControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public Orientation Orientation { get; set; }

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Width, 300.0), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Height, 300.0));
			List<GradientLegendItemData> list = new List<GradientLegendItemData>();
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.DataContext is GradientLegendItemData gradientLegendItemData)
				{
					child.Measure(availableSize2);
					gradientLegendItemData.Bounds = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), child.DesiredSize);
					list.Add(gradientLegendItemData);
				}
			}
			GradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy gradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy = GradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy.Create(Orientation);
			gradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy.CalculateLayout(list, availableSize2);
			gradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy.ProcessItemsOverlapping(list);
			if (GradientControl != null)
			{
				GradientControl.Margin = gradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy.GradientMargin;
			}
			return gradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy.TotalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in base.Children)
			{
				Rect finalRect = ((!(child.DataContext is GradientLegendItemData { Visible: not false } gradientLegendItemData)) ? new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) : gradientLegendItemData.Bounds);
				child.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class LegendItemList : List<LegendItem>, INotifyCollectionChanged, ILegendItemsCollection
	{
		private abstract class ListOperator
		{
			private readonly LegendItemList sourceList;

			protected LegendItemList SourceList => sourceList;

			protected ListOperator(LegendItemList sourceList)
			{
				this.sourceList = sourceList;
			}

			public abstract void Add(LegendItem item);

			public abstract int GetIndex(int index);

			public abstract void RemoveItems(int itemsCount);
		}

		private class StraightListOperator : ListOperator
		{
			public StraightListOperator(LegendItemList sourceList)
				: base(sourceList)
			{
			}

			public override void Add(LegendItem item)
			{
				base.SourceList.Add(item);
				base.SourceList.RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item));
			}

			public override int GetIndex(int index)
			{
				return index;
			}

			public override void RemoveItems(int itemsCount)
			{
				int num = base.SourceList.Count - 1;
				int num2 = base.SourceList.Count - itemsCount;
				for (int num3 = num; num3 >= num2; num3--)
				{
					base.SourceList.RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, base.SourceList[num3], num3));
				}
				base.SourceList.RemoveRange(num2, itemsCount);
			}
		}

		private class ReverseListOperator : ListOperator
		{
			public ReverseListOperator(LegendItemList sourceList)
				: base(sourceList)
			{
			}

			public override void Add(LegendItem item)
			{
				base.SourceList.Insert(0, item);
				base.SourceList.RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, 0));
			}

			public override int GetIndex(int index)
			{
				return base.SourceList.Count - index - 1;
			}

			public override void RemoveItems(int itemsCount)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < itemsCount; i++)
				{
					base.SourceList.RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, base.SourceList[0], 0));
					base.SourceList.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
		}

		private ListOperator listOperator;

		private bool reversed;

		int ILegendItemsCollection.Count => base.Count;

		private event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChanged;

		event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler INotifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				collectionChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				collectionChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public LegendItemList()
		{
			listOperator = CreateListOperator();
		}

		private void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.collectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.collectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		void ILegendItemsCollection.Update(IList items)
		{
			Update(items);
		}

		private ListOperator CreateListOperator()
		{
			if (reversed)
			{
				return new ReverseListOperator(this);
			}
			return new StraightListOperator(this);
		}

		internal void ReverseInternal(bool reverse)
		{
			if (reverse != reversed)
			{
				Reverse();
				reversed = reverse;
				int num = base.Count / 2;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					int num2 = base.Count - i - 1;
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, base[i], i, num2));
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, base[num2], num2, i + 1));
				}
				listOperator = CreateListOperator();
			}
		}

		internal LegendItem GetItemByIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= base.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base[listOperator.GetIndex(index)];
		}

		internal void Update(IList newItems)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < newItems.Count; i++)
			{
				LegendItem legendItem = (LegendItem)newItems[i];
				if (i >= base.Count)
				{
					listOperator.Add(legendItem);
					continue;
				}
				int index = listOperator.GetIndex(i);
				LegendItem legendItem2 = base[index];
				if (!legendItem2.Assign(legendItem))
				{
					base[index] = legendItem;
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, legendItem2, index));
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, legendItem, index));
				}
			}
			if (newItems.Count < base.Count)
			{
				listOperator.RemoveItems(base.Count - newItems.Count);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class MarkerRenderControlBase : FrameworkElement, IWeakEventListener
	{
		private System.Windows.Media.Pen pen;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush fill;

		private MarkerItem marker;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush opacityMask;

		protected MarkerItem Marker => marker;

		public MarkerRenderControlBase()
		{
			base.DataContextChanged += MarkerRenderControl_DataContextChanged;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is MarkerItem)
			{
				OnMarkerChanged();
				InvalidateVisual();
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void MarkerRenderControl_DataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, e.NewValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, this);
			marker = e.NewValue as MarkerItem;
			OnMarkerChanged();
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CloneBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush sourceBrush)
		{
			return sourceBrush?.CloneCurrentValue();
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen()
		{
			if (marker == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = CloneBrush(GetStroke());
			double penThickness = GetPenThickness();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = ((marker.MarkerLineStyle == null) ? new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, penThickness) : marker.MarkerLineStyle.CreatePen(brush, penThickness));
			pen.EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Square;
			pen.StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Square;
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		protected virtual double GetPenThickness()
		{
			return marker.ActualLineThickness;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetStroke()
		{
			return marker.ActualMarkerLineBrush;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetFill()
		{
			return marker.ActualMarkerBrush;
		}

		protected abstract void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush);

		protected virtual void OnMarkerChanged()
		{
			pen = null;
			fill = null;
			opacityMask = null;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (marker != null)
			{
				if (pen == null)
				{
					pen = CreatePen();
				}
				if (fill == null)
				{
					fill = CloneBrush(GetFill());
				}
				if (opacityMask == null)
				{
					opacityMask = Marker.OpacityMask;
				}
				drawingContext.PushOpacityMask(opacityMask);
				Render(drawingContext, pen, fill);
				drawingContext.Pop();
			}
		}
	}
	public class LineMarkerRenderControl : MarkerRenderControlBase
	{
		protected override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (pen != null)
			{
				double y = base.RenderSize.Height / 2.0;
				LineRenderer lineRenderer = new LineRenderer(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, y), new System.Windows.Point(11.0, y));
				lineRenderer.Render(drawingContext, pen);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetFill()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class RectangleMarkerRenderControl : MarkerRenderControlBase
	{
		protected const int MarkerSide = 12;

		protected void DrawRectangle(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, double penThickness, double penOffset)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(brush, pen, new Rect(penOffset, penOffset, 12.0 - penThickness, 12.0 - penThickness));
		}

		protected virtual void RenderBarMarker(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, double penThickness, double penOffset)
		{
			DrawRectangle(drawingContext, pen, brush, penThickness, penOffset);
		}

		protected override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			double thickness = pen.Thickness;
			double penOffset = thickness / 2.0;
			RenderBarMarker(drawingContext, pen, brush, thickness, penOffset);
		}
	}
	public class BarMarkerRenderControl : RectangleMarkerRenderControl
	{
	}
	public class WaterfallMarkerRenderControl : BarMarkerRenderControl
	{
		private WaterfallLegendItem LegendItem => base.Marker as WaterfallLegendItem;

		protected override void RenderBarMarker(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, double penThickness, double penOffset)
		{
			WaterfallLegendItem legendItem = LegendItem;
			if (legendItem == null || (legendItem.FallingColor == null && legendItem.RisingColor == null))
			{
				DrawRectangle(drawingContext, pen, brush, penThickness, penOffset);
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ((legendItem.RisingColor != null) ? legendItem.RisingColor : brush);
			DrawRectangle(drawingContext, pen, brush2, penThickness, penOffset);
			PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment();
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 12.0);
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(point);
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(12.0, 0.0));
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(default(System.Windows.Point));
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
			{
				IsClosed = true,
				IsFilled = true,
				StartPoint = point
			};
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			drawingContext.PushClip(pathGeometry);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush3 = ((legendItem.FallingColor != null) ? legendItem.FallingColor : brush);
			DrawRectangle(drawingContext, pen, brush3, penThickness, penOffset);
			drawingContext.Pop();
		}
	}
	public class PointMarkerRenderControl : MarkerRenderControlBase
	{
		private const double radius = 6.0;

		private const double selectedRadiusIncrement = 2.0;

		protected override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			double num = (base.Marker.GetIsSelected() ? 2.0 : 0.0);
			double num2 = 6.0 + num - pen.Thickness / 2.0;
			drawingContext.DrawEllipse(brush, pen, new System.Windows.Point(6.0, 6.0), num2, num2);
		}
	}
	public abstract class GeometryMarkerRenderControl : MarkerRenderControlBase
	{
		private StreamGeometry geometry;

		protected abstract void CreateGeometry(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext);

		protected override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (geometry == null)
			{
				geometry = new StreamGeometry();
				using StreamGeometryContext geometryContext = geometry.Open();
				CreateGeometry(geometryContext);
			}
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(brush, pen, geometry);
		}

		protected override void OnMarkerChanged()
		{
			geometry = null;
			base.OnMarkerChanged();
		}
	}
	public class AreaMarkerRenderControl : GeometryMarkerRenderControl
	{
		private readonly System.Windows.Point[] points = new System.Windows.Point[3]
		{
			new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 10.0),
			new System.Windows.Point(5.5, 3.0),
			new System.Windows.Point(11.0, 10.0)
		};

		private readonly System.Windows.Point[] selectedPoints = new System.Windows.Point[3]
		{
			new System.Windows.Point(-1.0, 10.0),
			new System.Windows.Point(6.0, 2.0),
			new System.Windows.Point(13.0, 10.0)
		};

		private System.Windows.Point[] ActualPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Marker.GetIsSelected())
				{
					return points;
				}
				return selectedPoints;
			}
		}

		private double[] CreateGuidelinesX(System.Windows.Point[] points, double penOffset)
		{
			return new double[3]
			{
				points[0].X + penOffset,
				points[1].X,
				points[2].X - penOffset
			};
		}

		private double[] CreateGuidelinesY(System.Windows.Point[] points, double penOffset)
		{
			return new double[3]
			{
				points[0].Y - penOffset,
				points[1].Y + penOffset,
				points[2].Y - penOffset
			};
		}

		protected override void CreateGeometry(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext)
		{
			System.Windows.Point[] actualPoints = ActualPoints;
			geometryContext.BeginFigure(actualPoints[0], isFilled: true, isClosed: false);
			geometryContext.PolyLineTo(actualPoints, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: false);
		}

		protected override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			double penOffset = pen.Thickness / 2.0;
			System.Windows.Point[] actualPoints = ActualPoints;
			drawingContext.PushGuidelineSet(new GuidelineSet(CreateGuidelinesX(actualPoints, penOffset), CreateGuidelinesY(actualPoints, penOffset)));
			base.Render(drawingContext, pen, brush);
			drawingContext.Pop();
		}

		protected override double GetPenThickness()
		{
			if (base.Marker.MarkerLineStyle == null)
			{
				return base.GetPenThickness();
			}
			return base.Marker.MarkerLineStyle.Thickness;
		}
	}
