	public class GridLayout : LayoutBase, IGridLayoutOptions, ILayoutOptions
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey RowDefinitionsPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ColumnDefinitionsPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowDefinitionsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnDefinitionsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowSpanProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnSpanProperty;

		private XYDiagram2D Diagram => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as XYDiagram2D;

		internal bool AsLinearLayout
		{
			get
			{
				if (RowDefinitions.Count != 1)
				{
					return ColumnDefinitions.Count == 1;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the grid pane layout’s rows.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public LayoutDefinitionCollection RowDefinitions => (LayoutDefinitionCollection)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(RowDefinitionsProperty);

		[Description("Returns the grid pane layout’s columns.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public LayoutDefinitionCollection ColumnDefinitions => (LayoutDefinitionCollection)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ColumnDefinitionsProperty);

		LayoutDirectionNative ILayoutOptions.Direction
		{
			get
			{
				if (RowDefinitions.Count == 1)
				{
					return LayoutDirectionNative.Horizontal;
				}
				if (ColumnDefinitions.Count == 1)
				{
					return LayoutDirectionNative.Vertical;
				}
				if (Diagram == null)
				{
					return LayoutDirectionNative.Vertical;
				}
				return ((ILayoutOptions)Diagram).Direction;
			}
		}

		IList<ILinearLayoutItem> IGridLayoutOptions.RowDefinitions
		{
			get
			{
				List<ILinearLayoutItem> list = new List<ILinearLayoutItem>();
				if (RowDefinitions != null)
				{
					foreach (LayoutDefinition rowDefinition in RowDefinitions)
					{
						list.Add(rowDefinition);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		IList<ILinearLayoutItem> IGridLayoutOptions.ColumnDefinitions
		{
			get
			{
				List<ILinearLayoutItem> list = new List<ILinearLayoutItem>();
				if (ColumnDefinitions != null)
				{
					foreach (LayoutDefinition columnDefinition in ColumnDefinitions)
					{
						list.Add(columnDefinition);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private static bool RowAndColumnValidation(object value)
		{
			return (int)value >= -1;
		}

		private static bool RowSpanAndColumnSpanValidation(object value)
		{
			return (int)value > 0;
		}

		static GridLayout()
		{
			RowDefinitionsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("RowDefinitions", typeof(LayoutDefinitionCollection), typeof(GridLayout), new PropertyMetadata());
			ColumnDefinitionsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ColumnDefinitions", typeof(LayoutDefinitionCollection), typeof(GridLayout), new PropertyMetadata());
			RowDefinitionsProperty = RowDefinitionsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ColumnDefinitionsProperty = ColumnDefinitionsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			RowProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Row", typeof(int), typeof(GridLayout), new PropertyMetadata(-1), (ValidateValueCallback)RowAndColumnValidation);
			ColumnProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Column", typeof(int), typeof(GridLayout), new PropertyMetadata(-1), (ValidateValueCallback)RowAndColumnValidation);
			RowSpanProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("RowSpan", typeof(int), typeof(GridLayout), new PropertyMetadata(1), (ValidateValueCallback)RowSpanAndColumnSpanValidation);
			ColumnSpanProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ColumnSpan", typeof(int), typeof(GridLayout), new PropertyMetadata(1), (ValidateValueCallback)RowSpanAndColumnSpanValidation);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(RowProperty.OwnerType);
		}

		public GridLayout()
		{
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(RowDefinitionsPropertyKey, (object)ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<LayoutDefinitionCollection>(this));
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ColumnDefinitionsPropertyKey, (object)ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<LayoutDefinitionCollection>(this));
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static int GetRow(Pane pane)
		{
			return (int)pane.GetValue(RowProperty);
		}

		}

		{
			pane.SetValue(ColumnProperty, column);
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static int GetRowSpan(Pane pane)
		{
			return (int)pane.GetValue(RowSpanProperty);
		}

		public static void SetRowSpan(Pane pane, int rowSpan)
		{
			pane.SetValue(RowSpanProperty, rowSpan);

	public enum ProcessEmptyPointsMode
	{
		InsertZero,
		Interpolate,
		Ignore
	}
	public class EmptyPointOptions : ChartDependencyObject, IEmptyPointColorizer
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ProcessPointsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ProcessPoints", typeof(ProcessEmptyPointsMode), typeof(EmptyPointOptions), new PropertyMetadata(ProcessEmptyPointsMode.InsertZero, FilterPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BrushProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Brush", typeof(SolidColorBrush), typeof(EmptyPointOptions), new PropertyMetadata(null, BrushPropertyChanged));

		private int? color;

		internal bool Enabled => color.HasValue;

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color? ActualColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (color.HasValue)
				{
					return ColorUtils.ConvertFromArgb(color.Value);
				}
				return null;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (value.HasValue)
				{
					color = ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(value.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					color = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal EmptyPointProcessingMode ActualProcessingMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (Enabled || ProcessPoints == ProcessEmptyPointsMode.Ignore)
				{
					return (EmptyPointProcessingMode)ProcessPoints;
				}
				return EmptyPointProcessingMode.NoAction;
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies how the chart control handles empty series points.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ProcessEmptyPointsMode ProcessPoints
		{
			get
			{
				return (ProcessEmptyPointsMode)GetValue(ProcessPointsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ProcessPointsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the brush that is used to paint empty points.")]
		[Category("Brushes")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SolidColorBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return (SolidColorBrush)GetValue(BrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		int? IEmptyPointColorizer.Color => color;

		private static void BrushPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is EmptyPointOptions emptyPointOptions)
			{
				emptyPointOptions.ActualColor = ((SolidColorBrush)e.NewValue)?.Color;
				FilterPropertyChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void FilterPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is EmptyPointOptions emptyPointOptions)
			{
				emptyPointOptions.NotifyPropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new EmptyPointOptions();
		}
	}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return ProcessWeakEvent(sender, e);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.Changed(args);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			if (oldOwner != null)
			{
				((IOwnedElement)WorkTimeRules).Owner = null;
				foreach (WorkTimeRule workTimeRule in WorkTimeRules)
				{
					((IOwnedElement)workTimeRule.WorkIntervals).Owner = null;
				}
				oldOwner.RemoveChild(this);
			}
			owner = newOwner;
			if (newOwner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			newOwner.AddChild(this);
			((IOwnedElement)WorkTimeRules).Owner = newOwner;
			foreach (WorkTimeRule workTimeRule2 in WorkTimeRules)
			{
				((IOwnedElement)workTimeRule2.WorkIntervals).Owner = newOwner;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessWeakEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is WorkdaysOptions)
			{
				if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs e2)
				{
					NotifyPropertyChanged(e2.PropertyName);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual DateTimeMeasureUnitNative CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetAutoGrid(double customGridSpacing)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetGridAlignment(DateTimeGridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
		}
	}

	public enum ScaleMode
	{
		Automatic,
		Manual,
		Continuous
	}
	public enum IntervalDivisionMode
	{
		Auto = 0,
		Count = 2,
		Width = 1
	}
	public enum GridLayoutMode
	{
		GridAndLabelCentered,
		GridShiftedLabelCentered,
		GridAndLabelShifted
	}
	public enum ProcessMissingPointsMode
	{
		Skip,
		InsertZeroValues,
		InsertEmptyPoints
	}
	public abstract class CustomAggregateFunction : ICustomAggregateFunction
	{
		double[] ICustomAggregateFunction.Calculate(object nativeArgument, IEnumerable<double> values1, IEnumerable<double> values2, IEnumerable<double> values3, IEnumerable<double> values4)
		{
			return Calculate(new GroupInfo(nativeArgument, values1, values2, values3, values4));
		}

		public abstract double[] Calculate(GroupInfo groupInfo);
	}
	public sealed class GroupInfo
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values1;

		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values2;

		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values3;

		private readonly IEnumerable<double> values4;

		private readonly object nativeArgument;

		public object Argument => nativeArgument;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values1 => values1;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values2 => values2;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values3 => values3;

		public IEnumerable<double> Values4 => values4;

		internal GroupInfo(object nativeArgument, IEnumerable<double> values1, IEnumerable<double> values2, IEnumerable<double> values3, IEnumerable<double> values4)
		{
			this.nativeArgument = nativeArgument;
			this.values1 = values1;
			this.values2 = values2;
			this.values3 = values3;
			this.values4 = values4;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ScaleOptionsBase : ChartDependencyObject
	{
		protected const ProcessMissingPointsMode DefaultProcessMissingPointsMode = ProcessMissingPointsMode.Skip;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinGridSpacingLengthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinGridSpacingLength", typeof(int?), typeof(ScaleOptionsBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, MinGridSpacingLengthPropertyChanged, CoerceMinGridSpacingLength));

		internal bool IsShiftedGridImpl => false;

		protected internal virtual bool IsIntervalScale => false;

		protected internal abstract ScaleModeNative ScaleModeImp { get; }

		protected internal abstract ProcessMissingPointsMode ActualProcessMissingPoints { get; }

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("Gets or sets the minimum allowed distance between two neighbor major tick marks and grid lines that affect an automatically calculated grid.")]
		public int? MinGridSpacingLength
		{
			get
			{
				return (int?)GetValue(MinGridSpacingLengthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinGridSpacingLengthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void MinGridSpacingLengthPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase)
			{
				scaleOptionsBase.NotifyPropertyChanged("MinGridSpacingLength");
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceMinGridSpacingLength(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			int? num = (int?)baseValue;
			return (!num.HasValue) ? ((int?)null) : ((num.Value > 0) ? num : new int?(0));
		}

		protected static void MeasureUnitsCalculatorPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase)
			{
				scaleOptionsBase.NotifyPropertyChanged("AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator");
			}
		}

		protected static void ProcessMissingPointsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase)
			{
				scaleOptionsBase.NotifyPropertyChanged("ProcessMissingPoints");
			}
		}

		internal static ValueChangeInfo<D> CreateInfo<D>(D value)
		{
			return new ValueChangeInfo<D>(value);
		}

		internal static ValueChangeInfo<D> CreateInfo<D>(D oldValue, D newValue)
		{
			return new ValueChangeInfo<D>(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		internal static ValueChangeInfo<D> GetInfo<D>(ValueChangeInfo<D> info, D currentValue)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				return new ValueChangeInfo<D>(currentValue);
			}
			return info;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<Series> EnumerateSeries(IEnumerable<ISeries> sourceSeries)
		{
			foreach (ISeries item in sourceSeries)
			{
				yield return (Series)item;
			}
		}
	}

	public enum Weekday
	{
		None = 0,

	[TypeConverter(typeof(DateTimeCollectionTypeConverter))]
	public class DateTimeCollection : ObservableCollection<DateTime>
	{
		public static DateTimeCollection Parse(string source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection = new DateTimeCollection();
			try
			{
				string[] array = source.Split(',', ' ');
				foreach (string s in array)
				{
					dateTimeCollection.Add(DateTime.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				return dateTimeCollection;
			}
			catch
			{
				throw new FormatException("Incorrect DateTimeCollection string format");
			}
		}

		public DateTimeCollection()
		{
		}

		public DateTimeCollection(IEnumerable<DateTime> collection)
		{
			foreach (DateTime item in collection)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		public string ToString(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			using (IEnumerator<DateTime> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string text2 = enumerator.Current.Date.ToString("d", provider);
					text = text + text2 + " ";
				}
			}
			return text.TrimEnd(' ');
		}
	}
	public class DateTimeCollectionTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string)
			{
				string text = value as string;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return DateTimeCollection.Parse(text);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType != null && destinationType == typeof(string) && value != null)
			{
				if (value is DateTimeCollection)
				{
					return ((DateTimeCollection)value).ToString(culture);
				}
				if (value is IEnumerable<DateTime>)
				{
					DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection = new DateTimeCollection();
					foreach (DateTime item in (IEnumerable<DateTime>)value)
					{
						dateTimeCollection.Add(item);
					}
					return dateTimeCollection.ToString(culture);
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

		public void LoadHolidays(string fileName, string location)
		{
			HolidayBaseCollection val = HolidaysLoader.LoadHolidaysCollection(fileName, string.Empty, string.Empty);
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection = new DateTimeCollection();
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(location))
				{
					foreach (Holiday item in (DXCollectionBase<Holiday>)(object)val)
					{
						dateTimeCollection.Add(((KnownDateDay)item).Date);
					}
					return;
				}
				foreach (Holiday item2 in (DXCollectionBase<Holiday>)(object)val)
				{
					if (item2.Location == location)
					{
						dateTimeCollection.Add(((KnownDateDay)item2).Date);
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				dateTimeCollection.Clear();
			}
			finally
			{
				SetValue(HolidaysProperty, (dateTimeCollection.Count > 0) ? dateTimeCollection : null);
			}
		}

		public void LoadHolidays(string fileName)
		{
			LoadHolidays(fileName, string.Empty);
		}
	}

	public class TimeIntervalCollection : ChartElementCollection<TimeInterval>
	{
		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				foreach (TimeInterval newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, newItem, base.Owner as IWeakEventListener);
				}
			}
			else if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				foreach (TimeInterval oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(oldItem, null, base.Owner as IWeakEventListener);
				}
			}
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}
	}

		protected internal abstract ColorCollection ActualColors { get; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count < 1 || index < 0)
				{
					return Colors.Transparent;
				}
				if (!ColorCycleLength.HasValue || ColorCycleLength == Count)
				{
					return ActualColors[index % ActualColors.Count];
				}
				if (ColorCycleLength.Value > Count)
				{
					return ConvertColor(ActualColors[index % ActualColors.Count], index % ColorCycleLength.Value, ColorCycleLength.Value);
				}
				return ActualColors[index % ColorCycleLength.Value];
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the number of colors in the palette.")]
		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualColors == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return ActualColors.Count;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the name of the chart palette.")]
		public virtual string PaletteName => null;

		[Description("Gets or sets the count of different colors that the palette provides.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int? ColorCycleLength { get; set; }

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color ConvertColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color, int cycleIndex, int cycleCount)
		{
			ColorHSL colorHSL = (ColorHSL)color;
			float num = (float)(cycleCount - 1) / (float)cycleCount;
			float num2 = colorHSL.Luminance - num * 0.5f;
			if (num2 < colorHSL.MinLuminance)
			{
				num2 = colorHSL.MinLuminance;
			}
			float num3 = colorHSL.Luminance + num * 0.5f;
			if (num3 > colorHSL.MaxLuminance)
			{
				num3 = colorHSL.MaxLuminance;
			}
			float num4 = (float)(cycleCount - 1) / 2f;
			float num5 = (float)cycleIndex - num4;
			if (num5 < 0f)
			{
				colorHSL.Luminance -= (num2 - colorHSL.Luminance) * (num5 / num4);
			}
			else
			{
				colorHSL.Luminance += (num3 - colorHSL.Luminance) * (num5 / num4);
			}
			return (System.Windows.Media.Color)colorHSL;
		}

		protected void OnColorsChanged()
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged("Colors");
		}

		protected bool ConvertToColor(object sourceItem, out object color)
		{
			color = null;
			if (sourceItem is System.Windows.Media.Color)
			{
				color = (System.Windows.Media.Color)sourceItem;
				return true;
			}
			if (sourceItem is string)
			{
				try
				{
					color = (System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString((string)sourceItem);
					return true;
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class PredefinedIndicatorsPalette : IndicatorsPalette
	{
		private readonly ColorCollection predefinedColors = new ColorCollection();

		protected internal override ColorCollection ActualColors => predefinedColors;

		private PredefinedIndicatorsPalette()
		{

		protected PredefinedIndicatorsPalette(System.Windows.Media.Color[] colors)
		{
			foreach (System.Windows.Media.Color item in colors)

		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()

		{
			if (values.Length < 5)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Five ore more values are expected.", "values");
			}
			Min = values[0];
			Quartile1 = values[1];
			Median = values[2];
			Quartile3 = values[3];
			Max = values[4];
			if (values.Length > 5)
			{
				Mean = values[5];
				if (values.Length > 6)
				{
					int num = values.Length - 6;
					double[] destinationArray = new double[num];
					Array.Copy(values, 6, destinationArray, 0, num);
					Outliers = destinationArray;
				}
			}
		}

			Quartile1 = quartile1;
			Median = median;
			Quartile3 = quartile3;
			Max = max;
			Mean = mean;
			Outliers = outliers;
		}

		public BoxPlotNumericValues()
		{
		}

		public double[] GetValues()
		{
			int num = ((Outliers != null) ? Outliers.Length : 0);
			double[] array = new double[6 + num];
			array[0] = Min;
			array[1] = Quartile1;
			array[2] = Median;
			array[3] = Quartile3;
			array[4] = Max;
			array[5] = Mean;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 6;
			while (num2 < num)
			{
				array[num3] = Outliers[num2];
				num2++;
				num3++;
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

	public class BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		private Matrix matrix;

		public override Rect Bounds { get; }

		public bool AnimationInProgress { get; private set; }

		protected override Matrix Matrix => matrix;

		public Rect Box { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point TopCapPoint1 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point TopCapPoint2 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point TopCapMiddle { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point BoxTopMiddle { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point BoxBottomMiddle { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point BottomCapMiddle { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point BottomCapPoint1 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point BottomCapPoint2 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point MedianPoint1 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point MedianPoint2 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point Mean { get; }

		public List<System.Windows.Point> Outliers { get; }

		internal BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout(BoxPlotSeries2D series, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, PaneMappingBase mapping)
			: base(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, mapping.Viewport.Width, mapping.Viewport.Height))
		{
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			IAxisMappingCore axisXMapping = mapping.AxisXMapping;
			double num = ((IArgumentPoint)refinedPoint).Argument + ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).Offset;
			double num2 = ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).FixedOffset;
			if (series.IsAxisXReversed)
			{
				num2 = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			double num3 = axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(num) + num2;
			double num4 = 0.5 * ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).BarWidth;
			double num5 = axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(num - num4) + num2;
			double num6 = axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(num + num4) + num2;
			IAxisMappingCore axisYMapping = mapping.AxisYMapping;
			double axisValue = axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Max);
			double axisValue2 = axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Min);
			double axisValue3 = axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Quartile1);
			double axisValue4 = axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Quartile3);
			double axisValue5 = axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Median);
			double y = ((((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Mean != double.NaN) ? axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Mean) : double.NaN);
			double num7 = double.MinValue;
			double num8 = double.MaxValue;
			if (((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Outliers != null)
			{
				Outliers = new List<System.Windows.Point>(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Outliers.Length);
				double[] outliers = ((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint).Outliers;
				foreach (double value in outliers)
				{
					double axisValue6 = axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(value);
					if (MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(axisValue6))
					{
						Outliers.Add(new System.Windows.Point(num3, axisValue6));
						if (axisValue6 > num7)
						{
							num7 = axisValue6;
						}
						if (axisValue6 < num8)
						{
							num8 = axisValue6;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			double y2 = Math.Max(axisValue, num7);
			double y3 = Math.Min(axisValue2, num8);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(num5, y2);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(num6, y3);
			double num9 = series.CapWidthPercentage / 100.0;
			double num10 = (num6 - num5) * num9 / 2.0;
			double x = num3 - num10;
			double x2 = num3 + num10;
			Bounds = new Rect(point, point2);
			Box = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num5, axisValue4), new System.Windows.Point(num6, axisValue3));
			TopCapPoint1 = new System.Windows.Point(x, axisValue);
			TopCapPoint2 = new System.Windows.Point(x2, axisValue);
			TopCapMiddle = new System.Windows.Point(num3, axisValue);
			BoxTopMiddle = new System.Windows.Point(num3, axisValue4);
			BoxBottomMiddle = new System.Windows.Point(num3, axisValue3);
			BottomCapMiddle = new System.Windows.Point(num3, axisValue2);
			BottomCapPoint1 = new System.Windows.Point(x, axisValue2);
			BottomCapPoint2 = new System.Windows.Point(x2, axisValue2);
			MedianPoint1 = new System.Windows.Point(num5, axisValue5);
			MedianPoint2 = new System.Windows.Point(num6, axisValue5);
			Mean = new System.Windows.Point(num3, y);
		}

		public void SetTransformMatrix(Matrix matrix)
		{
			this.matrix = matrix;
			AnimationInProgress = !matrix.IsIdentity;
		}
	}
	public class NumericalOutliersTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			string text = (string)value;
			string[] array = text.Split(',');
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				string s = text2.Trim();
				if (double.TryParse(s, out var result))
				{
					list.Add(result);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

		private static void OnValueOptionsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			WaterfallSeries2D waterfallSeries2D = null;
			foreach (Series item in xYDiagram2D.Series)
			{
				if (item is WaterfallSeries2D waterfallSeries2D2)
				{
					CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as WaterfallValueOptionsBase, e.NewValue as WaterfallValueOptionsBase, waterfallSeries2D2);
					RaiseValueOptionsChanged(waterfallSeries2D2);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RaiseValueOptionsChanged(DependencyObject d)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "ValueOptions"));
		}

		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d);
		}

		private SolidColorBrush GetActualTotalBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)

		private System.Windows.Point GetLabelAnchorPoint(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool isMultipleWaterfallSeries, Bar2D bar, out bool isLabelOutside)
		{
			isLabelOutside = false;
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = labelItem.PointItem.RefinedPoint;
			double x = ((GetDisplayOffset(refinedPoint) == 0.0) ? (mapping.AxisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(GetArgument(refinedPoint)) + (double)GetFixedOffset(refinedPoint)) : ((bar.Left + bar.Right) / 2.0));
			double num = Math.Min(bar.Top, bar.Bottom);
			double num2 = Math.Max(bar.Top, bar.Bottom);
			bool flag = IsDownwardBar(refinedPoint);
			double num3 = labelItem.LabelSize.Height / 2.0;
			switch (GetLabelPosition(base.ActualLabel))
			{
			case WaterfallLabelPosition.InsideStart:
				return new System.Windows.Point(x, flag ? (num2 - num3 - (double)base.ActualLabel.Indent) : (num + num3 + (double)base.ActualLabel.Indent));
			case WaterfallLabelPosition.InsideEnd:
				return new System.Windows.Point(x, flag ? (num + num3 + (double)base.ActualLabel.Indent) : (num2 - num3 - (double)base.ActualLabel.Indent));
			case WaterfallLabelPosition.Center:
				return new System.Windows.Point(x, num + (num2 - num) / 2.0);
			default:
				if (isMultipleWaterfallSeries)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Point(x, num + (num2 - num) / 2.0);
				}
				isLabelOutside = true;
				return CalculateOutsideAnchorPoint(labelItem, transform, x, num, num2, flag);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CalculateOutsideAnchorPoint(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, Transform transform, double x, double minY, double maxY, bool isDownBar)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(x, isDownBar ? minY : maxY);
			if (labelItem.PointItem.Model != null)
			{
				point = labelItem.PointItem.Model.CorrectOutsideLabelLocation(point, isDownBar);
			}
			return transform.Transform(point);
		}

		private bool ObtainIsMultipleWaterfallSeries()
		{
			foreach (SeriesContainerItem seriesContainer in ((Pane)ActualPane).SeriesContainers)
			{
				if (seriesContainer.Series.Contains(this))
				{
					return seriesContainer.Series.Count > 1;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			if (base.IsZeroValuePoint(point))
			{
				return !((IWaterfallPoint)point).IsSubTotal;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsDownwardBarCore(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (!((IWaterfallPoint)refinedPoint).IsSubTotal)
			{
				return ((IWaterfallPoint)refinedPoint).RelativeValue < 0.0;
			}
			return ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint).MaxValue < 0.0;
		}

		protected override LegendItem CreateLegendItem(Legend legend, object sourceElement, string text, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerLineBrush, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (IsSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return new WaterfallLegendItem(legend, this, sourceElement, text, markerBrush, markerLineBrush, LegendMarkerLineStyle, SupportedLegendMarkerSelectionType, isSelected, null, null);
			}
			return new WaterfallLegendItem(legend, this, sourceElement, text, markerBrush, markerLineBrush, LegendMarkerLineStyle, SupportedLegendMarkerSelectionType, isSelected, FallingBarBrush, RisingBarBrush);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)

			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ModelProperty);
			properties.Add(FallingBarBrushProperty);
			properties.Add(RisingBarBrushProperty);
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			if (labelItem.RefinedPoint == null || (IsZeroValuePoint(labelItem.RefinedPoint) && !BarSeries2D.GetShowZeroValueLabels(base.ActualLabel)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Bar2D? bar2D = CalculateBar(mapping, labelItem.PointItem.RefinedPoint, isLabelInCenter: true);
			if (!bar2D.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool isLabelOutside;
			System.Windows.Point labelAnchorPoint = GetLabelAnchorPoint(labelItem, mapping, transform, ObtainIsMultipleWaterfallSeries(), bar2D.Value, out isLabelOutside);
			XYSeriesLabel2DLayout xYSeriesLabel2DLayout = CalculateSeriesLabelLayoutCore(labelItem, mapping, transform, !isLabelOutside, bar2D.Value.Bounds, labelAnchorPoint);
			if (xYSeriesLabel2DLayout != null)
			{
				labelItem.ShowConnector = base.ActualLabel.ConnectorVisible && isLabelOutside;
			}
			return xYSeriesLabel2DLayout;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<LegendItem> CreateLegendItems(Legend legend, System.Windows.Media.Color color, string text, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (!IsSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				foreach (LegendItem item in base.CreateLegendItems(legend, color, text, isSelected))
				{
					yield return item;
				}
				yield break;
			}
			if (FallingBarBrush != null)
			{
				yield return CreateLegendItem(ActualChartLegend, this, FallingBarBrush.Color, "Decrease", isSelected);
			}
			if (RisingBarBrush != null)
			{
				yield return CreateLegendItem(ActualChartLegend, this, RisingBarBrush.Color, "Increase", isSelected);
			}
			SolidColorBrush subtotalBarBrush = GetSubtotalBarBrush((XYDiagram2D)Diagram);
			if (subtotalBarBrush != null)
			{
				yield return CreateLegendItem(ActualChartLegend, this, subtotalBarBrush.Color, "Total", isSelected);
			}
		}

		}

				PointDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.0)

		{
			return Model;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldFlipNegativeBar(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Color GetPointOriginalColorForCustomDraw(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, int pointIndex, System.Windows.Media.Color seriesColor, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = null;
			if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D diagram)
			{
				IWaterfallPoint waterfallPoint = points[pointIndex];
				if (waterfallPoint.IsSubTotal)
				{
					WaterfallValueOptionsBase valueOptions = GetValueOptions(diagram);
					solidColorBrush = ((valueOptions != null && valueOptions.IsSpreadsheetChart) ? GetActualTotalBrush(GetSubtotalBarBrush(diagram)) : ((pointIndex != 0) ? ((pointIndex == points.Count - 1) ? GetActualTotalBrush(GetTotalBarBrush(diagram)) : GetActualTotalBrush(GetSubtotalBarBrush(diagram))) : GetActualTotalBrush(GetStartBarBrush(diagram))));
				}
				else
				{
					solidColorBrush = ((waterfallPoint.RelativeValue > 0.0) ? RisingBarBrush : FallingBarBrush);
				}
			}
			return solidColorBrush?.Color ?? base.GetPointOriginalColorForCustomDraw(refinedSeries, pointIndex, seriesColor, points);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesInteractionRendererBase CreateInteractionRenderer()
		{
			return new WaterfallSeriesInteractionRenderer();
		}

		bool IWaterfallSeriesView.IsSubtotalPoint(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (!IsSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return point?.Tag is WaterfallPointType;
			}
			return base.ActualPoints.IndexOf((IDataPoint)point) < 0;
		}

		ISeriesPoint IWaterfallSeriesView.CreateSubtotalPoint(ISeries series, string argument, double value, int? colorCore, object tag)
		{
			object tag2 = (IsSpreadsheetChart ? tag : ((object)(WaterfallPointType)tag));
			if (colorCore.HasValue)
			{
				return new LightSeriesPoint((Series)series, argument, new object[1] { value }, tag2, null, ColorUtils.ConvertFromArgb(colorCore.Value));
			}
			return new LightSeriesPoint((Series)series, argument, new object[1] { value }, tag2, null, null);
		}
	}
	public enum WaterfallPointType
	{
		Start,
		Subtotal,
		Total
	}
	[ContentProperty("Subtotals")]
	public abstract class WaterfallValueOptionsBase : ChartDependencyObject, IWaterfallValueOptions, IWeakEventListener
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey SubtotalsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Subtotals", typeof(SubtotalCollection), typeof(WaterfallValueOptionsBase), new PropertyMetadata());

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SubtotalsProperty = SubtotalsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowTotalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowTotal", typeof(bool), typeof(WaterfallValueOptionsBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TotalLabelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TotalLabel", typeof(string), typeof(WaterfallValueOptionsBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata("Total", OnPropertyChanged));

		private List<ISubtotal> sortedPositiveSubtotals;

		private bool isSpreadsheetChart;

		internal bool IsSpreadsheetChart => isSpreadsheetChart;

		[Description("Gets or sets the waterfall total bar’s string label that is used in the axis label and crosshair.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TotalLabel
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(TotalLabelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TotalLabelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether to show the total bar.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowTotal
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowTotalProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowTotalProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns a collection of waterfall chart subtotals.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SubtotalCollection Subtotals => (SubtotalCollection)GetValue(SubtotalsProperty);

		protected virtual double StartBarValueCore => 0.0;

		protected virtual string StartBarLabelCore => string.Empty;

		double IWaterfallValueOptions.StartValue => StartBarValueCore;

		string IWaterfallValueOptions.StartLabel => StartBarLabelCore;

		IList<ISubtotal> IWaterfallValueOptions.SortedSubtotals
		{
			get
			{
				if (sortedPositiveSubtotals == null)
				{
					sortedPositiveSubtotals = new List<ISubtotal>();
					foreach (Subtotal subtotal in Subtotals)
					{
						if (subtotal.PointIndex > 0 || isSpreadsheetChart)
						{
							sortedPositiveSubtotals.Add(subtotal);
						}
					}
					sortedPositiveSubtotals.Sort((ISubtotal s1, ISubtotal s2) => s1.PointIndex.CompareTo(s2.PointIndex));
				}
				return sortedPositiveSubtotals;
			}
		}

		string IWaterfallValueOptions.TotalLabel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShowTotal || isSpreadsheetChart)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return TotalLabel;
			}
		}

		bool IWaterfallValueOptions.ShouldUpdateScaleMap => !isSpreadsheetChart;

		protected static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is WaterfallValueOptionsBase waterfallValueOptionsBase)
			{
				waterfallValueOptionsBase.NotifyPropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
			}
		}

		WaterfallPointInteraction IWaterfallValueOptions.CreatePointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (isSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return new WaterfallXCelPointInteraction(series, seriesIndex, point);
			}
			return CreatePointInteractionCore(series, seriesIndex, point);
		}

		WaterfallFilterBehavior IWaterfallValueOptions.CreateFilterBehavior(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (isSpreadsheetChart)
			{
				return new XCelWaterfallFilterBehavior(refinedSeries);
			}
			return new WaterfallFilterBehavior(refinedSeries);
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && (sender is SubtotalCollection || sender is Subtotal))
			{
				sortedPositiveSubtotals = null;
				NotifyPropertyChanged("Subtotals");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected WaterfallValueOptionsBase()
		{
			SubtotalCollection subtotalCollection = new SubtotalCollection();
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, subtotalCollection, this);
			SetValue(SubtotalsPropertyKey, subtotalCollection);
		}

		protected abstract WaterfallPointInteraction CreatePointInteractionCore(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point);

		internal void SetIsSpreadsheetChart()
		{
			isSpreadsheetChart = true;
		}
	}

	public class SubtotalCollection : ObservableCollection<Subtotal>, IWeakEventListener
	{
		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is Subtotal)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Items"));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, Subtotal item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, item, this);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, Subtotal item)
		{
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, item, this);
		}
	}

		public int PointIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return pointIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pointIndex != value)
				{
					pointIndex = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("PointIndex");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("A waterfall subtotal.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Label
		{
			get
			{
				return label;
			}
			set

				if (!(label == value))
				{
					label = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("Label");
				}
			}
		}

		{

			get

				string defaultFormat = GetDefaultFormat(base.ValueScaleType);
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append(PatternUtils.GetDefaultArgumentPattern(defaultArgumentFormat));
				stringBuilder.Append("\nMin: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("BP_MIN");
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultFormat);
				stringBuilder.Append("}\nQ1: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("BP_MIN");
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultFormat);
				stringBuilder.Append("}\nMedian: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("BP_MDN");
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultFormat);
				stringBuilder.Append("}\nQ3: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("BP_Q3");
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultFormat);
				stringBuilder.Append("}\nMax: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("BP_MAX");
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultFormat);
				stringBuilder.Append("}\nMean: {");
				stringBuilder.Append("BP_AVG");
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultFormat);
				stringBuilder.Append("}");

		private static void ValuesPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SeriesPoint listener = d as SeriesPoint;
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as BoxPlotValuesBase, e.NewValue as BoxPlotValuesBase, listener);
			SeriesPoint.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static bool BoxWidthValidation(object barWidth)
		{
			return (double)barWidth > 0.0;
		}

		private static void BoxWidthPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series && !series.UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "BoxWidth"));
			}
		}

		private static void LineStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BoxPlotSeries2D boxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				if (e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
				{
					LineStyle newValue = ((!(e.NewValue is LineStyle lineStyle)) ? boxPlotSeries2D.CreateDefaultLineStyle() : lineStyle);
					boxPlotSeries2D.SetActualLineStyle(e.OldValue as LineStyle, newValue);
				}
				boxPlotSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e);
			}
		}

		private static void ActualLineStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BoxPlotSeries2D boxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				boxPlotSeries2D.UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				boxPlotSeries2D.UpdateLegendItems();
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]

		{

		}

		public static void SetValues(SeriesPoint point, BoxPlotValuesBase values)
		{
			point.SetValue(ValuesProperty, values);
		}

		static BoxPlotSeries2D()
		{
			BoxWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BoxWidth", typeof(double), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.6, BoxWidthPropertyChanged), BoxWidthValidation);
			PointAnimationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PointAnimation", typeof(BoxPlot2DAnimationBase), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.PointAnimationPropertyChanged));
			ModelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Model", typeof(BoxPlot2DModel), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged));
			CapWidthPercentageProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CapWidthPercentage", typeof(double), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(50.0, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			ValuesProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Values", typeof(BoxPlotValuesBase), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ValuesPropertyChanged));
			MinValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			Quartile1ValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Quartile1ValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			MedianValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MedianValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			Quartile3ValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Quartile3ValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			MaxValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			MeanValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MeanValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			OutlierValuesDataMemberProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("OutlierValuesDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			MeanLineVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MeanLineVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			MeanLineStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MeanLineStyle", typeof(LineStyle), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(LineStyleChanged));
			ActualMeanLineStylePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualMeanLineStyle", typeof(LineStyle), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(ActualLineStyleChanged));
			ActualMeanLineStyleProperty = ActualMeanLineStylePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ActualMeanLineThicknessPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualMeanLineThickness", typeof(int), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata());
			ActualMeanLineThicknessProperty = ActualMeanLineThicknessPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SeriesAnimationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesAnimation", typeof(Line2DAnimationBase), typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.SeriesAnimationPropertyChanged));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(ValuesProperty);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(typeof(BoxPlotValuesBase));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(typeof(BoxPlotNumericValues));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(typeof(BoxPlotTimeSpanValues));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(typeof(BoxPlotDateTimeValues));
		}

		public BoxPlotSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BoxPlotSeries2D>(this);
			SetValue(ModelProperty, new SimpleBoxPlot2DModel());
			SetActualLineStyle(null, CreateDefaultLineStyle());
		}

		GeometryStripCreator IGeometryHolder.CreateStripCreator()
		{
			if (!MeanLineVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MeanLineGeometryStripCreator();
		}

		private LineStyle CreateDefaultLineStyle()
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle = new LineStyle();
			lineStyle.Thickness = 1;
			lineStyle.LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Miter;
			return lineStyle;
		}

		private void SetActualLineStyle(LineStyle oldValue, LineStyle newValue)
		{
			SetValue(ActualMeanLineStylePropertyKey, newValue);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(oldValue, newValue, this);
			UpdateActualLineThickness();
		}

		private void UpdateActualLineThickness()
		{
			bool inInteractiveState = ((IInteractiveElement)this).IsSelected || ((IInteractiveElement)this).IsHighlighted;
			SetValue(ActualMeanLineThicknessPropertyKey, VisualSelectionHelper.GetLineThickness(ActualMeanLineStyle.Thickness, inInteractiveState));
		}

		protected override Transform CreateSeriesAnimationTransform(IMapping mapping)
		{
			if (GetActualSeriesAnimation() is Line2DAnimationBase line2DAnimationBase)
			{
				return line2DAnimationBase.CreateAnimatedTransformation(mapping.Viewport, mapping.GetDiagramOriginPoint(), IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, mapping.Rotated, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesAnimationBase CreateDefaultSeriesAnimation()
		{
			return new Line2DUnwindAnimation();
		}

		public override SeriesAnimationBase GetSeriesAnimation()
		{
			return SeriesAnimation;
		}

		public override void SetSeriesAnimation(SeriesAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is Line2DAnimationBase)
			{
				SeriesAnimation = value as Line2DAnimationBase;
			}
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is LineStyle)
			{
				UpdateActualLineThickness();
				UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool isSelected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(isSelected);
			UpdateActualLineThickness();
		}

		protected override void OnIsHighlightedChanged()
		{
			base.OnIsHighlightedChanged();
			UpdateActualLineThickness();
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BoxPlotSeries2D();
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return new BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout(this, pointItem.RefinedPoint, mapping);
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return CreatePointItemLayout(mapping, pointItem);
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			IEnumerable<Type> enumerable = from t in typeof(BoxPlot2DAnimationBase).Assembly.GetTypes()
				where t.IsSubclassOf(typeof(BoxPlot2DAnimationBase)) && !t.IsAbstract
				select t;
			foreach (Type item in enumerable)
			{
				animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(item));
			}
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromLeftAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromRightAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromTopAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromBottomAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DUnwrapVerticallyAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DUnwrapHorizontallyAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DBlowUpAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DStretchFromNearAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DStretchFromFarAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DUnwindAnimation)));
			base.FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(animationKinds);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double val = double.MaxValue;
			if (((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers != null)
			{
				val = ((((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Length != 0) ? ((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Min() : double.MaxValue);
			}
			return Math.Min(((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Min, val);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double val = double.MinValue;
			if (((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers != null)
			{
				val = ((((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Length != 0) ? ((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers.Max() : double.MinValue);
			}
			return Math.Max(((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Max, val);
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override IList<string> GetValueDataMembers()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(7);
			list.Add(MinValueDataMember);
			list.Add(Quartile1ValueDataMember);
			list.Add(MedianValueDataMember);
			list.Add(Quartile3ValueDataMember);
			list.Add(MaxValueDataMember);
			list.Add(MeanValueDataMember);
			list.Add(OutlierValuesDataMember);
			return list;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(CapWidthPercentageProperty);
			properties.Add(BoxWidthProperty);
			properties.Add(MinValueDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(Quartile1ValueDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(MedianValueDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(Quartile3ValueDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(MaxValueDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(MeanValueDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(OutlierValuesDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(MeanLineVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ModelProperty);
			properties.Add(MeanLineStyleProperty);
			properties.Add(PointAnimationProperty);
			properties.Add(SeriesAnimationProperty);
		}

		internal override bool AreValueDataMembersSet()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(MinValueDataMember) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Quartile1ValueDataMember) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(MedianValueDataMember) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Quartile3ValueDataMember) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(MaxValueDataMember))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			BoxPlot2DAnimationBase animation = GetActualPointAnimation() as BoxPlot2DAnimationBase;
			if (animation != null)
			{
				double progress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
				PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(pointItem, null, delegate(IPresentation layout)
				{
					BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout = layout as BoxPlotSeries2DPointLayout;
					Matrix transformMatrix = animation.CalculateTransform(boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout, progress);
					boxPlotSeries2DPointLayout.SetTransformMatrix(transformMatrix);
				});
			}
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return Model;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			IBoxPlotPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			return transform.Transform(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Max));
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return base.CalculateAnnotationPoint(point);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, bool inLabel)
		{
			return base.CalculateToolTipPoint(pointItem, inLabel);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalBoxPlotSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase CreateDefaultPointAnimation()
		{
			return new BoxPlot2DSlideFromTopAnimation();
		}

		protected internal override double[] GetPointValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (!(GetValues(point) is BoxPlotNumericValues boxPlotNumericValues))
			{
				return new double[6]
				{
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN,
					double.NaN
				};
			}
			return boxPlotNumericValues.GetValues();
		}

		protected internal override TimeSpan[] GetPointTimeSpanValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (GetValues(point) is BoxPlotTimeSpanValues boxPlotTimeSpanValues)
			{
				return boxPlotTimeSpanValues.GetValues();
			}
			return base.GetPointTimeSpanValues(point);
		}

		protected internal override DateTime[] GetPointDateTimeValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (GetValues(point) is BoxPlotDateTimeValues boxPlotDateTimeValues)
			{
				return boxPlotDateTimeValues.GetValues();
			}
			return base.GetPointDateTimeValues(point);
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxPointRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram diagram, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			double value = point.RefinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotMax);
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, snapMode, 0.0, value);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.BoxPlotViewPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override void SetPointValues(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, double[] values, DateTime[] dateTimeValues, TimeSpan[] timeSpanValues)
		{
			BoxPlotValuesBase values2 = null;
			if (base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical && values != null && values.Length > 4)
			{
				values2 = new BoxPlotNumericValues(values);
			}
			if (base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime && dateTimeValues != null && dateTimeValues.Length > 4)
			{
				values2 = new BoxPlotDateTimeValues(dateTimeValues);
			}
			if (base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan && timeSpanValues != null && timeSpanValues.Length > 4)
			{
				values2 = new BoxPlotTimeSpanValues(timeSpanValues);
			}
			SetValues(seriesPoint, values2);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetPenBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			return Model.GetPenBrush(brush);
		}

		public override SeriesPointAnimationBase GetPointAnimation()
		{
			return PointAnimation;
		}

		public override void SetPointAnimation(SeriesPointAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is BoxPlot2DAnimationBase)
			{
				PointAnimation = (BoxPlot2DAnimationBase)value;
			}
		}
	}

	public class SidePoint : ChartDependencyObject, ICloneable
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualLabelPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualLabel", typeof(SeriesLabel), typeof(SidePoint), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualLabelChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualLabelProperty = ActualLabelPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Label", typeof(SeriesLabel), typeof(SidePoint), new PropertyMetadata(LabelChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelDisplayModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LabelDisplayMode", typeof(SidePointDisplayMode), typeof(SidePoint), new PropertyMetadata(SidePointDisplayMode.Default, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		private bool isFirst;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public SeriesLabel ActualLabel => (SeriesLabel)GetValue(ActualLabelProperty);

		[Description("Specifies the side series point’s label settings.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public SeriesLabel Label
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesLabel)GetValue(LabelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LabelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies how the label of a side series point is displayed.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SidePointDisplayMode LabelDisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (SidePointDisplayMode)GetValue(LabelDisplayModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LabelDisplayModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void ActualLabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SeriesLabel, e.NewValue as SeriesLabel, d as Series);
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		private static void LabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SidePoint sidePoint)
			{
				SeriesLabel seriesLabel = e.NewValue as SeriesLabel;
				if (seriesLabel == null)
				{
					seriesLabel = new SeriesLabel();
				}
				SetDefaultAngle(seriesLabel, sidePoint.isFirst);
				sidePoint.SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, seriesLabel);
				sidePoint.NotifyPropertyChanged("Label");
			}
		}

		private static void SetDefaultAngle(SeriesLabel label, bool isFirstPointLabel)
		{
			if (!CopyPropertyValueHelper.IsValueSet(label, MarkerSeries2D.AngleProperty))
			{
				label.SetCurrentValue(MarkerSeries2D.AngleProperty, isFirstPointLabel ? 180.0 : 0.0);
			}
		}

		public SidePoint()
		{
			SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, new SeriesLabel());
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return CloneCurrentValue();
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new SidePoint();
		}

		internal void Update(XYSeries2D series, bool isFirst)
		{
			ActualLabel.ChangeOwner(((IOwnedElement)ActualLabel).Owner, series);
			ActualLabel.UpdateLabelBehavior(series, LabelDisplayMode, isFirst);
			this.isFirst = isFirst;
			SetDefaultAngle(ActualLabel, this.isFirst);
		}

		internal void NotifyMarkerDisplayModeChanged()
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged("MarkerDisplayMode");
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class SelectionControl : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeof(SelectionControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnUpdateState));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsHighlightedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsHighlighted", typeof(bool), typeof(SelectionControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnUpdateState));

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsHighlighted
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsHighlightedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsHighlightedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnUpdateState(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SelectionControl selectionControl)
			{
				selectionControl.UpdateState();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateState()
		{
			if (IsHighlighted)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Highlighted", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else if (IsSelected)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Selected", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		public SelectionControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SelectionControl>(this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateState();
		}
	}

	public class PieTotalLabel : ChartElement, ICloneable, ISupportFlowDirection, IBindingPropertiesSource, IHitTestableElement, IInteractiveElement

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualContentPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualContent", typeof(object), typeof(PieTotalLabel), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.Update));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextPatternProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(PieTotalLabel), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, PatternChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Content", typeof(object), typeof(PieTotalLabel), new PropertyMetadata(null, ContentChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(PieTotalLabel), new PropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualContentProperty = ActualContentPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DonutHoleDiameterProperty = DonutHoleDiameterPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private SelectionInfo selectionInfo;

		private PieSeries2D Series => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as PieSeries2D;

		private string DefaultPattern
		{
			get
			{
				string text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.TotalLabelHeader);
				return text + "\n{TV:#.###}";
			}
		}

		private string ActualTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				string textPattern = TextPattern;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(textPattern))
				{
					return textPattern;
				}
				return DefaultPattern;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public SelectionInfo SelectionInfo => selectionInfo;

		[Description("Gets or sets a string that is the pattern specifying the text that a total label displays.")]

		private static void ContentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				((IChartElement)d).RemoveChild(e.OldValue);
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((IChartElement)d).AddChild(e.NewValue);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
			if (d is PieTotalLabel pieTotalLabel)
			{
				pieTotalLabel.SetActualContent();
			}
		}

		private static void PatternChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
			if (d is PieTotalLabel pieTotalLabel)
			{
				pieTotalLabel.SetActualContent();
			}
		}

		public PieTotalLabel()
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<PieTotalLabel>(this);
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
			DXSerializer.AddCustomGetSerializablePropertiesHandler((DependencyObject)this, new CustomGetSerializablePropertiesEventHandler(CustomPropertiesSerializationUtils.SerializablePieTotalLabelInheritedProperties));
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			PieTotalLabel pieTotalLabel = new PieTotalLabel();
			BindingPropertiesContainer<PieTotalLabel>.Apply(this, pieTotalLabel);
			return pieTotalLabel;
		}

		Transform ISupportFlowDirection.CreateDirectionTransform()
		{
			if (base.FlowDirection != FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				return new MatrixTransform();
			}
			return new ScaleTransform
			{
				ScaleX = -1.0,
				ScaleY = 1.0,
				CenterX = 0.5,
				CenterY = 0.5
			};
		}

		object IBindingPropertiesSource.CloneValue(object value)
		{

		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			properties.Add(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.ForegroundProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontFamilyProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontSizeProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontStretchProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontStyleProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontWeightProperty);
			properties.Add(TextPatternProperty);
			properties.Add(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			properties.Add(ContentProperty);
			properties.Add(ContentTemplateProperty);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		private void SetActualContent()
		{
			object content = Content;
			if (content == null && Series != null)
			{
				ActualContent = GetActualText();
			}
			else
			{
				ActualContent = content;
			}
		}

		private string GetActualText()
		{
			string actualTextPattern = ActualTextPattern;
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(actualTextPattern, Series);
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = Series.Item.RefinedSeries;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedSeries.Points[0], Series);
			}
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			DonutHoleDiameter = Math.Min(constraint.Height, constraint.Width) * Series.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0;
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			SetActualContent();
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailablePatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return new string[2] { "TV", "S" };
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.ChangeOwner(oldOwner, newOwner);
			SetActualContent();
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(TextPattern))
				{
					return TextPattern;
				}
				return DefaultTextPattern;
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItemBase> ISeriesLabel.Items => Items;

		[Description("Enables stacked bars’ total labels to be customized.")]
		public event CustomizeTotalLabelEventHandler Customize
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(CustomizeEvent, value);
				customizeEventHandlersCount++;
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(CustomizeEvent, value);
				customizeEventHandlersCount--;
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateIndent(object value)
		{
			return (int)value >= 0;
		}

		private static bool ValidateConnectorThickness(object connectorThickness)
		{
			return (int)connectorThickness >= 0;
		}

		public StackedBarTotalLabel()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<StackedBarTotalLabel>(this);
		}

		private string GetItemText(Series series, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			string actualLabelTextPattern = ActualLabelTextPattern;
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(actualLabelTextPattern, series);
			patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, series);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		internal void UpdateConnectorItems()
		{
			foreach (StackedBarTotalLabelItem item in Items)
			{
				item.ConnectorItem = new StackedBarTotalLabelConnectorItem(item);
				item.ShowConnector = ConnectorVisible;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateItems(StackedInteractionContainer stackedInteractionContainer, Series series, int seriesIndex)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> list = new List<SeriesPointItem>();
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in series.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = allPointItem.RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint != null && stackedInteractionContainer.ShouldCreateTotalLabel(seriesIndex, refinedPoint))
				{
					list.Add(allPointItem);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in list)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = item.RefinedPoint;
				string text = GetItemText(series, refinedPoint2);
				if (customizeEventHandlersCount > 0)
				{
					CustomizeTotalLabelEventArgs e = new CustomizeTotalLabelEventArgs(text, ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint2).ConnectedPoints, BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalValue(refinedPoint2));
					RaiseEvent(e);
					text = e.Text;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					StackedBarTotalLabelItem stackedBarTotalLabelItem = new StackedBarTotalLabelItem(this);
					Items.Add(stackedBarTotalLabelItem);
					stackedBarTotalLabelItem.PointItem = item;
					stackedBarTotalLabelItem.Text = text;
					item.TotalLabelItem = stackedBarTotalLabelItem;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailablePatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return new string[3] { "TV", "A", "G" };
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class StackedBarSeriesPointReadOnlyList : IEnumerable<SeriesPoint>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<SeriesPoint> points;

		[Description("")]
		public int Count => points.Count;

		[Description("")]
		public SeriesPoint this[int pointIndex] => points[pointIndex];

		internal StackedBarSeriesPointReadOnlyList(IList<RefinedPoint> source, double totalValue)
		{
			points = new List<SeriesPoint>(source.Count);
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in source)
			{
				if ((totalValue >= 0.0) ^ (item.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value) < 0.0))
				{
					points.Add(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(item));
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<SeriesPoint> IEnumerable<SeriesPoint>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				yield return point;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				yield return point;
			}
		}
	}

		internal StackedBarTotalLabelConnectorItem(StackedBarTotalLabelItem labelItem)
			: base(labelItem)
		{
		}

		protected override GRealPoint2D CalculateConnectorFinishPoint(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds, GRealPoint2D labelCenter, GRealPoint2D labelCorner1, GRealPoint2D labelCorner2)
		{
			IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(anchorPoint, labelCenter, labelCorner1, labelCorner2);
			if (!intersectionInfo.HasIntersection)
			{
				return labelCenter;
			}
			return intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint;
		}
	}
