	public class FunnelSeries2DPointLayout : SeriesPointLayout, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly Rect initialBounds;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point initTopLeftPoint;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point initBottomLeftPoint;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point initTopRightPoint;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point initBottomRightPoint;

		private readonly FunnelPointInfo pointInfo;

		private System.Windows.Point topLeftPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point bottomLeftPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point topRightPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point bottomRightPoint;

		private Rect geometryBounds;

		private Geometry pointGeometry;

		private Geometry borderGeometry;

		internal System.Windows.Point InitTopLeftPoint => initTopLeftPoint;

		internal System.Windows.Point InitBottomLeftPoint => initBottomLeftPoint;

		internal System.Windows.Point InitTopRightPoint => initTopRightPoint;

		internal System.Windows.Point InitBottomRightPoint => initBottomRightPoint;

		internal Rect GeometryBounds => geometryBounds;

		internal FunnelPointInfo PointInfo => pointInfo;

		[Description("")]
		public override Rect Bounds => initialBounds;

		[Description("")]
		public override Geometry ClipGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = topLeftPoint;
				pathFigure.IsClosed = true;
				pathFigure.IsFilled = true;
				PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment();
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(topLeftPoint);
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(topRightPoint);
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(bottomRightPoint);
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(bottomLeftPoint);
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public Geometry PointGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return pointGeometry;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pointGeometry != value)
				{
					pointGeometry = value;
					if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
					{
						this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("PointGeometry"));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public Geometry BorderGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return borderGeometry;
			}
			set
			{
				if (borderGeometry != value)
				{
					borderGeometry = value;
					if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
					{
						this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("BorderGeometry"));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public FunnelSeries2DPointLayout(Rect viewport, Rect bounds, FunnelPointInfo pointInfo)
			: base(viewport)
		{
			initialBounds = bounds;
			this.pointInfo = pointInfo;
			initTopLeftPoint = new System.Windows.Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.TopLeftPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.TopLeftPoint.Y));
			initTopRightPoint = new System.Windows.Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.TopRightPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.TopRightPoint.Y));
			initBottomRightPoint = new System.Windows.Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.BottomRightPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.BottomRightPoint.Y));
			initBottomLeftPoint = new System.Windows.Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.BottomLeftPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(pointInfo.BottomLeftPoint.Y));
			CalculateGeometryBounds();
			PointGeometry = ClipGeometry;
			BorderGeometry = ClipGeometry;
		}

		private void CalculateGeometryBounds()
		{
			if (initTopLeftPoint.X <= initBottomLeftPoint.X)
			{
				geometryBounds = new Rect(initTopLeftPoint.X, initTopLeftPoint.Y, initTopRightPoint.X - initTopLeftPoint.X, initBottomLeftPoint.Y - initTopLeftPoint.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				geometryBounds = new Rect(initBottomLeftPoint.X, initTopLeftPoint.Y, initBottomRightPoint.X - initBottomLeftPoint.X, initBottomLeftPoint.Y - initTopLeftPoint.Y);
			}
		}

		private void CalculatePoints(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (initTopLeftPoint.X <= initBottomLeftPoint.X)
			{
				topLeftPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X, bounds.Y);
				topRightPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X + bounds.Width, bounds.Y);
				double num = (initBottomLeftPoint.X - initBottomRightPoint.X) / (initTopLeftPoint.X - initTopRightPoint.X);
				double num2 = bounds.Width * num;
				bottomLeftPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X + (bounds.Width - num2) / 2.0, bounds.Y + bounds.Height);
				bottomRightPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X + bounds.Width - (bounds.Width - num2) / 2.0, bounds.Y + bounds.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				bottomLeftPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.Height);
				bottomRightPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X + bounds.Width, bounds.Y + bounds.Height);
				double num3 = (initTopLeftPoint.X - initTopRightPoint.X) / (initBottomLeftPoint.X - initBottomRightPoint.X);
				double num4 = bounds.Width * num3;
				topLeftPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X + (bounds.Width - num4) / 2.0, bounds.Y);
				topRightPoint = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.X + bounds.Width - (bounds.Width - num4) / 2.0, bounds.Y);
			}
		}

		internal void Complete(Rect animatedBounds)
		{
			CalculatePoints(animatedBounds);
			PointGeometry = ClipGeometry;
			BorderGeometry = ClipGeometry;
		}
	}

		public NestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout(Rect viewport, DonutSegment donutSegment, double outerDonutRadius)
			: base(viewport)

			System.Windows.Point location = donutSegment.Center.MoveByVector(0.0 - outerDonutRadius, 0.0 - outerDonutRadius);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(2.0 * outerDonutRadius, 2.0 * outerDonutRadius);
			bounds = new Rect(location, size);
			finalOuterRadiusOfOuterDonut = outerDonutRadius;

			animatedDonutSegment = donutSegment;
		}

		{
			animatedDonutSegment = segment;
			System.Windows.Point location = animatedDonutSegment.Center.MoveByVector(0.0 - animatedOuterRadiusOfOuterDonut, 0.0 - animatedOuterRadiusOfOuterDonut);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(2.0 * animatedOuterRadiusOfOuterDonut, 2.0 * animatedOuterRadiusOfOuterDonut);
			bounds = new Rect(location, size);
		}
	}
	public class PieSeries2DPointLayout : PieSeries2DPointLayoutBase
	{
		private struct PieSeries2DPointLayoutData : IEquatable<PieSeries2DPointLayoutData>
		{
			private readonly double initialFinishAngle;

			private readonly double initialStartAngle;

			private readonly double initialRadius;

			private readonly double holeRadiusPercent;

			private readonly double rotation;

			private readonly System.Windows.Point initialPieCenter;

			private readonly System.Windows.Point clipCenterPoint;

			public double InitialFinishAngle => initialFinishAngle;

			public double InitialStartAngle => initialStartAngle;

			public double InitialRadius => initialRadius;

			public double HoleRadiusPercent => holeRadiusPercent;

			public double Rotation => rotation;

			public System.Windows.Point InitialPieCenter => initialPieCenter;

			public System.Windows.Point ClipCenterPoint => clipCenterPoint;

			public PieSeries2DPointLayoutData(double initialFinishAngle, double initialStartAngle, double initialRadius, double holeRadiusPercent, double rotation, System.Windows.Point initialPieCenter, System.Windows.Point clipCenterPoint)
			{
				this.initialFinishAngle = initialFinishAngle;
				this.initialStartAngle = initialStartAngle;
				this.initialRadius = initialRadius;
				this.holeRadiusPercent = holeRadiusPercent;
				this.rotation = rotation;
				this.initialPieCenter = initialPieCenter;
				this.clipCenterPoint = clipCenterPoint;
			}

			public bool Equals(PieSeries2DPointLayoutData other)
			{
				if (initialFinishAngle == other.initialFinishAngle && initialStartAngle == other.initialStartAngle && initialRadius == other.initialRadius && holeRadiusPercent == other.holeRadiusPercent && rotation == other.rotation && initialPieCenter == other.initialPieCenter)
				{
					return clipCenterPoint == other.clipCenterPoint;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is PieSeries2DPointLayoutData other))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Equals(other);
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double, double, double, double, double, double, double, double>(initialFinishAngle, initialStartAngle, initialRadius, holeRadiusPercent, rotation, initialPieCenter.X, initialPieCenter.Y, clipCenterPoint.X, clipCenterPoint.Y);
			}
		}

		private double finishAngle;

		private double radius;

		private double startAngle;

		private System.Windows.Point clipCenter;

		private System.Windows.Point pieCenter;

		private PieSeries2DPointLayoutData layoutData;

		private double HoleRadius
		{
			get
			{
				double num = radius * layoutData.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0;
				if (MathUtils.StrongRound(num) == MathUtils.StrongRound(radius))
				{
					num = ((radius > 1.0) ? (radius - 1.0) : 0.0);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal double InitialFinishAngle => layoutData.InitialFinishAngle;

		internal System.Windows.Point InitialPieCenter => layoutData.InitialPieCenter;

		internal double InitialRadius => layoutData.InitialRadius;

		internal double InitialStartAngle => layoutData.InitialStartAngle;

		internal double Rotation => layoutData.Rotation;

		[Description("")]
		public override Rect Bounds => new Rect(pieCenter.X - radius, pieCenter.Y - radius, 2.0 * radius, 2.0 * radius);

		[Description("")]
		public override Geometry ClipGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				DonutSegment segment = new DonutSegment(clipCenter, new System.Windows.Point(radius, radius), HoleRadius, radius + 1.0, startAngle, finishAngle);
				segment.RotateCCW(layoutData.Rotation);
				return CalculateClipGeometry(segment);
			}
		}

		public static PieSeries2DPointLayout InitOrCreate(PieSeries2DPointLayout existingItem, Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pieCenter, double radius, double holeRadiusPercent, double rotation, double startAngle, double finishAngle, System.Windows.Point clipCenterPoint)
		{
			if (existingItem == null)
			{
				return new PieSeries2DPointLayout(viewport, pieCenter, radius, holeRadiusPercent, rotation, startAngle, finishAngle, clipCenterPoint);
			}
			existingItem.Assign(pieCenter, radius, holeRadiusPercent, rotation, startAngle, finishAngle, clipCenterPoint);
			return existingItem;
		}

		public PieSeries2DPointLayout(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point pieCenter, double radius, double holeRadiusPercent, double rotation, double startAngle, double finishAngle, System.Windows.Point clipCenterPoint)
			: base(viewport)
		{
			Assign(pieCenter, radius, holeRadiusPercent, rotation, startAngle, finishAngle, clipCenterPoint);
		}

		internal void Assign(System.Windows.Point pieCenter, double radius, double holeRadiusPercent, double rotation, double startAngle, double finishAngle, System.Windows.Point clipCenterPoint)
		{
			PieSeries2DPointLayoutData other = new PieSeries2DPointLayoutData(finishAngle, startAngle, radius, holeRadiusPercent, rotation, pieCenter, clipCenterPoint);
			if (!layoutData.Equals(other))
			{
				layoutData = other;
				base.IsApplyed = false;
			}
		}

		internal void Complete(System.Windows.Point pieCenter, double radius, double startAngle, double finishAngle)
		{
			this.pieCenter = pieCenter;
			this.radius = radius;
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.finishAngle = finishAngle;
			clipCenter = new System.Windows.Point(radius + (layoutData.ClipCenterPoint.X - pieCenter.X), radius + (layoutData.ClipCenterPoint.Y - pieCenter.Y));
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesPointLayout : IPresentation
	{
		private readonly Rect viewport;

		private Transform transform;

		protected virtual Matrix Matrix => Matrix.Identity;

		internal Rect Viewport => viewport;

		internal bool IsApplyed { get; set; }

		[Description("For internal use. Gets the point’s bounds.")]
		public abstract Rect Bounds { get; }

		[Description("For internal use. Gets the point layout geometry.")]
		public virtual Geometry ClipGeometry => null;

		[Description("For internal use. Gets the point’s transformations.")]
		public Transform Transform
		{
			get
			{
				if (transform == null && !Matrix.IsIdentity)
				{
					transform = new MatrixTransform(Matrix);
				}
				return transform;
			}
		}

		Geometry IPresentation.Geometry
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		Matrix IPresentation.Transform => Matrix;

		internal SeriesPointLayout(Rect viewport)
		{
			this.viewport = viewport;
		}

		protected void ResetTransform()
		{
			transform = null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PieSeries2DPointLayoutBase : SeriesPointLayout
	{
		public PieSeries2DPointLayoutBase(Rect viewport)
			: base(viewport)
		{
		}

		protected Geometry CalculateClipGeometry(DonutSegment segment)
		{
			if ((double)(float)segment.ArcAngleDeg < 360.0)
			{
				bool isLargeArc = segment.ArcAngleDeg > 180.0;
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
				pathFigure.StartPoint = segment.RelativeCenter.MoveByAngle(segment.InnerRadius, segment.StartAngleDeg);
				LineSegment value = new LineSegment
				{
					Point = segment.RelativeCenter.MoveByAngle(segment.OuterRadius, segment.StartAngleDeg)
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value);
				ArcSegment value2 = new ArcSegment
				{
					Point = segment.RelativeCenter.MoveByAngle(segment.OuterRadius, segment.EndAngleDeg),
					Size = new System.Windows.Size(segment.OuterRadius, segment.OuterRadius),
					IsLargeArc = isLargeArc,
					SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Counterclockwise
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value2);
				LineSegment value3 = new LineSegment
				{
					Point = segment.RelativeCenter.MoveByAngle(segment.InnerRadius, segment.EndAngleDeg)
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value3);
				ArcSegment value4 = new ArcSegment
				{
					Point = pathFigure.StartPoint,
					Size = new System.Windows.Size(segment.InnerRadius, segment.InnerRadius),
					IsLargeArc = isLargeArc,
					SweepDirection = SweepDirection.Clockwise
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value4);
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.EvenOdd
			};
			geometryGroup.Children.Add(new EllipseGeometry
			{
				Center = segment.RelativeCenter,
				RadiusX = segment.OuterRadius,
				RadiusY = segment.OuterRadius
			});
			geometryGroup.Children.Add(new EllipseGeometry
			{
				Center = segment.RelativeCenter,
				RadiusX = segment.InnerRadius,
				RadiusY = segment.InnerRadius
			});
			return geometryGroup;
		}
	}

	public class SeriesSurfaceControl : SeriesSurfaceControlBase
	{
		private bool rotated;

		private int invalidSizeCounter;

		internal bool Rotated
		{
			get
			{
				return rotated;
			}
			set
			{
				if (rotated != value)
				{
					rotated = value;
					UpdateTransform(base.RenderSize);
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesSurfaceControl()
		{
			base.RenderTransform = new ScaleTransform(1.0, -1.0);
			base.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5);
			base.LayoutTransform = Transform.Identity;
		}

		private void UpdateTransform(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (!Rotated)
			{
				base.RenderTransform = new ScaleTransform(1.0, -1.0);
				base.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5);
				base.LayoutTransform = Transform.Identity;
			}
			else
			{
				base.RenderTransform = Transform.Identity;
				base.RenderTransformOrigin = default(System.Windows.Point);
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform(-90.0));
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform(0.0, size.Width));
				base.LayoutTransform = transformGroup;
			}
			invalidSizeCounter = 2;
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			if (invalidSizeCounter > 0)
			{
				UpdateSurfaceSourceSize();
				invalidSizeCounter--;
			}
		}
	}
	public enum ColorDistributionDirection
	{
		Forward,
		Backward
	}
	public class PointBasedSegmentColorizer : SegmentColorizerBase, IPointSegmentColorizer
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DirectionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Direction", typeof(ColorDistributionDirection), typeof(PointBasedSegmentColorizer), new PropertyMetadata(ColorDistributionDirection.Forward, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		[Description("Gets or sets the direction that is used to distribute the point marker color.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ColorDistributionDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColorDistributionDirection)GetValue(DirectionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DirectionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		int? IPointSegmentColorizer.GetColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointIndex)
		{
			Series series = ChartElementHelper.GetOwner<Series>(this);
			if (series != null)
			{
				int num = ((Direction == ColorDistributionDirection.Forward) ? (pointIndex - 1) : pointIndex);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color? pointColor = series.ColorizerController.GetPointColor(points[num].SeriesPoint);
					if (pointColor.HasValue)
					{
						return ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(pointColor.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new PointBasedSegmentColorizer();
		}

		protected internal override IBezierStripSplitter CreateBezierStripSplitter()
		{
			return new BezierPointSplitter(this);
		}

		protected internal override IStripSplitter CreateStripSplitter()
		{
			return new StripPointSplitter(this);
		}
	}

		private static void OnRangeStopsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer)
			{
				rangeSegmentColorizer.colorizerBehavior.RangeStops = (DoubleCollection)e.NewValue;
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnLegendTextPatternChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer)
			{
				rangeSegmentColorizer.colorizerBehavior.LegendItemPattern = e.NewValue as string;
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems(d, e);
			}
		}

		public RangeSegmentColorizer()
		{
			colorizerBehavior = new SegmentRangeColorizerBehavior();
			SetValue(RangeStopsProperty, new DoubleCollection());
			SetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty, "{V1} - {V2}");
		}

		int? IRangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(double value)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? color = colorizerBehavior.GetColor(value, (Palette != null) ? Palette : SeriesPalette);
			if (color.HasValue)
			{
				return ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(color.Value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		int IRangeSegmentColorizer.GetRangeIndex(double value)
		{

		}

		}

		Palette ISupportPalette.GetPalette()

		}

		{

		}

		protected internal override IStripSplitter CreateStripSplitter()
		{
			IList<double> sortedRangeStops = colorizerBehavior.GetSortedRangeStops();
			if (sortedRangeStops == null || sortedRangeStops.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new StripRangeSplitter(this);
		}

		protected internal override IBezierStripSplitter CreateBezierStripSplitter()
		{
			return new BezierRangeSplitter(this);
		}
	}

		private static void OnColorPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is TrendSegmentColorizer trendSegmentColorizer)
			{
				trendSegmentColorizer.UpdateColors();
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems(d, e);
			}
		}

		public TrendSegmentColorizer()
		{
			UpdateColors();
		}

		int? ITrendSegmentColorizer.GetColor(double value, double previousValue)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsNaN(previousValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (value <= previousValue) ? fallingTrendColorInt : risingTrendColorInt;
		}

		List<ColorizerLegendItem> ILegendItemsProvider.GetLegendItems(Palette palette)
		{
			return new List<ColorizerLegendItem>
			{
				new ColorizerLegendItem(RisingTrendColor, RisingTrendLegendText),
				new ColorizerLegendItem(FallingTrendColor, FallingTrendLegendText)
			};
		}

		private void UpdateColors()
		{
			risingTrendColorInt = ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(RisingTrendColor);
			fallingTrendColorInt = ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(FallingTrendColor);
		}

		{
			return new TrendSegmentColorizer();
		}

		protected internal override IStripSplitter CreateStripSplitter()
		{
			return new StripTrendSplitter(this);
		}

		protected internal override IBezierStripSplitter CreateBezierStripSplitter()
		{
			return new BezierTrendSplitter(this);
		}

		private static void SummaryPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Summary listener)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, e.NewValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, listener);
				ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return ProcessWeakEvent(e as PropertyChangedEventArgs);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessWeakEvent(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(e?.PropertyName);
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Summary();
		}

		protected override bool FreezeCore(bool isChecking)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal ISummaryOptionsBase GetActualSummaryOptions(ISeries series)
		{
			return series.ArgumentScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => DateTimeSummaryOptions ?? new DateTimeSummaryOptions(useAxisMeasureUnit: true), 
				Scale.Numerical => NumericSummaryOptions ?? new NumericSummaryOptions(useAxisMeasureUnit: true), 
				Scale.Qualitative => QualitativeSummaryOptions ?? new QualitativeSummaryOptions(), 
				Scale.TimeSpan => TimeSpanSummaryOptions ?? new TimeSpanSummaryOptions(useAxisMeasureUnit: true), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal bool CanApply(Series series)
		{
			if (Function != null)
			{
				return Function.Check(series);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SummaryFunctionBase : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		protected virtual IList<string> DataMembers => new string[0];

		protected internal virtual SummaryDelegate FunctionDelegate => CreateSeriesPoints;

		internal virtual ScaleType[] ResultScaleTypes => null;

		internal virtual int? ResultDimension => null;

		public virtual string Name => "Custom";

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		protected internal string GetDataMembersString()
		{
			if (DataMembers.Count == 0)
			{
				return Name + "()";
			}
			string text = Name + "([";
			foreach (string dataMember in DataMembers)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
				{
					text += $"{dataMember},";
				}
			}
			text = text.Remove(text.Length - 1, 1);
			return text + "])";
		}

		protected virtual SeriesPoint[] CreateSeriesPoints(Series series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValues[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			return new SeriesPoint[0];
		}

		protected static bool CheckArgument(object argument)
		{
			if (argument is string text)
			{
				return text.Length != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static IList<object> ConstructTag(DataSourceValues[] values)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (DataSourceValues dataSourceValues in values)
			{
				if (dataSourceValues.TryGetValue(string.Empty, out var value))
				{
					list.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected static IDataPoint[] CreateSeriesPoints(ISeries series, object argument, object[] values, object tag, object[] colors)
		{
			return new IDataPoint[1] { series.CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument, values, tag, colors) };
		}

		protected internal virtual bool Check()
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal bool Check(Series series)
		{
			if (ResultScaleTypes != null && !ResultScaleTypes.Contains(series.ValueScaleTypeInternal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleSummaryFunctionScale), Name, series.ValueScaleTypeInternal));
			}
			if (ResultDimension.HasValue && ResultDimension.Value != series.PointDimension)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncompatibleSummaryFunctionDimension), Name, series.GetType().Name, ResultDimension, series.PointDimension));
			}
			return Check();
		}
	}
	public class CountSummaryFunction : SummaryFunctionBase
	{
		internal override int? ResultDimension => 1;

		public override string Name => "COUNT";

		protected internal override SummaryDelegate FunctionDelegate => CreatePoints;

		private IDataPoint[] CreatePoints(Series series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValues[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!SummaryFunctionBase.CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			double num = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcCount(values);
			return SummaryFunctionBase.CreateSeriesPoints(series, argument, new object[1] { num }, SummaryFunctionBase.ConstructTag(values), colors);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataMemberSummaryFunction : SummaryFunctionBase
	{
		private string valueDataMember = string.Empty;

		protected override IList<string> DataMembers
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueDataMember))
				{
					return new string[1] { ValueDataMember };
				}
				return new string[0];
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the data source field that provides data to be aggregated.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ValueDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return valueDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(valueDataMember == value))
				{
					valueDataMember = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ValueDataMember");
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool Check()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueDataMember);
		}
	}
	public class MinSummaryFunction : DataMemberSummaryFunction
	{
		protected internal override SummaryDelegate FunctionDelegate => Calculate;

		internal override int? ResultDimension => 1;

		public override string Name => "MIN";

		protected virtual IDataPoint[] Calculate(Series series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValues[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!SummaryFunctionBase.CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			int minIndex;
			object obj = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcMin(series, functionArguments, values, out minIndex);
			return SummaryFunctionBase.CreateSeriesPoints(series, argument, (obj == null) ? null : new object[1] { obj }, SummaryFunctionBase.ConstructTag(values), (colors == null || colors.Length == 0 || minIndex < 0) ? null : new object[1] { colors[minIndex] });
		}
	}
	public class MaxSummaryFunction : MinSummaryFunction
	{
		internal override int? ResultDimension => 1;

		public override string Name => "MAX";

		protected override IDataPoint[] Calculate(Series series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValues[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!SummaryFunctionBase.CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			int maxIndex;
			object obj = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcMax(series, functionArguments, values, out maxIndex);
			return SummaryFunctionBase.CreateSeriesPoints(series, argument, (obj == null) ? null : new object[1] { obj }, SummaryFunctionBase.ConstructTag(values), (colors == null || colors.Length == 0 || maxIndex < 0) ? null : new object[1] { colors[maxIndex] });
		}
	}
	public class SumSummaryFunction : DataMemberSummaryFunction
	{
		protected internal override SummaryDelegate FunctionDelegate => Calculate;

		internal override int? ResultDimension => 1;

		internal override ScaleType[] ResultScaleTypes => new ScaleType[2]
		{
			ScaleType.Numerical,
			ScaleType.TimeSpan
		};

		public override string Name => "SUM";

		protected virtual IDataPoint[] Calculate(Series series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValues[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!SummaryFunctionBase.CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			object[] array = new object[1];
			if (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				array[0] = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcTimeSpanSum(functionArguments, values);
			}
			else
			{
				array[0] = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcSum(functionArguments, values);
			}
			return SummaryFunctionBase.CreateSeriesPoints(series, argument, array, SummaryFunctionBase.ConstructTag(values), colors);
		}
	}
	public class AverageSummaryFunction : SumSummaryFunction
	{
		public override string Name => "AVERAGE";

		protected override IDataPoint[] Calculate(Series series, object argument, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValues[] values, object[] colors)
		{
			if (!SummaryFunctionBase.CheckArgument(argument))
			{
				return new SeriesPoint[0];
			}
			object[] array = new object[1];
			if (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				array[0] = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcTimeSpanAverage(functionArguments, values);
			}
			else
			{
				array[0] = SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore.CalcAverage(functionArguments, values);
			}
			return SummaryFunctionBase.CreateSeriesPoints(series, argument, array, SummaryFunctionBase.ConstructTag(values), colors);
		}
	}

	public class Chart3DContainer : ChartElementBase
	{
		private readonly Chart3DControl chart;

		private Viewport3D viewport3D;

		internal Chart3DControl Chart => chart;

		public Chart3DContainer(Chart3DControl chart)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Chart3DContainer>(this);
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		private XYZChartDomain CreateDomain(Viewport3D visualContainer)
		{
			return new XYZChartDomain(chart, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, visualContainer.RenderSize.Width, visualContainer.RenderSize.Height), new XYZChartBox(chart));
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			viewport3D.Children.Clear();
			XYZChartDomain xYZChartDomain = CreateDomain(viewport3D);
			xYZChartDomain.ValidateSeriesPointsCache();
			xYZChartDomain.Render(viewport3D);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			viewport3D = GetTemplateChild("PART_Viewport") as Viewport3D;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			double width = (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width) ? 0.0 : Math.Floor(constraint.Width));
			double height = (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height) ? 0.0 : Math.Floor(constraint.Height));
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		public System.Windows.Point Point3DToScreen2D(Point3D point, out bool inViewportRect)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)viewport3D, (UIElement)Chart);
			MatrixCamera camera = viewport3D.Camera as MatrixCamera;
			System.Windows.Point point2 = Viewport3DUtils.Point3DToScreen2D(point, camera, relativeElementRect);
			inViewportRect = relativeElementRect.Contains(point2);
			return point2;
		}

		public System.Windows.Point Point3DToScreen2D(Point3D point)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)viewport3D, (UIElement)Chart);
			MatrixCamera camera = viewport3D.Camera as MatrixCamera;
			return Viewport3DUtils.Point3DToScreen2D(point, camera, relativeElementRect);
		}
	}

	public abstract class Chart3DDependencyObject : Freezable, IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner
	{
		private readonly Locker changedLocker = new Locker();

		private IChartElement owner;

		protected object Owner => owner;

		protected ViewController ViewController
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.Controller;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				ChangeOwner(owner, value);
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller => ViewController;

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (!changedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					if (ProcessChanging(updateInfo))
					{
						if (owner != null)
						{
							return owner.Changed(updateInfo);
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				finally
				{
					changedLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject();

		protected virtual bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			if (oldOwner == newOwner)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				oldOwner?.RemoveChild(this);
				owner = newOwner;
				newOwner?.AddChild(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				changedLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			Chart3DDependencyObject chart3DDependencyObject = CreateObject();
			if (chart3DDependencyObject == null)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("Chart3DDependencyObject is expected");
			}
			return chart3DDependencyObject;
		}
	}
	public abstract class Chart3DNonVisualElement : DXFrameworkContentElement, IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner
	{
		private readonly List<object> logicalChildren = new List<object>();

		private readonly Locker changedLocker = new Locker();

		private IChartElement owner;

		protected virtual ViewController Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.Controller;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => logicalChildren.GetEnumerator();

		internal Locker ChangedLocker => changedLocker;

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				ChangeOwner(owner, value);
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller => Controller;

		protected virtual void AddChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
				((FrameworkContentElement)this).AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			if (logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Remove(child);
				((FrameworkContentElement)this).RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
			AddChild(child);
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveChild(child);
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (!changedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					if (ProcessChanging(updateInfo))
					{
						if (owner != null)
						{
							return owner.Changed(updateInfo);
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				finally
				{
					changedLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			if (oldOwner == newOwner)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				owner = null;
				oldOwner?.RemoveChild(this);
				owner = newOwner;
				newOwner?.AddChild(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				changedLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		public override void BeginInit()
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)this).BeginInit();
			changedLocker.Lock();
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)this).EndInit();
			changedLocker.Unlock();
		}
	}

	public class ColorEachColorizer3D : PaletteColorizer3DBase
	{
		protected internal override string DefaultLegendTextPattern => base.View.DefaultLegendPointTextPattern;

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ColorEachColorizer3D();
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, int pointIndex, Palette palette)
		{
			return palette[pointIndex];
		}

		protected override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(series);
			IList<RefinedPoint> points = refinedSeries.Points;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[i];
				legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, refinedPoint, CreateLegendItemText(refinedPoint), new SolidColorBrush(palette[i])));
			}
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return base.View.GetPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "ColorEachColorizer3D";
		}
	}
	public class ColorObjectColorizer3D : Colorizer3DBase
	{
		protected internal override string DefaultLegendTextPattern => base.View.DefaultLegendPointTextPattern;

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ColorObjectColorizer3D();
		}

		protected override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(series);
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color? color = ColorUtils.ParseColor(GetColorKey(point.SeriesPoint));
				if (color.HasValue)
				{
					legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, point, CreateLegendItemText(point), new SolidColorBrush(color.Value)));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return base.View.GetPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, int pointIndex, Palette palette)
		{
			return ColorUtils.ParseColor(colorKey);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "ColorObjectColorizer3D";
		}
	}

	public class KeyColorColorizer3D : PaletteColorizer3DBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeyProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeyProvider", typeof(IColorizer3DKeyProvider), typeof(KeyColorColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeysProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Keys", typeof(ColorizerKeysCollection), typeof(KeyColorColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(OnKeysPropertyChanged));

		private readonly Dictionary<object, int> actualKeyIndex = new Dictionary<object, int>();

		[Description("Gets or sets the key provider specifying which point values should be used as keys.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public IColorizer3DKeyProvider KeyProvider
		{

			{
				return (IColorizer3DKeyProvider)GetValue(KeyProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeyProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the collection of color keys.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public ColorizerKeysCollection Keys
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColorizerKeysCollection)GetValue(KeysProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeysProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool UseAutocreatedItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (Keys != null)
				{
					return Keys.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<object, int> ActualKeyIndex => actualKeyIndex;

		protected internal override string DefaultLegendTextPattern => "{V}";

		private static void OnKeysPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is KeyColorColorizer3D keyColorColorizer3D)
			{
				keyColorColorizer3D.OnKeysChanged(e.OldValue as ColorizerKeysCollection, e.NewValue as ColorizerKeysCollection);
			}
			Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		public KeyColorColorizer3D()
		{
			SetCurrentValue(KeysProperty, new ColorizerKeysCollection());
		}

		private void OnKeysChanged(ColorizerKeysCollection oldKeys, ColorizerKeysCollection newKeys)
		{
			if (oldKeys != null)
			{
				oldKeys.CollectionChanged -= KeysCollectionChanged;
			}
			if (newKeys != null)
			{
				newKeys.CollectionChanged += KeysCollectionChanged;
			}
			ActualKeyIndex.Clear();
		}

		private void KeysCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ActualKeyIndex.Clear();
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.ClearSeriesCache);
		}

		private void InitializeKeyIndex(Series3D series)
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(series);
			IList<RefinedPoint> points = refinedSeries.Points;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				GetPointColor(points[i].SeriesPoint, i);
			}
		}

		private void FillLegendItemsByKeyIndex(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			if (ActualKeyIndex.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, int> item in ActualKeyIndex)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = palette[item.Value % palette.Count];
				string text = CreateLegendItemText(item.Key);
				legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, text, new SolidColorBrush(color)));
			}
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new KeyColorColorizer3D();
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "V")
			{
				return new ValueLegendItemDataProvider();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			ActualKeyIndex.Clear();
			if (UseAutocreatedItems)
			{
				InitializeKeyIndex(series);
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Keys.Count; i++)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color color = palette[i];
					string text = CreateLegendItemText(Keys[i]);
					legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, text, new SolidColorBrush(color)));
				}
			}
			FillLegendItemsByKeyIndex(legendItems, legend, series, palette);
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Colorizer3DBase colorizer)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(colorizer);
			if (colorizer is KeyColorColorizer3D keyColorColorizer3D)
			{
				KeyProvider = keyColorColorizer3D.KeyProvider;
				Keys = keyColorColorizer3D.Keys.Clone();
			}
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, int pointIndex, Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette != null && palette.Count > 0)
			{
				object obj = ((KeyProvider != null) ? KeyProvider.GetKey(argumentX, argumentY, values, colorKey) : colorKey);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					if (!ActualKeyIndex.TryGetValue(obj, out var value))
					{
						value = (UseAutocreatedItems ? ActualKeyIndex.Count : Keys.IndexOf(obj));
						if (value >= 0)
						{
							ActualKeyIndex.Add(obj, value);
						}
					}
					if (value >= 0)
					{
						return palette[value % palette.Count];
					}
				}
				return palette[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "KeyColorColorizer3D";
		}
	}

	public interface IColorizer3DValueProvider

	public class RangeColorizer3D : PaletteColorizer3DBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueProvider", typeof(IColorizer3DValueProvider), typeof(RangeColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ValueProviderPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RangeStopsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RangeStops", typeof(DoubleCollection), typeof(RangeColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(RangeStopsPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ApproximateColorsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ApproximateColors", typeof(bool), typeof(RangeColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseEqualLegendIntervalsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UseEqualLegendIntervals", typeof(bool), typeof(RangeColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		private List<double> sortedRangeStops = new List<double>();

		[Description("Gets or sets the provider that specifies a point value the colorizer should use to define the point color.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public IColorizer3DValueProvider ValueProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (IColorizer3DValueProvider)GetValue(ValueProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the range stops of the colorizer.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public DoubleCollection RangeStops
		{
			get
			{
				return (DoubleCollection)GetValue(RangeStopsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RangeStopsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets value specifying whether the point colors should be approximate depending on their values.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool ApproximateColors
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ApproximateColorsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ApproximateColorsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether to use equal intervals in a gradient legend.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool UseEqualLegendIntervals
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(UseEqualLegendIntervalsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UseEqualLegendIntervalsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private int RangeCount => sortedRangeStops.Count - 1;

		private IColorizer3DValueProvider ActualValueProvider { get; set; }

		protected internal override string DefaultLegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ApproximateColors)
				{
					return "{V1} - {V2}";
				}
				return "{V}";
			}
		}

		private static void RangeStopsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeColorizer3D rangeColorizer3D)
			{
				rangeColorizer3D.UpdateSortedRangeStops();
			}
			Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void ValueProviderPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeColorizer3D rangeColorizer3D)
			{
				rangeColorizer3D.UpdateActualValueProvider(e.NewValue as IColorizer3DValueProvider);
			}
			Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		public RangeColorizer3D()
		{
			UpdateActualValueProvider(null);
		}

		private void UpdateActualValueProvider(IColorizer3DValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			ActualValueProvider = valueProvider ?? new ValueProvider3D();
		}

		private void UpdateSortedRangeStops()
		{
			if (RangeStops != null)
			{
				sortedRangeStops = new List<double>(RangeStops);
				sortedRangeStops.Sort();
			}
			else
			{
				sortedRangeStops = new List<double>();
			}
		}

		private int GetRangeIndex(double value)
		{
			if (RangeCount > 0)
			{
				if (value < sortedRangeStops[0])
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (value >= sortedRangeStops[sortedRangeStops.Count - 1])
				{
					return sortedRangeStops.Count - 1;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < RangeCount; i++)
				{
					if (value >= sortedRangeStops[i] && value < sortedRangeStops[i + 1])
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (ApproximateColors)
			{
				if (patternConstant == "V")
				{
					return new ValueLegendItemDataProvider();
				}
			}
			else if (patternConstant == "V1" || patternConstant == "V2")
			{
				return new ValueRangeLegendItemDataProvider(patternConstant);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette.Count <= 0 || RangeCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ApproximateColors)
			{
				List<GradientLegendItemData> list = new List<GradientLegendItemData>();
				double num = sortedRangeStops[0];
				double num2 = sortedRangeStops[sortedRangeStops.Count - 1] - num;
				GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < sortedRangeStops.Count; i++)
				{
					double num3 = sortedRangeStops[i];
					System.Windows.Media.Color color = palette[i];
					double num4 = 1.0 - (UseEqualLegendIntervals ? ((double)i / ((double)sortedRangeStops.Count - 1.0)) : ((num3 - num) / num2));
					list.Add(new GradientLegendItemData(num4, CreateLegendItemText(num3), color));
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(color, num4));
				}
				double angle = ((base.ActualLegend.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? 90.0 : 0.0);
				legendItems.Add(new GradientLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, new LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection, angle), list));
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < RangeCount; j++)
				{
					string text = CreateLegendItemText(new double[2]
					{
						sortedRangeStops[j],
						sortedRangeStops[j + 1]
					});
					legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, text, new SolidColorBrush(palette[j])));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new RangeColorizer3D();
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Colorizer3DBase colorizer)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(colorizer);
			if (colorizer is RangeColorizer3D rangeColorizer3D)
			{
				ValueProvider = rangeColorizer3D.ValueProvider;
				RangeStops = rangeColorizer3D.RangeStops.Clone();
				ApproximateColors = rangeColorizer3D.ApproximateColors;
			}
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, int pointIndex, Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette != null && palette.Count > 0 && sortedRangeStops != null && sortedRangeStops.Count > 0)
			{
				double value = ActualValueProvider.GetValue(argumentX, argumentY, values, colorKey);
				if (!double.IsNaN(value))
				{
					int rangeIndex = GetRangeIndex(value);
					if (rangeIndex >= 0)
					{
						if (ApproximateColors && rangeIndex < sortedRangeStops.Count - 1)
						{
							double ratio = (value - sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex]) / (sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex + 1] - sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex]);
							return ColorUtils.MixColors(palette[rangeIndex], palette[rangeIndex + 1], ratio);
						}
						return palette[rangeIndex];
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "RangeColorizer3D";
		}
	}
	public class ValueProvider3D : ChartDependencyObject, IColorizer3DValueProvider

		double IColorizer3DValueProvider.GetValue(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object color)

		}

	public class ColorObjectValueProvider3D : ChartDependencyObject, IColorizer3DValueProvider
	{

		{
			return DataItemsHelper.ParseNumerical(color) ?? double.NaN;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()

			return new ColorObjectValueProvider3D();
		}
	}
	public abstract class Colorizer3DBase : Chart3DDependencyObject, IPatternHolder
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LegendTextPatternProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LegendTextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(Colorizer3DBase), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowInLegendProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowInLegend", typeof(bool?), typeof(Colorizer3DBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LegendProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Legend", typeof(Legend), typeof(Colorizer3DBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		[Description("Gets or sets the text pattern specifying the text of the legend item of the colorizer.")]
		[Category("Legend")]
		public string LegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the legend should display the item that the colorizer provides.")]
		[Category("Legend")]
		public bool? ShowInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool?)GetValue(ShowInLegendProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowInLegendProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend in which the legend item of the colorizer should be shown.")]
		[Category("Legend")]
		public Legend Legend
		{
			get
			{
				return (Legend)GetValue(LegendProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LegendProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private string ActualLegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LegendTextPattern))
				{
					return LegendTextPattern;
				}
				return DefaultLegendTextPattern;
			}
		}

		protected Series3D Series => ChartElementHelper.GetOwner<Series3D>(this);

		protected Series3DViewBase View => ChartElementHelper.GetOwner<Series3DViewBase>(this);

		protected virtual Palette ActualPalette => Series.Palette;

		protected virtual bool DefaultShowInLegend => true;

		protected internal abstract string DefaultLegendTextPattern { get; }

		internal Legend ActualLegend => Legend ?? Series.ActualLegend;

		PatternDataProvider IPatternHolder.GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return GetPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected object GetColorKey(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint is LightSeriesPoint3D)
			{
				return ((LightSeriesPoint3D)seriesPoint).ColorKey;
			}
			if (seriesPoint is SeriesPoint3D)
			{
				return ((SeriesPoint3D)seriesPoint).Brush;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected string CreateLegendItemText(object context)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(ActualLegendTextPattern, this);
			patternParser.SetContext(context);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		protected virtual void AssignForBinding(Colorizer3DBase colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer != null)
			{
				LegendTextPattern = colorizer.LegendTextPattern;
				ShowInLegend = colorizer.ShowInLegend;
				Legend = colorizer.Legend;
			}
		}

		protected virtual PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "S")
			{
				return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette);

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSeriesLegendBrush(Series3D series)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = ActualPalette[base.ViewController.GetSeriesIndex(series)];
			return new SolidColorBrush(color);
		}

		internal Colorizer3DBase CreateCloneForBinding()
		{
			Colorizer3DBase colorizer3DBase = (Colorizer3DBase)CreateObject();
			colorizer3DBase.AssignForBinding(this);
			return colorizer3DBase;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, int pointIndex)
		{
			object userArgument = seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument;
			object userArgument2 = seriesPoint.ArgumentY.UserArgument;
			double[] numericalValues = seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues;
			if (seriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in ((AggregatedSeriesPoint)seriesPoint).SourcePoints)
				{
					list.Add(GetColorKey(sourcePoint.SeriesPoint));
				}
				return GetAggregatedPointColor(userArgument, userArgument2, numericalValues, list, pointIndex, ActualPalette);
			}
			return GetPointColor(userArgument, userArgument2, numericalValues, GetColorKey(seriesPoint), pointIndex, ActualPalette);
		}

		internal bool GetActualShowInLegend(Series3D series)
		{
			if (ShowInLegend.HasValue)
			{
				return ShowInLegend.Value;
			}
			if ((series.ShowInLegend.HasValue && !series.ShowInLegend.Value) || !((ISeries)series).ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!series.ActualView.DefaultShowColorizerInLegend)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DefaultShowInLegend;
		}

		internal void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series)
		{
			if (GetActualShowInLegend(series))
			{
				FillLegendItems(legendItems, legend, series, ActualPalette);
			}
		}

		public abstract System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, int pointIndex, Palette palette);

		public virtual System.Windows.Media.Color? GetAggregatedPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, List<object> colorKeys, int pointIndex, Palette palette)
		{
			object colorKey = colorKeys.FirstOrDefault();
			return GetPointColor(argumentX, argumentY, values, colorKey, pointIndex, palette);
		}
	}
	public class SolidColorizer3D : Colorizer3DBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Brush", typeof(SolidColorBrush), typeof(SolidColorizer3D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Gets or sets the brush used to color point markers.")]
		[Category("Brushes")]
		public SolidColorBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return (SolidColorBrush)GetValue(BrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool DefaultShowInLegend => false;

		protected internal override string DefaultLegendTextPattern => "{S}";

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new SolidColorizer3D();
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Colorizer3DBase colorizer)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(colorizer);
			if (colorizer is SolidColorizer3D solidColorizer3D)
			{
				Brush = solidColorizer3D.Brush;
			}
		}

		protected override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			SolidColorBrush markerBrush = ((Brush != null) ? Brush : new SolidColorBrush(series.BaseColor));
			legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, CreateLegendItemText(series), markerBrush));
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSeriesLegendBrush(Series3D series)
		{
			return Brush ?? base.GetSeriesLegendBrush(series);
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, int pointIndex, Palette palette)
		{
			if (Brush != null)
			{
				return Brush.Color;
			}
			return base.Series?.BaseColor;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "SolidColorizer3D";
		}
	}

	[Series3DSourceCustomBindingProperties]
	[DataAccessMetadata("All", SupportedProcessingModes = "Simple", DataSourceProperty = "DataSource", Platform = "WPF")]
	public class Series3DDataSourceAdapter : Series3DSourceBase, ISeriesFactory, ISeriesPointFactory, ISeriesDataAdapter, IChartBindingProvider, IBindingProvider, IFilteredComponent, IFilteredComponentBase
	{

		bool IBindingProvider.IsValidMembersForBinding
		{
			get
			{
				if (bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(XArgumentDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(YArgumentDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueDataMember))
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesDataMember);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		int IBindingProvider.ExistItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (Series3D item in series)
				{
					num += item.ActualPoints.Count;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private static void SeriesTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DDataSourceAdapter series3DDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				series3DDataSourceAdapter.OnSeriesTemplateChanged(e.NewValue as Series3DBase);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries);
		}

		private static void OnBindingChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries);
		}

		private static void DataSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DDataSourceAdapter series3DDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				series3DDataSourceAdapter.UpdateDataSource(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void FilterCriteriaChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DDataSourceAdapter series3DDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				string text = ((series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria != null) ? ((object)series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (text != series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterString)
				{
					series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterString = text;
				}
				series3DDataSourceAdapter.filterHelper.OnUpdateCriteria();
				OnBindingChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void FilterStringChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is Series3DDataSourceAdapter series3DDataSourceAdapter))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = e.NewValue as string;
			bool flag = series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria != null;
			if (!flag || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				string text2 = (flag ? ((object)series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (text2 != text)
				{
					series3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(text, new object[0]);
				}
			}
		}

		public Series3DDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			bindingProcessor = new ChartBindingProcessor(this);
			bindingBehavior = new BindingBehavior(this);
			bindingBehavior.ActualDataSourceChanged += ActualDataSourceChanged;
			filterHelper = new SeriesFilterHelper(this);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(CalculatedFieldsPropertyKey, (object)ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ChartCalculatedFieldCollection>(this));
		}

		IEnumerable<FilterColumn> IFilteredComponent.CreateFilterColumnCollection()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PropertyDescriptorCollection dataProperties = filterHelper.GetDataProperties();
			List<FilterColumn> list = new List<FilterColumn>();
			if (dataProperties != null)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in dataProperties)
				{
					FilterColumn val = new FilterColumn();
					val.ColumnType = item.PropertyType;
					val.FieldName = item.Name;
					val.ColumnCaption = item.DisplayName;
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		ISeries ISeriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(string seriesName, object seriesValue, ISeries existing)
		{
			return CreateSeries(seriesName);
		}

		IList<string> ISeriesDataAdapter.GetSeriesValueDataMembers()
		{
			Series3DBase series3DBase = ActualSeriesTemplate;
			List<string> list = new List<string> { ValueDataMember };
			if (series3DBase.View != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(series3DBase.View.GetAdditionalDataMembers(this));
			}
			return list;
		}

		bool IChartBindingProvider.UpdateAutoSeries(IList<ISeries> autoCreatedSeries)
		{
			foreach (Series3D item in series)
			{
				((IOwnedElement)item).Owner = null;
			}
			series.Clear();
			base.Chart.NotifySeriesClear();
			for (int i = 0; i < autoCreatedSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				Series3D series3D = (Series3D)autoCreatedSeries[i];
				if (series3D.ActualPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					((IOwnedElement)series3D).Owner = this;
					series.Add(series3D);
				}
			}
			base.Chart.NotifySeriesInsert(autoCreatedSeries);
			return true;
		}

		private object GetDataSource()
		{
			return bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource;
		}

		private Series3D CreateSeries(string seriesName)
		{
			Series3D series3D = CreateAndCustomizeSeries(seriesName);
			series3D.ChangedLocker.Lock();
			series3D.UpdateActualData(new SeriesTemplatePointStorage(this));
			series3D.ChangedLocker.Unlock();
			return series3D;
		}

		private Series3D CreateAndCustomizeSeries(string seriesName)
		{
			Series3D series3D = ((SeriesTemplate == null) ? new Series3D() : SeriesTemplate.CreateSeriesForBinding());
			series3D.DisplayName = seriesName;
			RaiseCustomizeSeriesEvent(series3D);
			return series3D;
		}

		private void RaiseCustomizeSeriesEvent(Series3D series)
		{
			CustomizeSeriesEventArgs e = new CustomizeSeriesEventArgs(CustomizeSeriesEvent, series);
			((ContentElement)(object)this).RaiseEvent((RoutedEventArgs)e);
		}

		private void UpdateDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			bindingBehavior.UpdateActualDataSource(dataSource);
		}

		private void ActualDataSourceChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			if (base.Chart != null)
			{
				ResetDataSourceScale();
				Controller.BeginUpdateData();
				bindingProcessor.RefreshData(updates, null);
				Controller.EndUpdateData();
			}
		}

		private void OnSeriesTemplateChanged(Series3DBase template)
		{
			if (actualSeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				actualSeriesTemplate.ChangeOwner(this, null);
			}
			actualSeriesTemplate = template;
			if (actualSeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				actualSeriesTemplate.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateAutoSeries)
			{
				UpdateData();
				return false;
			}
			return base.ProcessChanging(updateInfo);
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetXArgumentScaleType()
		{
			object actualDataSource = bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource;
			if (actualDataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(XArgumentDataMember))
			{
				return (ScaleType)BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, actualDataSource, XArgumentDataMember, CalculatedFields);
			}
			return base.GetXArgumentScaleType();
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetYArgumentScaleType()
		{
			object actualDataSource = bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource;
			if (actualDataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(YArgumentDataMember))
			{
				return (ScaleType)BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, actualDataSource, YArgumentDataMember, CalculatedFields);
			}
			return base.GetYArgumentScaleType();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateData()
		{
			bindingBehavior.ResetData();
		}

		protected internal override IList<Series3D> GetSeries()
		{
			return series;
		}

		internal void UpdateAutocreatedSeries()
		{
			Series3DTemplate seriesTemplate = SeriesTemplate;
			foreach (Series3D item in series)
			{
				item.ChangedLocker.Lock();
				seriesTemplate.CopyPropertiesForBinding(item);
				RaiseCustomizeSeriesEvent(item);
				item.ChangedLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}
	}

			{
			}
		}

		private static void OnBindingChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		private static void DataSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.UpdateDataSource(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void FilterCriteriaChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				string text = ((seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria != null) ? ((object)seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (text != seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterString)
				{
					seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterString = text;
				}
				seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.filterHelper.OnUpdateCriteria();
				OnBindingChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void FilterStringChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is SeriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = e.NewValue as string;
			bool flag = seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria != null;
			if (!flag || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				string text2 = (flag ? ((object)seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (text2 != text)
				{
					seriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter.FilterCriteria = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(text, new object[0]);
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesPoint3DDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			bindingProcessor = new SeriesBindingProcessor(this, boundPoints);
			bindingBehavior = new BindingBehavior(this);
			bindingBehavior.ActualDataSourceChanged += ActualDataSourceChanged;
			filterHelper = new SeriesFilterHelper(this);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(CalculatedFieldsPropertyKey, (object)ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ChartCalculatedFieldCollection>(this));
		}

		IEnumerable<FilterColumn> IFilteredComponent.CreateFilterColumnCollection()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PropertyDescriptorCollection dataProperties = filterHelper.GetDataProperties();
			List<FilterColumn> list = new List<FilterColumn>();
			if (dataProperties != null)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in dataProperties)
				{
					FilterColumn val = new FilterColumn();
					val.ColumnType = item.PropertyType;
					val.FieldName = item.Name;
					val.ColumnCaption = item.DisplayName;
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		IList<string> ISeriesDataAdapter.GetSeriesValueDataMembers()
		{
			return GetValueDataMembers();
		}

		void ISeriesBindingProvider.BindingClear(bool clearBoundPoints)
		{
			base.Series.NotifyPointsClear();
		}

		private void ActualDataSourceChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			if (base.Series != null && base.Series.Chart != null)
			{
				ResetDataSourceScale();
				base.Series.ViewController.BeginUpdateData();
				bindingProcessor.RefreshData(updates, null);
				base.Series.ViewController.EndUpdateData();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			bindingBehavior.UpdateActualDataSource(dataSource);
		}

		private bool AreValueDataMembersSet()
		{
			foreach (string valueDataMember in GetValueDataMembers())
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueDataMember))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private IList<string> GetValueDataMembers()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string> { ValueDataMember };
			if (base.Series.View != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(base.Series.View.GetAdditionalDataMembers(this));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected object GetDataSource()
		{
			return bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource;
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetXArgumentScaleType()
		{
			object dataSource = GetDataSource();
			if (dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(XArgumentDataMember))
			{
				return (ScaleType)BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, dataSource, XArgumentDataMember, CalculatedFields);
			}
			return base.GetXArgumentScaleType();
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetYArgumentScaleType()
		{
			object dataSource = GetDataSource();
			if (dataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(YArgumentDataMember))
			{
				return (ScaleType)BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, dataSource, YArgumentDataMember, CalculatedFields);
			}
			return base.GetYArgumentScaleType();
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateSeriesBinding)
			{
				UpdateData();
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessChanging(updateInfo);
		}

		internal override void UpdateData()
		{
			bindingBehavior.ResetData();
		}

		internal override IList<IDataPoint> GetPoints()
		{
			return boundPoints;
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			UpdateData();
			base.EndInit();
		}
