	public struct MatrixSize
	{
		private int width;

		private int height;

		public static MatrixSize Empty => new MatrixSize(0, 0);

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (width >= 1)
				{
					return height < 1;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public int Height => height;

		public int Width => width;

		public MatrixSize(int width, int height)
		{
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
		}
	}
	public interface IMatrixSourceDataAdapter
	{
		MatrixSize Dimension { get; }
	}
	public class SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter : SeriesPoint3DSourceBase, IMatrixSourceDataAdapter
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsCorrectDimensionPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsCorrectDimension", typeof(bool), typeof(SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(true));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCorrectDimensionProperty = IsCorrectDimensionPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty XArgumentsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("XArguments", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty YArgumentsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("YArguments", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValuesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Values", typeof(IEnumerable<double>), typeof(SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, ValuesPropertyChanged));

		private readonly IList<IDataPoint> seriesPoints = new List<IDataPoint>();

		private bool shouldUpdateData = true;

		private MatrixSize dimension;

		[Category("Data")]
		[Description("Returns the value identifying whether the count of values are adequate to create the required number of points.")]
		public bool IsCorrectDimension
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(IsCorrectDimensionProperty);
			}
			protected set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(IsCorrectDimensionPropertyKey, (object)value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		[Description("Gets or sets the X argument values of points.")]
		public IEnumerable XArguments
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(XArgumentsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(XArgumentsProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		[Description("Gets or sets the Y argument values of points.")]
		public IEnumerable YArguments
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(YArgumentsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(YArgumentsProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		[NonTestableProperty]
		[Category("Data")]
		[Description("Gets or sets the point values.")]
		public IEnumerable<double> Values
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<double>)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ValuesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ValuesProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		MatrixSize IMatrixSourceDataAdapter.Dimension => dimension;

		private static void DataPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SeriesPoint3DSourceBase.UpdateData(d as SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter);
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

		internal static void ValuesPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter seriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter)
			{
				seriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter.ValuesChanged();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearSeriesCache);
		}

		private int CalculateArgumentsCount(IEnumerable arguments)
		{
			if (arguments is IList<object> list)
			{
				return list.Count;
			}
			int num = 0;
			IEnumerator enumerator = arguments.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double[] CreateNextValues(IList<IEnumerator<double>> valuesEnumerators)
		{
			double[] array = new double[valuesEnumerators.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < valuesEnumerators.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!valuesEnumerators[i].MoveNext())
				{
					return null;
				}
				array[i] = valuesEnumerators[i].Current;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private bool GenerateEachArgumentY(object argumentX, IList<IEnumerator<double>> valuesEnumerators)
		{
			foreach (object yArgument in YArguments)
			{
				double[] array = CreateNextValues(valuesEnumerators);
				if (array == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IDataPoint item = new LightSeriesPoint3D(argumentX, yArgument, array, null, null, null, base.Series);
				seriesPoints.Add(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void RemoveExcessPoints(int realCount)
		{
			int num = seriesPoints.Count - realCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				seriesPoints.RemoveAt(seriesPoints.Count - 1);
			}
		}

		private void ValuesChanged()
		{
			if (shouldUpdateData)
			{
				if (UpdateDataIfPossible())
				{
					shouldUpdateData = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateValues();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateValues()
		{
			IList<IEnumerator<double>> list = CreateValuesEnumerators();
			if (list == null || base.Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = seriesPoints.Count - 1;
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
			{
				double[] array = CreateNextValues(list);
				if (array == null && i != num)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					((ISeriesPoint)seriesPoints[i]).Values.NumericalValues[j] = array[j];
				}
			}
			if (IsCorrectDimension != flag)
			{
				UpdateData();
			}
			else
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(this, new SeriesDataAdapterPropertyUpdateInfo(this, "Values", base.Series));
			}
		}

		private void GenerateData(IList<IEnumerator<double>> valuesEnumerators)
		{
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (object xArgument in XArguments)
			{
				if (!GenerateEachArgumentY(xArgument, valuesEnumerators))
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			int num2 = ((num > 0) ? CalculateArgumentsCount(YArguments) : seriesPoints.Count);
			if (num == 0 && seriesPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				RemoveExcessPoints(num * num2);
			}
			dimension = new MatrixSize(num, num2);
			IsCorrectDimension = flag;
		}

		private IList<IEnumerator<double>> CreateValuesEnumerators()
		{
			List<IEnumerator<double>> list = new List<IEnumerator<double>>();
			if (Values == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			list.Add(Values.GetEnumerator());
			if (base.Series.View != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<IEnumerable<double>> additionalValues = base.Series.View.GetAdditionalValues(this);
				foreach (IEnumerable<double> item in additionalValues)
				{
					if (item == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					list.Add(item.GetEnumerator());
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool UpdateDataIfPossible()
		{
			Series3D series = base.Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				shouldUpdateData = true;
				seriesPoints.Clear();
				series.NotifyPointsClear();
				ResetDataSourceScale();
				IList<IEnumerator<double>> list = CreateValuesEnumerators();
				if (list != null && XArguments != null && YArguments != null)
				{
					GenerateData(list);
					series.NotifyPointsInsert(seriesPoints);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void UpdateData()
		{
			UpdateDataIfPossible();
		}

		internal override IList<IDataPoint> GetPoints()
		{
			return seriesPoints;
		}
	}
	public class Series3DTemplate : Series3DBase
	{
		private Series3DDataSourceAdapter ChartDataAdapter => ChartElementHelper.GetOwner<Series3DDataSourceAdapter>(this);

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (ChartDataAdapter != null)
			{
				ChartDataAdapter.UpdateAutocreatedSeries();
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessChanging(updateInfo);
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetCoreXArgumentScaleType()
		{
			return ScaleType.Numerical;
		}

		protected override ScaleType GetCoreYArgumentScaleType()
		{
			return ScaleType.Numerical;
		}

		private void CopyLabel(Series3D recipient)
		{
			if (base.Label != null)
			{
				object value = ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(Series3DBase.LabelProperty);
				if (value != null)
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)recipient).SetValue(Series3DBase.LabelProperty, ((ICloneable)value).Clone());
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BindingPropertiesContainer<SeriesLabel>.Apply(base.ActualLabel, recipient.ActualLabel);
			}
			Marker3DSeriesView.SetLabelPosition(recipient.ActualLabel, Marker3DSeriesView.GetLabelPosition(base.ActualLabel));
		}

		internal void CopyPropertiesForBinding(Series3D recipient)
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				if (recipient.View == null || ((object)recipient.View).GetType() != ((object)base.View).GetType())
				{
					recipient.View = base.View.CreateCopyForBinding();
				}
				else
				{
					recipient.View.CopyPropertiesForBinding(base.View);
				}
			}
			recipient.Legend = base.Legend;
			recipient.LegendTextPattern = base.LegendTextPattern;
			recipient.CheckedInLegend = base.CheckedInLegend;
			recipient.CheckableInLegend = base.CheckableInLegend;
			recipient.ShowInLegend = base.ShowInLegend;
			recipient.Visible = base.Visible;
			recipient.CrosshairEnabled = base.CrosshairEnabled;
			recipient.XArgumentScaleType = base.XArgumentScaleType;
			recipient.YArgumentScaleType = base.YArgumentScaleType;
			recipient.CrosshairLabelVisibility = base.CrosshairLabelVisibility;
			recipient.CrosshairLabelPattern = base.CrosshairLabelPattern;
			recipient.CrosshairLabelTemplate = base.CrosshairLabelTemplate;
			recipient.LabelsVisibility = base.LabelsVisibility;
			CopyLabel(recipient);
		}

		internal Series3D CreateSeriesForBinding()
		{
			Series3D series3D = new Series3D();
			CopyPropertiesForBinding(series3D);
			return series3D;
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			if (ChartDataAdapter != null)
			{
				ChartDataAdapter.UpdateData();
			}
			base.EndInit();
		}
	}

	public enum UnitType
	{
		Absolute,
		Percent
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(RangeValueConverter))]
	public class Unit : Chart3DDependencyObject
	{
		private const double InternalFactor = 100.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(double), typeof(Unit), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, OnPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UnitTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UnitType", typeof(UnitType), typeof(Unit), new PropertyMetadata(UnitType.Absolute, OnPropertyChanged));

		private double internalValue;

		private UnitType internalUnitType;

		[Category("Common")]
		[Description("Returns the value of the unit.")]
		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Common")]
		[Description("Returns the type of the unit.")]
		public UnitType UnitType
		{
			get
			{
				return (UnitType)GetValue(UnitTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UnitTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Unit unit)
			{
				unit.UpdateInternal();
			}
		}

		public Unit()
			: this(double.NaN)
		{
		}

		public Unit(double value)
			: this(value, UnitType.Absolute)
		{
		}

		public Unit(double value, UnitType unitType)
		{
			Value = value;
			UnitType = unitType;
		}

		private void UpdateInternal()
		{
			internalValue = ((UnitType == UnitType.Percent) ? (Value / 100.0) : Value);
			internalUnitType = UnitType;
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Unit();
		}

		public double GetAbsolute(double min, double max)
		{
			if (internalUnitType == UnitType.Percent)
			{
				return min + (max - min) * internalValue;
			}
			return internalValue;
		}

		public double GetNormalize(double min, double max)
		{
			if (internalUnitType == UnitType.Percent)
			{
				return internalValue;
			}
			return MathUtils.Normalize(internalValue, min, max);
		}
	}

		internal ColorStop CreateCloneForBinding()
		{

			{
				Color = Color,
				Offset = Offset
			};
		}
	}
	public class ColorStopCollection : ChartElementCollection<ColorStop>
	{
		private class ColorValueComparer : IComparer<ColorStop>
		{
			private readonly double min;

			private readonly double max;

			public ColorValueComparer(double min, double max)
			{
				this.min = min;
				this.max = max;
			}

			int IComparer<ColorStop>.Compare(ColorStop x, ColorStop y)
			{
				double absolute = x.Offset.GetAbsolute(min, max);
				double absolute2 = y.Offset.GetAbsolute(min, max);
				return absolute.CompareTo(absolute2);
			}
		}

		internal const double Epsilon = 1E-16;

		protected override ChartElementChange Change => base.Change | ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache;

		internal bool NoOffsets
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<ColorStop> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ColorStop current = enumerator.Current;
						if (!current.NoOffset)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool NoColors
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<ColorStop> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ColorStop current = enumerator.Current;
						if (!current.NoColor)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void SortAndDistinct(List<ColorStop> colorStops, double min, double max)
		{
			colorStops.Sort(new ColorValueComparer(min, max));
			if (colorStops.Count < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = colorStops[0].Offset.GetAbsolute(min, max);
			for (int i = 1; i < colorStops.Count; i++)
			{
				double absolute = colorStops[i].Offset.GetAbsolute(min, max);
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(absolute, num, 1E-16) == 0)
				{
					colorStops.RemoveAt(i--);
				}
				num = absolute;
			}
		}

		internal void AssignForBinding(ColorStopCollection colorValueDictionary)
		{
			Clear();
			if (colorValueDictionary == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColorStop item in colorValueDictionary)
			{
				Add(item.CreateCloneForBinding());
			}
		}

		internal List<ColorStop> CopySortAndDistinct(double min, double max)
		{
			List<ColorStop> list = new List<ColorStop>();
			list.AddRange(this);
			if (!NoOffsets)
			{
				SortAndDistinct(list, min, max);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public enum TextureMappingStrategy

	}
	public abstract class FillStyleBase : Chart3DDependencyObject, IPatternHolder
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LegendTextPatternProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LegendTextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(FillStyleBase), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowInLegendProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowInLegend", typeof(bool?), typeof(FillStyleBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LegendProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Legend", typeof(Legend), typeof(FillStyleBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Color defaultFirstColor = Colors.Green;

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Color defaultLastColor = Colors.Blue;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the legend should display the item that the fill style provides.")]
		[Category("Legend")]
		public bool? ShowInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool?)GetValue(ShowInLegendProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowInLegendProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the text pattern specifying the text of the legend item of the fill style.")]
		[Category("Legend")]
		public string LegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LegendTextPatternProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend in which the legend item of the fill style should be shown.")]
		[Category("Legend")]
		public Legend Legend
		{
			get
			{
				return (Legend)GetValue(LegendProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LegendProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected BrushOffsetMappingHelper BrushOffsetMappingHelper { get; set; } = new BrushOffsetMappingHelper(null);

		protected Series3DViewBase View => base.Owner as Series3DViewBase;

		protected System.Windows.Media.Color DefaultFirstColor => defaultFirstColor;

		protected System.Windows.Media.Color DefaultLastColor => defaultLastColor;

		protected System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualBrush { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool DefaultShowInLegend => false;

		protected string ActualLegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LegendTextPattern))
				{
					return LegendTextPattern;
				}
				return DefaultLegendTextPattern;
			}
		}

		protected virtual string DefaultLegendTextPattern => "{S}";

		protected internal abstract TextureMappingStrategy TextureMappingStrategy { get; }

		internal Legend ActualLegend => Legend ?? View.Series.ActualLegend;

		PatternDataProvider IPatternHolder.GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return GetPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Color GetFistColor(Palette palette)
		{
			if (palette == null || palette.ActualColors.Count <= 0)
			{
				return DefaultFirstColor;
			}
			return palette.ActualColors[0];
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Color GetLastColor(Palette palette)
		{
			int num = ((palette != null && palette.ActualColors.Count > 0) ? (palette.ActualColors.Count - 1) : (-1));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return DefaultLastColor;
			}
			return palette.ActualColors[num];
		}

		protected virtual void AssignForBinding(FillStyleBase fillStyle)
		{
			if (fillStyle != null)
			{
				LegendTextPattern = fillStyle.LegendTextPattern;
				ShowInLegend = fillStyle.ShowInLegend;
				Legend = fillStyle.Legend;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrush(Palette palette, double minValue, double maxValue);

		protected internal virtual void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush = CreateBrush(palette, 0.0, 0.0);
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(ActualLegendTextPattern, this);
			patternParser.SetContext(series);
			legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, patternParser.GetText(), markerBrush));
		}

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSeriesLegendBrush(Series3D series)
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(series.BaseColor);
		}

		protected internal virtual PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "S")
			{
				return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(double value)
		{
			return ActualBrush ?? new SolidColorBrush(DefaultFirstColor);
		}

		internal bool GetActualShowInLegend(Series3D series)
		{
			if (ShowInLegend.HasValue)
			{
				return ShowInLegend.Value;
			}
			if ((series.ShowInLegend.HasValue && !series.ShowInLegend.Value) || !((ISeries)series).ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DefaultShowInLegend;
		}

		internal void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series)
		{
			if (GetActualShowInLegend(series))
			{
				FillLegendItems(legendItems, legend, series, series.Palette);
			}
		}

		internal FillStyleBase CreateCloneForBinding()
		{
			FillStyleBase fillStyleBase = (FillStyleBase)CreateInstanceCore();
			fillStyleBase.AssignForBinding(this);
			return fillStyleBase;
		}

		internal void UpdateBrushOffsetMapping(ILogarithmic logarithmic)
		{
			BrushOffsetMappingHelper = new BrushOffsetMappingHelper(logarithmic);
		}
	}
	public class GradientFillStyle : FillStyleBase
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ColorStopsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ColorStops", typeof(ColorStopCollection), typeof(GradientFillStyle), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColorStopsProperty = ColorStopsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseEqualLegendIntervalsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UseEqualLegendIntervals", typeof(bool), typeof(GradientFillStyle), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Gets or sets whether to use equal intervals in a gradient legend.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool UseEqualLegendIntervals
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(UseEqualLegendIntervalsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UseEqualLegendIntervalsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("Gets or sets the color stop collection of the fill style.")]
		public ColorStopCollection ColorStops => (ColorStopCollection)GetValue(ColorStopsProperty);

		protected override bool DefaultShowInLegend => true;

		protected override string DefaultLegendTextPattern => "{V}";

		protected internal override TextureMappingStrategy TextureMappingStrategy => TextureMappingStrategy.MapByYAxis;

		public GradientFillStyle()
		{
			SetValue(ColorStopsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ColorStopCollection>(this));
		}

		private List<ColorStop> GetActualColorStops(Palette palette, double min, double max)
		{
			ColorStopCollection colorStops = ColorStops;
			if (colorStops.Count == 0)
			{
				return new List<ColorStop>
				{
					new ColorStop(GetFistColor(palette), new Unit(0.0, UnitType.Percent)),
					new ColorStop(GetLastColor(palette), new Unit(100.0, UnitType.Percent))
				};
			}
			return GetActualColorStops(palette, min, max, colorStops.Count - 1);
		}

		private List<ColorStop> CreateDefaultColors(List<ColorStop> colorStops, Palette palette)
		{
			List<ColorStop> list = new List<ColorStop>(colorStops.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < colorStops.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new ColorStop(palette[i], colorStops[i].Offset));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<ColorStop> CreateDefaultOffsets(List<ColorStop> colorStops, int rangesCount)
		{
			if (colorStops.Count == 1)
			{
				return new List<ColorStop>
				{
					new ColorStop(colorStops[0].Color, new Unit(50.0, UnitType.Percent))
				};
			}
			List<ColorStop> list = new List<ColorStop>(colorStops.Count);
			int count = colorStops.Count;
			double num = 100.0 / (double)rangesCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new ColorStop(colorStops[i].Color, new Unit((double)i * num, UnitType.Percent)));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected double CalculateOffset(double value, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			return base.BrushOffsetMappingHelper.NormalizeOffset(value, minValue, maxValue);
		}

		protected List<ColorStop> GetActualColorStops(Palette palette, double min, double max, int rangesCount)
		{
			ColorStopCollection colorStops = ColorStops;
			List<ColorStop> list = colorStops.CopySortAndDistinct(min, max);
			if (colorStops.NoColors)
			{
				list = CreateDefaultColors(list, palette);
			}
			if (colorStops.NoOffsets)
			{
				list = CreateDefaultOffsets(list, rangesCount);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new GradientFillStyle();
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(FillStyleBase fillStyle)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(fillStyle);
			if (fillStyle is GradientFillStyle gradientFillStyle)
			{
				ColorStops.AssignForBinding(gradientFillStyle.ColorStops);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual double CalculateOffsetInBrush(LinearGradientBrush brush, double value, IMinMaxValues valuesRange)
		{
			return CalculateOffset(value, valuesRange.Min, valuesRange.Max);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrush(Palette palette, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection();
			List<ColorStop> actualColorStops = GetActualColorStops(palette, minValue, maxValue);
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(minValue, maxValue, 1E-16) == 0)
			{
				ColorStop colorStop = actualColorStops.OrderBy((ColorStop n) => Math.Abs(n.Offset.GetAbsolute(minValue, maxValue) - minValue)).FirstOrDefault();
				if (colorStop != null)
				{
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(colorStop.Color, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ColorStop item in actualColorStops)
				{
					double offset = CalculateOffset(item.Offset.GetAbsolute(minValue, maxValue), minValue, maxValue);
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(item.Color, offset));
				}
			}
			base.ActualBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection, 0.0)
			{
				MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
			return base.ActualBrush;
		}

		protected internal override PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "V")
			{
				return new ValueLegendItemDataProvider();
			}
			return base.GetPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected internal override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			IMinMaxValues valuesRange = series.GetValuesRange();
			List<ColorStop> actualColorStops = GetActualColorStops(palette, valuesRange.Min, valuesRange.Max);
			double num = actualColorStops[0].Offset.GetAbsolute(valuesRange.Min, valuesRange.Max);
			if (double.IsInfinity(num))
			{
				num = valuesRange.Min;
			}
			double num2 = actualColorStops[actualColorStops.Count - 1].Offset.GetAbsolute(valuesRange.Min, valuesRange.Max);
			if (double.IsInfinity(num2))
			{
				num2 = valuesRange.Max;
			}
			GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection();
			List<GradientLegendItemData> list = new List<GradientLegendItemData>();
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(base.ActualLegendTextPattern, this);
			foreach (ColorStop item in actualColorStops)
			{
				double absolute = item.Offset.GetAbsolute(valuesRange.Min, valuesRange.Max);
				patternParser.SetContext(absolute);
				double num3 = (UseEqualLegendIntervals ? (1.0 - (double)list.Count / (double)(actualColorStops.Count - 1)) : CalculateOffset(absolute, num2, num));
				gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(item.Color, num3));
				list.Add(new GradientLegendItemData(num3, patternParser.GetText(), item.Color));
			}
			double angle = ((base.ActualLegend.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? 90.0 : 0.0);
			LinearGradientBrush markerBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection, angle);
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, patternParser.GetText(), markerBrush));
			}
			else
			{
				legendItems.Add(new GradientLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, markerBrush, list));
			}
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(double value)
		{
			if (!(base.ActualBrush is LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush))
			{
				return base.GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(value);
			}
			double offset = CalculateOffsetInBrush(linearGradientBrush, value, base.View.Series.GetValuesRange());
			System.Windows.Media.Color relativeColor = linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.GetRelativeColor(offset);
			return new SolidColorBrush(relativeColor);
		}
	}

	public class StripeFillStyle : GradientFillStyle
	{
		private class ColorValueRange
		{
			public double Min { get; private set; }

			public double Max { get; private set; }

			public System.Windows.Media.Color Color { get; private set; }

			public ColorValueRange(double min, double max, System.Windows.Media.Color color)
			{
				Min = min;
				Max = max;
				Color = color;
			}
		}

		protected override string DefaultLegendTextPattern => "{V1} - {V2}";

		private List<ColorValueRange> CreatePredefinedRanges(Palette palette, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			List<ColorValueRange> list = new List<ColorValueRange>();
			double num = (maxValue - minValue) / (double)palette.ActualColors.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < palette.ActualColors.Count; i++)
			{
				double min = minValue + num * (double)i;
				double max = minValue + num * (double)(i + 1);
				list.Add(new ColorValueRange(min, max, palette.ActualColors[i]));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<ColorValueRange> GetActualRanges(Palette palette, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			if (base.ColorStops.Count == 0)
			{
				return CreatePredefinedRanges(palette, minValue, maxValue);
			}
			List<ColorStop> actualColorStops = GetActualColorStops(palette, minValue, maxValue, base.ColorStops.Count);
			List<ColorValueRange> list = new List<ColorValueRange>();
			for (int i = 0; i < actualColorStops.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new ColorValueRange(actualColorStops[i].Offset.GetAbsolute(minValue, maxValue), actualColorStops[i + 1].Offset.GetAbsolute(minValue, maxValue), actualColorStops[i].Color));
			}
			ColorStop colorStop = actualColorStops[actualColorStops.Count - 1];
			if (colorStop.Offset.GetAbsolute(minValue, maxValue) < maxValue)
			{
				list.Add(new ColorValueRange(colorStop.Offset.GetAbsolute(minValue, maxValue), maxValue, colorStop.Color));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrushCore(Palette palette, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection();
			List<ColorValueRange> actualRanges = GetActualRanges(palette, minValue, maxValue);
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(minValue, maxValue, 1E-16) == 0)
			{
				ColorValueRange colorValueRange = actualRanges.OrderBy((ColorValueRange n) => Math.Abs(n.Min - minValue)).FirstOrDefault();
				if (colorValueRange != null)
				{
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(colorValueRange.Color, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ColorValueRange item in actualRanges)
				{
					double offset = CalculateOffset(item.Min, minValue, maxValue);
					double offset2 = CalculateOffset(item.Max, minValue, maxValue);
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(item.Color, offset));
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(item.Color, offset2));
				}
			}
			return new LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection, 0.0)
			{
				MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new StripeFillStyle();
		}

		protected internal override double CalculateOffsetInBrush(LinearGradientBrush brush, double value, IMinMaxValues valuesRange)
		{
			double num = base.CalculateOffsetInBrush(brush, value, valuesRange);
			foreach (GradientStop gradientStop in brush.GradientStops)
			{
				if (num <= gradientStop.Offset)
				{
					num = gradientStop.Offset;
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "V1" || patternConstant == "V2")
			{
				return new ValueRangeLegendItemDataProvider(patternConstant);
			}
			return base.GetPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrush(Palette palette, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			if (palette.ActualColors.Count == 0 && base.ColorStops.Count == 0)
			{
				base.ActualBrush = new SolidColorBrush(base.DefaultFirstColor);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ActualBrush = CreateBrushCore(palette, minValue, maxValue);
			}
			return base.ActualBrush;
		}

		protected internal override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend, Series3D series, Palette palette)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(base.ActualLegendTextPattern, this);
			IMinMaxValues valuesRange = series.GetValuesRange();
			foreach (ColorValueRange actualRange in GetActualRanges(palette, valuesRange.Min, valuesRange.Max))
			{
				patternParser.SetContext(new double[2] { actualRange.Min, actualRange.Max });
				legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, series.ActualView, series, patternParser.GetText(), new SolidColorBrush(actualRange.Color)));
			}
		}
	}

		private static void ActualLabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

		private static void LabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DBase series3DBase)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is SeriesLabel value))
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)series3DBase).SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, (object)new SeriesLabel());
				}
				else
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)series3DBase).SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, (object)value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static ChartElementChange CalculateViewChangeUpdateType(Series3DViewBase oldView, Series3DViewBase newView)
		{
			ChartElementChange chartElementChange = ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache;
			if (oldView == null || newView == null || oldView.PointInterfaceType != newView.PointInterfaceType)
			{
				chartElementChange |= ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries;
			}
			return chartElementChange;
		}

		private static void ViewPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DBase series3DBase && e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				Series3DViewBase series3DViewBase = e.NewValue as Series3DViewBase;
				series3DBase.UpdateActualView(series3DViewBase);
				ChartElementChange change = CalculateViewChangeUpdateType(e.OldValue as Series3DViewBase, series3DViewBase);
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, change);
			}
		}

		private static void XArgumentScaleTypePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DBase series3DBase)
			{
				series3DBase.argumentXScaleType = (ScaleType)e.NewValue;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		private static void YArgumentScaleTypePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DBase series3DBase)
			{
				series3DBase.argumentYScaleType = (ScaleType)e.NewValue;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		private static void VisiblePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "Visible"), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
		}

		private static void CheckedInLegendPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "CheckedInLegend"), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
		}

		public Series3DBase()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set2<Series3DBase>(this);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, (object)new SeriesLabel());
			UpdateActualView(null);
		}

		private void UpdateActualView(Series3DViewBase view)
		{
			if (actualView != null)
			{
				((IOwnedElement)actualView).Owner = null;
			}
			if (view == null)
			{
				actualView = new SurfaceSeriesView();
				((IOwnedElement)actualView).Owner = this;
			}
			else
			{
				actualView = view;
			}
		}

		private ScaleType GetDataSourceXArgumentScale()
		{
			return GetActualDataAdapter()?.GetDataSourceXArgumentScaleType() ?? ScaleType.Auto;
		}

		private ScaleType GetDataSourceYArgumentScale()
		{
			return GetActualDataAdapter()?.GetDataSourceYArgumentScaleType() ?? ScaleType.Auto;
		}

		private ScaleType GetActualXArgumentScaleType()
		{
			ScaleType dataSourceXArgumentScale = GetDataSourceXArgumentScale();
			if (dataSourceXArgumentScale != ScaleType.Auto)
			{
				return dataSourceXArgumentScale;
			}
			return GetCoreXArgumentScaleType();
		}

		private ScaleType GetActualYArgumentScaleType()
		{
			ScaleType dataSourceYArgumentScale = GetDataSourceYArgumentScale();
			if (dataSourceYArgumentScale != ScaleType.Auto)
			{
				return dataSourceYArgumentScale;
			}
			return GetCoreYArgumentScaleType();
		}

		protected virtual Chart3DSourceBase GetActualDataAdapter()
		{
			return ChartElementHelper.GetOwner<Series3DSourceBase>(this);
		}

		protected abstract ScaleType GetCoreXArgumentScaleType();

		protected abstract ScaleType GetCoreYArgumentScaleType();
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PointItemContainer", Type = typeof(SeriesPointItemContainer))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PointPresenter", Type = typeof(ChartContentPresenter))]
	public class SeriesPointItemPresentation : Panel, IHitTestableElement, IToolTipPointDataProvider
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointItem", typeof(SeriesPointItem), typeof(SeriesPointItemPresentation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, PointItemPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Model", typeof(PointModel), typeof(SeriesPointItemPresentation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, ModelControlPropertyChanged));

		private ModelControl modelControl;

		private Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointItem == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PointItem.Series;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanLayout
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointItem != null && PointItem.ActualLayout != null && Series != null)
				{
					return modelControl != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SeriesPointItem PointItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesPointItem)GetValue(PointItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public PointModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return (PointModel)GetValue(ModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => Series;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointItem == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PointItem.SeriesPointData.RefinedPoint;
			}
		}

		private static void PointItemPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPointItemPresentation seriesPointItemPresentation)
			{
				seriesPointItemPresentation.UpdatePointItem(e.NewValue as SeriesPointItem);
			}
		}

		private static void ModelControlPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPointItemPresentation seriesPointItemPresentation)
			{
				seriesPointItemPresentation.UpdateModelControl(e.NewValue as PointModel);
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointItemPresentation()
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding("PointItem.Model")
			{
				Source = this
			};
			SetBinding(ModelProperty, binding);
		}

		private void UpdateModelControl(PointModel model)
		{
			base.Children.Clear();
			modelControl = null;
			if (model != null)
			{
				modelControl = model.CreateModelControl();
				if (modelControl != null)
				{
					modelControl.SetPointItemBinding(PointItem);
					base.Children.Add(modelControl);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePointItem(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (modelControl != null)
			{
				modelControl.SetPointItemBinding(PointItem);
			}
			if (pointItem != null)
			{
				pointItem.PointItemPresentation = this;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			SeriesPointItem pointItem = PointItem;
			SeriesPointLayout seriesPointLayout = null;
			if (pointItem != null)
			{
				pointItem.Opacity = pointItem.SeriesPointData.GetPointOpacity();
				seriesPointLayout = pointItem.ActualLayout;
			}
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			Geometry geometry = null;
			System.Windows.Size size;
			if (CanLayout)
			{
				Series.CompletePointLayout(pointItem);
				size = new System.Windows.Size(seriesPointLayout.Bounds.Width, seriesPointLayout.Bounds.Height);
				Transform flippedTransform = modelControl.GetFlippedTransform(size);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(flippedTransform);
				geometry = seriesPointLayout.ClipGeometry;
				if (geometry != null)
				{
					geometry.Transform = flippedTransform;
				}
				if (seriesPointLayout.Transform != null)
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(seriesPointLayout.Transform);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				size = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (modelControl != null)
			{
				modelControl.Clip = geometry;
				modelControl.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
				if (modelControl is SimpleFunnel2DModelControl && CanLayout)
				{
					((SimpleFunnel2DModelControl)modelControl).SetGeometries(seriesPointLayout.ClipGeometry, seriesPointLayout.ClipGeometry);
				}
				modelControl.Measure(size);
				return new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Width, modelControl.DesiredSize.Width), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Height, modelControl.DesiredSize.Height));
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Width, 0.0), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Height, 0.0));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			SeriesPointItem pointItem = PointItem;
			if (CanLayout)
			{
				Series.CompletePointLayout(pointItem);
				modelControl.Arrange(PointItem.ActualLayout.Bounds);
			}
			else if (modelControl != null)
			{
				modelControl.Arrange(RectExtensions.Zero);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer : Panel, IFinishInvalidation
	{
		private readonly XYSeries series;

		private bool onSeriesAttachedRequested;

		protected AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer(XYSeries series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			PopulateChildren(base.Children, series);
			SetSelectedState(((IInteractiveElement)series).IsSelected);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (onSeriesAttachedRequested)
			{
				OnSeriesAttached();
				onSeriesAttachedRequested = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			XYSeries xYSeries = series;
			onSeriesAttachedRequested = xYSeries != null && xYSeries.Item?.IsDirectXSurfaceRendering == true;
		}

		protected abstract void PopulateChildren(UIElementCollection children, XYSeries series);

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		internal void Update(bool shouldUpdateGeometry)
		{
			foreach (AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Update(shouldUpdateGeometry);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSelectedState(bool isSelected)
		{
			foreach (AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is ISelectableAdditionalSeriesGeometry selectableAdditionalSeriesGeometry)
				{
					selectableAdditionalSeriesGeometry.SelectedState = isSelected;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateHighlightedGeometry()
		{
			foreach (AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase child in base.Children)
			{
				child.InvalidateHighlightedItems();
			}
		}

		internal void OnBitmapCachingChanged()
		{
			foreach (AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase child in base.Children)
			{
				child.OnBitmapCachingChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void OnSeriesDetached()
		{
			foreach (AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase child in base.Children)
			{
				child.OnSeriesDetached();
			}
		}

		internal void OnSeriesAttached()
		{
			foreach (AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase child in base.Children)
			{
				child.OnSeriesAttached();
			}
		}
	}
	public class AdditionalSeriesPointGeometryContainer : AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer
	{
		public AdditionalSeriesPointGeometryContainer(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override void PopulateChildren(UIElementCollection children, XYSeries series)
		{
			if (!series.Item.IsDirectXSurfaceRendering)
			{
				children.Add(new AdditionalSeriesPointGeometry(series));
			}
			else
			{
				children.Add(new NativeSeriesPointSurface(series));
			}
			children.Add(new AdditionalSeriesHighlightedPointGeometry(series));
		}
	}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool InvertedStep
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).InvertedStep;
			}
		}

		[Category("Crosshair")]
		[Description("Indicates whether the crosshair label displays the actual step value.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool SnapCrosshairToActualStep
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(SnapCrosshairToActualStepProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SnapCrosshairToActualStepProperty, value);
			}
		}

		bool IStepSeriesView.InvertedStep
		{
			get
			{
				return InvertedStep;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).InvertedStep = value;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AreaStepFullStackedSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AreaStepFullStackedSeries2D();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(SnapCrosshairToActualStepProperty);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalStepAreaSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			if (ActualEmptyPointOptions.Enabled)
			{
				return new StackedStepAreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator(new EmptyPointStripSplitter(ActualEmptyPointOptions), InvertedStep);
			}
			return new StackedStepAreaGeometryStripCreator(InvertedStep);
		}

		protected override SeriesContainer CreateContainer()
		{
			return new FullStackedStepInteractionContainer(this, isContinuousView: true);
		}

		protected override LegendItem CreateLegendItem(Legend legend, object sourceElement, string text, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerLineBrush, bool isSelected)
		{

		}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_AdditionalGeometryHolder", Type = typeof(ChartContentPresenter))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PointsPanel", Type = typeof(SimplePanel))]
	public class SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D : AreaFullStackedSeries2D, IStackedSplineView, ISplineView, IStackedView, IGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private const SplineAlgorithm defaultSplineAlgorithm = SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax;

		private const double defaultLineTension = 0.8;

		private SplineAlgorithm actualSplineAlgorithm;

		private double actualLineTension = 0.8;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SplineAlgorithmProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SplineAlgorithm", typeof(SplineAlgorithm), typeof(SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax, OnSplineAlgorithmChange));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineTensionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineTension", typeof(double), typeof(SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.8, OnLineTensionChange));

		[Description("Specifies the drawing algorithm of the SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SplineAlgorithm SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithm)GetValue(SplineAlgorithmProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SplineAlgorithmProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the line tension to be used when drawing splines of the SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double LineTension
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LineTensionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineTensionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private SplineAlgorithm ActualSplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return actualSplineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				actualSplineAlgorithm = value;
			}
		}

		private double ActualLineTension
		{
			get
			{
				return actualLineTension;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(value) && 0.0 <= value && value <= 1.0)
				{
					actualLineTension = value;
				}
				else
				{
					actualLineTension = 0.8;
				}
			}
		}

		SplineAlgorithmCore ISplineView.SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				ActualSplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)value;
			}
		}

		int ISplineView.LineTensionPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)(ActualLineTension * 100.0);
			}
			set
			{
				ActualLineTension = (double)value / 100.0;
			}
		}

		private static void OnSplineAlgorithmChange(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (obj is SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D splineAreaFullStackedSeries2D)
			{
				splineAreaFullStackedSeries2D.ActualSplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)e.NewValue;
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(obj, e);
		}

		private static void OnLineTensionChange(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (obj is SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D splineAreaFullStackedSeries2D)
			{
				splineAreaFullStackedSeries2D.ActualLineTension = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(obj, e);
		}

		public SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(SplineAlgorithmProperty);
			properties.Add(LineTensionProperty);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D();
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return new SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator((SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm, ActualLineTension, base.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap.Transformation, base.ActualAxisY.ScaleMap.Transformation, CreateSplineColorSplitter());
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new StackedSplineViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalSplineStackedAreaSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		IGeometryStrip IGeometryStripCreator.CreateStrip()
		{
			return new BezierRangeStrip((SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm, ActualLineTension, base.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap.Transformation, base.ActualAxisY.ScaleMap.Transformation);
		}
	}

		private SplineAlgorithm actualSplineAlgorithm;

		private double actualLineTension = 0.8;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SplineAlgorithmProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SplineAlgorithm", typeof(SplineAlgorithm), typeof(SplineAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax, OnSplineAlgorithmChange));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineTensionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineTension", typeof(double), typeof(SplineAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.8, OnLineTensionChange));

		[Description("Specifies the drawing algorithm of the SplineAreaSeries2D.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SplineAlgorithm SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithm)GetValue(SplineAlgorithmProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SplineAlgorithmProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the line tension to be used when drawing splines of the SplineAreaSeries2D.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double LineTension
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LineTensionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineTensionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private SplineAlgorithm ActualSplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return actualSplineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				actualSplineAlgorithm = value;
			}
		}

		private double ActualLineTension
		{
			get
			{
				return actualLineTension;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(value) && 0.0 <= value && value <= 1.0)
				{
					actualLineTension = value;
				}
				else
				{
					actualLineTension = 0.8;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool EnableAntialiasing => true;

		SplineAlgorithmCore ISplineView.SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				ActualSplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)value;
			}
		}

		int ISplineView.LineTensionPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)(ActualLineTension * 100.0);
			}
			set
			{
				ActualLineTension = (double)value / 100.0;
			}
		}

		private static void OnSplineAlgorithmChange(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (obj is SplineAreaSeries2D splineAreaSeries2D)
			{
				splineAreaSeries2D.ActualSplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)e.NewValue;
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(obj, e);
		}

		private static void OnLineTensionChange(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (obj is SplineAreaSeries2D splineAreaSeries2D)
			{
				splineAreaSeries2D.ActualLineTension = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(obj, e);
		}

		public SplineAreaSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SplineAreaSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(SplineAlgorithmProperty);
			properties.Add(LineTensionProperty);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SplineAreaSeries2D();
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return new SplineAreaGeometryStripCreator((SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm, ActualLineTension, base.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap.Transformation, base.ActualAxisY.ScaleMap.Transformation, CreateSplineColorSplitter());
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new SplineViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalSplineAreaSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}
	}

		private static void BorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is CircularAreaSeries2D circularAreaSeries2D)
			{
				SeriesBorder seriesBorder = e.NewValue as SeriesBorder;
				circularAreaSeries2D.SetValue(ActualBorderPropertyKey, (seriesBorder == null) ? SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateDefaultBorder(1) : seriesBorder);
				if (!circularAreaSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
				{
					circularAreaSeries2D.UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();

			}
		}

			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			if (d is CircularLineSeries2D circularLineSeries2D)

					circularLineSeries2D.SetActualLineStyle(e.OldValue as LineStyle, newValue);

	public abstract class CircularSeriesBase2D : XYSeries, IXYSeriesView, ISeriesView
	{

			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointAnimationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported => true;

		protected internal override VisualSelectionType SupportedSelectionType => VisualSelectionType.Size;

		protected override bool Is3DView => false;

		private CircularDiagram2D CircularDiagram => base.Diagram as CircularDiagram2D;

		ISeriesBase ISeriesView.Owner => this;

		IAxisData IXYSeriesView.AxisXData
		{
			get
			{
				if (CircularDiagram == null || !(SupportedDiagramType == CircularDiagram.GetType()))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CircularDiagram.AxisXImpl;
			}
		}

		IAxisData IXYSeriesView.AxisYData
		{
			get
			{
				if (CircularDiagram == null || !(SupportedDiagramType == CircularDiagram.GetType()))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CircularDiagram.AxisYImpl;
			}
		}

		IAxisData IXYSeriesView.AxisZData => null;

		ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter IXYSeriesView.CrosshairConverter => null;

		AggregateFunctionNative IXYSeriesView.AggregateFunction => (AggregateFunctionNative)base.AggregateFunction;

		ICustomAggregateFunction IXYSeriesView.CustomAggregateFunction => base.CustomAggregateFunction;

		bool IXYSeriesView.CrosshairEnabled => false;

		CrosshairContentShowModeCore IXYSeriesView.CrosshairContentShowMode => CrosshairContentShowModeCore.Label;

		string IXYSeriesView.CrosshairLabelPattern => string.Empty;

		IPane IXYSeriesView.Pane => ActualPane;

		int IXYSeriesView.PixelsPerArgument => 40;

		bool IXYSeriesView.SideMarginsEnabled => true;

		IEnumerable<IIndicator> IXYSeriesView.CrosshairIndicators => new IIndicator[0];

		IEnumerable<double> IXYSeriesView.GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return null;
		}

		List<ISeparatePaneIndicator> IXYSeriesView.GetSeparatePaneIndicators()
		{
			return new List<ISeparatePaneIndicator>();
		}

		List<IAffectsAxisRange> IXYSeriesView.GetIndicatorsAffectRange()
		{
			return new List<IAffectsAxisRange>();
		}

		MinMaxValues IXYSeriesView.CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(point.Argument);
		}

		private void UpdateAdditionalGeometryClip()
		{
			AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer additionalGeometry = base.AdditionalGeometry;
			if (CircularDiagram != null && additionalGeometry != null)
			{
				Rect actualViewport = CircularDiagram.ActualViewport;
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, actualViewport.Width, actualViewport.Height);
				if (GetActualSeriesAnimation() is IUnwindAnimation unwindAnimation)
				{
					rect = unwindAnimation.CreateAnimatedClipBounds(rect, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
				}
				additionalGeometry.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = rect
				};
			}
		}

		internal void CreateSeriesPointsLayout()
		{
			CircularDiagramMapping mapping = new CircularDiagramMapping(CircularDiagram);
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				allPointItem.Layout = CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping, allPointItem);
			}
			UpdateAdditionalGeometry();
			UpdateAdditionalGeometryClip();
		}

		internal void CreateSeriesLabelsLayout(Rect viewport)
		{
			CircularDiagramMapping mapping = new CircularDiagramMapping(CircularDiagram, viewport);
			Transform viewportRenderTransform = CircularDiagram.ViewportRenderTransform;
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in base.ActualLabel.Items)
			{
				item.Layout = CreateSeriesLabelLayout(item, mapping, viewportRenderTransform);
			}
		}

		internal void CreateSeriesLabelConnectorsLayout()
		{
			if (base.ActualLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in base.ActualLabel.Items)
			{
				item.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
			}
		}

		protected abstract XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, CircularDiagramMapping mapping, Transform transform);

		protected abstract SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(CircularDiagramMapping mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem);

		protected override void SeriesProgressChanged()
		{
			base.SeriesProgressChanged();
			SeriesAnimationBase actualSeriesAnimation = GetActualSeriesAnimation();
			if (actualSeriesAnimation == null || actualSeriesAnimation.ShouldAnimateAdditionalGeometry)
			{
				UpdateAdditionalGeometry();
			}
			if (actualSeriesAnimation == null || actualSeriesAnimation.ShouldAnimateClipBounds)
			{
				UpdateAdditionalGeometryClip();
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value;
		}

		protected internal virtual AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalSeriesPointGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			MarkerSeries2DPointLayout markerSeries2DPointLayout = pointItem.Layout as MarkerSeries2DPointLayout;
			if (CircularDiagram != null && markerSeries2DPointLayout != null && pointItem.RefinedPoint != null)
			{
				Rect rect = markerSeries2DPointLayout.InitialBounds;
				if (pointItem.IsSelected && VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsSizeSelection(SupportedSelectionType))
				{
					rect = SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CalculateSelectedBounds(rect);
				}
				if (GetActualPointAnimation() is CircularMarkerAnimationBase circularMarkerAnimationBase)
				{
					double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
					rect = circularMarkerAnimationBase.CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(rect, markerSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress);
				}
				Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
				if (!pointItem.Model.IsRenderable)
				{
					identity.ScaleAt(1.0, -1.0, 0.0, rect.Height / 2.0);
				}
				markerSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(rect, identity);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnPointProgressChanged()
		{
			UpdateAdditionalGeometry();
		}

		protected internal override bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return label.ConnectorVisible;
		}

		protected override IMapping CreateDiagramMapping()
		{
			if (CircularDiagram == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new CircularDiagramMapping(CircularDiagram);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> andFillPointItems = base.Item.GetAndFillPointItems(point);
			if (andFillPointItems == null || andFillPointItems.Count <= 0)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Point);
			}
			return CalculateToolTipPoint(andFillPointItems[0], inLabel: false);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, bool inLabel)
		{
			Transform viewportRenderTransform = CircularDiagram.ViewportRenderTransform;
			CircularDiagramMapping circularDiagramMapping = new CircularDiagramMapping(CircularDiagram);
			System.Windows.Point point = viewportRenderTransform.Transform(circularDiagramMapping.GetDiagramPoint(pointItem.RefinedPoint.Argument, ((IValuePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Value));
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)CircularDiagram, (UIElement)base.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement);
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X + relativeElementRect.Left, point.Y + relativeElementRect.Top);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(PointAnimationProperty);
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerWidenAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerFadeInAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerSlideFromLeftCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerSlideFromRightCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerSlideFromTopCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerSlideFromBottomCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerSlideFromCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularMarkerSlideToCenterAnimation)));
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase CreateDefaultPointAnimation()
		{
			return new CircularMarkerSlideFromCenterAnimation();
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return GetXYDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		public override SeriesPointAnimationBase GetPointAnimation()
		{
			return PointAnimation;
		}

		public override void SetPointAnimation(SeriesPointAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is CircularMarkerAnimationBase)
			{
				PointAnimation = (CircularMarkerAnimationBase)value;
			}
		}
	}

		private static void BorderChangedInternal(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e, DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey)
		{
			if (d is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D circularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				SeriesBorder seriesBorder = e.NewValue as SeriesBorder;
				circularRangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue(propertyKey, (seriesBorder == null) ? SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateDefaultBorder(1) : seriesBorder);
				if (!circularRangeAreaSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
				{
					circularRangeAreaSeries2D.UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void Border1Changed(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BorderChangedInternal(d, e, ActualBorder1PropertyKey);
		}

		private static void Border2Changed(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BorderChangedInternal(d, e, ActualBorder2PropertyKey);
		}

		private static void ActualBorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeAreaSeries2D listener)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SeriesBorder, e.NewValue as SeriesBorder, listener);
			}
		}

		{

		}

		static CircularRangeAreaSeries2D()
		{
			Marker1ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker1Model", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty));
			Marker1SizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker1Size", typeof(int), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);
			Marker1VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker1Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			Marker2ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker2Model", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty));
			Marker2SizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker2Size", typeof(int), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);
			Marker2VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker2Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			Value2DataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Value2DataMember", typeof(string), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			Border1Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Border1", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Border1Changed));
			Border2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Border2", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Border2Changed));
			ActualBorder1PropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualBorder1", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualBorderChanged));
			ActualBorder1Property = ActualBorder1PropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ActualBorder2PropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualBorder2", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualBorderChanged));
			ActualBorder2Property = ActualBorder2PropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MinValueAngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("MinValueAngle", typeof(double), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(270.0, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			MaxValueAngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("MaxValueAngle", typeof(double), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(90.0, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			LabelKindProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("LabelKind", typeof(RangeAreaLabelKind), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			TransparencyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Transparency", typeof(double), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)AreaSeries2D.ValidateTransparency);
			SeriesAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesAnimation", typeof(CircularAreaAnimationBase), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.SeriesAnimationPropertyChanged));
			LabelValueSeparatorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LabelValueSeparator", typeof(string), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(", ", SeparatorPropertyChanged));
			LegendValueSeparatorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LegendValueSeparator", typeof(string), typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(", ", SeparatorPropertyChanged));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(MinValueAngleProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelKindProperty);
		}

		private double GetNormalizeRadianAngle(double angleDegree)
		{
			angleDegree = ((ActualPane is Pane { Rotated: not false }) ? (-90.0 + angleDegree) : (0.0 - angleDegree));
			double angleRadian = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angleDegree);
			return GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(angleRadian);
		}

		protected abstract TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue2Internal(SeriesPoint point);

		protected internal override double[] GetPointValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return new double[2]
			{
				point.NonAnimatedValue,
				GetValue2Internal(point)
			};
		}

		protected internal override void SetPointValues(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, double[] values, DateTime[] dateTimeValues, TimeSpan[] timeSpanValues)
		{
			base.SetPointValues(seriesPoint, values, dateTimeValues, timeSpanValues);
			if (values != null && values.Length > 1)
			{
				SetValue2Internal(seriesPoint, values[1]);
			}
			if (dateTimeValues != null && dateTimeValues.Length > 1)
			{
				SetDateTimeValue2Internal(seriesPoint, dateTimeValues[1]);
			}
			if (timeSpanValues != null && timeSpanValues.Length > 1)
			{
				SetTimeSpanValue2Internal(seriesPoint, timeSpanValues[1]);
			}
		}

		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.Value_1)
			{
				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value_2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointValueVisible(SeriesPointItem pointItem, RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				return Marker2Visible;
			}
			return Marker1Visible;
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				return Marker2Model;
			}
			return Marker1Model;
		}

		}
