		{
			RangeAreaLabelKind labelKind = GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel);
			return RangeAreaSeriesHelper.GetValueLevelForLabel(refinedPoint, labelKind);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetLabelsTexts(SeriesLabel label, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (base.ActualLabel.Formatter != null)
			{
				string dataLabelText = base.ActualLabel.Formatter.GetDataLabelText(refinedPoint);
				return new string[1] { dataLabelText };
			}
			return RangeAreaSeriesHelper.GetLabelsTexts(refinedPoint, GetActualLabelTextPattern(label), LabelValueSeparator, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal, GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel), this);
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValueFormat(valueScaleType);
			if (pointOptionsContainer is LegendPointOptionsContainer)
			{
				return "{V1" + text + "}" + LegendValueSeparator + "{V2" + text + "}";
			}
			return "{V" + text + "}";
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Max(((IRangePoint)point).Value1, ((IRangePoint)point).Value2);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Min(((IRangePoint)point).Value1, ((IRangePoint)point).Value2);
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)point).Value1), Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)point).Value2));
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, CircularDiagramMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = labelItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel) == RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel)
			{
				double value = (refinedPoint.Value1 + refinedPoint.Value2) / 2.0;
				System.Windows.Point anchorPoint = transform.Transform(((IMapping)mapping).GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, value));
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, DXRectangle.Empty);
			}
			double labelAngle = RangeAreaSeriesHelper.GetLabelAngle(refinedPoint, labelItem.PointItem.ValueLevel, GetMinValueAngle(labelItem.Label), GetMaxValueAngle(labelItem.Label));
			double normalizeRadianAngle = GetNormalizeRadianAngle(labelAngle);
			double value2 = ((labelItem.PointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? refinedPoint.Value1 : refinedPoint.Value2);
			System.Windows.Point point = transform.Transform(((IMapping)mapping).GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, value2));
			DXRectangle excludedRectangle = GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CalcAnchorHole(point, labelItem.Label.Indent));
			return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, point, labelItem.Label.Indent, normalizeRadianAngle, excludedRectangle);
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(CircularDiagramMapping mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			int markerSize = ((pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? Marker1Size : Marker2Size);
			double value = ((pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? refinedPoint.Value1 : refinedPoint.Value2);
			return SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping.Viewport.Size, markerSize, mapping.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, value));
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(Value2DataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(TransparencyProperty);
			properties.Add(Marker1SizeProperty);
			properties.Add(Marker1VisibleProperty);
			properties.Add(Marker2SizeProperty);
			properties.Add(Marker2VisibleProperty);
			properties.Add(LabelValueSeparatorProperty);
			properties.Add(LegendValueSeparatorProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(Marker1ModelProperty);
			properties.Add(Marker2ModelProperty);
			properties.Add(Border1Property);
			properties.Add(Border2Property);
			properties.Add(SeriesAnimationProperty);
		}

		protected internal override void CollectLabelProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectLabelProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MinValueAngleProperty);
			properties.Add(MaxValueAngleProperty);
			properties.Add(LabelKindProperty);
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is SeriesBorder)
			{
				UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularAreaZoomInAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularAreaSpinAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularAreaSpinZoomInAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(CircularAreaUnwindAnimation)));
			base.FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(animationKinds);
		}

		protected override Transform CreateSeriesAnimationTransform(IMapping mapping)
		{
			if (GetActualSeriesAnimation() is CircularAreaAnimationBase circularAreaAnimationBase)
			{
				return circularAreaAnimationBase.CreateAnimatedTransformation(mapping.Viewport, mapping.GetDiagramOriginPoint(), base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetPenBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			return ColorUtils.GetNotTransparentBrush(brush);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesAnimationBase CreateDefaultSeriesAnimation()
		{
			return new CircularAreaZoomInAnimation();
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return ToolTipPatternUtils.DateTimeRangeViewPointPatterns;
			}
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.RangeViewPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return label.ConnectorVisible;
		}

		public override void SetSeriesAnimation(SeriesAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is CircularAreaAnimationBase)
			{
				SeriesAnimation = (CircularAreaAnimationBase)value;
			}
		}

		public override SeriesAnimationBase GetSeriesAnimation()
		{
			return SeriesAnimation;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CircularSeries2D : CircularSeriesBase2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarkerModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarkerSizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AngleProperty;

		protected override bool SupportsNativeRendering
		{
			get
			{
				if (MarkerModel != null)
				{
					return MarkerModel.IsRenderable;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the size of circular series point markers.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int MarkerSize
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(MarkerSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MarkerSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the model used to draw markers of a 2D Circular Series.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Marker2DModel MarkerModel
		{
			get
			{
				return (Marker2DModel)GetValue(MarkerModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MarkerModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static CircularSeries2D()
		{
			MarkerModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MarkerModel", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(CircularSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(ModelPropertyChanged));
			MarkerSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MarkerSize", typeof(int), typeof(CircularSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);
			AngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Angle", typeof(double), typeof(CircularSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(45.0, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(AngleProperty);
		}

		protected static void ModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				series.UpdateMarkerAdditionalGeometryVisibility();
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty(d, e);
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static double GetAngle(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return (double)label.GetValue(AngleProperty);
		}

		public static void SetAngle(SeriesLabel label, double value)
		{
			label.SetValue(AngleProperty, value);
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, CircularDiagramMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Point point = transform.Transform(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(labelItem.RefinedPoint.Argument, ((IValuePoint)labelItem.RefinedPoint).Value));
			SeriesLabel label = labelItem.Label;
			int indent = label.Indent;
			return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, point, indent, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(0.0 - GetAngle(label))), GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CalcAnchorHole(point, indent)));
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(CircularDiagramMapping mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			IXYPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			return SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping.Viewport.Size, MarkerSize, mapping.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Value));
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MarkerSizeProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MarkerModelProperty);
		}

		protected internal override void OnPointProgressChanged()
		{
			if (SupportsNativeRendering)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Item.AllPointItems)
				{
					CompletePointLayout(allPointItem);
				}
			}
			base.OnPointProgressChanged();
		}

		protected internal override void CollectLabelProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectLabelProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(AngleProperty);
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return MarkerModel;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(string argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(DateTime argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(TimeSpan argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}
	}

		private static void BorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D)
			{
				SeriesBorder seriesBorder = e.NewValue as SeriesBorder;
				funnelSeries2D.SetValue(ActualBorderPropertyKey, (seriesBorder == null) ? SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateDefaultBorder(1) : seriesBorder);
				funnelSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e);
			}
		}

		private static void ActualBorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeAreaSeries2D listener)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SeriesBorder, e.NewValue as SeriesBorder, listener);
			}
		}

		private static void BrushPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D)
			{
				DrawOptions drawOptions = funnelSeries2D.Item.DrawOptions;
				if (drawOptions != null)
				{
					drawOptions.Color = funnelSeries2D.BaseColor;
				}
				if (!funnelSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update(d, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
				}
			}
		}

		static FunnelSeries2D()
		{
			TitlesPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Titles", typeof(TitleCollection), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata());
			TitlesProperty = TitlesPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ModelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Model", typeof(Funnel2DModel), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty));
			BorderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Border", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, BorderChanged));
			ActualBorderPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualBorder", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualBorderChanged));
			ActualBorderProperty = ActualBorderPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			PointDistanceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PointDistance", typeof(int), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			HeightToWidthRatioProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HeightToWidthRatio", typeof(double), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			HeightToWidthRatioAutoProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HeightToWidthRatioAuto", typeof(bool), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			AlignToCenterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AlignToCenter", typeof(bool), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			PointAnimationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PointAnimation", typeof(Funnel2DSeriesPointAnimationBase), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.PointAnimationPropertyChanged));
			LabelPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("LabelPosition", typeof(Funnel2DLabelPosition), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Funnel2DLabelPosition.Right, Series.UpdateLabelPropertyWithClearDiagramCache));
			ColorEachProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ColorEach", typeof(bool), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			BrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Brush", typeof(SolidColorBrush), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, BrushPropertyChanged));
			PointShapeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PointShape", typeof(FunnelPointShape), typeof(FunnelSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(FunnelPointShape.Trapezoid, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(LabelPositionProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

				return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);

				return new DataSourcePatternDataProvider(patternConstant, null);
			}
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (pointItem.Layout is FunnelSeries2DPointLayout funnelSeries2DPointLayout)
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pointItem.PointItemPresentation, (UIElement)pointItem.Series.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement);
				result = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.X + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.GeometryBounds.X + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.GeometryBounds.Width / 2.0, relativeElementRect.Y + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.GeometryBounds.Y + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.GeometryBounds.Height / 2.0);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem.Layout is FunnelSeries2DPointLayout funnelSeries2DPointLayout && pointItem.RefinedPoint != null)
			{
				if (GetActualPointAnimation() is Funnel2DSeriesPointAnimationBase funnel2DSeriesPointAnimationBase)
				{
					double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
					Rect animatedBounds = funnel2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedBounds(funnelSeries2DPointLayout.GeometryBounds, viewport, actualProgress);
					funnelSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(animatedBounds);
				}
				else
				{
					funnelSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(funnelSeries2DPointLayout.GeometryBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> andFillPointItems = base.Item.GetAndFillPointItems(point);
			if (andFillPointItems == null || andFillPointItems.Count <= 0)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Point);
			}
			return CalculateToolTipPoint(andFillPointItems[0]);
		}

		internal List<FunnelSeries2DPointLayout> GetSeriesPointsLayout(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			IList<SeriesPointItem> allPointItems = base.Item.AllPointItems;
			if (base.Diagram == null)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("Can't create series points layout because the Diagram is null.");
				return null;
			}
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(this);
			if (refinedSeries == null || refinedSeries.Points.Count == 0 || allPointItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(availableSize);
			if (size.Height <= 0.0 || size.Width <= 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = true;
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in allPointItems)
			{
				IFunnelPoint refinedPoint = item.RefinedPoint;
				flag |= double.IsNaN(refinedPoint.NormalizedValue);
				flag2 &= refinedPoint.Value == 0.0;
				list.Add(item.RefinedPoint);
			}
			base.Item.ShowExclamation = flag || flag2;
			Funnel2DLayoutCalculator funnel2DLayoutCalculator = new Funnel2DLayoutCalculator(new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height), list, PointDistance);
			List<FunnelPointInfo> list2 = funnel2DLayoutCalculator.Calculate(PointShape == FunnelPointShape.Rectangle);
			if (list2 != null)
			{
				List<FunnelSeries2DPointLayout> list3 = new List<FunnelSeries2DPointLayout>();
				{
					foreach (FunnelPointInfo item2 in list2)
					{
						list3.Add(new FunnelSeries2DPointLayout(bounds: new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height), viewport: viewport, pointInfo: item2));
					}
					return list3;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(Rect pointsBounds, Rect labelBounds, SeriesLabelItem labelItem, double maxLabelWidth)
		{
			FunnelSeries2DPointLayout funnelSeries2DPointLayout = labelItem.PointItem.Layout as FunnelSeries2DPointLayout;
			if (labelItem.PointItem.Layout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double width = labelItem.LabelSize.Width;
			double y = pointsBounds.Y + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.InitTopLeftPoint.Y + 1.0;
			double num = funnelSeries2DPointLayout.InitTopLeftPoint.X + pointsBounds.X;
			double num2 = funnelSeries2DPointLayout.InitTopRightPoint.X + pointsBounds.X;
			FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D = labelItem.Label.Series as FunnelSeries2D;
			int length = funnelSeries2D.AdditionalLengthCalculator.GetLength(labelItem.RefinedPoint);
			int num3 = labelItem.Label.Indent + length;
			switch (GetLabelPosition(base.ActualLabel))
			{
			case Funnel2DLabelPosition.Center:
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point((num + num2) / 2.0, (2.0 * pointsBounds.Y + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.InitTopRightPoint.Y + funnelSeries2DPointLayout.InitBottomRightPoint.Y) / 2.0);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = point;
				return new FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point2, point2);
			}
			case Funnel2DLabelPosition.RightColumn:
			{
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(num2 - 1.0, y);
				System.Windows.Point centerPoint = new System.Windows.Point(labelBounds.Right - width / 2.0, y);
				return new FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point2, centerPoint);
			}
			case Funnel2DLabelPosition.LeftColumn:
			{
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(num + 1.0, y);
				System.Windows.Point centerPoint = new System.Windows.Point(labelBounds.Left + width / 2.0, y);
				return new FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point2, centerPoint);
			}
			case Funnel2DLabelPosition.Left:
			{
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(num + 1.0, y);
				System.Windows.Point centerPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num - width / 2.0 - (double)num3, y);
				return new FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point2, centerPoint);
			}
			case Funnel2DLabelPosition.Right:
			{
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(num2 - 1.0, y);
				System.Windows.Point centerPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num2 + width / 2.0 + (double)num3, y);
				return new FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point2, centerPoint);
			}
			default:
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown funnel label position");
				System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = point;
				return new FunnelSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point, point);
			}
			}
		}

		internal void CreateSeriesPointsLayout(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			List<FunnelSeries2DPointLayout> seriesPointsLayout = GetSeriesPointsLayout(availableSize);
			if (seriesPointsLayout != null && seriesPointsLayout.Count == base.Item.AllPointItems.Count)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Item.AllPointItems.Count; i++)
				{
					base.Item.AllPointItems[i].Layout = seriesPointsLayout[i];
				}
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(System.Windows.Size bounds)
		{
			if (HeightToWidthRatioAuto)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double num = bounds.Width * HeightToWidthRatio;
			double width = bounds.Width;
			if (num > bounds.Height)
			{
				num = bounds.Height;
				width = num / HeightToWidthRatio;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, num);
		}

			}
		}

	public class FunnelSeries2DPanel : Panel
	{
		private class FunnelSeries2DElements
		{
			private readonly UIElementCollection elementCollection;

			public PointsContainer PointsContainer => FindElementByType(typeof(PointsContainer)) as PointsContainer;

			public SeriesLabel Label => FindElementByType(typeof(SeriesLabel)) as SeriesLabel;

			public IEnumerable<UIElement> LayoutElements
			{
				get
				{
					foreach (UIElement item in elementCollection)
					{
						if (item is LayoutElementPresentation)
						{
							yield return item;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private UIElement FindElementByType(Type elementType)
			{
				foreach (UIElement item in elementCollection)
				{
					if (item.GetType() == elementType)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public FunnelSeries2DElements(UIElementCollection elementCollection)
			{
				this.elementCollection = elementCollection;
			}
		}

		private const double defaultWidth = 300.0;

		private const double defaultHeight = 300.0;

		private FunnelSeries2DElements seriesElements;

		private Rect pointsBounds;

		private FunnelSeries2D GetSeries()
		{
			FunnelSeries2DItemsControl funnelSeries2DItemsControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<FunnelSeries2DItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (funnelSeries2DItemsControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (FunnelSeries2D)funnelSeries2DItemsControl.Series;
		}

		private Rect CorrectPointsBounds(Rect initialBounds, Thickness padding)
		{
			double num = initialBounds.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = pointsBounds.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			return new Rect(initialBounds.Left + padding.Left, initialBounds.Top + padding.Top, num, num2);
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout(SeriesLabel seriesLabel, Rect viewport, Rect labelBounds)
		{
			FunnelSeries2D series = GetSeries();
			if (seriesLabel == null || series == null || seriesLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in seriesLabel.Items)
			{
				if (num < item.LabelSize.Width)
				{
					num = item.LabelSize.Width;
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in seriesLabel.Items)
			{
				item2.Layout = series.CreateSeriesLabelLayout(viewport, labelBounds, item2, num);
				item2.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
			}
		}

		private void MeasureLayoutElements(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement2 in seriesElements.LayoutElements)
			{
				if (layoutElement2 is ILayoutElement)
				{
					layoutElement2.Measure(constraint);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeLayoutElements(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement2 in seriesElements.LayoutElements)
			{
				if (layoutElement2 is ILayoutElement layoutElement)
				{
					Rect finalRect = ((layoutElement.Layout == null || !layoutElement.Layout.Visible || !(pointsBounds.Width > 0.0) || !(pointsBounds.Height > 0.0)) ? RectExtensions.Zero : ((!layoutElement.Layout.Bounds.IsEmpty) ? layoutElement.Layout.Bounds : new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height)));
					layoutElement2.Arrange(finalRect);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesLabelsConnectors()
		{
			SeriesLabel label = seriesElements.Label;
			if (label == null || label.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in label.Items)
			{
				item.UpdateConnectorCoordinates();
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Width);
			double height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Height);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			Rect rect = (pointsBounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height));
			seriesElements = new FunnelSeries2DElements(base.Children);
			MeasureLayoutElements(size);
			FunnelSeries2D series = GetSeries();
			SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
			Thickness thickness = CalculateLabelPadding(actualLabel, series, rect);
			Diagram diagram = series.Diagram;
			Thickness thickness2 = default(Thickness);
			if (diagram.Annotations != null && diagram.Annotations.Count > 0)
			{
				thickness2 = GetMaxAnnotationsCorrection(diagram, rect, series);
			}
			Thickness padding = new Thickness(Math.Max(thickness.Left, thickness2.Left), Math.Max(thickness.Top, thickness2.Top), Math.Max(thickness.Right, thickness2.Right), Math.Max(thickness.Bottom, thickness2.Bottom));
			pointsBounds = CorrectPointsBounds(rect, padding);
			Rect newPointsBounds = CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(series, pointsBounds);
			rect = CorrectLabelBounds(rect, pointsBounds, newPointsBounds);
			pointsBounds = newPointsBounds;
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0 - pointsBounds.Left, 0.0 - pointsBounds.Top, width, height);
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.Viewport = rect2;
			}
			ItemsControl pointsContainer = seriesElements.PointsContainer;
			if (pointsContainer != null)
			{
				pointsContainer.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = rect2
				};
				pointsContainer.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(pointsBounds.Width, pointsBounds.Height));
			}
			CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout(actualLabel, pointsBounds, rect);
			return size;
		}

		private Thickness GetMaxAnnotationsCorrection(Diagram diagram, Rect availableBounds, FunnelSeries2D series)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (diagram.Annotations != null && series.Diagram.AnnotationsPanel != null)
			{
				diagram.AnnotationsPanel.Measure(availableBounds.Size);
				diagram.AnnotationsPanel.Arrange(availableBounds);
				foreach (Annotation annotation in diagram.Annotations)
				{
					if (!annotation.ActualLabelMode || !AnnotationHelper.IsSeriesContainsAnnotation(annotation, series))
					{
						continue;
					}
					System.Windows.Shapes.Path annotationPath = annotation.AnnotationPath;
					SeriesPointItemPresentation seriesPointItemPresentation = null;
					if (series.Item.AllPointItems.Count > 0)
					{
						seriesPointItemPresentation = series.Item.AllPointItems[0].PointItemPresentation;
					}
					if (annotationPath != null && seriesPointItemPresentation != null)
					{
						Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)annotationPath, (UIElement)series.Diagram);
						relativeElementRect.Size = annotation.GeometryBounds.Size;
						Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)seriesPointItemPresentation, (UIElement)diagram);
						if (relativeElementRect.Left < relativeElementRect2.Left)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, relativeElementRect2.Left - relativeElementRect.Left);
						}
						if (relativeElementRect.Right > relativeElementRect2.Right)
						{
							num3 = Math.Max(num3, relativeElementRect.Right - relativeElementRect2.Right);
						}
						if (relativeElementRect.Top < relativeElementRect2.Top)
						{
							num2 = Math.Max(num2, relativeElementRect2.Top - relativeElementRect.Top);
						}
						if (relativeElementRect.Bottom > relativeElementRect2.Bottom)
						{
							num4 = Math.Max(num4, relativeElementRect.Bottom - relativeElementRect2.Bottom);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new Thickness(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		private Thickness CalculateLabelPadding(SeriesLabel label, FunnelSeries2D series, Rect labelBounds)
		{
			Thickness result;
			if (label != null && series != null)
			{
				Funnel2DLabelPosition labelPosition = FunnelSeries2D.GetLabelPosition(label);
				List<FunnelSeries2DPointLayout> seriesPointsLayout = series.GetSeriesPointsLayout(labelBounds.Size);
				if (label == null || seriesPointsLayout == null || label.Items == null || label.Items.Count != seriesPointsLayout.Count)
				{
					return new Thickness(0.0);
				}
				List<FunnelLabelInfo> list = new List<FunnelLabelInfo>();
				for (int i = 0; i < label.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					SeriesLabelItem seriesLabelItem = label.Items[i];
					list.Add(new FunnelLabelInfo(seriesLabelItem.RefinedPoint, new GRealSize2D(seriesLabelItem.LabelSize.Width, seriesLabelItem.LabelSize.Height), seriesPointsLayout[i].PointInfo));
				}
				Thickness thickness = Funnel2DLabelCorrectionCalculator.CalculateMaxLabelPadding(labelBounds, series.AdditionalLengthCalculator, list, label.Indent, series.AlignToCenter, series.HeightToWidthRatioAuto, labelPosition);
				result = new Thickness(thickness.Left, thickness.Top, thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				result = new Thickness(1.0);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Rect CorrectLabelBounds(Rect labelBounds, Rect pointsBounds, Rect newPointsBounds)
		{
			if (pointsBounds.Width > newPointsBounds.Width)
			{
				double num = pointsBounds.Width - newPointsBounds.Width;
				return new Rect(labelBounds.X + num / 2.0, labelBounds.Y, labelBounds.Width - num, labelBounds.Height);
			}
			return labelBounds;
		}

		private Rect CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(FunnelSeries2D series, Rect pointsBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = series.CorrectBoundsBySizeAndRatio(pointsBounds.Size);
			if (pointsBounds.Width > size.Width)
			{
				double num = pointsBounds.Width - size.Width;
				return new Rect(pointsBounds.X + num / 2.0, pointsBounds.Y, pointsBounds.Width - num, pointsBounds.Height);
			}
			if (pointsBounds.Height > size.Height)
			{
				double num2 = pointsBounds.Height - size.Height;
				return new Rect(pointsBounds.X, pointsBounds.Y + num2 / 2.0, pointsBounds.Width, pointsBounds.Height - num2);
			}
			return pointsBounds;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			ArrangeLayoutElements(finalSize);
			UpdateSeriesLabelsConnectors();
			seriesElements.PointsContainer?.Arrange(pointsBounds);
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class FunnelSeries2DPointsPanel : SimplePanel
	{
		private FunnelSeries2D Series => base.DataContext as FunnelSeries2D;

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (Series != null)
			{
				Series.CreateSeriesPointsLayout(availableSize);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}
	}
	public enum SplineAlgorithm
	{
		StrictMinMax,
		Cardinal
	}
	public class SplineSeries2D : LineSeries2D, ISplineView
	{
		private const SplineAlgorithm defaultSplineAlgorithm = SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax;

		private const double defaultLineTension = 0.8;

		private SplineAlgorithm actualSplineAlgorithm;

		private double actualLineTension = 0.8;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SplineAlgorithmProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SplineAlgorithm", typeof(SplineAlgorithm), typeof(SplineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(SplineAlgorithm.StrictMinMax, OnSplineAlgorithmChange));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineTensionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineTension", typeof(double), typeof(SplineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.8, OnLineTensionChange));

		[Description("Specifies the drawing algorithm of the SplineSeries2D.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SplineAlgorithm SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithm)GetValue(SplineAlgorithmProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SplineAlgorithmProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the line tension to be used when drawing splines of the SplineSeries2D.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double LineTension
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LineTensionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineTensionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private SplineAlgorithm ActualSplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return actualSplineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				actualSplineAlgorithm = value;
			}
		}

		private double ActualLineTension
		{
			get
			{
				return actualLineTension;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(value) && 0.0 <= value && value <= 1.0)
				{
					actualLineTension = value;
				}
				else
				{
					actualLineTension = 0.8;
				}
			}
		}

		SplineAlgorithmCore ISplineView.SplineAlgorithm
		{
			get
			{
				return (SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm;
			}
			set
			{
				ActualSplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)value;
			}
		}

		int ISplineView.LineTensionPercent
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)(ActualLineTension * 100.0);
			}
			set
			{
				ActualLineTension = (double)value / 100.0;
			}
		}

		private static void OnSplineAlgorithmChange(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (obj is SplineSeries2D splineSeries2D)
			{
				splineSeries2D.ActualSplineAlgorithm = (SplineAlgorithm)e.NewValue;
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(obj, e);
		}

		private static void OnLineTensionChange(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (obj is SplineSeries2D splineSeries2D)
			{
				splineSeries2D.ActualLineTension = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(obj, e);
		}

		public SplineSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SplineSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(SplineAlgorithmProperty);
			properties.Add(LineTensionProperty);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SplineSeries2D();
		}

		protected override GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return new SplineGeometryStripCreator((SplineAlgorithmCore)ActualSplineAlgorithm, ActualLineTension, base.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap.Transformation, base.ActualAxisY.ScaleMap.Transformation, CreateSplineColorSplitter(), base.ShowIsolatedPoints);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalSplineSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new SplineViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}
	}
	public class NestedDonut2DGroupItemsControl : Diagram2DItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty NestedDonutGroupProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("NestedDonutGroup", typeof(NestedDonut2DGroup), typeof(NestedDonut2DGroupItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(Diagram2DItemsControl.PropertyChanged));

		[Category("Data")]
		public NestedDonut2DGroup NestedDonutGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return (NestedDonut2DGroup)GetValue(NestedDonutGroupProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NestedDonutGroupProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private void SetBinding(FrameworkElement target, DependencyProperty property, object source, string path)
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding(path);
			binding.Source = source;
			target.SetBinding(property, binding);
		}

		private PointsContainerPresenter CreatePointsContainerPresenter(SeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			PointsContainerPresenter pointsContainerPresenter = new PointsContainerPresenter();
			SetBinding(pointsContainerPresenter, PointsContainerPresenter.ItemsSourceProperty, seriesItem, "VisiblePointItems");
			SetBinding(pointsContainerPresenter, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, seriesItem, "Series");
			return pointsContainerPresenter;
		}

		protected override void CreateItems(HashSet<object> items)
		{
			NestedDonut2DGroup nestedDonutGroup = NestedDonutGroup;
			for (int i = 0; i < nestedDonutGroup.Count; i++)
			{
				items.Add(nestedDonutGroup[i]);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < nestedDonutGroup.Count; j++)
			{
				if (nestedDonutGroup[j].Series is NestedDonutSeries2D { TotalLabel: { } totalLabel })
				{
					items.Add(totalLabel);
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelConnectorItem labelConnectorItem in nestedDonutGroup.LabelConnectorItems)
			{
				items.Add(labelConnectorItem);
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem labelItem in nestedDonutGroup.LabelItems)
			{
				items.Add(labelItem);
			}
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new ChartContentPresenter();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (item is PieTotalLabel)
			{
				return;
			}
			ChartContentPresenter chartContentPresenter = (ChartContentPresenter)element;
			Type type = item.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(SeriesItem))
			{
				chartContentPresenter.Content = CreatePointsContainerPresenter((SeriesItem)item);
				return;
			}
			if (type == typeof(SeriesLabel))
			{
				FrameworkElement platformElement = ((Series)((SeriesLabel)item).Series).Diagram.Container.PlatformElement;
				SetBinding(chartContentPresenter, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, platformElement, "DataContext");
				chartContentPresenter.Content = item;
				return;
			}
			if (type == typeof(SeriesLabelItem) || type == typeof(SeriesLabelConnectorItem))
			{
				LayoutElementPresentation layoutElementPresentation = new LayoutElementPresentation();
				layoutElementPresentation.Content = GetItemPresentation(item);
				chartContentPresenter.Content = layoutElementPresentation;
				return;
			}
			MethodBase currentMethod = MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod();
			string message = $"The '{currentMethod.DeclaringType.Name}.{currentMethod.Name}' method cannot operate with an instance of the '{type.Name}' type passed as 'item' parameter.";
			throw new ArgumentException(message);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is PieTotalLabel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class NestedDonut2DGroupPanel : Panel
	{
		private Rect pointsBounds = RectExtensions.Zero;

		private List<NestedDonutSeries2D> seriesList;

		private List<ChartContentPresenter> pointsContainerList;

		private List<ChartContentPresenter> labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut;

		private List<ChartContentPresenter> labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts;

		private List<PieTotalLabel> totalLabels;

		private System.Windows.Size GetActualAvailableSize(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Width);
			double height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Height);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		private void SplitChildrenIntoGroups()
		{
			seriesList = new List<NestedDonutSeries2D>();
			pointsContainerList = new List<ChartContentPresenter>();
			labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut = new List<ChartContentPresenter>();
			labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts = new List<ChartContentPresenter>();
			totalLabels = new List<PieTotalLabel>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.Children[i] is ChartContentPresenter { Content: var content } chartContentPresenter)
				{
					if (content is PointsContainerPresenter)
					{
						pointsContainerList.Add(chartContentPresenter);
						PointsContainerPresenter pointsContainerPresenter = (PointsContainerPresenter)content;
						seriesList.Add((NestedDonutSeries2D)pointsContainerPresenter.DataContext);
						continue;
					}
					if (!(content is LayoutElementPresentation))
					{
						MethodBase currentMethod = MethodBase.GetCurrentMethod();
						string message = $"The '{currentMethod.DeclaringType.Name}.{currentMethod.Name}' method cannot operate with an instance of the '{content.GetType().Name}' type contained in the 'Children' collection.";
						throw new ArgumentException(message);
					}
					ProcessLayoutElementPresentation(labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut, labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts, (LayoutElementPresentation)content, chartContentPresenter);
				}
				else if (base.Children[i] is PieTotalLabel item)
				{
					totalLabels.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessLayoutElementPresentation(List<ChartContentPresenter> labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut, List<ChartContentPresenter> labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts, LayoutElementPresentation layoutElementPresentation, ChartContentPresenter contentPresenter)
		{
			object content = layoutElementPresentation.Content;
			if (content is SeriesLabelConnectorPresentation)
			{
				SeriesLabelConnectorPresentation seriesLabelConnectorPresentation = (SeriesLabelConnectorPresentation)content;
				NestedDonutSeries2D nestedDonutSeries2D = (NestedDonutSeries2D)seriesLabelConnectorPresentation.Label.Series;
				if (!nestedDonutSeries2D.IsOuter.HasValue)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Core calculations should be performed before. IsOuter status should be determinated.");
				}
				if (nestedDonutSeries2D.IsOuter.Value)
				{
					labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut.Add(contentPresenter);
				}
				else
				{
					labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts.Add(contentPresenter);
				}
			}
			else if (content is SeriesLabelPresentation)
			{
				SeriesLabelPresentation seriesLabelPresentation = (SeriesLabelPresentation)content;
				NestedDonutSeries2D nestedDonutSeries2D2 = (NestedDonutSeries2D)seriesLabelPresentation.Label.Series;
				if (!nestedDonutSeries2D2.IsOuter.HasValue)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Core calculations should be performed before. IsOuter status should be determinated.");
				}
				if (nestedDonutSeries2D2.IsOuter.Value)
				{
					labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut.Add(contentPresenter);
				}
				else
				{
					labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts.Add(contentPresenter);
				}
			}
		}

		private Rect CorrectPointsBounds(Rect initialBounds, Thickness padding)
		{
			double num = initialBounds.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return new Rect(initialBounds.X, initialBounds.Y, 0.0, initialBounds.Height);
			}
			double num2 = initialBounds.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				return new Rect(initialBounds.X, initialBounds.Y, num, 0.0);
			}
			return new Rect(initialBounds.Left + padding.Left, initialBounds.Top + padding.Top, num, num2);
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout(List<NestedDonutSeries2D> seriesList, Rect pointBounds, Rect availableBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Point donutCenter = new System.Windows.Point(0.5 * (pointBounds.Left + pointBounds.Right), 0.5 * (pointBounds.Top + pointBounds.Bottom));
			double maxRadius = 0.5 * Math.Min(pointBounds.Width, pointBounds.Height);
			NestedDonutSeries2D nestedDonutSeries2D = seriesList[0];
			ChartDebug.Assert(nestedDonutSeries2D.IsOuter.Value);
			CalculateLabelLayoutForSeries(nestedDonutSeries2D, availableBounds, donutCenter, maxRadius);
			for (int i = 1; i < seriesList.Count; i++)
			{
				CalculateLabelLayoutForSeries(seriesList[i], pointBounds, donutCenter, maxRadius);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateLabelLayoutForSeries(NestedDonutSeries2D series, Rect availableBounds, System.Windows.Point donutCenter, double maxRadius)
		{
			SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
			List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
			if (actualLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in actualLabel.Items)
			{
				item.Layout = series.CreateSeriesLabelLayout(donutCenter, maxRadius, availableBounds, item);
				item.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
				if (item.Layout != null)
				{
					list.Add((IPieLabelLayout)item.Layout);
				}
			}
			if (!series.LabelsResolveOverlapping)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(actualLabel), list, availableBounds, new GRealEllipse(donutCenter.ToGRealPoint2D(), maxRadius + (double)actualLabel.Indent, maxRadius + (double)actualLabel.Indent), series.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent, series.SweepDirection);
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in actualLabel.Items)
			{
				item2.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
			}
		}

		private void SetViewPortToAllSeries(Rect viewport, List<NestedDonutSeries2D> seriesList)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < seriesList.Count; i++)
			{
				seriesList[i].Viewport = viewport;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesLabelsConnectors(List<NestedDonutSeries2D> series)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
			{
				SeriesLabel actualLabel = series[i].ActualLabel;
				ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> items = actualLabel.Items;
				if (actualLabel != null && items != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < items.Count; j++)
					{
						items[j].UpdateConnectorCoordinates();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void MeasureLayoutElements(List<ChartContentPresenter> elements, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				elements[i].Measure(size);
			}
		}

		private void MeasurePointContainersAndSetClip(List<ChartContentPresenter> pointsContainerList, System.Windows.Size size, Rect clip)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pointsContainerList.Count; i++)
			{
				ChartContentPresenter chartContentPresenter = pointsContainerList[i];
				chartContentPresenter.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = clip
				};
				chartContentPresenter.Measure(size);
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeLayoutElements(List<ChartContentPresenter> elements, Rect availableBounds)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				ChartContentPresenter chartContentPresenter = elements[i];
				ILayoutElement layoutElement = (ILayoutElement)chartContentPresenter.Content;
				Rect finalRect = ((layoutElement.Layout != null && layoutElement.Layout.Visible && pointsBounds.Width > 0.0 && pointsBounds.Height > 0.0) ? ((!layoutElement.Layout.Bounds.IsEmpty) ? layoutElement.Layout.Bounds : availableBounds) : RectExtensions.Zero);
				chartContentPresenter.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
		}

		private void ArrangePointContainers(List<ChartContentPresenter> pointContainers, Rect pointsBounds)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pointContainers.Count; i++)
			{
				pointContainers[i].Arrange(pointsBounds);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size actualAvailableSize = GetActualAvailableSize(availableSize);
			SplitChildrenIntoGroups();
			ChartDebug.Assert(pointsContainerList.Count + labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut.Count + labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts.Count + totalLabels.Count == base.Children.Count);
			ChartDebug.Assert(seriesList.Count == pointsContainerList.Count);
			MeasureLayoutElements(labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut, actualAvailableSize);
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, actualAvailableSize.Width, actualAvailableSize.Height);
			ChartDebug.Assert(seriesList[0].IsOuter.Value);
			Thickness padding = Pie2DCalculator.CalculateMaxLabelAndAnnotationsPadding(rect, seriesList[0], seriesList[0].ActualLabel, obtainForAllAnnotation: true);
			pointsBounds = CorrectPointsBounds(rect, padding);
			MeasureLayoutElements(labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts, RectHelper.Size(pointsBounds));
			CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout(seriesList, pointsBounds, rect);
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0 - pointsBounds.Left, 0.0 - pointsBounds.Top, actualAvailableSize.Width, actualAvailableSize.Height);
			SetViewPortToAllSeries(rect2, seriesList);
			MeasurePointContainersAndSetClip(pointsContainerList, RectHelper.Size(pointsBounds), rect2);
			NestedDonutSeries2D nestedDonutSeries2D = seriesList[0];
			double num = nestedDonutSeries2D.CalculateNonExplodedPieRadius(Math.Min(pointsBounds.Width / 2.0, pointsBounds.Height / 2.0));
			double num2 = Math.Sqrt(2.0) * num;
			foreach (PieTotalLabel totalLabel in totalLabels)
			{
				totalLabel.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(num2, num2));
			}
			return actualAvailableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			List<ChartContentPresenter> list = new List<ChartContentPresenter>();
			list.AddRange(labelsAndConnectorsOfOuterDonut);
			list.AddRange(labelsAndConnectorsOfInnerDonuts);
			Rect availableBounds = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize);
			ArrangeLayoutElements(list, availableBounds);
			UpdateSeriesLabelsConnectors(seriesList);
			ArrangePointContainers(pointsContainerList, pointsBounds);
			if (totalLabels != null)
			{
				foreach (PieTotalLabel totalLabel in totalLabels)
				{
					Rect rectanglePlacedInCenter = pointsBounds.GetRectanglePlacedInCenter(totalLabel.DesiredSize);
					totalLabel.Arrange(rectanglePlacedInCenter);
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class NestedDonutSeries2D : PieSeries2D, ISupportSeriesGroups, INestedDoughnutSeriesView
	{
		private class DonutLayoutCalculator
		{
			private const double RoundAngle = 360.0;

			private IRefinedSeries RefinedSeries { get; set; }

			private NestedDonutSeries2D Series { get; set; }

			private INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries NestedDonutRefinedSeries { get; set; }

			internal double OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx { get; private set; }

			internal double OuterRadiusPx { get; private set; }

			internal double InnerRadiusPx { get; private set; }

			internal bool CalculationSuccess { get; private set; }

			internal Pie Pie { get; private set; }

			internal double RotationCcwDeg { get; private set; }

			public DonutLayoutCalculator(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool isOuterDonut, double halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, bool useSeriesAnimation = true)
			{
				RefinedSeries = refinedSeries;
				NestedDonutRefinedSeries = (INestedDoughnutRefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
				Series = (NestedDonutSeries2D)refinedSeries.Series;
				Calculate(isOuterDonut, halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, useSeriesAnimation);
			}

			private void Calculate(bool isOuterDonut, double halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, bool useSeriesAnimation)
			{
				OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx = CalculateNonExplodedRadiusOfOuterDonut(halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, NestedDonutRefinedSeries.ExplodedFactor);
				double num = NestedDonutRefinedSeries.HoleRadius * OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx;
				double num2 = OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx - NestedDonutRefinedSeries.TotalGroupIndentInPixels - num;
				if (isOuterDonut)
				{
					OuterRadiusPx = OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx;
				}
				else
				{
					OuterRadiusPx = OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx - NestedDonutRefinedSeries.StartOffset * num2 - NestedDonutRefinedSeries.StartOffsetInPixels;
				}
				double num3 = (MathUtils.IsNumericDouble(NestedDonutRefinedSeries.NormalizedWeight) ? (NestedDonutRefinedSeries.NormalizedWeight * num2) : 0.0);
				double num4 = OuterRadiusPx - num3;
				InnerRadiusPx = ((num4 < 0.0) ? 0.0 : num4);
				CalculationSuccess = InnerRadiusPx >= 0.0 && OuterRadiusPx - InnerRadiusPx > 1.0 && OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx >= OuterRadiusPx;
				Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase pie2DSeriesAnimationBase = (Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase)Series.GetActualSeriesAnimation();
				if (pie2DSeriesAnimationBase != null && CalculationSuccess && useSeriesAnimation)
				{
					CalculateAnimatedValues(pie2DSeriesAnimationBase);
					return;
				}
				Pie = new Pie(RefinedSeries, Series.SweepDirection, 360.0);
				RotationCcwDeg = Series.ActualRotation;
			}

			private double CalculateNonExplodedRadiusOfOuterDonut(double maxPossibleRadius, double maxExplodedFraction)
			{
				double num = maxPossibleRadius / (1.0 + maxExplodedFraction);
				if (!(num > 0.0))
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return num;
			}

			private void CalculateAnimatedValues(Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase seriesAnimation)
			{
				double progress = Series.SeriesProgress.Progress;
				OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedRadius(OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx, progress);
				OuterRadiusPx = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedRadius(OuterRadiusPx, progress);
				InnerRadiusPx = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedRadius(InnerRadiusPx, progress);
				double sweepAngle = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(360.0, progress);
				Pie = new Pie(RefinedSeries, Series.SweepDirection, sweepAngle);
				RotationCcwDeg = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedRotation(Series.ActualRotation, progress);
			}
		}

		public const double DefaultInnerIndent = 5.0;

		public const double DefaultWeight = 1.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Group", typeof(object), typeof(NestedDonutSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(GroupPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InnerIndentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("InnerIndent", typeof(double), typeof(NestedDonutSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(5.0, InnerIndentPropertyChanged, CoerceInnerIndent));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty WeightProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Weight", typeof(double), typeof(NestedDonutSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, WeightPropertyChanged, CoerceWeight));

		private bool? isOutside;

		protected override bool NeedSeriesGroupsInteraction => true;

		protected internal bool? IsOuter => isOutside;

		[Description("Specifies a group for all series having the same nested group value. These items are to be placed into the same nested donuts.")]

		{

				return 0.0;

		}

		{

				return 0.0;

		}

		protected internal override double GetMaxExplodedDistance(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (isOutside.HasValue && !isOutside.Value)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}

		protected internal override void CreateSeriesPointsLayout(System.Windows.Point donutCenter, double halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace)
		{
			if (!isOutside.HasValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Core calculations must have been performed before. IsOuter status must be known.");
			}
			DonutLayoutCalculator donutLayoutCalculator = new DonutLayoutCalculator(base.Item.RefinedSeries, isOutside.Value, halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace);
			if (!donutLayoutCalculator.CalculationSuccess)
			{
				SetNullLayoutForPointItems();
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = allPointItem.RefinedPoint.SeriesPoint;
				Slice slice = ((seriesPoint != null) ? donutLayoutCalculator.Pie[seriesPoint] : null);
				if (slice == null || slice.IsEmpty)
				{
					allPointItem.Layout = null;
					continue;
				}
				System.Windows.Point center = donutCenter;
				if (isOutside.Value && base.Points.Count > 1)
				{
					double pointExplodeDistance = GetPointExplodeDistance(seriesPoint);
					double num = pointExplodeDistance * donutLayoutCalculator.OuterRadiusPx;
					if (num > 0.0)
					{
						center = donutCenter.MoveByAngle(num, slice.MedianAngle - donutLayoutCalculator.RotationCcwDeg);
					}
				}
				System.Windows.Point relativeCenter = new System.Windows.Point(donutLayoutCalculator.OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx, donutLayoutCalculator.OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx);
				DonutSegment donutSegment = new DonutSegment(center, relativeCenter, donutLayoutCalculator.InnerRadiusPx, donutLayoutCalculator.OuterRadiusPx, slice, base.SweepDirection);
				donutSegment.RotateCCW(donutLayoutCalculator.RotationCcwDeg);
				allPointItem.Layout = new NestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout(base.Viewport, donutSegment, donutLayoutCalculator.OuterRadiusOfOuterDonutPx);
			}
		}

		protected internal override PieSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(System.Windows.Point donutCenter, double halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, Rect labelBounds, SeriesLabelItem labelItem)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = labelItem.PointItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint == null || refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!isOutside.HasValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Core calculation should be performed before. IsOutside status must be known.");
			}
			DonutLayoutCalculator donutLayoutCalculator = new DonutLayoutCalculator(base.Item.RefinedSeries, isOutside.Value, halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, useSeriesAnimation: false);
			if (!donutLayoutCalculator.CalculationSuccess)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (isOutside.Value)
			{
				return base.CreateSeriesLabelLayout(donutCenter, halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace, labelBounds, labelItem);
			}
			Pie pie = new Pie(base.Item.RefinedSeries, base.SweepDirection, 360.0);
			Slice slice = pie[refinedPoint.SeriesPoint];
			if (slice == null || slice.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = slice.MedianAngle - base.ActualRotation;
			double length = (donutLayoutCalculator.OuterRadiusPx - donutLayoutCalculator.InnerRadiusPx) / 2.0 + donutLayoutCalculator.InnerRadiusPx;
			System.Windows.Point point = donutCenter.MoveByAngle(length, num);
			return new PieSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point, point, num);
		}

		protected override PieSeriesLabel2DLayout CalculateLabelLayoutForInsidePosition(System.Windows.Point centerPie, SeriesLabelItem labelItem, double explodedDistance, double radius, double angle, double halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace)
		{
			DonutLayoutCalculator donutLayoutCalculator = new DonutLayoutCalculator(base.Item.RefinedSeries, isOutside.Value, halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace);
			System.Windows.Point point = centerPie.MoveByAngle((radius - donutLayoutCalculator.InnerRadiusPx) / 2.0 + donutLayoutCalculator.InnerRadiusPx + radius * explodedDistance, angle);
			return new PieSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point, point, angle);
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			NestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout = (NestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout)pointItem.Layout;
			if (nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout != null)
			{
				Pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase = (Pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase)GetActualPointAnimation();
				if (pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase != null)
				{
					double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
					System.Windows.Point center = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedPieCenter(nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalCenter, nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalOuterRadius, nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalMedianAngleDeg, nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress);
					double innerRadius = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedRadius(nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalInnerRadius, nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress);
					double outerRadius = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedRadius(nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalOuterRadius, nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress);
					double num = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedRadius(nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalOuterRadiusOfOuterDonut, nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress);
					double num2 = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.ArcAngleDeg, actualProgress);
					double startAngleDeg = nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalMedianAngleDeg + 0.5 * num2;
					double endAngleDeg = nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalMedianAngleDeg - 0.5 * num2;
					System.Windows.Point relativeCenter = new System.Windows.Point(num, num);
					DonutSegment segment = new DonutSegment(center, relativeCenter, innerRadius, outerRadius, startAngleDeg, endAngleDeg);
					nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.ChangeDuringPointAnimation(segment, num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.NestedDonutPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (pointItem.Layout is NestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout { FinalMedianAngleDeg: var finalMedianAngleDeg } nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout)
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pointItem.PointItemPresentation, (UIElement)pointItem.Series.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement);
				result = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.Width / 2.0, relativeElementRect.Height / 2.0).MoveByAngle(nestedDonutSeries2DPointLayout.FinalOuterRadius, finalMedianAngleDeg);
				result.X += relativeElementRect.Left;
				result.Y += relativeElementRect.Top;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private static bool ExplodedDistanceValidation(object explodedDistance)

		static PieSeries()
		{
			TitlesPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Titles", typeof(TitleCollection), typeof(PieSeries), new PropertyMetadata());
			TitlesProperty = TitlesPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			HoleRadiusPercentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HoleRadiusPercent", typeof(double), typeof(PieSeries), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(50.0, OnHoleRadiusPercentPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)HoleRadiusPercentValidation);
			ExplodedDistanceProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ExplodedDistance", typeof(double), typeof(PieSeries), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnExplodedDistancePropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ExplodedDistanceValidation);
			LabelPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("LabelPosition", typeof(PieLabelPosition), typeof(PieSeries), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PieLabelPosition.Outside, Series.UpdateLabelPropertyWithClearDiagramCache));
			PercentOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("PercentOptions", typeof(PercentOptions), typeof(PieSeries), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PointOptions.PercentOptionsPropertyChanged));
			LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent", typeof(int), typeof(PieSeries), new PropertyMetadata(-1, Series.UpdateSeriesPropertyWithClearDiagramCache));
			SeriesTitleTextPatternProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("SeriesTitleTextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(PieSeries), new PropertyMetadata(null, TextPatternPropertyChanged));
			OthersPointExplodedDistanceProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("OthersPointExplodedDistance", typeof(double), typeof(PieSeries), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(TopNOptionsBase.OptionsChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ExplodedDistanceValidation);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(ExplodedDistanceProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

		private SeriesPoint GetFullSeriesPoint(ISeriesPoint point)

			if (point is SeriesPoint result)

		}

			properties.Add(HoleRadiusPercentProperty);
		}

		}

		}

		{
			return new SimpleSeriesContainer(this);
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "A":
			case "V":
			case "VP":
			case "HINT":
			case "TV":
				return new SimplePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, null);
			case "S":
			case "G":
				return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
			default:
				return new DataSourcePatternDataProvider(patternConstant, null);
			}
		}

		{
			return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value;
		}

		protected override void OnFilterOptionsChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName == OthersPointExplodedDistanceProperty.Name)
			{
				OnExplodedDistanceChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnFilterOptionsChanged(propertyName);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnExplodedDistanceChanged()
		{
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual double GetMaxExplodedDistance(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, GetPointExplodeDistance(point.SeriesPoint));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal double GetMaxExplodedDistance()
		{
			return GetMaxExplodedDistance(Controller.GetRefinedSeries(this));
		}

		internal double GetPointExplodeDistance(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			SeriesPoint fullSeriesPoint = GetFullSeriesPoint(point);
			if (fullSeriesPoint != null)
			{
				if (fullSeriesPoint.IsAuxiliary && base.TopNOptionsInternal != null)
				{
					return GetOthersPointExplodedDistance(base.TopNOptionsInternal);
				}
				return GetExplodedDistance(fullSeriesPoint);
			}
			if (base.TopNOptionsInternal != null && point is AggregatedSeriesPoint { IsAuxiliary: not false })
			{
				return GetOthersPointExplodedDistance(base.TopNOptionsInternal);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			PercentOptions percentOptions = pointOptionsContainer.GetPercentOptions(PercentOptionsProperty);
			return pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValuePatternFromPercentOptions(percentOptions, valueScaleType);
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateConfiguration()
		{
			if (ConfigurationInfo != null)
			{
				if (ConfigurationInfo.ExplodedPointsIndexes.Count > 0)
				{
					SetExplodedDistance(base.Points, 0.0);
					SetExplodedDistance(GetSeriesPointsByIndeces(ConfigurationInfo.ExplodedPointsIndexes), ConfigurationInfo.ExplodedDistance);
				}
				else
				{
					SetExplodedDistance(base.Points, ConfigurationInfo.ExplodedDistance);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.PieFunnelDonutPointPatterns;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(string argument, double value)

		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(TimeSpan argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		private double CalculateNonExplodedPieRadius(double maxRadius, double maxExplodedFraction)
		{
			double num = Math.Floor(maxRadius / (1.0 + maxExplodedFraction));
			if (!(num > 0.0))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		}

		internal double CalculateNonExplodedPieRadius(double maxRadius)
