		protected internal virtual void CreateSeriesPointsLayout(System.Windows.Point centerPie, double maxRadius)
		{
			if (base.Diagram == null)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("Can't create series points layout because the Diagram is null.");
				return;
			}
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(this);
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			centerPie = MathUtils.StrongRound(centerPie);
			double num = MathUtils.StrongRound(CalculateNonExplodedPieRadius(maxRadius));
			Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase seriesAnimation = SeriesAnimation;
			double rotation = ActualRotation;
			double sweepAngle = 360.0;
			if (seriesAnimation != null)
			{
				num = MathUtils.StrongRound(seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedRadius(num, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress));
				rotation = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedRotation(rotation, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
				sweepAngle = seriesAnimation.CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(sweepAngle, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
			}
			Pie pie = new Pie(refinedSeries, SweepDirection, sweepAngle);
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = ((allPointItem.RefinedPoint != null) ? allPointItem.RefinedPoint.SeriesPoint : null);
				Slice slice = ((seriesPoint != null) ? pie[seriesPoint] : null);
				if (slice != null && !slice.IsEmpty)
				{
					double pointExplodeDistance = GetPointExplodeDistance(seriesPoint);
					double num2 = pointExplodeDistance * num;
					System.Windows.Point point = centerPie;
					System.Windows.Point clipCenterPoint = point;
					if (num2 > 0.0)
					{
						point = centerPie.MoveByAngle(num2, slice.MedianAngle - ActualRotation);
						point = MathUtils.StrongRound(point);
						clipCenterPoint = centerPie.MoveByAngle(num2, slice.MedianAngle - ActualRotation);
					}
					allPointItem.Layout = PieSeries2DPointLayout.InitOrCreate(allPointItem.Layout as PieSeries2DPointLayout, Viewport, point, num, base.HoleRadiusPercent, rotation, slice.StartAngle, slice.FinishAngle, clipCenterPoint);
				}
				else
				{
					allPointItem.Layout = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual PieSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(System.Windows.Point centerPie, double maxRadius, Rect labelBounds, SeriesLabelItem labelItem)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = labelItem.PointItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint.SeriesPoint == null || refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = MathUtils.StrongRound(CalculateNonExplodedPieRadius(maxRadius));
			Pie pie = new Pie(base.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(this), SweepDirection);
			Slice slice = pie[refinedPoint.SeriesPoint];
			if (slice == null || slice.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num2 = MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(slice.MedianAngle - ActualRotation);
			double pointExplodeDistance = GetPointExplodeDistance(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			switch (PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(base.ActualLabel))
			{
			default:
				return new PieSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, centerPie.MoveByAngle(num * (1.0 + pointExplodeDistance), num2), base.ActualLabel.Indent, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num2));
			case PieLabelPosition.Inside:
				return CalculateLabelLayoutForInsidePosition(centerPie, labelItem, pointExplodeDistance, num, num2, maxRadius);
			case PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns:
			{
				System.Windows.Point anchorPoint = centerPie.MoveByAngle(num * (1.0 + pointExplodeDistance), num2);
				System.Windows.Point point = centerPie.MoveByAngle((double)base.ActualLabel.Indent + num * (1.0 + pointExplodeDistance), num2);
				if (Math.Cos(MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num2)) >= 0.0)
				{
					return new PieSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, anchorPoint, new System.Windows.Point(labelBounds.Right - labelItem.LabelSize.Width * 0.5, point.Y), num2);
				}
				return new PieSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, anchorPoint, new System.Windows.Point(labelBounds.Left + labelItem.LabelSize.Width * 0.5, point.Y), num2);
			}
			}
		}

		protected virtual PieSeriesLabel2DLayout CalculateLabelLayoutForInsidePosition(System.Windows.Point centerPie, SeriesLabelItem labelItem, double explodedDistance, double radius, double angle, double halfOfMinSideOfAvailableSpace)
		{
			double num = radius * base.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0;
			System.Windows.Point point = centerPie.MoveByAngle((radius - num) / 2.0 + num + radius * explodedDistance, angle);
			return new PieSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, point, point, angle);
		}

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (pointItem.Layout is PieSeries2DPointLayout pieSeries2DPointLayout)
			{
				double angleDeg = (pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialFinishAngle + pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialStartAngle) / 2.0 - pieSeries2DPointLayout.Rotation;
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pointItem.PointItemPresentation, (UIElement)pointItem.Series.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement);
				result = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.Width / 2.0, relativeElementRect.Height / 2.0).MoveByAngle(pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialRadius, angleDeg);
				result.X += relativeElementRect.Left;
				result.Y += relativeElementRect.Top;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem.Layout is PieSeries2DPointLayout pieSeries2DPointLayout)
			{
				Pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase = GetActualPointAnimation() as Pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase;
				System.Windows.Point pieCenter = pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialPieCenter;
				double radius = pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialRadius;
				double num = 0.5 * (pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialStartAngle + pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialFinishAngle);
				double num2 = Math.Abs(pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialFinishAngle - pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialStartAngle);
				if (pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase != null)
				{
					double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
					pieCenter = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedPieCenter(pieCenter, pieSeries2DPointLayout.InitialRadius, MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(num - pieSeries2DPointLayout.Rotation), pieSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress);
					radius = MathUtils.StrongRound(pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedRadius(radius, pieSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, actualProgress));
					num2 = pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase.CalculateAnimatedSweepAngle(num2, actualProgress);
				}
				pieSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(pieCenter, radius, num + 0.5 * num2, num - 0.5 * num2);
			}
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return Model;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase CreateDefaultPointAnimation()
		{
			return new Pie2DFlyInAnimation();
		}

		public override void SetPointAnimation(SeriesPointAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is Pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase)
			{
				PointAnimation = value as Pie2DSeriesPointAnimationBase;
			}
		}

		public override void SetSeriesAnimation(SeriesAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase)
			{
				SeriesAnimation = value as Pie2DSeriesAnimationBase;
			}
		}
	}
	public class PieSeries2DPanel : Panel
	{
		private class PieSeries2DElements
		{
			private readonly UIElementCollection elementCollection;

			public PointsContainer PointsContainer => FindElementByType(typeof(PointsContainer)) as PointsContainer;

			public PieTotalLabel TotalLabel => FindElementByType(typeof(PieTotalLabel)) as PieTotalLabel;

			public SeriesLabel Label => FindElementByType(typeof(SeriesLabel)) as SeriesLabel;

			public IEnumerable<UIElement> LayoutElements
			{
				get
				{
					foreach (UIElement item in elementCollection)
					{
						if (item is LayoutElementPresentation)
						{
							yield return item;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private UIElement FindElementByType(Type elementType)
			{
				foreach (UIElement item in elementCollection)
				{
					if (item.GetType() == elementType)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public PieSeries2DElements(UIElementCollection elementCollection)
			{
				this.elementCollection = elementCollection;
			}
		}

		private const double defaultWidth = 300.0;

		private const double defaultHeight = 300.0;

		private bool isCorrectingSize;

		private PieSeries2DElements seriesElements;

		private Rect viewport;

		private Rect pointsBounds;

		private Rect labelBounds;

		private PieSeries2D GetSeries()
		{
			PieSeries2DItemsControl pieSeries2DItemsControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<PieSeries2DItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (pieSeries2DItemsControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (PieSeries2D)pieSeries2DItemsControl.Series;
		}

		private void CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout(SeriesLabel seriesLabel, Rect viewport, Rect labelBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Point centerPie = new System.Windows.Point(0.5 * (viewport.Left + viewport.Right), 0.5 * (viewport.Top + viewport.Bottom));
			double num = 0.5 * Math.Min(viewport.Width, viewport.Height);
			PieSeries2D series = GetSeries();
			List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
			if (seriesLabel == null || series == null || seriesLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in seriesLabel.Items)
			{
				item.Layout = series.CreateSeriesLabelLayout(centerPie, num, labelBounds, item);
				item.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
				if (item.Layout != null)
				{
					list.Add((IPieLabelLayout)item.Layout);
				}
			}
			if (!series.LabelsResolveOverlapping)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(seriesLabel), list, labelBounds, new GRealEllipse(new GRealPoint2D(centerPie.X, centerPie.Y), num + (double)seriesLabel.Indent, num + (double)seriesLabel.Indent), series.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent, series.SweepDirection);
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in seriesLabel.Items)
			{
				item2.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
			}
		}

		private void MeasureLayoutElements(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement2 in seriesElements.LayoutElements)
			{
				if (layoutElement2 is ILayoutElement)
				{
					layoutElement2.Measure(constraint);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeLayoutElements(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement layoutElement2 in seriesElements.LayoutElements)
			{
				if (layoutElement2 is ILayoutElement layoutElement)
				{
					Rect finalRect = ((layoutElement.Layout == null || !layoutElement.Layout.Visible || !(pointsBounds.Width > 0.0) || !(pointsBounds.Height > 0.0)) ? RectExtensions.Zero : ((!layoutElement.Layout.Bounds.IsEmpty) ? layoutElement.Layout.Bounds : new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height)));
					layoutElement2.Arrange(finalRect);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesLabelsConnectors()
		{
			SeriesLabel actualLabel = GetSeries().ActualLabel;
			if (actualLabel == null || actualLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in actualLabel.Items)
			{
				item.UpdateConnectorCoordinates();
			}
		}

		private Rect CorrectPointsBounds(Rect initialBounds, Thickness padding)
		{
			double num = initialBounds.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = pointsBounds.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom;
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			return new Rect(initialBounds.Left + padding.Left, initialBounds.Top + padding.Top, num, num2);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size MeasureAndUpdateLayout(System.Windows.Size availableSize, bool allowUpdateChildren)
		{
			double width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Width);
			double height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Height);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			labelBounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height);
			pointsBounds = labelBounds;
			seriesElements = new PieSeries2DElements(base.Children);
			if (allowUpdateChildren)
			{
				MeasureLayoutElements(size);
			}
			PieSeries2D series = GetSeries();
			SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			thickness = Pie2DCalculator.CalculateMaxLabelAndAnnotationsPadding(labelBounds, series, actualLabel, obtainForAllAnnotation: false);
			pointsBounds = CorrectPointsBounds(labelBounds, thickness);
			viewport = new Rect(0.0 - pointsBounds.Left, 0.0 - pointsBounds.Top, width, height);
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.Viewport = viewport;
			}
			CalculateSeriesLabelsLayout(actualLabel, pointsBounds, labelBounds);
			if (allowUpdateChildren)
			{
				seriesElements.PointsContainer?.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(pointsBounds.Width, pointsBounds.Height));
				PieTotalLabel totalLabel = seriesElements.TotalLabel;
				double maxRadius = Math.Min(pointsBounds.Width / 2.0, pointsBounds.Height / 2.0);
				double num = Math.Sqrt(2.0) * series.CalculateNonExplodedPieRadius(maxRadius);
				if (totalLabel != null)
				{
					totalLabel.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
					{
						Rect = viewport
					};
					totalLabel.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(num, num));
				}
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			return MeasureAndUpdateLayout(availableSize, allowUpdateChildren: true);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect value = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
			if (!labelBounds.Equals(value) && !isCorrectingSize)
			{
				isCorrectingSize = true;
				MeasureAndUpdateLayout(finalSize, allowUpdateChildren: false);
				isCorrectingSize = false;
			}
			ArrangeLayoutElements(finalSize);
			UpdateSeriesLabelsConnectors();
			ItemsControl pointsContainer = seriesElements.PointsContainer;
			if (pointsContainer != null)
			{
				pointsContainer.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = viewport
				};
				pointsContainer.Arrange(pointsBounds);
			}
			PieTotalLabel totalLabel = seriesElements.TotalLabel;
			if (totalLabel != null)
			{
				Rect rectanglePlacedInCenter = pointsBounds.GetRectanglePlacedInCenter(totalLabel.DesiredSize);
				totalLabel.Arrange(rectanglePlacedInCenter);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public class PieSeries3D : PieSeries
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DepthTransformProperty;

		private Pie3DModel actualModel;

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(SimpleDiagram3D);

		protected internal override VisualSelectionType SupportedSelectionType => VisualSelectionType.Brightness;

		[Description("Gets the actual model used to draw elements of a 3D Pie (Donut) series.")]
		public Pie3DModel ActualModel => actualModel;

		[Description("Gets or sets the model used to draw elements of a 3D Pie (Donut) series.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Pie3DModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return (Pie3DModel)GetValue(ModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value specifiying how the depth of the 3D Pie (Donut) series is transformed.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double DepthTransform
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(DepthTransformProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DepthTransformProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool Is3DView => true;

		static PieSeries3D()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(PieSeries3D);
			ModelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Model", typeof(Pie3DModel), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ModelPropertyChanged));
			DepthTransformProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DepthTransform", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, Series.UpdateSeriesPropertyWithClearDiagramCache), DepthTransformValidation);
		}

		private static bool DepthTransformValidation(object depthTransform)
		{
			return (double)depthTransform > 0.0;
		}

		private static void ModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PieSeries3D pieSeries3D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is Pie3DModel pie3DModel))
				{
					pieSeries3D.actualModel = new RectanglePie3DModel();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, pieSeries3D.actualModel);
				}
				else
				{
					pieSeries3D.actualModel = pie3DModel;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
			Series.UpdateSeriesCloneablePropertyWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		public PieSeries3D()
		{
			actualModel = new RectanglePie3DModel();
			actualModel.SetOwner(this);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<PieSeries3D>(this);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return CalculateToolTipPoint(point);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new PieSeries3D();
		}

		protected internal override SeriesData CreateSeriesData()
		{
			base.SeriesData = new PieSeries3DData(this);
			return base.SeriesData;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(DepthTransformProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ModelProperty);
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Color GetSeriesPointColor(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (isSelected && !(ActualModel is PredefinedPie3DModel))
			{
				return VisualSelectionHelper.CustomModelSelectionColor;
			}
			return base.GetSeriesPointColor(refinedPoint, isSelected);
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeSeriesPointSelection(IPlatformSeriesPoint seriesPoint, bool isSelected)
		{
			base.ChangeSeriesPointSelection(seriesPoint, isSelected);
			if (base.Diagram is SimpleDiagram3D simpleDiagram3D)
			{
				base.Cache.UpdateSelectionForPointCache(seriesPoint, this, isSelected, shouldResetCache: true);
				simpleDiagram3D.InvalidateDiagram();
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(IPlatformSeriesPoint point)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			Diagram3D diagram3D = base.Diagram as Diagram3D;
			SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = base.Cache.GetSeriesPointCache(point);
			if (seriesPointCache != null && diagram3D != null && diagram3D.Container != null)
			{
				RefinedSeries refinedSeries = diagram3D.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(this);
				int num = diagram3D.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries.IndexOf(refinedSeries);
				if (diagram3D.VisualContainers.Count > num)
				{
					VisualContainer visualContainer = diagram3D.VisualContainers[num];
					Diagram3DDomain diagram3DDomain = diagram3D.CreateDomain(visualContainer);
					if (diagram3DDomain != null)
					{
						Point3D point2 = base.SeriesData.CalculateToolTipPoint(seriesPointCache, diagram3DDomain);
						result = diagram3DDomain.Project(point2);
						Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)visualContainer, (UIElement)diagram3D.Container.PlatformElement);
						result.X += relativeElementRect.Left;
						result.Y += relativeElementRect.Top;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private ChartControl chart;

		private DispatcherTimer initialTimer = new DispatcherTimer();

		private DispatcherTimer popTimer = new DispatcherTimer();

		private object tooltipObject;

		{

				{
					return hitInfo.SeriesPoint != null;
				}
				return true;
			}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!InSeriesPoint)
				{
					return hitInfo.Series;

		[Description("Occurs when a tooltip is appearing.")]

		public ChartToolTipController()
		{
			initialTimer.Tick += initialTimer_Tick;
			popTimer.Tick += popTimer_Tick;
		}

		private void initialTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ShowToolTip();
		}

		private void popTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (OpenMode == ToolTipOpenMode.OnHover)
			{
				CloseToolTip();
			}
			else
			{
				HideToolTip();
			}
		}

		private string GetToolTipText(string pattern)
		{
			if (InSeriesPoint)
			{
				return PatternHelper.GetPointTextByFormatString(pattern, hitInfo.Series, hitInfo.RefinedPoint);
			}
			return PatternHelper.GetSeriesTextByFormatString(pattern, hitInfo.Series);
		}

		private void FillPresentationData(ToolTipPresentationData presentationData, string text, object hint, bool showHint)
		{
			presentationData.ToolTipText = text;
			presentationData.Hint = (showHint ? hint : null);
			presentationData.ChartElement = (InSeriesPoint ? ((object)hitInfo.SeriesPoint) : ((object)hitInfo.Series));
		}

		private ToolTipItem CreateToolTipItem()
		{
			if (hitInfo?.Series?.Diagram == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ToolTipItem toolTipItem = new ToolTipItem();
			toolTipItem.Position = mousePosition;
			toolTipItem.ContentMargin = ContentMargin;
			object obj = (InSeriesPoint ? hitInfo.SeriesPoint.ToolTipHint : hitInfo.Series.ToolTipHint);
			bool showHint = chart.ActualToolTipOptions.ShowHint;
			bool showBeak = ShowBeak;
			string pattern = (InSeriesPoint ? hitInfo.Series.ActualToolTipPointPattern : (pattern = hitInfo.Series.ToolTipSeriesPattern));
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = (InSeriesPoint ? hitInfo.Series.ToolTipPointTemplate : hitInfo.Series.ToolTipSeriesTemplate);
			if (this.ToolTipOpening != null || this.ToolTipClosing != null)
			{
				currentEventArgs = new ChartToolTipEventArgs(obj, showHint, showBeak, pattern, dataTemplate, hitInfo.Series, hitInfo.SeriesPoint, chart);
			}
			RaiseOpeningEvent(currentEventArgs);
			if (currentEventArgs != null)
			{
				if (currentEventArgs.Cancel)
				{
					return null;
				}
				obj = currentEventArgs.Hint;
				dataTemplate = currentEventArgs.Template;
				pattern = currentEventArgs.Pattern;
				showBeak = currentEventArgs.ShowBeak;
				showHint = currentEventArgs.ShowHint;
			}
			toolTipItem.ContentTemplate = dataTemplate;
			string toolTipText = GetToolTipText(pattern);
			bool flag = (InSeriesPoint ? hitInfo.Series.ToolTipPointTemplateChanged : hitInfo.Series.ToolTipTemplateChanged);
			if ((obj == null || !showHint) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolTipText) && !flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FillPresentationData(toolTipItem.PresentationData, toolTipText, obj, showHint);
			toolTipItem.ToolTipPosition = ActualToolTipPosition;
			if (ActualToolTipPosition is ToolTipRelativePosition)
			{
				toolTipItem.Position = hitInfo.ToolTipPoint;
			}
			showBeak = showBeak && !(ActualToolTipPosition is ToolTipFreePosition);
			toolTipItem.BeakVisibility = ((!showBeak) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			toolTipItem.ShowShadow = !(ActualToolTipPosition is ToolTipFreePosition) && ShowShadow;
			return toolTipItem;
		}

		private void ShowToolTip()
		{
			initialTimer.Stop();
			chart.ToolTipItem = CreateToolTipItem();
			if (chart.ToolTipItem != null)
			{
				isClosed = false;
				if (AutoPopDelay.TotalMilliseconds != 0.0)
				{
					popTimer.Interval = AutoPopDelay;
					popTimer.Start();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateToolTip()
		{
			bool flag = ((hitInfo.SeriesPoint != null) ? chart.PointsToolTipEnabled : chart.SeriesToolTipEnabled);
			if (hitInfo != null && InSeries && flag)
			{
				if (!NewToolTipObject.Equals(tooltipObject))
				{
					CloseToolTip();
					initialTimer.Interval = InitialDelay;
					tooltipObject = NewToolTipObject;
					if (initialTimer.Interval.TotalMilliseconds != 0.0)
					{
						initialTimer.Start();
					}
					else
					{
						ShowToolTip();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HideToolTip();
			}
		}

		private void CloseToolTip()
		{
			initialTimer.Stop();
			popTimer.Stop();
			chart.ToolTipItem = null;
			if (!isClosed)
			{
				isClosed = true;
				RaiseClosingEvent(currentEventArgs);
			}
		}

		private void HideToolTip()
		{
			tooltipObject = null;
			CloseToolTip();
		}

		private void UpdateLockedState(ToolTipNavigationAction action)
		{
			if (action == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDown || action == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging)
			{
				toolTipUpdateLocked = true;
			}
			if (action == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseUp || action == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragEnd || action == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseLeave)
			{
				toolTipUpdateLocked = false;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessToolTipOnHover(ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction)
		{
			switch (navigationAction)
			{
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDown:
				if (CloseOnClick)
				{
					CloseToolTip();
				}
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.Zooming:
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown:
				CloseToolTip();
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging:
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.Inertia:
				HideToolTip();
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseUp:
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseFreeMove:
				if (actualState != ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown && !toolTipUpdateLocked)
				{
					CreateToolTip();
				}
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragEnd:
				tooltipObject = null;
				CreateToolTip();
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyUp:
				CreateToolTip();
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseLeave:
				HideToolTip();
				break;
			}
			actualState = navigationAction;
		}

		private void ProcessToolTipOnClick(ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction)
		{
			switch (navigationAction)
			{
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseUp:
				CreateToolTip();
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseFreeMove:
				if (toolTipUpdateLocked)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (hitInfo != null && InSeries)
				{
					if (!NewToolTipObject.Equals(tooltipObject))
					{
						CloseToolTip();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HideToolTip();
				}
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging:
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.Zooming:
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown:
				HideToolTip();
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDown:
				if (CloseOnClick)
				{
					if (isClosed)
					{
						HideToolTip();
					}
					else
					{
						CloseToolTip();
					}
				}
				break;
			case ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseLeave:
				HideToolTip();
				break;
			}
			actualState = navigationAction;
		}

		internal void ClearToolTip()
		{
			hitInfo = null;
		}

		internal void UpdateToolTip(System.Windows.Point position, ChartControl chart, ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction)
		{
			if (chart.SeriesToolTipEnabled || chart.PointsToolTipEnabled)
			{
				UpdateToolTip(position, chart, navigationAction, touchUses: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateToolTip(System.Windows.Point position, ChartControl chart, ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction, bool touchUses)
		{
			if (chart.SeriesToolTipEnabled || chart.PointsToolTipEnabled)
			{
				UpdateToolTip(position, chart, navigationAction, new ToolTipHitInfo(chart, position, chart.SeriesToolTipEnabled, touchUses));
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateToolTip(System.Windows.Point position, ChartControl chart, ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction, ToolTipHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.chart = chart;
			mousePosition = position;
			if (!chart.SeriesToolTipEnabled && !chart.PointsToolTipEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.hitInfo = hitInfo;
			if (hitInfo.Series == null || hitInfo.Series.ActualToolTipEnabled)
			{
				UpdateLockedState(navigationAction);
				if (OpenMode == ToolTipOpenMode.OnClick)
				{
					ProcessToolTipOnClick(navigationAction);
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessToolTipOnHover(navigationAction);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				initialTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseOpeningEvent(ChartToolTipEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.ToolTipOpening != null)
			{
				this.ToolTipOpening(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseClosingEvent(ChartToolTipEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.ToolTipClosing != null)
			{
				this.ToolTipClosing(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ChartToolTipController();
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Visible", GroupName = "VisibleStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Invisible", GroupName = "VisibleStates")]
	[NonCategorized]
	public class ToolTipControl : ChartElementBase, IVisualChildOwner
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ToolTipItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipItem", typeof(ToolTipItem), typeof(ToolTipControl), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, ToolTipItemPropertyChanged));

		private FrameworkElement toolTipPanel;

		private FrameworkElement toolTipContent;

		private ToolTipLayoutCalculator layoutCalculator;

		public ToolTipItem ToolTipItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (ToolTipItem)GetValue(ToolTipItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ToolTipItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement ToolTipPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolTipPanel == null)
				{
					toolTipPanel = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_ToolTipPanel");
				}
				return toolTipPanel;
			}
		}

		private static void ToolTipItemPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ToolTipControl toolTipControl)
			{
				if (e.NewValue != null)
				{
					toolTipControl.ShowToolTip();
				}
				else
				{
					toolTipControl.HideToolTip();
				}
				toolTipControl.InvalidateLayout();
			}
		}

		void IVisualChildOwner.InvalidateVisualChild(object sender)
		{
			if (sender is ToolTipPanel)
			{
				toolTipPanel = null;
			}
		}

		public ToolTipControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ToolTipControl>(this);
			layoutCalculator = new ToolTipLayoutCalculator(this);
		}

		private void ShowToolTip()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Visible", useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void HideToolTip()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Invisible", useTransitions: true);
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size GetToolTipContentSize()
		{
			if (toolTipContent == null)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			return toolTipContent.DesiredSize;
		}

		internal ToolTipLayout CalculateToolTipLayout(Rect bounds)
		{
			ToolTipLayout toolTipLayout = null;
			if (ToolTipItem != null)
			{
				if (ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipMousePosition)
				{
					toolTipLayout = layoutCalculator.CalculatePointLayout(bounds);
				}
				if (ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipFreePosition)
				{
					IDockTarget dockTarget = ((ToolTipFreePosition)ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition).DockTarget;
					toolTipLayout = ((dockTarget == null) ? layoutCalculator.CalculateFreeLayout(bounds, bounds.Size) : layoutCalculator.CalculateFreeLayout(dockTarget.GetBounds(), bounds.Size));
				}
				if (ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipRelativePosition)
				{
					toolTipLayout = layoutCalculator.CalculatePointLayout(bounds);
				}
				ToolTipItem.Layout = toolTipLayout;
				ToolTipItem.UpdateLayoutProperties();
			}
			return toolTipLayout;
		}

		internal void InvalidateLayout()
		{
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(ToolTipPanel);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			toolTipPanel = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_ToolTipPanel");
			if (LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_Popup") is Popup popup)
			{
				toolTipContent = popup.Child as FrameworkElement;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ToolTipPanel : ChartItemsPanelBase
	{
		private ToolTipControl ToolTipControl => base.DataContext as ToolTipControl;

		private Rect CalculateBounds()
		{
			Rect result = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), base.RenderSize);
			Rect result2 = Rect.Empty;
			ToolTipControl toolTipControl = ToolTipControl;
			if (toolTipControl == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			ToolTipItem toolTipItem = toolTipControl.ToolTipItem;
			if (toolTipItem == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (!(toolTipItem.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipFreePosition))
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = toolTipItem.Position;
				System.Windows.Point screenPoint = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(toolTipControl);
				System.Windows.Point position2 = Mouse.GetPosition(toolTipControl);
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(screenPoint.X + position2.X, screenPoint.Y + position2.Y);
				Rect screenRect = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenRect(point);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(screenPoint.X + position.X, screenPoint.Y + position.Y);
				if (point2.X < screenRect.Left)
				{
					point2.X = screenRect.Left;
				}
				if (point2.X > screenRect.Right)
				{
					point2.X = screenRect.Right;
				}
				if (point2.Y > screenRect.Bottom)
				{
					point2.Y = screenRect.Bottom;
				}
				result2 = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenRect(point2);
			}
			if (!result2.IsEmpty)
			{
				return result2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				Popup popup = child as Popup;
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(popup.Child);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect bounds = CalculateBounds();
			ToolTipLayout toolTipLayout = ToolTipControl?.CalculateToolTipLayout(bounds);
			if (toolTipLayout != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point screenPoint = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(ToolTipControl);
				System.Windows.Point position = toolTipLayout.Position;
				Rect focusedScreenRect = ChartScreenHelper.GetFocusedScreenRect(position, ToolTipControl);
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(position.X - screenPoint.X, position.Y - screenPoint.Y);
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					if (child is Popup popup)
					{
						AnnotationPanel annotationPanel = popup.Child as AnnotationPanel;
						popup.Child.InvalidateArrange();
						popup.Child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), popup.Child.DesiredSize));
						System.Windows.Point point2 = annotationPanel.CalculatePopupOffset();
						System.Windows.Point point3 = ChartScreenHelper.CorrectPointByTransform(new System.Windows.Point(point.X + point2.X, point.Y + point2.Y), ToolTipControl);
						point3 = new System.Windows.Point(screenPoint.X + point3.X, screenPoint.Y + point3.Y);
						popup.HorizontalOffset = Math.Max(point3.X, focusedScreenRect.Left);
						popup.VerticalOffset = Math.Max(point3.Y, focusedScreenRect.Top);
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}
	}
	public abstract class HitInfoBase
	{
		protected List<IHitTestableElement> HitTestableElements { get; } = new List<IHitTestableElement>();

		protected System.Windows.Point Point { get; }

		internal UIElement Chart { get; }

		public abstract bool InLegend { get; }

		public abstract bool InAxis { get; }

		[Description("Returns the value indicating whether the test point is within an axis label.")]
		public bool InAxisLabel => AxisLabel != null;

		[Description("Returns the value indicating whether the test point is within an axis title.")]
		public bool InAxisTitle => AxisTitle != null;

		[Description("Returns the value indicating whether the test point is within a custom legend item.")]
		public bool InCustomLegendItem => CustomLegendItem != null;

		[Description("Returns the axis label located under the test point.")]
		public AxisLabel AxisLabel => GetElementByType<AxisLabel>();

		[Description("Returns the axis title located under the test point.")]
		public AxisTitle AxisTitle => GetElementByType<AxisTitle>();

		[Description("Returns the custom legend item located under the test point.")]
		public CustomLegendItem CustomLegendItem => GetElementByType<CustomLegendItem>();

		protected HitInfoBase()
		{
		}

		protected HitInfoBase(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
		{
			Chart = chart;
			Point = point;
			if (Chart.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				PrepareHitTestableElements(radius);
			}
		}

		private void AddUniqueHitTestableElement(IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement)
		{
			if (hitTestableElement != null && !HitTestableElements.Contains(hitTestableElement))
			{
				HitTestableElements.Add(hitTestableElement);
			}
		}

		private HitTestResultBehavior OnHitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
		{
			IHitTestableElement parentHitTestableElement = HitTestingHelper.GetParentHitTestableElement(result.VisualHit);
			HitTestingHelper.ProcessHitTestableElement(parentHitTestableElement, Point);
			AddUniqueHitTestableElement(parentHitTestableElement);
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
		}

		private object GetElementByType(Type elementType, bool isAdditionalElement)
		{
			foreach (IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement in HitTestableElements)
			{
				object obj = (isAdditionalElement ? hitTestableElement.AdditionalElement : hitTestableElement.Element);
				if (obj != null && elementType.IsAssignableFrom(obj.GetType()))
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected CustomAxisLabel GetCustomAxisLabel()
		{
			if (!(GetAdditionalElementByType(typeof(AxisLabelItem)) is AxisLabelItem axisLabelItem))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return axisLabelItem.CustomAxisLabel;
		}

		protected void PrepareHitTestableElements(double radius)
		{
			if (radius <= 0.0)
			{
				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(Chart, null, OnHitTestResult, new ChartPointHitTestParameters(Point));
				return;
			}
			double num = 2.0 * radius;
			Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(Point.X - radius, Point.Y - radius, num, num));
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(Chart, null, OnHitTestResult, new ChartGeometryHitTestParameters(geometry));
		}

		protected T GetElementByType<T>() where T : class
		{
			return (T)GetElementByType(typeof(T), isAdditionalElement: false);
		}

		protected object GetElementByType(Type elementType)
		{
			return GetElementByType(elementType, isAdditionalElement: false);
		}

		protected object GetAdditionalElementByType(Type elementType)
		{
			return GetElementByType(elementType, isAdditionalElement: true);
		}
	}

			get

			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the series title or chart title located under the test point.")]

		[Description("Returns the legend located under the test point.")]
		public Legend Legend => GetElementByType<Legend>();

		[Description("Returns the annotation located under the test point.")]
		public Annotation Annotation => GetElementByType<Annotation>();

		internal ChartHitInfoBase()
		{
		}

		internal ChartHitInfoBase(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
			: base(chart, point, radius)
		{
		}

		internal ChartHitInfoBase(Axis3D axis)

			this.axis = axis;
		}
	}
	public class ChartHitInfo : ChartHitInfoBase
	{
		private readonly Series series3D;

		private readonly RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

		private readonly SeriesLabel label3D;

		private Diagram diagram;

		private Series Series3D
		{
			get
			{
				if (series3D == null)
				{
					if (refinedPoint == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(refinedPoint).Owner as Series;
				}
				return series3D;
			}
		}

		internal RefinedPoint RefinedPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					if (GetAdditionalElementByType(typeof(RefinedPoint)) == null)
					{
						return GetElementByType(typeof(RefinedPoint)) as RefinedPoint;
					}
					return GetAdditionalElementByType(typeof(RefinedPoint)) as RefinedPoint;
				}
				return refinedPoint;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesLabel Label3D => label3D;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within a Pie series’ total label.")]
		public bool InPieTotalLabel => PieTotalLabel != null;

		[Description("Returns the value indicating whether the test point is within a total label.")]
		public bool InStackedBarTotalLabel => StackedBarTotalLabel != null;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within a pane.")]
		public bool InPane => Pane != null;

		[Description("Returns the value that indicates whether the test point is within a pane title.")]
		public bool InPaneTitle => PaneTitle != null;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within a diagram.")]
		public bool InDiagram => Diagram != null;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within a constant line.")]
		public bool InConstantLine => ConstantLine != null;

		[Description("Returns a value that indicates whether the test point is in a constant line title.")]
		public bool InConstantLineTitle => ConstantLineTitle != null;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within a strip.")]
		public bool InStrip => Strip != null;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within a series.")]
		public bool InSeries => Series != null;

		[Description("Gets a value that indicates whether the test point is within a series point.")]
		public bool InSeriesPoint => SeriesPoint != null;

		[Description("Gets a value indicating whether the test point is within an indicator.")]
		public bool InIndicator => Indicator != null;

		[Description("Returns the Pie series’ total label that is under the test point.")]
		public PieTotalLabel PieTotalLabel => GetElementByType<PieTotalLabel>();

		[Description("Returns the topmost total label that is under the test point.")]
		public StackedBarTotalLabel StackedBarTotalLabel => GetElementByType<StackedBarTotalLabel>();

		[Description("Gets a pane which is located under the test point.")]
		public Pane Pane => GetAdditionalElementByType(typeof(Pane)) as Pane;

		[Description("Returns a pane title that is located under the test point.")]
		public PaneTitle PaneTitle => GetElementByType<PaneTitle>();

		[Description("Gets a diagram which is located under the test point.")]
		public Diagram Diagram => diagram ?? GetElementByType<Diagram>();

		[Description("Gets a constant line which is located under the test point.")]
		public ConstantLine ConstantLine => GetElementByType<ConstantLine>();

		[Description("Returns a constant line title that is located under the test point.")]
		public ConstantLineTitle ConstantLineTitle
		{
			get
			{
				ConstantLineTitlePresentation constantLineTitlePresentation = (ConstantLineTitlePresentation)base.HitTestableElements.Find((IHitTestableElement e) => e.GetType() == typeof(ConstantLineTitlePresentation));
				if (constantLineTitlePresentation != null)
				{
					return (ConstantLineTitle)constantLineTitlePresentation.Title;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets a strip which is located under the test point.")]
		public Strip Strip => GetElementByType<Strip>();

		[Description("Gets an indicator which is located under the test point.")]
		public Indicator Indicator => GetElementByType<Indicator>();

		[Description("Gets the series which is located under the test point.")]
		public Series Series => Series3D ?? GetElementByType<Series>();

		[Description("Gets a series point which is located under the test point.")]
		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (RefinedPoint == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(RefinedPoint);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets a custom axis label which is located under the test point.")]
		public CustomAxisLabel CustomAxisLabel => GetCustomAxisLabel();

		[Description("Returns a chart breadcrumb navigation bar that is located under the test point.")]
		public ChartBreadcrumbControl ChartBreadcrumbControl => GetElementByType<ChartBreadcrumbControl>();

		[Description("Returns a breadcrumb item that is located under the test point.")]
		public BreadcrumbItemPresentation BreadcrumbItemPresentation => GetElementByType<BreadcrumbItemPresentation>();

		internal ChartHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius = 0.0)
			: base(chart, point, radius)
		{
		}

		internal ChartHitInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Series series3D, SeriesLabel label3D)
			: this(refinedPoint, series3D)
		{
			this.label3D = label3D;
		}

		internal ChartHitInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Series series3D)
		{
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
			this.series3D = series3D;
		}

		internal ChartHitInfo(Diagram3D diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
		}

		internal ChartHitInfo(Axis3D axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}
	}

	public class Chart3DHitInfo : ChartHitInfoBase
	{
		private readonly Series3DBase series;

		private readonly RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

		private Series3DBase Series3D
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					if (refinedPoint == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return SeriesPoint3D.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint).Series;
				}
				return series;
			}
		}

		internal RefinedPoint RefinedPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					if (GetAdditionalElementByType(typeof(RefinedPoint)) == null)
					{
						return GetElementByType(typeof(RefinedPoint)) as RefinedPoint;
					}
					return GetAdditionalElementByType(typeof(RefinedPoint)) as RefinedPoint;
				}
				return refinedPoint;
			}
		}

		protected override SeriesLabel Label3D => null;

		[Description("Returns the value indicating whether the test point is within a series.")]
		public bool InSeries => Series3D != null;

		[Description("Returns the series located under the test point.")]
		public Series3DBase Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series3D == null)
				{
					return GetElementByType(typeof(Series3DBase)) as Series3DBase;
				}
				return Series3D;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the series point located under the hit test series point.")]
		public SeriesPoint3D SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (RefinedPoint == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return SeriesPoint3D.GetSeriesPoint(RefinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
		}

		[Description("Stores additional information about a test point.")]
		public object AdditionalItem { get; }

		internal Chart3DHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius = 0.0)
			: base(chart, point, radius)
		{
		}

		internal Chart3DHitInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Series3DBase series)
			: this(refinedPoint, series, null)
		{
		}

		internal Chart3DHitInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Series3DBase series, object additionalItem)
		{
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
			this.series = series;
			AdditionalItem = additionalItem;
		}

		internal Chart3DHitInfo(Axis3D axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class LegendItemBase : MarkerItem
	{
		private readonly LegendBase legend;

		private string text;

		private object sourceElement;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush foreground;

		private double? fontSize;

		private System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily;

		private FontStretch? fontStretch;

		private System.Windows.FontStyle? fontStyle;

		private FontWeight? fontWeight;

		private HitTestableElement hitTestableElement;

		private Control fontPropertiesSource;

		internal HitTestableElement HitTestableElement => hitTestableElement;

		protected LegendBase LegendBase => legend;

		protected object SourceElement => sourceElement;

		[Description("Gets the legend item’s text.")]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (text != value)
				{
					text = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("Text");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the brush used to paint the foreground of the legend item.")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush Foreground
		{
			get
			{
				if (foreground == null)
				{
					return fontPropertiesSource.Foreground;
				}
				return foreground;
			}
			set
			{
				if (foreground != value)
				{
					foreground = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("Foreground");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the font family name of the legend item.")]
		public System.Windows.Media.FontFamily FontFamily
		{
			get
			{
				if (fontFamily == null)
				{
					return fontPropertiesSource.FontFamily;
				}
				return fontFamily;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fontFamily != value)
				{
					fontFamily = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FontFamily");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend item font size.")]
		public double FontSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!fontSize.HasValue)
				{
					return fontPropertiesSource.FontSize;
				}
				return fontSize.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fontSize != value)
				{
					fontSize = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FontSize");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend item font stretch.")]
		public FontStretch FontStretch
		{
			get
			{
				if (!fontStretch.HasValue)
				{
					return fontPropertiesSource.FontStretch;
				}
				return fontStretch.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fontStretch != value)
				{
					fontStretch = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FontStretch");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend item font style.")]
		public System.Windows.FontStyle FontStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (!fontStyle.HasValue)
				{
					return fontPropertiesSource.FontStyle;
				}
				return fontStyle.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fontStyle != value)
				{
					fontStyle = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FontStyle");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend item font weight.")]
		public FontWeight FontWeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (!fontWeight.HasValue)
				{
					return fontPropertiesSource.FontWeight;
				}
				return fontWeight.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fontWeight != value)
				{
					fontWeight = value;
					NotifyPropertyChanged("FontWeight");
				}
			}
		}

		protected LegendItemBase(LegendBase legend, ILegendVisible browsableObject, object sourceElement, string text, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerLineBrush, LineStyle markerLineStyle)
			: base(browsableObject, markerBrush, markerLineBrush, markerLineStyle)
		{
			this.legend = legend;
			UpdateFontPropertiesSource();
			this.sourceElement = sourceElement;
			hitTestableElement = new HitTestableElement(sourceElement);
			this.text = text;
		}

		private void UpdateFontPropertiesSource()
		{
			Control control = fontPropertiesSource;
			fontPropertiesSource = ((base.RepresentedElement is CustomLegendItem) ? ((Control)base.RepresentedElement) : LegendBase);
			if (control != null && control.FontWeight != FontWeight)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("FontWeight");
			}
			if (control != null && control.FontFamily != FontFamily)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("FontFamily");
			}
			if (control != null && control.FontStyle != FontStyle)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("FontStyle");
			}
			if (control != null && control.FontSize != FontSize)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("FontSize");
			}
			if (control != null && control.FontStretch != FontStretch)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("FontStretch");
			}
			if (control != null && control.Foreground != Foreground)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("Foreground");
			}
			if (fontPropertiesSource != control)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(control as INotifyPropertyChanged, fontPropertiesSource as INotifyPropertyChanged, this);
			}
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && e is PropertyChangedEventArgs e2)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged(e2.PropertyName);
				return true;
			}
			return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool Assign(LegendItemBase item)
		{
			Update(item);
			UpdateFontPropertiesSource();
			if (sourceElement != item.sourceElement)
			{
				sourceElement = item.sourceElement;
				hitTestableElement = new HitTestableElement(sourceElement);
				NotifyPropertyChanged("ChartElement");
			}
			Text = item.text;
			return true;
		}
	}

		[Description("Gets or sets the legend of the legend’s item.")]
		public Legend Legend => (Legend)base.LegendBase;

		[Description("Returns a value that indicates whether a legend item is selected.")]

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush CheckBoxBrush

		[Description("Gets or sets the chart element that this legend item is based on.")]
		public object ChartElement => GetChartElement();

		protected LegendItem(LegendBase legend, ILegendVisible browsableObject, object sourceElement, string text, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerBrush, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerLineBrush, LineStyle markerLineStyle, VisualSelectionType selectionType, bool isSelected, bool isEnabled)
			: base(legend, browsableObject, sourceElement, text, markerBrush, markerLineBrush, markerLineStyle)
		{
			this.isEnabled = isEnabled;
			this.selectionType = selectionType;
			this.isSelected = isSelected;
			UpdateCalculatedProperties();
		}

		private object GetChartElement()
		{
			if (!(base.SourceElement is RefinedPoint point))
			{
				return base.SourceElement;
			}
			return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(point);
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedState()
		{
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsHatchSelection(selectionType))
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("OpacityMask");
			}
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsBrightnessSelection(selectionType))
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualMarkerBrush");
				NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualMarkerLineBrush");
			}
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsSizeSelection(selectionType))
			{
				OnLineThicknessChanged();
				NotifyPropertyChanged("ActualMarkerMargin");
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCalculatedProperties()
		{
			CheckBoxBrush = ((base.MarkerLineStyle != null) ? base.MarkerLineBrush : null);
			CheckBoxVisible = GetCheckBoxVisible();
			ShowMarkerAfterCheckBox = GetShowMarkerAfterCheckBox();
			MarkerVisible = GetMarkerVisible();
			ShowMarkersIndent = GetShowMarkersIndent();
			ShowTextIndent = GetShowTextIndent();
		}

		private bool GetCheckBoxVisible()
		{
			if (Legend.UseCheckBoxes || Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox || Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker)
			{
				return base.RepresentedElement.CheckableInLegend;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetShowMarkerAfterCheckBox()
		{
			if (!Legend.UseCheckBoxes && Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.MarkerAndCheckBox)
			{
				return base.RepresentedElement.CheckableInLegend;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetMarkerVisible()
		{
			bool flag = base.RepresentedElement is CustomLegendItem && (Legend.MarkerMode != LegendMarkerMode.None || Legend.UseCheckBoxes);
			bool flag2 = Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.Marker || Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker || Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.MarkerAndCheckBox;
			return (!Legend.UseCheckBoxes && flag2) || flag;
		}

		private bool GetShowMarkersIndent()
		{
			if (!Legend.UseCheckBoxes && Legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker)
			{
				return base.RepresentedElement.CheckableInLegend;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetShowTextIndent()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Text))
			{
				if (!MarkerVisible)
				{
					return CheckBoxVisible;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override double GetActualLineThickness()
		{
			if (!VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsSizeSelection(selectionType))
			{
				return base.GetActualLineThickness();
			}
			return VisualSelectionHelper.GetLegendLineThickness(base.MarkerLineStyle.Thickness, isSelected);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetOpacityMask()
		{
			if (!isSelected || !VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsHatchSelection(selectionType))
			{
				return base.GetOpacityMask();
			}
			return VisualSelectionHelper.LegendMarkerSelectionOpacityMask;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetActualMarkerBrush()
		{
			if (base.MarkerBrush is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush && isSelected && VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsBrightnessSelection(selectionType))
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(VisualSelectionHelper.GetSelectedPointColor(solidColorBrush.Color));
			}
			return base.GetActualMarkerBrush();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetActualMarkerLineBrush()
		{
			if (base.MarkerLineBrush is SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush && isSelected && VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsBrightnessSelection(selectionType))
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(VisualSelectionHelper.GetSelectedPointColor(solidColorBrush.Color));
			}
			return base.GetActualMarkerLineBrush();
		}

		protected override Thickness GetActualMarkerMargin()
		{
			if (!isSelected || !VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsSizeSelection(selectionType))
			{
				return base.GetActualMarkerMargin();
			}
			return VisualSelectionHelper.SelectedLegendMarkerMargin;
		}

		protected internal override bool GetIsSelected()
		{
			return isSelected;
		}

		protected internal override bool Assign(LegendItemBase item)
		{
			if (item is LegendItem legendItem)
			{
				base.Assign(item);
				selectionType = legendItem.selectionType;
				IsEnabled = legendItem.isEnabled;
				IsSelected = legendItem.IsSelected;
				CrosshairTextVisible = legendItem.CrosshairTextVisible;
				CrosshairText = legendItem.CrosshairText;
				UpdateCalculatedProperties();
				return true;
			}
			return false;

	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class LegendItemPresentation : ChartElementBase
	{
		private System.Windows.Shapes.Path markerPath;

		protected System.Windows.Shapes.Path MarkerPath => markerPath;

		protected static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LegendItemPresentation legendItemPresentation)
			{
				legendItemPresentation.UpdateMarkerGeometry();
			}
		}

		public LegendItemPresentation()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<LegendItemPresentation>(this);
			UpdateMarkerGeometry();
		}

		protected abstract Geometry CreateLegendMarkerGeometry();

		internal void UpdateMarkerGeometry()
		{
			if (markerPath != null)
			{
				markerPath.Data = CreateLegendMarkerGeometry();
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			UpdateMarkerGeometry();
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			markerPath = GetTemplateChild("PART_MarkerPath") as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
			if (markerPath != null)
			{
				markerPath.Data = null;
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class StockLegendItemPresentation : LegendItemPresentation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowOpenCloseProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowOpenClose", typeof(StockType), typeof(StockLegendItemPresentation), new PropertyMetadata(LegendItemPresentation.PropertyChanged));

		public StockType ShowOpenClose
		{
			get
			{
				return (StockType)GetValue(ShowOpenCloseProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowOpenCloseProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private Geometry CreateLegendStockMarker(System.Windows.Point leftTopStockMarker)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = new Rect(leftTopStockMarker.X + 2.0, leftTopStockMarker.Y, 2.0, 10.0)
			});
			if (ShowOpenClose == StockType.Open || ShowOpenClose == StockType.Both)
			{
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(leftTopStockMarker.X, leftTopStockMarker.Y + 2.0, 2.0, 2.0)
				});
			}
			if (ShowOpenClose == StockType.Close || ShowOpenClose == StockType.Both)
			{
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(leftTopStockMarker.X + 4.0, leftTopStockMarker.Y + 6.0, 2.0, 2.0)
				});
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateLegendMarkerGeometry()
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			geometryGroup.Children.Add(CreateLegendStockMarker(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)));
			geometryGroup.Children.Add(CreateLegendStockMarker(new System.Windows.Point(6.0, 2.0)));
			return geometryGroup;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class LineStepLegendItemPresentation : LegendItemPresentation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty InvertedStepProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("InvertedStep", typeof(bool), typeof(LineStepLegendItemPresentation), new PropertyMetadata(LegendItemPresentation.PropertyChanged));

		public bool InvertedStep
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(InvertedStepProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InvertedStepProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Geometry CreateLegendMarkerGeometry()
		{
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment();
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 10.0));
			if (InvertedStep)
			{
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 0.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 5.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(10.0, 5.0));
			}
			else
			{
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 5.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 5.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 0.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(10.0, 0.0));
			}
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(10.0, 10.0));
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
			pathFigure.StartPoint = ((PolyLineSegment)pathFigure.Segments[0]).Points[0];
			pathFigure.IsFilled = false;
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			return pathGeometry;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class AreaStepLegendItemPresentation : LineStepLegendItemPresentation
	{
		protected override Geometry CreateLegendMarkerGeometry()
		{
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment();
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 11.0));
			if (base.InvertedStep)
			{
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 0.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 5.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(11.0, 5.0));
			}
			else
			{
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 5.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 5.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(5.0, 0.0));
				polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(11.0, 0.0));
			}
			polyLineSegment.Points.Add(new System.Windows.Point(11.0, 11.0));
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
			pathFigure.StartPoint = ((PolyLineSegment)pathFigure.Segments[0]).Points[0];
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			return pathGeometry;
		}
	}

	public class LegendItemsControl : ChartItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LegendItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LegendItems", typeof(LegendItemList), typeof(LegendItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(ItemsPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ReverseItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ReverseItems", typeof(bool), typeof(LegendItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(ReversePropertyChanged));

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[NonTestableProperty]
		public LegendItemList LegendItems
		{

			}

			{

			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public bool ReverseItems
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ReverseItemsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ReverseItemsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void ItemsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LegendItemsControl legendItemsControl)
			{
				legendItemsControl.ItemsSource = e.NewValue as IEnumerable;
				legendItemsControl.UpdateItemsOrder();
			}
		}

		private static void ReversePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LegendItemsControl legendItemsControl)
			{
				legendItemsControl.UpdateItemsOrder();

		}

		private void UpdateItemsOrder()
		{
			if (LegendItems != null)
			{
				LegendItems.ReverseInternal(ReverseItems);
			}
		}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Selection", Type = typeof(ContentPresenter))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Cursor", Type = typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Image))]
	[NonCategorized]
	public class NavigationLayer : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SupportNavigationControlProperty;

		private Rect selectionRect;

		private Cursor chartCursor;

		private Cursor afterQueryChartCursor;

		private ContentPresenter selectionBorder;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Image cursorImage;

		private Visibility cursorImageVisibilityCached;

		private FrameworkElement Control => (FrameworkElement)SupportNavigationControl;

		public bool IsSelectionVisible => !selectionRect.IsEmpty;

		public ISupportNavigationControl SupportNavigationControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (ISupportNavigationControl)GetValue(SupportNavigationControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SupportNavigationControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate SelectionTemplate => (SupportNavigationControl?.Diagram as XYDiagram2D)?.SelectionTemplate;

		static NavigationLayer()
		{
			SupportNavigationControlProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SupportNavigationControl", typeof(ISupportNavigationControl), typeof(NavigationLayer));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(NavigationLayer), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
		}

		public NavigationLayer()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<NavigationLayer>(this);
		}

		public void ShowSelection(Rect rect)
		{
			selectionRect = rect;
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		public void HideSelection()
		{
			selectionRect = default(Rect);
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		public void UpdateCursor(BitmapCursor bitmapCursor, System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			if (cursorImage != null && SupportNavigationControl != null)
			{
				if (bitmapCursor != null && Control.Cursor != afterQueryChartCursor)
				{
					chartCursor = Control.Cursor;
				}
				Cursor cursor = ((bitmapCursor != null) ? Cursors.None : chartCursor);
				QueryChartCursorEventArgs e = ((bitmapCursor == null) ? new QueryChartCursorEventArgs(SupportNavigationControl.QueryChartCursorEvent, cursor, null, position, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)) : new QueryChartCursorEventArgs(SupportNavigationControl.QueryChartCursorEvent, cursor, bitmapCursor.Image, position, bitmapCursor.Offset));
				Control.RaiseEvent(e);
				if (e.Cursor != Cursors.None)
				{
					HideCursorImage();
				}
				else
				{
					cursorImage.Source = e.CursorImage;
					cursorImage.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					Canvas.SetLeft(cursorImage, e.Position.X + e.CursorImageOffset.X);
					Canvas.SetTop(cursorImage, e.Position.Y + e.CursorImageOffset.Y);
				}
				afterQueryChartCursor = e.Cursor;
				Control.Cursor = e.Cursor;
			}
		}

		public void HideCursorImage()
		{
			cursorImage.Source = null;
			cursorImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public void PrepareBeforePrinting()
		{
			cursorImageVisibilityCached = cursorImage.Visibility;
			cursorImage.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public void RestoreAfterPrinting()
		{
			cursorImage.Visibility = cursorImageVisibilityCached;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (selectionBorder != null)
			{
				selectionBorder.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(selectionRect.Width, selectionRect.Height));
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			if (selectionBorder != null)
			{
				selectionBorder.Arrange(selectionRect);
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			selectionBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Selection") as ContentPresenter;
			cursorImage = GetTemplateChild("PART_Cursor") as System.Windows.Controls.Image;
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public class ReductionStockOptions : ChartDependencyObject, ICloneable, IBindingPropertiesSource
	{
		private static readonly SolidColorBrush defaultBrush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BrushProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Brush", typeof(SolidColorBrush), typeof(ReductionStockOptions), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LevelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Level", typeof(StockLevel), typeof(ReductionStockOptions), new PropertyMetadata(StockLevel.CloseValue, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EnabledProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Enabled", typeof(bool), typeof(ReductionStockOptions), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColorModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ColorMode", typeof(ReductionColorMode), typeof(ReductionStockOptions), new PropertyMetadata(ReductionColorMode.PreviousToCurrentPoint, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		private FrameworkElement Control => Series?.Diagram?.Container?.PlatformElement;

		private SolidColorBrush ThemedReductionBrush
		{
			get
			{
				if (Control == null)
				{
					return defaultBrush;
				}
				ChartBrushesThemeKeyExtension obj = new ChartBrushesThemeKeyExtension
				{
					ResourceKey = ChartBrushesThemeKeys.FinancialReductionBrush
				};
				((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = CommonThemeHelper.GetEditorThemeName((DependencyObject)Control);
				ChartBrushesThemeKeyExtension resourceKey = obj;
				object obj2 = Control.TryFindResource(resourceKey);
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					return (SolidColorBrush)obj2;
				}
				return defaultBrush;
			}
		}

		internal SolidColorBrush ActualBrush
		{
			get
			{
				if (Brush == null)
				{
					return ThemedReductionBrush;
				}
				return Brush;
			}
		}

		internal FinancialSeries2D Series { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the color of a price reduction.")]
		[Category("Brushes")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public SolidColorBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return (SolidColorBrush)GetValue(BrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a particular price value (open, close, high or low) used for the price action analysis.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public StockLevel Level
		{
			get
			{
				return (StockLevel)GetValue(LevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies whether price reductions are indicated within a series.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(EnabledProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EnabledProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the mode used to colorize the financial series points.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ReductionColorMode ColorMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (ReductionColorMode)GetValue(ColorModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ColorModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			ReductionStockOptions reductionStockOptions = new ReductionStockOptions();
			BindingPropertiesContainer<ReductionStockOptions>.Apply(this, reductionStockOptions);
			return reductionStockOptions;
		}

		object IBindingPropertiesSource.CloneValue(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is System.Windows.Media.Brush brush))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return brush.CloneCurrentValue();
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			properties.Add(LevelProperty);
			properties.Add(EnabledProperty);
			properties.Add(ColorModeProperty);
			properties.Add(CandleStickSeries2D.FillModeProperty);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			properties.Add(BrushProperty);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		internal void UpdateProperty(string name)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(name);
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ReductionStockOptions();
		}
	}
	public class CustomPalette : Palette
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColorItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ColorItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(CustomPalette), new PropertyMetadata(null, ColorItemsSourceChanged));

		private readonly ColorCollection colors;

		private readonly ItemsSourceCollectionManager itemsSourceManager;

		[Description("Gets or sets the source collection of the Palette’s colors.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public IEnumerable ColorItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)GetValue(ColorItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ColorItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override ColorCollection ActualColors => Colors;

		[Description("Gets the colors of the custom palette.")]
		public ColorCollection Colors => colors;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public ColorCollection ColorsSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				return Colors;
			}
			set
			{
				Colors.Clear();
				if (value == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (System.Windows.Media.Color item in value)
				{
					Colors.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the name of the CustomPalette.")]
		public override string PaletteName => "Custom";

		private static void ColorItemsSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is CustomPalette customPalette)
			{
				customPalette.itemsSourceManager.ItemsSourcePropertyChanged(e);
			}
		}

		public CustomPalette()
		{
			colors = new ColorCollection();
			itemsSourceManager = new ItemsSourceCollectionManager(Colors, base.OnColorsChanged, base.ConvertToColor);
			colors.CollectionChanged += itemsSourceManager.ItemsChanged;
			itemsSourceManager.ItemsChangedException = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUsingColorWhenColorItemsSourceNotEmptyCustomPalette);
			itemsSourceManager.ItemsSourceChangedException = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUsingColorItemsSourceWhenColorNotEmpty);
		}

		public CustomPalette(params System.Windows.Media.Color[] paletteColors)
			: this()
		{
			foreach (System.Windows.Media.Color item in paletteColors)
			{
				colors.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new CustomPalette();
		}
	}
	public class PredefinedPalette : Palette
	{
		private readonly ColorCollection predefinedColors = new ColorCollection();

		protected internal override ColorCollection ActualColors => predefinedColors;

		private PredefinedPalette()
		{
		}

		protected PredefinedPalette(System.Windows.Media.Color[] colors)
		{
			foreach (System.Windows.Media.Color item in colors)
			{
				predefinedColors.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new PredefinedPalette();
		}
	}
