	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class SeriesLabelConnectorItemBase : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		private readonly WeakReference labelItem;

		private SeriesLabel2DConnectorLayout layout;

		private List<System.Windows.Point> points;

		internal SeriesLabelItemBase LabelItemInternal => labelItem.Target as SeriesLabelItemBase;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public SeriesLabel2DConnectorLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				layout = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Layout");
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public List<System.Windows.Point> Points
		{
			get
			{
				return points;
			}
			set
			{
				points = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Points");
			}
		}

		protected SeriesLabelConnectorItemBase(SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem)
		{
			this.labelItem = new WeakReference(labelItem);
		}

		private bool AssertPoints(List<System.Windows.Point> points)
		{
			if (Points == null || Points.Count != points.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Points[i] != points[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract GRealPoint2D CalculateConnectorFinishPoint(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds, GRealPoint2D labelCenter, GRealPoint2D labelCorner1, GRealPoint2D labelCorner2);

		protected virtual List<System.Windows.Point> CalculateConnectorPoints(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalculateConnectorFinishPoint(anchorPoint, labelBounds, MathUtils.CalcCenter(labelBounds), new GRealPoint2D(((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top), new GRealPoint2D(((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Right, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Bottom));
			GRealPoint2D start = anchorPoint;
			GRealPoint2D end = gRealPoint2D;
			MathUtils.CorrectSmoothLine(LabelItemInternal.LabelInternal.ConnectorThickness, ref start, ref end);
			return new List<System.Windows.Point>
			{
				new System.Windows.Point(start.X, start.Y),
				new System.Windows.Point(end.X, end.Y)
			};
		}

		internal void UpdateCoordinates(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = CalculateConnectorPoints(anchorPoint, labelBounds);
			if (!AssertPoints(list))
			{
				Points = list;
			}
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class SeriesLabelConnectorItem : SeriesLabelConnectorItemBase
	{
		private bool IsBrokenLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelItem.Layout is IPieLabelLayout)
				{
					return PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(LabelItem.Label) == PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public SeriesLabelItem LabelItem => base.LabelItemInternal as SeriesLabelItem;

		internal SeriesLabelConnectorItem(SeriesLabelItem labelItem)
			: base(labelItem)
		{
		}

		private List<System.Windows.Point> CalculateBrokenConnectorPoints(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = ResolveOverlappingHelper.CalculateSalientPoint(anchorPoint, labelBounds, ((IPieLabelLayout)base.LabelItemInternal.Layout).Angle);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = CalculateConnectorFinishPoint(gRealPoint2D.HasValue ? gRealPoint2D.Value : anchorPoint, labelBounds, MathUtils.CalcCenter(labelBounds), new GRealPoint2D(((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top), new GRealPoint2D(((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Right, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Bottom));
			double thickness = LabelItem.Label.ConnectorThickness;
			if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				GRealPoint2D start = anchorPoint;
				GRealPoint2D end = gRealPoint2D.Value;
				GRealPoint2D end2 = gRealPoint2D2;
				MathUtils.CorrectSmoothLine(thickness, ref start, ref end);
				MathUtils.CorrectSmoothLine(thickness, ref end, ref end2);
				return new List<System.Windows.Point>
				{
					new System.Windows.Point(start.X, start.Y),
					new System.Windows.Point(end.X, end.Y),
					new System.Windows.Point(end2.X, end2.Y)
				};
			}
			GRealPoint2D start2 = anchorPoint;
			GRealPoint2D end3 = gRealPoint2D2;
			MathUtils.CorrectSmoothLine(thickness, ref start2, ref end3);
			return new List<System.Windows.Point>
			{
				new System.Windows.Point(start2.X, start2.Y),
				new System.Windows.Point(end3.X, end3.Y)
			};
		}

		protected override GRealPoint2D CalculateConnectorFinishPoint(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds, GRealPoint2D labelCenter, GRealPoint2D labelCorner1, GRealPoint2D labelCorner2)
		{
			//IL_010a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (LabelItem.Label.RenderMode)
			{
			case LabelRenderMode.RectangleConnectedToCenter:
				return labelCenter;
			case LabelRenderMode.Rectangle:
			{
				IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(anchorPoint, labelCenter, labelCorner1, labelCorner2);
				if (!intersectionInfo.HasIntersection)
				{
					return labelCenter;
				}
				return intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint;
			}
			case LabelRenderMode.CustomShape:
				if (LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)base.LabelItemInternal.Presentation, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement element) => element is ChartContentPresenter)) is ChartContentPresenter reference && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(reference) > 0 && VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(reference, 0) is System.Windows.Controls.Border border && GraphicsUtils.IsSimpleBorder(border))
				{
					IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRoundedRectIntersection(anchorPoint, labelCenter, labelCorner1, labelCorner2, border.CornerRadius.BottomLeft, border.CornerRadius.TopLeft, border.CornerRadius.TopRight, border.CornerRadius.BottomRight);
					if (!intersectionInfo.HasIntersection)
					{
						return labelCenter;
					}
					return intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint;
				}
				return IntersectionUtils.CalcIntersectionPointWithCustomShape(base.LabelItemInternal.Presentation, anchorPoint, labelCenter, labelBounds);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected ConnectorTargetKind.");
				goto case LabelRenderMode.RectangleConnectedToCenter;
			}
		}

		protected override List<System.Windows.Point> CalculateConnectorPoints(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsBrokenLine)
			{
				return CalculateBrokenConnectorPoints(anchorPoint, labelBounds);
			}
			return base.CalculateConnectorPoints(anchorPoint, labelBounds);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class SeriesLabelItemBase : NotifyPropertyChangedObject, ILayoutElement, ISupportFlowDirection
	{
		private string text;

		private SeriesLabel2DLayout layout;

		private double opacity;

		private readonly WeakReference label;

		private SeriesLabelConnectorItemBase connectorItem;

		private SeriesLabelPresentationBase labelPresentation;

		private bool showConnector = true;

		private SeriesPointItem pointItem;

		private RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

		ILayout ILayoutElement.Layout => Layout;

		internal ISeriesLabel LabelInternal => label.Target as ISeriesLabel;

		internal SeriesLabelConnectorItemBase ConnectorItemInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (!showConnector)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return connectorItem;
			}
			set
			{
				connectorItem = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowConnector
		{
			get
			{
				return showConnector;
			}
			set
			{
				showConnector = value;
			}
		}

		internal SeriesLabelPresentationBase Presentation
		{
			get
			{
				return labelPresentation;
			}
			set
			{
				labelPresentation = value;
			}
		}

		internal SeriesPointItem PointItem
		{
			get
			{
				return pointItem;
			}
			set
			{
				pointItem = value;
				PointItemChanged();
			}
		}

		internal RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => refinedPoint;

		internal System.Windows.Size LabelSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (labelPresentation == null)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
				}
				return labelPresentation.DesiredSize;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				text = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Text");
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public SeriesLabel2DLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				layout = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Layout");
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public double Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				double oldValue = opacity;
				opacity = value;
				OpacityPropertyChanged(oldValue, opacity);
				OnPropertyChanged("Opacity");
			}
		}

		protected SeriesLabelItemBase(ISeriesLabel label)
			: this(label, null)
		{
		}

		protected SeriesLabelItemBase(ISeriesLabel label, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			this.label = new WeakReference(label);
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
		}

		private void OpacityPropertyChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			bool flag = oldValue != 0.0;
			bool flag2 = newValue != 0.0;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				UpdateConnectorCoordinates();
			}
		}

		Transform ISupportFlowDirection.CreateDirectionTransform()
		{
			ISupportFlowDirection labelInternal = LabelInternal;
			if (label != null)
			{
				return labelInternal.CreateDirectionTransform();
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("Label must support ISupportFlowDirection interface.");
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void PointItemChanged()
		{
			refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
		}

		internal void UpdateConnectorItemLayout()
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ConnectorItemInternal != null)
			{
				SeriesLabel2DLayout seriesLabel2DLayout = Layout;
				if (seriesLabel2DLayout != null)
				{
					ConnectorItemInternal.Layout = (seriesLabel2DLayout.IsVisibleForResolveOverlapping ? new SeriesLabel2DConnectorLayout(Rect.Empty) : null);
					ConnectorItemInternal.UpdateCoordinates(seriesLabel2DLayout.AnchorPoint, seriesLabel2DLayout.LabelBounds);
				}
				else
				{
					ConnectorItemInternal.Layout = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateConnectorCoordinates()
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ConnectorItemInternal != null && Layout != null && Layout.Visible)
			{
				ConnectorItemInternal.UpdateCoordinates(Layout.AnchorPoint, Layout.LabelBounds);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateClipBounds(Rect viewport, bool shouldClip)
		{
			SeriesLabel2DLayout seriesLabel2DLayout = Layout;
			if (seriesLabel2DLayout != null)
			{
				if (seriesLabel2DLayout.Visible && shouldClip)
				{
					Rect bounds = seriesLabel2DLayout.Bounds;
					Rect rect = bounds;
					rect.Intersect(viewport);
					seriesLabel2DLayout.ClipBounds = (rect.IsEmpty ? RectExtensions.Zero : new Rect(rect.X - bounds.X, rect.Y - bounds.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height));
				}
				else
				{
					seriesLabel2DLayout.ClipBounds = Rect.Empty;
				}
			}
			SeriesLabelConnectorItemBase connectorItemInternal = ConnectorItemInternal;
			if (connectorItemInternal != null)
			{
				SeriesLabel2DConnectorLayout seriesLabel2DConnectorLayout = connectorItemInternal.Layout;
				if (seriesLabel2DConnectorLayout != null)
				{
					seriesLabel2DConnectorLayout.ClipBounds = (shouldClip ? viewport : Rect.Empty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class Pseudo3DSeriesPointsPanel : SimplePanel
	{
		private Pane Pane => base.DataContext as Pane;

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child?.Measure(pane.Rotated ? new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Height, availableSize.Width) : availableSize);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverrideCore(availableSize, measureChildren: false);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Pane pane = Pane;
			if (pane != null)
			{
				Transform viewportRenderTransform = pane.ViewportRenderTransform;
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					if (child != null)
					{
						child.RenderTransform = viewportRenderTransform;
						child.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), child.DesiredSize));
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

			set
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (presentationData.Layout != value)
				{
					flag = presentationData.Layout != null && value == null;
					presentationData.Layout = value;
				}
				if (flag || (presentationData.Layout != null && !presentationData.Layout.IsApplyed))
				{
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(PointItemPresentation);
					if (presentationData.Layout != null)
					{
						presentationData.Layout.IsApplyed = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> Layouts
		{
			get
			{
				return presentationData.Layouts;
			}
			set
			{
				presentationData.Layouts = value;
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(PointItemPresentation);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public SeriesLabelItem LabelItem
		{
			get
			{
				return labelItem;
			}
			set
			{
				labelItem = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public SeriesPointPresentationData PresentationData => presentationData;

		[Description("")]
		public Series Series => series;

		IPresentation IPresentationItem.Presentation
		{
			get
			{
				return Layout;
			}
			set
			{
				Layout = (SeriesPointLayout)value;
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> IPresentationItem.IntervalPresentations
		{
			get
			{
				return Layouts;
			}
			set
			{
				Layouts = value;
			}
		}

		internal SeriesPointItem(Series series, SeriesPointData seriesPointData)
			: this(series, seriesPointData, RangeValueLevel.Value1)
		{
		}

		internal SeriesPointItem(Series series, SeriesPointData seriesPointData, RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
			: this(series, seriesPointData, null, valueLevel)
		{
		}

		internal SeriesPointItem(Series series, SeriesPointData seriesPointData, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			this.series = series;
			this.seriesPointData = seriesPointData;
			if (presentationData == null)
			{
				this.presentationData = new SeriesPointPresentationData
				{
					SeriesSelectionType = series.SupportedSelectionType
				};
			}
			else
			{
				this.presentationData = new SeriesPointPresentationData();
				this.presentationData.Assign(presentationData);
			}
			this.valueLevel = valueLevel;
			Update();
		}

		private void OnSelectedStateChanged()
		{
			if (seriesPointData != null)
			{
				LegendItem legendItem = series.GetLegendItem(seriesPointData.LegendItemIndex);
				if (legendItem != null)
				{
					legendItem.IsSelected = IsSelected;
				}
			}
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsSizeSelection(series.SupportedSelectionType) && PointItemPresentation != null)
			{
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(PointItemPresentation);
			}
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			bool flag = series.IsPointValueVisible(this, valueLevel);
			Model = (flag ? series.GetModel(valueLevel) : null);
			ShowInFrontOfAxes = series.InFrontOfAxes && flag;
			ShowBehindAxes = !series.InFrontOfAxes && flag;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesPointItemContainer : Panel
	{
		private ChartContentPresenter SeriesPointItemPresenter => FindName("PART_PointPresenter") as ChartContentPresenter;

		private SeriesPointItem SeriesPointItem => base.DataContext as SeriesPointItem;

		private Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (SeriesPointItem != null)
				{
					return SeriesPointItem.Series;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private bool CanLayout
		{
			get
			{
				if (SeriesPointItem != null && SeriesPointItem.ActualLayout != null)
				{
					return Series != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2;
			if (CanLayout)
			{
				SeriesPointItem seriesPointItem = SeriesPointItem;
				Series.CompletePointLayout(seriesPointItem);
				Rect bounds = seriesPointItem.ActualLayout.Bounds;
				availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
			else
			{
				availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			SeriesPointItemPresenter.Measure(availableSize2);
			return new System.Windows.Size(MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Width, SeriesPointItemPresenter.DesiredSize.Width), MathUtils.ConvertInfinityToDefault(availableSize.Height, SeriesPointItemPresenter.DesiredSize.Height));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			ChartContentPresenter seriesPointItemPresenter = SeriesPointItemPresenter;
			if (CanLayout)
			{
				SeriesPointLayout actualLayout = SeriesPointItem.ActualLayout;
				seriesPointItemPresenter.RenderTransform = actualLayout.Transform;
				seriesPointItemPresenter.Clip = actualLayout.ClipGeometry;
				seriesPointItemPresenter.Arrange(actualLayout.Bounds);
			}
			else
			{
				seriesPointItemPresenter.Arrange(RectExtensions.Zero);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class SeriesPointPresentationData : NotifyPropertyChangedObject, IPresentationItem
	{
		private bool isHighlighted;

		private bool isSelected;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush opacityMask;

		private System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor;

		private double opacity;

		private IDataPoint internalSeriesPoint;

		private IList<IntervalPresentation> layouts;

		private SeriesPointLayout layout;

		private string labelText;

		private string legendText;

		internal SeriesPointLayout ActualLayout
		{
			get
			{
				if (layout != null)
				{
					return layout;
				}
				if (layouts == null || layouts.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return layouts[0].Presentation as SeriesPointLayout;
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color CrosshairPointColor => pointColor;

		internal IDataPoint InternalSeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return internalSeriesPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				if (internalSeriesPoint != value)
				{
					internalSeriesPoint = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SeriesPoint");
				}
			}
		}

		internal VisualSelectionType SeriesSelectionType { get; set; }

		[Description("For internal use. Returns a value that indicates whether presentation data is highlighted.")]
		public bool IsHighlighted
		{
			get
			{
				return isHighlighted;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (IsHighlighted != value)
				{
					isHighlighted = value;
					UpdatePointColor();
					OnPropertyChanged("IsHighlighted");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Returns a value that indicates whether presentation data is selected.")]
		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return isSelected;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (isSelected != value)
				{
					isSelected = value;
					OnSelectedStateChanged();
					OnPropertyChanged("IsSelected");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Specifies the point’s label text. This is a dependency property.")]
		public string LabelText
		{
			get
			{
				return labelText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (labelText != value)
				{
					labelText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("LabelText");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Specifies the series point layout. This is a dependency property.")]
		public SeriesPointLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				layout = value;
				UpdateOpacityMask();
				OnPropertyChanged("Layout");
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Specifies the series point layouts when scale breaks cross the point. This is a dependency property.")]
		public IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> Layouts
		{
			get
			{
				return layouts;
			}
			set
			{
				layouts = value as IList<IntervalPresentation>;
				UpdateOpacityMask();
				OnPropertyChanged("Layouts");
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Specifies the point’s legend text. This is a dependency property.")]
		public string LegendText
		{
			get
			{
				return legendText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (legendText != value)
				{
					legendText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("LegendText");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Specifies the point’s opacity. This is a dependency property.")]
		public double Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				if (opacity != value)
				{
					opacity = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Opacity");
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush OpacityMask => opacityMask;

		[Description("For internal use. Specifies the point’s color. This is a dependency property.")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Color PointColor
		{
			get
			{
				return GetPointColor();
			}
			set
			{
				if (pointColor != value)
				{
					pointColor = value;
					UpdatePointColor();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("For internal use. Returns the series point which uses this presentation data.")]
		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint => SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(internalSeriesPoint);

		IPresentation IPresentationItem.Presentation
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				Layout = (SeriesPointLayout)value;
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<IntervalPresentation> IPresentationItem.IntervalPresentations
		{
			get
			{
				return layouts;
			}
			set
			{
				Layouts = value;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color GetPointColor()
		{
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsBrightnessSelection(SeriesSelectionType) && isSelected)
			{
				return VisualSelectionHelper.GetSelectedPointColor(pointColor);
			}
			if (isHighlighted)
			{
				return VisualSelectionHelper.GetHighlightedPointColor(pointColor);
			}
			return pointColor;
		}

		private void OnSelectedStateChanged()
		{
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsHatchSelection(SeriesSelectionType))
			{
				UpdateOpacityMask();
			}
			if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsBrightnessSelection(SeriesSelectionType))
			{
				UpdatePointColor();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOpacityMask()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = opacityMask;
			SeriesPointLayout actualLayout = ActualLayout;
			if (isSelected && VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsHatchSelection(SeriesSelectionType) && actualLayout != null)
			{
				opacityMask = VisualSelectionHelper.GetOpacityMask(actualLayout.Transform);
			}
			else
			{
				opacityMask = null;
			}
			if (brush != opacityMask)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("OpacityMask");
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePointColor()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("PointColor");
		}

		internal void Assign(SeriesPointPresentationData sourceData)
		{
			SeriesSelectionType = sourceData.SeriesSelectionType;
			InternalSeriesPoint = sourceData.InternalSeriesPoint;
			IsHighlighted = sourceData.IsHighlighted;
			IsSelected = sourceData.IsSelected;
			LabelText = sourceData.LabelText;
			Layout = sourceData.Layout;
			Layouts = sourceData.Layouts;
			LegendText = sourceData.LegendText;
			Opacity = sourceData.Opacity;
			PointColor = sourceData.PointColor;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase : FrameworkElement, INativeHitTestableElement, IHitTestableElement, IToolTipPointDataProvider
	{
		private readonly XYSeries series;

		private bool shouldUpdateGeometry = true;

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen visualBoundsCorrectionPen;

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen VisualBoundsCorrectionPen
		{
			get
			{
				if (visualBoundsCorrectionPen == null)
				{
					visualBoundsCorrectionPen = CreateCorrectionPen();
				}
				return visualBoundsCorrectionPen;
			}
		}

		protected object AdditionalElement { get; set; }

		protected SeriesPointItem PointItem { get; set; }

		protected bool ShouldUpdateGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				return shouldUpdateGeometry;
			}
			set
			{
				shouldUpdateGeometry = value;
			}
		}

		protected XYSeries Series => series;

		protected virtual bool CacheEnabled => true;

		protected virtual bool UseVisualBoundsCorrectionPen => false;

		protected virtual Action<IRenderContext> OnSurfaceRendering => null;

		protected virtual Func<System.Windows.Point, Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>> OnSurfaceHitTest => null;

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => series;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => AdditionalElement;

		SeriesPointItem IToolTipPointDataProvider.PointItem => PointItem;

		protected AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase(XYSeries series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			OnBitmapCachingChanged();
			RegisterSurfaceCallback();
		}

		void INativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			HitTestNativeElements(point);
		}

		IList<object> INativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(Rect rect)
		{
			return HitTestNativeElements(rect);
		}

		private void RegisterSurfaceCallback()
		{
			if (Series.ActualPane is Pane pane)
			{
				pane.DirectXSeriesSurface?.RegisterSurfaceCallback(Series.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(series), OnSurfaceRendering, OnSurfaceHitTest, GetHashCode());
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void Update(bool shouldUpdateGeometry)
		{
			ShouldUpdateGeometry = shouldUpdateGeometry;
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSeriesDetached()
		{
		}

		internal void OnSeriesAttached()
		{
			RegisterSurfaceCallback();
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Pen CreateCorrectionPen()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, 0.0);
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			if (hitTestParameters is ChartPointHitTestParameters)
			{
				return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override GeometryHitTestResult HitTestCore(GeometryHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			if (hitTestParameters is ChartGeometryHitTestParameters)
			{
				return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			OnRenderCore(drawingContext);
		}

		protected virtual void OnRenderCore(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (UseVisualBoundsCorrectionPen)
			{
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(null, VisualBoundsCorrectionPen, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight));
			}
			drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight)));
			RenderContent(drawingContext);
			drawingContext.Pop();
		}

		protected virtual BitmapCache CreateBitmapCache()
		{
			return new BitmapCache
			{
				SnapsToDevicePixels = true
			};
		}

		protected abstract void RenderContent(DrawingContext drawingContext);

		protected virtual void HitTestNativeElements(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
		}

		protected virtual IList<object> HitTestNativeElements(Rect rect)
		{
			return new List<object>();
		}

		public virtual void InvalidateHighlightedItems()
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		public void OnBitmapCachingChanged()
		{
			if (CacheEnabled && Series.ActualCrosshairEnabled && (Series.Diagram == null || Series.Diagram.IsSeriesBitmapCachingEnabled))
			{
				base.CacheMode = CreateBitmapCache();
				base.CacheMode.Freeze();
			}
			else
			{
				base.CacheMode = null;
			}
		}
	}

		}

					base.AdditionalElement = highlightedPointsProvider.HighlightedPoints.First().RefinedPoint;

			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void InvalidateHighlightedItems()

		}
	}
	public class AdditionalSeriesPointGeometry : AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase
	{
		private readonly DrawingContextWrapper contextWrapper = new DrawingContextWrapper();

		public AdditionalSeriesPointGeometry(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private SeriesPointItem FindPointItem(System.Windows.Point point, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				List<ISeriesPoint> sourcePoints = SeriesPointHelper.GetSourcePoints(refinedPoint);
				List<SeriesPointItem> list = new List<SeriesPointItem>();
				foreach (ISeriesPoint item2 in sourcePoints)
				{
					List<SeriesPointItem> pointItems = base.Series.Item.GetPointItems(item2);
					if (pointItems != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(pointItems);
					}
				}
				point = base.Series.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement.TransformToVisual(this).Transform(point);
				foreach (SeriesPointItem item in list)
				{
					SeriesPointItem found = null;
					PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(item, null, delegate(IPresentation layout)
					{
						if (layout != null && layout.Bounds.Contains(point))
						{
							found = item;
						}
					});
					if (found != null)
					{
						return found;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ResetHitTestElements()
		{
			base.AdditionalElement = null;
			base.PointItem = null;
		}

		protected RefinedPoint FindSeriesPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!(base.Series.Diagram is INativeHitTestableDiagram nativeHitTestableDiagram))
			{
				return null;
			}
			RefinedSeries refinedSeries = (RefinedSeries)base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries;
			return nativeHitTestableDiagram.FindSeriesPoint(point, base.Series, GetRefinedPointFinder(refinedSeries));
		}

		protected virtual RefinedPointFinder GetRefinedPointFinder(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return new RefinedPointFinder(refinedSeries);
		}

		protected override void HitTestNativeElements(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			if (!point.HasValue)
			{
				ResetHitTestElements();
			}
			else
			{
				base.PointItem = FindPointItem(refinedPoint: (RefinedPoint)(base.AdditionalElement = FindSeriesPoint(point.Value)), point: point.Value);
			}
		}

		protected override IList<object> HitTestNativeElements(Rect rect)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			System.Windows.Point point = base.Series.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement.TransformToVisual(this).Transform(rect.TopLeft);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = base.Series.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement.TransformToVisual(this).Transform(rect.BottomRight);
			rect = new Rect(point, point2);
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = -1;
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Series.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				if (allPointItem.PresentationData.Layout.Bounds.IntersectsWith(rect))
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries.Points.IndexOf(allPointItem.RefinedPoint));
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries.Points.IndexOf(allPointItem.RefinedPoint));
				}
				else if (allPointItem.PresentationData.Layout.Bounds != rect2)
				{
					for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						list.Add(base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries.Points[i]);
					}
					num = int.MaxValue;
					num2 = -1;
				}
			}
			for (int j = num; j <= num2; j++)
			{
				list.Add(base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries.Points[j]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void RenderContent(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (base.Series.Item.ActualVisibleItems.Any())
			{
				Render(drawingContext, base.Series.Item.ActualVisibleItems);
			}
		}

		protected virtual SeriesGeometryRendererBase CreateSeriesGeometryRenderer()
		{
			return new SimpleSeriesGeometryRenderer();
		}

		protected void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> items)
		{
			if (base.Series.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
			{
				contextWrapper.UpdateContext(drawingContext);
				CreateSeriesGeometryRenderer().Render(base.Series, contextWrapper, items);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class AdditionalStripSeriesGeometryBase : AdditionalSeriesGeometryBase, ISelectableAdditionalSeriesGeometry, IGeometryCalculator
	{
		private const int maxBrushesCacheSize = 10;

		private readonly Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, SolidColorBrush> brushesCache = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, SolidColorBrush>();

		private Dictionary<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle> cachedGeometries;

		private bool selectedState;

		private IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> cachedAdditionalGeometries;

		protected virtual bool ShouldRoundPoints => false;

		protected bool SelectedState
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedState;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectedState != value)
				{
					selectedState = value;
					Update(shouldUpdateGeometry: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual SolidColorBrush ActualBrush => GetBrush(ActualColor);

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Color ActualColor => base.Series.Item.DrawOptions.ActualColor;

		protected internal Geometry Geometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedGeometries == null || cachedGeometries.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return cachedGeometries.First().Key;
			}
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> CachedAdditionalGeometries => cachedAdditionalGeometries;

		bool ISelectableAdditionalSeriesGeometry.SelectedState
		{
			get
			{
				return SelectedState;
			}
			set
			{
				SelectedState = value;
			}
		}

		protected AdditionalStripSeriesGeometryBase(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
			RenderOptions.SetBitmapScalingMode(this, BitmapScalingMode.NearestNeighbor);
		}

		ChartGeometry IGeometryCalculator.Calculate(IMapping mapping, IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			return CalculateGeometry(mapping, strip);
		}

		protected Dictionary<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle> CalculateRenderContextGeometry(IEnumerable<ChartGeometry> geometryList, Transform transform)
		{
			if (cachedGeometries == null || base.ShouldUpdateGeometry)
			{
				cachedGeometries = new Dictionary<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle>();
				List<Geometry> list = new List<Geometry>();
				foreach (ChartGeometry geometry in geometryList)
				{
					StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry
					{
						Transform = transform
					};
					list.Add(streamGeometry);
					using (StreamGeometryContext geometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
					{
						streamGeometry.Freeze();
						geometry.Render(geometryContext, list);
					}
					cachedGeometries[list.Last()] = ((geometry.Figures.Count > 0) ? geometry.Figures[0].Style : null);
				}
			}
			return cachedGeometries;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> CalculateRenderGeometry(out Transform transform)
		{
			transform = null;
			if (base.Series == null || base.Series.Item == null || base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<IGeometryStrip> list = CalculateStrips();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PresentationUpdater presentationUpdater = new PresentationUpdater(base.Series);
			transform = presentationUpdater.CreateAnimationTransform();
			if (transform != null)
			{
				transform.Freeze();
			}
			if (cachedAdditionalGeometries == null || base.ShouldUpdateGeometry)
			{
				cachedAdditionalGeometries = presentationUpdater.CalculateAdditionalGeometries(this, list);
				cachedGeometries = null;
			}
			return cachedAdditionalGeometries;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Color? GetActualEmptyPointColor(System.Windows.Media.Color? color)
		{
			return color;
		}

		protected override void RenderContent(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			Transform transform;
			IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> enumerable = CalculateRenderGeometry(out transform);
			if (enumerable != null && enumerable.Any())
			{
				RenderCore(drawingContext, cachedAdditionalGeometries, transform);
				base.ShouldUpdateGeometry = true;
			}
		}

		private IList<IGeometryStrip> CalculateStrips()
		{
			GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator = new GeometryCalculator();
			return geometryCalculator.CreateStrips(base.Series.Item.RefinedSeries);
		}

		protected abstract void RenderCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> geometryList, Transform transform);

		protected abstract ChartGeometry CalculateGeometry(IMapping mapping, IGeometryStrip strip);

		protected override IList<object> HitTestNativeElements(Rect rect)
		{
			return new List<object> { base.Series };
		}

		protected ChartGeometryFigure CreatePolyLineFigure(List<System.Windows.Point> points, GeometryStripStyle style)
		{
			ChartGeometryFigure chartGeometryFigure = new ChartGeometryFigure(style);
			if (points != null && points.Count > 0)
			{
				ChartPolyLineSegment chartPolyLineSegment = new ChartPolyLineSegment(points, ShouldRoundPoints);
				chartGeometryFigure.Segments.Add(chartPolyLineSegment);
				if (chartPolyLineSegment.Points.Count > 0)
				{
					chartGeometryFigure.StartPoint = chartPolyLineSegment.Points[0];
				}
			}
			return chartGeometryFigure;
		}

		protected ChartGeometryFigure CreatePolyBezierFigure(List<System.Windows.Point> points, GeometryStripStyle style)
		{
			ChartGeometryFigure chartGeometryFigure = new ChartGeometryFigure(style);
			if (points != null && points.Count > 0)
			{
				ChartPolyBezierSegment chartPolyBezierSegment = new ChartPolyBezierSegment(points, ShouldRoundPoints);
				chartGeometryFigure.Segments.Add(chartPolyBezierSegment);
				StartFigure(chartGeometryFigure, chartPolyBezierSegment);
			}
			return chartGeometryFigure;
		}

		protected virtual void StartFigure(ChartGeometryFigure figure, ChartPolyBezierSegment segment)
		{
			if (segment.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				figure.StartPoint = segment.Points[0];
				segment.Points.RemoveAt(0);
			}
		}

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> OptimizeCartesianStrip(List<GRealPoint2D> strip)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < strip.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D item = strip[i];
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = strip[i + 1];
				bool flag2 = item.Y == gRealPoint2D.Y;
				if (!flag || !flag2)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				flag = flag2;
			}
			list.Add(strip[strip.Count - 1]);
			return list;
		}

		protected SolidColorBrush GetBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (!brushesCache.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (brushesCache.Count == 10)
				{
					brushesCache.Clear();
				}
				value = new SolidColorBrush(color);
				value.Freeze();
				brushesCache.Add(color, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class AdditionalLineSeriesGeometry : AdditionalStripSeriesGeometryBase
	{
		private const int maxFastRenderLineThickness = 2;

		protected override bool ShouldRoundPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (CanRoundPoints)
				{
					return LineThickness % 2 == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int LineThickness => ((ILineSeries)base.Series).LineThickness;

		protected virtual int EmptyPointLineThickness => ((ILineSeries)base.Series).EmptyPointLineThickness;

		protected virtual LineStyle LineStyle => ((ILineSeries)base.Series).LineStyle;

		protected virtual LineStyle EmptyPointLineStyle => ((ILineSeries)base.Series).EmptyPointLineStyle;

		protected virtual bool CanRoundPoints => false;

		protected virtual bool CanRenderLineFast => true;

		protected virtual bool IsTopStrip => true;

		public AdditionalLineSeriesGeometry(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private bool ShouldRenderLineFast()
		{
			if (!CanRenderLineFast || LineThickness > 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (LineStyle == null || LineStyle.IsSolid)
			{
				if (EmptyPointLineStyle != null)
				{
					return EmptyPointLineStyle.IsSolid;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private GeometryHitTestResult GetHitTestResult(Geometry lineGeometry, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Geometry hitGeometry)
		{
			IntersectionDetail intersectionDetail = lineGeometry.StrokeContainsWithDetail(pen, hitGeometry);
			switch (intersectionDetail)
			{
			case IntersectionDetail.FullyInside:
			case IntersectionDetail.FullyContains:
			case IntersectionDetail.Intersects:
				return new GeometryHitTestResult(this, intersectionDetail);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private PenHolder CreatePenHolder(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			if (base.Series.NeedColorSegment)
			{
				return new MultiColorPenHolder(brush, LineStyle, LineThickness);
			}
			return new PenHolder(brush, LineStyle, LineThickness);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen GetActualPen(bool isEmptyPointLine, System.Windows.Media.Color? color, PenHolder penHolder)
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle;
			int thickness;
			if (isEmptyPointLine)
			{
				lineStyle = EmptyPointLineStyle;
				thickness = EmptyPointLineThickness;
				color = GetActualEmptyPointColor(color);
			}
			else
			{
				lineStyle = LineStyle;
				thickness = LineThickness;
			}
			return penHolder.GetPen(color, lineStyle, thickness);
		}

		protected void RenderNativeSurfaceGeometries(IRenderContext context, Action<List<System.Windows.Point>, System.Windows.Media.Color, int, LineStyle> render)
		{
			Transform transform;
			IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> enumerable = CalculateRenderGeometry(out transform);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry item in enumerable)
			{
				foreach (ChartGeometry geometry in item.Geometries)
				{
					foreach (ChartGeometryFigure figure in geometry.Figures)
					{
						System.Windows.Media.Color arg = (figure.Color.HasValue ? figure.Color.Value : ActualColor);
						LineStyle arg2 = (figure.IsEmptyPointStyle ? EmptyPointLineStyle : LineStyle);
						int arg3 = (figure.IsEmptyPointStyle ? EmptyPointLineThickness : LineThickness);
						foreach (ChartGeometrySegmentBase segment in figure.Segments)
						{
							render(segment.Points, arg, arg3, arg2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected List<System.Windows.Point> GetRoundedPoints(IMapping mapping, LineStrip lineStrip)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in lineStrip)
			{
				list.Add(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(item.X, item.Y));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override ChartGeometry CalculateGeometry(IMapping mapping, IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			ChartGeometry chartGeometry = new ChartGeometry();
			LineStrip lineStrip = ((!(strip is RangeStrip)) ? (strip as LineStrip) : (IsTopStrip ? ((RangeStrip)strip).TopStrip : ((RangeStrip)strip).BottomStrip));
			if (lineStrip != null)
			{
				List<System.Windows.Point> linePoints = GetLinePoints(mapping, lineStrip);
				ChartGeometryFigure item = CreatePolyLineFigure(linePoints, strip.Style);
				chartGeometry.Figures.Add(item);
			}
			return chartGeometry;
		}

		protected override void RenderCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> geometryList, Transform transform)
		{
			if (!geometryList.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			PenHolder penHolder = CreatePenHolder(ActualBrush);
			if (ShouldRenderLineFast())
			{
				foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry geometry in geometryList)
				{
					if (geometry.Clip != null)
					{
						drawingContext.PushClip(geometry.Clip);
					}
					foreach (ChartGeometry geometry2 in geometry.Geometries)
					{
						foreach (ChartGeometryFigure figure in geometry2.Figures)
						{
							System.Windows.Media.Pen actualPen = GetActualPen(figure.IsEmptyPointStyle, figure.Color, penHolder);
							figure.RenderFast(drawingContext, transform, actualPen);
						}
					}
					if (geometry.Clip != null)
					{
						drawingContext.Pop();
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry geometry3 in geometryList)
			{
				if (geometry3.Clip != null)
				{
					drawingContext.PushClip(geometry3.Clip);
				}
				Dictionary<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle> dictionary = CalculateRenderContextGeometry(geometry3.Geometries, transform);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle> item in dictionary)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color? color = null;
					if (item.Value.HasColor)
					{
						color = ColorUtils.ConvertFromArgb(item.Value.Color.Value);
					}
					System.Windows.Media.Pen actualPen2 = GetActualPen(item.Value.IsEmptyPointStyle, color, penHolder);
					drawingContext.DrawGeometry(null, actualPen2, item.Key);
				}
				if (geometry3.Clip != null)
				{
					drawingContext.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual List<System.Windows.Point> GetLinePoints(IMapping mapping, IGeometryStrip geometryStrip)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = (LineStrip)geometryStrip;
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			if (mapping != null)
			{
				int num = 125000;
				System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
				foreach (GRealPoint2D item in lineStrip)
				{
					System.Windows.Point diagramPoint = mapping.GetDiagramPoint(item.X, item.Y);
					if (diagramPoint.X == point.X && Math.Abs(diagramPoint.Y - point.Y) > (double)num)
					{
						diagramPoint.X--;
					}
					else if (diagramPoint.Y == point.Y && Math.Abs(diagramPoint.X - point.X) > (double)num)
					{
						diagramPoint.Y--;
					}
					point = diagramPoint;
					list.Add(diagramPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override GeometryHitTestResult HitTestCore(GeometryHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreatePenHolder(ActualBrush).GetPen(null, null, 1);
			if (base.Geometry != null)
			{
				return GetHitTestResult(base.Geometry, pen, hitTestParameters.HitGeometry);
			}
			if (base.CachedAdditionalGeometries != null)
			{
				List<Geometry> additionalGeometries = new List<Geometry>();
				foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry cachedAdditionalGeometry in base.CachedAdditionalGeometries)
				{
					StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
					using (StreamGeometryContext geometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
					{
						streamGeometry.Freeze();
						foreach (ChartGeometry geometry in cachedAdditionalGeometry.Geometries)
						{
							geometry.Render(geometryContext, additionalGeometries);
						}
					}
					GeometryHitTestResult hitTestResult = GetHitTestResult(streamGeometry, pen, hitTestParameters.HitGeometry);
					if (hitTestResult != null)
					{
						return hitTestResult;
					}
				}
			}
			return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
		}
	}

					{

					}
					point = diagramPoint;
					list.Add(diagramPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

	public class AdditionalSplineStackedAreaBorderSeriesGeometry : AdditionalSplineAreaBorderSeriesGeometry
	{
		public AdditionalSplineStackedAreaBorderSeriesGeometry(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override ChartGeometry CalculateGeometry(IMapping mapping, IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			ChartGeometry chartGeometry = new ChartGeometry();
			if (strip is BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip)
			{
				LineStrip topPoints = new LineStrip();
				LineStrip bottomPoints = new LineStrip();
				((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip).ClipLargeValues = false;
				((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip).ClipLargeValues = false;
				bezierRangeStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(out topPoints, out bottomPoints, 0.0);
				List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
				if (topPoints.Count >= 1)
				{
					list.Add(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(topPoints[0].X, topPoints[0].Y));
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < topPoints.Count; i++)
				{
					if (i % 3 != 0 || topPoints[i - 1].X != topPoints[i].X || topPoints[i - 1].Y == topPoints[i].Y)
					{
						list.Add(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(topPoints[i].X, topPoints[i].Y));
						continue;
					}
					chartGeometry.Figures.Add(CreatePolyBezierFigure(list, strip.Style));
					list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
					list.Add(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(topPoints[i].X, topPoints[i].Y));
				}
				chartGeometry.Figures.Add(CreatePolyBezierFigure(list, strip.Style));
			}
			return chartGeometry;
		}
	}
	public class AdditionalAreaSeriesGeometry : AdditionalStripSeriesGeometryBase
	{
		protected override bool UseVisualBoundsCorrectionPen => true;

		public AdditionalAreaSeriesGeometry(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private bool IsZeroWidthStrip(RangeStrip strip)
		{
			double? num = null;
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			list.AddRange(strip.TopStrip);
			list.AddRange(strip.BottomStrip);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in list)
			{
				if (num.HasValue && num != item.X)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!num.HasValue)
				{
					num = item.X;
				}
			}
			return num.HasValue;
		}

		private List<System.Windows.Point> GetZeroWidthStripPoints(IMapping mapping, RangeStrip strip)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = null;
			GetPointsForDrawing(strip, out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in topPoints)
			{
				if (!gRealPoint2D.HasValue || item.Y > gRealPoint2D.Value.Y)
				{
					gRealPoint2D = item;
				}
			}
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D2 = null;
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item2 in bottomPoints)
			{
				if (!gRealPoint2D2.HasValue || item2.Y < gRealPoint2D2.Value.Y)
				{
					gRealPoint2D2 = item2;
				}
			}
			if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue && gRealPoint2D2.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.Value.X, gRealPoint2D.Value.Y);
				System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint2 = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D2.Value.X, gRealPoint2D2.Value.Y);
				list.Add(new System.Windows.Point(roundedDiagramPoint.X, roundedDiagramPoint.Y));
				list.Add(new System.Windows.Point(roundedDiagramPoint.X + 1.0, roundedDiagramPoint.Y));
				list.Add(new System.Windows.Point(roundedDiagramPoint2.X + 1.0, roundedDiagramPoint2.Y));
				list.Add(new System.Windows.Point(roundedDiagramPoint2.X, roundedDiagramPoint2.Y));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual ChartGeometryFigure CreateAreaFigure(List<System.Windows.Point> points, GeometryStripStyle style)
		{
			return CreatePolyLineFigure(points, style);
		}

		protected virtual void GetPointsForDrawing(RangeStrip strip, out LineStrip topPoints, out LineStrip bottomPoints)
		{
			topPoints = strip.TopStrip;
			bottomPoints = strip.BottomStrip;
		}

		protected virtual List<System.Windows.Point> GetAreaPoints(IMapping mapping, RangeStrip strip)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in strip.TopStrip)
			{
				list.Add(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(item.X, item.Y));
			}
			if (base.Series.HasAdditionalGeometryBottomStrip)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> list2 = ((base.Series.Diagram is ICircularDiagram) ? strip.BottomStrip : OptimizeCartesianStrip(strip.BottomStrip));
				for (int num = list2.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = list2[num];
					list.Add(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override ChartGeometry CalculateGeometry(IMapping mapping, IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			ChartGeometry chartGeometry = new ChartGeometry();
			if (strip is RangeStrip rangeStrip)
			{
				List<System.Windows.Point> points = ((!IsZeroWidthStrip(rangeStrip) || !base.Series.HasAdditionalGeometryBottomStrip) ? GetAreaPoints(mapping, rangeStrip) : GetZeroWidthStripPoints(mapping, rangeStrip));
				ChartGeometryFigure chartGeometryFigure = CreateAreaFigure(points, rangeStrip.Style);
				chartGeometryFigure.IsClosed = true;
				chartGeometryFigure.IsFilled = true;
				chartGeometry.Figures.Add(chartGeometryFigure);
			}
			return chartGeometry;
		}

		protected override void RenderCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> geometryList, Transform transform)
		{
			foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry geometry in geometryList)
			{
				if (geometry.Clip != null)
				{
					drawingContext.PushClip(geometry.Clip);
				}
				drawingContext.PushOpacity(base.Series.GetOpacity());
				if (base.SelectedState)
				{
					drawingContext.PushOpacityMask(base.Series.AdditionalGeometrySelectionOpacityMask);
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Brush actualBrush = ActualBrush;
				Dictionary<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle> dictionary = CalculateRenderContextGeometry(geometry.Geometries, transform);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Geometry, GeometryStripStyle> item in dictionary)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = (item.Value.HasColor ? GetBrush(ColorUtils.ConvertFromArgb(item.Value.Color.Value)) : actualBrush);
					drawingContext.DrawGeometry(brush, null, item.Key);
				}
				if (base.SelectedState)
				{
					drawingContext.Pop();
				}
				drawingContext.Pop();
				if (geometry.Clip != null)
				{
					drawingContext.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Update(bool shouldUpdateGeometry)
		{
			if (base.Series is ISupportAntialiasing supportAntialiasing && ((ISeries)base.Series).ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				EdgeMode edgeMode = ((!supportAntialiasing.EnableAntialiasing) ? EdgeMode.Aliased : EdgeMode.Unspecified);
				RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, edgeMode);
			}
			base.Update(shouldUpdateGeometry);
		}
	}
	public class AdditionalStepAreaSeriesGeometry : AdditionalAreaSeriesGeometry
	{
		public AdditionalStepAreaSeriesGeometry(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override List<System.Windows.Point> GetAreaPoints(IMapping mapping, RangeStrip strip)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in strip.TopStrip)
			{
				list.Add(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(item.X, item.Y));
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			List<GRealPoint2D> list2 = OptimizeCartesianStrip(strip.BottomStrip);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item2 in list2)
			{
				list.Insert(count, mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(item2.X, item2.Y));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class AdditionalSplineAreaSeriesGeometry : AdditionalAreaSeriesGeometry
	{
		protected override bool ShouldRoundPoints => true;

		public AdditionalSplineAreaSeriesGeometry(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override List<System.Windows.Point> GetAreaPoints(IMapping mapping, RangeStrip strip)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			if (strip is BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip)
			{
				((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip).ClipLargeValues = false;
				((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip).ClipLargeValues = false;
				bezierRangeStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints, 0.0);
				foreach (GRealPoint2D item in topPoints)
				{
					list.Add(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(item.X, item.Y));
				}
				list.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
				list.Add(list[list.Count - 1]);
				if (base.Series.HasAdditionalGeometryBottomStrip)
				{
					foreach (GRealPoint2D item2 in bottomPoints)
					{
						list.Add(mapping.GetDiagramPoint(item2.X, item2.Y));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override ChartGeometryFigure CreateAreaFigure(List<System.Windows.Point> points, GeometryStripStyle style)
		{
			return CreatePolyBezierFigure(points, style);
		}

		protected override void GetPointsForDrawing(RangeStrip strip, out LineStrip topPoints, out LineStrip bottomPoints)
		{
			topPoints = strip.TopStrip;
			bottomPoints = strip.BottomStrip;
			if (strip is BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip)
			{
				((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip).ClipLargeValues = false;
				((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip).ClipLargeValues = false;
				bezierRangeStrip.GetPointsForDrawing(out topPoints, out bottomPoints);
			}
		}
	}

		public static void SetLabelKind(SeriesLabel label, RangeAreaLabelKind value)
		{
			label.SetValue(LabelKindProperty, value);
		}

		public static void SetMarkerDisplayMode(SidePoint sidePoint, SidePointDisplayMode value)
		{
			sidePoint.SetValue(MarkerDisplayModeProperty, value);
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static SidePointDisplayMode GetMarkerDisplayMode(SidePoint sidePoint)
		{
			return (SidePointDisplayMode)sidePoint.GetValue(MarkerDisplayModeProperty);
		}

		protected internal override bool IsMarkerEdgeMode(bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				if (ActualLastPoint != null)
				{
					return GetMarkerDisplayMode(ActualLastPoint) != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualFirstPoint != null)
			{
				return GetMarkerDisplayMode(ActualFirstPoint) != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
			}
			return false;
		}

			Marker1SizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker1Size", typeof(int), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);

			Marker2ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker2Model", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged));
			Marker2SizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker2Size", typeof(int), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);
			Marker2VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Marker2Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			TransparencyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Transparency", typeof(double), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)AreaSeries2D.ValidateTransparency);
			PointAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointAnimation", typeof(Marker2DAnimationBase), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.PointAnimationPropertyChanged));
			SeriesAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesAnimation", typeof(Area2DAnimationBase), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.SeriesAnimationPropertyChanged));
			Border1Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Border1", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Border1Changed));
			ActualBorder1PropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualBorder1", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualBorderChanged));
			ActualBorder1Property = ActualBorder1PropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			Border2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Border2", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Border2Changed));
			ActualBorder2PropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualBorder2", typeof(SeriesBorder), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualBorderChanged));
			ActualBorder2Property = ActualBorder2PropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			Value2DataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Value2DataMember", typeof(string), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			Value2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Value2", typeof(double), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, SeriesPoint.Update));
			DateTimeValue2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("DateTimeValue2", typeof(DateTime), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(DateTime.MinValue, SeriesPoint.Update));
			TimeSpanValue2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("TimeSpanValue2", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(TimeSpan.Zero, SeriesPoint.Update));
			LabelKindProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("LabelKind", typeof(RangeAreaLabelKind), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			LabelValueSeparatorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LabelValueSeparator", typeof(string), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(", ", LabelValueSeparatorPropertyChanged));
			LegendValueSeparatorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LegendValueSeparator", typeof(string), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(", ", LegendValueSeparatorPropertyChanged));
			MinValueAngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("MinValueAngle", typeof(double), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(270.0, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			MaxValueAngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("MaxValueAngle", typeof(double), typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(90.0, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> GetPointDataByVisibilityModeForTwoLabel(IList<SeriesPointItem> points)
		{
			if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
			{
				yield return points[0];
				yield return points[1];
			}
			if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
			{
				int lastIndex = points.Count - 1;
				yield return points[lastIndex];
				yield return points[lastIndex - 1];
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> GetPointDataByLabelMode(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, Func<SeriesPointItem, SeriesPointItem, SeriesPointItem> predicate)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count - 1; i += 2)
			{
				yield return predicate(points[i], points[i + 1]);
			}
		}

		private bool IsMarkerVisible(SeriesPointItem pointItem, RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if ((valueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? Marker1Visible : Marker2Visible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = base.Item.AllPointItems.IndexOf(pointItem);
			if (IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: true) && num < 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: false) && num >= base.Item.AllPointItems.Count - 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(ScreenPointCalculatorBase pointCalculator, PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			bool flag = pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			int markerSize = (flag ? Marker1Size : Marker2Size);
			double pointValue = (flag ? refinedPoint.Value1 : refinedPoint.Value2);
			return SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping.Viewport.Size, markerSize, pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(mapping, refinedPoint.Argument, pointValue, flag));
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<double> GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			yield return ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Min;
			yield return ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Max;
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is SeriesBorder)
			{
				UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = labelItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ScreenPointCalculatorBase pointCalculator = labelItem.Label.PointCalculator;
			if (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel) == RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel)
			{
				System.Windows.Point? point = RangeArea2DHelper.CalculateLabelAnchorPoint(this, mapping, labelItem, new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.Value1, refinedPoint.Value2), transform, pointCalculator);
				if (!point.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, point.Value, DXRectangle.Empty);
			}
			double pointValue = ((labelItem.PointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? refinedPoint.Value1 : refinedPoint.Value2);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = transform.Transform(pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(mapping, refinedPoint.Argument, pointValue, labelItem.PointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1));
			SeriesLabel label = labelItem.Label;
			int indent = label.Indent;
			double angle = (angle = RangeAreaSeriesHelper.GetLabelAngle(refinedPoint, labelItem.PointItem.ValueLevel, GetMinValueAngle(label), GetMaxValueAngle(label)));
			return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, point2, indent, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(NormalizeLabelAngle(angle)), GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CalcAnchorHole(point2, indent)), IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false));
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)

			base.FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(animationKinds);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> GetPointDataByVisibilityMode(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
			{
				switch (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel))
				{
				case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
					return GetPointDataByVisibilityModeForTwoLabel(points);
				case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
					return GetPointDataByLabelMode(points, (SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2) => (!(((IRangePoint)item1.RefinedPoint).Value1 > ((IRangePoint)item2.RefinedPoint).Value2)) ? item2 : item1);
				case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
					return GetPointDataByLabelMode(points, (SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2) => (!(((IRangePoint)item1.RefinedPoint).Value1 < ((IRangePoint)item2.RefinedPoint).Value2)) ? item2 : item1);
				case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
					return GetPointDataByLabelMode(points, (SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2) => item1);
				case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
					return GetPointDataByLabelMode(points, (SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2) => item2);
				}
			}
			return base.GetPointDataByVisibilityMode(points, isFirst);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> andFillPointItems = base.Item.GetAndFillPointItems(point);
			if (andFillPointItems != null && andFillPointItems.Count > 1)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point2 = CalculateToolTipPoint(andFillPointItems[0], inLabel: false);
				System.Windows.Point point3 = CalculateToolTipPoint(andFillPointItems[1], inLabel: false);
				return PointExtension.MiddlePoint(point2, point3);
			}
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel) == RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel && inLabel)
			{
				MinMaxValues minMaxValues = ((refinedPoint == null) ? new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.Value2) : new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.Value1, refinedPoint.Value2));
				double num = MathUtils.CalculateCenterValueByRange(((IAxisData)base.ActualAxisY).VisualRange, minMaxValues);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return transform.Transform(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, num));
				}
				return default(System.Windows.Point);
			}
			double value = ((pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? refinedPoint.Value1 : refinedPoint.Value2);
			return transform.Transform(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, value));
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValueFormat(valueScaleType);
			if (pointOptionsContainer is LegendPointOptionsContainer)
			{
				return "{V1" + text + "}" + LegendValueSeparator + "{V2" + text + "}";
			}
			return "{V" + text + "}";
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return ToolTipPatternUtils.DateTimeRangeViewPointPatterns;
			}
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.RangeViewPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointItemHidden(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return pointItem.ValueLevel switch
			{
				RangeValueLevel.TwoValues => false, 
				RangeValueLevel.Value1 => !Marker1Visible, 
				RangeValueLevel.Value2 => !Marker2Visible, 
				_ => base.IsPointItemHidden(pointItem), 
			};
		}

			}
		}
