	public abstract class BarSeries2DBase : XYSeries2D, IBarSeriesView
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BarWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BarWidth", typeof(double), typeof(BarSeries2DBase), new PropertyMetadata(0.6, BarWidthPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)BarWidthValidation);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointAnimation", typeof(Bar2DAnimationBase), typeof(BarSeries2DBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.PointAnimationPropertyChanged));

		private const double minBarPixelWidth = 3.0;

		[Description("Gets or sets the width of a bar.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double BarWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(BarWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BarWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the animation for the series’ point markers.")]
		[Category("Animation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Bar2DAnimationBase PointAnimation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Bar2DAnimationBase)GetValue(PointAnimationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointAnimationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(XYDiagram2D);

		protected internal override VisualSelectionType SupportedSelectionType => VisualSelectionType.Hatch;

		protected internal override bool ArePointsVisible => true;

		protected internal override bool LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported => true;

		protected virtual bool ShouldAnimateClipBounds => false;

		protected override int PixelsPerArgument => 40;

		private static bool BarWidthValidation(object barWidth)
		{
			return (double)barWidth > 0.0;
		}

		private static void BarWidthPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series && !series.UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "BarWidth"));
			}
		}

		private bool CheckValuesByRange(IMinMaxValues values)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(values.Max))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(values.Min);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Bar2D CalculateBar(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, double lowValue, double highValue)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(lowValue))
			{
				lowValue = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(highValue))
			{
				highValue = 0.0;
			}
			double argument = GetArgument(refinedPoint);
			double.IsNaN(argument);
			double num = GetBarWidth(refinedPoint) / 2.0;
			double num2 = GetFixedOffset(refinedPoint);
			if (IsAxisXReversed)
			{
				num2 = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			IAxisMappingCore axisXMapping = mapping.AxisXMapping;
			IAxisMappingCore axisYMapping = mapping.AxisYMapping;
			double bound = axisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(argument - num) + num2;
			double bound2 = axisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(argument + num) + num2;
			double bound3 = axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(highValue);
			double bound4 = axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(lowValue);
			Render2DHelper.CorrectBounds(ref bound3, ref bound4);
			CorrectZeroHeight(IsDownwardBar(refinedPoint), ref bound3, ref bound4);
			Render2DHelper.CorrectBoundsByMinDistance(ref bound, ref bound2, 3.0);
			return new Bar2D(argument, lowValue, highValue, num2, bound, bound2, bound3, bound4);
		}

		protected double GetArgument(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return refinedPoint.Argument + GetDisplayOffset(refinedPoint);
		}

		protected bool IsDownwardBar(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return IsDownwardBarCore(refinedPoint) ^ IsAxisYReversed;
		}

		protected Bar2D? CalculateBar(PaneMapping mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, bool isLabelInCenter)
		{
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(GetLowValue(refinedPoint), GetHighValue(refinedPoint));
			if (isLabelInCenter)
			{
				minMaxValues = MathUtils.CorrectMinMaxByRange(((IAxisData)base.ActualAxisY).VisualRange, minMaxValues);
				if (!CheckValuesByRange(minMaxValues))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return CalculateBar(mapping, refinedPoint, minMaxValues.Min, minMaxValues.Max);
		}

		protected double GetLabelAngle(SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem, PaneMapping mapping)
		{
			double num = GetLabelAngle(labelItem.PointItem.ValueLevel);
			if (IsDownwardBar(labelItem.RefinedPoint))
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			if (mapping.Rotated)
			{
				num += Math.PI / 2.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual double GetLowValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual double GetHighValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value;
		}

		protected virtual void CorrectZeroHeight(bool isDownwardBar, ref double top, ref double bottom)
		{
			if (top == bottom)
			{
				if (isDownwardBar)
				{
					bottom -= 1.0;
				}
				else
				{
					top += 1.0;
				}
			}
		}

		protected MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRangeSideBySide(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double num = ((ISideBySidePoint)point).BarWidth / 2.0;
			return new MinMaxValues(Math.Round(((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument - num + ((ISideBySidePoint)point).Offset, 6), Math.Round(((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument + num + ((ISideBySidePoint)point).Offset, 6));
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double num = BarWidth / 2.0;
			return new MinMaxValues(point.Argument - num, point.Argument + num);
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new BarViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected Rect CalculateSeriesPointBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, double lowValue, double highValue)
		{
			return CalculateBar(mapping, refinedPoint, lowValue, highValue).Bounds;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Point GetLabelAnchorPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, ScreenPointCalculatorBase pointCalculator, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool isLabelInCenter, Bar2D bar)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = pointCalculator.CorrectPointsByViewport(mapping, bar, GetArgument(refinedPoint), GetFixedOffset(refinedPoint), GetDisplayOffset(refinedPoint) == 0.0);
			if (isLabelInCenter)
			{
				double num = Math.Min(list[0].Y, list[1].Y);
				double num2 = Math.Max(list[0].Y, list[1].Y);
				double y = num + (num2 - num) / 2.0;
				System.Windows.Point result = new System.Windows.Point(list[0].X, y);
				return result;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(list[0].X, GetPointValue(pointItem.ValueLevel, list));
			if (pointItem.Model != null)
			{
				point = pointItem.Model.CorrectOutsideLabelLocation(point, IsDownwardBar(refinedPoint));
			}
			return transform.Transform(point);
		}

		protected abstract double GetBarWidth(RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		protected abstract int GetFixedOffset(RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		protected abstract double GetDisplayOffset(RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(BarWidthProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(PointAnimationProperty);
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DGrowUpAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DDropInAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DBounceAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DSlideFromLeftAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DSlideFromRightAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DSlideFromTopAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DSlideFromBottomAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DWidenAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Bar2DFadeInAnimation)));
		}

		protected virtual Rect CalculateSeriesPointBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			double lowValue = GetLowValue(refinedPoint);
			double highValue = GetHighValue(refinedPoint);
			return CalculateSeriesPointBounds(mapping, refinedPoint, lowValue, highValue);
		}

		protected virtual Rect? CalculateSeriesPointClipBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem, Rect viewport, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (pointItem.Model != null)
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
				if (xYDiagram2D != null && xYDiagram2D.IsNavigationEnabled && !base.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Left, viewport.Top);
					System.Windows.Point point2 = (xYDiagram2D.Rotated ? new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Bottom, viewport.Right) : new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Right, viewport.Bottom));
					return new Rect(point, point2);
				}
				Rect value = pointItem.Model.CalculateCorrectedBounds(viewport, bounds, xYDiagram2D.Rotated);
				if (!value.IsEmpty)
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsDownwardBarCore(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value < 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual double GetLabelAngle(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return -Math.PI / 2.0;
		}

		protected virtual double GetPointValue(RangeValueLevel valueLevel, List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			return points[1].Y;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return CreatePointItemLayout(mapping, pointItem);
		}

		protected internal XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CalculateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool isLabelInCenter)
		{
			Bar2D? bar2D = CalculateBar(mapping, labelItem.PointItem.RefinedPoint, isLabelInCenter);
			if (!bar2D.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point labelAnchorPoint = GetLabelAnchorPoint(labelItem.PointItem, labelItem.Label.PointCalculator, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter, bar2D.Value);
			return CalculateSeriesLabelLayoutCore(labelItem, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter, bar2D.Value.Bounds, labelAnchorPoint);
		}

		protected XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CalculateSeriesLabelLayoutCore(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool isLabelInCenter, Rect barBounds, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint)
		{
			if (isLabelInCenter)
			{
				System.Windows.Point anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection = transform.Transform(anchorPoint);
				if (labelItem.PointItem.Model != null)
				{
					anchorPoint = labelItem.PointItem.Model.CorrectCenterLabelLocation(anchorPoint);
				}
				anchorPoint = transform.Transform(anchorPoint);
				return labelItem.Label.CreateLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, transform, barBounds, anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection);
			}
			double labelAngle = GetLabelAngle(labelItem, mapping);
			return labelItem.Label.CreateLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, labelAngle);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalBarSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase CreateDefaultPointAnimation()
		{
			return new Bar2DGrowUpAnimation();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsNegativeBar(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Value < 0.0;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldFlipNegativeBar(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem.RefinedPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool shouldFlipBar = ShouldFlipNegativeBar(pointItem) && IsDownwardBar(pointItem.RefinedPoint);
			Bar2DAnimationBase animation = GetActualPointAnimation() as Bar2DAnimationBase;
			PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(pointItem, null, delegate(IPresentation layout)
			{
				if (layout is BarSeries2DPointLayout { InitialBounds: var rect, InitialClipBounds: var clipBounds } barSeries2DPointLayout)
				{
					if (animation != null)
					{
						double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
						if (ShouldAnimateClipBounds && clipBounds.HasValue)
						{
							Rect value = clipBounds.Value;
							Rect value2 = animation.CreateAnimatedBarBounds(value, barSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, ((IValuePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Value < 0.0, IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).Rotated, actualProgress);
							double num = ((value.Width == 0.0) ? 0.0 : Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width * value2.Width / value.Width));
							double num2 = ((value.Height == 0.0) ? 0.0 : Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height * value2.Height / value.Height));
							double num3 = value.X - rect.X;
							double x = ((rect.Width == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (value2.X - num3 * num / rect.Width));
							double num4 = value.Y - rect.Y;
							double y = ((rect.Height == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (value2.Y - num4 * num2 / rect.Height));
							rect = new Rect(x, y, num, num2);
							clipBounds = value2;
						}
						else
						{
							Rect rect2 = animation.CreateAnimatedBarBounds(rect, barSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, IsNegativeBar(pointItem), IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).Rotated, actualProgress);
							rect = new Rect(MathUtils.StrongRound(rect2.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect2.Y), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect2.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect2.Height));
						}
					}
					Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
					if (shouldFlipBar)
					{
						double centerY = rect.Height * 0.5 + (base.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry ? rect.Top : 0.0);
						identity.ScaleAt(1.0, -1.0, 0.0, centerY);
					}
					if (clipBounds.HasValue)
					{
						Rect value3 = clipBounds.Value;
						if (!base.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
						{
							value3.Offset(0.0 - rect.Left, 0.0 - rect.Top);
							value3.Transform(identity);
							clipBounds = value3;
						}
					}
					barSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(rect, identity, clipBounds);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			Bar2D? bar2D = CalculateBar(mapping, pointItem.RefinedPoint, isLabelInCenter: true);
			if (!bar2D.HasValue)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = GetLabelAnchorPoint(pointItem, ScreenPointCalculator.Instance, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter: true, bar2D.Value);
			if (pointItem.Model != null)
			{
				point = pointItem.Model.CorrectCenterLabelLocation(point);
			}
			return transform.Transform(point);
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem == null || pointItem.RefinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect bounds = CalculateSeriesPointBounds(mapping, pointItem.RefinedPoint);
			Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, mapping.Viewport.Width, mapping.Viewport.Height);
			return new BarSeries2DPointLayout(viewport, bounds, CalculateSeriesPointClipBounds(mapping, pointItem, viewport, bounds));
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxPointRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram diagram, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, snapMode, 0.0, point.RefinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value));
		}

		internal double GetPointValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return GetHighValue(refinedPoint);
		}

		public override SeriesPointAnimationBase GetPointAnimation()
		{
			return PointAnimation;
		}

		public override void SetPointAnimation(SeriesPointAnimationBase value)
		{
			if (value == null || value is Bar2DAnimationBase)
			{
				PointAnimation = value as Bar2DAnimationBase;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class BarSeries2D : BarSeries2DBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowZeroValueLabelsProperty;

		protected override bool SupportsNativeRendering
		{
			get
			{
				if (Model != null)
				{
					return Model.IsRenderable;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool InFrontOfAxes => Model?.ActualInFrontOfAxes ?? false;

		[Description("Gets or sets the model used to draw elements of a 2D bar series (e.g. 2D Side-by-Side Bar).")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Bar2DModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return (Bar2DModel)GetValue(ModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected static void BarModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as Bar2DModel, e.NewValue as Bar2DModel, d as BarSeries2D);
			XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		static BarSeries2D()
		{
			ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Model", typeof(Bar2DModel), typeof(BarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(BarModelPropertyChanged));
			ShowZeroValueLabelsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ShowZeroValueLabels", typeof(bool), typeof(BarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(ShowZeroValueLabelsProperty);
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static bool GetShowZeroValueLabels(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return (bool)label.GetValue(ShowZeroValueLabelsProperty);
		}

		public static void SetShowZeroValueLabels(SeriesLabel label, bool value)
		{
			label.SetValue(ShowZeroValueLabelsProperty, value);
		}

		protected abstract Bar2DLabelPosition GetSeriesLabelPosition(SeriesLabel label);

		protected virtual bool IsZeroValuePoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return point.SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0] == 0.0;
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			if (labelItem.RefinedPoint == null || (IsZeroValuePoint(labelItem.RefinedPoint) && !GetShowZeroValueLabels(base.ActualLabel)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Bar2DLabelPosition seriesLabelPosition = GetSeriesLabelPosition(labelItem.Label);
			XYSeriesLabel2DLayout xYSeriesLabel2DLayout;
			if (seriesLabelPosition == Bar2DLabelPosition.Auto)
			{
				xYSeriesLabel2DLayout = CalculateSeriesLabelLayout(labelItem, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter: true);
				if (xYSeriesLabel2DLayout != null)
				{
					labelItem.ShowConnector = false;
					double num = (mapping.Rotated ? xYSeriesLabel2DLayout.Bounds.Width : xYSeriesLabel2DLayout.Bounds.Height);
					if (labelItem.PointItem.ActualLayout is BarSeries2DPointLayout barSeries2DPointLayout && num > barSeries2DPointLayout.InitialBounds.Height)
					{
						xYSeriesLabel2DLayout = CalculateSeriesLabelLayout(labelItem, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter: false);
						labelItem.ShowConnector = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				xYSeriesLabel2DLayout = CalculateSeriesLabelLayout(labelItem, mapping, transform, seriesLabelPosition == Bar2DLabelPosition.Center);
				labelItem.ShowConnector = seriesLabelPosition != Bar2DLabelPosition.Center;
			}
			labelItem.ShowConnector = base.ActualLabel.ConnectorVisible;
			return xYSeriesLabel2DLayout;
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is CustomBar2DModel)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				return true;
			}
			return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ModelProperty);
		}

		protected internal override void CollectLabelProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectLabelProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ShowZeroValueLabelsProperty);
		}

		protected internal override bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			if (GetSeriesLabelPosition(label) == Bar2DLabelPosition.Outside)
			{
				return label.ConnectorVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return Model;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldFlipNegativeBar(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return Model?.ActualFlipNegativeBars ?? true;
		}

		protected internal override Rect GetPointBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return CalculateSeriesPointBounds(mapping, refinedPoint);
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(string argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(DateTime argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(TimeSpan argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class RangeBarOverlappedSeries2D : RangeBarSeries2D
	{
		public RangeBarOverlappedSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<RangeBarOverlappedSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override double GetBarWidth(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return base.BarWidth;
		}

		protected override int GetFixedOffset(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected override double GetDisplayOffset(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				return SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping.Viewport.Size, base.MinMarkerSize, mapping.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Min));
			}
			if (pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value2)
			{
				return SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping.Viewport.Size, base.MaxMarkerSize, mapping.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.Max));
			}
			return base.CreatePointItemLayout(mapping, pointItem);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new RangeBarOverlappedSeries2D();
		}
	}

		static RangeBarSeries2D()
		{
			ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Model", typeof(RangeBar2DModel), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(BarModelPropertyChanged));
			Value2DataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Value2DataMember", typeof(string), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			Value2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Value2", typeof(double), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, SeriesPoint.Update));
			DateTimeValue2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("DateTimeValue2", typeof(DateTime), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(DateTime.MinValue, SeriesPoint.Update));
			TimeSpanValue2Property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("TimeSpanValue2", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(TimeSpan.Zero, SeriesPoint.Update));
			MinMarkerModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinMarkerModel", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty));
			MinMarkerSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinMarkerSize", typeof(int), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);
			MinMarkerVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinMarkerVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			MaxMarkerModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxMarkerModel", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty));
			MaxMarkerSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxMarkerSize", typeof(int), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);
			MaxMarkerVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxMarkerVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));
			LabelKindProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("LabelKind", typeof(RangeBarLabelKind), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			LabelValueSeparatorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LabelValueSeparator", typeof(string), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(", ", LabelValueSeparatorPropertyChanged));
			LegendValueSeparatorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LegendValueSeparator", typeof(string), typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(", ", LegendValueSeparatorPropertyChanged));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(Value2Property.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelKindProperty);
		}

		private static void LabelValueSeparatorPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				series.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(d, e);
		}

		private static void LegendValueSeparatorPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				series.UpdateLegendTextPattern();
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(d, e);
		}

		private static void BarModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as Bar2DModel, e.NewValue as Bar2DModel, d as RangeBarSeries2D);
			XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private BarSeries2DPointLayout GetBarLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			SeriesPointItem seriesPointItem = null;
			foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem2 in pointItem.SeriesPointData.PointItems)
			{
				if (pointItem2.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.TwoValues)
				{
					seriesPointItem = pointItem2;
				}
			}
			if (seriesPointItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return seriesPointItem.ActualLayout as BarSeries2DPointLayout;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> GetPointDataByVisibilityModeForTwoLabel(IList<SeriesPointItem> points)
		{
			if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
			{
				yield return points[1];
				yield return points[2];
			}
			if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
			{
				int lastIndex = points.Count - 1;
				yield return points[lastIndex - 1];
				yield return points[lastIndex];
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<double> GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			yield return ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Min;
			yield return ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Max;
		}

		protected override IList<string> GetValueDataMembers()
		{
			return new string[2] { base.ValueDataMember, Value2DataMember };
		}

		protected override bool IsDownwardBarCore(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override double GetLowValue(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Min;
		}

		protected override double GetHighValue(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return ((IRangePoint)pointInfo).Max;
		}

		protected override double GetLabelAngle(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				return -Math.PI / 2.0;
			}
			return Math.PI / 2.0;
		}

		protected override double GetPointValue(RangeValueLevel valueLevel, List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			if (valueLevel != RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				return points[1].Y;
			}
			return points[0].Y;
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is CustomRangeBar2DModel)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				return true;
			}
			return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			if (labelItem.RefinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CalculateSeriesLabelLayout(labelItem, mapping, transform, GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel) == RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel);
		}

		protected override SeriesContainer CreateContainer()

			return new RangeSeriesContainer(this);
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.Value_1)
			{
				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value_2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Max(((IRangePoint)point).Value1, ((IRangePoint)point).Value2);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Min(((IRangePoint)point).Value1, ((IRangePoint)point).Value2);
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)point).Value1), Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)point).Value2));
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> GetPointDataByVisibilityMode(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel) != RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels || (!IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) && !IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false)))
			{
				return base.GetPointDataByVisibilityMode(points, isFirst);
			}
			return GetPointDataByVisibilityModeForTwoLabel(points);
		}

		protected internal override bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label)
		{

			{
				return label.ConnectorVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override double[] GetPointValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return new double[2]

				point.NonAnimatedValue,
				GetValue2(point)
			};
		}

		protected internal override void SetPointValues(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, double[] values, DateTime[] dateTimeValues, TimeSpan[] timeSpanValues)
		{
			base.SetPointValues(seriesPoint, values, dateTimeValues, timeSpanValues);
			if (values != null && values.Length > 1)
			{
				SetValue2(seriesPoint, values[1]);
			}
			if (dateTimeValues != null && dateTimeValues.Length > 1)
			{
				SetDateTimeValue2(seriesPoint, dateTimeValues[1]);
			}
			if (timeSpanValues != null && timeSpanValues.Length > 1)
			{
				SetTimeSpanValue2(seriesPoint, timeSpanValues[1]);
			}
		}

				GetDateTimeValue2(point)
			};
		}

			{
				point.TimeSpanValue,
				GetTimeSpanValue2(point)
			};
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointValueVisible(SeriesPointItem pointItem, RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return valueLevel switch
			{
				RangeValueLevel.TwoValues => true, 
				RangeValueLevel.Value1 => MinMarkerVisible, 
				_ => MaxMarkerVisible, 
			};
		}

		protected internal override bool IsNegativeBar(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.TwoValues)
			{
				base.CompletePointLayout(pointItem);
				return;
			}
			XYDiagram2D diagramXY = base.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			BarSeries2DPointLayout barLayout = GetBarLayout(pointItem);
			if (diagramXY == null || barLayout == null || pointItem.RefinedPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Bar2DAnimationBase animation = GetActualPointAnimation() as Bar2DAnimationBase;
			PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(pointItem, null, delegate(IPresentation layout)
			{
				if (layout is MarkerSeries2DPointLayout { InitialBounds: var rect } markerSeries2DPointLayout)
				{
					if (animation != null)
					{
						double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
						rect = ((pointItem.ValueLevel != RangeValueLevel.Value1) ? animation.CreateAnimatedMaxMarkerBounds(rect, barLayout.InitialBounds, markerSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, isNegativeBar: false, IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, diagramXY.Rotated, actualProgress) : animation.CreateAnimatedMinMarkerBounds(rect, barLayout.InitialBounds, markerSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, isNegativeBar: false, IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, diagramXY.Rotated, actualProgress));
					}
					Matrix transform = SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreatePointTransform(pointItem.Series, rect, diagramXY);
					markerSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(rect, transform);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointItem[] CreateSeriesPointItems(RefinedPoint pointInfo, SeriesPointData seriesPointData)
		{
			return new SeriesPointItem[3]
			{
				new SeriesPointItem(this, seriesPointData, RangeValueLevel.TwoValues),
				new SeriesPointItem(this, seriesPointData, RangeValueLevel.Value1),
				new SeriesPointItem(this, seriesPointData, RangeValueLevel.Value2)
			};
		}

		protected internal override RangeValueLevel GetValueLevelForLabel(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			switch (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel))
			{
			case RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels:
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			case RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel:
				return RangeValueLevel.TwoValues;
			case RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
				return RangeValueLevel.Value2;
			case RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown range bar label kind.");
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			}
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetLabelsTexts(SeriesLabel label, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (base.ActualLabel.Formatter == null)
			{
				PatternParser patternParser;
				switch (GetLabelKind(base.ActualLabel))
				{
				case RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels:
				{
					string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal);
					patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(GetActualLabelTextPattern(label), "V", minValuePlaceholder), this);
					patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, this);
					string text = patternParser.GetText();
					string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal);
					patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(GetActualLabelTextPattern(label), "V", maxValuePlaceholder), this);
					patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, this);
					string text2 = patternParser.GetText();
					return new string[2] { text, text2 };
				}
				case RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel:
				{
					string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal);
					string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal);
					patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(GetActualLabelTextPattern(label), "V", minValuePlaceholder, maxValuePlaceholder, LabelValueSeparator), this);
					break;
				}
				case RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
				{
					string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal);
					patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(GetActualLabelTextPattern(label), "V", minValuePlaceholder), this);
					break;
				}
				case RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
				{
					string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, (Scale)base.ValueScaleTypeInternal);
					patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(GetActualLabelTextPattern(label), "V", maxValuePlaceholder), this);
					break;
				}
				default:
					ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
					return new string[0];
				}
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, this);
				empty = patternParser.GetText();
			}
			else
			{
				empty = base.ActualLabel.Formatter.GetDataLabelText(refinedPoint);
			}
			return new string[1] { empty };
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return valueLevel switch
			{
				RangeValueLevel.Value1 => MinMarkerModel, 
				RangeValueLevel.Value2 => MaxMarkerModel, 
				_ => Model, 
			};
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValueFormat(valueScaleType);
			if (pointOptionsContainer is LegendPointOptionsContainer)
			{
				return "{V1" + text + "}" + LegendValueSeparator + "{V2" + text + "}";
			}
			return "{V" + text + "}";
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxPointRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram diagram, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			IRangePoint refinedPoint = point.RefinedPoint;
			double max = refinedPoint.Max;
			double min = refinedPoint.Min;
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, snapMode, min, max);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			if (base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || base.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				return ToolTipPatternUtils.DateTimeRangeViewPointPatterns;
			}
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.RangeViewPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointItemHidden(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return pointItem.ValueLevel switch
			{
				RangeValueLevel.TwoValues => false, 
				RangeValueLevel.Value1 => !MinMarkerVisible, 
				RangeValueLevel.Value2 => !MaxMarkerVisible, 
				_ => base.IsPointItemHidden(pointItem), 
			};
		}

	public class RangeBarSideBySideSeries2D : RangeBarSeries2D, ISideBySideBarSeriesView, IBarSeriesView
	{
		protected override bool NeedSeriesGroupsInteraction => true;

		double ISideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistance
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D))
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistance = value;
				}
			}
		}

		int ISideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistanceFixed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistanceFixed;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistanceFixed = value;
				}
			}
		}

		bool ISideBySideBarSeriesView.EqualBarWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).EqualBarWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).EqualBarWidth = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public RangeBarSideBySideSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<RangeBarSideBySideSeries2D>(this);
		}

		private SeriesPointLayout CreateMarkerLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem, int markerSize, double pointValue)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			double argument = refinedPoint.Argument + GetDisplayOffset(refinedPoint);
			int num = markerSize / 2;
			double num2 = GetFixedOffset(refinedPoint);
			if (IsAxisXReversed)
			{
				num2 = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(argument, pointValue);
			Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, mapping.Viewport.Width, mapping.Viewport.Height);
			return new MarkerSeries2DPointLayout(viewport, new Rect(roundedDiagramPoint.X - (double)num + num2, roundedDiagramPoint.Y - (double)num, markerSize, markerSize));
		}

		protected internal override double GetArgumentOffset(RefinedPoint refPoint)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)refPoint).Offset;
		}

		protected override double GetBarWidth(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)pointInfo).BarWidth;
		}

		protected override int GetFixedOffset(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)pointInfo).FixedOffset;
		}

		protected override double GetDisplayOffset(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)pointInfo).Offset;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				return CreateMarkerLayout(mapping, pointItem, base.MinMarkerSize, ((IRangePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Min);
			}
			if (pointItem.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value2)
			{
				return CreateMarkerLayout(mapping, pointItem, base.MaxMarkerSize, ((IRangePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Max);
			}

		}

		}

	public class SeriesCollection : ChartElementCollection<Series>
	{
		private bool autoSeriesLocked = true;

		private bool seriesSourceLocked;

		protected override ChartElementChange Change => ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems;

		protected override bool BatchUpdateSupported => true;

		private void ResetSeriesBinding(Series series)
		{
			if (series != null && !series.IsAutoSeries)
			{
				series.ResetSeriesBinding();
				series.Points.ClearUpdatesCache();
			}
		}

		internal void LockAutoSeries()
		{
			autoSeriesLocked = true;
		}

		internal void UnlockAutoSeries()
		{
			autoSeriesLocked = false;
		}

		protected override void PerformCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.PerformCollectionChanged(e);
			if (base.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (Series newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					ResetSeriesBinding(newItem);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && e.OldItems != null)
			{
				PerformAutoSeriesRemove(e.OldItems);
			}
		}

		protected override void ProcessLockedUpdateCore(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo is SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo { Operation: ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem } seriesCollectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				ResetSeriesBinding(seriesCollectionUpdateInfo.NewItem as Series);
			}
			base.ProcessLockedUpdateCore(updateInfo);
		}

		private void PerformAutoSeriesRemove(IList seriesList)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Series series in seriesList)
			{
				if (series.DataSource != null || series.IsAutoSeries)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag && base.Owner is Diagram)
			{
				((Diagram)base.Owner).RaiseBoundDataChangedEvent();
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Series series = base[num];
				if ((!autoSeriesLocked || !series.IsAutoSeries) && (!seriesSourceLocked || series.CreatedFromSeriesSource))
				{
					Remove(series);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			if (autoSeriesLocked && base[oldIndex].IsAutoSeries != base[newIndex].IsAutoSeries)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesReordering));
			}
			base.MoveItem(oldIndex, newIndex);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			Series series = base[index];
			if (autoSeriesLocked && series.IsAutoSeries)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesRemoving));
			}
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, Series item)
		{
			if (autoSeriesLocked && base[index].IsAutoSeries)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectSeriesReplacement));
			}
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			if ((action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && newItems != null && newItems.Count > 1) || (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 1))
			{
				return new SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), GetCollection<ISeries>(oldItems), oldStartingIndex, GetCollection<ISeries>(newItems), newStartingIndex);
			}
			ISeries oldItem = ((oldItems != null) ? (oldItems[0] as ISeries) : null);
			ISeries newItem = ((newItems != null) ? (newItems[0] as ISeries) : null);
			return new SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), oldItem, oldStartingIndex, newItem, newStartingIndex);
		}

		internal void LockSeriesSource()
		{
			seriesSourceLocked = true;
		}

		internal void UnlockSeriesSource()
		{
			seriesSourceLocked = false;
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}
	}
	public class SeriesObservableCollection : ObservableCollection<Series>, IList<ISeries>, ICollection<ISeries>, IEnumerable<ISeries>, IEnumerable
	{
		bool ICollection<ISeries>.IsReadOnly => false;

		ISeries IList<ISeries>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = (Series)value;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<ISeries> IEnumerable<ISeries>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<Series> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<ISeries>.Contains(ISeries series)
		{
			return Contains((Series)series);
		}

		void ICollection<ISeries>.Add(ISeries series)
		{
			Add((Series)series);
		}

		bool ICollection<ISeries>.Remove(ISeries series)
		{
			return Remove((Series)series);
		}

		void ICollection<ISeries>.CopyTo(ISeries[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = arrayIndex;
			while (num < base.Count)
			{
				array[num2] = base[num];
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
		}

		int IList<ISeries>.IndexOf(ISeries item)
		{
			return IndexOf((Series)item);
		}

		void IList<ISeries>.Insert(int index, ISeries series)
		{
			Insert(index, (Series)series);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class SeriesItem : NotifyPropertyChangedObject, ISeriesItem, IPointsProvider
	{
		private class PointDataCollection : Collection<SeriesPointData>
		{
			private readonly Series series;

			private readonly List<SeriesPointItem> allItems = new List<SeriesPointItem>();

			private readonly IPointsProvider pointsProvider;

			public List<SeriesPointItem> AllPointItems => allItems;

			private int GetStartIndexInItemCollection(int pointDataIndex, int itemCount)
			{
				return pointDataIndex * itemCount;
			}

			public PointDataCollection(Series series, IPointsProvider pointsProvider)
			{
				this.series = series;
				this.pointsProvider = pointsProvider;
			}

			protected override void ClearItems()
			{
				allItems.Clear();
				pointsProvider.VisiblePoints.Clear();
				base.ClearItems();
			}

			protected override void InsertItem(int index, SeriesPointData item)
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
				int startIndexInItemCollection = GetStartIndexInItemCollection(index, item.PointItems.Count);
				ICollection<SeriesPointItem> visiblePoints = pointsProvider.VisiblePoints;
				for (int i = 0; i < item.PointItems.Count; i++)
				{
					SeriesPointItem seriesPointItem = item.PointItems[i];
					allItems.Insert(startIndexInItemCollection + i, seriesPointItem);
					SubscribeToPropertyChangedEvent(seriesPointItem);
					if (seriesPointItem.ShowBehindAxes)
					{
						visiblePoints.Add(seriesPointItem);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
			{
				SeriesPointData seriesPointData = base[index];
				int startIndexInItemCollection = GetStartIndexInItemCollection(index, seriesPointData.PointItems.Count);
				ICollection<SeriesPointItem> visiblePoints = pointsProvider.VisiblePoints;
				for (int i = 0; i < seriesPointData.PointItems.Count; i++)
				{
					UnsubscribeToPropertyChangedEvent(seriesPointData.PointItems[i]);
					if (allItems[startIndexInItemCollection].ShowBehindAxes)
					{
						visiblePoints.Remove(allItems[startIndexInItemCollection]);
					}
					allItems.RemoveAt(startIndexInItemCollection);
				}
				base.RemoveItem(index);
			}

			protected override void SetItem(int index, SeriesPointData item)
			{
				base.SetItem(index, item);
				int startIndexInItemCollection = GetStartIndexInItemCollection(index, item.PointItems.Count);
				ICollection<SeriesPointItem> visiblePoints = pointsProvider.VisiblePoints;
				for (int i = 0; i < item.PointItems.Count; i++)
				{
					UnsubscribeToPropertyChangedEvent(allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i]);
					if (allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i].ShowBehindAxes)
					{
						visiblePoints.Remove(allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i]);
					}
					allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i] = item.PointItems[i];
					SubscribeToPropertyChangedEvent(allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i]);
					if (allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i].ShowBehindAxes)
					{
						visiblePoints.Add(allItems[startIndexInItemCollection + i]);
					}
				}
			}

			public void Update()
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem allItem in allItems)
				{
					allItem.Update();
				}
			}

			private void PointsData_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!(e.PropertyName != "ShowBehindOfAxes"))
				{
					SeriesPointItem seriesPointItem = sender as SeriesPointItem;
					ICollection<SeriesPointItem> visiblePoints = pointsProvider.VisiblePoints;
					if (seriesPointItem.ShowBehindAxes)
					{
						visiblePoints.Add(seriesPointItem);
					}
					else
					{
						visiblePoints.Remove(seriesPointItem);
					}
				}
			}

			private void SubscribeToPropertyChangedEvent(SeriesPointItem item)
			{
				item.PropertyChanged += PointsData_PropertyChanged;
			}

			private void UnsubscribeToPropertyChangedEvent(SeriesPointItem item)
			{
				item.PropertyChanged -= PointsData_PropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private class RefinedPointInfo
		{
			private RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

			private int index;

			public RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => refinedPoint;

			public int Index => index;

			public RefinedPointInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int index)
			{
				this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
				this.index = index;
			}
		}

		private readonly Series series;

		private string legendText = string.Empty;

		private bool showExclamation;

		private ObservableCollection<SeriesPointItem> visiblePointItems;

		private PointItemsDictionary pointItemsDictionary;

		public SeriesItem(Series series)

		private void CreateNativeVisiblePointsCollection()
		{
			nativeVisiblePoints = new HashSet<SeriesPointItem>();
			OnPropertyChanged("VisiblePointItems");
			NotifyUpdatePointSource();
		}

		private void CreateNotificationPoints()
		{
			visiblePointItems = new ObservableCollection<SeriesPointItem>(nativeVisiblePoints);
			nativeVisiblePoints.Clear();
		}

		internal void NotifyUpdatePointSource()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("DrawingPointItems");
		}

		private IEnumerable<int> CalculateIndexes(Series series)
		{
			bool firstSidePoint = series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || series.IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: true);
			bool lastSidePoint = series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false) || series.IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: false);
			bool flag = series.ActualColorEach && series.ActualLegend != null && series.ShowInLegend;
			int minIndex = ((!flag) ? refinedSeries.GetMinVisiblePointIndex(!firstSidePoint) : 0);
			int maxIndex = (flag ? (refinedSeries.Points.Count - 1) : refinedSeries.GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(!lastSidePoint));
			if (minIndex < 0 || maxIndex < 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (series.ShouldRaiseCustomDrawSeriesPointEvent || series.ActualColorEach || series.ArePointsVisible || series.LabelsVisibility)
			{
				for (int i = minIndex; i <= maxIndex; i++)
				{
					yield return i;
				}
				yield break;
			}
			if (firstSidePoint)
			{
				yield return minIndex;
			}
			if (lastSidePoint)
			{
				yield return maxIndex;
			}
		}

		void ISeriesItem.Update(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, out bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabels)
		{
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			shouldUpdateSeriesLabels = false;
			if (series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IContainerElement containerElement = series.Diagram?.Container;
			List<RefinedPointInfo> list = new List<RefinedPointInfo>();
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				IList<RefinedPoint> points = refinedSeries.Points;
				if (points.Count != 0 && containerElement != null)
				{
					foreach (int item in CalculateIndexes(series))
					{
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[item];
						if (refinedPoint.HasValues)
						{
							list.Add(new RefinedPointInfo(refinedPoint, item));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				if (seriesPointDataList.Count < count)
				{
					while (seriesPointDataList.Count < count)
					{
						seriesPointDataList.Add(new SeriesPointData(series, null));
					}
				}
				else if (seriesPointDataList.Count > count)
				{
					while (seriesPointDataList.Count > count)
					{
						seriesPointDataList.RemoveAt(count);
					}
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPointInfo refinedPointInfo = list[i];
					SeriesPointData seriesPointData = seriesPointDataList[i];
					series.ColorizerController.UnregisterRefinedPoint(seriesPointData.RefinedPoint);
					shouldUpdateSeriesLabels |= seriesPointData.RefinedPoint != refinedPointInfo.RefinedPoint;
					seriesPointData.RefinedPoint = refinedPointInfo.RefinedPoint;
					seriesPointData.IndexInSeries = refinedPointInfo.Index;
				}
				seriesPointDataList.Update();
				if (containerElement != null && ((containerElement.ToolTipOptions != null && containerElement.ToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions.HighlightPoints) || (containerElement.ChartOptions != null && containerElement.ChartOptions.SelectionController.ActualSelectionEnabled)))
				{
					FillPointItemsDictionary();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				seriesPointDataList.Clear();
				pointItemsDictionary = null;
			}
			ResetHighlightedItems();
		}

		private void ResetHighlightedItems()
		{
			if (Series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
			{
				xYSeries2D.ResetHighlightedItems();
			}
		}

		private void FillPointItemsDictionary()
		{
			pointItemsDictionary = new PointItemsDictionary();
			foreach (SeriesPointData seriesPointData in seriesPointDataList)
			{
				bool flag = seriesPointData.SeriesPoint is IInteractiveElement interactiveElement && interactiveElement.IsSelected;
				foreach (ISeriesPoint sourcePoint in SeriesPointHelper.GetSourcePoints(seriesPointData.SeriesPoint))
				{
					flag |= sourcePoint is IInteractiveElement && ((IInteractiveElement)sourcePoint).IsSelected;
					pointItemsDictionary.Add(sourcePoint, seriesPointData.PointItems);
				}
				foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in seriesPointData.PointItems)
				{
					pointItem.IsSelected = flag;
				}
			}
		}

		private RefinedPoint FindRefinedPoint(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, Series ownerSeries)
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = ownerSeries.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(ownerSeries);
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
				{
					foreach (ISeriesPoint sourcePoint in SeriesPointHelper.GetSourcePoints(point))
					{
						if (sourcePoint.IsSamePoints(seriesPoint))
						{
							return point;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdatePointItemsDictionary(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (pointItemsDictionary == null || !pointItemsDictionary.Contains(seriesPoint))
			{
				FillPointItemsDictionary();
			}
		}

		internal void AddPointItems(ISeriesPoint point, List<SeriesPointItem> pointItems)
		{
			if (pointItemsDictionary == null)
			{
				pointItemsDictionary = new PointItemsDictionary();
			}
			if (!pointItemsDictionary.Contains(point))
			{
				pointItemsDictionary.Add(point, pointItems);
			}
		}

		internal void RemovePointItems(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (pointItemsDictionary != null)
			{
				pointItemsDictionary.Remove(point);
			}
		}

		internal SeriesPointData CreatePointData(RefinedPoint point, System.Windows.Media.Color? seriesSegmentColor = null)
		{
			SeriesPointData seriesPointData = new SeriesPointData(series, point);
			if (DrawOptions != null)
			{
				((ISeriesPointData)seriesPointData).Color = (seriesSegmentColor.HasValue ? seriesSegmentColor.Value : DrawOptions.Color);
			}
			((ISeriesPointData)seriesPointData).Opacity = series.GetOpacity();
			return seriesPointData;
		}

		internal SeriesPointData GetPointData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPointDataList.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = Math.Max(refinedSeries.Points.IndexOf(refinedPoint), 0) - seriesPointDataList[0].IndexInSeries;
				if (num >= 0 && num < seriesPointDataList.Count)
				{
					return seriesPointDataList[num];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal List<SeriesPointItem> GetPointItems(ISeriesPoint pointInfo)
		{
			if (pointItemsDictionary != null)
			{
				return pointItemsDictionary[pointInfo];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal List<SeriesPointItem> GetAndFillPointItems(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> pointItems = GetPointItems(seriesPoint);
			if (pointItems == null)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = FindRefinedPoint(seriesPoint, ((SeriesPoint)seriesPoint).Series);
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					pointItems = GetPointItems(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
				}
				if (pointItems == null)
				{
					SeriesPointData seriesPointData = CreatePointData(refinedPoint);
					AddPointItems(seriesPoint, seriesPointData.PointItems);
				}
			}
			return pointItems;
		}

		internal void UpdateRenderingStrategy()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("IsDirectXSurfaceRendering");
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = ActualAxisX != null && ActualAxisX.ActualScaleOptions != null && ActualAxisX.ActualScaleOptions.IsIntervalScale;
				if (AllowResample && !((IResamplingSupportSeries)this).Require2dResampling)

					return !flag;

				return false;
			}

		{
			get
			{
				switch (CrosshairContentShowMode)
				{
				case CrosshairContentShowMode.Label:
					return true;
				case CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend:
					return false;
				default:
				{
					IContainerToolTipOptions containerToolTipOptions = base.Container?.ToolTipOptions;
					if (containerToolTipOptions != null && containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairOptions != null)
					{
						return containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairOptions.ContentShowMode != CrosshairContentShowMode.Legend;
					}
					return true;
				}
				}
			}
		}

				return crosshairEmptyValueLegendText;

		{
			get

				if (containerToolTipOptions != null && containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairSupported)
				{
					if (CrosshairEnabled.HasValue)
					{
						return CrosshairEnabled.Value;
					}
					if (containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairForced)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairEnabled.HasValue)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairEnabled.Value;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{

		protected internal override IPane ActualPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
				{
					return null;
				}
				Pane elementFromObject = TagUtils.GetElementFromObject(Pane, xYDiagram2D.Panes);
				if (elementFromObject == null)
				{
					return xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane;
				}
				return elementFromObject;
			}
		}

		private static void AxisXPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			xYSeries2D.AxisXInternal = e.NewValue;
			if (!xYSeries2D.UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)xYSeries2D.Diagram;
				if (xYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					IAxisData oldValue = xYSeries2D.GetAxisXFromObject(e.OldValue, xYDiagram2D) ?? xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisX;
					IAxisData newValue = xYSeries2D.GetAxisXFromObject(e.NewValue, xYDiagram2D) ?? xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisX;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(d, "AxisX", oldValue, newValue), ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
				}
			}
		}

		{

			{
				return;

			if (!xYSeries2D.UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))

					IAxisData newValue = xYSeries2D.GetAxisYFromObject(e.NewValue, xYDiagram2D) ?? xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisY;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(d, "AxisY", oldValue, newValue), ChartElementChange.UpdatePanesItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
				}
			}
		}

		private static string CrosshairPattenToEmptyValueLegendText(string pattern)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pattern))
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (char c in pattern)
				{
					if (c == '\n')
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					result = new string('\n', num);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void UpdateSidePoint(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (d is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
			{
				if (e.NewValue is SidePoint sidePoint)
				{
					sidePoint.Update(xYSeries2D, isFirst);
				}
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SidePoint, e.NewValue as SidePoint, xYSeries2D);
				Series.UpdateSeriesProperty(d, e);
			}
		}

				xYSeries2D.OnFilterOptionsChanged(string.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAdditionalGeometryClip()
		{
			Pane pane = ActualPane as Pane;
			AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer additionalGeometry = base.AdditionalGeometry;
			if (pane == null || additionalGeometry == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect viewport = pane.Viewport;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, viewport.Width, viewport.Height);
			GeneralTransform inverse = pane.ViewportTransform.Inverse;
			if (inverse != null)
			{
				if (GetActualSeriesAnimation() is IUnwindAnimation unwindAnimation)
				{
					rect = unwindAnimation.CreateAnimatedClipBounds(rect, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
				}
				rect = inverse.TransformBounds(rect);
			}
			additionalGeometry.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = rect
			};
		}

		}

		private int GetMaxIndex(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, double max)
		{
			int num = points.Count - 1;
			for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (CalcArgumentRange(points[num2].RefinedPoint).Min <= max)
				{
					return num2;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetMinIndex(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, double min)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (min <= CalcArgumentRange(points[i].RefinedPoint).Max)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal virtual ScreenPointCalculatorBase CreateScreenPointCalculator(SidePointDisplayMode displayMode)
		{
			return displayMode switch
			{
				SidePointDisplayMode.SeriesPoint => new EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder, alwaysOnDiagram: false), 
				SidePointDisplayMode.DiagramEdge => new EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder, alwaysOnDiagram: true), 
				_ => ScreenPointCalculator.Instance, 
			};
		}

		protected override void FillItemsForLabel(List<SeriesPointItem> pointItems, bool? isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst.HasValue)
			{
				base.FillItemsForLabel(pointItems, isFirst);
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in GetPointDataByVisibilityMode(base.Item.AllPointItems, isFirst.Value))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PresentationData.LabelText))
				{
					pointItems.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(point.Argument);
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> GetPointDataByVisibilityMode(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, bool isFirst)
		{
			yield return GetEdgePointItem(points, isFirst);
		}

		protected virtual SeriesPointItem GetEdgePointItem(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, bool isFirst)
		{
			Range actualVisualRange = ActualAxisX.ActualVisualRange;
			return points[isFirst ? GetMinIndex(points, actualVisualRange.ActualMinValueInternal) : GetMaxIndex(points, actualVisualRange.ActualMaxValueInternal)];
		}

		protected virtual EmptyPointOptions CreateDefaultEmptyPointOptions()

		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is RangeControlOptions)
			{
				base.Diagram?.ViewController?.UpdateRangeControlState(recreateItems: true, restoreSelection: true);
				return true;
			}
			if (sender is SidePoint sidePoint)
			{
				sidePoint.ActualLabel.UpdateLabelBehavior(this, sidePoint.LabelDisplayMode, sidePoint.Equals(FirstPoint));
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
				return true;
			}
			if (sender is EmptyPointOptions)
			{
				OnFilterOptionsChanged(string.Empty);
				return true;
			}
			return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> andFillPointItems = base.Item.GetAndFillPointItems(point);
			if (andFillPointItems == null || andFillPointItems.Count <= 0)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Point);
			}
			return CalculateToolTipPoint(andFillPointItems[0], inLabel: false);
		}

		protected bool CalculateLabelItemVisible(PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point initialAnchorPoint)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(initialAnchorPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(initialAnchorPoint.Y));
			return mapping.Viewport.Contains(point);
		}

		internal double NormalizeLabelAngle(double angle)
		{
			double num = 0.0 - angle;
			Pane pane = ActualPane as Pane;
			IAxisData actualAxisX = ActualAxisX;
			IAxisData actualAxisY = ActualAxisY;
			if (pane == null || actualAxisX == null || actualAxisY == null)
			{
				return MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(num);
			}
			if (actualAxisX.Reverse)
			{
				num = 180.0 - num;
			}
			if (actualAxisY.Reverse)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			return MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(pane.Rotated ? (-90.0 - num) : num);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, bool inLabel)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			Pane pane = (Pane)ActualPane;
			if (pane != null && pane.RenderSize != default(System.Windows.Size))
			{
				Transform viewportRenderTransform = pane.ViewportRenderTransform;
				PaneMapping mapping = new PaneMapping(pane, this);
				System.Windows.Point point = CalculateToolTipPoint(pointItem, mapping, viewportRenderTransform, inLabel);
				if (!LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)base.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement, (DependencyObject)pane))
				{
					return default(System.Windows.Point);
				}
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pane, (UIElement)base.Diagram.Container.PlatformElement);
				result = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + relativeElementRect.Left, point.Y + relativeElementRect.Top);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (base.ProcessChanging(updateInfo))
			{
				return (updateInfo.Change & ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsCompatible(Series series)
		{
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = series as XYSeries2D;
			if (!base.IsCompatible(series))
			{
				if (xYSeries2D != null)
				{
					return ActualAxisX.Equals(xYSeries2D.ActualAxisX);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal SolidColorBrush CreateCrosshairMarkerBrush(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? color = null;
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				SeriesPointData pointData = base.Item.GetPointData(refinedSeries, refinedPoint);
				if (pointData != null)
				{
					color = pointData.GetCrosshairColor(ActualColorEach);
				}
				if (!color.HasValue)
				{
					color = GetPointSeriesSegmentColor(refinedPoint);
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = (color.HasValue ? color.Value : base.Item.DrawOptions.Color);
			color2.A = (byte)((double)(int)color2.A * GetOpacity());
			return new SolidColorBrush(color2);
		}

		protected internal override void OnPointProgressChanged()
		{
			UpdateAdditionalGeometry();
		}

		protected override void SeriesProgressChanged()
		{
			base.SeriesProgressChanged();
			SeriesAnimationBase actualSeriesAnimation = GetActualSeriesAnimation();
			if (actualSeriesAnimation == null || actualSeriesAnimation.ShouldAnimateAdditionalGeometry)
			{
				UpdateAdditionalGeometry();
			}
			if (actualSeriesAnimation == null || actualSeriesAnimation.ShouldAnimateClipBounds)
			{
				UpdateAdditionalGeometryClip();
			}
		}

		}

		internal virtual void CreateSeriesPointsLayout()
		{
			PointCalculatorProvider = CreatePointCalculatorProvider();
			PresentationUpdater presentationUpdater = new PresentationUpdater(this);
			foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Item.AllPointItems)
			{
				presentationUpdater.UpdateItemPresentation(allPointItem);
			}
			pointsHighlighter.UpdateItemsPresentation(presentationUpdater);
			UpdateAdditionalGeometry();
			UpdateAdditionalGeometryClip();
		}

		internal IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> GetLabelItems()
		{
			if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
			{
				IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> items = FirstPoint.ActualLabel.Items;
				if (items != null)
				{
					foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in items)
					{
						yield return item;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ActualLabel.Items != null)
			{
				foreach (SeriesLabelItem item2 in ActualLabel.Items)
				{
					yield return item2;
				}
			}
			if (!IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
			{
				yield break;
			}
			IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> items2 = LastPoint.ActualLabel.Items;
			if (items2 == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item3 in items2)
			{
				yield return item3;
			}
		}

		internal void CreateSeriesLabelsLayout()
		{
			Pane pane = (Pane)ActualPane;
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PaneMapping mapping = new PaneMapping(pane, this);
			Transform viewportRenderTransform = pane.ViewportRenderTransform;
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem labelItem in GetLabelItems())
			{
				labelItem.Layout = CreateSeriesLabelLayout(labelItem, mapping, viewportRenderTransform);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSeriesLabelsClipBounds()
		{
			Pane pane = (Pane)ActualPane;
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect viewport = pane.Viewport;
			bool navigationEnabled = pane.NavigationEnabled;
			if (base.ActualLabel.Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in base.ActualLabel.Items)
			{
				item.UpdateClipBounds(viewport, navigationEnabled);
			}
		}

		internal void SetPointState(IDataPoint point, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, bool isHighlighted)
		{
			ISeriesPoint point2 = SeriesPointHelper.GetSourcePoints(point)[0];
			if (ShouldCalculatePointsData)
			{
				pointsHighlighter.SetPointState(point2, isHighlighted);
			}
			else if (isHighlighted && refinedPoint != null)
			{
				SeriesPointData seriesPointData = base.Item.CreatePointData(refinedPoint, GetPointSeriesSegmentColor(refinedPoint));
				base.Item.AddPointItems(point2, seriesPointData.PointItems);
				pointsHighlighter.SetPointState(point2, isHighlighted);
			}
			else
			{
				pointsHighlighter.SetPointState(point2, isHighlighted);
				base.Item.RemovePointItems(point2);
			}
			InvalidateAdditionalHighlightedGeometry();
		}

		internal void CreateSeriesLabelConnectorsLayout()
		{
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem labelItem in GetLabelItems())
			{
				labelItem.UpdateConnectorItemLayout();
			}
		}

		internal void ResetHighlightedItems()
		{
			pointsHighlighter.ResetHighlightedItems();
			InvalidateAdditionalHighlightedGeometry();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateLabelItems()
		{
			if (base.Item.AllPointItems.Count > 0)
			{
				List<SeriesPointItem> list = new List<SeriesPointItem>();
				if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
				{
					FillItemsForLabel(list, true);
					ActualFirstPoint.ActualLabel.UpdateItems(list);
				}
				List<SeriesPointItem> list2 = new List<SeriesPointItem>();
				if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
				{
					FillItemsForLabel(list2, false);
					foreach (SeriesPointItem item in list)
					{
						list2.Remove(item);
					}
					ActualLastPoint.ActualLabel.UpdateItems(list2);
				}
				List<SeriesPointItem> list3 = new List<SeriesPointItem>();
				if (base.LabelsVisibility)
				{
					foreach (SeriesPointItem allPointItem in base.Item.AllPointItems)
					{
						if (!allPointItem.RefinedPoint.IsEmpty && !list.Contains(allPointItem) && !list2.Contains(allPointItem) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(allPointItem.PresentationData.LabelText))
						{
							list3.Add(allPointItem);
						}
					}
				}
				base.ActualLabel.UpdateItems(list3);
			}
			else
			{
				if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true))
				{
					ActualFirstPoint.ActualLabel.UpdateItems(null);
				}
				if (IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
				{
					ActualLastPoint.ActualLabel.UpdateItems(null);
				}
				base.ActualLabel.UpdateItems(null);
			}
		}

		internal override void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			base.CompleteDeserializing();
			if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (paneIndex >= 0 && paneIndex < xYDiagram2D.Panes.Count)
			{
				Pane = xYDiagram2D.Panes[paneIndex];
			}
			if (axisXIndex >= 0 && axisXIndex < xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesXInternal.Count)
			{
				AxisX = xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesXInternal[axisXIndex];
			}
			if (axisYIndex >= 0 && axisYIndex < xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesYInternal.Count)
			{
				AxisY = xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesYInternal[axisYIndex];
			}
			foreach (Indicator indicator in Indicators)
			{
				indicator.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
		}

			properties.Add(PaneProperty);

			properties.Add(RangeControlOptionsProperty);
			properties.Add(EmptyPointOptionsProperty);
		}

		}

				SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = base.Cache.GetSeriesPointCache(seriesPoint);
				if (seriesPointCache != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color brushColor = (IsPredefinedModelUses ? GetSeriesPointColor(seriesPointCache.RefinedPoint) : VisualSelectionHelper.CustomModelSelectionColor);
					xYDiagram3D.ChangeItemBrush(seriesPoint, brushColor);
				}
			}

				xYDiagram3D.ChangeItemBrush(this, brushColor);

		internal System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(IPlatformSeriesPoint point)
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			Diagram3D diagram3D = base.Diagram as Diagram3D;
			SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = base.Cache.GetSeriesPointCache(point);
			if (seriesPointCache != null && diagram3D != null && diagram3D.Container != null && diagram3D.VisualContainers.Count > 0)
			{
				VisualContainer visualContainer = diagram3D.VisualContainers[0];
				Diagram3DDomain diagram3DDomain = diagram3D.CreateDomain(visualContainer);
				Point3D point2 = base.SeriesData.CalculateToolTipPoint(seriesPointCache, diagram3DDomain);
				result = diagram3DDomain.Project(point2);
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)visualContainer, (UIElement)diagram3D.Container.PlatformElement);
				result.X += relativeElementRect.Left;
				result.Y += relativeElementRect.Top;
			}
			return result;
		}
