	public class BrushOverlayConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush) && value is System.Windows.Media.Color color)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = null;
				if (parameter is string)
				{
					brush = new SolidColorBrush(ColorHelper.CreateColorFromString(parameter as string));
				}
				if (parameter is System.Windows.Media.Color)
				{
					brush = new SolidColorBrush((System.Windows.Media.Color)parameter);
				}
				if (parameter is System.Windows.Media.Brush)
				{
					brush = parameter as System.Windows.Media.Brush;
				}
				if (brush == null)
				{
					return new SolidColorBrush(color);
				}
				return ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(brush), color);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class RectsListToGeometryConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType == typeof(Geometry))
			{
				if (value is Rect)
				{
					return new RectangleGeometry
					{
						Rect = (Rect)value
					};
				}
				if (value is List<Rect>)
				{
					GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
					{
						foreach (Rect item in (List<Rect>)value)
						{
							geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
							{
								Rect = item
							});
						}
						return geometryGroup;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class LinesListToGeometryConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType == typeof(Geometry))
			{
				if (value is GRealLine2D gRealLine2D)

						EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(gRealLine2D.End.X, gRealLine2D.End.Y)
					};

				if (value is List<GRealLine2D>)

					GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();

								StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(item.Start.X, item.Start.Y),
								EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(item.End.X, item.End.Y)
							});
						}
						return geometryGroup;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

	public class AnnotationLocationToTransformConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is AnnotationLocation && targetType == typeof(Transform))
			{
				AnnotationLocation annotationLocation = (AnnotationLocation)value;
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				switch (annotationLocation)
				{
				case AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft:
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleX = -1.0,
						ScaleY = -1.0
					});
					break;
				case AnnotationLocation.BottomRight:
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleY = -1.0
					});
					break;
				case AnnotationLocation.TopLeft:
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleX = -1.0
					});
					break;
				}
				return transformGroup;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class PointCollectionToGeometryConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = value as List<System.Windows.Point>;
			if (targetType == typeof(Geometry) && list != null && list.Count > 1)
			{
				PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
				foreach (System.Windows.Point item in list)
				{
					pointCollection.Add(item);
				}
				PolyLineSegment value2 = new PolyLineSegment
				{
					Points = pointCollection
				};
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
				{
					IsFilled = false,
					IsClosed = false,
					StartPoint = list[0],
					Segments = new PathSegmentCollection()
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(value2);
				PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry
				{
					Figures = new PathFigureCollection()
				};
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
				return pathGeometry;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class SelectionListRectToGeometryConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType == typeof(Geometry) && value is List<Rect>)
			{
				List<Rect> list = (List<Rect>)value;
				if (list.Count == 1)
				{
					return new RectangleGeometry
					{
						Rect = list[0],
						RadiusX = VisualSelectionHelper.SelectionRectCornerRadius,
						RadiusY = VisualSelectionHelper.SelectionRectCornerRadius
					};
				}
				if (list.Count > 1)
				{
					EllipseGeometry geometry = CreateEllipseGeometry(list[0]);
					EllipseGeometry geometry2 = CreateEllipseGeometry(list[1]);
					return Geometry.Combine(geometry, geometry2, GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, null);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private EllipseGeometry CreateEllipseGeometry(Rect rect)
		{
			return new EllipseGeometry
			{
				RadiusX = rect.Width / 2.0,
				RadiusY = rect.Height / 2.0,
				Center = RectExtension.Center(rect)
			};
		}
	}

	public class BoolToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value.GetType() != typeof(bool) && value.GetType() != typeof(bool?))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return (!(bool)value) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class HeightToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				return Visibility.Hidden;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class BrushOverlayMultiConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (targetType != typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush) || values.Length != 2 || (values[0] != null && values[0].GetType() != typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush)) || values[1].GetType() != typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color))
			{
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning("The BrushOverlayMultiConverter is not applicable in this case.");
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = (System.Windows.Media.Color)values[1];
			if (values[0] != null)
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)values[1];
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = null;
			if (parameter is string)
			{
				brush = new SolidColorBrush(ColorHelper.CreateColorFromString(parameter as string));
			}
			if (parameter is System.Windows.Media.Color)
			{
				brush = new SolidColorBrush((System.Windows.Media.Color)parameter);
			}
			if (parameter is System.Windows.Media.Brush)
			{
				brush = parameter as System.Windows.Media.Brush;
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(color);
			}
			return ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(brush), color);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}
	public class CollapsedToPaneContentVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter

		}

	public class LayoutSizeValueConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				if (text.Equals("*"))
				{
					return new LayoutSizeValue(1.0, LayoutSizeValueType.Weight);
				}
				if (text.EndsWith("*"))
				{
					return new LayoutSizeValue(Convert.ToDouble(text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1), culture), LayoutSizeValueType.Weight);
				}
				return new LayoutSizeValue(Convert.ToDouble(text, culture), LayoutSizeValueType.Absolute);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is LayoutSizeValue layoutSizeValue && destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				string text = layoutSizeValue.Value.ToString(culture);
				if (layoutSizeValue.IsWeight)
				{
					return text + "*";
				}
				return text;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	public class SimplePanel : Panel
	{
		private const double defaultWidth = 300.0;

		private const double defaultHeight = 300.0;

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			return MeasureOverrideCore(availableSize, measureChildren: true);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size MeasureOverrideCore(System.Windows.Size availableSize, bool measureChildren)
		{
			double width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Width);
			double height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 300.0 : availableSize.Height);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			if (measureChildren)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child?.Measure(size);
				}
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			return ArrangeOverrideCore(finalSize, arrangeChildren: true);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverrideCore(System.Windows.Size finalSize, bool arrangeChildren)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize);
			if (arrangeChildren)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Arrange(finalRect);
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

		private static void PointSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3D series3D && e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				SeriesPoint3DSourceBase seriesPoint3DSourceBase = e.NewValue as SeriesPoint3DSourceBase;
				series3D.UpdateActualData(seriesPoint3DSourceBase);
				if (seriesPoint3DSourceBase != null)
				{
					seriesPoint3DSourceBase.UpdateData();

				{
					series3D.NotifyPointsClear();
				}
			}

		internal static IDataPoint CreateLightSeriesPoint(ISeriesDataAdapter adapter, Series3DBase series, object tag, IRowData rowData)
		{
			object boxedValue = rowData.DataMemberContainers[0].BoxedValue;
			object boxedValue2 = rowData.DataMemberContainers[1].BoxedValue;
			double[] array = new double[rowData.DataMemberContainers.Count - 2];
			for (int i = 2; i < rowData.DataMemberContainers.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i - 2] = ((IDataMemberContainer<double>)rowData.DataMemberContainers[i]).Value;
			}
			object colorKey = null;
			object hint = null;
			if (adapter != null && rowData.AdditionalContainers != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(adapter.ToolTipHintDataMember))
				{
					hint = rowData.AdditionalContainers[adapter.ToolTipHintDataMember].BoxedValue;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(adapter.ColorDataMember))
				{
					colorKey = rowData.AdditionalContainers[adapter.ColorDataMember].BoxedValue;
				}
			}
			return new LightSeriesPoint3D(boxedValue, boxedValue2, array, colorKey, tag, hint, series);
		}

		public Series3D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set2<Series3D>(this);
			cache = new SeriesCache();
		}

		internal void UpdateLegendItems(Legend legend, IList<LegendItem> legendItems, SeriesCache cache)
		{
			if ((base.ShowInLegend.HasValue ? base.ShowInLegend.Value : base.ActualView.DefaultShowSeriesInLegend) && legend == base.ActualLegend)
			{
				string pattern = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.LegendTextPattern) ? "{S}" : base.LegendTextPattern);
				PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(pattern, base.ActualView);
				patternParser.SetContext(this);
				string text = patternParser.GetText();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					legendItems.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, this, this, text, base.ActualView.GetSeriesLegendBrush(this)));
				}
			}
			base.ActualView.FillLegendItems(legend, legendItems);
		}

			return base.ActualView.CreateSeriesLabelData(chartBox);
		}

		internal string[] GetLabelsTexts(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (base.LabelsVisibility)
			{
				if (base.ActualLabel.Formatter == null)
				{
					PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(ActualLabelTextPattern, base.ActualView);
					patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, this);
					text = patternParser.GetText();
				}
				else
				{
					text = base.ActualLabel.Formatter.GetDataLabelText(refinedPoint);
				}
			}
			return new string[1] { text };
		}

		internal object CalculateAdditionalHitInfo(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult)
		{
			return base.ActualView?.CalculateAdditionalHitInfo(ray3DResult);
		}

		}

	public class Series3DCollection : ChartElementCollection<Series3D>
	{
		protected override bool BatchUpdateSupported => true;

		protected override ChartElementChange Change => ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache;

		protected override void PerformCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.PerformCollectionChanged(e);
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series3D newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				if (newItem != null && newItem.PointSource != null)
				{
					newItem.ActualPointAdapter.UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			if ((action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && newItems != null && newItems.Count > 1) || (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 1))
			{
				return new SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), GetCollection<ISeries>(oldItems), oldStartingIndex, GetCollection<ISeries>(newItems), newStartingIndex);
			}
			ISeries oldItem = ((oldItems != null) ? (oldItems[0] as ISeries) : null);
			ISeries newItem = ((newItems != null) ? (newItems[0] as ISeries) : null);
			return new SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), oldItem, oldStartingIndex, newItem, newStartingIndex);
		}
	}

		internal static SeriesPoint3D GetSeriesPoint(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point is SeriesPoint3D result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (point is LightSeriesPoint3D lightSeriesPoint3D)
			{
				return new SeriesPoint3D(lightSeriesPoint3D);
			}
			if (point is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
			{
				return new SeriesPoint3D(aggregatedPoint);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private SeriesPoint3D(LightSeriesPoint3D lightSeriesPoint3D)
		{
			argumentX = new SeriesPointArgumentXContainer(this, ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint3D).ArgumentX.UserArgument);
			argumentY = new SeriesPointArgumentYContainer(this, ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint3D).ArgumentY.UserArgument);
			numericalValue = ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint3D).Values.NumericalValues[0];
			Series3DBase series = lightSeriesPoint3D.Series;
			owner = series;
			tag = lightSeriesPoint3D.Tag;
		}

		private SeriesPoint3D(AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
		{
			argumentX = new SeriesPointArgumentXContainer(this, ((ISeriesPoint)aggregatedPoint).ArgumentX.UserArgument);
			argumentY = new SeriesPointArgumentYContainer(this, ((ISeriesPoint)aggregatedPoint).ArgumentY.UserArgument);
			numericalValue = ((ISeriesPoint)aggregatedPoint).Values.NumericalValues[0];
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedPoint.SourcePoints)
			{
				if (sourcePoint.SeriesPoint is LightSeriesPoint3D lightSeriesPoint3D)
				{
					list.Add(lightSeriesPoint3D.Tag);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				tag = list[0];
			}
			else
			{
				tag = list;
			}
			owner = (Series3DBase)aggregatedPoint.Series;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void Update(string propertyName)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo<ISeries, ISeriesPoint>(this, propertyName, null, null, Series), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

		internal static bool CheckEmpty(Scale valueScaleType, double[] values)
		{
			if (valueScaleType == Scale.Numerical)
			{
				foreach (double d in values)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(d))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect scale type for the series point value.");
			return true;
		}

	public class SeriesPoint3DCollection : ChartElementCollection<SeriesPoint3D>
	{
		private Series3D Series => ((SeriesPoint3DSourceBase)base.Owner).Series;

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateLogicalTree => false;

		protected override bool BatchUpdateSupported => true;

		protected override ChartElementChange Change => ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache;

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			if ((action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && newItems != null && newItems.Count > 1) || (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 1))
			{
				return new SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), Series, GetCollection<IDataPoint>(oldItems), oldStartingIndex, GetCollection<IDataPoint>(newItems), newStartingIndex);
			}
			IDataPoint oldItem = ((oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 0) ? (oldItems[0] as IDataPoint) : null);
			IDataPoint newItem = ((newItems != null && newItems.Count > 0) ? (newItems[0] as IDataPoint) : null);
			return new SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), Series, oldItem, oldStartingIndex, newItem, newStartingIndex);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}
	}

				BarSize = ((bar3DSeriesView.BarSize != null) ? ((Bar3DSize)bar3DSeriesView.BarSize.Clone()) : null);
				EqualBarSize = bar3DSeriesView.EqualBarSize;
			}

		}

		internal System.Windows.Size GetDrawingBarSize(XYZChartBox chartBox)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(1.0, chartBox.GetValueByAxisX(ActualBarSize.X));
			double num2 = Math.Max(1.0, chartBox.GetValueByAxisZ(ActualBarSize.Z));
			if (EqualBarSize)
			{
				num = (num2 = Math.Min(num, num2));
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(BarSizeConverter))]
	public class Bar3DSize : ICloneable
	{
		private const char Delimiter = ',';

		private const int ElementsCount = 2;

		private double x;

		private double z;

		internal bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (x > 0.0)
				{
					return z > 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the length of bars along the X-axis.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public double X
		{
			get
			{
				return x;
			}
			set
			{
				x = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the length of bars along the Z-axis.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public double Z
		{
			get
			{
				return z;
			}
			set
			{
				z = value;
			}
		}

		public static Bar3DSize Parse(string source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			try
			{
				string[] array = source.Split(',');
				if (array.Length != 2)
				{
					throw new Exception();
				}
				double[] array2 = new double[2];
				for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = double.Parse(array[i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				return new Bar3DSize(array2[0], array2[1]);
			}
			catch
			{
				throw new FormatException("Invalid format");
			}
		}

		public Bar3DSize(double x, double z)
		{
			this.x = x;
			this.z = z;
		}

		public Bar3DSize()
			: this(0.0, 0.0)
		{
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return new Bar3DSize(x, z);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"X: {x}; Z: {z}";
		}
	}

		double IXYWSeriesView.GetSideMargins(AxisGroup axisGroup, double min, double max)
		{
			if (axisGroup == AxisGroup.Value)
			{
				if (AutoSize)
				{
					double rangeInUnits = ((max == min) ? 1.0 : (max - min));
					double z = base.Chart.DrawingSize.Z;
					actualMaxSize = CalculateBubbleAutoSize(rangeInUnits, z, 0.2, 12.0);
					actualMinSize = CalculateBubbleAutoSize(rangeInUnits, z, 0.05, 4.0);
				}
				else
				{
					actualMaxSize = MaxSize;
					actualMinSize = MinSize;
				}
				return actualMaxSize;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		double IXYWSeriesView.GetMarkerSizeInAxisUnits(IXYWPoint point)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public Bubble3DSeriesView()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set2<Bubble3DSeriesView>(this);
		}

		private double CalculateBubbleAutoSize(double rangeInUnits, double rangeInPixels, double autoSizePercent, double minSizeInPixels)
		{
			double num = rangeInPixels / rangeInUnits;
			double num2 = autoSizePercent * rangeInUnits;
			if (num * num2 < minSizeInPixels)
			{
				return minSizeInPixels / num;
			}
			return num2;
		}

				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Weight;
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<IEnumerable<double>> GetAdditionalValues(SeriesPoint3DMatrixAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			yield return GetWeights(dataAdapter);
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Series3DViewBase seriesView)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(seriesView);
			if (seriesView is Bubble3DSeriesView bubble3DSeriesView)

	public abstract class Point3DModelBase : Chart3DDependencyObject
	{
		protected Series3DViewBase View => (Series3DViewBase)base.Owner;

		protected virtual string ModelName => string.Empty;

		protected abstract void CreatePointGeometry(Geometry3DWrapper geometry, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, XYZChartBox diagramBox);

		protected virtual void UpdateDrawingSettings(XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AssignForBinding(Point3DModelBase model)
		{
		}

		internal Model3D CreateSeriesModel(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			UpdateDrawingSettings(diagramBox);
			ModelAggregator modelAggregator = new ModelAggregator(View.ActualPointColorizer);
			for (int i = 0; i < refinedPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = refinedPoints[i];
				Geometry3DWrapper geometry3DWrapper = modelAggregator.PushGeometry(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint, i);
				if (geometry3DWrapper != null)
				{
					int pointsCount = geometry3DWrapper.PointsCount;
					CreatePointGeometry(geometry3DWrapper, refinedPoint, diagramBox);
					geometry3DWrapper.AddModel3DTag(pointsCount, refinedPoint);
				}
			}
			return modelAggregator.CreateModel();
		}

		internal Point3DModelBase CreateCloneForBinding()
		{
			Point3DModelBase point3DModelBase = (Point3DModelBase)CreateObject();
			point3DModelBase.AssignForBinding(this);
			return point3DModelBase;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ModelName))
			{
				return ModelName;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}
	}

	public abstract class Bar3DPointModel : Point3DModelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowFacetsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowFacets", typeof(bool), typeof(Bar3DPointModel), new PropertyMetadata(true, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		private Bar3DSeriesSettings seriesSettings;

		[Description("Gets or sets the value indicating whether the bar facets should be shown.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public bool ShowFacets
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowFacetsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowFacetsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private double GetZeroPosition(IMinMaxValues valuesRange)
		{
			if (valuesRange.Min < 0.0 && valuesRange.Max < 0.0)
			{
				return valuesRange.Max;
			}
			if (valuesRange.Min > 0.0 && valuesRange.Max > 0.0)
			{
				return valuesRange.Min;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override void UpdateDrawingSettings(XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			Bar3DSeriesView bar3DSeriesView = (Bar3DSeriesView)base.View;
			System.Windows.Size drawingBarSize = bar3DSeriesView.GetDrawingBarSize(diagramBox);
			double zeroPosition = GetZeroPosition(diagramBox.ValuesRange);
			double absoluteValueByAxisY = diagramBox.GetAbsoluteValueByAxisY(zeroPosition);
			seriesSettings = CreateSeriesSettings(drawingBarSize.Width, drawingBarSize.Height, absoluteValueByAxisY);
		}

		protected virtual Bar3DSeriesSettings CreateSeriesSettings(double widthX, double widthZ, double zeroY)
		{
			return new Bar3DSeriesSettings(zeroY, widthX, widthZ, ShowFacets);
		}

		protected abstract Bar3DRenderer CreateRenderer(Bar3DSeriesSettings seriesSettings, Point3D location);

		protected override void CreatePointGeometry(Geometry3DWrapper geometry, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			Point3D diagramPoint = diagramBox.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.ArgumentY, refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value));
			Bar3DRenderer bar3DRenderer = CreateRenderer(seriesSettings, diagramPoint);
			bar3DRenderer.Render(geometry);
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Point3DModelBase model)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(model);
			if (model is Bar3DPointModel bar3DPointModel)
			{
				ShowFacets = bar3DPointModel.ShowFacets;
			}
		}
	}

		{
			return ActualMarkerSize;
		}
	}
	public enum DetalizationLevel
	{
		Low,
		Normal,
		High
	}
	public abstract class Marker3DPointModel : Point3DModelBase
	{
		protected new Marker3DSeriesView View => (Marker3DSeriesView)base.View;
	}
	public class Marker3DSpherePointModel : Marker3DPointModel
	{
		private const int MaxDetalizationBase = 2;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SphereDetalizationLevelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SphereDetalizationLevel", typeof(DetalizationLevel), typeof(Marker3DSpherePointModel), new PropertyMetadata(DetalizationLevel.Normal, Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged));

		private readonly SphereModelCalculator sphereModelCalculator;

		[Description("Gets or sets the value specifying the detalization level of the sphere markers.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public DetalizationLevel SphereDetalizationLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (DetalizationLevel)GetValue(SphereDetalizationLevelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SphereDetalizationLevelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override string ModelName => "Sphere 3D Marker Model";

		internal static GeometryInfo CreateSphereMarker(double radius, int requiredLevel)
		{
			SphereModelCalculator sphereModelCalculator = new SphereModelCalculator(radius);
			return sphereModelCalculator.GetGeometry(requiredLevel);
		}

		public Marker3DSpherePointModel()
		{
			sphereModelCalculator = new SphereModelCalculator(1.0);
		}

		protected override void CreatePointGeometry(Geometry3DWrapper geometry, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			Point3D diagramPoint = diagramBox.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.ArgumentY, refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value));
			double num = base.View.GetMarkerSize(refinedPoint, diagramBox) / 2.0;
			double num2 = Math.Log(num, 5.0) * 0.8;
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num2 > 2.0)
			{
				num2 = 2.0;
			}
			int requiredLevel = (int)((int)num2 + SphereDetalizationLevel);
			GeometryInfo geometry2 = sphereModelCalculator.GetGeometry(requiredLevel);
			geometry.AddModel(geometry2.Points, geometry2.TriangleIndices, diagramPoint, num);
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Point3DModelBase model)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(model);
			if (model is Marker3DSpherePointModel marker3DSpherePointModel)
			{
				SphereDetalizationLevel = marker3DSpherePointModel.SphereDetalizationLevel;
			}
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Marker3DSpherePointModel();
		}
	}
	public class Marker3DCubePointModel : Marker3DPointModel
	{
		protected override string ModelName => "Cube 3D Marker Model";

		protected override void CreatePointGeometry(Geometry3DWrapper geometry, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			Point3D diagramPoint = diagramBox.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.ArgumentY, refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value));
			double num = base.View.GetMarkerSize(refinedPoint, diagramBox) / 2.0;
			Point3D point3D = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num, num);
			Point3D point3D2 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(0.0 - num, num, num);
			Point3D point3D3 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(num, num, num);
			Point3D point3D4 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(num, 0.0 - num, num);
			Point3D point3D5 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			Point3D point3D6 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(0.0 - num, num, 0.0 - num);
			Point3D point3D7 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(num, num, 0.0 - num);
			Point3D point3D8 = diagramPoint + new Vector3D(num, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			geometry.AddPlane(point3D, point3D2, point3D3, point3D4);
			geometry.AddPlane(point3D8, point3D7, point3D6, point3D5);
			geometry.AddPlane(point3D5, point3D6, point3D2, point3D);
			geometry.AddPlane(point3D4, point3D3, point3D7, point3D8);
			geometry.AddPlane(point3D3, point3D2, point3D6, point3D7);
			geometry.AddPlane(point3D5, point3D, point3D4, point3D8);
		}

		protected override Chart3DDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Marker3DCubePointModel();
		}
	}

		private static void ProjectionOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SurfaceSeriesView surfaceSeriesView)

				surfaceSeriesView.UpdateActualProjectionOptions(e.NewValue as ProjectionOptions);
				Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChanged(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnFillStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SurfaceSeriesView surfaceSeriesView)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				if (e.Property == FillStyleProperty)
				{
					surfaceSeriesView.UpdateActualFillStyle(e.NewValue as FillStyleBase);
				}
				Series3DViewBase.ViewPropertyChangedWithUpdateLegend(d, e);
			}
		}

		public SurfaceSeriesView()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set2<SurfaceSeriesView>(this);
			UpdateActualProjectionOptions(null);
			UpdateActualFillStyle(null);
		}

		private void ApplyBrushToMaterial(Material material, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (!(material is MaterialGroup materialGroup))
			{
				SetBrush(material, brush);
				return;
			}
			foreach (Material child in materialGroup.Children)
			{
				ApplyBrushToMaterial(child, brush);
			}
		}

		private void SetBrush(Material material, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (material is DiffuseMaterial { Brush: null } diffuseMaterial)
			{
				diffuseMaterial.Brush = brush;
			}
			else if (material is SpecularMaterial { Brush: null } specularMaterial)
			{
				specularMaterial.Brush = brush;
			}
			else if (material is EmissiveMaterial { Brush: null } emissiveMaterial)
			{
				emissiveMaterial.Brush = brush;
			}
		}

		private Material CreateModelMaterial(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			MaterialGroup materialGroup = new MaterialGroup();
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new DiffuseMaterial(brush));
			materialGroup.Children.Add(CreateDefaultSpecularMaterial());
			return materialGroup;
		}

		private Material CreateDefaultSpecularMaterial()
		{
			return new SpecularMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 75, 75, 75)), 9.0);
		}

		private void UpdateActualProjectionOptions(ProjectionOptions projectionOptions)
		{
			ActualXZProjectionOptions = projectionOptions ?? CreateDefaultProjectionOptions();
		}

		private void UpdateActualFillStyle(FillStyleBase fillStyle)
		{
			ActualFillStyle = fillStyle ?? CreateDefaultFillStyle();
		}

		private ProjectionOptions CreateDefaultProjectionOptions()
		{
			return new ProjectionOptions
			{
				Visible = false
			};
		}

		private FillStyleBase CreateDefaultFillStyle()
		{
			SolidFillStyle solidFillStyle = new SolidFillStyle();
			((IOwnedElement)solidFillStyle).Owner = this;
			return solidFillStyle;
		}

		private ModelCalculatorBase CreateModelCalculator(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			IMatrixSourceDataAdapter matrixSourceDataAdapter = ((base.Series != null) ? (base.Series.PointSource as IMatrixSourceDataAdapter) : null);
			if (matrixSourceDataAdapter != null)
			{
				return new MatrixModelCalculator(refinedPoints, diagramBox, matrixSourceDataAdapter.Dimension.Width, matrixSourceDataAdapter.Dimension.Height);
			}
			if (VisualizationMode == SurfaceVisualizationMode.Grid)
			{
				return new MatrixModelCalculator(refinedPoints, diagramBox, dimensionX, dimensionY);
			}
			if (VisualizationMode == SurfaceVisualizationMode.Triangulation)
			{
				return new TriangulatorModelCalculator(refinedPoints, diagramBox);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FillStyleBase CloneFillStyle(FillStyleBase source)
		{
			return source?.CreateCloneForBinding();
		}

		private ProjectionOptions CloneProjectionOptions(ProjectionOptions projectionOptions)
		{
			return projectionOptions?.CreateCloneForBinding();
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<IDrawingModelCreator> CreateDrawingModel(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, XYZChartBox diagramBox)
		{
			List<IDrawingModelCreator> list = new List<IDrawingModelCreator>();
			ModelCalculatorBase modelCalculator = CreateModelCalculator(refinedPoints, diagramBox);
			list.Add(new SurfaceDrawingModelCreator(modelCalculator, this));
			if (MarkerVisible)
			{
				list.AddRange(base.CreateDrawingModel(refinedPoints, diagramBox));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override Series3DViewBase CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new SurfaceSeriesView();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(double value, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ActualFillStyle.GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(value);
		}

		protected override void AssignForBinding(Series3DViewBase seriesView)
		{
			base.AssignForBinding(seriesView);
			if (seriesView is SurfaceSeriesView surfaceSeriesView)
			{
				MarkerSize = surfaceSeriesView.MarkerSize;
				VisualizationMode = surfaceSeriesView.VisualizationMode;
				MaxDrawingPointCount = surfaceSeriesView.MaxDrawingPointCount;
				FillStyle = CloneFillStyle(surfaceSeriesView.FillStyle);
				BackFillStyle = CloneFillStyle(surfaceSeriesView.BackFillStyle);
				XOYProjectionOptions = CloneProjectionOptions(surfaceSeriesView.XOYProjectionOptions);
				MarkerVisible = surfaceSeriesView.MarkerVisible;
				Material = surfaceSeriesView.Material;
			}
		}

		protected override Crosshair3DManagerBase CreateCrosshair3DManager()
		{
			return new SurfaceCrosshair3DManager(this);
		}

		protected internal override void FillLegendItems(Legend legend, IList<LegendItem> legendItems)
		{
			ActualFillStyle.UpdateBrushOffsetMapping(base.Chart?.ActualZAxis);
			if (FillStyle != null && ActualFillStyle.ActualLegend == legend)
			{
				ActualFillStyle.FillLegendItems(legendItems, legend, base.Series);
			}
			base.FillLegendItems(legend, legendItems);
		}

		protected internal override Series3DLabelData CreateSeriesLabelData(XYZChartBox chartBox)
		{
			return new SurfaceSeries3DLabelData(base.Series);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSeriesLegendBrush(Series3D series)
		{
			return ActualFillStyle.GetSeriesLegendBrush(series);
		}

		protected internal override object CalculateAdditionalHitInfo(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult)
		{
			Crosshair3DPoint crosshair3DPoint = base.Crosshair3DManager.CreateCrosshairPoint(ray3DResult);
			if (crosshair3DPoint != null)
			{
				double value = (double)crosshair3DPoint.CursorProjection.AxesYValue.CalculateNativeValue();
				System.Windows.Media.Brush crosshairMarkerBrush = GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(value, crosshair3DPoint.RefinedPoint);
				SeriesPoint3D nearestSeriesPoint = ((crosshair3DPoint.NearestPoint != null) ? SeriesPoint3D.GetSeriesPoint(crosshair3DPoint.NearestPoint.SeriesPoint) : null);
				return new SurfacePoint(crosshair3DPoint.CursorProjection.AxesXValue.CalculateNativeValue(), crosshair3DPoint.CursorProjection.AxesZValue.CalculateNativeValue(), crosshair3DPoint.CursorProjection.AxesYValue.CalculateNativeValue(), crosshairMarkerBrush, nearestSeriesPoint);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Material CreateMaterial(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			ActualFillStyle.UpdateBrushOffsetMapping(base.Chart?.ActualZAxis);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ActualFillStyle.CreateBrush(base.Palette, range.Min, range.Max);
			Material material = Material;
			if (material == null)
			{
				return CreateModelMaterial(brush);
			}
			Material material2 = material.Clone();
			ApplyBrushToMaterial(material2, brush);
			return material2;
		}
	}

		private static void ColorizerPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series3DViewBase series3DViewBase)

				series3DViewBase.UpdateActualColorizer(e.NewValue as Colorizer3DBase);
			}
			ViewPropertyChangedWithUpdateLegend(d, e);
		}

		{
			return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Value;
		}

		protected virtual void AssignForBinding(Series3DViewBase seriesView)
		{
			if (seriesView != null)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).Style = ((FrameworkContentElement)(object)seriesView).Style;
				LegendMarkerTemplate = seriesView.LegendMarkerTemplate;
				Colorizer = ((seriesView.Colorizer != null) ? seriesView.Colorizer.CreateCloneForBinding() : null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual Point3DModelBase CreateDefaultPointModel()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected void UpdateActualModel(Point3DModelBase model)
		{
			Point3DModelBase actualPointModel = ActualPointModel;
			ActualPointModel = model ?? CreateDefaultPointModel();
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(actualPointModel, ActualPointModel, this);
		}

		protected void UpdateActualColorizer(Colorizer3DBase colorizer)
		{
			Colorizer3DBase actualPointColorizer = ActualPointColorizer;
			ActualPointColorizer = colorizer ?? new SolidColorizer3D();
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(actualPointColorizer, ActualPointColorizer, this);
		}

		protected internal bool ProcessCrosshairData(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult, ObservableCollection<Crosshair3DAxisLabelItem> crosshairAxisLabelItems, ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelItem> crosshairSeriesLabelItems)
		{
			if (!Series.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Crosshair3DManager.ProcessCrosshairData(ray3DResult, crosshairAxisLabelItems, crosshairSeriesLabelItems);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal void ResetCrosshairData()
		{
			Crosshair3DManager.ResetCrosshairData();
		}

		protected internal virtual PatternDataProvider GetPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "S")
			{
				return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
			}
			if (patternConstant == "HINT")
			{
				return new SimplePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, null);
			}
			IAxisData axisByPatternConstant = GetAxisByPatternConstant(patternConstant);
			if (axisByPatternConstant != null)
			{
				return new XYZPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisByPatternConstant.AxisScaleTypeMap);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSeriesLegendBrush(Series3D series)
		{
			return ActualPointColorizer.GetSeriesLegendBrush(series);
		}

		protected internal abstract Series3DLabelData CreateSeriesLabelData(XYZChartBox chartBox);

		protected internal virtual object CalculateAdditionalHitInfo(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult)
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal Series3DViewBase CopyPropertiesForBinding(Series3DViewBase source)
		{
			try
			{
				base.ChangedLocker.Lock();
				AssignForBinding(source);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.ChangedLocker.Unlock();
			}
			return this;
		}

		internal Series3DViewBase CreateCopyForBinding()
		{
			Series3DViewBase series3DViewBase = CreateObjectForClone();
			series3DViewBase.CopyPropertiesForBinding(this);
			return series3DViewBase;
		}

		internal CrosshairMarkerItem CreateCrosshairMarkerItem(double value, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush crosshairMarkerBrush = GetCrosshairMarkerBrush(value, refinedPoint);
			return new CrosshairMarkerItem(Series, crosshairMarkerBrush, crosshairMarkerBrush, new LineStyle(1));
		}

		internal virtual double[] GetPointValues(SeriesPoint3D point)
		{
			return new double[1] { point.Value };
		}

		internal IAxisData GetAxisByPatternConstant(string patternConstant)
		{
			Chart3DControl chart = Chart;
			if (chart != null)
			{
				switch (patternConstant)
				{
				case "A":
				case "X":
					return chart.ActualXAxis;
				case "Y":
					return chart.ActualYAxis;
				case "Z":
				case "V":
				case "W":
					return chart.ActualZAxis;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color GetSeriesPointColor(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = Series.Cache.GetSeriesPointCache(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			if (seriesPointCache != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color? pointColor = ActualPointColorizer.GetPointColor(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint, seriesPointCache.IndexInSeries);
				if (!pointColor.HasValue)
				{
					return Series.BaseColor;
				}
				return pointColor.Value;
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("SeriesPointCache can not be null.");
			return Series.BaseColor;
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				foreach (Series3D item in Series)

					if (item.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return base.ActualCrosshairEnabled;
			}
		}

		private static void LightingCollectionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void SeriesSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl chart3DControl && e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				chart3DControl.NotifySeriesClear();
				if (e.NewValue is Series3DSourceBase series3DSourceBase)
				{
					series3DSourceBase.UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void XAxisPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl chart3DControl && e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				XAxis3D actualXAxis = chart3DControl.ActualXAxis;
				chart3DControl.UpdateActualXAxis(e.NewValue as XAxis3D);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)chart3DControl, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(chart3DControl, "XAxis", actualXAxis, chart3DControl.ActualXAxis), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void YAxisPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl chart3DControl && e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				YAxis3D actualYAxis = chart3DControl.ActualYAxis;
				chart3DControl.UpdateActualYAxis(e.NewValue as YAxis3D);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)chart3DControl, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(chart3DControl, "YAxis", actualYAxis, chart3DControl.ActualYAxis), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void ZAxisPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl chart3DControl && e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
			{
				ZAxis3D actualZAxis = chart3DControl.ActualZAxis;
				chart3DControl.UpdateActualZAxis(e.NewValue as ZAxis3D);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)chart3DControl, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(chart3DControl, "ZAxis", actualZAxis, chart3DControl.ActualZAxis), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void ContentTransformPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl chart3DControl)
			{
				Transform3D transform3D = e.NewValue as Transform3D;
				chart3DControl.actualTransform = ((transform3D == null) ? chart3DControl.CreateDefaultTransform() : transform3D);
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void VisualPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Chart3DControl chart3DControl)
			{
				chart3DControl.InvalidateDiagram();
			}
		}

		static Chart3DControl()
		{
			SeriesSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesSource", typeof(Series3DSourceBase), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, SeriesSourcePropertyChanged));
			XAxisProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("XAxis", typeof(XAxis3D), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, XAxisPropertyChanged));
			ZAxisProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ZAxis", typeof(ZAxis3D), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, ZAxisPropertyChanged));
			YAxisProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("YAxis", typeof(YAxis3D), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, YAxisPropertyChanged));
			DomainBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DomainBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			EnableRuntimeRotationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EnableRuntimeRotation", typeof(bool), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			EnableRuntimeScrollingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EnableRuntimeScrolling", typeof(bool), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			EnableRuntimeZoomingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EnableRuntimeZooming", typeof(bool), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(true));
			VerticalScrollPercentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScrollPercent", typeof(double), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, VisualPropertyChanged), ValidateScrollPercent);
			HorizontalScrollPercentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScrollPercent", typeof(double), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, VisualPropertyChanged), ValidateScrollPercent);
			ZoomPercentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ZoomPercent", typeof(double), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ChartControlBase.DefaultZoomPercent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, VisualPropertyChanged), ValidateZoomPercent);
			PerspectiveAngleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PerspectiveAngle", typeof(double), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(45.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, VisualPropertyChanged), ValidatePerspectiveAngle);
			PlaneDepthFixedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PlaneDepthFixed", typeof(double), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			ContentTransformProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ContentTransform", typeof(Transform3D), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, ContentTransformPropertyChanged));
			AspectRatioProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AspectRatio", typeof(Size3D), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Size3D(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			ShowXOZPlaneProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowXOZPlane", typeof(bool), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			ShowXOYPlaneProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowXOYPlane", typeof(bool), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			ShowYOZPlaneProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowYOZPlane", typeof(bool), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			AggregateFunctionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AggregateFunction", typeof(AggregateFunction), typeof(Chart3DControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(AggregateFunction.Average, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			LightingCollectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LightingCollection", typeof(LightingCollection), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, LightingCollectionChanged));
			CrosshairAxisLabelItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CrosshairAxisLabelItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<Crosshair3DAxisLabelItem>), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CrosshairSeriesLabelItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelItem>), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairSeriesLabelForegroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CrosshairSeriesLabelForeground", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairOptionsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CrosshairOptions", typeof(Crosshair3DOptions), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartControlBase.CrosshairOptionsPropertyChanged));
			CrosshairSeriesLabelTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CrosshairSeriesLabelTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairPopupBackgroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CrosshairPopupBackground", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairBorderBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CrosshairBorderBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairAxisLabelItemsProperty = CrosshairAxisLabelItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsProperty = CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CommandsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Commands", typeof(Chart3DCommands), typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartControlBase.CommandsPropertyChanged));
			PropertyMetadata metadata = ChartControlBase.AutoLayoutProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(ChartControlBase));
			ChartControlBase.AutoLayoutProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(Chart3DControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, metadata.PropertyChangedCallback));
		}

		private static Matrix3D PerformRotation(Matrix3D rotationMatrix, double angleX, double angleY)
		{
			Quaternion quaternion = new Quaternion(new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), angleX);
			Quaternion quaternion2 = new Quaternion(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), angleY);
			rotationMatrix.Rotate(quaternion2);
			rotationMatrix.Rotate(quaternion);
			return rotationMatrix;
		}

		private static bool ValidateMinZoomPercent(double zoom)
		{
			return zoom >= 1.0;
		}

		private static bool ValidateMaxZoomPercent(double zoom)
		{
			return zoom <= 500.0;
		}

		internal static bool ValidatePerspectiveAngle(object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num >= 0.0)
			{
				return num < 180.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateZoomPercent(object value)
		{
			double zoom = (double)value;
			if (ValidateMinZoomPercent(zoom))
			{
				return ValidateMaxZoomPercent(zoom);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateScrollPercent(object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num >= -100.0)
			{
				return num <= 100.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Chart3DControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Chart3DControl>(this);
			diagramContainer = new Chart3DContainer(this);
			viewController = new ViewController(this, null);
			Cache = new XYZChartCache();
			drawingSizeCalculator = new XYZChartSizeCalculator(this);
			navigationController = new XYZChartNavigationController(this);
			actualTransform = CreateDefaultTransform();
			UpdateActualXAxis(null);
			UpdateActualYAxis(null);
			UpdateActualZAxis(null);
			SetValue(CrosshairAxisLabelItemsPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<Crosshair3DAxisLabelItem>());
			SetValue(CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelItem>());
			SetValue(CommandsProperty, new Chart3DCommands(this));
		}

		{

		private void UpdateActualXAxis(XAxis3D xAxis)
		{
			XAxis3D actualXAxis = ActualXAxis;
			XAxis3D newElement = (ActualXAxis = ((xAxis != null) ? xAxis : new XAxis3D()));
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(actualXAxis, newElement, this);
		}

		private void UpdateActualZAxis(ZAxis3D zAxis)
		{
			ZAxis3D actualZAxis = ActualZAxis;
			ZAxis3D zAxis3D = zAxis ?? new ZAxis3D();
			zAxis3D.UpdateAlwaysShowZeroLevel();
			ActualZAxis = zAxis3D;
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(actualZAxis, zAxis3D, this);
		}

		private void UpdateActualYAxis(YAxis3D yAxis)
		{
			YAxis3D actualYAxis = ActualYAxis;
			YAxis3D newElement = (ActualYAxis = ((yAxis != null) ? yAxis : new YAxis3D()));
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(actualYAxis, newElement, this);
		}

		private Transform3D CreateDefaultTransform()
		{
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), -40.0)));
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 20.0)));
			return transform3DGroup;
		}

		private LightingCollection CreateDefaultLighting()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color ambientColor = default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			byte b = (ambientColor.B = 105);
			byte r = (ambientColor.G = b);
			ambientColor.R = r;
			LightingCollection lightingCollection = new LightingCollection();
			lightingCollection.Add(new AmbientLight(ambientColor));
			lightingCollection.Add(new DirectionalLight(Colors.White, new Vector3D(1.1, -1.0, -1.8)));
			return lightingCollection;
		}

		private void PerformDrag(double dx, double dy)
		{
			if (EnableRuntimeRotation)
			{
				double num = Math.PI / 4.0;
				double angleX = dx * num;
				double angleY = dy * num;
				actualTransform = new MatrixTransform3D(PerformRotation(actualTransform.Value, angleX, angleY));
			}
			InvalidateDiagram();
		}

		private void SetZoomPercent(double zoomPercent)
		{
			if (EnableRuntimeZooming)
			{
				if (ValidateMinZoomPercent(zoomPercent))
				{
					ZoomPercent = (ValidateMaxZoomPercent(zoomPercent) ? zoomPercent : 500.0);
				}
				else
				{
					ZoomPercent = 1.0;
				}
			}
			InvalidateDiagram();
		}

		private void SetHorizontalScrollPercent(double scrollPercent)
		{
			if (EnableRuntimeScrolling)
			{
				HorizontalScrollPercent = (ValidateScrollPercent(scrollPercent) ? scrollPercent : (100.0 * (double)Math.Sign(scrollPercent)));
			}
			InvalidateDiagram();
		}

		private void SetVerticalScrollPercent(double scrollPercent)
		{
			if (EnableRuntimeScrolling)
			{
				VerticalScrollPercent = (ValidateScrollPercent(scrollPercent) ? scrollPercent : (100.0 * (double)Math.Sign(scrollPercent)));
			}
			InvalidateDiagram();
		}

		private void InvalidateDiagram()
		{
			HideForcedCrosshair();
			diagramContainer.InvalidateVisual();
		}

		private void ClearCache()
		{
			Cache.Clear();
			ClearSeriesCache();
		}

		private void ClearSeriesCache()
		{
			Cache.SeriesModel = null;
			Cache.ProjectionContainer.Clear();
			foreach (Series3D item in Series)
			{
				if (item.Cache != null)
				{
					item.Cache.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		private void Update()
		{
			UpdateSeriesItemsInternal();
			foreach (Legend legend in base.Legends)
			{
				UpdateLegendItems(legend);
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				navigationController.UpdateCrosshair(base.CrosshairForced);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render, null);
		}

		private void UpdateLegendItems(Legend legend)
		{
			if (legend != null)
			{
				List<LegendItem> list = new List<LegendItem>();
				if (legend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
				{
					FillLegendItems(list, legend);
				}
				legend.FillCustomLegendItems(list);
				legend.UpdateItems(list);
			}
		}

		private void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItem> legendItems, Legend legend)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				Series3D series3D = (Series3D)((IRefinedSeries)item).Series;
				series3D.UpdateLegendItems(legend, legendItems, series3D.Cache);
			}
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height), new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>()));
			return list;
		}

		protected override void InvalidateItems(InvalidateMeasureFlags shouldInvalidate)
		{
			if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.MeasureDiagram) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0 && Diagram != null)
			{
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(diagramContainer);
			}
			if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.ArrangeDiagram) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0 && Diagram != null)
			{
				diagramContainer.InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new Chart3DControlAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected internal void NavigationDrag(int dx, int dy)
		{
			PerformDrag(dx, dy);
		}

		protected internal void NavigationZoomIn()
		{
			SetZoomPercent(ZoomPercent * 1.5);
		}

		protected internal void NavigationZoomOut()
		{
			SetZoomPercent(ZoomPercent / 1.5);
		}

		protected internal bool NavigationZoom(int delta)
		{
			double num = 1.0 + 0.05 * (double)Math.Abs(delta);
			num = ((delta > 0) ? num : (1.0 / num));
			SetZoomPercent(ZoomPercent * num);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal bool NavigationScrollHorizontally(int delta)
		{
			ResetCrosshairData();
			SetHorizontalScrollPercent(HorizontalScrollPercent - (double)delta);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal bool NavigationScrollVertically(int delta)
		{
			ResetCrosshairData();
			SetVerticalScrollPercent(VerticalScrollPercent + (double)delta);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareForPrintingBeforeResize()
		{
			base.PrepareForPrintingBeforeResize();
			if (base.ActualPrintCrosshair)
			{
				crosshairLocationBeforePrinting = navigationController.LastCrosshairLocation;
				return;
			}
			ResetCrosshairData();
			crosshairLocationBeforePrinting = null;
		}

		protected internal override void PrepareForPrintingAfterResize(double scaleX, double scaleY)
		{
			base.PrepareForPrintingAfterResize(scaleX, scaleY);
			if (crosshairLocationBeforePrinting.HasValue)
			{
				ShowCrosshair(new System.Windows.Point(crosshairLocationBeforePrinting.Value.X * scaleX, crosshairLocationBeforePrinting.Value.Y * scaleY));
				UpdateCrosshairPanelLayout();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RestoreAfterPrinting()
		{
			base.RestoreAfterPrinting();
			if (crosshairLocationBeforePrinting.HasValue)
			{
				ShowCrosshair(crosshairLocationBeforePrinting.Value);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSeriesItemsInternal()
		{
			foreach (Series3D item in Series)
			{
				ISeriesItem cache = item.Cache;
				if (cache.ShouldUpdate)
				{
					cache.Update(ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(item), out var _);
				}
				foreach (ISeriesPointData pointDatum in cache.PointData)
				{
					pointDatum.LabelsTexts = item.GetLabelsTexts(pointDatum.RefinedPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifySeriesInsert(IList<ISeries> seriesToInsert)
		{
			if (seriesToInsert.Count > 0)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, null, -1, seriesToInsert, 0));
			}
		}

		internal void NotifySeriesClear()
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, null, -1, null, -1));
		}

		void ISupportCrosshairLayout.CalculateLabelsLayout()
		{
			CalculateCrosshairLabelsLayout();
		}

		void ISupportCrosshairLayout.CompleteLabelsBounds()
		{
			UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabelItems(CrosshairSeriesLabelItems);
		}

		internal void ResetCrosshairData()
		{
			CrosshairAxisLabelItems.Clear();
			CrosshairSeriesLabelItems.Clear();
			foreach (Series3D item in Series)
			{
				item.ActualView.ResetCrosshairData();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateCrosshairLabelsLayout()
		{
			GRealRect2D constraintBounds = CalculateCrosshairLabelsConstraint(Mouse.GetPosition(this));
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesLabelItem crosshairSeriesLabelItem in CrosshairSeriesLabelItems)
			{
				IAnnotationLayout layout = crosshairSeriesLabelItem.Layout;
				if (constraintBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					AnnotationLayoutCalculator.CalculateAutoLayout(layout);
				}
				else
				{
					AnnotationLayoutCalculator.CalculateAutoLayout(layout, layout.Location, constraintBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		internal HitTestResultBehavior CrosshairHitTest(HitTestResult result)
		{
			CrosshairAxisLabelItems.Clear();
			if (!(result is RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult))
			{
				ResetCrosshairData();
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
			}
			if (rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesHitTestInfoProperty) is Series3DBase series3DBase && series3DBase.ActualView.ProcessCrosshairData(rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult, CrosshairAxisLabelItems, CrosshairSeriesLabelItems))
			{
				InvalidateCrosshairPanels();
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
			}
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (measureUnitsIsAffected)
			{
				XYDiagram3D.CheckMeasureUnits(constraint, ViewController, false, ActualXAxis, ActualYAxis, ActualZAxis);
				measureUnitsIsAffected = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override HitTestControllerBase CreateHitTestController()
		{
			return new XYZChartHitTestController(this);
		}

		protected override void HideCrosshairCore()
		{
			ResetCrosshairData();
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
		}

		protected internal override IHitTestResult Create3DHitTestResult(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult)
		{
			return new XYZHitTestResult3D(rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult);
		}

		protected internal override IHitTestResult Create2DHitTestResult()
		{
			return new XYZHitTestResult2D();
		}

		public Chart3DHitInfo CalcHitInfo(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return base.HitTestController.ProcessHitInfo(point, 0.0, new PointHitTestParameters(point)) as Chart3DHitInfo;
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(System.Windows.Point screenPoint)
		{
			ShowCrosshair(screenPoint, autoHide: true);
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(System.Windows.Point screenPoint, bool autoHide)
		{
			base.IsCrosshairHideManually = !autoHide;
			ForceCrosshair();
			if (ActualCrosshairEnabled)
			{
				navigationController.ForceCrosshair(screenPoint);
			}
		}

		public void HideCrosshair()
		{
			HideForcedCrosshairCore();
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThicknessProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Thickness", typeof(int), typeof(LineStyle), new PropertyMetadata(1, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateThickness);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DashStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DashStyle", typeof(System.Windows.Media.DashStyle), typeof(LineStyle), new PropertyMetadata(DashStyles.Solid, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		[Description("Specifies the line’s thickness.")]

		public int Thickness
		{
			get

				return (int)GetValue(ThicknessProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(ThicknessProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the shape at the end of the line.")]
		[Category("Common")]

		[Description("Specifies the shape that joins two lines or segments.")]

				return (PenLineJoin)GetValue(LineJoinProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineJoinProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the limit on the ratio of the miter length to half this line’s LineStyle.Thickness.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double MiterLimit
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MiterLimitProperty);

			set

				SetValue(MiterLimitProperty, value);
			}

		[Description("Specifies the dash style used to paint the line.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[DXDesignerSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public System.Windows.Media.DashStyle DashStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.DashStyle)GetValue(DashStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DashStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public List<double> DashesSerialize
		{
			get
			{
				return DashStyle.Dashes.ToList();
			}
			set
			{
				SetDashDashes(value);
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double OffsetSerialize
		{
			get
			{
				return DashStyle.Offset;
			}
			set
			{
				SetDashStyleOffset(value);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSolid
		{
			get
			{
				System.Windows.Media.DashStyle dashStyle = DashStyle;
				if (dashStyle != null && dashStyle.Dashes != null)
				{
					return dashStyle.Dashes.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateThickness(object value)
		{
			return (int)value > 0;
		}

		public LineStyle()
		{
		}

		public LineStyle(int thickness)
		{
			Thickness = thickness;
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollection.AfterDeserializeCollection(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			DashesSerialize = e.Collection as List<double>;
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollection.BeforeDeserializeCollection(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		bool IXtraSupportDeserializeCollection.ClearCollection(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new LineStyle();
		}

		private void SetDashStyleOffset(double offset)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.DashStyle dashStyle = new System.Windows.Media.DashStyle
			{
				Dashes = DashStyle.Dashes,
				Offset = offset
			};
			DashStyle = dashStyle;
		}

		private void SetDashDashes(List<double> dashes)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.DashStyle dashStyle = new System.Windows.Media.DashStyle
			{
				Dashes = new DoubleCollection(dashes),
				Offset = DashStyle.Offset
			};
			DashStyle = dashStyle;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, double thickness)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, thickness);
			pen.DashCap = DashCap;
			pen.DashStyle = DashStyle;
			pen.LineJoin = LineJoin;
			pen.MiterLimit = MiterLimit;
			return pen;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			return CreatePen(brush, Thickness);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle = new LineStyle();
			lineStyle.DashCap = DashCap;
			lineStyle.DashStyle = DashStyle.CloneCurrentValue();
			lineStyle.LineJoin = LineJoin;
			lineStyle.MiterLimit = MiterLimit;
			lineStyle.Thickness = Thickness;
			return lineStyle;
		}
	}

	public class ChartControl : ChartControlBase, IContainerElement, IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner, IContainerAnimationOptions, IEventArgsConverterSource, IXtraSupportDeserializeCollection, IChartBindingProvider, IBindingProvider, IVisualChildOwner, ISeriesObjectSelector, IChartWithData, IContainerEventsOptions, IContainerToolTipOptions, IContainerDataOptions, IContainerAnnotationsOptions, IContainerChartOptions, ISupportNavigationControl, ISelectionSupportControl, IDeserializableElement
	{
		private class EventArgsConverter : IDataRowEventArgsConverter
		{
			private readonly ChartControl chartControl;

			public EventArgsConverter(ChartControl chartControl)
			{
				this.chartControl = chartControl;
			}

			object IDataRowEventArgsConverter.GetDataRow(RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				IHitTestableElement parentHitTestableElement = GetParentHitTestableElement(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
				if (parentHitTestableElement != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point? point = ((e is MouseEventArgs e2) ? new System.Windows.Point?(e2.GetPosition(chartControl)) : ((System.Windows.Point?)null));
					HitTestingHelper.ProcessHitTestableElement(parentHitTestableElement, point);
					return FindDataObject(parentHitTestableElement);
				}
				return null;
			}

			private object FindDataObject(IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ((hitTestableElement.AdditionalElement is RefinedPoint) ? (hitTestableElement.AdditionalElement as RefinedPoint) : (hitTestableElement.Element as RefinedPoint));
				IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint = ((refinedPoint != null) ? SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(refinedPoint) : null);
				if (platformSeriesPoint != null)
				{
					if (platformSeriesPoint.Owner != null && ((Series)platformSeriesPoint.Owner).IsBoundPoints)
					{
						return platformSeriesPoint.Tag;
					}
					return platformSeriesPoint;
				}
				if (hitTestableElement is INativeHitTestableElement)
				{
					return hitTestableElement.Element;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private IHitTestableElement GetParentHitTestableElement(DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = dependencyObject;
				while (dependencyObject2 != null && !(dependencyObject2 is ChartControl))
				{
					if (dependencyObject2 is IHitTestableElement)
					{
						return (IHitTestableElement)dependencyObject2;
					}
					dependencyObject2 = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject2);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string RunDesignerInDesignTime
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			[SecurityCritical]
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					return;
				}
				string[] inputs = value.Split(new char[1] { '|' }, 2);
				if (inputs.Length != 2)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (TryParse(inputs[0], out var result))
				{
					resultEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
					SetSafeWaitHandle(resultEvent, new SafeWaitHandle(result, ownsHandle: true));
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(inputs[1]))
				{
					Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						try
						{
							RunNetDesigner(inputs[1]);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						finally
						{
							resultEvent?.Set();
							resultEvent = null;
						}
					});
				}
				else
				{
					resultEvent?.Set();
					resultEvent = null;
				}
			}
		}

		int IBindingProvider.ExistItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (Diagram != null)
				{
					foreach (Series item in Diagram.Series)
					{
						if (item.IsAutoSeries)
						{
							num += item.Points.Count;
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsAnimationCompleted
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = base.IsAnimationCompleted;
				if (Diagram != null && AnimationMode != ChartAnimationMode.Disabled)
				{
					foreach (Series item in Diagram.Series)
					{
						if (((IAnimatableElement)item).AnimationMode != ChartAnimationMode.Disabled && ((IAnimatableElement)item).AnimationAutoStartMode == AnimationAutoStartMode.PlayOnce)
						{
							flag &= ((IAnimatableElement)item).AnimationState == AnimationState.Completed;
						}
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}
