		static ChartControl()
		{
			DiagramProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Diagram", typeof(Diagram), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(DiagramPropertyChanged));
			LegendProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Legend", typeof(Legend), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(LegendPropertyChanged));
			DataSourceProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DataSource", typeof(object), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataSourcePropertyChanged));
			AnimationModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AnimationMode", typeof(ChartAnimationMode), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(ChartAnimationMode.Disabled, AnimationModePropertyChanged));
			ToolTipEnabledProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipEnabled", typeof(bool?), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ToolTipOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipOptions", typeof(ToolTipOptions), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ToolTipControllerProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipController", typeof(ChartToolTipController), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ToolTipItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipItem", typeof(ToolTipItem), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			SelectedItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedItem", typeof(object), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedItemChanged));
			SelectedItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedItems", typeof(IList), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedItemsChanged));
			SelectionModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectionMode", typeof(ElementSelectionMode), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(ElementSelectionMode.None));
			SeriesSelectionModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesSelectionMode", typeof(SeriesSelectionMode), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(SeriesSelectionMode.Point));
			IndicatorsPaletteProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IndicatorsPalette", typeof(IndicatorsPalette), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata());
			BreadcrumbItemTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BreadcrumbItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			AnnotationsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Annotations", typeof(AnnotationCollection), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata());
			AnnotationsProperty = AnnotationsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CalculatedFieldsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("CalculatedFields", typeof(ChartCalculatedFieldCollection), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata());
			CalculatedFieldsProperty = CalculatedFieldsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AnimationRecordsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("AnimationRecords", typeof(ChartAnimationRecordCollection), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata());
			AnimationRecordsProperty = AnimationRecordsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			EnableAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EnableAnimation", typeof(bool), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, EnableAnimationPropertyChanged));
			Diagram3DHitTestInfoProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Diagram3DHitTestInfo", typeof(Diagram3D), typeof(ChartControl));
			AnnotationItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnnotationItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<ChartControl, Annotation>), typeof(ChartControl));
			AnnotationItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnnotationItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, AnnotationsSourceChanged));
			AnnotationItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnnotationItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, AnnotationTemplateChanged));
			AnnotationItemTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnnotationItemTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, AnnotationTemplateChanged));
			IsDirectXSurfaceRenderingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDirectXSurfaceRendering", typeof(bool), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, IsDirectXSurfaceRenderingPropertyChanged));
			CommandsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Commands", typeof(ChartCommands), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartControlBase.CommandsPropertyChanged));
			BoundDataChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("BoundDataChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(ChartControl));
			CustomDrawSeriesEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("CustomDrawSeries", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(CustomDrawSeriesEventHandler), typeof(ChartControl));
			CustomDrawSeriesPointEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("_CustomDrawSeriesPoint", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(CustomDrawSeriesPointEventHandler), typeof(ChartControl));
			CustomDrawCrosshairEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("_CustomDrawCrosshair", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(CustomDrawCrosshairEventHandler), typeof(ChartControl));
			AxisScaleChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("AxisScaleChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(AxisScaleChangedEventHandler), typeof(ChartControl));
			QueryChartCursorEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("QueryChartCursor", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(QueryChartCursorEventHandler), typeof(ChartControl));
			CrosshairOptionsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CrosshairOptions", typeof(CrosshairOptions), typeof(ChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartControlBase.CrosshairOptionsPropertyChanged));
			SafeSerializationBinder.RegisterKnownType(typeof(Legend));
			DXSerializer.SerializationProviderProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ChartControl), new UIPropertyMetadata(new ChartSerializationProvider()));
			DXSerializer.SerializationIDDefaultProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ChartControl), new UIPropertyMetadata("ChartControl"));
			isRdpSession = RemoteDesktopDetector.IsRemoteSession;
		}

		private static void DiagramPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartControl chartControl = d as ChartControl;
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
			if (chartControl != null && chartControl.Diagram != null)
			{
				chartControl.UpdateData();
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IDiagram>(d, "Diagram", e.OldValue as IDiagram, e.NewValue as IDiagram));
			}
		}

		private static void DataSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is ChartControl chartControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (chartControl.Diagram != null)
			{
				foreach (Series item in chartControl.Diagram.Series)
				{
					item.ResetDataSourceScale();
				}
			}
			chartControl.bindingBehavior.UpdateActualDataSource(e.NewValue);
			chartControl.AddInvalidate((InvalidateMeasureFlags)7);
		}

		private static void EnableAnimationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartControl chartControl = (ChartControl)d;
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				chartControl.AnimationMode = ChartAnimationMode.OnLoad;
			}
			else
			{
				chartControl.AnimationMode = ChartAnimationMode.Disabled;
			}
		}

		private static void LegendPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartControl chartControl = d as ChartControl;
			if (chartControl.legendUpdateLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			Legend legend = e.OldValue as Legend;
			Legend legend2 = e.NewValue as Legend;
			if (chartControl != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && chartControl.Legends[0] == e.OldValue)
				{
					chartControl.Legends.Remove(legend);
				}
				if (chartControl.ShouldDeserializeLegend = legend2 != null)
				{
					if (chartControl.Legends.Count == 0)
					{
						chartControl.Legends.Add(legend2);
					}
					else
					{
						chartControl.Legends.Insert(0, legend2);
					}
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e);
		}

		private static void AnimationModePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartControl chartControl = (ChartControl)d;
			if (chartControl != null)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(chartControl);
				chartControl.AnimationModeChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartControl chartControl)
			{
				chartControl.selectionController.OnUpdateSelectedItem(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedItemsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartControl chartControl)
			{
				chartControl.selectionController.OnUpdateSelectedItems(e.NewValue as IList);
			}
		}

		private static void IsDirectXSurfaceRenderingPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is ChartControl { Diagram: not null } chartControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in chartControl.Diagram.Series)
			{
				item.Item.UpdateRenderingStrategy();
			}
			if (!(chartControl.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Pane allPane in xYDiagram2D.AllPanes)
			{
				allPane.ClearSeriesSurface();
			}
		}

		public ChartControl()

			bindingBehavior.ActualDataSourceChanged += ActualDataSourceChanged;
			selectionController = new SelectionController(this);
			highlightingController = new HighlightingController(this);
			toolTipController = new ChartToolTipController();
			navigationController = new ChartNavigationController(this);
			eventArgsConverter = new EventArgsConverter(this);
			base.KeyUp += navigationController.KeyUp;
			base.KeyDown += NavigationController.KeyDown;
			base.MouseMove += NavigationController.MouseMove;
			base.MouseWheel += NavigationController.MouseWheel;
			base.MouseLeftButtonDown += NavigationController.MouseLeftButtonDown;
			base.MouseLeftButtonUp += NavigationController.MouseLeftButtonUp;
			base.MouseLeave += NavigationController.MouseLeave;
			base.MouseEnter += NavigationController.MouseEnter;
			base.Loaded += ChartControl_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += ChartControl_Unloaded;
			base.ManipulationStarted += NavigationController.ManipulationStarted;
			base.ManipulationDelta += NavigationController.ManipulationDelta;
			base.ManipulationCompleted += NavigationController.ManipulationCompleted;
			base.IsVisibleChanged += OnVisibleChanged;
			SetValue(CommandsProperty, new ChartCommands(this));
		}

				parentWindow.Activated += NavigationController.ApplicationActivated;

			if (parentWindow != null)

		}

		private void UpdateAnnotationsCollections()
		{
			DiagramAnnotations.Clear();
			ChartAnnotations.Clear();
			foreach (Annotation annotation in Annotations)
			{
				if (annotation.ActualVisible)
				{
					bool isChartAnnotation = annotation.ActualShapePosition is FreePosition || annotation.ActualAnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint;
					AddAnnotation(annotation, isChartAnnotation);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddAnnotation(Annotation annotation, bool isChartAnnotation)
		{
			if (isChartAnnotation)
			{
				ChartAnnotations.Add(annotation);
			}
			else
			{
				DiagramAnnotations.Add(annotation);
			}
		}

		private bool IsPointOnConstantLine(ConstantLineItem item, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, Rect viewPortRelativeToChart, Pane pane)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			if (item.ConstantLine.Axis is AxisX2D)
			{
				transformGroup.Children.Add(pane.ViewportTransform);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = viewPortRelativeToChart.X,
					Y = viewPortRelativeToChart.Y
				});
			}
			else
			{
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform(-90.0));
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleY = -1.0
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(pane.ViewportTransform);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = viewPortRelativeToChart.X,
					Y = viewPortRelativeToChart.Y
				});
			}
			foreach (Rect item2 in item.SelectionGeometry)
			{
				Rect rect = transformGroup.TransformBounds(item2);
				if (RectExtension.IsInside(rect, chartPosition))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool UpdateAnnotations()
		{
			if (DiagramAnnotations.Count > 0 || ChartAnnotations.Count > 0 || Annotations.Count > 0)
			{
				UpdateAnnotationsCollections();
				InvalidateAnnotationsPanels();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			bindingProcessor.RefreshData(new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(), this);
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				Diagram.ClearViewportCache();
				if (Diagram.Series.Count <= 0)
				{
					base.HitTestController.Cleanup();
					foreach (CrosshairSeriesLabelItem crosshairSeriesLabelItem in Diagram.CrosshairSeriesLabelItems)
					{
						crosshairSeriesLabelItem.Layout = null;
					}
					Diagram.CrosshairSeriesLabelItems.Clear();
				}
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		void IDeserializableElement.StartDeserializing()
		{
			IsDeserializing = true;
		}

		void IDeserializableElement.CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			IsDeserializing = false;
			foreach (Annotation annotation in Annotations)
			{
				annotation.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				Diagram.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
			if (base.Legends.Count > 0 && ShouldDeserializeLegend)
			{
				try
				{
					legendUpdateLocked = true;
					Legend = base.Legends[0];
				}
				finally
				{
					legendUpdateLocked = false;
				}
			}
			foreach (Legend legend in base.Legends)
			{
				legend.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
		}

		}

		internal bool ProcessConstantLineDrag(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			if (DraggingConstantLine == null || !DraggingConstantLine.IsVisible || !DraggingConstantLine.CheckedInLegend)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)Diagram;
			DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(chartPosition);
			AxisValue axisValue = diagramCoordinates.GetAxisValue(DraggingConstantLine.Axis);
			if (axisValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DraggingConstantLine.SetCurrentValue(ConstantLine.ValueProperty, axisValue.ActualValue);
			return true;
		}

		{
			foreach (Annotation annotation in Annotations)

				if (annotation.IsMouseOver)
				{
					return annotation.GetCursor();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdateAnnotationsInteractivity()
		{
			selectedAnnotation = null;
			foreach (Annotation annotation in Annotations)
			{
				if (annotation.IsMouseOver && annotation.InteractivityEnabled)
				{
					selectedAnnotation = annotation;
					annotation.NavigationElementsVisible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					annotation.NavigationElementsVisible = false;
				}
				annotation.UpdateNavigationElements();
			}
		}

		internal ConstantLine FindConstantLineInPoint(Pane activePane, System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			if (activePane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect bounds = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds((FrameworkElement)activePane, (FrameworkElement)this);
			Rect viewport = activePane.Viewport;
			Rect viewPortRelativeToChart = new Rect(viewport.X + bounds.X, viewport.Y + bounds.Y, viewport.Width, viewport.Height);
			ConstantLine constantLine = null;
			foreach (ConstantLineItem constantLineBehindItem in activePane.ConstantLineBehindItems)
			{
				if (IsPointOnConstantLine(constantLineBehindItem, chartPosition, viewPortRelativeToChart, activePane))
				{
					constantLine = constantLineBehindItem.ConstantLine;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (constantLine == null)
			{
				foreach (ConstantLineItem constantLineInFrontItem in activePane.ConstantLineInFrontItems)
				{
					if (IsPointOnConstantLine(constantLineInFrontItem, chartPosition, viewPortRelativeToChart, activePane))
					{
						constantLine = constantLineInFrontItem.ConstantLine;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return constantLine;
		}

		internal ConstantLineTitle FindConstantLineTitleWithEditableContentInPoint(Pane activePane, System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			ConstantLineTitle result = null;
			foreach (ConstantLineTitleItem constantLineTitleItem in activePane.ConstantLineTitleItems)
			{
				if (constantLineTitleItem.Title.Content is EditableTextContent editableTextContent && RectExtension.IsInside(FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds((FrameworkElement)editableTextContent, (FrameworkElement)this), chartPosition))
				{
					result = (ConstantLineTitle)constantLineTitleItem.Title;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal Pane FindPaneInPoint(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			if (!(Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Pane result = null;
			foreach (Pane allPane in xYDiagram2D.AllPanes)
			{
				Rect bounds = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds((FrameworkElement)allPane, (FrameworkElement)this);
				if (RectExtension.IsInside(bounds, chartPosition))
				{
					result = allPane;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void UpdateInteractiveConstantLineReferences(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			DraggingConstantLine = null;
			ReadyForDeletionConstantLine = null;
			InConstantLineContentEditingMode = false;
			if (!(Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D) || (!xYDiagram2D.HasMovableConstantLines && !xYDiagram2D.HasDeletableConstantLines))
			{
				return;
			}
			Pane pane = FindPaneInPoint(chartPosition);
			if (pane != null)
			{
				ConstantLine constantLine = FindConstantLineInPoint(pane, chartPosition);
				ConstantLineTitle constantLineTitle = FindConstantLineTitleWithEditableContentInPoint(pane, chartPosition);
				if (constantLine != null && constantLine.RuntimeMoving)
				{
					DraggingConstantLine = constantLine;
				}
				if (constantLine != null && constantLine.RuntimeDeletion)
				{
					ReadyForDeletionConstantLine = constantLine;
				}
				if (constantLineTitle != null)
				{
					InConstantLineContentEditingMode = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveReadyForDeletionConstantLine()
		{
			if (HasReadyForDeletionConstantLine)
			{
				Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)((IOwnedElement)ReadyForDeletionConstantLine).Owner;
				if (axis2D != null)
				{
					axis2D.ConstantLinesBehind.Remove(ReadyForDeletionConstantLine);
					axis2D.ConstantLinesInFront.Remove(ReadyForDeletionConstantLine);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveReadyForDeletionAnnotation()
		{
			if (HasReadyForDeletionAnnotation)
			{
				Annotations.Remove(ReadyForDeletionAnnotation);
			}
		}

		{
			ResetBoundData(isSeriesReset: true);
		}

		}

	public enum AnimationRotationOrder
	{
		None,
		XYZ,
		XZY,
		YXZ,
		YZX,
		ZXY,
		ZYX
	}
	public struct AnimationRotation
	{
		private AnimationRotationOrder order;

		private double angleX;

		private double angleY;

		private double angleZ;

		[Description("Gets or sets a value which determines the order of rotation around the X, Y and Z axes.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public AnimationRotationOrder Order
		{
			get
			{
				return order;
			}
			set
			{
				order = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the value (in degrees) at which the object should be rotated around the X-axis.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double AngleX
		{
			get
			{
				return angleX;
			}
			set
			{
				angleX = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the value (in degrees) at which the object should be rotated around the Y-axis.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double AngleY
		{
			get
			{
				return angleY;
			}
			set

				angleY = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the value (in degrees) at which the object should be rotated around the Z-axis.")]

		public double AngleZ

			{
				return angleZ;
			}
			set

				angleZ = value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IRotationAnimation
	{
		Transform3D InitialTransform { get; }

		Transform3D Transform { set; }

		AnimationRotation InitialRotation { get; }

		AnimationRotation Rotation { get; }
	}
	internal static class RotationAnimationHelper
	{
		public static void PerformAnimation(IRotationAnimation animation, double value)
		{
			AxisAngleRotation3D axisAngleRotation3D = new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), animation.Rotation.AngleX * value);
			AxisAngleRotation3D axisAngleRotation3D2 = new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), animation.Rotation.AngleY * value);
			AxisAngleRotation3D axisAngleRotation3D3 = new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), animation.Rotation.AngleZ * value);
			AnimationRotationOrder animationRotationOrder = AnimationRotationOrder.None;
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			if (animation.InitialTransform == null)
			{
				animationRotationOrder = animation.InitialRotation.Order;
				axisAngleRotation3D.Angle += animation.InitialRotation.AngleX;
				axisAngleRotation3D2.Angle += animation.InitialRotation.AngleY;
				axisAngleRotation3D3.Angle += animation.InitialRotation.AngleZ;
			}
			else
			{
				animationRotationOrder = animation.Rotation.Order;
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(animation.InitialTransform);
			}
			RotateTransform3D value2 = new RotateTransform3D(axisAngleRotation3D);
			RotateTransform3D value3 = new RotateTransform3D(axisAngleRotation3D2);
			RotateTransform3D value4 = new RotateTransform3D(axisAngleRotation3D3);
			switch (animationRotationOrder)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case AnimationRotationOrder.XYZ:
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value4);
				break;
			case AnimationRotationOrder.XZY:
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value4);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
				break;
			case AnimationRotationOrder.YXZ:
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value4);
				break;
			case AnimationRotationOrder.YZX:
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value4);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				break;
			case AnimationRotationOrder.ZXY:
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value4);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
				break;
			case AnimationRotationOrder.ZYX:
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value4);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				break;
			}
			animation.Transform = transform3DGroup;
		}
	}

	public class ChartAnimationRecord : ChartElement
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey AnimationsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Animations", typeof(ChartAnimationCollection), typeof(ChartAnimationRecord), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationsProperty = AnimationsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ProgressProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Progress", typeof(double), typeof(ChartAnimationRecord), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, ProgressChanged, CoerceProgress));

		internal ChartControl ChartControl => (ChartControl)((IOwnedElement)this).Owner;

		[Description("Provides access to a collection of animations within the current animation record.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public ChartAnimationCollection Animations => (ChartAnimationCollection)GetValue(AnimationsProperty);

		[Description("Gets or sets a progress value of the current animation record.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double Progress
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ProgressProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ProgressProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public new bool Focusable
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Focusable;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Focusable = value;
			}
		}

		private static void ProgressChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			double num = (double)e.NewValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				double num2 = (double)e.OldValue;
				ChartAnimationRecord chartAnimationRecord = (ChartAnimationRecord)d;
				if (double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					chartAnimationRecord.Initialize();
					num2 = 0.0;
				}
				if (num != num2)
				{
					chartAnimationRecord.PerformAnimation(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceProgress(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (num > 1.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public ChartAnimationRecord()
		{
			SetValue(AnimationsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ChartAnimationCollection>(this));
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			foreach (ChartAnimation animation in Animations)
			{
				animation.Initialize();
			}
		}

		private void PerformAnimation(double value)
		{
			foreach (ChartAnimation animation in Animations)
			{
				animation.PerformAnimation(value);
			}
		}
	}

		{

		{
			if (!double.IsNaN((double)value))

				return Diagram3D.ValidateZoomPercent(value);

			if (!double.IsNaN(InitialHorizontalScrollPercent))

				diagram.HorizontalScrollPercent = InitialHorizontalScrollPercent;

			initialPerspectiveAngle = diagram.PerspectiveAngle;
			initialZoomPercent = diagram.ZoomPercent;
			initialVerticalScrollPercent = diagram.VerticalScrollPercent;
			initialHorizontalScrollPercent = diagram.HorizontalScrollPercent;
		}

		{
			foreach (Diagram3DAnimationAction action in Actions)

				action.PerformAnimation(value);

		private static void PerformSeriesPointAnimation(SeriesPoint point, double value, double maximumValue)
		{
			if (value <= 0.0)
			{
				point.SetAnimatedValue(0.0);
				return;
			}
			if (value >= 1.0)
			{
				point.SetAnimatedValue(point.NonAnimatedValue);
				return;
			}
			if (maximumValue == 0.0)
			{
				point.SetAnimatedValue(point.NonAnimatedValue * value);
				return;
			}
			double nonAnimatedValue = point.NonAnimatedValue;
			double num;
			if (point.Series is IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView && ((Axis)iXYSeriesView.AxisYData).Logarithmic)
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap = ((AxisBase)iXYSeriesView.AxisYData).ScaleMap;
				num = (double)scaleMap.InternalToNative(Math.Min(Math.Abs(scaleMap.NativeToInternal(nonAnimatedValue)), scaleMap.NativeToInternal(maximumValue) * value));
			}
			else
			{
				num = Math.Min(Math.Abs(nonAnimatedValue), maximumValue * value);
			}
			point.SetAnimatedValue((nonAnimatedValue < 0.0) ? (0.0 - num) : num);
		}

		protected internal override void PerformAnimation(double value)
		{
			Series series = base.Series;
			if (series == null || double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			if (EqualSpeed)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPoint point in series.Points)
				{
					double num2 = Math.Abs(point.NonAnimatedValue);
					if (num2 > num)
					{
						num = num2;
					}
				}
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (Sequential)
			{
				double num3 = DelayPercentage / 100.0;
				value *= (double)(series.Points.Count - 1) * num3 + 1.0;
				{
					foreach (SeriesPoint point2 in series.Points)
					{
						PerformSeriesPointAnimation(point2, value, num);
						value -= num3;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint point3 in series.Points)
			{
				PerformSeriesPointAnimation(point3, value, num);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class SeriesPointAnimation : ChartAnimation
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActionsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Actions", typeof(SeriesPointAnimationActionCollection), typeof(SeriesPointAnimation), new PropertyMetadata());

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActionsProperty = ActionsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TargetSeriesPointProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TargetSeriesPoint", typeof(SeriesPoint), typeof(SeriesPointAnimation), new PropertyMetadata(null, TargetSeriesPointChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InitialNumericalArgumentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InitialNumericalArgument", typeof(double?), typeof(SeriesPointAnimation), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InitialNumericalValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InitialNumericalValue", typeof(double?), typeof(SeriesPointAnimation), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InitialRotationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("InitialRotation", typeof(AnimationRotation), typeof(SeriesPointAnimation), new PropertyMetadata(default(AnimationRotation)));

		private SeriesPoint actualSeriesPoint;

		private double? initialNumericalArgument;

		private double? initialNumericalValue;

		private Transform3D initialTransform;

		internal SeriesPoint ActualSeriesPoint => actualSeriesPoint;

		internal double? ActualInitialNumericalArgument => initialNumericalArgument;

		internal double? ActualInitialNumericalValue => initialNumericalValue;

		internal Transform3D ActualInitialTransform => initialTransform;

		[Description("Provides access to animation actions for a specific series point.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public SeriesPointAnimationActionCollection Actions => (SeriesPointAnimationActionCollection)GetValue(ActionsProperty);

		[Description("Gets or sets the target series point, under which the animation is performed.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public SeriesPoint TargetSeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesPoint)GetValue(TargetSeriesPointProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TargetSeriesPointProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the initial numerical argument of the series point animation.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double? InitialNumericalArgument
		{
			get
			{
				return (double?)GetValue(InitialNumericalArgumentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InitialNumericalArgumentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the initial numerical value of the series point animation.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double? InitialNumericalValue
		{
			get
			{
				return (double?)GetValue(InitialNumericalValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InitialNumericalValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides access to the initial rotation settings of the series point animation.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public AnimationRotation InitialRotation
		{
			get
			{
				return (AnimationRotation)GetValue(InitialRotationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InitialRotationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void TargetSeriesPointChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((SeriesPointAnimation)d).Initialize((SeriesPoint)e.NewValue);
		}

		public SeriesPointAnimation()
		{
			SetValue(ActionsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<SeriesPointAnimationActionCollection>(this));
		}

		protected internal override void Initialize()
		{
			Initialize(TargetSeriesPoint);
		}

		protected internal override void PerformAnimation(double value)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointAnimationAction action in Actions)
			{
				action.PerformAnimation(value);
			}
		}

		private void Initialize(SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint != actualSeriesPoint)
			{
				PerformAnimation(1.0);
			}
			actualSeriesPoint = seriesPoint;
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (seriesPoint.Series.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal == ScaleType.Numerical)
			{
				initialNumericalArgument = InitialNumericalArgument;
				if (!initialNumericalArgument.HasValue)
				{
					initialNumericalArgument = ((ISeriesPoint)seriesPoint).ArgumentX.NumericalArgument;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				initialNumericalArgument = null;
			}
			initialNumericalValue = InitialNumericalValue;
			if (!initialNumericalValue.HasValue)
			{
				initialNumericalValue = ((ISeriesPoint)seriesPoint).Values.NumericalValues[0];
			}
			if (InitialRotation.Order == AnimationRotationOrder.None)
			{
				initialTransform = SeriesPointModel3D.GetTransform(seriesPoint);
				if (initialTransform == null)
				{
					initialTransform = new TranslateTransform3D();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				initialTransform = null;
			}
		}
	}

				{
					return false;
				}
				object content = title.Content;
				if (content == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string text = content as string;
				return text != string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceLogarithmicBase(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if ((double)value <= 1.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidLogarithmicBase));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static bool ValidateGridSpacing(object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return num > 0.0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void GridSpacingPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis axis)
			{
				axis.gridSpacing = (double)e.NewValue;
				axis.ActualGridSpacing = (double)e.NewValue;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void DateTimeOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis axis)
			{
				axis.dateTimeOptions = e.NewValue as DateTimeOptions;
				axis.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as DateTimeOptions, e.NewValue as DateTimeOptions, axis);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		[Obsolete]
		private static void RangePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis axis)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is AxisRange axisRange))
				{
					axis.ActualRange = new AxisRange();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, axis.ActualRange);
				}
				else
				{
					axisRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(axis);
					axis.ActualRange = axisRange;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

		}

		}

		private static void WholeRangePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis axis)
			{
				Range range = e.NewValue as Range;
				if (range == null)
				{
					range = new Range();
					axis.WholeRangeData.Reset(needUpdate: false, resetMin: true, resetMax: true);
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, range);
				}
				range.SetRangeData(axis.WholeRangeData);
				axis.ActualWholeRange = range;
				axis.CreateMediator();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
		}

			TitleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Title", typeof(AxisTitle), typeof(Axis), new PropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdateXYDiagram2DItems));
			LogarithmicProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Logarithmic", typeof(bool), typeof(Axis), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, LogarithmicPropertyChanged));
			LogarithmicBaseProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LogarithmicBase", typeof(double), typeof(Axis), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(10.0, LogarithmicPropertyChanged, CoerceLogarithmicBase));
			WholeRangeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("WholeRange", typeof(Range), typeof(Axis), new PropertyMetadata(WholeRangePropertyChanged));
			RangeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Range", typeof(AxisRange), typeof(Axis), new PropertyMetadata(RangePropertyChanged));

		{
			BeginInit();
			actualWholeRangeValue = new Range();
			actualWholeRangeValue.SetRangeData(base.WholeRangeData);
			actualWholeRangeValue.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			EndInit();
		}

		protected internal override IAxisMappingCore CreateMapping(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect bounds)
		{
			return AxisMappingCore.Create(intervalLayoutProvider, this, IsVertical ? bounds.Height : bounds.Width);
		}

		protected override void TryApplyUserRange()
		{
			Range range = WholeRange;
			if (range != null && (range.MinValue != null || range.MaxValue != null))
			{
				range.ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateUserValues()
		{
			base.UpdateUserValues();
			DeserializeObsolete();
			if (base.ActualWholeRange != null)
			{
				base.ActualWholeRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete]
		private void DeserializeObsolete()
		{
			if (Range != null)
			{
				Range.UpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		string ICrosshairAxis.LabelPattern => ActualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions.Pattern;

		bool ICrosshairAxis.LabelVisible => ActualCrosshairLabelVisibility;

		private bool ActualCrosshairLabelVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions.Visibility.HasValue)
				{
					return ActualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions.Visibility.Value;
				}
				IContainerToolTipOptions containerToolTipOptions = Diagram2D?.Container?.ToolTipOptions;
				if (containerToolTipOptions == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				CrosshairOptions actualCrosshairOptions = containerToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions;
				if (!IsValuesAxis)
				{
					return actualCrosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLabels;
				}
				return actualCrosshairOptions.ShowValueLabels;
			}
		}

		protected bool AreMultipleIntervals
		{
			get
			{
				if (intervals != null)
				{
					return intervals.Count > 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets an actual scrolling range of the Axis2D object.")]
		[Obsolete("This property is obsolete now. To specify a custom range, use the AxisBase.ActualWholeRange and Axis2D.ActualVisualRange properties instead. For more information, see the corresponding topic in the documentation.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public AxisRange ActualScrollingRange => actualScrollingRange;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Description("Gets the actual visible range of a 2D-axis. This is a dependency property.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Range ActualVisualRange
		{
			get
			{
				return actualVisualRange;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!IsInDesigner)
				{
					if (!IsDeserializing)
					{
						throw new Exception("ActualVisualRange setter cannot be accessed. VisualRange dependency property setter should be used instead");
					}
					actualVisualRange = value;
					ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(null, actualVisualRange, this);
					actualVisualRange.SetRangeData(base.VisualRangeData);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Description("Returns the actual whole range.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public new Range ActualWholeRange
		{
			get
			{
				return base.ActualWholeRange;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!IsInDesigner)
				{
					if (!IsDeserializing)
					{
						throw new Exception("ActualWholeRange setter cannot be accessed. WholeRange dependency property setter should be used instead");
					}
					base.ActualWholeRange = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDeserializing
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Diagram?.Container?.ChartOptions != null)
				{
					return base.Diagram.Container.ChartOptions.IsDeserializing;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInDesigner
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Diagram?.Container?.ChartOptions != null)
				{
					return base.Diagram.Container.ChartOptions.IsInDesigner;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache OverlappingCache { get; set; }

		internal XYDiagram2D Diagram2D => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as XYDiagram2D;

		internal bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Visible.HasValue)
				{
					return Visible.Value;
				}
				return autoLayoutVisible;
			}
		}

		internal CrosshairAxisLabelOptions ActualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultCrosshairAxisLabelOptions == null)
				{
					defaultCrosshairAxisLabelOptions = new CrosshairAxisLabelOptions();
					defaultCrosshairAxisLabelOptions.AppearanceProvider = this;
				}
				if (CrosshairAxisLabelOptions != null)
				{
					return CrosshairAxisLabelOptions;
				}
				return defaultCrosshairAxisLabelOptions;
			}
		}

		internal ScaleBreakOptions ActualScaleBreakOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultScaleBreakOptions == null)
				{
					defaultScaleBreakOptions = new ScaleBreakOptions
					{
						AppearanceProvider = this
					};
				}
				return ScaleBreakOptions ?? defaultScaleBreakOptions;
			}
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Brush ActualCrosshairLineBrush
		{
			get
			{
				IContainerToolTipOptions containerToolTipOptions = Diagram2D?.Container?.ToolTipOptions;
				if (containerToolTipOptions != null)
				{
					if (!IsValuesAxis)
					{
						return containerToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions.ActualArgumentLineBrush;
					}
					return containerToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions.ActualValueLineBrush;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal Func<GRealRect2D> GetBoundsDelegate { private get; set; }

				reverse = value;

		}

				isTickmarksOutside = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowTitleAboveLine => TitlePosition == AxisTitlePosition.Outside;

		internal bool LabelInOutsidePosition => LabelPosition == AxisLabelPosition.Outside;

		internal AxisLabelAlignmentCore ActualLabelAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelAlignment != AxisLabelAlignment.Auto)
				{
					return (AxisLabelAlignmentCore)LabelAlignment;
				}
				return (AxisLabelAlignmentCore)DefaultLabelAlignment;
			}
		}

		internal bool PositionInsideDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualAlignment != AxisAlignment.Zero)
				{
					return ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Center;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual AxisLabelAlignment DefaultLabelAlignment => AxisLabelAlignment.Center;

		protected abstract int LayoutPriority { get; }

		protected override int GridSpacingFactor
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					if (base.ActualScaleOptions is QualitativeScaleOptions)
					{
						return 20;
					}
					if (!AreMultipleIntervals)
					{
						return 70;
					}
					return 40;
				}
				if (!AreMultipleIntervals)
				{
					return 100;
				}
				return 50;
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<IConstantLine> ConstantLinesImpl
		{
			get
			{
				List<IConstantLine> list = new List<IConstantLine>();
				list.AddRange(ConstantLinesBehind);
				list.AddRange(ConstantLinesInFront);
				return list;
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> ScaleBreaksImpl => ScaleBreaks;

		protected override IEnumerable<IStrip> StripsImpl => Strips;

		protected override IEnumerable<ICustomAxisLabel> CustomLabelsImpl => CustomLabels;

		protected override bool CanShowCustomWithAutoLabels => LabelVisibilityMode == AxisLabelVisibilityMode.AutoGeneratedAndCustom;

		protected internal override AxisAlignment ActualAlignment => actualAlignment;

		protected internal override bool IsReversed => ReverseInternal;

		protected internal override bool ShouldRotateTitle => IsVertical;

		protected internal override AxisVisibilityInPanes ActualVisibilityInPanes => actualVisibilityInPanes;

		protected internal override bool LabelsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.LabelsVisible)
				{
					return ActualVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static void CrosshairAxisLabelOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CrosshairAxisLabelOptions crosshairAxisLabelOptions = e.NewValue as CrosshairAxisLabelOptions;
			if (e.OldValue is CrosshairAxisLabelOptions crosshairAxisLabelOptions2)
			{
				crosshairAxisLabelOptions2.AppearanceProvider = null;
			}
			if (crosshairAxisLabelOptions != null)
			{
				crosshairAxisLabelOptions.AppearanceProvider = d as ICrosshairAxisLabelAppearanceProvider;
			}
		}

		private static void ReversePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				axis2D.ReverseInternal = (bool)e.NewValue;
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
				axis2D.RangeLimitsUpdated();
			}
		}

		[Obsolete]
		private static void ScrollingRangePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is AxisRange axisRange))
				{
					axis2D.actualScrollingRange = new AxisRange();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, axis2D.actualScrollingRange);
				}
				else
				{
					axisRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(axis2D);
					axis2D.actualScrollingRange = axisRange;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e);
		}

		private static bool ValidateThickness(object thickness)
		{
			return (int)thickness >= 0;
		}

		private static bool ValidateTickmarksThickness(object thickness)
		{
			return (int)thickness > 0;
		}

		private static bool ValidateTickmarksLength(object length)
		{
			return (int)length > 0;
		}

		private static object CoerceAxisAlignment(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			AxisAlignment axisAlignment = (AxisAlignment)value;
			bool flag = d is SecondaryAxisX2D || d is SecondaryAxisY2D;
			if (axisAlignment == AxisAlignment.Zero && flag)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidZeroAxisAlignment));
			}
			if (axisAlignment == AxisAlignment.Center && flag)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgInvalidCenterAxisAlignment));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void VisualRangePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				Range range = e.NewValue as Range;
				if (range == null)
				{
					range = new Range();
					axis2D.VisualRangeData.Reset(needUpdate: false, resetMin: true, resetMax: true);
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, range);
				}
				axis2D.SetVisualRange(range);
				axis2D.CreateMediator();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e);
		}

		private static void AutoScaleBreaksPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as AutoScaleBreaks, e.NewValue as AutoScaleBreaks, axis2D);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)axis2D, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new AxisElementUpdateInfo(axis2D.AutoScaleBreaks, axis2D), ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
			}
		}

		private static void ScaleBreakOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions = e.NewValue as ScaleBreakOptions;
			ScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions2 = e.OldValue as ScaleBreakOptions;
			if (d is Axis2D axis2D)
			{
				if (scaleBreakOptions2 != null)
				{
					scaleBreakOptions2.AppearanceProvider = null;
				}
				if (scaleBreakOptions != null)
				{
					scaleBreakOptions.AppearanceProvider = axis2D;
				}
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(scaleBreakOptions2, scaleBreakOptions, axis2D);
				ChartElementHelper.FullyUpdate(d);
			}
		}

		}

		public Axis2D()
		{
			BeginInit();
			actualVisibilityInPanes = new ActualAxisVisibilityInPanes(this);
			actualScrollingRange = new AxisRange();
			actualScrollingRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualVisualRange = new Range();
			actualVisualRange.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualVisualRange.SetRangeData(base.VisualRangeData);
			CreateMediator();
			SetValue(ConstantLinesBehindPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ConstantLineCollection>(this));
			SetValue(ConstantLinesInFrontPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ConstantLineCollection>(this));
			SetValue(StripsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<StripCollection>(this));
			SetValue(CustomLabelsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<CustomAxisLabelCollection>(base.ActualLabel));
			SetValue(VisibilityInPanesPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<VisibilityInPaneCollection>(this));
			SetValue(ScaleBreaksPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ScaleBreakCollection>(this));
			EndInit();
		}

		Transform ITransformable.GetGeometryTransform(Axis2DItem axisItem)
		{
			switch (axisItem.ElementPosition)
			{
			case AxisPosition.Left:
				if (IsTickmarksOutside)
				{
					return new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleX = -1.0,
						ScaleY = -1.0
					};
				}
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleY = -1.0
				};
			case AxisPosition.Right:
				if (IsTickmarksOutside)
				{
					return new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleY = -1.0
					};
				}
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleX = -1.0,
					ScaleY = -1.0
				};
			case AxisPosition.Top:
				if (IsTickmarksOutside)
				{
					return new ScaleTransform
					{
						ScaleY = -1.0
					};
				}
				return new MatrixTransform
				{
					Matrix = Matrix.Identity
				};
			case AxisPosition.Bottom:
				if (IsTickmarksOutside)
				{
					return new MatrixTransform
					{
						Matrix = Matrix.Identity
					};
				}
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleY = -1.0
				};
			default:
				return new MatrixTransform
				{
					Matrix = Matrix.Identity
				};
			}
		}

		[Obsolete]
		private void DeserializeObsolete()
		{
			if (ScrollingRange != null)
			{
				ScrollingRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		private void FillConstantLinesLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, IEnumerable<ConstantLine> constantLines, Legend legend)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLine constantLine in constantLines)
			{
				if (constantLine.ActualLegend == legend && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(constantLine.LegendText) && constantLine.Visible)
				{
					legendItems.Add(constantLine.CreateLegendItem(legend));
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetVisualRange(Range range)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(null, range, this);
			range.SetRangeData(base.VisualRangeData);
			actualVisualRange = range;
		}

		internal void UpdateActualAlignment(AxisAlignment actualAlignment)
		{
			this.actualAlignment = actualAlignment;
		}

		internal void FillConstantLinesLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, Legend legend)
		{
			FillConstantLinesLegendItems(legendItems, ConstantLinesBehind, legend);
			FillConstantLinesLegendItems(legendItems, ConstantLinesInFront, legend);
		}

		internal void FillStripsLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, Legend legend)
		{
			foreach (Strip strip in Strips)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(strip.LegendText) && strip.Visible && strip.ActualLegend == legend)
				{
					legendItems.Add(strip.CreateLegendItem(legend));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RangeLimitsUpdated()
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram2D = Diagram2D;
			if (diagram2D == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AxisPaneContainer axisPaneContainer = diagram2D.AxisPaneContainer;
			PaneAxesContainerRepository paneAxesContainerRepository = diagram2D.PaneAxesContainerRepository;
			if (axisPaneContainer == null || paneAxesContainerRepository == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<IPane> panes = axisPaneContainer.GetPanes(this);
			if (panes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Pane item in panes)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer container = paneAxesContainerRepository.GetContainer(item);
				if (container == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ScrollBarItem scrollBarItem = ((container.PrimaryAxisX == this) ? item.AxisXScrollBarItem : ((container.PrimaryAxisY != this) ? null : item.AxisYScrollBarItem));
				if (scrollBarItem != null)
				{
					IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = ((IAxisData)this).VisualRange;
					IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = ((IAxisData)this).WholeRange;
					double min = minMaxValues2.Min;
					double delta = minMaxValues2.Delta;
					if (IsReversed)
					{
						scrollBarItem.MinPosition = 1.0 - (minMaxValues.Max - min) / delta;
						scrollBarItem.MaxPosition = 1.0 - (minMaxValues.Min - min) / delta;
					}
					else
					{
						scrollBarItem.MinPosition = (minMaxValues.Min - min) / delta;
						scrollBarItem.MaxPosition = (minMaxValues.Max - min) / delta;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal double CalcInternalValue(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, Rect viewport, double coordinate)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, viewport);
			return axisMappingCore.GetInternalCoord(coordinate);
		}

		internal double CalcInternalValue(Pane pane, double coordinate)
		{
			return CalcInternalValue(pane, pane.Viewport, coordinate);
		}

		internal MinMaxValues CalcInternalCoordDiapason(Pane pane, double coordinate, int diapason)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = CreateMapping(pane, pane.Viewport);
			return axisMappingCore.GetCoordDiapasonInternal(coordinate, diapason);
		}

		internal double CalcAxisValue(Pane pane, double valueInternal)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = CreateMapping(pane, pane.Viewport);
			return axisMappingCore.GetAxisValue(valueInternal);
		}

		internal bool IsValueInRange(double value)
		{
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = ((IAxisData)this).VisualRange;
			if (value >= minMaxValues.Min)
			{
				return value <= minMaxValues.Max;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateVisibilityInPanes(IList<IPane> axisPanes)
		{
			actualVisibilityInPanes.UpdateVisibilityInPanes(VisibilityInPanes, axisPanes);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationLayout> GetScrollBarAnnotationLayouts(ScrollBarOptions options)
		{
			if ((options.AnnotatedElements & ScrollBarAnnotationElement.Strip) == ScrollBarAnnotationElement.Strip)
			{
				foreach (Strip strip in Strips)
				{
					if (strip.Visible)
					{
						yield return Diagram2D.CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(this, strip);
					}
				}
			}
			if ((options.AnnotatedElements & ScrollBarAnnotationElement.ConstantLine) == ScrollBarAnnotationElement.ConstantLine)
			{
				foreach (ConstantLine item in ConstantLinesBehind)
				{
					if (item.Visible)
					{
						yield return Diagram2D.CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(this, item);
					}
				}
				foreach (ConstantLine item2 in ConstantLinesInFront)
				{
					if (item2.Visible)
					{
						yield return Diagram2D.CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(this, item2);
					}
				}
			}
			if ((options.AnnotatedElements & ScrollBarAnnotationElement.CustomLabel) != ScrollBarAnnotationElement.CustomLabel)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (CustomAxisLabel customLabel in CustomLabels)
			{
				if (customLabel.Visible)
				{
					yield return Diagram2D.CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(this, customLabel);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			foreach (VisibilityInPane visibilityInPane in VisibilityInPanes)
			{
				visibilityInPane.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
			foreach (ConstantLine item in ConstantLinesBehind)
			{
				item.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
			foreach (ConstantLine item2 in ConstantLinesInFront)
			{
				item2.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
			foreach (Strip strip in Strips)
			{
				strip.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
		}

		protected override void TryApplyUserRange()
		{
			Range range = base.WholeRange;
			if (range != null && (range.MinValue != null || range.MaxValue != null))
			{
				range.ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(this);
				return;
			}
			Range range2 = VisualRange;
			if (range2 != null && (range2.MinValue != null || range2.MaxValue != null))
			{
				range2.ForceUpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		protected override GRealRect2D GetLabelBounds(Pane pane)
		{
			return pane.GetLabelBounds(this);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessWeakEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is AutoScaleBreaks || sender is ScaleBreakOptions)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessWeakEvent(sender, e);
		}

		protected override void LabelPropertyChanged()
		{
			base.LabelPropertyChanged();
			((IOwnedElement)CustomLabels).Owner = base.ActualLabel;
		}

		protected override void ScaleTypeUpdated()
		{
			base.ScaleTypeUpdated();
			if (actualScrollingRange != null)
			{
				actualScrollingRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
			foreach (Strip strip in Strips)
			{
				strip.UpdateMinMaxLimits();
			}
		}

		protected internal override RenderGeometryBase CreateGridLineGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double axisValue, int thickness)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, axisBounds);
			double num = Render2DHelper.CorrectLinePosition(axisMappingCore.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(axisValue), thickness);
			System.Windows.Point startPoint;
			System.Windows.Point endPoint;
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				startPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, axisBounds.Height - num);
				endPoint = new System.Windows.Point(axisBounds.Width, axisBounds.Height - num);
			}
			else
			{
				startPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0);
				endPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num, axisBounds.Height);
			}
			return new LineRenderGeometry(startPoint, endPoint);
		}

		protected internal override RenderGeometryBase CreateInterlaceGeometry(Rect axisBounds, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, double nearAxisValue, double farAxisValue)
		{
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = CreateMapping(intervalLayoutProvider, axisBounds);
			double bound = axisMappingCore.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(nearAxisValue);
			double bound2 = axisMappingCore.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(farAxisValue);
			System.Windows.Point point;
			System.Windows.Point point2;
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				bound = axisBounds.Height - bound;
				bound2 = axisBounds.Height - bound2;
				Render2DHelper.CorrectBounds(ref bound, ref bound2);
				point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, Math.Min(bound, bound2));
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(axisBounds.Width, Math.Max(bound, bound2));
			}
			else
			{
				Render2DHelper.CorrectBounds(ref bound, ref bound2);
				point = new System.Windows.Point(Math.Min(bound, bound2), 0.0);
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(Math.Max(bound, bound2), axisBounds.Height);
			}
			return new RectangleRenderGeometry(new Rect(point, point2));
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateUserValues()
		{
			base.UpdateUserValues();
			DeserializeObsolete();
			if (ActualVisualRange != null)
			{
				ActualVisualRange.UpdateMinMaxValues(this);
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeVisible(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return Visible.HasValue;
		}

		private bool XtraShouldSerializeActualVisualRange()
		{
			return VisualRange == null;
		}

		private bool XtraShouldSerializeActualWholeRange()
		{
			return XtraShouldSerializeActualVisualRange();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		object ISupportTag.get_Tag()
		{
			return base.Tag;
		}
	}

	public enum TitleAlignment
	{
		Near,
		Center,
		Far
	}
	public class AxisTitle : AxisElementTitleBase, ISupportVisibilityControlElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AlignmentProperty;

		private bool autoLayoutVisible = true;

		private Rect bounds;

		private int id = -1;

		[Description("Gets or sets the alignment of the axis title.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public TitleAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (TitleAlignment)GetValue(AlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal TitleAlignment ActualAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				TitleAlignment alignment = Alignment;
				Axis axis = Axis;
				if (axis != null && axis.IsReversed)
				{
					switch (alignment)
					{
					case TitleAlignment.Near:
						return TitleAlignment.Far;
					case TitleAlignment.Far:
						return TitleAlignment.Near;
					}
				}
				return alignment;
			}
		}

		internal override bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Visible.HasValue)
				{
					return base.Visible.Value;
				}
				return autoLayoutVisible;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Axis Axis => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as Axis;

		protected internal override object HitTestableElement => this;

		protected internal override bool ShouldRotate => Axis?.ShouldRotateTitle ?? false;

		protected internal override double RotateAngle => (Axis.ActualAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far) ? 90 : (-90);

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Priority
		{
			get
			{
				if (Axis == null)
				{
					return 100;
				}
				if (Axis is AxisX2D || Axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
				{
					return 6;
				}
				if (Axis is AxisY2D || Axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
				{
					return 7;
				}
				return 100;
			}
		}

		bool ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Visible.HasValue)
				{
					return autoLayoutVisible;
				}
				return base.Visible.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!base.Visible.HasValue)
				{
					autoLayoutVisible = value;
				}
			}
		}

		GRealRect2D ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				_ = bounds;
				if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					return new GRealRect2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				}
				return GRealRect2D.Empty;
			}
		}

		VisibilityElementOrientation ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				if (Axis == null)
				{
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Inside;
				}
				if (!Axis.IsVertical)
				{
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Horizontal;
				}
				return VisibilityElementOrientation.Vertical;
			}
		}

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		static AxisTitle()
		{
			AlignmentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Alignment", typeof(TitleAlignment), typeof(AxisTitle), new PropertyMetadata(TitleAlignment.Center, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(AxisTitle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			TitleBase.VisibleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(AxisTitle), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((bool?)null));
		}

		public AxisTitle()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AxisTitle>(this);
		}

		internal void SetBounds(Rect value)
		{
			if (!value.IsEmpty && value.Height != 0.0 && value.Width != 0.0)
			{
				bounds = value;
			}
		}
	}

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ConstantLine constantLine)
			{
				object obj = e.NewValue;
				string text = obj as string;
				if (text == string.Empty)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				IAxisData axis = constantLine.Axis;
				if (obj == null || axis == null)
				{
					constantLine.axisValue = obj;
				}
				else
				{
					AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
					constantLine.axisValue = ((axisScaleTypeMap == null) ? obj : axisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(obj, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					constantLine.valueInternal = double.NaN;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new AxisElementUpdateInfo(constantLine, axis));
			}
		}

		private static void LineStylePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ConstantLine constantLine)
			{
				LineStyle lineStyle = e.NewValue as LineStyle;
				constantLine.SetValue(ActualLineStylePropertyKey, (lineStyle == null) ? new LineStyle() : lineStyle);
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as LineStyle, lineStyle, constantLine);
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void VisiblePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ConstantLine constantLine)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new AxisElementUpdateInfo(constantLine, constantLine.Axis), ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
			}
		}

		private ConstantLine(object value, string title)
			: this()
		{
			Value = value;
			if (Title == null)
			{
				Title = new ConstantLineTitle();
			}
			Title.Content = title;
		}

		public ConstantLine(string value, string title)
			: this((object)value, title)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(DateTime value, string title)
			: this((object)value, title)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(TimeSpan value, string title)
			: this((object)value, title)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine(double value, string title)
			: this((object)value, title)
		{
		}

		public ConstantLine()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ConstantLine>(this);
			SetValue(ActualLineStylePropertyKey, new LineStyle());
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType != typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
			return true;
		}

		void IScrollBarAnnotation.Render(DrawingContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.Width > 0.0 || bounds.Height > 0.0)
			{
				context.DrawLine(new System.Windows.Media.Pen(Brush, ActualLineStyle.Thickness), bounds.TopLeft, bounds.BottomRight);
			}
		}

		internal void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Axis?.Diagram?.Container?.LegendOptions;
			if (containerLegendOptions != null)
			{
				if (legendIndex == -1)
				{
					Legend = containerLegendOptions.Legend;
				}
				else if (legendIndex >= 0 && legendIndex < containerLegendOptions.Legends.Count)
				{
					Legend = containerLegendOptions.Legends[legendIndex];
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool GetActualVisible()
		{
			if (Visible)
			{
				IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Axis?.Diagram?.Container?.LegendOptions;
				if (containerLegendOptions != null && containerLegendOptions.LegendUseCheckBoxes)
				{
					if (CheckableInLegend)
					{
						return CheckedInLegend;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal LegendItem CreateLegendItem(Legend legend)
		{
			return new DefaultLegendItem(legend, this, this, LegendText, null, Brush, ActualLineStyle, isEnabled: true);
		}
	}
	public class ConstantLineCollection : ChartElementCollection<ConstantLine>, IEnumerable<IConstantLine>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override ChartElementChange Change => base.Change | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems;

		IEnumerator<IConstantLine> IEnumerable<IConstantLine>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<ConstantLine> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		internal void FillConstantLinesAndTitles(HashSet<object> items)
		{
			using IEnumerator<ConstantLine> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ConstantLine current = enumerator.Current;
				items.Add(current);
				ConstantLineTitle title = current.Title;
				if (title != null)
				{
					items.Add(title);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FillConstantLineItems(HashSet<ConstantLineItem> constantLineItems, HashSet<ConstantLineTitleItem> constantLineTitleItems, HashSet<ConstantLineItem> existingConstantLineItems, HashSet<ConstantLineTitleItem> existingConstantLineTitleItems)
		{
			using IEnumerator<ConstantLine> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ConstantLine constantLine = enumerator.Current;
				ConstantLineItem item = GetOrCreate((ConstantLineItem s) => s.ConstantLine == constantLine, () => new ConstantLineItem(constantLine), existingConstantLineItems.ToList());
				constantLineItems.Add(item);
				ConstantLineTitle title = constantLine.Title;
				if (title != null)
				{
					constantLineTitleItems.Add(GetOrCreate((ConstantLineTitleItem s) => s.Title == title && s.ConstantLineItem == item, () => new ConstantLineTitleItem(title, item), existingConstantLineTitleItems.ToList()));
				}
			}
		}

		internal static T GetOrCreate<T>(Predicate<T> match, Func<T> create, List<T> existingItems) where T : class
		{
			T val = ((existingItems != null) ? existingItems.Find(match) : null);
			return val ?? create();
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			return new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, (AxisBase)base.Owner);
		}
	}

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is CustomAxisLabel customAxisLabel)
			{
				object obj = e.NewValue;
				if (obj is string && (string)obj == string.Empty)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				IAxisData axis = customAxisLabel.Axis;
				customAxisLabel.axisValue = ((obj == null || axis == null || axis.AxisScaleTypeMap == null) ? obj : axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(obj, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				if (obj == null)
				{
					customAxisLabel.valueInternal = double.NaN;
				}
				if (customAxisLabel.Axis != null)
				{
					customAxisLabel.Axis.NeedUpdateLabelItems = true;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new AxisElementUpdateInfo(customAxisLabel, axis));
			}
		}

		private static void VisiblePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is CustomAxisLabel customAxisLabel)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new AxisElementUpdateInfo(customAxisLabel, customAxisLabel.Axis));
			}
		}

		private CustomAxisLabel(object value, string text)
		{
			Value = value;
			Content = text;
		}

		{
		}

			: this((object)value, text)
		{
		}

		public CustomAxisLabel(DateTime value, string text)
			: this((object)value, text)
		{
		}

		public CustomAxisLabel(TimeSpan value, string text)
			: this((object)value, text)
		{
		}

		public CustomAxisLabel(double value, string text)
			: this((object)value, text)
		{
		}

		void IScrollBarAnnotation.Render(DrawingContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.Width != 0.0 || bounds.Height != 0.0)
			{
				if (bounds.Width == 0.0)
				{
					bounds.Width = 4.0;
				}
				if (bounds.Height == 0.0)
				{
					bounds.Height = 4.0;
				}
				context.DrawRectangle(brush, null, bounds);
			}
		}

		{
			if (d is Strip strip)

				strip.UpdateMinLimitAxisValue(e.NewValue);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new AxisElementUpdateInfo(strip, strip.Axis));
			}
		}

		{
