		private Strip(object minLimitValue, object maxLimitValue)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Strip>(this);
			minLimit = new StripLimit(this, double.NegativeInfinity);
			maxLimit = new StripLimit(this, double.PositiveInfinity);
			if (minLimitValue != null)
			{
				MinLimit = minLimitValue;
			}
			if (maxLimitValue != null)
			{
				MaxLimit = maxLimitValue;
			}
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
		}

		public Strip()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public Strip(string minLimit, string maxLimit)
			: this((object)minLimit, (object)maxLimit)
		{
		}

		public Strip(DateTime minLimit, DateTime maxLimit)
			: this((object)minLimit, (object)maxLimit)
		{
		}

		public Strip(TimeSpan minLimit, TimeSpan maxLimit)
			: this((object)minLimit, (object)maxLimit)
		{
		}

		public Strip(double minLimit, double maxLimit)
			: this((object)minLimit, (object)maxLimit)
		{
		}

		void IStrip.CorrectLimits()
		{
		}

		void IScrollBarAnnotation.Render(DrawingContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.Width > 0.0 && bounds.Height > 0.0)
			{
				context.DrawRectangle(Brush, new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(BorderColor), 1.0), bounds);
			}
			else if (bounds.Width > 0.0 || bounds.Height > 0.0)
			{
				context.DrawLine(new System.Windows.Media.Pen(Brush, 1.0), bounds.TopLeft, bounds.BottomRight);
			}
		}

		private object ConvertValueWithAxisScaleMap(object value)
		{
			if (value is string && (string)value == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IAxisData axis = Axis;
			if (axis == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap != null)
			{
				return axisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void UpdateMinLimitAxisValue(object value)
		{
			minLimit.UpdateAxisValue(ConvertValueWithAxisScaleMap(value));
		}

		private void UpdateMaxLimitAxisValue(object value)
		{
			maxLimit.UpdateAxisValue(ConvertValueWithAxisScaleMap(value));
		}

		internal void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Axis?.Diagram?.Container?.LegendOptions;
			if (containerLegendOptions != null)
			{
				if (legendIndex == -1)
				{
					Legend = containerLegendOptions.Legend;
				}
				else if (legendIndex >= 0 && legendIndex < containerLegendOptions.Legends.Count)
				{
					Legend = containerLegendOptions.Legends[legendIndex];
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateMinMaxLimits()
		{
			UpdateMinLimitAxisValue(MinLimit);
			UpdateMaxLimitAxisValue(MaxLimit);
		}

		internal bool GetActualVisible()
		{
			if (Visible)
			{
				IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Axis?.Diagram?.Container?.LegendOptions;
				if (containerLegendOptions != null && containerLegendOptions.LegendUseCheckBoxes)
				{
					if (CheckableInLegend)
					{
						return CheckedInLegend;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal LegendItem CreateLegendItem(Legend legend)
		{
			return new DefaultLegendItem(legend, this, this, LegendText, Brush);
		}
	}
	public class StripCollection : ChartElementCollection<Strip>, IEnumerable<IStrip>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override ChartElementChange Change => base.Change | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems;

		IEnumerator<IStrip> IEnumerable<IStrip>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<Strip> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			return new AxisElementUpdateInfo(this, (AxisBase)base.Owner);
		}
	}
	public class TitlesLayoutControl : ChartItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MasterElementProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TitlesProperty;

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public FrameworkElement MasterElement
		{
			get
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)GetValue(MasterElementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MasterElementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public TitleCollection Titles
		{
			get
			{
				return (TitleCollection)GetValue(TitlesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TitlesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void MasterElementChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is TitlesLayoutControl titlesLayoutControl)
			{
				titlesLayoutControl.Update();
			}
		}

		private static void TitlesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is TitlesLayoutControl titlesLayoutControl)
			{
				if (e.OldValue is TitleCollection titleCollection)
				{
					titleCollection.CollectionChanged -= titlesLayoutControl.TitlesCollectionChanged;
				}
				if (e.NewValue is TitleCollection titleCollection2)
				{
					titleCollection2.CollectionChanged += titlesLayoutControl.TitlesCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		static TitlesLayoutControl()
		{
			MasterElementProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MasterElement", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(TitlesLayoutControl), new PropertyMetadata(MasterElementChanged));
			TitlesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Titles", typeof(TitleCollection), typeof(TitlesLayoutControl), new PropertyMetadata(TitlesChanged));
			FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(DockPanel));
			frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(FrameworkElement.NameProperty, "TitlesDockPanel");
			ItemsPanelTemplate itemsPanelTemplate = new ItemsPanelTemplate(frameworkElementFactory);
			itemsPanelTemplate.Seal();
			ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TitlesLayoutControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(itemsPanelTemplate));
		}

		private void TitlesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is TitleCollection)
			{
				Update();
			}
		}

		private void Update()
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			if (Titles != null)
			{
				foreach (Title title in Titles)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(title);
				}
			}
			if (MasterElement != null)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(MasterElement);
			}
			base.ItemsSource = observableCollection;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is Title title)
			{
				Binding binding = new Binding("Dock");
				binding.Source = title;
				title.SetBinding(DockPanel.DockProperty, binding);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (!double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width) && !double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				return constraint;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class ChartElementItemsControl : ChartItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DiagramProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Diagram", typeof(Control), typeof(ChartElementItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, PropertyChanged));

		private readonly ChartTargetLegendsCollection legends = new ChartTargetLegendsCollection();

		private ObservableCollection<Control> items;

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public Control Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				return (Control)GetValue(DiagramProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DiagramProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public ChartTargetLegendsCollection Legends => legends;

		private static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartElementItemsControl chartElementItemsControl)
			{
				chartElementItemsControl.Update();
			}
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			if (base.ItemsSource != null)
			{
				if (Diagram == null)
				{
					if (items.Count > 0 && items[0] is Diagram)
					{
						items.RemoveAt(0);
					}
				}
				else if (!items.Contains(Diagram))
				{
					if (items.Count > 0 && items[0] is Diagram)
					{
						items.RemoveAt(0);
					}
					items.Insert(0, Diagram);
				}
				List<Control> list = new List<Control>();
				foreach (Control item3 in items)
				{
					if (!(item3 is Legend))
					{
						list.Add(item3);
					}
				}
				if (Legends != null && Legends.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (Legend legend in Legends)
					{
						list.Add(legend);
					}
				}
				if (IsSame(list, items))
				{
					return;
				}
				items.Clear();
				{
					foreach (Control item4 in list)
					{
						items.Add(item4);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			items = new ObservableCollection<Control>();
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				items.Add(Diagram);
			}
			if (Legends != null)
			{
				foreach (Legend legend2 in Legends)
				{
					items.Add(legend2);
				}
			}
			base.ItemsSource = items;
		}

		private bool IsSame(List<Control> forAdd, ObservableCollection<Control> items)
		{
			if (items.Count != forAdd.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Control item in forAdd)
			{
				if (!items.Contains(item))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			}

		private static object CoerceAngle(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			int num = (int)value;
			if (num > 360 || num < -360)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLabelAngle));
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static void ResolveOverlappingOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisLabel axisLabel)
			{
				AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions = e.NewValue as AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions;
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions, axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions, axisLabel);
				axisLabel.actualResolveOverlappingOptions = ((axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions != null) ? axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions : new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions());
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e);
		}

		private static void BeginTextPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisLabel axisLabel)
			{
				axisLabel.beginText = (string)e.NewValue;
				axisLabel.ResetTextPattern();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void EndTextPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisLabel axisLabel)
			{
				axisLabel.endText = (string)e.NewValue;
				axisLabel.ResetTextPattern();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		internal static void TextPatternPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisLabel axisLabel)
			{
				axisLabel.textPattern = (string)e.NewValue;
				axisLabel.shouldUpdatePattern = false;
				if (!axisLabel.textPatternUpdateLocked)
				{
					ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
				}
			}
		}

		static AxisLabel()
		{
			StaggeredProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Staggered", typeof(bool), typeof(AxisLabel), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			BeginTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BeginText", typeof(string), typeof(AxisLabel), new PropertyMetadata("", BeginTextPropertyChanged));
			EndTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EndText", typeof(string), typeof(AxisLabel), new PropertyMetadata("", EndTextPropertyChanged));
			AngleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Angle", typeof(int), typeof(AxisLabel), new PropertyMetadata(0, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache, CoerceAngle));
			TextPatternProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(AxisLabel), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, TextPatternPropertyChanged));
			FormatterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Formatter", typeof(IAxisLabelFormatter), typeof(AxisLabel), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(AxisLabel);
			FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			Control.FontFamilyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemFonts.MessageFontFamily, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, FontPropertyChanged));
			Control.FontSizeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemFonts.MessageFontSize, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, FontPropertyChanged));
			Control.FontStretchProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(TextElement.FontStretchProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, FontPropertyChanged));
			Control.FontStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemFonts.MessageFontStyle, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, FontPropertyChanged));
			Control.FontWeightProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.SystemFonts.MessageFontWeight, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, FontPropertyChanged));
		}

		private static void FontPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisLabel)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateAxisLabelsMeasure(d, e);
			}
		}

		public AxisLabel()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AxisLabel>(this);
			actualResolveOverlappingOptions = new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions();
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return ProcessWeakEvent(sender);
			}
			return false;
		}

		PatternDataProvider IPatternHolder.GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return new AxisPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		private bool ProcessWeakEvent(object sender)
		{
			if (sender is AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		Transform ISupportFlowDirection.CreateDirectionTransform()
		{
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleX = -1.0,
					ScaleY = 1.0,
					CenterX = 0.5,
					CenterY = 0.5
				};
			}
			return Transform.Identity;
		}

		private DataTemplate GetDefaultTemplate()
		{
			string axisLabelItemTemplate = TemplateHelper.GetAxisLabelItemTemplate(this);
			int hashCode = axisLabelItemTemplate.GetHashCode();
			if (!ItemTemplateCache.TryGetValue(hashCode, out var value))
			{
				value = XamlHelper.GetTemplate(axisLabelItemTemplate);
				ItemTemplateCache.Add(hashCode, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal void ResetTextPattern()
		{
			shouldUpdatePattern = true;
		}

		internal void UpdateTextPattern()
		{
			if (!shouldUpdatePattern)
			{
				return;
			}
			textPatternUpdateLocked = true;
			string text = string.Empty;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			AxisBase axis = Axis;
			if (axis != null)
			{
				text = (axis.IsValuesAxis ? "V" : "A");
				if (axis.ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime && axis.DateTimeOptionsImpl != null)
				{
					text2 = ":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(axis.DateTimeOptionsImpl);
				}
				if (axis.ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical && axis.NumericOptionsInternal != null)
				{
					text2 = ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(axis.NumericOptionsInternal);
				}
				else if (axis.ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
				{
					textPattern = textPattern + ":" + PatternUtils.GetTimeSpanFormat();
				}
			}
			TextPattern = beginText + "{" + text + text2 + "}" + endText;
			shouldUpdatePattern = false;
			textPatternUpdateLocked = false;
		}

		internal DataTemplate GetItemTemplate()
		{
			ValueSource valueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(this, ChartTextElement.ElementTemplateProperty);
			if (base.ElementTemplate == null || valueSource.BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.DefaultStyle)
			{
				return GetDefaultTemplate();
			}
			return base.ElementTemplate;
		}

		internal void SetResolveOverlappingOptionsInternal(IAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions options)
		{
			if (options != null)
			{
				actualResolveOverlappingOptions = new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions
				{
					AllowHide = options.AllowHide,
					AllowRotate = options.AllowRotate,
					AllowStagger = options.AllowStagger,
					MinIndent = options.MinIndent
				};
			}
			else
			{
				actualResolveOverlappingOptions = new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions();
			}
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(AxisRangeTypeConverter))]
	[Obsolete("The AxisRange class is obsolete now. Use the Range class instead.")]
	public sealed class AxisRange : ChartNonVisualElement, IAxisRange, ICloneable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinValueProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinValue", typeof(object), typeof(AxisRange), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, MinValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxValueProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxValue", typeof(object), typeof(AxisRange), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, MaxValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinValueInternalProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinValueInternal", typeof(double), typeof(AxisRange), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, MinInternalValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxValueInternalProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxValueInternal", typeof(double), typeof(AxisRange), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, MaxInternalValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SideMarginsEnabledProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SideMarginsEnabled", typeof(bool), typeof(AxisRange), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, SideMarginsEnabledPropertyChanged));

		private readonly Locker locker = new Locker();

		private object actualMinValue;

		private object actualMaxValue;

		private double actualMinInternalValue = double.NaN;

		private double actualMaxInternalValue = double.NaN;

		private object Min
		{
			set
			{
				actualMinValue = value;
				if (Axis == null || value == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				TryDisableSideMargins();
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					if (IsScrollingRange)
					{
						Axis.WholeRangeData.MinValue = value;
					}
					else
					{
						Axis.VisualRangeData.MinValue = value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Axis.WholeRangeData.MinValue = value;
					Axis.VisualRangeData.MinValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private object Max
		{
			set
			{
				actualMaxValue = value;
				if (Axis == null || value == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				TryDisableSideMargins();
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					if (IsScrollingRange)
					{
						Axis.WholeRangeData.MaxValue = value;
					}
					else
					{
						Axis.VisualRangeData.MaxValue = value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Axis.WholeRangeData.MaxValue = value;
					Axis.VisualRangeData.MaxValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private double MinInternal
		{
			set
			{
				if (Axis == null || double.IsNaN(value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(actualMaxInternalValue))
				{
					actualMaxInternalValue = 1.0;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
				if (NeedSwapMinMax(value, actualMaxInternalValue))
				{
					SetInternalMinMaxValues(actualMaxInternalValue, value);
					return;
				}
				actualMinInternalValue = value;
				double minValueInternal = CorrectDatetime(value);
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					Axis.VisualRangeData.MinValueInternal = minValueInternal;
					return;
				}
				Axis.WholeRangeData.MinValueInternal = minValueInternal;
				Axis.VisualRangeData.MinValueInternal = minValueInternal;
			}
		}

		private double MaxInternal
		{
			set
			{
				if (Axis == null || double.IsNaN(value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(actualMinInternalValue))
				{
					actualMinInternalValue = 0.0;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
				if (NeedSwapMinMax(actualMinInternalValue, value))
				{
					SetInternalMinMaxValues(value, actualMinInternalValue);
					return;
				}
				actualMaxInternalValue = value;
				double maxValueInternal = CorrectDatetime(value);
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					Axis.VisualRangeData.MaxValueInternal = maxValueInternal;
					return;
				}
				Axis.WholeRangeData.MaxValueInternal = maxValueInternal;
				Axis.VisualRangeData.MaxValueInternal = maxValueInternal;
			}
		}

		private bool SideMargins
		{
			set
			{
				if (Axis != null)
				{
					if (!value)
					{
						Axis.WholeRangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
						Axis.WholeRangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						Axis.WholeRangeData.AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.Enable;
						Axis.VisualRangeData.AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.Enable;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool AlwaysShowZeroLevel
		{
			set
			{
				if (Axis != null)
				{
					Axis.WholeRangeData.AlwaysShowZeroLevel = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsScrollingRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Axis is Axis2D axis2D))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return axis2D.ScrollingRange == this;
			}
		}

		private static object CorrectValueProperty(IAxisData axis, object value)
		{
			if (axis == null || axis.AxisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.TryParse(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisRange axisRange && !axisRange.locker.IsLocked)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void MinValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisRange axisRange)
			{
				axisRange.Min = CorrectValueProperty(axisRange.Axis, e.NewValue);
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void MaxValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisRange axisRange)
			{
				axisRange.Max = CorrectValueProperty(axisRange.Axis, e.NewValue);
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		private static void SideMarginsEnabledPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisRange axisRange)
			{
				axisRange.SideMargins = (bool)e.NewValue;
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		internal static void AlwaysShowZeroLevelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AxisRange axisRange)
			{
				axisRange.AlwaysShowZeroLevel = (bool)e.NewValue;
			}
			PropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		void IAxisRange.Assign(IAxisRange source)
		{
			locker.Lock();
			try
			{
				MinValue = source.MinValue;
				MaxValue = source.MaxValue;
				MinValueInternal = source.MinValueInternal;
				MaxValueInternal = source.MaxValueInternal;
			}
			finally
			{
				locker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		void IAxisRange.Assign(IAxisRangeData source)
		{
		}

		void IAxisRange.UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			actualMaxValue = max;
			actualMinValue = min;
			actualMinInternalValue = internalMin;
			actualMaxInternalValue = internalMax;
		}

		internal void UpdateMinMaxValues(AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (Axis != null && Axis.WholeRangeData.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues && Axis.VisualRangeData.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues)
			{
				object obj = CorrectValueProperty(axis, MinValue);
				if (!double.IsNaN(axis.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(obj)))
				{
					Min = obj;
				}
				object obj2 = CorrectValueProperty(axis, MaxValue);
				if (!double.IsNaN(axis.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(obj2)))
				{
					Max = obj2;
				}
			}
			if (Axis != null && (Axis.WholeRangeData.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues || Axis.VisualRangeData.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues))
			{
				SetMinInternal(MinValueInternal);
				SetMaxInternal(MaxValueInternal);
			}
		}

		private void TryDisableSideMargins()
		{
			if (((IAxisData)Axis).AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
			{
				Axis.WholeRangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
				Axis.WholeRangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
				Axis.VisualRangeData.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
				Axis.VisualRangeData.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
			}
		}

		private void SetMinInternal(double value)
		{
			if (Axis != null && !double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				actualMinInternalValue = value;
				double min = CorrectDatetime(value);
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					((IMinMaxValues)Axis.VisualRangeData).Min = min;
					return;
				}
				((IMinMaxValues)Axis.WholeRangeData).Min = min;
				((IMinMaxValues)Axis.VisualRangeData).Min = min;
			}
		}

		private void SetMaxInternal(double value)
		{
			if (Axis != null && !double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				actualMaxInternalValue = value;
				double max = CorrectDatetime(value);
				if (IsScrollingEnable())
				{
					((IMinMaxValues)Axis.VisualRangeData).Max = max;
					return;
				}
				((IMinMaxValues)Axis.WholeRangeData).Max = max;
				((IMinMaxValues)Axis.VisualRangeData).Max = max;
			}
		}

		private bool IsScrollingEnable()
		{
			if (((IOwnedElement)Axis).Owner is XYDiagram2D { AxisPaneContainer: not null } xYDiagram2D)
			{
				IList<IPane> panes = xYDiagram2D.AxisPaneContainer.GetPanes(Axis);
				if (panes != null)
				{
					foreach (IPane item in panes)
					{
						if (Axis.IsValuesAxis && ((Pane)item).ActualEnableAxisYNavigation)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (!Axis.IsValuesAxis && ((Pane)item).ActualEnableAxisXNavigation)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (Axis.IsValuesAxis && xYDiagram2D.EnableAxisYNavigation)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (!Axis.IsValuesAxis && xYDiagram2D.EnableAxisXNavigation)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CorrectDatetime(double value)
		{
			if (Axis.ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return value + ((AxisDateTimeMap)Axis.ScaleMap).Min;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool NeedSwapMinMax(double first, double second)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(first) || double.IsNaN(second))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return first > second;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			AxisRange axisRange = new AxisRange();
			((IAxisRange)axisRange).Assign((IAxisRange)Axis.ActualRange);
			return axisRange;
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.ChangeOwner(oldOwner, newOwner);
			object min = actualMinValue;
			object max = actualMaxValue;
			Max = max;
			Min = min;
			SideMargins = SideMarginsEnabled;
		}

		public void SetAuto()
		{
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(MinValueProperty);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(MaxValueProperty);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(MinValueInternalProperty);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(MaxValueInternalProperty);
			Axis.WholeRangeData.CorrectionMode = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			Axis.VisualRangeData.CorrectionMode = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			Axis.WholeRangeData.AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.Enable;
			Axis.VisualRangeData.AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.Enable;
			PropertyChanged((DependencyObject)(object)this, default(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs));
		}

		public void SetMinMaxValues(object minValue, object maxValue)
		{
			TryDisableSideMargins();
			if (IsScrollingEnable())
			{
				Axis.VisualRangeData.SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
			}
			else
			{
				Axis.WholeRangeData.SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
				Axis.VisualRangeData.SetRange(minValue, maxValue, double.NaN, double.NaN, needUpdate: true);
			}
			MinValue = minValue;
			MaxValue = maxValue;
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(MinValueInternalProperty);
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(MaxValueInternalProperty);
		}

		public void SetInternalMinMaxValues(double min, double max)
		{
			actualMinInternalValue = min;
			actualMaxInternalValue = max;
			double internalMin = CorrectDatetime(min);
			double internalMax = CorrectDatetime(max);
			TryDisableSideMargins();
			if (IsScrollingEnable())
			{
				Axis.VisualRangeData.SetRange(null, null, internalMin, internalMax, needUpdate: true);
				return;
			}
			Axis.WholeRangeData.SetRange(null, null, internalMin, internalMax, needUpdate: true);
			Axis.VisualRangeData.SetRange(null, null, internalMin, internalMax, needUpdate: true);
		}
	}

		Transform ISupportFlowDirection.CreateDirectionTransform()
		{
			if (FlowDirection != FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				return new MatrixTransform();
			}
			return new ScaleTransform
			{
				ScaleX = -1.0,
				ScaleY = 1.0,
				CenterX = 0.5,
				CenterY = 0.5
			};
		}

			properties.Add(Control.FontStretchProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontStyleProperty);
			properties.Add(Control.FontWeightProperty);
		}

	public abstract class Diagram2D : Diagram
	{
		protected override bool Is3DView => false;

		protected internal Diagram2D(IRefinedSeriesFactory factory)
			: base(factory)
		{
		}

		public Diagram2D()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			RaiseCanExecutedChanged();
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			bool result = base.ProcessChanging(args) && (args.Change & ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly) == 0;
			if (args != null && args.ShouldUpdateSeriesBinding && args.UpdateInfo is PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData> && ((PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>)args.UpdateInfo).NewValue is AxisBase axisBase)
			{
				axisBase.ResetSeriesBinding();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			base.UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			if (!shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				item.UpdateLabelItems();
			}
		}

		protected override ISeriesItem GetSeriesItem(Series series)
		{
			return series.Item;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCanExecutedChanged()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateDiagram()
		{
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasureRecursive(this);
		}
	}

		private DiagramLightingCollection ActualLighting
		{
			get
			{
				if (Lighting.Count != 0)
				{
					return Lighting;
				}
				return CreateDefaultLighting();
			}
		}

		private bool AnimationInProgress
		{
			get
			{
				IContainerAnimationOptions containerAnimationOptions = base.Container?.AnimationOptions;
				if (containerAnimationOptions != null)
				{
					foreach (ChartAnimationRecord animationRecord in containerAnimationOptions.AnimationRecords)
					{
						foreach (ChartAnimation animation in animationRecord.Animations)
						{
							if (animation is Diagram3DAnimation && animationRecord.Progress < 1.0)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal List<VisualContainer> VisualContainers => visualContainers;

		internal Matrix3D ContentTransformMatrix => ActualContentTransform.Value;

		internal NavigationOptions3D ActualNavigationOptions => NavigationOptions ?? new NavigationOptions3D();

		protected internal override bool IsDiagram3D => true;

		protected internal override bool IsMouseNavigationEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!AnimationInProgress)
				{
					return ActualNavigationOptions.UseMouse;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsKeyboardNavigationEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!AnimationInProgress)
				{
					return ActualNavigationOptions.UseKeyboard;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IsManipulationNavigationEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!AnimationInProgress)
				{
					return ActualNavigationOptions.UseTouchDevice;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override Rect ActualViewport
		{
			get
			{
				double width = Math.Max(base.DesiredSize.Width - base.Margin.Left - base.BorderThickness.Left - base.Padding.Left - base.Padding.Right - base.BorderThickness.Right - base.Margin.Right, 0.0);
				double height = Math.Max(base.DesiredSize.Height - base.Margin.Top - base.BorderThickness.Top - base.Padding.Top - base.Padding.Bottom - base.BorderThickness.Bottom - base.Margin.Bottom, 0.0);
				return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, width, height);
			}

		protected override bool Is3DView => true;

		[Description("Gets the actual object with information on how to transform the 3D Diagram‘s contents.")]
		public Transform3D ActualContentTransform => actualContentTransform;

		static Diagram3D()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(Diagram3D);
			ContentTransformProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ContentTransform", typeof(Transform3D), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, ContentTransformPropertyChanged));
			PerspectiveAngleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PerspectiveAngle", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(50.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, ChartElementHelper.Update), ValidatePerspectiveAngle);
			ZoomPercentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ZoomPercent", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ChartControlBase.DefaultZoomPercent, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender), ValidateZoomPercent);
			HorizontalScrollPercentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScrollPercent", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender), ValidateScrollPercent);
			VerticalScrollPercentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScrollPercent", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender), ValidateScrollPercent);
			LightingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Lighting", typeof(DiagramLightingCollection), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentArrange | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate));
			RuntimeRotationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RuntimeRotation", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			RuntimeScrollingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RuntimeScrolling", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			RuntimeZoomingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RuntimeZooming", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			NavigationOptionsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NavigationOptions", typeof(NavigationOptions3D), typeof(Diagram3D));
		}

		private static void ContentTransformPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Diagram3D diagram3D)
			{
				Transform3D transform3D = e.NewValue as Transform3D;
				diagram3D.actualContentTransform = ((transform3D == null) ? diagram3D.CreateDefaultContentTransform() : transform3D);
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateMinZoomPercent(double zoom)
		{
			return zoom >= 1.0;
		}

		private static bool ValidateMaxZoomPercent(double zoom)
		{
			return zoom <= 500.0;
		}

		internal static bool ValidatePerspectiveAngle(object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num >= 0.0)
			{
				return num < 180.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateZoomPercent(object value)
		{
			double zoom = (double)value;
			if (ValidateMinZoomPercent(zoom))
			{
				return ValidateMaxZoomPercent(zoom);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateScrollPercent(object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num >= -100.0)
			{
				return num <= 100.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Diagram3D()
		{
			actualContentTransform = CreateDefaultContentTransform();
			Lighting = new DiagramLightingCollection();
		}

		private void PerformDrag(double dx, double dy)
		{
			if (RuntimeRotation)
			{
				double num = Math.PI / 4.0;
				double angleX = dx * num;
				double angleY = dy * num;
				ContentTransform = new MatrixTransform3D(Domain3DBase.PerformRotation(ContentTransformMatrix, angleX, angleY));
			}
		}

		private void SetZoomPercent(double zoomPercent)
		{
			if (RuntimeZooming)
			{
				if (ValidateMinZoomPercent(zoomPercent))
				{
					ZoomPercent = (ValidateMaxZoomPercent(zoomPercent) ? zoomPercent : 500.0);
				}
				else
				{
					ZoomPercent = 1.0;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetHorizontalScrollPercent(double scrollPercent)
		{
			if (RuntimeScrolling)
			{
				HorizontalScrollPercent = (ValidateScrollPercent(scrollPercent) ? scrollPercent : (100.0 * (double)Math.Sign(scrollPercent)));
			}
		}

		private void SetVerticalScrollPercent(double scrollPercent)
		{
			if (RuntimeScrolling)
			{
				VerticalScrollPercent = (ValidateScrollPercent(scrollPercent) ? scrollPercent : (100.0 * (double)Math.Sign(scrollPercent)));
			}
		}

		private bool InChart(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			if (chartPosition.X > 0.0 && chartPosition.Y > 0.0 && chartPosition.X < base.Container.PlatformElement.ActualWidth)
			{
				return chartPosition.Y < base.Container.PlatformElement.ActualHeight;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateAnnotations()
		{
			if (base.Container?.AnnotationsOptions != null)
			{
				base.Container.AnnotationsOptions.InvalidateAnnotationsPanels();
			}
		}

		protected void PerformRender()
		{
			foreach (VisualContainer visualContainer in visualContainers)
			{
				visualContainer.Clear();
			}
			if (base.Container != null && visualContainers.Count != 0 && base.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ActualViewport.Width > 0.0 && ActualViewport.Height > 0.0)
			{
				foreach (VisualContainer visualContainer2 in visualContainers)
				{
					Diagram3DDomain diagram3DDomain = CreateDomain(visualContainer2);
					if (diagram3DDomain != null)
					{
						diagram3DDomain.ValidateSeriesPointsCache();
						diagram3DDomain.Render(visualContainer2);
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateAnnotations();
		}

		protected void PerformTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldTemplate, ControlTemplate newTemplate)
		{
			if (oldTemplate != newTemplate)
			{
				VisualContainers.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected virtual Transform3D CreateDefaultContentTransform()
		{
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), -40.0)));
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 20.0)));
			return transform3DGroup;
		}

		protected virtual DiagramLightingCollection CreateDefaultLighting()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color ambientColor = default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			byte b = (ambientColor.B = 105);
			byte r = (ambientColor.G = b);
			ambientColor.R = r;
			DiagramLightingCollection diagramLightingCollection = new DiagramLightingCollection();
			diagramLightingCollection.Add(new AmbientLight(ambientColor));
			diagramLightingCollection.Add(new DirectionalLight(Colors.White, new Vector3D(1.1, -1.0, -1.8)));
			return diagramLightingCollection;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			PerformRender();
		}

		protected override void OnTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldTemplate, ControlTemplate newTemplate)
		{
			base.OnTemplateChanged(oldTemplate, newTemplate);
			PerformTemplateChanged(oldTemplate, newTemplate);
		}

		protected override ISeriesItem GetSeriesItem(Series series)
		{
			return series.Cache;
		}

		protected internal virtual Diagram3DDomain CreateDomain(VisualContainer visualContainer)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void InvalidateDiagram()
		{
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected internal override void NavigationDrag(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, int dx, int dy, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			PerformDrag(dx, dy);
		}

		protected internal override void NavigationZoomIn()
		{
			SetZoomPercent(ZoomPercent * 1.5);
		}

		protected internal override void NavigationZoomOut()
		{
			SetZoomPercent(ZoomPercent / 1.5);
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationZoom(System.Windows.Point position, int delta, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, bool isDragging)
		{
			SetZoomPercent(ZoomPercent * (1.0 + 0.1 * (double)delta));
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFocus(System.Windows.Point position, bool allowPostponedExecute = true)
		{
			base.Container.PlatformElement.Focus();
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationBeginDrag(System.Windows.Point position, MouseButtonState leftButtonState, bool isShiftKey)
		{
			if (isShiftKey)
			{
				NavigationZoomIn();
				return false;
			}
			if (leftButtonState == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				return RuntimeRotation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationScrollHorizontally(int delta, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			SetHorizontalScrollPercent(HorizontalScrollPercent - (double)delta);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationScrollVertically(int delta, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			SetVerticalScrollPercent(VerticalScrollPercent + (double)delta);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationCanZoomIn(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, bool useFocusedPane)
		{
			if (InChart(chartPosition) && RuntimeZooming)
			{
				return ZoomPercent != 500.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationCanZoomOut(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, bool useFocusedPane)
		{
			if (InChart(chartPosition) && RuntimeZooming)
			{
				return ValidateMinZoomPercent(ZoomPercent / 1.5);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationInDiagram(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationCanDrag(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, bool isDragging)
		{
			if (IsMouseNavigationEnabled && RuntimeRotation)
			{
				return InChart(chartPosition);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool ManipulationStart(System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			startZoomPercent = ZoomPercent;
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void ManipulationZoom(double scaleX, double scaleY, double deltaDistance)
		{
			SetZoomPercent(startZoomPercent * Math.Sqrt(scaleX * scaleY));
		}

		protected internal override void ManipulationRotate(double degreeAngle)
		{
			if (RuntimeRotation)
			{
				ContentTransform = new MatrixTransform3D(Domain3DBase.PerformRotation(ContentTransformMatrix, 0.0 - degreeAngle));
			}
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point ManipulationDrag(System.Windows.Point translation, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			PerformDrag(translation.X, translation.Y);
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}
	}

	}

		private ObservableCollection<object> GroupSeries(IList<RefinedSeries> activeRefinedSeries)
		{
			Dictionary<object, NestedDonut2DGroup> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, NestedDonut2DGroup>();
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < activeRefinedSeries.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = (Series)activeRefinedSeries[i].Series;
				SeriesItem item = series.Item;
				if (series is ISupportSeriesGroups { SeriesGroup: var obj })
				{
					if (obj == null)
					{
						obj = DefaultGroup;
					}
					object key = obj;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
					value = new NestedDonut2DGroup(item);
					observableCollection.Add(value);
					dictionary.Add(key, value);
				}
				else
				{
					observableCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return observableCollection;
		}

		protected internal override bool ManipulationStart(System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			return IsManipulationNavigationEnabled;
		}

		protected override void EnsureSeriesItems()
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = GroupSeries(base.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries);
			int count = observableCollection.Count;
			ReadOnlyObservableCollection<object> items = Items;
			if (items == null || items.Count != count)
			{
				SetValue(ItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<object>(observableCollection));
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] != observableCollection[i] && (items[i].GetType() != typeof(NestedDonut2DGroup) || observableCollection[i].GetType() != typeof(NestedDonut2DGroup)))
				{
					SetValue(ItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<object>(observableCollection));
					break;
				}
				if (!(items[i] is NestedDonut2DGroup))
				{
					continue;
				}
				NestedDonut2DGroup nestedDonut2DGroup = (NestedDonut2DGroup)items[i];
				NestedDonut2DGroup nestedDonut2DGroup2 = (NestedDonut2DGroup)observableCollection[i];
				if (nestedDonut2DGroup.Count != nestedDonut2DGroup2.Count)
				{
					SetValue(ItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<object>(observableCollection));
					break;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < nestedDonut2DGroup2.Count; j++)
				{
					if (nestedDonut2DGroup[j] != nestedDonut2DGroup2[j])
					{
						SetValue(ItemsPropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<object>(observableCollection));
						return;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			base.UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				if (!(item is PieSeries2D { TotalLabel: var totalLabel } pieSeries2D))
				{
					continue;
				}
				totalLabel?.Update();
				foreach (Title title in pieSeries2D.Titles)
				{
					title.Update();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnDataWasChanged()
		{
			base.OnDataWasChanged();
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				item.UpdateConfiguration();
			}
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			if (base.Series.Count == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			List<DXRectangle> elementsBounds = SimpleDiagramLayout.Calculate(this, new DXRectangle(0, 0, (int)size.Width, (int)size.Height), base.Series.Count);
			elementsBounds = CorrectElementsBounds(elementsBounds);
			for (int i = 0; i < elementsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = base.Series[i];
				System.Windows.Size size2 = elementsBounds[i].ToRect().Size;
				list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(new GRealSize2D(size2.Width, size2.Height), GetElementsForAutoLayout(series)));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<DXRectangle> CorrectElementsBounds(List<DXRectangle> elementsBounds)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			elementsBounds.Sort(new RectComparer());
			DXRectangle val = elementsBounds[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < elementsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				if (InFrame(val, elementsBounds[i]))
				{
					elementsBounds[i] = val;
				}
				else
				{
					val = elementsBounds[i];
				}
			}
			return elementsBounds;
		}

		private bool InFrame(DXRectangle pattern, DXRectangle rect)
		{
			if ((double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height < (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Height * 1.05 && (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height > (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Height * 0.95 && (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width < (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Width * 1.05)
			{
				return (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width > (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Width * 0.95;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> GetElementsForAutoLayout(Series series)
		{
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			TitleCollection titleCollection = null;
			if (series is FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D)
			{
				titleCollection = funnelSeries2D.Titles;
			}
			if (series is PieSeries pieSeries)
			{
				titleCollection = pieSeries.Titles;
			}
			if (titleCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (Title item in titleCollection)
				{
					if (!item.Visible.HasValue)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.Container?.ChartOptions == null || base.Container.ChartOptions.AutoLayout)
			{
				int count = Items.Count;
				Dimension = SimpleDiagramAutoLayoutHelper.CalculateDimension((int)constraint.Width, (int)constraint.Height, count);
				LayoutDirection = LayoutDirection.Horizontal;
			}
			if (Elements == null)
			{
				ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
				foreach (Series item in base.Series)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(item.ActualLabel);
				}
				Elements = observableCollection;
				ItemsControl itemsControl = (ItemsControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_LogicalTreeHolder");
				itemsControl.ItemsSource = Elements;
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

	public abstract class SimpleDiagramPanelBase : Panel
	{
		private IList<DXRectangle> seriesBounds;

		private int CalculateCellCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (ShouldShowElement(child))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private IList<DXRectangle> CalculateSeriesBounds(ISimpleDiagram diagram, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<DXRectangle> list = new List<DXRectangle>();
			int num = CalculateCellCount();
			DXRectangle bounds = default(DXRectangle);
			((DXRectangle)(ref bounds))..ctor(0, 0, (int)Math.Floor(constraint.Width), (int)Math.Floor(constraint.Height));
			IList<DXRectangle> list2 = ((num > 0) ? SimpleDiagramLayout.Calculate(diagram, bounds, num) : null);
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (ShouldShowElement(child))
				{
					list.Add(list2[num2++]);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(new DXRectangle(0, 0, 0, 0));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected abstract ISimpleDiagram GetDiagram();

		protected abstract bool ShouldShowElement(UIElement child);

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			ISimpleDiagram diagram = GetDiagram();
			if (diagram != null && base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				seriesBounds = CalculateSeriesBounds(diagram, constraint);
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					DXRectangle val = seriesBounds[i];
					base.Children[i].Measure(new System.Windows.Size(((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height));
				}
			}
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ISimpleDiagram diagram = GetDiagram();
			if (diagram != null && base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					DXRectangle val = seriesBounds[i];
					base.Children[i].Arrange(new Rect(((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height));
				}
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}
	}

		private IEnumerable<Axis2D> Axes

			get

				yield return actualAxisX;

				{
					yield return item;
				}
				yield return actualAxisY;
				foreach (SecondaryAxisY2D item2 in SecondaryAxesYInternal)
				{
					yield return item2;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsDeserializing
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Container?.ChartOptions != null)
				{
					return base.Container.ChartOptions.IsDeserializing;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal Pane FocusedPane
		{
			get
			{
				IContainerElement container = base.Container;
				if (container == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Pane pane = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(container.PlatformElement) as Pane;
				if (pane == null && pseudoFocusedPane != null && pseudoFocusedPane.IsAlive)
				{
					pane = pseudoFocusedPane.Target as Pane;
				}
				if (pane == null || ((IOwnedElement)pane).Owner == null || ((IOwnedElement)pane).Owner != this)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return pane;
			}
		}

		bool IXYDiagram.DependentValueRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (!DependentAxesYRange.HasValue)
				{
					return !IsNavigationEnabled;
				}
				return DependentAxesYRange.Value;
			}
		}

		IAxisData IXYDiagram.AxisX => actualAxisX;

		IAxisData IXYDiagram.AxisY => actualAxisY;

		IEnumerable<IAxisData> IXYDiagram.AllAxes
		{
			get
			{
				List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
				if (actualAxisX != null)
				{
					list.Add(actualAxisX);
				}
				if (actualAxisY != null)
				{
					list.Add(actualAxisY);
				}
				if (SecondaryAxesXInternal != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(SecondaryAxesXInternal);
				}
				if (SecondaryAxesYInternal != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(SecondaryAxesYInternal);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		{
			get

		private static void AllowSeriesBitmapCachingPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SeriesBitmapCachingChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void AxisXPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
			{
				AxisX2D axisX2D = e.NewValue as AxisX2D;
				AxisX2D axisX2D2 = xYDiagram2D.actualAxisX;
				if (axisX2D == null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.actualAxisX = new AxisX2D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, xYDiagram2D.actualAxisX);
				}
				else
				{
					xYDiagram2D.actualAxisX = axisX2D;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(xYDiagram2D, "AxisX", axisX2D2, axisX2D), ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
				AggregateFunctionNative functionBeforeUpdate = ((axisX2D2 != null && axisX2D2.ActualScaleOptionsWrapper != null) ? axisX2D2.ActualScaleOptionsWrapper.AggregateFunction : AggregateFunctionNative.None);
				if (xYDiagram2D.actualAxisX.CheckUpdatingSeriesBinding(functionBeforeUpdate, xYDiagram2D.actualAxisX.ActualScaleOptionsWrapper, out var changes))
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(xYDiagram2D, "AxisX", axisX2D2, axisX2D), changes);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
			{
				AxisY2D axisY2D = e.NewValue as AxisY2D;
				AxisY2D oldValue = xYDiagram2D.actualAxisY;
				if (axisY2D == null)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.actualAxisY = new AxisY2D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, xYDiagram2D.actualAxisY);
				}
				else
				{
					xYDiagram2D.actualAxisY = axisY2D;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(xYDiagram2D, "AxisY", oldValue, axisY2D), ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
			}
		}

		private static void BarDistanceFixedPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "SideBySideBarDistanceFixed"));
		}

		private static bool BarDistanceFixedValidation(object barDistanceFixed)
		{
			return (int)barDistanceFixed >= 0;
		}

		private static void BarDistancePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "SideBySideBarDistance"));
		}

		private static bool BarDistanceValidation(object barDistance)
		{
			return (double)barDistance >= 0.0;
		}

		private static void IndicatorAxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
			{
				separatePaneIndicator.AxisY = e.NewValue as SecondaryAxisY2D;
			}
		}

		private static void IndicatorPanePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
			{

		internal static System.Windows.Point CalcAxisValues(Pane pane, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY, double argument, double value)
		{
			double num = axisX.CalcAxisValue(pane, argument);
			double num2 = axisY.CalcAxisValue(pane, value);
			double x;
			double y;
			if (pane.Diagram.Rotated)
			{
				x = num2;
				y = num;
			}
			else
			{
				x = num;
				y = num2;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		internal static ControlCoordinates MapInternalToPoint(Pane pane, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY, double argument, double value)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = CalcAxisValues(pane, axisX, axisY, argument, value);
			Rect value2 = pane.LastMappingBounds.Value;
			point.Y = value2.Height - point.Y;
			point.X += value2.Left;
			point.Y += value2.Top;
			bool flag = axisX.IsValueInRange(argument);
			bool flag2 = axisY.IsValueInRange(value);
			ControlCoordinatesVisibility visibility = ((!(flag && flag2)) ? ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Hidden : ControlCoordinatesVisibility.Visible);
			return new ControlCoordinates(pane, axisX, axisY, visibility, point);
		}

		internal XYDiagram2D(IRefinedSeriesFactory factory)
			: base(factory)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<XYDiagram2D>(this);
			actualDefaultPane = new Pane();
			actualDefaultPane.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualAxisX = new AxisX2D();
			actualAxisX.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			actualAxisY = new AxisY2D();
			actualAxisY.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			SetValue(SecondaryAxesXPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<SecondaryAxisXCollection>(this));
			SetValue(SecondaryAxesYPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<SecondaryAxisYCollection>(this));
			SetValue(PanesPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<PaneCollection>(this));
			secondaryAxesX = SecondaryAxesX;
			secondaryAxesY = SecondaryAxesY;
			UpdateActualPanes();
			crosshairManager = new CrosshairManager(this);
			panesCollapsingOrder = new PanesCollapsingOrderManager(this);
			ScrollHorizontallyCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollHorizontally((int)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollHorizontally((int)parameter));
			ScrollVerticallyCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)

				ScrollVertically((int)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollVertically((int)parameter));
			ScrollAxisXToCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollAxisXTo((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollAxisXTo((double)parameter));
			ScrollAxisYToCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				ScrollAxisYTo((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanScrollAxisYTo((double)parameter));
			SetAxisXRangeCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisXRange((AxisRangePositions)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisXRange());
			SetAxisYRangeCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisYRange((AxisRangePositions)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisYRange());
			SetAxisXZoomRatioCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisXZoomRatio((double)parameter);
			}, (object parameter) => CanSetAxisXZoomRatio());
			SetAxisYZoomRatioCommand = CreateDelegateCommand(delegate(object parameter)
			{
				SetAxisYZoomRatio((double)parameter);

				ZoomIntoRectangle((Rect)parameter);

		RefinedPoint INativeHitTestableDiagram.FindSeriesPoint(System.Windows.Point point, XYSeries series, RefinedPointFinder pointFinder)
		{
			if (!(series is IXYSeriesView view))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int markerSize = ((series is ISupportMarker2DHitTest supportMarker2DHitTest) ? supportMarker2DHitTest.HitTestMarkerSize : 0);
			GetInternalValueAndArgumentRange(view, point, markerSize, out var internalAxisYValue, out var axisXInternalDiapason);
			if (!axisXInternalDiapason.HasValue || double.IsNaN(internalAxisYValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return pointFinder.FindNearestPoint(axisXInternalDiapason, internalAxisYValue, ((IXYDiagram)this).AxisX.VisualRange.Delta, ((IXYDiagram)this).AxisY.VisualRange.Delta);
		}

		private void GetInternalValueAndArgumentRange(IXYSeriesView view, System.Windows.Point point, int markerSize, out double internalAxisYValue, out MinMaxValues? axisXInternalDiapason)
		{
			internalAxisYValue = double.NaN;
			axisXInternalDiapason = null;
			Pane pane = (Pane)view.Pane;
			Rect rect = CalculateRelativeAxesRect(point, pane);
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				Axis2D axis2D = view.AxisYData as Axis2D;
				internalAxisYValue = axis2D.ScaleMap.Transformation.TransformBackward(axis2D.CalcInternalValue(pane, rect.Y));
				axisXInternalDiapason = ((Axis2D)view.AxisXData).CalcInternalCoordDiapason(pane, rect.X, markerSize);
			}
		}

		private void AddIndicatorToRepository(Indicator indicator, IPane pane)
		{
			if (!IndicatorsRepository.ContainsKey(pane))
			{
				IndicatorsRepository.Add(pane, new List<Indicator>());
			}
			IndicatorsRepository[pane].Add(indicator);
		}

		private bool ApplyRangesStates(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues correctedRange)
		{
			if (!correctedRange.HasValues)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IVisualAxisRangeData visualRange = axis.VisualRange;
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			if (wholeRange.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
			{
				wholeRange.Min = correctedRange.Min;
				wholeRange.Max = correctedRange.Max;
				if (visualRange.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
				{
					visualRange.Min = correctedRange.Min;
					visualRange.Max = correctedRange.Max;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ControlCoordinates CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(Pane pane, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY, object argument, object value)
		{
			double num = axisX.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(argument);
			bool flag = axisX.IsValueInRange(num);
			if (axisX.ScaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative && !flag)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
			}
			double value2 = axisY.ScaleMap.NativeToInternal(value);
			return MapInternalToPoint(pane, axisX, axisY, num, value2);
		}

		void ISupportCrosshairLayout.CalculateLabelsLayout()
		{
			if (lastCrosshairInfo != null)
			{
				lastCrosshairInfo.CompleteLabelsLayout();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateLayout()
		{
			IEnumerable<Pane> actualPanes = ActualPanes;
			foreach (Pane item2 in actualPanes)
			{
				Rect viewport = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), item2.DesiredSize);
				viewport = item2.CorrectViewportForLegends(viewport);
				item2.UpdateIntervalsGridAndTextData(viewport.Size);
				item2.UpdateAxesLabelItems();
				item2.UpdateAxisItems();
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool isNavigationEnabled = IsNavigationEnabled;
			if (isNavigationEnabled)
			{
				AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateIntervals(performRangeCorrection: true, this);
				foreach (Pane item3 in actualPanes)
				{
					flag |= item3.CalculateOuterItemsLayoutAndViewport(shouldUpdateViewportCache: false, isScrolling);
					PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(item3);
					IEnumerable<SeriesItem> seriesItems = item3.SeriesItems;
					if (axesContainer == null || seriesItems == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool rotated = item3.Rotated;
					System.Windows.Point wholeRangeZeroPoint = GetWholeRangeZeroPoint(item3, axesContainer, rotated);
					List<ISeries> list = new List<ISeries>();
					foreach (SeriesItem item4 in seriesItems)
					{
						list.Add(item4.Series);
					}
					CorrectRangesBySeriesLabels(item3, list, rotated, wholeRangeZeroPoint, axesContainer.PrimaryAxisY.Reverse);
				}
			}
			foreach (Pane item5 in actualPanes)
			{
				flag |= item5.CalculateOuterItemsLayoutAndViewport(shouldUpdateViewportCache: true, isScrolling);
			}
			panesPanelManager = PanesPanelLayoutManager.Create(this);
			if (panesPanelManager != null)
			{
				panesPanelManager.CorrectLayout();
			}
			TooManyConstantLines = false;
			foreach (Pane item6 in actualPanes)
			{
				Rect viewport2 = item6.Viewport;
				item6.CalculateOuterItemsLayout();
				((IZoomablePane)item6).RangeLimitsUpdated();
				foreach (Axis2DItem axisItem in item6.AxisItems)
				{
					axisItem.UpdateGeometry(item6, item6.GetGridAndTextData(axisItem.Axis2D), viewport2);
				}
				IList<SeriesItem> seriesItems2 = item6.SeriesItems;
				if (seriesItems2 != null)
				{
					List<XYSeries> list2 = new List<XYSeries>();
					bool flag2 = false;
					foreach (SeriesItem item7 in seriesItems2)
					{
						if (item7.Series is XYSeries item && base.Series.Contains(item))
						{
							flag2 |= item7.Series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || item7.Series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false);
							list2.Add(item);
						}
					}
					SeriesLabel2DLayoutCache labelsLayoutCache = item6.LabelsLayoutCache;
					Rect rangeBounds = item6.RangeBounds;
					if (viewport2 != labelsLayoutCache.Viewport || rangeBounds.Width != labelsLayoutCache.RangeBounds.Width || rangeBounds.Height != labelsLayoutCache.RangeBounds.Height)
					{
						labelsLayoutCache.Invalidate();
					}
					labelsLayoutCache.Viewport = viewport2;
					labelsLayoutCache.RangeBounds = rangeBounds;
					foreach (XYSeries2D item8 in list2)
					{
						item8.CreateSeriesPointsLayout();
						item8.CreateSeriesLabelsLayout();
					}
					item6.CreateTotalLabelsLayout();
					StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(item6);
					if (labelsLayoutCache.UpdateCacheItems(list2, totalLabel))
					{
						ResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(list2, totalLabel, (isNavigationEnabled && !flag2) ? item6.RangeBounds : item6.OuterBounds, LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
						labelsLayoutCache.CompleteCacheItems();
					}
					else
					{
						labelsLayoutCache.UpdateLabelBounds();
					}
					foreach (XYSeries2D item9 in list2)
					{
						item9.CreateSeriesLabelConnectorsLayout();
						item9.UpdateSeriesLabelsClipBounds();
					}
					item6.UpdateTotalLabels();
				}
				TooManyConstantLines |= item6.GetConstantLinesCount() > 100;
				item6.UpdateAxesElementsItemsLayout();
				item6.CalculateIndicatorItems();
				item6.UpdateIndicatorItems();
				item6.InvalidateInnerPanels();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.Container?.ChartOptions?.InvalidateChartElementPanel();
			}
		}

		private Rect CalculateRelativeAxesRect(System.Windows.Point point, Pane pane)
		{
			Rect value = pane.LastMappingBounds.Value;
			if (value.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			point.X -= value.Left;
			point.Y -= value.Top;
			if (point.X < 0.0 || point.X > value.Width || point.Y < 0.0 || point.Y > value.Height)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			point.Y = value.Height - point.Y;
			double x;
			double y;
			double width;
			double height;
			if (Rotated)
			{
				x = point.Y;
				y = point.X;
				width = value.Height;
				height = value.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				x = point.X;
				y = point.Y;
				width = value.Width;
				height = value.Height;
			}
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private bool CanScrollPane(Pane pane)
		{
			if (pane != null && !pane.Collapsed)
			{
				if (!pane.CanScrollHorizontallyInternal(1) && !pane.CanScrollHorizontallyInternal(-1) && !pane.CanScrollVerticallyInternal(1))
				{
					return pane.CanScrollVerticallyInternal(-1);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CheckOutOfBounds(OutOfBoundsChecker checker, IList<ISeries> seriesOnPane, StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel, bool rotated, System.Windows.Point zeroPointForScrollingRange, bool yAxisReversed)
		{
			List<Series> seriesForAxis = GetSeriesForAxis(checker.Axis, seriesOnPane);
			Rect correctionRect = GetCorrectionRect(seriesForAxis, ((AxisBase)checker.Axis).WholeRangeData, totalLabel, rotated, zeroPointForScrollingRange, yAxisReversed);
			if (!correctionRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				GRealRect2D bounds = new GRealRect2D(correctionRect.X, correctionRect.Y, correctionRect.Width, correctionRect.Height);
				checker.CheckOutOfBounds(bounds);
			}
		}

		private void CleanStripItemsInStrips()
		{
			foreach (Strip strip in ActualAxisX.Strips)
			{
				strip.StripItems.Clear();
			}
			foreach (Strip strip2 in ActualAxisY.Strips)
			{
				strip2.StripItems.Clear();
			}
			foreach (SecondaryAxisX2D item in SecondaryAxesXInternal)
			{
				foreach (Strip strip3 in item.Strips)
				{
					strip3.StripItems.Clear();
				}
			}
			foreach (SecondaryAxisY2D item2 in SecondaryAxesYInternal)
			{
				foreach (Strip strip4 in item2.Strips)
				{
					strip4.StripItems.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		void ISupportCrosshairLayout.CompleteLabelsBounds()
		{
			base.Container.ToolTipOptions?.UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabelItems(base.CrosshairSeriesLabelItems);
		}

		private void CorrectRangesBySeriesLabels(Pane pane, IList<ISeries> seriesOnPane, bool rotated, System.Windows.Point zeroPointForScrollingRange, bool yAxisReversed)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(pane);
			DXRectangle rangeBounds = GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(pane.Viewport);
			List<OutOfBoundsChecker> list = new List<OutOfBoundsChecker>();
			list.Add(new OutOfBoundsChecker(axesContainer.PrimaryAxisX, !pane.Rotated, rangeBounds, axesContainer.PrimaryAxisX.WholeRange));
			list.Add(new OutOfBoundsChecker(axesContainer.PrimaryAxisY, pane.Rotated, rangeBounds, axesContainer.PrimaryAxisY.WholeRange));
			foreach (IAxisData item in axesContainer.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				list.Add(new OutOfBoundsChecker(item, !pane.Rotated, rangeBounds, item.WholeRange));
			}
			foreach (IAxisData item2 in axesContainer.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				list.Add(new OutOfBoundsChecker(item2, pane.Rotated, rangeBounds, item2.WholeRange));
			}
			foreach (OutOfBoundsChecker item3 in list)
			{
				CheckOutOfBounds(item3, seriesOnPane, BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(pane), rotated, zeroPointForScrollingRange, yAxisReversed);
			}
			Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, MinMaxValues>();
			foreach (OutOfBoundsChecker item4 in list)
			{
				dictionary.Add(item4.Axis, item4.GetCorrectedWholeRange());
			}
			foreach (IAxisData key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				if (ApplyRangesStates(key, dictionary[key]))
				{
					pane.LabelsLayoutCache.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateAndRaiseEvent(CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfos)
		{
			IContainerEventsOptions eventsOptions = base.Container.EventsOptions;
			if (eventsOptions != null && eventsOptions.ShouldRaiseCustomDrawCrosshairEvent)
			{
				CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs args = new CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs(eventsOptions.CustomDrawCrosshairEvent, crosshairDrawInfos.CursorLineElement, crosshairDrawInfos.CrosshairAxisLabelElements, crosshairDrawInfos.CrosshairElementGroups, crosshairDrawInfos.LegendElements, crosshairDrawInfos.IndicatorLegendElements);
				crosshairDrawInfos.SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(OnCrosshairElementsChanged);
				eventsOptions.RaiseCustomDrawCrosshair(args);
				crosshairDrawInfos.UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(OnCrosshairElementsChanged);
				if (needSynchronizeCrosshairCustomDrawCollection)
				{
					SynchronizeCrosshairElementCollections(args);
				}
			}
		}
