		private ControlCoordinates DiagramToPointInternal(DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates)
		{
			if (diagramCoordinates == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Pane pane = diagramCoordinates.Pane;
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AxisX2D axisX2D = diagramCoordinates.AxisX;
			AxisY2D axisY = diagramCoordinates.AxisY;
			double argument = diagramCoordinates.NumericalArgument;
			double numericalValue = diagramCoordinates.NumericalValue;
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(pane);
			if (axisX2D == null && axesContainer != null)
			{
				foreach (AxisX2D item in axesContainer.SecondaryAxesX)
				{
					AxisValue axisValue = diagramCoordinates.GetAxisValue(item);
					if (axisValue != null)
					{
						axisX2D = item;
						argument = axisValue.NumericalValue;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (axisY == null && axesContainer != null)
			{
				foreach (AxisY2D item2 in axesContainer.SecondaryAxesY)
				{
					AxisValue axisValue2 = diagramCoordinates.GetAxisValue(item2);
					if (axisValue2 != null)
					{
						numericalValue = axisValue2.NumericalValue;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (axisX2D != null && axisY != null)
			{
				return MapInternalToPoint(pane, axisX2D, axisY, argument, numericalValue);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ControlCoordinates DiagramToPointInternal(object argument, object value)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(ActualDefaultPane);
			if (axesContainer == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(ActualDefaultPane);
			}
			AxisX2D axisX2D = (AxisX2D)axesContainer.PrimaryAxisX;
			AxisY2D axisY2D = (AxisY2D)axesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (axisX2D == null || axisY2D == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(ActualDefaultPane);
			}
			DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(argument, axisX2D.ScaleMap);
			DiagramToPointUtils.CheckValue(value, axisY2D.ScaleMap);
			return CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(ActualDefaultPane, axisX2D, axisY2D, argument, value);
		}

		private ControlCoordinates DiagramToPointInternal(object argument, object value, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
			if (AxisPaneContainer == null)
			{
				return new ControlCoordinates(ActualDefaultPane);
			}
			if (AxisPaneContainer.GetFirstPaneByAxes(axisX, axisY) is Pane pane)
			{
				return CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(pane, axisX, axisY, argument, value);
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(ActualDefaultPane);
		}

		private ControlCoordinates DiagramToPointInternal(object argument, object value, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY, Pane pane)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(pane);
			if (axesContainer != null && axesContainer.AxesX.Contains(axisX) && axesContainer.AxesY.Contains(axisY))
			{
				return CalcDiagramToPointCoordinates(pane, axisX, axisY, argument, value);
			}
			return new ControlCoordinates(pane);
		}

		private void FillCrosshairAxisLabelItem(CrosshairAxisLabelItem crosshairAxisLabelItem, CrosshairAxisInfo labelInfo, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axesLabelElement)
		{
			crosshairAxisLabelItem.LabelInfo = labelInfo;
			Axis2D axis = (Axis2D)labelInfo.Axis;
			CrosshairAxisLabelPresentationData presentationData = crosshairAxisLabelItem.PresentationData;
			presentationData.Axis = axis;
			presentationData.Text = axesLabelElement.Text;
			presentationData.Background = axesLabelElement.Background;
			presentationData.Foreground = axesLabelElement.Foreground;
			presentationData.FontWeight = axesLabelElement.FontWeight;
			presentationData.FontStyle = axesLabelElement.FontStyle;
			presentationData.FontStretch = axesLabelElement.FontStretch;
			presentationData.FontSize = axesLabelElement.FontSize;
			presentationData.FontFamily = axesLabelElement.FontFamily;
			presentationData.CrosshairAxisLabelTemplate = axesLabelElement.CrosshairLabelTemplate;
		}

		private bool FillCrosshairSeriesLabelItem(CrosshairSeriesLabelItem crosshairSeriesLabelItem, CrosshairLabelInfo labelInfo, CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfo)
		{
			crosshairSeriesLabelItem.Layout = labelInfo;
			crosshairSeriesLabelItem.LabelTemplate = base.Container.ToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions.PopupTemplate ?? CrosshairSeriesLabelTemplate;
			crosshairSeriesLabelItem.Background = CrosshairPopupBackground;
			crosshairSeriesLabelItem.BorderBrush = CrosshairBorderBrush;
			ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData> crosshairPresentationData = GetCrosshairPresentationData(crosshairSeriesLabelItem.PresentationData);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairElementGroups)
			{
				if (crosshairDrawInfo.GetGroupLabelInfo(crosshairElementGroup) != labelInfo)
				{
					continue;
				}
				CrosshairGroupHeaderElement headerElement = crosshairElementGroup.HeaderElement;
				if (headerElement != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerElement.Text) && headerElement.Visible)
				{
					if (num >= crosshairPresentationData.Count)
					{
						crosshairPresentationData.Add(CreateGroupHeaderPresentationData(headerElement));
					}
					else
					{
						UpdateGroupHeaderPresentationData(crosshairPresentationData[num], headerElement);
					}
					num++;
				}
				foreach (CrosshairElementBase element in crosshairElementGroup.Elements)
				{
					if (element.Visible && element.LabelElement.Visible)
					{
						UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData(crosshairPresentationData, num++, element);
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				crosshairPresentationData.Clear();
				return false;
			}
			TruncateCollection(crosshairPresentationData, num);
			crosshairSeriesLabelItem.PresentationData = crosshairPresentationData;
			return true;
		}

		private void FillSeriesLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, LegendBase legend)
		{
			if (legendCrosshairItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = base.SeriesTemplate != null && base.SeriesTemplate.HasColorizer;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)((IRefinedSeries)item).Series;
				if (xYSeries2D.ActualLegend == legend)
				{
					if (!flag || !xYSeries2D.IsAutoSeries)
					{
						xYSeries2D.UpdateLegendItems(legendItems, legend, GetSeriesItem(xYSeries2D));
					}
					legendCrosshairItems.Add(xYSeries2D);
				}
				foreach (Indicator indicator in xYSeries2D.Indicators)
				{
					if (indicator.ActualLegend == legend)
					{
						indicator.Item.UpdateLegendItem((Legend)legend);
						legendCrosshairItems.Add(indicator);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && base.SeriesTemplate.ActualLegend == legend)
			{
				base.SeriesTemplate.UpdateColorizerLegendItems(legendItems, (Legend)legend);
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<AxisBase> GetAutoMeasurementUnitsAffectedAxes(bool updateIntervals)
		{
			HashSet<AxisBase> hashSet = new HashSet<AxisBase>();
			ObservableCollection<Pane> actualPanes = ActualPanes;
			foreach (Pane item in actualPanes)
			{
				hashSet.UnionWith(UpdateAutomaticMeasurementUnits(item, updateIntervals));
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private HashSet<AxisBase> GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			HashSet<AxisBase> hashSet = new HashSet<AxisBase>();
			ObservableCollection<Pane> actualPanes = ActualPanes;
			foreach (Pane item in actualPanes)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(item);
				if (axesContainer == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (IAxisData item2 in axesContainer.AxesX)
				{
					if (valueRangeChanged || AxisUtils.ShouldUpdateSkippingRangesWithoutPoints(item2, valueRangeChanged))
					{
						hashSet.Add(item2 as AxisBase);
					}
				}
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		private double GetAxisLength(Pane pane, bool isValueAxis)
		{
			bool flag = !isValueAxis ^ Rotated;
			double num = (flag ? pane.InnerBounds.Width : pane.InnerBounds.Height);
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num) || num == 0.0)
			{
				return GetPseudoAxisLength(flag);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private Rect GetCorrectionRect(List<Series> seriesList, WholeRangeData wholeRange, StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel, bool rotated, System.Windows.Point zeroPointForScrollingRange, bool yAxisReversed)
		{
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			foreach (Series series in seriesList)
			{
				Rect correctionRectForLabel = GetCorrectionRectForLabel(series.ActualLabel);
				rect = GraphicsUtils.UnionRect(rect, correctionRectForLabel);
				Rect correctionRectForModel = GetCorrectionRectForModel(GetModelFromSeries(series), wholeRange, zeroPointForScrollingRange, yAxisReversed, rotated);
				rect = GraphicsUtils.UnionRect(rect, correctionRectForModel);
			}
			Rect rect2 = ((totalLabel != null) ? GetCorrectionRectForLabel(totalLabel) : Rect.Empty);
			return GraphicsUtils.UnionRect(rect, rect2);
		}

		private Rect GetCorrectionRectForLabel(ISeriesLabel label)
		{
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			if (label.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.None || label.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped)
			{
				IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItemBase> items = label.Items;
				if (items != null)
				{
					foreach (SeriesLabelItemBase item in items)
					{
						SeriesLabel2DLayout layout = item.Layout;
						if (layout != null && layout.IsVisibleForResolveOverlapping)
						{
							rect = GraphicsUtils.UnionRect(rect, layout.Bounds);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private Rect GetCorrectionRectForModel(PredefinedBar2DModel model, WholeRangeData wholeRange, System.Windows.Point controlPoint, bool yAxisReversed, bool rotated)
		{
			if (model != null)
			{
				int num = (yAxisReversed ? model.ReversedCorrectionSize : model.CorrectionSize);
				int correctionInPixels = wholeRange.CorrectionInPixels;
				if (num == correctionInPixels)
				{
					return new Rect(controlPoint, new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
				}
				wholeRange.CorrectionInPixels = num;
				num -= correctionInPixels;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					if (yAxisReversed)
					{
						if (rotated)
						{
							return new Rect(controlPoint, new System.Windows.Size(num, 1.0));
						}
						return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(controlPoint.X, controlPoint.Y - (double)num), new System.Windows.Size(1.0, num));
					}
					if (rotated)
					{
						return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(controlPoint.X - (double)num, controlPoint.Y), new System.Windows.Size(num, 1.0));
					}
					return new Rect(controlPoint, new System.Windows.Size(1.0, num));
				}
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

			}

		private System.Windows.Point GetOverPan(int dx, int dy)
		{
			Pane focusedPane = FocusedPane;
			if (focusedPane == null)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(dx, dy);
			}
			Rect viewport = focusedPane.Viewport;
			viewport.X += dx;
			viewport.Y += dy;
			Rect rangeBounds = focusedPane.RangeBounds;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (viewport.Left < rangeBounds.Left)
			{
				num = viewport.Left - rangeBounds.Left;
			}
			else if (viewport.Right > rangeBounds.Right)
			{
				num = viewport.Right - rangeBounds.Right;
			}
			if (viewport.Top < rangeBounds.Top)
			{
				num2 = viewport.Top - rangeBounds.Top;
			}
			else if (viewport.Bottom > rangeBounds.Bottom)
			{
				num2 = viewport.Bottom - rangeBounds.Bottom;
			}
			if (focusedScrollBar != null)
			{
				if (focusedScrollBar.Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Point(0.0, num2);
				}
				return new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num2);
		}

		private Pane GetPaneByPoint(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				if (actualPane.PanePanel != null && base.Container != null)
				{
					Rect? lastMappingBounds = actualPane.LastMappingBounds;
					if (lastMappingBounds.HasValue && lastMappingBounds.Value.Contains(p))
					{
						return actualPane;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private GRealSize2D GetPaneSizeForAutoLayout(Pane pane, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			if (base.DesiredSize.Width != 0.0)
			{
				num = pane.OuterBounds.Size.Width / base.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			double num2 = 1.0;
			if (base.DesiredSize.Height != 0.0)
			{
				num2 = pane.OuterBounds.Size.Height / base.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			return new GRealSize2D(constraint.Width * num, constraint.Height * num2);
		}

		private double GetPseudoAxisLength(bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if (!isHorizontal)
			{
				if (base.ActualHeight != 0.0)
				{
					return base.ActualHeight * 0.8;
				}
				return 500.0;
			}
			if (base.ActualWidth != 0.0)
			{
				return base.ActualWidth * 0.8;
			}
			return 500.0;
		}

		private List<Series> GetSeriesForAxis(IAxisData axis, IList<ISeries> seriesOnPane)
		{
			IList<ISeries> seriesByAxis = base.ViewController.SeriesController.GetSeriesByAxis(axis);
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
			foreach (ISeries item in seriesByAxis)
			{
				if (seriesOnPane.Contains(item))
				{
					list.Add(item as Series);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Rect GetVerticalRect(Rect rect, Pane pane)

			return new Rect(rect.X, 0.0, rect.Width, pane.Viewport.Height);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetWholeRangeZeroPoint(Pane pane, PaneAxesContainer paneAxesData, bool rotated)
		{
			Rect viewport = pane.Viewport;
			IAxisData axisData;
			IAxisData axis;
			if (rotated)
			{
				axisData = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
				axis = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
			}
			else
			{
				axisData = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisX;
				axis = paneAxesData.PrimaryAxisY;
			}
			double zeroPointOffset = GetZeroPointOffset(axisData, viewport.Width);
			double zeroPointOffset2 = GetZeroPointOffset(axis, viewport.Height);
			if (axisData.Reverse)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Right + zeroPointOffset, viewport.Top - zeroPointOffset2);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Left - zeroPointOffset, viewport.Bottom + zeroPointOffset2);
		}

		private double GetZeroPointOffset(IAxisData axis, double axisLength)
		{
			IMinMaxValues wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			double num = wholeRange.Min - axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(((IAxisRangeData)wholeRange).MinValue);
			return num * axisLength / wholeRange.Delta;
		}

			{
				crosshairSeriesLabelItem.PresentationData = new ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData>();
				crosshairSeriesLabelItem.LabelTemplate = CrosshairEmptySeriesLabelTemplate;
			}
		}

		private void HighlightPoints(CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfo, List<IDataPoint> resetedPoints)
		{
			if (base.Container.ToolTipOptions == null || !base.Container.ToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions.HighlightPoints)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				CrosshairPaneInfo byPane = lastCrosshairInfo.GetByPane(actualPane);
				if (byPane != null)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairDrawInfo.CrosshairElementGroups)
				{
					foreach (CrosshairElement crosshairElement in crosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements)
					{
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint = crosshairElement.RefinedPoint;
						IDataPoint dataPoint = refinedPoint;
						if (crosshairElement.RefinedSeries.Series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D && crosshairElement.Visible)
						{
							if (!highlightedPoints.Contains(dataPoint))
							{
								xYSeries2D.SetPointState(dataPoint, refinedPoint, isHighlighted: true);
								highlightedPoints.Add(dataPoint);
							}
							resetedPoints.Remove(dataPoint);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (CrosshairLegendElement legendElement in crosshairDrawInfo.LegendElements)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = legendElement.RefinedPoint;
				if (refinedPoint2 != null)
				{
					IDataPoint dataPoint2 = refinedPoint2;
					if (!highlightedPoints.Contains(dataPoint2))
					{
						XYSeries2D series = legendElement.Series;
						series.SetPointState(dataPoint2, refinedPoint2, isHighlighted: true);
						highlightedPoints.Add(dataPoint2);
					}
					resetedPoints.Remove(dataPoint2);
				}
			}
		}

				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(base.Container.PlatformElement, filter, UpdateFocusResult, new ChartPointHitTestParameters(position));
			}
		}

		private bool InViewport(System.Windows.Point position, Pane pane)
		{
			if (pane == null || pane.Collapsed || pane.Diagram == null || pane.Diagram != this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pane, (UIElement)base.Container.PlatformElement);
			Rect rect = new Rect(relativeElementRect.X + pane.Viewport.X, relativeElementRect.Y + pane.Viewport.Y, pane.Viewport.Width, pane.Viewport.Height);
			if (position.X > rect.Left && position.Y > rect.Top && position.X < rect.Right - 1.0)
			{
				return position.Y < rect.Bottom - 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private InternalCoordinates MapPointToInternal(Pane pane, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			PaneAxesContainer container = PaneAxesContainerRepository.GetContainer(pane);
			if (container == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect rect = CalculateRelativeAxesRect(point, pane);
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			InternalCoordinates internalCoordinates = new InternalCoordinates(pane);
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)container.PrimaryAxisX;
			if (axis2D != null)
			{
				double num = axis2D.CalcInternalValue(pane, rect.X);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisXValue(axis2D, num);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item in container.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				double num2 = item.CalcInternalValue(pane, rect.X);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisXValue(item, num2);
				}
			}
			Axis2D axis2D3 = (Axis2D)container.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (axis2D3 != null)
			{
				double num3 = axis2D3.CalcInternalValue(pane, rect.Y);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisYValue(axis2D3, num3);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in container.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				double num4 = item2.CalcInternalValue(pane, rect.Y);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					internalCoordinates.AddAxisYValue(item2, num4);
				}
			}
			return internalCoordinates;
		}

		private void OnNavigationOptionsPropertyChanged(NavigationOptions oldOptions, NavigationOptions newOptions)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(oldOptions, newOptions, this);
			if (ShouldChangeScrollBarsCommands(oldOptions, newOptions))
			{
				UpdateScrollBarItems();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCrosshairUpdate()
		{
			if (lastCrosshairLocation.HasValue && PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) != null)
			{
				ResetPointsHighlighting();
				UpdateCrosshairLocation(lastCrosshairLocation.Value);
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is NavigationOptions)
			{
				if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs { PropertyName: "UseScrollBars" })
				{
					UpdateScrollBarItems();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetLegendItemsCrosshairValues()
		{
			if (lastCrosshairInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPoint seriesLegendPoint in lastCrosshairInfo.SeriesLegendPoints)
			{
				XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)seriesLegendPoint.LegendItem;
				if (xYSeries2D.LegendItem != null)
				{
					xYSeries2D.LegendItem.CrosshairText = xYSeries2D.ActualCrosshairEmptyValueLegendText;
				}
			}
			foreach (CrosshairIndicatorPoint indicatorLegendPoint in lastCrosshairInfo.IndicatorLegendPoints)
			{
				Indicator indicator = (Indicator)indicatorLegendPoint.LegendItem;
				if (indicator.LegendItem != null)
				{
					indicator.LegendItem.CrosshairText = indicator.CrosshairEmptyValueLegendText;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetPointsHighlighting()
		{
			foreach (IDataPoint highlightedPoint in highlightedPoints)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(highlightedPoint);
				if (seriesPoint.Series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
				{
					xYSeries2D.SetPointState(highlightedPoint, null, isHighlighted: false);
				}
			}
			highlightedPoints.Clear();
		}

		private void SaveCrosshairLocationForPrintingInternal()
		{
			crosshairLocationBeforePrinting = ((base.Container.ToolTipOptions != null && base.Container.ToolTipOptions.PrintCrosshair && lastCrosshairLocation.HasValue) ? PointToDiagram(lastCrosshairLocation.Value) : null);
		}

		private void SeriesBitmapCachingChanged()
		{
			foreach (XYSeries item in base.Series)
			{
				item.OnBitmapCachingChanged();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldChangeScrollBarsCommands(NavigationOptions oldOptions, NavigationOptions newOptions)
		{
			if (newOptions == null)
			{
				if (oldOptions != null)
				{
					return !oldOptions.UseScrollBars;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (oldOptions == null)
			{
				return !newOptions.UseScrollBars;
			}
			return oldOptions.UseScrollBars != newOptions.UseScrollBars;
		}

		private void SynchronizeCrosshairElementCollections(CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs args)
		{
			needSynchronizeCrosshairCustomDrawCollection = false;
			CrosshairCollectionSynchronizer<CrosshairElement, CrosshairElementBase> crosshairCollectionSynchronizer = new CrosshairCollectionSynchronizer<CrosshairElement, CrosshairElementBase>();
			foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in args.CrosshairElementGroups)
			{
				crosshairCollectionSynchronizer.Synchronize(crosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements, crosshairElementGroup.Elements);
			}
		}

		private void TruncateCollection(IList collection, int newCollectionLength)
		{
			if (newCollectionLength == 0)
			{
				collection.Clear();
			}
			while (collection.Count > newCollectionLength)
			{
				collection.RemoveAt(collection.Count - 1);
			}
		}

		private void UnHighlightPoints(List<IDataPoint> resetedPoints)
		{
			foreach (IDataPoint resetedPoint in resetedPoints)
			{
				highlightedPoints.Remove(resetedPoint);
				IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(resetedPoint);
				if (platformSeriesPoint.Owner is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
				{
					xYSeries2D.SetPointState(resetedPoint, null, isHighlighted: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<AxisBase> UpdateAutomaticMeasurementUnits(Pane pane, bool updateIntervals = false)
		{
			List<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(pane);
			if (axesContainer != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(UpdateAutomaticMeasurementUnits(pane, axesContainer.AxesX, updateIntervals));
				list.AddRange(UpdateAutomaticMeasurementUnits(pane, axesContainer.AxesY, updateIntervals));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<AxisBase> UpdateAutomaticMeasurementUnits(Pane pane, IList<IAxisData> axes, bool updateIntervals)
		{
			List<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			if (axes.Count > 0)
			{
				double axisLength = GetAxisLength(pane, axes[0].IsValueAxis);
				foreach (AxisBase axis in axes)
				{
					bool flag = axis.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(axisLength);
					bool flag2 = updateIntervals && axis.UpdateIntervals();
					if (flag || flag2)
					{
						list.Add(axis);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void UpdateAxes(IEnumerable<AxisBase> affectedAxes)
		{
			if (affectedAxes.Count() > 0)
			{
				base.ViewController.SendDataAggregationUpdates(affectedAxes);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairLegendElements(CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfo)
		{
			ObservableCollection<CrosshairAxisLabelItem> crosshairAxisLabelItems = base.CrosshairAxisLabelItems;
			int num = crosshairAxisLabelItems.Count;
			foreach (CrosshairLegendElementBase actualLegendElement in crosshairDrawInfo.ActualLegendElements)
			{
				LegendItem legendItem = actualLegendElement.LegendItem;
				if (legendItem != null)
				{
					legendItem.CrosshairText = (actualLegendElement.Visible ? actualLegendElement.Text : actualLegendElement.Series.DefaultMultilineCrosshairEmptyValueLegendText);
					legendItem.CrosshairTextVisible = actualLegendElement.Visible;
					legendItem.CrosshairForeground = actualLegendElement.Foreground;
					legendItem.CrosshairFontSizeInternal = actualLegendElement.FontSize;
					legendItem.CrosshairFontFamily = actualLegendElement.FontFamily;
					legendItem.CrosshairFontStretchInternal = actualLegendElement.FontStretch;
					legendItem.CrosshairFontStyleInternal = actualLegendElement.FontStyle;
					legendItem.CrosshairFontWeightInternal = actualLegendElement.FontWeight;
				}
				CrosshairLineElement lineElement = actualLegendElement.LineElement;
				if (lineElement != null)
				{
					Pane pane = actualLegendElement.Pane;
					ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData> crosshairLinesGeometry = pane.CrosshairLinesGeometry;
					if (actualLegendElement.Visible && lineElement.Visible)
					{
						CrosshairLine elementLine = actualLegendElement.ElementLine;
						crosshairLinesGeometry.Add(CreateCrosshairLinePresentationData(pane, elementLine, lineElement));
					}
				}
				CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = actualLegendElement.AxisLabelElement;
				if (axisLabelElement != null && actualLegendElement.Visible && axisLabelElement != null && axisLabelElement.Visible)
				{
					CrosshairAxisLabelItem item = CrosshairUtils.GetItem(crosshairAxisLabelItems, num);
					num++;
					FillCrosshairAxisLabelItem(item, actualLegendElement.ElementAxisInfo, axisLabelElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairLinePresentationData(CrosshairLinePresentationData linePresentationData, Pane pane, CrosshairLine crossLine, CrosshairLineElement lineElement)
		{
			Rect value = pane.LastMappingBounds.Value;
			double num = 0.0 - value.X + pane.Viewport.X;
			double num2 = 0.0 - value.Y + pane.Viewport.Y;
			UpdateCrosshairLinePresentationData(linePresentationData, crossLine.Line.Start.X + num, crossLine.Line.Start.Y + num2, crossLine.Line.End.X + num, crossLine.Line.End.Y + num2, lineElement);
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairLinePresentationData(CrosshairLinePresentationData linePresentationData, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, CrosshairLineElement lineElement)
		{
			linePresentationData.X1 = x1;
			linePresentationData.Y1 = y1;
			linePresentationData.X2 = x2;
			linePresentationData.Y2 = y2;
			linePresentationData.LineStyle = lineElement.LineStyle;
			linePresentationData.Brush = lineElement.Brush;
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairPaneElements(CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfo)
		{
			if (base.Container.ToolTipOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObservableCollection<CrosshairAxisLabelItem> crosshairAxisLabelItems = base.CrosshairAxisLabelItems;
			List<Pane> list = new List<Pane>(ActualPanes);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (CrosshairPaneDrawInfo paneElement in crosshairDrawInfo.PaneElements)
			{
				if (paneElement.CursorArgumentLine == null && paneElement.CursorValueLine == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Pane pane = paneElement.Pane;
				list.Remove(pane);
				ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData> crosshairLinesGeometry = pane.CrosshairLinesGeometry;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo item3 in paneElement.ElementsDrawInfo)
				{
					CrosshairElementBase element = item3.Element;
					CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = element.AxisLabelElement;
					CrosshairLineElement lineElement = element.LineElement;
					if (!element.Visible || ((lineElement == null || !lineElement.Visible) && (axisLabelElement == null || !axisLabelElement.Visible)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					IPane pane2 = item3.Element.Pane;
					if (pane2 == null || !pane2.MappingBounds.HasValue)
					{
						continue;
					}
					GRealRect2D value = pane2.MappingBounds.Value;
					GRealLine2D line = item3.ElementLine.Line;
					if (value.Contains(line.Start) && value.Contains(line.End))
					{
						if (lineElement != null && lineElement.Visible)
						{
							UpdateLineGeometry(item3.ElementLine, num2, crosshairLinesGeometry, pane, lineElement);
							num2++;
						}
						if (axisLabelElement != null && axisLabelElement.Visible)
						{
							CrosshairAxisLabelItem item = CrosshairUtils.GetItem(crosshairAxisLabelItems, num);
							num++;
							FillCrosshairAxisLabelItem(item, item3.ElementAxisInfo, axisLabelElement);
						}
					}
				}
				CrosshairLineElement cursorLineElement = crosshairDrawInfo.CursorLineElement;
				CrosshairOptions actualCrosshairOptions = base.Container.ToolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions;
				if (paneElement.CursorArgumentLine != null && actualCrosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLine && (actualCrosshairOptions.SnapMode != CrosshairSnapMode.NearestArgument || cursorLineElement.Visible))
				{
					UpdateLineGeometry(paneElement.CursorArgumentLine, num2, crosshairLinesGeometry, pane, cursorLineElement);
					num2++;
				}
				if (paneElement.CursorValueLine != null && actualCrosshairOptions.ShowValueLine && (actualCrosshairOptions.SnapMode != CrosshairSnapMode.NearestValue || cursorLineElement.Visible))
				{
					UpdateLineGeometry(paneElement.CursorValueLine, num2, crosshairLinesGeometry, pane, cursorLineElement);
					num2++;
				}
				TruncateCollection(crosshairLinesGeometry, num2);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<CrosshairAxisLabelElement, CrosshairAxisInfo> item4 in paneElement.CursorAxesInfo)
				{
					CrosshairAxisLabelElement key = item4.Key;
					if (key.Visible)
					{
						CrosshairAxisLabelItem item2 = CrosshairUtils.GetItem(crosshairAxisLabelItems, num);
						num++;
						FillCrosshairAxisLabelItem(item2, item4.Value, key);
					}
				}
				pane.InvalidateCrosshairLinesRendering();
			}
			foreach (Pane item5 in list)
			{
				item5.ClearCrosshair();
			}
			TruncateCollection(crosshairAxisLabelItems, num);
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData(IList<CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData> presentationDataCollection, int index, CrosshairElementBase element)
		{
			if (index >= presentationDataCollection.Count)
			{
				presentationDataCollection.Add(new CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData());
			}
			CrosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData = presentationDataCollection[index];
			CrosshairLabelElement labelElement = element.LabelElement;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.Text = labelElement.Text;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.HeaderText = labelElement.HeaderText;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FooterText = labelElement.FooterText;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.Series = element.Series;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.CrosshairSeriesLabelTemplate = labelElement.CrosshairLabelTemplate;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.Foreground = labelElement.Foreground;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FontFamily = labelElement.FontFamily;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FontSize = labelElement.FontSize;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FontStretch = labelElement.FontStretch;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FontStyle = labelElement.FontStyle;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FontWeight = labelElement.FontWeight;
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.TextVisibility = ((!labelElement.TextVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.MarkerVisibility = ((!labelElement.MarkerVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.ElementAlignment = ((!labelElement.MarkerVisible) ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.HeaderTextVisibility = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelElement.HeaderText) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.FooterTextVisibility = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(labelElement.FooterText) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			CrosshairMarkerItem markerItem = crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.MarkerItem;
			CrosshairMarkerItem markerItem2 = element.CreateMarkerItem();
			if (markerItem != null)
			{
				markerItem.Update(markerItem2);
			}
			else
			{
				crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.MarkerItem = markerItem2;
			}
			crosshairSeriesLabelPresentationData.SeriesPoint = element.GetSeriesPoint();
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabels(CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfo, List<CrosshairLabelInfo> labelsInfo)
		{
			if (labelsInfo.Count == 0)
			{
				HideCrosshairSeriesLabels();
				return;
			}
			ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelItem> crosshairSeriesLabelItems = base.CrosshairSeriesLabelItems;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < labelsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				CrosshairSeriesLabelItem item = CrosshairUtils.GetItem(crosshairSeriesLabelItems, num);
				if (FillCrosshairSeriesLabelItem(item, labelsInfo[i], crosshairDrawInfo))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			TruncateCollection(crosshairSeriesLabelItems, num);
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorsRepository()
		{
			IndicatorsRepository.Clear();
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				if (!(item is XYSeries2D { Visible: not false } xYSeries2D))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Indicator indicator in xYSeries2D.Indicators)
				{
					if (indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
					{
						IPane actualPane = separatePaneIndicator.ActualPane;
						AddIndicatorToRepository(separatePaneIndicator, actualPane);
					}
					else
					{
						AddIndicatorToRepository(indicator, xYSeries2D.ActualPane);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLineGeometry(CrosshairLine line, int lineIndex, ObservableCollection<CrosshairLinePresentationData> crosshairLinesGeometry, Pane pane, CrosshairLineElement cursorLineElement)
		{
			if (line != null)
			{
				if (lineIndex >= crosshairLinesGeometry.Count)
				{
					crosshairLinesGeometry.Add(CreateCrosshairLinePresentationData(pane, line, cursorLineElement));
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateCrosshairLinePresentationData(crosshairLinesGeometry[lineIndex], pane, line, cursorLineElement);
				}
			}
		}

		}

			}
		}

		void IIndicatorCalculator.UpdateSeriesIndicators(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> pointsUpdateInfo)
		{
			if (!refinedSeries.Series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				return;
			}
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = refinedSeries.Series as XYSeries2D;
			if (isUpdatingIndicators || xYSeries2D == null || xYSeries2D.Indicators.Count <= 0 || xYSeries2D.ActualAxisX == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isUpdatingIndicators = true;
				List<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints = new List<RefinedPoint>(((IRefinedSeries)refinedSeries).Points);
				double minArgument = ((IRefinedSeries)refinedSeries).GetMinArgument(xYSeries2D.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap);
				double maxArgument = ((IRefinedSeries)refinedSeries).GetMaxArgument(xYSeries2D.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap);
				Indicator.DataCalculationContext context = new Indicator.DataCalculationContext(refinedSeries, refinedPoints, minArgument, maxArgument);
				List<Indicator> source = xYSeries2D.Indicators.Where((Indicator i) => i.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && i.Visible).ToList();
				Parallel.ForEach(source, delegate(Indicator indicator)
				{
					indicator.CalculateData(context);
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				crosshairManager.UpdateIndicatorsData();
				isUpdatingIndicators = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualItemsCore()
		{
			CleanStripItemsInStrips();
			foreach (Pane allPane in AllPanes)
			{
				allPane.UpdateVisualItems(needUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure);
			}
			needUpdateVisualItems = false;
			needUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure = false;
		}

		private void UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(ConstantLineCollection collection)
		{
			foreach (ConstantLine item in collection)
			{
				if (item.RuntimeMoving)
				{
					HasMovableConstantLines = true;
				}
				if (item.RuntimeDeletion)
				{
					HasDeletableConstantLines = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private HitTestFilterBehavior UpdateFocusFilter(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is Pane pane && pane.Diagram.Container == base.Container)
			{
				pane.Focus();
				pseudoFocusedPane = new WeakReference(pane);
				paneUnderMouse = pane;
			}
			if (obj is AxisScrollBar axisScrollBar)
			{
				focusedScrollBar = axisScrollBar;
			}
			if (obj is AxisScrollBarThumb axisScrollBarThumb)
			{
				focusedThumb = axisScrollBarThumb;
			}
			if (obj is AxisScrollBarThumbResizer axisScrollBarThumbResizer)
			{
				focusedResizer = axisScrollBarThumbResizer;
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Stop;
			}
			return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
		}

		private HitTestResultBehavior UpdateFocusResult(HitTestResult result)
		{
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
		}

		private HitTestFilterBehavior UpdatePaneUnderMouseFilter(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is Pane pane && pane.Diagram.Container == base.Container)
			{
				paneUnderMouse = pane;
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Stop;
			}
			return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
		}

		private static Axis2D FindFocusedAxis(UIElement control, Pane pane, System.Windows.Point hitPoint)
		{
			foreach (Tuple<Axis2D, SelectionGeometryItem> axesBound in pane.AxesBounds)
			{
				if (axesBound.Item1.Visible == false)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)pane, control);
				Rect rect = MathUtils.CalcBounds(axesBound.Item2.Geometry);
				if (!rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					rect.Offset(relativeElementRect.X, relativeElementRect.Y);
					if (rect.Contains(hitPoint))
					{
						return axesBound.Item1;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void EnsureSeriesItems()
		{
			foreach (Axis2D axis in Axes)
			{
				IList<IPane> panes = axisPaneRepository.GetPanes(axis);
				axis.UpdateVisibilityInPanes(panes);
				if (axisPaneRepository != null)
				{
					axis.ActualVisibilityInPanes.UpdateVisibilityInPanes(panes);
				}
			}
			AxisValueContainerHelper.UpdateAxisElementsAndIntervals(this);
			UpdateIndicatorsRepository();
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				actualPane.Update();
			}
		}

		protected override void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, LegendBase legend)
		{
			FillSeriesLegendItems(legendItems, legend);
			Legend legend2 = legend as Legend;
			foreach (Axis2D axis in Axes)
			{
				axis.FillConstantLinesLegendItems(legendItems, legend2);
			}
			foreach (Axis2D axis2 in Axes)
			{
				axis2.FillStripsLegendItems(legendItems, legend2);
			}
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				actualPane.FillIndicatorsLegendItems(legendItems, legend2);
			}
		}

		protected override void InvalidateVisualChild(object sender)
		{
			base.InvalidateVisualChild(sender);
			if (sender is XYDiagram2DPanesPanel)
			{
				panesRootPanel = null;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			ObservableCollection<Pane> allPanes = AllPanes;
			if (allPanes != null && allPanes.Count <= 0)
			{
				UpdateCrosshairLocation(null, shouldClear: true);
			}
			if (!UseViewportCache || base.DiagramLayoutChanged)
			{
				ClearViewportCache();
			}
			base.DiagramLayoutChanged = false;
			if (Elements == null || needUpdateVisualItems)
			{
				UpdateVisualItemsCore();
				UpdateLogicalElements();
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
				{
					actualPane.EnsureItems();
				}
			}
			availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Floor(availableSize.Width), Math.Floor(availableSize.Height));
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			UpdateAxes(GetAutoMeasurementUnitsAffectedAxes(updateIntervals: false));
			CalculateLayout();
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			if (lastCrosshairLocation.HasValue)
			{
				UpdateCrosshairLocation(lastCrosshairLocation);
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected internal override bool BeginSelection(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)

				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)focusedPane.PanePanel, (UIElement)base.Container.PlatformElement);
				startRectanglePoint = (lastPosition = new System.Windows.Point(chartPosition.X - relativeElementRect.X, chartPosition.Y - relativeElementRect.Y));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void CheckMeasureUnits(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			IEnumerable<AxisBase> autoMeasurementUnitsAffectedAxes = GetAutoMeasurementUnitsAffectedAxes(updateIntervals: true);

			axesUpdateInfos.AddRange(base.ViewController.GetAxesUpdateInfos(autoMeasurementUnitsAffectedAxes, "SkipRangesWithoutPoints"));
			base.ViewController.SendUpdates(axesUpdateInfos);
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				if (actualPane.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> elementsForAutoLayout = actualPane.GetElementsForAutoLayout();
					GRealSize2D paneSizeForAutoLayout = GetPaneSizeForAutoLayout(actualPane, size);
					list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(paneSizeForAutoLayout, elementsForAutoLayout));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point ManipulationDrag(System.Windows.Point translation, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(translation.X);
			int num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(translation.Y);
			if (focusedScrollBar != null)
			{
				if ((focusedScrollBar.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal && translation.X != 0.0) || (focusedScrollBar.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical && translation.Y != 0.0))
				{
					if (focusedResizer == null)
					{
						focusedScrollBar.ThumbDragDelta(translation.X, translation.Y);
						return GetOverPan(num, num2);
					}
					focusedScrollBar.DragThumbResizer(focusedResizer, translation.X, translation.Y);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Pane focusedPane = FocusedPane;
				if (focusedPane != null)
				{
					if (focusedPane.CanScroll(num, num2))
					{
						focusedPane.Scroll(num, num2, navigationType);
					}
					return GetOverPan(-num, -num2);
				}
			}
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		protected internal override bool ManipulationStart(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			TouchFocusedAxis = null;
			Pane focusedPane = FocusedPane;
			if (focusedPane == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!InViewport(point, focusedPane))
			{
				if (focusedScrollBar != null && focusedThumb != null)
				{
					focusedScrollBar.StartThumbDrag();
				}
				else
				{
					TouchFocusedAxis = FindFocusedAxis(base.Container.PlatformElement, focusedPane, point);
					if (TouchFocusedAxis == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					manipulationStartPoint = point;
				}
				return true;
			}
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(focusedPane);
			gestureZoomManager = GestureZoomManager.Initialize(axesContainer);
			manipulationStartPoint = point;
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void ManipulationZoom(double scaleX, double scaleY, double deltaDistance)
		{
			Pane focusedPane = FocusedPane;
			if (manipulationStartPoint.HasValue && focusedPane != null && (focusedPane.ActualCanZoomIn || focusedPane.ActualCanZoomOut))
			{
				if (TouchFocusedAxis == null)
				{
					focusedPane.Zoom(manipulationStartPoint.Value, 1.0 / scaleX, 1.0 / scaleY, gestureZoomManager);
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(deltaDistance) > 5.0)
				{
					focusedPane.ZoomAxis(TouchFocusedAxis, manipulationStartPoint.Value, Math.Sign(deltaDistance), ZoomingKind.Gesture);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationBeginDrag(System.Windows.Point position, MouseButtonState leftButtonState, bool isShiftKey)
		{
			UpdateScrollingState(isScrolling: true);
			Pane focusedPane = FocusedPane;
			if (InViewport(position, focusedPane) && focusedPane.PanePanel != null && IsNavigationEnabled)
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)focusedPane.PanePanel, (UIElement)base.Container.PlatformElement);
				startRectanglePoint = (lastPosition = new System.Windows.Point(position.X - relativeElementRect.X, position.Y - relativeElementRect.Y));
				if (!isShiftKey)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return NavigationCanZoomIntoRectangle();
			}
			return false;
		}

			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void NavigationShowSelection(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			Pane focusedPane = FocusedPane;
			if (focusedPane == null || base.Container.ChartOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)focusedPane.PanePanel, (UIElement)base.Container.PlatformElement);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(chartPosition.X - relativeElementRect.X, chartPosition.Y - relativeElementRect.Y);
			Rect viewport = focusedPane.Viewport;
			double x = Math.Max(Math.Min(viewport.Width, point.X), 0.0);
			double y = Math.Max(Math.Min(viewport.Height, point.Y), 0.0);
			Rect rect = new Rect(startRectanglePoint, new System.Windows.Point(x, y));
			if (EnableAxisXNavigation)
			{
				if (!EnableAxisYNavigation)
				{
					rect = (Rotated ? GetHorizontalRect(rect, focusedPane) : GetVerticalRect(rect, focusedPane));
				}
			}
			else if (EnableAxisYNavigation)
			{
				rect = (Rotated ? GetVerticalRect(rect, focusedPane) : GetHorizontalRect(rect, focusedPane));
			}
			base.Container.ChartOptions.NavigationLayer.ShowSelection(new Rect(rect.X + offsetX, rect.Y + offsetY, rect.Width, rect.Height));
		}

		protected internal override void NavigationUndoZoom()

		}

		protected internal override bool NavigationZoom(System.Windows.Point position, int delta, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, bool isDragging)
		{
			Pane pane = FocusedPane ?? paneUnderMouse;
			if ((isDragging && pane != null) || InViewport(position, pane))
			{
				return pane.PerformZoom(position, delta, zoomingKind);
			}
			if (pane != null)
			{
				Axis2D axis2D = FindFocusedAxis(base.Container.PlatformElement, pane, position);
				if (axis2D != null)
				{
					return pane.ZoomAxis(axis2D, position, delta, zoomingKind);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

			}

				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)focusedPane.PanePanel, (UIElement)base.Container.PlatformElement);
				System.Windows.Point point = (lastPosition = new System.Windows.Point(chartPosition.X - relativeElementRect.X, chartPosition.Y - relativeElementRect.Y));
				Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)base.Container.ChartOptions.NavigationLayer, (UIElement)base.Container.PlatformElement);

				offsetY = point2.Y - point.Y;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RestoreAfterPrinting()
		{
			base.RestoreAfterPrinting();
			IContainerToolTipOptions toolTipOptions = base.Container.ToolTipOptions;
			if (toolTipOptions != null && crosshairLocationBeforePrinting != null)
			{
				UpdateCrosshairLocation(null);
				ControlCoordinates controlCoordinates = DiagramToPointInternal(crosshairLocationBeforePrinting);
				if (controlCoordinates != null)
				{
					UpdateLayout();
					UpdateCrosshairLocation(controlCoordinates.Point);
					toolTipOptions.UpdateCrosshairPanelLayout();
				}
				crosshairLocationBeforePrinting = null;
			}
			isPrintingInPrintPreview = false;
		}

		}

		protected internal override void UpdateActualPanes()
		{
			PaneCollection panes = Panes;
			if (panes != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<Pane> newAllPanes = new Pane[1] { actualDefaultPane }.Concat(panes.Cast<Pane>());
				IEnumerable<Pane> newActualPanes = newAllPanes.Where((Pane item) => !item.Collapsed && item.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed);
				if (AllPanes == null || AllPanes.Count != newAllPanes.Count() || AllPanes.Where((Pane p) => !newAllPanes.Contains(p)).Count() > 0)
				{
					SetValue(AllPanesPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<Pane>(newAllPanes));
				}
				if (ActualPanes == null || ActualPanes.Count != newActualPanes.Count() || ActualPanes.Where((Pane p) => !newActualPanes.Contains(p)).Count() > 0)
				{
					SetValue(ActualPanesPropertyKey, new ObservableCollection<Pane>(newActualPanes));
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateCrosshairLocation(System.Windows.Point? crosshairLocation, bool shouldClear = false)
		{
			lastCrosshairLocation = crosshairLocation;
			IContainerToolTipOptions toolTipOptions = base.Container.ToolTipOptions;
			if (toolTipOptions != null && crosshairLocation.HasValue)
			{
				Pane paneByPoint = GetPaneByPoint(crosshairLocation.Value);
				if (paneByPoint != null && paneByPoint.IsVisible)
				{
					GRealPoint2D crosshairLocation2 = new GRealPoint2D(crosshairLocation.Value.X, crosshairLocation.Value.Y);
					GRealRect2D labelsConstraint = toolTipOptions.CalculateCrosshairLabelsConstraint(crosshairLocation.Value);
					List<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries = new List<IRefinedSeries>(base.ViewController.SeriesController.ActiveRefinedSeries);
					lastCrosshairInfo = crosshairManager.CalculateCrosshairInfo(crosshairLocation2, crosshairLocationIsEmpty: false, labelsConstraint, PaneAxesContainerRepository.Values, paneByPoint, refinedSeries, legendCrosshairItems, needGenerateFullInfo: true);
					if (lastCrosshairInfo != null)
					{
						CrosshairDrawInfo crosshairDrawInfo = new CrosshairDrawInfo(toolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairOptions, this);
						List<CrosshairLabelInfo> list = new List<CrosshairLabelInfo>();
						Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts = new Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings>();
						Dictionary<Pane, List<CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<Pane, List<CrosshairPaneElementDrawInfo>>();
						foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
						{
							actualPane.UpdateCrosshairAppearance();
							CrosshairPaneInfo byPane = lastCrosshairInfo.GetByPane(actualPane);
							if (byPane != null && byPane.LabelsInfo != null)
							{
								list.AddRange(byPane.LabelsInfo);
								actualPane.UpdateCrosshairLabelsInfo(byPane.LabelsInfo);
								crosshairDrawInfo.AddCrosshairPaneInfo(byPane, actualPane, dictionary, axesFonts);
							}
						}
						foreach (CrosshairPaneDrawInfo paneElement in crosshairDrawInfo.PaneElements)
						{
							if (dictionary.TryGetValue(paneElement.Pane, out var value))
							{
								paneElement.ElementsDrawInfo.AddRange(value);
							}
						}
						crosshairDrawInfo.AddCrosshairLegendElements(lastCrosshairInfo, axesFonts);
						CreateAndRaiseEvent(crosshairDrawInfo);
						List<IDataPoint> resetedPoints = new List<IDataPoint>(highlightedPoints);
						HighlightPoints(crosshairDrawInfo, resetedPoints);
						UnHighlightPoints(resetedPoints);
						UpdateCrosshairSeriesLabels(crosshairDrawInfo, list);
						UpdateCrosshairPaneElements(crosshairDrawInfo);
						UpdateCrosshairLegendElements(crosshairDrawInfo);
						toolTipOptions.InvalidateCrosshairPanels();
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (shouldClear)
			{
				crosshairManager.ClearCrosshairData();
			}
			ResetPointsHighlighting();
			ResetLegendItemsCrosshairValues();
			lastCrosshairInfo = null;
			foreach (Pane actualPane2 in ActualPanes)
			{
				actualPane2.ClearCrosshair();
			}
			if (base.CrosshairAxisLabelItems.Count > 0)
			{
				base.CrosshairAxisLabelItems.Clear();
			}
			HideCrosshairSeriesLabels();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFocus(System.Windows.Point position, bool allowPostponedExecute = true)
		{
			lPosition = position;
			if (allowPostponedExecute)
			{
				if (!isInvoked)
				{
					isInvoked = true;
					Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						UpdateFocusCore(lPosition);
						isInvoked = false;
					}, DispatcherPriority.Background);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateFocusCore(lPosition);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateLegends()
		{
			base.UpdateLegends();
			if (base.Container.LegendOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			actualDefaultPane.Legends.IsDefaultPane = true;
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				base.Container.LegendOptions.LegendCollectionsManager.TargetCollections.Add(actualPane.Legends);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateLogicalElements()
		{
			ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = Elements;
			bool flag = false;
			if (observableCollection == null)
			{
				observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>();
				flag = true;
			}
			ObservableCollectionHelper<object> val = new ObservableCollectionHelper<object>(observableCollection, false);
			try
			{
				foreach (Series item in base.Series)
				{
					val.Add((object)item.ActualLabel);
					if (!(item is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (Indicator indicator in xYSeries2D.Indicators)
					{
						val.Add((object)indicator);
					}
				}
				foreach (Axis2D axis in Axes)
				{
					val.Add((object)axis);
					foreach (Strip strip in axis.Strips)
					{
						val.Add((object)strip);
					}
					axis.ConstantLinesBehind.FillConstantLinesAndTitles(val.NewElements);
					axis.ConstantLinesInFront.FillConstantLinesAndTitles(val.NewElements);
					val.Add((object)axis.ActualLabel);
					if (axis.Title != null)
					{
						val.Add((object)axis.Title);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Elements = observableCollection;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			base.UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				actualPane.LabelsLayoutCache.Invalidate();
				actualPane.UpdateSeriesItems(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			}
			ProcessCrosshairUpdate();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateVisualItems(bool isUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure)
		{
			needUpdateVisualItems = true;
			needUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure = isUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure;
		}

		internal bool CheckIsLastNotCollapsedPane(Pane pane)
		{
			List<Pane> list = new List<Pane>();
			foreach (Pane actualPane in ActualPanes)
			{
				if (actualPane.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					list.Add(actualPane);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0] == pane;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			base.CompleteDeserializing();
			(base.SeriesTemplate as XYSeries)?.CompleteDeserializing();
			foreach (Axis2D axis in Axes)
			{
				axis.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
		}

		internal FontSettings CreateCrosshairSeriesLabelFont()
		{
			return new FontSettings(base.FontFamily, base.FontStretch, base.FontWeight, base.FontStyle, base.FontSize, CrosshairSeriesLabelForeground);
		}

		internal PaneAxesContainer GetAxesContainer(Pane pane)
		{
			if (pane == null || PaneAxesContainerRepository == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PaneAxesContainerRepository.GetContainer(pane);
		}

		internal double GetAxisLength(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			if (axisPaneRepository != null)
			{
				IList<IPane> panes = axisPaneRepository.GetPanes(axisData);
				if (panes != null && panes.Count > 0)
				{
					return GetAxisLength((Pane)panes[0], axisData.IsValueAxis);
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		internal void RaisePaneCollapsedChangedEvent(PaneCollapsedChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (eventArgs != null)
			{
				RaiseEventCore(eventArgs);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseScrollEvent(ScrollingOrientation orientation, NavigationType navigationType, RangesSnapshot oldRange, RangesSnapshot newRange, Pane pane, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY)
		{
			XYDiagram2DScrollEventArgs eventArgs = new XYDiagram2DScrollEventArgs((XYDiagram2DScrollOrientation)orientation, (XYDiagram2DScrollEventType)navigationType, pane, axisX, axisY, oldRange.XRange, oldRange.YRange, newRange.XRange, newRange.YRange);
			RaiseEventCore(eventArgs);
		}

		internal void RaiseZoomEvent(NavigationType navigationType, RangesSnapshot oldRange, RangesSnapshot newRange, Pane pane, AxisX2D axisX, AxisY2D axisY)
		{
			XYDiagram2DZoomEventArgs eventArgs = new XYDiagram2DZoomEventArgs((XYDiagram2DZoomEventType)navigationType, pane, axisX, axisY, oldRange.XRange, oldRange.YRange, newRange.XRange, newRange.YRange);
			base.DiagramLayoutChanged = true;
			RaiseEventCore(eventArgs);
		}

		private void RaiseEventCore(RoutedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			RaiseEvent(eventArgs);
			needUpdateVisualItems = true;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(this);
		}

		internal Indicator FindPaneIndicatorsByTag(object tag)
		{
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				if (item is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
				{
					Indicator indicator = TagUtils.FindElementByTag(tag, xYSeries2D.Indicators);
					if (indicator != null)
					{
						return indicator;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void RemoveSecondaryAxisYByTag(object tag)
		{
			SecondaryAxisY2D item = TagUtils.FindElementByTag(tag, SecondaryAxesY);
			SecondaryAxesY.Remove(item);
		}

		internal void RemovePaneByTag(object tag)
		{
			Pane item = TagUtils.FindElementByTag(tag, Panes);
			Panes.Remove(item);
		}

		internal void RemoveIndicator(Indicator indicator)
		{
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{

				}
			}
		}

		internal ScrollBarAnnotationLayout CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(Axis2D axis, IScrollBarAnnotation annotation)
		{
			return CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(axis, annotation, annotation.AxisValueStart, annotation.AxisValueEnd);
		}

		internal ScrollBarAnnotationLayout CreateScrollBarAnnotationLayout(Axis2D axis, IScrollBarAnnotation annotation, double valueStart, double valueEnd)
		{
			double num = axis.ActualWholeRange.GetNormalizedRangeValue(valueStart);
			double num2 = axis.ActualWholeRange.GetNormalizedRangeValue(valueEnd);
			if (axis.Reverse)
			{
				num = 1.0 - num;
				num2 = 1.0 - num2;
			}
			return new ScrollBarAnnotationLayout(annotation, num, num2, annotation.WidthStart, annotation.WidthEnd);
		}

		internal override void UpdateHasMovableOrDeletableConstantLine()
		{
			HasMovableConstantLines = false;
			HasDeletableConstantLines = false;
			UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(ActualAxisX.ConstantLinesBehind);
			UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(ActualAxisX.ConstantLinesInFront);
			UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(ActualAxisY.ConstantLinesBehind);
			UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(ActualAxisY.ConstantLinesInFront);
			foreach (SecondaryAxisX2D item in SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(item.ConstantLinesBehind);
				UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(item.ConstantLinesInFront);
			}
			foreach (SecondaryAxisY2D item2 in SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(item2.ConstantLinesBehind);
				UpdateHasMovableConstantLine(item2.ConstantLinesInFront);
			}
		}

		public DiagramCoordinates PointToDiagram(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = new DiagramCoordinates();
			Pane paneByPoint = GetPaneByPoint(p);
			if (paneByPoint == null)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			diagramCoordinates.SetPane(paneByPoint);
			PaneAxesContainer axesContainer = GetAxesContainer(paneByPoint);
			if (axesContainer == null)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			if (!paneByPoint.LastMappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			Rect rect = CalculateRelativeAxesRect(p, paneByPoint);
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return diagramCoordinates;
			}
			AxisX2D axisX2D = (AxisX2D)axesContainer.PrimaryAxisX;
			AxisY2D axisY2D = (AxisY2D)axesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;
			if (axisX2D != null && axisY2D != null)
			{
				diagramCoordinates.SetAxes(axisX2D, axisY2D);
				double num = axisX2D.CalcInternalValue(paneByPoint, rect.X);
				double num2 = axisY2D.CalcInternalValue(paneByPoint, rect.Y);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && !double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					diagramCoordinates.SetArgumentAndValue(num, num2);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item in axesContainer.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				double num3 = item.CalcInternalValue(paneByPoint, rect.X);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					diagramCoordinates.AddAxisValue(item, num3);
				}
			}
			foreach (Axis2D item2 in axesContainer.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				double num4 = item2.CalcInternalValue(paneByPoint, rect.Y);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					diagramCoordinates.AddAxisValue(item2, num4);
				}
			}
			return diagramCoordinates;
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(System.Windows.Point screenPoint)
		{
			IContainerToolTipOptions toolTipOptions = base.Container.ToolTipOptions;
			if (toolTipOptions != null)
			{
				if (!toolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
				{
					toolTipOptions.ForceCrosshair();
					crosshairManager.UpdateDataForSeries(base.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries);
				}
				if (toolTipOptions.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
				{
					UpdateCrosshairLocation(screenPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ShowCrosshair(ControlCoordinates coordinates)
		{
			ShowCrosshair(coordinates.Point);
		}

		public void ShowCrosshair(object argument, object value, AxisX2D axisX = null, AxisY2D axisY = null, Pane pane = null)
		{
			if (axisX == null)
			{
				axisX = ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (axisY == null)
			{
				axisY = ActualAxisY;
			}
			if (pane == null)
			{
				pane = ActualDefaultPane;
			}
			ShowCrosshair(DiagramToPointInternal(argument, value, axisX, axisY, pane));
		}

	public class DrawOptions : ICloneable
	{
		private System.Windows.Media.Color color;

		private readonly Series series;

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color ActualColor
		{
			get
			{
				IInteractiveElement interactiveElement = series;
				if (VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsBrightnessSelection(series.SupportedSelectionType) && interactiveElement.IsSelected)
				{
					return VisualSelectionHelper.GetSelectedPointColor(Color);
				}
				if (interactiveElement.IsHighlighted)
				{
					return VisualSelectionHelper.GetHighlightedPointColor(Color);
				}
				return Color;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the series or series point color when implementing custom drawing in the chart control.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				color = value;
			}
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DrawOptions a, DrawOptions b)
		{
			if ((object)a == null && (object)b == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)a == null || (object)b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return a.Equals(b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DrawOptions a, DrawOptions b)
		{
			if ((object)a == null && (object)b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((object)a == null || (object)b == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !a.Equals(b);
		}

		private DrawOptions()
		{
		}

		internal DrawOptions(Series series)
		{
			Color = series.BaseColor;
			this.series = series;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			DrawOptions drawOptions = new DrawOptions();
			drawOptions.DeepClone(this);
			return drawOptions;
		}

		private void DeepClone(object obj)
		{
			DrawOptions drawOptions = obj as DrawOptions;
			if (drawOptions != null)
			{
				Color = drawOptions.Color;
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				DrawOptions drawOptions = obj as DrawOptions;
				if (drawOptions != null)
				{
					return Color.Equals(drawOptions.Color);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Color.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public abstract class PointModel : ChartDependencyObject, ICloneable, IBindingPropertiesSource
	{
		protected internal const int maxCacheSize = 12;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush maskBrush;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush strokeBrush;

		private readonly Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Pen> pens = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Pen>();

		private readonly Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Brush> brushes = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Brush>();

		protected virtual double LineThickness => 1.0;

		protected internal virtual bool CanBeDrawnWithZeroSize => false;

		protected internal virtual bool IsRenderable => false;

		protected System.Windows.Media.Brush MaskBrush
		{
			get
			{
				if (maskBrush == null)
				{
					maskBrush = CreateMaskBrush();
					maskBrush.Freeze();
				}
				return maskBrush;
			}
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Brush StrokeMaskBrush
		{
			get
			{
				if (strokeBrush == null)
				{
					strokeBrush = CreateStrokeMaskBrush();
					strokeBrush.Freeze();
				}
				return strokeBrush;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically
		{
			get
			{
				if (MaskBrush == null || !(MaskBrush is GradientBrush))
				{
					if (StrokeMaskBrush != null)
					{
						return StrokeMaskBrush is GradientBrush;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			PointModel pointModel = CreateModel();
			BindingPropertiesContainer<PointModel>.Apply(this, pointModel);
			return pointModel;
		}

		object IBindingPropertiesSource.CloneValue(object value)
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		protected abstract PointModel CreateModel();

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		protected virtual void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract ModelControl CreateModelControl();

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Point CorrectCenterLabelLocation(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			return location;
		}

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Point CorrectOutsideLabelLocation(System.Windows.Point location, bool isDownwardBar)
		{
			return location;
		}

		protected internal virtual Rect CalculateCorrectedBounds(Rect viewport, Rect initialBounds, bool rotated)
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (!pens.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (pens.Count == 12)
				{
					pens.Clear();
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(StrokeMaskBrush), color);
				brush.Freeze();
				value = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, LineThickness);
				value.Freeze();
				pens[color] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Media.Brush GetBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color, Transform relativeTransform = null)
		{
			if (!brushes.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (brushes.Count == 12)
				{
					brushes.Clear();
				}
				value = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(MaskBrush), color);
				if (relativeTransform != null)
				{
					value.RelativeTransform = relativeTransform;
				}
				value.Freeze();
				brushes[color] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateActualFillStyle(SeriesPointData seriesPointData)
		{
		}
	}

	public class Quasi3DBar2DModel : PredefinedBar2DModel
	{
		internal const int Depth = 8;

		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => false;

		[Description("Gets the name of the Quasi3DBar2DModel.")]
		public override string ModelName => "Quasi-3D Bar";

		protected internal override bool ActualOverlapBars => false;

		protected internal override bool ActualInFrontOfAxes => true;

		protected internal override bool ActualFlipNegativeBars => false;

		protected internal override int CorrectionSize => 8;

		private static bool ValueWithinRange(double value)
		{
			if (value < 8.0)
			{
				return value >= 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Bar2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Quasi3DBar2DModel();
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			return new Quasi3DBar2DModelControl();
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CorrectCenterLabelLocation(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(location.X - 8.0, location.Y - 8.0);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CorrectOutsideLabelLocation(System.Windows.Point location, bool isDownwardBar)
		{
			if (!isDownwardBar)
			{
				return location;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(location.X - 8.0, location.Y - 8.0);
		}

		protected internal override Rect CalculateCorrectedBounds(Rect viewport, Rect initialBounds, bool rotated)
		{
			if (initialBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return initialBounds;
			}
			double x = (ValueWithinRange(initialBounds.Left - viewport.Left) ? (initialBounds.Left - 8.0) : viewport.Left);
			double y = (ValueWithinRange(initialBounds.Top - viewport.Top) ? (initialBounds.Top - 8.0) : viewport.Top);
			double x2 = (rotated ? viewport.Bottom : viewport.Right);
			double y2 = (rotated ? viewport.Right : viewport.Bottom);
			return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), new System.Windows.Point(x2, y2));
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Quasi3DBar2DModel();
		}
	}
	public class GlassCylinderBar2DModel : PredefinedBar2DModel
	{
		internal const int CoverHalfHeight = 9;

		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => false;

		[Description("Gets the name of the GlassCylinderBar2DModel.")]
		public override string ModelName => "Glass Cylinder";

		protected internal override bool ActualOverlapBars => false;

		protected internal override bool ActualInFrontOfAxes => true;

		protected internal override bool ActualFlipNegativeBars => false;

		protected internal override int CorrectionSize => 9;

		protected internal override int ReversedCorrectionSize => 9;

		private static bool ValueWithinRange(double value)
		{
			if (value < 9.0)
			{
				return value >= 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Bar2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new GlassCylinderBar2DModel();
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			return new GlassCylinderBar2DModelControl();
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CorrectCenterLabelLocation(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(location.X, location.Y - 9.0);
		}

		protected internal override Rect CalculateCorrectedBounds(Rect viewport, Rect initialBounds, bool rotated)
		{
			if (initialBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return initialBounds;
			}
			double left = viewport.Left;
			double y = (ValueWithinRange(initialBounds.Top - viewport.Top) ? (initialBounds.Top - 9.0) : viewport.Top);
			double x = (rotated ? viewport.Bottom : viewport.Right);
			return new Rect(point2: new System.Windows.Point(x, (!rotated) ? (ValueWithinRange(viewport.Bottom - initialBounds.Bottom) ? (initialBounds.Bottom + 9.0) : viewport.Bottom) : (ValueWithinRange(viewport.Right - initialBounds.Bottom) ? (initialBounds.Bottom + 9.0) : viewport.Right)), point1: new System.Windows.Point(left, y));
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new GlassCylinderBar2DModel();
		}
	}
