	public class CustomBar2DModel : Bar2DModel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OverlapBarsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("OverlapBars", typeof(bool), typeof(CustomBar2DModel), new PropertyMetadata(ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FlipNegativeBarsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FlipNegativeBars", typeof(bool), typeof(CustomBar2DModel), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InFrontOfAxesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("InFrontOfAxes", typeof(bool), typeof(CustomBar2DModel), new PropertyMetadata(false, ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(CustomBar2DModel));

		[Description("Specifies whether Bars should overlap when the custom model is defined for them.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool OverlapBars
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(OverlapBarsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OverlapBarsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether bars corresponding to negative values should be flipped (mirrored). This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool FlipNegativeBars
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(FlipNegativeBarsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FlipNegativeBarsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether Bars are drawn in front, or behind the X-axis. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool InFrontOfAxes
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(InFrontOfAxesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InFrontOfAxesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the point template for the Bar series’ custom model. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public ControlTemplate PointTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(PointTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PointTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the name of the CustomBar2DModel.")]
		public override string ModelName => "Custom";

		protected internal override bool ActualOverlapBars => OverlapBars;

		protected internal override bool ActualInFrontOfAxes => InFrontOfAxes;

		protected internal override bool ActualFlipNegativeBars => FlipNegativeBars;

		protected override Bar2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CustomBar2DModel();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(InFrontOfAxesProperty);
			properties.Add(OverlapBarsProperty);
			properties.Add(FlipNegativeBarsProperty);
			properties.Add(PointTemplateProperty);
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			CustomModelControl customModelControl = new CustomModelControl();
			customModelControl.SetBinding(Control.TemplateProperty, new Binding("PointTemplate")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			return customModelControl;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new CustomBar2DModel();
		}
	}
	internal class Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel : SymmetricBar2DModel
	{
		protected internal override bool ActualOverlapBars => false;

		protected internal override bool ActualFlipNegativeBars => true;

		protected internal override bool ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically)
				{
					if (FillStyleModel != null)
					{
						return FillStyleModel.FillMode == FillMode.Gradient;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override string ModelName => "";

		public FillStyle FillStyleModel { get; set; }

		public DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border BorderModel { get; set; }

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel();
		}

		protected override Bar2DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel();
		}

		protected internal override ModelControl CreateModelControl()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("This model does not support point templates.");
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			ModelRenderBehavior.DrawRect(context, SpecialBarModelHelper.CreteBrush(pointColor, FillStyleModel), SpecialBarModelHelper.CreatePen(BorderModel), layout.Bounds);
		}
	}
	public abstract class Bar3DModel : DependencyObject, IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner, ICloneable, IBindingPropertiesSource
	{
		private IChartElement owner;

		internal List<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData;

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				SetOwner(value);
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.Controller;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract bool ActualLoadFromResources { get; }

		internal List<Bar3DSectionData> SectionsData
		{
			get
			{
				if (sectionsData == null)
				{
					sectionsData = CreateSectionsData();
				}
				return sectionsData;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the name of the Bar3DModel.")]
		public abstract string ModelName { get; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			Changed(args);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			if ((args.Change & ChartElementChange.CollectionModified) > ChartElementChange.None)
			{
				sectionsData = null;
			}
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.Changed(args);
			}
		}

		internal void SetOwner(IChartElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<Bar3DKind> GetPredefinedKinds()
		{
			return Bar3DKind.List;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			Bar3DModel bar3DModel = CreateObjectForClone();
			BindingPropertiesContainer<Bar3DModel>.Apply(this, bar3DModel);
			return bar3DModel;
		}

		object IBindingPropertiesSource.CloneValue(object value)
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			CollectCollectionProperties(properties);
		}

		protected abstract Bar3DModel CreateObjectForClone();

		protected virtual void CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class PredefinedBar3DModel : Bar3DModel
	{
		private List<PredefinedBar3DSection> sections = new List<PredefinedBar3DSection>();

		protected internal override bool ActualLoadFromResources => true;

		protected void AddSection(string source, bool fixedHeight, bool alignByX, bool alignByY, bool alignByZ, bool useViewColor)
		{
			sections.Add(new PredefinedBar3DSection(source, fixedHeight, alignByX, alignByY, alignByZ, useViewColor));
		}

		protected internal override List<Bar3DSectionData> CreateSectionsData()
		{
			List<Bar3DSectionData> list = new List<Bar3DSectionData>(sections.Count);
			foreach (PredefinedBar3DSection section in sections)
			{
				Bar3DSectionData bar3DSectionData = Bar3DSectionData.CreateInstance(section, ActualLoadFromResources);
				if (bar3DSectionData != null)
				{
					list.Add(bar3DSectionData);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	[ContentProperty("Sections")]
	public class CustomBar3DModel : Bar3DModel
	{
		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey SectionsPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LoadFromResourcesProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SectionsProperty;

		[Description("Specifies whether the custom model should be loaded from resources. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public bool LoadFromResources
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(LoadFromResourcesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LoadFromResourcesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides access to the collection of custom 3D Bar model sections. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public CustomBar3DSectionCollection Sections => (CustomBar3DSectionCollection)GetValue(SectionsProperty);

		protected internal override bool ActualLoadFromResources => LoadFromResources;

		[Description("Gets the name of the CustomBar3DModel.")]
		public override string ModelName => "Custom";

		static CustomBar3DModel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(CustomBar3DModel);
			LoadFromResourcesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LoadFromResources", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, LoadFromResourcesPropertyChanged));
			SectionsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Sections", typeof(CustomBar3DSectionCollection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata());
			SectionsProperty = SectionsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		private static void LoadFromResourcesPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is CustomBar3DModel customBar3DModel)
			{
				foreach (CustomBar3DSection section in customBar3DModel.Sections)
				{
					section.ClearCache();
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		protected internal override List<Bar3DSectionData> CreateSectionsData()
		{
			List<Bar3DSectionData> list = new List<Bar3DSectionData>(Sections.Count);
			foreach (CustomBar3DSection section in Sections)
			{
				Bar3DSectionData bar3DSectionData = Bar3DSectionData.CreateInstance(section, ActualLoadFromResources);
				if (bar3DSectionData != null)
				{
					list.Add(bar3DSectionData);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public CustomBar3DModel()
		{
			SetValue(SectionsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<CustomBar3DSectionCollection>(this));
		}

		protected override Bar3DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CustomBar3DModel();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(LoadFromResourcesProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCollectionProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(SectionsProperty);
		}
	}
	public abstract class Bar3DSection : ModelBase
	{
		private Model3D model;

		protected abstract bool IsInternalModel { get; }

		protected internal abstract string ActualSource { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ActualFixedHeight { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ActualAlignByX { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ActualAlignByY { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ActualAlignByZ { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ActualUseViewColor { get; }

		internal Model3D GetModel(bool loadFromResources)
		{
			if (model == null)
			{
				model = Model3DExtractor.Extract(LoadObject(ActualSource, loadFromResources, IsInternalModel));
			}
			return model;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearCache()
		{
			model = null;
		}
	}

		public abstract string ModelName { get; }

	public abstract class PredefinedCandleStick2DModel : CandleStick2DModel
	{
		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => true;

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128));
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = GetPen(pointColor);
			CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout candleStickSeries2DPointLayout = (CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout)layout;
			Rect bounds = candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.Bounds;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.Bounds.Left + candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.Bounds.Width * 0.5, candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.Bounds.Top);
			double num = Math.Abs(candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.ClosePortion - candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.OpenPortion) * bounds.Height;
			double num2 = (1.0 - Math.Max(candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.OpenPortion, candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.ClosePortion)) * bounds.Height;
			if (num < 1.0)
			{
				num2 -= 1.0 - num;
				num = pen.Thickness;
			}
			double num3 = pen.Thickness * 0.5;
			Rect candleRect = new Rect(bounds.Left, point.Y + num2, Math.Max(pen.Thickness, bounds.Width), Math.Max(pen.Thickness, num));
			candleRect.Inflate(0.0 - num3, 0.0 - num3);
			GuidelineSet guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(candleRect.Left + num3);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(candleRect.Right + num3);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(candleRect.Top + num3);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(candleRect.Bottom + num3);
			guidelineSet.Freeze();
			context.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
			if (candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.IsCandleFilled)
			{
				DrawInvertedCandleBody(context, pointColor, pen, candleRect);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawCandleBody(context, pen, candleRect);
			}
			context.Pop();
			double num4 = (candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.IsCandleInverted ? candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.OpenPortion : candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.ClosePortion);
			double num5 = (1.0 - Math.Max(num4, candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.HighPortion)) * bounds.Height;
			double num6 = Math.Abs(num4 - candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.HighPortion) * bounds.Height;
			double num7 = (candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.IsCandleInverted ? candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.ClosePortion : candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.OpenPortion);
			double num8 = (1.0 - Math.Max(num7, candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.LowPortion)) * bounds.Height;
			double num9 = Math.Abs(num7 - candleStickSeries2DPointLayout.LowPortion) * bounds.Height;
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + num5);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + num5 + num6);
			System.Windows.Point p3 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + num8);
			System.Windows.Point p4 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + num8 + num9);
			guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(point.X + num3);
			guidelineSet.Freeze();
			context.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
			context.DrawLine(pen, p, p2);
			context.DrawLine(pen, p3, p4);
			context.Pop();
		}

		protected virtual void DrawInvertedCandleBody(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect candleRect)
		{
			context.DrawRoundedRectangle(GetBrush(color), pen, candleRect, 2.0, 2.0);
		}

		protected virtual void DrawCandleBody(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect candleRect)
		{
			context.DrawRoundedRectangle(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, pen, candleRect, 1.0, 1.0);
		}
	}

	public abstract class PredefinedGeometryStock2DModel : PredefinedStock2DModel
	{
		private SvgImage image;

		private Rect modelBounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 7.0, 5.0);

		private static readonly WpfSvgPalette emptySvgPalette;

		protected abstract string ImageName { get; }

		static PredefinedGeometryStock2DModel()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			emptySvgPalette = new WpfSvgPalette();
			emptySvgPalette.BeginInit();
			emptySvgPalette.EndInit();
		}

		protected virtual void DrawGeometry(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Drawing drawing = WpfSvgRenderer.CreateDrawing(GetSvgImage(ImageName), modelBounds.Size, emptySvgPalette, string.Empty);
			context.DrawDrawing(drawing);
		}

		protected override void DrawOpenCloseMark(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect bounds, StockType stockType, double openElementTop, double closeElementTop)
		{
			double num = (int)(bounds.Width * 0.5 + 0.5);
			double num2 = ((num < modelBounds.Width) ? (num / modelBounds.Width) : 1.0);
			if (stockType != StockType.Close)
			{
				Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
				identity.Scale(num2, num2);
				identity.Translate(bounds.Left + num - modelBounds.Width * num2 - 2.0, openElementTop - modelBounds.Height * 0.5 * num2);
				context.PushTransform(new MatrixTransform(identity));
				DrawGeometry(context, pen.Brush);
				context.Pop();
			}
			if (stockType != StockType.Open)
			{
				Matrix identity2 = Matrix.Identity;
				identity2.Scale(0.0 - num2, num2);
				identity2.Translate(bounds.Right - num + modelBounds.Width * num2 + 2.0, closeElementTop - modelBounds.Height * 0.5 * num2);
				context.PushTransform(new MatrixTransform(identity2));
				DrawGeometry(context, pen.Brush);
				context.Pop();
			}
		}

		protected virtual SvgImage GetSvgImage(string imageName)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (image == null)
			{
				Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(AxisCoordCalculator).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.Charts.GeometricPrimitives.SVG." + imageName);
				if (manifestResourceStream == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("marker image not found");
				}
				image = new SvgImage(manifestResourceStream);
			}
			return image;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PredefinedStock2DModel : Stock2DModel
	{
		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => true;

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128));
		}

		protected virtual void DrawOpenCloseMark(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect bounds, StockType stockType, double openElementTop, double closeElementTop)
		{
			if (stockType != StockType.Close)
			{
				context.DrawLine(pen, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, openElementTop), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + bounds.Width * 0.5, openElementTop));
			}
			if (stockType != StockType.Open)
			{
				context.DrawLine(pen, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + bounds.Width * 0.5, closeElementTop), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right, closeElementTop));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = GetPen(presentationData.PointColor);
			StockSeries2DPointLayout stockSeries2DPointLayout = (StockSeries2DPointLayout)layout;
			Rect bounds = stockSeries2DPointLayout.Bounds;
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + bounds.Width * 0.5, bounds.Top);
			System.Windows.Point p2 = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + bounds.Width * 0.5, bounds.Bottom);
			double openElementTop = stockSeries2DPointLayout.OpenPortion * bounds.Height + bounds.Top;
			double closeElementTop = stockSeries2DPointLayout.ClosePortion * bounds.Height + bounds.Top;
			context.DrawLine(pen, p, p2);
			DrawOpenCloseMark(context, pen, bounds, stockSeries2DPointLayout.ShowOpenClose, openElementTop, closeElementTop);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SimplePredefinedMarker2DModel : PredefinedMarker2DModel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128)
			};
		}

		protected void DrawEllipse(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect bounds)
		{
			Rect rect = ((pen != null) ? RenderUtils.TransformUniformBounds(pen.Thickness, bounds.Size, bounds) : bounds);
			double num = rect.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = rect.Height / 2.0;
			System.Windows.Point center = new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left + num, rect.Top + num2);
			context.DrawEllipse(brush, pen, center, num, num2);
		}
	}

	public abstract class GeometryMarker2DModel : PredefinedMarker2DModel
	{
		private const double width = 10.0;

		private const double height = 10.0;

		protected abstract Geometry Geometry { get; }

		protected internal override bool ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically => false;

		protected internal override bool IsRenderable => true;

		protected override double LineThickness => BorderThickness;

		internal bool ColorFromSeries { get; set; }

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color Color { get; set; }

		internal bool BorderVisible { get; set; }

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color BorderColor { get; set; }

		internal double BorderThickness { get; set; }

		public GeometryMarker2DModel()
		{
			ColorFromSeries = true;
			BorderVisible = true;
			BorderThickness = 0.5;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.499995, 0.0286458),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.499995, 0.971449)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 110, 110, 110), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 146, 146, 146), 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		protected internal override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color;
			if (ColorFromSeries)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
				color = pointColor;
				color.A = (byte)((double)(int)color.A * presentationData.Opacity);
			}
			else
			{
				color = Color;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color penColor = ((!BorderVisible || BorderColor.A <= 0 || !(BorderThickness > 0.0)) ? color : BorderColor);
			Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
			Geometry geometry = Geometry.CloneCurrentValue();
			geometry.Transform = new ScaleTransform(bounds.Width / 10.0, bounds.Height / 10.0);
			context.PushTransform(new TranslateTransform(bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2.0, bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2.0));
			DrawGeometry(context, color, penColor, geometry);
			context.Pop();
		}

		protected internal virtual void DrawGeometry(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Color brushColor, System.Windows.Media.Color penColor, Geometry geometry)
		{
			context.DrawGeometry(GetBrush(brushColor), GetPen(penColor), geometry);
		}
	}
	public class PolygonMarker2DModel : GeometryMarker2DModel
	{
		private Geometry initialGeometry = Geometry.Parse("M 0,5 -4.33,2.5 l 0,-5 L 0,-5 4.33,-2.5 l 0,5 z");

		protected override Geometry Geometry => initialGeometry;

		[Description("Gets the name of the PolygonMarker2DModel.")]
		public override string ModelName => "Polygon";

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.126788, 0.201497),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0826, 0.201497)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 146, 146, 146), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 110, 110, 110), 1.0));
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new SkewTransform(-12.6804, 0.0, 0.126788, 0.201497));
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform(38.66, 0.126788, 0.201497));
			linearGradientBrush.RelativeTransform = transformGroup;
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		{
			return new PolygonMarker2DModel();
		}

		protected override Marker2DModel CreateObjectForClone()

	public abstract class Marker3DModel : ModelBase
	{
		private Model3D model;

		protected abstract bool IsInternalModel { get; }

		protected internal abstract string ActualSource { get; }

		protected abstract bool ActualLoadFromResources { get; }

		[Description("Gets the name of the Marker3DModel.")]
		public abstract string ModelName { get; }

		public static IEnumerable<Marker3DKind> GetPredefinedKinds()
		{
			return Marker3DKind.List;
		}

		internal Model3D GetModel()
		{
			if (model == null)
			{
				model = Model3DExtractor.Extract(LoadObject(ActualSource, ActualLoadFromResources, IsInternalModel));
			}
			return model;
		}

		protected abstract Marker3DModel CreateObjectForClone();

		protected override ModelBase CreateModel()
		{
			return CreateObjectForClone();
		}

		protected internal override void ClearCache()
		{
			model = null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PredefinedMarker3DModel : Marker3DModel
	{
		protected override bool IsInternalModel => true;

		protected override bool ActualLoadFromResources => true;
	}

	public class CustomMarker3DModel : Marker3DModel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LoadFromResourcesProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SourceProperty;

		[Description("Specifies whether the custom model should be loaded from resources. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public bool LoadFromResources
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(LoadFromResourcesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LoadFromResourcesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the source of the CustomMarker3DModel. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public string Source
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(SourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInternalModel => false;

		protected override bool ActualLoadFromResources => LoadFromResources;

		protected internal override string ActualSource => Source;

		[Description("Gets the name of the CustomMarker3DModel.")]
		public override string ModelName => "Custom";

		static CustomMarker3DModel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(CustomMarker3DModel);
			LoadFromResourcesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LoadFromResources", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, ModelBase.PropertyChanged));
			SourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Source", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ModelBase.PropertyChanged));
		}

		protected override Marker3DModel CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CustomMarker3DModel();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(LoadFromResourcesProperty);
			properties.Add(SourceProperty);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ModelBase : DependencyObject, IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner, ICloneable, IBindingPropertiesSource
	{
		private IChartElement owner;

		private const string modelRootPath = "component/Models/";

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				SetOwner(value);
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.Controller;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => GetType().Name;

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			Changed(args);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.Changed(args);
			}
		}

		internal void SetOwner(IChartElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		private static DependencyObject LoadInternal(string source)
		{
			string path = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source) ? string.Empty : System.IO.Path.Combine("component/Models/", source));
			return XamlLoaderHelper<DependencyObject>.LoadFromResource(path);
		}

		private static DependencyObject LoadExternal(string source)
		{
			string path = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source) ? string.Empty : (";component/" + source));
			return XamlLoaderHelper<DependencyObject>.LoadFromUserResource(path);
		}

		protected static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ModelBase modelBase)
			{
				modelBase.ClearCache();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			ModelBase modelBase = CreateModel();
			BindingPropertiesContainer<ModelBase>.Apply(this, modelBase);
			return modelBase;
		}

		object IBindingPropertiesSource.CloneValue(object value)
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		void IBindingPropertiesSource.CollectCollectionProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		protected DependencyObject LoadObject(string source, bool loadFromResources, bool internalModel)
		{
			if (!loadFromResources)
			{
				return XamlLoaderHelper<DependencyObject>.LoadFromFile(source);
			}
			if (internalModel)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = LoadInternal(source);
				if (dependencyObject != null)
				{
					return dependencyObject;
				}
			}
			return LoadExternal(source);
		}

		protected abstract ModelBase CreateModel();

		protected virtual void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract void ClearCache();
	}

		protected abstract string ActualSource { get; }

		protected abstract bool ActualLoadFromResources { get; }

		[Description("Gets the name of the Pie3DModel.")]
		public abstract string ModelName { get; }

		public static IEnumerable<Pie3DKind> GetPredefinedKinds()
		{
			return Pie3DKind.List;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Size GetSize()
		{
			return GetPolyline()?.RenderedGeometry.Bounds.Size ?? System.Windows.Size.Empty;
		}

		internal Polyline GetPolyline()
		{
			if (polyline == null)
			{
				polyline = ShapeExtractor.ExtractPolyline(LoadObject(ActualSource, ActualLoadFromResources, IsInternalModel));
			}
			return polyline;
		}

		protected abstract Pie3DModel CreateObjectForClone();

		protected override ModelBase CreateModel()
		{
			return CreateObjectForClone();
		}

		protected internal override void ClearCache()
		{
			polyline = null;
		}
	}

	public class VisualContainer : ChartElementBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DiagramProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Diagram", typeof(Diagram), typeof(VisualContainer), new PropertyMetadata(DiagramChanged));

		private DrawingVisual visual2D = new DrawingVisual();

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public Diagram Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				return (Diagram)GetValue(DiagramProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DiagramProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount => 1;

		internal Rect Bounds => new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), base.DesiredSize);

		[Description("")]
		public DrawingVisual Visual2D => visual2D;

		private static void DiagramChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Diagram3D diagram3D = (Diagram3D)e.NewValue;
			Diagram3D diagram3D2 = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Diagram3D>(d);
			bool flag = false;
			if (diagram3D is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				if (diagram3D2 == null || diagram3D2 == diagram3D)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (diagram3D is SimpleDiagram3D && diagram3D2 != null && diagram3D2 == diagram3D)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				diagram3D.VisualContainers.RemoveAll((VisualContainer container) => !(container.DataContext is Series));
				diagram3D.VisualContainers.Add((VisualContainer)d);
				diagram3D.InvalidateVisual();
			}
		}

		public VisualContainer()
		{
			AddVisualChild(visual2D);
			AddLogicalChild(visual2D);
		}

		protected T GetParent<T>(DependencyObject obj) where T : class
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (obj is T)
			{
				return obj as T;
			}
			DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(obj);
			return GetParent<T>(parent);
		}

		protected virtual void Initialize()
		{
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			return visual2D;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, null, Bounds);
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size
			{
				Width = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? 0.0 : Math.Floor(availableSize.Width)),
				Height = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? 0.0 : Math.Floor(availableSize.Height))
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			return arrangeBounds;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			VisualCollection.Enumerator enumerator = visual2D.Children.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				Visual current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current is DrawingVisual drawingVisual)
				{
					drawingVisual.Children.Clear();
				}
			}
			visual2D.Children.Clear();
		}

		public void AddVisual(Visual visual)
		{
			visual2D.Children.Add(visual);
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public abstract class SeriesLabel2DLayout : ILayout
	{
		private readonly SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem;

		private readonly GRealPoint2D anchorPoint;

		private Rect clipBounds = Rect.Empty;

		private DXRectangle labelBounds;

		protected SeriesLabelItemBase LabelItem => labelItem;

		protected internal abstract bool IsVisibleForResolveOverlapping { get; }

		internal GRealPoint2D AnchorPoint => anchorPoint;

		internal DXRectangle LabelBounds
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return labelBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				labelBounds = value;
			}
		}

		public Rect Bounds => new Rect(((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top, labelItem.LabelSize.Width, labelItem.LabelSize.Height);

		public bool CanClip => true;

		public Rect ClipBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return clipBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				clipBounds = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract bool Visible { get; }

		System.Windows.Point ILayout.Location => new System.Windows.Point(((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top);

		System.Windows.Size ILayout.Size => labelItem.LabelSize;

		double ILayout.Angle => 0.0;

		Rect[] ILayout.ClipRects => new Rect[1] { clipBounds };

		private static System.Windows.Point CalculateCenterPoint(System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, System.Windows.Size labelSize, double indent, double angle)
		{
			double num = Math.Sin(angle);
			double num2 = Math.Cos(angle);
			double num3 = labelSize.Width / 2.0;
			double num4 = labelSize.Height / 2.0;
			double num5 = indent;
			num5 = ((num4 + num == num4) ? (num5 + Math.Abs(num3 / num2)) : ((num3 + num2 != num3) ? (num5 + Math.Min(Math.Abs(num3 / num2), Math.Abs(num4 / num))) : (num5 + Math.Abs(num4 / num))));
			return new System.Windows.Point(anchorPoint.X + num5 * num2, anchorPoint.Y + num5 * num);
		}

		private SeriesLabel2DLayout(SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint)
		{
			this.labelItem = labelItem;
			this.anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(anchorPoint.X, anchorPoint.Y);
		}

		protected SeriesLabel2DLayout(SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, double indent, double angle)
			: this(labelItem, anchorPoint)
		{
			CalculateLabelBounds(CalculateCenterPoint(anchorPoint, labelItem.LabelSize, indent, angle));
		}

		protected SeriesLabel2DLayout(SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, System.Windows.Point centerPoint)
			: this(labelItem, anchorPoint)
		{
			CalculateLabelBounds(centerPoint);
		}

		private void CalculateLabelBounds(System.Windows.Point centerPoint)
		{
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(labelItem.LabelSize.Width);
			Rect rect = new Rect(centerPoint.X - (double)num / 2.0, centerPoint.Y - labelItem.LabelSize.Height / 2.0, num, labelItem.LabelSize.Height);
			LabelBounds = GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(rect);
		}
	}

		private readonly Rect viewport;

		private readonly bool edgeLabel;

		private bool isVisibleForResolveOverlapping;

		DXRectangle ILabelLayout.LabelBounds
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return base.LabelBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				base.LabelBounds = value;
			}
		}

		bool ILabelLayout.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return IsVisibleForResolveOverlapping;
			}
			set
			{
				isVisibleForResolveOverlapping = value;
			}
		}

		DXPoint IXYDiagramLabelLayout.AnchorPoint => new DXPoint(MathUtils.StrongRound(base.AnchorPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(base.AnchorPoint.Y));

		DXRectangle IXYDiagramLabelLayout.ExcludedRectangle => excludedRectangle;

		DXRectangle IXYDiagramLabelLayout.ValidRectangle => validRectangle;

		ResolveOverlappingModeCore IXYDiagramLabelLayout.ResolveOverlappingMode => resolveOverlappingMode;

		protected internal override bool IsVisibleForResolveOverlapping
		{
			get
			{
				if (isVisibleForResolveOverlapping)
				{
					if (!viewport.Contains(base.AnchorPoint.X, base.AnchorPoint.Y))
					{
						return viewport.IntersectsWith(base.Bounds);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DXRectangle ValidRectangle => validRectangle;

		public override bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (isVisibleForResolveOverlapping)
				{
					if ((!edgeLabel || !viewport.Contains(base.AnchorPoint.X, base.AnchorPoint.Y)) && isNavigationEnabled)
					{
						return viewport.IntersectsWith(base.Bounds);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

	public class AreaFullStackedSeries2D : AreaStackedSeries2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PercentOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("PercentOptions", typeof(PercentOptions), typeof(AreaFullStackedSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(PointOptions.PercentOptionsPropertyChanged));

		protected internal override ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter ToolTipPointValuesConverter => new ToolTipFullStackedValueToStringConverter(this);

		protected override Type PointInterfaceType => typeof(IFullStackedPoint);

		protected override string DefaultLabelTextPattern => "{VP:G4}";

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public new bool ColorEach
		{
			get
			{
				return base.ColorEach;
			}
			set
			{
				base.ColorEach = value;
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("The PercentOptions property is obsolete now. Use the SeriesLabel.TextPattern property instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static PercentOptions GetPercentOptions(PointOptions pointOptions)
		{
			return (PercentOptions)pointOptions.GetValue(PercentOptionsProperty);
		}

		[Obsolete("The PercentOptions property is obsolete now. Use the SeriesLabel.TextPattern property instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void SetPercentOptions(PointOptions pointOptions, PercentOptions value)
		{
			pointOptions.SetValue(PercentOptionsProperty, value);
		}

		public AreaFullStackedSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AreaFullStackedSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AreaFullStackedSeries2D();
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IStackedPoint refinedPoint = labelItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point? point = RangeArea2DHelper.CalculateLabelAnchorPoint(this, mapping, labelItem, new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.MinValue, refinedPoint.MaxValue), transform, labelItem.Label.PointCalculator);
				if (point.HasValue)
				{
					return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, point.Value, DXRectangle.Empty);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			IFullStackedPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = ((refinedPoint == null) ? new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.Value) : new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.MinValue, refinedPoint.MaxValue));
			double num = MathUtils.CalculateCenterValueByRange(((IAxisData)base.ActualAxisY).VisualRange, minMaxValues);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return transform.Transform(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, num));
			}
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		protected internal override bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override SeriesContainer CreateContainer()
		{
			return new FullStackedInteractionContainer(this, isContinuousView: true);
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			PercentOptions percentOptions = pointOptionsContainer.GetPercentOptions(PercentOptionsProperty);
			return pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValuePatternFromPercentOptions(percentOptions, valueScaleType);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.FullStackedSeriesPointPatterns;
		}
	}

	public class AreaSeries3D : XYSeries3D, IGeometryHolder
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AreaWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaterialProperty;

		private Material actualMaterial;

		[Description("Gets the actual material which is used to draw a 3D Area Series.")]
		public Material ActualMaterial => actualMaterial;

		[Description("Gets or sets the depth of a slice that represents the 3D area series (the extent of the area series along the Z-axis).")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double AreaWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(AreaWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AreaWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a material to draw the 3D Area Series.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		public Material Material
		{
			get
			{
				return (Material)GetValue(MaterialProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaterialProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public new bool ColorEach
		{
			get
			{
				return base.ColorEach;
			}
			set
			{
				base.ColorEach = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSortPoints => true;

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(XYDiagram3D);

		protected internal override double SeriesDepth => AreaWidth;

		protected internal override bool ActualColorEach => false;

		protected internal override bool IsPredefinedModelUses => Material == null;

		static AreaSeries3D()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(AreaSeries3D);
			AreaWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AreaWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.6, Series.UpdateSeriesPropertyWithClearDiagramCache), AreaWidthValidation);
			MaterialProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Material", typeof(Material), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, MaterialPropertyChanged));
		}

		private static bool AreaWidthValidation(object areaWidth)
		{
			return (double)areaWidth > 0.0;
		}

		private static void MaterialPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AreaSeries3D areaSeries3D = (AreaSeries3D)d;
			if (areaSeries3D != null)
			{
				Material material = e.NewValue as Material;
				areaSeries3D.actualMaterial = ((material == null) ? CreateDefaultMaterial() : material);
			}
			Series.UpdateSeriesCloneablePropertyWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static Material CreateDefaultMaterial()
		{
			MaterialGroup materialGroup = new MaterialGroup();
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128))));
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new SpecularMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(229, 229, 229)), 56.0));
			return materialGroup;
		}

		public AreaSeries3D()
		{
			actualMaterial = CreateDefaultMaterial();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AreaSeries3D>(this);
		}

		GeometryStripCreator IGeometryHolder.CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return CreateStripCreator();
		}

		protected virtual GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return new AreaGeometryStripCreator();
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new AreaSeries3D();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(AreaWidthProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MaterialProperty);
		}

		protected override object CloneValue(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is Material material))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return material.CloneCurrentValue();
		}

		protected internal override SeriesData CreateSeriesData()
		{
			base.SeriesData = new AreaSeries3DData(this);
			return base.SeriesData;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(string argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(DateTime argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

		public SeriesPoint AddPoint(TimeSpan argument, double value)
		{
			SeriesPoint result = new SeriesPoint(argument, value);
			base.Points.Add(result);
			return result;
		}

	public class BarStackedSeries2D : BarSeries2D, IStackedView
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TotalLabelProperty;

		protected virtual bool IsOverlapBars
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Model == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Model.ActualOverlapBars;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldAnimateClipBounds => IsOverlapBars;

		protected override bool NeedSeriesInteraction => true;

		protected override Type PointInterfaceType => typeof(IStackedPoint);

		protected internal override bool LabelsResolveOverlappingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = GetTotalLabel((Pane)ActualPane);
				if (!base.LabelsResolveOverlappingEnabled)
				{
					if (totalLabel != null)
					{
						return totalLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		static BarStackedSeries2D()
		{
			TotalLabelProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("TotalLabel", typeof(StackedBarTotalLabel), typeof(BarStackedSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(TotalLabelProperty);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(TotalLabelProperty);
		}

		[Category("Elements")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public static StackedBarTotalLabel GetTotalLabel(Pane pane)
		{
			return (StackedBarTotalLabel)pane.GetValue(TotalLabelProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTotalLabel(Pane pane, StackedBarTotalLabel label)
		{
			pane.SetValue(TotalLabelProperty, label);
		}

		internal static double GetTotalValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (refinedPoint != null && !double.IsNaN(((IFullStackedPoint)refinedPoint).TotalValue))
			{
				return ((IFullStackedPoint)refinedPoint).TotalValue;
			}
			return ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint)?.TotalValue ?? 0.0;
		}

		public BarStackedSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BarStackedSeries2D>(this);
		}

		private double GetMaxValue(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return ((IStackedPoint)pointInfo).TotalValue;
		}

		protected virtual double GetPointMinBound(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override double GetLowValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint).MinValue;
		}

		protected override double GetHighValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint).MaxValue;
		}

		protected override double GetBarWidth(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return base.BarWidth;
		}

		protected override int GetFixedOffset(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected override double GetDisplayOffset(RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BarStackedSeries2D();
		}

		protected override Rect CalculateSeriesPointBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			if (!IsOverlapBars)
			{
				return base.CalculateSeriesPointBounds(mapping, pointInfo);
			}
			return CalculateSeriesPointBounds(mapping, pointInfo, GetPointMinBound(pointInfo), GetMaxValue(pointInfo));
		}

		protected override Rect? CalculateSeriesPointClipBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem, Rect viewport, Rect barBounds)
		{
			if (IsOverlapBars)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
				Rect rect = CalculateSeriesPointBounds(mapping, refinedPoint, GetLowValue(refinedPoint), GetHighValue(refinedPoint));
				return new Rect(rect.Left - 1.0, rect.Top, rect.Width + 2.0, rect.Height);
			}
			return base.CalculateSeriesPointClipBounds(mapping, pointItem, viewport, barBounds);
		}

		protected override Bar2DLabelPosition GetSeriesLabelPosition(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return Bar2DLabelPosition.Center;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase CreateDefaultPointAnimation()
		{
			return new Bar2DDropInAnimation();
		}

		protected internal override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateTotalLabelLayout(StackedBarTotalLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (labelItem.RefinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Bar2D? bar2D = CalculateBar(mapping, labelItem.PointItem.RefinedPoint, isLabelInCenter: false);
			if (!bar2D.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point labelAnchorPoint = GetLabelAnchorPoint(labelItem.PointItem, ScreenPointCalculator.Instance, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter: false, bar2D.Value);
			double labelAngle = GetLabelAngle(labelItem, mapping);
			return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, labelAnchorPoint, labelItem.Label.Indent, labelAngle, DXRectangle.Empty);
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.StackedSeriesPointPatterns;
		}

		protected internal override MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxPointRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram diagram, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			IStackedPoint refinedPoint = point.RefinedPoint;
			double maxValue = refinedPoint.MaxValue;
			double minValue = refinedPoint.MinValue;
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, snapMode, minValue, maxValue);
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Abs(((IValuePoint)point).Value);
		}

		protected override SeriesContainer CreateContainer()
		{
			return new StackedInteractionContainer(this);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<double> GetCrosshairValues(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			yield return ((IStackedPoint)refinedPoint).MaxValue;
		}
	}

	}

	public class DataFilter : ChartNonVisualElement, IDataFilter, ICloneable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnNameProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ConditionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty;

		private bool required;

		private Type actualDataType;

		private object actualValue;

		private Series Series => (Series)((IOwnedElement)this).Owner;

		internal Type ActualType => actualDataType;

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the data field which the filter condition is applied to.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ColumnName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ColumnNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ColumnNameProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the data type of the value associated with the current data filter object.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DataTypeTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Type DataType
		{
			get
			{
				return (Type)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(DataTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(DataTypeProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the comparison operator used to filter the data points within a series.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public DataFilterCondition Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataFilterCondition)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ConditionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ConditionProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the filter value represented by the current data filter item.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ValueTypeConverter))]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		DevExpress.Charts.Native.Condition IDataFilter.Condition => (DevExpress.Charts.Native.Condition)Condition;

		Type IDataFilter.DataType => actualDataType;

		bool IDataFilter.Required => required;

		object IDataFilter.Value => actualValue;

		static DataFilter()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(DataFilter);
			ColumnNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ColumnName", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, ColumnNameChanged));
			DataTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DataType", typeof(Type), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(DataTypeChanged));
			ConditionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Condition", typeof(DataFilterCondition), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(DataFilterCondition.Equal, ConditionChanged));
			ValueProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, ValueChanged));
		}

		private static object ConvertToCompatibleValue(IDataFilter dataFilter, object value)
		{
			if (dataFilter.DataType != null && value != null && value.GetType() != dataFilter.DataType)
			{
				return TypeConversion.ConvertToCompatibleValue(value, dataFilter.DataType);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void ColumnNameChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DataFilter { Series: not null } dataFilter)
			{
				if (dataFilter.DataType == null)
				{
					dataFilter.actualDataType = BindingHelperCore.GetMemberType(null, dataFilter.Series.GetDataSource(), dataFilter.ColumnName, dataFilter.Series.GetCalculatedFields());
					dataFilter.actualValue = ConvertToCompatibleValue(dataFilter, dataFilter.Value);
				}
				dataFilter.Series.SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		private static void DataTypeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DataFilter dataFilter)
			{
				dataFilter.actualDataType = (Type)e.NewValue;
				dataFilter.actualValue = ConvertToCompatibleValue(dataFilter, dataFilter.Value);
				if (dataFilter.Series != null)
				{
					dataFilter.Series.SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		private static void ConditionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DataFilter { Series: not null } dataFilter)
			{
				dataFilter.Series.SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		private static void ValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DataFilter dataFilter)
			{
				dataFilter.actualValue = ConvertToCompatibleValue(dataFilter, e.NewValue);
				if (dataFilter.Series != null)
				{
					dataFilter.Series.SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
		}

		internal DataFilter(string columnName, string dataTypeName, DataFilterCondition condition, object val, bool required)
		{
			ColumnName = columnName;
			if (dataTypeName != null)
			{
				DataType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(dataTypeName, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)false);
			}
			Condition = condition;
			Value = ConvertToCompatibleValue(this, val);
			this.required = required;
		}

		public DataFilter(string columnName, string dataTypeName, DataFilterCondition condition, object val)
			: this(columnName, dataTypeName, condition, val, required: false)
		{
		}

		public DataFilter()
		{
		}

		CriteriaOperator IDataFilter.ToCriteriaOperator()
		{
			return DataFilterToCriteriaConverter.Convert(this);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			DataFilter dataFilter = new DataFilter(ColumnName, (DataType == null) ? null : DataType.ToString(), Condition, Value, required);
			dataFilter.actualDataType = actualDataType;
			dataFilter.actualValue = actualValue;
			return dataFilter;
		}

		internal void UpdateActualParams()
		{
			actualDataType = BindingHelperCore.GetMemberType(null, Series.GetDataSource(), ColumnName, Series.GetCalculatedFields());
			actualValue = ConvertToCompatibleValue(this, Value);
		}
	}
	public class DataFilterCollection : ChartElementCollection<DataFilter>, IEnumerable<IDataFilter>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected override ChartElementChange Change => ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding;

		IEnumerator<IDataFilter> IEnumerable<IDataFilter>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			using IEnumerator<DataFilter> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return enumerator.Current;
			}
		}
	}
	public enum CandleStickFillMode
	{
		FilledOnReduction,
		FilledOnIncrease,
		AlwaysEmpty,
		AlwaysFilled
	}
	public class CandleStickSeries2D : FinancialSeries2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FillModeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CandleWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModelProperty;

		protected override double BarWidth => CandleWidth;

		protected override bool SupportsNativeRendering
		{
			get
			{
				if (Model != null)
				{
					return Model.IsRenderable;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value specifying the width (in axis units) of the candle in 2D Candle Stick series.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double CandleWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(CandleWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CandleWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the model used to draw elements of a 2D Candle Stick Series.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public CandleStick2DModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return (CandleStick2DModel)GetValue(ModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static CandleStickSeries2D()
		{
			FillModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("FillMode", typeof(CandleStickFillMode), typeof(CandleStickSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(CandleStickFillMode.FilledOnReduction, UpdateReductionOptionsProperty));
			CandleWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CandleWidth", typeof(double), typeof(CandleStickSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.5, Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)CandleWidthValidation);
			ModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Model", typeof(CandleStick2DModel), typeof(CandleStickSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(FillModeProperty);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(FillModeProperty);
		}

		private static bool CandleWidthValidation(object candleWidth)
		{
			return (double)candleWidth > 0.0;
		}

		private static void UpdateReductionOptionsProperty(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ReductionStockOptions reductionStockOptions)
			{
				reductionStockOptions.UpdateProperty(FillModeProperty.Name);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static CandleStickFillMode GetFillMode(ReductionStockOptions options)
		{
			return (CandleStickFillMode)options.GetValue(FillModeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetFillMode(ReductionStockOptions options, CandleStickFillMode value)
		{
			options.SetValue(FillModeProperty, value);
		}

		public CandleStickSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<CandleStickSeries2D>(this);
		}

		private bool IsCandleFilledInverted(IFinancialPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			switch (GetFillMode(base.ActualReductionOptions))
			{
			case CandleStickFillMode.AlwaysEmpty:
				return false;
			case CandleStickFillMode.FilledOnIncrease:
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return refinedPoint.Close > refinedPoint.Open;
			case CandleStickFillMode.FilledOnReduction:
				if (refinedPoint == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return refinedPoint.Close < refinedPoint.Open;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new CandleStickSeries2D();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(CandleWidthProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ModelProperty);
		}

		protected override int CalculateSeriesPointWidth(IAxisMappingCore mapping)
		{
			return Math.Max(1, mapping.GetRoundedInterval(CandleWidth));
		}

		protected override void CorrectOpenClosePositions(ref double openPosition, ref double closePosition)
		{
			Render2DHelper.CorrectBounds(ref openPosition, ref closePosition);
		}

		protected override FinancialSeries2DPointLayout CreateFinancialSeriesPointLayout(IFinancialPoint refinedPoint, Rect viewport, Rect bounds, FinancialLayoutPortions layoutPortions)
		{
			bool isCandleFilled = IsCandleFilledInverted(refinedPoint);
			bool isCandleInverted = refinedPoint != null && refinedPoint.Close < refinedPoint.Open;
			return new CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout(viewport, bounds, layoutPortions, isCandleInverted, isCandleFilled);
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return Model;
		}
	}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color ThemedRisingColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Container == null || base.Container.PlatformElement == null)
				{
					return DefaultColor;
				}
				ChartBrushesThemeKeyExtension obj = new ChartBrushesThemeKeyExtension
				{
					ResourceKey = ChartBrushesThemeKeys.FinancialRisingBrush
				};
				((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = CommonThemeHelper.GetEditorThemeName((DependencyObject)base.Container.PlatformElement);
				ChartBrushesThemeKeyExtension resourceKey = obj;
				object obj2 = base.Container.PlatformElement.TryFindResource(resourceKey);
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					return ((SolidColorBrush)obj2).Color;
				}
				return DefaultColor;
			}
		}

			OpenValueDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("OpenValueDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(FinancialSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));

		private static void ReductionStockOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as ReductionStockOptions, e.NewValue as ReductionStockOptions, d as FinancialSeries2D);
			Series.UpdateSeriesCloneableProperty(d, e);
			FinancialSeries2D series = (FinancialSeries2D)d;
			ReductionStockOptions reductionStockOptions = (ReductionStockOptions)e.NewValue;
			reductionStockOptions.Series = series;
		}

		private double GetReductionValue(IFinancialPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			switch (ActualReductionOptions.Level)
			{
			case StockLevel.LowValue:
				return refinedPoint.Low;
			case StockLevel.HighValue:
				return refinedPoint.High;
			case StockLevel.OpenValue:
				return refinedPoint.Open;
			case StockLevel.CloseValue:
				return refinedPoint.Close;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown StockLevel value.");
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		private double GetFinancialValuePortion(double value, double bottomValue, double topValue)
		{
			double num = topValue - bottomValue;
			double num2 = ((num != 0.0) ? ((value - bottomValue) / num) : 0.0);
			if (!IsAxisYReversed)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return 1.0 - num2;
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)

		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is ReductionStockOptions)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			IFinancialPoint refinedPoint = labelItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double value = Math.Max(Math.Max(refinedPoint.Low, refinedPoint.High), Math.Max(refinedPoint.Open, refinedPoint.Close));
			System.Windows.Point point = transform.Transform(labelItem.Label.PointCalculator.CorrectPointByViewport(mapping, refinedPoint.Argument, value));
			bool flag = ((IAxisData)base.ActualAxisY)?.Reverse ?? false;
			System.Windows.Point centerPoint = point;
			if (mapping.Rotated)
			{
				centerPoint.X += (double)((!flag) ? 1 : (-1)) * ((double)base.ActualLabel.Indent + labelItem.LabelSize.Width / 2.0);
			}
			else
			{
				centerPoint.Y += (double)(flag ? 1 : (-1)) * ((double)base.ActualLabel.Indent + labelItem.LabelSize.Height / 2.0);
			}
			return labelItem.Label.CreateLayout(labelItem, point, mapping, centerPoint);
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{

			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Stock2DSlideFromRightAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Stock2DSlideFromTopAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Stock2DSlideFromBottomAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Stock2DExpandAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Stock2DFadeInAnimation)));
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			IFinancialPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IAxisMappingCore axisYMapping = mapping.AxisYMapping;
			double bound = axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(refinedPoint.High);
			double bound2 = axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(refinedPoint.Low);
			Render2DHelper.CorrectBounds(ref bound, ref bound2);
			double openPosition = axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(refinedPoint.Open);
			double closePosition = axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(refinedPoint.Close);
			CorrectOpenClosePositions(ref openPosition, ref closePosition);
			double num = Math.Max(Math.Max(bound2, bound), Math.Max(openPosition, closePosition));
			double num2 = Math.Min(Math.Min(bound2, bound), Math.Min(openPosition, closePosition));
			double financialValuePortion = GetFinancialValuePortion(bound2, num2, num);
			double financialValuePortion2 = GetFinancialValuePortion(bound, num2, num);
			double financialValuePortion3 = GetFinancialValuePortion(openPosition, num2, num);
			double financialValuePortion4 = GetFinancialValuePortion(closePosition, num2, num);
			int num3 = CalculateSeriesPointWidth(mapping.AxisXMapping);
			if (num3 % 2 == 0)
			{
				num3 = Math.Max(1, num3 - 1);
			}
			double num4 = mapping.AxisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(refinedPoint.Argument);
			if (MathUtils.StrongRound(num3) % 2 != 0)
			{
				num4 += 0.5;
			}
			Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, mapping.Viewport.Width, mapping.Viewport.Height);
			Rect bounds = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num4 - (double)num3 / 2.0, num), new System.Windows.Point(num4 + (double)num3 / 2.0, num2));
			bounds.Height = Math.Max(bounds.Height, 1.0);
			return CreateFinancialSeriesPointLayout(refinedPoint, viewport, bounds, new FinancialLayoutPortions(financialValuePortion, financialValuePortion2, financialValuePortion3, financialValuePortion4));
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)

		}

		}

		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)

			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Color GetPointOriginalColorForCustomDraw(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, int pointIndex, System.Windows.Media.Color seriesColor, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			if (pointIndex == 0)
			{
				return seriesColor;
			}
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[pointIndex];
			if (refinedPoint == null || refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				return seriesColor;
			}
			ReductionStockOptions actualReductionOptions = ActualReductionOptions;
			if (actualReductionOptions.Enabled)
			{
				if (actualReductionOptions.ColorMode == ReductionColorMode.PreviousToCurrentPoint)
				{
					while (--pointIndex >= 0)
					{
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = points[pointIndex];
						if (refinedPoint2 != null && !refinedPoint2.IsEmpty)
						{
							if (!(GetReductionValue(refinedPoint) < GetReductionValue(refinedPoint2)))
							{
								return seriesColor;
							}
							return actualReductionOptions.ActualBrush.Color;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (actualReductionOptions.ColorMode == ReductionColorMode.OpenToCloseValue)
				{
					if (!(((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Close < ((IFinancialPoint)refinedPoint).Open))
					{
						return seriesColor;
					}
					return actualReductionOptions.ActualBrush.Color;
				}
			}
			return seriesColor;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetPenBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram = base.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Stock2DAnimationBase animation = GetActualPointAnimation() as Stock2DAnimationBase;
			bool shouldFlipSeriesPoint = IsAxisYReversed;
			PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(pointItem, null, delegate(IPresentation layout)
			{
				if (layout is FinancialSeries2DPointLayout { InitialBounds: var rect } financialSeries2DPointLayout)
				{
					if (animation != null)
					{
						double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
						rect = animation.CreateAnimatedStockBounds(rect, financialSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, diagram.Rotated, actualProgress);
					}
					Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
					if (shouldFlipSeriesPoint)
					{
						double centerY = rect.Height / 2.0 + (base.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry ? rect.Top : 0.0);
						identity.ScaleAt(1.0, -1.0, 0.0, centerY);
					}
					financialSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(rect, identity);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			IFinancialPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			double value = Math.Max(Math.Max(refinedPoint.Low, refinedPoint.High), Math.Max(refinedPoint.Open, refinedPoint.Close));
			return transform.Transform(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, value));
		}

		{

		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			StockLevel stockLevel = (StockLevel)pointOptionsContainer.PointOptions.GetValue(ValueToDisplayProperty);
			string text = pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValueFormat(valueScaleType);
			string text2 = "V";
			switch (stockLevel)
			{
			case StockLevel.LowValue:
				text2 = "LV";
				break;
			case StockLevel.HighValue:
				text2 = "HV";
				break;
			case StockLevel.OpenValue:
				text2 = "OV";
				break;
			case StockLevel.CloseValue:
				text2 = "CV";
				break;
			}
			return "{" + text2 + text + "}";
		}

		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.FinancialViewPointPatterns;
		}

	public class FinancialLayoutPortions
	{
		private readonly double low;

		private readonly double high;

		private readonly double open;

		private readonly double close;

		[Description("")]
		public double Low => low;

		[Description("")]
		public double High => high;

		[Description("")]
		public double Open => open;

		[Description("")]
		public double Close => close;

		public FinancialLayoutPortions(double lowPortion, double highPortion, double openPortion, double closePortion)
		{
			low = lowPortion;
			high = highPortion;
			open = openPortion;
			close = closePortion;
		}
	}
