		protected override void CorrectOpenClosePositions(ref double openPosition, ref double closePosition)
		{
			openPosition = (double)MathUtils.StrongRound(openPosition) + 0.5;
			closePosition = (double)MathUtils.StrongRound(closePosition) + 0.5;
		}

		protected override FinancialSeries2DPointLayout CreateFinancialSeriesPointLayout(IFinancialPoint refinedPoint, Rect viewport, Rect bounds, FinancialLayoutPortions layoutPortions)
		{
			return new StockSeries2DPointLayout(viewport, bounds, layoutPortions, ShowOpenClose);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count = {Count}")]
	public class SeriesPointCollection : ChartElementCollection<SeriesPoint>, IList<SeriesPoint>, ICollection<SeriesPoint>, IEnumerable<SeriesPoint>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection
	{
		private class SeriesPointEnumerator : IEnumerator<SeriesPoint>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly IList<SeriesPoint> collection;

			private int currentIndex;

			public object Current => collection[currentIndex];

			SeriesPoint IEnumerator<SeriesPoint>.Current => collection[currentIndex];

			public SeriesPointEnumerator(IList<SeriesPoint> collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return ++currentIndex < collection.Count;
			}
		}

		private IList<IDataPoint> boundPoints;

		private Series Series => base.Owner as Series;

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateLogicalTree => false;

		protected override bool BatchUpdateSupported => true;

		protected override bool Loading
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series != null && Series.Diagram != null && Series.Diagram.Container != null)
				{
					return Series.Diagram.Container.Loading;
				}
				return base.Loading;
			}
		}

		protected override ChartElementChange Change => ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache;

		internal bool IsBoundPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (boundPoints != null)
				{
					return boundPoints.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public new int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsBoundPoints)
				{
					return base.Count;
				}
				return boundPoints.Count;
			}
		}

		public new SeriesPoint this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsBoundPoints)
				{
					if (boundPoints[index] is LightSeriesPoint || boundPoints[index] is RefinedPoint)
					{
						ReplaceBoundPoint(index);
					}
					return (SeriesPoint)boundPoints[index];
				}
				return base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				CheckUnboundMode();
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		int ICollection.Count => Count;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = (SeriesPoint)value;
			}
		}

		int ICollection<SeriesPoint>.Count => Count;

		SeriesPoint IList<SeriesPoint>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = value;
			}
		}

		internal static SeriesPointCollection CreateInstance(IChartElement owner, IList<IDataPoint> boundPoints)
		{
			SeriesPointCollection seriesPointCollection = ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<SeriesPointCollection>(owner);
			seriesPointCollection.boundPoints = boundPoints;
			return seriesPointCollection;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int count = Count;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = arrayIndex;
			while (num < count)
			{
				array.SetValue(this[num], num2);
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is SeriesPoint point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Contains(point);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is SeriesPoint point))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexOf(point);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value is SeriesPoint point)
			{
				Insert(index, point);
			}
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value is SeriesPoint point)
			{
				Remove(point);
			}
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		IEnumerator<SeriesPoint> IEnumerable<SeriesPoint>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		bool ICollection<SeriesPoint>.Contains(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return Contains(point);
		}

		bool ICollection<SeriesPoint>.Remove(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (!Contains(point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Remove(point);
			return true;
		}

		void ICollection<SeriesPoint>.CopyTo(SeriesPoint[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		int IList<SeriesPoint>.IndexOf(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return IndexOf(point);
		}

		void IList<SeriesPoint>.Insert(int index, SeriesPoint point)
		{
			Insert(index, point);
		}

		private void ReplaceBoundPoint(int index)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(boundPoints[index]);
			ChartUpdate updateInfo = new ChartUpdate(new ReplaceSeriesPointUpdateInfo(this, Series, seriesPoint, index));
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)Series, updateInfo);
			boundPoints[index] = seriesPoint;
		}

		private void CheckUnboundMode()
		{
			if (IsBoundPoints)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPointsCreation));
			}
		}

		internal void ClearInternal(bool clearBoundPoints = false)
		{
			if (clearBoundPoints)
			{
				boundPoints?.Clear();
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		internal void AddRange(IList<ISeriesPoint> items)
		{
			if (items.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginInit();
			foreach (SeriesPoint item in items)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
			EndInit();
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, SeriesPoint item)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.MoveItem(oldIndex, newIndex);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, SeriesPoint item)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			if ((action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && newItems != null && newItems.Count > 1) || (action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 1))
			{
				return new SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), Series, GetCollection<IDataPoint>(oldItems), oldStartingIndex, GetCollection<IDataPoint>(newItems), newStartingIndex);
			}
			IDataPoint oldItem = ((oldItems != null && oldItems.Count > 0) ? (oldItems[0] as IDataPoint) : null);
			IDataPoint newItem = ((newItems != null && newItems.Count > 0) ? (newItems[0] as IDataPoint) : null);
			return new SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo(this, GetOperation(action), Series, oldItem, oldStartingIndex, newItem, newStartingIndex);
		}

		protected override void SetOwnerForChildren(IList children, IChartElement owner)
		{
			if (!IsBoundPoints)
			{
				base.SetOwnerForChildren(children, owner);
			}
		}

		public new void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public new void Remove(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.Remove(point);
		}

		public new void Insert(int index, SeriesPoint point)
		{
			CheckUnboundMode();
			base.Insert(index, point);
		}

		public new int IndexOf(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (IsBoundPoints)
			{
				int count = Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (this[i] == point)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return base.IndexOf(point);
		}

		public new bool Contains(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return IndexOf(point) >= 0;
		}

		public new void CopyTo(SeriesPoint[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			int count = Count;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = arrayIndex;
			while (num < count)
			{
				array[num2] = this[num];
				num++;
				num2++;
			}
		}

		public new IEnumerator<SeriesPoint> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new SeriesPointEnumerator(this);
		}
	}

	public class BubbleSeries3D : MarkerSeries3D, IXYWSeriesView, IXYSeriesView, ISeriesView
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty WeightProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueToDisplayProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxSizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinSizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty WeightDataMemberProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoSizeProperty;

		private double ActualMaxSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (AutoSize && base.Diagram is XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D)
				{
					double delta = ((IMinMaxValues)xYDiagram3D.ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData).Delta;
					System.Windows.Size size = xYDiagram3D.ActualViewport.Size;
					double automaticMaxSize = BubbleUtils.GetAutomaticMaxSize(BubbleSizeUnitCore.AxisXMeasureUnit, new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height), delta);
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(automaticMaxSize))
					{
						return automaticMaxSize;
					}
				}
				return MaxSize;
			}
		}

		private double ActualMinSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (AutoSize && base.Diagram is XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D)
				{
					double delta = ((IMinMaxValues)xYDiagram3D.ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData).Delta;
					System.Windows.Size size = xYDiagram3D.ActualViewport.Size;
					double automaticMinSize = BubbleUtils.GetAutomaticMinSize(BubbleSizeUnitCore.AxisXMeasureUnit, new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height), delta);
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(automaticMinSize))
					{
						return automaticMinSize;
					}
				}
				return MinSize;
			}
		}

		protected override double Size => MaxSize;

		protected override string DefaultLabelTextPattern => "{W}";

		protected override Type PointInterfaceType => typeof(IXYWPoint);

		protected internal override int PointDimension => 2;

		protected internal override double SeriesDepth => ActualMaxSize;

		protected internal override ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter ToolTipPointValuesConverter => new ToolTipBubbleValueToStringConverter(this);

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum size of the bubble marker.")]

			WeightProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Weight", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries3D), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, SeriesPoint.Update));
			ValueToDisplayProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ValueToDisplay", typeof(BubbleLabelValueToDisplay), typeof(BubbleSeries3D), new PropertyMetadata(BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight, PointOptions.ValueToDisplayPropertyChanged));
			MaxSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxSize", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries3D), new PropertyMetadata(0.9, Series.UpdateSeriesPropertyWithClearDiagramCache), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateSize);
			MinSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinSize", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries3D), new PropertyMetadata(0.3, Series.UpdateSeriesPropertyWithClearDiagramCache), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateSize);
			WeightDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("WeightDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BubbleSeries3D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			AutoSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AutoSize", typeof(bool), typeof(BubbleSeries3D), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BubbleSeries3D);
			Series.ArgumentDataMemberProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Series.OnBindingChanged));
			Series.ValueDataMemberProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Series.OnBindingChanged));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(typeFromHandle);
		}

		double IXYWSeriesView.GetSideMargins(AxisGroup axisGroup, double min, double max)
		{

			{
				return MaxSize;

		}

			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MaxSizeProperty);
			properties.Add(MinSizeProperty);
			properties.Add(WeightDataMemberProperty);
			properties.Add(AutoSizeProperty);
		}

		protected override bool IsCorrectValueLevel(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (valueLevel != ValueLevelInternal.Value)
			{
				return valueLevel == ValueLevelInternal.Weight;
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		protected internal override double[] GetPointValues(SeriesPoint point)
		{

				point.NonAnimatedValue,
				GetWeight(point)
			};
		}

		protected internal override void SetPointValues(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, double[] values, DateTime[] dateTimeValues, TimeSpan[] timeSpanValues)
		{
			base.SetPointValues(seriesPoint, values, dateTimeValues, timeSpanValues);
			if (values != null && values.Length > 1)
			{
				SetWeight(seriesPoint, values[1]);
			}
		}

		protected internal override SeriesData CreateSeriesData()
		{
			base.SeriesData = new BubbleSeries3DData(this);
			return base.SeriesData;
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			BubbleLabelValueToDisplay bubbleLabelValueToDisplay = (BubbleLabelValueToDisplay)pointOptionsContainer.PointOptions.GetValue(ValueToDisplayProperty);
			string text = pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValuePattern(valueScaleType);
			switch (bubbleLabelValueToDisplay)
			{
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight:
				text = PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(text, "V", "W");
				break;
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.ValueAndWeight:
				text = PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(text, "V", "V", "W");
				break;
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected internal override string[] GetAvailablePointPatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.BubbleViewPointPatterns;
		}

	public enum Marker3DLabelPosition

	}
	public abstract class MarkerSeries3D : XYSeries3D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelPositionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TransformProperty;

		private Marker3DModel actualModel;

		protected abstract double Size { get; }

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(XYDiagram3D);

		protected internal override bool IsPredefinedModelUses => ActualModel is PredefinedMarker3DModel;

		[Description("Gets the actual model used to draw elements of a 3D series with markers (e.g. 3D Point Series).")]
		public Marker3DModel ActualModel => actualModel;

		[Description("Gets or sets the model used to draw elements of a 3D series with markers (e.g. 3D Point Series).")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Marker3DModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return (Marker3DModel)GetValue(ModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static MarkerSeries3D()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(MarkerSeries3D);
			ModelProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Model", typeof(Marker3DModel), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(MarkerModelPropertyChanged));
			LabelPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("LabelPosition", typeof(Marker3DLabelPosition), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Marker3DLabelPosition.Center, Series.UpdateLabelPropertyWithClearDiagramCache));
			TransformProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Transform", typeof(Transform3D), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(TransformPropertyChanged));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(typeFromHandle);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

		protected static void MarkerModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MarkerSeries3D markerSeries3D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is Marker3DModel marker3DModel))
				{
					markerSeries3D.actualModel = new SphereMarker3DModel();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, markerSeries3D.actualModel);
				}
				else
				{
					markerSeries3D.actualModel = marker3DModel;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
			Series.UpdateSeriesCloneablePropertyWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void TransformPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SeriesPoint.SynchronizeProperties(d, e, TransformProperty, SeriesPointModel3D.TransformProperty);

		private static void BorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AreaSeries2D areaSeries2D)
			{
				SeriesBorder seriesBorder = e.NewValue as SeriesBorder;
				areaSeries2D.SetValue(ActualBorderPropertyKey, (seriesBorder == null) ? SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateDefaultBorder(1) : seriesBorder);
				if (!areaSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
				{
					areaSeries2D.UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ActualBorderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RangeAreaSeries2D listener)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SeriesBorder, e.NewValue as SeriesBorder, listener);
			}
		}

		internal static bool ValidateTransparency(object transparency)
		{
			if ((double)transparency >= 0.0)
			{
				return (double)transparency <= 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

				flag = true;

			if (!flag)
			{
				return base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
			}
			return true;
		}

	public class BarSideBySideSeries2D : BarSeries2D, ISideBySideBarSeriesView, IBarSeriesView
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelPositionProperty;

		protected override Type PointInterfaceType => typeof(IValuePoint);

		protected override bool NeedSeriesGroupsInteraction => true;

		double ISideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistance
		{

					return 0.0;
				}
				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistance;
			}
			set
			{

		{

				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistanceFixed;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).BarDistanceFixed = value;
				}
			}
		}

		bool ISideBySideBarSeriesView.EqualBarWidth
		{
			get
			{

				{
					return true;
				}
				return ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).EqualBarWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).EqualBarWidth = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static Bar2DLabelPosition GetLabelPosition(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return (Bar2DLabelPosition)label.GetValue(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

		public static void SetLabelPosition(SeriesLabel label, Bar2DLabelPosition value)
		{
			label.SetValue(LabelPositionProperty, value);
		}

		static BarSideBySideSeries2D()
		{
			LabelPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("LabelPosition", typeof(Bar2DLabelPosition), typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(Bar2DLabelPosition.Auto, Series.UpdateLabelPropertyWithClearDiagramCache));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(LabelPositionProperty);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

		public BarSideBySideSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BarSideBySideSeries2D>(this);
		}

		protected override double GetBarWidth(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).BarWidth;
		}

		protected override int GetFixedOffset(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).FixedOffset;
		}

		protected override double GetDisplayOffset(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).Offset;
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BarSideBySideSeries2D();
		}

		protected override Bar2DLabelPosition GetSeriesLabelPosition(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return GetLabelPosition(label);
		}

		protected internal override void CollectLabelProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectLabelProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			Bar2D? bar2D = CalculateBar(mapping, pointItem.RefinedPoint, isLabelInCenter: false);
			if (!bar2D.HasValue)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			return GetLabelAnchorPoint(pointItem, ScreenPointCalculator.Instance, mapping, transform, isLabelInCenter: false, bar2D.Value);
		}

		protected internal override double GetArgumentOffset(RefinedPoint refPoint)
		{
			return ((ISideBySidePoint)refPoint).Offset;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override bool GetRefinedPointMinMaxValuesAreSame()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Abs(((IValuePoint)point).Value);
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues CalcArgumentRange(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return CalcArgumentRangeSideBySide(point);
		}
	}
	public class BarSeries3D : XYSeries3D, IBarSeriesView
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ModelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BarWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TransformProperty;

		private Bar3DModel actualModel;

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(XYDiagram3D);

		protected internal override bool IsPredefinedModelUses => ActualModel is PredefinedBar3DModel;

		protected internal override double SeriesDepth => BarWidth;

		[Description("Gets the actual model used to draw elements of a 3D bar series (e.g. 3D Side-by-Side Bar).")]
		public Bar3DModel ActualModel => actualModel;

		[Description("Gets or sets the model used to draw elements of a 3D bar series (e.g. 3D Side-by-Side Bar).")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public Bar3DModel Model
		{
			get
			{
				return (Bar3DModel)GetValue(ModelProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ModelProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the width of a bar (measured as a fraction of axis units).")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double BarWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(BarWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BarWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static BarSeries3D()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BarSeries3D);
			ModelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Model", typeof(Bar3DModel), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(ModelPropertyChanged));
			BarWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BarWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(0.6, BarWidthPropertyChanged), BarWidthValidation);
			TransformProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Transform", typeof(Transform3D), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(TransformPropertyChanged));
		}

		private static bool BarWidthValidation(object barWidth)
		{
			return (double)barWidth > 0.0;
		}

		private static void BarWidthPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series && !series.UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, "BarWidth"), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void ModelPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BarSeries3D barSeries3D)
			{
				if (!(e.NewValue is Bar3DModel bar3DModel))
				{
					barSeries3D.actualModel = new BoxBar3DModel();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, barSeries3D.actualModel);
				}
				else
				{
					barSeries3D.actualModel = bar3DModel;
				}
			}
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
			Series.UpdateSeriesCloneablePropertyWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void TransformPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SeriesPoint.SynchronizeProperties(d, e, TransformProperty, SeriesPointModel3D.TransformProperty);
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		public static Transform3D GetTransform(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return (Transform3D)point.GetValue(TransformProperty);
		}

		public static void SetTransform(SeriesPoint point, Transform3D transform)
		{
			point.SetValue(TransformProperty, transform);
		}

		public BarSeries3D()
		{
			actualModel = new BoxBar3DModel();
			actualModel.SetOwner(this);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BarSeries3D>(this);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new BarSeries3D();
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(BarWidthProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ModelProperty);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesData CreateSeriesData()
		{
			base.SeriesData = new BarSeries3DData(this);
			return base.SeriesData;
		}
	}

		internal bool CanShowAutogeneratedItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (ItemVisibilityMode != LegendItemVisibilityMode.AutoGeneratedAndCustom)
				{
					return CustomItems.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool ActualVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Visible.HasValue)
				{
					return Visible.Value;
				}
				return autoLayoutVisible;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInsidePosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside && HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.RightOutside && VerticalPosition != VerticalPosition.TopOutside)
				{
					return VerticalPosition != VerticalPosition.BottomOutside;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOutsidePosition => !IsInsidePosition;

		internal bool IsBottomPosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (VerticalPosition != VerticalPosition.Bottom)
				{
					return VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanCollect
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DataContext == null)
				{
					return dataContextNeverSet;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => this;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => null;

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Priority => 8;

		bool ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Visible.HasValue)
				{
					return autoLayoutVisible;
				}
				return Visible.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Visible.HasValue)
				{
					autoLayoutVisible = value;
				}
			}
		}

		GRealRect2D ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(bounds.Left) || double.IsInfinity(bounds.Top) || double.IsInfinity(bounds.Width) || double.IsInfinity(bounds.Height))
				{
					return default(GRealRect2D);
				}
				return new GRealRect2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			}
		}

		VisibilityElementOrientation ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				if ((HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside && VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside) || (HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside && VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside) || (HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside && VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside) || (HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside && VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside))
				{
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Corner;
				}
				if (HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside || HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside)
				{
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Vertical;
				}
				if (VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside || VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside)
				{
					return VisibilityElementOrientation.Horizontal;
				}
				return VisibilityElementOrientation.Inside;
			}
		}

		int ISupportVisibilityControlElement.Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		static LegendBase()
		{
			CustomItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CustomItems", typeof(CustomLegendItemCollection), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata());
			CustomItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<LegendBase, CustomLegendItem>), typeof(LegendBase));
			HorizontalPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HorizontalPosition", typeof(HorizontalPosition), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(HorizontalPosition.RightOutside, PropertyChanged));
			VerticalPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("VerticalPosition", typeof(VerticalPosition), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(VerticalPosition.Top, PropertyChanged));
			IndentFromDiagramProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IndentFromDiagram", typeof(Thickness), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(PropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			ItemsPanelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ItemsPanel", typeof(ItemsPanelTemplate), typeof(LegendBase));
			OrientationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical, PropertyChanged));
			VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Visible", typeof(bool?), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, VisiblePropertyChanged));
			ItemVisibilityModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemVisibilityMode", typeof(LegendItemVisibilityMode), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(LegendItemVisibilityMode.Default, ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems));
			CustomItemsProperty = CustomItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CustomItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, CustomItemsSourceChanged));
			CustomItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, CustomItemTemplateChanged));
			CustomItemTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomItemTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, CustomItemTemplateChanged));
			TitleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Title", typeof(LegendTitle), typeof(LegendBase), new PropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.Update));
			FontPropertiesBinder.AttachPropertiesNotification(typeof(LegendBase), ChartNotificationElement.RaisePropertyChanged);
		}

		protected static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LegendBase legendBase && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				legendBase.NotifyLegendChanged();
			}
		}

		private static void VisiblePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LegendBase { Control: not null } legendBase)
			{
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(legendBase);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d);
			}
		}

		private static void CustomItemsSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<LegendBase, CustomLegendItem>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged(d, e, CustomItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, CustomItemTemplateProperty, CustomItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DependencyProperty)null, (Func<LegendBase, IList>)((LegendBase legend) => legend.CustomItems), (Func<LegendBase, CustomLegendItem>)((LegendBase legend) => new CustomLegendItem()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<CustomLegendItem>)null, d.GetValue(CustomItemsProperty) as ISupportInitialize, (Action<CustomLegendItem, object>)TagUtils.AttachTagToChartElement, true, true, (Func<CustomLegendItem, bool>)null, false);
		}

		private static void CustomItemTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<LegendBase, CustomLegendItem>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged(d, e, CustomItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		protected LegendBase()
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<LegendBase>(this);
			DXSerializer.AddCustomGetSerializablePropertiesHandler((DependencyObject)this, new CustomGetSerializablePropertiesEventHandler(CustomPropertiesSerializationUtils.SerializableControlProperties));
			SetValue(CustomItemsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<CustomLegendItemCollection>(this));
			base.DataContextChanged += OnDataContextChanged;
		}

		private void OnDataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			dataContextNeverSet = false;
		}

		internal void UpdateItems(IList items)
		{
			ItemsCore.Update(items);
			Visibility visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (ItemsCore != null && ItemsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			EmptyContentVisibility = visibility;
		}

		internal void FillCustomLegendItems(IList items)
		{
			foreach (CustomLegendItem customItem in CustomItems)
			{
				if (customItem.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					items.Add(CreateDefaultLegendItem(customItem));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyLegendChanged()
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update((DependencyObject)this, ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (!result.IsEmpty && result.Height > 0.0 && result.Width > 0.0)
			{
				bounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, result.Width, result.Height);
			}
			if (!ActualVisible)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal abstract LegendItemBase CreateDefaultLegendItem(CustomLegendItem customItem);

		public bool ShouldSerializeVisible(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return Visible.HasValue;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeItems(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

		private static object CoerceMaxCrosshairContentWidth(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num <= 0.0 || num >= 1000.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLegendMaxCrosshairContentWidth));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static object CoerceMaxCrosshairContentHeight(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (!double.IsNaN(num) && (num <= 0.0 || num >= 1000.0))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectLegendMaxCrosshairContentHeight));
			}
			return value;
		}

		public Legend()
		{
			selectionInfo = new SelectionInfo();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<Legend>(this);
			Items = new LegendItemList();
			base.MouseEnter += OnMouseEnter;
			base.MouseLeave += OnMouseLeave;
		}

		private void OnMouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ChartControl != null)
			{
				ChartControl.SetIsPointerInLegend(isPointerInLegend: false);
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ChartControl != null)
			{
				ChartControl.SetIsPointerInLegend(isPointerInLegend: true);
			}
		}

		internal void CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			if (ChartControl is ChartControl { Diagram: XYDiagram2D diagram })
			{
				if (dockTargetIndex == 0)
				{
					DockTarget = diagram.ActualDefaultPane;
				}
				if (dockTargetIndex > 0 && dockTargetIndex - 1 < diagram.Panes.Count)
				{
					DockTarget = diagram.Panes[dockTargetIndex - 1];
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void NotifyLegendChanged()
		{
			if (ChartControl != null)
			{
				ChartControl.LegendPropertyChanged(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override LegendItemBase CreateDefaultLegendItem(CustomLegendItem customItem)
		{
			return new DefaultLegendItem(this, customItem, customItem, customItem.Text, customItem.MarkerBrush);
		}

	public class LegendsPanel : SimplePanel
	{
		private Pane pane;

		private Rect prevViewport = Rect.Empty;

		private Pane Pane
		{
			get
			{
				if (pane == null)
				{
					pane = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Pane>((DependencyObject)this);
				}
				return pane;
			}
		}

		private Thickness ActualIndentFromDiagram(LegendBase legend)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			num = ((legend.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside || legend.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside) ? 0.0 : legend.IndentFromDiagram.Left);
			num2 = ((legend.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside || legend.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside) ? 0.0 : legend.IndentFromDiagram.Right);
			num3 = ((legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside || legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside) ? 0.0 : legend.IndentFromDiagram.Top);
			num4 = ((legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside || legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside) ? 0.0 : legend.IndentFromDiagram.Bottom);
			return new Thickness(num, num3, num2, num4);
		}

		private bool LegendHasItems(LegendBase legend)
		{
			if (legend != null && legend.ItemsCore != null)
			{
				return legend.ItemsCore.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double GetLegendOffset(LegendBase legend, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition key = new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend.HorizontalPosition, legend.VerticalPosition);
			if (!legendPositionOffsets.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				legendPositionOffsets.Add(key, 0.0);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void AddLegendOffset(LegendBase legend, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition key = new DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition(legend.HorizontalPosition, legend.VerticalPosition);
			double num = ((legend.IsInsidePosition && key.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center) ? legend.DesiredSize.Width : legend.DesiredSize.Height);
			legendPositionOffsets[key] += num;
		}

		private double CalculateLegendX(LegendBase legend, System.Windows.Size finalSize, Rect paneViewport, Thickness paneMargins, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = ((legend.IsInsidePosition && legend.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center) ? GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets) : 0.0);
			switch (legend.HorizontalPosition)
			{
			case HorizontalPosition.Left:
				num = paneViewport.Left + ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left + num2;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Center:
				num = paneViewport.Left + paneViewport.Width / 2.0 - legend.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0;
				if (num < ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left)
				{
					num = ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Left;
				}
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.Right:
				num = paneViewport.Right - legend.DesiredSize.Width - ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Right - num2;
				break;
			case HorizontalPosition.RightOutside:
				num = finalSize.Width - paneMargins.Right;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalculateLegendY(LegendBase legend, System.Windows.Size finalSize, Rect paneViewport, Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = ((!legend.IsInsidePosition || legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.Center) ? GetLegendOffset(legend, legendPositionOffsets) : 0.0);
			switch (legend.VerticalPosition)
			{
			case VerticalPosition.TopOutside:
				num = num2;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Top:
				num = paneViewport.Top + ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top + num2;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Center:
				num = paneViewport.Top + paneViewport.Height / 2.0 - legend.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0 + num2;
				if (num < ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top)
				{
					num = ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Top;
				}
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.Bottom:
				num = paneViewport.Bottom - legend.DesiredSize.Height - ActualIndentFromDiagram(legend).Bottom - num2;
				break;
			case VerticalPosition.BottomOutside:
				num = finalSize.Height - legend.DesiredSize.Height - num2;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), availableSize);
			if (Pane != null)
			{
				rect = Pane.Viewport;
			}
			Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double>();
			bool flag = prevViewport == rect;
			foreach (LegendBase child in base.Children)
			{
				double legendOffset = GetLegendOffset(child, legendPositionOffsets);
				AddLegendOffset(child, legendPositionOffsets);
				if (child.IsMeasureValid && child.DesiredSize.Width > 0.0 && flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (child.IsInsidePosition)
				{
					System.Windows.Size size = rect.Size;
					if (child.HorizontalPosition != HorizontalPosition.Center)
					{
						size.Width = Math.Max(0.0, size.Width - legendOffset);
					}
					else
					{
						size.Height = Math.Max(0.0, size.Height - legendOffset);
					}
					double width = ((child.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) ? Math.Max(size.Width - child.IndentFromDiagram.Left - child.IndentFromDiagram.Right, 0.0) : 0.0);
					double height = ((child.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) ? Math.Max(size.Height - child.IndentFromDiagram.Top - child.IndentFromDiagram.Bottom, 0.0) : 0.0);
					System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = (LegendHasItems(child) ? new System.Windows.Size(width, height) : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
					child.Measure(availableSize2);
				}
				else
				{
					System.Windows.Size availableSize3 = availableSize;
					availableSize3.Height = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize3.Height - legendOffset);
					child.Measure(availableSize3);
				}
			}
			prevViewport = rect;
			return MeasureOverrideCore(availableSize, measureChildren: false);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect paneViewport = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), finalSize);
			if (Pane != null)
			{
				paneViewport = Pane.Viewport;
			}
			Thickness paneMargins = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (LegendBase child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && child.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside)
				{
					paneMargins.Right = Math.Max(paneMargins.Right, child.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
			}
			Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double> legendPositionOffsets = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.LegendPosition, double>();
			foreach (LegendBase child2 in base.Children)
			{
				double x = 0.0;
				double y = 0.0;
				System.Windows.Size size = (LegendHasItems(child2) ? child2.DesiredSize : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
				if (child2.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					x = CalculateLegendX(child2, finalSize, paneViewport, paneMargins, legendPositionOffsets);
					y = CalculateLegendY(child2, finalSize, paneViewport, legendPositionOffsets);
					AddLegendOffset(child2, legendPositionOffsets);
				}
				child2.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), size));
			}
			return ArrangeOverrideCore(finalSize, arrangeChildren: false);
		}
	}

	public class LineSeries2D : SegmentSeries2DBase, ISupportMarker2DHitTest, ISupportMarker2D, ILineSeries, IGeometryHolder
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualLineThicknessPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualLineThickness", typeof(int), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata());

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualLineThicknessProperty = ActualLineThicknessPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarkerModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MarkerModel", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarkerSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MarkerSize", typeof(int), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(10, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)MarkerSeries2D.MarkerSizeValidation);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarkerVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MarkerVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LineStyle", typeof(LineStyle), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(LineStyleChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualLineStyleProperty = ActualLineStylePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PointAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointAnimation", typeof(Marker2DAnimationBase), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.PointAnimationPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesAnimation", typeof(Line2DAnimationBase), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.SeriesAnimationPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowIsolatedPointsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowIsolatedPoints", typeof(bool), typeof(LineSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(false, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty));

		internal const int DefaultLineThickness = 2;

		protected override int PixelsPerArgument
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ArePointsVisible)
				{
					return 2 * ActualLineThickness;
				}
				return Math.Max(MarkerSize, 2 * ActualLineThickness);
			}
		}

		protected override bool SupportsNativeRendering
		{
			get
			{
				if (MarkerModel != null)
				{
					return MarkerModel.IsRenderable;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool HasInvisibleMarkers => !ArePointsVisible;

		private static void ActualLineStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LineSeries2D lineSeries2D)
			{
				lineSeries2D.UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				lineSeries2D.UpdateLegendItems();
			}
		}

		private static void LineStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is LineSeries2D lineSeries2D)
			{
				if (e.NewValue != e.OldValue)
				{
					LineStyle newValue = ((!(e.NewValue is LineStyle lineStyle)) ? lineSeries2D.CreateDefaultLineStyle() : lineStyle);
					lineSeries2D.SetActualLineStyle(e.OldValue as LineStyle, newValue);
				}
				lineSeries2D.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e);
			}
		}

		public LineSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<LineSeries2D>(this);
			SetActualLineStyle(null, CreateDefaultLineStyle());
		}

		GeometryStripCreator IGeometryHolder.CreateStripCreator()
		{
			return CreateStripCreator();
		}

		private LineStyle CreateDefaultLineStyle()
		{
			LineStyle lineStyle = new LineStyle();
			lineStyle.Thickness = 2;
			lineStyle.LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Miter;
			return lineStyle;
		}

		private void SetActualLineStyle(LineStyle oldValue, LineStyle newValue)
		{
			SetValue(ActualLineStylePropertyKey, newValue);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(oldValue, newValue, this);
			UpdateActualLineThickness();
		}

		private void UpdateActualLineThickness()
		{
			bool inInteractiveState = ((IInteractiveElement)this).IsSelected || ((IInteractiveElement)this).IsHighlighted;
			SetValue(ActualLineThicknessPropertyKey, VisualSelectionHelper.GetLineThickness(ActualLineStyle.Thickness, inInteractiveState));
		}

		protected virtual GeometryStripCreator CreateStripCreator()
		{
			IStripSplitter stripSplitter = CreateLineColorSplitter();
			if (stripSplitter != null)
			{
				return new LineGeometrySplittedStripCreator(stripSplitter, closed: false, ShowIsolatedPoints);
			}
			return new LineGeometryStripCreator(closed: false, ShowIsolatedPoints);
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new LineSeries2D();
		}

		protected override EmptyPointOptions CreateDefaultEmptyPointOptions()
		{
			return new LineEmptyPointOptions();
		}

		protected override bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = base.PerformWeakEvent(managerType, sender, e);
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager) && sender is LineStyle)
			{
				UpdateActualLineThickness();
				UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MarkerSizeProperty);
			properties.Add(MarkerVisibleProperty);
			properties.Add(ShowIsolatedPointsProperty);
		}

		protected override void CollectCloneableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectCloneableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(MarkerModelProperty);
			properties.Add(LineStyleProperty);
			properties.Add(PointAnimationProperty);
			properties.Add(SeriesAnimationProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool isSelected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(isSelected);
			UpdateActualLineThickness();
		}

		protected override void OnIsHighlightedChanged()
		{
			base.OnIsHighlightedChanged();
			UpdateActualLineThickness();
		}

		protected override int CalculateMarkerSize(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			return MarkerSize;
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			FillMarkerAnimationKinds(animationKinds);
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromLeftAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromRightAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromTopAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DSlideFromBottomAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DUnwrapVerticallyAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DUnwrapHorizontallyAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DBlowUpAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DStretchFromNearAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DStretchFromFarAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Line2DUnwindAnimation)));
			base.FillPredefinedSeriesAnimationKinds(animationKinds);
		}

		protected internal override AdditionalSeriesGeometryContainer CreateAdditionalGeometry()
		{
			return new AdditionalLineSeriesGeometryContainer(this);
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (CanLayoutPointItem(pointItem))

				base.CompletePointLayout(pointItem);
			}
		}

		protected internal override PointModel GetModel(RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			return MarkerModel;
		}

		protected override Transform CreateSeriesAnimationTransform(IMapping mapping)
		{
			if (GetActualSeriesAnimation() is Line2DAnimationBase line2DAnimationBase)
			{
				return line2DAnimationBase.CreateAnimatedTransformation(mapping.Viewport, mapping.GetDiagramOriginPoint(), IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed, mapping.Rotated, base.SeriesProgress.ActualProgress);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointAnimationBase CreateDefaultPointAnimation()
		{
			return new Marker2DFadeInAnimation();
		}

		protected internal override SeriesAnimationBase CreateDefaultSeriesAnimation()
		{
			return new Line2DStretchFromNearAnimation();
		}

		{
			return CrosshairManager.CalculateMinMaxContinuousSeriesRangeValues(point, range, isHorizontalCrosshair, crosshairPaneInfo, snapMode);
		}

		protected internal override SeriesPointItem[] CreateSeriesPointItems(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, SeriesPointData seriesPointData)
		{
			return new SeriesPointItem[1]
			{
				new SeriesPointItem(this, seriesPointData)
			};
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointItemHidden(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return !ArePointsVisible;
		}

		}

			}
		}

		private static void DateTimeOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is PointOptions pointOptions)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as DateTimeOptions, e.NewValue as DateTimeOptions, pointOptions);
				pointOptions.NotifyPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(e.Property));
			}
		}

		{

		internal static void ValueToDisplayPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				NotifyPropertyChanged("PointOptions");
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			return new PointOptions();
		}

		private const double PixelSideMarginsFactor = 1.2;

		private bool isRenderRegistered;

		private double ActualMaxSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (AutoSize)
				{
					GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = ((Pane)ActualPane).Viewport.ToGRealRect2D();
					double delta = ((IMinMaxValues)base.ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData).Delta;
					double automaticMaxSize = BubbleUtils.GetAutomaticMaxSize((BubbleSizeUnitCore)SizeUnit, gRealRect2D.Size, delta);
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(automaticMaxSize))
					{
						return automaticMaxSize;
					}
				}
				return MaxSize;
			}
		}

		private double ActualMinSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (AutoSize)
				{
					GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = ((Pane)ActualPane).Viewport.ToGRealRect2D();
					double delta = ((IMinMaxValues)base.ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData).Delta;
					double automaticMinSize = BubbleUtils.GetAutomaticMinSize((BubbleSizeUnitCore)SizeUnit, gRealRect2D.Size, delta);
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(automaticMinSize))
					{
						return automaticMinSize;
					}
				}
				return MinSize;
			}
		}

		static BubbleSeries2D()
		{
			WeightProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Weight", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(double.NaN, SeriesPoint.Update, CoerceWeight));
			ValueToDisplayProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ValueToDisplay", typeof(BubbleLabelValueToDisplay), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight, PointOptions.ValueToDisplayPropertyChanged));
			LabelPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("LabelPosition", typeof(Bubble2DLabelPosition), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(Bubble2DLabelPosition.Center, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			WeightDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("WeightDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, Series.OnBindingChanged));
			MarkerModelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MarkerModel", typeof(Marker2DModel), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(XYSeries2D.ModelPropertyChanged));
			MaxSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxSize", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.9, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateSize);
			MinSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinSize", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.3, Series.UpdateSeriesProperty), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateSize);
			TransparencyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Transparency", typeof(double), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(0.0, TransparencyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateTransparency);
			PointAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PointAnimation", typeof(Marker2DAnimationBase), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(null, Series.PointAnimationPropertyChanged));
			AutoSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AutoSize", typeof(bool), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(true, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			SizeUnitProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SizeUnit", typeof(BubbleSizeUnit), typeof(BubbleSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(BubbleSizeUnit.AxisXMeasureUnit, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(WeightProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(LabelPositionProperty);
		}

		private static bool ValidateSize(object size)
		{
			return (double)size > 0.0;
		}

		private static bool ValidateTransparency(object transparency)
		{
			if ((double)transparency >= 0.0)
			{
				return (double)transparency <= 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void TransparencyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BubbleSeries2D bubbleSeries2D && !bubbleSeries2D.UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
			{
				bubbleSeries2D.UpdatePointDataOpacity();
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceWeight(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			double d2 = (double)baseValue;
			if (double.IsInfinity(d2))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		public BubbleSeries2D()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BubbleSeries2D>(this);
		}

		double IXYWSeriesView.GetSideMargins(AxisGroup axisGroup, double min, double max)
		{
			if (axisGroup == AxisGroup.Value)
			{
				if (SizeUnit != BubbleSizeUnit.Pixel)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return CalculateSideMarginsPixelUnit(base.ActualAxisY, min, max);
			}
			return CalculateSideMarginsX(min, max);
		}

		double IXYWSeriesView.GetMarkerSizeInAxisUnits(IXYWPoint point)
		{
			if (SizeUnit != BubbleSizeUnit.AxisXMeasureUnit)
			{
				return CalculateMarkerSizeInPixelUnit(point.Size);
			}
			return point.Size;
		}

		private void RegisterRender()
		{
			if (!isRenderRegistered)
			{
				isRenderRegistered = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					isRenderRegistered = false;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
			}
		}

		private double CalculateValueInPixelUnit(double valueInPx, IAxisData axisData, double axisRange)
		{
			if (((Pane)ActualPane).Viewport.IsEmptyOrZero())
			{
				RegisterRender();
			}
			double axisLength = ((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).GetAxisLength(axisData);
			if (axisRange != 0.0)
			{
				return axisRange * valueInPx / axisLength;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double CalculateSideMarginsPixelUnit(IAxisData axisData, double min, double max)
		{
			return CalculateValueInPixelUnit(ActualMaxSize * 1.2, axisData, Math.Abs(max - min));
		}

		private double CalculateMarkerSizeInPixelUnit(double sizeInPx)
		{
			IAxisData actualAxisX = base.ActualAxisX;
			return CalculateValueInPixelUnit(sizeInPx, actualAxisX, actualAxisX.VisualRange.Delta);
		}

		private double CalculateSideMarginsX(double min, double max)
		{
			if (SizeUnit == BubbleSizeUnit.Pixel)
			{
				return CalculateSideMarginsPixelUnit(base.ActualAxisX, min, max);
			}
			if (!AutoSize)
			{
				return MaxSize;
			}
			return (max - min) * 0.2;
		}

		private int CalculateMarkerSizeInPx(PaneMappingBase mapping, double pointSize)
		{
			return (int)((SizeUnit == BubbleSizeUnit.AxisXMeasureUnit) ? ((double)Math.Max(mapping.AxisXMapping.GetRoundedInterval(pointSize), 2)) : pointSize);
		}

		private void UpdatePointDataOpacity()
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointData seriesPointData2 in base.Item.SeriesPointDataList)
			{
				ISeriesPointData seriesPointData = seriesPointData2;
				if (seriesPointData != null)
				{
					seriesPointData.Opacity = ((Transparency >= 0.0 && Transparency <= 1.0) ? (1.0 - Transparency) : 1.0);
				}
				else
				{
					ChartDebug.Fail("ISeriesPointItem is expected.");
				}
			}
			UpdateAdditionalGeometryAppearance();
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CorrectLabelLayoutPointWithViewport(Rect viewport, System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point finishPoint)
		{
			IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(startPoint.X, startPoint.Y), new GRealPoint2D(finishPoint.X, finishPoint.Y), new GRealPoint2D(viewport.Left, viewport.Bottom), new GRealPoint2D(viewport.Right, viewport.Top));
			if (!intersectionInfo.HasIntersection)
			{
				return startPoint;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint.X, intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint.Y);
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0106: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(labelItem.RefinedPoint.Argument, ((IValuePoint)labelItem.RefinedPoint).Value);
			roundedDiagramPoint = transform.Transform(roundedDiagramPoint);
			double num = CalculateMarkerSize(mapping, labelItem.RefinedPoint);
			double num2 = num / 2.0;
			if (GetLabelPosition(labelItem.Label) == Bubble2DLabelPosition.Outside)
			{
				double num3 = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(NormalizeLabelAngle(MarkerSeries2D.GetAngle(labelItem.Label)));
				double num4 = num2 + (double)labelItem.Label.Indent;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(roundedDiagramPoint.X + num4 * Math.Cos(num3), roundedDiagramPoint.Y + num4 * Math.Sin(num3));
				if (!mapping.Viewport.Contains(roundedDiagramPoint))
				{
					roundedDiagramPoint = CorrectLabelLayoutPointWithViewport(mapping.Viewport, roundedDiagramPoint, point);
				}
				if (!mapping.Viewport.Contains(point))
				{
					point = CorrectLabelLayoutPointWithViewport(mapping.Viewport, point, roundedDiagramPoint);
				}
				num4 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(point, roundedDiagramPoint);
				DXRectangle excludedRectangle = GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CalcAnchorHole(roundedDiagramPoint, num4));
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, roundedDiagramPoint, num4, num3, excludedRectangle);
			}
			Rect rect = MathUtils.StrongRound(new Rect(roundedDiagramPoint.X - num2, roundedDiagramPoint.Y - num2, num, num));
			return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, roundedDiagramPoint, GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(rect));
		}

		protected override int CalculateMarkerSize(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return CalculateMarkerSizeInPx(mapping, ((IXYWPoint)refinedPoint).Size);
		}

		protected internal override string ConstructValuePattern(PointOptionsContainerBase pointOptionsContainer, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			BubbleLabelValueToDisplay bubbleLabelValueToDisplay = (BubbleLabelValueToDisplay)pointOptionsContainer.PointOptions.GetValue(ValueToDisplayProperty);
			string text = pointOptionsContainer.ConstructValuePattern(valueScaleType);
			switch (bubbleLabelValueToDisplay)
			{
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight:
				text = PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(text, "V", "W");
				break;
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.ValueAndWeight:
				text = PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(text, "V", "V", "W");
				break;
			}
			return text;
		}

		{
			return ToolTipPatternUtils.BubbleViewPointPatterns;
		}

	public abstract class MarkerSeries2D : XYSeries2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AngleProperty;

		protected internal override bool LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported => true;

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(XYDiagram2D);

		protected internal override VisualSelectionType SupportedSelectionType => VisualSelectionType.Size;

		static MarkerSeries2D()
		{
			AngleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("Angle", typeof(double), typeof(MarkerSeries2D), new PropertyMetadata(45.0, Series.UpdateLabelProperty));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(AngleProperty);
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static double GetAngle(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return (double)label.GetValue(AngleProperty);
		}

		{
			label.SetValue(AngleProperty, value);
		}

		internal static bool MarkerSizeValidation(object size)
		{
			return (int)size > 0;
		}

		private SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(ScreenPointCalculatorBase pointCalculator, PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointItem.RefinedPoint;
			int markerSize = CalculateMarkerSize(mapping, refinedPoint);
			System.Windows.Point center = pointCalculator.CalculatePoint(mapping, refinedPoint.Argument, GetMaxValue(refinedPoint));
			return SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CreateSeriesPointLayout(mapping.Viewport.Size, markerSize, center);
		}

		protected virtual int CalculateMarkerSize(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal override void CollectLabelProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectLabelProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(AngleProperty);
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Point point = transform.Transform(labelItem.Label.PointCalculator.CalculatePoint(mapping, labelItem.RefinedPoint.Argument, GetMaxValue(labelItem.RefinedPoint)));
			SeriesLabel label = labelItem.Label;
			int indent = label.Indent;
			return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, point, indent, MathUtils.Degree2Radian(NormalizeLabelAngle(GetAngle(label))), GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CalcAnchorHole(point, indent)), IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false));
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return CreateSeriesPointLayout(base.PointCalculatorProvider.GetPointCalculator(pointItem), mapping, pointItem);
		}

		protected internal override void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			SeriesWithMarkerHelper.CompletePointLayout(pointItem, base.Diagram, GetActualPointAnimation(), IsAxisXReversed, IsAxisYReversed);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			return transform.Transform(mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(pointItem.RefinedPoint.Argument, ((IValuePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Value));
		}

		protected internal override bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			return label.ConnectorVisible;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return CreateSeriesPointLayout(ScreenPointCalculator.Instance, mapping, pointItem);
		}

		protected virtual double GetMaxValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value;
		}

		protected void FillMarkerAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			SeriesWithMarkerHelper.FillMarkerAnimationKinds(animationKinds);
		}

		protected Rect CalculateMarkerBounds(PaneMappingBase mapping, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int markerSize)
		{
			double num = (double)markerSize / 2.0;
			System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, GetMaxValue(refinedPoint));
			return new Rect(roundedDiagramPoint.X - num, roundedDiagramPoint.Y - num, markerSize, markerSize);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SegmentSeries2DBase : MarkerSeries2D
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SegmentColorizerProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MarkerDisplayModeProperty;

		private ProcessMissingPointsMode processMissingPointsMode = ProcessMissingPointsMode.InsertEmptyPoints;

		protected internal ProcessMissingPointsMode ProcessMissingPointsMode
		{
			get
			{
				return processMissingPointsMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (processMissingPointsMode != value)
				{
					processMissingPointsMode = value;
					ChartElementHelper.Update((DependencyObject)this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldCalculateEdgeLabelText => ShouldSortPoints;

		protected internal override bool NeedColorSegment
		{
			get
			{
				if (SegmentColorizer == null)
				{
					return base.NeedColorSegment;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool HasColorizer
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.HasColorizer)
				{
					return SegmentColorizer != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the colorizer that colors the line/area segments.")]

		static SegmentSeries2DBase()

			MarkerDisplayModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("MarkerDisplayMode", typeof(SidePointDisplayMode), typeof(SegmentSeries2DBase), new PropertyMetadata(SidePointDisplayMode.Default, XYSeries2D.UpdateMarkerDisplayMode));
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(MarkerDisplayModeProperty);

		protected IStripSplitter CreateLineColorSplitter()
		{
			IStripSplitter stripSplitter = (ActualEmptyPointOptions.Enabled ? new EmptyPointStripSplitter(ActualEmptyPointOptions) : null);
			IStripSplitter stripSplitter2 = SegmentColorizer?.CreateStripSplitter();
			if (stripSplitter != null && stripSplitter2 != null)
			{
				return new StripSplitterContainer(stripSplitter, stripSplitter2);
			}
			if (stripSplitter2 != null)
			{
				return stripSplitter2;
			}
			return stripSplitter;
		}

		protected IBezierStripSplitter CreateSplineColorSplitter()
		{
			IBezierStripSplitter bezierStripSplitter = (ActualEmptyPointOptions.Enabled ? new BezierEmptyPointSplitter(ActualEmptyPointOptions) : null);
			IBezierStripSplitter bezierStripSplitter2 = SegmentColorizer?.CreateBezierStripSplitter();
			if (bezierStripSplitter != null && bezierStripSplitter2 != null)
			{
				return new BezierStripSplitterContainer(bezierStripSplitter, bezierStripSplitter2);
			}
			if (bezierStripSplitter2 != null)
			{
				return bezierStripSplitter2;
			}
			if (bezierStripSplitter != null)
			{
				return bezierStripSplitter;
			}
			return DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance;
		}

		protected override ViewportIntersectionHolder CreateViewportIntersectionHolder()
		{
			return new LineViewportIntersectionHolder(this);
		}

		protected override bool UpdateSegmentColorizerLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> items, Legend legend)
		{
			return UpdateColorizerLegendItemsCore(items, legend, SegmentColorizer as ILegendItemsProvider);
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(SegmentColorizerProperty);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointSeriesSegmentColor(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (SegmentColorizer is PointBasedSegmentColorizer)
			{
				return base.ColorizerController.GetPointColor(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
			if (SegmentColorizer is IRangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer)
			{
				int? color = rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(GetMaxValue(refinedPoint));
				if (color.HasValue)
				{
					return ColorUtils.ConvertFromArgb(color.Value);
				}
			}
			return base.GetPointSeriesSegmentColor(refinedPoint);
		}

		protected override SeriesPointItem GetEdgePointItem(IList<SeriesPointItem> points, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				return points[points.Count - 1];
			}
			return points[0];
		}

		protected internal override bool IsPointValueVisible(SeriesPointItem pointItem, RangeValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			if (!base.IsPointValueVisible(pointItem, valueLevel) && (!IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || base.Item.AllPointItems.IndexOf(pointItem) != 0))
			{
				if (IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
				{
					return base.Item.AllPointItems.IndexOf(pointItem) == base.Item.AllPointItems.Count - 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override PointCalculatorProvider CreatePointCalculatorProvider()
		{
			bool flag = IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: true);
			bool flag2 = IsMarkerEdgeMode(isFirst: false);
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				return new EdgePointCalculatorProvider(this, flag, flag2);
			}
			return base.CreatePointCalculatorProvider();
		}

		protected internal override bool IsMarkerEdgeMode(bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				if (ActualLastPoint != null)
				{
					return GetMarkerDisplayMode(ActualLastPoint) != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualFirstPoint != null)
			{
				return GetMarkerDisplayMode(ActualFirstPoint) != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(ColorCollectionTypeConverter))]
	public class ColorCollection : ObservableCollection<System.Windows.Media.Color>, IFormattable
	{
		public string ToString(string format, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			using (IEnumerator<System.Windows.Media.Color> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					list.Add(enumerator.Current.ToString(formatProvider));
				}
			}
			return string.Join(" ", list);
		}
	}
	public class ColorCollectionTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destType)
		{
			if (!(destType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return destType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destType)
		{
			if (value is ColorCollection)
			{
				if (destType == typeof(string))
				{
					return ((IFormattable)value).ToString(null, culture);
				}
				if (destType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { ((ColorCollection)value).ToString() });
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			ColorCollection colorCollection = new ColorCollection();
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string[] array = text.Split(' ');
				if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
				{
					string[] array2 = array;
					foreach (string value2 in array2)
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value2))
						{
							try
							{
								System.Windows.Media.Color item = (System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(value2);
								colorCollection.Add(item);
							}
							catch
							{
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return colorCollection;
		}
	}

				CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(this, title, Control.FontWeightProperty);

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (!result.IsEmpty && result.Height != 0.0 && result.Width != 0.0)
			{
				availableSize = result;
			}
			return result;
