		protected override void OnContentChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetActualContent();
		}

		private PieSeries FindSeries()
		{
			IOwnedElement ownedElement = this;
			while (true)
			{
				if (ownedElement.Owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ownedElement.Owner is PieSeries)
				{
					break;
				}
				ownedElement = ownedElement.Owner;
			}
			return (PieSeries)ownedElement.Owner;
		}

		private string GetActualText(PieSeries series)
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string seriesTitleTextPattern = PieSeries.GetSeriesTitleTextPattern(this);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesTitleTextPattern))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(seriesTitleTextPattern, series);
			if (Controller == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = Controller.GetRefinedSeries(series);
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedSeries.Points[0], series);
			}
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		internal void SetActualContent()
		{
			object content = base.Content;
			if (content == null || content.Equals(TitleBase.ContentProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue))
			{
				PieSeries pieSeries = FindSeries();
				if (pieSeries != null)
				{
					string actualText = GetActualText(pieSeries);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualText))
					{
						ActualContent = actualText;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			ActualContent = content;
		}

		internal void SetVisibilityPriority(int visibilityPriority)
		{
			if (this.visibilityPriority > visibilityPriority)
			{
				this.visibilityPriority = visibilityPriority;
			}
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			SetActualContent();
		}

		internal string[] GetAvailablePatternPlaceholders()
		{
			return new string[2] { "TV", "S" };
		}

		internal void SetRootElement(UIElement rootElement)
		{
			this.rootElement = rootElement;
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.ChangeOwner(oldOwner, newOwner);
			SetActualContent();
		}
	}
	public class TitleCollection : ChartElementCollection<Title>
	{
		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				foreach (Title newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.SetVisibilityPriority(5);
					if (base.Owner is Series { Diagram: not null } series)
					{
						newItem.SetRootElement(series.Diagram.Container?.PlatformElement);
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}
	}
	public class ChartTitleCollection : TitleCollection

			{
				foreach (Title newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.SetVisibilityPriority(1);
					newItem.SetRootElement(base.Owner as UIElement);
				}
			}
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}
	}

		protected static void ContentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TitleBase titleBase = d as TitleBase;
			titleBase?.OnContentChanged(e);
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				((IChartElement)d).RemoveChild(e.OldValue);
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((IChartElement)d).AddChild(e.NewValue);
			}
			if (e.NewValue is IEditableContent)
			{
				titleBase.EditableContentSerializable = (IEditableContent)e.NewValue;
			}
			else
			{
				titleBase.editableContentSerializable = null;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void VisibleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TitleBase element = d as TitleBase;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		public TitleBase()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DXSerializer.AddCustomGetSerializablePropertiesHandler((DependencyObject)this, new CustomGetSerializablePropertiesEventHandler(CustomPropertiesSerializationUtils.SerializableControlProperties));
		}

		Transform ISupportFlowDirection.CreateDirectionTransform()
		{
			if (FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform
				{
					ScaleX = -1.0,
					ScaleY = 1.0,
					CenterX = 0.5,
					CenterY = 0.5
				};
			}
			return Transform.Identity;
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return base.MeasureOverride(ActualVisible ? constraint : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			return base.ArrangeOverride(ActualVisible ? arrangeBounds : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeVisible(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return Visible.HasValue;
		}
	}

	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		private List<CrosshairElement> crosshairElements;

		private CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement;

		private List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> crosshairAxisLabelElements;

		private List<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement> crosshairGroupHeaderElements;

		private List<CrosshairElementGroup> crosshairElementGroups;

		private List<CrosshairLegendElement> crosshairLegendElements;

		private List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> indicatorLegendElements;

		[Description("Gets crosshair elements (crosshair value lines, crosshair value labels, crosshair labels) to customize their appearance.")]
		[Obsolete("The CrosshairElements property is obsolete now. Use the CrosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public List<CrosshairElement> CrosshairElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (crosshairElements == null)
				{
					crosshairElements = new List<CrosshairElement>();
					foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairElementGroups)
					{
						crosshairElements.AddRange(crosshairElementGroup.CrosshairElements);
					}
				}
				return crosshairElements;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the settings of a crosshair line element to customize its appearance (color, line style).")]
		public CrosshairLineElement CrosshairLineElement => crosshairLineElement;

		[Description("Gets the settings of crosshair axis label elements to customize their appearance.")]
		public List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> CrosshairAxisLabelElements => crosshairAxisLabelElements;

		[Description("Gets the settings of crosshair group header elements to customize their appearance.")]
		[Obsolete("The CrosshairGroupHeaderElements property is obsolete now. Use the CrosshairElementGroup.HeaderElement property instead.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public List<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement> CrosshairGroupHeaderElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (crosshairGroupHeaderElements == null)
				{
					crosshairGroupHeaderElements = new List<CrosshairGroupHeaderElement>();
					foreach (CrosshairElementGroup crosshairElementGroup in crosshairElementGroups)
					{
						crosshairGroupHeaderElements.Add(crosshairElementGroup.HeaderElement);
					}
				}
				return crosshairGroupHeaderElements;
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides access to the settings of crosshair elements and crosshair group header elements to customize their appearance.")]
		public List<CrosshairElementGroup> CrosshairElementGroups => crosshairElementGroups;

		[Description("Returns crosshair legend elements to customize their appearance.")]
		public List<CrosshairLegendElement> CrosshairLegendElements => crosshairLegendElements;

		[Description("Returns all indicator elements that the Crosshair Cursor shows in a legend.")]
		public List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> IndicatorLegendElements => indicatorLegendElements;

		internal CustomDrawCrosshairEventArgs(RoutedEvent routedEvent, CrosshairLineElement crosshairLineElement, List<CrosshairAxisLabelElement> crosshairAxisLabelElements, List<CrosshairElementGroup> crosshairElementGroups, List<CrosshairLegendElement> crosshairLegendElements, List<CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement> indicatorLegendElements)
			: base(routedEvent)
		{
			this.crosshairLineElement = crosshairLineElement;
			this.crosshairAxisLabelElements = crosshairAxisLabelElements;
			this.crosshairElementGroups = crosshairElementGroups;
			this.crosshairLegendElements = crosshairLegendElements;
			this.indicatorLegendElements = indicatorLegendElements;
		}

		protected override void InvokeEventHandler(Delegate genericHandler, object genericTarget)
		{
			((CustomDrawCrosshairEventHandler)genericHandler)(genericTarget, this);
		}
	}

	public class IndicatorPoint
	{
		private readonly Indicator indicator;

		private readonly object argument;

		private readonly double[] values;

		private readonly Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> valuesByType;

		public Indicator Indicator => indicator;

		public object Argument => argument;

		public double[] Values => values;

		internal IndicatorPoint(Indicator indicator, object argument, Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> valuesByType)
		{
			this.indicator = indicator;
			this.argument = argument;
			this.valuesByType = valuesByType;
			values = valuesByType.Values.ToArray();
		}

		public double? GetNumericValue(IndicatorValueLevel valueLevel)
		{
			valuesByType.TryGetValue((IndicatorValueLevelCore)valueLevel, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class CrosshairElementGroup
	{
		private readonly CrosshairGroupHeaderElement headerElement;

		private readonly List<CrosshairIndicatorElement> indicatorElements;

		private readonly List<CrosshairElementBase> elements;

		private readonly ObservableCollection<CrosshairElement> crosshairElements;

		internal List<CrosshairElementBase> Elements => elements;

		[Description("Gets the settings of crosshair group header elements to customize their appearance.")]
		public CrosshairGroupHeaderElement HeaderElement => headerElement;

		[Description("Returns all indicator elements that the Crosshair Cursor displays.")]
		public IList<CrosshairIndicatorElement> IndicatorElements => indicatorElements;

		public IList<CrosshairElement> CrosshairElements => crosshairElements;

		internal CrosshairElementGroup(CrosshairGroupHeaderElement headerElement)
		{
			this.headerElement = headerElement;
			elements = new List<CrosshairElementBase>();
			indicatorElements = new List<CrosshairIndicatorElement>();
			crosshairElements = new ObservableCollection<CrosshairElement>();
		}

		internal void SubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChangedHandler)
		{
			crosshairElements.CollectionChanged += collectionChangedHandler;
		}

		internal void UnsubscribeCrosshairElementsCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler collectionChangedHandler)
		{
			crosshairElements.CollectionChanged -= collectionChangedHandler;
		}
	}

	public class ValueChangeInfo<T>
	{
		private readonly T oldValue;

		private readonly T newValue;

		public T OldValue => oldValue;

		public T NewValue => newValue;

		public bool IsChanged => !oldValue.Equals(newValue);

		internal ValueChangeInfo(T value)
		{
			oldValue = value;
			newValue = value;
		}

		internal ValueChangeInfo(T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			this.oldValue = oldValue;
			this.newValue = newValue;
		}
	}

	public abstract class ChartNonVisualElement : DXFrameworkContentElement, IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner, IDeserializableElement
	{
		private readonly Locker changedLocker = new Locker();

		private IChartElement owner;

		internal Locker ChangedLocker => changedLocker;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TypeNameSerializable => ((object)this).GetType().Name;

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				ChangeOwner(owner, value);
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					return owner.Controller;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsDeserializing { get; set; }

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate args)
		{
			if (!changedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					if (owner != null)
					{
						owner.Changed(args);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					changedLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			try
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				owner = null;
				oldOwner?.RemoveChild(this);
				owner = newOwner;
				newOwner?.AddChild(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				changedLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		void IDeserializableElement.StartDeserializing()
		{
			IsDeserializing = true;
		}

		void IDeserializableElement.CompleteDeserializing()
		{
			IsDeserializing = false;
		}
	}

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				ChangeOwner(owner, value);
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller => Controller;

		protected virtual void AddChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
				AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			if (logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Remove(child);
				RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
			AddChild(child);
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveChild(child);
		}

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (!changedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					if (ProcessChanging(updateInfo))
					{
						if (owner != null)
						{
							return owner.Changed(updateInfo);
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				finally
				{
					changedLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			if (oldOwner == newOwner)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				changedLocker.Lock();
				owner = null;
				oldOwner?.RemoveChild(this);
				owner = newOwner;
				newOwner?.AddChild(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				changedLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		public override void BeginInit()
		{
			base.BeginInit();
			changedLocker.Lock();
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			base.EndInit();
			changedLocker.Unlock();
		}
	}

			}
		}

			{
				this.propertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

		public static OwnerType GetOwner<OwnerType>(IOwnedElement element) where OwnerType : class, IChartElement
		{
			if (element.Owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (IChartElement owner = element.Owner; owner != null; owner = owner.Owner)
			{
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(OwnerType);
				if (typeFromHandle.IsAssignableFrom(owner.GetType()))
				{
					return owner as OwnerType;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static TOwner FindOwnerByType<TOwner>(IChartElement chartElement) where TOwner : class, IChartElement
		{
			IChartElement owner = chartElement.Owner;
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (owner is TOwner)
			{
				return (TOwner)owner;
			}
			return FindOwnerByType<TOwner>(owner);
		}

		{
			Update((IChartElement)series, update);
		}

	public abstract class ChartDependencyObjectCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>, ISupportInitialize, IOwnedElement
	{
		private readonly Locker changedLocker = new Locker();

		private IChartElement owner;

		protected virtual bool Loading => false;

		protected virtual ChartElementChange Change => ChartElementChange.None;

		protected IChartElement Owner => owner;

		protected virtual bool BatchUpdateSupported => false;

		protected virtual bool ShouldUpdateLogicalTree => true;

		protected Locker ChangedLocker => changedLocker;

		protected bool IsLocked
		{
			get
			{
				if (!changedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					return Loading;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				RemoveChildren(this);
				owner = value;
				AddChildren(this);
			}
		}

		protected void Update()
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(owner, Change | ChartElementChange.CollectionModified);
			}
		}

		protected ChartCollectionOperation GetOperation(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action)
		{
			return action switch
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add => ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, 
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move => ChartCollectionOperation.MoveItem, 
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove => ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, 
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace => ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem, 
				NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset => ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
			};
		}

		protected ICollection<D> GetCollection<D>(IList list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICollection<D> collection = new Collection<D>();
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				collection.Add((D)item);
			}
			return collection;
		}

		protected void AddChildren(IList children)
		{
			SetOwnerForChildren(children, owner);
			if (Owner == null || !ShouldUpdateLogicalTree)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object child in children)
			{
				Owner.AddChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveChildren(IList children)
		{
			SetOwnerForChildren(children, null);
			if (Owner == null || !ShouldUpdateLogicalTree)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object child in children)
			{
				Owner.RemoveChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetOwnerForChildren(IList children, IChartElement owner)
		{
			foreach (object child in children)
			{
				if (child is IChartElement chartElement)
				{
					chartElement.Owner = owner;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndInit(bool shouldUpdate)
		{
			changedLocker.Unlock();
			if (shouldUpdate && !IsLocked)
			{
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> items)
		{
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void BeginInit()
		{
			changedLocker.Lock();
		}

		public void EndInit()
		{
			EndInit(shouldUpdate: true);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartElementCollection<T> : ChartDependencyObjectCollection<T>
	{
		private class BatchUpdateHelper
		{
			private ChartElementCollection<T> owner;

			private List<ChartUpdateInfoBase> lockUpdateInfos = new List<ChartUpdateInfoBase>();

			public BatchUpdateHelper(ChartElementCollection<T> owner)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			private bool IsCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
			{
				if (!(updateInfo is SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo))
				{
					return updateInfo is SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private bool CanCreateBatchUpdate(CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo != null)
				{
					if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation != ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
					{
						return collectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private object GetItem(CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation != ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					return collectionUpdateInfo.OldItem;
				}
				return collectionUpdateInfo.NewItem;
			}

			private int GetIndex(CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation != ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					return collectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex;
				}
				return collectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex;
			}

			private bool IsIndexValid(CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo, int lastIndex)
			{
				if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					return lastIndex + 1 == collectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex;
				}
				return lastIndex == collectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex;
			}

			public List<ChartUpdateInfoBase> CreateUpdateInfos()
			{
				List<ChartUpdateInfoBase> list = new List<ChartUpdateInfoBase>();
				for (int i = 0; i < lockUpdateInfos.Count; i++)
				{
					ChartUpdateInfoBase chartUpdateInfoBase = lockUpdateInfos[i];
					if (IsCollectionBatchUpdateInfo(chartUpdateInfoBase))
					{
						list.Add(chartUpdateInfoBase);
						continue;
					}
					CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo = lockUpdateInfos[i] as CollectionUpdateInfo;
					if (!CanCreateBatchUpdate(collectionUpdateInfo))
					{
						list.Add(lockUpdateInfos[i]);
						continue;
					}
					if (!owner.BatchUpdateSupported)
					{
						list.Add(lockUpdateInfos[i]);
						continue;
					}
					IList updateInfoSequence = GetUpdateInfoSequence(i);
					if (updateInfoSequence == null || updateInfoSequence.Count == 1)
					{
						list.Add(lockUpdateInfos[i]);
						continue;
					}
					if (collectionUpdateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
					{
						list.Add(owner.CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, updateInfoSequence, null, collectionUpdateInfo.NewIndex, -1));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(owner.CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, null, updateInfoSequence, -1, collectionUpdateInfo.OldIndex));
					}
					i += updateInfoSequence.Count - 1;
				}
				return list;
			}

			private IList GetUpdateInfoSequence(int index)
			{
				IList list = null;
				CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo = lockUpdateInfos[index++] as CollectionUpdateInfo;
				ChartCollectionOperation operation = collectionUpdateInfo.Operation;
				if (collectionUpdateInfo != null)
				{
					list = new List<object>();
					int index2 = GetIndex(collectionUpdateInfo);
					list.Add(GetItem(collectionUpdateInfo));
					while (index < lockUpdateInfos.Count && lockUpdateInfos[index++] is CollectionUpdateInfo collectionUpdateInfo2 && collectionUpdateInfo2.Operation == operation && IsIndexValid(collectionUpdateInfo2, index2))
					{
						list.Add(GetItem(collectionUpdateInfo2));
						index2 = GetIndex(collectionUpdateInfo2);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			public void Add(ChartUpdateInfoBase changeInfo)
			{
				lockUpdateInfos.Add(changeInfo);
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				lockUpdateInfos.Clear();
			}
		}

		private readonly BatchUpdateHelper updateHelper;

		public ChartElementCollection()
		{
			updateHelper = new BatchUpdateHelper(this);
		}

		protected virtual ChartUpdateInfoBase CreateUpdateInfo(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, IList newItems, IList oldItems, int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex)
		{
			return new EmptyUpdateInfo(base.Owner);
		}

		protected virtual void PerformCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			RemoveChildren(this);
			base.ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null && (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace))
			{
				RemoveChildren(e.OldItems);
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null && (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace))
			{
				AddChildren(e.NewItems);
			}
			if (!base.IsLocked)
			{
				ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo = CreateUpdateInfo(e.Action, e.NewItems, e.OldItems, e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldStartingIndex);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(base.Owner, updateInfo, Change | ChartElementChange.CollectionModified);
			}
			else
			{
				ChartUpdateInfoBase changeInfo = CreateUpdateInfo(e.Action, e.NewItems, e.OldItems, e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldStartingIndex);
				updateHelper.Add(changeInfo);
			}
			PerformCollectionChanged(e);
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		internal void ClearUpdatesCache()
		{
			updateHelper.Clear();
		}

		internal void ForceEndInit()
		{
			List<ChartUpdateInfoBase> list = updateHelper.CreateUpdateInfos();
			foreach (ChartUpdateInfoBase item in list)
			{
				ProcessLockedUpdateCore(item);
			}
			ClearUpdatesCache();
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessLockedUpdateCore(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(base.Owner, updateInfo, Change | ChartElementChange.CollectionModified);
		}

		protected internal override void EndInit(bool shouldUpdate)
		{
			base.ChangedLocker.Unlock();
			if (!base.IsLocked)
			{
				ForceEndInit();
			}
		}

		internal List<J> Convert<J>(Func<T, J> converter)
		{
			List<J> list = new List<J>();
			using IEnumerator<T> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				T current = enumerator.Current;
				J val = converter(current);
				if (val != null)
				{
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Series")]
	public abstract class Diagram : ChartElement, IDiagram, IChartDiagram, IInteractiveElement, IVisualChildOwner, ISeriesTemplateContainer
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey SeriesPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey CrosshairAxisLabelItemsPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey BreadcrumbItemsPropertyKey;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsDrillDownEnabledProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BreadcrumbItemsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnnotationsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesDataMemberProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CrosshairAxisLabelItemsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesItemsSourceProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesItemTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesItemTemplateSelectorProperty;

		public static readonly RoutedEvent DrillDownStateChangedEvent;

		private readonly ViewController viewController;

		private readonly SelectionInfo selectionInfo;

		private AnnotationLayoutPanel annotationsPanel;

		protected override ViewController Controller => viewController;

		protected abstract bool Is3DView { get; }

		internal bool IsValidMembersForBinding
		{
			get
			{
				IBindingProvider seriesTemplate = SeriesTemplate;
				if (SeriesTemplate != null && SeriesTemplate.Visible && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesDataMember))
				{
					return seriesTemplate.IsValidMembersForBinding;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal ViewController ViewController => viewController;

		internal IContainerElement Container => ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as IContainerElement;

		internal AnnotationLayoutPanel AnnotationsPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (annotationsPanel == null)
				{
					annotationsPanel = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType<AnnotationLayoutPanel>((FrameworkElement)this, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null);
				}
				return annotationsPanel;
			}
		}

		[Description("Occurs when end users navigate by detail levels when the Chart is is the Drill Mode.")]

		static Diagram()
		{
			SeriesPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Series", typeof(SeriesCollection), typeof(Diagram), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));
			CrosshairAxisLabelItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("CrosshairAxisLabelItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<CrosshairAxisLabelItem>), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("CrosshairSeriesLabelItems", typeof(ObservableCollection<CrosshairSeriesLabelItem>), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			BreadcrumbItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("BreadcrumbItems", typeof(BreadcrumbItemCollection), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			SeriesItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<Diagram, Series>), typeof(Diagram));
			IsDrillDownEnabledProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDrillDownEnabled", typeof(bool), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			BreadcrumbItemsProperty = BreadcrumbItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AnnotationsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Annotations", typeof(ObservableCollection<Annotation>), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.Update));
			SeriesProperty = SeriesPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SeriesTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesTemplate", typeof(Series), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null, SeriesTemplateChanged));
			SeriesDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, SeriesDataMemberChanged));
			CrosshairAxisLabelItemsProperty = CrosshairAxisLabelItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsProperty = CrosshairSeriesLabelItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SeriesItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesItemsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null, SeriesItemsSourceChanged));
			SeriesItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null, SeriesItemTemplateChanged));
			SeriesItemTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeriesItemTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(Diagram), new PropertyMetadata(null, SeriesItemTemplateChanged));
			DrillDownStateChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DrillDownStateChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(DrillDownStateChangedEventHandler), typeof(Diagram));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(Diagram);
			Control.PaddingProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			FrameworkElement.MarginProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
			Control.BorderThicknessProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure, ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
		}

		private static void CheckSeriesItemTemplateUsing(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (d is Diagram diagram)
			{
				diagram.CheckSeriesItemTemplateUsing();
			}
		}

		private static void SeriesTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckSeriesItemTemplateUsing(d);
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries);
		}

		private static void SeriesDataMemberChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckSeriesItemTemplateUsing(d);
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries);
		}

		private static void SeriesItemsSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Diagram diagram)
			{
				diagram.BreadcrumbItems.Clear();
				if (e.NewValue is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase)
				{
					hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.Diagram = diagram;
					diagram.BreadcrumbItems.Add(new BreadcrumbItem("Home", null, isHome: true)
					{
						IsNotLast = false
					});
					Binding binding = new Binding("DataContext");
					binding.Source = diagram;
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(hierarchicalDataAdapterBase, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, binding);
					diagram.IsDrillDownEnabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					diagram.IsDrillDownEnabled = false;
				}
				PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(diagram, (IEnumerable)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		internal static void RunSeriesItemsSourceAction(Diagram diagram, Action action)
		{
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.Series.LockSeriesSource();
				action();
				diagram.Series.UnlockSeriesSource();
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		private static void LinkSeriesWithSource(Series series, object source)
		{
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.CreatedFromSeriesSource = true;
				TagUtils.AttachTagToChartElement(series, source);
			}
		}

		private static void SeriesItemTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RunSeriesItemsSourceAction((Diagram)d, delegate
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<Diagram, DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Series>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged(d, e, SeriesItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
			});
		}

		private static void PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(Diagram chartDiagram, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			chartDiagram.viewController.BeginUpdateData();
			RunSeriesItemsSourceAction(chartDiagram, delegate
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<Diagram, DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Series>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)chartDiagram, (IEnumerable)null, newValue, SeriesItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, SeriesItemTemplateProperty, SeriesItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DependencyProperty)null, (DependencyProperty)null, (Func<Diagram, IList>)((Diagram diagram) => diagram.Series), (Func<Diagram, Series>)((Diagram diagram) => new BarSideBySideSeries2D()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<Series>)null, chartDiagram.GetValue(SeriesProperty) as ISupportInitialize, (Action<Series, object>)LinkSeriesWithSource, true, true, (Func<Series, bool>)null, (Action<Series, Series>)null, false);
			});
			chartDiagram.viewController.EndUpdateData();
		}

		void IChartDiagram.UpdateSeriesItems()
		{
			bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems = false;
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.LabelsResolveOverlappingEnabled || item.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true) || item.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false))
				{
					shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			UpdateSeriesItems(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems);
		}

		private void UpdateAutoSeriesProperties()
		{
			Series seriesTemplate = SeriesTemplate;
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (!item.IsAutoSeries)
				{
					break;
				}
				item.CopyPropertiesForBinding(seriesTemplate, onlyUpdateProperties: true);
			}
		}

		private void CheckSeriesItemTemplateUsing()
		{
			if ((SeriesItemTemplate != null || SeriesItemTemplateSelector != null) && SeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				throw new Exception(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgUsingSeriesTemplateAndItemTemplate));
			}
		}

		private bool IsColorEachInSeries()
		{
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				if (item.ActualColorEach || item.ColorEachByColorizer)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SeriesContainerItem FindSeriesContainerItem(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			SeriesContainer seriesContainer = ViewController.GetSeriesContainer((RefinedSeries)refinedSeries);
			SeriesContainerItem seriesContainerItem = null;
			foreach (SeriesContainerItem containerItem in containerItems)
			{
				if (containerItem.Container == seriesContainer)
				{
					seriesContainerItem = containerItem;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (seriesContainerItem == null)
			{
				seriesContainerItem = new SeriesContainerItem(seriesContainer);
				containerItems.Add(seriesContainerItem);
			}
			return seriesContainerItem;
		}

		private string[] GetLabelTexts(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, Series series, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int index, bool firstPointEdgeMode, bool lastPointEdgeMode)
		{
			SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = null;
			if (firstPointEdgeMode)
			{
				list = series.ViewportIntersectionHolder.GetViewportEdgePoints(index, isLeft: true);
				if (list != null)
				{
					actualLabel = series.ActualFirstPoint.ActualLabel;
				}
			}
			if (list == null && lastPointEdgeMode)
			{
				list = series.ViewportIntersectionHolder.GetViewportEdgePoints(index, isLeft: false);
				if (list != null)
				{
					actualLabel = series.ActualLastPoint.ActualLabel;
				}
			}
			if (!series.LabelsVisibility && list == null)
			{
				return new string[1] { string.Empty };
			}
			return series.GetLabelsTexts(actualLabel, (list != null) ? refinedSeries.GetCorrectRefinedPointForLabel(refinedPoint, list) : refinedPoint);
		}

		protected virtual void FillLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> legendItems, LegendBase legend)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				Series series = (Series)((IRefinedSeries)item).Series;
				if (series.ActualLegend == legend)
				{
					series.UpdateLegendItems(legendItems, legend, GetSeriesItem(series));
				}
			}
		}

			}

		internal bool UpdateAutoSeries(IList<ISeries> autoCreatedSeries)
		{
			bool result = false;
			SeriesCollection series = Series;
			series.BeginInit();
			series.UnlockAutoSeries();
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
				{
					if (series[i].IsAutoSeries)
					{
						result = true;
						series.RemoveAt(i--);
					}
				}
				if (series.Count == 0)
				{
					series.Reset();
				}
				int num = 0;
				foreach (Series item in autoCreatedSeries)
				{
					if (item.ActualPoints.Count > 0)
					{
						result = true;
						series.Insert(num++, item);
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				series.LockAutoSeries();
				series.EndInit(shouldUpdate: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateLegendItems(LegendBase legend)
		{
			if (legend != null)
			{
				List<LegendItemBase> list = new List<LegendItemBase>();
				if (legend.CanShowAutogeneratedItems)
				{
					FillLegendItems(list, legend);
				}
				legend.FillCustomLegendItems(list);
				legend.UpdateItems(list);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateLegendsItems(IContainerLegendOptions parent)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LegendBase legend in parent.Legends)
			{
				UpdateLegendItems(legend);
			}
		}

		protected int GetPointIndex(int pointIndex, ISeriesPointData pointData)
		{
			return pointData?.IndexInSeries ?? pointIndex;
		}

		internal void Update(bool shouldUpdatePanesItems, bool shouldUpdateXYDiagram2DItems, bool shouldUpdateLegendItems, bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems)
		{
			Update(shouldUpdatePanesItems, shouldUpdateXYDiagram2DItems, shouldUpdateLegendItems, shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, shouldUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure: false);
		}

		internal void Update(bool shouldUpdatePanesItems, bool shouldUpdateXYDiagram2DItems, bool shouldUpdateLegendItems, bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, bool shouldUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure)
		{
			IContainerElement container = Container;
			UpdateAxesTextPattern();
			EnsureSeriesItems();
			UpdateSeriesItems(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems);
			if (container != null && (shouldUpdateLegendItems || IsColorEachInSeries()))
			{
				UpdateLegendsItems(container.LegendOptions);
			}
			if (shouldUpdateXYDiagram2DItems)
			{
				UpdateVisualItems(shouldUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure);
				UpdateLogicalElements();
			}
			else if (shouldUpdatePanesItems || shouldUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure)
			{
				UpdateVisualItems(shouldUpdateAxisLabelsMeasure);
			}
		}

		internal bool TryUpdatePalette()
		{
			if (Container?.DataOptions != null)
			{
				foreach (Series item in Series)
				{
					if (item.Colorizer is ISupportPalette supportPalette && supportPalette.GetPalette() == null)
					{
						Container.DataOptions.UpdateData();
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void RaiseBoundDataChangedEvent()
		{
			if (Container != null)
			{
				((IChartWithData)Container).RaiseBoundDataChangedEvent();
			}
		}

		internal bool DrillDownInternal(object seriesSourceObj, object pointSourceObj)
		{
			if (!(SeriesItemsSource is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			object dataItem = ((pointSourceObj != null) ? pointSourceObj : seriesSourceObj);
			string breadcrumbText = hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.GetBreadcrumbText(seriesSourceObj, pointSourceObj);
			return DrillDown(dataItem, breadcrumbText);
		}

		internal bool CanDrillDown(object dataItem)
		{
			if (!(SeriesItemsSource is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.CanDrillDown(dataItem);
		}

		internal void DrillUpTo(object sourceObject)
		{
			if (SeriesItemsSource is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase && BreadcrumbItems.Count >= 2)
			{
				while (BreadcrumbItems.Last().SourceObject != sourceObject && BreadcrumbItems.Count > 0)
				{
					BreadcrumbItems.RemoveLast();
				}
				if (sourceObject == null)
				{
					hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.DrillUpToTop();
				}
				else
				{
					hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.DrillDown(sourceObject);
				}
				BreadcrumbItems.Last().IsNotLast = false;
				PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(this, SeriesItemsSource);
				RaiseDrillDownStateChangedEvent();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSeriesItems(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems)
		{
			List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems = new List<SeriesContainerItem>();
			foreach (Series item in Series)
			{
				IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(item);
				ISeriesItem seriesItem = GetSeriesItem(item);
				if (seriesItem.ShouldUpdate)
				{
					seriesItem.Update(refinedSeries, out var shouldUpdateSeriesLabels);
					shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems = shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems || shouldUpdateSeriesLabels;
				}
				if (refinedSeries != null)
				{
					SeriesContainerItem seriesContainerItem = FindSeriesContainerItem(refinedSeries, containerItems);
					seriesContainerItem.Series.Add(item);
				}
			}
			UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			IContainerEventsOptions containerEventsOptions = Container?.EventsOptions;
			if (containerEventsOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RoutedEvent customDrawSeriesEvent = containerEventsOptions.CustomDrawSeriesEvent;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				Series series = (Series)((IRefinedSeries)item).Series;
				ISeriesItem seriesItem = GetSeriesItem(series);
				DrawOptions drawOptions = (seriesItem.DrawOptions = new DrawOptions(series));
				IInteractiveElement interactiveElement = series;
				CustomDrawSeriesEventArgs e = new CustomDrawSeriesEventArgs(customDrawSeriesEvent, drawOptions, series.GetSeriesLegendText(), series, interactiveElement.IsSelected);
				try
				{
					ViewController.LockAllUpdates();
					Container.PlatformElement.RaiseEvent(e);
				}
				finally
				{
					ViewController.UnlockAllUpdates();
				}
				seriesItem.LegendText = e.LegendText;
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = drawOptions.Color;
				double opacity = series.GetOpacity();
				int num = 0;
				interactiveElement.IsSelected = ((IInteractiveElement)e).IsSelected;
				DrawOptions drawOptions3 = null;
				series.UpdatePointsSelection();
				IList<RefinedPoint> points = ((IRefinedSeries)item).Points;
				bool firstPointEdgeMode = series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: true);
				bool lastPointEdgeMode = series.IsLabelEdgeMode(isFirst: false);
				foreach (ISeriesPointData pointDatum in seriesItem.PointData)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointDatum.RefinedPoint;
					if (refinedPoint == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
					if (platformSeriesPoint != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = (platformSeriesPoint.Color.HasValue ? platformSeriesPoint.Color.Value : ((!refinedPoint.IsEmpty || series.ActualEmptyPointOptions == null || !series.ActualEmptyPointOptions.ActualColor.HasValue) ? series.GetPointOriginalColorForCustomDraw(item, GetPointIndex(num, pointDatum), color, points) : series.ActualEmptyPointOptions.ActualColor.Value));
						if (containerEventsOptions.ShouldRaiseCustomDrawSeriesPointEvent)
						{
							if (drawOptions3 != drawOptions)
							{
								drawOptions3 = (DrawOptions)drawOptions.Clone();
							}
							drawOptions3.Color = color2;
							SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
							double percentValue = refinedPoint.GetPercentValue();
							double totalValue = refinedPoint.GetTotalValue();
							string[] labelTexts = GetLabelTexts(item, series, refinedPoint, pointDatum.IndexInSeries, firstPointEdgeMode, lastPointEdgeMode);
							string pointLegendText = series.GetPointLegendText(refinedPoint);
							CustomDrawSeriesPointEventArgs e2 = new CustomDrawSeriesPointEventArgs(containerEventsOptions.CustomDrawSeriesPointEvent, drawOptions3, pointLegendText, series, labelTexts, seriesPoint, totalValue, percentValue, platformSeriesPoint.IsSelected);
							try
							{
								ViewController.LockAllUpdates();
								containerEventsOptions.RaiseCustomDrawSeriesPoint(e2);
							}
							finally
							{
								ViewController.UnlockAllUpdates();
							}
							pointDatum.Color = drawOptions3.Color;
							pointDatum.LegendText = e2.LegendText;
							pointDatum.LabelsTexts = e2.LabelsTexts;
							platformSeriesPoint.IsSelected = ((IInteractiveElement)e2).IsSelected;
						}
						else
						{
							pointDatum.Color = color2;
							pointDatum.LegendText = series.GetPointLegendText(refinedPoint);
							pointDatum.LabelsTexts = GetLabelTexts(item, series, refinedPoint, pointDatum.IndexInSeries, firstPointEdgeMode, lastPointEdgeMode);
						}
						pointDatum.Opacity = opacity;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateAutoSeries || updateInfo.ShouldUpdateAutoSeriesProperties)
			{
				DiagramLayoutChanged = true;
				if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateAutoSeries && Container?.DataOptions != null)
				{
					Container.DataOptions.ResetBoundData(isSeriesReset: false);
				}
				else if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateAutoSeriesProperties)
				{
					ViewController.BeginUpdateData();
					UpdateAutoSeriesProperties();
					ViewController.EndUpdateData();
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool DrillDown(object dataItem, string breadcrumbText = null)
		{
			HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase = SeriesItemsSource as HierarchicalDataAdapterBase;
			if (dataItem == null || hierarchicalDataAdapterBase == null || dataItem == BreadcrumbItems.Last().SourceObject)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.DrillDown(dataItem);
			if (flag)
			{
				string text = ((breadcrumbText == null) ? dataItem.ToString() : breadcrumbText);
				BreadcrumbItems.Last().IsNotLast = true;
				BreadcrumbItems.Add(new BreadcrumbItem(text, dataItem, isHome: false)
				{
					IsNotLast = false
				});
				PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(this, SeriesItemsSource);
				RaiseDrillDownStateChangedEvent();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool DrillUp()
		{
			if (!(SeriesItemsSource is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase) || BreadcrumbItems.Count < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object sourceObject = BreadcrumbItems[BreadcrumbItems.Count - 2].SourceObject;
			if (sourceObject == null)
			{
				hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.DrillUpToTop();
				BreadcrumbItems.RemoveLast();
				BreadcrumbItems.Last().IsNotLast = false;
				PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(this, SeriesItemsSource);
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.DrillDown(sourceObject);
			if (flag)
			{
				BreadcrumbItems.RemoveLast();
				BreadcrumbItems.Last().IsNotLast = false;
				PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(this, SeriesItemsSource);
				RaiseDrillDownStateChangedEvent();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public void ResetDrillDown()
		{
			if (SeriesItemsSource is HierarchicalDataAdapterBase hierarchicalDataAdapterBase)
			{
				hierarchicalDataAdapterBase.ResetWithoutNotification();
				BreadcrumbItems.Clear();
				BreadcrumbItems.Add(new BreadcrumbItem("Home", null, isHome: true)
				{
					IsNotLast = false
				});
				RaiseDrillDownStateChangedEvent();
				PerformNewSeriesItemSourceProcessing(this, SeriesItemsSource);
			}
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			base.EndInit();
			if (Container?.DataOptions != null)
			{
				Container.DataOptions.ResetBoundData(isSeriesReset: false);
				if (!Container.PlatformElement.IsVisible)
				{
					ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		void ISeriesTemplateContainer.OnDataWasChanged()
		{
			OnDataWasChanged();
		}

		{
			public static LabelBehavior Instance { get; } = new LabelBehavior();

			public override ScreenPointCalculatorBase PointCalculator => ScreenPointCalculator.Instance;

			public override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, Transform transform, Rect barBounds, System.Windows.Point anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection)
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				DXRectangle val = GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(transform.TransformBounds(barBounds));
				if (((DXRectangle)(ref val)).IsCollapsed)
				{
					int num = ((((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width <= 0) ? 1 : 0);
					int num2 = ((((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height <= 0) ? 1 : 0);
					val = val.Inflate(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, num, num2));
				}
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, val, anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection);
			}

			public override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, int indent, double angle)
			{
				//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, indent, angle, DXRectangle.Empty);
			}

			public override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, int indent, System.Windows.Point centerPoint)
			{
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, anchorPoint, mapping, centerPoint, anchorPoint);
			}
		}

		private class EdgeLabelBehavior : LabelBehaviorBase
		{
			private readonly ScreenPointCalculatorBase pointCalculator;

			private readonly bool isFirst;

			public override ScreenPointCalculatorBase PointCalculator => pointCalculator;

			public EdgeLabelBehavior(ScreenPointCalculatorBase pointCalculator, bool isFirst)
			{
				this.pointCalculator = pointCalculator;
				this.isFirst = isFirst;
			}

			private XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayoutCore(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, int indent, double angle)
			{
				//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				double angle2 = ((!pointCalculator.AlwaysOnDiagram) ? angle : (isFirst ? Math.PI : 0.0));
				return new XYSeriesLabel2DLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, indent, angle2, DXRectangle.Empty, edgeLabel: true);
			}

			public override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, Transform transform, Rect barBounds, System.Windows.Point anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection)
			{
				return CreateLayoutCore(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, 0, isFirst ? Math.PI : 0.0);
			}

			public override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, int indent, double angle)
			{
				return CreateLayoutCore(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, indent, angle);
			}

			public override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, int indent, System.Windows.Point centerPoint)
			{
				return CreateLayoutCore(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, indent, -Math.PI / 2.0);
			}
		}

		static SeriesLabel()
		{
			VisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(false, VisiblePropertyChanged));
			ItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Items", typeof(ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem>), typeof(SeriesLabel));
			IndentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Indent", typeof(int), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(10, NotifyPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateIndent);
			RenderModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("RenderMode", typeof(LabelRenderMode), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(LabelRenderMode.RectangleConnectedToCenter, NotifyPropertyChanged));
			ConnectorVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ConnectorVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(true, NotifyPropertyChanged));
			ConnectorThicknessProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ConnectorThickness", typeof(int), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(1, NotifyPropertyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateConnectorThickness);
			ResolveOverlappingModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ResolveOverlappingMode", typeof(ResolveOverlappingMode), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(ResolveOverlappingMode.None, NotifyPropertyChanged));
			TextOrientationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TextOrientation", typeof(TextOrientation), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(TextOrientation.Horizontal, TextOrientationPropertyChanged));
			TextPatternProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(SeriesLabel), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, TextPatternPropertyChanged));
			FrameworkElement.FlowDirectionProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SeriesLabel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache));
		}

		public SeriesLabel()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SeriesLabel>(this);
		}

		string ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetClassName()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetClassName(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true);
		}

		string ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetComponentName()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetComponentName(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true);
		}

		AttributeCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetAttributes()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetAttributes(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true);
		}

		private bool IsPropertySupported(PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			if (property.Name == ResolveOverlappingModeProperty.Name && !Series.LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (property.Name == ConnectorVisibleProperty.Name && !Series.LabelConnectorSupported)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (property.Name == ConnectorThicknessProperty.Name && !Series.LabelConnectorSupported)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetFilteredProperties(PropertyDescriptorCollection properties)
		{
			if (Series == null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in properties)
			{
				if (IsPropertySupported(property))
				{
					list.Add(property);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetProperties()
		{
			return GetFilteredProperties(TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true));
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetProperties(Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return GetFilteredProperties(TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this, attributes, noCustomTypeDesc: true));
		}

		PropertyDescriptor ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetDefaultProperty()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetDefaultProperty(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true);
		}

		EventDescriptorCollection ICustomTypeDescriptor.GetEvents()
		{
			return TypeDescriptor.GetEvents(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true);
		}

			return this;

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			SeriesLabel seriesLabel = new SeriesLabel();
			BindingPropertiesContainer<SeriesLabel>.Apply(this, seriesLabel);
			return seriesLabel;
		}

		private void UpdateLabelTransform()
		{
			base.LayoutTransform = TextUtils.CalculateTransform(TextOrientation);
		}

		private void UpdateConnectorItems(ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> labelItems)
		{
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem labelItem in labelItems)
			{
				bool showConnector = Series != null && Series.IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(this);
				labelItem.ConnectorItem = new SeriesLabelConnectorItem(labelItem);
				labelItem.ShowConnector = showConnector;
			}
		}

		private void NotifyPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(e, diagram3DOnly: false);
		}

		private void NotifyPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e, bool diagram3DOnly)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new SeriesLabelPropertyChangedEventArgs(e, diagram3DOnly));
			}
		}

		internal Series GetSeries()
		{
			return ((IOwnedElement)this).Owner as Series;
		}

		internal void UpdateItems(IList<SeriesPointItem> pointItems)
		{
			ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem> observableCollection = Items;
			if (observableCollection == null || pointItems == null || observableCollection.Count != pointItems.Count)
			{
				observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<SeriesLabelItem>();
			}
			if (pointItems != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < pointItems.Count; i++)
				{
					if (observableCollection.Count <= i)
					{
						observableCollection.Add(new SeriesLabelItem(this));
					}
					observableCollection[i].PointItem = pointItems[i];
					pointItems[i].LabelItem = observableCollection[i];
				}
			}
			UpdateConnectorItems(observableCollection);
			Items = observableCollection;
		}

		protected override void CollectAssignableProperties(List<DependencyProperty> properties)
		{
			base.CollectAssignableProperties(properties);
			properties.Add(ConnectorVisibleProperty);
			properties.Add(ConnectorThicknessProperty);
			properties.Add(IndentProperty);
			properties.Add(RenderModeProperty);
			properties.Add(ResolveOverlappingModeProperty);
			properties.Add(TextOrientationProperty);
			properties.Add(TextPatternProperty);
			GetSeries()?.CollectLabelProperties(properties);
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			base.ChangeOwner(oldOwner, newOwner);
			if (Series != null && (bool)GetValue(VisibleProperty))
			{
				Series.SetLabelsVisibility(value: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void ElementTemplatePropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void FontPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(e, diagram3DOnly: true);
		}

		internal void UpdateTextPattern(string pattern)
		{
			changeLocker = true;
			TextPattern = pattern;
			changeLocker = false;
		}

		internal void UpdateLabelBehavior(XYSeries2D series, SidePointDisplayMode labelDisplayMode, bool isFirst)
		{
			behavior = new EdgeLabelBehavior(series.CreateScreenPointCalculator(labelDisplayMode), isFirst);
		}

		internal XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, Transform transform, Rect barBounds, System.Windows.Point anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection)
		{
			return behavior.CreateLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, transform, barBounds, anchorPointWithoutModelCorrection);
		}

		internal XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, double angle)
		{
			return behavior.CreateLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, Indent, angle);
		}

		internal XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, System.Windows.Point anchorPoint, PaneMapping mapping, System.Windows.Point centerPoint)
		{
			return behavior.CreateLayout(labelItem, mapping, anchorPoint, Indent, centerPoint);
		}

		[DefaultValue(typeof(string), "")]
		[Description("Gets or sets the series point’s argument.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string Argument
		{
			get
			{
				return argumentContainer.Argument;
			}
			set
			{
				if (argumentContainer.Argument != value)
				{
					argumentContainer.Argument = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Argument");
					Update("Argument");
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(double.NaN)]
		[Description("Gets or sets the series point’s value.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return numericalValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (double.IsInfinity(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgSeriesPointIncorrectValue));
				}
				if (numericalValue != value)
				{
					numericalValue = value;
					if (!animationInProcess)
					{
						baseNumericalValue = value;
					}
					Update("Values");
					RaisePropertyChanged("Value");
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(typeof(DateTime), "01/01/0001 00:00 AM")]
		[Description("Gets the point’s value of a date-time type.")]
		[Category("Common")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]

		{
			get

		private static void SetFinancialValues(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, double low, double high, double open, double close)
		{
			FinancialSeries2D.SetLowValue(seriesPoint, low);
			FinancialSeries2D.SetHighValue(seriesPoint, high);
			FinancialSeries2D.SetOpenValue(seriesPoint, open);
			FinancialSeries2D.SetCloseValue(seriesPoint, close);
		}

		internal static void Update(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
			{
				seriesPoint.Update("Values");
			}
		}

		internal static SeriesPoint GetSeriesPoint(IDataPoint point)
		{
			if (point is SeriesPoint result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (point is LightSeriesPoint lightSeriesPoint)
			{
				return lightSeriesPoint.FullSeriesPoint;
			}
			if (point is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
			{
				return new SeriesPoint(aggregatedPoint);
			}
			if (point is RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
			{
				return GetSeriesPoint((IDataPoint)refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static IPlatformSeriesPoint GetPlatformSeriesPoint(IDataPoint point)
		{
			if (point is RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
			{
				return GetPlatformSeriesPoint((IDataPoint)refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
			if (point is IPlatformSeriesPoint)
			{
				return (IPlatformSeriesPoint)point;
			}
			return new SeriesPoint((AggregatedSeriesPoint)point);
		}

		internal static void SynchronizeProperties(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e, DependencyProperty source, DependencyProperty destination)
		{
			if (d is SeriesPoint seriesPoint && !seriesPoint.synchronizePropertiesLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				seriesPoint.synchronizePropertiesLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					seriesPoint.SetValue(destination, seriesPoint.GetValue(source));
				}
				finally
				{
					seriesPoint.synchronizePropertiesLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
		}

		internal SeriesPoint(LightSeriesPoint lightSeriesPoint)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Series series = (Series)((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).Owner;
			argumentContainer = new SeriesPointArgumentXContainer(this, ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).ArgumentX.UserArgument);
			series.SetPointValues(this, ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).Values.NumericalValues, ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).Values.DateTimeValues, ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).Values.TimeSpanValues);
			tag = ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).Tag;
			toolTipHint = ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).ToolTipHint;
			indicatorPoint = ((ISeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).IndicatorPoint;
			isHighlighted = ((IInteractiveElement)lightSeriesPoint).IsHighlighted;
			isSelected = ((IInteractiveElement)lightSeriesPoint).IsSelected;
			brush = series.ColorizerController.GetSeriesPointBrush(((IPlatformSeriesPoint)lightSeriesPoint).Color);
			owner = series;
		}

		private SeriesPoint(AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			argumentContainer = new SeriesPointArgumentXContainer(this, aggregatedPoint.ArgumentX.Argument);
			Series series = (Series)aggregatedPoint.Series;
			series.SetPointValues(this, aggregatedPoint.Values.NumericalValues, aggregatedPoint.Values.DateTimeValues, aggregatedPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues);
			tag = SeriesPointHelper.GetPointTag(aggregatedPoint);
			brush = series.ColorizerController.GetBrushForAggregatedPoint(aggregatedPoint);
			isAuxiliary = aggregatedPoint.IsAuxiliary;
			owner = series;
			toolTipHint = ((ISeriesPoint)aggregatedPoint).ToolTipHint;
		}

		bool ISeriesPoint.IsEmpty(Scale valueScaleType)
		{
			switch (valueScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
			{
				double[] values = GetValues();
				int num = Math.Min(values.Length, 5);
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					if (double.IsNaN(values[k]))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			case Scale.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime[] dateTimeValues = GetDateTimeValues();
				int num = Math.Min(dateTimeValues.Length, 5);
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					if (dateTimeValues[j].Equals(DateTime.MinValue))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
			{
				TimeSpan[] timeSpanValues = GetTimeSpanValues();
				int num = Math.Min(timeSpanValues.Length, 5);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (timeSpanValues[i].Equals(TimeSpan.Zero))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect scale type for the series point value.");
				return true;
			}
		}

		bool ISeriesPoint.IsSamePoints(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint is LightSeriesPoint lightSeriesPoint)
			{
				return this == lightSeriesPoint.FullSeriesPoint;
			}
			return this == seriesPoint;
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AggregateFunctionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AggregateFunction", typeof(SeriesAggregateFunction), typeof(XYSeries), new PropertyMetadata(SeriesAggregateFunction.Default, AggregateFunctionPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CustomAggregateFunctionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CustomAggregateFunction", typeof(CustomAggregateFunction), typeof(XYSeries), new PropertyMetadata(null, AggregateFunctionCalculatorPropertyChanged));

		private static void AggregateFunctionPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

				ChartElementChange change = ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems;

		private static void BrushPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XYSeries xYSeries)
			{
				xYSeries.UpdateDrawOptionsColor();
				if (!xYSeries.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e))
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update(d, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
				}
			}
		}

			{

		protected override double GetRefinedPointMax(RefinedPoint point)

			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetRefinedPointAbsMin(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
		}

		protected override bool CanLoadOneDimensionData(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			if (AggregateFunction == SeriesAggregateFunction.Histogram)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IAxisData axisXCore = AxisXCore;
			if (axisXCore != null)
			{
				IScaleOptionsBase scaleOptionsBase = null;
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					scaleOptionsBase = axisXCore.NumericScaleOptions;
					break;
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					scaleOptionsBase = axisXCore.DateTimeScaleOptions;
					break;
				case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
					scaleOptionsBase = axisXCore.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
					break;
				case ScaleType.Qualitative:
					scaleOptionsBase = axisXCore.QualitativeScaleOptions;
					break;
				}
				if (scaleOptionsBase != null)
				{
					return scaleOptionsBase.AggregateFunction == AggregateFunctionNative.Histogram;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void ChangeOwner(IChartElement oldOwner, IChartElement newOwner)
		{
			if (AdditionalGeometry != null && newOwner == null && oldOwner != null)
			{
				AdditionalGeometry.OnSeriesDetached();
			}
			base.ChangeOwner(oldOwner, newOwner);
			if (AdditionalGeometry != null && newOwner != null && oldOwner == null)
			{
				AdditionalGeometry.OnSeriesAttached();
			}
		}
	}
	public enum SeriesAggregateFunction
	{
		Default = -1,
		None = 0,
		Average = 1,
		Sum = 4,
		Minimum = 2,
		Maximum = 3,
		Count = 5,
		Histogram = 6,
		Financial = 7,
		Custom = 8
	}

	public abstract class Series : ChartElement, ISeries, ISeriesBase, ISeriesPointFactory, ISeriesFactory, ISeriesView, ISeriesDataAdapter, ILegendVisible, IWeakEventListener, IAnimatableElement, IWizardDataProvider, IInteractiveElement, IPatternHolder, ISeriesLabelDataProvider, IBindingPropertiesSource, ISeriesBindingProvider, IBindingProvider, IFilteredComponent, IFilteredComponentBase, IPointsFilterOptions, ISupportTag, ISeriesTemplate
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualLabelPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualLabel", typeof(SeriesLabel), typeof(Series), new PropertyMetadata(null, ActualLabelChanged));

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey PointsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Points", typeof(SeriesPointCollection), typeof(Series), new PropertyMetadata());

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualLabelProperty = ActualLabelPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisplayNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DisplayName", typeof(string), typeof(Series), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, UpdateSeriesPropertyWithLegendAndClearDiagramCache));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LabelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Label", typeof(SeriesLabel), typeof(Series), new PropertyMetadata(LabelChanged));

		private Storyboard Storyboard
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Resources.Contains("storyboard"))
				{
					Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
					storyboard.Completed += OnStoryboardCompleted;
					base.Resources.Add("storyboard", storyboard);
				}
				return (Storyboard)base.Resources["storyboard"];
			}
		}

		private bool AnimationEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Container != null && Container.AnimationOptions != null)
				{
					return Container.AnimationOptions.AnimationMode != ChartAnimationMode.Disabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsManualPointsAdded
		{
			get
			{
				if (Points.Count > 0)
				{
					return !IsBoundPoints;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool CheckMarkerAdditionalGeometryUsage => SupportsNativeRendering;

		private bool CanUseTopNOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (valueScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical)
				{
					return PointDimension == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected SeriesData SeriesData
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesData;
			}
			set
			{
				seriesData = value;
			}
		}

		protected IContainerElement Container
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Diagram.Container;
			}
		}

		protected TopNOptionsBase TopNOptionsInternal => topNOptions;

		protected internal virtual EmptyPointOptions ActualEmptyPointOptions => null;

		internal bool ActualToolTipEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (ToolTipEnabled.HasValue)
				{
					return ToolTipEnabled.Value;
				}
				IContainerToolTipOptions containerToolTipOptions = Container?.ToolTipOptions;
				if (containerToolTipOptions != null)
				{
					if (containerToolTipOptions.ToolTipEnabled.HasValue)
					{
						return containerToolTipOptions.ToolTipEnabled.Value;
					}
					return !containerToolTipOptions.CrosshairSupported;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsAutoSeries => isAutoSeries;

		internal bool IsBoundPoints => boundPoints.Count > 0;

		internal bool IsSeriesTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram != null)
				{
					return this == Diagram.SeriesTemplate;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ToolTipTemplateChanged => toolTipTemplateChanged;

		internal bool ToolTipPointTemplateChanged => toolTipPointTemplateChanged;

		internal bool ShouldRaiseCustomDrawSeriesPointEvent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Container?.EventsOptions != null)
				{
					return Container.EventsOptions.ShouldRaiseCustomDrawSeriesPointEvent;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool CreatedFromSeriesSource
		{
			get
			{
				return createdFromSeriesSource;
			}
			set
			{
				createdFromSeriesSource = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry => canUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry;

		internal string ActualToolTipPointPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(ToolTipPointPattern != ""))
				{
					return ToolTipPointValuesConverter.ActualPointPattern;
				}
				return ToolTipPointPattern;
			}
		}

		internal string ActualLegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (legendTextPatternAutoCreated)
				{
					UpdateLegendTextPattern();
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LegendTextPattern))
				{
					return LegendTextPattern;
				}
				return DefaultLegendTextPattern;
			}
		}

		internal SeriesCache Cache => cache;

		internal Legend ActualChartLegend => ActualLegend as Legend;

		internal IList<IDataPoint> ActualPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (boundPoints.Count <= 0)
				{
					return pointCollectionDecorator;
				}
				return boundPoints;
			}
		}

		internal object SeriesDataSource => bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource;

		internal DataFilterCollection ActualDataFilters => (DataFilterCollection)GetValue(DataFiltersPropertyKey.DependencyProperty);

		internal ConjunctionTypes ActualConjunctionMode { get; set; }

		internal LegendItem LegendItem => GetLegendItem(legendItemIndex);

		internal ScaleType ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (ArgumentScaleTypeInternal == ScaleType.Auto)
				{
					return GetActualArgumentScaleType();
				}
				return ArgumentScaleTypeInternal;
			}
		}

		internal bool ColorEachByColorizer
		{
			get
			{
				if (Colorizer is ILegendItemsProvider)
				{
					return ((ILegendItemsProvider)Colorizer).ShowInLegend;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal Palette Palette => ChartElementHelper.GetOwner<IContainerElement>(this)?.ChartOptions?.ActualPalette;
