		protected internal virtual bool LabelConnectorSupported => true;

		protected internal virtual bool LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported => false;

		protected internal virtual bool LabelsResolveOverlappingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported)
				{
					return ActualLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual double SeriesDepth => 0.6;

		protected internal virtual bool ArePointsVisible => false;

		protected internal virtual ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter ToolTipPointValuesConverter => new ToolTipValueToStringConverter(this);

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Color BaseColor => Palette?[Diagram.ViewController.GetSeriesIndex(this)] ?? Colors.Black;

		protected internal virtual bool InFrontOfAxes => false;

		protected internal virtual string DefaultPointToolTipPattern
		{
			get
			{
				string text = "{A" + GetDefaultArgumentFormat() + "}";
				string text2 = " : {V" + GetDefaultFormat(ValueScaleTypeInternal) + "}";
				return text + text2;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual int PointDimension => 1;

		protected internal virtual bool NeedColorSegment => false;

		protected internal virtual LineStyle LegendMarkerLineStyle => new LineStyle(1);

		protected internal virtual bool HasColorizer => Colorizer != null;

		protected internal virtual bool AllowSurfaceRendering
		{
			get
			{
				if (!SupportsNativeRendering || Container?.ChartOptions == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Container.ChartOptions.ActualIsDirectXSurfaceRendering;
			}
		}

		bool ISeries.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (Container?.LegendOptions != null && CheckableInLegend)
				{
					foreach (LegendBase legend2 in Container.LegendOptions.Legends)
					{
						if (legend2 is Legend legend && (legend.UseCheckBoxes || legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBox || legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.CheckBoxAndMarker || legend.MarkerMode == LegendMarkerMode.MarkerAndCheckBox))
						{
							return Visible && CheckedInLegend;
						}
					}
				}
				return Visible;
			}
		}

		bool IBindingProvider.IsValidMembersForBinding
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetDataSource() != null)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ArgumentDataMember) && AreValueDataMembersSet())
					{
						return true;
					}
					UpdateArgumentScaleTypeFromDataSource();
					if (CanLoadOneDimensionData(argumentScaleByDataSource))
					{
						bool flag = true;
						foreach (string valueDataMember in GetValueDataMembers())
						{
							flag &= string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueDataMember);
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							return argumentScaleByDataSource != ScaleType.Auto;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static void ActualLabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as SeriesLabel, e.NewValue as SeriesLabel, d as Series);
			ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdate(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems);
		}

		private static void ArgumentScaleTypePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Series series = d as Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.ArgumentScaleTypeInternal = (ScaleType)e.NewValue;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo(d, DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(e.Property)), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			if (e.OldValue != e.NewValue && series != null)
			{
				RaiseAxesScaleChanged((ScaleType)e.NewValue, series.GetAxesX());
			}
		}

		private static void ValueScaleTypePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Series series = d as Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.ValueScaleTypeInternal = (ScaleType)e.NewValue;
			}
			ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
			if (e.OldValue != e.NewValue && series != null)
			{
				RaiseAxesScaleChanged((ScaleType)e.NewValue, series.GetAxesY());
			}
		}

		private static void FilterCriteriaChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				string text = ((series.FilterCriteria != null) ? ((object)series.FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (text != series.FilterString)
				{
					series.FilterString = text;
				}
				series.filterHelper.OnUpdateCriteria();
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
			}
		}

		private static void FilterStringChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is Series series))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = e.NewValue as string;
			bool flag = series.FilterCriteria != null;
			if (flag || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				string text2 = (flag ? ((object)series.FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (text2 != text)
				{
					series.FilterCriteria = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(text, new object[0]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DataFiltersConjunctionModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series && series.DataFilters.Count > 0)
			{
				series.ActualConjunctionMode = (ConjunctionTypes)e.NewValue;
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, e, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
				series.SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSeriesPropertyWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceDataSource(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (d is Series { IsSeriesTemplate: false, IsManualPointsAdded: not false })
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.MsgIncorrectPointsCreation));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void DataSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				series.bindingBehavior.UpdateActualDataSource(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void LabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				SeriesLabel seriesLabel = e.NewValue as SeriesLabel;
				series.UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(e);
				if (seriesLabel == null)
				{
					series.SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, new SeriesLabel());
				}
				else
				{
					series.SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, seriesLabel);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void PointOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				series.pointOptions = (PointOptions)e.NewValue;
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as PointOptions, e.NewValue as PointOptions, series);
				series.UpdateLabelTextPattern();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void LegendPointOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is Series series)
			{
				series.legendPointOptions = (PointOptions)e.NewValue;
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as PointOptions, e.NewValue as PointOptions, series);
				series.UpdateLegendTextPattern();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
		}

		private static void RaiseAxesScaleChanged(ScaleType scale, IEnumerable<IAxisData> axes)
		{
			switch (scale)
			{
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
			{
				foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
				{
					axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged();
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
			{
				foreach (IAxisData axis2 in axes)
				{
					axis2.TimeSpanScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged();
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
			{
				foreach (IAxisData axis3 in axes)
				{
					axis3.NumericScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged();
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public Series()
		{
			BeginInit();
			cache = new SeriesCache();
			item = new SeriesItem(this);
			RecreateBindingProcessor();
			pointOptionsContainer = new PointOptionsContainer(this);
			legendPointOptionsContainer = new LegendPointOptionsContainer(this);
			seriesProgress = new AnimationProgress(this);
			canUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry = DefaultCanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry;
			SetValue(ActualLabelPropertyKey, new SeriesLabel());
			ActualLabel.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			SetValue(PointsPropertyKey, SeriesPointCollection.CreateInstance(this, boundPoints));
			pointCollectionDecorator = new ChartElementCollectionDecorator<SeriesPoint, IDataPoint>(Points);
			SetValue(DataFiltersPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<DataFilterCollection>(this));
			colorizerController = new ColorizerController(this);
			bindingBehavior = new BindingBehavior(this);
			bindingBehavior.ActualDataSourceChanged += ActualDataSourceChanged;
			filterHelper = new SeriesFilterHelper(this);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			Points.CollectionChanged += Points_CollectionChanged;
			ActualDataFilters.CollectionChanged += DataFilters_CollectionChanged;
			ActualConjunctionMode = ConjunctionTypes.And;
			EndInit();
		}

		IEnumerable<FilterColumn> IFilteredComponent.CreateFilterColumnCollection()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PropertyDescriptorCollection dataProperties = filterHelper.GetDataProperties();
			List<FilterColumn> list = new List<FilterColumn>();
			if (dataProperties != null)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in dataProperties)
				{
					FilterColumn val = new FilterColumn();
					val.ColumnType = item.PropertyType;
					val.FieldName = item.Name;
					val.ColumnCaption = item.DisplayName;
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		{
			return new LightSeriesPoint((Series)owner, argument, new object[0]);
		}

		IDataPoint ISeriesPointFactory.CreateSeriesPoint(ISeries owner, object tag, SeriesPointDataContainer templaContainer, IRowData rowData)
		{
			SeriesPointDataContainer seriesPointDataContainer = templaContainer.Create(rowData.DataMemberContainers, rowData.IsEmpty);
			LightSeriesPoint lightSeriesPoint = new LightSeriesPoint((Series)owner, seriesPointDataContainer, tag);
			if (rowData.AdditionalContainers != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ToolTipHintDataMember))
				{
					lightSeriesPoint.ToolTipHint = rowData.AdditionalContainers[ToolTipHintDataMember].BoxedValue;
				}
				IIndicatorDataPoint indicatorDataPoint = BindingHelperCore.CreateIndicatorPoint(((ISeriesBase)this).Indicators, rowData.AdditionalContainers);
				if (indicatorDataPoint != null)
				{
					lightSeriesPoint.IndicatorPoint = indicatorDataPoint;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ColorDataMember))
				{
					object boxedValue = rowData.AdditionalContainers[ColorDataMember].BoxedValue;
					if (boxedValue != null)
					{
						object userArgument = ((ISeriesPointArgument)lightSeriesPoint).UserArgument;
						object[] array = new object[seriesPointDataContainer.Dimension];
						for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
						{
							switch (seriesPointDataContainer.ValueScaleType)
							{
							case Scale.DateTime:
								array[i] = seriesPointDataContainer.DateTimeValues[i];
								break;
							case Scale.TimeSpan:
								array[i] = seriesPointDataContainer.TimeSpanValues[i];
								break;
							default:
								array[i] = seriesPointDataContainer.Values[i];
								break;
							}
						}
						lightSeriesPoint.Color = ColorizerController.GetSeriesPointColor(userArgument, array, boxedValue);
					}
				}
			}
			return lightSeriesPoint;
		}

		IDataPoint ISeriesPointFactory.CreateSeriesPoint(ISeries owner, object argument, object[] values, object tag, object[] colors)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? seriesPointColor = ColorizerController.GetSeriesPointColor(argument, values, (colors != null && colors.Length != 0) ? colors[0] : null);
			return new LightSeriesPoint((Series)owner, argument, values, tag, string.Empty, seriesPointColor);
		}

		ISeries ISeriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(string seriesName, object seriesValue, ISeries existing)
		{
			Series series = existing as Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.isLoaded = false;
			}
			Series series2 = CreateCopyForBinding(series);
			series2.DisplayName = seriesName;
			series2.Tag = seriesValue;
			return series2;
		}

		private void Points_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IContainerAnimationOptions containerAnimationOptions = Container?.AnimationOptions;
			if (containerAnimationOptions != null && containerAnimationOptions.AnimationMode == ChartAnimationMode.OnDataChanged)
			{
				containerAnimationOptions.Animate();
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isLoaded = true;
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || AnimationAutoStartMode == AnimationAutoStartMode.PlayOnce)
			{
				Animate();
			}
		}

		private void OnStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ClockGroup clockGroup)
			{
				ClockGroup clockGroup2 = ((clockGroup.Children.Count > 0) ? (clockGroup.Children[0] as ClockGroup) : null);
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = ((clockGroup2 != null && clockGroup2.Children.Count > 0) ? (clockGroup2.Children[0].Timeline as DoubleAnimation) : null);
				if (doubleAnimation != null && !AnimationHelper.ContainsAnimation(Storyboard, doubleAnimation))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			FinishAnimation();
		}

		private List<SeriesPointItem> GetPointItemsForLabels()
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> list = new List<SeriesPointItem>();
			if (Item.AllPointItems.Count > 0)
			{
				FillItemsForLabel(list, null);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void UpdateLegendItemsForSeries(IList<LegendItemBase> items, Legend legend, ISeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			string text = seriesItem.LegendText;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
				{
					return;
				}
				text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.EmptyLegendText);
			}
			legendItemIndex = items.Count;
			foreach (LegendItem item in CreateLegendItems(legend, seriesItem.DrawOptions.Color, text, isSelected))
			{
				InitializeSeriesLegendItem(item);
				items.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLegendItemsForSeriesPoints(IList<LegendItemBase> items, Legend legend, ISeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			foreach (ISeriesPointData pointDatum in seriesItem.PointData)
			{
				string text = pointDatum.LegendText;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || PointOptionsHelper.ConvertToPointView(ActualLegendTextPattern) != PointViewKind.SeriesName)
					{
						continue;
					}
					text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.EmptyLegendText);
				}
				IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(pointDatum.SeriesPoint);
				LegendItem legendItem = CreateLegendItem(legend, pointDatum.RefinedPoint, pointDatum.Color, text, platformSeriesPoint.IsSelected);
				pointDatum.LegendItemIndex = items.Count;
				items.Add(legendItem);
			}
		}

		internal void ActualDataSourceChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			if (Diagram != null && Diagram.Container != null && Diagram.Series.Contains(this))
			{
				if (updates == null)
				{
					updates = DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.CreateResetView(this);
				}
				if (updates.IsExistUpdateTypeOf(ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset) | updates.IsExistUpdateTypeOf(ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ViewportChanged))
				{
					ResetDataSourceScale();
				}
				BindingProcessor.QueryUpdate(updates, Container as IChartWithData);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void StartAnimation()
		{
			animationState = AnimationState.InProgress;
			foreach (AnimationProgress item in GetAnimationProgress())
			{
				item.Start();
			}
		}

		{
			Controller.BeginUpdateData();
			base.ChangedLocker.Lock();
		}

		private void EndUpdateAutoSeriesProperties()
		{
			base.ChangedLocker.Unlock();
			Controller.EndUpdateData(shouldUpdateDiagramItems: true);
		}

		private void AssignForBinding(Series series, bool onlyUpdateProperties)
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (onlyUpdateProperties)
			{
				BindingPropertiesContainer<Series>.ApplyCollectionProperties(series, this);
				return;
			}
			BindingPropertiesContainer<Series>.Apply(series, this);
			if (series.Label == null)
			{
				BindingPropertiesContainer<SeriesLabel>.Apply(series.ActualLabel, ActualLabel);
			}
			argumentScaleByDataSource = series.argumentScaleByDataSource;
			argumentScaleByCore = series.argumentScaleByCore;
		}

		private void DataFilters_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SynchronizeFilterCriteria();
		}

		private IEnumerable<AnimationProgress> GetAnimationProgress()
		{
			yield return seriesProgress;
			foreach (SeriesPointData seriesPointData in Item.SeriesPointDataList)
			{
				yield return seriesPointData.PointProgress;
				yield return seriesPointData.LabelProgress;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateArgumentScaleTypeFromDataSource()
		{
			if (argumentScaleByDataSource == ScaleType.Auto)
			{
				object dataSource = GetDataSource();
				if (dataSource != null)
				{
					argumentScaleByDataSource = (ScaleType)BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, dataSource, ArgumentDataMember, GetCalculatedFields());
				}
			}
		}

		private ScaleType GetActualArgumentScaleType()
		{
			UpdateArgumentScaleTypeFromDataSource();
			if (argumentScaleByDataSource != ScaleType.Auto)
			{
				return argumentScaleByDataSource;
			}
			if (IsSeriesTemplate)
			{
				return ScaleType.Numerical;
			}
			return argumentScaleByCore;
		}

		private IEnumerable<IAxisData> GetAxesX()
		{
			if (!(Diagram is IXYDiagram diagram))
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (diagram.AxisX != null)
			{
				yield return diagram.AxisX;
			}
			if (diagram.SecondaryAxesX == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (IAxisData item in diagram.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<IAxisData> GetAxesY()
		{
			if (!(Diagram is IXYDiagram diagram))
			{
				yield break;
			}
			if (diagram.AxisY != null)
			{
				yield return diagram.AxisY;
			}
			if (diagram.SecondaryAxesY == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (IAxisData item in diagram.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<Series> GetAutocreatedSeries(Diagram diagram)
		{
			foreach (Series item in diagram.Series)
			{
				if (item.IsAutoSeries)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesLabel> GetAutocreatedSeriesLabels(Diagram diagram)

			{
				yield return item.ActualLabel;
			}
		}

			yield return CreateLegendItem(legend, this, color, text, isSelected);
		}

		protected LegendItem CreateLegendItem(Legend legend, object sourceElement, System.Windows.Media.Color color, string text, bool isSelected)
		{
			color.A = (byte)((double)(int)color.A * GetOpacity());
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			return CreateLegendItem(legend, sourceElement, text, solidColorBrush, GetPenBrush(solidColorBrush), isSelected);
		}

			Diagram diagram = Diagram;

		protected string GetDefaultFormat(ScaleType scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.DateTime => ":d", 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => ":g", 
				_ => "", 
			};
		}

		protected string GetDefaultArgumentFormat()
		{
			if (this is IXYSeriesView { AxisXData: not null } iXYSeriesView && ArgumentScaleTypeInternal == ScaleType.DateTime && iXYSeriesView.AxisXData.Label != null)
			{
				return ":" + PatternUtils.GetArgumentFormat(iXYSeriesView.AxisXData.Label.TextPattern);
			}
			return GetDefaultFormat(ArgumentScaleTypeInternal);
		}

		protected PatternDataProvider GetXYDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView = (IXYSeriesView)this;
			IAxisData axisXData = iXYSeriesView.AxisXData;
			IAxisData axisYData = iXYSeriesView.AxisYData;
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "A":
				return CretePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisXData);
			case "V":
			case "VP":
			case "V1":
			case "V2":
			case "OV":
			case "CV":
			case "HV":
			case "LV":
			case "W":
			case "HINT":
			case "VD":
			case "TV":
			case "VABS":
			case "BP_MAX":
			case "BP_AVG":
			case "BP_MDN":
			case "BP_MIN":
			case "BP_Q1":
			case "BP_Q3":
				return CretePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisYData);
			case "VDTD":
			case "VDTH":
			case "VDTM":
			case "VDTS":
			case "VDTMS":
				if (ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime || ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
				{
					return CretePointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisYData);
				}
				return null;
			case "S":
			case "G":
				return new SeriesPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
			default:
				return new DataSourcePatternDataProvider(patternConstant, null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual PatternDataProvider CretePointPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, IAxisData axisXData)
		{
			return new PointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant, axisXData?.AxisScaleTypeMap);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessChanging(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (IsSeriesTemplate)
			{
				if (updateInfo.ShouldUpdateSeriesBinding)
				{
					updateInfo.Change |= ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeries;
				}
				else
				{
					updateInfo.Change |= ChartElementChange.UpdateAutoSeriesProperties;
				}
			}
			else if (!isAutoSeries && updateInfo.ShouldUpdateSeriesBinding && Diagram != null && Diagram.Series.Contains(this))
			{
				ResetSeriesBinding();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool PerformWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				if (sender is AnimationBase)
				{
					OnAnimationChanged();
					result = true;
				}
				else if (sender is PointOptions)
				{
					if (sender == LegendPointOptionsContainer.PointOptions)
					{
						UpdateLegendTextPattern();
					}
					if (sender == PointOptionsContainer.PointOptions)
					{
						UpdateLabelTextPattern();
					}
					ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
					result = true;
				}
				else if (sender is ChartColorizerBase)
				{
					ResetDataSourceScale();
					ChartElementHelper.Update((DependencyObject)this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
					result = true;
				}
				else if (sender is SeriesLabel)
				{
					if (e is SeriesLabelPropertyChangedEventArgs e2 && !UpdateAutocreatedLabelProperties(e2.DependencyPropertyArgs) && (Diagram is Diagram3D || !e2.Diagram3DOnly))
					{
						ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this, e2.DependencyPropertyArgs);
					}
					result = true;
				}
				else if (sender is TopNOptionsBase)
				{
					if (!UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(TopNOptionsProperty, topNOptions, topNOptions)))
					{
						OnFilterOptionsChanged(((PropertyChangedEventArgs)e).PropertyName);
					}
					result = true;
				}
				else if (sender is Summary)
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update((DependencyObject)this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateSeriesBinding);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal string GetActualLabelTextPattern(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			if (labelTextPatternAutoCreated)
			{
				UpdateLabelTextPattern();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(label.TextPattern))
			{
				return label.TextPattern;
			}
			return DefaultLabelTextPattern;
		}

		internal bool IsLabelEdgeMode(bool isFirst)
		{
			if (!isFirst)
			{
				if (ActualLastPoint != null)
				{
					return ActualLastPoint.LabelDisplayMode != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ActualFirstPoint != null)
			{
				return ActualFirstPoint.LabelDisplayMode != SidePointDisplayMode.Default;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateDataFilters()
		{
			DataFilterCollection actualDataFilters = ActualDataFilters;
			foreach (DataFilter item in actualDataFilters)
			{
				if (item.ActualType == null)
				{
					item.UpdateActualParams();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeFilterCriteria()
		{
			CriteriaOperator value = DataFilterToCriteriaConverter.Convert(ActualDataFilters, (Conjunction)ActualConjunctionMode);
			SetCurrentValue(FilterCriteriaProperty, value);
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> items, LegendBase legend, ISeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			Legend legend2 = (Legend)legend;
			if (ShowInLegend && !UpdateColorizerLegendItems(items, legend2))
			{
				if (ActualColorEach && seriesItem.HasPoints && Container.LegendOptions != null && !Container.LegendOptions.LegendUseCheckBoxes)
				{
					UpdateLegendItemsForSeriesPoints(items, legend2, seriesItem);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateLegendItemsForSeries(items, legend2, seriesItem);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool UpdateColorizerLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> items, Legend legend)
		{
			bool flag = UpdateSegmentColorizerLegendItems(items, legend);
			return UpdateColorizerLegendItemsCore(items, legend, Colorizer as ILegendItemsProvider) || flag;
		}

		protected internal void ResetSeriesBinding()
		{
			if (Container != null && resetSeriesBindingCounter <= 0)
			{
				resetSeriesBindingCounter++;
				bindingBehavior.ResetData();
				resetSeriesBindingCounter--;
			}
		}

		internal void FinishAnimation()
		{
			animationState = AnimationState.Completed;
			foreach (AnimationProgress item in GetAnimationProgress())
			{
				item.Finish();
			}
		}

		internal void OnAnimationChanged()
		{
			if (isLoaded)
			{
				bool flag = DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || animationState == AnimationState.InProgress;
				FinishAnimation();
				if (flag)
				{
					Animate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdatePointsSelection()
		{
			if (isSelected)

				SetPointsSelection(isSelected);
			}
		}

		internal bool UpdateAutocreatedSeriesProperties(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			Diagram diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram != null && IsSeriesTemplate)
			{
				try
				{
					BeginUpdateAutoSeriesProperties();
					BindingPropertiesContainer<Series>.UpdateAssignableProperty(this, GetAutocreatedSeries(diagram), eventArgs.Property, eventArgs.NewValue);
					return true;
				}
				finally
				{
					EndUpdateAutoSeriesProperties();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool UpdateAutocreatedLabelProperties(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			Diagram diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram != null && IsSeriesTemplate)
			{
				try
				{
					BeginUpdateAutoSeriesProperties();
					BindingPropertiesContainer<SeriesLabel>.UpdateAssignableProperty(ActualLabel, GetAutocreatedSeriesLabels(diagram), eventArgs.Property, eventArgs.NewValue);
					return true;
				}
				finally
				{
					EndUpdateAutoSeriesProperties();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool UpdateCloneableAutocreatedSeriesProperties(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs eventArgs)

		internal bool GetActualVisible()
		{
			if (Visible)
			{
				IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Container?.LegendOptions;
				if (containerLegendOptions != null && containerLegendOptions.LegendUseCheckBoxes)
				{
					if (CheckableInLegend)
					{
						return CheckedInLegend;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool AreValueDataMembersSet()
		{
			foreach (string valueDataMember in GetValueDataMembers())

				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueDataMember))

			return true;

		internal double GetOpacity()
		{
			double result = 1.0;
			if (this is ISupportTransparency supportTransparency)
			{
				result = 1.0 - supportTransparency.Transparency;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal string GetPointLegendText(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (ActualColorEach && ShowInLegend)
			{
				PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(ActualLegendTextPattern, this);
				patternParser.SetContext(point, this);
				return patternParser.GetText();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal string GetSeriesLegendText()
		{
			IContainerLegendOptions containerLegendOptions = Container?.LegendOptions;
			string result = ((ShowInLegend && ((containerLegendOptions != null && containerLegendOptions.LegendUseCheckBoxes) || !ActualColorEach)) ? DisplayName : string.Empty);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(LegendTextPattern))
			{
				return result;
			}
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(LegendTextPattern, this);
			patternParser.SetContext(this);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		internal Series CopyPropertiesForBinding(Series source, bool onlyUpdateProperties)
		{
			try
			{
				base.ChangedLocker.Lock();
				AssignForBinding(source, onlyUpdateProperties);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.ChangedLocker.Unlock();
			}
			return this;
		}

		internal Series CreateCopyForBinding(Series existing = null)
		{
			Series series = existing ?? CreateObjectForClone();
			bool? flag = existing?.CheckedInLegend;
			series.CopyPropertiesForBinding(this, onlyUpdateProperties: false);
			if (flag.HasValue)
			{
				series.CheckedInLegend = flag.Value;
			}
			series.isAutoSeries = true;
			return series;
		}

		internal SeriesPointAnimationBase GetActualPointAnimation()
		{
			if (Container != null && Container.IsPrinting)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SeriesPointAnimationBase pointAnimation = GetPointAnimation();
			if (pointAnimation != null)

				return pointAnimation;

			if (AnimationEnabled)

				SeriesPointAnimationBase seriesPointAnimationBase = CreateDefaultPointAnimation();

				return seriesPointAnimationBase;

			return null;
		}

		public void Animate()
		{
			ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
			if (storyboardStarted)
			{
				Storyboard.Stop();
			}
			if (Storyboard.Children.Count != 0)
			{
				Storyboard.Children.Clear();
			}
			PrepareStoryboard();
			StartAnimation();
			Action method = delegate
			{
				Storyboard.Begin();
				storyboardStarted = true;
			};
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(method, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		public object GetDataSource()
		{
			if (SeriesDataSource != null)
			{
				return SeriesDataSource;
			}
			return Diagram?.Container?.DataOptions?.ActualDataSource;
		}

			return list;
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (Diagram != null && Diagram.Series.Contains(this))
			{
				flag = true;
				ResetSeriesBinding();
			}
			base.EndInit();
			if (!flag)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

			}
			else

			}
		}

	public sealed class SimpleDiagram3D : Diagram3D, ISimpleDiagram, IDiagram, IHitTestableElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DimensionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutDirectionProperty;

		protected internal override CompatibleViewType CompatibleViewType => CompatibleViewType.SimpleView;

		[Description("Gets or sets the number of 3D Pie (Donut) Series that can be displayed in one line (row or column).")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Dimension
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(DimensionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DimensionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a value that specifies the manner in which multiple 3D Pie charts are positioned within a chart control’s diagram.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public LayoutDirection LayoutDirection
		{
			get

			}

			}
		}

		SimpleDiagramLayoutDirection ISimpleDiagram.LayoutDirection => (SimpleDiagramLayoutDirection)LayoutDirection;

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => this;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => null;

		static SimpleDiagram3D()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(SimpleDiagram3D);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SimpleDiagram3D>();
			DimensionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Dimension", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(3, ChartElementHelper.Update), DimensionValidation);
			LayoutDirectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LayoutDirection", typeof(LayoutDirection), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(LayoutDirection.Horizontal, ChartElementHelper.Update));
			Diagram3D.PerspectiveAngleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(20.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, ChartElementHelper.Update));
		}

		private static bool DimensionValidation(object dimension)
		{
			if ((int)dimension > 0)
			{
				return (int)dimension < 100;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public SimpleDiagram3D()
		{
			EndInit();
		}

		protected override Transform3D CreateDefaultContentTransform()
		{
			return new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), -60.0));
		}

		protected override DiagramLightingCollection CreateDefaultLighting()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color ambientColor = default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			byte b = (ambientColor.B = 130);
			byte r = (ambientColor.G = b);
			ambientColor.R = r;
			DiagramLightingCollection diagramLightingCollection = new DiagramLightingCollection();
			diagramLightingCollection.Add(new AmbientLight(ambientColor));
			diagramLightingCollection.Add(new DirectionalLight(Colors.White, new Vector3D(1.0, -1.5, -2.0)));
			return diagramLightingCollection;
		}

		protected internal override Diagram3DDomain CreateDomain(VisualContainer visualContainer)
		{
			if (visualContainer.Bounds.Height > 0.0 && visualContainer.Bounds.Width > 0.0)
			{
				int num = base.VisualContainers.IndexOf(visualContainer);
				if (num >= 0 && num < base.Series.Count)
				{
					if (!(base.Series[num] is PieSeries3D pieSeries3D))
					{
						ChartDebug.Fail("PieSeries3D is expected");
						return null;
					}
					if (pieSeries3D.GetActualVisible())
					{
						return new SimpleDiagram3DDomain(this, visualContainer.Bounds, pieSeries3D);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override void OnDataWasChanged()
		{
			base.OnDataWasChanged();
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				item.UpdateConfiguration();
			}
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			if (base.Series.Count == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			List<DXRectangle> elementsBounds = SimpleDiagramLayout.Calculate(this, new DXRectangle(0, 0, (int)size.Width, (int)size.Height), base.Series.Count);
			elementsBounds = CorrectElementsBounds(elementsBounds);
			for (int i = 0; i < elementsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				Series series = base.Series[i];
				System.Windows.Size size2 = elementsBounds[i].ToRect().Size;
				list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(new GRealSize2D(size2.Width, size2.Height), GetElementsForAutoLayout(series)));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			base.UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				if (!(item is PieSeries pieSeries))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (Title title in pieSeries.Titles)
				{
					title.Update();
				}
			}
		}

		private List<DXRectangle> CorrectElementsBounds(List<DXRectangle> elementsBounds)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			elementsBounds.Sort(new RectComparer());
			DXRectangle val = elementsBounds[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < elementsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				if (InFrame(val, elementsBounds[i]))
				{
					elementsBounds[i] = val;
				}
				else
				{
					val = elementsBounds[i];
				}
			}
			return elementsBounds;
		}

		private bool InFrame(DXRectangle pattern, DXRectangle rect)
		{
			if ((double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height < (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Height * 1.05 && (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height > (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Height * 0.95 && (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width < (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Width * 1.05)
			{
				return (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width > (double)((DXRectangle)(ref pattern)).Width * 0.95;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> GetElementsForAutoLayout(Series series)
		{
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			TitleCollection titleCollection = null;
			if (series is FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D)
			{
				titleCollection = funnelSeries2D.Titles;
			}
			if (series is PieSeries pieSeries)
			{
				titleCollection = pieSeries.Titles;
			}
			if (titleCollection != null)
			{
				foreach (Title item in titleCollection)
				{
					if (!item.Visible.HasValue)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.Container?.ChartOptions == null || base.Container.ChartOptions.AutoLayout)
			{
				Dimension = SimpleDiagramAutoLayoutHelper.CalculateDimension((int)constraint.Width, (int)constraint.Height, base.Series.Count);
				LayoutDirection = LayoutDirection.Horizontal;
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}
	}

		private static void AxisXPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D)
			{
				AxisX3D axisX3D = e.NewValue as AxisX3D;
				IAxisData oldValue = xYDiagram3D.actualAxisX;
				if (axisX3D == null)
				{
					xYDiagram3D.actualAxisX = new AxisX3D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, xYDiagram3D.actualAxisX);
				}
				else
				{
					xYDiagram3D.actualAxisX = axisX3D;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(xYDiagram3D, "AxisX", oldValue, axisX3D), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static void AxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D)
			{
				IAxisData oldValue = xYDiagram3D.actualAxisY;
				AxisY3D axisY3D = e.NewValue as AxisY3D;
				if (axisY3D == null)
				{
					xYDiagram3D.actualAxisY = new AxisY3D();
					e = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(e.Property, e.OldValue, xYDiagram3D.actualAxisY);
				}
				else
				{
					xYDiagram3D.actualAxisY = axisY3D;
				}
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwner(d, e);
				ChartElementHelper.Update(d, new PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>(xYDiagram3D, "AxisY", oldValue, axisY3D), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache);
			}
		}

		private static bool HeightToWidthRatioValidation(object heightToWidthRatio)
		{

				if ((double)heightToWidthRatio >= 0.1)
				{
					return (double)heightToWidthRatio <= 10.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static IList<AxisBase> UpdateMeasureUnits(System.Windows.Size size, params Axis3D[] axes)
		{
			IList<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			foreach (Axis3D axis3D in axes)
			{
				if (UpdateAxis(axis3D, size))
				{
					list.Add(axis3D);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static bool UpdateAxis(AxisBase axis, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			double num = (axis.IsValuesAxis ? size.Height : size.Width);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				num = 700.0;
			}
			return axis.UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(num);
		}

		private static List<AxisBase> GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(bool valueRangeChanged, params Axis3D[] axes)
		{
			List<AxisBase> list = new List<AxisBase>();
			foreach (IAxisData axisData in axes)
			{
				if (AxisUtils.ShouldUpdateSkippingRangesWithoutPoints(axisData, valueRangeChanged))
				{
					list.Add(axisData as AxisBase);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private double CalculateSeriesPadding()
		{
			if (base.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				return Math.Max(base.Series[0].SeriesDepth, base.Series[base.Series.Count - 1].SeriesDepth) / 2.0 + 0.05;
			}
			return 0.35;
		}

		private double CalculateSeriesDistance()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (Series item in base.Series)
			{
				if (item.SeriesDepth > num)
				{
					num = item.SeriesDepth;
				}
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				return num + 0.3;
			}
			return 1.3;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSeriesItemsCore(bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			base.UpdateSeriesItemsCore(shouldUpdateSeriesLabelItems, containerItems);
			this.containerItems = containerItems;
		}

		protected internal override void ClearCache()
		{
			base.ClearCache();
			cache.Clear();
		}

		protected internal override Diagram3DDomain CreateDomain(VisualContainer visualContainer)
		{
			return new XYDiagram3DDomain(this, visualContainer.Bounds, containerItems);
		}

		protected internal override void CheckMeasureUnits(bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			CheckMeasureUnits(ActualViewport.Size, base.ViewController, valueRangeChanged, ActualAxisX, ActualAxisY);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			IEnumerable<AxisBase> enumerable = UpdateMeasureUnits(constraint, ActualAxisX, ActualAxisY);
			if (enumerable.Count() > 0)
			{
				base.ViewController.SendDataAggregationUpdates(enumerable);
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.Diagram3DOnly);
				ChartElementHelper.ApplyChanges(this);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void CheckMeasureUnits(System.Windows.Size size, ViewController controller, bool valueRangeChanged, params Axis3D[] axes)
		{
			IList<AxisBase> axes2 = UpdateMeasureUnits(size, axes);
			List<PropertyUpdateInfo> axesUpdateInfos = controller.GetAxesUpdateInfos(axes2, "DataAggregation");
			axes2 = GetAxesForSeriesPointsInternalArgumentsUpdate(valueRangeChanged, axes);
			axesUpdateInfos.AddRange(controller.GetAxesUpdateInfos(axes2, "SkipRangesWithoutPoints"));
			controller.SendUpdates(axesUpdateInfos);
		}

		internal List<SeriesData> CreateSeriesDataList()
		{
			List<SeriesData> list = new List<SeriesData>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				Series series = (Series)item.Series;
				if (series.ActualPoints.Count > 0 && series.GetActualVisible())
				{
					list.Add(series.CreateSeriesData());
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void ChangeItemBrush(object item, System.Windows.Media.Color brushColor)
		{
			if (Cache != null)
			{
				Cache.ChangeModelBrush(item, new SolidColorBrush(brushColor));
			}
			InvalidateDiagram();
		}

		protected internal override List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> list = new List<VisibilityLayoutRegion>();
			list.Add(new VisibilityLayoutRegion(GetPaneSizeForAutoLayout(size), new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>()));
			return list;
		}

		private GRealSize2D GetPaneSizeForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new GRealSize2D(constraint.Width, constraint.Height);
		}
	}
}

	public class ChartLocalizerExtension : DXMarkupExtensionBase
	{
		public ChartStringId StringId { get; set; }

		static ChartLocalizerExtension()
		{
			ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.EmptyLegendText);
		}

		private string GetString()
		{
			return XtraLocalizer<ChartStringId>.Active.GetLocalizedString(StringId);
		}

		private BindingBase CreateBinding()
		{
			return new Binding
			{
				Mode = BindingMode.OneTime,
				Source = GetString()
			};
		}

		protected sealed override object ProvideValueCore()
		{
			if (DXMarkupExtensionBase.IsInTemplate(((DXMarkupExtensionBase)this).TargetProvider))
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (DXMarkupExtensionBase.IsInBinding(((DXMarkupExtensionBase)this).TargetProvider))
			{
				return GetString();
			}
			if (DXMarkupExtensionBase.IsInSetter(((DXMarkupExtensionBase)this).TargetProvider))
			{
				return CreateBinding();
			}
			return GetString();
		}
	}

	public class RangeValueConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				if (text.EndsWith("%"))
				{
					return new Unit(Convert.ToDouble(text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1), culture), UnitType.Percent);
				}
				return new Unit(Convert.ToDouble(text, culture));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is Unit)
			{
				Unit unit = (Unit)value;
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					string text = unit.Value.ToString(culture);
					if (unit.UnitType == UnitType.Percent)
					{
						return text + "%";
					}
					return text;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
	public class BarSizeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			string text = value as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return Bar3DSize.Parse(text);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class AxisRangeTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
	{
		private enum TokenKind
		{
			Error,
			MinValue,
			MaxValue,
			MinValueInternal,
			MaxValueInternal,
			SideMarginsEnabled,
			AlwaysShowZeroLevel
		}

		private struct TokenIdentifier
		{
			private TokenKind tokenKind;

			private string identifier;

			public TokenKind TokenKind => tokenKind;

			public string Identifier => identifier;

			public TokenIdentifier(TokenKind tokenKind, string identifier)
			{
				this.tokenKind = tokenKind;
				this.identifier = identifier;
			}
		}

		private const char assignChar = '=';

		private const char openBracketChar = '(';

		private const char closeBracketChar = ')';

		private const char quoteChar = '\'';

		private const char delimiterChar = ';';

		private const string trueValue = "True";

		private const string falseValue = "False";

		private const string dateTimeFunctionName = "DateTime";

		private static readonly TokenIdentifier[] identifiers;

		private static object defaultMinValue;

		private static object defaultMaxValue;

		private static double defaultMinValueInternal;

		private static double defaultMaxValueInternal;

		private static bool defaultSideMarginsEnabled;

		private static bool defaultAlwaysShowZeroLevel;

		[Obsolete]
		static AxisRangeTypeConverter()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(AxisRange);
			defaultMinValue = AxisRange.MinValueProperty.GetMetadata(typeFromHandle).DefaultValue;
			defaultMaxValue = AxisRange.MaxValueProperty.GetMetadata(typeFromHandle).DefaultValue;
			defaultMinValueInternal = (double)AxisRange.MinValueInternalProperty.GetMetadata(typeFromHandle).DefaultValue;
			defaultMaxValueInternal = (double)AxisRange.MaxValueInternalProperty.GetMetadata(typeFromHandle).DefaultValue;
			defaultSideMarginsEnabled = (bool)AxisRange.SideMarginsEnabledProperty.GetMetadata(typeFromHandle).DefaultValue;
			defaultAlwaysShowZeroLevel = (bool)AxisY2D.AlwaysShowZeroLevelProperty.GetMetadata(typeFromHandle).DefaultValue;
			identifiers = new TokenIdentifier[6]
			{
				new TokenIdentifier(TokenKind.MinValueInternal, "MinValueInternal"),
				new TokenIdentifier(TokenKind.MaxValueInternal, "MaxValueInternal"),
				new TokenIdentifier(TokenKind.MinValue, "MinValue"),
				new TokenIdentifier(TokenKind.MaxValue, "MaxValue"),
				new TokenIdentifier(TokenKind.SideMarginsEnabled, "SideMarginsEnabled"),
				new TokenIdentifier(TokenKind.AlwaysShowZeroLevel, "AlwaysShowZeroLevel")
			};
		}

		private static void ThrowFormatException(string value)
		{
			throw new FormatException($"AxisRange de-serialization: The '{value}' string is in an incorrect format.");
		}

		private static string FindToken(ref string value)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				if (value[i] == '\'')
				{
					flag = !flag;
				}
				else if (value[i] == ';' && !flag)
				{
					string result = value.Substring(0, i);
					value = value.Substring(i + 1);
					return result;
				}
			}
			string result2 = value;
			value = null;
			return result2;
		}

		private static TokenKind ExtractValue(string token, out string value)
		{
			value = null;
			TokenKind tokenKind = TokenKind.Error;
			TokenIdentifier[] array = identifiers;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				TokenIdentifier tokenIdentifier = array[i];
				if (token.StartsWith(tokenIdentifier.Identifier))
				{
					tokenKind = tokenIdentifier.TokenKind;
					value = token.Substring(tokenIdentifier.Identifier.Length);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (tokenKind == TokenKind.Error)
			{
				return tokenKind;
			}
			value = value.Trim();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value[0] != '=')
			{
				return TokenKind.Error;
			}
			value = value.Substring(1).Trim();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return TokenKind.Error;
			}
			return tokenKind;
		}

		private static object GetDeserializedObject(string str)
		{
			try
			{
				IFormatProvider invariantCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
				if (str[0] == '\'')
				{
					if (str.Length < 2 || str[str.Length - 1] != '\'')
					{
						return null;
					}
					str = str.Substring(1, str.Length - 2);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
					{
						return null;
					}
					string text = new string('\'', 2);
					int num = 0;
					do
					{
						int num2 = str.IndexOf('\'', num);
						if (num2 == -1)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (str.IndexOf(text, num) != num2)
						{
							return null;
						}
						num = num2 + 2;
					}
					while (num < str.Length);
					return str.Replace(text, new string('\'', 1));
				}
				if (str.StartsWith("DateTime"))
				{
					str = str.Substring("DateTime".Length).Trim();
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str) || (str[0] != '(' && str[str.Length - 1] != ')'))
					{
						return null;
					}
					str = str.Substring(1, str.Length - 2).Trim();
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return DateTimeValueHelper.ConvertFromString(str);
				}
				if (str == "True")
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (str == "False")
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Convert.ToDouble(str, invariantCulture);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		[Obsolete]
		private object ConvertFromInternal(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			object obj = defaultMinValue;
			object obj2 = defaultMaxValue;
			double minValueInternal = defaultMinValueInternal;
			double maxValueInternal = defaultMaxValueInternal;
			bool flag = defaultSideMarginsEnabled;
			bool flag2 = defaultAlwaysShowZeroLevel;
			string value2 = text;
			while (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				value2 = value2.TrimStart(null);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
				{
					break;
				}
				string token = FindToken(ref value2);
				string value3 = null;
				TokenKind tokenKind = ExtractValue(token, out value3);
				if (tokenKind == TokenKind.Error)
				{
					ThrowFormatException(text);
				}
				object deserializedObject = GetDeserializedObject(value3);
				if (deserializedObject == null)
				{
					ThrowFormatException(text);
				}
				switch (tokenKind)
				{
				case TokenKind.MinValue:
					obj = deserializedObject;
					minValueInternal = defaultMinValueInternal;
					break;
				case TokenKind.MaxValue:
					obj2 = deserializedObject;
					maxValueInternal = defaultMaxValueInternal;
					break;
				case TokenKind.MinValueInternal:
					if (!(deserializedObject is double))
					{
						ThrowFormatException(text);
					}
					minValueInternal = (double)deserializedObject;
					obj = defaultMinValue;
					break;
				case TokenKind.MaxValueInternal:
					if (!(deserializedObject is double))
					{
						ThrowFormatException(text);
					}
					maxValueInternal = (double)deserializedObject;
					obj2 = defaultMaxValue;
					break;
				case TokenKind.SideMarginsEnabled:
					if (!(deserializedObject is bool))
					{
						ThrowFormatException(text);
					}
					flag = (bool)deserializedObject;
					break;
				case TokenKind.AlwaysShowZeroLevel:
					if (!(deserializedObject is bool))
					{
						ThrowFormatException(text);
					}
					flag2 = (bool)deserializedObject;
					break;
				}
			}
			AxisRange axisRange = new AxisRange();
			if (obj != defaultMinValue)
			{
				axisRange.MinValue = obj;
			}
			if (obj2 != defaultMaxValue)
			{
				axisRange.MaxValue = obj2;
			}
			if (minValueInternal.CompareTo(defaultMinValueInternal) != 0)
			{
				axisRange.MinValueInternal = minValueInternal;
			}
			if (maxValueInternal.CompareTo(defaultMaxValueInternal) != 0)
			{
				axisRange.MaxValueInternal = maxValueInternal;
			}
			if (flag != defaultSideMarginsEnabled)
			{
				axisRange.SideMarginsEnabled = flag;
			}
			if (flag2 != defaultAlwaysShowZeroLevel)
			{
				AxisY2D.SetAlwaysShowZeroLevel(axisRange, flag2);
				AxisY3D.SetAlwaysShowZeroLevel(axisRange, flag2);
			}
			return axisRange;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			return ConvertFromInternal(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	public class TimeIntervalTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			try
			{
				string[] array = text.Split(new string[1] { "-" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.Parse(array[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				DateTime dateTime2 = DateTime.Parse(array[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				return new TimeInterval
				{
					StartHour = dateTime.Hour,
					StartMinute = dateTime.Minute,
					StartSecond = dateTime.Second,
					EndHour = dateTime2.Hour,
					EndMinute = dateTime2.Minute,
					EndSecond = dateTime2.Second
				};
			}
			catch
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
		}
	}

	public class NativeLineSeriesSurface : AdditionalLineSeriesGeometry
	{
		protected override Action<IRenderContext> OnSurfaceRendering => OnSurfaceRenderingCore;

		protected override Func<System.Windows.Point, Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>> OnSurfaceHitTest => OnSurfaceHitTestCore;

		public NativeLineSeriesSurface(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private void OnSurfaceRenderingCore(IRenderContext context)
		{
			RenderNativeSurfaceGeometries(context, delegate(List<System.Windows.Point> points, System.Windows.Media.Color color, int thickness, LineStyle lineStyle)
			{
				context.DrawPolyline(points, color, thickness, lineStyle);
			});
		}

		private Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint> OnSurfaceHitTestCore(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			LineSeries2D lineSeries2D = (LineSeries2D)base.Series;
			if (lineSeries2D.Points.Count <= 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)lineSeries2D.Diagram;
			Pane pane = xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes[0];
			double num = lineSeries2D.ActualLineStyle.Thickness / 2;
			double num2 = num * num;
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection pointsSortedByArgument = lineSeries2D.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(lineSeries2D).PointsSortedByArgument;
			System.Windows.Point actualPoint = NativeHitTestHelper.GetActualPoint(xYDiagram2D, pane, point);
			if (base.CachedAdditionalGeometries == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry cachedAdditionalGeometry in base.CachedAdditionalGeometries)
			{
				foreach (ChartGeometry geometry in cachedAdditionalGeometry.Geometries)
				{
					foreach (ChartGeometryFigure figure in geometry.Figures)
					{
						foreach (ChartGeometrySegmentBase segment in figure.Segments)
						{
							NativeHitTestHelper.GetRange(segment.Points, actualPoint, num * NativeHitTestHelper.SquareRootOf2, 1, out var left, out var right);
							System.Windows.Point point2 = segment.Points[left];
							double num3 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredDistance(actualPoint, point2);
							for (int i = left; i < right; i++)
							{
								System.Windows.Point p = point2;
								point2 = segment.Points[i + 1];
								double num4 = num3;
								num3 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredDistance(actualPoint, point2);
								double num5 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p, point2);
								double num6 = (num5 * num5 + num3 - num4) / 2.0 / num5;
								double num7 = num3 - num6 * num6;
								if (num6 >= 0.0 - num && num6 <= num5 + num && num7 <= num2)
								{
									return new Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>(lineSeries2D, null);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnRenderCore(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void Update(bool shouldUpdateGeometry)
		{
			base.ShouldUpdateGeometry = shouldUpdateGeometry;
			((Pane)base.Series.ActualPane)?.DirectXSeriesSurface?.Invalidate();
		}

		protected internal override void OnSeriesDetached()
		{
			((Pane)base.Series.ActualPane)?.DirectXSeriesSurface?.UnregisterSurfaceCallback(GetHashCode());
			base.OnSeriesDetached();
		}
	}

	public class NativeSplineSeriesSurface : AdditionalSplineSeriesGeometry
	{
		private const double Accuracy = 0.001;

		protected override Action<IRenderContext> OnSurfaceRendering => OnSurfaceRenderingCore;

		protected override Func<System.Windows.Point, Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>> OnSurfaceHitTest => OnSurfaceHitTestCore;

		public NativeSplineSeriesSurface(XYSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private void OnSurfaceRenderingCore(IRenderContext context)
		{
			RenderNativeSurfaceGeometries(context, delegate(List<System.Windows.Point> points, System.Windows.Media.Color color, int thickness, LineStyle lineStyle)
			{
				context.DrawPolyBezier(points, color, thickness, lineStyle);
			});
		}

		private Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint> OnSurfaceHitTestCore(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			SplineSeries2D splineSeries2D = (SplineSeries2D)base.Series;
			if (splineSeries2D.Points.Count <= 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)splineSeries2D.Diagram;
			Pane pane = xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes[0];
			double num = splineSeries2D.ActualLineStyle.Thickness / 2;
			double num2 = num * num;
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection pointsSortedByArgument = splineSeries2D.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(splineSeries2D).PointsSortedByArgument;
			System.Windows.Point actualPoint = NativeHitTestHelper.GetActualPoint(xYDiagram2D, pane, point);
			if (base.CachedAdditionalGeometries == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (SeriesAdditionalGeometry cachedAdditionalGeometry in base.CachedAdditionalGeometries)
			{
				foreach (ChartGeometry geometry in cachedAdditionalGeometry.Geometries)
				{
					foreach (ChartGeometryFigure figure in geometry.Figures)
					{
						foreach (ChartGeometrySegmentBase segment in figure.Segments)
						{
							NativeHitTestHelper.GetRange(segment.Points, actualPoint, num * NativeHitTestHelper.SquareRootOf2, 3, out var left, out var right);
							for (int i = left; i < right; i += 3)
							{
								double num3 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredDistance(actualPoint, segment.Points[i]);
								double num4 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredDistance(actualPoint, segment.Points[i + 3]);
								if (num3 <= num2 || num4 <= num2)
								{
									return new Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>(splineSeries2D, null);
								}
								if (i == 0 || i == segment.Points.Count - 4)
								{
									double num5 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(segment.Points[i], segment.Points[i + 3]);
									double num6 = (num5 * num5 + num4 - num3) / 2.0 / num5;
									double num7 = num4 - num6 * num6;
									if (num7 < num2 && ((i == 0 && num6 > num5 && num6 <= num5 + num) || (i == segment.Points.Count - 4 && num6 < 0.0 && num6 >= 0.0 - num)))
									{
										return new Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>(splineSeries2D, null);
									}
								}
								double num8 = 0.0;
								double num9 = 1.0;
								while (num9 - num8 > 0.001)
								{
									double num10 = (num8 + num9) / 2.0;
									double num11 = MathUtils.CalcSquaredDistance(actualPoint, NativeHitTestHelper.GetBezierPoint(segment.Points, num10, i));
									if (num11 <= num2)
									{
										return new Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>(splineSeries2D, null);
									}
									if (num11 >= num3 && num11 >= num4)
									{
										return null;
									}
									if (num3 > num4)
									{
										num3 = num11;
										num8 = num10;
									}
									else
									{
										num4 = num11;
										num9 = num10;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnRenderCore(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
		}

		protected override void StartFigure(ChartGeometryFigure figure, ChartPolyBezierSegment segment)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void Update(bool shouldUpdateGeometry)
		{
			base.ShouldUpdateGeometry = shouldUpdateGeometry;
			((Pane)base.Series.ActualPane)?.DirectXSeriesSurface?.Invalidate();
		}

		protected internal override void OnSeriesDetached()
		{
			((Pane)base.Series.ActualPane)?.DirectXSeriesSurface?.UnregisterSurfaceCallback(GetHashCode());
			base.OnSeriesDetached();
		}
	}
	public class SeriesSurfaceControlBase : System.Windows.Controls.Image, IHitTestableElement, INativeHitTestableElement
	{
		internal class SurfaceCallback
		{
			private readonly Action<IRenderContext> render;

			public int ZOrder { get; }

			public int HashCode { get; }

			public Func<System.Windows.Point, Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>> HitTest { get; }

			public event EventHandler OnRender;

			public SurfaceCallback(Action<IRenderContext> render, Func<System.Windows.Point, Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>> hitTest, int zOrder, int hashCode)
			{
				this.render = render;
				HitTest = hitTest;
				ZOrder = zOrder;
				HashCode = hashCode;
			}

			public void Render(IRenderContext context)
			{
				this.OnRender?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				render(context);
			}
		}

		private class HashCodeSurfaceCallbackComparer : IEqualityComparer<SurfaceCallback>
		{
			public static HashCodeSurfaceCallbackComparer Instance { get; } = new HashCodeSurfaceCallbackComparer();

			private HashCodeSurfaceCallbackComparer()
			{
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<SurfaceCallback>.Equals(SurfaceCallback x, SurfaceCallback y)
			{
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return x == y;
				}
				return x.HashCode == y.HashCode;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<SurfaceCallback>.GetHashCode(SurfaceCallback obj)
			{
				return obj.HashCode;
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan ResizeInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(400.0);

		private readonly List<SurfaceCallback> surfaceCallbacks = new List<SurfaceCallback>();

		private bool loaded;

		private DispatcherTimer resizeTimer;

		private SeriesSurfaceSource surfaceSource;

		private ChartControl chart;

		private System.Windows.Size lastChartSize = System.Windows.Size.Empty;

		private Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint> hitTest;

		private bool invalidResizeState;

		private bool InvalidState { get; set; } = true;

		private ChartControl Chart
		{
			get
			{
				if (chart == null)
				{
					chart = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<ChartControl>((DependencyObject)this);
				}
				return chart;
			}
		}

		private SeriesSurfaceSource SurfaceSource
		{
			get
			{
				return surfaceSource;
			}
			set
			{
				surfaceSource?.Dispose();
				surfaceSource = value;
			}
		}

		internal List<SurfaceCallback> SurfaceCallbacks => surfaceCallbacks;

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => hitTest?.Item1;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => hitTest?.Item2;

		private static void StartResizeTimer(DispatcherTimer timer)
		{
			if (timer.Interval != ResizeInterval)
			{
				timer.Interval = ResizeInterval;
			}
			else
			{
				timer.Start();
			}
		}

		public SeriesSurfaceControlBase()
		{
			OnCreating();
		}

		void INativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			HitTest(point);
		}

		IList<object> INativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(Rect rect)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private DispatcherTimer CreateResizeTimer(bool shouldStartTimer)
		{
			DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Render);
			dispatcherTimer.Tick += OnResizeTimerTick;
			if (shouldStartTimer)
			{
				StartResizeTimer(dispatcherTimer);
			}
			return dispatcherTimer;
		}

		private void Init()
		{
			try
			{
				SurfaceSource = new SeriesSurfaceSource(RenderCore);
				base.Stretch = Stretch.Fill;
				base.Source = SurfaceSource;
				bool flag = (int)base.ActualWidth == 0 && (int)base.ActualHeight == 0;
				resizeTimer = CreateResizeTimer(flag);
				if (!flag)
				{
					OnResizeTimerTick(null, null);
				}
				loaded = true;
				invalidResizeState = true;
			}
			catch
			{
				DisableDirectXRender();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateRender()
		{
			InvalidState = true;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Init();
		}

		private void OnResizeTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			resizeTimer.Stop();
			UpdateSurfaceSourceSize();
		}

		protected void UpdateSurfaceSourceSize()
		{
			if (NeedUpdateSurfaceSourceSize())
			{
				try
				{
					SurfaceSource.UpdateSize((int)base.ActualWidth, (int)base.ActualHeight);
					Invalidate();
				}
				catch
				{
					DisableDirectXRender();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NeedUpdateSurfaceSourceSize()
		{
			int num = (int)base.ActualWidth;
			int num2 = (int)base.ActualHeight;
			SeriesSurfaceSource seriesSurfaceSource = SurfaceSource;
			if (seriesSurfaceSource != null && num > 0 && num2 > 0)
			{
				if (num == seriesSurfaceSource.PixelWidth)
				{
					return num2 != seriesSurfaceSource.PixelHeight;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void DisableDirectXRender()
		{
			ChartControl chartControl = Chart;
			if (chartControl != null)
			{
				chartControl.IsDirectXSurfaceRendering = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnLoad();
		}

		private void Render()
		{
			if (InvalidState)
			{
				OnSurfaceRenderRequest();
				InvalidState = false;
			}
		}

		private void RenderCore(IRenderContext context)
		{
			foreach (SurfaceCallback surfaceCallback in surfaceCallbacks)
			{
				surfaceCallback.Render(context);
			}
		}

		public void HitTest(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			hitTest = null;
			for (int num = surfaceCallbacks.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				hitTest = surfaceCallbacks[num].HitTest?.Invoke(point.Value);
				if (hitTest != null)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Render();
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeSize);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCreating()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			ChartControl chartControl = Chart;
			if (chartControl == null || chartControl.RenderSize.Width != lastChartSize.Width || chartControl.RenderSize.Height != lastChartSize.Height || invalidResizeState)
			{
				StartResizeTimer(resizeTimer);
				invalidResizeState = false;
			}
			else
			{
				Invalidate();
			}
			if (chartControl != null)
			{
				lastChartSize = chartControl.RenderSize;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSurfaceRenderRequest()
		{
			try
			{
				SurfaceSource?.Render();
			}
			catch
			{
				DisableDirectXRender();
			}
		}

		internal void UnLoad()
		{
			if (loaded)
			{
				surfaceCallbacks.Clear();
				resizeTimer.Stop();
				resizeTimer.Tick -= OnResizeTimerTick;
				SurfaceSource = null;
			}
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			InvalidateRender();
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		public void RegisterSurfaceCallback(int index, Action<IRenderContext> render, Func<System.Windows.Point, Tuple<Series, RefinedPoint>> hitTest, int hashCode)
		{
			if (render == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SurfaceCallback surfaceCallback = new SurfaceCallback(render, hitTest, index, hashCode);
			if (!surfaceCallbacks.Contains(surfaceCallback, HashCodeSurfaceCallbackComparer.Instance))
			{
				surfaceCallbacks.Add(surfaceCallback);
				surfaceCallbacks.Sort((SurfaceCallback item1, SurfaceCallback item2) => item1.ZOrder.CompareTo(item2.ZOrder));
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterSurfaceCallback(int hashCode)
		{
			surfaceCallbacks.RemoveAll((SurfaceCallback c) => c.HashCode == hashCode);
		}
	}
	public class D2DRenderer : DirectXRendererBase
	{
		private D3D11Device device;

		private D3D11DeviceContext deviceContext;

		private D2D1Factory1 d2DFactory1;

		private D2DStylesHelper stylesHelper;

		private D2D1RenderTarget renderTarget;

		private readonly Dictionary<int, D2D1Geometry> cachedGeometries = new Dictionary<int, D2D1Geometry>();

		private readonly Stack<Action> pushCommands = new Stack<Action>();

		private D2D1_COLOR_F clearColor;

		private SeriesSurfaceSource seriesSurfaceSource;

		internal static D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC CreateTextureParams(int width, int height)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC val = default(DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC);
			((DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC)(ref val)).Count = 1;
			((DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC)(ref val)).Quality = 0;
			return new D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC(width, height, 1, 1, (DXGI_FORMAT)87, val, (D3D11_USAGE)0, (D3D11_BIND_FLAG)40, (D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_FLAG)0, (D3D11_RESOURCE_MISC_FLAG)2);
		}

		internal static D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES CreateRenderTargetParams()

		private void AppendSegment(List<System.Windows.Point> points, bool closing, D2D1GeometrySink pSink, bool filled)
		{

		private D2D1Geometry ObtainGeometry(Geometry geometry)
		{
			if (geometry == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int hashCode = geometry.GetHashCode();
			if (!cachedGeometries.TryGetValue(hashCode, out var value))
			{
				value = (D2D1Geometry)(object)D2DRenderHelper.CreateGeometry(d2DFactory1, geometry);
				if (value != null)
				{
					cachedGeometries.Add(hashCode, value);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

				stylesHelper = null;

		}

			cachedGeometries.Clear();
		}

		}
