	public class D2DStylesHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private D2D1SolidColorBrush solidFillBrush;

		private D2D1SolidColorBrush solidStrokeBrush;

		private D2D1LinearGradientBrush gradientBrush;

		private D2D1_COLOR_F currentStrokeColor = D2D1_COLOR_F.TransparentWhite;

		private D2D1_COLOR_F currentFillColor = D2D1_COLOR_F.TransparentWhite;

		private D2D1StrokeStyle cachedStrokeStyle;

		private long cachedStrokeStyleKey;

		private D2D1RenderTarget RenderTarget { get; }

		private D2D1Factory1 D2DFactory1 { get; }

		public D2DStylesHelper(D2D1Factory1 d2DFactory1, D2D1RenderTarget renderTarget)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RenderTarget = renderTarget;
			D2DFactory1 = d2DFactory1;
			solidFillBrush = renderTarget.CreateSolidColorBrush(D2D1_COLOR_F.TransparentWhite, D2D1_BRUSH_PROPERTIES.Default);
			solidStrokeBrush = renderTarget.CreateSolidColorBrush(D2D1_COLOR_F.TransparentWhite, D2D1_BRUSH_PROPERTIES.Default);
		}

		private D2D1SolidColorBrush GetSolidFillBrush(D2D1_COLOR_F color)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!currentFillColor.CompareTo(color))
			{
				solidFillBrush.SetColor(color);
				currentFillColor = color;
			}
			return solidFillBrush;
		}

		private D2D1SolidColorBrush GetSolidStrokeBrush(D2D1_COLOR_F color)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!currentStrokeColor.CompareTo(color))
			{
				solidStrokeBrush.SetColor(color);
				currentStrokeColor = color;
			}
			return solidStrokeBrush;
		}

		private D2D1Brush GetBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect rect, Func<D2D1_COLOR_F, D2D1SolidColorBrush> getSolidBrush)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0199: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0141: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0161: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (brush is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = ((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color;
				if (color.A == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (D2D1Brush)(object)getSolidBrush(D2DRenderHelper.ObtainColor(color));
			}
			if (brush is LinearGradientBrush { GradientStops: not null } linearGradientBrush)
			{
				if (linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Count > 1)
				{
					int count = linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Count;
					D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP[] array = (D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP[])(object)new D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP[count];
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						array[i] = new D2D1_GRADIENT_STOP((float)linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[i].Offset, D2DRenderHelper.ObtainColor(linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[i].Color));
					}
					D2D_POINT_2F val = default(D2D_POINT_2F);
					((D2D_POINT_2F)(ref val))..ctor((float)(rect.Left + rect.Width * linearGradientBrush.StartPoint.X), (float)(rect.Top + rect.Height * linearGradientBrush.StartPoint.Y));
					D2D_POINT_2F val2 = default(D2D_POINT_2F);
					((D2D_POINT_2F)(ref val2))..ctor((float)(rect.Left + rect.Width * linearGradientBrush.EndPoint.X), (float)(rect.Top + rect.Height * linearGradientBrush.EndPoint.Y));
					D2D1_LINEAR_GRADIENT_BRUSH_PROPERTIES val3 = default(D2D1_LINEAR_GRADIENT_BRUSH_PROPERTIES);
					((D2D1_LINEAR_GRADIENT_BRUSH_PROPERTIES)(ref val3))..ctor(val, val2);
					D2D1GradientStopCollection val4 = RenderTarget.CreateGradientStopCollection(array, (D2D1_GAMMA)1, (D2D1_EXTEND_MODE)0);
					gradientBrush = RenderTarget.CreateLinearGradientBrush(val3, D2D1_BRUSH_PROPERTIES.Default, val4);
					return (D2D1Brush)(object)gradientBrush;
				}
				if (linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Count == 1)
				{
					return (D2D1Brush)(object)getSolidBrush(D2DRenderHelper.ObtainColor(linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[0].Color));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ClearStyles()
		{
			if (cachedStrokeStyle != null)
			{
				((ComObject)cachedStrokeStyle).Dispose();
				cachedStrokeStyle = null;
			}
			cachedStrokeStyleKey = 0L;
		}

		private void ClearBrushes()
		{
			if (gradientBrush != null)
			{
				((ComObject)gradientBrush).Dispose();
				gradientBrush = null;
			}
			if (solidFillBrush != null)
			{
				((ComObject)solidFillBrush).Dispose();
				solidFillBrush = null;
			}
			if (solidStrokeBrush != null)
			{
				((ComObject)solidStrokeBrush).Dispose();
				solidStrokeBrush = null;
			}
		}

		private void CleanUp()
		{
			ClearStyles();
			ClearBrushes();
		}

		~D2DStylesHelper()
		{
			Dispose();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			CleanUp();
		}

		public D2D1StrokeStyle GetStrokeStyle(PenLineCap lineCap, PenLineJoin lineJoin, double miterLimit, System.Windows.Media.DashStyle dashStyle)

		private static float[] ConvertDashes(DoubleCollection dashes)
		{
			float[] array = new float[dashes.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < dashes.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Convert.ToSingle(dashes[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static D2D1_LINE_JOIN ToLineJoin(PenLineJoin lineJoin)
		{
			return (D2D1_LINE_JOIN)(lineJoin switch
			{
				PenLineJoin.Miter => 0, 
				PenLineJoin.Bevel => 1, 
				PenLineJoin.Round => 2, 
				_ => 1, 
			});
		}

		private static D2D1_CAP_STYLE ToCapStyle(PenLineCap lineCap)
		{
			return (D2D1_CAP_STYLE)(lineCap switch
			{
				PenLineCap.Flat => 0, 
				PenLineCap.Square => 1, 
				PenLineCap.Round => 2, 
				PenLineCap.Triangle => 3, 
				_ => 0, 
			});
		}

		private static D2D_POINT_2F[] ConvertPoints(PointCollection points)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			D2D_POINT_2F[] array = (D2D_POINT_2F[])(object)new D2D_POINT_2F[points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = points[i].ToD2DPointF();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static D2D1PathGeometry CreatePathGeometry(D2D1Factory1 d2DFactory1, PathGeometry pathGeometry)
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (pathGeometry == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			D2D1PathGeometry val = ((D2D1Factory)d2DFactory1).CreatePathGeometry();
			D2D1GeometrySink val2 = val.Open();
			try
			{
				((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val2).SetFillMode((D2D1_FILL_MODE)((pathGeometry.FillRule != FillRule.EvenOdd) ? 1 : 0));
				foreach (PathFigure figure in pathGeometry.Figures)
				{
					D2D_POINT_2F val3 = figure.StartPoint.ToD2DPointF();
					((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val2).BeginFigure(val3, (D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN)(!figure.IsFilled));
					foreach (PathSegment segment in figure.Segments)
					{
						if (segment is PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment)
						{
							((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val2).AddLines(ConvertPoints(polyLineSegment.Points));
						}
					}
					((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val2).EndFigure((D2D1_FIGURE_END)(figure.IsClosed ? 1 : 0));
				}
				((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val2).Close();
				return val;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static bool CompareTo(this D2D1_COLOR_F c1, D2D1_COLOR_F c2)
		{
			if (((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c1)).A == ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c2)).A && ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c1)).R == ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c2)).R && ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c1)).G == ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c2)).G)
			{
				return ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c1)).B == ((D2D1_COLOR_F)(ref c2)).B;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class SeriesSurfaceSource : D3DImage, IDisposable
	{
		public delegate void OnSurfaceRendering(IRenderContext context);

		private readonly OnSurfaceRendering onSurfaceRendering;

		private readonly DirectXRendererBase renderer;

		private Direct3DSurface9 backBuffer;

		private bool isDisposed;

		internal DirectXRendererBase Renderer => renderer;

		public SeriesSurfaceSource(OnSurfaceRendering renderDelegate)
		{
			renderer = new D2DRenderer(this);
			renderer.Init();
			onSurfaceRendering = renderDelegate;
			base.IsFrontBufferAvailableChanged += OnIsFrontBufferAvailableChanged;
		}

		private void ClearBackBuffer()
		{
			backBuffer?.Dispose();
			backBuffer = null;
			Lock();
			SetBackBuffer(D3DResourceType.IDirect3DSurface9, IntPtr.Zero);
			Unlock();
		}

		private void OnIsFrontBufferAvailableChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Convert.ToBoolean(e.OldValue) && Convert.ToBoolean(e.NewValue) && backBuffer != null)
			{
				SetBackBuffer(backBuffer.NativeInterface);
			}
		}

		private void SetBackBuffer(IntPtr ptr)
		{
			Lock();
			SetBackBuffer(D3DResourceType.IDirect3DSurface9, ptr, enableSoftwareFallback: true);
			AddDirtyRect(new Int32Rect(0, 0, base.PixelWidth, base.PixelHeight));
			Unlock();
		}

		private void DisposeCore()
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				ClearBackBuffer();
				renderer.Dispose();
				isDisposed = true;
			}
		}

		public void SetRenderTarget(D3D11Texture2D texture)
		{
			if (backBuffer != null)
			{
				ClearBackBuffer();
			}
			Direct3DSurface9 direct3DSurface = Direct3D9Interop.CreateSharedD3D9Surface(texture);
			if (direct3DSurface != null)
			{
				SetBackBuffer(direct3DSurface.NativeInterface);
				backBuffer = direct3DSurface;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSize(int actualWidth, int actualHeight)
		{
			renderer.SizeChanged(actualWidth, actualHeight);
			Render();
		}

		public void Render()
		{
			if (base.IsFrontBufferAvailable)
			{
				renderer.BeginDraw();
				onSurfaceRendering?.Invoke(renderer);
				renderer.EndDraw();
				Lock();
				AddDirtyRect(new Int32Rect(0, 0, base.PixelWidth, base.PixelHeight));
				Unlock();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeCore();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~SeriesSurfaceSource()
		{
			DisposeCore();
		}
	}

				IsDisposed = true;
				DisposeOverride(disposing);
			}
		}

		~DirectXRendererBase()
		{

		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeOverride(bool disposing)
		{
		}

		public abstract void Init();

		public virtual void SizeChanged(int actualWidth, int actualHeight)

		}

		public abstract void DrawRoundedRectangle(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect rect, double rX, double rY);

		public abstract void DrawGeometry(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Geometry geometry);

		public abstract void DrawEllipse(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point center, double radiusX, double radiusY);

		{

		}
	}

	{
		[DllImport("d3d9.dll")]
		internal static extern int Direct3DCreate9Ex(int SDKVersion, out Direct3D9ComInterface.IDirect3D9Ex directX);

		[DllImport("user32.dll")]
		private static extern IntPtr GetDesktopWindow();

		private static D3D9FORMAT ToD3D9Format(DXGI_FORMAT format)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if ((int)format != 28)
			{
				if ((int)format != 29)
				{
					return (format - 87) switch
					{
						0 => D3D9FORMAT.A8R8G8B8, 
						4 => D3D9FORMAT.A8R8G8B8, 
						1 => D3D9FORMAT.X8R8G8B8, 
						_ => D3D9FORMAT.UNKNOWN, 
					};
				}
				return D3D9FORMAT.A8B8G8R8;
			}
			return D3D9FORMAT.A8B8G8R8;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Direct3DDevice9Ex CreateDevice()
		{
			IntPtr desktopWindow = GetDesktopWindow();
			using Direct3D9Ex direct3D9Ex = Direct3D9Ex.Create(32);
			D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS pPresentationParameters = new D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS
			{
				Windowed = 1,
				SwapEffect = 1,
				hDeviceWindow = desktopWindow,
				PresentationInterval = int.MinValue
			};
			return direct3D9Ex.CreateDeviceEx(0u, 1, desktopWindow, 70, pPresentationParameters, null);
		}

		private static Direct3DTexture9 GetSharedSurface(Direct3DDevice9Ex device, D3D11Texture2D texture2D)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC desc = texture2D.GetDesc();
			if ((((D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC)(ref desc)).MiscFlags & 2) == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Texture must be created with ResourceOptionFlags.Shared");
			}
			D3D9FORMAT d3D9FORMAT = ToD3D9Format(((D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC)(ref desc)).Format);
			if (d3D9FORMAT == D3D9FORMAT.UNKNOWN)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Texture format is not compatible with OpenSharedResource");
			}
			DXGIResource val = texture2D.AsResource();
			try
			{
				IntPtr pSharedHandle = val.SharedHandle;
				return device.CreateTexture((uint)((D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC)(ref desc)).Width, (uint)((D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC)(ref desc)).Height, 1u, 1, (int)d3D9FORMAT, 0, ref pSharedHandle);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static Direct3DSurface9 CreateSharedD3D9Surface(D3D11Texture2D texture2D)
		{
			if (texture2D == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using Direct3DDevice9Ex device = CreateDevice();
			using Direct3DTexture9 direct3DTexture = GetSharedSurface(device, texture2D);
			return direct3DTexture.GetSurfaceLevel(0u);
		}
	}
}

	public abstract class SankeyColorizerBase : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				propertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.propertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.propertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateLinkBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color start, System.Windows.Media.Color end)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(start, 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(end, 1.0));
			linearGradientBrush.SpreadMethod = GradientSpreadMethod.Reflect;
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetNodeBrush(SankeyNode info)
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(GetNodeColor(info));
		}

		internal virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetLinkBrush(SankeyLink link)
		{
			return CreateLinkBrush(GetLinkSourceColor(link), GetLinkTargetColor(link));
		}

		public abstract System.Windows.Media.Color GetNodeColor(SankeyNode info);

		public abstract System.Windows.Media.Color GetLinkSourceColor(SankeyLink link);

		public abstract System.Windows.Media.Color GetLinkTargetColor(SankeyLink link);
	}

	public class SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm : SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase, ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm, ISankeyLayoutAlgorithm
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ResolveOverlappingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ResolveOverlapping", typeof(bool?), typeof(SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm), new PropertyMetadata(true, ResolveOverlappingChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NodeAlignmentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("NodeAlignment", typeof(SankeyNodeAlignment), typeof(SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm), new PropertyMetadata(SankeyNodeAlignment.Center, NodeAlignmentChanged));

		private const bool DefaultResolveOverlapping = true;

		private const SankeyNodeAlignment DefaultNodeAlignment = SankeyNodeAlignment.Center;

		private SankeyLayoutAlgorithmCore linearLayoutAlgorithmCore;

		public bool ActualResolveOverlapping => ResolveOverlapping ?? linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping;

		[Description("Indicates whether nodes are automatically repositioned to avoid link overlap.")]

		bool ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.ResolveOverlapping
		{
			get
			{
				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping;
			}

				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeComparison;

		{

			}
		}

		SankeyNodeAlignmentCore ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.NodeAlignment
		{
			get
			{
				return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment;
			}
			set
			{
				linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment = value;
			}
		}

		private static void ResolveOverlappingChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)
			{
				sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping = e.NewValue == null || ((bool?)e.NewValue).Value;
				sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.NotifyPropertyChanged("ResolveOverlapping");
			}
		}

		private static void NodeAlignmentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)
			{
				sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment = ((e.NewValue == null) ? SankeyNodeAlignmentCore.Center : ((SankeyNodeAlignmentCore)e.NewValue));
				sankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.NotifyPropertyChanged("NodeAlignment");
			}
		}

		public SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm()
		{
			linearLayoutAlgorithmCore = new SankeyLayoutAlgorithmCore();
			linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.ResolveOverlapping = true;
			linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.NodeAlignment = SankeyNodeAlignmentCore.Center;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm();
		}

		bool ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm.CalculateNodeBoundsInternal(IEnumerable<ISankeyNodeLayoutItem> nodes, DXRectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return linearLayoutAlgorithmCore.CalculateNodeBoundsInternal(nodes, bounds);
		}
	}
	public class SankeyLink : IWeakEventListener, ILink, IInteractiveElement
	{
		private readonly SankeyNodeItem sourceItem;

		private readonly SankeyNodeItem targetItem;

		private readonly SankeyLinkLayoutInfo info;

		private bool isHighlighted;

		private bool isSelected;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

		private UIElement presentation;

		internal SankeyLinkLayoutInfo Info => info;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<object> Tags { get; }

		public SankeyNode SourceNode => sourceItem.Node;

		public SankeyNode TargetNode => targetItem.Node;

		public double TotalWeight => info.Weight;

		INode ILink.Source => sourceItem;

		INode ILink.Target => targetItem;

		SankeyLinkLayoutInfo ILink.Info => info;

		System.Windows.Media.Brush ILink.Brush => brush;

		bool IInteractiveElement.IsHighlighted
		{
			get
			{
				return isHighlighted;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isHighlighted != value)
				{
					isHighlighted = value;
					presentation?.InvalidateVisual();
				}
			}
		}

		bool IInteractiveElement.IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return isSelected;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isSelected != value)
				{
					isSelected = value;
					presentation?.InvalidateVisual();
				}
			}
		}

		object IInteractiveElement.Content => Tags;

		internal SankeyLink(SankeyLinkLayoutInfo info, SankeyNodeItem source, SankeyNodeItem target)
		{
			this.info = info;
			Tags = info.Tags.AsReadOnly();
			sourceItem = source;
			targetItem = target;
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, source, this);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, target, this);
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is SankeyNodeItem)
			{
				presentation?.InvalidateVisual();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			this.brush = brush;
		}

		internal void SetPresentation(UIElement presentation)
		{
			this.presentation = presentation;
		}
	}

	public class SankeyToolTipItem : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly SankeyToolTipInfo info;

		private bool visible;

		private DataTemplate contentTemplate;

		private System.Windows.Point position;

		internal bool CanBeShown => info.SourceObject != null;

		public SankeyToolTipInfo Info => info;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (visible != value)
				{
					visible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Visible");
				}
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Point Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (position != value)
				{
					position = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Position");
				}
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate ContentTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return contentTemplate;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (contentTemplate != value)
				{
					contentTemplate = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ContentTemplate");
				}
			}
		}

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				propertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		internal SankeyToolTipItem()
		{
			info = new SankeyToolTipInfo();
		}

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.propertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.propertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

	public class SankeyElementsPanel : Grid
	{
		private SankeyDiagramControl diagram;

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				diagram = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<SankeyDiagramControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			}
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				DXRectangle bounds = default(DXRectangle);
				((DXRectangle)(ref bounds))..ctor(0, 0, (int)arrangeBounds.Width, (int)arrangeBounds.Height);
				diagram.IsSmall = !SankeyLayoutCalculatorChooser<SankeyNode>.CalculateNodes(bounds, diagram.DataController.Nodes, diagram.DataController, diagram);
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}
	}
	public class SankeyNodesPanel : Panel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				SankeyNodeLayoutInfo sankeyNodeLayoutInfo = (child as SankeyNodePresentation).Node?.Info;
				if (sankeyNodeLayoutInfo != null)
				{
					child.Arrange(sankeyNodeLayoutInfo.Bounds.ToRect());
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class SankeyNodeLabelsPanel : Panel
	{
		private const int Indent = 5;

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				SankeyNodeLabelPresentation sankeyNodeLabelPresentation = (SankeyNodeLabelPresentation)child;
				SankeyNodeLayoutInfo sankeyNodeLayoutInfo = sankeyNodeLabelPresentation.Node?.Info;
				if (sankeyNodeLayoutInfo != null)
				{
					GRealSize2D textBounds = new GRealSize2D(Math.Ceiling(child.DesiredSize.Width), Math.Ceiling(child.DesiredSize.Height));
					DXRectangle gRect = LabelLayoutCalculator.CalculateBounds(SankeyLabelAlignmentCore.OutsideAuto, textBounds, sankeyNodeLayoutInfo.Bounds, 5, sankeyNodeLayoutInfo.IsLast, isVerticalText: false);
					child.Arrange(gRect.ToRect());
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class SankeyLinksPanel : Panel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		public void InvalidateChildrenVisual()
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.InvalidateVisual();
			}
		}
	}

		static SankeyDiagramControl()
		{
			DataSourceProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DataSource", typeof(object), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(DataSourcePropertyChanged));
			SourceDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SourceDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, DataMemberChanged));
			TargetDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TargetDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, DataMemberChanged));
			WeightDataMemberProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("WeightDataMember", typeof(string), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, DataMemberChanged));
			ColorizerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Colorizer", typeof(SankeyColorizerBase), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(ColorizerPropertyChanged));
			NodeTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NodeTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			NodeLabelProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("NodeLabel", typeof(SankeyNodeLabel), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(NodeLabelPropertyChanged));
			ToolTipOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipOptions", typeof(SankeyToolTipOptions), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			ToolTipItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipItem", typeof(SankeyToolTipItem), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			NodeComparerProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("NodeComparer", typeof(IComparer<SankeyNode>), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(NodeComparerPropertyChanged));
			LayoutAlgorithmProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LayoutAlgorithm", typeof(SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(LayoutAlgorithmPropertyChanged));
			ViewOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ViewOptions", typeof(SankeyViewOptions), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(ViewOptionsPropertyChanged));
			TitlesPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Titles", typeof(SankeyTitleCollection), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata());
			TitlesProperty = TitlesPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			PrintOptionsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PrintOptions", typeof(SankeyPrintOptions), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			SmallSankeyTextProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SmallSankeyText", typeof(SmallSankeyText), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			EmptySankeyTextProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EmptySankeyText", typeof(EmptySankeyText), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			EnableHighlightingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("EnableHighlighting", typeof(bool?), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			HighlightedItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HighlightedItems", typeof(IList), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnHighlightedItemsChanged));
			SelectionModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectionMode", typeof(SankeySelectionMode), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(SankeySelectionMode.None));
			SelectedItemsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedItems", typeof(IList), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedItemsChanged));
			NodeToolTipContentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NodeToolTipContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			LinkToolTipContentTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LinkToolTipContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			ToolTipTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ToolTipTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(SankeyDiagramControl));
			DXSerializer.SerializationProviderProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new UIPropertyMetadata(new SankeySerializationProvider()));
			DXSerializer.SerializationIDDefaultProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SankeyDiagramControl), new UIPropertyMetadata("SankeyDiagramControl"));
		}

		{
			if (d is SankeyDiagramControl sankeyDiagramControl)

				sankeyDiagramControl.DataController.BindingBehavior.UpdateActualDataSource(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		{

				sankeyDiagramControl.DataController.UpdateInitialData();
			}
		}

		{
			if (d is SankeyDiagramControl sankeyDiagramControl)

				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, e.NewValue as INotifyPropertyChanged, sankeyDiagramControl);

			}
		}

		}

		public SankeyDiagramControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SankeyDiagramControl>(this);
			SetValue(TitlesPropertyKey, new SankeyTitleCollection());
			defaultViewOptions = new SankeyViewOptions();
			dataController = new SankeyDataController(this);
			defaultColorizer = new SankeyPaletteColorizer();
			toolTipController = new SankeyToolTipController(this);
			defaultNodeLabel = new SankeyNodeLabel();
			defaultToolTipOptions = new SankeyToolTipOptions();
			defaultSmallSankeyText = new SmallSankeyText();
			defaultEmptySankeyText = new EmptySankeyText();
			defaultLayoutAlgorithm = new SankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm();
			highlightingController = new SankeyHighlightingController(this, dataController);
			selectionController = new SankeySelectionController(this, dataController);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, defaultColorizer, this);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, defaultViewOptions, this);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, defaultNodeLabel, this);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, dataController, this);
			CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(null, defaultLayoutAlgorithm, this);
			base.MouseDown += OnMouseDown;
			base.MouseUp += OnMouseUp;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (e is PropertyChangedEventArgs)
			{
				if (sender is SankeyColorizerBase)
				{
					ColorizeElements();
					return true;
				}
				if (sender is SankeyViewOptions || sender is SankeyDataController)
				{
					InvalidateLayout();
					return true;
				}
				if (sender is SankeyNodeLabel)
				{
					NodeLabelsPanel?.InvalidateArrange();
					return true;
				}
				if (sender is SankeyLayoutAlgorithmBase)
				{
					InvalidateLayout();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IPrintableControl.PagePrintedCallback(IEnumerator pageBrickEnumerator, Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> brickUpdaters)
		{
			while (pageBrickEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = pageBrickEnumerator.Current;
				ImageBrick val = (ImageBrick)((current is ImageBrick) ? current : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((BrickBase)val).NoClip = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			LastMousePosition = e.GetPosition(this);
			toolTipController.UpdateOnClick();
		}

		private void OnMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			SelectionController.ResetSelection(Keyboard.Modifiers);
		}

		private void UpdateControlContent()
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				obj = ActualEmptySankeyText;
			}
			else if (IsSmall)
			{
				obj = ActualSmallSankeyText;
			}
			TopContentPresenter.Content = obj;
			TopContentPresenter.Visibility = ((obj == null) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			TitleItemsContainer.Visibility = ((obj != null) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		private void InvalidateLayout()
		{
			NodesPanel?.InvalidateArrange();
			NodeLabelsPanel?.InvalidateArrange();
			LinksPanel?.InvalidateArrange();
			LinksPanel?.InvalidateChildrenVisual();
			ElementsPanel?.InvalidateArrange();
		}

		internal void ColorizeElements()
		{
			foreach (SankeyNodeItem platformNode in DataController.PlatformNodes)
			{
				platformNode.Brush = ActualColorizer.GetNodeBrush(platformNode.Node);
			}
			foreach (SankeyLink link in DataController.Links)
			{
				link.SetBrush(ActualColorizer.GetLinkBrush(link));
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeNodeComparer(XamlDesignerSerializationManager manager)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			topContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_TopContent") as ContentPresenter;
			titleItemsContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_TitleItemsContainer") as SankeyTitleItemsControl;
			elementsPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_ElementsContainer") as SankeyElementsPanel;
			nodeItemsContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_NodeItemsContainer") as SankeyNodeItemsControl;
			nodeLabelItemsContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_NodeLabelItemsContainer") as SankeyNodeLabelItemsControl;
			linkItemsContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_LinkItemsContainer") as SankeyLinkItemsControl;
			if (nodeItemsContainer != null && linkItemsContainer != null && nodeLabelItemsContainer != null)
			{
				nodeItemsContainer.ItemsSource = dataController.PlatformNodes;
				nodeLabelItemsContainer.ItemsSource = dataController.PlatformNodes;
				linkItemsContainer.ItemsSource = dataController.Links;
			}
			UpdateControlContent();
		}

	public class SankeyNode
	{
		private readonly SankeyNodeLayoutInfo info;

		private readonly List<SankeyLink> inputLinks;

		private readonly List<SankeyLink> outputLinks;

		internal int Index => info.Index;

		internal SankeyNodeLayoutInfo Info => info;

		internal SankeyNodeItem NodeItem { get; }

		public object Tag => info.Tag;

		public int Level => info.LevelIndex;

		public double SourceWeight => info.SourceWeight;

		public double TargetWeight => info.TargetWeight;

		public double TotalWeight => info.TotalWeight;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<SankeyLink> InputLinks => inputLinks.AsReadOnly();

		public ReadOnlyCollection<SankeyLink> OutputLinks => outputLinks.AsReadOnly();

		internal SankeyNode(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo info, SankeyNodeItem nodeItem)
		{
			this.info = info;
			inputLinks = new List<SankeyLink>();
			outputLinks = new List<SankeyLink>();
			NodeItem = nodeItem;
		}

		internal void AddInputLinks(SankeyLink link)
		{
			inputLinks.Add(link);
		}

		internal void AddOutputLinks(SankeyLink link)
		{
			outputLinks.Add(link);
		}
	}
	public class SankeyNodeItem : DependencyObject, INode, IInteractiveElement, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private bool isHighlighted;

		private bool isSelected;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

		public SankeyNode Node { get; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return brush;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (brush != value)
				{
					brush = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Brush");
				}
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush OpacityMask => GetOpacityMask();

		bool IInteractiveElement.IsHighlighted
		{
			get
			{
				return isHighlighted;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isHighlighted != value)
				{
					isHighlighted = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("OpacityMask");
				}
			}
		}

		bool IInteractiveElement.IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return isSelected;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isSelected != value)
				{
					isSelected = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("OpacityMask");
				}
			}
		}

		object IInteractiveElement.Content => Node.Tag;

		SankeyNodeLayoutInfo INode.Info => Node.Info;

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				propertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public SankeyNodeItem(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo nodeInfo)
		{
			Node = new SankeyNode(nodeInfo, this);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush GetOpacityMask()
		{
			if (isSelected)
			{
				return SankeyVisualHelper.GetSelectionBrush();
			}
			if (isHighlighted)
			{
				return SankeyVisualHelper.GetHighlightingBrush();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.propertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.propertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

	public class SankeyTitleItemsControl : ItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LastChildProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TitlesProperty;

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public FrameworkElement LastChild
		{
			get
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)GetValue(LastChildProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LastChildProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		[Category("Common")]
		public SankeyTitleCollection Titles
		{
			get
			{
				return (SankeyTitleCollection)GetValue(TitlesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TitlesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void LastChildChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as SankeyTitleItemsControl)?.UpdateItemsSource();
		}

		private static void TitlesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SankeyTitleItemsControl sankeyTitleItemsControl)
			{
				if (e.OldValue is SankeyTitleCollection sankeyTitleCollection)
				{
					sankeyTitleCollection.CollectionChanged -= sankeyTitleItemsControl.TitlesCollectionChanged;
				}
				if (e.NewValue is SankeyTitleCollection sankeyTitleCollection2)
				{
					sankeyTitleCollection2.CollectionChanged += sankeyTitleItemsControl.TitlesCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		static SankeyTitleItemsControl()
		{
			LastChildProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LastChild", typeof(FrameworkElement), typeof(SankeyTitleItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(LastChildChanged));
			TitlesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Titles", typeof(SankeyTitleCollection), typeof(SankeyTitleItemsControl), new PropertyMetadata(TitlesChanged));
			ItemsPanelTemplate itemsPanelTemplate = new ItemsPanelTemplate(new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(DockPanel)));
			itemsPanelTemplate.Seal();
			ItemsControl.ItemsPanelProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(SankeyTitleItemsControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(itemsPanelTemplate));
		}

		private void TitlesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateItemsSource();
		}

		private void UpdateItemsSource()
		{
			if (Titles != null)
			{
				ObservableCollection<object> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<object>(Titles);
				observableCollection.Add(LastChild);
				base.ItemsSource = observableCollection;
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (element is SankeyTitle sankeyTitle)
			{
				sankeyTitle.SetBinding(DockPanel.DockProperty, new Binding("Dock")
				{
					Source = sankeyTitle
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public class SankeyNodePresentation : Control
	{
		private SankeyDiagramControl diagram;

		private SankeyDiagramControl Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagram == null)
				{
					diagram = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<SankeyDiagramControl>((DependencyObject)this);
				}
				return diagram;
			}
		}

		internal INode Node { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate NodeTemplate => Diagram?.NodeTemplate;

		internal SankeyNodePresentation()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SankeyNodePresentation>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting || Diagram.ActualToolTipOptions.ActualNodeToolTipEnabled)
			{
				Diagram.HighlightingController.Highlight(Node);
				Diagram.ToolTipController.UpdateOnHover();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting || Diagram.ActualToolTipOptions.ActualNodeToolTipEnabled)
			{
				Diagram.HighlightingController.Unhighlight();
				Diagram.ToolTipController.UpdateOnHover();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			Diagram.ShouldResetSelection = false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseUp(e);
			if (PointExtensions.Distance(e.GetPosition(Diagram), Diagram.LastMousePosition) < 5.0)
			{
				Diagram.SelectionController.ChangeSelection(Node, Keyboard.Modifiers);
			}
		}
	}

	public class SankeyLinkPresentation : Control
	{
		private SankeyDiagramControl diagram;

		private SankeyDiagramControl Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagram == null)
				{
					diagram = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<SankeyDiagramControl>((DependencyObject)this);
				}
				return diagram;
			}
		}

		internal ILink Link { get; set; }

		internal SankeyLinkPresentation()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SankeyLinkPresentation>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			drawingContext.PushOpacity(Diagram.ActualViewOptions.LinkOpacity);
			if (Link.IsSelected)
			{
				drawingContext.PushOpacityMask(SankeyVisualHelper.GetSelectionBrush());
			}
			else if (Link.IsHighlighted)
			{
				drawingContext.PushOpacityMask(SankeyVisualHelper.GetHighlightingBrush());
			}
			LinkPointsCalculator linkPointsCalculator = new LinkPointsCalculator(Link.Info);
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometry.Freeze();
				streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(linkPointsCalculator.FirstTop.ToPoint(), isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
				streamGeometryContext.PolyBezierTo(new List<System.Windows.Point>
				{
					linkPointsCalculator.SecondTop.ToPoint(),
					linkPointsCalculator.ThirdTop.ToPoint(),
					linkPointsCalculator.FourthTop.ToPoint()
				}, isStroked: false, isSmoothJoin: false);
				streamGeometryContext.LineTo(linkPointsCalculator.FourthBottom.ToPoint(), isStroked: false, isSmoothJoin: false);
				streamGeometryContext.PolyBezierTo(new List<System.Windows.Point>
				{
					linkPointsCalculator.ThirdBottom.ToPoint(),
					linkPointsCalculator.SecondBottom.ToPoint(),
					linkPointsCalculator.FirstBottom.ToPoint()
				}, isStroked: false, isSmoothJoin: false);
			}
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(Link.Brush, null, streamGeometry);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting || Diagram.ActualToolTipOptions.ActualLinkToolTipEnabled)
			{
				Diagram.HighlightingController.Highlight(Link);
				Diagram.ToolTipController.UpdateOnHover();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting || Diagram.ActualToolTipOptions.ActualLinkToolTipEnabled)
			{
				Diagram.HighlightingController.Unhighlight();
				Diagram.ToolTipController.UpdateOnHover();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			Diagram.ShouldResetSelection = false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseUp(e);
			if (PointExtensions.Distance(e.GetPosition(Diagram), Diagram.LastMousePosition) < 5.0)
			{
				Diagram.SelectionController.ChangeSelection(Link, Keyboard.Modifiers);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SankeyViewOptions : ChartDependencyObject, ISankeyViewOptionsProvider
	{
		private const int DefaultVerticalNodeIndentProperty = -1;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NodeWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("NodeWidth", typeof(int), typeof(SankeyViewOptions), new PropertyMetadata(5, NodeWidthChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VerticalNodeIndentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("VerticalNodeIndent", typeof(int), typeof(SankeyViewOptions), new PropertyMetadata(-1, VerticalNodeIndentChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LinkTransparencyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LinkTransparency", typeof(double), typeof(SankeyViewOptions), new PropertyMetadata(0.7, LinkTransparencyChanged), (ValidateValueCallback)ValidateLinkTransparency);

		internal double LinkOpacity => 1.0 - LinkTransparency;

		[Description("Gets or sets the Sankey node‘s width.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int NodeWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(NodeWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NodeWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies the vertical indent between Sankey nodes.")]
		[Category("Layout")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int VerticalNodeIndent
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(VerticalNodeIndentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(VerticalNodeIndentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the Sankey link‘s transparency.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public double LinkTransparency
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LinkTransparencyProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LinkTransparencyProperty, value);
			}
		}

		bool ISankeyViewOptionsProvider.AutoVerticalNodeIndent => VerticalNodeIndent == -1;

		private static bool ValidateLinkTransparency(object transparency)
		{
			if ((double)transparency >= 0.0)
			{
				return (double)transparency <= 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void NodeWidthChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SankeyViewOptions sankeyViewOptions)
			{
				sankeyViewOptions.NotifyPropertyChanged("NodeWidth");
			}
		}

		private static void VerticalNodeIndentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SankeyViewOptions sankeyViewOptions)
			{
				sankeyViewOptions.NotifyPropertyChanged("VerticalNodeIndent");
			}
		}

		private static void LinkTransparencyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SankeyViewOptions sankeyViewOptions)
			{
				sankeyViewOptions.NotifyPropertyChanged("LinkTransparency");
			}
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new SankeyViewOptions();
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Sankey.Native
{
	public abstract class SankeyInteractionController
	{
		private readonly SankeyDiagramControl diagram;

		private readonly SankeyDataController dataController;

		private IList activeTags;

		protected SankeyDiagramControl Diagram => diagram;

		protected SankeyDataController DataController => dataController;

		protected IList ActiveTags => activeTags;

		protected bool ShouldUpdateCollection { get; set; } = true;

		protected virtual bool SetAdjacentLinksActive { get; set; } = true;

		protected virtual bool SetAdjacentNodesActive { get; set; }

		public SankeyInteractionController(SankeyDiagramControl diagram, SankeyDataController dataController)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.dataController = dataController;
			SetCollection(new ControlledObservableCollection<object>());
		}

		private void Subscribe(IList list)
		{
			if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += CollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void Unsubscribe(object list)
		{
			if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= CollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void PerformWithoutUpdatingCollection(Action action)
		{
			ShouldUpdateCollection = false;
			action();
			ShouldUpdateCollection = true;
		}

		private void AddLinksToActive(IList<SankeyLink> links)
		{
			foreach (SankeyLink link in links)
			{
				AddActive(link);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLinksFromActive(IList<SankeyLink> links)
		{
			foreach (SankeyLink link in links)
			{
				RemoveActive(link);
			}
		}

		private void Add(INode iNode, bool shouldReset = true)
		{
			PerformWithoutUpdatingCollection(delegate
			{
				if (shouldReset)
				{
					Reset();
				}
				AddActive(iNode);
				SankeyNode node = ((SankeyNodeItem)iNode).Node;
				if (SetAdjacentLinksActive)
				{
					AddLinksToActive(node.InputLinks);
					AddLinksToActive(node.OutputLinks);
				}
				ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> platformNodes = dataController.PlatformNodes;
				if (platformNodes != null)
				{
					SankeyNode sankeyNode = platformNodes.LastOrDefault((SankeyNodeItem x) => x.Node.Tag.Equals(node.Tag) && x.Node != node)?.Node;
					if (sankeyNode != null)
					{
						SetIsActive(sankeyNode.NodeItem, value: true);
						if (SetAdjacentLinksActive)
						{
							AddLinksToActive(sankeyNode.InputLinks);
							AddLinksToActive(sankeyNode.OutputLinks);
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void Add(ILink iLink, bool shouldReset = true)
		{
			PerformWithoutUpdatingCollection(delegate
			{
				if (shouldReset)
				{
					Reset();
				}
				AddActive(iLink);
				SankeyLink sankeyLink = (SankeyLink)iLink;
				if (SetAdjacentNodesActive)
				{
					if (sankeyLink.SourceNode != null)
					{
						AddActive(sankeyLink.SourceNode.NodeItem);
					}
					if (sankeyLink.TargetNode != null)
					{
						AddActive(sankeyLink.TargetNode.NodeItem);
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void Remove(INode iNode)
		{
			PerformWithoutUpdatingCollection(delegate
			{
				RemoveActive(iNode);
				SankeyNode node = ((SankeyNodeItem)iNode).Node;
				if (SetAdjacentLinksActive)
				{
					RemoveLinksFromActive(node.InputLinks);
					RemoveLinksFromActive(node.OutputLinks);
				}
				ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> platformNodes = dataController.PlatformNodes;
				if (platformNodes != null)
				{
					SankeyNode sankeyNode = platformNodes.LastOrDefault((SankeyNodeItem x) => x.Node.Tag.Equals(node.Tag) && x.Node != node)?.Node;
					if (sankeyNode != null)
					{
						SetIsActive(sankeyNode.NodeItem, value: false);
						if (SetAdjacentLinksActive)
						{
							RemoveLinksFromActive(sankeyNode.InputLinks);
							RemoveLinksFromActive(sankeyNode.OutputLinks);
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void Remove(ILink iLink)
		{
			PerformWithoutUpdatingCollection(delegate
			{
				RemoveActive(iLink);
				SankeyLink sankeyLink = (SankeyLink)iLink;
				if (SetAdjacentNodesActive)
				{
					if (sankeyLink.SourceNode != null)
					{
						RemoveActive(sankeyLink.SourceNode.NodeItem);
					}
					if (sankeyLink.TargetNode != null)
					{
						RemoveActive(sankeyLink.TargetNode.NodeItem);
					}
				}
			});
		}

		protected abstract void CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e);

		protected abstract void SetIsActive(IInteractiveElement interactiveElement, bool value);

		protected abstract bool GetIsActive(IInteractiveElement interactiveElement);

		protected virtual void AddActive(ILink link)
		{
			if (GetIsActive(link))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object tag in ((SankeyLink)link).Tags)
			{
				ActiveTags.Add(tag);
			}
			SetIsActive(link, value: true);
		}

		protected virtual void AddActive(INode node)
		{
			if (!GetIsActive(node))
			{
				ActiveTags.Add(node.Content);
				SetIsActive(node, value: true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveActive(ILink link)
		{
			if (!GetIsActive(link))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object tag in ((SankeyLink)link).Tags)
			{
				ActiveTags.Remove(tag);
			}
			SetIsActive(link, value: false);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveActive(INode node)
		{
			if (GetIsActive(node))
			{
				ActiveTags.Remove(node.Content);
				SetIsActive(node, value: false);
			}
		}

		protected void Add(IInteractiveElement sankeyInteractiveElement, bool shouldReset = true)
		{
			if (sankeyInteractiveElement is INode)
			{
				Add((INode)sankeyInteractiveElement, shouldReset);
			}
			else
			{
				Add((ILink)sankeyInteractiveElement, shouldReset);
			}
		}

		protected void Remove(IInteractiveElement sankeyInteractiveElement)
		{
			if (sankeyInteractiveElement is INode)
			{
				Remove((INode)sankeyInteractiveElement);
			}
			else
			{
				Remove((ILink)sankeyInteractiveElement);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void Reset()
		{
			ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> platformNodes = DataController.PlatformNodes;
			if (platformNodes != null)
			{
				foreach (SankeyNodeItem item in platformNodes)
				{
					SetIsActive(item, value: false);
				}
			}
			ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyLink> links = DataController.Links;
			if (links != null)
			{
				foreach (SankeyLink item2 in links)
				{
					SetIsActive(item2, value: false);
				}
			}
			ActiveTags.Clear();
		}

		internal void SetCollection(IList list)
		{
			Unsubscribe(activeTags);
			activeTags = list;
			Subscribe(activeTags);
			CollectionChanged(null, null);
		}
	}
	public class SankeyHighlightingController : SankeyInteractionController
	{
		public object HighlightedItem { get; private set; }

		public SankeyHighlightingController(SankeyDiagramControl diagram, SankeyDataController dataController)
			: base(diagram, dataController)
		{
		}

		protected override void CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.ShouldUpdateCollection)
			{
				return;
			}
			ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> platformNodes = base.DataController.PlatformNodes;
			ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyLink> links = base.DataController.Links;
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			if (platformNodes != null && links != null)
			{
				foreach (SankeyNodeItem item in platformNodes)
				{
					bool flag = base.ActiveTags.Contains(item.Node.Tag);
					if (base.Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting)
					{
						((IInteractiveElement)item).IsHighlighted = flag;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				foreach (SankeyLink item2 in links)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					foreach (object tag in item2.Tags)
					{
						if (base.ActiveTags.Contains(tag))
						{
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (base.Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting)
					{
						((IInteractiveElement)item2).IsHighlighted = flag2;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						list.Add(item2);
					}
				}
			}
			HighlightedItem = list.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		protected override void SetIsActive(IInteractiveElement interactiveElement, bool value)
		{
			if (base.Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting)
			{
				interactiveElement.IsHighlighted = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool GetIsActive(IInteractiveElement interactiveElement)
		{
			return interactiveElement.IsHighlighted;
		}

		protected override void AddActive(ILink link)
		{
			if (base.Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting)
			{
				base.AddActive(link);
			}
		}

		protected override void AddActive(INode node)
		{
			if (base.Diagram.ActualEnableHighlighting)
			{
				base.AddActive(node);
			}
		}

		internal void Highlight(IInteractiveElement sankeyInteractiveElement)
		{
			Add(sankeyInteractiveElement);
			HighlightedItem = sankeyInteractiveElement;
		}

		internal void Unhighlight()
		{
			Reset();
			HighlightedItem = null;
		}

		internal override void Reset()
		{
			HighlightedItem = null;
			base.Reset();
		}
	}
	public class SankeySelectionController : SankeyInteractionController
	{
		internal const int TouchDelta = 5;

		public SankeySelectionController(SankeyDiagramControl diagram, SankeyDataController dataController)
			: base(diagram, dataController)
		{
		}

		private SelectionAction CalculateSelectionAction(bool currentSelection, SankeySelectionMode selectionMode, ModifierKeys keyModifiers)
		{
			switch (selectionMode)
			{
			case SankeySelectionMode.Single:
				return SelectionAction.ReplaceAll;
			case SankeySelectionMode.Multiple:
				if (!currentSelection)
				{
					return SelectionAction.Add;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Remove;
			case SankeySelectionMode.Extended:
				if ((keyModifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != ModifierKeys.None)
				{
					if (!currentSelection)
					{
						return SelectionAction.Add;
					}
					return SelectionAction.None;
				}
				if ((keyModifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != ModifierKeys.None)
				{
					if (!currentSelection)
					{
						return SelectionAction.Add;
					}
					return SelectionAction.Remove;
				}
				return SelectionAction.ReplaceAll;
			default:
				return SelectionAction.None;
			}
		}

		protected override void CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.ShouldUpdateCollection)
			{
				return;
			}
			ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> platformNodes = base.DataController.PlatformNodes;
			ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyLink> links = base.DataController.Links;
			if (platformNodes == null || links == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SankeyNodeItem item in platformNodes)
			{
				bool isSelected = base.ActiveTags.Contains(item.Node.Tag);
				((IInteractiveElement)item).IsSelected = isSelected;
			}
			foreach (SankeyLink item2 in links)
			{
				bool isSelected2 = false;
				foreach (object tag in item2.Tags)
				{
					if (base.ActiveTags.Contains(tag))
					{
						isSelected2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				((IInteractiveElement)item2).IsSelected = isSelected2;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetIsActive(IInteractiveElement interactiveElement, bool value)
		{
			interactiveElement.IsSelected = value;
		}

		protected override bool GetIsActive(IInteractiveElement interactiveElement)
		{
			return interactiveElement.IsSelected;
		}

		internal void ChangeSelection(IInteractiveElement sankeyInteractiveElement, ModifierKeys keyModifiers)
		{
			switch (CalculateSelectionAction(sankeyInteractiveElement.IsSelected, base.Diagram.SelectionMode, keyModifiers))
			{
			case SelectionAction.ReplaceAll:
				Add(sankeyInteractiveElement);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.Add:
				Add(sankeyInteractiveElement, shouldReset: false);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.Remove:
				Remove(sankeyInteractiveElement);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.None:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void ResetSelection(ModifierKeys modifierKeys)
		{
			if (!base.Diagram.ShouldResetSelection || (base.Diagram.SelectionMode == SankeySelectionMode.Extended && (modifierKeys & ModifierKeys.Shift) != ModifierKeys.None))
			{
				base.Diagram.ShouldResetSelection = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Reset();
			}
		}
	}
	public class SankeyDataController : ISankeyDataSourceProvider, INotifyPropertyChanged, INodesCreator<SankeyNode>
	{
		private readonly SankeyDiagramControl diagram;

		private readonly SankeyDataAggregator aggregator;

		private readonly BindingBehavior bindingBehavior;

		private readonly List<ISankeyLink> designTimeFakeData;

		private readonly ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> platformNodes;

		private readonly ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodes;

		private readonly ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyLink> linkInfos;

		private ICollection<ISankeyLink> initialLinks;

		private ICollection<ISankeyLink> InitialLinks
		{
			get
			{
				if (initialLinks != null && initialLinks.Count > 0)
				{
					return initialLinks;
				}
				if (bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource == null && diagram.DesignMode)
				{
					return designTimeFakeData;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal ICollection<ISankeyLink> ProcessedLinks => aggregator.GetLinks(InitialLinks);

		internal ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> Nodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (nodes.Count == 0)
				{
					UpdateAdditionalData();
				}
				return nodes;
			}
		}

		internal ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem> PlatformNodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (platformNodes.Count == 0)
				{
					UpdateAdditionalData();
				}
				return platformNodes;
			}
		}

		internal ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyLink> Links
		{
			get
			{
				if (linkInfos.Count == 0)
				{
					UpdateAdditionalData();
				}
				return linkInfos;
			}
		}

		internal BindingBehavior BindingBehavior => bindingBehavior;

		object ISankeyDataSourceProvider.DataSource => BindingBehavior.ActualDataSource;

		string ISankeyDataSourceProvider.SourceDataMember => diagram.SourceDataMember;

		string ISankeyDataSourceProvider.TargetDataMember => diagram.TargetDataMember;

		string ISankeyDataSourceProvider.WeightDataMember => diagram.WeightDataMember;

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				propertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public SankeyDataController(SankeyDiagramControl diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			platformNodes = new ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeItem>();
			nodes = new ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo>();
			linkInfos = new ControlledObservableCollection<SankeyLink>();
			aggregator = new SankeyDataAggregator();
			designTimeFakeData = SankeyFakeDataGenerator.GenerateFakeData();
			bindingBehavior = new BindingBehavior(null);
			bindingBehavior.ActualDataSourceChanged += ActualDataSourceChanged;
		}

		SankeyNode INodesCreator<SankeyNode>.GetNode(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo info)
		{
			return platformNodes.FirstOrDefault((SankeyNodeItem x) => x.Node.Info.Equals(info))?.Node;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.propertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.propertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void ActualDataSourceChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			UpdateInitialData();
		}

		private bool MembersAreValid()
		{
			if (bindingBehavior.ActualDataSource != null && diagram.SourceDataMember != diagram.TargetDataMember && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(diagram.SourceDataMember))
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(diagram.TargetDataMember);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateAdditionalData()
		{
			aggregator.Reset();
			nodes.BeginUpdate();
			platformNodes.BeginUpdate();
			linkInfos.BeginUpdate();
			nodes.Clear();
			ICollection<ISankeyLink> collection = InitialLinks;
			if (collection != null && collection.Count > 0)
			{
				nodes.AddRange(SankeyNodeCreator.GetNodes(ProcessedLinks));
			}
			platformNodes.Clear();
			platformNodes.AddRange(nodes.Select((SankeyNodeLayoutInfo x) => new SankeyNodeItem(x)));
			linkInfos.Clear();
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo node in nodes)
			{
				if (node.TargetLinks == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (SankeyLinkLayoutInfo link in node.TargetLinks)
				{
					SankeyNodeItem sankeyNodeItem = platformNodes.FirstOrDefault((SankeyNodeItem x) => x.Node.Tag.Equals(link.Source.Tag));
					SankeyNodeItem sankeyNodeItem2 = platformNodes.LastOrDefault((SankeyNodeItem x) => x.Node.Tag.Equals(link.Target.Tag));
					SankeyLink sankeyLink = new SankeyLink(link, sankeyNodeItem, sankeyNodeItem2);
					linkInfos.Add(sankeyLink);
					sankeyNodeItem.Node.AddOutputLinks(sankeyLink);
					sankeyNodeItem2.Node.AddInputLinks(sankeyLink);
				}
			}
			nodes.EndUpdate();
			platformNodes.EndUpdate();
			linkInfos.EndUpdate();
			if (nodes.Count > 0)
			{
				diagram.ColorizeElements();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateInitialData()
		{
			initialLinks = null;
			if (MembersAreValid())
			{
				using SankeyBindingProcedure sankeyBindingProcedure = new SankeyBindingProcedure(this);
				initialLinks = sankeyBindingProcedure.Process();
			}
			UpdateAdditionalData();
			RaisePropertyChanged("DataSource");
		}
	}
	public interface INode : IInteractiveElement
	{
		SankeyNodeLayoutInfo Info { get; }
	}
	public interface ILink : IInteractiveElement
	{
		INode Source { get; }

		INode Target { get; }

		SankeyLinkLayoutInfo Info { get; }

		System.Windows.Media.Brush Brush { get; }
	}
	public class SankeyToolTipController
	{
		private const int PopupOffset = 10;

		private readonly SankeyToolTipItem item;

		private readonly SankeyDiagramControl diagram;

		private readonly DispatcherTimer initialTimer = new DispatcherTimer();

		private readonly DispatcherTimer popTimer = new DispatcherTimer();

		private SankeyToolTipOptions Options => diagram.ActualToolTipOptions;

		public SankeyToolTipController(SankeyDiagramControl diagram)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			item = new SankeyToolTipItem();
			diagram.SetCurrentValue(SankeyDiagramControl.ToolTipItemProperty, item);
			initialTimer.Tick += OnInitialTimerTick;
			popTimer.Tick += OnPopTimerTick;
		}

		private void OnInitialTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OpenPopup();
		}

		private void OnPopTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ClosePopup();
		}

		private void Show()
		{
			if (Options.InitialDelay.TotalMilliseconds > 0.0)
			{
				initialTimer.Interval = Options.InitialDelay;
				initialTimer.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				OpenPopup();
			}
		}

		private void OpenPopup()
		{
			initialTimer.Stop();
			item.Visible = true;
			System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(diagram);
			System.Windows.Point screenPoint = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(diagram);
			position = position.MoveByVector(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y);
			double num = ChartScreenHelper.Scale(10.0, diagram);
			item.Position = position.MoveByVector(num, num);
			if (Options.AutoPopDelay.TotalMilliseconds != 0.0)
			{
				popTimer.Interval = Options.AutoPopDelay;
				popTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void ClosePopup()
		{
			initialTimer.Stop();
			popTimer.Stop();
			item.Visible = false;
		}

		private void UpdateItem(object currentObject)
		{
			INode node = currentObject as INode;
			ILink link = currentObject as ILink;
			if (node != null && Options.ActualNodeToolTipEnabled)
			{
				SankeyNode node2 = ((SankeyNodeItem)node).Node;
				item.Info.SourceObject = node2;
				item.Info.ToolTipText = SankeyDefaultTextConstructor.GetToolTipText(node2.Info).Item1;
				item.ContentTemplate = diagram.NodeToolTipContentTemplate;
			}
			else if (link != null && Options.ActualLinkToolTipEnabled)
			{
				item.Info.SourceObject = link;
				item.Info.ToolTipText = SankeyDefaultTextConstructor.GetToolTipText(((SankeyLink)link).Info).Item1;
				item.ContentTemplate = diagram.LinkToolTipContentTemplate;
			}
			else
			{
				item.Info.SourceObject = null;
				item.Info.ToolTipText = string.Empty;
				item.ContentTemplate = null;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateOnHover()
		{
			if (!diagram.ActualToolTipEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Options.OpenMode != ToolTipOpenMode.OnHover)
			{
				ClosePopup();
				return;
			}
			UpdateItem(diagram.HighlightingController.HighlightedItem);
			if (item.CanBeShown)
			{
				Show();
			}
			else
			{
				ClosePopup();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateOnClick()
		{
			if (!diagram.ActualToolTipEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Options.OpenMode != ToolTipOpenMode.OnClick)
			{
				if (Options.CloseOnClick)
				{
					ClosePopup();
				}
				return;
			}
			UpdateItem(diagram.HighlightingController.HighlightedItem);
			if (!item.Visible && item.CanBeShown)
			{
				Show();
			}
			else if (Options.CloseOnClick)
			{
				ClosePopup();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ControlledObservableCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>
	{
		private int suppressNotification;

		public ControlledObservableCollection()
		{
		}

		public ControlledObservableCollection(List<T> list)
			: base(list)
		{
		}

		public ControlledObservableCollection(IEnumerable<T> collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (suppressNotification == 0)
			{
				base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			}
		}

		internal void BeginUpdate()
		{
			suppressNotification++;
		}

		internal void EndUpdate(bool raiseChanged = true)
		{
			suppressNotification--;
			if (raiseChanged)
			{
				OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("list");
			}
			BeginUpdate();
			foreach (T item in list)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
			EndUpdate();
		}
	}
	public static class SankeyVisualHelper
	{
		private static byte highlightingAlpha = 130;

		private static byte selectionAlpha = 50;

		private static System.Windows.Point endPoint = new System.Windows.Point(3.0, 3.0);

		private static LinearGradientBrush highlightingMask;

		private static LinearGradientBrush selectionMask;

		private static LinearGradientBrush GetBrush(byte alpha)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				SpreadMethod = GradientSpreadMethod.Repeat,
				EndPoint = endPoint,
				MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(alpha, 0, 0, 0),
				Offset = 0.5
			});
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = Colors.Black,
				Offset = 0.5
			});
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		public static LinearGradientBrush GetHighlightingBrush()
		{
			if (highlightingMask == null)
			{
				highlightingMask = GetBrush(highlightingAlpha);
			}
			return highlightingMask;
		}

		public static LinearGradientBrush GetSelectionBrush()
		{
			if (selectionMask == null)
			{
				selectionMask = GetBrush(selectionAlpha);
			}
			return selectionMask;
		}
	}

		string IRangeControlClient.FormatText(object value)
		{
			string text = base.ThumbLabelFormatString;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "{0}";
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Format(text, value);
		}

		double IRangeControlClient.GetComparableValue(object realValue)
		{
			if (realValue == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			SparklineScaleType val = default(SparklineScaleType);
			double? num = SparklineMathUtils.ConvertToDouble(realValue, ref val);
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return num.Value;
		}

		object IRangeControlClient.GetRealValue(double comparable)
		{
			return ScaleProcessor.ConvertToNative(comparable);
		}

		object IRangeControlClient.GetSnappedValue(object value, bool isLeft)
		{
			if (IsPointsExist)
			{
				return ChartGridCalculator.GetSnappedValue(value, rangeClientState.ActualStart, rangeClientState.ActualEnd);
			}
			return value;
		}

		RangeControlClientHitTestResult IRangeControlClient.HitTest(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (ChartGridCalculator != null && ScaleProcessor != null)
			{
				double internalValue = GetInternalValue(point);
				if (!double.IsNaN(internalValue))
				{
					object nativeValue = ScaleProcessor.ConvertToNative(internalValue);
					return ChartGridCalculator.HitTest(nativeValue, base.Viewport.Width, rangeClientState.ActualStart, rangeClientState.ActualEnd);
				}
			}
			return new RangeControlClientHitTestResult((RangeControlClientRegionType)0, (object)null, (object)null);
		}

		void IRangeControlClient.Invalidate(System.Windows.Size viewport)
		{
			base.Viewport = viewport;
			UpdateItems();
			InvalidateLayout(viewport);
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.SetRange(object wholeStart, object wholeEnd, System.Windows.Size viewportSize)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (rangeClientState.ActualStart != wholeStart || rangeClientState.ActualEnd != wholeEnd)
			{
				object obj = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(wholeStart);
				object obj2 = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(wholeEnd);
				if (ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj))
				{
					rangeClientState.WholeStart = obj;
				}
				if (ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj2))
				{
					rangeClientState.WholeEnd = obj2;
				}
				if (ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj) && ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj2))
				{
					UpdateSparklinesRange(base.Sparklines, rangeClientState.ActualStart, rangeClientState.ActualEnd);
					UpdateItems();
				}
				else
				{
					result = false;
					foreach (SparklineControl sparkline in base.Sparklines)
					{
						sparkline.ArgumentRange.Auto = true;
					}
				}
				InvalidateLayout(viewportSize);
			}
			return result;
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.SetSelectionRange(object selectionStart, object selectionEnd, System.Windows.Size viewportSize, bool isSnapped)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			object obj = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(selectionStart);
			object obj2 = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(selectionEnd);
			if (rangeClientState.SelectedStart == obj && rangeClientState.SelectedEnd == obj2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj))
			{
				rangeClientState.SelectedStart = obj;
			}
			if (ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj2))
			{
				rangeClientState.SelectedEnd = obj2;
			}
			flag = ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj) && ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj2);
			if (!flag)
			{
				UpdateItems();
			}
			InvalidateLayout(viewportSize);
			return flag;
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.SetVisibleRange(object visibleStart, object visibleEnd, System.Windows.Size viewportSize)
		{
			object obj = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(visibleStart);
			object obj2 = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(visibleEnd);
			bool flag = ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj);
			bool flag2 = ScaleProcessor.CheckValueType(obj2);
			if (flag && !flag2)
			{
				rangeClientState.VisibleStart = visibleStart;
			}
			else if (!flag && flag2)
			{
				rangeClientState.VisibleEnd = visibleEnd;
			}
			else if (flag && flag2)
			{
				ScaleProcessor.CorrectVisibleRange(rangeClientState.VisibleStart, rangeClientState.VisibleEnd, obj, obj2, out var correctStart, out var correctEnd);
				rangeClientState.VisibleStart = correctStart;
				rangeClientState.VisibleEnd = correctEnd;
				UpdateItems();
				return false;
			}
			InvalidateLayout(viewportSize);
			return true;
		}

		private void InitSparklineControl(SparklineControl sparkline)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			};

			sparkline.SparklinePointsChanged += new SparklinePointsChangedEventHandler(sparkline_SparklinePointsChanged);
		}
