		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			sparkline.SparklinePointsChanged -= new SparklinePointsChangedEventHandler(sparkline_SparklinePointsChanged);
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)sparkline, SparklineControl.PointsProperty);
			sparkline.SparklineArgumentRangeChanged -= new SparklineArgumentRangeChangedEventHandler(sparkline_SparklineArgumentRangeChanged);
		}

		private void sparkline_SparklineArgumentRangeChanged(object sender, SparklineRangeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.SparklineRangeChanging && ScaleProcessor != null)
			{
				base.SparklineRangeChanging = true;
				rangeClientState.SparklineStart = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(e.MinValue);
				rangeClientState.SparklineEnd = ScaleProcessor.TryParseValue(e.MaxValue);
				RaiseClientDataChanged(e.MinValue, e.MaxValue);
				base.SparklineRangeChanging = false;
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal new void AddLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
				base.AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected internal new void RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			if (logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Remove(child);
				base.RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSparklinesUpdated(IEnumerable<SparklineControl> oldItems, IEnumerable<SparklineControl> newItems)
		{
			foreach (SparklineControl oldItem in oldItems)
			{
				DestroySparklineControl(oldItem);
			}
			foreach (SparklineControl newItem in newItems)
			{
				InitSparklineControl(newItem);
			}
		}

		protected override IMinMaxValues GetSparklinesRange()
		{
			double min = RangeControlClientSimpleGridValuesProvider.SparklineNativeToInternal(rangeClientState.ActualStart);
			double max = RangeControlClientSimpleGridValuesProvider.SparklineNativeToInternal(rangeClientState.ActualEnd);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<SparklineControl> CreateSparklines()
		{
			return new List<SparklineControl> { ActualView.Sparkline };
		}

		protected override RangeControlClientGridValuesProvider CreateGridProvider()
		{
			IList<double> gridValues = ChartGridCalculator.CalculateGrid(base.Viewport.Width, rangeClientState.VisibleStart, rangeClientState.VisibleEnd);
			string text = ArgumentLabelFormatString;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "{0}";
			}
			return new RangeControlClientSimpleGridValuesProvider(gridValues, GridMap, text);
		}
	}

		{

			base.Loaded += ChartRangeControlClient_Loaded;

		private double ProcessAxisLabel(RangeClientAxisLabelItem item, RangeControlClientGridValuesProvider gridValuesProvider, int gridIndex)
		{
			double value = gridValuesProvider.GetValue(gridIndex);
			object obj = gridValuesProvider.ConvertToNativeValue(value);
			double result = (item.InternalValue = gridValuesProvider.GetRealValue(value, obj));
			item.Value = obj;
			item.Text = gridValuesProvider.ConvertToFormattedValue(obj);
			item.Template = ArgumentLabelTemplate;
			item.Visible = ShowArgumentLabels;
			return result;
		}

		protected IList<double> UpdateLabels()
		{
			List<object> itemsExpect = itemsManager.GetItemsExpect<RangeClientAxisLabelItem>();
			itemsManager.Clear();
			itemsExpect.ForEach(delegate(object item4)
			{
				itemsManager.Add(item4);
			});
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (Viewport.Width <= 1.0)
			{
				return new List<double>();
			}
			RangeControlClientGridValuesProvider rangeControlClientGridValuesProvider = CreateGridProvider();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 20;
			int num3 = (int)Viewport.Width / num2;
			int num4 = Math.Max(1, rangeControlClientGridValuesProvider.ValuesCount / num3);
			int num5 = 0;
			foreach (RangeClientAxisLabelItem item4 in itemsManager.GetItems<RangeClientAxisLabelItem>())
			{
				if (num5++ % num4 == 0)
				{
					if (num < rangeControlClientGridValuesProvider.ValuesCount)
					{
						double item = ProcessAxisLabel(item4, rangeControlClientGridValuesProvider, num);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						item4.Visible = false;
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
			for (; num < rangeControlClientGridValuesProvider.ValuesCount; num += num4)
			{
				RangeClientAxisLabelItem item2 = new RangeClientAxisLabelItem();
				double item3 = ProcessAxisLabel(item2, rangeControlClientGridValuesProvider, num);
				list.Add(item3);
				itemsManager.Add(item2);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected double GetInternalValue(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (scaleMap == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return scaleMap.GetInternalValue(point);
		}

		protected void InvalidateLayout()
		{
			RangeClientItemsPanel element = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement frameworkElement) => frameworkElement is RangeClientItemsPanel)) as RangeClientItemsPanel;
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(element);
		}

		protected void InvalidateLayout(System.Windows.Size clientSize)
		{
			if (LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement element) => element is RangeClientItemsPanel)) is RangeClientItemsPanel rangeClientItemsPanel)
			{
				rangeClientItemsPanel.UpdateClientSize(clientSize);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateItems()
		{
			IList<double> gridValues = UpdateLabels();
			gridLinesItem.UpdateGrid(gridValues);
			InvalidateLayout();
		}

		private void ChartRangeControlClient_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseClientLayoutChanged();
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsLoaded)
			{
				RaiseClientLayoutChanged();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSparklinesRange(IEnumerable<SparklineControl> sparklines, object min, object max)
		{
			if (SparklineRangeChanging)
			{
				return;
			}
			SparklineRangeChanging = true;
			foreach (SparklineControl sparkline in sparklines)
			{
				sparkline.ArgumentRange.Limit1 = min;
				sparkline.ArgumentRange.Limit2 = max;
				sparkline.ArgumentRange.Auto = false;
			}
			SparklineRangeChanging = false;
		}

		protected void UpdateSparklines()
		{
			itemsManager.Clear();
			IEnumerable<SparklineControl> enumerable = CreateSparklines();
			OnSparklinesUpdated(sparklines, enumerable);
			sparklines.Clear();
			foreach (SparklineControl item in enumerable)
			{
				itemsManager.Add<SparklineControl>(item);
			}
			itemsManager.Add(gridLinesItem);
			sparklines.AddRange(enumerable);
			UpdateItems();
		}

		protected abstract IMinMaxValues GetSparklinesRange();

		protected abstract IEnumerable<SparklineControl> CreateSparklines();

		protected abstract void OnSparklinesUpdated(IEnumerable<SparklineControl> oldItems, IEnumerable<SparklineControl> newItems);

		protected abstract RangeControlClientGridValuesProvider CreateGridProvider();

		protected void RaiseClientLayoutChanged()
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (this.ClientLayoutChanged != null)
			{
				this.ClientLayoutChanged(this, new LayoutChangedEventArgs((LayoutChangedType)0, (object)null, (object)null));
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseClientDataChanged(object start, object end)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (this.ClientLayoutChanged != null)
			{
				this.ClientLayoutChanged(this, new LayoutChangedEventArgs((LayoutChangedType)1, start, end));
			}
		}

		internal IRangeClientScaleMap UpdateScaleMap(double rangeWidth)
		{
			IMinMaxValues sparklinesRange = GetSparklinesRange();
			scaleMap = new RangeClientScaleMap(sparklinesRange.Min, sparklinesRange.Max, rangeWidth);
			return scaleMap;
		}

		internal void SetClientSize(Rect value)
		{
			if (clientBounds != value)
			{
				clientBounds = value;
				RaiseClientLayoutChanged();
			}
		}

		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ItemsContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_ItemsContainer") as ItemsControl;
		}

			if (d is DateTimeChartRangeControlClient dateTimeChartRangeControlClient && e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((DateTimeGridCalculator)dateTimeChartRangeControlClient.ChartGridCalculator).UpdateSnapAlignment((DateTimeMeasurementUnit)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnGridAlignmentPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DateTimeChartRangeControlClient dateTimeChartRangeControlClient && e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((DateTimeGridCalculator)dateTimeChartRangeControlClient.ChartGridCalculator).UpdateGridAlignment((DateTimeGridAlignment)e.NewValue);
				((RangeControlClientDateTimeScaleProvider)dateTimeChartRangeControlClient.ScaleProcessor).GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)e.NewValue;
				dateTimeChartRangeControlClient.UpdateItems();
			}
		}

		public DateTimeChartRangeControlClient()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<DateTimeChartRangeControlClient>(this);
			gridCalculator = new DateTimeGridCalculator(GridAlignment);
			scaleProcessor = new RangeControlClientDateTimeScaleProvider();
		}
	}

		internal string ActualLabelFormat
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(LabelFormat))
				{
					return LabelFormat;
				}
				return "{0}";
			}
		}

		internal IFormatProvider ActualLabelFormatProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelFormatProvider == null)
				{
					return GetInternalOptions().CreateDefaultLabelFormatProvider();
				}
				return LabelFormatProvider;
			}
		}

		internal GridBehaviorBase ActualGridBehavior
		{

					return defaultGridBehavior;

				return GridBehavior;
			}

		internal SnapBehaviorBase ActualSnapBehavior
		{
			get

				}
				return SnapBehavior;
			}
		}

		private static void OnSnapBehaviorPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ScaleOptions scaleOptions)
			{
				SnapBehaviorBase snapBehaviorBase = e.NewValue as SnapBehaviorBase;
				snapBehaviorBase.ScaleOptions = scaleOptions;
			}
			ChartDependencyObject.NotifyPropertyChanged(d, e);
		}

		public ScaleOptions()
		{
			defaultGridBehavior = new AutoGridBehavior();
			defaultSnapBehavior = new AutoSnapBehavior
			{
				ScaleOptions = this
			};
			numericScaleOptions = new ChartRangeControlClientNumericGridOptions(this);
			dateTimeScaleOptions = new ChartRangeControlClientDateTimeGridOptions(this);
			timeSpanScaleOptions = new ChartRangeControlClientTimeSpanGridOptions(this);
			qualitativeScaleOptions = new ChartRangeControlClientQualitativeGridOptions(this);
		}

		internal ScaleOptions(ChartBoundRangeControlClient chartContainer)
			: this()
		{
			ChartContainer = chartContainer;
		}

		protected override ChartDependencyObject CreateObject()
		{
			return new ScaleOptions();
		}

		internal ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions GetInternalOptions()
		{
			return ChartContainer.ActualAxisX.ScaleMap.ScaleType switch
			{
				ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime => dateTimeScaleOptions, 
				ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical => numericScaleOptions, 
				ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan => timeSpanScaleOptions, 
				_ => qualitativeScaleOptions, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class RangeClientItemsPanel : Panel
	{
		private const double defaultWidth = 300.0;

		private const double defaultHeight = 50.0;

		private System.Windows.Size? clientSize;

		private bool CanPerformLayout => GetClient() != null;

		private ChartRangeControlClientBase GetClient()
		{
			return base.DataContext as ChartRangeControlClientBase;
		}

		private IRangeClientItem GetLayout(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element is ContentPresenter)
			{
				return ((ContentPresenter)element).Content as IRangeClientItem;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdateClientSize(System.Windows.Size clientSize)
		{
			if (!this.clientSize.HasValue || this.clientSize.Value != clientSize)
			{
				this.clientSize = clientSize;
				CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(this);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (!CanPerformLayout)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			double width = (clientSize.HasValue ? clientSize.Value.Width : 300.0);
			double height = (clientSize.HasValue ? clientSize.Value.Height : 50.0);
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(size);
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!CanPerformLayout)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			ChartRangeControlClientBase client = GetClient();
			IRangeClientScaleMap map = client.UpdateScaleMap(finalSize.Width);
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				IRangeClientItem layout = GetLayout(child);
				if (layout != null && !layout.IsMaster)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, child.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height - num);
			if (((IRangeControlClient)client).ClientBounds != rect)
			{
				client.SetClientSize(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height - num));
				return finalSize;
			}
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (UIElement child2 in base.Children)
			{
				IRangeClientItem layout2 = GetLayout(child2);
				if (layout2 != null && !layout2.IsMaster)
				{
					layout2.CalculateLayout(map, finalSize, child2.DesiredSize);
					child2.Arrange(new Rect(layout2.Location, layout2.Size));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(child2);
				}
			}
			foreach (UIElement item in list)
			{
				IRangeClientItem layout3 = GetLayout(item);
				if (layout3 != null)
				{
					layout3.CalculateLayout(map, new System.Windows.Size(finalSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - num)), item.DesiredSize);
					item.Arrange(new Rect(layout3.Location, layout3.Size));
				}
				else
				{
					item.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - num)));
				}
			}
			client.SetClientSize(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height - num));
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class RangeClientItemTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		[Category("Behavior")]

		[Category("Behavior")]

			{
				return LabelTemplate;
			}
			if (item is RangeClientGridLinesItem)
			{
				return GridLinesTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChartProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Chart", typeof(ChartControl), typeof(ChartBoundRangeControlClient), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnChartPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScaleOptionsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScaleOptions", typeof(ScaleOptions), typeof(ChartBoundRangeControlClient), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnScaleOptionsPropertyChanged));

		private readonly ScaleOptions defaultScaleOptions;

		private SelectionBehaviorBase selectionBehavior;

		private RangeControlMapping rangeControlMap;

		private bool stickToLeft;

		private bool stickToRight;

		private double currentVisibleStart;

		private double currentVisibleEnd;

		private bool shouldRaiseClientChanged = true;

		private double prevWholeRangeMin;

		private double prevWholeRangeMax;

		[Description("Gets or sets a chart to which the Range Control is bound. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public ChartControl Chart
		{
			get
			{
				return (ChartControl)GetValue(ChartProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChartProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the scale options that configure grid appearance. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public ScaleOptions ScaleOptions
		{

				return (ScaleOptions)GetValue(ScaleOptionsProperty);

				SetValue(ScaleOptionsProperty, value);

		private RangeControlMapping RangeControlMap
		{
			get
			{
				if (rangeControlMap == null)
				{
					rangeControlMap = RangeControlMapping.Create(ActualAxisX, excludeSideMargins: false);
				}
				return rangeControlMap;
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidChartDiagram => Diagram != null;

		private AxisScaleTypeMap ChartScaleMap => ActualAxisX.ScaleMap;

		private XYDiagram2D Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (Chart == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			}
		}

		internal AxisX2D ActualAxisX => Diagram.ActualAxisX;

		internal ScaleOptions ActualScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (ScaleOptions == null)
				{
					return defaultScaleOptions;
				}
				return ScaleOptions;
			}
		}

		private double WholeRangeMinValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsValidChartDiagram)
				{
					return ChartScaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(ActualAxisX.WholeRangeData.MinValueInternal);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		private double WholeRangeMaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsValidChartDiagram)
				{
					return ChartScaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(ActualAxisX.WholeRangeData.MaxValueInternal);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		internal double VisualRangeMinValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsValidChartDiagram)
				{
					return ChartScaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData.MinValueInternal);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		internal double VisualRangeMaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsValidChartDiagram)
				{
					return ChartScaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData.MaxValueInternal);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.GrayOutNonSelectedRange => true;

		bool IRangeControlClient.ConvergeThumbsOnZoomingOut => false;

		bool IRangeControlClient.SnapSelectionToGrid => false;

		bool IRangeControlClient.AllowThumbs => true;

		Rect IRangeControlClient.ClientBounds => base.ClientBounds;

		object IRangeControlClient.Start => CreateUserObject(WholeRangeMinValue);

		object IRangeControlClient.End => CreateUserObject(WholeRangeMaxValue);

		object IRangeControlClient.SelectionStart => CreateUserObject(selectionBehavior.ActualSelectedStart);

		object IRangeControlClient.SelectionEnd => CreateUserObject(selectionBehavior.ActualSelectedEnd);

		object IRangeControlClient.VisibleStart => CreateUserObject(currentVisibleStart);

		object IRangeControlClient.VisibleEnd => CreateUserObject(currentVisibleEnd);

		event EventHandler<LayoutChangedEventArgs> IRangeControlClient.LayoutChanged
		{
			add
			{
				base.ClientLayoutChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				base.ClientLayoutChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		private static void OnChartPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartBoundRangeControlClient chartBoundRangeControlClient)
			{
				ChartControl chartControl = e.NewValue as ChartControl;
				chartControl.RangeControlClient = ((chartControl != null) ? chartBoundRangeControlClient : null);
				chartBoundRangeControlClient.UpdateSparklines();
			}
		}

		private static void OnScaleOptionsPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ChartBoundRangeControlClient chartBoundRangeControlClient)
			{
				ScaleOptions scaleOptions = e.NewValue as ScaleOptions;
				if (scaleOptions != null)
				{
					scaleOptions.ChartContainer = chartBoundRangeControlClient;
				}
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(e.OldValue as ScaleOptions, scaleOptions, chartBoundRangeControlClient);
			}
		}

		public ChartBoundRangeControlClient()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ChartBoundRangeControlClient>(this);
			defaultScaleOptions = new ScaleOptions(this);
			selectionBehavior = new SimpleSelectionBehavior(this);
		}

		string IRangeControlClient.FormatText(object value)
		{
			string text = base.ThumbLabelFormatString;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "{0}";
			}
			if (!(value is ChartValue chartValue))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Format(text, chartValue.DataValue);
		}

		double IRangeControlClient.GetComparableValue(object realValue)
		{
			return ExtractInternalValue(realValue);
		}

		object IRangeControlClient.GetRealValue(double comparable)
		{
			return CreateUserObject(comparable);
		}

		object IRangeControlClient.GetSnappedValue(object objectValue, bool isLeft)
		{
			double value = ExtractInternalValue(objectValue);
			ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions internalOptions = ActualScaleOptions.GetInternalOptions();
			RangeControlClientSnapCalculator rangeControlClientSnapCalculator = new RangeControlClientSnapCalculator(internalOptions.ClientGridMapping, RangeControlMap);
			double value2 = rangeControlClientSnapCalculator.RoundValue(internalOptions.SnapUnit, value, limitByRangeBounds: true);
			return CreateUserObject(value2);
		}

		RangeControlClientHitTestResult IRangeControlClient.HitTest(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			double internalValue = GetInternalValue(point);
			if (!double.IsNaN(internalValue))
			{
				ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions internalOptions = ActualScaleOptions.GetInternalOptions();
				RangeControlClientSnapCalculator rangeControlClientSnapCalculator = new RangeControlClientSnapCalculator(internalOptions.ClientGridMapping, RangeControlMap);
				double value = rangeControlClientSnapCalculator.FloorValue(internalOptions.SnapUnit, internalValue);
				double value2 = rangeControlClientSnapCalculator.CeilValue(internalOptions.SnapUnit, internalValue);
				return new RangeControlClientHitTestResult((RangeControlClientRegionType)1, (object)CreateUserObject(value), (object)CreateUserObject(value2));
			}
			return new RangeControlClientHitTestResult((RangeControlClientRegionType)0, (object)null, (object)null);
		}

		void IRangeControlClient.Invalidate(System.Windows.Size viewport)
		{
			base.Viewport = viewport;
			UpdateItems();
			InvalidateLayout(viewport);
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.SetRange(object wholeStart, object wholeEnd, System.Windows.Size viewportSize)
		{
			if (ExtractInternalValue(wholeStart) != WholeRangeMinValue)
			{
				return ExtractInternalValue(wholeEnd) == WholeRangeMaxValue;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.SetSelectionRange(object selectionStart, object selectionEnd, System.Windows.Size viewportSize, bool isSnapped)
		{
			if (selectionStart == null || selectionEnd == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = ExtractInternalValue(selectionStart);
			double num2 = ExtractInternalValue(selectionEnd);
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				RaiseClientDataChanged(CreateUserObject(WholeRangeMinValue), CreateUserObject(WholeRangeMaxValue));
				return false;
			}
			if (num == num2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num != VisualRangeMinValue || num2 != VisualRangeMaxValue)
			{
				selectionBehavior.UpdateSelection(num, num2);
				shouldRaiseClientChanged = false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IRangeControlClient.SetVisibleRange(object visibleStart, object visibleEnd, System.Windows.Size viewportSize)
		{
			if (visibleStart == null || visibleEnd == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = ExtractInternalValue(visibleStart);
			double num2 = ExtractInternalValue(visibleEnd);
			if (num == num2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num != currentVisibleStart || num2 != currentVisibleEnd)
			{
				stickToLeft = num == WholeRangeMinValue;
				stickToRight = num2 == WholeRangeMaxValue;
				currentVisibleStart = num;
				currentVisibleEnd = num2;
				UpdateItems();
				InvalidateLayout(viewportSize);
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IRangeControlClientExtension.UpdateState(bool recreateItems, bool restoreSelection)
		{
			if (recreateItems)
			{
				UpdateSparklines();
			}
			rangeControlMap = null;
			double wholeRangeMinValue = WholeRangeMinValue;
			double wholeRangeMaxValue = WholeRangeMaxValue;
			if (shouldRaiseClientChanged || prevWholeRangeMin != wholeRangeMinValue || prevWholeRangeMax != wholeRangeMaxValue)
			{
				prevWholeRangeMin = wholeRangeMinValue;
				prevWholeRangeMax = wholeRangeMaxValue;
				if (currentVisibleStart != wholeRangeMinValue || currentVisibleEnd != wholeRangeMaxValue)
				{
					if (stickToLeft)
					{
						currentVisibleStart = wholeRangeMinValue;
					}
					if (stickToRight)
					{
						currentVisibleEnd = wholeRangeMaxValue;
					}
					if (restoreSelection)
					{
						selectionBehavior.RestoreSelection();
					}
				}
				selectionBehavior.AssignSelectionFromClient();
				RaiseClientDataChanged(CreateUserObject(wholeRangeMinValue), CreateUserObject(wholeRangeMaxValue));
				RaiseClientLayoutChanged();
			}
			shouldRaiseClientChanged = true;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateItems();
			return true;
		}

		private ChartValue CreateUserObject(double value)
		{
			if (!IsValidChartDiagram || double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ChartValue(value, ChartScaleMap.RefinedToNative(value));
		}

		private double ExtractInternalValue(object userObject)
		{
			if (!(userObject is ChartValue chartValue))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (chartValue.IsInternalInitialized)
			{
				return chartValue.InternalValue;
			}
			if (!IsValidChartDiagram)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return ChartScaleMap.NativeToRefined(chartValue.DataValue);
		}

		private void UpdateSparklineBrush(SparklineControl sparkline, XYSeries2D series)
		{
			if (series != null)
			{
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(series.BaseColor);
				LineSparklineControl val = (LineSparklineControl)(object)((sparkline is LineSparklineControl) ? sparkline : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.MarkerBrush = solidColorBrush;
				}
				sparkline.Brush = solidColorBrush;
			}
		}

		private void SetSparklineValueRange(SparklineControl sparklineControl, double min, double max)
		{
			sparklineControl.ValueRange.Limit1 = min;
			sparklineControl.ValueRange.Limit2 = max;
			sparklineControl.ValueRange.Auto = false;
		}

		private bool ShouldDrawSeries(XYSeries2D series)
		{
			if (series != null && series.ActualRangeControlOptions.Visible)
			{
				if (series.ActualAxisX == Diagram.ActualAxisX)
				{
					return series.ActualAxisY == Diagram.ActualAxisY;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IMinMaxValues GetSparklinesRange()
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(WholeRangeMinValue, WholeRangeMaxValue);
		}

		protected override void OnSparklinesUpdated(IEnumerable<SparklineControl> oldItems, IEnumerable<SparklineControl> newItems)
		{
			UpdateSparklinesRange(newItems, WholeRangeMinValue, WholeRangeMaxValue);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<SparklineControl> CreateSparklines()
		{
			//IL_012e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0138: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0116: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!IsValidChartDiagram)
			{
				return (IEnumerable<SparklineControl>)(object)new SparklineControl[0];
			}
			double minValue = double.MaxValue;
			double maxValue = double.MinValue;
			List<SparklineControl> list = new List<SparklineControl>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in Chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = ((IRefinedSeries)item).Series as XYSeries2D;
				if (!ShouldDrawSeries(xYSeries2D))
				{
					continue;
				}
				RangeControlOptions actualRangeControlOptions = xYSeries2D.ActualRangeControlOptions;
				SparklineControl sparkline = actualRangeControlOptions.ActualView.Sparkline;
				if (actualRangeControlOptions.UseSeriesBrush)
				{
					UpdateSparklineBrush(sparkline, xYSeries2D);
				}
				List<SparklinePoint> list2 = new List<SparklinePoint>();
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in ((IRefinedSeries)item).Points)
				{
					double num = ChartScaleMap.InternalToRefined(point.Argument);
					if (point.SeriesPoint.IsEmpty((Scale)Diagram.ActualAxisY.ScaleMap.ScaleType))
					{
						list2.Add(new SparklinePoint(num, double.NaN));
						continue;
					}
					double value = point.GetValue((ValueLevelInternal)actualRangeControlOptions.ValueLevel);
					list2.Add(new SparklinePoint(num, value));
					minValue = Math.Min(minValue, value);
					maxValue = Math.Max(maxValue, value);
				}
				sparkline.Points.Clear();
				sparkline.Points.AddRange((IEnumerable<SparklinePoint>)list2);
				list.Add(sparkline);
			}
			list.ForEach(delegate(SparklineControl item)
			{
				SetSparklineValueRange(item, minValue, maxValue);
			});
			return list;
		}

		protected override RangeControlClientGridValuesProvider CreateGridProvider()
		{
			ChartRangeControlClientGridOptions internalOptions = ActualScaleOptions.GetInternalOptions();
			internalOptions.UpdateRangeSettings(currentVisibleEnd - currentVisibleStart, base.Viewport.Width);
			IList<double> gridValues = new GridGenerator().GenerateGridValues(currentVisibleStart, currentVisibleEnd, internalOptions.GridUnit, internalOptions.ClientGridMapping, RangeControlMap);
			return new RangeControlClientChartGridValuesProvider(gridValues, ChartScaleMap, ActualScaleOptions.ActualLabelFormatProvider, ActualScaleOptions.ActualLabelFormat);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateVisualRange(double selectionStart, double selectionEnd)
		{
			if (IsValidChartDiagram)
			{
				if (selectionStart < WholeRangeMinValue)
				{
					selectionStart = WholeRangeMinValue;
				}
				if (selectionEnd > WholeRangeMaxValue)
				{
					selectionEnd = WholeRangeMaxValue;
				}
				double internalMin = ChartScaleMap.RefinedToInternalExact(selectionStart);
				double internalMax = ChartScaleMap.RefinedToInternalExact(selectionEnd);
				ActualAxisX.VisualRangeData.SetRange(null, null, internalMin, internalMax, needUpdate: true, isRangeControl: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			if (selectionBehavior != null)
			{
				selectionBehavior.CleanUp();
			}
			UIElement element = (UIElement)base.Parent;
			selectionBehavior = new MouseUpSelectionBehavior(this, element);
		}
	}

				return dataValue;
			}

				dataValue = value;
			}
		}

		internal ChartValue(double internalValue, object dataValue)
		{
			isInternalInitialized = true;
			this.internalValue = internalValue;
			this.dataValue = dataValue;
		}

		public ChartValue(object dataValue)
		{
			this.dataValue = dataValue;
		}

		public ChartValue()
		{
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.Native
{
	public class RangeClientAxisLabelItem : RangeClientItem, IRangeClientItem
	{
		private System.Windows.Point location;

		private System.Windows.Size size;

		private string text;

		private DataTemplate template;

		[Category("Data")]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (text != value)
				{
					text = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Text");
				}
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public DataTemplate Template
		{
			get
			{
				return template;
			}
			set
			{
				if (template != value)
				{
					template = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Template");
				}
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public object Value { get; set; }

		[Category("Data")]
		public double InternalValue { get; set; }

		[Category("Data")]
		public bool IsMaster => false;

		[Category("Data")]
		public bool Visible { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Point Location => location;

		public System.Windows.Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Visible)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
				}
				return size;
			}
		}

		public RangeClientAxisLabelItem()
		{
			Visible = true;
		}

		void IRangeClientItem.CalculateLayout(IRangeClientScaleMap map, System.Windows.Size availableSize, System.Windows.Size desiredSize)
		{
			size = desiredSize;
			double num = map.GetScreenPoint(InternalValue) - desiredSize.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = num + desiredSize.Width - availableSize.Width;
			if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				num -= num2;
			}
			num = Math.Max(0.0, num);
			double y = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - desiredSize.Height);
			location = new System.Windows.Point(num, y);
		}
	}
	public class RangeClientGridLinesItem : RangeClientItem, IRangeClientItem
	{
		private readonly List<double> values = new List<double>();

		private System.Windows.Size size;

		private Geometry geometry;

		private SolidColorBrush brush;

		[Category("Data")]
		public Geometry Geometry
		{
			get
			{
				return geometry;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (geometry != value)
				{
					geometry = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Geometry");
				}
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public bool IsMaster => true;

		[Category("Data")]
		public System.Windows.Point Location => new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);

		[Category("Data")]
		public System.Windows.Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Visible)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
				}
				return size;
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public bool Visible { get; set; }

		[Category("Data")]
		public SolidColorBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return brush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (brush != value)
				{
					brush = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Brush");
				}
			}
		}

		public RangeClientGridLinesItem()
		{
			Visible = true;
			Brush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
		}

		void IRangeClientItem.CalculateLayout(IRangeClientScaleMap map, System.Windows.Size availableSize, System.Windows.Size desiredSize)
		{
			size = availableSize;
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry
			{
				Figures = new PathFigureCollection()
			};
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				double x = Math.Round(map.GetScreenPoint(value)) + 0.5;
				PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
				{
					StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(x, 0.0),
					Segments = new PathSegmentCollection()
				};
				pathFigure.Segments.Add(new LineSegment
				{
					Point = new System.Windows.Point(x, availableSize.Height)
				});
				pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			}
			Geometry = pathGeometry;
		}

		internal void UpdateGrid(IEnumerable<double> gridValues)
		{
			values.Clear();
			values.AddRange(gridValues);
		}
	}
	internal interface IRangeClientItem
	{
		bool IsMaster { get; }

		System.Windows.Point Location { get; }

		System.Windows.Size Size { get; }

		void CalculateLayout(IRangeClientScaleMap map, System.Windows.Size availableSize, System.Windows.Size desiredSize);
	}

				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

	public class RangeClientItemsManager
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollection<object> items = new ObservableCollection<object>();

		public ObservableCollection<object> Items => items;

		public IEnumerable<T> GetItems<T>()
		{
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				if (item is T)
				{
					yield return (T)item;
				}
			}
		}

		public List<object> GetItemsExpect<T>()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				if (!(item is T))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void Add<T>(T item)
		{
			items.Add(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			items.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal interface IRangeClientScaleMap
	{
		double GetScreenPoint(double value);

		double GetInternalValue(System.Windows.Point screenPoint);
	}
	public class RangeClientScaleMap : IRangeClientScaleMap
	{
		private readonly double valueMin;

		private readonly double valueMax;

		private readonly double scaleLength;

		public RangeClientScaleMap(double valueMin, double valueMax, double scaleLength)
		{
			this.valueMin = valueMin;
			this.valueMax = valueMax;
			this.scaleLength = scaleLength;
		}

		private bool InRange(double value)
		{
			if (value >= valueMin)
			{
				return value <= valueMax;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public double GetScreenPoint(double value)
		{
			return (value - valueMin) / (valueMax - valueMin) * scaleLength;
		}

		public double GetInternalValue(System.Windows.Point screenPoint)
		{
			if (scaleLength == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = valueMin + screenPoint.X / scaleLength * (valueMax - valueMin);
			if (!InRange(num))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal class RangeClientState
	{
		private object defaultStart;

		private object defaultEnd;

		private object sparklineStart;

		private object sparklineEnd;

		private object rangeControlStart;

		private object rangeControlEnd;

		private object selectedStart;

		private object selectedEnd;

		private object visibleStart;

		private object visibleEnd;

		private bool isSetSparklineStart;

		private bool isSetSparklineEnd;

		private bool isSetWholeStart;

		private bool isSetWholeEnd;

		private bool isSetSelectedStart;

		private bool isSetSelectedEnd;

		private bool isSetVisibleStart;

		private bool isSetVisibleEnd;

		internal object SparklineStart
		{
			get
			{
				return sparklineStart;
			}
			set
			{
				sparklineStart = value;
				isSetSparklineStart = true;
			}
		}

		internal object SparklineEnd
		{
			get
			{
				return sparklineEnd;
			}
			set
			{
				sparklineEnd = value;
				isSetSparklineEnd = true;
			}
		}

		internal object WholeStart
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetWholeStart)
				{
					return ActualStart;
				}
				return rangeControlStart;
			}
			set
			{
				rangeControlStart = value;
				isSetWholeStart = true;
			}
		}

		internal object WholeEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetWholeEnd)
				{
					return ActualEnd;
				}
				return rangeControlEnd;
			}
			set
			{
				rangeControlEnd = value;
				isSetWholeEnd = true;
			}
		}

		internal object SelectedStart
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetSelectedStart)
				{
					return ActualStart;
				}
				return selectedStart;
			}
			set
			{
				selectedStart = value;
				isSetSelectedStart = true;
			}
		}

		internal object SelectedEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetSelectedEnd)
				{
					return ActualEnd;
				}
				return selectedEnd;
			}
			set
			{
				selectedEnd = value;
				isSetSelectedEnd = true;
			}
		}

		internal object VisibleStart
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetVisibleStart)
				{
					return ActualStart;
				}
				return visibleStart;
			}
			set
			{
				visibleStart = value;
				isSetVisibleStart = true;
			}
		}

		internal object VisibleEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetVisibleEnd)
				{
					return ActualEnd;
				}
				return visibleEnd;
			}
			set
			{
				visibleEnd = value;
				isSetVisibleEnd = true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsRangeSet
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetWholeStart || !isSetWholeEnd)
				{
					if (isSetSparklineStart)
					{
						return isSetSparklineEnd;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public object ActualStart
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetWholeStart)
				{
					if (!isSetSparklineStart)
					{
						return defaultStart;
					}
					return SparklineStart;
				}
				return WholeStart;
			}
		}

		public object ActualEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isSetWholeEnd)
				{
					if (!isSetSparklineEnd)
					{
						return defaultEnd;
					}
					return SparklineEnd;
				}
				return WholeEnd;
			}
		}

		internal void SetDefaultRange(object start, object end)
		{
			defaultStart = start;
			defaultEnd = end;
		}
	}
	public abstract class RangeControlClientScaleProvider
	{
		public abstract object ConvertToNative(double value);

		public abstract void CorrectVisibleRange(object oldStart, object oldEnd, object newStart, object newEnd, out object correctStart, out object correctEnd);

		public abstract bool CheckValueType(object value);

		public abstract object TryParseValue(object value);
	}
	public class RangeControlClientNumericScaleProvider : RangeControlClientScaleProvider
	{
		public const double DefaultGridAlignment = 0.0;

		private double MinVisualRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (GridAlignment != 0.0)
				{
					return GridAlignment;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
		}

		public double GridAlignment { get; set; }

		public override object ConvertToNative(double value)
		{
			return SparklineMathUtils.ConvertToNative(value, (SparklineScaleType)1);
		}

		public override void CorrectVisibleRange(object oldStart, object oldEnd, object newStart, object newEnd, out object correctStart, out object correctEnd)
		{
			double num = (double)newEnd - (double)newStart;
			if (num < MinVisualRange)
			{
				correctStart = oldStart;
				correctEnd = oldEnd;
			}
			else
			{
				correctStart = newStart;
				correctEnd = newEnd;
			}
		}

		public override bool CheckValueType(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(value.GetType());
		}

		public override object TryParseValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(string))
			{
				if (double.TryParse((string)value, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			else if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type))
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(value);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class RangeControlClientDateTimeScaleProvider : RangeControlClientScaleProvider
	{
		private TimeSpan MinVisualRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (GridAlignment == DateTimeGridAlignment.Auto)
				{
					return TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0);
				}
				return GridAlignment switch
				{
					DateTimeGridAlignment.Millisecond => TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1.0), 
					DateTimeGridAlignment.Second => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0), 
					DateTimeGridAlignment.Minute => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0), 
					DateTimeGridAlignment.Hour => TimeSpan.FromHours(1.0), 
					DateTimeGridAlignment.Day => TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0), 
					_ => TimeSpan.FromDays(7.0), 
				};
			}
		}

		public DateTimeGridAlignment GridAlignment { get; set; }

		public override object ConvertToNative(double value)
		{
			return SparklineMathUtils.ConvertToNative(value, (SparklineScaleType)2);
		}

		public override void CorrectVisibleRange(object oldStart, object oldEnd, object newStart, object newEnd, out object correctStart, out object correctEnd)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = (DateTime)newEnd - (DateTime)newStart;
			if (timeSpan < MinVisualRange)
			{
				correctStart = oldStart;
				correctEnd = oldEnd;
			}
			else
			{
				correctStart = newStart;
				correctEnd = newEnd;
			}
		}

		public override bool CheckValueType(object value)
		{
			return value is DateTime;
		}

		public override object TryParseValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(string))
			{
				if (DateTime.TryParse((string)value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class RangeControlClientTimeSpanScaleProvider : RangeControlClientScaleProvider
	{
		private TimeSpan MinVisualRange
		{
			get
			{
				TimeSpanGridAlignment timeSpanGridAlignment = ((GridAlignment == TimeSpanGridAlignment.Auto) ? TimeSpanGridAlignment.Minute : GridAlignment);
				return DateTimeUtilsExt.ToTimeSpan(1.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)timeSpanGridAlignment);
			}
		}

		public TimeSpanGridAlignment GridAlignment { get; set; }

		public override object ConvertToNative(double value)
		{
			return SparklineMathUtils.ConvertToNative(value, (SparklineScaleType)3);
		}

		public override void CorrectVisibleRange(object oldStart, object oldEnd, object newStart, object newEnd, out object correctStart, out object correctEnd)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = (TimeSpan)newEnd - (TimeSpan)newStart;
			if (timeSpan < MinVisualRange)
			{
				correctStart = oldStart;
				correctEnd = oldEnd;
			}
			else
			{
				correctStart = newStart;
				correctEnd = newEnd;
			}
		}

		public override bool CheckValueType(object value)
		{
			return value is TimeSpan;
		}

		public override object TryParseValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(string))
			{
				if (TimeSpan.TryParse((string)value, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SelectionBehaviorBase
	{
		protected ChartBoundRangeControlClient Client { get; private set; }

		protected double SelectionStart { get; set; } = double.NaN;

		protected double SelectionEnd { get; set; } = double.NaN;

		public double ActualSelectedStart { get; protected set; }

		public double ActualSelectedEnd { get; protected set; }

		public SelectionBehaviorBase(ChartBoundRangeControlClient client)
		{
			Client = client;
			AssignSelectionFromClient();
		}

		protected void ApplySelection(double selectionStart, double selectionEnd)
		{
			Client.UpdateVisualRange(selectionStart, selectionEnd);
			AssignSelectionFromClient();
		}

		public void AssignSelectionFromClient()
		{
			ActualSelectedStart = Client.VisualRangeMinValue;
			ActualSelectedEnd = Client.VisualRangeMaxValue;
		}

		public void RestoreSelection()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(SelectionStart) && !double.IsNaN(SelectionEnd) && (SelectionStart != ActualSelectedStart || SelectionEnd != ActualSelectedEnd))
			{
				ApplySelection(SelectionStart, SelectionEnd);
			}
		}

		public virtual void CleanUp()
		{
		}

		public abstract void UpdateSelection(double selectionStart, double selectionEnd);
	}
	internal class SimpleSelectionBehavior : SelectionBehaviorBase
	{
		public SimpleSelectionBehavior(ChartBoundRangeControlClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(double selectionStart, double selectionEnd)
		{
			base.SelectionStart = selectionStart;
			base.SelectionEnd = selectionEnd;
			ApplySelection(selectionStart, selectionEnd);
		}
	}
	internal class MouseUpSelectionBehavior : SelectionBehaviorBase
	{
		private readonly UIElement element;

		private bool interactiveSelectionInProcess;

		public MouseUpSelectionBehavior(ChartBoundRangeControlClient client, UIElement element)
			: base(client)
		{
			this.element = element;
			this.element.PreviewMouseUp += PreviewMouseUp;
			this.element.PreviewMouseDown += PreviewMouseDown;
		}

		private void PreviewMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			ApplySelection(base.ActualSelectedStart, base.ActualSelectedEnd);
			interactiveSelectionInProcess = false;
		}

		private void PreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			interactiveSelectionInProcess = true;
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(double selectionStart, double selectionEnd)
		{
			base.ActualSelectedStart = selectionStart;
			base.ActualSelectedEnd = selectionEnd;
			base.SelectionStart = selectionStart;
			base.SelectionEnd = selectionEnd;
			if (!interactiveSelectionInProcess)
			{
				ApplySelection(base.ActualSelectedStart, base.ActualSelectedEnd);
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			element.PreviewMouseUp -= PreviewMouseUp;
			element.PreviewMouseDown -= PreviewMouseDown;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.ModelSupport
{
	public static class ModelConfiguratorHelper
	{
		public static SolidColorBrush CreateSolidBrush(ColorARGB model, bool checkTransparency = false)
		{
			if (model.IsEmpty || (checkTransparency && model.IsTransparent))
			{
				return null;
			}
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(model.ToColor());
			solidColorBrush.Freeze();
			return solidColorBrush;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		protected System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateFillStyleBrush(FillStyle fillStyle, ColorARGB color, bool checkTransparency)
		{
			if (fillStyle == null || fillStyle.FillMode != FillMode.Gradient || fillStyle.Options == null)
			{
				return ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(color, checkTransparency);
			}
			return CreateGradientBrush(fillStyle, color);
		}

		protected LinearGradientBrush CreateGradientBrush(FillStyle fillStyle, ColorARGB color)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			GradientStop value = new GradientStop
			{
				Color = color.ToColor(),
				Offset = 0.0
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value);
			GradientStop value2 = new GradientStop
			{
				Color = fillStyle.Options.Color2.ToColor(),
				Offset = 1.0
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(value2);
			GradientStop gradientStop = null;
			switch (fillStyle.Options.GradientMode)
			{
			case GradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0);
				break;
			case GradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				break;
			case GradientMode.BottomToTop:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0);
				break;
			case GradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0);
				gradientStop = new GradientStop
				{
					Color = fillStyle.Options.Color2.ToColor(),
					Offset = 0.0
				};
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Insert(0, gradientStop);
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[1].Offset = 0.5;
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[2].Offset = 1.0;
				break;
			case GradientMode.FromCenterVertical:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
				gradientStop = new GradientStop
				{
					Color = fillStyle.Options.Color2.ToColor(),
					Offset = 0.0
				};
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Insert(0, gradientStop);
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[1].Offset = 0.5;
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[2].Offset = 1.0;
				break;
			case GradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0);
				gradientStop = new GradientStop
				{
					Color = color.ToColor(),
					Offset = 1.0
				};
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[1].Offset = 0.5;
				break;
			case GradientMode.ToCenterVertical:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
				gradientStop = new GradientStop
				{
					Color = color.ToColor(),
					Offset = 1.0
				};
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops[1].Offset = 0.5;
				break;
			case GradientMode.LeftToRight:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5);
				break;
			case GradientMode.RightToLeft:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
				break;
			case GradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0);
				break;
			case GradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
				break;
			case GradientMode.TopToBottom:
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0);
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0);
				break;
			}
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		protected void ConfigureShadow(UIElement element, Shadow shadowModel)
		{
			DropShadowEffect dropShadowEffect = new DropShadowEffect();
			if (!shadowModel.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				dropShadowEffect.Color = shadowModel.Color.ToColor();
			}
			dropShadowEffect.ShadowDepth = shadowModel.Size;
			element.Effect = dropShadowEffect;
		}

		protected void ConfigureBorder(Control control, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border borderModel)
		{
			if (!borderModel.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				control.BorderBrush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(borderModel.Color);
			}
			control.BorderThickness = new Thickness(borderModel.Thickness);
		}

		protected void ConfigureSeriesBorder(SeriesBorder border, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border borderModel)
		{
			if (!borderModel.Color.IsEmpty)
			{
				border.Brush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(borderModel.Color);
			}
			if (border.LineStyle == null)
			{
				border.LineStyle = new LineStyle();
			}
			border.LineStyle.Thickness = borderModel.Thickness;
		}

		protected void ConfigurePadding(Control control, RectangleIndents indentsModel)
		{
			if (indentsModel.All != -1)
			{
				control.Padding = new Thickness(indentsModel.All);
			}
			else
			{
				control.Padding = new Thickness(indentsModel.Left, indentsModel.Top, indentsModel.Right, indentsModel.Bottom);
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureMargins(Control control, RectangleIndents indentsModel)
		{
			if (indentsModel.All != -1)
			{
				control.Margin = new Thickness(indentsModel.All);
			}
			else
			{
				control.Margin = new Thickness(indentsModel.Left, indentsModel.Top, indentsModel.Right, indentsModel.Bottom);
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureLineStyle(LineStyle lineStyle, DevExpress.Charts.Model.LineStyle lineStyleModel)
		{
			lineStyle.DashStyle = lineStyleModel.DashStyle.ToDashStyle();
			lineStyle.Thickness = lineStyleModel.Thickness;
		}
	}
	public class ChartAppearanceConfigurator : AppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		private IModelElementContainer container;

		public ChartAppearanceConfigurator(IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			this.container = container;
		}

		private void ConfigureLegend(Legend legend, LegendAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!appearance.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				legend.Background = CreateFillStyleBrush(appearance.FillStyle, appearance.BackColor, checkTransparency: true);
			}
			if (!appearance.TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				legend.Foreground = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.TextColor);
			}
			if (appearance.Border != null)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(legend, appearance.Border);
			}
			if (appearance.Shadow != null)
			{
				ConfigureShadow(legend, appearance.Shadow);
			}
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureLegendMargins(legend, appearance.Margins);
			}
			if (appearance.Padding != null)
			{
				ConfigurePadding(legend, appearance.Padding);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureLegendMargins(Legend legend, RectangleIndents indentsModel)
		{
			if (indentsModel.All != -1)
			{
				legend.IndentFromDiagram = new Thickness(indentsModel.All);
			}
			else
			{
				legend.IndentFromDiagram = new Thickness(indentsModel.Left, indentsModel.Top, indentsModel.Right, indentsModel.Bottom);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureChart(ChartControl chart, ChartAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (!appearance.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				chart.Background = CreateFillStyleBrush(appearance.FillStyle, appearance.BackColor, checkTransparency: true);
			}
			if (appearance.Border != null)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(chart, appearance.Border);
			}
			if (appearance.Padding != null)
			{
				ConfigurePadding(chart, appearance.Padding);
			}
			if (appearance.TitleAppearance != null)
			{
				ConfigureChartTitles(chart.Titles, appearance.TitleAppearance);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureChartTitles(TitleCollection titles, ChartTitleAppearance appearance)
		{
			foreach (Title title in titles)
			{
				if (!appearance.TextColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					title.Foreground = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.TextColor);
				}
				title.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, appearance.Indent);
			}
		}

		private bool DetermineSeriesHasCustomAppearance(ChartControl chart)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (chart.Diagram != null)
			{
				foreach (Series item in chart.Diagram.Series)
				{
					SeriesModel seriesModel = container.FindModelElement(item) as SeriesModel;
					if (seriesModel.Appearance != null)
					{
						result = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Configure(ChartControl chart, ChartAppearanceOptions appearance)
		{
			bool flag = DetermineSeriesHasCustomAppearance(chart);
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				if (appearance.ChartAppearance != null)
				{
					ConfigureChart(chart, appearance.ChartAppearance);
				}
				if (appearance.LegendAppearance != null && chart.Legend != null)
				{
					ConfigureLegend(chart.Legend, appearance.LegendAppearance);
				}
				DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase diagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase = DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase.CreateConfigurator(chart.Diagram, container);
				if (diagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase != null)
				{
					if (appearance.DiagramAppearance != null)
					{
						diagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase.Configure(chart.Diagram, appearance.DiagramAppearance);
					}
					if (appearance.SeriesAppearance != null || flag)
					{
						diagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase.ConfigureSeries(chart.Diagram.Series, appearance.SeriesAppearance);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase.CreateConfigurator(chart.Diagram, container)?.ConfigureSeries(chart.Diagram.Series, null);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase : AppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		private readonly IModelElementContainer container;

		protected IModelElementContainer Container => container;

		public static DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase CreateConfigurator(Diagram diagram, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				return new CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is CircularDiagram2D)
			{
				return new CircularDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is SimpleDiagram2D)
			{
				return new SimpleDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				return new XYDiagram3DAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			if (diagram is SimpleDiagram3D)
			{
				return new SimpleDiagram3DAppearanceConfigurator(container);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase(IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			this.container = container;
		}

		protected AxisAppearance GetAxisActualAppearance(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance allAxesAppearance)
		{
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase axisBase = null;
			if (axis != null)
			{
				axisBase = Container.FindModelElement(axis) as DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase;
			}
			if (axisBase != null && axisBase.Appearance != null)
			{
				return axisBase.Appearance;
			}
			return allAxesAppearance;
		}

		protected void ConfigureSeriesLabel(SeriesLabel label, SeriesLabelAppearance appearance)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = new DataTemplate();
			FrameworkElementFactory visualTree = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(SeriesLabelForChartModel));
			dataTemplate.VisualTree = visualTree;
			label.ElementTemplate = dataTemplate;
			if (!appearance.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				label.Background = CreateFillStyleBrush(appearance.FillStyle, appearance.BackColor, checkTransparency: false);
			}
			if (appearance.Border != null)
			{
				ConfigureBorder(label, appearance.Border);
			}
			label.Indent = appearance.LineLength;
			label.ConnectorVisible = appearance.LineVisible;
			if (appearance.Shadow != null)
			{
				ConfigureShadow(label, appearance.Shadow);
			}
			if (!appearance.TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				label.Foreground = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.TextColor);
			}
			if (appearance.LineStyle != null)
			{
				label.ConnectorThickness = appearance.LineStyle.Thickness;
			}
			label.RenderMode = LabelRenderMode.Rectangle;
		}

		protected abstract void ConfigureView(Series view, SeriesAppearance appearance);

		public abstract void Configure(Diagram diagram, DiagramAppearance appearance);

		public void ConfigureSeries(SeriesCollection seriesCollection, SeriesAppearance appearance)
		{
			foreach (Series item in seriesCollection)
			{
				SeriesAppearance seriesAppearance = appearance;
				if (Container.FindModelElement(item) is SeriesModel { Appearance: not null } seriesModel)
				{
					seriesAppearance = seriesModel.Appearance;
				}
				if (seriesAppearance != null)
				{
					if (seriesAppearance.LabelAppearance != null)
					{
						ConfigureSeriesLabel(item.ActualLabel, seriesAppearance.LabelAppearance);
					}
					ConfigureView(item, seriesAppearance);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void ConfigureAxis(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				if (!appearance.GridLinesColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					axis.GridLinesBrush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.GridLinesColor);
				}
				if (!appearance.GridLinesMinorColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					axis.GridLinesMinorBrush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.GridLinesMinorColor);
				}
				if (appearance.GridLinesLineStyle != null)
				{
					axis.GridLinesLineStyle = new LineStyle();
					ConfigureLineStyle(axis.GridLinesLineStyle, appearance.GridLinesLineStyle);
				}
				if (appearance.GridLinesMinorLineStyle != null)
				{
					axis.GridLinesMinorLineStyle = new LineStyle();
					ConfigureLineStyle(axis.GridLinesMinorLineStyle, appearance.GridLinesMinorLineStyle);
				}
				axis.Interlaced = appearance.Interlaced;
				if (!appearance.InterlacedColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					axis.InterlacedBrush = CreateFillStyleBrush(appearance.InterlacedFillStyle, appearance.InterlacedColor, checkTransparency: false);
				}
				if (!appearance.LabelTextColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					axis.ActualLabel.Foreground = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.LabelTextColor);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator : DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		public CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxes(XYDiagram2D diagram, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.ActualAxisX, GetAxisActualAppearance(diagram.ActualAxisX, appearance));
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.ActualAxisY, GetAxisActualAppearance(diagram.ActualAxisY, appearance));
			foreach (SecondaryAxisX2D item in diagram.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(item, GetAxisActualAppearance(item, appearance));
			}
			foreach (SecondaryAxisY2D item2 in diagram.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				ConfigureAxis(item2, GetAxisActualAppearance(item2, appearance));
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureViewBorder(XYSeries2D view, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border borderModel)
		{
			if (view is AreaSeries2D)
			{
				if (borderModel == null || borderModel.Thickness == 0)
				{
					((AreaSeries2D)view).Border = null;
				}
				else
				{
					((AreaSeries2D)view).Border = new SeriesBorder();
					ConfigureSeriesBorder(((AreaSeries2D)view).Border, borderModel);
				}
			}
			if (view is AreaStackedSeries2D)
			{
				if (borderModel == null || borderModel.Thickness == 0)
				{
					((AreaStackedSeries2D)view).Border = null;
				}
				else
				{
					((AreaStackedSeries2D)view).Border = new SeriesBorder();
					ConfigureSeriesBorder(((AreaStackedSeries2D)view).Border, borderModel);
				}
			}
			if (view is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				if (borderModel == null || borderModel.Thickness == 0)
				{
					((RangeAreaSeries2D)view).Border1 = null;
					((RangeAreaSeries2D)view).Border2 = null;
				}
				else
				{
					((RangeAreaSeries2D)view).Border1 = new SeriesBorder();
					((RangeAreaSeries2D)view).Border2 = new SeriesBorder();
					ConfigureSeriesBorder(((RangeAreaSeries2D)view).Border1, borderModel);
					ConfigureSeriesBorder(((RangeAreaSeries2D)view).Border2, borderModel);
				}
			}
			if (view is BarSeries2D)
			{
				Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel bar2DModelForCommonChartModel = (Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel)((BarSeries2D)view).Model;
				bar2DModelForCommonChartModel.BorderModel = borderModel;
			}
			if (view is WaterfallSeries2D)
			{
				Waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel = (Waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel)((WaterfallSeries2D)view).Model;
				waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel.BorderModel = borderModel;
			}
			if (view is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				RangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel rangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel = (RangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel)((RangeBarSeries2D)view).Model;
				rangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel.BorderModel = borderModel;
			}
			if (view is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				BoxPlotSeries2D boxPlotSeries2D = (BoxPlotSeries2D)view;
				SimpleBoxPlot2DModel simpleBoxPlot2DModel = (SimpleBoxPlot2DModel)boxPlotSeries2D.Model;
				simpleBoxPlot2DModel.LineThicknessForModel = borderModel.Thickness;
				simpleBoxPlot2DModel.BorderColor = borderModel.Color.ToColor();
			}
		}

		protected override void ConfigureView(Series view, SeriesAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (view is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
			{
				if (xYSeries2D is LineSeries2D && appearance.LineStyle != null)
				{
					((LineSeries2D)xYSeries2D).LineStyle = new LineStyle
					{
						LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Bevel
					};
					ConfigureLineStyle(((LineSeries2D)xYSeries2D).LineStyle, appearance.LineStyle);
				}
				if (!appearance.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					xYSeries2D.Brush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.Color);
				}
				if (appearance.Shadow != null)
				{
					ConfigureShadow(xYSeries2D, appearance.Shadow);
				}
				ConfigureViewBorder(xYSeries2D, appearance.Border);
				if (view is BarSeries2D)
				{
					Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel bar2DModelForCommonChartModel = (Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel)((BarSeries2D)view).Model;
					bar2DModelForCommonChartModel.FillStyleModel = appearance.FillStyle;
				}
				if (view is RangeBarSeries2D)
				{
					RangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel rangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel = (RangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel)((RangeBarSeries2D)view).Model;
					rangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel.FillStyleModel = appearance.FillStyle;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)diagram;
			if (!appearance.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane.DomainBrush = CreateFillStyleBrush(appearance.FillStyle, appearance.BackColor, checkTransparency: false);
			}
			if (appearance.BorderVisible && !appearance.BorderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane.DomainBorderBrush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.BorderColor);
			}
			else
			{
				xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane.DomainBorderBrush = null;
			}
			if (appearance.Shadow != null)
			{
				ConfigureShadow(xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane, appearance.Shadow);
			}
			ConfigureAxes(xYDiagram2D, appearance.AxesAppearance);
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureMargins(xYDiagram2D, appearance.Margins);
			}
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxis(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			base.ConfigureAxis(axis, appearance);
			Axis2D axis2D = axis as Axis2D;
			if (appearance != null && axis2D != null)
			{
				if (!appearance.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					axis2D.Brush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.Color);
				}
				axis2D.Thickness = appearance.Thickness;
				if (appearance.TitleAppearance != null && axis2D.Title != null && !appearance.TitleAppearance.TextColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					axis2D.Title.Foreground = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.TitleAppearance.TextColor);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CircularDiagramAppearanceConfigurator : DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		public CircularDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxes(CircularDiagram2D diagram, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			AxisBase axis = ((diagram is RadarDiagram2D) ? ((CircularAxisX2D)((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisX) : ((CircularAxisX2D)((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisX));
			AxisBase axis2 = ((diagram is RadarDiagram2D) ? ((CircularAxisY2D)((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisY) : ((CircularAxisY2D)((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisY));
			ConfigureAxis(axis, GetAxisActualAppearance(axis, appearance));
			ConfigureAxis(axis2, GetAxisActualAppearance(axis2, appearance));
		}

		private void ConfigureViewBorder(CircularSeriesBase2D view, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border borderModel)
		{
			if (view is CircularAreaSeries2D)
			{
				if (borderModel == null || borderModel.Thickness == 0)
				{
					((CircularAreaSeries2D)view).Border = null;
					return;
				}
				((CircularAreaSeries2D)view).Border = new SeriesBorder();
				ConfigureSeriesBorder(((CircularAreaSeries2D)view).Border, borderModel);
			}
		}

		protected override void ConfigureView(Series view, SeriesAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (view is CircularSeriesBase2D circularSeriesBase2D)
			{
				if (circularSeriesBase2D is CircularLineSeries2D && appearance.LineStyle != null)
				{
					ConfigureLineStyle(((CircularLineSeries2D)circularSeriesBase2D).ActualLineStyle, appearance.LineStyle);
				}
				if (!appearance.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					circularSeriesBase2D.Brush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.Color);
				}
				if (appearance.Shadow != null)
				{
					ConfigureShadow(circularSeriesBase2D, appearance.Shadow);
				}
				if (appearance.Border != null)
				{
					ConfigureViewBorder(circularSeriesBase2D, appearance.Border);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			CircularDiagram2D circularDiagram2D = (CircularDiagram2D)diagram;
			if (!appearance.BackColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				circularDiagram2D.DomainBrush = CreateFillStyleBrush(appearance.FillStyle, appearance.BackColor, checkTransparency: false);
			}
			if (appearance.BorderVisible && !appearance.BorderColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				circularDiagram2D.DomainBorderBrush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.BorderColor);
			}
			else
			{
				circularDiagram2D.DomainBorderBrush = null;
			}
			if (appearance.Shadow != null)
			{
				ConfigureShadow(circularDiagram2D, appearance.Shadow);
			}
			ConfigureAxes(circularDiagram2D, appearance.AxesAppearance);
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureMargins(circularDiagram2D, appearance.Margins);
			}
		}

		public override void ConfigureAxis(AxisBase axis, AxisAppearance appearance)
		{
			base.ConfigureAxis(axis, appearance);
			if (appearance != null && axis is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				if (!appearance.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					((CircularAxisY2D)axis).Brush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.Color);
				}
				((CircularAxisY2D)axis).Thickness = appearance.Thickness;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagramAppearanceConfigurator : DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase
	{
		public SimpleDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		protected override void ConfigureView(Series view, SeriesAppearance appearance)
		{
			if (view is FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D && appearance.Border != null)
			{
				funnelSeries2D.Border = new SeriesBorder();
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(appearance.Border.Color.ToColor());
				solidColorBrush.Freeze();
				funnelSeries2D.Border.Brush = solidColorBrush;
				funnelSeries2D.Border.LineStyle = new LineStyle();
				funnelSeries2D.Border.LineStyle.Thickness = appearance.Border.Thickness;
				if (!appearance.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush2 = new SolidColorBrush(appearance.Color.ToColor());
					solidColorBrush2.Freeze();
					funnelSeries2D.Brush = solidColorBrush2;
				}
				if (appearance.Shadow != null)
				{
					ConfigureShadow(funnelSeries2D, appearance.Shadow);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			SimpleDiagram2D simpleDiagram2D = (SimpleDiagram2D)diagram;
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureMargins(simpleDiagram2D, appearance.Margins);
			}
			if (appearance.BackColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				simpleDiagram2D.Background = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(appearance.BackColor);
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void ConfigureView(Series view, SeriesAppearance appearance)
