		}

		public override void Configure(Diagram diagram, DiagramAppearance appearance)
		{
			SimpleDiagram3D control = (SimpleDiagram3D)diagram;
			if (appearance.Margins != null)
			{
				ConfigureMargins(control, appearance.Margins);
			}
		}
	}
	public class Cartesian3DChartConfigurator : ChartConfigurator
	{
		private new Cartesian3DChart ChartModel => base.ChartModel as Cartesian3DChart;

		protected override bool Is3D => true;

		public Cartesian3DChartConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		protected override void ConfigureDiagram(ChartControl chart)
		{
			XYDiagram3D xYDiagram3D = new XYDiagram3D();
			xYDiagram3D.PerspectiveAngle = ChartModel.Options3D.PerspectiveAngle;
			((IXYDiagram)xYDiagram3D).UseRangeDependentEnqueuer = ChartModel.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer;
			chart.Diagram = xYDiagram3D;
		}
	}
	public class BarSeries3DPropertiesConfigurator : GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			BarSeries3D barSeries3D = (BarSeries3D)series;
			barSeries3D.BarWidth = ((ISupportBarWidthSeries)seriesModel).BarWidth;
			switch (((ISupportBar3DModelSeries)seriesModel).Model)
			{
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.Bar3DModel.Box:
				barSeries3D.Model = new BoxBar3DModel();
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.Bar3DModel.Cone:
				barSeries3D.Model = new ConeBar3DModel();
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.Bar3DModel.Cylinder:
				barSeries3D.Model = new CylinderBar3DModel();
				break;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.Bar3DModel.Pyramid:
				barSeries3D.Model = new PyramidBar3DModel();
				break;
			default:
				barSeries3D.Model = new BoxBar3DModel();
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class MarkerSeries3DPropertiesConfigurator : GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		private new Marker3DModel GetMarkerModel(MarkerType markerType)
		{
			return markerType switch
			{
				MarkerType.Circle => new SphereMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Cross => new SphereMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Diamond => new SphereMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Hexagon => new HexagonMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.InvertedTriangle => new PyramidMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Pentagon => new SphereMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Plus => new SphereMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Square => new CubeMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Star => new StarMarker3DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Triangle => new PyramidMarker3DModel(), 
				_ => new SphereMarker3DModel(), 
			};
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			Marker marker = ((ISupportMarkerSeries)seriesModel).Marker;
			if (marker != null)
			{
				MarkerSeries3D markerSeries3D = (MarkerSeries3D)series;
				markerSeries3D.Model = GetMarkerModel(marker.MarkerType);
				if (series is PointSeries3D)
				{
					((PointSeries3D)series).MarkerSize = marker.Size;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CartesianChartConfigurator : ChartConfigurator
	{
		private new CartesianChart ChartModel => base.ChartModel as CartesianChart;

		public CartesianChartConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxes(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			CartesianAxesConfigurator cartesianAxesConfigurator = new CartesianAxesConfigurator(ChartModel, base.Container);
			cartesianAxesConfigurator.Configure(diagram);
		}

		private void ConfigureChartDataTable(ChartDataTable dataTable)
		{
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.ChartDataTable chartDataTable = ChartModel.ChartDataTable;
			if (chartDataTable.Font != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(chartDataTable.Font.Name))
				{
					dataTable.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(chartDataTable.Font.Name);
				}
				dataTable.FontSize = FontConversion.ConvertFromPointToPixel(chartDataTable.Font.Size);
			}
			if (!chartDataTable.LineColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(chartDataTable.LineColor.ToColor());
				brush.Freeze();
				dataTable.LineBrush = brush;
			}
			dataTable.Visible = chartDataTable.Visible;
			dataTable.VerticalIndent = chartDataTable.VerticalIndent;
			dataTable.ShowBorder = chartDataTable.ShowBorder;
			dataTable.ShowHorizontalLines = chartDataTable.ShowHorizontalLines;
			dataTable.ShowLegendMarker = chartDataTable.ShowLegendMarker;
			dataTable.ShowVerticalLines = chartDataTable.ShowVerticalLines;
			dataTable.LineStyle.Thickness = chartDataTable.LineStyle.Thickness;
			dataTable.LineStyle.DashStyle = chartDataTable.LineStyle.DashStyle.ToDashStyle();
			dataTable.ArgumentFormatter = new ModelAxisLabelFormatter(ChartModel.ArgumentAxis.Label.Formatter);
			if (!chartDataTable.TextColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = new SolidColorBrush(chartDataTable.TextColor.ToColor());
				brush2.Freeze();
				dataTable.Foreground = brush2;
			}
		}

		protected override void ConfigureDiagram(ChartControl chart)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = new XYDiagram2D();
			xYDiagram2D.Rotated = ChartModel.Rotated;
			xYDiagram2D.BarDistance = ChartModel.BarDistance;
			xYDiagram2D.BarDistanceFixed = ChartModel.BarDistanceFixed;
			((IXYDiagram)xYDiagram2D).UseRangeDependentEnqueuer = ChartModel.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer;
			chart.Diagram = xYDiagram2D;
			ConfigureAxes(xYDiagram2D);
			if (ChartModel.ChartDataTable != null)
			{
				ConfigureChartDataTable(xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane.ChartDataTable);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CartesianSeriesPropertiesConfigurator : GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)series;
			ConfigureAxis(xYSeries2D, (CartesianSeriesBase)seriesModel, (XYDiagram2D)diagram);
			ConfigureIndicators(xYSeries2D, (CartesianSeriesBase)seriesModel);
		}

		private void ConfigureAxis(XYSeries2D series, CartesianSeriesBase seriesModel, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			SecondaryAxisX2D secondaryAxisXByIndex = GetSecondaryAxisXByIndex(seriesModel.SecondaryArgumentAxisIndex, diagram.SecondaryAxesX);
			if (secondaryAxisXByIndex != null)
			{
				series.AxisX = secondaryAxisXByIndex;
			}
			SecondaryAxisY2D secondaryAxisYByIndex = GetSecondaryAxisYByIndex(seriesModel.SecondaryValueAxisIndex, diagram.SecondaryAxesY);
			if (secondaryAxisYByIndex != null)
			{
				series.AxisY = secondaryAxisYByIndex;
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureIndicators(XYSeries2D xySeries, CartesianSeriesBase cartesianSeriesBaseModel)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Indicator indicator2 in cartesianSeriesBaseModel.Indicators)
			{
				Indicator indicator = null;
				switch (indicator2.GetType().Name)
				{
				case "RegressionLine":
					indicator = new RegressionLine
					{
						ForecastBackwardPeriods = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression)indicator2).ForecastBackwardPeriods,
						ForecastForwardPeriods = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression)indicator2).ForecastForwardPeriods
					};
					break;
				case "SimpleMovingAverage":
					indicator = new SimpleMovingAverage
					{
						PointsCount = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.SimpleMovingAverage)indicator2).PointsCount,
						IgnoreEmptyValues = true,
						StartFromFirstPoint = false
					};
					break;
				case "ExponentialRegression":
					indicator = new ExponentialRegression();
					break;
				case "LogarithmicRegression":
					indicator = new LogarithmicRegression();
					break;
				case "PowerRegression":
					indicator = new PowerRegression();
					break;
				case "PolynomialRegression":
					indicator = new PolynomialRegression
					{
						Degree = ((DevExpress.Charts.Model.PolynomialRegression)indicator2).Degree
					};
					break;
				case "DataSourceBasedErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.DataSourceBasedErrorBars dataSourceBasedErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.DataSourceBasedErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new DataSourceBasedErrorBars
					{
						PositiveErrorDataMember = dataSourceBasedErrorBars.PositiveErrorDataMember,
						NegativeErrorDataMember = dataSourceBasedErrorBars.NegativeErrorDataMember
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "FixedValueErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.FixedValueErrorBars fixedValueErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.FixedValueErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new FixedValueErrorBars
					{
						NegativeError = fixedValueErrorBars.NegativeError,
						PositiveError = fixedValueErrorBars.PositiveError
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "PercentageErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.PercentageErrorBars percentageErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.PercentageErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new PercentageErrorBars
					{
						Percent = percentageErrorBars.Percent
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "StandardDeviationErrorBars":
				{
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.StandardDeviationErrorBars standardDeviationErrorBars = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.StandardDeviationErrorBars)indicator2;
					indicator = new StandardDeviationErrorBars
					{
						Multiplier = standardDeviationErrorBars.Multiplier
					};
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				}
				case "StandardErrorBars":
					indicator = new StandardErrorBars();
					SetCommonErrorBarProperties(indicator, indicator2);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException($"The {indicator2.GetType().Name} indicator model type is unknown.");
				}
				if (indicator != null)
				{
					ParametricRegression parametricRegression = indicator as ParametricRegression;
					DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression parametricRegression2 = indicator2 as DevExpress.Charts.Model.ParametricRegression;
					if (parametricRegression != null && parametricRegression2 != null)
					{
						parametricRegression.ForecastBackwardPeriods = parametricRegression2.ForecastBackwardPeriods;
						parametricRegression.ForecastForwardPeriods = parametricRegression2.ForecastForwardPeriods;
					}
					indicator.Brush = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(indicator2.Color);
					indicator.Item.LineStyle.Thickness = indicator2.LineStyle.Thickness;
					indicator.Item.LineStyle.DashStyle = indicator2.LineStyle.DashStyle.ToDashStyle();
					indicator.DisplayName = indicator2.Name;
					indicator.ShowInLegend = indicator2.ShowInLegend;
					indicator.Visible = indicator2.Visible;
					xySeries.Indicators.Add(indicator);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetCommonErrorBarProperties(Indicator indicator, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Indicator indicatorModel)
		{
			ErrorBars errorBars = (ErrorBars)indicator;
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.ErrorBars errorBars2 = (DevExpress.Charts.Model.ErrorBars)indicatorModel;
			errorBars.Direction = errorBars2.Direction switch
			{
				ErrorBarsDirection.Both => ErrorBarDirection.Both, 
				ErrorBarsDirection.Minus => ErrorBarDirection.Minus, 
				ErrorBarsDirection.Plus => ErrorBarDirection.Plus, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException($"The {errorBars2.Direction} error bar direction is unknown."), 
			};
			errorBars.EndStyle = errorBars2.EndStyle switch
			{
				ErrorBarsEndStyle.Cap => ErrorBarEndStyle.Cap, 
				ErrorBarsEndStyle.NoCap => ErrorBarEndStyle.NoCap, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("The {errorBarsModel.EndStyle} error bar end style is unknown"), 
			};
		}

		private SecondaryAxisX2D GetSecondaryAxisXByIndex(int index, SecondaryAxisXCollection collection)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= collection.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return collection[index];
		}

		private SecondaryAxisY2D GetSecondaryAxisYByIndex(int index, SecondaryAxisYCollection collection)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= collection.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return collection[index];
		}
	}
	public abstract class BarSeries2DPropertiesConfiguratorBase : CartesianSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		protected virtual void SetLabelPosition(SeriesModel seriesModel, SeriesLabel label)
		{
			switch (seriesModel.Label.Position)
			{
			case SeriesLabelPosition.Center:
			case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideBase:
			case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd:
				BarSideBySideSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(label, Bar2DLabelPosition.Center);
				break;
			case SeriesLabelPosition.OutsideEnd:
				BarSideBySideSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(label, Bar2DLabelPosition.Outside);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			((BarSeries2DBase)series).BarWidth = ((ISupportBarWidthSeries)seriesModel).BarWidth;
			if (seriesModel.Label != null)
			{
				SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
				actualLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)seriesModel.Label.TextOrientation;
				SetLabelPosition(seriesModel, actualLabel);
			}
		}
	}
	public class BarSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : BarSeries2DPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			((BarSeries2D)series).Model = new Bar2DModelForCommonChartModel();
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : BarSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		protected override void SetLabelPosition(SeriesModel seriesModel, SeriesLabel label)
		{
			switch (seriesModel.Label.Position)
			{
			case SeriesLabelPosition.Center:
				WaterfallSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(label, WaterfallLabelPosition.Center);
				break;
			case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideBase:
				WaterfallSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(label, WaterfallLabelPosition.InsideStart);
				break;
			case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd:
				WaterfallSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(label, WaterfallLabelPosition.InsideEnd);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			WaterfallSeries waterfallSeries = seriesModel as WaterfallSeries;
			WaterfallSeries2D waterfallSeries2D = series as WaterfallSeries2D;
			if (waterfallSeries == null || waterfallSeries2D == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WaterfallRelativeValueOptions waterfallRelativeValueOptions = new WaterfallRelativeValueOptions();
			waterfallRelativeValueOptions.SetIsSpreadsheetChart();
			XYDiagram2D diagram2 = (XYDiagram2D)diagram;
			if (waterfallSeries.FallingBarColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				waterfallSeries2D.FallingBarBrush = new SolidColorBrush(waterfallSeries.FallingBarColor.ToColor());
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.RisingBarColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				waterfallSeries2D.RisingBarBrush = new SolidColorBrush(waterfallSeries.RisingBarColor.ToColor());
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
			{
				WaterfallSeries2D.SetSubtotalBarBrush(diagram2, new SolidColorBrush(waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarColor.ToColor()));
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.ShowConnectors)
			{
				if (waterfallSeries.ConnectorColor != ColorARGB.Empty)
				{
					WaterfallSeries2D.SetConnectorBrush(diagram2, new SolidColorBrush(waterfallSeries.ConnectorColor.ToColor()));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				WaterfallSeries2D.SetConnectorBrush(diagram2, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent);
			}
			if (waterfallSeries.Subtotals != null)
			{
				foreach (int subtotal in waterfallSeries.Subtotals)
				{
					waterfallRelativeValueOptions.Subtotals.Add(new Subtotal
					{
						PointIndex = subtotal
					});
				}
			}
			WaterfallSeries2D.SetValueOptions(diagram2, waterfallRelativeValueOptions);
			waterfallSeries2D.Model = new Waterfall2DModelForCommonChartModel
			{
				FallingFillStyleModel = waterfallSeries.FallingBarFillStyle,
				RisingFillStyleModel = waterfallSeries.RisingBarFillStyle,
				SubtotalFillStyleModel = waterfallSeries.SubtotalBarFillStyle
			};
		}
	}
	public class RangeBarSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : BarSeries2DPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			((RangeBarSeries2D)series).Model = new RangeBar2DModelForCommonChartModel();
		}
	}
	public class MarkerSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : CartesianSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			Marker marker = ((ISupportMarkerSeries)seriesModel).Marker;
			if (marker != null)
			{
				ISupportMarker2D supportMarker2D = (ISupportMarker2D)series;
				if (!(series is PointSeries2D) && !(series is BubbleSeries2D))
				{
					supportMarker2D.MarkerVisible = marker.Visible;
				}
				supportMarker2D.MarkerSize = marker.Size;
				GeometryMarker2DModel markerModel = GetMarkerModel(marker.MarkerType);
				markerModel.ColorFromSeries = false;
				markerModel.Color = marker.Color.ToColor();
				markerModel.BorderVisible = marker.BorderVisible;
				markerModel.BorderColor = marker.BorderColor.ToColor();
				markerModel.BorderThickness = marker.BorderThickness;
				supportMarker2D.MarkerModel = markerModel;
			}
		}
	}
	public class LineSeries2DConfigurator : MarkerSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			if (series is SegmentSeries2DBase segmentSeries2DBase)
			{
				if (!(segmentSeries2DBase is AreaSeries2D) && !(segmentSeries2DBase is AreaStackedSeries2D))
				{
					segmentSeries2DBase.SegmentColorizer = new PointBasedSegmentColorizer
					{
						Direction = ColorDistributionDirection.Backward
					};
				}
				if (seriesModel is ScatterLineSeries)
				{
					segmentSeries2DBase.ProcessMissingPointsMode = (ProcessMissingPointsMode)((ScatterLineSeries)seriesModel).ProcessMissingPointsMode;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class BubbleSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : MarkerSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			BubbleSeries bubbleSeries = seriesModel as BubbleSeries;
			BubbleSeries2D bubbleSeries2D = series as BubbleSeries2D;
			if (bubbleSeries != null && bubbleSeries2D != null)
			{
				if (bubbleSeries.MinSize < bubbleSeries2D.MaxSize)
				{
					bubbleSeries2D.MinSize = bubbleSeries.MinSize;
					bubbleSeries2D.MaxSize = bubbleSeries.MaxSize;
				}
				else
				{
					bubbleSeries2D.MaxSize = bubbleSeries.MaxSize;
					bubbleSeries2D.MinSize = bubbleSeries.MinSize;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TransparencySeriesPropertiesConfigurator : SeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			((ISupportTransparency)series).Transparency = (double)(int)((ISupportTransparencySeries)seriesModel).Transparency / 255.0;
		}
	}
	public class PointSeriesLabelPropertiesConfigurator : SeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (seriesModel.Label != null)
			{
				SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
				actualLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)seriesModel.Label.TextOrientation;
				switch (seriesModel.Label.Position)
				{
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Left:
					MarkerSeries2D.SetAngle(actualLabel, 180.0);
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Top:
					MarkerSeries2D.SetAngle(actualLabel, 90.0);
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Right:
					MarkerSeries2D.SetAngle(actualLabel, 0.0);
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Bottom:
					MarkerSeries2D.SetAngle(actualLabel, 270.0);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class BubbleSeriesLabelPropertiesConfigurator : PointSeriesLabelPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			if (seriesModel.Label != null)
			{
				SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
				actualLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)seriesModel.Label.TextOrientation;
				SeriesLabelPosition position = seriesModel.Label.Position;
				if (position == SeriesLabelPosition.Center)
				{
					BubbleSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(actualLabel, Bubble2DLabelPosition.Center);
				}
				else
				{
					BubbleSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(actualLabel, Bubble2DLabelPosition.Outside);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ModelAxisLabelFormatter : IAxisLabelFormatter, IAxisLabelFormatterCore
	{
		private readonly DevExpress.Charts.Model.IAxisLabelFormatter formatter;

		public ModelAxisLabelFormatter(DevExpress.Charts.Model.IAxisLabelFormatter formatter)
		{
			this.formatter = formatter;
		}

		public string GetAxisLabelText(object axisValue)
		{
			return formatter.GetAxisLabelText(axisValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisBaseConfigurator : ConfiguratorBase
	{
		protected abstract DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase AppearanceConfigurator { get; }

		public AxisBaseConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		protected void ConfigureAxisBase(AxisBase axis, DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxis)
		{
			base.Container.Register(axis, modelAxis);
			axis.GridLinesVisible = modelAxis.GridLinesVisible;
			axis.GridLinesMinorVisible = modelAxis.GridLinesMinorVisible;
			axis.ActualQualitativeScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor;
			axis.ActualDateTimeScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor;
			axis.ActualTimeSpanScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor;
			axis.ActualNumericScaleOptions.MinGridSpacingLength = modelAxis.GridSpacingFactor;
			if (modelAxis.Label != null)
			{
				axis.ActualLabel.Visible = modelAxis.Label.Visible;
				axis.ActualLabel.Angle = modelAxis.Label.RotationAngleDegree;
				if (modelAxis.Label.Formatter != null)
				{
					axis.ActualLabel.Formatter = new ModelAxisLabelFormatter(modelAxis.Label.Formatter);
				}
				ModelAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions resolveOverlappingOptions = modelAxis.Label.ResolveOverlappingOptions;
				if (resolveOverlappingOptions != null)
				{
					AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions = new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions();
					axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide = resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide;
					axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowRotate = resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowRotate;
					axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.AllowStagger = resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowStagger;
					axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions.MinIndent = resolveOverlappingOptions.MinIndent;
					axis.ActualLabel.SetResolveOverlappingOptionsInternal(axisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ConfigureAxisCore(AxisBase axis, DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase);

		protected void ConfigureAxis(AxisBase axis, DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxis)
		{
			ConfigureAxisCore(axis, modelAxis);
			if (modelAxis != null && modelAxis.Appearance != null)
			{
				AppearanceConfigurator.ConfigureAxis(axis, modelAxis.Appearance);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CartesianAxesConfigurator : AxisBaseConfigurator
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition, AxisAlignment> alignmentDict;

		private CartesianChart ChartModel => base.ModelElement as CartesianChart;

		protected override DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase AppearanceConfigurator => new CartesianDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(base.Container);

		static CartesianAxesConfigurator()
		{
			alignmentDict = new Dictionary<DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition, AxisAlignment>();
			alignmentDict[DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition.Left] = AxisAlignment.Near;
			alignmentDict[DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition.Top] = AxisAlignment.Far;
			alignmentDict[DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition.Right] = AxisAlignment.Far;
			alignmentDict[DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition.Bottom] = AxisAlignment.Near;
		}

		public CartesianAxesConfigurator(CartesianChart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigurateSecondaryArgumentAxes(SecondaryAxisXCollection targetAxes, IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis> modelAxes)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis modelAxis in modelAxes)
			{
				SecondaryAxisX2D secondaryAxisX2D = new SecondaryAxisX2D();
				ConfigureAxis(secondaryAxisX2D, modelAxis);
				targetAxes.Add(secondaryAxisX2D);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigurateSecondaryValueAxes(SecondaryAxisYCollection targetAxes, IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis> modelAxes)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis modelAxis in modelAxes)
			{
				SecondaryAxisY2D secondaryAxisY2D = new SecondaryAxisY2D();
				ConfigureAxis(secondaryAxisY2D, modelAxis);
				targetAxes.Add(secondaryAxisY2D);
			}
		}

		private NumericScaleOptionsBase CreateNumericIntervalOptions(ModelIntervalOptions modelIntervalOptions, bool autoGrid, double gridSpacing)
		{
			double? underflowValue = null;
			double? overflowValue = null;
			object underflowValue2 = modelIntervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
			if (underflowValue2 != null && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(underflowValue2.GetType()))
			{
				underflowValue = Convert.ToDouble(underflowValue2);
			}
			object overflowValue2 = modelIntervalOptions.OverflowValue;
			if (overflowValue2 != null && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(overflowValue2.GetType()))
			{
				overflowValue = Convert.ToDouble(overflowValue2);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(gridSpacing))
			{
				gridSpacing = 1.0;
			}
			return modelIntervalOptions.DivisionMode switch
			{
				DevExpress.Charts.Model.IntervalDivisionMode.Count => new CountIntervalNumericScaleOptions
				{
					AutoGrid = autoGrid,
					GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
					Count = modelIntervalOptions.Count,
					UnderflowValue = underflowValue,
					OverflowValue = overflowValue,
					AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Histogram
				}, 
				DevExpress.Charts.Model.IntervalDivisionMode.Width => new WidthIntervalNumericScaleOptions
				{
					AutoGrid = autoGrid,
					GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
					Width = modelIntervalOptions.Width,
					UnderflowValue = underflowValue,
					OverflowValue = overflowValue,
					AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Histogram
				}, 
				_ => new IntervalNumericScaleOptions
				{
					AutoGrid = autoGrid,
					GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
					UnderflowValue = underflowValue,
					OverflowValue = overflowValue,
					AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Histogram
				}, 
			};
		}

		private AxisTitle ConfigureTitle(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisTitle titleModel, AxisTitleAppearance titleAppearance)
		{
			AxisTitle axisTitle = new AxisTitle();
			if (titleModel.RichFormattedText != null)
			{
				axisTitle.Content = RichTextFormatter.CreateContent(titleModel.RichFormattedText, titleModel.Font, titleAppearance?.TextColor ?? ColorARGB.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				axisTitle.Content = titleModel.Text;
			}
			axisTitle.Visible = titleModel.Visible;
			if (titleModel.Font != null)
			{
				if (titleModel.Font.Bold)
				{
					axisTitle.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
				}
				if (titleModel.Font.Italic)
				{
					axisTitle.FontStyle = FontStyles.Italic;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(titleModel.Font.Name))
				{
					axisTitle.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(titleModel.Font.Name);
				}
				axisTitle.FontSize = FontConversion.ConvertFromPointToPixel(titleModel.Font.Size);
			}
			return axisTitle;
		}

		internal AxisAlignment CalculateAxisAlignment(DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisPosition pos)
		{
			AxisAlignment value = AxisAlignment.Near;
			if (alignmentDict.TryGetValue(pos, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return AxisAlignment.Near;
		}

		protected override void ConfigureAxisCore(AxisBase axis, DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = axis as Axis2D;
			if (!(modelAxisBase is DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis axis2) || axis2D == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool autoGrid = axis2.AutoGrid;
			double gridSpacing = (autoGrid ? double.NaN : axis2.GridSpacing);
			if (axis is AxisX2D)
			{
				AxisX2D axisX2D = (AxisX2D)axis2D;
				ModelIntervalOptions intervalOptions = axis2.IntervalOptions;
				double gridSpacing2 = (autoGrid ? 1.0 : axis2.GridSpacing);
				if (intervalOptions != null)
				{
					axisX2D.NumericScaleOptions = CreateNumericIntervalOptions(intervalOptions, autoGrid, gridSpacing);
					axisX2D.DateTimeScaleOptions = new IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions
					{
						AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Histogram,
						AutoGrid = autoGrid,
						GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
						GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)axis2.GridAlignment,
						UnderflowValue = DataItemsHelper.ParseDateTime(intervalOptions.UnderflowValue),
						OverflowValue = DataItemsHelper.ParseDateTime(intervalOptions.OverflowValue),
						DivisionMode = (IntervalDivisionModeNative)intervalOptions.DivisionMode,
						IntervalCount = intervalOptions.Count,
						IntervalWidth = intervalOptions.Width
					};
					axisX2D.QualitativeScaleOptions = new QualitativeScaleOptions
					{
						AutoGrid = autoGrid,
						GridSpacing = gridSpacing2,
						AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.Sum
					};
				}
				else
				{
					NumericStartPoint gridAlignmentStartPoint = ((axis2.Range != null) ? NumericStartPoint.MinRangeValue : NumericStartPoint.Zero);
					axisX2D.NumericScaleOptions = new ContinuousNumericScaleOptions
					{
						AutoGrid = autoGrid,
						GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
						GridAlignmentStartPoint = gridAlignmentStartPoint
					};
					axisX2D.DateTimeScaleOptions = new ManualDateTimeScaleOptions
					{
						AggregateFunction = AggregateFunction.None,
						AutoGrid = autoGrid,
						GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
						GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)axis2.GridAlignment
					};
					axisX2D.QualitativeScaleOptions = new QualitativeScaleOptions
					{
						AutoGrid = autoGrid,
						GridSpacing = gridSpacing2
					};
				}
			}
			if (axis is AxisY2D)
			{
				AxisY2D axisY2D = (AxisY2D)axis2D;
				axisY2D.NumericScaleOptions = new ContinuousNumericScaleOptions
				{
					AutoGrid = autoGrid,
					GridSpacing = gridSpacing
				};
				axisY2D.DateTimeScaleOptions = new ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions
				{
					AutoGrid = autoGrid,
					GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
					GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)axis2.GridAlignment
				};
			}
			axis.Label = new AxisLabel();
			axis.Label.Padding = (axis.IsVertical ? new Thickness(5.0, 0.0, 5.0, 0.0) : new Thickness(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0));
			axis2D.Visible = modelAxisBase.Visible;
			ConfigureAxisBase(axis, axis2);
			axis2D.Alignment = CalculateAxisAlignment(axis2.Position);
			axis2D.TickmarksVisible = axis2.TickmarksVisible;
			axis2D.TickmarksMinorVisible = axis2.TickmarksMinorVisible;
			axis2D.TickmarksCrossAxis = axis2.TickmarksCrossAxis;
			if (axis2.Title != null)
			{
				axis2D.Title = ConfigureTitle(axis2.Title, modelAxisBase.Appearance?.TitleAppearance);
			}
			if (axis2.Range != null)
			{
				axis2D.WholeRange = new Range();
				axis2D.WholeRange.SideMarginsValue = 0.0;
				if (axis2.Range.MinValue != null)
				{
					axis2D.WholeRange.MinValue = axis2.Range.MinValue;
				}
				if (axis2.Range.MaxValue != null)
				{
					axis2D.WholeRange.MaxValue = axis2.Range.MaxValue;
				}
			}
			axis2D.Reverse = axis2.Reverse;
			axis2D.Logarithmic = axis2.Logarithmic;
			if (axis2.Logarithmic)
			{
				axis2D.LogarithmicBase = axis2.LogarithmicBase;
			}
		}

		public void Configure(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			diagram.AxisX = new AxisX2D();
			diagram.AxisY = new AxisY2D();
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.AxisX, ChartModel.ArgumentAxis);
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.AxisY, ChartModel.ValueAxis);
			diagram.SecondaryAxesX.Clear();
			diagram.SecondaryAxesY.Clear();
			ConfigurateSecondaryArgumentAxes(diagram.SecondaryAxesX, (IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis>)ChartModel.SecondaryArgumentAxes);
			ConfigurateSecondaryValueAxes(diagram.SecondaryAxesY, (IList<DevExpress.Charts.Model.Axis>)ChartModel.SecondaryValueAxes);
		}
	}
	public class XpfChartsModelControllerFactory : ModelControllerFactoryBase
	{
		public override IController CreateController()
		{
			return new ModelController();
		}

		public override IChartRenderContext CreateRenderContext(ModelRect bounds, params object[] renderParams)
		{
			if (renderParams.Length != 0 && renderParams[0] is ContentPresenter container)
			{
				return new ChartRenderContext(container, bounds);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ChartRenderContext : IChartRenderContext
	{
		private ContentPresenter container;

		private ModelRect bounds;

		public ModelRect Bounds => bounds;

		public ContentPresenter Container => container;

		public ChartRenderContext(ContentPresenter container, ModelRect bounds)
		{
			this.container = container;
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}
	}
	public class ModelController : Controller
	{
		private readonly ChartControl chart;

		private ChartConfigurator configurator;

		private IInteractiveElement selectedElement;

		public ModelController()
		{
			chart = new ChartControl();
		}

		private object GetHitObject(ChartHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo.InSeries)
			{
				return hitInfo.Series;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InSeriesLabel)
			{
				return hitInfo.SeriesLabel.Series;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InAxis)
			{
				return hitInfo.Axis;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InAxisLabel)
			{
				return hitInfo.AxisLabel.Axis;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InAxisTitle)
			{
				return hitInfo.AxisTitle.Axis;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InDiagram || hitInfo.InConstantLine || hitInfo.InIndicator || hitInfo.InStrip || hitInfo.InPane)
			{
				return chart;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InLegend)
			{
				return hitInfo.Legend;
			}
			if (hitInfo.InTitle)
			{
				return hitInfo.Title;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ApplyModel()
		{
			if (configurator != null)
			{
				configurator.Configure(chart);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnModelChanged()
		{
			configurator = ChartConfigurator.CreateChartConfigurator((Chart)base.ChartModel, base.ElementContainer);
			ApplyModel();
		}

		public override void RenderChart(IChartRenderContext renderContext)
		{
			if (renderContext is ChartRenderContext { Container: not null } chartRenderContext)
			{
				chart.Width = chartRenderContext.Bounds.Width;
				chart.Height = chartRenderContext.Bounds.Height;
				chartRenderContext.Container.Content = chart;
			}
		}

		public override HitInfo CalcHitInfo(double x, double y)
		{
			ChartHitInfo hitInfo = chart.CalcHitInfo(new System.Windows.Point(x, y));
			object hitObject = GetHitObject(hitInfo);
			return CreateHitInfo(hitObject);
		}

		public override void Select(ModelElement element)
		{
			if (selectedElement != null && selectedElement != element)
			{
				selectedElement.IsSelected = false;
			}
			selectedElement = base.ElementContainer.FindViewObject(element) as IInteractiveElement;
			if (selectedElement != null)
			{
				selectedElement.IsSelected = true;
			}
		}

		public override void Deselect(ModelElement element)
		{
			selectedElement = base.ElementContainer.FindViewObject(element) as IInteractiveElement;
			if (selectedElement != null)
			{
				selectedElement.IsSelected = false;
			}
		}

		public override void ClearSelection()
		{
			if (selectedElement != null)
			{
				selectedElement.IsSelected = false;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ConfiguratorBase
	{
		private readonly ModelElement model;

		private readonly IModelElementContainer container;

		protected ModelElement ModelElement => model;

		protected IModelElementContainer Container => container;

		protected static Exception MakeUnknownTypeException(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return new Exception("Unexpected null model value");
			}
			return new Exception("Unknown model type: " + value.GetType().Name);
		}

		public ConfiguratorBase(ModelElement model, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			this.model = model;
			this.container = container;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartConfigurator : ConfiguratorBase
	{
		private readonly SeriesConfigurator seriesConfigurator;

		protected Chart ChartModel => base.ModelElement as Chart;

		protected virtual bool Is3D => false;

		public static ChartConfigurator CreateChartConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
		{
			if (chartModel != null)
			{
				Type type = chartModel.GetType();
				if (type == typeof(CartesianChart))
				{
					return new CartesianChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				if (type == typeof(PieChart))
				{
					return new PieChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				if (type == typeof(RadarChart))
				{
					return new RadarChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				if (type == typeof(PolarChart))
				{
					return new PolarChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				if (type == typeof(Cartesian3DChart))
				{
					return new Cartesian3DChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				if (type == typeof(Pie3DChart))
				{
					return new Pie3DChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				if (type == typeof(FunnelChart))
				{
					return new FunnelChartConfigurator(chartModel, container);
				}
				throw ConfiguratorBase.MakeUnknownTypeException(chartModel);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ChartConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
			seriesConfigurator = new SeriesConfigurator();
		}

		private void ConfigureLegend(Legend chartLegend, DevExpress.Charts.Model.Legend legendModel)
		{
			chartLegend.HorizontalPosition = (HorizontalPosition)LegendPositionConverter.ConverterToHorizontalAlignment(legendModel.LegendPosition, legendModel.Overlay);
			chartLegend.VerticalPosition = (VerticalPosition)LegendPositionConverter.ConverterToVerticalAlignment(legendModel.LegendPosition, legendModel.Overlay);
			chartLegend.Orientation = ((legendModel.Orientation == LegendOrientation.Vertical) ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
		}

		private void ConfigureChartTitles(TitleCollection titles)
		{
			titles.Clear();
			foreach (ChartTitle item in (DXCollectionBase<ChartTitle>)(object)ChartModel.Titles)
			{
				Title title = new Title();
				base.Container.Register(title, item);
				if (item.RichFormattedText != null)
				{
					title.Content = RichTextFormatter.CreateContent(item.RichFormattedText, item.Font, ChartModel.Appearance.ChartAppearance.TitleAppearance.TextColor);
				}
				else
				{
					title.Content = string.Join("\n", item.Lines);
				}
				if (item.Font != null)
				{
					if (item.Font.Bold)
					{
						title.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
					}
					if (item.Font.Italic)
					{
						title.FontStyle = FontStyles.Italic;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Font.Name))
					{
						title.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(item.Font.Name);
					}
					title.FontSize = FontConversion.ConvertFromPointToPixel(item.Font.Size);
				}
				title.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
				titles.Add(title);
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureSeries(Diagram diagram)
		{
			diagram.Series.Clear();
			foreach (SeriesModel item in (DXCollectionBase<SeriesModel>)(object)ChartModel.Series)
			{
				Series series = seriesConfigurator.CreateSeries(item, Is3D);
				if (series != null)
				{
					base.Container.Register(series, item);
					diagram.Series.Add(series);
					seriesConfigurator.Configure(series, item, diagram);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ConfigureChartPalette(ChartControl chart)
		{
			CustomPalette customPalette = new CustomPalette();
			foreach (PaletteEntry entry in ChartModel.Palette.Entries)
			{
				customPalette.Colors.Add(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(entry.Color.A, entry.Color.R, entry.Color.G, entry.Color.B));
			}
			chart.Palette = customPalette;
		}

		private void ConfigureChartAppearance(ChartControl chart, ChartAppearanceOptions appearance)
		{
			ChartAppearanceConfigurator chartAppearanceConfigurator = new ChartAppearanceConfigurator(base.Container);
			chartAppearanceConfigurator.Configure(chart, appearance);
		}

		private void UpdateChart(ChartControl chart, UpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			string propertyName = updateInfo.PropertyName;
			if (!(propertyName == "Palette"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Appearance")
				{
					ConfigureChartAppearance(chart, ChartModel.Appearance);
					updateInfo.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ConfigureChartPalette(chart);
				updateInfo.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ConfigureDiagram(ChartControl chart);

		public void Configure(ChartControl chart)
		{
			base.Container.Clear();
			base.Container.Register(chart, ChartModel);
			chart.BeginInit();
			chart.CrosshairEnabled = false;
			ConfigureDiagram(chart);
			ConfigureSeries(chart.Diagram);
			DevExpress.Charts.Model.Legend legend = ChartModel.Legend;
			if (legend != null)
			{
				Legend legend2 = new Legend();
				base.Container.Register(legend2, legend);
				ConfigureLegend(legend2, legend);
				chart.Legend = legend2;
				FontModel font = legend.Font;
				if (font != null)
				{
					if (font.Bold)
					{
						legend2.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
					}
					if (font.Italic)
					{
						legend2.FontStyle = FontStyles.Italic;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(font.Name))
					{
						legend2.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(font.Name);
					}
					legend2.FontSize = FontConversion.ConvertFromPointToPixel(font.Size);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				chart.Legend = null;
			}
			ConfigureChartTitles(chart.Titles);
			if (ChartModel.Palette != null)
			{
				ConfigureChartPalette(chart);
			}
			ConfigureChartAppearance(chart, ChartModel.Appearance);
			chart.AutoLayout = ChartModel.AutoLayout;
			chart.EndInit();
		}

		public void Update(ChartControl chart, UpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			chart.BeginInit();
			if (updateInfo.Element is Chart)
			{
				UpdateChart(chart, updateInfo);
			}
			chart.EndInit();
		}
	}

			: base(chartModel, container)

		}

		protected override void ConfigureDiagram(ChartControl chart)

			chart.Diagram = diagram;
		}
	}
	internal class FunnelSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			FunnelSeries2D funnelSeries2D = (FunnelSeries2D)series;
			FunnelSeries funnelSeries = (FunnelSeries)seriesModel;
			funnelSeries2D.PointDistance = funnelSeries.GapWidth;
			funnelSeries2D.ColorEach = funnelSeries.ColorEach;
			funnelSeries2D.PointShape = (FunnelPointShape)funnelSeries.PointShape;
			FunnelSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, Funnel2DLabelPosition.Center);
			series.ActualLabel.TextPattern = "{V}";
		}
	}
	public class ModelDataLabelFormatter : DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native.IDataLabelFormatter
	{
		private readonly DevExpress.Charts.Model.IDataLabelFormatter formatter;

		private readonly Series series;

		public ModelDataLabelFormatter(DevExpress.Charts.Model.IDataLabelFormatter formatter, Series series)
		{
			this.formatter = formatter;
			this.series = series;
		}

		private double GetNormalizedValue(IDataPoint point)
		{
			if (series is PieSeries)
			{
				return new PieNormalizedValuesCalculator(series).CalculateNormalizedValue(point);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public string GetDataLabelText(IDataPoint point)
		{
			IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(point);
			if (platformSeriesPoint != null)
			{
				LabelPointData pointData = new LabelPointData(platformSeriesPoint.Tag, ((ISeriesPoint)platformSeriesPoint).ArgumentX.UserArgument, GetNormalizedValue(point));
				return formatter.GetDataLabelText(pointData);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	public class PieSeries3DPropertiesConfigurator : PieSeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			PieSeriesBase pieSeriesBase = (PieSeriesBase)seriesModel;
			if (pieSeriesBase.DepthPercent != 0)
			{
				((PieSeries3D)series).DepthTransform = (double)pieSeriesBase.DepthPercent / 50.0;
			}
		}
	}
	public class Pie3DChartConfigurator : ChartConfigurator
	{
		private new Pie3DChart ChartModel => base.ChartModel as Pie3DChart;

		protected override bool Is3D => true;

		public Pie3DChartConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		protected override void ConfigureDiagram(ChartControl chart)
		{
			SimpleDiagram3D simpleDiagram3D = new SimpleDiagram3D();
			simpleDiagram3D.PerspectiveAngle = ChartModel.Options3D.PerspectiveAngle;
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			RotateTransform3D value = new RotateTransform3D
			{
				Rotation = new AxisAngleRotation3D
				{
					Angle = ChartModel.Options3D.RotationAngleX,
					Axis = new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
				}
			};
			RotateTransform3D value2 = new RotateTransform3D
			{
				Rotation = new AxisAngleRotation3D
				{
					Angle = ChartModel.Options3D.RotationAngleY,
					Axis = new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)
				}
			};
			RotateTransform3D value3 = new RotateTransform3D
			{
				Rotation = new AxisAngleRotation3D
				{
					Angle = ChartModel.Options3D.RotationAngleZ,
					Axis = new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
				}
			};
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value3);
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value);
			simpleDiagram3D.ContentTransform = transform3DGroup;
			chart.Diagram = simpleDiagram3D;
		}
	}
	public class PieChartConfigurator : ChartConfigurator
	{
		public PieChartConfigurator(Chart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		protected override void ConfigureDiagram(ChartControl chart)

	public class RadarAxesConfigurator : AxisBaseConfigurator
	{
		private RadarChart ChartModel => base.ModelElement as RadarChart;

		protected override DiagramAppearanceConfiguratorBase AppearanceConfigurator => new CircularDiagramAppearanceConfigurator(base.Container);

		protected RadarAxesConfigurator(CircularChart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		public RadarAxesConfigurator(RadarChart chartModel, IModelElementContainer container)
			: base(chartModel, container)
		{
		}

		private void ConfigureAxisX(RadarAxisX2D axis, RadarAxisX modelAxis)
		{
			if (modelAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double gridSpacing = (modelAxis.AutoGrid ? double.NaN : modelAxis.GridSpacing);
			axis.NumericScaleOptions = new ContinuousNumericScaleOptions
			{
				AutoGrid = modelAxis.AutoGrid,
				GridSpacing = gridSpacing
			};
			axis.DateTimeScaleOptions = new ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions
			{
				AutoGrid = modelAxis.AutoGrid,
				GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
				GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)modelAxis.GridAlignment
			};
			ConfigureAxisBase(axis, modelAxis);
			if (modelAxis.Range != null)
			{
				axis.WholeRange = new Range();
				if (modelAxis.Range.MinValue != null)
				{
					axis.WholeRange.MinValue = modelAxis.Range.MinValue;
				}
				if (modelAxis.Range.MaxValue != null)
				{
					axis.WholeRange.MaxValue = modelAxis.Range.MaxValue;
				}
			}
			axis.Logarithmic = modelAxis.Logarithmic;
			if (modelAxis.Logarithmic)
			{
				axis.LogarithmicBase = modelAxis.LogarithmicBase;
			}
		}

		protected void ConfigureAxisY(CircularAxisY2D axis, CircularAxisY modelAxis)
		{
			if (modelAxis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double gridSpacing = (modelAxis.AutoGrid ? double.NaN : modelAxis.GridSpacing);
			axis.NumericScaleOptions = new ContinuousNumericScaleOptions
			{
				AutoGrid = modelAxis.AutoGrid,
				GridSpacing = gridSpacing
			};
			axis.DateTimeScaleOptions = new ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions
			{
				AutoGrid = modelAxis.AutoGrid,
				GridSpacing = gridSpacing,
				GridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)modelAxis.GridAlignment
			};
			axis.Visible = modelAxis.Visible;
			ConfigureAxisBase(axis, modelAxis);
			axis.TickmarksVisible = modelAxis.TickmarksVisible;
			axis.TickmarksMinorVisible = modelAxis.TickmarksMinorVisible;
			axis.TickmarksCrossAxis = modelAxis.TickmarksCrossAxis;
			if (modelAxis.Range != null)
			{
				axis.WholeRange = new Range();
				if (modelAxis.Range.MinValue != null)
				{
					axis.WholeRange.MinValue = modelAxis.Range.MinValue;
				}
				if (modelAxis.Range.MaxValue != null)
				{
					axis.WholeRange.MaxValue = modelAxis.Range.MaxValue;
				}
			}
			axis.Logarithmic = modelAxis.Logarithmic;
			if (modelAxis.Logarithmic)
			{
				axis.LogarithmicBase = modelAxis.LogarithmicBase;
			}
		}

		protected override void ConfigureAxisCore(AxisBase axis, DevExpress.Charts.Model.AxisBase modelAxisBase)
		{
			if (axis is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				ConfigureAxisX((RadarAxisX2D)axis, (RadarAxisX)modelAxisBase);
			}
			if (axis is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				ConfigureAxisY((CircularAxisY2D)axis, (CircularAxisY)modelAxisBase);
			}
		}

		public void Configure(RadarDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			diagram.AxisX = new RadarAxisX2D();
			diagram.AxisY = new RadarAxisY2D();
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.AxisX, ChartModel.ArgumentAxis);
			ConfigureAxis(diagram.AxisY, ChartModel.ValueAxis);
		}
	}

	public class RichTextFormatter
	{
		private static Run CreateRun(RunModel runModel, FontModel defaultFontModel, ColorARGB defaultFontColor)
		{
			Run run = new Run();
			run.Text = runModel.Text;
			FontModel font = runModel.Font;
			if (font.Name != defaultFontModel.Name)
			{
				run.FontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(font.Name);
			}
			if (font.Size != defaultFontModel.Size || font.Subscript || font.Superscript)
			{
				float num = font.Size;
				if (font.Subscript || font.Superscript)
				{
					num *= 0.6f;
				}
				run.FontSize = FontConversion.ConvertFromPointToPixel(num);
			}
			if (font.Bold)
			{
				run.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
			}
			if (font.Italic)
			{
				run.FontStyle = FontStyles.Italic;
			}
			if (font.Strikeout)
			{
				run.TextDecorations.Add(TextDecorations.Strikethrough);
			}
			if (font.Underline)
			{
				run.TextDecorations.Add(TextDecorations.Underline);
			}
			if (font.Superscript)
			{
				run.BaselineAlignment = BaselineAlignment.Superscript;
			}
			if (font.Subscript)
			{
				run.BaselineAlignment = BaselineAlignment.Subscript;
			}
			if (runModel.Color != defaultFontColor)
			{
				run.Foreground = ModelConfiguratorHelper.CreateSolidBrush(runModel.Color);
			}
			return run;
		}

		public static TextBlock CreateContent(IList<ParagraphModel> paragraphs, FontModel defaultFontModel, ColorARGB defaultFontColor)
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock
			{
				TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < paragraphs.Count; i++)
			{
				foreach (RunModel run in paragraphs[i].Runs)
				{
					textBlock.Inlines.Add(CreateRun(run, defaultFontModel, defaultFontColor));
				}
				if (i < paragraphs.Count - 1)
				{
					textBlock.Inlines.Add(new LineBreak());
				}
			}
			return textBlock;
		}
	}

		public Series CreateSeries(SeriesModel seriesModel, bool is3D)
		{
			Type value;
			if (is3D)
			{
				if (modelSeriesMapping3D.TryGetValue(seriesModel.GetType(), out value))
				{
					return (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(value);
				}
			}
			else if (modelSeriesMapping2D.TryGetValue(seriesModel.GetType(), out value))
			{
				return (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (seriesConfiguratorsMapping.TryGetValue(series.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				SeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase[] array = value;
				foreach (SeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase seriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase in array)
				{
					seriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public abstract void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram);
	}
	public class GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator : SeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		private string GetDataMemberValue(Dictionary<DataMemberType, string> dataMembers, DataMemberType key)
		{
			string value = null;
			if (dataMembers.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ConfigureArgumentColorDataMembers(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			series.ArgumentDataMember = GetDataMemberValue(seriesModel.DataMembers, DataMemberType.Argument);
			series.ColorDataMember = GetDataMemberValue(seriesModel.DataMembers, DataMemberType.Color);
		}

		private void ConfigureLegendTextPattern(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			series.LegendTextPattern = seriesModel.LegendPointPattern;
		}

		private void ConfigureScaleTypes(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			series.ArgumentScaleType = (ScaleType)seriesModel.ArgumentScaleType;
			series.ValueScaleType = (ScaleType)seriesModel.ValueScaleType;
		}

		private void ConfigureSeriesLabels(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			series.LabelsVisibility = seriesModel.LabelsVisibility;
			if (seriesModel.Label != null && seriesModel.Label.Formatter != null)
			{
				series.ActualLabel.Formatter = new ModelDataLabelFormatter(seriesModel.Label.Formatter, series);
			}
		}

		protected GeometryMarker2DModel GetMarkerModel(MarkerType markerType)
		{
			return markerType switch
			{
				MarkerType.Cross => new CrossMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Diamond => new DiamondMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Hexagon => new PolygonMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.InvertedTriangle => new InvertedTriangleMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Pentagon => new PentagonMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Plus => new PlusMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Square => new SquareMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Star => new StarMarker2DModel(), 
				MarkerType.Triangle => new TriangleMarker2DModel(), 
				_ => new CircleMarker2DModel(), 
			};
		}

		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			series.DisplayName = seriesModel.DisplayName;
			series.ShowInLegend = seriesModel.ShowInLegend;
			series.DataSource = seriesModel.DataSource;
			ConfigureScaleTypes(series, seriesModel);
			ConfigureArgumentColorDataMembers(series, seriesModel);
			ConfigureLegendTextPattern(series, seriesModel);
			ConfigureSeriesLabels(series, seriesModel);
		}
	}
	public class ColorEachSeriesPropertiesConfigurator : GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			XYSeries xYSeries = (XYSeries)series;
			if (seriesModel is ISupportColorEachSeries)

				xYSeries.ColorEach = ((ISupportColorEachSeries)seriesModel).ColorEach;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class PieSeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase : GeneralSeriesPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			PieSeries series2 = (PieSeries)series;
			ConfigureExplodeMode(series2, (PieSeriesBase)seriesModel);
			ConfigureHoleRadiusPercent(series2, (PieSeriesBase)seriesModel);
		}

		private void ConfigureExplodeMode(PieSeries series, PieSeriesBase seriesModel)
		{
			switch (seriesModel.ExplodeMode)
			{
			case PieExplodeMode.All:
				series.ConfigurationInfo = new PieSeriesConfigurationInfo(seriesModel.ExplodedDistancePercentage / 100.0);
				break;
			case PieExplodeMode.UsePoints:
				series.ConfigurationInfo = new PieSeriesConfigurationInfo(seriesModel.ExplodedDistancePercentage / 100.0, seriesModel.ExplodedPointsIndexes);
				break;
			default:
				series.ConfigurationInfo = new PieSeriesConfigurationInfo(0.0);
				break;
			}
			series.UpdateConfiguration();
		}

		private void ConfigureHoleRadiusPercent(PieSeries series, PieSeriesBase seriesModel)
		{
			if (seriesModel is DevExpress.Charts.Model.PieSeries)
			{
				series.HoleRadiusPercent = 0.0;
			}
			if (seriesModel is DonutSeries)
			{
				series.HoleRadiusPercent = ((DonutSeries)seriesModel).HoleRadiusPercent;
			}
		}
	}
	public class PieSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator : PieSeriesPropertiesConfiguratorBase
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			PieSeries2D pieSeries2D = (PieSeries2D)series;
			PieSeriesBase pieSeriesBase = (PieSeriesBase)seriesModel;
			pieSeries2D.Rotation = pieSeriesBase.RotationAngle;
			pieSeries2D.SweepDirection = ((pieSeriesBase.SweepDirection == DevExpress.Charts.Model.PieSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? PieSweepDirection.Clockwise : PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
			if (seriesModel.Label != null)
			{
				SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
				actualLabel.TextOrientation = (TextOrientation)seriesModel.Label.TextOrientation;
				switch (seriesModel.Label.Position)
				{
				case SeriesLabelPosition.OutsideEnd:
					PieSeries.SetLabelPosition(actualLabel, PieLabelPosition.Outside);
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.Center:
					PieSeries.SetLabelPosition(actualLabel, PieLabelPosition.Inside);
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.BestFit:
					PieSeries.SetLabelPosition(actualLabel, PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns);
					actualLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode = ResolveOverlappingMode.Default;
					pieSeries2D.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent = 3;
					break;
				case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideBase:
				case SeriesLabelPosition.InsideEnd:
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class NestedDonutPropertiesConfigurator : PieSeries2DPropertiesConfigurator
	{
		public override void Configure(Series series, SeriesModel seriesModel, Diagram diagram)
		{
			base.Configure(series, seriesModel, diagram);
			((NestedDonutSeries2D)series).InnerIndent = 0.0;
		}
	}

	public class HeatmapDiagram : Freezable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BorderBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(HeatmapDiagram), new PropertyMetadata(UpdatePane));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BackgroundBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BackgroundBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(HeatmapDiagram), new PropertyMetadata(UpdatePane));

		private Pane pane;

		internal Pane Pane
		{
			get
			{
				return pane;
			}
			set
			{
				pane = value;
				UpdatePane();
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the brush used to paint the heatmap diagram border.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush BorderBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(BorderBrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BorderBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the brush used to fill the heatmap diagram.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		public System.Windows.Media.Brush BackgroundBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(BackgroundBrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BackgroundBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdatePane(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapDiagram heatmapDiagram)
			{
				heatmapDiagram.UpdatePane();
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePane()
		{
			if (Pane != null)
			{
				if (BackgroundBrush != null)
				{
					Pane.DomainBrush = BackgroundBrush;
				}
				if (BorderBrush != null)
				{
					Pane.DomainBorderBrush = BorderBrush;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new HeatmapDiagram();
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapRangeColorProvider : HeatmapPaletteColorProvider
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ApproximateColorsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ApproximateColors", typeof(bool), typeof(HeatmapRangeColorProvider), new PropertyMetadata(OnApproximateColorsChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RangeStopsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RangeStops", typeof(HeatmapRangeStopCollection), typeof(HeatmapRangeColorProvider), new PropertyMetadata(OnUnitCollectionChanged));

		private readonly IColorizerValueProvider valueProvider = new NumericColorizerValueProvider();

		private UnitRangeColorizerBehavior UnitColorizerBehavior => base.ColorizerBehavior as UnitRangeColorizerBehavior;

		[Description("Returns the collection of color ranges for the heatmap range color provider.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		public HeatmapRangeStopCollection RangeStops
		{
			get
			{
				return (HeatmapRangeStopCollection)GetValue(RangeStopsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RangeStopsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Specifies whether to approximate colors.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		public bool ApproximateColors
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ApproximateColorsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ApproximateColorsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private UnitRangeColorizerBehavior RangeBehavior => (UnitRangeColorizerBehavior)base.ColorizerBehavior;

		protected override string DefaultLegendItemPattern => "{V1} - {V2}";

		private static void OnApproximateColorsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapRangeColorProvider heatmapRangeColorProvider)
			{
				heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeBehavior.ApproximateColors = (bool)e.NewValue;
				heatmapRangeColorProvider.NotifyPropertyChanged("ApproximateColors");
			}
		}

		private static void OnUnitCollectionChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapRangeColorProvider heatmapRangeColorProvider)
			{
				heatmapRangeColorProvider.SubscribeOnRangeStops((INotifyCollectionChanged)e.OldValue, (INotifyCollectionChanged)e.NewValue);
				heatmapRangeColorProvider.RangeBehavior.RangeStops = (IList<HeatmapRangeStop>)e.NewValue;
				heatmapRangeColorProvider.NotifyPropertyChanged("RangeStops");
			}
		}

		public HeatmapRangeColorProvider()
		{
			SetValue(RangeStopsProperty, new HeatmapRangeStopCollection());
		}

		private void SubscribeOnRangeStops(INotifyCollectionChanged oldRangeStops, INotifyCollectionChanged newRangeStops)
		{
			if (oldRangeStops != null)
			{
				oldRangeStops.CollectionChanged -= RangeStopsChanged;
			}
			if (newRangeStops != null)
			{
				newRangeStops.CollectionChanged += RangeStopsChanged;
			}
		}

		private void RangeStopsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RangeBehavior.InvalidateRangeStops();
			NotifyPropertyChanged("RangeStops");
		}

		protected override PaletteColorizerBehavior CreateColorizerBehavior()
		{
			return new UnitRangeColorizerBehavior();
		}

		protected internal override int GetColor(HeatmapItem dataItem, double min, double max)
		{
			return ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(UnitColorizerBehavior.GetColor(valueProvider.GetValue(dataItem.Value), min, max, base.ActualPalette));
		}

		protected internal override void Invalidate()
		{
			RangeBehavior.InvalidateRangeStops();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(HeatmapRangeColorProvider)";
		}
	}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LegendItemPatternProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LegendItemPattern", typeof(string), typeof(HeatmapPaletteColorProvider), new PropertyMetadata(OnLegendItemPatternChanged));

		private readonly Palette DefaultPalette = new OfficePalette();

		protected abstract string DefaultLegendItemPattern { get; }

			}

		[Category("Presentation")]

		{
			get

			}

				heatmapPaletteColorProvider.ColorizerBehavior.LegendItemPattern = e.NewValue as string;
				heatmapPaletteColorProvider.NotifyPropertyChanged("LegendItemPattern");
			}
		}

		private static void OnPaletteChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapPaletteColorProvider heatmapPaletteColorProvider)
			{
				heatmapPaletteColorProvider.OnPaletteChanged();
			}
		}

		{
			ColorizerBehavior = CreateColorizerBehavior();
			SetValue(LegendItemPatternProperty, DefaultLegendItemPattern);
			ActualPalette = DefaultPalette;

		{
			return ColorizerBehavior.GetLegendItems(Palette, info);

		private void OnPaletteChanged()
		{
			ActualPalette = Palette ?? DefaultPalette;
			NotifyPropertyChanged("Palette");
		}

	public class HeatmapKeyColorProvider : HeatmapPaletteColorProvider
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeysProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Keys", typeof(ColorizerKeysCollection), typeof(HeatmapKeyColorProvider), new PropertyMetadata(OnKeysPropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeyProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeyProvider", typeof(IColorizerKeyProvider), typeof(HeatmapKeyColorProvider), new PropertyMetadata(OnKeyProviderChanged));

		private KeyColorizerBehavior KeyColorizerBehavior => base.ColorizerBehavior as KeyColorizerBehavior;

		protected override string DefaultLegendItemPattern => "{V}";

		[Description("Gets or sets a key provider that is used to obtain keys based on a custom logic.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		public IColorizerKeyProvider KeyProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return (IColorizerKeyProvider)GetValue(KeyProviderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeyProviderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the collection of keys that the HeatmapKeyColorProvider uses to paint heatmap cells.")]
		[Category("Appearance")]
		public ColorizerKeysCollection Keys
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColorizerKeysCollection)GetValue(KeysProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeysProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnKeysPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapKeyColorProvider heatmapKeyColorProvider)
			{
				ColorizerKeysCollection colorizerKeysCollection = e.NewValue as ColorizerKeysCollection;
				heatmapKeyColorProvider.KeyColorizerBehavior.Keys = colorizerKeysCollection;
				heatmapKeyColorProvider.SubscribeKeyChanged(e.OldValue as ColorizerKeysCollection, colorizerKeysCollection);
				heatmapKeyColorProvider.NotifyPropertyChanged("Keys");
			}
		}

		private static void OnKeyProviderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapKeyColorProvider heatmapKeyColorProvider)
			{
				heatmapKeyColorProvider.KeyColorizerBehavior.KeyProvider = e.NewValue as IColorizerKeyProvider;
				heatmapKeyColorProvider.NotifyPropertyChanged("KeyProvider");
			}
		}

		public HeatmapKeyColorProvider()
		{
			SetValue(KeysProperty, new ColorizerKeysCollection());
		}

		private void SubscribeKeyChanged(ColorizerKeysCollection oldValue, ColorizerKeysCollection newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CollectionChanged -= KeyCollectionChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.CollectionChanged += KeyCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void KeyCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			KeyColorizerBehavior.InvalidateKeys();
			NotifyPropertyChanged("Keys");
		}

		protected internal override int GetColor(HeatmapItem dataItem, double min, double max)
		{
			return ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(KeyColorizerBehavior.GetColor(dataItem.Value, base.ActualPalette));
		}

		protected override PaletteColorizerBehavior CreateColorizerBehavior()
		{
			return new KeyColorizerBehavior();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(HeatmapKeyColorProvider)";
		}
	}
	public abstract class HeatmapDataAdapterBase : NotificationElement, IHeatmapAdapter
	{
		private HeatmapColorProviderBase colorProvider;

		private HeatmapData heatmapData = HeatmapData.Empty;

		internal HeatmapColorProviderBase ColorProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return colorProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				if (SetProperty(ref colorProvider, value, "ColorProvider", delegate
				{
					UpdateData();
				}))
				{
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		protected HeatmapData HeatmapData
		{
			get
			{
				return heatmapData;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref heatmapData, value, "HeatmapData");
			}
		}

		HeatmapData IHeatmapAdapter.HeatmapData => HeatmapData;

		IHeatmapColorProvider IHeatmapAdapter.ColorProvider => colorProvider;

		private static void DataSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapDataSourceAdapter heatmapDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				heatmapDataSourceAdapter.bindingBehavior.UpdateActualDataSource(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void BindingChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapDataSourceAdapter heatmapDataSourceAdapter)
			{
				heatmapDataSourceAdapter.UpdateData();
			}
		}

		public HeatmapDataSourceAdapter()
		{
			bindingBehavior = new BindingBehavior(null);
			bindingBehavior.ActualDataSourceChanged += ActualDataSourceChanged;
		}

		object IHeatmapDataSourceProvider.GetValue(int x, int y, string dataMember)
		{
			return GetValue(x, y, dataMember);
		}

		private void ActualDataSourceChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		private object GetValue(int x, int y, string dataMember)
		{
			return BindingHelperCore.GetValue(base.HeatmapData.GetTag(x, y), DataSource, dataMember);
		}

		protected override void UpdateData()
		{
			base.UpdateData();
			base.HeatmapData = HeatmapData.Create(this);
		}

		protected override object GetColorValue(int x, int y)
		{
			return GetValue(x, y, ColorDataMember);
		}

		protected override bool IsCellEmpty(int x, int y)
		{
			return base.HeatmapData.GetTag(x, y) == null;
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new HeatmapDataSourceAdapter();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(DataSourceAdapter)";
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapMatrixAdapter : HeatmapDataAdapterBase, IHeatmapMatrixProvider, IHeatmapAdapter
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty XArgumentsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("XArguments", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(HeatmapMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty YArgumentsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("YArguments", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(HeatmapMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValuesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Values", typeof(double[,]), typeof(HeatmapMatrixAdapter), new PropertyMetadata(null, DataChanged));

		[Description("Gets or sets arguments for the heatmap x-axis.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public IEnumerable XArguments
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)GetValue(XArgumentsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(XArgumentsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)GetValue(YArgumentsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(YArgumentsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public double[,] Values
		{
			get
			{
				return (double[,])GetValue(ValuesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValuesProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void DataChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			HeatmapMatrixAdapter heatmapMatrixAdapter = d as HeatmapMatrixAdapter;
			heatmapMatrixAdapter.UpdateData();
		}

		protected override void UpdateData()
		{
			base.UpdateData();
			if (base.ColorProvider != null)
			{
				base.HeatmapData = HeatmapData.Create(this);

		{
			return Values[y, x];
		}

		{

		}

		}
