		private static void UpdateAxis(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapAxis heatmapAxis)
			{
				heatmapAxis.UpdateAxisProperties();
			}
		}

		private static void CustomLabelsSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<HeatmapAxis, CustomAxisLabel>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged(d, e, CustomLabelsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, CustomLabelItemTemplateProperty, CustomLabelItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DependencyProperty)null, (Func<HeatmapAxis, IList>)((HeatmapAxis axis) => axis.CustomLabels), (Func<HeatmapAxis, CustomAxisLabel>)((HeatmapAxis axis) => new CustomAxisLabel()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<CustomAxisLabel>)null, d.GetValue(CustomLabelsProperty) as ISupportInitialize, (Action<CustomAxisLabel, object>)TagUtils.AttachTagToChartNonVisualElement, true, true, (Func<CustomAxisLabel, bool>)null, false);
		}

		private static void CustomLabelTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<HeatmapAxis, CustomAxisLabel>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged(d, e, CustomLabelsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		public HeatmapAxis()
		{
			SetValue(CustomLabelsPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<CustomAxisLabelCollection>(null));
		}

		private void InitAxis()
		{
			if (innerAxis != null && !inUpdate)
			{
				inUpdate = true;
				innerAxis.ActualWholeRange.SideMarginsValue = 0.0;
				innerAxis.Interlaced = false;
				innerAxis.GridLinesVisible = false;
				innerAxis.TickmarksMinorVisible = false;
				if (CustomLabels.Count > 0)
				{
					innerAxis.CustomLabels.Clear();
					innerAxis.CustomLabels.AddRange(CustomLabels);
				}
				SetValue(CustomLabelsPropertyKey, innerAxis.GetValue(Axis2D.CustomLabelsProperty));
				inUpdate = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisProperties()
		{
			if (innerAxis != null && !inUpdate)
			{
				inUpdate = true;
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.VisibleProperty, Visible);
				if (Brush != null)
				{
					innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.BrushProperty, Brush);
				}
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.AlignmentProperty, (AxisAlignment)Alignment);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.ReverseProperty, Reverse);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.ThicknessProperty, Thickness);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.LabelVisibilityModeProperty, LabelVisibilityMode);
				innerAxis.SetValue(AxisBase.LabelProperty, Label);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis.TitleProperty, Title);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.TickmarksVisibleProperty, TickmarksVisible);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.TickmarksLengthProperty, TickmarksLength);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.TickmarksThicknessProperty, TickmarksThickness);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.TickmarksCrossAxisProperty, TickmarksCrossAxis);
				innerAxis.ActualQualitativeScaleOptions.SetValue(QualitativeScaleOptions.AutoGridProperty, AutoGrid);
				innerAxis.ActualQualitativeScaleOptions.SetValue(QualitativeScaleOptions.GridSpacingProperty, (double)GridSpacing);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.CustomLabelItemsSourceProperty, CustomLabelItemsSource);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.CustomLabelItemTemplateProperty, CustomLabelItemTemplate);
				innerAxis.SetValue(Axis2D.CustomLabelItemTemplateSelectorProperty, CustomLabelItemTemplateSelector);
				inUpdate = false;
			}
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new HeatmapAxis();
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class HeatmapElementItemsControl : ChartItemsControl
	{
		private HeatmapControl control;

		internal HeatmapLegend Legend { get; set; }

		internal void Update()
		{
			ObservableCollection<Control> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<Control>();
			if (control != null)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(control.ChartDiagram);
				if (Legend != null)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(Legend);
				}
			}
			base.ItemsSource = observableCollection;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			control = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<HeatmapControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			Update();
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapHitInfo : HitInfoBase
	{
		[Description("Returns the value that indicates whether the test point is within an axis.")]
		public override bool InAxis => Axis != null;

		[Description("Indicates whether the test point is within the heatmap legend.")]
		public override bool InLegend => Legend != null;

		[Description("Indicates whether the test point is in a heatmap cell.")]
		public bool InHeatmapCell => HeatmapCell != null;

		[Description("Returns the axis located under the test point.")]
		public HeatmapAxis Axis
		{
			get
			{
				AxisBase elementByType = GetElementByType<AxisBase>();
				if (elementByType != null)
				{
					HeatmapControl heatmapControl = (HeatmapControl)base.Chart;
					if (heatmapControl.ActualAxisX.InnerAxis == elementByType)
					{
						return heatmapControl.ActualAxisX;
					}
					if (heatmapControl.ActualAxisY.InnerAxis == elementByType)
					{
						return heatmapControl.ActualAxisY;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns the legend that is positioned in the test point.")]
		public HeatmapLegend Legend => GetElementByType<HeatmapLegend>();

		[Description("Returns the custom axis label located under the test point.")]
		public CustomAxisLabel CustomAxisLabel => GetCustomAxisLabel();

		[Description("Returns the heatmap cell located under the test point.")]
		public HeatmapCell HeatmapCell => GetElementByType<HeatmapCell>();

		internal HeatmapHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
			: base(chart, point, radius)
		{
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapHitTestResult2D : IHitTestResult
	{
		public HitInfoBase CreateHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
		{
			return new HeatmapHitInfo(chart, point, radius);
		}

	public enum ElementSelectionMode
	{
		None,
		Single,
		Multiple,
		Extended
	}
	public class HeatmapSelectionController : SelectionControllerBase<HeatmapCell>
	{
		public ObservableCollection<HeatmapCell> SelectedCells { get; } = new ObservableCollection<HeatmapCell>();

		public HeatmapSelectionController(HeatmapControl control)
			: base((ISelectionSupportControl)control)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CalculateItemsSelection(IList<HeatmapCell> elements)
		{
			foreach (HeatmapCell element in elements)
			{
				if (!base.SelectedItems.Contains(GetElementContent(element)))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override object GetElementContent(HeatmapCell element)
		{
			return element.Tag ?? element;
		}

		internal override void UpdateElementsSelection()
		{
			SelectedCells.Clear();
			HeatmapSeries heatmapSeries = ((HeatmapControl)base.Control).HeatmapSeries;
			foreach (HeatmapCell cellsByTag in heatmapSeries.GetCellsByTagList(base.SelectedItems))
			{
				SelectedCells.Add(cellsByTag);
			}
		}
	}

		private static void LegendChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl)
			{
				heatmapControl.AddOwner(e.OldValue as IOwnedElement, e.NewValue as IOwnedElement);
				ChartElementHelper.UpdateLegendItems(d, e);
			}
		}

		private static void DataAdapterChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl)
			{
				heatmapControl.UpdateDataAdapter();
			}
		}

		private static void ColorProviderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			HeatmapControl heatmapControl = d as HeatmapControl;
			if (heatmapControl.DataAdapter != null)
			{
				heatmapControl.DataAdapter.ColorProvider = (HeatmapColorProviderBase)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static void LabelChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl && e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent((INotifyPropertyChanged)e.OldValue, (INotifyPropertyChanged)e.NewValue, heatmapControl);
				ChartElementHelper.ChangeOwnerAndUpdateWithClearDiagramCache(d, e);
				heatmapControl.HeatmapSeries.UpdateLabels();
			}
		}

		private static void AxisXPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				((HeatmapControl)d).SetAxisX(e.NewValue as HeatmapAxis);
			}
		}

		private static void AxisYPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				((HeatmapControl)d).SetAxisY(e.NewValue as HeatmapAxis);
			}
		}

		private static void EnableAxisXNavigationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl)
			{
				heatmapControl.ChartDiagram.EnableAxisXNavigation = (bool)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static void EnableAxisYNavigationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl)
			{
				heatmapControl.ChartDiagram.EnableAxisYNavigation = (bool)e.NewValue;
			}
		}

		private static void HeatmapDiagramChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((HeatmapControl)d).SetHeatmapDiagram(e.NewValue as HeatmapDiagram);
		}

		private static void OnSelectedItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl)
			{
				heatmapControl.SelectionController.OnUpdateSelectedItem(e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedItemsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapControl heatmapControl)
			{
				heatmapControl.SelectionController.OnUpdateSelectedItems(e.NewValue as IList);
			}
		}

		public HeatmapControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<HeatmapControl>(this);
			base.SnapsToDevicePixels = true;
			HeatmapSeries heatmapSeries = new HeatmapSeries();
			diagram = new XYDiagram2D(heatmapSeries);
			diagram.ChangeOwner(null, this);
			dataController = new HeatmapDataController(diagram, heatmapSeries);
			diagram.Series.Add(heatmapSeries);
			SetAxisX();
			SetAxisY();
			SetHeatmapDiagram();
			diagram.ActualDefaultPane.InvertViewport = false;
			SetValue(TitlesPropertyKey, ChartElementHelper.CreateInstance<ChartTitleCollection>(this));
			hitTestController = new HeatmapHitTestController(this);
			SelectionController = new HeatmapSelectionController(this);
			navigationController = new HeatmapNavigationController(this);
			defaultToolTipOptions = new HeatmapToolTipOptions();
			toolTipController = new HeatmapToolTipController(this);
			base.KeyUp += navigationController.KeyUp;
			base.KeyDown += navigationController.KeyDown;
			base.MouseMove += navigationController.MouseMove;
			base.MouseWheel += navigationController.MouseWheel;
			base.MouseLeftButtonDown += navigationController.MouseLeftButtonDown;
			base.MouseLeftButtonUp += navigationController.MouseLeftButtonUp;
			base.MouseLeave += navigationController.MouseLeave;
			base.MouseEnter += navigationController.MouseEnter;
			base.ManipulationStarted += navigationController.ManipulationStarted;
			base.ManipulationDelta += navigationController.ManipulationDelta;
			base.ManipulationCompleted += navigationController.ManipulationCompleted;
			base.LayoutUpdated += Control_LayoutUpdated;
			base.SizeChanged += Control_SizeChanged;
		}

		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType != typeof(PropertyChangedWeakEventManager))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sender is HeatmapLabel)
			{
				HeatmapSeries.UpdateLabels();
			}
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
			return true;
		}

		Rect IDockTarget.GetBounds()
		{
			return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), base.RenderSize);
		}

		List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> IAutoLayoutSupport.GetElementsForAutoLayout(System.Windows.Size size)

			return ChartDiagram.GetElementsForAutoLayout(size);
		}

			AddInvalidate(flags);
		}

		void IAutoLayoutSupport.Update()
		{
			ChartElementHelper.UpdateWithClearDiagramCache(this);
		}

		}

		void IPrintableControl.PagePrintedCallback(IEnumerator pageBrickEnumerator, Dictionary<IVisualBrick, IOnPageUpdater> brickUpdaters)
		{
			while (pageBrickEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object current = pageBrickEnumerator.Current;
				ImageBrick val = (ImageBrick)((current is ImageBrick) ? current : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((BrickBase)val).NoClip = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetAxisX(HeatmapAxis newValue = null)
		{
			actualAxisX = newValue ?? new HeatmapAxis();
			AxisX2D axisX2D = new AxisX2D();
			ChartDiagram.AxisX = axisX2D;
			actualAxisX.InnerAxis = axisX2D;
		}

		private void SetAxisY(HeatmapAxis newValue = null)
		{
			actualAxisY = newValue ?? new HeatmapAxis();
			AxisY2D axisY2D = new AxisY2D();
			ChartDiagram.AxisY = axisY2D;
			actualAxisY.InnerAxis = axisY2D;
		}

		private void SetHeatmapDiagram(HeatmapDiagram diagram = null)
		{
			actualHeatmapDiagram = diagram ?? new HeatmapDiagram();
			actualHeatmapDiagram.Pane = this.diagram.ActualDefaultPane;
		}

		private void PrepareForPrintingBeforeResize()
		{
			navigationLayer?.PrepareBeforePrinting();
		}

		private void RestoreAfterPrinting()
		{
			navigationLayer?.RestoreAfterPrinting();
		}

		private void AddOwner(IOwnedElement oldValue, IOwnedElement newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Owner = null;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.Owner = this;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLegends()
		{
			ChartDiagram.ActualDefaultPane.Legends.Clear();
			SetOutsideLegend(null);
			if (Legend != null)
			{
				if (Legend.IsInsidePosition)
				{
					ChartDiagram.ActualDefaultPane.Legends.Add(Legend);
				}
				else
				{
					SetOutsideLegend(Legend);
				}
			}
			InvalidateLegendControls();
		}

		private void SetOutsideLegend(HeatmapLegend legend)
		{
			if (elementItemsControl != null)
			{
				elementItemsControl.Legend = legend;
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateLegendControls()
		{
			elementItemsControl?.Update();
			CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(LayoutHelper.FindElementByType<ChartElementPanelBase>((FrameworkElement)this, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null));
			ChartDiagram.InvalidateLegends();
		}

		private void Control_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
		}

		private void Control_LayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				if (shouldInvalidate <= (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.MeasureDiagram) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(this);
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(ChartDiagram);
				}
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.Titles) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					foreach (Title title in Titles)
					{
						if (!title.Visible.HasValue)
						{
							CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(title);
						}
					}
				}
				if ((shouldInvalidate & InvalidateMeasureFlags.ArrangeDiagram) > (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0)
				{
					ChartDiagram.InvalidateArrange();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				shouldInvalidate = (InvalidateMeasureFlags)0;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDataAdapter()
		{
			if (DataAdapter != null)
			{
				DataAdapter.ColorProvider = ColorProvider;
			}
			dataController.DataAdapter = DataAdapter;
			SelectionController.OnUpdateSelectedItems(SelectedItems);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			ChartDiagram.ClearViewportCache();
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			ChartDiagram.ViewController.ApplyChanges();
			if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width))
			{
				constraint.Width = Math.Max(300.0, base.ActualWidth);
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				constraint.Height = Math.Max(300.0, base.ActualHeight);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected internal void AddInvalidate(InvalidateMeasureFlags flags)
		{
			shouldInvalidate |= flags;
		}

		internal void Highlight(System.Windows.Point? chartPosition)
		{
			HeatmapSeries.HighlightElement = ((HighlightMode == HeatmapHighlightMode.None || !chartPosition.HasValue) ? null : CalcHitInfo(chartPosition.Value)?.HeatmapCell);
		}

		public HeatmapHitInfo CalcHitInfo(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return hitTestController.ProcessHitInfo(point, 0.0, new ChartPointHitTestParameters(point)) as HeatmapHitInfo;
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			base.EndInit();
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)ChartDiagram, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new OnLoadEndUpdateInfo(this), ChartElementChange.ClearDiagramCache | ChartElementChange.UpdateXYDiagram2DItems | ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			navigationLayer = GetTemplateChild("PART_NavigationLayer") as NavigationLayer;
			elementItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("HeatmapElements") as HeatmapElementItemsControl;
			UpdateLegends();
		}

	public class HeatmapLabel : ChartTextElement, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextPatternProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextOrientationProperty;

		internal string ActualTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(TextPattern))
				{
					return TextPattern;
				}
				return "{V}";
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a string pattern that formats heatmap label text.")]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string TextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(TextPatternProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextPatternProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the text orientation for heatmap labels.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public TextOrientation TextOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (TextOrientation)GetValue(TextOrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextOrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler INotifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				PropertyChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				PropertyChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		static HeatmapLabel()
		{
			TextPatternProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TextPattern", typeof(string), typeof(HeatmapLabel), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, NotifyPropertyChanged));
			TextOrientationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("TextOrientation", typeof(TextOrientation), typeof(HeatmapLabel), new PropertyMetadata(TextOrientation.Horizontal, TextOrientationPropertyChanged));
			ChartTextElement.VisibleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(HeatmapLabel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, NotifyPropertyChanged));
		}

		private static void NotifyPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapLabel heatmapLabel)
			{
				heatmapLabel.NotifyPropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
			}
		}

		private static void TextOrientationPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is HeatmapLabel heatmapLabel)
			{
				heatmapLabel.LayoutTransform = TextUtils.CalculateTransform((TextOrientation)e.NewValue);
				heatmapLabel.NotifyPropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
			}
		}

		public HeatmapLabel()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<HeatmapLabel>(this);
		}

		protected void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		protected override void FontPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
		}

		protected override void ElementTemplatePropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapLabelItem

		public object Tag { get; }

		public object ColorValue { get; }

		{
			Text = text;
			Tag = tag;
			ColorValue = colorValue;
			CellIndex = cellIndex;
			HeatmapSeries = heatmapSeries;
		}
	}

	[NonCategorized]
	public class HeatmapLabelItemsPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GeometryProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Geometry", typeof(HeatmapGeometry), typeof(HeatmapLabelItemsPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public HeatmapGeometry Geometry
		{
			get
			{
				return (HeatmapGeometry)GetValue(GeometryProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GeometryProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.Children.Count > 0 && Geometry != null)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					HeatmapLabelItem labelItem = ((HeatmapLabelPresentation)child).LabelItem;
					DXRectangle cellBounds = Geometry.GetCellBounds(labelItem.CellIndex, shouldCalcRelative: true);
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = child.DesiredSize;
					if (desiredSize.Width <= (double)((DXRectangle)(ref cellBounds)).Width && desiredSize.Height <= (double)((DXRectangle)(ref cellBounds)).Height)
					{
						child.Arrange(new Rect((double)(((DXRectangle)(ref cellBounds)).Left + ((DXRectangle)(ref cellBounds)).Width / 2) - desiredSize.Width / 2.0, (double)(((DXRectangle)(ref cellBounds)).Top + ((DXRectangle)(ref cellBounds)).Height / 2) - desiredSize.Height / 2.0, desiredSize.Width, desiredSize.Height));
					}
					else
					{
						child.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
					}
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	internal class HeatmapSeries : XYSeries2D, IRefinedSeriesFactory
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty HighlightElementProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HighlightElement", typeof(HeatmapCell), typeof(HeatmapSeries), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private readonly HeatmapLabel defaultLabel;

		private readonly ObservableCollection<HeatmapLabelItem> labelItems;

		private readonly ColorizerLegendVisibleProvider legendVisible;

		private HeatmapRefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		private HeatmapPresentation heatmapPresentation;

		private bool ActualLabelVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Label != null)
				{
					return Label.Visible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private HeatmapControl Heatmap => (HeatmapControl)Diagram.Container;

		protected override bool Is3DView => false;

		protected internal override Type SupportedDiagramType => typeof(XYDiagram2D);

		protected internal override IPane ActualPane
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Diagram.ActualDefaultPane;
			}
		}

		protected override int PixelsPerArgument => 40;

		internal new XYDiagram2D Diagram => (XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram;

		internal ObservableCollection<HeatmapLabelItem> LabelItems => labelItems;

		internal new HeatmapLabel ActualLabel => Label ?? defaultLabel;

		public new HeatmapLabel Label => Heatmap.Label;

		public ObservableCollection<HeatmapCell> SelectedCells => Heatmap.SelectionController.SelectedCells;

		public HeatmapCell HighlightElement
		{
			get
			{
				return (HeatmapCell)GetValue(HighlightElementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HighlightElementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public HeatmapSeries()
		{
			base.LegendMarkerTemplate = CreateLegendMarkerTemplate();
			defaultLabel = new HeatmapLabel();
			labelItems = new ObservableCollection<HeatmapLabelItem>();
			legendVisible = new ColorizerLegendVisibleProvider(this);
		}

		RefinedSeries IRefinedSeriesFactory.Create(ISeries series, IRefinedSeriesContainer seriesContainer)
		{
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				refinedSeries = new HeatmapRefinedSeries(HeatmapData.Empty, series, seriesContainer);
			}
			return refinedSeries;
		}

		private DataTemplate CreateLegendMarkerTemplate()
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = new DataTemplate();
			dataTemplate.VisualTree = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(HeatmapCellMarkerRenderControl));
			return dataTemplate;
		}

		private void UpdateLabels(HeatmapData heatmapData)
		{
			labelItems.Clear();
			if (!ActualLabelVisible || heatmapData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string actualTextPattern = ActualLabel.ActualTextPattern;
			HeatmapPatternHelper heatmapPatternHelper = new HeatmapPatternHelper(actualTextPattern, heatmapData);
			for (int i = 0; i < heatmapData.XCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < heatmapData.YCoords.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!heatmapData.IsCellEmpty(i, j))
					{
						CellIndex cellIndex = new CellIndex(i, j);
						string text = heatmapPatternHelper.GetText(cellIndex);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
						{
							object tag = heatmapData.GetTag(i, j);
							object colorValue = heatmapData.GetColorValue(i, j);
							labelItems.Add(new HeatmapLabelItem(text, tag, colorValue, cellIndex, this));
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Series CreateObjectForClone()
		{
			return new HeatmapSeries();
		}

		protected override void FillPredefinedPointAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override XYSeriesLabel2DLayout CreateSeriesLabelLayout(SeriesLabelItem labelItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override SeriesPointLayout CreatePointItemLayout(PaneMappingBase mapping, SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateAnnotationPoint(SeriesPoint point)
		{
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointItem pointItem, PaneMapping mapping, Transform transform, bool inLabel)
		{
			return default(System.Windows.Point);
		}

		protected internal override FrameworkElement CreateSeriesPresentation(SeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			heatmapPresentation = new HeatmapPresentation(seriesItem);
			return heatmapPresentation;
		}

		internal override void UpdateLegendItems(IList<LegendItemBase> items, LegendBase legend, ISeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			if (!(Heatmap.ColorProvider is IHeatmapLegendItemsProvider heatmapLegendItemsProvider) || refinedSeries.HeatmapData.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<ColorizerLegendItem> legendItems = heatmapLegendItemsProvider.GetLegendItems(refinedSeries.HeatmapData.ValueRange);
			foreach (ColorizerLegendItem item in legendItems)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorizerBrushCache.Instance.GetBrush(item.Color);
				items.Add(new HeatmapLegendItem(legend, legendVisible, null, item.Text, brush, brush, LegendMarkerLineStyle));
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateHeatmapData(HeatmapData heatmapData)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				refinedSeries.HeatmapData = heatmapData;
				UpdateLabels(heatmapData);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateLabels()
		{
			UpdateLabels(refinedSeries?.HeatmapData);
		}

		internal override void CreateSeriesPointsLayout()
		{
			heatmapPresentation?.InvalidateGeometry();
		}

		public List<HeatmapCell> GetCellsByTagList(IList selectedItems)
		{
			return refinedSeries.HeatmapData.GetCellsByTagList(selectedItems);
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class HeatmapPresentation : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GeometryProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Geometry", typeof(HeatmapGeometry), typeof(HeatmapPresentation), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		private SeriesItem SeriesItem => (SeriesItem)base.DataContext;

		private HeatmapSeries HeatmapSeries => (HeatmapSeries)SeriesItem.Series;

		public ObservableCollection<HeatmapLabelItem> Labels => HeatmapSeries.LabelItems;

		public HeatmapGeometry Geometry
		{
			get
			{
				return (HeatmapGeometry)GetValue(GeometryProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GeometryProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal HeatmapPresentation(SeriesItem seriesItem)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<HeatmapPresentation>(this);
			SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, new Binding
			{
				Source = seriesItem
			});
		}

		private HeatmapGeometry CalculateHeatmapGeometry()
		{
			HeatmapSeries series = HeatmapSeries;
			AxisX2D axisX = series.Diagram.ActualAxisX;
			AxisY2D axisY = series.Diagram.ActualAxisY;
			return HeatmapGeometry.Calculate((HeatmapRefinedSeries)SeriesItem.RefinedSeries, axisX, axisY, delegate(double x, double y)
			{
				//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				System.Windows.Point point = XYDiagram2D.MapInternalToPoint((Pane)series.ActualPane, axisX, axisY, x, y).Point;
				return new DXPoint((int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
			});
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			InvalidateGeometry();
			return constraint;
		}

		internal void InvalidateGeometry()
		{
			Geometry = CalculateHeatmapGeometry();
		}
	}
	[NonCategorized]
	public class HeatmapGeometryPresentation : Canvas, INativeHitTestableElement, IHitTestableElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GeometryProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Geometry", typeof(HeatmapGeometry), typeof(HeatmapGeometryPresentation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeriesItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeriesItem", typeof(SeriesItem), typeof(HeatmapGeometryPresentation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		private HeatmapCell hitTestElement;

		private HeatmapRefinedSeries RefinedSeries => (HeatmapRefinedSeries)SeriesItem.RefinedSeries;

		public SeriesItem SeriesItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (SeriesItem)GetValue(SeriesItemProperty);
			}

			}

		{
			get
			{
				return (HeatmapGeometry)GetValue(GeometryProperty);
			}

			{
				SetValue(GeometryProperty, value);
			}
		}

		object IHitTestableElement.Element => hitTestElement;

		object IHitTestableElement.AdditionalElement => null;

		void INativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			hitTestElement = CalcHitElement(point);
		}

		IList<object> INativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(Rect rect)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private HeatmapCell CalcHitElement(System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (point.HasValue && Geometry != null)
			{
				CellIndex cellIndex = Geometry.CalculateCellIndex(new DXPoint((int)point.Value.X, (int)point.Value.Y));
				HeatmapData heatmapData = RefinedSeries.HeatmapData;
				if (cellIndex.IsValid && !heatmapData.IsCellEmpty(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y))
				{
					object colorValue = heatmapData.GetColorValue(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y);
					object tag = heatmapData.GetTag(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y);
					return new HeatmapCell(heatmapData.XCoords[cellIndex.X], heatmapData.YCoords[cellIndex.Y], colorValue, tag, cellIndex);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private WriteableBitmap CreateBitmap(int[] imageData, System.Windows.Size heatmapSize)
		{
			if (imageData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WriteableBitmap writeableBitmap = new WriteableBitmap((int)heatmapSize.Width, (int)heatmapSize.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null);
			int stride = writeableBitmap.PixelWidth * 4;
			writeableBitmap.WritePixels(new Int32Rect(0, 0, (int)heatmapSize.Width, (int)heatmapSize.Height), imageData, stride, 0);
			return writeableBitmap;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (Geometry != null)
			{
				DXRectangle bounds = Geometry.Bounds;
				double width = ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width;
				bounds = Geometry.Bounds;
				System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(width, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height);
				WriteableBitmap imageSource = CreateBitmap(Geometry.CreateHeatmap(RefinedSeries.HeatmapData), size);
				dc.DrawImage(imageSource, new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), size));
			}
		}
	}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedCellsProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedCells", typeof(ObservableCollection<HeatmapCell>), typeof(HeatmapHighlightGeometryPresentation), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, SelectedCellsPropertyChanged));

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen highlightBorderPen;

		private LinearGradientBrush CreateGradientBrush(byte alpha1, byte alpha2)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				SpreadMethod = GradientSpreadMethod.Repeat,
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(3.0, 3.0),
				MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(alpha1, 0, 0, 0),
				Offset = 0.5
			});
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(alpha2, 0, 0, 0),
				Offset = 0.5
			});
			linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private GeometryGroup CreateGroupGeometry(List<DXRectangle> cellBounds)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GeometryCollection geometryCollection = new GeometryCollection(cellBounds.Count);
			foreach (DXRectangle cellBound in cellBounds)
			{
				geometryCollection.Add(new RectangleGeometry(cellBound.ToRect()));
			}
			return new GeometryGroup
			{
				Children = geometryCollection
			};
		}

		private RectangleGeometry CreateRectangleGeometry(DXRectangle cellBounds)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new RectangleGeometry(cellBounds.ToRect());
		}

		internal Geometry CalculateHighlightGeometry(HeatmapHighlightMode highlightMode, CellIndex cellIndex)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (highlightMode)
			{
			case HeatmapHighlightMode.Cell:
				return CreateRectangleGeometry(Geometry.GetCellBounds(cellIndex, shouldCalcRelative: true));
			case HeatmapHighlightMode.Column:
				return CreateGroupGeometry(Geometry.GetColumnBounds(cellIndex.X, shouldCalcRelative: true));
			case HeatmapHighlightMode.Row:
				return CreateGroupGeometry(Geometry.GetRowBounds(cellIndex.Y, shouldCalcRelative: true));
			case HeatmapHighlightMode.RowAndColumn:
			{
				Geometry item = CreateGroupGeometry(Geometry.GetRowBounds(cellIndex.Y, shouldCalcRelative: true));
				Geometry item2 = CreateGroupGeometry(Geometry.GetColumnBounds(cellIndex.X, shouldCalcRelative: true));
				return new GeometryGroup
				{
					Children = new GeometryCollection(new List<Geometry> { item, item2 }),
					FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero
				};
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Geometry == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (SelectedCells != null)
			{
				foreach (HeatmapCell selectedCell in SelectedCells)
				{
					dc.PushOpacityMask(SelectionOpacityMask);
					Geometry geometry = CreateRectangleGeometry(Geometry.GetCellBounds(selectedCell.Index, shouldCalcRelative: true));
					dc.DrawGeometry(HighlightBrush, null, geometry);
					dc.Pop();
				}
			}
			if (HighlightElement != null)
			{
				dc.DrawGeometry(null, HighlightBorderPen, CreateRectangleGeometry(Geometry.GetCellBounds(HighlightElement.Index, shouldCalcRelative: true)));
				dc.PushOpacityMask(HighlightOpacityMask);
				Geometry geometry2 = CalculateHighlightGeometry(HighlightMode, HighlightElement.Index);
				dc.DrawGeometry(HighlightBrush, null, geometry2);
			}
		}
	}

	public class HeatmapLegendItemList : ObservableCollection<HeatmapLegendItem>, ILegendItemsCollection
	{
		int ILegendItemsCollection.Count => base.Count;

		void ILegendItemsCollection.Update(IList items)
		{
			Update(items);
		}

		private void Update(IList newItems)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < newItems.Count; i++)
			{
				HeatmapLegendItem heatmapLegendItem = (HeatmapLegendItem)newItems[i];
				if (i >= base.Count)
				{
					Add(heatmapLegendItem);
				}
				else if (!base[i].Assign(heatmapLegendItem))
				{
					base[i] = heatmapLegendItem;
				}
			}
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int j = newItems.Count; j < count; j++)
			{
				RemoveAt(newItems.Count);
			}
		}
	}

	public class HeatmapDataController
	{
		private readonly XYDiagram2D heatmap;

		private readonly HeatmapSeries fakeSeries;

		private HeatmapDataAdapterBase adapter;

		public HeatmapDataAdapterBase DataAdapter
		{
			get
			{
				return adapter;
			}
			set
			{
				if (adapter != value)
				{
					UnsubscribeDataAdapter();
					adapter = value;
					SubscribeDataAdapter();
					UpdateData();
				}
			}
		}

		public HeatmapData HeatmapData => GetHeatmapData();

		internal HeatmapDataController(XYDiagram2D heatmap, HeatmapSeries fakeSeries)
		{
			this.heatmap = heatmap;
			this.fakeSeries = fakeSeries;
		}

		private HeatmapData GetHeatmapData()
		{
			return ((IHeatmapAdapter)DataAdapter)?.HeatmapData ?? HeatmapData.Empty;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataAdapter()
		{
			if (DataAdapter != null)
			{
				DataAdapter.PropertyChanged -= OnDataChanged;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeDataAdapter()
		{
			if (DataAdapter != null)
			{
				DataAdapter.PropertyChanged += OnDataChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnDataChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		private void UpdateData()
		{
			fakeSeries.UpdateHeatmapData(GetHeatmapData());
			heatmap.ViewController.Notify(new ChartUpdate(DataAdapter, ChartElementChange.UpdateLegendItems));
			heatmap.ViewController.Notify(new ChartUpdate(new SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo(this, ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, fakeSeries, null, -1, null, -1)));
		}
	}

	public class NotificationElement : Freezable, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new NotificationElement();
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null, PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChangedHandler = null, EventHandler propertyChangingHandler = null)
		{
			if (object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (storage is NotificationElement notificationElement)
			{
				notificationElement.PropertyChanged -= propertyChangedHandler;
			}
			storage = value;
			if (storage is NotificationElement notificationElement2)
			{
				notificationElement2.PropertyChanged += propertyChangedHandler;
			}
			NotifyPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapToolTipController
	{
		private const int PopupOffset = 10;

		private readonly HeatmapControl control;

		private readonly HeatmapTooltipItem tooltipItem;

		private readonly DispatcherTimer initialTimer = new DispatcherTimer();

		private readonly DispatcherTimer popTimer = new DispatcherTimer();

		private EventHandler openPopup;

		private HeatmapToolTipOptions Options => control.ActualToolTipOptions;

		public HeatmapToolTipController(HeatmapControl control)
		{
			this.control = control;
			popTimer.Tick += OnPopTimerTick;
			tooltipItem = new HeatmapTooltipItem();
			control.SetCurrentValue(HeatmapControl.ToolTipItemProperty, tooltipItem);
		}

		private void OnPopTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ClosePopup();
		}

		private void Show(System.Windows.Point position, HeatmapHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (Options.InitialDelay.TotalMilliseconds > 0.0 && !tooltipItem.Visible)
			{
				initialTimer.Interval = Options.InitialDelay;
				openPopup = delegate
				{
					OpenPopup(position, hitInfo);
				};
				initialTimer.Tick += openPopup;
				initialTimer.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				OpenPopup(position, hitInfo);
			}
		}

		private void OpenPopup(System.Windows.Point position, HeatmapHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			initialTimer.Stop();
			UpdateItem(position, hitInfo);
			if (Options.AutoPopDelay.TotalMilliseconds != 0.0)
			{
				popTimer.Interval = Options.AutoPopDelay;
				popTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void ClosePopup()
		{
			initialTimer.Stop();
			initialTimer.Tick -= openPopup;
			popTimer.Stop();
			tooltipItem.Visible = false;
			tooltipItem.Cell = null;
		}

		private void UpdateItem(System.Windows.Point position, HeatmapHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo != null && hitInfo.HeatmapCell != null)
			{
				HeatmapPatternHelper heatmapPatternHelper = new HeatmapPatternHelper(Options.ActualPattern, control.DataController.HeatmapData);
				string text = heatmapPatternHelper.GetText(hitInfo.HeatmapCell.Index);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					tooltipItem.Visible = true;
					System.Windows.Point screenPoint = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(control);
					double num = ChartScreenHelper.Scale(10.0, control);
					tooltipItem.Position = position.MoveByVector(screenPoint.X + num, screenPoint.Y + num);
					tooltipItem.ToolTipText = text;
					tooltipItem.ContentMargin = Options.ContentMargin;
					tooltipItem.Cell = hitInfo.HeatmapCell;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClosePopup();
			}
		}

		public void Update(System.Windows.Point position, ToolTipNavigationAction toolTipNavigationAction)
		{
			if (!control.ToolTipEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeatmapHitInfo heatmapHitInfo = control.CalcHitInfo(position);
			if (heatmapHitInfo?.HeatmapCell == null || (tooltipItem.Visible && tooltipItem.Cell != heatmapHitInfo.HeatmapCell))
			{
				ClosePopup();
				return;
			}
			HeatmapToolTipOptions options = Options;
			if (toolTipNavigationAction == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseFreeMove && options.OpenMode == ToolTipOpenMode.OnHover)
			{
				Show(position, heatmapHitInfo);
			}
			else if (toolTipNavigationAction == ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseUp)
			{
				if (options.CloseOnClick && tooltipItem.Visible)
				{
					ClosePopup();
				}
				else if (options.OpenMode == ToolTipOpenMode.OnClick)
				{
					Show(position, heatmapHitInfo);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Native
{
	public enum AnimationState
	{
		BeforeFirst,
		InProgress,
		Completed
	}
	public class AnimationProgress : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ProgressProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Progress", typeof(double), typeof(AnimationProgress), new PropertyMetadata(1.0, ProgressPropertyChanged));

		private readonly IAnimatableElement element;

		public double Progress
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ProgressProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ProgressProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ActualProgress
		{
			get
			{
				if (element != null)
				{
					if (element.AnimationMode == ChartAnimationMode.Disabled)
					{
						return 1.0;
					}
					switch (element.AnimationState)
					{
					case AnimationState.BeforeFirst:
						if (element.AnimationAutoStartMode != AnimationAutoStartMode.SetFinalState)
						{
							return 0.0;
						}
						return 1.0;
					case AnimationState.InProgress:
						return Progress;
					case AnimationState.Completed:
						break;
					default:
						ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown AnimationState.");
						break;
					}
					return 1.0;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
		}

		private static void ProgressPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is AnimationProgress animationProgress)
			{
				animationProgress.OnProgressChanged();
			}
		}

		public AnimationProgress(IAnimatableElement element)
		{
			this.element = element;
		}

		private void OnProgressChanged()
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				element.ProgressChanged(this);
			}
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			Progress = 0.0;
			OnProgressChanged();
		}

		public void Finish()
		{
			Progress = 1.0;
			OnProgressChanged();
		}
	}
	public static class AnimationHelper
	{
		private const double delayFactor = 4.0;

		private static List<Series> CreateSeriesSubsetBySampleSeries(Series sampleSeries, Diagram diagram)
		{
			List<Series> list = new List<Series>();
			foreach (Series item in diagram.Series)
			{
				if (item.GetType().Equals(sampleSeries.GetType()))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void PrepareAnimation(AnimationBase animation, SeriesAnimationBase seriesAnimation, int seriesIndex)
		{
			animation.BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Math.Round(seriesAnimation.Duration.TotalMilliseconds / 4.0) * (double)seriesIndex);
		}

		public static void PrepareDefaultPointAnimation(SeriesPointAnimationBase pointAnimation, SeriesAnimationBase seriesAnimation, Series series, Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (pointAnimation == null || series == null || diagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Series> list = CreateSeriesSubsetBySampleSeries(series, diagram);
			int num = list.IndexOf(series);
			if (list.Count > 0 && num > -1)
			{
				if (seriesAnimation != null)
				{
					PrepareAnimation(pointAnimation, seriesAnimation, num);
					return;
				}
				pointAnimation.BeginTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(pointAnimation.PointDelay.TotalMilliseconds * (double)num);
				pointAnimation.PointDelay = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(pointAnimation.PointDelay.TotalMilliseconds * (double)list.Count);
			}
		}

		public static void PrepareDefaultSeriesAnimation(SeriesAnimationBase seriesAnimation, Series series, Diagram diagram)
		{
			if (seriesAnimation != null && series != null && diagram != null)
			{
				List<Series> list = CreateSeriesSubsetBySampleSeries(series, diagram);
				int num = list.IndexOf(series);
				if (list.Count > 0 && num > -1)
				{
					PrepareAnimation(seriesAnimation, seriesAnimation, num);
				}
			}
		}

		public static Rect CreateSlideFromLeftAnimatedBounds(Rect bounds, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double x;
			double y;
			if (diagramRotated)
			{
				x = bounds.X;
				y = bounds.Y - (bounds.Y + bounds.Height) * (1.0 - progress);
			}
			else
			{
				x = bounds.X - (bounds.X + bounds.Width) * (1.0 - progress);
				y = bounds.Y;
			}
			double width = bounds.Width;
			double height = bounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static Rect CreateSlideFromRightAnimatedBounds(Rect bounds, Rect viewport, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double x;
			double y;
			if (diagramRotated)
			{
				x = bounds.X;
				y = bounds.Y + (viewport.Width - bounds.Y) * (1.0 - progress);
			}
			else
			{
				x = bounds.X + (viewport.Width - bounds.X) * (1.0 - progress);
				y = bounds.Y;
			}
			double width = bounds.Width;
			double height = bounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static Rect CreateSlideFromTopAnimatedBounds(Rect bounds, Rect viewport, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double x;
			double y;
			if (diagramRotated)
			{
				x = bounds.X + (viewport.Height - bounds.X) * (1.0 - progress);
				y = bounds.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				x = bounds.X;
				y = bounds.Y + (viewport.Height - bounds.Y) * (1.0 - progress);
			}
			double width = bounds.Width;
			double height = bounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static Rect CreateSlideFromBottomAnimatedBounds(Rect bounds, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			double x;
			double y;
			if (diagramRotated)
			{
				x = bounds.X - (bounds.X + bounds.Width) * (1.0 - progress);
				y = bounds.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				x = bounds.X;
				y = bounds.Y - (bounds.Y + bounds.Height) * (1.0 - progress);
			}
			double width = bounds.Width;
			double height = bounds.Height;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static Rect CreateWidenAnimatedMarkerBounds(Rect markerBounds, Rect viewport, bool axisXReverse, bool axisYReverse, bool diagramRotated, double progress)
		{
			if (progress == 0.0)
			{
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			if (progress == 1.0)
			{
				return markerBounds;
			}
			double x = markerBounds.X + markerBounds.Width / 2.0 - markerBounds.Width * progress / 2.0;
			double y = markerBounds.Y + markerBounds.Height / 2.0 - markerBounds.Height * progress / 2.0;
			double width = markerBounds.Width * progress;
			double height = markerBounds.Height * progress;
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public static bool ContainsAnimation(Storyboard root, DoubleAnimation animation)
		{
			foreach (Timeline child in root.Children)
			{
				if (child is Storyboard root2 && ContainsAnimation(root2, animation))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (child as DoubleAnimation == animation)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

	public static class FadeInAnimationHelper
	{
		private static FadeInMode GetCorrectedMode(Series series, FadeInMode mode)
		{
			if (mode == FadeInMode.Auto)
			{
				return series?.AutoFadeInMode ?? FadeInMode.PointsAndLabels;
			}
			return mode;
		}

		public static bool ShouldAnimateSeriesPointOpacity(Series series, FadeInMode mode)
		{
			return GetCorrectedMode(series, mode) switch
			{
				FadeInMode.Points => true, 
				FadeInMode.PointsAndLabels => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public static bool ShouldAnimateSeriesLabelOpacity(Series series, FadeInMode mode)
		{
			return GetCorrectedMode(series, mode) switch
			{
				FadeInMode.Labels => true, 
				FadeInMode.PointsAndLabels => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}
	}
	public static class UnwindAnimationHelper
	{
		public static Rect CreateAnimatedClipBounds(Rect clipBounds, double progress, UnwindDirection unwindDirection)
		{
			double x;
			double y;
			double width;
			double height;
			switch (unwindDirection)
			{
			case UnwindDirection.LeftToRight:
				x = clipBounds.X;
				y = clipBounds.Y;
				width = clipBounds.Width * progress;
				height = clipBounds.Height;
				break;
			case UnwindDirection.RightToLeft:
				x = clipBounds.X + clipBounds.Width * (1.0 - progress);
				y = clipBounds.Y;
				width = clipBounds.Width * progress;
				height = clipBounds.Height;
				break;
			case UnwindDirection.TopToBottom:
				x = clipBounds.X;
				y = clipBounds.Y;
				width = clipBounds.Width;
				height = clipBounds.Height * progress;
				break;
			case UnwindDirection.BottomToTop:
				x = clipBounds.X;
				y = clipBounds.Y + clipBounds.Height * (1.0 - progress);
				width = clipBounds.Width;
				height = clipBounds.Height * progress;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown unwind direction.");
				goto case UnwindDirection.LeftToRight;
			}
			return new Rect(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}
	public static class AnnotationHelper
	{
		public static Thickness GetMaxAnnotationsCorrection(IList<Annotation> annotations)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			foreach (Annotation annotation in annotations)
			{
				annotation.CalculateLayout();
				if (annotation.Layout != null)
				{
					if (annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Top > 0.0)
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Top);
					}
					if (annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Left > 0.0)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Left);
					}
					if (annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Right > 0.0)
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Right);
					}
					if (annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Bottom > 0.0)
					{
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, annotation.Layout.LabelModeCorrection.Bottom);
					}
				}
			}
			return new Thickness(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		public static bool IsSeriesContainsAnnotation(Annotation annotation, Series series)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = ((SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint).SeriesPoint;
			if (annotation.ActualLabelMode && seriesPoint != null)
			{
				return seriesPoint.Series == series;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		MeasureDiagram = 1,

	public class AutoLayoutController
	{
		private GRealSize2D minSize = new GRealSize2D(200.0, 100.0);

		private IAutoLayoutSupport control;

		private System.Windows.Size previousConstraint;

		private HashSet<int> previousElementsId = new HashSet<int>();

		private HashSet<int> previousChangedElementsId = new HashSet<int>();

		private int globalElementsId;

		public void CalculateLayout(IAutoLayoutSupport control, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (constraint == new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0))
			{
				return;
			}
			this.control = control;
			constraint = RemovePaddings(constraint);
			List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> elementsForAutoLayout = this.control.GetElementsForAutoLayout(constraint);
			if (elementsForAutoLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> chartElementsForAutoLayout = GetChartElementsForAutoLayout();
			if (this.control.CalculateAutoLayout)
			{
				SetDefaultVisible(chartElementsForAutoLayout, elementsForAutoLayout);
			}
			else
			{
				VisibilityCalculator visibilityCalculator = new VisibilityCalculator(minSize);
				List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = visibilityCalculator.CalculateLayout(chartElementsForAutoLayout, elementsForAutoLayout);
				if (!ItemsAlreadyCalculated(constraint, elementsForAutoLayout, chartElementsForAutoLayout, list) && list.Count > 0)
				{
					this.control.AddInvalidate((InvalidateMeasureFlags)7);
					List<Title> list2 = list.ConvertAll((ISupportVisibilityControlElement x) => x as Title);
					if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
					{
						this.control.Update();
					}
				}
			}
			if (this.control.HasAnnotations)
			{
				this.control.AddInvalidate(InvalidateMeasureFlags.Annotations);
			}
		}

		private void SetDefaultVisible(List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> chartElements, List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> models)
		{
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			list.AddRange(chartElements);
			foreach (VisibilityLayoutRegion model in models)
			{
				list.AddRange(model.Elements);
			}
			foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item in list)
			{
				item.Visible = true;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size RemovePaddings(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			double num = constraint.Width - control.Padding.Left - control.Padding.Right;
			if (num <= 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			double num2 = constraint.Height - control.Padding.Top - control.Padding.Bottom;
			if (num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			constraint = new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
			return constraint;
		}

		private List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> GetChartElementsForAutoLayout()
		{
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			if (control.Legends != null)
			{
				foreach (LegendBase legend in control.Legends)
				{
					if (!legend.Visible.HasValue && (legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.RightOutside || legend.HorizontalPosition == HorizontalPosition.LeftOutside || legend.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.BottomOutside || legend.VerticalPosition == VerticalPosition.TopOutside))
					{
						list.Add(legend);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (Title title in control.Titles)
			{
				if (!title.Visible.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(title);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private int GetElementID(ISupportVisibilityControlElement element)
		{
			int num = element.Id;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = (element.Id = globalElementsId++);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool ItemsAlreadyCalculated(System.Windows.Size constraint, List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> regions, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> chartElements, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> changed)
		{
			HashSet<int> hashSet = new HashSet<int>();
			HashSet<int> hashSet2 = new HashSet<int>();
			bool flag = previousConstraint == constraint && previousChangedElementsId.Count > 0 && previousElementsId.Count > 0;
			foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item in changed)
			{
				int elementID = GetElementID(item);
				flag &= previousChangedElementsId.Remove(elementID);
				hashSet2.Add(elementID);
			}
			HashSet<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> hashSet3 = new HashSet<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>(chartElements);
			foreach (VisibilityLayoutRegion region in regions)
			{
				hashSet3.UnionWith(region.Elements);
				hashSet3.UnionWith(region.ElementsToRemove);
			}
			foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item2 in hashSet3)
			{
				int elementID2 = GetElementID(item2);
				flag &= previousElementsId.Remove(elementID2);
				hashSet.Add(elementID2);
			}
			flag &= previousElementsId.Count == 0;
			previousConstraint = constraint;
			previousElementsId = hashSet;
			previousChangedElementsId = hashSet2;
			return flag;
		}
	}

	public class AxisLabelsResolveOverlappingHelper
	{
		public static void Process(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, AxisBase axis, AxisAlignment axisAlignment, bool isRadar)
		{
			AxisLabelOverlappingResolver axisLabelOverlappingResolver = CreateOverlappingResolver(labels, axis, axisAlignment, isRadar, outsideLabels: true);
			axisLabelOverlappingResolver.Process();
		}

		public static AxisLabelOverlappingResolver CreateOverlappingResolver(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, AxisBase axis, AxisAlignment axisAlignment, bool isRadar, bool outsideLabels)
		{
			bool mirrored = (axisAlignment == AxisAlignment.Far && outsideLabels) || (axisAlignment != AxisAlignment.Far && !outsideLabels);

		}

	public class Axis2DLabelItemLayout : ILayout, IAxisLabelLayout
	{
		private readonly Rect initialBounds;

		private readonly int gridIndex;

		private readonly bool isCustomLabel;

		private readonly bool isIntersectionAutoLabel;

		private bool visible = true;

		private double angle = -100.0;

		private double radianAngle;

		private double normalizedAngle;

		private GRealPoint2D offset;

		private GRealPoint2D limitsOffset;

		private System.Windows.Point location;

		private System.Windows.Size size;

		private string text = " ";

		private NearTextPosition textPosition;

		public System.Windows.Point BasePoint => new System.Windows.Point(initialBounds.Left, initialBounds.Top);

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				text = value;
			}
		}

		public GRealPoint2D Pivot => new GRealPoint2D(location.X + size.Width / 2.0, location.Y + size.Height / 2.0);

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				visible = value;
			}
		}

		public GRealPoint2D Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				ApplyOffset(offset, value);
				offset = value;
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Size Size => size;

		public System.Windows.Point Location => location;

		public virtual Rect Bounds => GetBounds();

		public virtual double Angle
		{
			get
			{
				return angle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (angle != value)
				{
					angle = value;
					normalizedAngle = MathUtils.NormalizeAngle(angle);
					radianAngle = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(normalizedAngle);
					Rotate();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsOutOfRange { get; set; }

		Rect[] ILayout.ClipRects => new Rect[0];

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsCustomLabel => isCustomLabel;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsIntersectionAutoLabel => isIntersectionAutoLabel;

		GRealSize2D IAxisLabelLayout.Size => new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height);

		int IAxisLabelLayout.GridIndex => gridIndex;

		GRealPoint2D IAxisLabelLayout.LimitsOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return limitsOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				ApplyOffset(limitsOffset, value);
				limitsOffset = value;
			}
		}

		GRealRect2D IAxisLabelLayout.Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsOutOfRange)
				{
					return Bounds.ToGRealRect2D();
				}
				return GRealRect2D.Empty;
			}
		}

		string IAxisLabelLayout.Text => Text;

		bool IAxisLabelLayout.IsIntervalEdge => false;

		public Axis2DLabelItemLayout(Rect bounds, AxisLabelItem labelItem, NearTextPosition textPosition)
		{
			gridIndex = labelItem.GridIndex;
			isCustomLabel = labelItem.IsCustomLabel;
			isIntersectionAutoLabel = labelItem.IsIntersectionAutoLabel;
			initialBounds = bounds;
			IsOutOfRange = false;
			size = new System.Windows.Size(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			location = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);
			this.textPosition = textPosition;
		}

		private void ApplyOffset(GRealPoint2D oldOffset, GRealPoint2D newOffset)
		{
			location = new System.Windows.Point(location.X - oldOffset.X, location.Y - oldOffset.Y);
			location = new System.Windows.Point(location.X + newOffset.X, location.Y + newOffset.Y);
		}

		private Rect GetBounds()
		{
			GRealPoint2D[] array = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotatedItemPoints(new GRealRect2D(location.X, location.Y, size.Width, size.Height), radianAngle);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MaxValue;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			GRealPoint2D[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = array2[i];
				if (gRealPoint2D.X < num)
				{
					num = gRealPoint2D.X;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.X > num3)
				{
					num3 = gRealPoint2D.X;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.Y < num2)
				{
					num2 = gRealPoint2D.Y;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.Y > num4)
				{
					num4 = gRealPoint2D.Y;
				}
			}
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);
		}

		private void Rotate()
		{
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(initialBounds.Left + Offset.X, initialBounds.Top + Offset.Y, initialBounds.Width, initialBounds.Height);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateOffset(AxisLabelPositionHelper.CalculateRotation(textPosition, normalizedAngle), gRealRect2D, radianAngle);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = AxisLabelPositionHelper.CalculateLeftTopPoint(textPosition, gRealRect2D, normalizedAngle, radianAngle, useBoundsRounding: false);
			location = new System.Windows.Point(gRealPoint2D2.X + gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.Y + gRealPoint2D.Y);
			size = new System.Windows.Size(initialBounds.Width, initialBounds.Height);
		}
	}

	public class ActualAxisVisibilityInPanes : AxisVisibilityInPanes
	{
		private bool NeedHideForAllPanes(VisibilityInPaneCollection collection)
		{
			foreach (VisibilityInPane item in collection)
			{
				if (item.Pane == null && !item.Visible)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ActualAxisVisibilityInPanes(Axis2D axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		public void UpdateVisibilityInPanes(VisibilityInPaneCollection collection, IList<IPane> axisPanes)
		{
			Reset(visible: true);
			if (NeedHideForAllPanes(collection))
			{
				foreach (IPane axisPane in axisPanes)
				{
					SetVisibilityInPaneCore(axisPane, visible: false);
				}
			}
			foreach (VisibilityInPane item in collection)
			{
				SetVisibilityInPaneCore(item.ActualPane, item.Visible);
			}
		}
