	public class IntervalsGridAndTextData
	{
		private readonly List<GridAndTextData> gridAndTextData = new List<GridAndTextData>();

		private readonly List<IntervalLayout> intervalLayouts = new List<IntervalLayout>();

		private readonly List<GRealRect2D> intervalsBounds = new List<GRealRect2D>();

		private double axisLength;

		public List<GridAndTextData> GridAndTextData => gridAndTextData;

		public List<IntervalLayout> IntervalLayouts => intervalLayouts;

		public List<GRealRect2D> IntervalsBounds => intervalsBounds;

		public double AxisLength => axisLength;

		public IntervalsGridAndTextData(IEnumerable<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalLayouts, AxisBase axis, System.Windows.Size size, bool navigationEnabled, double axisLength)
		{
			this.axisLength = axisLength;
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout intervalLayout in intervalLayouts)
			{
				AxisInterval interval = intervalLayout.Interval;
				gridAndTextData.Add(new GridAndTextData(axis.GetSeries(), axis, navigationEnabled, interval.Range, intervalLayout.Bounds.Length, staggered: false));
				this.intervalLayouts.Add(new IntervalLayout(interval, intervalLayout.Bounds));
				intervalsBounds.Add(CalculateBounds(axis, size, intervalLayout.Bounds));
			}
		}

		private GRealRect2D CalculateBounds(AxisBase axis, System.Windows.Size size, Interval interval)
		{
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				return new GRealRect2D(0.0, axis.IsReversed ? interval.Start : (size.Height - interval.End), size.Width, interval.Length);
			}
			return new GRealRect2D(axis.IsReversed ? (size.Width - interval.End) : interval.Start, 0.0, interval.Length, size.Height);
		}

		public void UpdateIntervalsLayout(Axis2D axis, System.Windows.Size size, double axisLength)
		{
			this.axisLength = axisLength;
			intervalLayouts.Clear();
			intervalsBounds.Clear();
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in AxisIntervalLayout.CreateIntervalsLayout(axis, (int)axisLength))
			{
				AxisInterval interval = item.Interval;
				intervalLayouts.Add(new IntervalLayout(interval, item.Bounds));
				intervalsBounds.Add(CalculateBounds(axis, size, item.Bounds));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator
	{
		protected readonly Axis2DItem axisItem;

		protected readonly Rect viewport;

		protected readonly Rect diagramBounds;

		protected readonly CircularDiagramRotationDirection rotationDirection;

		protected readonly double startAngle;

		private readonly IAxisMappingCore axisMapping;

		protected IAxisMappingCore AxisMapping => axisMapping;

		public static void CalculateLayout(Axis2DItem axisItem, Rect viewport, Rect diagramBounds, CircularDiagramRotationDirection direction, double startAngle, ref Thickness offsets)
		{
			CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator circularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator = ((!(axisItem.Axis is CircularAxisY2D)) ? ((CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator)new RoundAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator(axisItem, viewport, direction, startAngle, diagramBounds)) : ((CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator)new VerticalAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator(axisItem, viewport, direction, startAngle, diagramBounds)));
			circularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator.CreateLayout();
		}

		protected CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator(Axis2DItem axisItem, Rect viewport, Rect diagramBounds, CircularDiagramRotationDirection direction, double startAngle)
		{
			this.axisItem = axisItem;
			this.viewport = viewport;
			this.diagramBounds = diagramBounds;
			rotationDirection = direction;
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			axisMapping = axisItem.Axis.CreateMapping(null, viewport);
		}

		private void CreateLayout()
		{
			AxisBase axis = axisItem.Axis;
			Axis2DElementLayout layout = new Axis2DElementLayout(CalculateAxisItemRect(), new Rect[0]);
			IList<AxisLabelItem> labelItems = axisItem.LabelItems;
			bool flag = true;
			if (axis is CircularAxisY2D && !((CircularAxisY2D)axis).Visible)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			Rect labelRect;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (labelItems == null || labelItems.Count == 0)
				{
					labelRect = RectExtensions.Zero;
				}
				else if (axis.LabelsVisible && labelItems != null)
				{
					List<IAxisLabelLayout> list = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();
					foreach (AxisLabelItem item in labelItems)
					{
						IAxisLabelLayout axisLabelLayout = new CircularAxis2DLabelItemLayout(CalculateLabelItemRect(item), item);
						axisLabelLayout.Visible = !item.IsOutOfRange;
						list.Add(axisLabelLayout);
					}
					AxisLabelsResolveOverlappingHelper.Process(list, axis, AxisAlignment.Near, isRadar: true);
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						labelItems[i].Visible = list[i].Visible;
						labelItems[i].Layout = (labelItems[i].Visible ? (list[i] as Axis2DLabelItemLayout) : null);
					}
					labelRect = Rect.Empty;
					foreach (AxisLabelItem item2 in labelItems)
					{
						if (item2.Visible)
						{
							Rect bounds = item2.Layout.Bounds;
							if (labelRect.IsEmpty)
							{
								labelRect = bounds;
							}
							else
							{
								labelRect.Union(bounds);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (AxisLabelItem item3 in labelItems)
					{
						item3.Layout = null;
					}
					labelRect = RectExtensions.Zero;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				layout = null;
				if (labelItems != null)
				{
					foreach (AxisLabelItem item4 in labelItems)
					{
						item4.Layout = null;
					}
				}
				labelRect = RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			axisItem.Layout = layout;
			axisItem.LabelRect = labelRect;
		}

		protected abstract Rect CalculateLabelItemRect(AxisLabelItem labelItem);

		protected abstract Rect CalculateAxisItemRect();
	}
	public class VerticalAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator : CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator
	{
		private Rect axisItemRect;

		internal VerticalAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator(Axis2DItem axisItem, Rect viewport, CircularDiagramRotationDirection direction, double startAngle, Rect diagramBounds)
			: base(axisItem, viewport, diagramBounds, direction, startAngle)
		{
		}

		protected override Rect CalculateAxisItemRect()
		{
			double num = (((CircularAxisY2D)axisItem.Axis).TickmarksCrossAxis ? (axisItem.TotalThickness / 2.0) : ((double)axisItem.Thickness / 2.0 + (double)axisItem.MaxTickmarksLength));
			axisItemRect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.5 * (viewport.Left + viewport.Right) - num, viewport.Top), new System.Windows.Size(axisItem.TotalThickness, 0.5 * viewport.Height));
			return axisItemRect;
		}

		protected override Rect CalculateLabelItemRect(AxisLabelItem labelItem)
		{
			System.Windows.Size measuredSize = labelItem.MeasuredSize;
			double normalizedStartAngleInRadian = GetNormalizedStartAngleInRadian();
			Vector vector = new Vector(Math.Cos(normalizedStartAngleInRadian), 0.0 - Math.Sin(normalizedStartAngleInRadian));
			double axisValue = base.AxisMapping.GetAxisValue(labelItem.InternalValue);
			System.Windows.Point point = RectExtension.Center(viewport);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = Vector.Add(vector * axisValue, point);
			point2.X -= measuredSize.Width / 2.0;
			point2.Y -= measuredSize.Height / 2.0;
			double num = Math.Sqrt(measuredSize.Height * measuredSize.Height + measuredSize.Width * measuredSize.Width);
			Vector vector2 = new Vector(vector.Y, 0.0 - vector.X);
			vector2.Normalize();
			point2 = Vector.Add(vector2 * ((double)axisItem.MaxTickmarksLength + num / 2.0), point2);
			return new Rect(point2, measuredSize);
		}

		private double GetNormalizedStartAngleInRadian()
		{
			double num = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(startAngle);
			if (rotationDirection == CircularDiagramRotationDirection.Clockwise)
			{
				num = 0.0 - num;
			}
			return num + Math.PI / 2.0;
		}
	}
	public class RoundAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator : CircularAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator
	{
		private new CircularAxisXMapping AxisMapping => base.AxisMapping as CircularAxisXMapping;

		internal RoundAxis2DElementsLayoutCalculator(Axis2DItem axisItem, Rect viewport, CircularDiagramRotationDirection direction, double startAngle, Rect diagramBounds)
			: base(axisItem, viewport, diagramBounds, direction, startAngle)
		{
		}

		protected override Rect CalculateLabelItemRect(AxisLabelItem labelItem)
		{
			if (AxisMapping.IsLastValue(labelItem.InternalValue))
			{
				labelItem.Layout = null;
				return RectExtensions.Zero;
			}
			double normalizedAngleRadian = AxisMapping.GetNormalizedAngleRadian(labelItem.InternalValue);
			double num = Math.Cos(normalizedAngleRadian);
			double num2 = 0.0 - Math.Sin(normalizedAngleRadian);
			System.Windows.Point point = RectExtension.Center(viewport);
			GRealPoint2D pointOnCircularAxis = AxisMapping.GetPointOnCircularAxis(labelItem.InternalValue, point.ToGRealPoint2D());
			System.Windows.Size measuredSize = labelItem.MeasuredSize;
			if (Math.Round(num, 12) == 0.0)
			{
				pointOnCircularAxis.X -= measuredSize.Width / 2.0;
			}
			else if (num < 0.0)
			{
				pointOnCircularAxis.X -= measuredSize.Width;
			}
			if (Math.Round(num2, 12) == 0.0)
			{
				pointOnCircularAxis.Y -= measuredSize.Height / 2.0;
			}
			else if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				pointOnCircularAxis.Y -= measuredSize.Height;
			}
			return new Rect(pointOnCircularAxis.X, pointOnCircularAxis.Y, measuredSize.Width, measuredSize.Height);
		}

		protected override Rect CalculateAxisItemRect()
		{
			return viewport;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class RangeDataBase : ChartElement, IAxisRangeData, IMinMaxValues
	{
		private class RangeChangeChecker
		{
			private readonly RangeDataBase range;

			private RangeSnapshot oldRange;

			private RangeSnapshot newRange;

			public bool Changed
			{
				get
				{
					if (newRange != null && oldRange != null)
					{
						return !newRange.IsSame(oldRange);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public RangeChangeChecker(RangeDataBase range)
			{
				this.range = range;
			}

			private void Clear()
			{
				oldRange = null;
				newRange = null;
			}

			private void ClearRangeChangeChecker()
			{
				if (range.Axis.WholeRangeData != range)
				{
					range.Axis.WholeRangeData.rangeChangeChecker.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					range.Axis.VisualRangeData.rangeChangeChecker.Clear();
				}
			}

			public void UpdateMeasureUnit()
			{
				if (Changed)
				{
					if (!range.Axis.IsValuesAxis)
					{
						range.Axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit();
						range.Axis.UpdateIntervalsWithPropertyChange();
					}
					Clear();
					ClearRangeChangeChecker();
				}
			}

			public void CacheOldValues()
			{
				if (oldRange == null)
				{
					Clear();
					oldRange = new RangeSnapshot(range);
				}
			}

			public void CacheNewValues()
			{
				if (oldRange != null)
				{
					newRange = new RangeSnapshot(range);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly RangeChangeChecker rangeChangeChecker;

		private SideMarginSizeUnitNative sideMarginSizeUnit;

		private SideMarginMode autoSideMarginsValue = SideMarginMode.Enable;

		private object min;

		private object max;

		private double minInternal = double.NaN;

		private double maxInternal = double.NaN;

		private double minRefined = double.NaN;

		private double maxRefined = double.NaN;

		private MinMaxValues sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(0.0);

		private double actualStartSideMargin;

		private double actualEndSideMargin;

		private bool isMinChanged;

		private bool isMaxChanged;

		private bool autoMin = true;

		private bool autoMax = true;

		private RangeCorrectionMode correctionModeValue;

		public AxisBase Axis => axis as AxisBase;

		public virtual double ActualStartSideMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return actualStartSideMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((actualStartSideMargin != value && !double.IsNaN(value)) || SideMarginSizeUnit == SideMarginSizeUnitNative.AxisRangePercentage)
				{
					OnSideMarginsValueChanged();
					actualStartSideMargin = value;
					autoSideMarginsValue = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
				else if (value == 0.0)
				{
					OnSideMarginsValueChanged();
					AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double ActualEndSideMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return actualEndSideMargin;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((actualEndSideMargin != value && !double.IsNaN(value)) || SideMarginSizeUnit == SideMarginSizeUnitNative.AxisRangePercentage)
				{
					OnSideMarginsValueChanged();
					actualEndSideMargin = value;
					autoSideMarginsValue = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
				else if (value == 0.0)
				{
					OnSideMarginsValueChanged();
					AutoSideMargins = SideMarginMode.UserDisable;
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual SideMarginMode AutoSideMargins
		{
			get
			{
				return autoSideMarginsValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != autoSideMarginsValue)
				{
					autoSideMarginsValue = value;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual object MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				return min;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null && (!value.Equals(min) || !isMinChanged))
				{
					isMinChanged = true;
					CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Min = 0.0;
					autoMin = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
					min = value;
					minInternal = double.NaN;
					minRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(min);
					if (minRefined > maxRefined)
					{
						maxRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(max);
					}
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual object MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				return max;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null && (!value.Equals(max) || !isMaxChanged))
				{
					isMaxChanged = true;
					CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Max = 0.0;
					autoMax = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
					max = value;
					maxInternal = double.NaN;
					maxRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(max);
					if (minRefined > maxRefined)
					{
						minRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(min);
					}
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double MinValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return minInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (minInternal != value && (!double.IsNaN(value) || !double.IsNaN(minInternal)))
				{
					CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Min = 0.0;
					autoMin = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
					min = null;
					minInternal = value;
					minRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(minInternal);
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double MaxValueInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return maxInternal;
			}
			set
			{
				if (maxInternal != value && (!double.IsNaN(value) || !double.IsNaN(maxInternal)))
				{
					CacheOldValues();
					sideMargins.Max = 0.0;
					autoMax = false;
					correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
					max = null;
					maxInternal = value;
					maxRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(maxInternal);
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AutoMin
		{
			get
			{
				return autoMin;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != autoMin)
				{
					autoMin = value;
					correctionModeValue = ((!autoMin || !autoMax) ? correctionModeValue : RangeCorrectionMode.Auto);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AutoMax
		{
			get
			{
				return autoMax;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != autoMax)
				{
					autoMax = value;
					correctionModeValue = ((!autoMin || !autoMax) ? correctionModeValue : RangeCorrectionMode.Auto);
					RaiseControlChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public RangeCorrectionMode CorrectionMode
		{
			get
			{
				return correctionModeValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (correctionModeValue != value)
				{
					CacheOldValues();
					correctionModeValue = value;
					autoMin = value == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
					autoMax = value == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public double Delta => Math.Abs(maxInternal - minInternal);

		public virtual bool AlwaysShowZeroLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public virtual SideMarginSizeUnitNative SideMarginSizeUnit
		{
			get
			{
				return sideMarginSizeUnit;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != sideMarginSizeUnit)
				{
					sideMarginSizeUnit = value;
					ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
					UpdateMeasureUnit();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsZeroRange => ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(MaxValueInternal - MinValueInternal, 0.0, double.Epsilon) == 0;

		bool IAxisRangeData.Auto => correctionModeValue == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;

		public RangeDataBase(IAxisData axis)
		{
			ChangeOwner(null, axis as IChartElement);
			this.axis = axis;
			if (!axis.IsValueAxis)
			{
				rangeChangeChecker = new RangeChangeChecker(this);
			}
		}

		void IAxisRangeData.Reset(bool needUpdate, bool resetMin, bool resetMax)
		{
			Reset(needUpdate, resetMin, resetMax);
		}

		bool IAxisRangeData.Contains(double value)
		{
			if (MinValueInternal <= value)
			{
				return value <= MaxValueInternal;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IAxisRangeData.UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			UpdateRange(min, max, internalMin, internalMax);
		}

		void IAxisRangeData.ApplyState(RangeSnapshot rangeSnapshot)
		{
			minInternal = rangeSnapshot.Min;
			maxInternal = rangeSnapshot.Max;
			min = rangeSnapshot.MinValue;
			max = rangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
		}

		double IMinMaxValues.CalculateCenter()
		{
			return MinMaxValues.CalculateCenter(this);
		}

		void IMinMaxValues.Intersection(IMinMaxValues minMaxValues)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = MinMaxValues.Intersection(this, minMaxValues);
			maxInternal = minMaxValues2.Max;
			minInternal = minMaxValues2.Min;
		}

		private void CacheOldValues()
		{
			if (rangeChangeChecker != null)
			{
				rangeChangeChecker.CacheOldValues();
			}
		}

		private void CacheNewValues()
		{
			if (rangeChangeChecker != null)
			{
				rangeChangeChecker.CacheNewValues();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (rangeChangeChecker != null)
			{
				rangeChangeChecker.UpdateMeasureUnit();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax)
		{
			CacheOldValues();
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			minInternal = internalMin;
			maxInternal = internalMax;
			CacheNewValues();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSideMarginsValueChanged()
		{
		}

		public virtual void Assign(RangeDataBase axisRange)
		{
			if (axisRange != null)
			{
				correctionModeValue = axisRange.correctionModeValue;
				min = axisRange.min;
				max = axisRange.max;
				minInternal = axisRange.minInternal;
				maxInternal = axisRange.maxInternal;
				minRefined = axisRange.minRefined;
				maxRefined = axisRange.maxRefined;
				autoSideMarginsValue = axisRange.autoSideMarginsValue;
				autoMax = axisRange.autoMax;
				autoMin = axisRange.autoMin;
				sideMargins.Max = axisRange.sideMargins.Max;
				sideMargins.Min = axisRange.sideMargins.Min;
				sideMargins = axisRange.sideMargins;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Reset(bool needUpdate, bool resetMin, bool resetMax)
		{
			if (resetMax)
			{
				autoMax = true;
			}
			if (resetMin)
			{
				autoMin = true;
			}
			if (resetMax && resetMin)
			{
				correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Auto;
			}
			if (needUpdate)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)axis, new PropertyUpdateInfo(this, "AutoRange"));
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetRange(object min, object max, double internalMin, double internalMax, bool needUpdate, bool isRangeControl = false)
		{
			autoMin = false;
			autoMax = false;
			if (min != null || max != null)
			{
				correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.Values;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(internalMin) || !double.IsNaN(internalMax))
			{
				correctionModeValue = RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues;
			}
			CacheOldValues();
			sideMargins.Min = 0.0;
			sideMargins.Max = 0.0;
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			minInternal = internalMin;
			maxInternal = internalMax;
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null)
			{
				if (min != null && max != null)
				{
					minRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(min);
					maxRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(max);
				}
				else if (!double.IsNaN(internalMin) && !double.IsNaN(internalMax))
				{
					minRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(internalMin);
					maxRefined = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(internalMax);
				}
			}
			if (needUpdate)
			{
				ChartElementHelper.Update(this);
			}
			CacheNewValues();
			UpdateMeasureUnit();
			axis.IsUpdating = true;
			ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)this, (ChartUpdateInfoBase)new RangeChangedUpdateInfo(this, axis.IsArgumentAxis));
		}
	}

	public static class GeometryCreator
	{
		public static Geometry CreateGeometry(IList<GRealPoint2D> points, bool close)
		{
			System.Windows.Point[] points2 = CreateWpfPoints(points);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry
			{
				Figures = new PathFigureCollection
				{
					new PathFigure
					{
						Segments = new PathSegmentCollection
						{
							new PolyLineSegment(points2, isStroked: false)
						},
						IsClosed = close
					}
				}
			};
			pathGeometry.Freeze();
			return pathGeometry;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point[] CreateWpfPoints(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			System.Windows.Point[] array = new System.Windows.Point[points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new System.Windows.Point(points[i].X, points[i].Y);
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public static class PaneAreaPresentationCreator
	{
		private static BorderPresentation CreateBorderPresentation(PaneAreaSide side, IList<GRealPoint2D> path, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			if (!side.IsInner)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions = (ScaleBreakOptions)side.Options;
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = scaleBreakOptions.ActualLineStyle.CreatePen(scaleBreakOptions.ActualBrush);
			return new BorderPresentation((path != null) ? GeometryCreator.CreateWpfPoints(path) : new System.Windows.Point[2] { start, end }, pen);
		}

		private static List<BorderPresentation> CreateBorderPresentations(XYDiagramPaneArea area)
		{
			List<BorderPresentation> list = new List<BorderPresentation>();
			if (!area.TopSide.IsInner && !area.BottomSide.IsInner && !area.LeftSide.IsInner && !area.RightSide.IsInner)
			{
				return list;
			}
			GRealRect2D bounds = area.Bounds;
			BorderPresentation borderPresentation = CreateBorderPresentation(area.TopSide, area.TopPath, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Top), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Top));
			if (borderPresentation != null)
			{
				list.Add(borderPresentation);
			}
			borderPresentation = CreateBorderPresentation(area.BottomSide, area.BottomPath, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom));
			if (borderPresentation != null)
			{
				list.Add(borderPresentation);
			}
			borderPresentation = CreateBorderPresentation(area.LeftSide, area.LeftPath, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Top), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom));
			if (borderPresentation != null)
			{
				list.Add(borderPresentation);
			}
			borderPresentation = CreateBorderPresentation(area.RightSide, area.RightPath, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Top), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom));
			if (borderPresentation != null)
			{
				list.Add(borderPresentation);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static List<BorderPresentation> CreateBorderPresentations(XYDiagramPaneAreas paneAreas)
		{
			List<BorderPresentation> list = new List<BorderPresentation>();
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea area in paneAreas.Areas)
			{
				list.AddRange(CreateBorderPresentations(area));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramPaneAreas
	{
		private readonly RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry = new RaggedEdgeGeometry(shouldCutEdge: false);

		private readonly WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry = new WavedEdgeGeometry(shouldCutEdge: false);

		private readonly List<XYDiagramPaneArea> areas = new List<XYDiagramPaneArea>();

		private Geometry clipRegion;

		public Geometry ClipRegion => clipRegion;

		public List<XYDiagramPaneArea> Areas => areas;

		public XYDiagramPaneAreas(List<Tuple<Axis2D, IntervalsGridAndTextData>> axesIntervals)
		{
			if (axesIntervals.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Axis2D item = axesIntervals[0].Item1;
			List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list = XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator.GenerateAreas(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, item, item.ActualScaleBreakOptions, axesIntervals[0].Item2.IntervalsBounds);
			for (int i = 1; i < axesIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				item = axesIntervals[i].Item1;
				List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list2 = XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator.GenerateAreas(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, item, item.ActualScaleBreakOptions, axesIntervals[i].Item2.IntervalsBounds);
				List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list3 = new List<XYDiagramPaneArea>();
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item2 in list2)
				{
					foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item3 in list)
					{
						XYDiagramPaneArea xYDiagramPaneArea = XYDiagramPaneArea.Intersect(item2, item3);
						if (xYDiagramPaneArea != null)
						{
							list3.Add(xYDiagramPaneArea);
						}
					}
				}
				list = list3;
			}
			foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item4 in list)
			{
				item4.Complete();
				areas.Add(item4);
			}
			CalculateClipRegion();
		}

		private void CalculateClipRegion()
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			for (int i = 0; i < areas.Count; i++)
			{
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(GeometryCreator.CreateGeometry(areas[i].Border, close: true));
			}
			clipRegion = geometryGroup;
		}
	}

	public class ScaleBreakEdge : IAxisValueContainer
	{
		private readonly ScaleBreak scaleBreak;

		private object axisValue;

		private double value;

		public object AxisValue
		{
			get
			{
				return axisValue;
			}
			set
			{
				axisValue = value;
			}
		}

		public double Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAxisValueContainer.Axis => scaleBreak.Axis;

		bool IAxisValueContainer.IsEnabled => scaleBreak.Visible;

		CultureInfo IAxisValueContainer.Culture => CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

		object IAxisValueContainer.UserValue => axisValue;

		public ScaleBreakEdge(ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
			: this(scaleBreak, null)
		{
		}

		public ScaleBreakEdge(ScaleBreak scaleBreak, object axisValue)
		{
			this.scaleBreak = scaleBreak;
			this.axisValue = axisValue;
		}

		private object ConvertValueWithAxisScaleMap(object value)
		{
			if (value is string && (string)value == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IAxisData axis = scaleBreak.Axis;
			if (axis == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap != null)
			{
				return axisScaleTypeMap.ConvertValue(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void Update(object axisValue)
		{
			axisValue = ConvertValueWithAxisScaleMap(axisValue);
			this.axisValue = axisValue;
			if (this.axisValue == null)
			{
				value = double.NaN;
			}
		}
	}
	public class AutoScaleBreaksCreator : IAutoScaleBreaksCreator
	{
		private readonly AutoScaleBreaks autoScaleBreaks;

		public AutoScaleBreaksCreator(AutoScaleBreaks autoScaleBreaks)
		{
			this.autoScaleBreaks = autoScaleBreaks;
		}

		IEnumerable<IScaleDiapason> IAutoScaleBreaksCreator.Calculate(List<double> axisValues, int maxScaleBreaksCount)
		{
			IAutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator automaticScaleBreaksCalculator = autoScaleBreaks.AutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator;
			if (automaticScaleBreaksCalculator != null)
			{
				return automaticScaleBreaksCalculator.Calculate(axisValues, maxScaleBreaksCount);
			}
			return DefaultAutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator.Calculate(this, axisValues, maxScaleBreaksCount);
		}

		IScaleDiapason IAutoScaleBreaksCreator.CreatePlatformAutoScaleBreak(double edge1, double edge2)
		{
			return new AutomaticScaleBreak(edge1, edge2);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ScrollBarLayoutCalculator
	{
		private const double thumbSizeAccuracy = 0.0001;

		private readonly AxisScrollBar parent;

		protected AxisScrollBar Parent => parent;

		public abstract DependencyProperty SizeProperty { get; }

		public AxisScrollBarThumb Thumb { get; set; }

		public AxisScrollBarThumbResizer ThumbIncrease { get; set; }

		public AxisScrollBarThumbResizer ThumbDecrease { get; set; }

		public RepeatButton SmallIncrease { get; set; }

		public RepeatButton SmallDecrease { get; set; }

		public RepeatButton LargeIncrease { get; set; }

		public RepeatButton LargeDecrease { get; set; }

		public Grid Container { get; set; }

		public FrameworkElement Root { get; set; }

		public ScrollBarBorder Background { get; set; }

		public double TrackLength => GetParentSize() - GetControlSize(SmallDecrease) - GetControlSize(SmallIncrease);

		public double ThumbMinSize => Math.Max(GetControlMinSize(Thumb), GetControlSize(ThumbDecrease) + GetControlSize(ThumbIncrease));

		protected ScrollBarLayoutCalculator(AxisScrollBar parent)
		{
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		private void SetElementsVisibility(Visibility visibility, params UIElement[] elements)
		{
			foreach (UIElement uIElement in elements)
			{
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.Visibility = visibility;
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract double GetParentSize();

		protected abstract double GetControlSize(Control control);

		protected abstract double GetControlMinSize(Control control);

		public void UpdateElementsLayout()
		{
			double num = TrackLength;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				SetElementsVisibility(Visibility.Collapsed, Container);
				return;
			}
			SetElementsVisibility(Visibility.Visible, Container);
			double thumbMinSize = ThumbMinSize;
			if (num < thumbMinSize || num < 1.0)
			{
				SetElementsVisibility(Visibility.Collapsed, Thumb, ThumbDecrease, ThumbIncrease);
				return;
			}
			double num2 = num * (parent.MaxValue - parent.MinValue);
			if (num2 < thumbMinSize - 0.0001)
			{
				num2 = thumbMinSize;
				SetElementsVisibility(Visibility.Collapsed, ThumbDecrease, ThumbIncrease);
			}
			else
			{
				SetElementsVisibility(Visibility.Visible, ThumbDecrease, ThumbIncrease);
			}
			if (Thumb != null)
			{
				num -= num2;
				Thumb.SetValue(SizeProperty, num2);
				Thumb.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (LargeDecrease != null)
			{
				double minValue = parent.MinValue;
				double num3 = minValue + 1.0 - parent.MaxValue;
				LargeDecrease.SetValue(SizeProperty, Math.Max(0.0, (minValue + num3 == minValue) ? (num / 2.0) : (num * minValue / num3)));
			}
			if (Parent != null && Background != null)
			{
				Background.Orientation = Parent.Orientation;
				Background.NearIndent = GetControlSize(SmallDecrease);
				Background.FarIndent = GetControlSize(SmallIncrease);
			}
		}
	}
	public class VerticalScrollBarLayoutCalculator : ScrollBarLayoutCalculator

	public class LineRenderer
	{
		private const double ValueTolerance = 1E-09;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point start;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point finish;

		private bool IsHorizontal => EqualDoubles(start.Y, finish.Y);

		private bool IsVertical => EqualDoubles(start.X, finish.X);

		private bool EqualDoubles(double value1, double value2)
		{
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < 1E-09;
		}

		private GuidelineSet CalculateGuidelines(System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			double num = pen.Thickness / 2.0;
			if (IsVertical)
			{
				GuidelineSet guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
				guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(start.X + num);
				return guidelineSet;
			}
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				GuidelineSet guidelineSet2 = new GuidelineSet();
				guidelineSet2.GuidelinesY.Add(start.Y + num);
				return guidelineSet2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public LineRenderer(System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point finish)
		{
			this.start = start;
			this.finish = finish;
		}

		public void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			GuidelineSet guidelineSet = CalculateGuidelines(pen);
			if (guidelineSet != null)
			{
				drawingContext.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
			}
			drawingContext.DrawLine(pen, start, finish);
			if (guidelineSet != null)
			{
				drawingContext.Pop();
			}
		}
	}

	public class PolylineRenderGeometry : RenderGeometryBase
	{
		private readonly IList<System.Windows.Point> points;

		private readonly bool isClosed;

		internal IList<System.Windows.Point> Points => points;

		public PolylineRenderGeometry(IList<System.Windows.Point> points, bool isClosed)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.isClosed = isClosed;
		}

		public override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			if (points.Count < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (points.Count == 2)
			{
				LineRenderer lineRenderer = new LineRenderer(points[0], points[1]);
				lineRenderer.Render(drawingContext, pen);
				return;
			}
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometry.Freeze();
				streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(points[0], isFilled: false, isClosed);
				streamGeometryContext.PolyLineTo(points, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: false);
			}
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(null, pen, streamGeometry);
		}
	}
	public class PolygonRenderGeometry : RenderGeometryBase
	{
		private readonly List<System.Windows.Point> points;

		private readonly List<System.Windows.Point> holePoints;

		public PolygonRenderGeometry(List<System.Windows.Point> points, List<System.Windows.Point> holePoints)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.holePoints = holePoints;
		}

		private void RenderPolygon(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext, List<System.Windows.Point> points)
		{
			geometryContext.BeginFigure(points[0], isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
			geometryContext.PolyLineTo(points, isStroked: false, isSmoothJoin: false);
		}

		public override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			if (points.Count <= 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry
			{
				FillRule = FillRule.EvenOdd
			};
			using (StreamGeometryContext geometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometry.Freeze();
				RenderPolygon(geometryContext, points);
				if (holePoints.Count > 2)
				{
					RenderPolygon(geometryContext, holePoints);
				}
			}
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(brush, pen, streamGeometry);
		}
	}
	public class RingRenderGeometry : RenderGeometryBase
	{
		private readonly Rect outerBounds;

		private readonly Rect innerBounds;

		public RingRenderGeometry(Rect outerBounds, Rect innerBounds)
		{
			this.outerBounds = outerBounds;
			this.innerBounds = innerBounds;
		}

		private void AddEllipse(Rect bounds, GeometryGroup geometryGroup)
		{
			EllipseGeometry ellipseGeometry = new EllipseGeometry(bounds);
			geometryGroup.Children.Add(ellipseGeometry);
			ellipseGeometry.Freeze();
		}

		private Geometry CreateEllipseGeometry()
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			AddEllipse(outerBounds, geometryGroup);
			if (innerBounds.Width > 0.0 && innerBounds.Height > 0.0)
			{
				AddEllipse(innerBounds, geometryGroup);
			}
			geometryGroup.Freeze();
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		public override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(brush, pen, CreateEllipseGeometry());
		}
	}
	public class PieRenderGeometry : RenderGeometryBase
	{
		private readonly List<System.Windows.Point> points;

		private readonly SweepDirection direction;

		private readonly Rect bounds;

		public PieRenderGeometry(List<System.Windows.Point> points, SweepDirection direction, Rect bounds)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.direction = direction;
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		private void CreateArc(StreamGeometryContext context, System.Windows.Point p1, System.Windows.Point p2, Rect bounds, SweepDirection direction)
		{
			GRealPoint2D p3 = new GRealPoint2D(0.5 * (bounds.Left + bounds.Right), 0.5 * (bounds.Top + bounds.Right));
			double num = GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle(p3, new GRealPoint2D(p1.X, p1.Y));
			double num2 = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(GeometricUtils.CalcBetweenPointsAngle(p3, new GRealPoint2D(p2.X, p2.Y)) - num);
			bool isLargeArc = ((direction == SweepDirection.Clockwise) ? (num2 > Math.PI) : (num2 < Math.PI));
			context.ArcTo(p2, new System.Windows.Size(0.5 * bounds.Height, 0.5 * bounds.Width), 0.0, isLargeArc, direction, isStroked: false, isSmoothJoin: false);
		}

		private Geometry CreatePieGeometry()
		{
			if (points.Count > 2)
			{
				StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry
				{
					FillRule = FillRule.EvenOdd
				};
				using StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open();
				streamGeometry.Freeze();
				streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(points[0], isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
				CreateArc(streamGeometryContext, points[0], points[1], bounds, direction);
				streamGeometryContext.LineTo(points[2], isStroked: false, isSmoothJoin: false);
				return streamGeometry;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Render(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(brush, pen, CreatePieGeometry());
		}
	}

		private static List<Pane> GetPanes(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			List<Pane> list = new List<Pane> { diagram.ActualDefaultPane };
			list.AddRange(diagram.Panes);
			list.RemoveAll((Pane x) => x.Visibility != Visibility.Visible);
			return list;
		}

		private static void InitializeNewIndicatorLegend(ChartControl chart, SeparatePaneIndicator indicator)
		{
			Legend legend = chart.Legends.FirstOrDefault((Legend x) => x.Visible ?? true);
			Legend legend2 = new Legend();
			chart.Legends.Add(legend2);
			indicator.Legend = legend2;
			legend2.Tag = indicator.Tag;
			legend2.DockTarget = indicator.Pane;
			if (legend != null)
			{
				CopyProperties(legend2, legend, legendPropertiesForClone);
			}
		}

		private static Pane InitializeNewIndicatorPane(XYDiagram2D diagram, SeparatePaneIndicator indicator)
		{
			Pane pane = new Pane();
			pane.Tag = indicator.Tag;
			Pane pane2 = GetPanes(diagram).LastOrDefault();
			diagram.Panes.Add(pane);
			if (pane2 != null)
			{
				CopyProperties(pane, pane2, panePropertiesForClone);
			}
			return pane;
		}

		private static SecondaryAxisY2D InitializeNewIndicatorAxisY(XYDiagram2D diagram, SeparatePaneIndicator indicator)
		{
			SecondaryAxisY2D secondaryAxisY2D = new SecondaryAxisY2D();
			secondaryAxisY2D.Tag = indicator.Tag;
			AxisY2D.SetAlwaysShowZeroLevel(secondaryAxisY2D.ActualWholeRange, value: false);
			diagram.SecondaryAxesY.Add(secondaryAxisY2D);
			if (diagram.AxisY != null)
			{
				CopyProperties(secondaryAxisY2D, diagram.AxisY, axisYPropertiesForClone);
			}
			return secondaryAxisY2D;
		}

		private static PanesState GetCurrentPanesState(XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			IList<Pane> panes = GetPanes(diagram);
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			foreach (Pane pane in panes)
			{
				flag |= pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions != null && pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions.Visible;
				VisibilityInPane visibilityInPane = diagram.ActualAxisX.VisibilityInPanes.FirstOrDefault((VisibilityInPane x) => x.Pane.Equals(pane));
				flag2 |= (diagram.ActualAxisX.Visible ?? true) && (visibilityInPane?.Visible ?? true);
			}
			return new PanesState
			{
				ScrollbarIsVisible = flag,
				AxisXIsVisible = flag2
			};
		}

		private static void UpdateAllPanes(XYDiagram2D diagram, PanesState panesState)
		{
			IList<Pane> panes = GetPanes(diagram);
			for (int i = 0; i < panes.Count; i++)
			{
				Pane pane = panes[i];
				if (pane.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					ScrollBarOptions scrollBarOptions = pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions;
					if (scrollBarOptions == null)
					{
						scrollBarOptions = (pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions = new ScrollBarOptions());
					}
					scrollBarOptions.Visible = i == panes.Count - 1 && panesState.ScrollbarIsVisible;
					VisibilityInPane visibilityInPane = diagram.ActualAxisX.VisibilityInPanes.FirstOrDefault((VisibilityInPane x) => x.Pane.Equals(pane));
					bool visible = i == panes.Count - 1 && panesState.AxisXIsVisible;
					if (visibilityInPane != null)
					{
						visibilityInPane.Visible = visible;
						continue;
					}
					diagram.ActualAxisX.VisibilityInPanes.Add(new VisibilityInPane
					{
						Visible = visible,
						Pane = pane
					});
				}
			}
			if (!(diagram.PaneLayout is GridLayout { AsLinearLayout: not false } gridLayout))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = diagram.PaneOrientation == Orientation.Vertical;
			LayoutDefinitionCollection layoutDefinitionCollection = (flag ? gridLayout.RowDefinitions : gridLayout.ColumnDefinitions);
			layoutDefinitionCollection.Clear();
			for (int num = 0; num < panes.Count; num++)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					GridLayout.SetRowSpan(panes[num], (num != 0) ? 1 : 2);
				}
				else
				{
					GridLayout.SetColumnSpan(panes[num], (num != 0) ? 1 : 2);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void InitializeSeparatePaneIndicator(ChartControl chart, SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
		{
			if (chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D diagram)
			{
				PanesState currentPanesState = GetCurrentPanesState(diagram);
				separatePaneIndicator.Pane = InitializeNewIndicatorPane(diagram, separatePaneIndicator);
				separatePaneIndicator.AxisY = InitializeNewIndicatorAxisY(diagram, separatePaneIndicator);
				InitializeNewIndicatorLegend(chart, separatePaneIndicator);
				UpdateAllPanes(diagram, currentPanesState);
			}
		}

		private static void AnimateIndicator(Indicator indicator)
		{
			DispatcherTimer timer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Normal)
			{
				Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50.0)
			};
			int maxThickness = 4;
			int step = 1;
			timer.Tick += delegate
			{
				int num = indicator.LineStyle.Thickness + step;
				indicator.LineStyle.Thickness = num;
				if (num == maxThickness)
				{
					step = -1;
				}
				else if (num == 1)
				{
					timer.IsEnabled = false;
				}
			};
			timer.IsEnabled = true;
		}

		public static void AddIndicator(ChartControl chart, XYSeries2D series, Indicator indicator)
		{
			indicator.Tag = indicator.GetHashCode();
			if (indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator)
			{
				InitializeSeparatePaneIndicator(chart, (SeparatePaneIndicator)indicator);
			}
			if (!series.Indicators.Contains(indicator))
			{
				series.Indicators.Add(indicator);
			}
			string[] indicatorsNames = CommonUtils.GetIndicatorsNames(series.Indicators);
			indicator.DisplayName = NameGenerator.UniqueName(indicator.GetType().Name, indicatorsNames, useFirstItemIndex: false);
			indicator.ShowInLegend = true;
		}

		public static void AddAnimatedIndicator(ChartControl chart, XYSeries2D series, Indicator indicator)
		{
			AddIndicator(chart, series, indicator);
			indicator.LineStyle = new LineStyle();
			AnimateIndicator(indicator);
		}

		public static void RemoveIndicator(ChartControl chart, Indicator indicator)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator separatePaneIndicator)
			{
				PanesState currentPanesState = GetCurrentPanesState(xYDiagram2D);
				chart.RemoveLegendByTag(separatePaneIndicator.Tag);
				xYDiagram2D.RemovePaneByTag(separatePaneIndicator.Tag);
				xYDiagram2D.RemoveSecondaryAxisYByTag(separatePaneIndicator.Tag);
				UpdateAllPanes(xYDiagram2D, currentPanesState);
			}
			xYDiagram2D.RemoveIndicator(indicator);
		}

		public static void CopyProperties(DependencyObject currentObject, DependencyObject objectForCopy, IEnumerable<DependencyProperty> properties = null)
		{
			if (properties == null)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties2 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(objectForCopy, new Attribute[1]
				{
					new PropertyFilterAttribute(PropertyFilterOptions.SetValues)
				});
				List<DependencyProperty> list = new List<DependencyProperty>();
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties2)
				{
					DependencyPropertyDescriptor dependencyPropertyDescriptor = DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(item);
					if (dependencyPropertyDescriptor != null && !dependencyPropertyDescriptor.IsReadOnly)
					{
						list.Add(dependencyPropertyDescriptor.DependencyProperty);
					}
				}
				properties = list;
			}
			foreach (DependencyProperty property in properties)
			{
				currentObject.SetCurrentValue(property, objectForCopy.GetValue(property));
			}
		}
	}

	public class KeyColorizerBehavior : PaletteColorizerBehavior
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<object, int> indexList = new Dictionary<object, int>();

		private ObservableCollection<object> keys;

		private bool UseAutocreatedItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (keys != null)
				{
					return keys.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<object> Keys
		{
			get
			{
				return keys;
			}
			set
			{
				if (keys != value)
				{
					InvalidateKeys();
					keys = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public IColorizerKeyProvider KeyProvider { get; set; }

		internal void InvalidateKeys()
		{
			indexList.Clear();
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider CreateDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (!(patternConstant == "V"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ValueLegendItemDataProvider();
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetColor(object colorKey, Palette palette)
		{
			object obj = ((KeyProvider != null) ? KeyProvider.GetKey(colorKey) : colorKey);
			if (palette != null && palette.Count > 0)
			{
				if (!indexList.TryGetValue(obj, out var value))
				{
					lock (indexList)
					{
						if (!indexList.TryGetValue(obj, out value))
						{
							value = (UseAutocreatedItems ? indexList.Count : Keys.IndexOf(obj));
							if (value >= 0)
							{
								indexList.Add(obj, value);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (value >= 0)
				{
					return palette[value % palette.Count];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override List<ColorizerLegendItem> GetLegendItems(Palette palette, object additionalInfo)
		{
			List<ColorizerLegendItem> list = new List<ColorizerLegendItem>();
			if (palette == null || palette.Count == 0 || (keys.Count == 0 && indexList.Keys.Count == 0))
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (keys.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < keys.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(new ColorizerLegendItem(palette[i % palette.Count], CreateLegendItemText(keys[i].ToString())));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (object key in indexList.Keys)
				{
					list.Add(new ColorizerLegendItem(palette[indexList[key] % palette.Count], CreateLegendItemText(key.ToString())));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseRangeColorizerBehavior<T> : PaletteColorizerBehavior
	{
		private readonly List<double> sortedRangeStops = new List<double>();

		private IList<T> rangeStops;

		private bool isDirty = true;

		public IList<T> RangeStops
		{
			get
			{
				return rangeStops;
			}
			set
			{
				if (rangeStops != value)
				{
					rangeStops = value;
				}
				InvalidateRangeStops();
			}
		}

		public bool ApproximateColors { get; set; }

		internal void InvalidateRangeStops()
		{
			isDirty = true;
		}

		private void CheckSortedRangeStops(Func<T, double> selector = null)
		{
			if (!isDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (sortedRangeStops)
			{
				if (isDirty)
				{
					sortedRangeStops.Clear();
					IList<double> list = ConvertRangesToAbsoluteValues(selector);
					if (list != null)
					{
						sortedRangeStops.AddRange(list);
						sortedRangeStops.Remove(double.NaN);
						sortedRangeStops.Remove(double.MaxValue);
						sortedRangeStops.Remove(double.MinValue);
						sortedRangeStops.Sort(Comparer<double>.Default);
						isDirty = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color CalculateApproximatedColor(double normalized, Palette palette)
		{
			double num = normalized * (double)(palette.Count - 1);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor(num);
			if (num2 == palette.Count - 1)
			{
				return palette[num2];
			}
			double ratio = num - (double)num2;
			return ColorUtils.MixColors(palette[num2], palette[num2 + 1], ratio);
		}

		protected abstract IList<double> ConvertRangesToAbsoluteValues(Func<T, double> selector);

		protected abstract List<T> GetSortedRangeStopsForLegend(MinMaxValues valueRange);

		protected System.Windows.Media.Color? GetColorCore(double value, Palette palette, Func<T, double> selector)
		{
			CheckSortedRangeStops(selector);
			int num = ((sortedRangeStops != null) ? (sortedRangeStops.Count - 1) : 0);
			if (palette != null && palette.Count > 0 && num > 0 && !double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				int rangeIndex = GetRangeIndex(value);
				if (rangeIndex >= 0 && rangeIndex < rangeStops.Count)
				{
					if (ApproximateColors)
					{
						double num2 = sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex];
						double num3 = sortedRangeStops[rangeIndex + 1];
						System.Windows.Media.Color fromUnit = ((palette.Count > num) ? palette[rangeIndex] : CalculateApproximatedColor((double)rangeIndex / (double)num, palette));
						System.Windows.Media.Color toUnit = ((palette.Count > num) ? palette[rangeIndex + 1] : CalculateApproximatedColor((double)(rangeIndex + 1) / (double)num, palette));
						return ColorUtils.MixColors(fromUnit, toUnit, (value - num2) / (num3 - num2));
					}
					if (palette.Count < num)
					{
						return CalculateApproximatedColor((double)rangeIndex / (double)(num - 1), palette);
					}
					if (rangeIndex < palette.Count)
					{
						return palette[rangeIndex];
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected List<ColorizerLegendItem> GetLegendItemsCore(Palette palette, MinMaxValues valueRange, Func<T, T, object> createContext)
		{
			List<ColorizerLegendItem> list = new List<ColorizerLegendItem>();
			List<T> sortedRangeStopsForLegend = GetSortedRangeStopsForLegend(valueRange);
			int num = sortedRangeStopsForLegend.Count - 1;
			if (palette.Count == 0 || num == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = ((palette.Count < num) ? CalculateApproximatedColor((double)i / (double)(num - 1), palette) : palette[i]);
				string text = CreateLegendItemText(createContext(sortedRangeStopsForLegend[i], sortedRangeStopsForLegend[i + 1]));
				list.Add(new ColorizerLegendItem(color, text));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public virtual int GetRangeIndex(double value)
		{
			List<double> list = GetSortedRangeStops();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (list[i] <= value && value <= list[i + 1])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public List<double> GetSortedRangeStops(Func<T, double> selector = null)
		{
			CheckSortedRangeStops(selector);
			return sortedRangeStops;
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetColor(double value, Palette palette)
		{
			return GetColorCore(value, palette, null);
		}
	}
	public class RangeColorizerBehavior : BaseRangeColorizerBehavior<double>
	{
		protected override List<double> GetSortedRangeStopsForLegend(MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			return GetSortedRangeStops();
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider CreateDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return new ValueRangeLegendItemDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected override IList<double> ConvertRangesToAbsoluteValues(Func<double, double> selector)
		{
			return base.RangeStops?.Distinct().ToList();
		}

		public override List<ColorizerLegendItem> GetLegendItems(Palette palette, object additionalInfo)
		{
			return GetLegendItemsCore(palette, MinMaxValues.Empty, (double v1, double v2) => new double[2] { v1, v2 });
		}
	}
	public class SegmentRangeColorizerBehavior : RangeColorizerBehavior
	{
		public override int GetRangeIndex(double value)
		{
			List<double> list = GetSortedRangeStops();
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(list.ToArray(), value);
			if (num < -1)
			{
				num = ~num;
				if (num != list.Count)
				{
					return num - 1;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class UnitRangeColorizerBehavior : BaseRangeColorizerBehavior<HeatmapRangeStop>
	{
		protected override List<HeatmapRangeStop> GetSortedRangeStopsForLegend(MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			return (from v in base.RangeStops.Distinct()
				orderby v.GetAbsolute(valueRange)
				select v).ToList();
		}

		protected override PatternDataProvider CreateDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			return new UnitRangeLegendItemDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}

		protected override IList<double> ConvertRangesToAbsoluteValues(Func<HeatmapRangeStop, double> selector)
		{
			return base.RangeStops.Select(selector).ToList();
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetColor(double value, double min, double max, Palette palette)
		{
			return GetColorCore(value, palette, (HeatmapRangeStop unit) => unit.GetAbsolute(min, max));
		}

		public override List<ColorizerLegendItem> GetLegendItems(Palette palette, object additionalInfo)
		{
			MinMaxValues valueRange = (MinMaxValues)additionalInfo;
			return GetLegendItemsCore(palette, valueRange, (HeatmapRangeStop v1, HeatmapRangeStop v2) => new UnitItemData(valueRange, v1, v2));
		}
	}
	public class ColorizerController
	{
		private Series series;

		private ColorObjectColorizer defaultColorizer;

		private Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, SolidColorBrush> aggregatedPointsCache;

		private ColorizerLegendVisibleProvider legendVisible;

		private Palette SeriesPalette => series.Palette;

		private ChartColorizerBase Colorizer => series.Colorizer;

		private ChartColorizerBase ActualColorizer
		{
			get
			{
				if (Colorizer == null)
				{
					return defaultColorizer;
				}
				return Colorizer;
			}
		}

		internal Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, SolidColorBrush> AggregatedPointsCache => aggregatedPointsCache;

		public ColorizerController(Series series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			defaultColorizer = new ColorObjectColorizer();
			aggregatedPointsCache = new Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, SolidColorBrush>();
			legendVisible = new ColorizerLegendVisibleProvider(series);
		}

		private Palette GetPalette(ISupportPalette supportPaletteColorizer)
		{
			if (supportPaletteColorizer != null)
			{
				Palette palette = supportPaletteColorizer.GetPalette();
				if (palette != null)
				{
					return palette;
				}
			}
			return SeriesPalette;
		}

		public void ClearBrushCache()
		{
			aggregatedPointsCache.Clear();
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetSeriesPointColor(object argument, object[] values, object colorKey)
		{
			if (colorKey != null)
			{
				return ActualColorizer.GetPointColor(argument, values, colorKey, GetPalette(ActualColorizer as ISupportPalette));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public SolidColorBrush GetSeriesPointBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color? color)
		{
			if (color.HasValue)
			{
				return ColorizerBrushCache.Instance.GetBrush(color.Value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public SolidColorBrush GetBrushForAggregatedPoint(AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
		{
			if (aggregatedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (aggregatedPointsCache.ContainsKey(aggregatedPoint))
			{
				return aggregatedPointsCache[aggregatedPoint];
			}
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedPoint.SourcePoints)
			{
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(sourcePoint);
				if (seriesPoint != null)
				{
					list.Add(seriesPoint);
				}
			}
			List<object> values = new List<object>();
			Palette palette = GetPalette(ActualColorizer as ISupportPalette);
			System.Windows.Media.Color? aggregatedPointColor = ActualColorizer.GetAggregatedPointColor(aggregatedPoint.ArgumentX.Argument, values, list, palette);
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = null;
			if (aggregatedPointColor.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color value = aggregatedPointColor.Value;
				solidColorBrush = ColorizerBrushCache.Instance.GetBrush(value);
				aggregatedPoint.Color = ColorUtils.ConvertToArgb(value);
			}
			aggregatedPointsCache.Add(aggregatedPoint, solidColorBrush);
			return solidColorBrush;
		}

		public void UpdateLegendItems(ILegendItemsProvider legendItemsProvider, IList<LegendItemBase> items, Legend legend)
		{
			List<ColorizerLegendItem> legendItems = legendItemsProvider.GetLegendItems(GetPalette(legendItemsProvider as ISupportPalette));
			foreach (ColorizerLegendItem item in legendItems)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorizerBrushCache.Instance.GetBrush(item.Color);
				items.Add(new DefaultLegendItem(legend, legendVisible, null, item.Text, brush, brush, series.LegendMarkerLineStyle, isEnabled: true));
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point is IPlatformSeriesPoint)
			{
				return ((IPlatformSeriesPoint)point).Color;
			}
			return GetBrushForAggregatedPoint((AggregatedSeriesPoint)point)?.Color;
		}

		public void UnregisterRefinedPoint(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				aggregatedPointsCache.Remove(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ColorizerLegendVisibleProvider : DependencyObject, ILegendVisible
	{
		private Series series;

		public DataTemplate LegendMarkerTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return series.LegendMarkerTemplate;
			}
		}

		public bool CheckedInLegend { get; set; }

		public bool CheckableInLegend { get; set; }

		public ColorizerLegendVisibleProvider(Series series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			CheckedInLegend = false;
			CheckableInLegend = false;
		}
	}
	public class ColorizerBrushCache
	{
		private static ColorizerBrushCache instance;

		private readonly Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, SolidColorBrush> brushCache = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, SolidColorBrush>();

		public static ColorizerBrushCache Instance => instance ?? (instance = new ColorizerBrushCache());

		private ColorizerBrushCache()
		{
		}

		public SolidColorBrush GetBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (!brushCache.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				value = new SolidColorBrush(color);
				value.Freeze();
				brushCache.Add(color, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			brushCache.Clear();
		}
	}
	public interface ICrosshairAxisLabelAppearanceProvider
	{
		System.Windows.Media.FontFamily FontFamily { get; }

		double FontSize { get; }

		FontStretch FontStretch { get; }

		System.Windows.FontStyle FontStyle { get; }

		FontWeight FontWeight { get; }

		System.Windows.Media.Brush LineBrush { get; }
	}
	public static class CrosshairElementFactory
	{
		private static LineStyle CreateCopy(LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (lineStyle == null)
			{
				return new LineStyle();
			}
			return (LineStyle)lineStyle.Clone();
		}

		private static bool GetCrosshairAxisLabelVisibility(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, bool isValuesAxis, CrosshairAxisLabelOptions axisLabelOptions)
		{
			if (axisLabelOptions.Visibility.HasValue)
			{
				return axisLabelOptions.Visibility.Value;
			}
			if (!isValuesAxis)
			{
				return crosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLabels;
			}
			return crosshairOptions.ShowValueLabels;
		}

		private static List<SeriesPoint> PopulateSeriesPoints(CrosshairPointsGroup pointsGroup)
		{
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPoint seriesPoint in pointsGroup.SeriesPoints)
			{
				list.Add(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(seriesPoint.RefinedPoint));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static CrosshairLabelElement CreateCrosshairLabelElement(CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint, FontSettings font, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerFill, System.Windows.Media.Brush markerStroke)
		{
			string crosshairSeriesText = crosshairPoint.CrosshairSeriesText;
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = crosshairPoint.RefinedSeries;
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)refinedSeries.Series;
			return new CrosshairLabelElement(crosshairSeriesText, font, xYSeries2D.ActualCrosshairLabelVisible, xYSeries2D.CrosshairLabelTemplate, markerFill, markerStroke);
		}

		private static CrosshairElement CreateCrosshairElement(CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, FontSettings seriesLabelFont)
		{
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = crosshairSeriesPoint.RefinedSeries;
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)refinedSeries.Series;
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = xYSeries2D.CreateCrosshairMarkerBrush(refinedSeries, crosshairSeriesPoint.RefinedPoint);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush penBrush = xYSeries2D.GetPenBrush(solidColorBrush);
			CrosshairLabelElement labelElement = CreateCrosshairLabelElement(crosshairSeriesPoint, seriesLabelFont, solidColorBrush, penBrush);
			return new CrosshairElement(lineElement, axisLabelElement, labelElement, refinedSeries, crosshairSeriesPoint.RefinedPoint);
		}

		private static CrosshairIndicatorElement CreateCrosshairIndicatorElement(CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, FontSettings seriesLabelFont)
		{
			Indicator indicator = (Indicator)crosshairIndicatorPoint.Indicator;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = indicator.Item.Brush;
			CrosshairLabelElement labelElement = CreateCrosshairLabelElement(crosshairIndicatorPoint, seriesLabelFont, brush, brush);
			IndicatorPoint indicatorPoint = new IndicatorPoint(indicator, crosshairIndicatorPoint.AxisXProjection.Value, crosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType);
			return new CrosshairIndicatorElement(indicatorPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, labelElement, crosshairIndicatorPoint.RefinedSeries);
		}

		public static CrosshairLineElement CreateCrosshairLineElement(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, bool isValueLine)
		{
			if (isValueLine)
			{
				return new CrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions.ShowValueLine, crosshairOptions.ActualValueLineBrush, CreateCopy(crosshairOptions.ActualValueLineStyle));
			}
			return new CrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions.ShowArgumentLine, crosshairOptions.ActualArgumentLineBrush, CreateCopy(crosshairOptions.ActualArgumentLineStyle));
		}

		public static CrosshairAxisLabelElement CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			if (crosshairAxisInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)crosshairAxisInfo.Axis;
			CrosshairAxisLabelOptions actualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions = axis2D.ActualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions;
			if (!axesFonts.TryGetValue(axis2D, out var value))
			{
				value = actualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions.CreateFont();
				axesFonts.Add(axis2D, value);
			}
			return new CrosshairAxisLabelElement(crosshairAxisInfo.Text, actualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions.ActualBackground, value, GetCrosshairAxisLabelVisibility(crosshairOptions, axis2D.IsValuesAxis, actualCrosshairAxisLabelOptions), crosshairAxisInfo.Value, axis2D.CrosshairLabelTemplate);
		}

		public static CrosshairGroupHeaderElement CreateGroupHeaderElement(CrosshairPointsGroup group, FontSettings font)
		{
			DataTemplate crosshairLabelTemplate = null;
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = group.Points[0].RefinedSeries.Series as XYSeries2D;
			if (xYSeries2D != null)
			{
				crosshairLabelTemplate = xYSeries2D.CrosshairLabelTemplate;
			}
			return new CrosshairGroupHeaderElement(PopulateSeriesPoints(group), group.HeaderText, font, xYSeries2D.ActualCrosshairLabelVisible, crosshairLabelTemplate);
		}

		public static CrosshairElementBase CreateCrosshairElementBase(CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, FontSettings seriesLabelFont, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			CrosshairLineElement lineElement = ((crosshairPoint.CrosshairLine != null) ? CreateCrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions, crosshairPoint.CrosshairLine.IsValueLine) : null);
			CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(crosshairOptions, crosshairPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo, axesFonts);
			if (crosshairPoint is CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint)
			{
				return CreateCrosshairElement(crosshairSeriesPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, seriesLabelFont);
			}
			return CreateCrosshairIndicatorElement((CrosshairIndicatorPoint)crosshairPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, seriesLabelFont);
		}
	}
	public static class CrosshairLegendElementFactory
	{
		private static CrosshairLegendElement CreateCrosshairSeriesLegendElementCore(XYSeries2D series, SeriesPoint seriesPoint, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, string crosshairSeriesText, bool crosshairLegendTextVisible, CrosshairLine crosshairLine, CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo)
		{
			return new CrosshairLegendElement(series, seriesPoint, refinedPoint, crosshairSeriesText, crosshairLegendTextVisible, series.ActualChartLegend, lineElement, axisLabelElement, crosshairLine, crosshairAxisInfo, seriesPoint == null);
		}

		private static CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement CreateCrosshairIndicatorLegendElementCore(Indicator indicator, IndicatorPoint indicatorPoint, CrosshairLineElement lineElement, CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement, string crosshairSeriesText, bool crosshairLegendTextVisible, CrosshairLine crosshairLine, CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo)
		{
			return new CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement(indicator, indicatorPoint, crosshairSeriesText, crosshairLegendTextVisible, lineElement, axisLabelElement, crosshairLine, crosshairAxisInfo, indicatorPoint == null);
		}

		private static CrosshairAxisLabelElement CreateAxisLabelElement(CrosshairLegendPoint legendPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			if (legendPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairAxisLabelElement(crosshairOptions, legendPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo, axesFonts);
		}

		private static CrosshairLineElement CreateLineElement(CrosshairLegendPoint legendPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			if (legendPoint.CrosshairLine == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CrosshairElementFactory.CreateCrosshairLineElement(crosshairOptions, legendPoint.CrosshairLine.IsValueLine);
		}

		public static CrosshairLegendElement CreateCrosshairLegendElement(CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			CrosshairLineElement lineElement = CreateLineElement(crosshairSeriesPoint, crosshairOptions);
			CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = CreateAxisLabelElement(crosshairSeriesPoint, crosshairOptions, axesFonts);
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = crosshairSeriesPoint.RefinedPoint;
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)crosshairSeriesPoint.RefinedSeries.Series;
			if (xYSeries2D.ActualChartLegend == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateCrosshairSeriesLegendElementCore(xYSeries2D, SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint), refinedPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, crosshairSeriesPoint.CrosshairSeriesText, crosshairSeriesPoint.LegendItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible, crosshairSeriesPoint.CrosshairLine, crosshairSeriesPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo);
		}

		public static CrosshairIndicatorLegendElement CreateCrosshairIndicatorLegendElement(CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			CrosshairLineElement lineElement = CreateLineElement(crosshairIndicatorPoint, crosshairOptions);
			CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = CreateAxisLabelElement(crosshairIndicatorPoint, crosshairOptions, axesFonts);
			Indicator indicator = (Indicator)crosshairIndicatorPoint.Indicator;
			IndicatorPoint indicatorPoint = new IndicatorPoint(indicator, crosshairIndicatorPoint.AxisXProjection.Value, crosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType);
			return CreateCrosshairIndicatorLegendElementCore(indicator, indicatorPoint, lineElement, axisLabelElement, crosshairIndicatorPoint.CrosshairSeriesText, crosshairIndicatorPoint.LegendItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible, crosshairIndicatorPoint.CrosshairLine, crosshairIndicatorPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo);
		}

		public static CrosshairLegendElementBase CreateCrosshairEmptyLegendElement(CrosshairLegendPoint legendPoint, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, Dictionary<Axis2D, FontSettings> axesFonts)
		{
			CrosshairLineElement lineElement = CreateLineElement(legendPoint, crosshairOptions);
			CrosshairAxisLabelElement axisLabelElement = CreateAxisLabelElement(legendPoint, crosshairOptions, axesFonts);
			if (legendPoint.LegendItem is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
			{
				return CreateCrosshairSeriesLegendElementCore(xYSeries2D, null, null, lineElement, axisLabelElement, xYSeries2D.ActualCrosshairEmptyValueLegendText, legendPoint.LegendItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible, legendPoint.CrosshairLine, legendPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo);
			}
			Indicator indicator = (Indicator)legendPoint.LegendItem;
			return CreateCrosshairIndicatorLegendElementCore(indicator, null, lineElement, axisLabelElement, indicator.CrosshairEmptyValueLegendText, legendPoint.LegendItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible, legendPoint.CrosshairLine, legendPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo);
		}
	}
	public static class CrosshairUtils
	{

		{
			while (items.Count <= index)
			{
				items.Add(new T());
			}
			return items[index];
		}
	}
