	public abstract class PaneMappingBase : IMapping
	{
		private readonly Pane pane;

		private readonly AxisBase axisX;

		private readonly AxisBase axisY;

		private readonly bool navigationEnabled;

		private IAxisMappingCore axisXMapping;

		private IAxisMappingCore axisYMapping;

		protected Pane Pane => pane;

		protected AxisBase AxisY => axisY;

		public AxisBase AxisX => axisX;

		public Rect Viewport => pane.Viewport;

		public bool Rotated => pane.Rotated;

		public bool NavigationEnabled => navigationEnabled;

		public IAxisMappingCore AxisXMapping => axisXMapping;

		public IAxisMappingCore AxisYMapping => axisYMapping;

		protected PaneMappingBase(Pane pane, AxisBase axisX, AxisBase axisY)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.axisX = axisX;
			this.axisY = axisY;
			navigationEnabled = pane.NavigationEnabled;
		}

		protected void UpdateAxesMapping()
		{
			axisXMapping = CreateAxisXMapping();
			axisYMapping = CreateAxisYMapping();
		}

		protected abstract IAxisMappingCore CreateAxisXMapping();

		protected abstract IAxisMappingCore CreateAxisYMapping();

		public bool IsLabelVisibleForResolveOverlapping(System.Windows.Point initialAnchorPoint)
		{
			if (!NavigationEnabled)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(MathUtils.StrongRound(initialAnchorPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(initialAnchorPoint.Y));
				return Viewport.Contains(point);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetDiagramPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(argument), axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetDiagramPoint(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(point.X), axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(point.Y));
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetDiagramOriginPoint()
		{
			return GetDiagramPoint(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetRoundedDiagramPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(axisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(argument), axisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(value));
		}
	}
	public class PaneMapping : PaneMappingBase
	{
		public PaneMapping(Pane pane, IXYSeriesView view)

		}

		public PaneMapping(Pane pane, AxisBase axisX, AxisBase axisY)

		protected override IAxisMappingCore CreateAxisXMapping()
		{
			return base.AxisX.CreateMapping(base.Pane, base.Pane.Viewport);
		}

		protected override IAxisMappingCore CreateAxisYMapping()
		{
			return base.AxisY.CreateMapping(base.Pane, base.Pane.Viewport);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeriesInteractionRendererBase
	{
		public abstract void RenderInteractions(DrawingContext drawingContext, Series primarySeries, IList<IPointInteraction> interactions, System.Windows.Size bounds);
	}
	public class WaterfallSeriesInteractionRenderer : SeriesInteractionRendererBase
	{
		private System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen(WaterfallSeries2D waterfallSeries)
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram = (XYDiagram2D)waterfallSeries.Diagram;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush connectorBrush = WaterfallSeries2D.GetConnectorBrush(diagram);
			LineStyle connectorStyle = WaterfallSeries2D.GetConnectorStyle(diagram);
			if (connectorStyle != null)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Media.Pen(connectorBrush, connectorStyle.Thickness)
				{
					LineJoin = connectorStyle.LineJoin,
					DashCap = connectorStyle.DashCap,
					MiterLimit = connectorStyle.MiterLimit,
					Thickness = connectorStyle.Thickness,
					DashStyle = connectorStyle.DashStyle
				};
			}
			return new System.Windows.Media.Pen(connectorBrush, 1.0);
		}

		public override void RenderInteractions(DrawingContext drawingContext, Series primarySeries, IList<IPointInteraction> interactions, System.Windows.Size bounds)
		{
			WaterfallSeries2D waterfallSeries2D = (WaterfallSeries2D)primarySeries;
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreatePen(waterfallSeries2D);
			pen.Freeze();
			IMapping mapping = ((IPresentationCreator)waterfallSeries2D).CreateMapping();
			for (int i = 0; i < interactions.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction = (WaterfallPointInteraction)interactions[i];
				if (waterfallPointInteraction.HasOnlyEmptyPoints)
				{
					continue;
				}
				WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction2 = null;
				for (int j = i + 1; j < interactions.Count; j++)
				{
					WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction3 = (WaterfallPointInteraction)interactions[j];
					if (!waterfallPointInteraction3.HasOnlyEmptyPoints)
					{
						waterfallPointInteraction2 = waterfallPointInteraction3;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (waterfallPointInteraction2 == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				double totalValue = waterfallPointInteraction.GetTotalValue();
				double value = (waterfallPointInteraction2.IsSubtotal ? waterfallPointInteraction2.GetTotalValue() : totalValue);
				System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(waterfallPointInteraction.Argument + waterfallSeries2D.BarWidth / 2.0, totalValue);
				roundedDiagramPoint.Y = bounds.Height - roundedDiagramPoint.Y - pen.Thickness / 2.0;
				System.Windows.Point roundedDiagramPoint2 = mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(waterfallPointInteraction2.Argument - waterfallSeries2D.BarWidth / 2.0, value);
				roundedDiagramPoint2.Y = bounds.Height - roundedDiagramPoint2.Y - pen.Thickness / 2.0;
				drawingContext.DrawLine(pen, roundedDiagramPoint, roundedDiagramPoint2);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class VisibilityControllerState
	{
		public class PaneAutoLayoutWrapper
		{
			private readonly Pane pane;

			private readonly List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> elements;

			private readonly System.Windows.Size minSize;

			public Rect Bounds => pane.OuterBounds;

			public PaneAutoLayoutWrapper(Pane pane, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> elements, System.Windows.Size minSize)
			{
				this.pane = pane;
				this.elements = elements;
				this.minSize = minSize;
			}
		}

		private static VisibilityControllerState state;

		private List<PaneAutoLayoutWrapper> wrappers;

		public static VisibilityControllerState State
		{
			get
			{
				if (state == null)
				{
					state = new VisibilityControllerState();
				}
				return state;
			}
		}

		private VisibilityControllerState()
		{
			wrappers = new List<PaneAutoLayoutWrapper>();
		}

		public void Add(PaneAutoLayoutWrapper element)
		{
			if (!wrappers.Contains(element))
			{
				wrappers.Add(element);
			}
		}

		public void Add(List<PaneAutoLayoutWrapper> elements)
		{
			foreach (PaneAutoLayoutWrapper element in elements)
			{
				Add(element);
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			wrappers = new List<PaneAutoLayoutWrapper>();
		}
	}

	public static class PresentationItemRenderHelper
	{
		public static Rect GetPresentationBounds(IPresentationItem item)
		{
			if (item.Presentation != null)
			{
				return item.Presentation.Bounds;
			}
			Rect empty = Rect.Empty;
			if (item.IntervalPresentations != null)
			{
				foreach (IntervalPresentation intervalPresentation in item.IntervalPresentations)
				{
					empty.Intersect(intervalPresentation.Presentation.Bounds);
				}
			}
			return empty;
		}

		public static void DoAction(IPresentationItem item, IRenderContext context, Action<IPresentation> action)
		{
			if (item.Presentation != null)
			{
				action(item.Presentation);
			}
			else
			{
				if (item.IntervalPresentations == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (context == null)
				{
					foreach (IntervalPresentation intervalPresentation in item.IntervalPresentations)
					{
						action(intervalPresentation.Presentation);
					}
					return;
				}
				foreach (IntervalPresentation intervalPresentation2 in item.IntervalPresentations)
				{
					Geometry intervalClip = intervalPresentation2.IntervalClip;
					if (intervalClip != null)
					{
						context.PushClip(intervalClip);
					}
					action(intervalPresentation2.Presentation);
					if (intervalClip != null)
					{
						context.Pop();
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class PresentationUpdater
	{
		private abstract class CreationStrategyBase
		{
			private readonly IPresentationCreator presentationCreator;

			protected IPresentationCreator PresentationCreator => presentationCreator;

			protected CreationStrategyBase(IPresentationCreator presentationCreator)
			{
				this.presentationCreator = presentationCreator;
			}

			public abstract void SetItemPresentation(IPresentationItem item);

			public abstract void SetHighlightingItemPresentation(IPresentationItem highlightingItem, IPresentationItem sourceItem);

			public abstract Transform CreateAnimationTransform();

			public abstract IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> CalculateAdditionalGeometries(IGeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips);
		}

		private class SinglePresentationCreationStrategy : CreationStrategyBase
		{
			private readonly IMapping mapping;

			public SinglePresentationCreationStrategy(IPresentationCreator presentationCreator)
				: base(presentationCreator)
			{
				mapping = presentationCreator.CreateMapping();
			}

			public override void SetItemPresentation(IPresentationItem item)
			{
				item.IntervalPresentations = null;
				IPresentation presentation = base.PresentationCreator.CreateItemPresentation(mapping, item);
				if (base.PresentationCreator.ShouldApplyItemPresentation(presentation, item))
				{
					item.Presentation = presentation;
				}
			}

			public override void SetHighlightingItemPresentation(IPresentationItem highlightingItem, IPresentationItem sourceItem)
			{
				highlightingItem.IntervalPresentations = null;
				highlightingItem.Presentation = base.PresentationCreator.CreateHighlightingItemPresentation(mapping, sourceItem);
			}

			public override Transform CreateAnimationTransform()
			{
				return base.PresentationCreator.CreateAnimationTransform(mapping);
			}

			public override IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> CalculateAdditionalGeometries(IGeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips)
			{
				List<ChartGeometry> list = new List<ChartGeometry>();
				foreach (IGeometryStrip strip in strips)
				{
					list.Add(geometryCalculator.Calculate(mapping, strip));
				}
				return new SeriesAdditionalGeometry[1]
				{
					new SeriesAdditionalGeometry(null, list)
				};
			}
		}

		private class MultiPresentationCreationStrategy : CreationStrategyBase
		{
			private readonly Pane pane;

			private readonly AxisBase axisX;

			private readonly AxisBase axisY;

			private readonly IList<IntervalLayout> horizontalLayouts;

			private readonly IList<IntervalLayout> verticalLayouts;

			public MultiPresentationCreationStrategy(IPresentationCreator presentationCreator, Pane pane, AxisBase axisX, AxisBase axisY, IList<IntervalLayout> horizontalLayouts, IList<IntervalLayout> verticalLayouts)
				: base(presentationCreator)
			{
				this.pane = pane;
				this.axisX = axisX;
				this.axisY = axisY;
				this.horizontalLayouts = horizontalLayouts;
				this.verticalLayouts = verticalLayouts;
			}

			private Geometry CalculateClipGeometry(Interval horizontalInterval, Interval verticalInterval)
			{
				GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
				List<XYDiagramPaneArea> areas = pane.PaneAreas.Areas;
				foreach (XYDiagramPaneArea item in areas)
				{
					if (IsAreaInsideInterval(item.Bounds, horizontalInterval, verticalInterval))
					{
						geometryGroup.Children.Add(GeometryCreator.CreateGeometry(item.Border, close: true));
					}
				}
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform(1.0, -1.0));
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform(0.0, pane.Viewport.Height));
				geometryGroup.Transform = transformGroup;
				return geometryGroup;
			}

			private bool IsAreaInsideInterval(GRealRect2D areaBounds, Interval horizontalInterval, Interval verticalInterval)
			{
				double num = pane.Viewport.Height - verticalInterval.End;
				double num2 = pane.Viewport.Height - verticalInterval.Start;
				if (horizontalInterval.Start <= areaBounds.Left && areaBounds.Right <= horizontalInterval.End && num <= areaBounds.Top)
				{
					return areaBounds.Bottom <= num2;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override void SetItemPresentation(IPresentationItem item)
			{
				item.Presentation = null;
				List<IntervalPresentation> list = new List<IntervalPresentation>();
				foreach (IntervalLayout horizontalLayout in horizontalLayouts)
				{
					foreach (IntervalLayout verticalLayout in verticalLayouts)
					{
						PaneIntervalMapping mapping = new PaneIntervalMapping(pane, axisX, axisY, horizontalLayout, verticalLayout);
						IPresentation presentation = base.PresentationCreator.CreateItemPresentation(mapping, item);
						if (base.PresentationCreator.ShouldApplyItemPresentation(presentation, item))
						{
							Geometry intervalClip = CalculateClipGeometry(horizontalLayout.Bounds, verticalLayout.Bounds);
							list.Add(new IntervalPresentation(intervalClip, presentation));
						}
					}
				}
				item.IntervalPresentations = list;
			}

			public override void SetHighlightingItemPresentation(IPresentationItem highlightingItem, IPresentationItem sourceItem)
			{
				highlightingItem.Presentation = null;
				List<IntervalPresentation> list = new List<IntervalPresentation>();
				foreach (IntervalLayout horizontalLayout in horizontalLayouts)
				{
					foreach (IntervalLayout verticalLayout in verticalLayouts)
					{
						PaneIntervalMapping mapping = new PaneIntervalMapping(pane, axisX, axisY, horizontalLayout, verticalLayout);
						IPresentation presentation = base.PresentationCreator.CreateHighlightingItemPresentation(mapping, sourceItem);
						Geometry intervalClip = CalculateClipGeometry(horizontalLayout.Bounds, verticalLayout.Bounds);
						list.Add(new IntervalPresentation(intervalClip, presentation));
					}
				}
				highlightingItem.IntervalPresentations = list;
			}

			public override Transform CreateAnimationTransform()
			{
				if (horizontalLayouts.Count == 0 || verticalLayouts.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PaneIntervalMapping mapping = new PaneIntervalMapping(pane, axisX, axisY, horizontalLayouts[0], verticalLayouts[0]);
				return base.PresentationCreator.CreateAnimationTransform(mapping);
			}

			public override IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> CalculateAdditionalGeometries(IGeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips)
			{
				List<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> list = new List<SeriesAdditionalGeometry>();
				foreach (IntervalLayout horizontalLayout in horizontalLayouts)
				{
					foreach (IntervalLayout verticalLayout in verticalLayouts)
					{
						PaneIntervalMapping mapping = new PaneIntervalMapping(pane, axisX, axisY, horizontalLayout, verticalLayout);
						List<ChartGeometry> list2 = new List<ChartGeometry>();
						foreach (IGeometryStrip strip in strips)
						{
							list2.Add(geometryCalculator.Calculate(mapping, strip));
						}
						Geometry clip = CalculateClipGeometry(horizontalLayout.Bounds, verticalLayout.Bounds);
						list.Add(new SeriesAdditionalGeometry(clip, list2));
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private readonly CreationStrategyBase creationStrategy;

		public PresentationUpdater(IPresentationCreator presentationCreator)
		{
			creationStrategy = CreateCreationStrategy(presentationCreator, presentationCreator.Pane);
		}

		private CreationStrategyBase CreateCreationStrategy(IPresentationCreator presentationCreator, Pane pane)
		{
			if (pane == null || !presentationCreator.SupportMultiplePresentations)
			{
				return new SinglePresentationCreationStrategy(presentationCreator);
			}
			AxisBase axisX = presentationCreator.AxisX;
			AxisBase axisY = presentationCreator.AxisY;
			IList<IntervalLayout> intervalLayouts = ((IIntervalLayoutProvider)pane).GetIntervalLayouts((IIntervalLayoutKey)axisX);
			IList<IntervalLayout> intervalLayouts2 = ((IIntervalLayoutProvider)pane).GetIntervalLayouts((IIntervalLayoutKey)axisY);
			if ((intervalLayouts != null && intervalLayouts.Count > 1) || (intervalLayouts2 != null && intervalLayouts2.Count > 1))
			{
				return new MultiPresentationCreationStrategy(presentationCreator, pane, axisX, axisY, intervalLayouts, intervalLayouts2);
			}
			return new SinglePresentationCreationStrategy(presentationCreator);
		}

		public void UpdateItemPresentation(IPresentationItem item)
		{
			creationStrategy.SetItemPresentation(item);
		}

		public void UpdateHighlightingItemPresentation(IPresentationItem highlightingItem, IPresentationItem sourceItem)
		{
			creationStrategy.SetHighlightingItemPresentation(highlightingItem, sourceItem);
		}

		public Transform CreateAnimationTransform()
		{
			return creationStrategy.CreateAnimationTransform();
		}

		public IEnumerable<SeriesAdditionalGeometry> CalculateAdditionalGeometries(IGeometryCalculator geometryCalculator, IList<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			return creationStrategy.CalculateAdditionalGeometries(geometryCalculator, strips);
		}
	}

	internal static class SpecialBarModelHelper
	{
		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateLinearGradientBrush(System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point endPoint, System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Color color2)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = startPoint,
				EndPoint = endPoint
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(color, 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(color2, 1.0));
			linearGradientBrush.SpreadMethod = GradientSpreadMethod.Reflect;
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreteBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color, FillStyle fillStyle)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;
			if (fillStyle == null)
			{
				brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			}
			else
			{
				switch (fillStyle.FillMode)
				{
				case FillMode.Empty:
				case FillMode.Solid:
					brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
					break;
				case FillMode.Gradient:
				{
					ColorARGB color2 = fillStyle.Options.Color2;
					System.Windows.Media.Color color3 = (color2.IsEmpty ? color : color2.ToColor());
					brush = fillStyle.Options.GradientMode switch
					{
						GradientMode.BottomLeftToTopRight => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.BottomRightToTopLeft => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.BottomToTop => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.FromCenterHorizontal => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.FromCenterVertical => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5), new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.LeftToRight => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.RightToLeft => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5), new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.ToCenterHorizontal => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5), new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.ToCenterVertical => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.TopLeftToBottomRight => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.TopRightToBottomLeft => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0), color, color3), 
						GradientMode.TopToBottom => CreateLinearGradientBrush(new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0), color, color3), 
						_ => throw new NotSupportedException("Unknown GradientMode: " + fillStyle.Options.GradientMode), 
					};
					break;
				}
				default:
					throw new NotSupportedException("Unknown FillMode: " + fillStyle.FillMode);
				}
			}
			if (!brush.IsFrozen)
			{
				brush.Freeze();
			}
			return brush;
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen(DevExpress.Charts.Model.Border borderModel)
		{
			if (borderModel == null || borderModel.Thickness == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = borderModel.Color.ToColor();
			SolidColorBrush brush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, borderModel.Thickness);
			if (!pen.IsFrozen)
			{
				pen.Freeze();
			}
			return pen;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CandleStickElement
	{
		private CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout;

		protected CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout PointLayout => pointLayout;

		public abstract bool IsVisible { get; }

		public static CandleStickElement CreateInstance(CandleStickElements elementKind, CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			switch (elementKind)
			{
			case CandleStickElements.Candle:
				return new CandleElement(pointLayout);
			case CandleStickElements.InvertedCandle:
				return new InvertedCandleElement(pointLayout);
			case CandleStickElements.TopStick:
				return new TopStickElement(pointLayout);
			case CandleStickElements.BottomStick:
				return new BottomStickElement(pointLayout);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown CandleStickElements value.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		public CandleStickElement(CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			this.pointLayout = pointLayout;
		}

		public abstract Rect CalculateArrangeRect(System.Windows.Size constraint);
	}
	public abstract class CandleElementBase : CandleStickElement
	{
		public CandleElementBase(CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null && IsVisible)
			{
				double val = Math.Abs(base.PointLayout.ClosePortion - base.PointLayout.OpenPortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				double y = (1.0 - Math.Max(base.PointLayout.OpenPortion, base.PointLayout.ClosePortion)) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				return new Rect(0.0, y, constraint.Width, Math.Min(val, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public class CandleElement : CandleElementBase
	{
		public override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.PointLayout == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !base.PointLayout.IsCandleFilled;
			}
		}

		public CandleElement(CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null && IsVisible)
			{
				double num = Math.Abs(base.PointLayout.ClosePortion - base.PointLayout.OpenPortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				double num2 = (1.0 - Math.Max(base.PointLayout.OpenPortion, base.PointLayout.ClosePortion)) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				if (num < 1.0)
				{
					num2 -= 1.0 - num;
					num = 1.0;
				}
				return new Rect(0.0, num2, constraint.Width, Math.Min(num, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public class InvertedCandleElement : CandleElement
	{
		public override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.PointLayout == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.PointLayout.IsCandleFilled;
			}
		}

		public InvertedCandleElement(CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}
	}
	public class TopStickElement : CandleStickElement
	{
		public override bool IsVisible => base.PointLayout != null;

		public TopStickElement(CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null)
			{
				double num = (base.PointLayout.IsCandleInverted ? base.PointLayout.OpenPortion : base.PointLayout.ClosePortion);
				double y = (1.0 - Math.Max(num, base.PointLayout.HighPortion)) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				double val = Math.Abs(num - base.PointLayout.HighPortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				return new Rect(0.0, y, constraint.Width, Math.Min(val, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public class BottomStickElement : CandleStickElement
	{
		public override bool IsVisible => base.PointLayout != null;

		public BottomStickElement(CandleStickSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null)
			{
				double num = (base.PointLayout.IsCandleInverted ? base.PointLayout.ClosePortion : base.PointLayout.OpenPortion);
				double y = (1.0 - Math.Max(num, base.PointLayout.LowPortion)) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				double val = Math.Abs(num - base.PointLayout.LowPortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				return new Rect(0.0, y, constraint.Width, Math.Min(val, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public abstract class StockElement
	{
		private readonly StockSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout;

		protected StockSeries2DPointLayout PointLayout => pointLayout;

		public abstract bool IsVisible { get; }

		public static StockElement CreateInstance(StockElements elementKind, StockSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			switch (elementKind)
			{
			case StockElements.CenterLine:
				return new CenterLineStockElement(pointLayout);
			case StockElements.OpenLine:
				return new OpenLineStockElement(pointLayout);
			case StockElements.CloseLine:
				return new CloseLineStockElement(pointLayout);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown StockElements value.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		public StockElement(StockSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
		{
			this.pointLayout = pointLayout;
		}

		public abstract System.Windows.Size CalculateMeasureSize(System.Windows.Size constraint);

		public abstract Rect CalculateArrangeRect(UIElement element, System.Windows.Size constraint);
	}
	public class CenterLineStockElement : StockElement
	{
		public override bool IsVisible => base.PointLayout != null;

		public CenterLineStockElement(StockSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateMeasureSize(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return constraint;
		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(UIElement element, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null && element != null && IsVisible)
			{
				double y = (1.0 - Math.Max(base.PointLayout.LowPortion, base.PointLayout.HighPortion)) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				double val = Math.Abs(base.PointLayout.HighPortion - base.PointLayout.LowPortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height;
				double width = CalculateMeasureSize(constraint).Width;
				return new Rect(0.0, y, width, Math.Min(val, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public class OpenLineStockElement : StockElement
	{
		public override bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.PointLayout == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.PointLayout.ShowOpenClose != StockType.Close;
			}
		}

		public OpenLineStockElement(StockSeries2DPointLayout pointLayout)
			: base(pointLayout)
		{
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateMeasureSize(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size((int)(constraint.Width / 2.0), constraint.Height);
		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(UIElement element, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null && element != null && IsVisible)
			{
				double y = (1.0 - base.PointLayout.OpenPortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height - element.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				double width = CalculateMeasureSize(constraint).Width;
				return new Rect(0.0, y, width, Math.Min(element.DesiredSize.Height, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public class CloseLineStockElement : StockElement

		}

		{

		}

		public override Rect CalculateArrangeRect(UIElement element, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.PointLayout != null && element != null && IsVisible)
			{
				double y = (1.0 - base.PointLayout.ClosePortion) * base.PointLayout.Bounds.Height - element.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				double width = CalculateMeasureSize(constraint).Width;
				return new Rect((int)(constraint.Width / 2.0 + 0.5), y, width, Math.Min(element.DesiredSize.Height, constraint.Height));
			}
			return RectExtensions.Zero;
		}
	}
	public abstract class HitTestControllerBase
	{
		private IHitTestResult result;

		protected UIElement Chart { get; }

		protected HitTestControllerBase(UIElement chart)
		{
			Chart = chart;
		}

		protected virtual HitTestResultBehavior GetHitTestResultBehavior(HitTestResult result)
		{
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
		}

		protected abstract IHitTestResult Create3DHitTestResult(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult);

		protected abstract IHitTestResult Create2DHitTestResult();

		private IHitTestResult WrapResult(HitTestResult result)
		{
			if (result is RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult)
			{
				return Create3DHitTestResult((RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult)result);
			}
			if (result.VisualHit is Pie3DLabelVisual)
			{
				return new HitTestResultMixed((Pie3DLabelVisual)result.VisualHit);
			}
			return Create2DHitTestResult();
		}

		private HitTestResultBehavior HitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
		{
			this.result = WrapResult(result);
			return GetHitTestResultBehavior(result);
		}

		public HitInfoBase ProcessHitInfo(System.Windows.Point point, double radius, HitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			result = null;
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(Chart, HitTestingHelper.HitFilter, HitTestResult, hitTestParameters);
			if (result == null)
			{
				result = new HitTestResult2D();
			}
			return result.CreateHitInfo(Chart, point, radius);
		}

		public void Cleanup()
		{
			result = null;
		}
	}
	public class ChartHitTestController : HitTestControllerBase
	{
		public ChartHitTestController(ChartControlBase chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
		}

		protected override IHitTestResult Create2DHitTestResult()
		{
			return new HitTestResult2D();
		}

		protected override IHitTestResult Create3DHitTestResult(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult)
		{
			return new HitTestResult3D(rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult);
		}

		public ChartHitInfo CalcHitInfo(System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
		{
			if (((ChartControl)base.Chart).Diagram is Diagram3D)
			{
				return ProcessHitInfo(point, 0.0, new ChartPointHitTestParameters(point)) as ChartHitInfo;
			}
			double num = 2.0 * radius;
			Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(point.X - radius, point.Y - radius, num, num));
			return ProcessHitInfo(point, radius, new ChartGeometryHitTestParameters(geometry)) as ChartHitInfo;
		}
	}
	public class XYZChartHitTestController : HitTestControllerBase
	{
		public XYZChartHitTestController(ChartControlBase chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
		}

		protected override IHitTestResult Create2DHitTestResult()
		{
			return new XYZHitTestResult2D();
		}

		protected override IHitTestResult Create3DHitTestResult(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult)
		{
			return new XYZHitTestResult3D(rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult);
		}

		protected override HitTestResultBehavior GetHitTestResultBehavior(HitTestResult result)
		{
			if (result is RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult && rayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult.MeshHit.GetValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty) is CrosshairMarker3D)
			{
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class GradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy
	{
		protected const double TickmarkPadding = 1.0;

		protected const double MaxItemSizePercent = 0.5;

		public System.Windows.Size TotalSize { get; protected set; }

		public Thickness GradientMargin { get; protected set; }

		public static GradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy Create(Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				return new VerticalGradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy();
			}
			return new HorizontalGradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy();
		}

		public abstract void CalculateLayout(List<GradientLegendItemData> items, System.Windows.Size availableSize);

		public void ProcessItemsOverlapping(List<GradientLegendItemData> items)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = items.Count - 1;
			for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)
			{
				GradientLegendItemData gradientLegendItemData = items[i];
				GradientLegendItemData gradientLegendItemData2 = items[num];
				bool flag = num != 0 || i != num2;
				if (gradientLegendItemData2.Bounds.IntersectsWith(gradientLegendItemData.Bounds) && flag)
				{
					if (i != num2)
					{
						gradientLegendItemData.Visible = false;
					}
					else
					{
						gradientLegendItemData2.Visible = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					gradientLegendItemData.Visible = true;
					num = i;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class VerticalGradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy : GradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy
	{
		public override void CalculateLayout(List<GradientLegendItemData> items, System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = items[0].Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			double num2 = items[items.Count - 1].Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = availableSize.Height * 0.5;
			double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, num4 - num - num2);
			foreach (GradientLegendItemData item in items)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = item.Bounds.Size;
				double num6 = num + num5 * item.Value;
				item.Bounds = new Rect(0.0, num6 - size.Height / 2.0, size.Width, size.Height);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, size.Width);
			}
			base.TotalSize = new System.Windows.Size(num3, num4);
			base.GradientMargin = new Thickness(0.0, num - 1.0, 0.0, num2 - 1.0);
		}
	}
	internal class HorizontalGradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy : GradientLegendItemLayoutStrategy
	{
		public override void CalculateLayout(List<GradientLegendItemData> items, System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = items[0].Bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = items[items.Count - 1].Bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num3 = availableSize.Width * 0.5;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, num3 - num - num2);
			foreach (GradientLegendItemData item in items)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = item.Bounds.Size;
				double num6 = num + num5 * item.Value;
				item.Bounds = new Rect(num6 - size.Width / 2.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, size.Height);
			}
			base.TotalSize = new System.Windows.Size(num3, num4);
			base.GradientMargin = new Thickness(num - 1.0, 0.0, num2 - 1.0, 0.0);
		}
	}

		public TimeSpanScaleOptionsWrapper(AxisBase axis, TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions)
			: base(axis, (ScaleOptionsBase)scaleOptions)
		{
		}

		bool ITimeSpanScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative gridAlignment, double spacing)
		{
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit> valueChangeInfo = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> valueChangeInfo2 = null;
			if (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Automatic && autoMeasureUnit != measureUnit)
			{
				valueChangeInfo = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((TimeSpanMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit, (TimeSpanMeasureUnit)measureUnit);
				autoMeasureUnit = measureUnit;
			}
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				TimeSpanMeasureUnit measureUnitImp = MeasureUnitImp;
				if ((ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Manual || ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Interval) && (int)measureUnitImp > (int)gridAlignment)
				{
					gridAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)measureUnitImp;
					spacing = 1.0;
				}
				if (autoGridAlignment != gridAlignment || autoGridSpacing != spacing)
				{
					valueChangeInfo2 = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((TimeSpanGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment, (TimeSpanGridAlignment)gridAlignment);
					autoGridAlignment = gridAlignment;
					autoGridSpacing = spacing;
				}
			}
			if ((valueChangeInfo != null && valueChangeInfo.IsChanged) || (valueChangeInfo2 != null && valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged))
			{
				OnScaleChanged(valueChangeInfo, null, valueChangeInfo2, null, null, null, null, null, null);
			}
			return valueChangeInfo?.IsChanged ?? false;
		}

		void ITimeSpanScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticGrid(TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative selectedAlignment, double selectedSpacing)
		{
			if (!NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				return;
			}
			TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative measureUnitImp = (TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)MeasureUnitImp;
			if (selectedAlignment < measureUnitImp || (selectedAlignment == measureUnitImp && selectedSpacing < (double)MeasureUnitMultiplierImp))
			{
				selectedAlignment = measureUnitImp;
				selectedSpacing = MeasureUnitMultiplierImp;
			}
			if (autoGridAlignment != selectedAlignment || autoGridSpacing != selectedSpacing)
			{
				ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> valueChangeInfo = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((TimeSpanGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment, (TimeSpanGridAlignment)selectedAlignment);
				ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(autoGridSpacing, selectedSpacing);
				autoGridAlignment = selectedAlignment;
				autoGridSpacing = selectedSpacing;
				if (valueChangeInfo.IsChanged)
				{
					OnScaleChanged(null, null, valueChangeInfo, null, gridSpacingChange, null, null, null, null);
				}
			}
		}

		void ITimeSpanScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged()
		{
			OnScaleChanged(null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		private void SetContinuousTimeSpanOptions(ContinuousTimeSpanScaleOptions continuousOptions)
		{
			ActualContinuousAutoGrid = continuousOptions.AutoGrid;
			ActualContinuousGridSpacing = continuousOptions.GridSpacing;
			ActualContinuousGridOffset = continuousOptions.GridOffset;
			ActualContinuousGridAlignment = continuousOptions.GridAlignment;
		}

		private void SetAutomaticTimeSpanOptions(AutomaticTimeSpanScaleOptions automaticOptions)
		{
			ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction = automaticOptions.AggregateFunction;
			ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = automaticOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
		}

		private void SetIntervalTimeSpanOptions(IntervalTimeSpanScaleOptions intervalOptions)
		{
			base.IntervalPattern = intervalOptions.Pattern;
			base.UnderflowPattern = intervalOptions.UnderflowValuePattern;
			base.OverflowPattern = intervalOptions.OverflowValuePattern;
			ActualUnderflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
			ActualOverflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
		}

		private void SetManualTimeSpanOptions(ManualTimeSpanScaleOptions manualOptions)
		{
			ActualManualAggregateFunction = manualOptions.AggregateFunction;
			ActualManualAggregateFunctionCalculator = manualOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			ActualManualMeasureUnit = manualOptions.MeasureUnit;
			ActualManualMeasureUnitMultiplier = manualOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
			ActualManualAutoGrid = manualOptions.AutoGrid;
			ActualManualGridSpacing = manualOptions.GridSpacing;
			ActualManualGridOffset = manualOptions.GridOffset;
			ActualManualGridAlignment = manualOptions.GridAlignment;
		}

		private void UpdateAutomaticTimeSpanOptions(string propertyName, AutomaticTimeSpanScaleOptions automaticOptions)
		{
			if (propertyName == "AggregateFunction")
			{
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction = automaticOptions.AggregateFunction;
			}
			else if (propertyName == "AggregateFunctionCalculator")
			{
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = automaticOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateManualTimeSpanOptions(string propertyName, ManualTimeSpanScaleOptions manualOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AggregateFunction":
				ActualManualAggregateFunction = manualOptions.AggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "AggregateFunctionCalculator":
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = manualOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "MeasureUnit":
				ActualManualMeasureUnit = manualOptions.MeasureUnit;
				break;
			case "MeasureUnitMultiplier":
				ActualManualMeasureUnitMultiplier = manualOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
				break;
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualManualAutoGrid = manualOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualManualGridSpacing = manualOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualManualGridOffset = manualOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "GridAlignment":
				ActualManualGridAlignment = manualOptions.GridAlignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIntervalTimeSpanOptions(string propertyName, IntervalTimeSpanScaleOptions intervalOptions)
		{
			if (propertyName == "UnderflowValue")
			{
				ActualUnderflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
			}
			else if (propertyName == "OverflowValue")
			{
				ActualOverflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateContinuousTimeSpanOptions(string propertyName, ContinuousTimeSpanScaleOptions continuousOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualContinuousAutoGrid = continuousOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualContinuousGridSpacing = continuousOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualContinuousGridOffset = continuousOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "GridAlignment":
				ActualContinuousGridAlignment = continuousOptions.GridAlignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void OnScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange, ValueChangeInfo<int> measureUnitMultiplierChange, ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpanGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange, ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> aggregateFunctionChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridOffsetChange, ValueChangeInfo<bool> autoGridChange, ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<TimeSpan?> overflowValueChange)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				TimeSpanScaleChangedEventArgs eventArgs = new TimeSpanScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((ScaleMode)ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(measureUnitChange, (TimeSpanMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(measureUnitMultiplierChange, MeasureUnitMultiplierImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridAlignmentChange, (TimeSpanGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridSpacingChange, autoGridSpacing), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(aggregateFunctionChange, AggregateFunctionImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridOffsetChange, GridOffsetImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(autoGridChange, AutoGridImp), new IntervalOptionsChangeInfo<TimeSpan?>(ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(underflowValueChange, underflowValue), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(overflowValueChange, overflowValue)));
				RaiseAxisScaleChangedEvent(eventArgs, doInvalidate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			return ScaleOptions.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(series, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualMin, visualMax, wholeMin, wholeMax);
		}

		protected override ScaleOptionsImage CreateScaleOptionsImage()
		{
			return new TimeSpanScaleOptionsImage(this);
		}

		public override void SetActualProperties(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			autoMeasureUnit = TimeSpanUnitSelector.DefaultMeasureUnit;
			autoGridAlignment = TimeSpanUnitSelector.DefaultGridAlignment;
			autoGridSpacing = 1.0;
			switch (options.ScaleModeImp)
			{
			case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
				SetAutomaticTimeSpanOptions((AutomaticTimeSpanScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				SetManualTimeSpanOptions((ManualTimeSpanScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
			{
				IntervalTimeSpanScaleOptions intervalTimeSpanScaleOptions = (IntervalTimeSpanScaleOptions)options;
				SetManualTimeSpanOptions(intervalTimeSpanScaleOptions);
				SetIntervalTimeSpanOptions(intervalTimeSpanScaleOptions);
				break;
			}
			default:
				SetContinuousTimeSpanOptions((ContinuousTimeSpanScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			}
			TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase timeSpanScaleOptionsBase = options as TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase;
			base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)timeSpanScaleOptionsBase.GridLayoutMode;
		}

		public override void UpdateActualProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			TimeSpanScaleOptionsBase timeSpanScaleOptionsBase = ScaleOptions;
			switch (timeSpanScaleOptionsBase.ScaleModeImp)
			{
			case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
				UpdateAutomaticTimeSpanOptions(propertyName, (AutomaticTimeSpanScaleOptions)timeSpanScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				UpdateManualTimeSpanOptions(propertyName, (ManualTimeSpanScaleOptions)timeSpanScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
			{
				IntervalTimeSpanScaleOptions intervalTimeSpanScaleOptions = (IntervalTimeSpanScaleOptions)timeSpanScaleOptionsBase;
				UpdateManualTimeSpanOptions(propertyName, intervalTimeSpanScaleOptions);
				UpdateIntervalTimeSpanOptions(propertyName, intervalTimeSpanScaleOptions);
				break;
			}
			default:
				UpdateContinuousTimeSpanOptions(propertyName, (ContinuousTimeSpanScaleOptions)timeSpanScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			}
			if (propertyName == "GridLayoutMode")
			{
				base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)timeSpanScaleOptionsBase.GridLayoutMode;
			}
		}
	}

		bool IDateTimeScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative gridAlignment, double spacing)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0026: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit> valueChangeInfo = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment> valueChangeInfo2 = null;
			if (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Automatic && autoMeasureUnit != measureUnit)
			{
				valueChangeInfo = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((DateTimeMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit, (DateTimeMeasureUnit)measureUnit);
				autoMeasureUnit = measureUnit;
			}
			if (NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				DateTimeMeasureUnit measureUnitImp = MeasureUnitImp;
				if ((ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Manual || ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Interval) && (int)measureUnitImp > (int)gridAlignment)
				{
					gridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)measureUnitImp;
					spacing = 1.0;
				}
				if (autoGridAlignment != gridAlignment || autoGridSpacing != spacing)
				{
					valueChangeInfo2 = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((DateTimeGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment, (DateTimeGridAlignment)gridAlignment);
					autoGridAlignment = gridAlignment;
					autoGridSpacing = spacing;
				}
			}
			if ((valueChangeInfo != null && valueChangeInfo.IsChanged) || (valueChangeInfo2 != null && valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged))
			{
				OnScaleChanged(valueChangeInfo, null, valueChangeInfo2, null, null, null, null, null, null);
			}
			return valueChangeInfo?.IsChanged ?? false;
		}

		void IDateTimeScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticGrid(DateTimeGridAlignmentNative selectedAlignment, double selectedSpacing)
		{
			if (!NeedAutoGridAlignment)
			{
				return;
			}
			DateTimeGridAlignmentNative measureUnitImp = (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)MeasureUnitImp;
			if (selectedAlignment < measureUnitImp || (selectedAlignment == measureUnitImp && selectedSpacing < (double)MeasureUnitMultiplierImp))
			{
				selectedAlignment = measureUnitImp;
				selectedSpacing = MeasureUnitMultiplierImp;
			}
			if (autoGridAlignment != selectedAlignment || autoGridSpacing != selectedSpacing)
			{
				ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment> valueChangeInfo = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((DateTimeGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment, (DateTimeGridAlignment)selectedAlignment);
				ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(autoGridSpacing, selectedSpacing);
				autoGridAlignment = selectedAlignment;
				autoGridSpacing = selectedSpacing;
				if (valueChangeInfo.IsChanged)
				{
					OnScaleChanged(null, null, valueChangeInfo, null, gridSpacingChange, null, null, null, null);
				}
			}
		}

		void IDateTimeScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged()
		{
			OnScaleChanged(null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		private void SetContinuousDateTimeOptions(ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions continuousOptions)
		{
			ActualContinuousAutoGrid = continuousOptions.AutoGrid;
			ActualContinuousGridSpacing = continuousOptions.GridSpacing;
			ActualContinuousGridOffset = continuousOptions.GridOffset;
			ActualContinuousGridAlignment = continuousOptions.GridAlignment;
		}

		private void SetAutomaticDateTimeOptions(AutomaticDateTimeScaleOptions automaticOptions)
		{
			ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction = automaticOptions.AggregateFunction;
			ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = automaticOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
		}

		private void SetIntervalDateTimeOptions(IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions intervalOptions)
		{
			base.IntervalPattern = intervalOptions.Pattern;
			base.UnderflowPattern = intervalOptions.UnderflowValuePattern;
			base.OverflowPattern = intervalOptions.OverflowValuePattern;
			ActualUnderflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
			ActualOverflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
			DivisionMode = intervalOptions.DivisionMode;
			if (DivisionMode == IntervalDivisionModeNative.Count)
			{
				IntervalCount = intervalOptions.IntervalCount;
			}
			else if (DivisionMode == IntervalDivisionModeNative.Width)
			{
				IntervalWidth = intervalOptions.IntervalWidth;
			}
		}

		private void SetManualDateTimeOptions(ManualDateTimeScaleOptions manualOptions)
		{
			ActualManualAggregateFunction = manualOptions.AggregateFunction;
			ActualManualAggregateFunctionCalculator = manualOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			ActualManualMeasureUnit = manualOptions.MeasureUnit;
			ActualManualMeasureUnitMultiplier = manualOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
			ActualManualAutoGrid = manualOptions.AutoGrid;
			ActualManualGridSpacing = manualOptions.GridSpacing;
			ActualManualGridOffset = manualOptions.GridOffset;
			ActualManualGridAlignment = manualOptions.GridAlignment;
		}

		private void UpdateAutomaticDateTimeOptions(string propertyName, AutomaticDateTimeScaleOptions automaticOptions)
		{
			if (propertyName == "AggregateFunction")
			{
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction = automaticOptions.AggregateFunction;
			}
			else if (propertyName == "AggregateFunctionCalculator")
			{
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = automaticOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateManualDateTimeOptions(string propertyName, ManualDateTimeScaleOptions manualOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AggregateFunction":
				ActualManualAggregateFunction = manualOptions.AggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "AggregateFunctionCalculator":
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = manualOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "MeasureUnit":
				ActualManualMeasureUnit = manualOptions.MeasureUnit;
				break;
			case "MeasureUnitMultiplier":
				ActualManualMeasureUnitMultiplier = manualOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
				break;
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualManualAutoGrid = manualOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualManualGridSpacing = manualOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualManualGridOffset = manualOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "GridAlignment":
				ActualManualGridAlignment = manualOptions.GridAlignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIntervalDateTimeOptions(string propertyName, IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions intervalOptions)
		{
			if (propertyName == "UnderflowValue")
			{
				ActualUnderflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
			}
			else if (propertyName == "OverflowValue")
			{
				ActualOverflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateContinuousDateTimeOptions(string propertyName, ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions continuousOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualContinuousAutoGrid = continuousOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualContinuousGridSpacing = continuousOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualContinuousGridOffset = continuousOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "GridAlignment":
				ActualContinuousGridAlignment = continuousOptions.GridAlignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void OnScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeMeasureUnit> measureUnitChange, ValueChangeInfo<int> measureUnitMultiplierChange, ValueChangeInfo<DateTimeGridAlignment> gridAlignmentChange, ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> aggregateFunctionChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridOffsetChange, ValueChangeInfo<bool> autoGridChange, ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<DateTime?> overflowValueChange)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (base.Axis != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				DateTimeScaleChangedEventArgs eventArgs = new DateTimeScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((ScaleMode)ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(measureUnitChange, (DateTimeMeasureUnit)autoMeasureUnit), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(measureUnitMultiplierChange, MeasureUnitMultiplierImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridAlignmentChange, (DateTimeGridAlignment)autoGridAlignment), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridSpacingChange, autoGridSpacing), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(aggregateFunctionChange, AggregateFunctionImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridOffsetChange, GridOffsetImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(autoGridChange, AutoGridImp), new IntervalOptionsChangeInfo<DateTime?>(ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(underflowValueChange, underflowValue), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(overflowValueChange, overflowValue)));
				RaiseAxisScaleChangedEvent(eventArgs, doInvalidate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override DateTimeMeasureUnitNative CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ScaleOptions.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(series, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualMin, visualMax, wholeMin, wholeMax);
		}

		protected override ScaleOptionsImage CreateScaleOptionsImage()
		{
			return new DateTimeScaleOptionsImage(this);
		}

		public override void SetActualProperties(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			autoMeasureUnit = DateTimeUnitSelector.DefaultMeasureUnit;
			autoGridAlignment = DateTimeUnitSelector.DefaultGridAlignment;
			autoGridSpacing = 1.0;
			switch (options.ScaleModeImp)
			{
			case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
				SetAutomaticDateTimeOptions((AutomaticDateTimeScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				SetManualDateTimeOptions((ManualDateTimeScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
			{
				IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions intervalDateTimeScaleOptions = (IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions)options;
				SetManualDateTimeOptions(intervalDateTimeScaleOptions);
				SetIntervalDateTimeOptions(intervalDateTimeScaleOptions);
				break;
			}
			default:
				SetContinuousDateTimeOptions((ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			}
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsBase = options as DateTimeScaleOptionsBase;
			ActualWorkdaysOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptions = dateTimeScaleOptionsBase;
			ActualWorkTimeRuleCollectionWrapper.ScaleOptions = dateTimeScaleOptionsBase;
			base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)dateTimeScaleOptionsBase.GridLayoutMode;
		}

		public override void UpdateActualProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsBase = ScaleOptions;
			switch (dateTimeScaleOptionsBase.ScaleModeImp)
			{
			case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
				UpdateAutomaticDateTimeOptions(propertyName, (AutomaticDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				UpdateManualDateTimeOptions(propertyName, (ManualDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
			{
				IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions intervalDateTimeScaleOptions = (IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeScaleOptionsBase;
				UpdateManualDateTimeOptions(propertyName, intervalDateTimeScaleOptions);
				UpdateIntervalDateTimeOptions(propertyName, intervalDateTimeScaleOptions);
				break;
			}
			default:
				UpdateContinuousDateTimeOptions(propertyName, (ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			}
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "WorkdaysOptions":
				ActualWorkdaysOptionsWrapper.ScaleOptions = dateTimeScaleOptionsBase;
				break;
			case "ExactWorkdays":
			case "Holidays":
				ActualWorkdaysOptionsWrapper.UpdateActualProperty(propertyName);
				break;
			case "GridLayoutMode":
				base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)dateTimeScaleOptionsBase.GridLayoutMode;
				break;
			}
		}
	}

		private double GridAlignmentImp
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.AxisData is ILogarithmic && ((ILogarithmic)base.AxisData).Enabled)
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				if (GridSpacingAutoImp)
				{
					return autoGridAlignment;
				}
				return ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp switch
				{
					ScaleModeNative.Continuous => Math.Max(ActualContinuousGridAlignment, 1.0), 
					ScaleModeNative.Manual => Math.Max(ActualManualGridAlignment, ActualManualMeasureUnit), 
					ScaleModeNative.Interval => ActualManualGridAlignment, 
					_ => 1.0, 
				};
			}
		}

		private double ActualMeasureUnit
		{
			get
			{
				if (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp != ScaleModeNative.Manual && ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp != ScaleModeNative.Interval)
				{
					return autoMeasureUnit;
				}
				return ActualManualMeasureUnit;
			}
		}

		protected override double MeasureUnit => ActualMeasureUnit;

		protected override bool UseCustomMeasureUnit => ScaleOptions.UseCustomMeasureUnit;

		{

				return true;

		protected override AggregateFunction AggregateFunctionImp
		{
			get
			{
				if (ScaleOptions != null)
				{
					switch (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp)
					{
					case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
						return ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction;
					case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
					case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
						return ActualManualAggregateFunction;
					}
				}
				return AggregateFunction.None;
			}
		}

		protected override CustomAggregateFunction CustomAggregateFunctionImp
		{
			get
			{
				switch (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp)
				{
				case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
					return ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator;
				case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
					return ActualManualAggregateFunctionCalculator;
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override double GridSpacingImp
		{
			get
			{
				switch (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp)
				{
				case ScaleModeNative.Continuous:
					if (!AutoGridImp)
					{
						return ActualContinuousGridSpacing;
					}
					return continuousAutoGridSpacing;
				case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
					if (!AutoGridImp)
					{
						return ActualManualGridSpacing;
					}
					return manualAutoGridSpacing;
				default:
					return double.NaN;
				}
			}
			set
			{
				switch (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp)
				{
				case ScaleModeNative.Continuous:
					continuousAutoGridSpacing = value;
					break;
				case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
					manualAutoGridSpacing = value;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override double GridOffsetImp
		{
			get
			{
				switch (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp)
				{
				case ScaleModeNative.Continuous:
					return ActualContinuousGridOffset;
				case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
					return ActualManualGridOffset;
				default:
					return 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override double? UnderflowValue => underflowValue;

		protected override double? OverflowValue => overflowValue;

		public override bool AutoGridImp
		{
			get
			{
				switch (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp)
				{
				case ScaleModeNative.Continuous:
					if (!ActualContinuousAutoGrid)
					{
						return double.IsNaN(ActualContinuousGridSpacing);
					}
					return true;
				case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
					return ActualManualAutoGrid;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		{
		}

		bool INumericScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(double measureUnit)
		{
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo2 = null;
			ValueChangeInfo<double> valueChangeInfo3 = null;
			bool result = false;
			double num = autoMeasureUnit;
			autoMeasureUnit = measureUnit;
			if (ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp == ScaleModeNative.Automatic && num != autoMeasureUnit)
			{
				valueChangeInfo = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(num, autoMeasureUnit);
				result = true;
			}
			if (GridSpacingAutoImp)
			{
				valueChangeInfo2 = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(autoGridAlignment, measureUnit);
				autoGridAlignment = measureUnit;
				if (autoGridSpacing != GridSpacingImp)
				{
					valueChangeInfo3 = ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(autoGridSpacing, GridSpacingImp);
					autoGridSpacing = GridSpacingImp;
				}
			}
			if ((valueChangeInfo != null && valueChangeInfo.IsChanged) || (valueChangeInfo2 != null && valueChangeInfo2.IsChanged) || (valueChangeInfo3 != null && valueChangeInfo3.IsChanged))
			{
				OnScaleChanged(valueChangeInfo, valueChangeInfo2, null, valueChangeInfo3, null, null);
			}
			return result;
		}

		void INumericScaleOptions.RaiseScaleChanged()
		{
			OnScaleChanged(null, null, null, null, null, null);
		}

		private void SetContinuousNumericScaleOptions(ContinuousNumericScaleOptions continuousOptions)

			ActualContinuousGridSpacing = continuousOptions.GridSpacing;

			ActualContinuousGridAlignment = continuousOptions.GridAlignment;
			ActualGridAlignmentStartPoint = continuousOptions.GridAlignmentStartPoint;

		{
			ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction = automaticOptions.AggregateFunction;

		}

		private void SetManualNumericScaleOptions(ManualNumericScaleOptions manualOptions)
		{
			ActualManualAggregateFunction = manualOptions.AggregateFunction;
			ActualManualAggregateFunctionCalculator = manualOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			ActualManualMeasureUnit = manualOptions.MeasureUnit;
			ActualManualAutoGrid = manualOptions.AutoGrid;
			ActualManualGridSpacing = manualOptions.GridSpacing;
			ActualManualGridOffset = manualOptions.GridOffset;
			ActualManualGridAlignment = manualOptions.GridAlignment;
		}

		private void SetIntervalNumericScaleOptions(IntervalNumericScaleOptions intervalOptions)
		{
			base.IntervalPattern = intervalOptions.Pattern;
			base.UnderflowPattern = intervalOptions.UnderflowValuePattern;
			base.OverflowPattern = intervalOptions.OverflowValuePattern;
			ActualUnderflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
			ActualOverflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
			base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)intervalOptions.GridLayoutMode;
			if (intervalOptions.DivisionModeImp == IntervalDivisionMode.Width)
			{
				ActualIntervalWidth = ((WidthIntervalNumericScaleOptions)intervalOptions).Width;
			}
			else if (intervalOptions.DivisionModeImp == IntervalDivisionMode.Count)
			{
				ActualIntervalCount = ((CountIntervalNumericScaleOptions)intervalOptions).Count;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAutomaticNumericOptions(string propertyName, AutomaticNumericScaleOptions automaticOptions)
		{
			if (propertyName == "AggregateFunction")
			{
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunction = automaticOptions.AggregateFunction;
			}
			else if (propertyName == "AggregateFunctionCalculator")
			{
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = automaticOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateManualNumericOptions(string propertyName, ManualNumericScaleOptions manualOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AggregateFunction":
				ActualManualAggregateFunction = manualOptions.AggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "AggregateFunctionCalculator":
				ActualAutomaticAggregateFunctionCalculator = manualOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "MeasureUnit":
				ActualManualMeasureUnit = manualOptions.MeasureUnit;
				break;
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualManualAutoGrid = manualOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualManualGridSpacing = manualOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualManualGridOffset = manualOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "GridAlignment":
				ActualManualGridAlignment = manualOptions.GridAlignment;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIntervalNumericOptions(string propertyName, IntervalNumericScaleOptions intervalOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "UnderflowValue":
				ActualUnderflowValue = intervalOptions.UnderflowValue;
				break;
			case "OverflowValue":
				ActualOverflowValue = intervalOptions.OverflowValue;
				break;
			case "GridLayoutMode":
				base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)intervalOptions.GridLayoutMode;
				break;
			case "Width":
				ActualIntervalWidth = ((WidthIntervalNumericScaleOptions)intervalOptions).Width;
				break;
			case "Count":
				ActualIntervalCount = ((CountIntervalNumericScaleOptions)intervalOptions).Count;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateContinuousNumericOptions(string propertyName, ContinuousNumericScaleOptions continuousOptions)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualContinuousAutoGrid = continuousOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualContinuousGridSpacing = continuousOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualContinuousGridOffset = continuousOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "GridAlignment":
				ActualContinuousGridAlignment = continuousOptions.GridAlignment;
				break;
			case "GridAlignmentStartPoint":
				ActualGridAlignmentStartPoint = continuousOptions.GridAlignmentStartPoint;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void OnScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<double> measureUnitChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridAlignmentChange, ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> aggregateFunctionChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridOffsetChange, ValueChangeInfo<bool> autoGridChange)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				NumericScaleChangedEventArgs eventArgs = new NumericScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((ScaleMode)ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(measureUnitChange, ActualMeasureUnit), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridAlignmentChange, GridAlignmentImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridSpacingChange, GridSpacingImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(aggregateFunctionChange, AggregateFunctionImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridOffsetChange, GridOffsetImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(autoGridChange, AutoGridImp), new NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, ActualUnderflowValue), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, ActualOverflowValue), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, ActualIntervalWidth), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, ActualIntervalCount)));
				RaiseAxisScaleChangedEvent(eventArgs, doInvalidate: false);
			}
		}

		protected void OnIntervalScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<double?> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<double?> overflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<double?> intervalWidthChange, ValueChangeInfo<int?> intervalCountChange)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				NumericScaleChangedEventArgs e = new NumericScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo((ScaleMode)ScaleOptions.ScaleModeImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, ActualMeasureUnit), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, GridAlignmentImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, GridSpacingImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, AggregateFunctionImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, GridOffsetImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(null, AutoGridImp), new NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(underflowValueChange, overflowValueChange, intervalWidthChange, intervalCountChange));
				base.Container.PlatformElement.RaiseEvent(e);
			}
		}

		protected override double CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> series, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, double visualMin, double visualMax, double wholeMin, double wholeMax)
		{
			return ScaleOptions.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(series, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualMin, visualMax, wholeMin, wholeMax);
		}

		protected override ScaleOptionsImage CreateScaleOptionsImage()
		{
			return new NumericScaleOptionsImage(this);
		}

		public override void SetActualProperties(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			autoMeasureUnit = double.NaN;
			autoGridSpacing = double.NaN;
			autoGridAlignment = 1.0;
			switch (options.ScaleModeImp)
			{
			case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
				SetAutomaticNumericScaleOptions((AutomaticNumericScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				SetManualNumericScaleOptions((ManualNumericScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
			{
				IntervalNumericScaleOptions intervalNumericScaleOptions = (IntervalNumericScaleOptions)options;
				SetManualNumericScaleOptions(intervalNumericScaleOptions);
				SetIntervalNumericScaleOptions(intervalNumericScaleOptions);
				break;
			}
			default:
				SetContinuousNumericScaleOptions((ContinuousNumericScaleOptions)options);
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateActualProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			NumericScaleOptionsBase numericScaleOptionsBase = ScaleOptions;
			switch (numericScaleOptionsBase.ScaleModeImp)
			{
			case ScaleModeNative.Automatic:
				UpdateAutomaticNumericOptions(propertyName, (AutomaticNumericScaleOptions)numericScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Manual:
				UpdateManualNumericOptions(propertyName, (ManualNumericScaleOptions)numericScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			case ScaleModeNative.Interval:
			{
				IntervalNumericScaleOptions intervalNumericScaleOptions = (IntervalNumericScaleOptions)numericScaleOptionsBase;
				UpdateManualNumericOptions(propertyName, intervalNumericScaleOptions);
				UpdateIntervalNumericOptions(propertyName, intervalNumericScaleOptions);
				break;
			}
			default:
				UpdateContinuousNumericOptions(propertyName, (ContinuousNumericScaleOptions)numericScaleOptionsBase);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo : IntervalOptionsChangeInfo<double?>
	{
		private readonly ValueChangeInfo<double?> intervalWidthChange;

		private readonly ValueChangeInfo<int?> intervalCountChange;

		public ValueChangeInfo<double?> IntervalWidthChange => intervalWidthChange;

		public ValueChangeInfo<int?> IntervalCountChange => intervalCountChange;

		public NumericIntervalOptionsChangeInfo(ValueChangeInfo<double?> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<double?> overflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<double?> intervalWidthChange, ValueChangeInfo<int?> intervalCountChange)
			: base(underflowValueChange, overflowValueChange)
		{
			this.intervalWidthChange = intervalWidthChange;
			this.intervalCountChange = intervalCountChange;
		}
	}
	public class QualitativeScaleOptionsWrapper : ScaleOptionsWrapper
	{
		private bool autoGrid;

		private double gridSpacing = 1.0;

		private double gridOffset;

		private AggregateFunction aggregateFunction;

		private CustomAggregateFunction aggregateFunctionCalculator;

		private AggregateFunction ActualAggregateFunction
		{
			get
			{
				return aggregateFunction;
			}
			set
			{
				if (aggregateFunction != value)
				{
					OnScaleChanged(ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(aggregateFunction, value), null, null, null);
				}
				aggregateFunction = value;
			}
		}

		private CustomAggregateFunction ActualAggregateFunctionCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				return aggregateFunctionCalculator;
			}
			set
			{
				aggregateFunctionCalculator = value;
			}
		}

		private bool ActualAutoGrid
		{
			get
			{
				return autoGrid;
			}
			set
			{
				if (autoGrid != value)
				{
					OnScaleChanged(null, null, null, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(autoGrid, value));
				}
				autoGrid = value;
			}
		}

		private double ActualGridSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return gridSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (gridSpacing != value)
				{
					OnScaleChanged(null, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(gridSpacing, value), null, null);
				}
				gridSpacing = value;
			}
		}

		private double ActualGridOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return gridOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				if (gridOffset != value)
				{
					OnScaleChanged(null, null, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(gridOffset, value), null);
				}
				gridOffset = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool GridSpacingAutoImp => AutoGridImp;

		protected override AggregateFunction AggregateFunctionImp => ActualAggregateFunction;

		protected override CustomAggregateFunction CustomAggregateFunctionImp => ActualAggregateFunctionCalculator;

		protected override double GridSpacingImp
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualGridSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				ActualGridSpacing = value;
			}
		}

		protected override double GridOffsetImp => ActualGridOffset;

		public override bool AutoGridImp
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ActualAutoGrid)
				{
					return double.IsNaN(GridSpacingImp);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public new QualitativeScaleOptions ScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return base.ScaleOptions as QualitativeScaleOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				base.ScaleOptions = value;
			}
		}

		public QualitativeScaleOptionsWrapper(AxisBase axis, QualitativeScaleOptions scaleOptions)
			: base(axis, scaleOptions)
		{
		}

		private void OnScaleChanged(ValueChangeInfo<AggregateFunction> aggregateFunctionChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridSpacingChange, ValueChangeInfo<double> gridOffsetChange, ValueChangeInfo<bool> autoGridChange)
		{
			if (base.Axis != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				QualitativeScaleChangedEventArgs eventArgs = new QualitativeScaleChangedEventArgs(base.Axis, ScaleOptionsBase.CreateInfo(ScaleMode.Continuous), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridSpacingChange, GridSpacingImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(aggregateFunctionChange, AggregateFunctionImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(gridOffsetChange, GridOffsetImp), ScaleOptionsBase.GetInfo(autoGridChange, AutoGridImp));
				RaiseAxisScaleChangedEvent(eventArgs, doInvalidate: false);
			}
		}

		protected override ScaleOptionsImage CreateScaleOptionsImage()
		{
			return new QualitativeScaleOptionsImage(this);
		}

		public override void SetActualProperties(ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			QualitativeScaleOptions qualitativeScaleOptions = (QualitativeScaleOptions)options;
			ActualAutoGrid = qualitativeScaleOptions.AutoGrid;
			ActualGridSpacing = qualitativeScaleOptions.GridSpacing;
			ActualGridOffset = qualitativeScaleOptions.GridOffset;
			ActualAggregateFunction = qualitativeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction;
			ActualAggregateFunctionCalculator = qualitativeScaleOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)qualitativeScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode;
		}

		public override void UpdateActualProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			QualitativeScaleOptions qualitativeScaleOptions = ScaleOptions;
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "AutoGrid":
				ActualAutoGrid = qualitativeScaleOptions.AutoGrid;
				break;
			case "GridSpacing":
				ActualGridSpacing = qualitativeScaleOptions.GridSpacing;
				break;
			case "GridOffset":
				ActualGridOffset = qualitativeScaleOptions.GridOffset;
				break;
			case "AggregateFunction":
				ActualAggregateFunction = qualitativeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "AggregateFunctionCalculator":
				ActualAggregateFunctionCalculator = qualitativeScaleOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
				break;
			case "GridLayoutMode":
				base.GridLayoutModeImp = (GridLayoutModeNative)qualitativeScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
