	public abstract class ScaleOptionsWrapper : IChartElement, IOwnedElement, INotificationOwner, IScaleOptionsBase
	{
		public abstract class ScaleOptionsImage
		{
			public bool IsValidImage { get; private set; }

			public ScaleMode ScaleMode { get; private set; }

			public double GridSpacing { get; private set; }

			public double GridOffset { get; private set; }

			public bool AutoGrid { get; private set; }

			public AggregateFunction AggregateFunction { get; private set; }

			public ScaleOptionsImage(ScaleOptionsWrapper initialWrapper)
			{
				if (initialWrapper.ScaleOptions != null)
				{
					ScaleMode = (ScaleMode)((IScaleOptionsBase)initialWrapper).ScaleMode;
					GridSpacing = ((IScaleOptionsBase)initialWrapper).GridSpacing;
					GridOffset = ((IScaleOptionsBase)initialWrapper).GridOffset;
					AutoGrid = initialWrapper.AutoGridImp;
					AggregateFunction = (AggregateFunction)((IScaleOptionsBase)initialWrapper).AggregateFunction;
					IsValidImage = true;
				}
				else
				{
					IsValidImage = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract class HistogramScaleOptionsImage<TMeasureUnit> : ScaleOptionsImage where TMeasureUnit : struct
		{
			public string Pattern { get; private set; }

			public string UnderflowValuePattern { get; private set; }

			public string OverflowValuePattern { get; private set; }

			public HistogramScaleOptionsImage(ScaleOptionsWrapper initialWrapper)
				: base(initialWrapper)
			{
				if (initialWrapper.ScaleOptions != null)
				{
					IScaleOptionsBase<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptionsBase = (IScaleOptionsBase<TMeasureUnit>)initialWrapper;
					Pattern = scaleOptionsBase.IntervalPattern;
					UnderflowValuePattern = scaleOptionsBase.UnderflowPattern;
					OverflowValuePattern = scaleOptionsBase.OverflowPattern;
				}
			}
		}

		public class DateTimeScaleOptionsImage : HistogramScaleOptionsImage<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative>
		{

			public int DateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier { get; private set; }

			public DateTimeGridAlignment DateTimeGridAlignment { get; private set; }

			public DateTime? UnderflowValue { get; private set; }

			public DateTime? OverflowValue { get; private set; }

			public DateTimeScaleOptionsImage(DateTimeScaleOptionsWrapper initialWrapper)
				: base((ScaleOptionsWrapper)initialWrapper)
			{
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				if (initialWrapper.ScaleOptions != null)
				{
					DateTimeMeasureUnit = (DateTimeMeasureUnit)((IScaleOptionsBase<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative>)initialWrapper).MeasureUnit;
					DateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier = ((IDateTimeScaleOptions)initialWrapper).MeasureUnitMultiplier;
					DateTimeGridAlignment = (DateTimeGridAlignment)((IDateTimeScaleOptions)initialWrapper).GridAlignment;
					UnderflowValue = initialWrapper.ActualUnderflowValue;
					OverflowValue = initialWrapper.ActualOverflowValue;
				}
			}
		}

					TimeSpanGridAlignment = (TimeSpanGridAlignment)((ITimeSpanScaleOptions)initialWrapper).GridAlignment;

					OverflowValue = ((IScaleOptionsBase<double>)initialWrapper).OverflowValue;

					IntervalCount = ((IScaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport<double>)initialWrapper).IntervalCount;

		public class QualitativeScaleOptionsImage : ScaleOptionsImage
		{
			public QualitativeScaleOptionsImage(QualitativeScaleOptionsWrapper initialWrapper)
				: base(initialWrapper)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly AxisBase axis;

		private ScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions;

		private bool isEventLocked;

		private Diagram Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				IOwnedElement ownedElement = Axis;
				if (ownedElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ownedElement.Owner as Diagram;
			}
		}

		protected IContainerElement Container
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Diagram.Container;
			}
		}

		protected AxisBase Axis => axis;

		protected IAxisData AxisData => axis;

		protected GridLayoutModeNative GridLayoutModeImp { get; set; }

		protected abstract AggregateFunction AggregateFunctionImp { get; }

		protected abstract CustomAggregateFunction CustomAggregateFunctionImp { get; }

		protected abstract bool GridSpacingAutoImp { get; }

		protected abstract double GridSpacingImp { get; set; }

		protected abstract double GridOffsetImp { get; }

		public abstract bool AutoGridImp { get; }

		public ScaleOptionsBase ScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return scaleOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(scaleOptions, value, axis);
				if (scaleOptions is IOwnedElement ownedElement)
				{
					ownedElement.Owner = null;
				}
				ScaleOptionsImage oldOptions = CreateScaleOptionsImage();
				AggregateFunction aggregateFunctionImp = AggregateFunctionImp;
				scaleOptions = value;
				SetActualProperties(value);
				if (scaleOptions is IOwnedElement ownedElement2)
				{
					ownedElement2.Owner = axis;
				}
				AxisScaleChangedEventArgs eventArgs = AxisScaleChangedEventArgsHelper.Create(Axis, oldOptions, CreateScaleOptionsImage());
				if (Container != null)
				{
					RaiseAxisScaleChangedEvent(eventArgs, doInvalidate: true);
				}
				if (axis != null && axis.CheckUpdatingSeriesBinding((AggregateFunctionNative)aggregateFunctionImp, this, out var changes))
				{
					ChartElementHelper.Update((IChartElement)axis, changes);
				}
			}
		}

		IChartElement IOwnedElement.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return axis;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		ViewController INotificationOwner.Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (axis != null)
				{
					return ((INotificationOwner)axis).Controller;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		AggregateFunctionNative IScaleOptionsBase.AggregateFunction => (AggregateFunctionNative)AggregateFunctionImp;

		ICustomAggregateFunction IScaleOptionsBase.CustomAggregateFunction => CustomAggregateFunctionImp;

		ScaleModeNative IScaleOptionsBase.ScaleMode => scaleOptions.ScaleModeImp;

		ProcessMissingPointsModeNative IScaleOptionsBase.ProcessMissingPoints => (ProcessMissingPointsModeNative)scaleOptions.ActualProcessMissingPoints;

		bool IScaleOptionsBase.GridSpacingAuto => GridSpacingAutoImp;

		double IScaleOptionsBase.GridSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return GridSpacingImp;
			}
			set
			{
				GridSpacingImp = value;
			}
		}

		double IScaleOptionsBase.GridOffset => GridOffsetImp;

		GridLayoutModeNative IScaleOptionsBase.GridLayoutMode => GridLayoutModeImp;

		bool IChartElement.Changed(ChartUpdate updateInfo)
		{
			if (axis != null)
			{
				return ((IChartElement)axis).Changed(updateInfo);
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IChartElement.AddChild(object child)
		{
		}

		void IChartElement.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
		}

		public ScaleOptionsWrapper(AxisBase axis, ScaleOptionsBase options)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			ScaleOptions = options;
		}

		protected void RaiseAxisScaleChangedEvent(AxisScaleChangedEventArgs eventArgs, bool doInvalidate)
		{
			if (!isEventLocked && eventArgs != null)
			{
				isEventLocked = true;
				Container.PlatformElement.RaiseEvent(eventArgs);
				if (doInvalidate)
				{
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(Diagram);
				}
				isEventLocked = false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract ScaleOptionsImage CreateScaleOptionsImage();

		public abstract void SetActualProperties(ScaleOptionsBase options);

		public abstract void UpdateActualProperty(string propertyName);
	}
	public class IntervalOptionsChangeInfo<T>
	{
		private readonly ValueChangeInfo<T> underflowValueChange;

		private readonly ValueChangeInfo<T> overflowValueChange;

		public ValueChangeInfo<T> UnderflowValueChange => underflowValueChange;

		public ValueChangeInfo<T> OverflowValueChange => overflowValueChange;

		internal IntervalOptionsChangeInfo(ValueChangeInfo<T> underflowValueChange, ValueChangeInfo<T> overflowValueChange)
		{
			this.underflowValueChange = underflowValueChange;
			this.overflowValueChange = overflowValueChange;
		}
	}

					}
					IEnumerable<DateTime> enumerable2;
					if (value == null)
					{
						IEnumerable<DateTime> enumerable = new DateTimeCollection();
						enumerable2 = enumerable;
					}
					else
					{
						enumerable2 = value;
					}
					actualHolidays = enumerable2;
					if (actualHolidays is INotifyCollectionChanged)

						enumerable2 = value;
					}
					actualExactWorkdays = enumerable2;
					if (actualExactWorkdays is INotifyCollectionChanged)

					}
				}
			}

		private WorkdaysOptions WorkdaysOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return workdaysOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				WorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions = ((value != null) ? value : new WorkdaysOptions());
				CommonUtils.SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(this.workdaysOptions, workdaysOptions, ScaleOptions);
				this.workdaysOptions = workdaysOptions;
				customDays = new CustomDateCollection();
				ActualExactWorkdays = new DateTimeCollection();
				ActualHolidays = new DateTimeCollection();
				SetActualProperties(workdaysOptions);
			}
		}

		public DateTimeScaleOptionsBase ScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return scaleOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				scaleOptions = value;
				WorkdaysOptions = value.WorkdaysOptions;
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<CustomDate> IWorkdaysOptions.CustomDates
		{
			get
			{
				SyncCustomDates();
				return customDays.Dates;
			}

		DayOfWeek IWorkdaysOptions.FirstDayOfWeek => Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;

		public WorkdaysOptionsWrapper(DateTimeScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions)
		{
			this.scaleOptions = scaleOptions;
			WorkdaysOptions = scaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions;
		}

		private void SyncCustomDates()
		{
			if (customDays != null)
			{
				customDays.Clear();
			}
			if (ActualHolidays != null)
			{
				foreach (DateTime actualHoliday in ActualHolidays)
				{
					customDays.SetDate(actualHoliday.Date, isHoliday: true);
				}
			}
			if (ActualExactWorkdays == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DateTime actualExactWorkday in ActualExactWorkdays)
			{
				customDays.SetDate(actualExactWorkday.Date, isHoliday: false);
			}
		}

		private void SetActualProperties(WorkdaysOptions options)
		{
			ActualExactWorkdays = options.ExactWorkdays;
			ActualHolidays = options.Holidays;
		}

		public void UpdateActualProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			WorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions = WorkdaysOptions;
			if (!(propertyName == "ExactWorkdays"))
			{
				if (propertyName == "Holidays")
				{
					ActualHolidays = workdaysOptions.Holidays;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ActualExactWorkdays = workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays;
			}
		}
	}
	public class WorkTimeRuleCollectionWrapper : IWorkTimeRuleCollection
	{
		private readonly List<WorkTimeRuleWrapper> workTimeRuleWrappers = new List<WorkTimeRuleWrapper>();

		private DateTimeScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions;

		public IWorkTimeRule this[int index] => workTimeRuleWrappers[index];

		public int Count => workTimeRuleWrappers.Count;

		public bool WorkTimeOnly => scaleOptions.WorkTimeOnly;

		public DateTimeScaleOptionsBase ScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return scaleOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				ProcessSubscriptions(scaleOptions, value);
				scaleOptions = value;
				UpdateWorkTimeRules(scaleOptions.WorkTimeRules);
			}
		}

		public WorkTimeRuleCollectionWrapper(DateTimeScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions)
		{
			ScaleOptions = scaleOptions;
		}

		private void ProcessSubscriptions(DateTimeScaleOptionsBase oldScaleOptions, DateTimeScaleOptionsBase newScaleOptions)
		{
			if (oldScaleOptions != null)
			{
				oldScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules.CollectionChanged -= OnWorkTimeRulesChanged;
			}
			if (newScaleOptions != null)
			{
				newScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules.CollectionChanged += OnWorkTimeRulesChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnWorkTimeRulesChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateWorkTimeRules((WorkTimeRuleCollection)sender);
			IChartElement chartElement = ScaleOptions;
			ChartElementHelper.Update(chartElement, new PropertyUpdateInfo(chartElement.Owner, "WorkTimeRules"));
		}

		private void UpdateWorkTimeRules(WorkTimeRuleCollection workTimeRuleCollection)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < workTimeRuleWrappers.Count; i++)
			{
				workTimeRuleWrappers[i].Release();
			}
			workTimeRuleWrappers.Clear();
			for (int j = 0; j < workTimeRuleCollection.Count; j++)
			{
				workTimeRuleWrappers.Add(new WorkTimeRuleWrapper(workTimeRuleCollection[j]));
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class PrintLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		public abstract System.Windows.Size CalculateRenderSize(System.Windows.Size Size, System.Windows.Size pageSize);

		public abstract System.Windows.Size CalculateImageSize(System.Windows.Size Size, System.Windows.Size pageSize);

		public System.Windows.Size CalculateActualSize(Control control)
		{
			double width = (double.IsNaN(control.Width) ? control.ActualWidth : control.Width);
			double height = (double.IsNaN(control.Height) ? control.ActualHeight : control.Height);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}
	}
	public class DefaultPrintLayoutCalculator : PrintLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateImageSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return size;
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateRenderSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return size;
		}
	}
	public class StretchPrintLayoutCalculator : PrintLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateImageSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return pageSize;
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateRenderSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return pageSize;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ZoomPrintLayoutCalculator : PrintLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		protected System.Windows.Size CalculateFinalSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size usablePageSize)
		{
			if (size.Width == 0.0 || size.Height == 0.0)
			{
				double num = Math.Min(usablePageSize.Width, usablePageSize.Height);
				return new System.Windows.Size(num, num);
			}
			double val = usablePageSize.Width / size.Width;
			double val2 = usablePageSize.Height / size.Height;
			double num2 = Math.Min(val, val2);
			return new System.Windows.Size(size.Width * num2, size.Height * num2);
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateImageSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return CalculateFinalSize(size, pageSize);
		}
	}
	public class NonProportionalZoomPrintLayoutCalculator : ZoomPrintLayoutCalculator
	{
		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateRenderSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return CalculateFinalSize(size, pageSize);
		}
	}
	public class ProportionalZoomPrintLayoutCalculator : ZoomPrintLayoutCalculator
	{
		public override System.Windows.Size CalculateRenderSize(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size pageSize)
		{
			return size;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class PrintLayoutStrategy
	{
		private readonly Control control;

		protected Control Control => control;

		protected bool ActualAutoLayout => ((IChartsPrintableControl)control).ActualAutoLayout;

		public static PrintLayoutStrategy Create(Control control)
		{
			if (control.IsVisible)
			{
				return new VisiblePrintLayoutStrategy(control);
			}
			return new InvisiblePrintLayoutStrategy(control);
		}

		protected PrintLayoutStrategy(Control control)
		{
			this.control = control;
		}

		private void MeasureAndArrange(Rect bounds)
		{
			control.Measure(bounds.Size);
			control.Arrange(bounds);
		}

		private void Resize(System.Windows.Size newSize)
		{
			control.Width = newSize.Width;
			control.Height = newSize.Height;
			control.MinWidth = 0.0;
			control.MinHeight = 0.0;
		}

		protected void PerformStraightLayoutPass(Rect bounds)
		{
			MeasureAndArrange(bounds);
			control.UpdateLayout();
		}

		protected void PerformReverseLayoutPass(Rect bounds)
		{
			control.UpdateLayout();
			MeasureAndArrange(bounds);
		}

		public virtual void PrepareLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			Resize(size);
			control.Margin = new Thickness(0.0);
		}

		public abstract void PrepareContainer(System.Windows.Size size);

		public abstract void RestoreContainer();

		public void RestoreLayout(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (ActualAutoLayout)
			{
				System.Windows.Size newSize = new System.Windows.Size(bounds.Width + 1.0, bounds.Height + 1.0);
				Resize(newSize);
				PerformStraightLayoutPass(bounds);
			}
			Resize(bounds.Size);
			PerformStraightLayoutPass(bounds);
		}
	}
	internal class VisiblePrintLayoutStrategy : PrintLayoutStrategy
	{
		public VisiblePrintLayoutStrategy(Control control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public override void PrepareLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			base.PrepareLayout(size);
			Rect bounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height);
			PerformReverseLayoutPass(bounds);
			if (base.ActualAutoLayout)
			{
				PerformReverseLayoutPass(bounds);
			}
		}

		public override void PrepareContainer(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
		}

		public override void RestoreContainer()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class InvisiblePrintLayoutStrategy : PrintLayoutStrategy
	{
		private VisualParentContextBase parentContext;

		public InvisiblePrintLayoutStrategy(Control control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public override void PrepareLayout(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			base.PrepareLayout(size);
			Rect bounds = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height);
			PerformStraightLayoutPass(bounds);
			if (!base.Control.IsArrangeValid)
			{
				PerformStraightLayoutPass(bounds);
			}
		}

		public override void PrepareContainer(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			parentContext = VisualParentContextBase.Create(base.Control);
			parentContext.Apply(size);
		}

		public override void RestoreContainer()
		{
			parentContext.Restore();
		}
	}
	public class RootDataNode : IRootDataNode, IDataNode
	{
		private readonly WeakReference controlReference;

		private readonly VisualDataNode visualChild;

		internal Control Control
		{
			get
			{
				if (!controlReference.IsAlive)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return controlReference.Target as Control;
			}
		}

		int IDataNode.Index => -1;

		bool IDataNode.IsDetailContainer => true;

		bool IDataNode.PageBreakAfter => false;

		bool IDataNode.PageBreakBefore => false;

		IDataNode IDataNode.Parent => null;

		public RootDataNode(Control control, System.Windows.Size usablePageSize, System.Windows.Size pageHeaderSize, System.Windows.Size pageFooterSize)
		{
			controlReference = new WeakReference(control);
			System.Windows.Size availableSize = GetAvailableSize(usablePageSize, pageHeaderSize, pageFooterSize);
			visualChild = new VisualDataNode(this, availableSize);
		}

		int IRootDataNode.GetTotalDetailCount()
		{
			return 1;
		}

		bool IDataNode.CanGetChild(int index)
		{
			return IsValidChildIndex(index);
		}

		IDataNode IDataNode.GetChild(int index)
		{
			if (!IsValidChildIndex(index))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (IDataNode)(object)visualChild;
		}

		private bool IsValidChildIndex(int childIndex)
		{
			return childIndex == 0;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetAvailableSize(System.Windows.Size usablePageSize, System.Windows.Size pageHeaderSize, System.Windows.Size pageFooterSize)
		{
			double height = usablePageSize.Height - pageHeaderSize.Height - pageFooterSize.Height;
			return new System.Windows.Size(usablePageSize.Width, height);
		}
	}
	public class VisualDataNode : IVisualDetailNode, IDataNode
	{
		private const double dpiX = 96.0;

		private const double dpiY = 96.0;

		private const double dpiFactor3D = 3.0;

		private const double dpiFactor2D = 1.0;

		private const string printingTemplateString = "<Border xmlns:dxp=\"http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/printing\">\r\n                                                        <Image Source=\"{Binding Content.BitmapSource}\" dxp:ExportSettings.TargetType=\"Image\"\r\n                                                                                            dxp:ImageExportSettings.ImageSource=\"{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=Self}}\"\r\n                                                                                            dxp:ImageExportSettings.ImageRenderMode=\"UseImageSource\"\r\n                                                                                            Width=\"{Binding Content.ImageWidth}\"\r\n                                                                                            Height=\"{Binding Content.ImageHeight}\"\r\n                                                                                            Stretch=\"{Binding Content.Stretch}\"/>\r\n                                                     </Border>";

		private readonly RootDataNode parent;

		private readonly System.Windows.Size usablePageSize;

		int IDataNode.Index => 0;

		bool IDataNode.IsDetailContainer => false;

		bool IDataNode.PageBreakAfter => false;

		bool IDataNode.PageBreakBefore => false;

		IDataNode IDataNode.Parent => (IDataNode)(object)parent;

		public VisualDataNode(RootDataNode parent, System.Windows.Size usablePageSize)
		{
			this.parent = parent;
			this.usablePageSize = usablePageSize;
		}

		RowViewInfo IVisualDetailNode.GetDetail(bool allowContentReuse)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new RowViewInfo(GetPrintingTemplate(), (object)CreateRenderContext());
		}

		bool IDataNode.CanGetChild(int index)
		{
			return false;
		}

		IDataNode IDataNode.GetChild(int index)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private RenderContext CreateRenderContext()
		{
			Control control = parent.Control;
			IChartsPrintableControl chartsPrintableControl = (IChartsPrintableControl)control;
			TextFormattingMode textFormattingMode = TextOptions.GetTextFormattingMode(control);
			TextOptions.SetTextFormattingMode(control, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			PrintSizeMode actualPrintSizeMode = chartsPrintableControl.ActualPrintSizeMode;
			PrintLayoutCalculatorBase printLayoutCalculatorBase = CreatePrintLayoutCalculator(actualPrintSizeMode);
			System.Windows.Size size = printLayoutCalculatorBase.CalculateActualSize(control);
			System.Windows.Size size2 = printLayoutCalculatorBase.CalculateRenderSize(size, usablePageSize);
			System.Windows.Size size3 = printLayoutCalculatorBase.CalculateImageSize(size, usablePageSize);
			size2 = new System.Windows.Size((int)size2.Width, (int)size2.Height);
			size3 = RoundSize(size3);
			Rect bounds = CalculateArrangeBounds(control, size);
			Control bufferControl = new Control();
			SaveProperties(control, bufferControl);
			PrintLayoutStrategy printLayoutStrategy = PrintLayoutStrategy.Create(control);
			printLayoutStrategy.PrepareContainer(size2);
			chartsPrintableControl.PrepareForPrintingBeforeResize();
			if (size2 == size)
			{
				printLayoutStrategy.PrepareLayout(new System.Windows.Size(1.0, 1.0));
			}
			printLayoutStrategy.PrepareLayout(size2);
			double scaleX = ((size.Width > 0.0) ? (size2.Width / size.Width) : 1.0);
			double scaleY = ((size.Height > 0.0) ? (size2.Height / size.Height) : 1.0);
			chartsPrintableControl.PrepareForPrintingAfterResize(scaleX, scaleY);
			double num = (chartsPrintableControl.Is3DControl ? 3.0 : 1.0);
			size2 = RoundSize(size2);
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)(num * size2.Width), (int)(num * size2.Height), num * 96.0, num * 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(control);
			TextOptions.SetTextFormattingMode(control, textFormattingMode);
			printLayoutStrategy.RestoreContainer();
			printLayoutStrategy.RestoreLayout(bounds);
			RestoreProperties(control, bufferControl);
			chartsPrintableControl.RestoreAfterPrinting();
			Stretch stretch = ((actualPrintSizeMode == PrintSizeMode.ProportionalZoom) ? Stretch.Uniform : Stretch.None);
			return new RenderContext(renderTargetBitmap, size3.Width, size3.Height, stretch);
		}

		private Rect TryGetParentBounds(Control control, bool useLogicalTree)
		{
			if (LayoutHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)control, useLogicalTree) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				try
				{
					return LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)control, uIElement);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		private Rect GetParentBounds(Control control)
		{
			Rect result = TryGetParentBounds(control, useLogicalTree: false);
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				return TryGetParentBounds(control, useLogicalTree: true);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Rect CalculateArrangeBounds(Control control, System.Windows.Size initialSize)
		{
			Rect parentBounds = GetParentBounds(control);
			if (!parentBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				Thickness margin = control.Margin;
				return new Rect(parentBounds.Left - margin.Left, parentBounds.Top - margin.Top, parentBounds.Width + margin.Left + margin.Right, parentBounds.Height + margin.Top + margin.Bottom);
			}
			return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, initialSize.Width, initialSize.Height);
		}

		private PrintLayoutCalculatorBase CreatePrintLayoutCalculator(PrintSizeMode sizeMode)
		{
			switch (sizeMode)
			{
			case PrintSizeMode.None:
				return new DefaultPrintLayoutCalculator();
			case PrintSizeMode.Stretch:
				return new StretchPrintLayoutCalculator();
			case PrintSizeMode.NonProportionalZoom:
				return new NonProportionalZoomPrintLayoutCalculator();
			case PrintSizeMode.ProportionalZoom:
				return new ProportionalZoomPrintLayoutCalculator();
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown PrintSizeMode");
				return new DefaultPrintLayoutCalculator();
			}
		}

		private void SaveProperties(Control control, Control bufferControl)
		{
			object dataContext = control.DataContext;
			CopyProperties(control, bufferControl);
			control.DataContext = dataContext;
		}

		private void RestoreProperties(Control control, Control bufferControl)
		{
			CopyProperties(bufferControl, control);
		}

		private void CopyProperty(Control source, Control target, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			target.ClearValue(dp);
			CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValue(target, source, dp);
			source.ClearValue(dp);
		}

		private void CopyPropertyByRef(Control source, Control target, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			target.ClearValue(dp);
			CopyPropertyValueHelper.CopyPropertyValueByRef(target, source, dp);
			source.ClearValue(dp);
		}

		private void CopyProperties(Control source, Control target)
		{
			CopyPropertyByRef(source, target, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			CopyProperty(source, target, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
			CopyProperty(source, target, FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
			CopyProperty(source, target, FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
			CopyProperty(source, target, FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
			CopyProperty(source, target, FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size RoundSize(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max((int)size.Width, 1), Math.Max((int)size.Height, 1));
		}

		private DataTemplate GetPrintingTemplate()
		{
			return XamlHelper.GetTemplate("<Border xmlns:dxp=\"http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/printing\">\r\n                                                        <Image Source=\"{Binding Content.BitmapSource}\" dxp:ExportSettings.TargetType=\"Image\"\r\n                                                                                            dxp:ImageExportSettings.ImageSource=\"{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=Self}}\"\r\n                                                                                            dxp:ImageExportSettings.ImageRenderMode=\"UseImageSource\"\r\n                                                                                            Width=\"{Binding Content.ImageWidth}\"\r\n                                                                                            Height=\"{Binding Content.ImageHeight}\"\r\n                                                                                            Stretch=\"{Binding Content.Stretch}\"/>\r\n                                                     </Border>");
		}
	}
	public class RenderContext : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly RenderTargetBitmap bitmapSource;

		private readonly double imageWidth;

		private readonly double imageHeight;

		private readonly Stretch stretch;

		public RenderTargetBitmap BitmapSource => bitmapSource;

		public double ImageWidth => imageWidth;

		public double ImageHeight => imageHeight;

		public Stretch Stretch => stretch;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public RenderContext(RenderTargetBitmap bitmapSource, double imageWidth, double imageHeight, Stretch stretch)
		{
			this.bitmapSource = bitmapSource;
			this.imageWidth = imageWidth;
			this.imageHeight = imageHeight;
			this.stretch = stretch;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class VisualParentContextBase
	{
		private readonly FrameworkElement parent;

		private readonly Control control;

		private Grid printContainer;

		protected FrameworkElement Parent => parent;

		protected Control Chart => control;

		internal static VisualParentContextBase Create(Control control)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = control.Parent as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement is Grid)
			{
				return new GridVisualParentContext((Grid)frameworkElement, control);
			}
			if (frameworkElement is Panel)
			{
				return new PanelVisualParentContext((Panel)frameworkElement, control);
			}
			if (frameworkElement is ContentControl)
			{
				return new ContentControlVisualParentContext((ContentControl)frameworkElement, control);
			}
			if (frameworkElement is ContentPresenter)
			{
				return new ContentPresenterVisualParentContext((ContentPresenter)frameworkElement, control);
			}
			if (frameworkElement is Decorator)
			{
				return new DecoratorVisualParentContext((Decorator)frameworkElement, control);
			}
			if (!(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(control) is FrameworkElement))
			{
				return new EmptyVisualParentContext(null, control);
			}
			return new DefaultVisualParentContext(frameworkElement, control);
		}

		protected VisualParentContextBase(FrameworkElement parent, Control control)
		{
			this.parent = parent;
			this.control = control;
		}

		protected abstract void SaveState();

		protected abstract void RestoreState();

		protected virtual void ApplyContainer(System.Windows.Size chartSize)
		{
			printContainer = new Grid
			{
				Width = chartSize.Width,
				Height = chartSize.Height
			};
			printContainer.Children.Add(control);
			Grid.SetRow(control, 0);
			Grid.SetColumn(control, 0);
		}

		protected virtual void RestoreContainer()
		{
			printContainer.Children.Remove(control);
		}

		internal void Apply(System.Windows.Size chartSize)
		{
			SaveState();
			ApplyContainer(chartSize);
		}

		internal void Restore()
		{
			RestoreContainer();
			RestoreState();
		}
	}
	internal class DecoratorVisualParentContext : VisualParentContextBase

			: base(panel, control)

		}

	public abstract class GridCalculator
	{
		private delegate bool IsLeftDel(double value, double alignedLeft, double alignedRight);

		private readonly List<double> grid = new List<double>();

		protected bool IsSnapAlignmentSet { get; set; }

		protected bool IsAutoGridSpacing { get; set; }

		protected AxisGridMapping SnapMapping { get; set; }

		public abstract IAxisGridMapping GridMapping { get; }

		public double GridSpacing { get; set; }

		public GridCalculator()
		{
			IsAutoGridSpacing = true;
			IsSnapAlignmentSet = false;
			GridSpacing = 1.0;
		}

		private double CalcGridStep(double rangeWidth, object visibleRangeStart, object visibleRangeEnd)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(GetInternalValue(visibleRangeEnd) - GetInternalValue(visibleRangeStart));
			if (rangeWidth > 1.0)
			{
				return num / rangeWidth * 200.0;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		private double GetGridSpacing(double rangeWidth, object visibleRangeStart, object visibleRangeEnd)
		{
			double result;
			if (IsAutoGridSpacing)
			{
				double num = CalcGridStep(rangeWidth, visibleRangeStart, visibleRangeEnd);
				result = 1.0;
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					result = GridMapping.InternalToAligned(num);
					result = ((result != 0.0) ? Math.Ceiling(result) : 1.0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = GridSpacing;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private object GetAutoSnapValue(object value, object wholeStart, object wholeEnd, IsLeftDel isLeft)
		{
			double internalValue = GetInternalValue(value);
			double internalValue2 = GetInternalValue(wholeStart);
			double internalValue3 = GetInternalValue(wholeEnd);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			list.Add(internalValue2);
			for (int i = 0; i < grid.Count; i++)
			{
				if (grid[i] > internalValue2 && grid[i] < internalValue3)
				{
					list.Add(grid[i]);
				}
			}
			list.Add(internalValue3);
			double num = list[0];
			for (int j = 1; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				double num2 = list[j];
				if (internalValue >= num && internalValue <= num2)
				{
					if (isLeft(internalValue, num, num2))
					{
						return GetNativeValue(num);
					}
					return GetNativeValue(num2);
				}
				num = list[j];
			}
			if (!isLeft(internalValue, internalValue, internalValue))
			{
				return wholeEnd;
			}
			return wholeStart;
		}

		private object GetManualSnapValue(object value, object wholeStart, object wholeEnd, IsLeftDel isLeft)
		{
			double num = SnapMapping.NativeToInternal(value);
			double num2 = Math.Floor(SnapMapping.InternalToAligned(num));
			double val = SnapMapping.AlignedToInternal(num2);
			double val2 = SnapMapping.AlignedToInternal(num2 + 1.0);
			double internalValue = GetInternalValue(wholeStart);
			double internalValue2 = GetInternalValue(wholeEnd);
			val = Math.Max(val, internalValue);
			val2 = Math.Min(val2, internalValue2);
			if (isLeft(num, val, val2))
			{
				return SnapMapping.InternalToNative(val);
			}
			return SnapMapping.InternalToNative(val2);
		}

		private object GetSnappedValue(object value, bool isLeft, object wholeStart, object wholeEnd)
		{
			if (IsSnapAlignmentSet)
			{
				return GetManualSnapValue(value, wholeStart, wholeEnd, (double internalValue, double alignedLeft, double alignedRight) => isLeft);
			}
			return GetAutoSnapValue(value, wholeStart, wholeEnd, (double internalValue, double alignedLeft, double alignedRight) => isLeft);
		}

		public RangeControlClientHitTestResult HitTest(object nativeValue, double rangeWidth, object wholeStart, object wholeEnd)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			double internalValue = GetInternalValue(nativeValue);
			if (!double.IsNaN(internalValue))
			{
				object snappedValue = GetSnappedValue(nativeValue, isLeft: true, wholeStart, wholeEnd);
				object snappedValue2 = GetSnappedValue(nativeValue, isLeft: false, wholeStart, wholeEnd);
				return new RangeControlClientHitTestResult((RangeControlClientRegionType)1, snappedValue, snappedValue2);
			}
			return new RangeControlClientHitTestResult((RangeControlClientRegionType)0, (object)null, (object)null);
		}

		public object GetSnappedValue(object value, object wholeStart, object wholeEnd)
		{
			if (IsSnapAlignmentSet)
			{
				return GetManualSnapValue(value, wholeStart, wholeEnd, (double internalValue, double alignedLeft, double alignedRight) => internalValue < alignedLeft + (alignedRight - alignedLeft) / 2.0);
			}
			return GetAutoSnapValue(value, wholeStart, wholeEnd, (double internalValue, double alignedLeft, double alignedRight) => internalValue < alignedLeft + (alignedRight - alignedLeft) / 2.0);
		}

		public IList<double> CalculateGrid(double rangeWidth, object visibleStart, object visibleEnd)
		{
			double internalValue = Math.Min(GetInternalValue(visibleStart), GetInternalValue(visibleEnd));
			double internalValue2 = Math.Max(GetInternalValue(visibleStart), GetInternalValue(visibleEnd));
			double gridSpacing = GetGridSpacing(rangeWidth, visibleStart, visibleEnd);
			double num = Math.Floor(GridMapping.InternalToAligned(internalValue) / gridSpacing) * gridSpacing;
			double num2 = Math.Floor(GridMapping.InternalToAligned(internalValue2) / gridSpacing) * gridSpacing;
			grid.Clear();
			for (double num3 = num; num3 <= num2; num3 += gridSpacing)
			{
				grid.Add(GridMapping.AlignedToInternal(num3));
			}
			return grid;
		}

		protected virtual double GetInternalValue(object nativeValue)
		{
			return GridMapping.NativeToInternal(nativeValue);
		}

		protected virtual object GetNativeValue(double internalValue)
		{
			return GridMapping.InternalToNative(internalValue);
		}
	}
	public class DateTimeGridCalculator : GridCalculator
	{
		private IAxisGridMapping gridMapping;

		public override IAxisGridMapping GridMapping => gridMapping;

		public DateTimeGridCalculator(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.DateTimeGridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
			gridMapping = new AxisDateTimeGridMapping(new AxisDateTimeMap(), (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)((gridAlignment == DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.DateTimeGridAlignment.Auto) ? DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.DateTimeGridAlignment.Day : gridAlignment), 0.0);
		}

		public void UpdateSnapAlignment(DateTimeMeasurementUnit snapAlignment)
		{
			base.IsSnapAlignmentSet = true;
			base.SnapMapping = new AxisDateTimeGridMapping(new AxisDateTimeMap(), (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)snapAlignment, 0.0);
		}

		public void UpdateGridAlignment(DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.DateTimeGridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
			base.IsAutoGridSpacing = gridAlignment == DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.DateTimeGridAlignment.Auto;
			gridMapping = new AxisDateTimeGridMapping(new AxisDateTimeMap(), (DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)(base.IsAutoGridSpacing ? DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.RangeControlClient.DateTimeGridAlignment.Day : gridAlignment), 0.0);
		}
	}

	public class PointCalculatorProvider
	{
		public virtual ScreenPointCalculatorBase GetPointCalculator(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			return ScreenPointCalculator.Instance;
		}
	}
	public class EdgePointCalculatorProvider : PointCalculatorProvider
	{
		private readonly IList<SeriesPointItem> allPointItems;

		private readonly ScreenPointCalculatorBase firstPointCalculator;

		private readonly ScreenPointCalculatorBase lastPointCalculator;

		public EdgePointCalculatorProvider(XYSeries2D series, bool isFirstPointEdgeMode, bool isLastPointEdgeMode)
		{
			allPointItems = series.Item.AllPointItems;
			firstPointCalculator = (isFirstPointEdgeMode ? series.CreateScreenPointCalculator(SegmentSeries2DBase.GetMarkerDisplayMode(series.FirstPoint)) : null);
			lastPointCalculator = (isLastPointEdgeMode ? series.CreateScreenPointCalculator(SegmentSeries2DBase.GetMarkerDisplayMode(series.LastPoint)) : null);
		}

		public override ScreenPointCalculatorBase GetPointCalculator(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (firstPointCalculator != null && allPointItems.IndexOf(pointItem) == 0)
			{
				return firstPointCalculator;
			}
			if (lastPointCalculator != null && allPointItems.IndexOf(pointItem) == allPointItems.Count - 1)
			{
				return lastPointCalculator;
			}
			return base.GetPointCalculator(pointItem);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ScreenPointCalculatorBase
	{
		public virtual bool AlwaysOnDiagram => false;

		public abstract System.Windows.Point CalculatePoint(PaneMappingBase mapping, double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isBottom = true);

		public abstract List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectPointsByViewport(PaneMapping mapping, Bar2D bar, double argument, int fixedOffset, bool isZeroDisplayOffset);

		public abstract System.Windows.Point CorrectPointByViewport(PaneMapping mapping, double argument, double value);
	}
	public class ScreenPointCalculator : ScreenPointCalculatorBase
	{
		private static ScreenPointCalculator instance;

		public static ScreenPointCalculator Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					instance = new ScreenPointCalculator();
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		public override System.Windows.Point CalculatePoint(PaneMappingBase mapping, double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isValue1 = true)
		{
			return mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(pointArgument, pointValue);
		}

		public override List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectPointsByViewport(PaneMapping mapping, Bar2D bar, double argument, int fixedOffset, bool isZeroDisplayOffset)
		{
			double x = (isZeroDisplayOffset ? (mapping.AxisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(argument) + (double)fixedOffset) : ((bar.Left + bar.Right) / 2.0));
			return new List<GRealPoint2D>
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(x, bar.Bottom),
				new GRealPoint2D(x, bar.Top)
			};
		}

		public override System.Windows.Point CorrectPointByViewport(PaneMapping mapping, double argument, double value)
		{
			return CalculatePoint(mapping, argument, value);
		}
	}
	public class EdgeScreenPointCalculator : ScreenPointCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly ViewportIntersectionHolder intersectionHolder;

		private readonly bool alwaysOnDiagram;

		public override bool AlwaysOnDiagram => alwaysOnDiagram;

		public EdgeScreenPointCalculator(ViewportIntersectionHolder intersectionHolder, bool alwaysOnDiagram)
		{
			this.intersectionHolder = intersectionHolder;
			this.alwaysOnDiagram = alwaysOnDiagram;
		}

		public override System.Windows.Point CalculatePoint(PaneMappingBase mapping, double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isValue1 = true)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = (alwaysOnDiagram ? intersectionHolder.GetEdgePointOnDiagram(pointArgument, pointValue, isValue1) : intersectionHolder.GetEdgePoint(pointArgument, pointValue, isValue1));
			return mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y);
		}

		public override List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectPointsByViewport(PaneMapping mapping, Bar2D bar, double argument, int fixedOffset, bool isZeroDisplayOffset)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = intersectionHolder.CorrectValuesByViewport(bar.Argument, bar.LowValue, bar.HighValue, alwaysOnDiagram);
			double x = mapping.AxisXMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(list[0].X) + (double)((!alwaysOnDiagram) ? fixedOffset : 0);
			return new List<GRealPoint2D>
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(x, mapping.AxisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(list[0].Y)),
				new GRealPoint2D(x, mapping.AxisYMapping.GetRoundedAxisValue(list[1].Y))
			};
		}

		public override System.Windows.Point CorrectPointByViewport(PaneMapping mapping, double argument, double value)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = intersectionHolder.CorrectValuesByViewport(argument, value, value, alwaysOnDiagram);
			return mapping.GetRoundedDiagramPoint(list[0].X, list[0].Y);
		}
	}
	public class XYSeries2DPointsHighlighter
	{
		private readonly XYSeries2D series;

		private readonly OrderedDictionary highlightedPointItems = new OrderedDictionary();

		private readonly List<SeriesPointItem> highlightedInvisibleMarkerItems = new List<SeriesPointItem>();

		public IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> HighlightedPoints => highlightedPointItems.Values.Cast<SeriesPointItem>();

		public XYSeries2DPointsHighlighter(XYSeries2D series)
		{
			this.series = series;
		}

		private void AddAdditionalHighlightedItem(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			SeriesPointItem seriesPointItem = new SeriesPointItem(series, pointItem.SeriesPointData, pointItem.PresentationData, pointItem.ValueLevel);
			seriesPointItem.IsHighlighted = true;
			UpdatePointItemLayout(pointItem, seriesPointItem);
			seriesPointItem.Model = series.GetModel(pointItem.ValueLevel);
			highlightedPointItems[pointItem] = seriesPointItem;
		}

		private void UpdatePointItemLayout(SeriesPointItem sourceItem, SeriesPointItem highlightingItem)
		{
			PresentationUpdater presentationUpdater = new PresentationUpdater(series);
			presentationUpdater.UpdateHighlightingItemPresentation(highlightingItem, sourceItem);
		}

		private void SetInvisibleMarkerHighlighting(SeriesPointItem pointItem, bool isHighlighted)
		{
			if (series.HasInvisibleMarkers && series.IsPointItemHidden(pointItem))
			{
				if (isHighlighted)
				{
					UpdatePointItemLayout(pointItem, pointItem);
					pointItem.Model = series.GetModel(pointItem.ValueLevel);
					series.Item.ActualVisibleItems.Add(pointItem);
					highlightedInvisibleMarkerItems.Add(pointItem);
				}
				else if (highlightedInvisibleMarkerItems.Contains(pointItem))
				{
					series.Item.ActualVisibleItems.Remove(pointItem);
					pointItem.PointItemPresentation = null;
					highlightedInvisibleMarkerItems.Remove(pointItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NeedSelectPointItem(IPlatformSeriesPoint seriesPoint, RefinedPoint highlightedPoint)
		{
			if (highlightedPoint != null)
			{
				return SeriesPointHelper.GetSourcePoints(highlightedPoint).Contains(seriesPoint);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetHighlightedItems()
		{
			if (!series.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem value in highlightedPointItems.Values)
				{
					value.IsHighlighted = false;
					SetInvisibleMarkerHighlighting(value, isHighlighted: false);
				}
			}
			highlightedPointItems.Clear();
			highlightedInvisibleMarkerItems.Clear();
		}

		public void UpdateHighlightedItemsSelection(IPlatformSeriesPoint seriesPoint, bool isSelected)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointItem value in highlightedPointItems.Values)
			{
				if (NeedSelectPointItem(seriesPoint, value.RefinedPoint))
				{
					value.IsSelected = isSelected;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetPointState(ISeriesPoint point, bool isHighlighted)
		{
			List<SeriesPointItem> pointItems = series.Item.GetPointItems(point);
			if (pointItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool canUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry = series.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry;
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in pointItems)
			{
				if (!canUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
				{
					item.IsHighlighted = isHighlighted;
					SetInvisibleMarkerHighlighting(item, isHighlighted);
				}
				if (isHighlighted)
				{
					if (canUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
					{
						AddAdditionalHighlightedItem(item);
					}
					else
					{
						highlightedPointItems[item] = item;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					highlightedPointItems.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsHighlightedInvisibleMarkerItem(SeriesPointItem point)
		{
			return highlightedInvisibleMarkerItems.Contains(point);
		}

		public void UpdateItemsPresentation(PresentationUpdater layoutUpdater)
		{
			if (!series.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem value in highlightedPointItems.Values)
			{
				layoutUpdater.UpdateHighlightingItemPresentation(value, value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectionController : SelectionControllerBase<IInteractiveElement>
	{
		private ChartControl Chart => (ChartControl)base.Control;

		public bool ActualSelectionEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Control.SelectionMode == ElementSelectionModeCore.None)
				{
					return base.IsForcedSelection;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private IList CollectSelectedItems(Predicate<object> seriesCondition, Func<object, object, bool> pointsCondition)
		{
			IList list = CreateNewSelectedItems();
			bool flag = seriesCondition != null;
			bool flag2 = pointsCondition != null;
			foreach (Series item in Chart.Diagram.Series)
			{
				IInteractiveElement interactiveElement = item;
				if (interactiveElement.IsSelected = flag && seriesCondition(interactiveElement.Content))
				{
					list.Add(interactiveElement.Content);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (IDataPoint actualPoint in item.ActualPoints)
					{
						SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(actualPoint);
						bool flag4 = pointsCondition(interactiveElement.Content, SeriesPointHelper.GetPointTag((ISeriesPoint)actualPoint) ?? seriesPoint);
						((IInteractiveElement)actualPoint).IsSelected = flag4;
						if (flag4)
						{
							list.Add(seriesPoint);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void ForceSelection(Predicate<object> seriesCondition, Func<object, object, bool> pointsCondition)
		{
			if (Chart.Diagram != null && Chart.Diagram.Series != null)
			{
				LockedUpdate(delegate
				{
					ClearSelectedItems();
					base.IsForcedSelection = true;
					IList list = CollectSelectedItems(seriesCondition, pointsCondition);
					SetCurrentSelectedItems(list);
					UpdateSelectedItemByList(list);
				});
			}
		}

		public SelectionController(ChartControl chart)
			: base((ISelectionSupportControl)chart)
		{
		}

		private void UpdateElementSelection(IInteractiveElement element)
		{
			element.IsSelected = base.SelectedItems != null && base.SelectedItems.Contains(GetElementContent(element));
		}

		protected override object GetElementContent(IInteractiveElement element)
		{
			if (!base.IsForcedSelection || !(element is IDataPoint))
			{
				return element.Content;
			}
			return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(element as IDataPoint);
		}

		protected override bool CalculateItemsSelection(IList<IInteractiveElement> elements)
		{
			foreach (IInteractiveElement element in elements)
			{
				if (!element.IsSelected)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void ClearSelectionCore()
		{
			foreach (object selectedItem in base.SelectedItems)
			{
				if (selectedItem is IInteractiveElement interactiveElement)
				{
					interactiveElement.IsSelected = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateElementsSelection()
		{
			ChartControl chart = Chart;
			if (chart.Diagram == null || chart.Diagram.Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in chart.Diagram.Series)
			{
				UpdateElementSelection(item);
				if (((IInteractiveElement)item).IsSelected)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (IInteractiveElement actualPoint in item.ActualPoints)
				{
					UpdateElementSelection(actualPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void HideSelection()
		{
			ChartControl chart = Chart;
			if (chart.Diagram == null || chart.Diagram.Series == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Series item in chart.Diagram.Series)
			{
				((IInteractiveElement)item).IsSelected = false;
				foreach (IInteractiveElement actualPoint in item.ActualPoints)
				{
					actualPoint.IsSelected = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void AddElementCore(IInteractiveElement element)
		{
			base.AddElementCore(element);
			element.IsSelected = true;
		}

		protected override void RemoveElementCore(IInteractiveElement element)
		{
			element.IsSelected = false;
			base.RemoveElementCore(element);
		}

		public void UpdateSelection(IInteractiveElement element, ModifierKeys keyModifiers, bool touchSelectionStarted)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				UpdateSelection(new IInteractiveElement[1] { element }, keyModifiers, touchSelectionStarted);
			}
		}
	}
	public class HighlightingController
	{
		private readonly ChartControl chart;

		public HighlightingController(ChartControl chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		public void HighlightSeries(Predicate<object> seriesCondition)
		{
			if (chart.Diagram == null || seriesCondition == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in chart.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				IInteractiveElement interactiveElement = (Series)item.Series;
				interactiveElement.IsHighlighted = seriesCondition(interactiveElement.Content);
			}
		}

		public void HighlightSeriesPoints(Func<object, object, bool> pointsCondition)
		{
			if (chart.Diagram == null || pointsCondition == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in chart.ViewController.RefinedSeriesForLegend)
			{
				Series series = (Series)item.Series;
				IInteractiveElement interactiveElement = series;
				foreach (SeriesPointItem actualVisibleItem in series.Item.ActualVisibleItems)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = actualVisibleItem.RefinedPoint;
					if (refinedPoint != null)
					{
						object arg = SeriesPointHelper.GetPointTag(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint) ?? SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
						series.UpdatePointHighlighting(actualVisibleItem, pointsCondition(interactiveElement.Content, arg));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public enum SelectionAction
	{
		None,
		Add,
		Remove,
		ReplaceAll
	}
	public abstract class SelectionControllerBase<T>
	{
		private IList currentList;

		private Locker changeLocker = new Locker();

		private CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<SelectionControllerBase<T>> collectionChangedHandler;

		private bool shouldUpdateSelectedItem = true;

		protected ISelectionSupportControl Control { get; }

		protected bool IsForcedSelection { get; set; }

		public object SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				return Control.SelectedItem;
			}
			set
			{
				Control.SelectedItem = value;
			}
		}

		public IList SelectedItems
		{
			get
			{
				return Control.SelectedItems;
			}
			set
			{
				Control.SelectedItems = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler SelectionUpdated;

		protected SelectionControllerBase(ISelectionSupportControl control)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Control = control;
			collectionChangedHandler = (CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<SelectionControllerBase<T>>)(object)new CollectionChangedWeakEventHandler<SelectionControllerBase<SelectionControllerBase<T>>>((SelectionControllerBase<SelectionControllerBase<T>>)(object)this, (Action<SelectionControllerBase<SelectionControllerBase<T>>, object, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>)(Action<SelectionControllerBase<T>, object, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>)delegate(SelectionControllerBase<T> owner, object o, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				owner.OnCollectionChanged();
			});
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (shouldUpdateSelectedItem)
			{
				LockedUpdate(delegate
				{
					UpdateSelectedItemByList(SelectedItems);
					UpdateElementsSelection();
				});
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeListEvents(object list)
		{
			if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<SelectionControllerBase<SelectionControllerBase<T>>, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)collectionChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeListEvents(object list)
		{
			if (list is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<SelectionControllerBase<SelectionControllerBase<T>>, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)collectionChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureSelectedItems()
		{
			if (SelectedItems == null)
			{
				SetCurrentSelectedItems(CreateNewSelectedItems());
			}
		}

		private SelectionAction CalculateSelectionAction(ElementSelectionModeCore selectionMode, ModifierKeys keyModifiers, bool touchSelectionStarted, IList<T> elements)
		{
			switch (selectionMode)
			{
			case ElementSelectionModeCore.Single:
				return SelectionAction.ReplaceAll;
			case ElementSelectionModeCore.Multiple:
				if (elements.Count <= 0)
				{
					return SelectionAction.ReplaceAll;
				}
				if (!CalculateItemsSelection(elements))
				{
					return SelectionAction.Add;
				}
				return SelectionAction.Remove;
			case ElementSelectionModeCore.Extended:
				if (keyModifiers == ModifierKeys.Shift)
				{
					return SelectionAction.Add;
				}
				if (keyModifiers == ModifierKeys.Control || touchSelectionStarted)
				{
					if (!CalculateItemsSelection(elements))
					{
						return SelectionAction.Add;
					}
					return SelectionAction.Remove;
				}
				return SelectionAction.ReplaceAll;
			default:
				return SelectionAction.None;
			}
		}

		private void RaiseSelectionUpdated()
		{
			if (this.SelectionUpdated != null)
			{
				this.SelectionUpdated(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void AddElements(IList<T> elements)
		{
			IsForcedSelection = false;
			if (elements.Count > 0)
			{
				BatchUpdateSelectedItems(delegate
				{
					foreach (T element in elements)
					{
						if (SelectedItems != null && !SelectedItems.Contains(GetElementContent(element)))
						{
							AddElementCore(element);
						}
					}
				});
			}
			else
			{
				LockedUpdate(delegate
				{
					UpdateSelectedItemByList(SelectedItems);
					UpdateElementsSelection();
				});
			}
		}

		private void RemoveElements(IList<T> elements)
		{
			BatchUpdateSelectedItems(delegate
			{
				if (SelectedItems != null)
				{
					foreach (T element in elements)
					{
						RemoveElementCore(element);
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void BatchUpdateSelectedItems(Action action)
		{
			shouldUpdateSelectedItem = false;
			action();
			shouldUpdateSelectedItem = true;
			OnCollectionChanged();
		}

		private void SetCurrentList(IList list)
		{
			UnsubscribeListEvents(currentList);
			currentList = list;
			SubscribeListEvents(currentList);
		}

		protected abstract object GetElementContent(T element);

		protected abstract bool CalculateItemsSelection(IList<T> elements);

		protected virtual void ClearSelectionCore()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AddElementCore(T element)
		{
			SelectedItems?.Add(GetElementContent(element));
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveElementCore(T element)
		{
			SelectedItems.Remove(GetElementContent(element));
		}

		protected void ClearSelectedItems()
		{
			if (SelectedItems != null)
			{
				ClearSelectionCore();
				SelectedItems.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected void SetCurrentSelectedItems(IList newList)
		{
			SetCurrentList(newList);
			SelectedItems = newList;
		}

		protected IList CreateNewSelectedItems()
		{
			return new ObservableCollection<object>();
		}

		protected void LockedUpdate(Action updateAction)
		{
			if (!changeLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				changeLocker.Lock();
				updateAction();
				RaiseSelectionUpdated();
				changeLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectedItemByList(IList list)
		{
			object obj = ((list != null && list.Count > 0) ? list[0] : null);
			if (SelectedItem != obj)
			{
				SelectedItem = obj;
			}
		}

		internal abstract void UpdateElementsSelection();

		public void OnUpdateSelectedItem(object item)
		{
			LockedUpdate(delegate
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					IsForcedSelection = false;
					IList list = CreateNewSelectedItems();
					list.Add(item);
					SetCurrentSelectedItems(list);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearSelectedItems();
				}
				UpdateElementsSelection();
			});
		}

		public void OnUpdateSelectedItems(IList list)
		{
			LockedUpdate(delegate
			{
				IsForcedSelection = false;
				SetCurrentList(list);
				UpdateSelectedItemByList(list);
				UpdateElementsSelection();
			});
		}

		public void ReplaceElements(IList<T> elements)
		{
			EnsureSelectedItems();
			shouldUpdateSelectedItem = false;
			ClearSelectedItems();
			shouldUpdateSelectedItem = true;
			AddElements(elements);
		}

		public void UpdateSelection(IList<T> elements, ModifierKeys keyModifiers, bool touchSelectionStarted)
		{
			EnsureSelectedItems();
			switch (CalculateSelectionAction(Control.SelectionMode, keyModifiers, touchSelectionStarted, elements))
			{
			case SelectionAction.ReplaceAll:
				ReplaceElements(elements);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.Add:
				AddElements(elements);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.Remove:
				RemoveElements(elements);
				break;
			case SelectionAction.None:
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	[Flags]
	public enum VisualSelectionType
	{
		None = 0,
		Hatch = 1,
		Size = 2,
		Brightness = 4
	}
	public static class VisualSelectionHelper
	{
		private const int InteractiveLineThicknessMultiplier = 2;

		private const int SelectedLegendLineThicknessIncrement = 1;

		private const byte SeriesSelectionAlpha = 191;

		private const byte LegendItemSelectionAlpha = 150;

		private const double SelectedPointColorBrightnessPercentage = 0.6;

		private const double HighlightedPointColorBrightnessPercentage = 0.7;

		private static readonly Thickness selectedLegendMarkerMargin = new Thickness(-2.0);

		private static readonly System.Windows.Media.Color customModelSelectionColor = Colors.Orange;

		private static readonly System.Windows.Media.Color selectionColor3D = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(64, 74, 203, 252);

		private static readonly double selectionRectInflate = 4.0;

		private static readonly double selectionRectCornerRadius = 4.0;

		public static LinearGradientBrush SelectionOpacityMask => CreateItemOpacityMask(new System.Windows.Point(8.0, -8.0));

		public static LinearGradientBrush LegendMarkerSelectionOpacityMask => CreateLegendItemOpacityMask(new System.Windows.Point(3.0, 3.0));

		public static Thickness SelectedLegendMarkerMargin => selectedLegendMarkerMargin;

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color CustomModelSelectionColor => customModelSelectionColor;

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color SelectionColor3D => selectionColor3D;

		public static double SelectionRectInflate => selectionRectInflate;

		public static double SelectionRectCornerRadius => selectionRectCornerRadius;

		private static LinearGradientBrush CreateOpacityMask(System.Windows.Point endPoint, byte alpha)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				SpreadMethod = GradientSpreadMethod.Repeat,
				EndPoint = endPoint,
				MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(alpha, 0, 0, 0),
				Offset = 0.5
			});
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = Colors.Black,
				Offset = 0.5
			});
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private static LinearGradientBrush CreateItemOpacityMask(System.Windows.Point endPoint)
		{
			return CreateOpacityMask(endPoint, 191);
		}

		private static LinearGradientBrush CreateLegendItemOpacityMask(System.Windows.Point endPoint)
		{
			return CreateOpacityMask(endPoint, 150);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color ChangeColorBrightness(System.Windows.Media.Color color, double percentage)
		{
			byte a = Convert.ToByte(Math.Min(color.A + 255, 255));
			byte r = Convert.ToByte((double)(int)color.R + (double)(255 - color.R) * percentage);
			byte g = Convert.ToByte((double)(int)color.G + (double)(255 - color.G) * percentage);
			byte b = Convert.ToByte((double)(int)color.B + (double)(255 - color.B) * percentage);
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(a, r, g, b);
		}

		public static LinearGradientBrush GetOpacityMask(Transform transform)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush selectionOpacityMask = SelectionOpacityMask;
			if (!transform.IsIdentity())
			{
				selectionOpacityMask.Transform = transform;
			}
			return selectionOpacityMask;
		}

		public static int GetLineThickness(int thickness, bool inInteractiveState)
		{
			if (!inInteractiveState)
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			return thickness * 2;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color GetSelectedPointColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return ChangeColorBrightness(color, 0.6);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color GetHighlightedPointColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return ChangeColorBrightness(color, 0.7);
		}

		public static int GetLegendLineThickness(int thickness, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (!isSelected)
			{
				return thickness;
			}
			return thickness + 1;
		}

		public static bool SupportsHatchSelection(VisualSelectionType selectionType)
		{
			return (selectionType & VisualSelectionType.Hatch) != 0;
		}

		public static bool SupportsSizeSelection(VisualSelectionType selectionType)
		{
			return (selectionType & VisualSelectionType.Size) != 0;
		}

		public static bool SupportsBrightnessSelection(VisualSelectionType selectionType)
		{
			return (selectionType & VisualSelectionType.Brightness) != 0;
		}
	}
	public class SerializationControllerBase
	{
		private static Assembly ChartAssembly => typeof(SerializationControllerBase).Assembly;

		protected static object OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e, object propertyValue, string defaultPublicNamespace)
		{
			if (propertyValue == null)
			{
				propertyValue = ((!(e.CollectionName == "Colors")) ? XtraSerializingUtils.GetKnownContentPropertyInstance(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item, ChartAssembly, defaultPublicNamespace) : ((object)default(System.Windows.Media.Color)));
			}
			((IList)((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Collection).Add(propertyValue);
			return propertyValue;
		}

		public static object OnCreateContentPropertyValue(XtraCreateContentPropertyValueEventArgs e)
		{
			string fullName = e.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType.FullName;
			string typeNamespace = fullName.Remove(fullName.LastIndexOf('.') + 1);
			object knownContentPropertyInstance = XtraSerializingUtils.GetKnownContentPropertyInstance(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item, ChartAssembly, typeNamespace);
			e.PropertyDescriptor.SetValue(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Owner, knownContentPropertyInstance);
			return knownContentPropertyInstance;
		}

		public static void OnClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((IList)e.Collection).Clear();
		}
	}
	public class ChartSerializationController : SerializationControllerBase
	{
		private const string DefaultPublicNamespace = "DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.";

		public const string DefaultID = "ChartControl";

		public static bool OnShouldSerializeCollectionItem(object propertyValue)
		{
			if (propertyValue is Series && ((Series)propertyValue).IsAutoSeries)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propertyValue is SeriesPoint && ((SeriesPoint)propertyValue).Series.IsBoundPoints)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static object OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			object propertyValue = null;
			if (e.CollectionName == "ExactWorkdays" || e.CollectionName == "Holidays")
			{
				propertyValue = default(DateTime);
			}
			return SerializationControllerBase.OnCreateCollectionItem(e, propertyValue, "DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.");
		}
	}

	public class ChartSerializationProvider : SerializationProvider
	{
		protected override object OnCreateContentPropertyValue(XtraCreateContentPropertyValueEventArgs e)
		{
			return SerializationControllerBase.OnCreateContentPropertyValue(e);
		}

		protected override object OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return ChartSerializationController.OnCreateCollectionItem(e);
		}

		protected override void OnClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SerializationControllerBase.OnClearCollection(e);
		}

		protected override bool OnShouldSerializeCollectionItem(XtraShouldSerailizeCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			return ChartSerializationController.OnShouldSerializeCollectionItem(e.Value);
		}

		protected override void OnStartDeserializing(DependencyObject dObj, LayoutAllowEventArgs ea)
		{
			if (dObj is WorkdaysOptions)
			{
				((WorkdaysOptions)dObj).Holidays = new DateTimeCollection();
				((WorkdaysOptions)dObj).ExactWorkdays = new DateTimeCollection();
			}
			if (dObj is IDeserializableElement deserializableElement)
			{
				deserializableElement.StartDeserializing();
			}
			((SerializationProvider)this).OnStartDeserializing(dObj, ea);
		}

		protected override void OnEndDeserializing(DependencyObject dObj, string restoredVersion)
		{
			((SerializationProvider)this).OnEndDeserializing(dObj, restoredVersion);
			if (dObj is WorkdaysOptions)
			{
				if (((WorkdaysOptions)dObj).Holidays.Count() == 0)
				{
					((WorkdaysOptions)dObj).Holidays = null;
				}
				if (((WorkdaysOptions)dObj).ExactWorkdays.Count() == 0)
				{
					((WorkdaysOptions)dObj).ExactWorkdays = null;
				}
			}
			if (dObj is IDeserializableElement deserializableElement)
			{
				deserializableElement.CompleteDeserializing();
			}
		}
	}

	public class SeriesPointHelper
	{
		public static List<ISeriesPoint> GetSourcePoints(IDataPoint point)
		{
			List<ISeriesPoint> list = new List<ISeriesPoint>();
			if (point is IPlatformSeriesPoint)
			{
				list.Add((IPlatformSeriesPoint)point);
			}
			if (point is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					list.Add(sourcePoint.SeriesPoint);
				}
			}
			if (point is RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
			{
				return GetSourcePoints((IDataPoint)refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static IList<IInteractiveElement> GetInteractiveSourcePoints(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return new List<IInteractiveElement>();
			}
			return GetInteractiveSourcePoints(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
		}

		public static IList<IInteractiveElement> GetInteractiveSourcePoints(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			List<IInteractiveElement> list = new List<IInteractiveElement>();
			if (point is IPlatformSeriesPoint)
			{
				list.Add((IInteractiveElement)point);
			}
			if (point is AggregatedSeriesPoint)
			{
				AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint = point as AggregatedSeriesPoint;
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					list.Add((IInteractiveElement)sourcePoint.SeriesPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static object GetPointTag(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
				{
					if (sourcePoint.SeriesPoint is IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint)
					{
						list.Add(platformSeriesPoint.Tag);
					}
				}
				if (list.Count == 1)
				{
					return list[0];
				}
				return list;
			}
			return point.Tag;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesGeometryRendererBase
	{
		protected void DrawItem(IRenderContext drawingContext, SeriesPointItem item)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush opacityMask = item.PresentationData.OpacityMask;
			double pointOpacity = item.SeriesPointData.GetPointOpacity();
			bool shouldReflectVertically = item.Model.ShouldNonSymmetricalModelReflectVertically;
			SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData = item.PresentationData;
			if (opacityMask != null)
			{
				drawingContext.PushOpacityMask(opacityMask);
			}
			if (pointOpacity < 1.0)
			{
				drawingContext.PushOpacity(pointOpacity);
			}
			PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(presentationData, drawingContext, delegate(IPresentation pointLayout)
			{
				if (item.Model.CanBeDrawnWithZeroSize || (pointLayout.Bounds.Width != 0.0 && pointLayout.Bounds.Height != 0.0))
				{
					Geometry clipGeometry = pointLayout.ClipGeometry;
					if (clipGeometry != null)
					{
						drawingContext.PushClip(clipGeometry);
					}
					Matrix transform = pointLayout.Transform;
					if (shouldReflectVertically)
					{
						transform.ScaleAt(1.0, -1.0, 0.0, pointLayout.Bounds.Top + pointLayout.Bounds.Height * 0.5);
					}
					if (!transform.IsIdentity)
					{
						drawingContext.PushTransform(new MatrixTransform(transform));
					}
					item.Model.UpdateActualFillStyle(item.SeriesPointData);
					item.Model.Draw(drawingContext, presentationData, pointLayout);
					if (!transform.IsIdentity)
					{
						drawingContext.Pop();
					}
					if (clipGeometry != null)
					{
						drawingContext.Pop();
					}
				}
			});
			if (opacityMask != null)
			{
				drawingContext.Pop();
			}
			if (pointOpacity < 1.0)
			{
				drawingContext.Pop();
			}
		}

		public abstract void Render(XYSeries series, IRenderContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> items);
	}
	public class ThinningByBoundsSeriesGeometryRenderer : SeriesGeometryRendererBase
	{
		public override void Render(XYSeries series, IRenderContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> items)
		{
			SeriesPointItem seriesPointItem = null;
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in items)
			{
				if (item.Model == null || item.ActualLayout == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				series.CompletePointLayout(item);
				if (seriesPointItem == null)
				{
					seriesPointItem = item;
					rect = PresentationItemRenderHelper.GetPresentationBounds(seriesPointItem.PresentationData);
					continue;
				}
				Rect presentationBounds = PresentationItemRenderHelper.GetPresentationBounds(item.PresentationData);
				if (!rect.Contains(presentationBounds))
				{
					if (presentationBounds.Contains(rect))
					{
						seriesPointItem = item;
						rect = PresentationItemRenderHelper.GetPresentationBounds(seriesPointItem.PresentationData);
					}
					else
					{
						DrawItem(drawingContext, seriesPointItem);
						seriesPointItem = item;
						rect = PresentationItemRenderHelper.GetPresentationBounds(seriesPointItem.PresentationData);
					}
				}
			}
			if (seriesPointItem != null)
			{
				DrawItem(drawingContext, seriesPointItem);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SimpleSeriesGeometryRenderer : SeriesGeometryRendererBase
	{
		public override void Render(XYSeries series, IRenderContext drawingContext, IEnumerable<SeriesPointItem> items)
		{
			MarkerSeries2DPointLayout markerSeries2DPointLayout = null;
			int num = 0;
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in items)
			{
				MarkerSeries2DPointLayout markerSeries2DPointLayout2 = item.ActualLayout as MarkerSeries2DPointLayout;
				if (item.Model != null && item.ActualLayout != null && (markerSeries2DPointLayout == null || markerSeries2DPointLayout2 == null || (int)markerSeries2DPointLayout.InitialBounds.Left != (int)markerSeries2DPointLayout2.InitialBounds.Left || (int)markerSeries2DPointLayout.InitialBounds.Top != (int)markerSeries2DPointLayout2.InitialBounds.Top))
				{
					series.CompletePointLayout(item);
					DrawItem(drawingContext, item);
					if (num++ > 100)
					{
						markerSeries2DPointLayout = markerSeries2DPointLayout2;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class StringMeasurer
	{
		public static System.Windows.Size MeasureString(string str, string typefaceName, double fontSize)
		{
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(str, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface(typefaceName), fontSize, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black);
			return new System.Windows.Size(formattedText.Width, formattedText.Height);
		}

		public static double GetFontHeight(string typefaceName, double fontSize)
		{
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText("█", CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface(typefaceName), fontSize, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black);
			return formattedText.Height;
		}
	}
