		}
	}
	public class ColorHSL
	{
		private const float minLuminance = 0.5f;

		private const float maxLuminance = 0.8f;

		private float hue;

		private float saturation;

		private float luminance;

		public float Hue
		{
			get
			{
				return hue;
			}
			set
			{
				hue = value;
			}
		}

		public float Saturation
		{
			get
			{
				return saturation;
			}
			set
			{
				saturation = value;
			}
		}

		public float Luminance
		{
			get
			{
				return luminance;
			}
			set
			{
				luminance = value;
			}
		}

		public float MinLuminance => Math.Min(0.5f, luminance * 0.9f);

		public float MaxLuminance => Math.Max(0.8f, luminance + (1f - luminance) * 0.15f);

		private static float GetHue(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (color.R == color.G && color.G == color.B)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			float num5 = num;
			float num6 = num;
			if (num2 > num5)
			{
				num5 = num2;
			}
			if (num3 > num5)
			{
				num5 = num3;
			}
			if (num2 < num6)
			{
				num6 = num2;
			}
			if (num3 < num6)
			{
				num6 = num3;
			}
			float num7 = num5 - num6;
			if (num == num5)
			{
				num4 = (num2 - num3) / num7;
			}
			else if (num2 == num5)
			{
				num4 = 2f + (num3 - num) / num7;
			}
			else if (num3 == num5)
			{
				num4 = 4f + (num - num2) / num7;
			}
			num4 *= 60f;
			if (num4 < 0f)
			{
				num4 += 360f;
			}
			return num4;
		}

		private static float GetSaturation(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			float result = 0f;
			float num4 = num;
			float num5 = num;
			if (num2 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num2;
			}
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num3;
			}
			if (num2 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num2;
			}
			if (num3 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num3;
			}
			if (num4 != num5)
			{
				float num6 = (num4 + num5) / 2f;
				result = ((!((double)num6 <= 0.5)) ? ((num4 - num5) / (2f - num4 - num5)) : ((num4 - num5) / (num4 + num5)));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static float GetBrightness(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			float num = (float)(int)color.R / 255f;
			float num2 = (float)(int)color.G / 255f;
			float num3 = (float)(int)color.B / 255f;
			float num4 = num;
			float num5 = num;
			if (num2 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num2;
			}
			if (num3 > num4)
			{
				num4 = num3;
			}
			if (num2 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num2;
			}
			if (num3 < num5)
			{
				num5 = num3;
			}
			return (num4 + num5) / 2f;
		}

		private static byte GetComponent(float q, float p, float t)
		{
			while (t < 0f)
			{
				t += 1f;
			}
			while (t > 1f)
			{
				t -= 1f;
			}
			float num = ((t < 1f / 6f) ? (p + (q - p) * 6f * t) : ((t < 0.5f) ? q : ((!(t < 2f / 3f)) ? p : (p + (q - p) * (2f / 3f - t) * 6f))));
			return (byte)Math.Round(num * 255f);
		}

		public static explicit operator ColorHSL(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new ColorHSL(GetHue(color), GetSaturation(color), GetBrightness(color));
		}

		public static explicit operator System.Windows.Media.Color(ColorHSL color)
		{
			float num = ((color.luminance < 0.5f) ? (color.luminance * (1f + color.saturation)) : (color.luminance + color.saturation - color.luminance * color.saturation));
			float p = 2f * color.luminance - num;
			float num2 = color.hue / 360f;
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, GetComponent(num, p, num2 + 1f / 3f), GetComponent(num, p, num2), GetComponent(num, p, num2 - 1f / 3f));
		}

		public ColorHSL(float hue, float saturation, float luminance)
		{
			this.hue = hue;
			this.saturation = saturation;
			this.luminance = luminance;
		}
	}

	}
	public class ChartCommandManipulator
	{
		private abstract class BehaviorBase
		{
			private WeakReference control;

			private bool useMouseCached;

			public ChartControl Chart
			{
				get
				{
					if (control == null || !control.IsAlive)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return control.Target as ChartControl;
				}
			}

			public abstract ChartCommandMode Mode { get; }

			protected BehaviorBase(WeakReference control)
			{
				this.control = control;
			}

			public virtual void Enable()
			{
				if (Chart?.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
				{
					useMouseCached = xYDiagram2D.ActualNavigationOptions.UseMouse;
					xYDiagram2D.ActualNavigationOptions.SetCurrentValue(NavigationOptionsBase.UseMouseProperty, false);
				}
			}

			public virtual void Disable()
			{
				if (Chart?.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
				{
					xYDiagram2D.ActualNavigationOptions.SetCurrentValue(NavigationOptionsBase.UseMouseProperty, useMouseCached);
				}
			}

			public virtual Cursor GetQueryCursor()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public virtual void OnMouseDown(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
			}

			public virtual void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
			}

			public virtual void OnMouseUp(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
			}
		}

		private abstract class IndicatorDrawingBehavior : BehaviorBase
		{
			private Cursor cursor;

			private FinancialIndicator draggingIndicator;

			private ConstantLine trendlineBorder;

			private bool isDrawingInProcess;

			private bool? crosshairEnabled;

			private XYSeries2D CurrentSeries => base.Chart?.Commands.ActiveSeries as XYSeries2D;

			protected IndicatorDrawingBehavior(WeakReference control)
				: base(control)
			{
				cursor = new Cursor(AssemblyHelper.GetResourceStream(Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)), "Images/Apply.cur", false));
			}

			private object getArgument(DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
			{
				return coordinates.ArgumentScaleType switch
				{
					ScaleType.Qualitative => coordinates.QualitativeArgument, 
					ScaleType.Numerical => coordinates.NumericalArgument, 
					ScaleType.DateTime => coordinates.DateTimeArgument, 
					ScaleType.TimeSpan => coordinates.TimeSpanArgument, 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}

			private ValueLevel GetValueLevel()
			{
				if (CurrentSeries is FinancialSeries2D)
				{
					return ValueLevel.Close;
				}
				return ValueLevel.Value;
			}

			public override Cursor GetQueryCursor()
			{
				return cursor;
			}

			protected abstract FinancialIndicator CreateIndicator();

			public override void OnMouseDown(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				ChartControl chart = base.Chart;
				if (CurrentSeries != null)
				{
					crosshairEnabled = chart.CrosshairEnabled;
					chart.SetCurrentValue(ChartControlBase.CrosshairEnabledProperty, false);
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
					DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(point);
					if (diagramCoordinates != null && !diagramCoordinates.IsEmpty)
					{
						draggingIndicator = CreateIndicator();
						ChartCommandHelper.AddIndicator(chart, CurrentSeries, draggingIndicator);
						chart.BeginInit();
						object argument = getArgument(diagramCoordinates);
						draggingIndicator.Argument1 = argument;
						draggingIndicator.Argument2 = argument;
						ValueLevel valueLevel = GetValueLevel();
						draggingIndicator.ValueLevel1 = valueLevel;
						draggingIndicator.ValueLevel2 = valueLevel;
						trendlineBorder = new ConstantLine
						{
							Value = argument
						};
						xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisX.ConstantLinesInFront.Add(trendlineBorder);
						chart.EndInit();
						chart.CaptureMouse();
						isDrawingInProcess = true;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.Chart?.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
				if (isDrawingInProcess && xYDiagram2D != null)
				{
					DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(point);
					if (diagramCoordinates != null && !diagramCoordinates.IsEmpty)
					{
						object argument = getArgument(diagramCoordinates);
						draggingIndicator.Argument2 = argument;
						trendlineBorder.Value = argument;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void OnMouseUp(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				ChartControl chart = base.Chart;
				if (isDrawingInProcess && chart != null)
				{
					isDrawingInProcess = false;
					draggingIndicator = null;
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
					xYDiagram2D.ActualAxisX.ConstantLinesInFront.Remove(trendlineBorder);
					trendlineBorder = null;
					chart.SetCurrentValue(ChartControlBase.CrosshairEnabledProperty, crosshairEnabled);
					chart.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		private class IndicatorRemovingBehavior : BehaviorBase
		{
			private Cursor cursor;

			private Indicator indicatorToRemove;

			private ElementSelectionMode selectionModeCached;

			public override ChartCommandMode Mode => ChartCommandMode.Removing;

			public IndicatorRemovingBehavior(WeakReference control)
				: base(control)
			{
				cursor = new Cursor(AssemblyHelper.GetResourceStream(Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)), "Images/Remove.cur", false));
			}

			public override void Enable()
			{
				base.Enable();
				ChartControl chart = base.Chart;
				if (chart != null)
				{
					selectionModeCached = chart.SelectionMode;
					if (selectionModeCached == ElementSelectionMode.None)
					{
						chart.SetCurrentValue(ChartControl.SelectionModeProperty, ElementSelectionMode.Single);
					}
				}
			}

			public override void Disable()
			{
				base.Disable();
				base.Chart?.SetCurrentValue(ChartControl.SelectionModeProperty, selectionModeCached);
			}

			public override Cursor GetQueryCursor()
			{
				return cursor;
			}

			public override void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				Indicator indicator = (base.Chart?.CalcHitInfo(point))?.Indicator;
				if (indicator != null)
				{
					LineStyle lineStyle = indicator.LineStyle;
					if (lineStyle == null)
					{
						lineStyle = (indicator.LineStyle = new LineStyle());
					}
					if (indicatorToRemove != indicator)
					{
						lineStyle.Thickness *= 2;
						if (indicatorToRemove != null)
						{
							indicatorToRemove.LineStyle.Thickness /= 2;
						}
					}
					indicatorToRemove = indicator;
				}
				else if (indicatorToRemove != null)
				{
					indicatorToRemove.LineStyle.Thickness /= 2;
					indicatorToRemove = null;
				}
			}

			public override void OnMouseUp(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				ChartControl chart = base.Chart;
				if (indicatorToRemove == null && chart != null)
				{
					ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = chart.CalcHitInfo(point);
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
					Pane pane = (chartHitInfo.InPane ? chartHitInfo.Pane : ((chartHitInfo.InDiagram && xYDiagram2D != null) ? xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane : null));
					if (pane != null)
					{
						indicatorToRemove = xYDiagram2D.FindPaneIndicatorsByTag(pane.Tag);
					}
				}
				if (indicatorToRemove != null)
				{
					ChartCommandHelper.RemoveIndicator(chart, indicatorToRemove);
					indicatorToRemove = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private abstract class AddAnnotationBehavior : BehaviorBase
		{
			private Cursor cursor;

			protected AddAnnotationBehavior(WeakReference control)
				: base(control)
			{
				cursor = new Cursor(AssemblyHelper.GetResourceStream(Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)), "Images/Apply.cur", false));
			}

			private object GetAxisXValue(PaneAnchorPoint anchorPoint, DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
			{
				AxisValue axisValue = coordinates.GetAxisValue(coordinates.AxisX);
				if (axisValue == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return coordinates.ArgumentScaleType switch
				{
					ScaleType.DateTime => anchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = axisValue.DateTimeValue, 
					ScaleType.Numerical => anchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = axisValue.NumericalValue, 
					ScaleType.Qualitative => anchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = axisValue.QualitativeValue, 
					ScaleType.TimeSpan => anchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = axisValue.TimeSpanValue, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown scale type"), 
				};
			}

			private object GetAxisYValue(PaneAnchorPoint anchorPoint, DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
			{
				AxisValue axisValue = coordinates.GetAxisValue(coordinates.AxisY);
				return coordinates.ValueScaleType switch
				{
					ScaleType.DateTime => anchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = axisValue.DateTimeValue, 
					ScaleType.Numerical => anchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = axisValue.NumericalValue, 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown scale type"), 
				};
			}

			private bool SetUpAnnotation(Annotation annotation, DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
			{
				if (coordinates == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				PaneAnchorPoint paneAnchorPoint = new PaneAnchorPoint();
				paneAnchorPoint.Pane = coordinates.Pane;
				Axis2D axisX = coordinates.AxisX;
				if (axisX != null)
				{
					paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.Axis = axisX;
					object axisXValue = GetAxisXValue(paneAnchorPoint, coordinates);
					if (axisXValue != null)
					{
						paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisXCoordinate.AxisValue = axisXValue;
						Axis2D axisY = coordinates.AxisY;
						if (axisY != null)
						{
							paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.Axis = axisY;
							object axisYValue = GetAxisYValue(paneAnchorPoint, coordinates);
							if (axisYValue != null)
							{
								paneAnchorPoint.ActualAxisYCoordinate.AxisValue = axisYValue;
								annotation.AnchorPoint = paneAnchorPoint;
								annotation.ShapePosition = new RelativePosition();
								annotation.RuntimeAnchoring = true;
								annotation.RuntimeMoving = true;
								annotation.RuntimeResizing = true;
								annotation.RuntimeDeletion = true;
								return true;
							}
							return false;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected abstract Annotation CreateAnnotation();

			protected virtual void RunAfterAddingAction(Annotation annotation)
			{
			}

			public override void OnMouseUp(System.Windows.Point location)
			{
				if (base.Chart?.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
				{
					DiagramCoordinates coordinates = xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(location);
					Annotation annotation = CreateAnnotation();
					if (SetUpAnnotation(annotation, coordinates))
					{
						base.Chart.Annotations.Add(annotation);
						RunAfterAddingAction(annotation);
					}
				}
			}

			public override Cursor GetQueryCursor()
			{
				return cursor;
			}
		}

		private abstract class AddConstantLineBehavior : BehaviorBase
		{
			private Cursor cursor;

			protected AddConstantLineBehavior(WeakReference control)
				: base(control)
			{
				cursor = new Cursor(AssemblyHelper.GetResourceStream(Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)), "Images/Apply.cur", false));
			}

			protected abstract Axis2D GetAxis(DiagramCoordinates coordinates);

			public override void OnMouseUp(System.Windows.Point location)
			{
				if (base.Chart?.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D)
				{
					DiagramCoordinates diagramCoordinates = xYDiagram2D.PointToDiagram(location);
					Axis2D axis = GetAxis(diagramCoordinates);
					if (axis != null)
					{
						ConstantLine constantLine = new ConstantLine
						{
							RuntimeMoving = true,
							RuntimeDeletion = true
						};
						string text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.ToolbarDefaultConstantLineTitle);
						ConstantLineTitle title = new ConstantLineTitle
						{
							Content = new EditableTextContent
							{
								Text = text,
								EditModeEnabled = true
							}
						};
						constantLine.Title = title;
						constantLine.Title.Visible = true;
						constantLine.Value = diagramCoordinates.GetAxisValue(axis).ActualValue;
						axis.ConstantLinesInFront.Add(constantLine);
					}
				}
			}

			public override Cursor GetQueryCursor()
			{
				return cursor;
			}
		}

		private class AddVerticalConstantLineBehavior : AddConstantLineBehavior
		{
			public override ChartCommandMode Mode => ChartCommandMode.AddVerticalConstantLine;

			public AddVerticalConstantLineBehavior(WeakReference control)
				: base(control)
			{
			}

			protected override Axis2D GetAxis(DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
			{
				if (coordinates == null || coordinates.AxisX == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (coordinates.AxisX.IsVertical)
				{
					return coordinates.AxisY;
				}
				return coordinates.AxisX;
			}
		}

		private class AddHorizontalConstantLineBehavior : AddConstantLineBehavior
		{
			public override ChartCommandMode Mode => ChartCommandMode.AddHorizontalConstantLine;

			public AddHorizontalConstantLineBehavior(WeakReference control)
				: base(control)
			{
			}

			protected override Axis2D GetAxis(DiagramCoordinates coordinates)
			{
				if (coordinates == null || coordinates.AxisX == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!coordinates.AxisX.IsVertical)
				{
					return coordinates.AxisY;
				}
				return coordinates.AxisX;
			}
		}

		private static ChartCommandManipulator instance;

		private const int IndicatorThicknessMultiplier = 2;

		private BehaviorBase currentBehavior;

		public static ChartCommandManipulator Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					instance = new ChartCommandManipulator();
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		private ChartCommandManipulator()
		{
		}

		private void ProcessMouseDown(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			currentBehavior.OnMouseDown(location);
		}

		private void ProcessMouseMove(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			currentBehavior.OnMouseMove(location);
		}

		private void ProcessMouseUp(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			if (currentBehavior != null)
			{
				currentBehavior.OnMouseUp(location);
				ChartControl chart = currentBehavior.Chart;
				if (chart != null)
				{
					chart.Commands.ActualToolbarMode = ChartCommandMode.None;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseDown(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseDown(e.GetPosition(currentBehavior.Chart));
		}

		private void OnMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseMove(e.GetPosition(currentBehavior.Chart));
		}

		private void OnMouseUp(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseUp(e.GetPosition(currentBehavior.Chart));
		}

		private void QueryCursor(object sender, QueryChartCursorEventArgs e)
		{
			Cursor cursor = currentBehavior?.GetQueryCursor();
			if (cursor != null)
			{
				e.Cursor = cursor;
			}
		}

		private BehaviorBase CreateBehavior(ChartCommandMode mode, WeakReference control)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				ChartCommandMode.TrendLineDrawing => new TrendLineIndicatorDrawingBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.FibonacciArcsDrawing => new FibonacciArcsIndicatorDrawingBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.FibonacciFansDrawing => new FibonacciFansIndicatorDrawingBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.FibonacciRetracementDrawing => new FibonacciRetracementDrawingBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.Removing => new IndicatorRemovingBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.AddTextAnnotation => new AddTextAnnotationBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.AddImageAnnotation => new AddImageAnnotationBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.AddHorizontalConstantLine => new AddHorizontalConstantLineBehavior(control), 
				ChartCommandMode.AddVerticalConstantLine => new AddVerticalConstantLineBehavior(control), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private void Enable(ChartCommandMode mode, ChartControl newChart)
		{
			ChartControl obj = currentBehavior?.Chart;
			if (!newChart.Equals(obj) || currentBehavior == null || currentBehavior.Mode != mode)
			{
				Disable();
				currentBehavior = CreateBehavior(mode, new WeakReference(newChart));
				newChart.MouseDown += OnMouseDown;
				newChart.MouseMove += OnMouseMove;
				newChart.MouseUp += OnMouseUp;
				newChart.QueryChartCursor += QueryCursor;
				if (currentBehavior != null)
				{
					currentBehavior.Enable();
				}
			}
		}

		private void Disable()
		{
			if (currentBehavior != null)
			{
				currentBehavior.Disable();
				ChartControl chart = currentBehavior.Chart;
				if (chart != null)
				{
					chart.MouseDown -= OnMouseDown;
					chart.MouseMove -= OnMouseMove;
					chart.MouseUp -= OnMouseUp;
					chart.QueryChartCursor -= QueryCursor;
				}
				currentBehavior = null;
			}
		}

		public void Update(ChartCommandMode mode, ChartControl control = null)
		{
			if (mode == ChartCommandMode.None || control == null)
			{
				Disable();
			}
			else
			{
				Enable(mode, control);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class RenderUtils
	{
		private static void GetStretchMetrics(double strokeThickness, System.Windows.Size availableSize, Rect geometryBounds, out double xScale, out double yScale, out double dX, out double dY, out System.Windows.Size stretchedSize)
		{
			if (!geometryBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				double num = strokeThickness * 0.5;
				bool flag = false;
				xScale = Math.Max(availableSize.Width - strokeThickness, 0.0);
				yScale = Math.Max(availableSize.Height - strokeThickness, 0.0);
				dX = num - geometryBounds.Left;
				dY = num - geometryBounds.Top;
				if (geometryBounds.Width > xScale * double.Epsilon)
				{
					xScale /= geometryBounds.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					xScale = 1.0;
					if (geometryBounds.Width == 0.0)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (geometryBounds.Height > yScale * double.Epsilon)
				{
					yScale /= geometryBounds.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					yScale = 1.0;
					if (geometryBounds.Height == 0.0)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (yScale > xScale)
					{
						yScale = xScale;
					}
					else
					{
						xScale = yScale;
					}
				}
				stretchedSize = new System.Windows.Size(geometryBounds.Width * xScale + strokeThickness, geometryBounds.Height * yScale + strokeThickness);
			}
			else
			{
				xScale = (yScale = 1.0);
				dX = (dY = 0.0);
				stretchedSize = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private static Matrix GetStretchMatrix(double strokeThickness, System.Windows.Size availableSize, Rect geometryBounds, bool applyBoundsOffset)
		{
			GetStretchMetrics(strokeThickness, availableSize, geometryBounds, out var xScale, out var yScale, out var dX, out var dY, out var _);
			Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
			identity.ScaleAt(xScale, yScale, geometryBounds.Location.X, geometryBounds.Location.Y);
			if (applyBoundsOffset)
			{
				identity.Translate(geometryBounds.Location.X + dX, geometryBounds.Location.Y + dY);
			}
			else
			{
				identity.Translate(dX, dY);
			}
			return identity;
		}

		public static Matrix GetStretchMatrix(double strokeThickness, System.Windows.Size availableSize, Rect geometryBounds)
		{
			return GetStretchMatrix(strokeThickness, availableSize, geometryBounds, applyBoundsOffset: false);
		}

		public static Rect TransformUniformBounds(double strokeThickness, System.Windows.Size availableSize, Rect bounds)
		{
			Matrix stretchMatrix = GetStretchMatrix(strokeThickness, availableSize, bounds, applyBoundsOffset: true);
			return Rect.Transform(bounds, stretchMatrix);
		}

		public static void DrawRoundedRectangle(IRenderContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect rect, CornerRadius cornerRadius)
		{
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				bool isStroked = pen != null;
				streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(rect.TopLeft + new Vector(0.0, cornerRadius.TopLeft), brush != null, isClosed: true);
				streamGeometryContext.ArcTo(new System.Windows.Point(rect.TopLeft.X + cornerRadius.TopLeft, rect.TopLeft.Y), new System.Windows.Size(cornerRadius.TopLeft, cornerRadius.TopLeft), 90.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.LineTo(rect.TopRight - new Vector(cornerRadius.TopRight, 0.0), isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.ArcTo(new System.Windows.Point(rect.TopRight.X, rect.TopRight.Y + cornerRadius.TopRight), new System.Windows.Size(cornerRadius.TopRight, cornerRadius.TopRight), 90.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.LineTo(rect.BottomRight - new Vector(0.0, cornerRadius.BottomRight), isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.ArcTo(new System.Windows.Point(rect.BottomRight.X - cornerRadius.BottomRight, rect.BottomRight.Y), new System.Windows.Size(cornerRadius.BottomRight, cornerRadius.BottomRight), 90.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.LineTo(rect.BottomLeft + new Vector(cornerRadius.BottomLeft, 0.0), isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.ArcTo(new System.Windows.Point(rect.BottomLeft.X, rect.BottomLeft.Y - cornerRadius.BottomLeft), new System.Windows.Size(cornerRadius.BottomLeft, cornerRadius.BottomLeft), 90.0, isLargeArc: false, SweepDirection.Clockwise, isStroked, isSmoothJoin: true);
				streamGeometryContext.Close();
			}
			dc.DrawGeometry(brush, pen, streamGeometry);
		}
	}
	public static class TagUtils
	{
		public static void AttachTagToChartElement<TChartElement>(TChartElement chartElement, object tag) where TChartElement : ChartElement
		{
			chartElement.Tag = tag;
		}

		public static void AttachTagToChartNonVisualElement<TChartElement>(TChartElement chartElement, object tag) where TChartElement : ChartNonVisualElement
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)chartElement).Tag = tag;
		}

		public static Legend GetActualChartLegend(object legendObject, IChartElement owner)
		{
			if (legendObject is Legend result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			ChartControl chartControl = ChartElementHelper.FindOwnerByType<ChartControl>(owner);
			if (chartControl != null)
			{
				if (legendObject == null && chartControl.Legends.Count > 0)
				{
					return chartControl.Legends[0];
				}
				return chartControl.GetLegendByTag(legendObject);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static LegendBase GetActualLegend(object legendObject, IChartElement owner)
		{
			Legend actualChartLegend = GetActualChartLegend(legendObject, owner);
			if (actualChartLegend != null)
			{
				return actualChartLegend;
			}
			return ChartElementHelper.FindOwnerByType<HeatmapControl>(owner)?.Legend;
		}

		public static TElement GetElementFromObject<TElement>(object sourceObject, ObservableCollection<TElement> elements) where TElement : class, ISupportTag
		{
			if (sourceObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (sourceObject is TElement val)
			{
				if (!elements.Contains(val))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return val;
			}
			return FindElementByTag(sourceObject, elements);
		}

		public static TItem FindElementByTag<TItem>(object tag, IList<TItem> elements) where TItem : class, ISupportTag
		{
			if (tag != null)
			{
				foreach (TItem element in elements)
				{
					if (object.Equals(element.Tag, tag))
					{
						return element;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxesBoxCreator
	{
		private readonly IDomainBox3D domain;

		private readonly Chart3DCacheBase cache;

		private readonly Diagram3DBox diagramBox;

		private readonly BoxPlane planes;

		private Box bottom;

		private Box top;

		private Box back;

		private Box fore;

		private Box left;

		private Box right;

		private MaterialGroup planeXMaterial;

		private MaterialGroup planeYMaterial;

		private MaterialGroup planeZMaterial;

		private MaterialGroup axisXMaterial;

		private MaterialGroup axisYMaterial;

		private MaterialGroup axisZMaterial;

		private MaterialGroup axisZRotatedMaterial;

		private Material backgroundMaterial;

		protected IDomainBox3D Domain => domain;

		protected Chart3DCacheBase Cache => cache;

		protected Diagram3DBox DiagramBox => diagramBox;

		protected abstract IEnumerable<Axis3DInfoBase> AxesInfo { get; }

		internal Box Left => left;

		internal Box Right => right;

		internal Box Top => top;

		internal Box Bottom => bottom;

		internal Box Back => back;

		internal Box Fore => fore;

		public AxesBoxCreator(IDomainBox3D domain, Chart3DCacheBase cache, Diagram3DBox diagramBox, BoxPlane planes)
		{
			this.domain = domain;
			this.cache = cache;
			this.diagramBox = diagramBox;
			this.planes = planes;
		}

		private void CalcDiagramPlanes()
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			Point3D point3D = new Point3D(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			point3D = new Point3D(point3D.X, point3D.Y, point3D.Z);
			num *= 2.0;
			double num2 = diagramBox.InnerWidth + num;
			double num3 = diagramBox.InnerHeight + num;
			double num4 = diagramBox.InnerDepth + num;
			bottom = new Box(point3D, num2, 0.0 - domain.PlaneDepthFixed, num4, num2, num3, num4);
			top = new Box(MathUtils.Offset(point3D, 0.0, num3, 0.0), num2, domain.PlaneDepthFixed, num4, num2, num3, num4);
			back = new Box(point3D, num2, num3, 0.0 - domain.PlaneDepthFixed, num2, num3, num4);
			fore = new Box(MathUtils.Offset(point3D, 0.0, 0.0, num4), num2, num3, domain.PlaneDepthFixed, num2, num3, num4);
			left = new Box(point3D, 0.0 - domain.PlaneDepthFixed, num3, num4, num2, num3, num4);
			right = new Box(MathUtils.Offset(point3D, num2, 0.0, 0.0), domain.PlaneDepthFixed, num3, num4, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		private void CreateAxesMaterials(Material materialX, Material materialY, Material materialZ, Material materialRotatedZ)
		{
			axisXMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			axisYMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			axisZMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			axisZRotatedMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			axisXMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			axisYMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			axisZMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			axisZRotatedMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			axisXMaterial.Children.Add(materialX);
			axisYMaterial.Children.Add(materialY);
			axisZMaterial.Children.Add(materialZ);
			axisZRotatedMaterial.Children.Add(materialRotatedZ);
		}

		private void CreatePlanesMaterials(Material materialX, Material materialY, Material materialZ, Material materialRotatedZ)
		{
			planeXMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			planeYMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			planeZMaterial = new MaterialGroup();
			planeXMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			planeYMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			planeZMaterial.Children.Add(backgroundMaterial);
			planeXMaterial.Children.Add(materialX);
			planeXMaterial.Children.Add(materialY);
			planeXMaterial.Children.Add(CreateCrosshairMaterialX());
			planeYMaterial.Children.Add(materialY);
			planeYMaterial.Children.Add(materialZ);
			planeYMaterial.Children.Add(CreateCrosshairMaterialY());
			planeZMaterial.Children.Add(materialX);
			planeZMaterial.Children.Add(materialRotatedZ);
			planeZMaterial.Children.Add(CreateCrosshairMaterialZ());
		}

		private void CreateDiagramMaterials()
		{
			backgroundMaterial = domain.CreateBackgroundMaterial();
			Material materialX = CreateMaterialX();
			Material materialY = CreateMaterialY();
			Material materialZ = CreateMaterialZ();
			Material materialRotatedZ = CreateRotatedMaterialZ();
			CreateAxesMaterials(materialX, materialY, materialZ, materialRotatedZ);
			CreatePlanesMaterials(materialX, materialY, materialZ, materialRotatedZ);
		}

		private void BackPlaneTextureMapping()
		{
			back.Fore.Material = planeXMaterial;
			back.Left.Material = axisYMaterial;
			back.Right.Material = axisYMaterial;
			back.Bottom.Material = axisXMaterial;
			back.Top.Material = axisXMaterial;
		}

		private void ForePlaneTextureMapping()
		{
			fore.Back.Material = planeXMaterial;
			fore.Left.Material = axisYMaterial;
			fore.Right.Material = axisYMaterial;
			fore.Bottom.Material = axisXMaterial;
			fore.Top.Material = axisXMaterial;
		}

		private void LeftPlaneTextureMapping()
		{
			left.Right.Material = planeYMaterial;
			left.Back.Material = axisYMaterial;
			left.Fore.Material = axisYMaterial;
			left.Bottom.Material = axisZRotatedMaterial;
			left.Top.Material = axisZRotatedMaterial;
		}

		private void RightPlaneTextureMapping()
		{
			right.Left.Material = planeYMaterial;
			right.Back.Material = axisYMaterial;
			right.Fore.Material = axisYMaterial;
			right.Top.Material = axisZRotatedMaterial;
			right.Bottom.Material = axisZRotatedMaterial;
		}

		private void BottomPlaneTextureMapping()
		{
			bottom.Bottom.Material = backgroundMaterial;
			bottom.Top.Material = planeZMaterial;
			bottom.Fore.Material = axisXMaterial;
			bottom.Back.Material = axisXMaterial;
			bottom.Left.Material = axisZMaterial;
			bottom.Right.Material = axisZMaterial;
		}

		private void TopPlaneTextureMapping()
		{
			top.Bottom.Material = planeZMaterial;
			top.Fore.Material = axisXMaterial;
			top.Back.Material = axisXMaterial;
			top.Left.Material = axisZMaterial;
			top.Right.Material = axisZMaterial;
		}

		private void TextureMapping()
		{
			if (domain.ShowXOYPlane)
			{
				BackPlaneTextureMapping();
				ForePlaneTextureMapping();
			}
			if (domain.ShowYOZPlane)
			{
				LeftPlaneTextureMapping();
				RightPlaneTextureMapping();
			}
			if (domain.ShowXOZPlane)
			{
				BottomPlaneTextureMapping();
				TopPlaneTextureMapping();
			}
		}

		private void CreateDiagramModelCache()
		{
			int width = (int)DiagramBox.InnerWidth;
			if (!cache.IsDiagramModelValid(width))
			{
				CalcDiagramPlanes();
				CreateDiagramMaterials();
				TextureMapping();
				cache.Bottom = bottom.GetModel();
				cache.Top = top.GetModel();
				cache.Back = back.GetModel();
				cache.Fore = fore.GetModel();
				cache.Left = left.GetModel();
				cache.Right = right.GetModel();
				cache.Width = width;
			}
		}

		public void CreateDiagramModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			CreateDiagramModelCache();
			if ((planes & BoxPlane.Back) > BoxPlane.None)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(cache.Back);
			}
			if ((planes & BoxPlane.Fore) > BoxPlane.None)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(cache.Fore);
			}
			if ((planes & BoxPlane.Left) > BoxPlane.None)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(cache.Left);
			}
			if ((planes & BoxPlane.Right) > BoxPlane.None)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(cache.Right);
			}
			if ((planes & BoxPlane.Top) > BoxPlane.None)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(cache.Top);
			}
			if ((planes & BoxPlane.Bottom) > BoxPlane.None)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(cache.Bottom);
			}
		}

		public void CreateAxesLabels(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			List<LabelModelContainer> list = new List<LabelModelContainer>();
			foreach (Axis3DInfoBase item in AxesInfo)
			{
				item.CreateLabelsAndTitle(list);
			}
			list.Sort(LabelModelContainer.CompareByDistance);
			foreach (LabelModelContainer item2 in list)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(item2.Model);
			}
		}

		protected DiffuseMaterial CreateEmptyMaterial()
		{
			return new DiffuseMaterial(new ImageBrush());
		}

		protected abstract Material CreateMaterialX();

		protected abstract Material CreateMaterialY();

		protected abstract Material CreateMaterialZ();

		protected abstract Material CreateRotatedMaterialZ();

		protected abstract Material CreateCrosshairMaterialX();

		protected abstract Material CreateCrosshairMaterialY();

		protected abstract Material CreateCrosshairMaterialZ();

		public void CreateAxesBoxAndLabels(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			CreateDiagramModel(modelHolder);
			CreateAxesLabels(modelHolder);
		}
	}
	public class XYZAxesBoxCreator : AxesBoxCreator
	{
		protected override IEnumerable<Axis3DInfoBase> AxesInfo
		{
			get
			{
				yield return Domain.AxisInfoX;
				yield return Domain.AxisInfoY;
				yield return Domain.AxisInfoZ;
			}
		}

		protected new XYZChartCache Cache => (XYZChartCache)base.Cache;

		private Material CreateMaterial(Axis3DInfoBase axisInfo, bool isRotated, System.Windows.Size size, double lineLength)
		{
			Axis3D axis = axisInfo.Axis;
			if (axis.InterlacedBrush is SolidColorBrush && IsSimpleLine(axis.GridLinesBrush, axis.ActualGridLinesLineStyle) && IsSimpleLine(axis.GridLinesMinorBrush, axis.ActualGridLinesMinorLineStyle))
			{
				return new AxisMaterialFastCreator(axisInfo).CreateMaterial(size, lineLength, isRotated);
			}
			return new AxisMaterialCreator(axisInfo).CreateMaterial(size, lineLength, isRotated);
		}

		private bool IsSimpleLine(System.Windows.Media.Brush lineBrush, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (lineBrush is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				return lineStyle.IsSolid;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Material CreateMaterialX()
		{
			double lineLength = Math.Max(base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight, base.DiagramBox.InnerDepth);
			return CreateMaterial(base.Domain.AxisInfoX, isRotated: false, new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight), lineLength);
		}

		protected override Material CreateMaterialY()
		{
			double lineLength = Math.Max(base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, base.DiagramBox.InnerDepth);
			return CreateMaterial(base.Domain.AxisInfoY, isRotated: false, new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight), lineLength);
		}

		protected override Material CreateMaterialZ()
		{
			double lineLength = Math.Max(base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight, base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth);
			return CreateMaterial(base.Domain.AxisInfoZ, isRotated: false, new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerDepth, base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth), lineLength);
		}

		protected override Material CreateRotatedMaterialZ()
		{
			double lineLength = Math.Max(base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight, base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth);
			return CreateMaterial(base.Domain.AxisInfoZ, isRotated: true, new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, base.DiagramBox.InnerDepth), lineLength);
		}

		protected override Material CreateCrosshairMaterialX()
		{
			Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.CrosshairAxisXYMaterial = CreateEmptyMaterial();
			return Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.CrosshairAxisXYMaterial;
		}

		protected override Material CreateCrosshairMaterialY()
		{
			Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.CrosshairAxisZYMaterial = CreateEmptyMaterial();
			return Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.CrosshairAxisZYMaterial;
		}

		protected override Material CreateCrosshairMaterialZ()
		{
			Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.CrosshairAxisXZMaterial = CreateEmptyMaterial();
			return Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.CrosshairAxisXZMaterial;
		}

		public XYZAxesBoxCreator(IDomainBox3D domain, XYZChartCache cache, Diagram3DBox diagramBox, BoxPlane planes)
			: base(domain, cache, diagramBox, planes)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisMaterialCreatorBase<T>
	{
		private readonly Axis3DInfoBase axisInfo;

		protected Axis3DInfoBase AxisInfo => axisInfo;

		public AxisMaterialCreatorBase(Axis3DInfoBase axisInfo)
		{
			this.axisInfo = axisInfo;
		}

		private Transform CalculateTransform(bool isNeedRotate)
		{
			GRealRect2D bounds = axisInfo.AxisMapping.Bounds;
			AxisGroup axisGroupType = axisInfo.Axis.AxisGroupType;
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			switch (axisGroupType)
			{
			case AxisGroup.Value:
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
				{
					Angle = -90.0
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = 0.0,
					Y = bounds.Height
				});
				break;
			case AxisGroup.ArgumentY:
				if (isNeedRotate)
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
					{
						Angle = 90.0
					});
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = bounds.Height,
						Y = 0.0
					});
				}
				else
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
					{
						Angle = 180.0
					});
					transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = bounds.Width,
						Y = bounds.Height
					});
				}
				break;
			}
			return transformGroup;
		}

		protected abstract void RenderInterlaced(T renderer, double lineLength, Transform transform);

		protected abstract void RenderGridLines(T renderer, double lineLength, Transform transform);

		protected abstract void RenderMinorGridLines(T renderer, double lineLength, Transform transform);

		protected void Render(T renderer, double lineLength, bool isNeedRotate)
		{
			Transform transform = CalculateTransform(isNeedRotate);
			if (axisInfo.Axis.Interlaced)
			{
				RenderInterlaced(renderer, lineLength, transform);
			}
			if (axisInfo.Axis.GridLinesVisible)
			{
				RenderGridLines(renderer, lineLength, transform);
			}
			if (axisInfo.Axis.GridLinesMinorVisible)
			{
				RenderMinorGridLines(renderer, lineLength, transform);
			}
		}

		public abstract Material CreateMaterial(System.Windows.Size size, double lineLength, bool isNeedRotate);
	}
	public class AxisMaterialFastCreator : AxisMaterialCreatorBase<BitmapRenderer>
	{
		public AxisMaterialFastCreator(Axis3DInfoBase axisInfo)
			: base(axisInfo)
		{
		}

		private bool IsValueInsideInterlaced(double value, IList<InterlacedData> interlacedData)
		{
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in interlacedData)
			{
				double num = Math.Min(interlacedDatum.Near, interlacedDatum.Far);
				double num2 = Math.Max(interlacedDatum.Near, interlacedDatum.Far);
				if (value > num && value < num2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void RenderInterlaced(BitmapRenderer renderer, double lineLength, Transform transform)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = ((SolidColorBrush)base.AxisInfo.Axis.InterlacedBrush).Color;
			foreach (InterlacedData interlacedDatum in base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.InterlacedData)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(interlacedDatum.Near), 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(interlacedDatum.Far) + 1.0, lineLength));
				renderer.DrawRect(rect, transform, color);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderGridLines(BitmapRenderer renderer, double lineLength, Transform transform)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = ((SolidColorBrush)base.AxisInfo.Axis.GridLinesBrush).Color;
			int thickness = base.AxisInfo.Axis.ActualGridLinesLineStyle.Thickness;
			foreach (double visibleGridLineValue in base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleGridLineValues)
			{
				double num = base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(visibleGridLineValue) + 1.0;
				renderer.DrawLine((int)num, 0, (int)lineLength, thickness, transform, color);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderMinorGridLines(BitmapRenderer renderer, double lineLength, Transform transform)
		{
			IList<InterlacedData> interlacedData = base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.InterlacedData;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = ((SolidColorBrush)base.AxisInfo.Axis.InterlacedBrush).Color;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = ((SolidColorBrush)base.AxisInfo.Axis.GridLinesMinorBrush).Color;
			int thickness = base.AxisInfo.Axis.ActualGridLinesMinorLineStyle.Thickness;
			foreach (double visibleGridLineValue in base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.MinorItems.VisibleGridLineValues)
			{
				double num = base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(visibleGridLineValue) + 1.0;
				System.Windows.Media.Color backColor = (IsValueInsideInterlaced(visibleGridLineValue, interlacedData) ? color : System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0));
				renderer.DrawLine((int)num, 0, (int)lineLength, thickness, transform, color2, backColor);
			}
		}

		public override Material CreateMaterial(System.Windows.Size size, double lineLength, bool isNeedRotate)
		{
			BitmapRenderer bitmapRenderer = new BitmapRenderer((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height);
			Render(bitmapRenderer, lineLength, isNeedRotate);
			ImageBrush brush = new ImageBrush(bitmapRenderer.CreateTexture());
			Graphics3DUtils.CacheBrush(brush);
			return new DiffuseMaterial(brush);
		}
	}
	public class AxisMaterialCreator : AxisMaterialCreatorBase<DrawingContext>
	{
		private const double ImageBrushDpi = 96.0;

		public AxisMaterialCreator(Axis3DInfoBase axisInfo)
			: base(axisInfo)
		{
		}

		private ImageBrush CreateBrush(DrawingVisual drawingVisual, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			size = new System.Windows.Size(size.Width * num, size.Height * num);
			if (size.Width < 1.0)
			{
				size.Width = 1.0;
			}
			if (size.Height < 1.0)
			{
				size.Height = 1.0;
			}
			size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(4000.0, size.Width), Math.Min(2000.0, size.Height));
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Default);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(drawingVisual);
			ImageBrush imageBrush = new ImageBrush(renderTargetBitmap);
			Graphics3DUtils.CacheBrush(imageBrush);
			return imageBrush;
		}

		private Geometry CreateInterlacedGeometry(double size)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			IList<InterlacedData> interlacedData = base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.InterlacedData;
			foreach (InterlacedData item in interlacedData)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(item.Near), 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(item.Far) + 1.0, size));
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = rect
				});
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		private GeometryGroup CreateGridLinesGeometry(List<double> values, LineStyle lineStyle, double size)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			bool flag = lineStyle.Thickness % 2 == 1;
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				double num = base.AxisInfo.AxisMapping.GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(value) + 1.0;
				if (flag)
				{
					num -= 0.5;
				}
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new LineGeometry
				{
					StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0),
					EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(num, size)
				});
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		protected override void RenderInterlaced(DrawingContext drawingContext, double lineLength, Transform transform)
		{
			Geometry geometry = CreateInterlacedGeometry(lineLength);
			geometry.Transform = transform;
			drawingContext.DrawGeometry(base.AxisInfo.Axis.InterlacedBrush, null, geometry);
		}

		protected override void RenderGridLines(DrawingContext drawingContext, double lineLength, Transform transform)
		{
			Geometry geometry = CreateGridLinesGeometry(base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.Items.VisibleGridLineValues, base.AxisInfo.Axis.ActualGridLinesLineStyle, lineLength);
			if (geometry != null)
			{
				geometry.Transform = transform;
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(null, base.AxisInfo.Axis.ActualGridLinesLineStyle.CreatePen(base.AxisInfo.Axis.GridLinesBrush), geometry);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderMinorGridLines(DrawingContext drawingContext, double lineLength, Transform transform)
		{
			Geometry geometry = CreateGridLinesGeometry(base.AxisInfo.GridAndTextData.GridData.MinorItems.VisibleGridLineValues, base.AxisInfo.Axis.ActualGridLinesMinorLineStyle, lineLength);
			if (geometry != null)
			{
				geometry.Transform = transform;
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(null, base.AxisInfo.Axis.ActualGridLinesMinorLineStyle.CreatePen(base.AxisInfo.Axis.GridLinesMinorBrush), geometry);
			}
		}

		public override Material CreateMaterial(System.Windows.Size size, double lineLength, bool isNeedRotate)
		{
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			using DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen();
			Render(drawingContext, lineLength, isNeedRotate);
			drawingContext.Close();
			return new DiffuseMaterial(CreateBrush(drawingVisual, size));
		}
	}

	public class Geometry3DWrapper
	{
		private readonly Point3DCollection points = new Point3DCollection();

		private readonly Int32Collection triangleIndices = new Int32Collection();

		private readonly Model3DTagCollection model3DTagCollection = new Model3DTagCollection();

		public int PointsCount => points.Count;

		private void AddTriangleIndeces(int indexOffset, int point1Index, int point2Index, int point3Index)
		{
			triangleIndices.Add(indexOffset + point1Index);
			triangleIndices.Add(indexOffset + point2Index);
			triangleIndices.Add(indexOffset + point3Index);
		}

		public void AddModel(IList<Point3D> modelPoints, IList<int> modelTriangleIndexes, Point3D offset, double mul)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			foreach (Point3D modelPoint in modelPoints)
			{
				Matrix3D matrix3D = default(Matrix3D);
				matrix3D.Scale(new Vector3D(mul, mul, mul));
				Point3D value = modelPoint * matrix3D;
				value.Offset(offset.X, offset.Y, offset.Z);
				points.Add(value);
			}
			foreach (int modelTriangleIndex in modelTriangleIndexes)
			{
				triangleIndices.Add(count + modelTriangleIndex);
			}
		}

		public void AddPlane(Point3D leftTop, Point3D rightTop, Point3D rightBottom, Point3D leftBottom)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			points.Add(leftTop);
			points.Add(rightTop);
			points.Add(rightBottom);
			points.Add(leftBottom);
			AddTriangleIndeces(count, 1, 0, 3);
			AddTriangleIndeces(count, 3, 2, 1);
		}

		public void AddTriangle(Point3D top, Point3D left, Point3D right)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			points.Add(top);
			points.Add(left);
			points.Add(right);
			AddTriangleIndeces(count, 0, 1, 2);
		}

		public MeshGeometry3D CreateGeometry()
		{
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D
			{
				Positions = points,
				TriangleIndices = triangleIndices
			};
			Model3DTagCollection.SetModel3DTagCollection(meshGeometry3D, model3DTagCollection);
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		public void AddModel3DTag(int startIndex, object tag)
		{
			model3DTagCollection.Add(new Model3DTag
			{
				StartIndex = startIndex,
				EndIndex = PointsCount - 1,
				Tag = tag
			});
		}
	}
	public class ModelAggregator
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color?, Geometry3DWrapper> geometries = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color?, Geometry3DWrapper>();

		private readonly Colorizer3DBase colorizer;

		public ModelAggregator(Colorizer3DBase colorizer)
		{
			this.colorizer = colorizer;
		}

		private Material CreateMaterial(System.Windows.Media.Color? color)
		{
			MaterialGroup materialGroup = new MaterialGroup();
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = (color.HasValue ? new SolidColorBrush(color.Value) : null);
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new DiffuseMaterial(brush));
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new SpecularMaterial
			{
				SpecularPower = 56.0,
				Brush = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(229, 229, 229))
			});
			return materialGroup;
		}

		private GeometryModel3D CreateGeometryModel(System.Windows.Media.Color? color, Geometry3DWrapper geometry)
		{
			return new GeometryModel3D(geometry.CreateGeometry(), CreateMaterial(color));
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color? GetPointColor(ISeriesPoint point, Colorizer3DBase colorizer, int pointIndex)
		{
			if (point is SeriesPoint3D { Brush: not null } seriesPoint3D)
			{
				return seriesPoint3D.Brush.Color;
			}
			return colorizer.GetPointColor(point, pointIndex);
		}

		public Geometry3DWrapper PushGeometry(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, int pointIndex)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? pointColor = GetPointColor(seriesPoint, colorizer, pointIndex);
			if (!pointColor.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!geometries.TryGetValue(pointColor, out var value))
			{
				value = new Geometry3DWrapper();
				geometries.Add(pointColor, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public Model3D CreateModel()
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			foreach (System.Windows.Media.Color? key in geometries.Keys)
			{
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(CreateGeometryModel(key, geometries[key]));
			}
			return model3DGroup;
		}
	}
	public class BitmapRenderer
	{
		private const double BitmapDpi = 96.0;

		private const int BitsPerPixel = 4;

		private readonly Int32Rect bounds;

		private readonly int arraySize;

		private readonly int stride;

		private readonly byte[] pixelsArray;

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Color emptyColor = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);

		public BitmapRenderer(int width, int height)
		{
			bounds = new Int32Rect(0, 0, Math.Max(width, 1), Math.Max(height, 1));
			stride = bounds.Width * 4;
			arraySize = stride * bounds.Height;
			pixelsArray = new byte[arraySize];
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color MixColors(System.Windows.Media.Color topColor, System.Windows.Media.Color bottomColor)
		{
			double num = (double)(int)topColor.A / 255.0;
			double num2 = (double)(int)bottomColor.A / 255.0;
			double num3 = 1.0 - num;
			byte b = (byte)((double)(int)topColor.B * num + (double)(int)bottomColor.B * num3);
			byte g = (byte)((double)(int)topColor.G * num + (double)(int)bottomColor.G * num3);
			byte r = (byte)((double)(int)topColor.R * num + (double)(int)bottomColor.R * num3);
			byte a = (byte)((num + num2 * num3) * 255.0);
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(a, r, g, b);
		}

		private void DrawAlphaBlendingRect(Rect rect, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Color fill)
		{
			Rect rect2 = transform?.TransformBounds(rect) ?? rect;
			int num = stride * Math.Max((int)rect2.Top, bounds.Y);
			int num2 = stride * Math.Min((int)rect2.Bottom, bounds.Height + bounds.Y);
			int num3 = Math.Max((int)rect2.Left * 4, bounds.X);
			int num4 = Math.Min((int)rect2.Right, bounds.Width + bounds.X) * 4;
			double num5 = (double)(int)fill.A / 255.0;
			double num6 = 1.0 - num5;
			double num7 = (double)(int)fill.B * num5;
			double num8 = (double)(int)fill.R * num5;
			double num9 = (double)(int)fill.G * num5;
			for (int i = num; i < num2; i += stride)
			{
				for (int j = num3; j < num4; j += 4)
				{
					int num10 = i + j;
					pixelsArray[num10] = (byte)(num7 + (double)(int)pixelsArray[num10] * num6);
					pixelsArray[num10 + 1] = (byte)(num9 + (double)(int)pixelsArray[num10 + 1] * num6);
					pixelsArray[num10 + 2] = (byte)(num8 + (double)(int)pixelsArray[num10 + 2] * num6);
					double num11 = (double)(int)pixelsArray[num10 + 3] / 255.0;
					pixelsArray[num10 + 3] = (byte)((num5 + num11 * num6) * 255.0);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawRect(Rect rect, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Color fill, System.Windows.Media.Color backColor)
		{
			Rect rect2 = transform?.TransformBounds(rect) ?? rect;
			int num = stride * Math.Max((int)rect2.Top, bounds.Y);
			int num2 = stride * Math.Min((int)rect2.Bottom, bounds.Height + bounds.Y);
			int num3 = Math.Max((int)rect2.Left * 4, bounds.X);
			int num4 = Math.Min((int)rect2.Right, bounds.Width + bounds.X) * 4;
			System.Windows.Media.Color bottomColor = MixColors(backColor, emptyColor);
			bottomColor = MixColors(fill, bottomColor);
			byte b = bottomColor.B;
			byte r = bottomColor.R;
			byte g = bottomColor.G;
			byte a = bottomColor.A;
			for (int i = num; i < num2; i += stride)
			{
				for (int j = num3; j < num4; j += 4)
				{
					int num5 = i + j;
					pixelsArray[num5] = b;
					pixelsArray[num5 + 1] = g;
					pixelsArray[num5 + 2] = r;
					pixelsArray[num5 + 3] = a;
				}
			}
		}

		private Rect CalculateLineRectBounds(int x, int yStart, int yEnd, int thickness)
		{
			return new Rect(x - thickness / 2, yStart, thickness, yEnd - yStart);
		}

		public void DrawLine(int x, int yStart, int yEnd, int thickness, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Color fill)
		{
			Rect rect = CalculateLineRectBounds(x, yStart, yEnd, thickness);
			DrawAlphaBlendingRect(rect, transform, fill);
		}

		public void DrawLine(int x, int yStart, int yEnd, int thickness, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Color fill, System.Windows.Media.Color backColor)
		{
			Rect rect = CalculateLineRectBounds(x, yStart, yEnd, thickness);
			DrawRect(rect, transform, fill);
		}

		public void DrawRect(Rect rect, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Color fill)
		{
			DrawRect(rect, transform, fill, emptyColor);
		}

		public BitmapSource CreateTexture()
		{
			return BitmapSource.Create(bounds.Width, bounds.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32, null, pixelsArray, stride);
		}
	}
	public interface IDiagramMapping
	{
		Point3D GetDiagramPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value);
	}
	public abstract class ModelCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly IDiagramMapping diagramMapping;

		private IList<Triangle> triangles;

		private IList<Point3D> points;

		private MinMaxValues drawingRangeX = MinMaxValues.Empty;

		private MinMaxValues drawingRangeZ = MinMaxValues.Empty;

		private MinMaxValues drawingRangeY = MinMaxValues.Empty;

		public IList<RefinedPoint> RefinedPoints { get; }

		public MinMaxValues DrawingRangeX => drawingRangeX;

		public MinMaxValues DrawingRangeZ => drawingRangeZ;

		public MinMaxValues DrawingRangeY => drawingRangeY;

		protected internal IList<Triangle> Triangles
		{
			get
			{
				if (triangles == null)
				{
					triangles = CreateTriangles();
				}
				return triangles;
			}
		}

		protected internal IList<Point3D> Points
		{
			get
			{
				if (points == null)
				{
					points = CreatePoints();
				}
				return points;
			}
		}

		public ModelCalculatorBase(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, IDiagramMapping diagramMapping)
		{
			RefinedPoints = refinedPoints;
			this.diagramMapping = diagramMapping;
		}

		private void UpdateMinMax(Point3D point)
		{
			drawingRangeX = Union(drawingRangeX, point.X);
			drawingRangeY = Union(drawingRangeY, point.Y);
			drawingRangeZ = Union(drawingRangeZ, point.Z);
		}

		private MinMaxValues Union(MinMaxValues sourceValues, double value)
		{
			sourceValues.Union(value);
			return sourceValues;
		}

		private IList<Point3D> CreatePoints()
		{
			if (RefinedPoints == null)
			{
				return new List<Point3D>();
			}
			List<Point3D> list = new List<Point3D>(RefinedPoints.Count);
			foreach (RefinedPoint refinedPoint in RefinedPoints)
			{
				IXYZPoint iXYZPoint = refinedPoint;
				Point3D diagramPoint = diagramMapping.GetDiagramPoint(iXYZPoint.Argument, iXYZPoint.ArgumentY, iXYZPoint.Value);
				UpdateMinMax(diagramPoint);
				list.Add(diagramPoint);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<Triangle> CreateTriangles()
		{
			ITriangulator triangulator = CreateTriangulator();
			return triangulator.Triangulate();
		}

		protected abstract ITriangulator CreateTriangulator();
	}
	public class TriangulatorModelCalculator : ModelCalculatorBase
	{
		public TriangulatorModelCalculator(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, IDiagramMapping diagramMapping)
			: base(refinedPoints, diagramMapping)
		{
		}

		protected override ITriangulator CreateTriangulator()
		{
			return new IterativeTriangulator(base.Points);
		}
	}

	public class BrushOffsetMappingHelper
	{
		private readonly Transformation transformation;

		public BrushOffsetMappingHelper(ILogarithmic logarithmic)
		{
			transformation = ((logarithmic != null && logarithmic.Enabled) ? ((Transformation)new LogarithmicTransformation(logarithmic.Base, 0.0, coerenceNegative: false)) : ((Transformation)new IdentityTransformation()));
		}

		private static double ValidateOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (double.IsNegativeInfinity(offset))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(offset))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return offset;
		}

		public double NormalizeOffset(double value, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			return ValidateOffset(MathUtils.Normalize(transformation.TransformForward(value), transformation.TransformForward(minValue), transformation.TransformForward(maxValue)));
		}
	}
	public static class GradientStopCollectionExtensions
	{
		public static System.Windows.Media.Color GetRelativeColor(this GradientStopCollection gsc, double offset)
		{
			offset = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(offset, 1.0));
			GradientStop gradientStop = gsc.Where((GradientStop w) => w.Offset == gsc.Min((GradientStop m) => m.Offset)).First();
			GradientStop gradientStop2 = gsc.Where((GradientStop w) => w.Offset == gsc.Max((GradientStop m) => m.Offset)).First();
			foreach (GradientStop item in gsc)
			{
				if (item.Offset <= offset && item.Offset > gradientStop.Offset)
				{
					gradientStop = item;
				}
				if (item.Offset >= offset && item.Offset < gradientStop2.Offset)
				{
					gradientStop2 = item;
				}
			}
			if (gradientStop.Color.Equals(gradientStop2.Color))
			{
				return gradientStop.Color;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color result = default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			double num = offset - gradientStop.Offset;
			double num2 = gradientStop2.Offset - gradientStop.Offset;
			result.ScA = (float)(num * (double)(gradientStop2.Color.ScA - gradientStop.Color.ScA) / num2 + (double)gradientStop.Color.ScA);
			result.ScR = (float)(num * (double)(gradientStop2.Color.ScR - gradientStop.Color.ScR) / num2 + (double)gradientStop.Color.ScR);
			result.ScG = (float)(num * (double)(gradientStop2.Color.ScG - gradientStop.Color.ScG) / num2 + (double)gradientStop.Color.ScG);
			result.ScB = (float)(num * (double)(gradientStop2.Color.ScB - gradientStop.Color.ScB) / num2 + (double)gradientStop.Color.ScB);
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class OctagonBar3DRenderer : Bar3DRenderer
	{
		private readonly double edgeLeft;

		private readonly double edgeRight;

		private readonly double edgeFront;

		private readonly double edgeBack;

		private readonly double edgeLeftWithFacet;

		private readonly double edgeRightWithFacet;

		private readonly double edgeFrontWithFacet;

		private readonly double edgeBackWithFacet;

		public OctagonBar3DRenderer(Point3D barPoint, Bar3DSeriesSettings seriesSettings)
			: base(barPoint, seriesSettings)
		{
			double num = 1.0 + Math.Sqrt(2.0);
			double num2 = seriesSettings.RadiusX / num;
			double num3 = seriesSettings.RadiusXWithFacet / num;
			double num4 = seriesSettings.RadiusZ / num;
			double num5 = seriesSettings.RadiusZWithFacet / num;
			edgeLeft = barPoint.X - num2;
			edgeRight = barPoint.X + num2;
			edgeFront = barPoint.Z + num4 * base.BarSign;
			edgeBack = barPoint.Z - num4 * base.BarSign;
			edgeLeftWithFacet = barPoint.X - num3;
			edgeRightWithFacet = barPoint.X + num3;
			edgeFrontWithFacet = barPoint.Z + num5 * base.BarSign;
			edgeBackWithFacet = barPoint.Z - num5 * base.BarSign;
		}

		protected override void CreateFoundation(Geometry3DWrapper geometry)
		{
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Back), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Back));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Front), new Point3D(base.Right, base.Bottom, edgeFront), new Point3D(base.Right, base.Bottom, edgeBack), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Back));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.Left, base.Bottom, edgeFront), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Back), new Point3D(base.Left, base.Bottom, edgeBack));
		}

		protected override void CreateFoundationFacet(Geometry3DWrapper geometry)
		{
		}

		protected override void CreateBar(Geometry3DWrapper geometry)
		{
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Back), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Back));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Back), new Point3D(base.Right, base.Bottom, edgeBack));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront), new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack), new Point3D(base.Right, base.Bottom, edgeBack), new Point3D(base.Right, base.Bottom, edgeFront));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front), new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront), new Point3D(base.Right, base.Bottom, edgeFront), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Front));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.Bottom, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Front));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Front), new Point3D(base.Left, base.Bottom, edgeFront));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack), new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront), new Point3D(base.Left, base.Bottom, edgeFront), new Point3D(base.Left, base.Bottom, edgeBack));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back), new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack), new Point3D(base.Left, base.Bottom, edgeBack), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.Bottom, base.Back));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(base.RightWithFacet, base.Top, edgeBackWithFacet), new Point3D(base.RightWithFacet, base.Top, edgeFrontWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.LeftWithFacet, base.Top, edgeBackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet), new Point3D(base.LeftWithFacet, base.Top, edgeFrontWithFacet));
		}

		protected override void CreateBarFacet(Geometry3DWrapper geometry)
		{
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.RightWithFacet, base.Top, edgeBackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back), new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.RightWithFacet, base.Top, edgeFrontWithFacet), new Point3D(base.RightWithFacet, base.Top, edgeBackWithFacet), new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack), new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet), new Point3D(base.RightWithFacet, base.Top, edgeFrontWithFacet), new Point3D(base.Right, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRightWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeRight, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.LeftWithFacet, base.Top, edgeFrontWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.FrontWithFacet), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Front), new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(base.LeftWithFacet, base.Top, edgeBackWithFacet), new Point3D(base.LeftWithFacet, base.Top, edgeFrontWithFacet), new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeFront), new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack));
			geometry.AddPlane(new Point3D(edgeLeftWithFacet, base.Top, base.BackWithFacet), new Point3D(base.LeftWithFacet, base.Top, edgeBackWithFacet), new Point3D(base.Left, base.TopWithFacet, edgeBack), new Point3D(edgeLeft, base.TopWithFacet, base.Back));
		}
	}
	public class SphereModelCalculator
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<long, int> middlePointIndexCache = new Dictionary<long, int>();

		private readonly IList<GeometryInfo> geometryCache = new List<GeometryInfo>();

		private readonly IList<Point3D> points = new List<Point3D>();

		private readonly double initialRadius;

		private int lastCachedLevel = -1;

		public SphereModelCalculator(double initialRadius)
		{
			points = new List<Point3D>();
			this.initialRadius = initialRadius;
			FillZeroLevelGeometry();
		}

		private int AddVertex(Point3D p)
		{
			double num = Math.Sqrt(p.X * p.X + p.Y * p.Y + p.Z * p.Z);
			double num2 = num / initialRadius;
			points.Add(new Point3D(p.X / num2, p.Y / num2, p.Z / num2));
			return points.Count - 1;
		}

		private int AddMiddleVertex(int p1, int p2)
		{
			bool flag = p1 < p2;
			long num = (flag ? p1 : p2);
			long num2 = (flag ? p2 : p1);
			long key = (num << 32) + num2;
			if (middlePointIndexCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			Point3D point3D = points[p1];
			Point3D point3D2 = points[p2];
			Point3D p3 = new Point3D((point3D.X + point3D2.X) / 2.0, (point3D.Y + point3D2.Y) / 2.0, (point3D.Z + point3D2.Z) / 2.0);
			int num3 = AddVertex(p3);
			middlePointIndexCache.Add(key, num3);
			return num3;
		}

		private void CreateBaseVertices()
		{
			double num = (1.0 + Math.Sqrt(5.0)) * 0.5;
			AddVertex(new Point3D(-1.0, num, 0.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(1.0, num, 0.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(-1.0, 0.0 - num, 0.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(1.0, 0.0 - num, 0.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(0.0, -1.0, num));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(0.0, 1.0, num));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(0.0, -1.0, 0.0 - num));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0 - num));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(num, 0.0, -1.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(num, 0.0, 1.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(0.0 - num, 0.0, -1.0));
			AddVertex(new Point3D(0.0 - num, 0.0, 1.0));
		}

		private List<Triangle> CreateBaseFaces()
		{
			List<Triangle> list = new List<Triangle>();
			list.Add(new Triangle(0, 11, 5));
			list.Add(new Triangle(0, 5, 1));
			list.Add(new Triangle(0, 1, 7));
			list.Add(new Triangle(0, 7, 10));
			list.Add(new Triangle(0, 10, 11));
			list.Add(new Triangle(1, 5, 9));
			list.Add(new Triangle(5, 11, 4));
			list.Add(new Triangle(11, 10, 2));
			list.Add(new Triangle(10, 7, 6));
			list.Add(new Triangle(7, 1, 8));
			list.Add(new Triangle(3, 9, 4));
			list.Add(new Triangle(3, 4, 2));
			list.Add(new Triangle(3, 2, 6));
			list.Add(new Triangle(3, 6, 8));
			list.Add(new Triangle(3, 8, 9));
			list.Add(new Triangle(4, 9, 5));
			list.Add(new Triangle(2, 4, 11));
			list.Add(new Triangle(6, 2, 10));
			list.Add(new Triangle(8, 6, 7));
			list.Add(new Triangle(9, 8, 1));
			return list;
		}

		private void FillZeroLevelGeometry()
		{
			CreateBaseVertices();
			geometryCache.Add(new GeometryInfo(points, CreateBaseFaces()));
			lastCachedLevel = 0;
		}

		private void FillGeometry(int requiredLevel)
		{
			int num = requiredLevel - lastCachedLevel;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IList<Triangle> faces = geometryCache[lastCachedLevel + i].Faces;
				IList<Triangle> list = new List<Triangle>();
				foreach (Triangle item in faces)
				{
					int num2 = AddMiddleVertex(item.V1, item.V2);
					int num3 = AddMiddleVertex(item.V2, item.V3);
					int num4 = AddMiddleVertex(item.V3, item.V1);
					list.Add(new Triangle(item.V1, num2, num4));
					list.Add(new Triangle(item.V2, num3, num2));
					list.Add(new Triangle(item.V3, num4, num3));
					list.Add(new Triangle(num2, num3, num4));
				}
				geometryCache.Add(new GeometryInfo(points, list));
			}
			lastCachedLevel = requiredLevel;
		}

		public GeometryInfo GetGeometry(int requiredLevel)
		{
			if (requiredLevel < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (requiredLevel > lastCachedLevel)
			{
				FillGeometry(requiredLevel);
			}
			return geometryCache[requiredLevel];
		}
	}
	public class GeometryInfo
	{
		private readonly IList<Triangle> faces;

		private readonly Point3DCollection points;

		private Int32Collection triangleIndices;

		public IList<Triangle> Faces => faces;

		public Point3DCollection Points => points;

		public Int32Collection TriangleIndices
		{
			get
			{
				if (triangleIndices == null)
				{
					triangleIndices = CreateTriangleIndices();
				}
				return triangleIndices;
			}
		}

		public GeometryInfo(IList<Point3D> points, IList<Triangle> faces)
		{
			this.points = new Point3DCollection(points);
			this.faces = faces;
		}

		private Int32Collection CreateTriangleIndices()
		{
			Int32Collection int32Collection = new Int32Collection();
			foreach (Triangle face in faces)
			{
				int32Collection.Add(face.V1);
				int32Collection.Add(face.V2);
				int32Collection.Add(face.V3);
			}
			return int32Collection;
		}
	}

	public class BarSeries3DLabelData : Series3DLabelData
	{
		private readonly System.Windows.Size barDrawingSize;

		public BarSeries3DLabelData(ISeriesLabelDataProvider seriesLabelDataProvider, System.Windows.Size barDrawingSize)
			: base(seriesLabelDataProvider)
		{
			this.barDrawingSize = barDrawingSize;
		}

		private Point3D GetLowPoint(RefinedPoint pointInfo, XYZChartBox xyzChartBox)
		{
			return xyzChartBox.GetDiagramPoint(pointInfo.Argument, pointInfo.ArgumentY, 0.0);
		}

		private Point3D GetHighPoint(RefinedPoint pointInfo, XYZChartBox xyzChartBox)
		{
			return xyzChartBox.GetDiagramPoint(pointInfo.Argument, pointInfo.ArgumentY, pointInfo.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value));
		}

		private Model3DInfo CreateModelInfo(Point3D lowPoint, Point3D highPoint, double barWidth, double barDepth, RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			lowPoint.Offset((0.0 - barWidth) / 2.0, 0.0, (0.0 - barDepth) / 2.0);
			bool flag = highPoint.Y < lowPoint.Y;
			double num = highPoint.Y - lowPoint.Y;
			num = ((num == 0.0) ? double.Epsilon : num);
			Rect3D modelBounds = new Rect3D(lowPoint.X, flag ? highPoint.Y : lowPoint.Y, lowPoint.Z, barWidth, Math.Abs(num), barDepth);
			XYSeriesLabel3DLayout labelLayout = new XYSeriesLabel3DLayout(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, BarSeries3DData.CalcSeriesLabelPoint(modelBounds, flag), new Vector3D(0.0, (!flag) ? 1 : (-1), 0.0));
			return new XYSeriesModel3DInfo(pointInfo.SeriesPoint, null, labelLayout);
		}

		protected override Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			XYZChartBox xyzChartBox = (XYZChartBox)domain.DiagramBox;
			return CreateModelInfo(GetLowPoint(refinedPoint, xyzChartBox), GetHighPoint(refinedPoint, xyzChartBox), barDrawingSize.Width, barDrawingSize.Height, refinedPoint);
		}
	}
	public abstract class MarkerSeries3DLabelData : Series3DLabelData
	{
		public MarkerSeries3DLabelData(ISeriesLabelDataProvider seriesLabelDataProvider)
			: base(seriesLabelDataProvider)
		{
		}

		private XYSeriesLabel3DLayout CreateLabelLayout(Rect3D bounds)
		{
			if (!base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.LabelsVisibility)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Point3D point3D = MathUtils.CalcCenter(bounds);
			switch (Marker3DSeriesView.GetLabelPosition(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel))
			{
			case Marker3DLabelPosition.Top:
				return new Marker3DLabelLayout(point: new Point3D(point3D.X, point3D.Y + bounds.SizeY * 0.75, point3D.Z), label: base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, connectorPoint: point3D, direction: new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), bounds: bounds);
			case Marker3DLabelPosition.Center:
				return new Marker3DLabelLayout(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, point3D, point3D, default(Vector3D), bounds);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Marker3DLabelPosition value.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected abstract Size3D CalculateMarkerSize(XYZChartBox xyzChartBox, RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		protected override Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			SeriesPoint3D seriesPoint = SeriesPoint3D.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XYZChartBox xYZChartBox = (XYZChartBox)domain.DiagramBox;
			Point3D diagramPoint = xYZChartBox.GetDiagramPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, refinedPoint.ArgumentY, ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value);
			Size3D size = CalculateMarkerSize(xYZChartBox, refinedPoint);
			diagramPoint.Offset(size.X * -0.5, size.Y * -0.5, size.Z * -0.5);
			Rect3D bounds = new Rect3D(diagramPoint, size);
			return new XYSeriesModel3DInfo(seriesPoint, null, CreateLabelLayout(bounds));
		}
	}
