	public class LightSeriesPoint3D : ISeriesPoint, ISeriesPointValues, IDataPoint
	{
		private readonly SeriesPointArgumentXContainer argumentX;

		private readonly SeriesPointArgumentYContainer argumentY;

		private readonly double[] values;

		private readonly object colorKey;

		private readonly object hint;

		private readonly object tag;

		private readonly Series3DBase series;

		public object Tag => tag;

		public object ColorKey => colorKey;

		public Series3DBase Series => series;

		ISeries ISeriesPoint.Owner => Series as ISeries;

		ISeriesPointArgument ISeriesPoint.ArgumentX => argumentX;

		ISeriesPointArgument ISeriesPoint.ArgumentY => argumentY;

		IIndicatorDataPoint ISeriesPoint.IndicatorPoint => null;

		object ISeriesPoint.ToolTipHint
		{
			get
			{
				return hint;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		ISeriesPointValues ISeriesPoint.Values => this;

		DataContextBase ISeriesPoint.DataContext
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Series is ISeriesPointFactory { DataAdapter: not null } seriesPointFactory))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return seriesPointFactory.DataAdapter.DataContext;
			}
		}

		object ISeriesPoint.Tag => tag;

		int? ISeriesPoint.ColorCore => null;

		DateTime[] ISeriesPointValues.DateTimeValues => null;

		TimeSpan[] ISeriesPointValues.TimeSpanValues => null;

		double[] ISeriesPointValues.NumericalValues => values;

		int ISeriesPointValues.Dimension => values.Length;

		Scale ISeriesPointValues.ValueScaleType => Scale.Numerical;

		bool IDataPoint.IsEmpty => SeriesPoint3D.CheckEmpty(Scale.Numerical, values);

		double IDataPoint.NumericalValue => values[0];

		object IDataPoint.Argument => argumentX.ActualArgument;

		ISeriesPointArgument IDataPoint.ArgumentX => argumentX;

		public LightSeriesPoint3D(object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, object colorKey, object tag, object hint, Series3DBase series)
		{
			this.argumentX = new SeriesPointArgumentXContainer(this, argumentX);
			this.argumentY = new SeriesPointArgumentYContainer(this, argumentY);
			this.values = values ?? new double[1] { double.NaN };
			this.colorKey = colorKey;

	public abstract class ChartGeometrySegmentBase
	{
		private readonly List<System.Windows.Point> points;

		protected abstract bool ShouldOptimizePoints { get; }

		public List<System.Windows.Point> Points => points;

		protected ChartGeometrySegmentBase(List<System.Windows.Point> points, bool shouldRoundPoints)
		{
			this.points = (ShouldOptimizePoints ? OptimizePoints(points) : points);
			if (shouldRoundPoints)
			{
				RoundPoints(this.points);
			}
		}

		private bool SamePixels(double d1, double d2)
		{
			return Math.Floor(d1) == Math.Floor(d2);
		}

		private void AddPointToListConditional(List<System.Windows.Point> points, System.Windows.Point point, bool condition)
		{
			if (condition)
			{
				points.Add(point);
			}
		}

		private List<System.Windows.Point> OptimizePoints(List<System.Windows.Point> sourcePoints)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			int count = sourcePoints.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Point item = sourcePoints[i];
				double y = item.Y;
				double y2 = item.Y;
				System.Windows.Point item2 = default(System.Windows.Point);
				int num = i;
				int num2 = i;
				int num3 = i;
				for (int j = i + 1; j < count; j++)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = sourcePoints[j];
					if (!SamePixels(item.X, point.X))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (point.Y < y)
					{
						y = point.Y;
						num = j;
					}
					else if (point.Y > y2)
					{
						y2 = point.Y;
						num2 = j;
					}
					item2 = point;
					num3 = j;
				}
				list.Add(item);
				if (num3 != i)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(item.X, y);
					System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(item.X, y2);
					bool condition = num != i && num != num3;
					bool condition2 = num2 != i && num2 != num3;
					if (num < num2)
					{
						AddPointToListConditional(list, point2, condition);
						AddPointToListConditional(list, point3, condition2);
					}
					else
					{
						AddPointToListConditional(list, point3, condition2);
						AddPointToListConditional(list, point2, condition);
					}
					list.Add(item2);
					i = num3;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void RoundPoints(List<System.Windows.Point> points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = points[i];
				points[i] = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + 0.5, point.Y + 0.5);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void RenderCore(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext, List<System.Windows.Point> renderPoints, List<Geometry> additionalGeometries);

		protected abstract void RenderCoreFast(DrawingContext drawingContext, List<System.Windows.Point> renderPoints, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen);

		public void Render(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext, List<Geometry> additionalGeometries)
		{
			if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				RenderCore(geometryContext, points, additionalGeometries);
			}
		}

		public void RenderFast(DrawingContext drawingContext, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				RenderCoreFast(drawingContext, points, transform, pen);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartPolyLineSegment : ChartGeometrySegmentBase
	{
		protected override bool ShouldOptimizePoints => true;

		public ChartPolyLineSegment(List<System.Windows.Point> points, bool shouldRoundPoints)
			: base(points, shouldRoundPoints)
		{
		}

		private System.Windows.Point TransformPoint(System.Windows.Point point, Transform transform)
		{
			return transform.Transform(point);
		}

		private void DrawSimpleGeometry(DrawingContext drawingContext, List<System.Windows.Point> renderPoints, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			pen?.Freeze();
			if (renderPoints.Count > 1)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = renderPoints[0];
				for (int i = 1; i < renderPoints.Count; i++)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point2 = renderPoints[i];
					if (point.Y != point2.Y || i == renderPoints.Count - 1 || renderPoints[i + 1].Y != point2.Y)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
						point = point2;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Point point3 = renderPoints[0];
				double thickness = pen.Thickness;
				Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(point3.X - thickness / 2.0, point3.Y - thickness / 2.0, thickness, thickness)
				};
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, pen, geometry);
			}
		}

		private void DrawTransformedGeometry(DrawingContext drawingContext, List<System.Windows.Point> renderPoints, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = TransformPoint(renderPoints[0], transform);
			pen?.Freeze();
			if (renderPoints.Count > 1)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < renderPoints.Count; i++)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point2 = TransformPoint(renderPoints[i], transform);
					if (point.Y != point2.Y || i == renderPoints.Count - 1 || TransformPoint(renderPoints[i + 1], transform).Y != point2.Y)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
						point = point2;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
				double thickness = pen.Thickness;
				geometryGroup.Children.Add(new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(point.X - thickness / 2.0, point.Y - thickness / 2.0, thickness, thickness)
				});
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(null, pen, geometryGroup);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderCore(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext, List<System.Windows.Point> renderPoints, List<Geometry> additionalGeometries)
		{
			if (renderPoints.Count > 1)
			{
				geometryContext.PolyLineTo(renderPoints, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: false);
			}
			else
			{
				additionalGeometries.Add(new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(renderPoints[0], default(System.Windows.Size))));
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderCoreFast(DrawingContext drawingContext, List<System.Windows.Point> renderPoints, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			if (transform == null || transform.Value.IsIdentity)
			{
				DrawSimpleGeometry(drawingContext, renderPoints, pen);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawTransformedGeometry(drawingContext, renderPoints, transform, pen);
			}
		}
	}

		public ChartPolyBezierSegment(List<System.Windows.Point> points, bool shouldRoundPoints)

		{
		}
	}
	public class ChartGeometryFigure
	{
		private readonly List<ChartGeometrySegmentBase> segments = new List<ChartGeometrySegmentBase>();

		private bool isClosed;

		private bool isFilled;

		private System.Windows.Media.Color? color;

		private GeometryStripStyle style;

		public List<ChartGeometrySegmentBase> Segments => segments;

		public System.Windows.Point StartPoint { get; set; }

		public bool IsClosed
		{
			get
			{
				return isClosed;
			}
			set
			{
				isClosed = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsFilled
		{
			get
			{
				return isFilled;
			}
			set
			{
				isFilled = value;
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? Color => color;

		public bool IsEmptyPointStyle
		{
			get
			{
				if (style != null)
				{
					return style.IsEmptyPointStyle;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public GeometryStripStyle Style => style;

		public ChartGeometryFigure(GeometryStripStyle style)
			: this(isFilled: true, isClosed: false, style)
		{
		}

		public ChartGeometryFigure(bool isFilled, bool isClosed, GeometryStripStyle style = null)
		{
			this.isFilled = isFilled;
			this.isClosed = isClosed;
			if (style != null)
			{
				if (style.HasColor)
				{
					color = ColorUtils.ConvertFromArgb(style.Color.Value);
				}
				this.style = style;
			}
		}

		public void Render(StreamGeometryContext geometryContext, List<Geometry> additionalGeometries)
		{
			if (segments.Count > 0)
			{
				geometryContext.BeginFigure(StartPoint, IsFilled, IsClosed);
			}
			foreach (ChartGeometrySegmentBase segment in segments)
			{
				segment.Render(geometryContext, additionalGeometries);
			}
		}

		public void RenderFast(DrawingContext drawingContext, Transform transform, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			foreach (ChartGeometrySegmentBase segment in segments)
			{
				segment.RenderFast(drawingContext, transform, pen);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Funnel2DLabelCorrectionCalculator
	{
		private static double CalculateOffsetForColumnPosition(List<FunnelLabelInfo> labelInfos, int connectorLength)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < labelInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				FunnelLabelInfo funnelLabelInfo = labelInfos[i];
				num = Math.Max(num, funnelLabelInfo.LabelSize.Width + (double)connectorLength);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double CalculateOffsetForOutsidePosition(Rect viewport, AdditionalLengthCalculator lengthCalculator, List<FunnelLabelInfo> labelInfos, int connectorLength, bool alignToCenter, bool heightToWidthRatioAuto)
		{
			lengthCalculator.Calculate(labelInfos, connectorLength);
			if (alignToCenter || !heightToWidthRatioAuto)
			{
				return CalculateOffsetForAlignToCenterSeries(viewport, lengthCalculator, labelInfos, connectorLength);
			}
			return CalculateOffsetForStretchSeries(viewport, lengthCalculator, labelInfos, connectorLength);
		}

		private static double CalculateOffsetForStretchSeries(Rect viewport, AdditionalLengthCalculator additionalLengthCalculator, List<FunnelLabelInfo> labelInfos, int connectorLength)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < labelInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				FunnelLabelInfo funnelLabelInfo = labelInfos[i];
				double num2 = (0.5 + ((IFunnelPoint)funnelLabelInfo.RefinedPoint).NormalizedValue / 2.0) * viewport.Width;
				double num3 = funnelLabelInfo.LabelSize.Width + num2 + (double)connectorLength + (double)additionalLengthCalculator.GetLength(funnelLabelInfo.RefinedPoint);
				double num4 = (num3 - viewport.Width) * viewport.Width / num2;
				if (num3 > viewport.Width && num < num4)
				{
					num = num4;
				}
				if (num > viewport.Width)
				{
					num = viewport.Width;
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double CalculateOffsetForAlignToCenterSeries(Rect viewport, AdditionalLengthCalculator additionalLengthCalculator, List<FunnelLabelInfo> labelInfos, int connectorLength)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < labelInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				FunnelLabelInfo funnelLabelInfo = labelInfos[i];
				double num2 = viewport.Width / 2.0;
				double num3 = ((IFunnelPoint)funnelLabelInfo.RefinedPoint).NormalizedValue * num2;
				double num4 = num3 + funnelLabelInfo.LabelSize.Width + (double)connectorLength + (double)additionalLengthCalculator.GetLength(funnelLabelInfo.RefinedPoint);
				double num5 = (num4 - num2) / ((IFunnelPoint)funnelLabelInfo.RefinedPoint).NormalizedValue;
				if (num4 > num2 && num < num5)
				{
					num = num5;
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					num = num2;
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static Thickness CalculateMaxLabelPadding(Rect viewport, AdditionalLengthCalculator lengthCalculator, List<FunnelLabelInfo> labelInfos, int connectorLength, bool alignToCenter, bool heightToWidthRatioAuto, Funnel2DLabelPosition labelPosition)
		{
			double top = ((labelInfos.Count > 0) ? (labelInfos[0].LabelSize.Height / 2.0) : 0.0);
			if (labelPosition == Funnel2DLabelPosition.Center)
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((labelPosition != Funnel2DLabelPosition.Left && labelPosition != Funnel2DLabelPosition.Right) ? CalculateOffsetForColumnPosition(labelInfos, connectorLength) : CalculateOffsetForOutsidePosition(viewport, lengthCalculator, labelInfos, connectorLength, alignToCenter, heightToWidthRatioAuto));
			if (alignToCenter)
			{
				return new Thickness(num, top, num, 0.0);
			}
			if (labelPosition == Funnel2DLabelPosition.Left || labelPosition == Funnel2DLabelPosition.LeftColumn)
			{
				return new Thickness(num, top, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			return new Thickness(0.0, top, num, 0.0);
		}
	}
	internal class AdditionalLengthCalculator
	{
		private Dictionary<RefinedPoint, int> connectorAdditionalLengths;

		public AdditionalLengthCalculator()
		{
			connectorAdditionalLengths = new Dictionary<RefinedPoint, int>();
		}

		private void AddLength(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, int additionalConnectorLength)
		{
			if (connectorAdditionalLengths.ContainsKey(refinedPoint))
			{
				connectorAdditionalLengths[refinedPoint] = Math.Max(connectorAdditionalLengths[refinedPoint], additionalConnectorLength);
			}
			else
			{
				connectorAdditionalLengths[refinedPoint] = additionalConnectorLength;
			}
		}

		private int CalculateLength(int connectorLength, GRealPoint2D topPointOfPolygon, GRealPoint2D bottomPointOfPolygon, GRealSize2D labelSize, GRealPoint2D anchorLabelPoint, bool forTopPolygon)
		{
			int num = ((!forTopPolygon) ? 1 : (-1));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(anchorLabelPoint.X - (double)connectorLength, anchorLabelPoint.Y + (double)num * labelSize.Height / 2.0);
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D2 = Funnel2DLayoutCalculator.CalcIntersectionPoint(topPointOfPolygon, bottomPointOfPolygon, gRealPoint2D.Y);
			if (gRealPoint2D2.HasValue && gRealPoint2D2.Value.X < gRealPoint2D.X)
			{
				return (int)(gRealPoint2D.X - gRealPoint2D2.Value.X) + 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public void Calculate(List<FunnelLabelInfo> labelInfos, int connectorLength)
		{
			connectorAdditionalLengths.Clear();
			if (labelInfos == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < labelInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealSize2D labelSize = labelInfos[i].LabelSize;
				FunnelPointInfo pointInfo = labelInfos[i].PointInfo;
				int num = 0;
				if (i > 0)
				{
					FunnelPointInfo pointInfo2 = labelInfos[i - 1].PointInfo;
					num = CalculateLength(connectorLength, pointInfo2.TopLeftPoint, pointInfo2.BottomLeftPoint, labelSize, pointInfo.TopLeftPoint, forTopPolygon: true);
					AddLength(labelInfos[i].RefinedPoint, num);
				}
				num = CalculateLength(connectorLength, pointInfo.TopLeftPoint, pointInfo.BottomLeftPoint, labelSize, pointInfo.TopLeftPoint, forTopPolygon: false);
				AddLength(labelInfos[i].RefinedPoint, num);
			}
		}

		public int GetLength(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (connectorAdditionalLengths.ContainsKey(refinedPoint))
			{
				return connectorAdditionalLengths[refinedPoint];
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public static class SeriesWithMarkerHelper
	{
		private const int HighlightedSizeIncrement = 4;

		private const double SelectedSizeMultiplier = 1.5;

		private static Rect CalculateHighlightedBounds(Rect initialBounds)
		{
			return new Rect(initialBounds.X - 2.0, initialBounds.Y - 2.0, initialBounds.Width + 4.0, initialBounds.Height + 4.0);
		}

		public static Rect CalculateSelectedBounds(Rect initialBounds)
		{
			return new Rect(initialBounds.X - initialBounds.Width * 0.5 / 2.0, initialBounds.Y - initialBounds.Height * 0.5 / 2.0, initialBounds.Width * 1.5, initialBounds.Height * 1.5);
		}

		public static Rect CalcAnchorHole(System.Windows.Point anchor, double lineLength)
		{
			return new Rect(anchor.X - lineLength, anchor.Y - lineLength, lineLength * 2.0, lineLength * 2.0);
		}

		public static SeriesPointLayout CreateSeriesPointLayout(System.Windows.Size viewportSize, int markerSize, System.Windows.Point center)
		{
			int num = markerSize / 2;
			Rect viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, viewportSize.Width, viewportSize.Height);
			return new MarkerSeries2DPointLayout(viewport, new Rect(center.X - (double)num, center.Y - (double)num, markerSize, markerSize));
		}

		public static Matrix CreatePointTransform(Series series, Rect markerBounds, XYDiagram2D diagramXY)
		{
			if (!series.CanUseMarkerAdditionalGeometry && diagramXY.Rotated)
			{
				Matrix identity = Matrix.Identity;
				identity.ScaleAt(-1.0, 1.0, markerBounds.Width / 2.0, 0.0);
				identity.RotateAt(-90.0, markerBounds.Width / 2.0, markerBounds.Height / 2.0);
				return identity;
			}
			return Matrix.Identity;
		}

		public static void CompletePointLayout(SeriesPointItem pointItem, Diagram diagram, SeriesPointAnimationBase animation, bool isAxisXReversed, bool isAxisYReversed)
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagramXY = diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (diagramXY == null || pointItem.RefinedPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool selected = pointItem.IsSelected;
			PresentationItemRenderHelper.DoAction(pointItem, null, delegate(IPresentation layout)
			{
				if (layout is MarkerSeries2DPointLayout { InitialBounds: var rect } markerSeries2DPointLayout)
				{
					if (selected && VisualSelectionHelper.SupportsSizeSelection(pointItem.Series.SupportedSelectionType))
					{
						rect = CalculateSelectedBounds(rect);
					}
					if (pointItem.IsHighlighted && !selected)
					{
						rect = CalculateHighlightedBounds(rect);
					}
					if (animation is Marker2DAnimationBase marker2DAnimationBase)
					{
						double actualProgress = pointItem.PointProgress.ActualProgress;
						rect = marker2DAnimationBase.CreateAnimatedMarkerBounds(rect, markerSeries2DPointLayout.Viewport, isAxisXReversed, isAxisYReversed, diagramXY.Rotated, actualProgress);
					}
					Matrix transform = CreatePointTransform(pointItem.Series, rect, diagramXY);
					markerSeries2DPointLayout.Complete(rect, transform);
				}
			});
		}

		public static void FillMarkerAnimationKinds(List<AnimationKind> animationKinds)
		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DWidenAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromLeftAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromRightAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromTopAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromBottomAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromLeftCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromRightCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromTopCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromBottomCenterAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromLeftTopCornerAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromRightTopCornerAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromRightBottomCornerAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DSlideFromLeftBottomCornerAnimation)));
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Marker2DFadeInAnimation)));
		}

		{
			animationKinds.Add(new AnimationKind(typeof(Area2DGrowUpAnimation)));

		{
			SeriesBorder seriesBorder = new SeriesBorder();

	public static class RangeAreaSeriesHelper
	{
		public static double GetLabelAngle(IRangePoint rangePoint, RangeValueLevel valueLevel, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			if (valueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1)
			{
				if (!(rangePoint.Value1 >= rangePoint.Value2))
				{
					return minValue;
				}
				return maxValue;
			}
			if (!(rangePoint.Value1 >= rangePoint.Value2))
			{
				return maxValue;
			}
			return minValue;
		}

		public static RangeValueLevel GetValueLevelForLabel(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, RangeAreaLabelKind labelPosition)
		{
			switch (labelPosition)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel:
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
				return RangeValueLevel.Value2;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
				if (!(((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Value1 >= ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Value2))
				{
					return RangeValueLevel.Value2;
				}
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
				if (!(((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Value1 < ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Value2))
				{
					return RangeValueLevel.Value2;
				}
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown range area label kind.");
				return RangeValueLevel.Value1;
			}
		}

		public static string[] GetLabelsTexts(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, string labelTextPattern, string labelValueSeparator, Scale valueScaleType, RangeAreaLabelKind labelKind, IPatternHolder patternHolder)
		{
			PatternParser patternParser;
			switch (labelKind)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			{
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", "V1"), patternHolder);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, patternHolder);
				string text = patternParser.GetText();
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", "V2"), patternHolder);
				patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, patternHolder);
				string text2 = patternParser.GetText();
				return new string[2] { text, text2 };
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", "V1", "V2", labelValueSeparator), patternHolder);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", "V1"), patternHolder);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", "V2"), patternHolder);
				break;
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
			{
				string minValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMinValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, valueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", minValuePlaceholder), patternHolder);
				break;
			}
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
			{
				string maxValuePlaceholder = PatternUtils.GetMaxValuePlaceholder(refinedPoint, valueScaleType);
				patternParser = new PatternParser(PatternUtils.ReplacePlaceholder(labelTextPattern, "V", maxValuePlaceholder), patternHolder);
				break;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected RangeArea label kind.");
				return new string[0];
			}
			patternParser.SetContext(refinedPoint, patternHolder);
			return new string[1] { patternParser.GetText() };
		}
	}
	public struct DonutSegment
	{
		public System.Windows.Point Center { get; private set; }

		public System.Windows.Point RelativeCenter { get; private set; }

		public double InnerRadius { get; private set; }

		public double OuterRadius { get; private set; }

		public double StartAngleDeg { get; private set; }

		public double EndAngleDeg { get; private set; }

		public double ArcAngleDeg { get; private set; }

		public double MedianAngleDeg { get; private set; }

		public DonutSegment(System.Windows.Point center, System.Windows.Point relativeCenter, double innerRadius, double outerRadius, Slice startEndAnglesDeg, PieSweepDirection sweepDirection)
		{
			this = default(DonutSegment);
			if (innerRadius < 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Value must be greater than or equal to 0.", "innerRadius");
			}
			if (outerRadius < 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Value must be greater than or equal to 0.", "outerRadius");
			}
			Center = center;
			RelativeCenter = relativeCenter;
			InnerRadius = innerRadius;
			OuterRadius = outerRadius;
			if (sweepDirection == PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise)
			{
				StartAngleDeg = startEndAnglesDeg.StartAngle;
				EndAngleDeg = startEndAnglesDeg.FinishAngle;
			}
			else
			{
				StartAngleDeg = startEndAnglesDeg.FinishAngle;
				EndAngleDeg = startEndAnglesDeg.StartAngle;
			}
			ArcAngleDeg = Math.Abs(EndAngleDeg - StartAngleDeg);
			MedianAngleDeg = CalculateMedianAngle();
		}

		public DonutSegment(System.Windows.Point center, System.Windows.Point relativeCenter, double innerRadius, double outerRadius, double startAngleDeg, double endAngleDeg)
		{
			this = default(DonutSegment);
			if (innerRadius < 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Value must be greater than or equal to 0.", "innerRadius");
			}
			if (outerRadius < 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Value must be greater than or equal to 0.", "outerRadius");
			}
			Center = center;
			RelativeCenter = relativeCenter;
			InnerRadius = innerRadius;
			OuterRadius = outerRadius;
			StartAngleDeg = startAngleDeg;
			EndAngleDeg = endAngleDeg;
			ArcAngleDeg = Math.Abs(EndAngleDeg - StartAngleDeg);
			MedianAngleDeg = 0.5 * (StartAngleDeg + EndAngleDeg);
		}

		private double CalculateMedianAngle()
		{
			return 0.5 * (StartAngleDeg + EndAngleDeg);
		}

		public void RotateCCW(double angleDeg)
		{
			double num = EndAngleDeg - StartAngleDeg;
			StartAngleDeg = MathUtils.NormalizeDegree(StartAngleDeg - angleDeg);
			EndAngleDeg = StartAngleDeg + num;
			MedianAngleDeg = CalculateMedianAngle();
		}
	}
	public class NestedDonut2DGroup
	{
		private List<SeriesItem> items = new List<SeriesItem>();

		public SeriesItem this[int index] => items[index];

		public IEnumerable<SeriesLabelConnectorItem> LabelConnectorItems
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
				{
					SeriesLabel label = items[0].Series.ActualLabel;
					for (int j = 0; j < label.Items.Count; j++)
					{
						SeriesLabelConnectorItem connectorItem = label.Items[j].ConnectorItem;
						if (connectorItem != null)
						{
							yield return connectorItem;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<SeriesLabelItem> LabelItems
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
				{
					SeriesLabel label = items[i].Series.ActualLabel;
					for (int j = 0; j < label.Items.Count; j++)
					{
						yield return label.Items[j];
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<SeriesLabel> SeriesLabels
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
				{
					yield return items[i].Series.ActualLabel;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => items.Count;

		public NestedDonut2DGroup(SeriesItem item)
		{
			items.Add(item);
		}

		public void Add(SeriesItem item)
		{
			if (item.Series.GetType() != typeof(NestedDonutSeries2D))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Expected a SeriesItem which according to a NestedDonutSeries2D.");
			}
			items.Add(item);
		}
	}
	public class Slice
	{
		private readonly double startAngle;

		private readonly double finishAngle;

		public double StartAngle => startAngle;

		public double FinishAngle => finishAngle;

		public double MedianAngle => 0.5 * (startAngle + finishAngle);

		public bool IsEmpty { get; private set; }

		public Slice(double startAngle, double finishAngle, bool isEmpty)
		{
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.finishAngle = finishAngle;
			IsEmpty = isEmpty;
		}
	}
	public class Pie
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, Slice> pointSlices = new Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, Slice>();

		public Slice this[ISeriesPoint point]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!pointSlices.TryGetValue(point, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public Pie(IRefinedSeries series, PieSweepDirection sweepDirection)
			: this(series, sweepDirection, 360.0)
		{
		}

		public Pie(IRefinedSeries series, PieSweepDirection sweepDirection, double sweepAngle)
		{
			if (series.Points.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = ((sweepDirection != PieSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? 360 : 0);
				for (int i = 0; i < series.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					double normalizedValue = ((IPiePoint)series.Points[i]).NormalizedValue;
					double num2 = ((i != series.Points.Count - 1) ? ((sweepDirection == PieSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? (num + sweepAngle * normalizedValue) : (num - sweepAngle * normalizedValue)) : ((sweepDirection == PieSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? sweepAngle : (360.0 - sweepAngle)));
					pointSlices.Add(series.Points[i].SeriesPoint, new Slice(num, num2, normalizedValue == 0.0));
					num = num2;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Pie2DCalculator
	{
		public static Thickness CalculateMaxLabelAndAnnotationsPadding(Rect viewport, PieSeries2D series, SeriesLabel seriesLabel, bool obtainForAllAnnotation)
		{
			double maxLabelHeight = 0.0;
			double maxLabelWidth = 0.0;
			if (seriesLabel.Items != null)
			{
				GetMaxLabelWidthAndHeight(seriesLabel, ref maxLabelHeight, ref maxLabelWidth);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			if (series.Diagram.Annotations != null && series.Diagram.Annotations.Count > 0)
			{
				num = GetMaxAnnotationCorrection(viewport, series, obtainForAllAnnotation);
			}
			if (seriesLabel.Items == null || seriesLabel.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return new Thickness(num);
			}
			double num2 = Math.Min(0.5 * viewport.Width, 0.5 * viewport.Height);
			double num3 = num2 * series.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0;
			switch (PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(seriesLabel))
			{
			case PieLabelPosition.Outside:
			{
				maxLabelHeight += (double)seriesLabel.Indent;
				maxLabelWidth += (double)seriesLabel.Indent;
				double val = Math.Max(num2 + maxLabelWidth - viewport.Width / 2.0, num2 + maxLabelHeight - viewport.Height / 2.0);
				return new Thickness(Math.Max(val, num));
			}
			case PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns:
				maxLabelHeight = 0.5 * maxLabelHeight + (double)seriesLabel.Indent;
				maxLabelWidth += (double)seriesLabel.Indent;
				return new Thickness(maxLabelWidth, maxLabelHeight, maxLabelWidth, maxLabelHeight);
			case PieLabelPosition.Inside:
			{
				maxLabelHeight /= 2.0;
				maxLabelWidth /= 2.0;
				double num4 = (num2 - num3) / 2.0 + num3;
				double val = Math.Max(num4 + maxLabelWidth - viewport.Width / 2.0, num4 + maxLabelHeight - viewport.Height / 2.0);
				return new Thickness(Math.Max(val, num));
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown PieLabelPosition value.");
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
		}

		private static double GetMaxAnnotationCorrection(Rect viewport, PieSeries2D series, bool obtainAllAnnotations)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (series.Diagram.AnnotationsPanel != null)
			{
				series.Diagram.AnnotationsPanel.Measure(viewport.Size);
				series.Diagram.AnnotationsPanel.Arrange(viewport);
				foreach (Annotation annotation in series.Diagram.Annotations)
				{
					if (!annotation.ActualLabelMode || (!obtainAllAnnotations && !AnnotationHelper.IsSeriesContainsAnnotation(annotation, series)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					System.Windows.Shapes.Path annotationPath = annotation.AnnotationPath;
					if (annotationPath != null)
					{
						Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)annotationPath, (UIElement)series.Diagram);
						relativeElementRect.Size = annotation.GeometryBounds.Size;
						Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)series.Item.AllPointItems[0].PointItemPresentation, (UIElement)series.Diagram);
						if (relativeElementRect.Left < relativeElementRect2.Left)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, relativeElementRect2.Left - relativeElementRect.Left);
						}
						if (relativeElementRect.Right > relativeElementRect2.Right)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, relativeElementRect.Right - relativeElementRect2.Right);
						}
						if (relativeElementRect.Top < relativeElementRect2.Top)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, relativeElementRect2.Top - relativeElementRect.Top);
						}
						if (relativeElementRect.Bottom > relativeElementRect2.Bottom)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, relativeElementRect.Bottom - relativeElementRect2.Bottom);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void GetMaxLabelWidthAndHeight(SeriesLabel seriesLabel, ref double maxLabelHeight, ref double maxLabelWidth)
		{
			foreach (SeriesLabelItem item in seriesLabel.Items)
			{
				if (maxLabelHeight < item.LabelSize.Height)
				{
					maxLabelHeight = item.LabelSize.Height;
				}
				if (maxLabelWidth < item.LabelSize.Width)
				{
					maxLabelWidth = item.LabelSize.Width;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SliceInfo
	{

		public SliceInfo(Model3D model, Point3D maxBottom, Point3D maxTop)

			this.model = model;
			this.maxBottom = maxBottom;
			this.maxTop = maxTop;
		}
	}
	public sealed class Pie3DCalculator
	{
		private const int minPieSegmentation = 10;

		private const double maxHoleRadiusRatio = 0.993;

		private static int NormPieSegmentation(int segmentation)
		{
			if (segmentation >= 10)
			{
				return segmentation;
			}
			return 10;
		}

		private static List<double> CalcAngles(double minAngle, double maxAngle, double pieSegmentation)
		{
			double num = 360.0 / pieSegmentation;
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			for (double num2 = minAngle; num2 <= maxAngle; num2 += num)
			{
				list.Add(num2);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0 && list[list.Count - 1] != maxAngle)
			{
				list.Add(maxAngle);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void CalcNormals(MeshGeometry3D section)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < section.Positions.Count; i++)
			{
				Point3D p = section.Positions[(i == 0) ? (section.Positions.Count - 1) : (i - 1)];
				Point3D point3D = section.Positions[i];
				Point3D p2 = section.Positions[(i != section.Positions.Count - 1) ? (i + 1) : 0];
				Point3D p3 = MathUtils.Offset(point3D, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
				Vector3D vector3D = MathUtils.CalcNormal(p, point3D, p3);
				Vector3D vector3D2 = MathUtils.CalcNormal(point3D, p2, p3);
				Vector3D n = vector3D + vector3D2;
				MathUtils.Normalize(ref n);
				section.Normals.Add(n);
			}
		}

		private static MeshGeometry3D CalcSection(MeshGeometry3D section, double angle)
		{
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = section.CloneCurrentValue();
			Matrix3D matrix = CalcMatrix(angle);
			Graphics3DUtils.Transform(meshGeometry3D, matrix);
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		private static List<MeshGeometry3D> CalcSections(IList<double> samplingAngles, MeshGeometry3D section)
		{
			List<MeshGeometry3D> list = new List<MeshGeometry3D>();
			foreach (double samplingAngle in samplingAngles)
			{
				list.Add(CalcSection(section, samplingAngle));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static MeshGeometry3D CalcSurface(IList<MeshGeometry3D> sections)
		{
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			int count = sections[0].Positions.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j <= count; j++)
				{
					if (j < count)
					{
						meshGeometry3D.Positions.Add(sections[i].Positions[j]);
						meshGeometry3D.Normals.Add(sections[i].Normals[j]);
					}
					if (i > 0 && j > 0)
					{
						int value = j - 1 + (i - 1) * count;
						int value2 = ((j != count) ? j : 0) + (i - 1) * count;
						int value3 = ((j != count) ? j : 0) + i * count;
						int value4 = j - 1 + i * count;
						meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(value);
						meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(value3);
						meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(value2);
						meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(value);
						meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(value4);
						meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(value3);
					}
				}
			}
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		private static MeshGeometry3D CalcSidewalls(IList<MeshGeometry3D> sections, bool firstSidewall, bool lastSidewall)
		{
			if (!firstSidewall && !lastSidewall)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			if (lastSidewall)
			{
				Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, sections[sections.Count - 1].Positions);
				Graphics3DUtils.InvertTriangles(meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices);
			}
			if (firstSidewall)
			{
				Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, sections[0].Positions);
			}
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		private static Model3DGroup CalcModel(IList<MeshGeometry3D> sections, bool firstSidewall, bool lastSidewall, Material material)
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = CalcSurface(sections);
			if (meshGeometry3D != null)
			{
				GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D = new GeometryModel3D();
				geometryModel3D.Geometry = meshGeometry3D;
				geometryModel3D.Material = material;
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(geometryModel3D);
			}
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D2 = CalcSidewalls(sections, firstSidewall, lastSidewall);
			if (meshGeometry3D2 != null)
			{
				GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D2 = new GeometryModel3D();
				geometryModel3D2.Geometry = meshGeometry3D2;
				geometryModel3D2.Material = material;
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(geometryModel3D2);
			}
			return model3DGroup;
		}

		private static Pie3DLabelLayout CalcLabelLayout(SeriesLabel label, MeshGeometry3D section, double startAngle, double finishAngle)
		{
			Rect3D bounds = section.Bounds;
			Point3D point = new Point3D(bounds.Location.X + bounds.SizeX / 2.0, bounds.Location.Y, 0.0);
			Point3D point2 = new Point3D(bounds.Location.X + bounds.SizeX / 2.0, bounds.Location.Y + bounds.SizeY, 0.0);
			Matrix3D matrix3D = CalcMatrix(startAngle + (finishAngle - startAngle) / 2.0);
			return new Pie3DLabelLayout(label, GetMaxTop(section, startAngle, finishAngle), GetMaxBottom(section, startAngle, finishAngle), matrix3D.Transform(point2), matrix3D.Transform(point), matrix3D.Transform(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0)));
		}

		internal static Point3D GetMaxBottom(MeshGeometry3D section, double startAngle, double finishAngle)
		{
			Rect3D bounds = section.Bounds;
			Point3D point = new Point3D(bounds.Location.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Location.Y + bounds.SizeY / 2.0, 0.0);
			foreach (Point3D position in section.Positions)
			{
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(position.X, point.X, 0.0001) == 0 && position.Y < point.Y)
				{
					point = position;
				}
			}
			return CalcMatrix(startAngle + (finishAngle - startAngle) / 2.0).Transform(point);
		}

		internal static Point3D GetMaxTop(MeshGeometry3D section, double startAngle, double finishAngle)
		{
			Rect3D bounds = section.Bounds;
			Point3D point3D = new Point3D(bounds.Location.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Location.Y + bounds.SizeY / 2.0, 0.0);
			Point3D point = point3D;
			foreach (Point3D position in section.Positions)
			{
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(position.X, point3D.X, 0.0001) == 0 && position.Y >= point3D.Y && position.Y > point.Y)
				{
					point = position;
				}
			}
			return CalcMatrix(startAngle + (finishAngle - startAngle) / 2.0).Transform(point);
		}

		internal static GeometryModel3D CreateSectionModel(Pie3DModel model)
		{
			if (model == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Polyline polyline = model.GetPolyline();
			if (polyline == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (polyline.Points == null || polyline.Points.Count < 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			foreach (System.Windows.Point point in polyline.Points)
			{
				Point3D value = new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, 0.0);
				meshGeometry3D.Positions.Add(value);
			}
			double num = MathUtils.CalcArea(polyline.Points);
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				Graphics3DUtils.RevertPositions(meshGeometry3D.Positions);
			}
			GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D = new GeometryModel3D();
			MaterialGroup materialGroup = new MaterialGroup();
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new DiffuseMaterial());
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new SpecularMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 229, 229, 229)), 50.0));
			geometryModel3D.Material = materialGroup;
			geometryModel3D.Geometry = meshGeometry3D;
			return geometryModel3D;
		}

		internal static void Prepare(MeshGeometry3D section, double heightRatio, double radius, double holeRadiusRatio)
		{
			double num = radius * (1.0 - NormalizeHoleRadiusRatio(holeRadiusRatio));
			double num2 = num / section.Bounds.SizeX;
			Matrix3D matrix = Graphics3DUtils.CalcAlignByZeroMatrix(section.Bounds);
			matrix.Scale(new Vector3D(num2, heightRatio * num2, 1.0));
			matrix.Append(new Matrix3D
			{
				OffsetX = radius - num / 2.0
			});
			Graphics3DUtils.Transform(section, matrix);
		}

		internal static Matrix3D CalcMatrix(double angle)
		{
			Matrix3D result = default(Matrix3D);
			result.Rotate(new Quaternion(new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), angle));
			return result;
		}

		public static double NormalizeHoleRadiusRatio(double holeRadiusRatio)
		{
			if (!(holeRadiusRatio > 0.993))
			{
				return holeRadiusRatio;
			}
			return 0.993;
		}

		public static Model3D CalculateSlice(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain, SeriesLabel label, Pie3DModel model, double radius, double holeRadiusRatio, double heightRatio, double startAngle, double finishAngle, bool startSidewall, bool finishSidewall, int pieSegmentation, SolidColorBrush brush, out Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout)
		{
			labelLayout = null;
			pieSegmentation = NormPieSegmentation(pieSegmentation);
			double minAngle = Math.Min(startAngle, finishAngle);
			double maxAngle = Math.Max(startAngle, finishAngle);
			List<double> samplingAngles = CalcAngles(minAngle, maxAngle, pieSegmentation);
			GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D = CreateSectionModel(model);
			if (geometryModel3D == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MeshGeometry3D section = (MeshGeometry3D)geometryModel3D.Geometry;
			Prepare(section, heightRatio, radius, holeRadiusRatio);
			CalcNormals(section);
			List<MeshGeometry3D> sections = CalcSections(samplingAngles, section);
			if (startAngle > finishAngle)
			{
				bool flag = startSidewall;
				startSidewall = finishSidewall;
				finishSidewall = flag;
			}
			Graphics3DUtils.SetMaterialBrush(geometryModel3D.Material, brush, diffuseMaterialOnly: true);
			labelLayout = CalcLabelLayout(label, section, startAngle, finishAngle);
			return CalcModel(sections, startSidewall, finishSidewall, geometryModel3D.Material);
		}
	}
	public class PieSeries3DData : SeriesData
	{
		private Pie pie;

		private PieSeries3D PieSeries => (PieSeries3D)base.Series;

		public PieSeries3DData(PieSeries3D series)
			: base(series)
		{
			pie = new Pie(series.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(series), PieSweepDirection.Counterclockwise);
		}

		protected override PointGeometry CreateSeriesPointGeometry(Domain3DBase domain, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (!(domain is SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = CreateSeriesPointLabelContentPresenter(refinedPoint);
			return new Series3DPointGeometry(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, contentPresenter, Label3DHelper.CreateModel(contentPresenter, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel), CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(refinedPoint, domain2));
		}

		private Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			Slice slice = pie[refinedPoint.SeriesPoint];
			if (slice == null || slice.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double radius = domain.DiagramBox.Width / 2.0;
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout;
			Model3D model = Pie3DCalculator.CalculateSlice(domain, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, PieSeries.ActualModel, radius, PieSeries.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0, PieSeries.DepthTransform, slice.StartAngle, slice.FinishAngle, startSidewall: true, finishSidewall: true, 200, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetSeriesPointColorBrush(refinedPoint), out labelLayout);
			double angle = slice.StartAngle + (slice.FinishAngle - slice.StartAngle) / 2.0;
			double pointExplodeDistance = PieSeries.GetPointExplodeDistance(seriesPoint);
			return new PieModel3DInfo(seriesPoint, model, angle, radius, pointExplodeDistance, labelLayout);
		}

		public void Create3DContent(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			CreateModel(modelHolder, GetAdditionalTransform(domain), refinedSeries, domain);
			List<LabelModelContainer> list = new List<LabelModelContainer>();
			CreateLabelsModel(domain, modelHolder, list, refinedSeries);
			list.Sort(LabelModelContainer.CompareByDistance);
			foreach (LabelModelContainer item in list)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(item.Model);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<IPieLabelLayout> CreateLabelsVisual(Diagram3DDomain domain, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = null;
			Transform3D additionalTransform = GetAdditionalTransform(domain);
			List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty && GetPointGeometry(point, domain) is Series3DPointGeometry { ModelInfo: not null, ModelInfo: var modelInfo, LabelContentPresenter: var labelContentPresenter } series3DPointGeometry && modelInfo != null && labelContentPresenter != null && series3DPointGeometry.IsLabelPresent && modelInfo.LabelLayout is Pie3DLabelLayout pie3DLabelLayout)
				{
					pie3DLabelLayout.ContentPresenter = labelContentPresenter;
					CalculateLabelLayout(pie3DLabelLayout, domain, additionalTransform, labelContentPresenter);
					pie3DLabelLayout.LabelConnectorColor = base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetPointLabelColor(point);
					pie3DLabelLayout.CompleteLayout(domain as SimpleDiagram3DDomain);
					pie3DLabelLayout.ApplyRefinedPoint(point);
					list.Add(pie3DLabelLayout);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0 && ((Pie3DLabelLayout)list[0]).Position == PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns && PieSeries.LabelsResolveOverlapping)
			{
				SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping.ArrangeByColumn(list, new GRealRect2D(0.0, 0.0, domain.Viewport.Width, domain.Viewport.Height), PieSeries.LabelsResolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override Point3D CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointCache pointCache, Diagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			Point3D result = default(Point3D);
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(((ISeriesPointData)pointCache).SeriesPoint);
			Series3DPointGeometry series3DPointGeometry = pointCache.PointGeometry as Series3DPointGeometry;
			if (seriesPoint != null && series3DPointGeometry != null)
			{
				Slice slice = pie[seriesPoint];
				double startAngle = slice.StartAngle;
				double finishAngle = slice.FinishAngle;
				GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D = Pie3DCalculator.CreateSectionModel(PieSeries.ActualModel);
				if (geometryModel3D != null && !slice.IsEmpty)
				{
					MeshGeometry3D section = (MeshGeometry3D)geometryModel3D.Geometry;
					double radius = domain.DiagramBox.Width / 2.0;
					double depthTransform = PieSeries.DepthTransform;
					double holeRadiusRatio = PieSeries.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0;
					Pie3DCalculator.Prepare(section, depthTransform, radius, holeRadiusRatio);
					result = (((SimpleDiagram3DDomain)domain).IsTopVisible ? Pie3DCalculator.GetMaxTop(section, startAngle, finishAngle) : Pie3DCalculator.GetMaxBottom(section, startAngle, finishAngle));
					Transform3D transform = series3DPointGeometry.ModelInfo.Model.Transform;
					return transform.Transform(result);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetMaxSize(Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout, ContentPresenter labelPresenter)
		{
			if (labelLayout.Position == PieLabelPosition.Outside || labelLayout.Position == PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns)
			{
				return labelPresenter.DesiredSize;
			}
			return default(System.Windows.Size);
		}

		private Transform3D GetAdditionalTransform(Diagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			double maxExplodedDistance = ((PieSeries)base.Series).GetMaxExplodedDistance();
			double num = 1.0 / (1.0 + maxExplodedDistance);
			double num2 = ((domain.DiagramBox.Width > 0.0) ? (1.0 - 2.0 * GetMaxLabelSize(domain, PieSeries.Diagram.Annotations) / domain.DiagramBox.Width) : 0.0);
			num2 = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.001);
			double num3 = num * num2;
			if (num3 != 1.0)
			{
				return new ScaleTransform3D(num3, num3, num3);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void CreateModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder, Transform3D commonTransform, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, Diagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty && GetPointGeometry(point, domain) is Series3DPointGeometry { ModelInfo: not null } series3DPointGeometry)
				{
					series3DPointGeometry.ModelInfo.UpdateTransform(commonTransform);
					Model3D model = series3DPointGeometry.ModelInfo.Model;
					if (model != null)
					{
						Chart3DControl.SetSeriesPointHitTestInfo(model, point);
						modelHolder.Children.Add(model);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateLabelsModel(Diagram3DDomain domain, Model3DGroup modelHolder, List<LabelModelContainer> transparentLabelContainers, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty && GetPointGeometry(point, domain) is Series3DPointGeometry { ModelInfo: { LabelLayout: not null } modelInfo, IsLabelPresent: not false } series3DPointGeometry)
				{
					list.Add(modelInfo.LabelLayout as IPieLabelLayout);
					LabelModelContainer labelModelContainer = modelInfo.LabelLayout.CreateModel(domain, series3DPointGeometry, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetPointLabelColor(point), modelHolder);
					if (labelModelContainer != null)
					{
						Chart3DControl.SetSeriesPointLabelHitTestInfo(labelModelContainer.Model, point, base.Series, modelInfo.LabelLayout.Label);
						transparentLabelContainers.Add(labelModelContainer);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateLabelLayout(Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout, Diagram3DDomain domain, Transform3D additionalTransform, ContentPresenter labelPresenter)
		{
			SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain2 = domain as SimpleDiagram3DDomain;
			switch (labelLayout.Position)
			{
			case PieLabelPosition.Inside:
				CalculateLabelsInsidePosition(labelLayout, domain2, labelPresenter);
				break;
			case PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns:
				CalculateLabelsTwoColumnsPosition(labelLayout, domain2, additionalTransform, labelPresenter);
				break;
			case PieLabelPosition.Outside:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CalculateLabelsInsidePosition(Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout, SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain, ContentPresenter presenter)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Point3D dockPoint = labelLayout.GetDockPoint(domain);
			System.Windows.Point location = domain.Project(dockPoint);
			location.Offset((0.0 - presenter.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0, (0.0 - presenter.DesiredSize.Height) / 2.0);
			labelLayout.LabelBounds = ConvertRectToDxRect(new Rect(location, presenter.DesiredSize));
		}

		private DXRectangle ConvertRectToDxRect(Rect rect)
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new DXRectangle(MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Left), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Top), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Width), MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Height));
		}

		private void CalculateLabelsTwoColumnsPosition(Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout, SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain, Transform3D additionalTransform, ContentPresenter presenter)
		{
			//IL_01b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Point labelPoint2D = labelLayout.GetLabelPoint2D(domain);
			Vector direction2D = labelLayout.GetDirection2D(domain);
			Point3D point = domain.BackwardRotationOnlyTransform.Transform(additionalTransform.Transform(new Point3D(domain.ViewRadius, 0.0, 0.0)));
			System.Windows.Point point2 = domain.Project(point);
			Point3D point3 = domain.BackwardRotationOnlyTransform.Transform(additionalTransform.Transform(new Point3D(0.0 - domain.ViewRadius, 0.0, 0.0)));
			System.Windows.Point point4 = domain.Project(point3);
			point4.X -= labelLayout.LabelIndent;
			point2.X += labelLayout.LabelIndent;
			System.Windows.Point point5 = System.Windows.Point.Add(labelPoint2D, direction2D * labelLayout.LabelIndent);
			System.Windows.Point point6 = new System.Windows.Point
			{
				Y = point5.Y
			};
			if (direction2D.X < 0.0)
			{
				point6.X = CalculateConnectorPointXCoordInLeftColumn(point4.X, presenter.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				point6.X = CalculateConnectorPointXCoordInRightColumn(point2.X, domain.Viewport.Width, presenter.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			System.Windows.Point location = new System.Windows.Point(point6.X, point6.Y - 0.5 * presenter.DesiredSize.Height);
			location.X = ((direction2D.X < 0.0) ? (location.X - presenter.DesiredSize.Width) : location.X);
			labelLayout.LabelBounds = ConvertRectToDxRect(new Rect(location, presenter.DesiredSize));
		}

		private double CalculateConnectorPointXCoordInLeftColumn(double outermostLeftPointXCoord, double labelWidth)
		{
			if (!(0.0 + labelWidth < outermostLeftPointXCoord))
			{
				return outermostLeftPointXCoord;
			}
			return 0.0 + labelWidth;
		}

		private double CalculateConnectorPointXCoordInRightColumn(double outermostRightPointXCoord, double rightBoundXCoord, double labelWidth)
		{
			if (!(rightBoundXCoord - labelWidth > outermostRightPointXCoord))
			{
				return outermostRightPointXCoord;
			}
			return rightBoundXCoord - labelWidth;
		}

		private double GetMaxLabelSize(Diagram3DDomain domain, ObservableCollection<Annotation> annotations)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = default(System.Windows.Size);
			Transform3D transform3D = domain.CreateScaleTransform(default(Point3D));
			foreach (SeriesPointCache item in (IEnumerable<SeriesPointCache>)base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesCache)
			{
				if (item.PointGeometry is Series3DPointGeometry { LabelContentPresenter: var labelContentPresenter, ModelInfo: var modelInfo } && labelContentPresenter != null && modelInfo != null && modelInfo.LabelLayout is Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout)
				{
					System.Windows.Size maxSize = GetMaxSize(labelLayout, labelContentPresenter);
					size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, maxSize.Width);
					size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, maxSize.Height);
				}
			}
			if (DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel) == PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns)
			{
				size.Height = (double)base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel.Indent + size.Height * 0.5;
				Point3D point = domain.BackwardRotationOnlyTransform.Transform(new Point3D(domain.ViewRadius, 0.0, 0.0));
				double num = domain.ProjectWithoutZoomAndScroll(point).X + size.Width + (double)base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel.Indent;
				double num2 = num - domain.Viewport.Width;
				size.Width = ((num2 > 0.0) ? num2 : 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				size.Height += base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel.Indent;
				size.Width += base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel.Indent;
			}
			if (annotations != null && annotations.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (Annotation annotation in annotations)
				{
					SeriesPoint seriesPoint = ((SeriesPointAnchorPoint)annotation.AnchorPoint).SeriesPoint;
					if (annotation.ActualLabelMode && seriesPoint != null && seriesPoint.Series == base.Series)
					{
						Rect geometryBounds = annotation.GeometryBounds;
						size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, geometryBounds.Width);
						size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, geometryBounds.Height);
					}
				}
			}
			Rect3D rect = new Rect3D(default(Point3D), new Size3D(size.Width, size.Height, 0.0));
			rect = transform3D.TransformBounds(rect);
			return Math.Max(rect.SizeX, rect.SizeY);
		}
	}
	public class ToolTipHitInfo
	{
		private const double seriesRelativePositionOffsetX = 0.5;

		private const double seriesRelativePositionOffsetY = 0.5;

		private const double touchTargetSize = 10.0;

		private readonly bool calculateForSeries;

		private readonly bool touchUses;

		private readonly ChartControl chart;

		private readonly Diagram diagram;

		private readonly System.Windows.Point point;

		private IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint;

		private SeriesPoint seriesPoint;

		private RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

		private Series series;

		private BreadcrumbItem breadcrumbItem;

		private IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement;

		private bool inElement;

		private bool inLegend;

		private bool inLabel;

		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint => seriesPoint;

		public RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => refinedPoint;

		public Series Series => series;

		public System.Windows.Point ToolTipPoint => GetToolTipPoint();

		public BreadcrumbItem BreadcrumbItem => breadcrumbItem;

		internal ToolTipHitInfo(ChartControl chart, System.Windows.Point point, bool calculateForSeries, bool touchUses, bool breadcrumbHitTesting = false)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			this.point = point;
			this.touchUses = touchUses;
			this.calculateForSeries = calculateForSeries;
			diagram = this.chart.Diagram;
			if (chart != null && diagram != null && chart.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				PerformHitTesting(breadcrumbHitTesting);
			}
		}

		private void PerformHitTesting(bool breadcrumbHitTesting)
		{
			if (breadcrumbHitTesting)
			{
				ChartBreadcrumbControl element = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType<ChartBreadcrumbControl>((FrameworkElement)chart, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null);
				Diagram diagram = chart.Diagram;
				if (diagram != null && diagram.IsDrillDownEnabled && PerformElementHitTesting(element))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			foreach (Annotation annotation in chart.Annotations)
			{
				if (annotation.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && PerformElementHitTesting(annotation))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			foreach (Legend legend in chart.Legends)
			{
				if (legend.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && PerformElementHitTesting(legend))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			PerformDiagramHitTesting();
		}

		private void PerformDiagram2DHitTesting()
		{
			if (chart.Diagram is SimpleDiagram2D || chart.Diagram is CircularDiagram2D)
			{
				PerformElementHitTesting(chart.Diagram);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Pane actualPane in xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes)
				{
					if (PerformElementHitTesting(actualPane))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private IPlatformSeriesPoint GetPlatformPoint(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
		}

		private SeriesPoint GetSeriesPoint(IPlatformSeriesPoint platformPoint)
		{
			if (platformPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(platformPoint);
		}

		private Rect GetTouchRect(System.Windows.Point elementPoint)
		{
			double num = 5.0;
			return new Rect(elementPoint.X - num, elementPoint.Y - num, 10.0, 10.0);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetToolTipPoint()
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			if (inLegend)
			{
				if (hitTestableElement is LegendItemContainer legendItemContainer)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)legendItemContainer, "PART_MarkerPath");
					if (frameworkElement != null)
					{
						Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)frameworkElement, (UIElement)chart);
						result = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.Left + relativeElementRect.Width * 0.5, relativeElementRect.Top + relativeElementRect.Height * 0.5);
					}
					else
					{
						Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)legendItemContainer, (UIElement)chart);
						result = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect2.Left + relativeElementRect2.Width * 0.5, relativeElementRect2.Top + relativeElementRect2.Height * 0.5);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (platformSeriesPoint != null)
				{
					return GetSeriesPointToolTipLocation();
				}
				if (series != null)
				{
					return point;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPoint2DLocation()
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			SeriesPointItem pointItem = GetPointItem();
			if (pointItem != null)
			{
				if (series is PieSeries2D)
				{
					return ((PieSeries2D)series).CalculateToolTipPoint(pointItem);
				}
				if (series is XYSeries)
				{
					return ((XYSeries)series).CalculateToolTipPoint(pointItem, inLabel);
				}
				if (series is FunnelSeries2D)
				{
					return ((FunnelSeries2D)series).CalculateToolTipPoint(pointItem);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SeriesPointItem GetPointItem()
		{
			if (!(hitTestableElement is IToolTipPointDataProvider toolTipPointDataProvider))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return toolTipPointDataProvider.PointItem;
		}

		private void PerformHitTesting3D()
		{
			ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = chart.CalcHitInfo(point);
			series = chartHitInfo.Series;
			refinedPoint = chartHitInfo.RefinedPoint;
			platformSeriesPoint = GetPlatformPoint(refinedPoint);
			seriesPoint = GetSeriesPoint(platformSeriesPoint);
			if (platformSeriesPoint != null && series == null)
			{
				series = platformSeriesPoint.Owner as Series;
			}
		}

		private HitTestResultBehavior OnElementHitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
		{
			inElement = true;
			hitTestableElement = HitTestingHelper.GetParentHitTestableElement(result.VisualHit);
			HitTestResultBehavior result2 = HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			if (hitTestableElement is BreadcrumbItemPresentation breadcrumbItemPresentation)
			{
				result2 = HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
				breadcrumbItem = breadcrumbItemPresentation.BreadcrumbItem;
			}
			else if (hitTestableElement != null)
			{
				HitTestingHelper.ProcessHitTestableElement(hitTestableElement, point);
				inLegend = hitTestableElement is LegendItemContainer;
				inLabel = hitTestableElement is SeriesLabelPresentation || hitTestableElement is SeriesLabelConnectorPresentation;
				series = hitTestableElement.Element as Series;
				refinedPoint = ((hitTestableElement.AdditionalElement is RefinedPoint) ? ((RefinedPoint)hitTestableElement.AdditionalElement) : (hitTestableElement.Element as RefinedPoint));
				platformSeriesPoint = GetPlatformPoint(refinedPoint);
				seriesPoint = GetSeriesPoint(platformSeriesPoint);
				if (platformSeriesPoint != null || (calculateForSeries && series != null))
				{
					result2 = HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
				}
				if (platformSeriesPoint != null && series == null)
				{
					series = platformSeriesPoint.Owner as Series;
				}
			}
			return result2;
		}

		private bool PerformElementHitTesting(UIElement element)
		{
			inElement = false;
			if (element != null && chart.FindCommonVisualAncestor(element) != null)
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(element, (UIElement)chart);
				System.Windows.Point elementPoint = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - relativeElementRect.Left, point.Y - relativeElementRect.Top);
				HitTestParameters hitTestParameters;
				if (touchUses)
				{
					Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(GetTouchRect(elementPoint));
					hitTestParameters = new ChartGeometryHitTestParameters(geometry);
				}
				else
				{
					hitTestParameters = new ChartPointHitTestParameters(elementPoint);
				}
				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(element, null, OnElementHitTestResult, hitTestParameters);
			}
			return inElement;
		}

		private void PerformDiagramHitTesting()
		{
			if (diagram is Diagram3D)
			{
				PerformHitTesting3D();
			}
			else
			{
				PerformDiagram2DHitTesting();
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetSeriesPointToolTipLocation()
		{
			if (diagram is Diagram3D)
			{
				return GetPoint3DLocation();
			}
			return GetPoint2DLocation();
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPoint3DLocation()
		{
			System.Windows.Point result = default(System.Windows.Point);
			series = platformSeriesPoint.Owner as Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				if (series is PieSeries3D)
				{
					return ((PieSeries3D)series).CalculateToolTipPoint(platformSeriesPoint);
				}
				return ((XYSeries3D)series).CalculateToolTipPoint(platformSeriesPoint);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class ChartPointHitTestParameters : PointHitTestParameters
	{
		public ChartPointHitTestParameters(System.Windows.Point point)
			: base(point)
		{
		}
	}
	public class ChartGeometryHitTestParameters : GeometryHitTestParameters
	{
		public ChartGeometryHitTestParameters(Geometry geometry)
			: base(geometry)
		{
		}
	}
	public class ToolTipLayout : IAnnotationLayout
	{
		private readonly GRealPoint2D anchorPoint;

		private readonly double additionalOffset;

		private AnnotationLocation location;

		private GRealSize2D size;

		private GRealRect2D bounds;

		private GRealPoint2D offset;

		private GRealPoint2D initOffset;

		private bool showBeak;

		GRealPoint2D IAnnotationLayout.AnchorPoint => anchorPoint;

		GRealRect2D IAnnotationLayout.Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			set
			{
				bounds = value;
			}
		}

		AnnotationLocation IAnnotationLayout.Location
		{
			get
			{
				return location;
			}
			set
			{
				location = value;
			}
		}

		double IAnnotationLayout.CursorOffset => additionalOffset;

		GRealPoint2D IAnnotationLayout.InitOffset => initOffset;

		GRealPoint2D IAnnotationLayout.Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				offset = value;
			}
		}

		bool IAnnotationLayout.ShowTail => showBeak;

		public System.Windows.Point Position => new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);

		public GRealSize2D Size
		{
			get
			{
				return size;
			}
			set
			{
				size = value;
			}
		}

		public ToolTipLayout(System.Windows.Point position, System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			location = AnnotationLocation.TopRight;
			anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(position.X, position.Y);
			additionalOffset = 0.0;
			initOffset = new GRealPoint2D(offset.X, offset.Y);
			this.size = new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height);
			bounds = new GRealRect2D(anchorPoint.X, anchorPoint.Y, size.Width, size.Height);
			showBeak = false;
		}

		public ToolTipLayout(ToolTipLocation location, System.Windows.Point position, System.Windows.Size size, bool showBeak, System.Windows.Point offset, double additionalOffset)
		{
			this.location = (AnnotationLocation)location;
			anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(position.X, position.Y);
			initOffset = new GRealPoint2D(offset.X, offset.Y);
			this.additionalOffset = additionalOffset;
			this.size = new GRealSize2D(size.Width, size.Height);
			bounds = GRealRect2D.Empty;
			this.showBeak = showBeak;
		}
	}
	public class ToolTipLayoutCalculator
	{
		private ToolTipControl toolTipControl;

		internal static double CursorOffset => 20.0;

		private ToolTipItem ToolTipItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolTipControl == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return toolTipControl.ToolTipItem;
			}
		}

		private bool ShowBeak => ToolTipItem.BeakVisibility == Visibility.Visible;

		public ToolTipLayoutCalculator(ToolTipControl toolTipControl)
		{
			this.toolTipControl = toolTipControl;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CalculateLocalScreenPosition(System.Windows.Point controlAnchorPosition)
		{
			if (toolTipControl.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				controlAnchorPosition = new System.Windows.Point(toolTipControl.ActualWidth - controlAnchorPosition.X, controlAnchorPosition.Y);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(toolTipControl);
			if (toolTipControl.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				point = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - toolTipControl.ActualWidth, point.Y);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X + controlAnchorPosition.X, point.Y + controlAnchorPosition.Y);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CalculateScreenAnchorPosition(System.Windows.Point controlAnchorPosition)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = CalculateLocalScreenPosition(controlAnchorPosition);
			System.Windows.Point result = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - 16.0, point.Y - 16.0);
			Rect focusedScreenRect = ChartScreenHelper.GetFocusedScreenRect(point, toolTipControl);
			result.X = Math.Max(result.X, focusedScreenRect.Left);
			return result;
		}

		private ToolTipLayout CorrectToolTipLayout(ToolTipLayout initialLayout)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			if (toolTipControl.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				System.Windows.Size toolTipContentSize = toolTipControl.GetToolTipContentSize();
				point = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + toolTipContentSize.Width + ((IAnnotationLayout)initialLayout).Offset.X * 2.0, point.Y);
			}
			((IAnnotationLayout)initialLayout).Bounds = new GRealRect2D(((IAnnotationLayout)initialLayout).Bounds.Left + 16.0 + point.X, ((IAnnotationLayout)initialLayout).Bounds.Top + 16.0 + point.Y, ((IAnnotationLayout)initialLayout).Bounds.Width, ((IAnnotationLayout)initialLayout).Bounds.Height);
			return initialLayout;
		}

		private GRealRect2D CalculateBoundsForFreePosition(System.Windows.Size boundsSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = ChartScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(toolTipControl);
			if (toolTipControl.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				point2 = new System.Windows.Point(point2.X - toolTipControl.ActualWidth, point2.Y);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(point2.X + point.X, point2.Y + point.Y);
			Rect focusedScreenRect = ChartScreenHelper.GetFocusedScreenRect(point3, toolTipControl);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(point3.X - 16.0, point3.Y - 16.0);
			point.X = Math.Max(point.X, focusedScreenRect.Left);
			point.Y = Math.Max(point.Y, focusedScreenRect.Top);
			return new GRealRect2D(point.X, point.Y, boundsSize.Width, boundsSize.Height);
		}

		private ToolTipLayout CalculateLayoutForFreePosition(DockCorner location, Rect layoutRect, System.Windows.Size boundsSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Point controlAnchorPosition = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Windows.Size toolTipContentSize = toolTipControl.GetToolTipContentSize();
			switch (location)
			{
			case DockCorner.TopRight:
			case DockCorner.BottomRight:
				controlAnchorPosition.X = layoutRect.Right;
				break;
			case DockCorner.TopLeft:
			case DockCorner.BottomLeft:
				controlAnchorPosition.X = layoutRect.Left;
				break;
			}
			switch (location)
			{
			case DockCorner.TopRight:
			case DockCorner.TopLeft:
				controlAnchorPosition.Y = layoutRect.Top;
				break;
			case DockCorner.BottomRight:
			case DockCorner.BottomLeft:
				controlAnchorPosition.Y = layoutRect.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = CalculateScreenAnchorPosition(controlAnchorPosition);
			AnnotationLocation defaultLocation = AnnotationLocation.BottomRight;
			switch (location)
			{
			case DockCorner.TopLeft:
				defaultLocation = AnnotationLocation.BottomRight;
				break;
			case DockCorner.TopRight:
				defaultLocation = AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft;
				break;
			case DockCorner.BottomLeft:
				defaultLocation = AnnotationLocation.TopRight;
				break;
			case DockCorner.BottomRight:
				defaultLocation = AnnotationLocation.TopLeft;
				break;
			}
			ToolTipLayout toolTipLayout = new ToolTipLayout(position, toolTipContentSize, ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition.Offset);
			AnnotationLayoutCalculator.CalculateAutoLayout(toolTipLayout, defaultLocation, CalculateBoundsForFreePosition(boundsSize));
			return CorrectToolTipLayout(toolTipLayout);
		}

		public ToolTipLayout CalculatePointLayout(Rect bounds)
		{
			ToolTipLocation toolTipLocation = ToolTipLocation.TopRight;
			if (ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipPositionWithLocation)
			{
				toolTipLocation = ((ToolTipPositionWithLocation)ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition).Location;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = toolTipControl.ToolTipItem.Position;
			System.Windows.Point position2 = CalculateScreenAnchorPosition(position);
			System.Windows.Size toolTipContentSize = toolTipControl.GetToolTipContentSize();
			System.Windows.Point offset = (ShowBeak ? new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0) : ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition.Offset);
			double additionalOffset = ((!ShowBeak && ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipMousePosition) ? CursorOffset : 0.0);
			ToolTipLayout toolTipLayout = new ToolTipLayout(toolTipLocation, position2, toolTipContentSize, ShowBeak, offset, additionalOffset);
			AnnotationLayoutCalculator.CalculateAutoLayout(toolTipLayout, (AnnotationLocation)toolTipLocation, new GRealRect2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, bounds.Width - 16.0, bounds.Height - 16.0));
			return CorrectToolTipLayout(toolTipLayout);
		}

		public ToolTipLayout CalculateFreeLayout(Rect layoutRect, System.Windows.Size boundsSize)
		{
			ToolTipFreePosition toolTipFreePosition = (ToolTipFreePosition)ToolTipItem.ToolTipPosition;
			return CalculateLayoutForFreePosition(toolTipFreePosition.DockCorner, layoutRect, boundsSize);
		}
	}

	public interface IHitTestResult
	{
		HitInfoBase CreateHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius);
	}
	public class HitTestResult3D : IHitTestResult
	{
		private readonly RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult;

		public HitTestResult3D(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult)
		{
			this.ray3DResult = ray3DResult;
		}

		public HitInfoBase CreateHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesPointHitTestInfoProperty) as RefinedPoint;
			SeriesLabel seriesLabel = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesPointLabelHitTestInfoProperty) as SeriesLabel;
			Series series = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesHitTestInfoProperty) as Series;
			Axis3D axis3D = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.Axis3DHitTestInfoProperty) as Axis3D;
			Diagram3D diagram3D = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControl.Diagram3DHitTestInfoProperty) as Diagram3D;
			if (seriesLabel != null)
			{
				return new ChartHitInfo(refinedPoint, series, seriesLabel);
			}
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				return new ChartHitInfo(refinedPoint, series);
			}
			if (series != null)
			{
				return new ChartHitInfo(refinedPoint, series);
			}
			if (axis3D != null)
			{
				return new ChartHitInfo(axis3D);
			}
			if (diagram3D != null)
			{
				return new ChartHitInfo(diagram3D);
			}
			return new ChartHitInfo(chart, point, radius);
		}
	}
	public class XYZHitTestResult3D : IHitTestResult
	{
		private readonly RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult;

		public XYZHitTestResult3D(RayMeshGeometry3DHitTestResult ray3DResult)
		{
			this.ray3DResult = ray3DResult;
		}

		public HitInfoBase CreateHitInfo(UIElement chart, System.Windows.Point point, double radius)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = Crosshair3DManagerBase.ExtractRefinedPoint(ray3DResult);
			Series3D series3D = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesHitTestInfoProperty) as Series3D;
			Axis3D axis3D = ray3DResult.ModelHit.GetValue(ChartControlBase.Axis3DHitTestInfoProperty) as Axis3D;
			if (refinedPoint != null)
			{
				return new Chart3DHitInfo(refinedPoint, series3D);
			}
			if (series3D != null)
			{
				return new Chart3DHitInfo(refinedPoint, series3D, series3D.CalculateAdditionalHitInfo(ray3DResult));
			}
			if (axis3D != null)
			{
				return new Chart3DHitInfo(axis3D);
			}
			return new Chart3DHitInfo(chart, point, radius);
		}
	}
	public class HitTestResultMixed : IHitTestResult
