	public abstract class NavigationControllerBase
	{
		private enum NavigationState
		{
			Free,
			MouseDown,
			MouseStarting,
			MouseDragging,
			ManipulationStartingSingle,
			ManipulationStartingMultiple,
			ManipulationSingle,
			ManipulationMultiple,
			Inertia,
			MouseLeave
		}

		private enum NavigationAction
		{
			MouseBegin,
			MouseDown,
			MouseUp,
			MouseMove,
			MouseFinish,
			MouseLeave,
			MouseWheel,
			TouchStartSingle,
			TouchStartMultiple,
			TouchChange,
			TouchFinish,
			Inertia,
			InertiaFinish
		}

		private class NavigationArgs
		{
			public MouseButtonState? LeftMouseButton { get; private set; }

			public System.Windows.Point? TouchBPosition { get; private set; }

			public System.Windows.Point? TouchAPosition { get; private set; }

			public int MouseWheelDelta { get; private set; }

			public NavigationArgs(MouseButtonState? leftMouseButton)
			{
				LeftMouseButton = leftMouseButton;
			}

			public NavigationArgs(int mouseWheelDelta)
			{
				MouseWheelDelta = mouseWheelDelta;
			}

			public NavigationArgs(System.Windows.Point touchAPosition, System.Windows.Point touchBPosition)
			{
				TouchAPosition = touchAPosition;
				TouchBPosition = touchBPosition;
			}
		}

		private const int keyScrollStep = 10;

		private const int mouseWheelDeltaFactor = 120;

		private const int inertiaVelocityExpirePeriod = 100;

		private const double inertialDeceleration = 0.9;

		internal const int InertiaAnimationInterval = 10;

		internal const int TouchDelta = 5;

		private readonly ISupportNavigationControl navigationElement;

		private readonly ChartInteractivityElementsManager interactivityElementsManager;

		private int mouseWheelDelta;

		private bool isPointerInChart;

		private bool isPointerInLegend;

		private bool multipleTouchStarted;

		private double touchZoomBeginDistance;

		private double prevTouchZoomDistance;

		private System.Windows.Point inertiaVelocity;

		private System.Windows.Point lastChartPosition;

		private System.Windows.Point startZoomPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point overPan;

		private DateTime inertiaVelocityExpire;

		private DispatcherTimer animationTimer;

		private NavigationState currentState;

		private System.Windows.Point lastTouchPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point initialTouchPoint;

		private System.Windows.Point prevChartPosition;

		private bool IsMouseAccessible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Mouse.Captured != null && Mouse.Captured != navigationElement.NavigationLayer)
				{
					return Mouse.Captured is AnnotationThumb;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool IsAltKey => (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Alt) == ModifierKeys.Alt;

		private bool IsShiftKey => (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Shift;

		private bool KeyboardEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram != null)
				{
					return Diagram.IsKeyboardNavigationEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool MouseEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram != null && navigationElement.NavigationLayer != null)
				{
					return Diagram.IsMouseNavigationEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ManipulationEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram != null && navigationElement.NavigationLayer != null)
				{
					return Diagram.IsManipulationNavigationEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ZoomToRectangleEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (Diagram != null && navigationElement.NavigationLayer != null)
				{
					return Diagram.IsZoomToRectangleEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool InteractionEnabledOnMouseUp { get; }

		protected abstract ElementSelectionMode SelectionMode { get; }

		protected bool IsCtrlKey => (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control;

		protected FrameworkElement Chart => (FrameworkElement)navigationElement;

		protected bool HasSelectedAnnotation
		{
			get
			{
				if (interactivityElementsManager != null)
				{
					return interactivityElementsManager.HasSelectedAnnotation;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool PopupEnabled { get; private set; } = true;

		protected bool TouchUsed { get; private set; }

		protected Diagram Diagram => navigationElement.Diagram;

		internal DispatcherTimer AnimationTimer => animationTimer;

		public bool AllowPostponedUpdates { get; set; }

		public NavigationControllerBase(ISupportNavigationControl control)
		{
			navigationElement = control;
			animationTimer = new DispatcherTimer
			{
				Interval = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 10)
			};
			animationTimer.Tick += AnimationTimerTicked;
			AllowPostponedUpdates = true;
			interactivityElementsManager = CreateInteractivityElementsManager();
		}

		private BitmapCursor ClipCursor(BitmapCursor cursor)
		{
			if (cursor != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Point offset = cursor.Offset;
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point((double)cursor.Image.PixelWidth + offset.X, (double)cursor.Image.PixelHeight + offset.Y);
				if (lastChartPosition.X >= 0.0 - offset.X && lastChartPosition.X <= Chart.ActualWidth - point.X && lastChartPosition.Y >= 0.0 - offset.Y && lastChartPosition.Y <= Chart.ActualHeight - point.Y && isPointerInChart)
				{
					return cursor;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private BitmapCursor GetKeyboardCursor(bool useFocusedPane)
		{
			if (KeyboardEnabled)
			{
				if (!useFocusedPane && !Diagram.NavigationInDiagram(lastChartPosition))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (IsShiftKey)
				{
					if (!Diagram.NavigationCanZoomIn(lastChartPosition, useFocusedPane))
					{
						return DragCursors.ZoomLimitCursor;
					}
					return DragCursors.ZoomInCursor;
				}
				if (IsAltKey)
				{
					if (!Diagram.NavigationCanZoomOut(lastChartPosition, useFocusedPane))
					{
						return DragCursors.ZoomLimitCursor;
					}
					return DragCursors.ZoomOutCursor;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdateCursor(System.Windows.Point cursorPosition)
		{
			if (Diagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BitmapCursor bitmapCursor = interactivityElementsManager?.GetCursor(cursorPosition);
			if (bitmapCursor == null)
			{
				switch (currentState)
				{
				case NavigationState.Free:
				case NavigationState.Inertia:
				{
					BitmapCursor keyboardCursor = GetKeyboardCursor(useFocusedPane: false);
					bitmapCursor = ProcessDrillDown(cursorPosition);
					bool flag = Diagram.NavigationCanDrag(lastChartPosition, useFocusedPane: false);
					bitmapCursor = ((!(bitmapCursor == null && MouseEnabled && keyboardCursor == null && flag) || isPointerInLegend) ? keyboardCursor : DragCursors.HandCursor);
					break;
				}
				case NavigationState.MouseStarting:
				{
					ChartInteractivityElementsManager chartInteractivityElementsManager = interactivityElementsManager;
					if (chartInteractivityElementsManager != null && chartInteractivityElementsManager.HasDraggingConstantLine)
					{
						bitmapCursor = DragCursors.MoveCursor;
						break;
					}
					bitmapCursor = GetKeyboardCursor(useFocusedPane: true);
					if (bitmapCursor == null && MouseEnabled && Diagram.NavigationCanDrag(lastChartPosition, useFocusedPane: false))
					{
						bitmapCursor = DragCursors.HandDragCursor;
					}
					break;
				}
				case NavigationState.MouseDragging:
				{
					ChartInteractivityElementsManager chartInteractivityElementsManager2 = interactivityElementsManager;
					if (chartInteractivityElementsManager2 != null && chartInteractivityElementsManager2.HasDraggingConstantLine)
					{
						bitmapCursor = DragCursors.MoveCursor;
						break;
					}
					bitmapCursor = GetKeyboardCursor(useFocusedPane: true);
					if (bitmapCursor == null && MouseEnabled && Diagram.NavigationCanDrag(lastChartPosition, useFocusedPane: true))
					{
						bitmapCursor = DragCursors.HandDragCursor;
					}
					break;
				}
				case NavigationState.MouseLeave:
					navigationElement.NavigationLayer?.HideCursorImage();
					return;
				}
			}
			navigationElement.NavigationLayer?.UpdateCursor(ClipCursor(bitmapCursor), cursorPosition);
		}

		private void UpdateOnMouseUp(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			if (InteractionEnabledOnMouseUp)
			{
				UpdateOnMouseUpCore(chartPosition, lastChartPosition, startZoomPoint, initialTouchPoint);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInertiaVelocity(System.Windows.Point velocity)
		{
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			int num = (int)(now - inertiaVelocityExpire).TotalMilliseconds;
			if (num > 100 || Math.Abs(inertiaVelocity.X * inertiaVelocity.Y) < Math.Abs(velocity.X * velocity.Y))
			{
				inertiaVelocity = velocity;
				inertiaVelocityExpire = now;
			}
		}

		private void AnimationTimerTicked(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			ProcessAction(NavigationAction.Inertia, null, null);
		}

		private bool ProcessMouseLeave(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			currentState = NavigationState.Free;
			return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
		}

		private bool IsPlusKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key != Key.Add)
			{
				return key == Key.OemPlus;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsMinusKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key != Key.Subtract)
			{
				return key == Key.OemMinus;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ProcessFree(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			if (Diagram == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.MouseBegin:
				interactivityElementsManager?.UpdateChartInteractivity(chartPosition);
				if (!HasSelectedAnnotation)
				{
					ChartInteractivityElementsManager chartInteractivityElementsManager = interactivityElementsManager;
					if (chartInteractivityElementsManager == null || !chartInteractivityElementsManager.HasDraggingConstantLine)
					{
						UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDown);
						if (Diagram != null)
						{
							ChartInteractivityElementsManager chartInteractivityElementsManager2 = interactivityElementsManager;
							if (chartInteractivityElementsManager2 != null && !chartInteractivityElementsManager2.InConstantLineContentEditingMode)
							{
								Diagram.UpdateFocus(chartPosition, AllowPostponedUpdates);
							}
						}
						if (MouseEnabled)
						{
							if (!Diagram.NavigationBeginDrag(chartPosition, args.LeftMouseButton.Value, IsShiftKey) && (SelectionMode != ElementSelectionMode.Multiple || !IsCtrlKey || !Diagram.BeginSelection(chartPosition)))
							{
								currentState = NavigationState.MouseDown;
								lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
								return false;
							}
							navigationElement.NavigationLayer.CaptureMouse();
							startZoomPoint = chartPosition;
							inertiaVelocity = default(System.Windows.Point);
							inertiaVelocityExpire = DateTime.Now;
							currentState = NavigationState.MouseStarting;
						}
						else
						{
							currentState = NavigationState.MouseDown;
						}
						lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
						return false;
					}
				}
				currentState = NavigationState.MouseStarting;
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				return false;
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartSingle:
			{
				Diagram.UpdateFocus(chartPosition, AllowPostponedUpdates);
				bool flag = Diagram.ManipulationStart(chartPosition);
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				if (flag)
				{
					inertiaVelocity = default(System.Windows.Point);
					inertiaVelocityExpire = DateTime.Now;
					currentState = NavigationState.ManipulationStartingSingle;
				}
				return flag;
			}
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartMultiple:
			{
				Diagram.UpdateFocus(chartPosition, AllowPostponedUpdates);
				bool flag = Diagram.ManipulationStart(chartPosition);
				if (flag)
				{
					multipleTouchStarted = true;
					System.Windows.Point value = args.TouchBPosition.Value;
					initialTouchPoint = (lastTouchPoint = value);
					lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
					inertiaVelocity = default(System.Windows.Point);
					inertiaVelocityExpire = DateTime.Now;
					touchZoomBeginDistance = PointExtensions.Distance(args.TouchAPosition.Value, value);
					prevTouchZoomDistance = touchZoomBeginDistance;
					currentState = NavigationState.ManipulationStartingMultiple;
				}
				return flag;
			}
			case NavigationAction.MouseWheel:
			{
				bool result = false;
				int num = args.MouseWheelDelta;
				mouseWheelDelta += num;
				Diagram.UpdateFocus(chartPosition, AllowPostponedUpdates);
				if (Math.Abs(mouseWheelDelta) >= 120)
				{
					result = Diagram.NavigationZoom(chartPosition, mouseWheelDelta / 120, ZoomingKind.MouseWheel, isDragging: false);
					mouseWheelDelta = 0;
				}
				else if ((num > 0 && Diagram.NavigationCanZoomIn(chartPosition, useFocusedPane: false)) || (num < 0 && Diagram.NavigationCanZoomOut(chartPosition, useFocusedPane: false)))
				{
					result = true;
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.Zooming);
				return result;
			}
			case NavigationAction.MouseMove:
				if (HasSelectedAnnotation)
				{
					return true;
				}
				Diagram.ProcessMouseMove(chartPosition);
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseFreeMove);
				return false;
			case NavigationAction.MouseLeave:
				currentState = NavigationState.MouseLeave;
				return true;
			case NavigationAction.MouseDown:
				currentState = NavigationState.MouseDown;
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				interactivityElementsManager?.UpdateChartInteractivity(chartPosition);
				if (HasSelectedAnnotation)
				{
					currentState = NavigationState.MouseStarting;
					return false;
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDown);
				return false;
			case NavigationAction.TouchFinish:
				UpdateOnMouseUp(chartPosition);
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessMouseStarting(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.MouseMove:
				if (chartPosition == lastChartPosition)
				{
					return true;
				}
				currentState = NavigationState.MouseDragging;
				Diagram.UpdateFocus(chartPosition, AllowPostponedUpdates);
				return ProcessMouseDragging(action, chartPosition);
			case NavigationAction.MouseFinish:
				if (IsShiftKey)
				{
					Diagram.NavigationZoomIn(chartPosition);
				}
				if (IsAltKey)
				{
					Diagram.NavigationZoomOut();
				}
				UpdateOnMouseUp(chartPosition);
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				navigationElement.NavigationLayer.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				break;
			case NavigationAction.MouseLeave:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessMouseDragging(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.MouseMove:
			{
				ChartInteractivityElementsManager chartInteractivityElementsManager = interactivityElementsManager;
				if (chartInteractivityElementsManager != null && chartInteractivityElementsManager.ProcessDragElement(chartPosition, lastChartPosition))
				{
					lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
					return true;
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging);
				if (IsAltKey)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ((IsShiftKey && Diagram.NavigationCanZoomIntoRectangle() && ZoomToRectangleEnabled) || (IsCtrlKey && SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.Multiple))
				{
					Diagram.NavigationShowSelection(chartPosition);
				}
				else
				{
					System.Windows.Point velocity = new System.Windows.Point(chartPosition.X - lastChartPosition.X, chartPosition.Y - lastChartPosition.Y);
					Diagram.NavigationDrag(chartPosition, MathUtils.StrongRound(velocity.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(velocity.Y), NavigationType.LeftButtonMouseDrag);
					UpdateInertiaVelocity(velocity);
				}
				Diagram.ProcessMouseMove(chartPosition);
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				return true;
			}
			case NavigationAction.MouseFinish:
			{
				NavigationLayer navigationLayer = navigationElement.NavigationLayer;
				if (IsShiftKey || IsAltKey || IsCtrlKey)
				{
					if (IsShiftKey && Diagram.NavigationCanZoomIntoRectangle() && ZoomToRectangleEnabled)
					{
						Diagram.NavigationZoomIntoRectangle(new Rect(startZoomPoint, chartPosition));
						navigationLayer.HideSelection();
					}
					if (IsAltKey)
					{
						Diagram.NavigationZoomOut();
					}
					if (IsCtrlKey && SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.Multiple && lastChartPosition != startZoomPoint)
					{
						UpdateSelection(new Rect(startZoomPoint, lastChartPosition));
						navigationLayer.HideSelection();
					}
					currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateInertiaVelocity(default(System.Windows.Point));
					animationTimer.Start();
					currentState = NavigationState.Inertia;
					Diagram.ProcessEndScrolling();
				}
				if (navigationLayer.IsMouseCaptured)
				{
					navigationLayer.ReleaseMouseCapture();
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case NavigationAction.MouseUp:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessMouseDown(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			if (action == NavigationAction.MouseFinish || action == NavigationAction.MouseUp)
			{
				UpdateOnMouseUp(chartPosition);
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessManipulationStartingSingle(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartMultiple:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchChange:
				if (chartPosition == lastChartPosition)
				{
					return true;
				}
				overPan = default(System.Windows.Point);
				currentState = NavigationState.ManipulationSingle;
				return ProcessManipulationSingle(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchFinish:
				if (!multipleTouchStarted)
				{
					UpdateOnMouseUp(chartPosition);
				}
				multipleTouchStarted = false;
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessManipulationStartingMultiple(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartSingle:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				UpdateOnMouseUp(lastTouchPoint);
				return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchChange:
				if (chartPosition == lastChartPosition)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (args != null && args.TouchBPosition.HasValue)
				{
					lastTouchPoint = args.TouchBPosition.Value;
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging);
				currentState = NavigationState.ManipulationMultiple;
				return ProcessManipulationMultiple(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchFinish:
				multipleTouchStarted = false;
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessManipulationSingle(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartMultiple:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchChange:
			{
				if (args != null && (args.TouchAPosition.HasValue || args.TouchBPosition.HasValue))
				{
					currentState = NavigationState.Free;
					return ProcessFree(NavigationAction.TouchStartMultiple, chartPosition, args);
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging);
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(chartPosition.X - lastChartPosition.X, chartPosition.Y - lastChartPosition.Y);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = Diagram.ManipulationDrag(point, NavigationType.Gesture);
				UpdateInertiaVelocity(point);
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				overPan.X += point2.X;
				overPan.Y += point2.Y;
				return true;
			}
			case NavigationAction.TouchFinish:
				animationTimer.Start();
				currentState = NavigationState.Inertia;
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessManipulationMultiple(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartSingle:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchChange:
			{
				if (args == null)
				{
					currentState = NavigationState.Free;
					UpdateOnMouseUp(lastTouchPoint);
					return ProcessFree(NavigationAction.TouchStartSingle, chartPosition, args);
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragging);
				System.Windows.Point value = args.TouchBPosition.Value;
				double num = PointExtensions.Distance(args.TouchAPosition.Value, value);
				double num2 = num / touchZoomBeginDistance;
				double deltaDistance = num - prevTouchZoomDistance;
				Diagram.ManipulationZoom(num2, num2, deltaDistance);
				prevTouchZoomDistance = num;
				lastTouchPoint = value;
				return true;
			}
			case NavigationAction.TouchFinish:
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessInertia(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point chartPosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case NavigationAction.MouseBegin:
				animationTimer.Stop();
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.TouchStartSingle:
				animationTimer.Stop();
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				return ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
			case NavigationAction.InertiaFinish:
				animationTimer.Stop();
				currentState = NavigationState.Free;
				Diagram.ProcessEndScrolling();
				UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseDragEnd);
				return true;
			case NavigationAction.Inertia:
				inertiaVelocity.X *= 0.9;
				inertiaVelocity.Y *= 0.9;
				Diagram.ManipulationDrag(inertiaVelocity, NavigationType.LeftButtonMouseDrag);
				if (Math.Abs(inertiaVelocity.X) < 1.0 && Math.Abs(inertiaVelocity.Y) < 1.0)
				{
					return ProcessAction(NavigationAction.InertiaFinish, null, null);
				}
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.Inertia);
				return true;
			case NavigationAction.MouseMove:
				Diagram.ProcessMouseMove(lastChartPosition);
				lastChartPosition = chartPosition;
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessAction(NavigationAction action, System.Windows.Point? chartNullablePosition, NavigationArgs args)
		{
			System.Windows.Point chartPosition = chartNullablePosition ?? new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			bool result = false;
			switch (currentState)
			{
			case NavigationState.MouseLeave:
				result = ProcessMouseLeave(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.Free:
				result = ProcessFree(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.MouseStarting:
				result = ProcessMouseStarting(action, chartPosition);
				break;
			case NavigationState.MouseDragging:
				result = ProcessMouseDragging(action, chartPosition);
				break;
			case NavigationState.ManipulationStartingSingle:
				result = ProcessManipulationStartingSingle(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.ManipulationStartingMultiple:
				result = ProcessManipulationStartingMultiple(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.ManipulationSingle:
				result = ProcessManipulationSingle(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.ManipulationMultiple:
				result = ProcessManipulationMultiple(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.Inertia:
				result = ProcessInertia(action, chartPosition, args);
				break;
			case NavigationState.MouseDown:
				result = ProcessMouseDown(action, chartPosition);
				break;
			}
			UpdateCursor(chartNullablePosition ?? lastChartPosition);
			return result;
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateOnMouseUpCore(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, System.Windows.Point lastChartPosition, System.Windows.Point startZoomPoint, System.Windows.Point initialTouchPoint);

		protected abstract HitTestResultBehavior MultipleSelectionCallback(HitTestResult result);

		protected abstract void UpdateCrosshair(System.Windows.Point? chartPosition);

		protected abstract void SaveCrosshairLocationForPrinting();

		protected abstract ChartInteractivityElementsManager CreateInteractivityElementsManager();

		protected abstract BitmapCursor ProcessDrillDown(System.Windows.Point cursorPosition);

		protected abstract void UpdateToolTip(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction);

		internal void SetIsPointerInLegend(bool pointerInLegend)
		{
			isPointerInLegend = pointerInLegend;
		}

		internal bool OnKeyDown(Key key)
		{
			bool result = false;
			TouchUsed = false;
			if (KeyboardEnabled)
			{
				switch (key)
				{
				case Key.Z:
					if (IsCtrlKey)
					{
						Diagram.NavigationUndoZoom();
						UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
					}
					break;
				case Key.Left:
					if (IsCtrlKey && Diagram.NavigationScrollHorizontally(10, NavigationType.ArrowKeys))
					{
						result = true;
						UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
					}
					break;
				case Key.Right:
					if (IsCtrlKey && Diagram.NavigationScrollHorizontally(-10, NavigationType.ArrowKeys))
					{
						result = true;
						UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
					}
					break;
				case Key.Up:
					if (IsCtrlKey && Diagram.NavigationScrollVertically(10, NavigationType.ArrowKeys))
					{
						result = true;
						UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
					}
					break;
				case Key.Down:
					if (IsCtrlKey && Diagram.NavigationScrollVertically(-10, NavigationType.ArrowKeys))
					{
						result = true;
						UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
					}
					break;
				case Key.Tab:
					if (IsShiftKey && Chart.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && KeyboardNavigation.GetControlTabNavigation(Chart) == KeyboardNavigationMode.Once)
					{
						result = true;
						Chart.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Previous));
					}
					break;
				default:
					if (IsCtrlKey)
					{
						if (IsPlusKey(key))
						{
							Diagram.NavigationZoomIn();
							UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
						}
						if (IsMinusKey(key))
						{
							Diagram.NavigationZoomOut();
							UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyDown);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			UpdateCursor(lastChartPosition);
			return result;
		}

		internal void OnKeyUp(Key key)
		{
			TouchUsed = false;
			NavigationLayer navigationLayer = navigationElement.NavigationLayer;
			if (!IsShiftKey && !IsCtrlKey && navigationLayer != null && navigationLayer.IsSelectionVisible && currentState == NavigationState.MouseDragging)
			{
				navigationLayer.HideSelection();
				if (SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.Multiple && startZoomPoint != lastChartPosition)
				{
					UpdateSelection(new Rect(startZoomPoint, lastChartPosition));
				}
				UpdateToolTip(lastChartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.KeyUp);
			}
			if (key == Key.Delete)
			{
				interactivityElementsManager?.RemoveElements();
			}
			UpdateCursor(lastChartPosition);
		}

		internal bool OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, bool stylusDeviceUsed)
		{
			bool result = false;
			isPointerInChart = true;
			TouchUsed = stylusDeviceUsed;
			ChartInteractivityElementsManager chartInteractivityElementsManager = interactivityElementsManager;
			if (chartInteractivityElementsManager != null && chartInteractivityElementsManager.CanDragSelectedAnnotation && IsMouseAccessible)
			{
				ProcessAction(NavigationAction.MouseMove, chartPosition, null);
			}
			if (MouseEnabled && IsMouseAccessible)
			{
				result = ProcessAction(NavigationAction.MouseMove, chartPosition, null);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateCursor(chartPosition);
				UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseFreeMove);
			}
			if (currentState == NavigationState.Free && !isPointerInLegend && Chart.IsMeasureValid && Chart.IsArrangeValid)
			{
				UpdateCrosshair(chartPosition);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateCrosshair(null);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool OnMouseWheel(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, int delta, bool stylusDeviceUsed)
		{
			bool result = false;
			TouchUsed = stylusDeviceUsed;
			if (MouseEnabled)
			{
				NavigationArgs args = new NavigationArgs(delta);
				result = ProcessAction(NavigationAction.MouseWheel, chartPosition, args);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool OnLeftMouseButtonDown(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, MouseButtonState leftButtonState, bool stylusDeviceUsed)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			TouchUsed = stylusDeviceUsed;
			NavigationArgs args = new NavigationArgs(leftButtonState);
			return ProcessAction(NavigationAction.MouseBegin, chartPosition, args);
		}

		internal bool OnLeftMouseButtonUp(System.Windows.Point position, bool stylusDeviceUsed)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			TouchUsed = stylusDeviceUsed;
			NavigationAction action = ((MouseEnabled || HasSelectedAnnotation) ? NavigationAction.MouseFinish : NavigationAction.MouseUp);
			return ProcessAction(action, position, null);
		}

		internal void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Point position, bool stylusDeviceUsed)
		{
			isPointerInChart = false;
			TouchUsed = stylusDeviceUsed;
			if (MouseEnabled)
			{
				ProcessAction(NavigationAction.MouseLeave, position, null);
			}
			UpdateCrosshair(null);
			UpdateToolTip(position, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseLeave);
		}

		internal void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			isPointerInChart = true;
			currentState = NavigationState.Free;
		}

		internal bool OnManipulationStarted(System.Windows.Point manipulationOrigin, IEnumerable<IManipulator> manipulators)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (!ManipulationEnabled)
			{
				lastChartPosition = manipulationOrigin;
			}
			else
			{
				TouchUsed = true;
				List<IManipulator> list = manipulators.ToList();
				if (list.Count > 1)
				{
					IManipulator manipulator = list[0];
					IManipulator manipulator2 = list[1];
					NavigationArgs args = new NavigationArgs(manipulator.GetPosition(Chart), manipulator2.GetPosition(Chart));
					result = ProcessAction(NavigationAction.TouchStartMultiple, manipulationOrigin, args);
				}
				else
				{
					result = ProcessAction(NavigationAction.TouchStartSingle, manipulationOrigin, null);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal Tuple<bool, ManipulationDelta> OnManipulationDelta(System.Windows.Point manipulationOrigin, IEnumerable<IManipulator> manipulators)
		{
			bool item = false;
			ManipulationDelta item2 = null;
			if (ManipulationEnabled)
			{
				TouchUsed = true;
				List<IManipulator> list = manipulators.ToList();
				if (list.Count > 1)
				{
					IManipulator manipulator = list[0];
					IManipulator manipulator2 = list[1];
					NavigationArgs args = new NavigationArgs(manipulator.GetPosition(Chart), manipulator2.GetPosition(Chart));
					item = ProcessAction(NavigationAction.TouchChange, manipulationOrigin, args);
				}
				else
				{
					item = ProcessAction(NavigationAction.TouchChange, manipulationOrigin, null);
					if (overPan.X != 0.0 || overPan.Y != 0.0)
					{
						item2 = new ManipulationDelta(new Vector(overPan.X, overPan.Y), 0.0, default(Vector), default(Vector));
					}
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, ManipulationDelta>(item, item2);
		}

		internal void OnManipulationCompleted(System.Windows.Point manipulationOrigin)
		{
			TouchUsed = true;
			ProcessAction(NavigationAction.TouchFinish, manipulationOrigin, null);
		}

		internal abstract void UpdateSelection(Rect rect);

		public void KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = OnKeyDown(e.Key);
		}

		public void KeyUp(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			OnKeyUp(e.Key);
		}

		public void MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool stylusDeviceUsed = e.StylusDevice != null;
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(Chart);
			if (prevChartPosition != position)
			{
				e.Handled = OnMouseMove(position, stylusDeviceUsed);
				prevChartPosition = position;
			}
		}

		public void MouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			bool stylusDeviceUsed = e.StylusDevice != null;
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(Chart);
			e.Handled = OnMouseWheel(position, e.Delta, stylusDeviceUsed);
		}

		public void MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			bool stylusDeviceUsed = e.StylusDevice != null;
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(Chart);
			e.Handled = OnLeftMouseButtonDown(position, e.LeftButton, stylusDeviceUsed);
		}

		public void MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(Chart);
			bool stylusDeviceUsed = e.StylusDevice != null;
			e.Handled = OnLeftMouseButtonUp(position, stylusDeviceUsed);
		}

		public void MouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetPosition(Chart);
			bool stylusDeviceUsed = e.StylusDevice != null;
			OnMouseLeave(position, stylusDeviceUsed);
		}

		public void MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseEnter();
		}

		public void ManipulationStarted(object sender, ManipulationStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = OnManipulationStarted(e.ManipulationOrigin, e.Manipulators);
		}

		public void ManipulationDelta(object sender, ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			Tuple<bool, ManipulationDelta> tuple = OnManipulationDelta(e.ManipulationOrigin, e.Manipulators);
			if (tuple.Item2 != null)
			{
				e.ReportBoundaryFeedback(tuple.Item2);
			}
			e.Handled = tuple.Item1;
		}

		public void ManipulationCompleted(object sender, ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationCompleted(e.ManipulationOrigin);
		}

		public void ApplicationActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Chart.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				PopupEnabled = true;
			});
		}

		public void ApplicationDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Chart.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				SaveCrosshairLocationForPrinting();
				UpdateCrosshair(null);
				UpdateToolTip(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseLeave);
				PopupEnabled = false;
			});
		}

		public void UpdateAnnotationDraggingCursor(System.Windows.Point cursorPosition)
		{

			{
				BitmapCursor cursor = interactivityElementsManager?.GetAnnotationCursor();
				navigationElement.NavigationLayer.UpdateCursor(ClipCursor(cursor), cursorPosition);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ChartNavigationController : NavigationControllerBase
	{
		private List<IInteractiveElement> itemsToSelect;

		private Rect selectionRect;

		private ChartControl ChartControl => (ChartControl)base.Chart;

		private bool IsDrillDownEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Diagram != null)
				{
					return base.Diagram.IsDrillDownEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override ElementSelectionMode SelectionMode => ChartControl.SelectionMode;

		protected override bool InteractionEnabledOnMouseUp
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ChartControl.SeriesToolTipEnabled && !ChartControl.PointsToolTipEnabled && SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.None && (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D) || !((XYDiagram2D)base.Diagram).ActualRuntimePaneCollapse))
				{
					return IsDrillDownEnabled;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ChartNavigationController(ISupportNavigationControl chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
		}

		private IList<IInteractiveElement> FindSeriesPointsByArgument(string argument)
		{
			List<IInteractiveElement> list = new List<IInteractiveElement>();
			if (base.Diagram?.Series != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in ChartControl.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
				{
					foreach (RefinedPoint finalPoint in item.FinalPoints)
					{
						if (!(finalPoint.SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument == argument))
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (finalPoint.SeriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint)
						{
							foreach (RefinedPoint sourcePoint in aggregatedSeriesPoint.SourcePoints)
							{
								list.Add((IPlatformSeriesPoint)sourcePoint.SeriesPoint);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add((IPlatformSeriesPoint)finalPoint.SeriesPoint);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void UpdateToolTip(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, ToolTipNavigationAction navigationAction)
		{
			if (base.PopupEnabled)
			{
				ChartControl.ActualToolTipController.UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ChartControl, navigationAction, base.TouchUsed);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCrosshair(System.Windows.Point? cursorLocation)
		{
			if (ChartControl.ActualCrosshairEnabled)
			{
				Diagram diagram = base.Diagram;
				if (diagram != null && !ChartControl.CrosshairForced)
				{
					diagram.UpdateCrosshairLocation(cursorLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void SaveCrosshairLocationForPrinting()
		{
			base.Diagram?.SaveCrosshairLocationForPrinting();
		}

		protected override void UpdateOnMouseUpCore(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, System.Windows.Point lastChartPosition, System.Windows.Point startZoomPoint, System.Windows.Point initialTouchPoint)
		{
			if (SelectionMode == ElementSelectionMode.Multiple && chartPosition != lastChartPosition && base.IsCtrlKey)
			{
				UpdateSelection(new Rect(startZoomPoint, lastChartPosition));
				return;
			}
			ToolTipHitInfo toolTipHitInfo = new ToolTipHitInfo(ChartControl, chartPosition, calculateForSeries: true, base.TouchUsed, breadcrumbHitTesting: true);
			if (IsDrillDownEnabled)
			{
				object obj = toolTipHitInfo.Series?.Tag;
				object obj2 = toolTipHitInfo.SeriesPoint?.Tag;
				if (obj != null || obj2 != null)
				{
					base.Diagram.DrillDownInternal(obj, obj2);
				}
				else if (toolTipHitInfo.BreadcrumbItem != null)
				{
					base.Diagram.DrillUpTo(toolTipHitInfo.BreadcrumbItem.SourceObject);
				}
			}
			ChartControl.ActualToolTipController.UpdateToolTip(chartPosition, ChartControl, ToolTipNavigationAction.MouseUp, toolTipHitInfo);
			bool flag = PointExtensions.Distance(initialTouchPoint, chartPosition) < 5.0;
			if (chartPosition == lastChartPosition || flag)
			{
				UpdateSelection(toolTipHitInfo, flag);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSelection(ToolTipHitInfo hitInfo, bool selectionStarted)
		{
			switch (ChartControl.SeriesSelectionMode)
			{
			case SeriesSelectionMode.Series:
				ChartControl.SelectionController.UpdateSelection(hitInfo.Series, Keyboard.Modifiers, selectionStarted);
				break;
			case SeriesSelectionMode.Point:
				ChartControl.SelectionController.UpdateSelection(SeriesPointHelper.GetInteractiveSourcePoints(hitInfo.RefinedPoint), Keyboard.Modifiers, selectionStarted);
				break;
			case SeriesSelectionMode.Argument:
				if (hitInfo.SeriesPoint != null)
				{
					IList<IInteractiveElement> elements = FindSeriesPointsByArgument(hitInfo.SeriesPoint.Argument);
					ChartControl.SelectionController.UpdateSelection(elements, Keyboard.Modifiers, selectionStarted);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override HitTestResultBehavior MultipleSelectionCallback(HitTestResult result)
		{
			IHitTestableElement parentHitTestableElement = HitTestingHelper.GetParentHitTestableElement(result.VisualHit);
			if (parentHitTestableElement != null)
			{
				IList<object> list = HitTestingHelper.ProcessHitTestableElement(parentHitTestableElement, selectionRect);
				switch (ChartControl.SeriesSelectionMode)
				{
				case SeriesSelectionMode.Series:
					foreach (object item in list)
					{
						ISeries series = item as ISeries;
						if (series == null)
						{
							RefinedPoint refinedPoint3 = ((item is RefinedPoint) ? ((RefinedPoint)item) : (item as RefinedPoint));
							IPlatformSeriesPoint platformSeriesPoint = ((refinedPoint3 != null) ? SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(refinedPoint3) : null);
							if (platformSeriesPoint != null && platformSeriesPoint.Owner != null && !itemsToSelect.Contains((IInteractiveElement)platformSeriesPoint.Owner))
							{
								series = platformSeriesPoint.Owner;
							}
						}
						if (series != null)
						{
							itemsToSelect.Add((IInteractiveElement)series);
						}
					}
					break;
				case SeriesSelectionMode.Point:
					foreach (object item2 in list)
					{
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = ((item2 is RefinedPoint) ? ((RefinedPoint)item2) : (item2 as RefinedPoint));
						if (refinedPoint2 != null)
						{
							itemsToSelect.AddRange(SeriesPointHelper.GetInteractiveSourcePoints(refinedPoint2));
						}
					}
					break;
				case SeriesSelectionMode.Argument:
					foreach (object item3 in list)
					{
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ((item3 is RefinedPoint) ? ((RefinedPoint)item3) : (item3 as RefinedPoint));
						if (refinedPoint != null)
						{
							IList<IInteractiveElement> list2 = FindSeriesPointsByArgument(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument);
							if (list2 != null)
							{
								itemsToSelect.AddRange(list2);
							}
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
		}

		protected override ChartInteractivityElementsManager CreateInteractivityElementsManager()
		{
			return new ChartInteractivityElementsManager(ChartControl);
		}

		protected override BitmapCursor ProcessDrillDown(System.Windows.Point cursorPosition)
		{
			if (IsDrillDownEnabled)
			{
				ChartHitInfo chartHitInfo = ChartControl.CalcHitInfo(cursorPosition);
				if ((chartHitInfo.SeriesPoint != null && base.Diagram.CanDrillDown(chartHitInfo.SeriesPoint.Tag)) || (chartHitInfo.Series != null && base.Diagram.CanDrillDown(chartHitInfo.Series.Tag)))
				{
					return DragCursors.HandPointerCursor;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override void UpdateSelection(Rect rect)
		{
			if (!(base.Diagram is XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			selectionRect = rect;
			itemsToSelect = new List<IInteractiveElement>();
			foreach (Pane actualPane in xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes)
			{
				if (base.Chart.FindCommonVisualAncestor(actualPane) != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point location = base.Chart.TranslatePoint(rect.Location, actualPane);
					Geometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(location, rect.Size));
					HitTestParameters hitTestParameters = new ChartGeometryHitTestParameters(geometry);
					VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(actualPane, null, MultipleSelectionCallback, hitTestParameters);
				}
			}
			ChartControl.SelectionController.ReplaceElements(itemsToSelect);
			itemsToSelect = null;
		}
	}
	public class ChartInteractivityElementsManager
	{
		private readonly ChartControl chart;

		public bool HasSelectedAnnotation => chart.HasSelectedAnnotation;

		public bool CanDragSelectedAnnotation => chart.CanDragSelectedAnnotation;

		public bool HasDraggingConstantLine => chart.HasDraggingConstantLine;

		public bool InConstantLineContentEditingMode => chart.InConstantLineContentEditingMode;

		public ChartInteractivityElementsManager(ChartControl chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		public void UpdateChartInteractivity(System.Windows.Point chartPosition)
		{
			chart.UpdateAnnotationsInteractivity();
			chart.UpdateInteractiveConstantLineReferences(chartPosition);
		}

		public BitmapCursor GetAnnotationCursor()
		{
			return chart.GetAnnotationCursor();
		}

		public BitmapCursor GetCursor(System.Windows.Point cursorPosition)
		{
			BitmapCursor bitmapCursor = chart.GetAnnotationCursor();
			if (bitmapCursor == null && chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D { HasMovableConstantLines: not false })
			{
				Pane activePane = chart.FindPaneInPoint(cursorPosition);
				ConstantLine constantLine = chart.FindConstantLineInPoint(activePane, cursorPosition);
				if (constantLine != null && constantLine.IsVisible && constantLine.CheckedInLegend)
				{
					bitmapCursor = DragCursors.MoveCursor;
				}
			}
			return bitmapCursor;
		}

		public bool ProcessDragElement(System.Windows.Point chartPosition, System.Windows.Point lastChartPosition)
		{
			if (!chart.ProcessAnnotationDrag(chartPosition.X - lastChartPosition.X, chartPosition.Y - lastChartPosition.Y))
			{
				return chart.ProcessConstantLineDrag(chartPosition);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveElements()
		{
			chart.RemoveReadyForDeletionAnnotation();
			chart.RemoveReadyForDeletionConstantLine();
		}
	}
	public class CustomShape
	{
		private readonly int pixelWidth;

		private readonly int pixelHeight;

		private readonly int stride;

		private readonly byte[] pixels;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (pixels != null)
				{
					return pixels.Length == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public CustomShape(UIElement presenterElement)
		{
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)presenterElement.DesiredSize.Width, (int)presenterElement.DesiredSize.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
			presenterElement.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, presenterElement.DesiredSize.Width, presenterElement.DesiredSize.Height));
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(presenterElement);
			pixelWidth = (int)renderTargetBitmap.Width;
			pixelHeight = (int)renderTargetBitmap.Height;
			stride = pixelWidth * 4;
			pixels = new byte[pixelHeight * stride];
			renderTargetBitmap.CopyPixels(pixels, stride, 0);
		}

		public byte? GetAlpha(int x, int y)
		{
			int num = (pixelHeight - y) * stride + x * 4 + 3;
			if (num < pixels.Length)
			{
				return pixels[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < stride * pixelHeight; i += 4)
			{
				pixels[i] = 0;
				pixels[i + 1] = 0;
				pixels[i + 2] = 0;
			}
		}
	}

	public class PenHolder
	{
		protected System.Windows.Media.Pen Pen { get; private set; }

		public PenHolder(SolidColorBrush brush, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
		{
			Pen = CreatePen(brush, lineStyle, thickness);
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatePen(SolidColorBrush brush, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, thickness);
			if (lineStyle != null)
			{
				pen.DashCap = lineStyle.DashCap;
				pen.DashStyle = lineStyle.DashStyle;
				pen.LineJoin = lineStyle.LineJoin;
				pen.MiterLimit = lineStyle.MiterLimit;
			}
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		public virtual System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(System.Windows.Media.Color? color, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
		{
			return Pen;
		}
	}
	public class MultiColorPenHolder : PenHolder
	{
		private class StyleKey
		{
			public System.Windows.Media.Color Color { get; }

			public LineStyle LineStyle { get; }

			public int Thickness { get; }

			public StyleKey(System.Windows.Media.Color color, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
			{
				Color = color;
				LineStyle = lineStyle;
				Thickness = thickness;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is StyleKey styleKey && Color.Equals(styleKey.Color) && EqualityComparer<LineStyle>.Default.Equals(LineStyle, styleKey.LineStyle))
				{
					return Thickness == styleKey.Thickness;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<System.Windows.Media.Color, LineStyle, int>(Color, LineStyle, Thickness);
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<StyleKey, System.Windows.Media.Pen> penCache = new Dictionary<StyleKey, System.Windows.Media.Pen>();

		public MultiColorPenHolder(SolidColorBrush brush, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
			: base(brush, lineStyle, thickness)
		{
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Pen GetPen(System.Windows.Media.Color? color, LineStyle lineStyle, int thickness)
		{
			if (!color.HasValue)
			{
				return base.Pen;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color value = color.Value;
			StyleKey key = new StyleKey(value, lineStyle, thickness);
			if (!penCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
			{
				value2 = CreatePen(new SolidColorBrush(value), lineStyle, thickness);
				penCache[key] = value2;
			}
			return value2;
		}
	}

	public abstract class RangeSeriesValueToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		private readonly string separator;

		private readonly bool isLegendConverter;

		protected abstract bool ShouldSortValues { get; }

		protected abstract bool IsOneLabel { get; }

		protected bool IsLegendConverter => isLegendConverter;

		public static object[] SortValues(object[] values)
		{
			object[] array = new object[2];
			Array.Copy(values, 0, array, 0, 2);
			Array.Sort(array);
			return array;
		}

		public RangeSeriesValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, bool isLegendConverter, string separator)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
			this.separator = separator;
			this.isLegendConverter = isLegendConverter;
		}

		public override string ConvertTo(object[] values)
		{
			if (ShouldSortValues)
			{
				values = SortValues(values);
			}
			if (isLegendConverter || IsOneLabel)
			{
				return GetValueText(values[0]) + separator + GetValueText(values[1]);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(values);
		}
	}
	public class RangeAreaValueToStringConverter : RangeSeriesValueToStringConverter
	{
		private readonly RangeAreaLabelKind labelKind;

		protected override bool ShouldSortValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (labelKind != RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel)
				{
					return labelKind == RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsOneLabel => labelKind == RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel;

		public RangeAreaValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, RangeAreaLabelKind labelKind, string separator)
			: this(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions, labelKind, isLegendConverter: false, separator)
		{
		}

		public RangeAreaValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, RangeAreaLabelKind labelKind, bool isLegendConverter, string separator)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions, isLegendConverter, separator)
		{
			this.labelKind = labelKind;
		}

		protected override object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			switch (labelKind)
			{
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label:
				return values[0];
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
			case RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label:
				return values[1];
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown range area label kind.");
				return values[0];
			}
		}
	}
	public class RangeAreaValue2ToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		public RangeAreaValue2ToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
		}

		protected override object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			return values[1];
		}
	}
	public struct Bar2D
	{
		public readonly double Argument;

		public readonly double LowValue;

		public readonly double HighValue;

		public readonly double FixedOffset;

		public readonly double Left;

		public readonly double Right;

		public readonly double Top;

		public readonly double Bottom;

		public readonly Rect Bounds;

		public Bar2D(double argument, double lowValue, double highValue, double fixedOffset, double left, double right, double top, double bottom)
		{
			Argument = argument;
			LowValue = lowValue;
			HighValue = highValue;
			FixedOffset = fixedOffset;
			Left = left;
			Right = right;
			Top = top;
			Bottom = bottom;
			Bounds = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(Left, Top), new System.Windows.Point(Right, Bottom));
		}
	}
	public class SeriesPointDrawingOrderComparer : IComparer<SeriesPointItem>
	{
		private readonly SeriesStackedGroupComparer stackedGroupComparer;

		private readonly IList<XYSeries2D> seriesCollection;

		private static double ActualSeriesPointValue(SeriesPointItem pointItem)
		{
			if (pointItem.Series is BarSeries2D barSeries2D)
			{
				IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView = barSeries2D;
				if (iXYSeriesView != null && iXYSeriesView.AxisYData is AxisY2D { ReverseInternal: not false })
				{
					return 0.0 - barSeries2D.GetPointValue(pointItem.RefinedPoint);
				}
				return barSeries2D.GetPointValue(pointItem.RefinedPoint);
			}
			return ((IValuePoint)pointItem.RefinedPoint).Value;
		}

		public SeriesPointDrawingOrderComparer(IList<XYSeries2D> series)
		{
			seriesCollection = series;
			stackedGroupComparer = SeriesStackedGroupComparer.Create(seriesCollection);
		}

		private int CompareByValue(SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2)
		{
			double num = ActualSeriesPointValue(item1);
			double num2 = ActualSeriesPointValue(item2);
			return Math.Sign(num - num2);
		}

		private int CompareBySeriesIndex(SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2)
		{
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = item1.Series as XYSeries2D;
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D2 = item2.Series as XYSeries2D;
			if (xYSeries2D != null && xYSeries2D2 != null)
			{
				double num = seriesCollection.IndexOf(xYSeries2D);
				double num2 = seriesCollection.IndexOf(xYSeries2D2);
				return Math.Sign(num - num2);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public int Compare(SeriesPointItem item1, SeriesPointItem item2)
		{
			if (item1 == null || item2 == null || item1.RefinedPoint == null || item2.RefinedPoint == null || item1.Series == null || item2.Series == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (item1.Series.GetType() == item2.Series.GetType())
			{
				if (item1.RefinedPoint.Argument == item2.RefinedPoint.Argument)
				{
					if (item1.Series is ISupportStackedGroup && item2.Series is ISupportStackedGroup)
					{
						int num = stackedGroupComparer.Compare(((ISupportStackedGroup)item1.Series).StackedGroup, ((ISupportStackedGroup)item2.Series).StackedGroup);
						if (num != 0)
						{
							return num;
						}
						return CompareByValue(item1, item2);
					}
					if (item1.Series is BarStackedSeries2D && item2.Series is BarStackedSeries2D)
					{
						return CompareByValue(item1, item2);
					}
					if (item1.Series is BarSideBySideSeries2D && item2.Series is BarSideBySideSeries2D)
					{
						if (item1.Series != item2.Series)
						{
							return CompareBySeriesIndex(item1, item2);
						}
						return CompareByValue(item1, item2);
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return Math.Sign(item1.RefinedPoint.Argument - item2.RefinedPoint.Argument);
			}
			if (!(item1.Series is BarStackedSeries2D) || !(item2.Series is BarSideBySideSeries2D))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesStackedGroupComparer
	{
		private readonly List<object> stackedGroupDrawingOrder = new List<object>();

		public static SeriesStackedGroupComparer Create(IList<XYSeries2D> seriesCollection)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (XYSeries2D item in seriesCollection)
			{
				if (item is ISupportStackedGroup)
				{
					object stackedGroup = ((ISupportStackedGroup)item).StackedGroup;
					if (!list.Contains(stackedGroup))
					{
						list.Add(stackedGroup);
					}
				}
			}
			return new SeriesStackedGroupComparer(list);
		}

		private SeriesStackedGroupComparer(List<object> stackedGroupDrawingOrder)
		{
			this.stackedGroupDrawingOrder = stackedGroupDrawingOrder;
		}

		public int Compare(object group1, object group2)
		{
			if (group1 == null || group2 == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return stackedGroupDrawingOrder.IndexOf(group1) - stackedGroupDrawingOrder.IndexOf(group2);
		}
	}
	public class RangeBarValueToStringConverter : RangeSeriesValueToStringConverter
	{
		private readonly RangeBarLabelKind labelKind;

		protected override bool ShouldSortValues => true;

		protected override bool IsOneLabel => labelKind == RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel;

		public RangeBarValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, RangeBarLabelKind labelKind, string separator)
			: this(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions, labelKind, isLegendConverter: false, separator)
		{
		}

		public RangeBarValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, RangeBarLabelKind labelKind, bool isLegendConverter, string separator)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions, isLegendConverter, separator)
		{
			this.labelKind = labelKind;
		}

		protected override object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			switch (labelKind)
			{
			case RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels:
			case RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel:
				return values[0];
			case RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel:
				return values[1];
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown range bar label kind.");
				return values[0];
			}
		}
	}
	public class RangeBarValue2ToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		public RangeBarValue2ToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
		}

		protected override object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			values = RangeSeriesValueToStringConverter.SortValues(values);
			return values[1];
		}
	}

		private object Object => objectRef.Target;

		public object Element
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Object is IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement))
				{
					return Object;
				}
				return hitTestableElement.Element;
			}
		}

		public object AdditionalElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Object is IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return hitTestableElement.AdditionalElement;
			}
		}

		public HitTestableElement(object obj)
		{
			objectRef = new WeakReference(obj);
		}
	}

	public class SeriesPointData : ISeriesPointData, IAnimatableElement
	{
		private readonly Series series;

		private readonly AnimationProgress pointProgress;

		private readonly AnimationProgress labelProgress;

		private readonly List<SeriesPointItem> pointItems = new List<SeriesPointItem>();

		private RefinedPoint refinedPoint;

		private int indexInSeries;

		public AnimationProgress PointProgress => pointProgress;

		public AnimationProgress LabelProgress => labelProgress;

		public List<SeriesPointItem> PointItems => pointItems;

		public RefinedPoint RefinedPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return refinedPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				refinedPoint = value;
				RefinedPointChanged();
			}
		}

		public IDataPoint SeriesPoint => (IDataPoint)RefinedPoint.SeriesPoint;

		public int IndexInSeries
		{
			get
			{
				return indexInSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				indexInSeries = value;
			}
		}

		public int LegendItemIndex { get; set; }

		System.Windows.Media.Color ISeriesPointData.Color
		{
			get
			{
				return PointItems[0].PresentationData.PointColor;
			}
			set
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in PointItems)
				{
					pointItem.PresentationData.PointColor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		string ISeriesPointData.LegendText
		{
			get
			{
				return PointItems[0].PresentationData.LegendText;
			}
			set
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in PointItems)
				{
					pointItem.PresentationData.LegendText = value;
				}
			}
		}

		string[] ISeriesPointData.LabelsTexts
		{
			get
			{
				int count = pointItems.Count;
				string[] array = new string[count];
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = pointItems[i].PresentationData.LabelText;
				}
				return array;
			}
			set
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in PointItems)
				{
					pointItem.PresentationData.LabelText = null;
				}
				if (value.Length == 2)
				{
					foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem2 in PointItems)
					{
						if (pointItem2.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value1)
						{
							pointItem2.PresentationData.LabelText = value[0];
						}
						else if (pointItem2.ValueLevel == RangeValueLevel.Value2)
						{
							pointItem2.PresentationData.LabelText = value[1];
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem3 in PointItems)
				{
					if (pointItem3.ValueLevel == series.GetValueLevelForLabel(refinedPoint))
					{
						pointItem3.PresentationData.LabelText = value[0];
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		double ISeriesPointData.Opacity
		{
			get
			{
				return PointItems[0].PresentationData.Opacity;
			}
			set
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in PointItems)
				{
					pointItem.PresentationData.Opacity = value;
				}
			}
		}

		ChartAnimationMode IAnimatableElement.AnimationMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					return ChartAnimationMode.Disabled;
				}
				return ((IAnimatableElement)series).AnimationMode;
			}
		}

		AnimationState IAnimatableElement.AnimationState
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					return AnimationState.Completed;
				}
				return ((IAnimatableElement)series).AnimationState;
			}
		}

		AnimationAutoStartMode IAnimatableElement.AnimationAutoStartMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					return AnimationAutoStartMode.SetFinalState;
				}
				return series.AnimationAutoStartMode;
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointData(Series series, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			this.series = series;
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
			SeriesPointItem[] array = series.CreateSeriesPointItems(refinedPoint, this);
			foreach (SeriesPointItem item in array)
			{
				pointItems.Add(item);
			}
			pointProgress = new AnimationProgress(this);
			labelProgress = new AnimationProgress(this);
			LegendItemIndex = -1;
		}

		void IAnimatableElement.ProgressChanged(AnimationProgress source)
		{
			if (source == pointProgress)
			{
				PointProgressChanged();
			}
			else if (source == labelProgress)
			{
				LabelProgressChanged();
			}
		}

		private void PointProgressChanged()
		{
			SeriesPointAnimationBase actualAnimation = GetActualAnimation();
			if (actualAnimation == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in pointItems)
			{
				if (actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateSeriesPointLayout)
				{
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasureRecursive(pointItem.PointItemPresentation);
				}
				if (actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateSeriesPointOpacity(series))
				{
					CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasure(pointItem.PointItemPresentation);
				}
				if (series != null && actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateSeriesLabelOpacity(series))
				{
					if (pointItem.LabelItem != null)
					{
						CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasureRecursive(pointItem.LabelItem.Presentation);
					}
					if (pointItem.TotalLabelItem != null)
					{
						CommonUtils.InvalidateMeasureRecursive(pointItem.TotalLabelItem.Presentation);
					}
				}
			}
			if (series != null)
			{
				series.OnPointProgressChanged();
			}
		}

		private void LabelProgressChanged()
		{
			SeriesPointAnimationBase actualAnimation = GetActualAnimation();
			if (actualAnimation == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in pointItems)
			{
				if (pointItem.PointItemPresentation != null)
				{
					pointItem.PointItemPresentation.InvalidateArrange();
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefinedPointChanged()
		{
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPointItem pointItem in pointItems)
			{
				pointItem.PresentationData.InternalSeriesPoint = SeriesPoint;
			}
		}

		private SeriesPointAnimationBase GetActualAnimation()
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return series.GetActualPointAnimation();
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color? GetCrosshairColor(bool colorEach)
		{
			if (!colorEach)
			{
				if (SeriesPoint is AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedPoint)
				{
					return series.ColorizerController.GetBrushForAggregatedPoint(aggregatedPoint)?.Color;
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Color? color = DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.SeriesPoint.GetPlatformSeriesPoint(SeriesPoint).Color;
				if (color.HasValue)
				{
					return color;
				}
				color = ((XYSeries2D)series).GetPointSeriesSegmentColor(refinedPoint);
				if (color.HasValue)
				{
					return color;
				}
			}
			return PointItems[0].PresentationData.CrosshairPointColor;
		}

		internal double GetLabelOpacity()
		{
			SeriesPointAnimationBase actualAnimation = GetActualAnimation();
			if (actualAnimation == null || !actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateSeriesLabelOpacity(series))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return labelProgress.ActualProgress;
		}

		internal double GetPointOpacity()
		{
			SeriesPointAnimationBase actualAnimation = GetActualAnimation();
			if (actualAnimation == null || !actualAnimation.ShouldAnimateSeriesPointOpacity(series))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return pointProgress.ActualProgress;
		}
	}

	public interface ISupportMeasureNotify
	{
		bool IsMeasuring { get; }

	public static class CommonUtils
	{
		public static Binding CreateBinding(DependencyProperty property, object source)
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(property));
			binding.Source = source;
			return binding;
		}

		public static Binding CreateBinding(string path, object source)
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding(path);
			binding.Source = source;
			return binding;
		}

		public static DoubleCollection CloneDoubleCollection(DoubleCollection collection)
		{
			DoubleCollection doubleCollection = new DoubleCollection();
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (double item in collection)
				{
					doubleCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return doubleCollection;
		}

		private static void InvalidateRecursive(UIElement element, bool invalidateMeasure, bool invalidateArrange)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (invalidateMeasure)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure(element);
			}
			if (invalidateArrange)
			{
				element.InvalidateArrange();
			}
			if (!(element is IFinishInvalidation))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(element); i++)
				{
					InvalidateRecursive(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(element, i) as UIElement, invalidateMeasure, invalidateArrange);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void InvalidateChildren(UIElement element, Predicate<UIElement> predicate, bool invalidateMeasure, bool invalidateArrange)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(element); i++)
			{
				if (!(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(element, i) is UIElement uIElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (predicate(uIElement))
				{
					if (invalidateMeasure)
					{
						InvalidateMeasure(uIElement);
					}
					if (invalidateArrange)
					{
						uIElement.InvalidateArrange();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InvalidateChildren(uIElement, predicate, invalidateMeasure, invalidateArrange);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void InvalidateMeasure(UIElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is ISupportMeasureNotify { IsMeasuring: not false }))
			{
				element?.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		public static void InvalidateMeasureRecursive(UIElement element)
		{
			InvalidateRecursive(element, invalidateMeasure: true, invalidateArrange: false);
		}

		public static void InvalidateArrange(UIElement element)
		{
			InvalidateRecursive(element, invalidateMeasure: false, invalidateArrange: true);
		}

		public static void SubscribePropertyChangedWeakEvent(INotifyPropertyChanged oldSource, INotifyPropertyChanged newSource, IWeakEventListener listener)
		{
			if (listener != null)
			{
				if (oldSource != null)
				{
					PropertyChangedWeakEventManager.RemoveListener(oldSource, listener);
				}
				if (newSource != null)
				{
					PropertyChangedWeakEventManager.AddListener(newSource, listener);
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsCompatibleSeriesForIndicator(Type indicatorType, Series series)
		{
			if (typeof(AverageTrueRange).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return AverageTrueRangeCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(ChaikinsVolatility).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return ChaikinsVolatilityCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(CommodityChannelIndex).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return CommodityChannelIndexCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(MassIndex).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return MassIndexCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(WilliamsR).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return WilliamsRCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(MedianPrice).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return MedianPriceCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(TypicalPrice).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return TypicalPriceCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(WeightedClose).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return WeightedCloseCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			if (typeof(ErrorBars).IsAssignableFrom(indicatorType))
			{
				return ErrorBarsCalculator.IsCompatible(series);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static string[] GetIndicatorsNames(IndicatorCollection indicators)
		{
			int count = indicators.Count;
			string[] array = new string[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = indicators[i].DisplayName;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static List<string> GetCalculatesFieldsNames(ChartCalculatedFieldCollection fields)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < fields.Count; i++)
			{
				string fieldName = fields[i].FieldName;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
				{
					list.Add(fieldName);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public static class ChartInteractionUtils
	{
		public static void MouseDown(ChartControl chart, System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			chart.NavigationController.OnLeftMouseButtonDown(position, MouseButtonState.Pressed, stylusDeviceUsed: false);
		}

		public static void MouseMove(ChartControl chart, System.Windows.Point position)
		{

		private static bool DetectRemoteSession()
		{
			bool flag = false;

			}
		}

	public static class Direct2DCheckingHelper
	{
		public static bool CanUseDirectX()
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			D3D11DeviceContext val = null;
			D3D11Device val2 = null;
			D2D1Factory1 val3 = null;
			D3D11Texture2D val4 = null;
			DXGISurface val5 = null;
			Direct3DSurface9 direct3DSurface = null;
			D2D1RenderTarget val6 = null;
			try
			{
				val2 = D3DNativeInterop.CreateD3D11Device(false, ref val);
				if (val2 == null || val == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				val3 = D2D1NativeInterop.CreateFactory();
				if (val3 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC val7 = D2DRenderer.CreateTextureParams(1920, 1080);
				val4 = val2.CreateTexture2D(val7);
				if (val4 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				val5 = val4.AsSurface();
				if (val5 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_PROPERTIES val8 = D2DRenderer.CreateRenderTargetParams();
				val6 = ((D2D1Factory)val3).CreateDxgiSurfaceRenderTarget(val5, val8);
				if (val6 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				direct3DSurface = Direct3D9Interop.CreateSharedD3D9Surface(val4);
				if (direct3DSurface == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (val5 != null)
				{
					((ComObject)val5).Dispose();
				}
				if (val4 != null)
				{
					((ComObject)val4).Dispose();
				}
				direct3DSurface?.Dispose();
				if (val6 != null)
				{
					((ComObject)val6).Dispose();
				}
				if (val3 != null)
				{
					((ComObject)val3).Dispose();
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					((ComObject)val).Dispose();
				}
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					((ComObject)val2).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class GeometricLine
	{
		private double a;

		private double b;

		private double c;

		public static System.Windows.Point CalculateIntersectionPoint(GeometricLine line1, GeometricLine line2)
		{
			double x = (line1.b * line2.c - line2.b * line1.c) / (line1.a * line2.b - line2.a * line1.b);
			double y = (line1.c * line2.a - line2.c * line1.a) / (line1.a * line2.b - line2.a * line1.b);
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point? CalculateIntersectionPoint(GeometricLine line, GeometricSegment segment)
		{
			GeometricLine line2 = new GeometricLine(segment.Point1, segment.Point2);
			System.Windows.Point point = CalculateIntersectionPoint(line, line2);
			if (segment.Contains(point))
			{
				return point;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public GeometricLine(double a, double b, double c)
		{
			if (a == 0.0 && b == 0.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("At least one of parameters 'a' or 'b' must be non equal to 0");
			}
			this.a = a;
			this.b = b;
			this.c = c;
		}

		public GeometricLine(System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			if (start == end)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Points must be non equal");
			}
			a = start.Y - end.Y;
			b = end.X - start.X;
			c = start.X * end.Y - end.X * start.Y;
		}

		public GeometricLine(GRealPoint2D start, GRealPoint2D end)
		{
			if (start == end)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Points must be non equal");
			}
			a = start.Y - end.Y;
			b = end.X - start.X;
			c = start.X * end.Y - end.X * start.Y;
		}

		public Vector GetDirectingVector()
		{
			return new Vector(0.0 - a, b);
		}

		public Vector GetNormalizedDirectingVector()
		{
			Vector directingVector = GetDirectingVector();
			directingVector.Normalize();
			return directingVector;
		}

		public Vector GetNormalVector()
		{
			return new Vector(a, b);
		}

		public Vector GetNormalizedNormalVector()
		{
			Vector normalVector = GetNormalVector();
			normalVector.Normalize();
			return normalVector;
		}

		public double DistanceToPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return (a * point.X + b * point.Y + c) / Math.Sqrt(a * a + b * b);
		}
	}
	public class GeometricSegment
	{
		public System.Windows.Point Point1 { get; }

		public System.Windows.Point Point2 { get; }

		public GeometricSegment(System.Windows.Point point1, System.Windows.Point point2)
		{
			Point1 = point1;
			Point2 = point2;
		}

		public bool Contains(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return (Point1 - point).Length + (Point2 - point).Length == (Point2 - Point1).Length;
		}
	}

		{
			Series series = null;
			series = ((chart.Diagram != null && chart.Diagram.Series.Count > 0) ? chart.Diagram.Series[0] : ((chart.Diagram == null) ? new BarSideBySideSeries2D() : chart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate.CreateCopyForBinding()));

		private static Series FindStackedBarSeries(Pane pane)
		{
			foreach (Series item in pane.Diagram.Series)
			{
				if (item is BarStackedSeries2D && ((BarStackedSeries2D)item).Pane == pane)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return new BarStackedSeries2D();
		}

		private static object GetPointArgument(Series series)
		{
			object obj = null;
			switch (series.ActualArgumentScaleTypeInternal)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				return 12.3456789;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				return DateTime.Now;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				return new TimeSpan(1, 2, 3, 456);
			case ScaleType.Qualitative:
				if (series.ActualPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					return ((ISeriesPoint)series.ActualPoints[0]).ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument;
				}
				return "A";
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static object GetPointValue(Series series)
		{
			object obj = null;
			return series.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				ScaleType.Numerical => 12.3456789, 
				ScaleType.DateTime => DateTime.Now, 
				ScaleType.TimeSpan => new TimeSpan(1, 2, 3, 456), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
