	public abstract class CrosshairLineRendererBase
	{
		private readonly int width;

		private readonly int height;

		protected int Width => width;

		protected int Height => height;

		public CrosshairLineRendererBase(int width, int height)
		{
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
		}

		public abstract void DrawLine(System.Windows.Point point, System.Windows.Media.Brush lineBrush, LineStyle lineStyle, bool isVertical);

		public abstract ImageBrush CreateBrush();

		public static bool IsSimpleLineStyle(System.Windows.Media.Brush lineBrush, LineStyle lineStyle)
		{
			if (lineBrush is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				return lineStyle.IsSolid;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static CrosshairLineRendererBase CreateRenderer(int width, int height, bool isSimpleRenderer)
		{
			if (!isSimpleRenderer)
			{
				return new CrosshairVisualLineRenderer(width, height);
			}
			return new CrosshairSimpleLineRenderer(width, height);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairSimpleLineRenderer : CrosshairLineRendererBase
	{
		private readonly BitmapRenderer renderer;

		public CrosshairSimpleLineRenderer(int width, int height)
			: base(width, height)
		{
			renderer = new BitmapRenderer(width, height);
		}

		public override void DrawLine(System.Windows.Point point, System.Windows.Media.Brush lineBrush, LineStyle lineStyle, bool isVertical)
		{
			Rect rect = (isVertical ? new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(point.X - (double)lineStyle.Thickness / 2.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(lineStyle.Thickness, base.Height)) : new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, (double)base.Height - point.Y - (double)lineStyle.Thickness / 2.0), new System.Windows.Size(base.Width, lineStyle.Thickness)));
			renderer.DrawRect(rect, null, ((SolidColorBrush)lineBrush).Color);
		}

		public override ImageBrush CreateBrush()
		{
			return new ImageBrush(renderer.CreateTexture());
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairVisualLineRenderer : CrosshairLineRendererBase
	{
		private const double ImageBrushDpi = 96.0;

		private readonly DrawingVisual drawingVisual;

		private readonly DrawingContext drawingContext;

		public CrosshairVisualLineRenderer(int width, int height)
			: base(width, height)
		{
			drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen();
		}

		private ImageBrush CreateBrush(DrawingVisual drawingVisual)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size((double)base.Width * num, (double)base.Height * num);
			if (size.Width < 1.0)
			{
				size.Width = 1.0;
			}
			if (size.Height < 1.0)
			{
				size.Height = 1.0;
			}
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Default);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(drawingVisual);
			return new ImageBrush(renderTargetBitmap);
		}

		public override void DrawLine(System.Windows.Point point, System.Windows.Media.Brush lineBrush, LineStyle lineStyle, bool isVertical)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point2 = (isVertical ? new System.Windows.Point(point.X, 0.0) : new System.Windows.Point(0.0, (double)base.Height - point.Y));
			System.Windows.Point point3 = (isVertical ? new System.Windows.Point(point.X, base.Height) : new System.Windows.Point(base.Width, (double)base.Height - point.Y));
			drawingContext.DrawLine(lineStyle.CreatePen(lineBrush), point2, point3);
		}

		public override ImageBrush CreateBrush()
		{
			if (drawingContext != null)
			{
				drawingContext.Close();
			}
			return CreateBrush(drawingVisual);
		}
	}

	public class XYZAxis3DInfo : Axis3DInfoBase
	{
		public new Axis3DBase Axis => (Axis3DBase)base.Axis;

		public XYZAxis3DInfo(Domain3DBase domain, Axis3DBase axis, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, AxisCache cache, Rect bounds, BoxPlane visiblePlanes)
			: base(domain, axis, gridAndTextData, cache, bounds, visiblePlanes)
		{
		}

		protected override Point3D CalcAxisPoint(double value)
		{
			return base.AxisData.AxisGroup switch
			{
				AxisGroup.ArgumentX => base.AxisDomain.GetClippedDiagramPoint(value, double.NegativeInfinity, double.NegativeInfinity), 
				AxisGroup.ArgumentY => base.AxisDomain.GetClippedDiagramPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, value, double.NegativeInfinity), 
				_ => base.AxisDomain.GetClippedDiagramPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, double.NegativeInfinity, value), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class XYZChartCache : Chart3DCacheBase
	{
		public XYZProjectionContainer ProjectionContainer { get; private set; }

		public Crosshair3DHolder Crosshair3DHolder { get; set; }

		public XYZChartCache()
		{
			ProjectionContainer = new XYZProjectionContainer();
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			ProjectionContainer.Clear();
			Crosshair3DHolder = null;
		}

	public class XYZProjectionContainer
	{
		private IProjectionModelCreator projectionModelCreator;

		private Model3D model;

		public Model3D Model
		{
			get
			{
				if (model == null && projectionModelCreator != null)
				{
					model = projectionModelCreator.CreateProjectionModel();
				}
				return model;
			}
		}

		private double GetProjectionOffset(BoxPlane visiblePlanes, Diagram3DBox diagramBox)
		{
			if (projectionModelCreator.ProjectionBehavior == ProjectionBehavior.Top || (projectionModelCreator.ProjectionBehavior == ProjectionBehavior.Auto && (visiblePlanes & BoxPlane.Top) > BoxPlane.None))
			{
				return diagramBox.InnerHeight;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public void SetProjectionCreator(IProjectionModelCreator projectionModelCreator)
		{
			if (projectionModelCreator != null)
			{
				this.projectionModelCreator = projectionModelCreator;
				model = null;
			}
		}

		public void ApplyProjectionPosition(BoxPlane visiblePlanes, Diagram3DBox diagramBox)
		{
			if (Model != null)
			{
				double projectionOffset = GetProjectionOffset(visiblePlanes, diagramBox);
				Model.Transform = new TranslateTransform3D(new Vector3D(0.0, projectionOffset, 0.0));
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			projectionModelCreator = null;
			model = null;
		}
	}
	public class XYZChartDomain : Domain3DBase, IDomainBox3D
	{
		private readonly XYZAxis3DInfo axisXInfo;

		private readonly XYZAxis3DInfo axisZInfo;

		private readonly XYZAxis3DInfo axisYInfo;

		private readonly AxesBoxCreator boxCreator;

		private readonly BoxPlane visiblePlanes;

		private readonly List<Series3DLabelData> seriesLabelDataList;

		Axis3DInfoBase IDomainBox3D.AxisInfoX => axisXInfo;

		Axis3DInfoBase IDomainBox3D.AxisInfoY => axisYInfo;

		Axis3DInfoBase IDomainBox3D.AxisInfoZ => axisZInfo;

		bool IDomainBox3D.ShowXOZPlane => Chart.ShowXOYPlane;

		bool IDomainBox3D.ShowXOYPlane => Chart.ShowXOZPlane;

		bool IDomainBox3D.ShowYOZPlane => Chart.ShowYOZPlane;

		double IDomainBox3D.PlaneDepthFixed => PlaneDepthFixed;

		double IDomainBox3D.HeightToWidthRatio => base.DiagramBox.Height / base.DiagramBox.Width;

		private double PlaneDepthFixed => Chart.PlaneDepthFixed;

		private List<Series3DLabelData> SeriesLabelDataList => seriesLabelDataList;

		internal AxesBoxCreator BoxCreator => boxCreator;

		protected XYZChartBox ChartBox => (XYZChartBox)base.DiagramBox;

		protected Chart3DControl Chart => (Chart3DControl)base.Diagram;

		Material IDomainBox3D.CreateBackgroundMaterial()
		{
			return new DiffuseMaterial(Chart.DomainBrush);
		}

		Point3D IDomainBox3D.GetClippedDiagramPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value)
		{
			return GetClippedDiagramPoint(argumentX, argumentY, value);
		}

		public XYZChartDomain(Chart3DControl chart, Rect viewport, XYZChartBox chartBox)
			: base(chart, viewport, chartBox)
		{
			XAxis3D actualXAxis = chart.ActualXAxis;
			ZAxis3D actualZAxis = chart.ActualZAxis;
			YAxis3D actualYAxis = chart.ActualYAxis;
			GridAndTextData gridAndTextData = new GridAndTextData(chart.ViewController.GetSeriesByAxis(actualXAxis), actualXAxis, scrollingEnabled: false, actualXAxis.VisualRangeData, base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, actualXAxis.ActualLabel != null && actualXAxis.ActualLabel.Staggered);
			GridAndTextData gridAndTextData2 = new GridAndTextData(chart.ViewController.GetSeriesByAxis(actualZAxis), actualZAxis, scrollingEnabled: false, actualZAxis.VisualRangeData, base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight, actualZAxis.ActualLabel != null && actualZAxis.ActualLabel.Staggered);
			GridAndTextData gridAndTextData3 = new GridAndTextData(chart.ViewController.GetSeriesByAxis(actualYAxis), actualYAxis, scrollingEnabled: false, actualYAxis.VisualRangeData, base.DiagramBox.InnerDepth, actualYAxis.ActualLabel != null && actualYAxis.ActualLabel.Staggered);
			AxisCache axisCache = chart.Cache.GetAxisCache(actualXAxis);
			AxisCache axisCache2 = chart.Cache.GetAxisCache(actualZAxis);
			AxisCache axisCache3 = chart.Cache.GetAxisCache(actualYAxis);
			visiblePlanes = CalcVisiblePlanes();
			axisXInfo = new XYZAxis3DInfo(this, actualXAxis, gridAndTextData, axisCache, new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight)), visiblePlanes);
			axisYInfo = new XYZAxis3DInfo(this, actualZAxis, gridAndTextData2, axisCache2, new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth, base.DiagramBox.InnerHeight)), visiblePlanes);
			axisZInfo = new XYZAxis3DInfo(this, actualYAxis, gridAndTextData3, axisCache3, new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(base.DiagramBox.InnerDepth, base.DiagramBox.InnerWidth)), visiblePlanes);
			boxCreator = new XYZAxesBoxCreator(this, Chart.Cache, base.DiagramBox, visiblePlanes);
			seriesLabelDataList = CreateSeriesDataList();
		}

		private List<Series3DLabelData> CreateSeriesDataList()
		{
			List<Series3DLabelData> list = new List<Series3DLabelData>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in Chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				Series3D series3D = (Series3D)item.Series;
				if (series3D.LabelsVisibility && series3D.GetActualVisible() && series3D.ActualPoints.Count > 0)
				{
					Series3DLabelData series3DLabelData = series3D.CreateSeriesLabelData(ChartBox);
					if (series3DLabelData != null)
					{
						list.Add(series3DLabelData);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Model3D CreateSeriesModel(XYZProjectionContainer projectionContainer)
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in Chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				Series3D series3D = (Series3D)item.Series;
				if (series3D.ActualPoints.Count <= 0 || !series3D.GetActualVisible())
				{
					continue;
				}
				IList<RefinedPoint> continuesDrawingPoints = item.GetContinuesDrawingPoints();
				IEnumerable<IDrawingModelCreator> enumerable = series3D.CreateDrawingModel(continuesDrawingPoints, ChartBox);
				foreach (IDrawingModelCreator item2 in enumerable)
				{
					Model3D model3D = item2.CreateSeriesModel();
					model3DGroup.Children.Add(model3D);
					Chart3DControl.SetSeriesHitTestInfo(model3D, series3D);
					projectionContainer.SetProjectionCreator(item2 as IProjectionModelCreator);
				}
			}
			if (projectionContainer.Model != null)
			{
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(projectionContainer.Model);
			}
			return model3DGroup;
		}

		private void AssignTagObjectToMeshModel(Model3D model, object tag)
		{
			if (model is Model3DGroup model3DGroup)
			{
				{
					foreach (Model3D child in model3DGroup.Children)
					{
						AssignTagObjectToMeshModel(child, tag);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (model is GeometryModel3D { Geometry: MeshGeometry3D geometry })
			{
				geometry.SetValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty, tag);
			}
		}

		private void CreateCrosshairModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder, Crosshair3DHolder crosshairHolder)
		{
			Model3D value = (crosshairHolder.CrosshairModel = CreateCrosshairModel());
			modelHolder.Children.Add(value);
		}

		private Model3D CreateCrosshairModel()
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			if (Chart.ActualCrosshairOptions.ShowMarker)
			{
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(Chart.ActualCrosshairOptions.ActualMarkerModel);
			}
			model3DGroup.Transform = new ScaleTransform3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			AssignTagObjectToMeshModel(model3DGroup, new CrosshairMarker3D());
			return model3DGroup;
		}

		private void CreateSeriesModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			if (Chart.Cache.SeriesModel == null)
			{
				Chart.Cache.SeriesModel = CreateSeriesModel(Chart.Cache.ProjectionContainer);
			}
			modelHolder.Children.Add(Chart.Cache.SeriesModel);
		}

		private void Render3DContent(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			Crosshair3DHolder crosshairHolder = CreateCrosshair3DHolder();
			boxCreator.CreateDiagramModel(modelHolder);
			CreateSeriesModel(modelHolder);
			boxCreator.CreateAxesLabels(modelHolder);
			CreateSeriesLabelsModel(modelHolder);
			CreateCrosshairModel(modelHolder, crosshairHolder);
			Chart.Cache.ProjectionContainer.ApplyProjectionPosition(visiblePlanes, base.DiagramBox);
		}

		private void CreateSeriesLabelsModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			List<LabelModelContainer> list = new List<LabelModelContainer>();
			foreach (Series3DLabelData seriesLabelData in SeriesLabelDataList)
			{
				seriesLabelData.CreateLabelsModel(this, modelHolder, list, Chart.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(seriesLabelData.Series));
			}
			foreach (LabelModelContainer item in list)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(item.Model);
			}
		}

		private Crosshair3DHolder CreateCrosshair3DHolder()
		{
			if (Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder == null)
			{
				Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder = new Crosshair3DHolder();
			}
			Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.AxisXInfo = axisXInfo;
			Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.AxisZInfo = axisZInfo;
			Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.AxisYInfo = axisYInfo;
			Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder.ScaleFactor = base.CrosshairScaleFactor;
			return Chart.Cache.Crosshair3DHolder;
		}

		private bool IsFirstSeriesBar()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in Chart.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				if (item.Series.Visible)
				{
					return item.Series.SeriesView is IXYZBarSeriesView;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private BoxPlane CalcVisiblePlanes()
		{
			BoxPlane boxPlane = BoxPlane.None;
			Point3D point = new Point3D((0.0 - base.DiagramBox.Width) / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			Point3D point2 = new Point3D(base.DiagramBox.Width / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			Point3D point3 = new Point3D(0.0, 0.0, (0.0 - base.DiagramBox.Depth) / 2.0);
			Point3D point4 = new Point3D(0.0, 0.0, base.DiagramBox.Depth / 2.0);
			Point3D point5 = new Point3D(0.0, (0.0 - base.DiagramBox.Height) / 2.0, 0.0);
			Point3D point6 = new Point3D(0.0, base.DiagramBox.Height / 2.0, 0.0);
			point = Chart.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point);
			point2 = Chart.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point2);
			point3 = Chart.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point3);
			point4 = Chart.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point4);
			point5 = Chart.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point5);
			point6 = Chart.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point6);
			double num = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point);
			double num2 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point2);
			double num3 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point3);
			double num4 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point4);
			double num5 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point5);
			double num6 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point6);
			boxPlane = (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((num < num2) ? 32 : 16));
			boxPlane = (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((!(num3 < num4)) ? 1 : 2));
			return (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((num6 < num5 || IsFirstSeriesBar()) ? 4 : 8));
		}

		public void Render(Viewport3D visualContainer)
		{
			ModelVisual3D modelVisual3D = new ModelVisual3D();
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			model3DGroup.Transform = base.ModelTransform;
			Render3DContent(model3DGroup);
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup2 = new Model3DGroup();
			model3DGroup2.Children.Add(CreateLighting());
			model3DGroup2.Children.Add(model3DGroup);
			modelVisual3D.Content = model3DGroup2;
			visualContainer.Camera = base.Camera;
			visualContainer.Children.Add(modelVisual3D);
			visualContainer.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(base.Viewport);
		}

		public Point3D GetClippedDiagramPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value)
		{
			return ChartBox.GetClippedDiagramPoint(argumentX, argumentY, value);
		}

		public void ValidateSeriesPointsCache()
		{
			foreach (Series3DLabelData seriesLabelData in SeriesLabelDataList)
			{
				if (seriesLabelData.Series.LabelsVisibility)
				{
					seriesLabelData.ValidateSeriesPointsCache(this, Chart.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(seriesLabelData.Series));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYZChartBox : Diagram3DBox, IDiagramMapping
	{
		private readonly Chart3DControl chart;

		private readonly IAxisMappingCore axisXMapping;

		private readonly IAxisMappingCore axisZMapping;

		private readonly IAxisMappingCore axisYMapping;

		private readonly double correction;

		private XAxis3D AxisX => chart.ActualXAxis;

		private YAxis3D AxisZ => chart.ActualYAxis;

		private ZAxis3D AxisY => chart.ActualZAxis;

		public IMinMaxValues ValuesRange => AxisY.VisualRangeData;

		public override double SideCorrection => correction;

		public XYZChartBox(Chart3DControl chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			correction = chart.PlaneDepthFixed + 1.0;
			Size3D drawingSize = chart.DrawingSize;
			base.InnerWidth = drawingSize.X;
			base.InnerHeight = drawingSize.Y;
			base.InnerDepth = drawingSize.Z;
			axisXMapping = AxisX.CreateMapping(null, new Rect(new System.Windows.Size(base.InnerWidth, base.InnerHeight)));
			axisZMapping = AxisZ.CreateMapping(null, new Rect(new System.Windows.Size(base.InnerDepth, base.InnerWidth)));
			axisYMapping = AxisY.CreateMapping(null, new Rect(new System.Windows.Size(base.InnerWidth, base.InnerHeight)));
		}

		public Point3D GetDiagramPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value)
		{
			return new Point3D(axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(argumentX), axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(value), axisZMapping.GetAxisValue(argumentY));
		}

		public Point3D GetInternalPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value)
		{
			return new Point3D(axisXMapping.GetInternalCoord(argumentX), axisYMapping.GetInternalCoord(value), axisZMapping.GetInternalCoord(argumentY));
		}

		public Point3D GetClippedDiagramPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value)
		{
			return new Point3D(axisXMapping.GetClampedAxisValue(argumentX), axisYMapping.GetClampedAxisValue(value), axisZMapping.GetClampedAxisValue(argumentY));
		}

		public override Transform3D CreateModelTransform()
		{
			return new TranslateTransform3D((0.0 - base.InnerWidth) * 0.5, (0.0 - base.InnerHeight) * 0.5, (0.0 - base.InnerDepth) * 0.5);
		}

		public double GetValueByAxisX(double value)
		{
			return Math.Abs(axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(0.0) - axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}

		public double GetValueByAxisZ(double value)
		{
			return Math.Abs(axisZMapping.GetAxisValue(0.0) - axisZMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}

		public double GetValueByAxisY(double value)
		{
			return Math.Abs(axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(0.0) - axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}

		public double GetAbsoluteValueByAxisY(double value)
		{
			return Math.Abs(axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}
	}
	public abstract class Axis3DInfoBase
	{
		private const int ElementIndent = 3;

		private readonly Domain3DBase domain;

		private readonly Axis3D axis;

		private readonly Axis3DMappingCore axisMapping;

		private readonly GridAndTextData gridAndTextData;

		private readonly AxisCache cache;

		private readonly BoxPlane planes;

		private readonly Vector3D positionOffset;

		private readonly Vector3D positionOffsetWithPlaneDepth;

		private readonly Vector direction;

		protected Domain3DBase Domain => domain;

		protected BoxPlane Planes => planes;

		protected IDomainBox3D AxisDomain => (IDomainBox3D)domain;

		protected IAxisData AxisData => axis;

		public Axis3D Axis => axis;

		public Axis3DMappingCore AxisMapping => axisMapping;

		public GridAndTextData GridAndTextData => gridAndTextData;

		public Vector3D PositionOffset => positionOffset;

		public Vector Direction => direction;

		protected Axis3DInfoBase(Domain3DBase domain, Axis3D axis, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, AxisCache cache, Rect bounds, BoxPlane visiblePlanes)
		{
			this.domain = domain;
			this.axis = axis;
			axisMapping = (Axis3DMappingCore)axis.CreateMapping(null, bounds);
			this.gridAndTextData = gridAndTextData;
			this.cache = cache;
			planes = visiblePlanes;
			positionOffset = CalculatePositionOffsets();
			positionOffsetWithPlaneDepth = positionOffset + CalculatePlaneDepthOffset();
			direction = CalculateDirection();
		}

		private Vector CalculateDirection()
		{
			Point3D point = CalcDrawingAxisPoint(double.PositiveInfinity);
			Point3D point2 = CalcDrawingAxisPoint(double.NegativeInfinity);
			System.Windows.Point point3 = domain.Project(point);
			System.Windows.Point point4 = domain.Project(point2);
			System.Windows.Point point5 = ((AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.ArgumentY) ? domain.Project(new Point3D(((planes & BoxPlane.Right) != BoxPlane.None) ? (domain.DiagramBox.Width - 2.0 * AxisDomain.PlaneDepthFixed) : 0.0, (point.Y + point2.Y) / 2.0, (point.Z + point2.Z) / 2.0)) : domain.Project(new Point3D((point.X + point2.X) / 2.0, (point.Y + point2.Y) / 2.0, ((planes & BoxPlane.Fore) != BoxPlane.None) ? (domain.DiagramBox.Depth - 2.0 * AxisDomain.PlaneDepthFixed) : 0.0)));
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = GeometricUtils.CalcLinesIntersection(line2P2: new GRealPoint2D(point5.X - (point3.Y - point4.Y), point5.Y + (point3.X - point4.X)), line1P1: new GRealPoint2D(point4.X, point4.Y), line1P2: new GRealPoint2D(point3.X, point3.Y), line2P1: new GRealPoint2D(point5.X, point5.Y), intervalMode: false);
			Vector result = ((!gRealPoint2D.HasValue) ? default(Vector) : new Vector(gRealPoint2D.Value.X - point5.X, gRealPoint2D.Value.Y - point5.Y));
			result.Normalize();
			return result;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetRotationOffset(System.Windows.Size presenterSize)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.NormalizeAngle(360 - axis.ActualLabel.Angle);
			double num2 = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(num);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = default(GRealPoint2D);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = default(GRealPoint2D);
			if (!axis.IsVertical && direction.Y >= 0.0)
			{
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(presenterSize.Width / 2.0, presenterSize.Height, presenterSize.Width, presenterSize.Height);
				gRealPoint2D = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateOffset(AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForTopNearPosition(num), gRealRect2D, num2);
				gRealPoint2D2 = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForTopPosition(gRealRect2D, num, num2, useBoundsRounding: false);
			}
			if (!axis.IsVertical && direction.Y < 0.0)
			{
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(presenterSize.Width / 2.0, 0.0, presenterSize.Width, presenterSize.Height);
				gRealPoint2D = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateOffset(AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForBottomNearPosition(num), gRealRect2D, num2);
				gRealPoint2D2 = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForBottomPosition(gRealRect2D, num, num2, useBoundsRounding: false);
			}
			if (axis.IsVertical && (planes & BoxPlane.Left) != BoxPlane.None)
			{
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(presenterSize.Width, presenterSize.Height / 2.0, presenterSize.Width, presenterSize.Height);
				gRealPoint2D = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateOffset(AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForLeftNearPosition(num), gRealRect2D, num2);
				gRealPoint2D2 = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForLeftPosition(gRealRect2D, num, num2, useBoundsRounding: false);
			}
			if (axis.IsVertical && (planes & BoxPlane.Right) != BoxPlane.None)
			{
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(0.0, presenterSize.Height / 2.0, presenterSize.Width, presenterSize.Height);
				gRealPoint2D = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateOffset(AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForRightNearPosition(num), gRealRect2D, num2);
				gRealPoint2D2 = AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForRightPosition(gRealRect2D, num, num2, useBoundsRounding: false);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(gRealPoint2D2.X + gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.Y + gRealPoint2D.Y);
		}

		private Vector CreateLabels(IList<LabelModelContainer> textElements, IList<AxisTextItem> items, double initialStaggeredSize)
		{
			Vector offset = direction * 3.0 + new Vector(0.0, initialStaggeredSize);
			Vector result = default(Vector);
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			foreach (AxisTextItem item in items)
			{
				ContentPresenter labelPresenter = cache.GetLabelPresenter(axis, item);
				Vector vector = new Vector(direction.X * labelPresenter.DesiredSize.Width, direction.Y * labelPresenter.DesiredSize.Height);
				if (vector.LengthSquared > result.LengthSquared)
				{
					result = vector;
				}
				Point3D point3D = CalcCenter(item.Value, offset, vector, labelPresenter.DesiredSize);
				Point3D point = domain.Project3D(point3D);
				point.Offset(vector.X, vector.Y, 0.0);
				Point3D point3D2 = domain.RestoredFromProject3D(point);
				Vector3D vector3D = point3D2 - point3D;
				System.Windows.Point rotationOffset = GetRotationOffset(labelPresenter.DesiredSize);
				LabelModelContainer labelModelContainer = Label3DHelper.CreateLabelModelContainer(domain, labelPresenter, cache.GetModel(axis.ActualLabel, labelPresenter), point3D, vector3D, LabelRenderMode.Rectangle, axis.ActualLabel.Angle, rotationOffset);
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(labelModelContainer.Model);
				textElements.Add(labelModelContainer);
			}
			if (((IInteractiveElement)axis).IsSelected && model3DGroup.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				Model3D model3D = CreateBoundingBox(model3DGroup.Bounds);
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(model3D);
				textElements.Add(new LabelModelContainer(model3D, 0.0));
			}
			Chart3DControl.SetAxis3DHitTestInfo(model3DGroup, axis);
			return result;
		}

		private Model3D CreateBoundingBox(Rect3D bounds)
		{
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			meshGeometry3D.Positions = new Point3DCollection
			{
				new Point3D(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Z),
				new Point3D(bounds.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Y, bounds.Z),
				new Point3D(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.SizeY, bounds.Z),
				new Point3D(bounds.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Y + bounds.SizeY, bounds.Z),
				new Point3D(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Z + bounds.SizeZ),
				new Point3D(bounds.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Y, bounds.Z + bounds.SizeZ),
				new Point3D(bounds.X, bounds.Y + bounds.SizeY, bounds.Z + bounds.SizeZ),
				new Point3D(bounds.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Y + bounds.SizeY, bounds.Z + bounds.SizeZ)
			};
			meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices = new Int32Collection
			{
				2, 3, 1, 2, 1, 0, 7, 1, 3, 7,
				5, 1, 6, 5, 7, 6, 4, 5, 6, 2,
				0, 6, 0, 4, 2, 7, 3, 2, 6, 7,
				0, 1, 5, 0, 5, 4
			};
			return new GeometryModel3D(meshGeometry3D, new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(VisualSelectionHelper.SelectionColor3D)));
		}

		private Vector3D CalculatePositionOffsets()
		{
			Vector3D result = default(Vector3D);
			if ((AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.Value && (planes & BoxPlane.Right) > BoxPlane.None) || (AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.ArgumentY && (planes & BoxPlane.Left) > BoxPlane.None))
			{
				result.X = domain.DiagramBox.InnerWidth;
			}
			if (AxisData.AxisGroup != AxisGroup.Value && (planes & BoxPlane.Top) != BoxPlane.None)
			{
				result.Y = domain.DiagramBox.InnerHeight;
			}
			if (AxisData.AxisGroup != AxisGroup.ArgumentY && (planes & BoxPlane.Back) != BoxPlane.None)
			{
				result.Z = domain.DiagramBox.InnerDepth;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Vector3D CalculatePlaneDepthOffset()
		{
			Vector3D result = default(Vector3D);
			if (AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.Value)
			{
				if ((Planes & BoxPlane.Left) > BoxPlane.None)
				{
					result.X -= AxisDomain.PlaneDepthFixed;
				}
				else if ((Planes & BoxPlane.Right) > BoxPlane.None)
				{
					result.X += AxisDomain.PlaneDepthFixed;
				}
			}
			if (AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.ArgumentX || AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.ArgumentY)
			{
				if ((Planes & BoxPlane.Bottom) > BoxPlane.None)
				{
					result.Y -= AxisDomain.PlaneDepthFixed;
				}
				else if ((Planes & BoxPlane.Top) > BoxPlane.None)
				{
					result.Y += AxisDomain.PlaneDepthFixed;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Vector CalculateOffsetDiagonalInfluence(Vector direction, Vector offset)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(direction.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(direction.Y);
			double num3 = ((num <= 0.5) ? (num / 0.5) : ((1.0 - num) / 0.5));
			double num4 = ((num2 <= 0.5) ? (num2 / 0.5) : (0.5 / num2));
			return new Vector(offset.X * num3, offset.Y * num4);
		}

		protected abstract Point3D CalcAxisPoint(double value);

		protected Point3D CalcCenter(double value, Vector offset, Vector angleDirection, System.Windows.Size labelSize)
		{
			Point3D point3D = CalcCenter(value, offset);
			if (Axis.AxisGroupType == AxisGroup.Value || (planes & BoxPlane.Bottom) == 0)
			{
				return point3D;
			}
			Point3D point = Domain.Project3D(point3D);
			point.Offset(angleDirection.X, angleDirection.Y, 0.0);
			Point3D point3D2 = Label3DHelper.CalcRectangleLocation(Domain.RotationOnlyTransform.Transform(Domain.RestoredFromProject3D(point) - point3D), new Rect(new System.Windows.Point((0.0 - labelSize.Width) / 2.0, (0.0 - labelSize.Height) / 2.0), labelSize));
			Matrix3D value2 = new TranslateTransform3D(point3D2.X, point3D2.Y, point3D2.Z).Value;
			value2.Append(Domain.CreateScaleTransform(point3D).Value);
			value2.Append(Domain.BackwardRotationOnlyTransform.Value);
			value2.Translate(new Vector3D(point3D.X, point3D.Y, point3D.Z));
			Model3D model = new LabelPlaneRectangle(default(Point3D), labelSize.Width, labelSize.Height).GetModel();
			model.Transform = new MatrixTransform3D(value2);
			double num = 1000.0 * AxisDomain.HeightToWidthRatio * 0.002;
			double num2 = model.Bounds.Y + model.Bounds.SizeY + num - CalcDrawingAxisPoint(value).Y;
			if (num2 <= 0.0)
			{
				return point3D;
			}
			point3D.Y -= num2;
			Point3D point2 = Domain.ModelTransform.Transform(point3D);
			double num3 = (Domain.DiagramBox.Width * Domain.DiagramBox.Width + Domain.DiagramBox.Height * Domain.DiagramBox.Height + Domain.DiagramBox.Depth * Domain.DiagramBox.Depth) / (2.0 * (point2.X * point2.X + point2.Y * point2.Y + point2.Z * point2.Z));
			if (num3 >= 1.0)
			{
				return point3D;
			}
			point2.X *= num3;
			point2.Y *= num3;
			point2.Z *= num3;
			return Domain.BackwardModelTransform.Transform(point2);
		}

		protected Point3D CalcDrawingAxisPoint(double value)
		{
			Point3D point3D = CalcAxisPoint(value);
			return point3D + positionOffsetWithPlaneDepth;
		}

		protected Point3D CalcCenter(double value, Vector offset)
		{
			Point3D point = domain.Project3D(CalcDrawingAxisPoint(value));
			point.Offset(offset.X, offset.Y, 0.0);
			return domain.RestoredFromProject3D(point);
		}

		public void CreateLabelsAndTitle(List<LabelModelContainer> textElements)
		{
			Vector vector = default(Vector);
			if (axis.LabelsVisible)
			{
				vector = CreateLabels(textElements, gridAndTextData.GetTextData().PrimaryItems, 0.0);
				vector.Y += CreateLabels(textElements, gridAndTextData.GetTextData().StaggeredItems, vector.Y).Y;
			}
			if (axis.IsTitleVisible)
			{
				ContentPresenter titlePresenter = cache.GetTitlePresenter(axis);
				System.Windows.Point p = domain.Project(CalcDrawingAxisPoint(double.PositiveInfinity));
				System.Windows.Point p2 = domain.Project(CalcDrawingAxisPoint(double.NegativeInfinity));
				double num = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p, p2);
				double num2 = ((num < 1.0) ? 0.0 : (((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange.Delta * titlePresenter.DesiredSize.Width / (num * 2.0)));
				double num3 = titlePresenter.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0;
				double value;
				switch (axis.Title.Alignment)
				{
				case TitleAlignment.Near:
					value = ((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange.Min + num2;
					break;
				case TitleAlignment.Center:
					value = (((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange.Max + ((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange.Min) / 2.0;
					break;
				case TitleAlignment.Far:
					value = ((IAxisData)axis).VisualRange.Max - num2;
					break;
				default:
					ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown AxisTitle alignment.");
					goto case TitleAlignment.Center;
				}
				Matrix3D value2 = new TranslateTransform3D((0.0 - titlePresenter.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0, 0.0 - num3, 0.0).Value;
				double num4 = MathUtils.Radian2Degree(GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(Math.Atan2(p.Y - p2.Y, p.X - p2.X)));
				if (num4 > 90.0 && num4 < 270.0)
				{
					num4 -= 180.0;
				}
				value2.Append(new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0 - num4)).Value);
				Vector vector2 = direction * axis.Title.Margin.Top;
				Vector offset = vector + direction * (3.0 + num3) + CalculateOffsetDiagonalInfluence(direction, vector) + vector2;
				Point3D center = CalcCenter(value, offset);
				textElements.Add(Label3DHelper.CreateModelContainer(domain, cache.GetModel(axis.Title, titlePresenter), center, value2));
			}
		}
	}
	public class Axis3DInfo : Axis3DInfoBase
	{
		public Axis3DInfo(Domain3DBase domain, Axis3D axis, GridAndTextData gridAndTextData, AxisCache cache, Rect bounds, BoxPlane visiblePlanes)
			: base(domain, axis, gridAndTextData, cache, bounds, visiblePlanes)
		{
		}

		protected override Point3D CalcAxisPoint(double value)
		{
			if (base.AxisData.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.Value)
			{
				return base.AxisDomain.GetClippedDiagramPoint(double.NegativeInfinity, 0.0, value);
			}
			return base.AxisDomain.GetClippedDiagramPoint(value, 0.0, double.NegativeInfinity);
		}
	}
	public class StripLimit : IStripLimit, IAxisValueContainer
	{
		private readonly Strip strip;

		private readonly double infinity;

		private object axisValue;

		private double value = double.NaN;

		private bool IsEnabled => axisValue != null;

		public object AxisValue => axisValue;

		public double ActualValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEnabled || double.IsNaN(value))
				{
					return infinity;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		IAxisData IAxisValueContainer.Axis => strip.Axis;

		bool IAxisValueContainer.IsEnabled => IsEnabled;

		CultureInfo IAxisValueContainer.Culture => CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

		object IAxisValueContainer.UserValue => axisValue;

		object IAxisValueContainer.AxisValue
		{
			get
			{
				return axisValue;
			}
			set
			{
				axisValue = value;
			}
		}

		double IAxisValueContainer.Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public StripLimit(Strip strip, double infinity)
		{
			this.strip = strip;
			this.infinity = infinity;
		}

		public void UpdateAxisValue(object axisValue)

			if (axisValue == null)

				value = double.NaN;
			}
		}
	}
	internal delegate void BindingHandler(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates);
	internal class BindingBehavior : IWeakEventListener
	{
		private readonly IBindingProvider bindingProvider;

		private bool isDataSourceRecreated;

		private object dataSource;

		private object actualDataSource;

		private DataSet dataSet;

		private DataSourceProvider dataSourceProvider;

		public object ActualDataSource => actualDataSource;

		public event BindingHandler ActualDataSourceChanged;

		public BindingBehavior(IBindingProvider bindingProvider)
		{
			this.bindingProvider = bindingProvider;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(DataChangedEventManager))
			{
				DataProviderDataChanged();
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(bindingProvider, (NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs)e);
				DataSourceChanged(updates);
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(ListChangedEventManager))
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates2 = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection(bindingProvider, (ListChangedEventArgs)e);
				DataSourceChanged(updates2);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object GetOriginalDataSource(object bindingDataSource)
		{
			BindingListAdapterBase val = (BindingListAdapterBase)((bindingDataSource is BindingListAdapterBase) ? bindingDataSource : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.OriginalDataSource;
			}
			return bindingDataSource;
		}

		private object GetBindingDataSource(object originalDataSource)
		{
			if (originalDataSource is IList source && originalDataSource is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				ChartBindingListAdapter chartBindingListAdapter = new ChartBindingListAdapter(source, (ItemPropertyNotificationMode)(originalDataSource is INotifyPropertyChanged));
				((BindingListAdapterBase)chartBindingListAdapter).OriginalDataSource = originalDataSource;
				return chartBindingListAdapter;
			}
			return originalDataSource;
		}

		private void ProcessActualDataSource(object originalDataSource)
		{
			ClearDataSet();
			isDataSourceRecreated = false;
			if (originalDataSource is ICollectionViewFactory)
			{
				ICollectionView collectionView = ((ICollectionViewFactory)originalDataSource).CreateView();
				actualDataSource = DataBindingHelper.ExtractDataSource((object)collectionView, true, false, false);
				isDataSourceRecreated = true;
			}
			else if (originalDataSource is ICollectionView)
			{
				actualDataSource = DataBindingHelper.ExtractDataSource(originalDataSource, true, false, false);
				isDataSourceRecreated = true;
			}
			else if (originalDataSource is IList || originalDataSource is IListSource)
			{
				actualDataSource = PerformListDataSource(originalDataSource);
			}
			else
			{
				actualDataSource = null;
			}
			if (actualDataSource == null && originalDataSource is IEnumerable)
			{
				actualDataSource = PerformEnumerableDataSource((IEnumerable)originalDataSource);
			}
		}

		private void ClearDataSource()
		{
			UnregisterIfBindingList(dataSource);
			UnregisterIfBindingList(actualDataSource);
			if (dataSource is INotifyCollectionChanged source)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(source, this);
			}
			actualDataSource = null;
			dataSource = null;
			ClearDataSet();
		}

		private void SetDataSource(object originalDataSource)
		{
			ClearDataSource();
			if (originalDataSource != null)
			{
				object bindingDataSource = GetBindingDataSource(originalDataSource);
				RegisterIfBindingList(bindingDataSource);
				if (bindingDataSource is INotifyCollectionChanged source)
				{
					CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(source, this);
				}
				ProcessActualDataSource(originalDataSource);
				dataSource = bindingDataSource;
			}
		}

		private void RegisterIfBindingList(object source)
		{
			if (source is IBindingList bindingList)
			{
				ListChangedEventManager.AddListener(bindingList, (IWeakEventListener)this);
			}
		}

		private void UnregisterIfBindingList(object source)
		{
			if (source is IBindingList bindingList)
			{
				ListChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(bindingList, (IWeakEventListener)this);
			}
		}

		private void CreateDataSet(XmlNode node)
		{
			XmlNodeReader xmlNodeReader = new XmlNodeReader(node);
			try
			{
				dataSet = new DataSet();
				dataSet.ReadXml(xmlNodeReader);
			}
			finally
			{
				xmlNodeReader.Close();
			}
		}

		private void DataProviderDataChanged()
		{
			if (dataSourceProvider != null)
			{
				SetDataSource(dataSourceProvider.Data);
			}
			DataSourceReseted();
		}

		private void ClearDataSet()
		{
			if (dataSet != null)
			{
				dataSet.Dispose();
				dataSet = null;
			}
		}

		private void BeforeUpdateDataSource()
		{
			if (dataSourceProvider != null)
			{
				DataChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(dataSourceProvider, this);
			}
		}

		private object PerformNewDataSource(object newDataSource)
		{
			dataSourceProvider = newDataSource as DataSourceProvider;
			if (dataSourceProvider != null)
			{
				DataChangedEventManager.AddListener(dataSourceProvider, this);
				return dataSourceProvider.Data;
			}
			if (newDataSource is MarkupExtension markupExtension)
			{
				return markupExtension.ProvideValue(null);
			}
			return newDataSource;
		}

		private object PerformEnumerableDataSource(IEnumerable enumerable)
		{
			XmlNode xmlNode = enumerable as XmlNode;
			IList list = enumerable as IList;
			if (xmlNode != null)
			{
				return PerformXmlNode(xmlNode);
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				return enumerable;
			}
			return new ChartEnumerableWrapper(enumerable);
		}

		private object PerformListDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource is ICollection { Count: 1 } collection)
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = collection.GetEnumerator();
				if (enumerator != null && enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator.Current is XmlNode node)
				{
					CreateDataSet(node);
					return dataSet;
				}
			}
			if (dataSource is IListSource listSource)
			{
				IList list;
				try
				{
					list = listSource.GetList();
					RegisterIfBindingList(list);
				}
				catch
				{
					list = null;
				}
				return list;
			}
			return dataSource;
		}

		private object PerformXmlNode(XmlNode node)
		{
			if (node == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.Name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlNode node2 = ((node.ParentNode != null) ? node.ParentNode : node);
			CreateDataSet(node2);
			return dataSet.Tables[node.Name];
		}

		private void DataSourceReseted()
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates = DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.CreateReset(bindingProvider);
			DataSourceChanged(updates);
		}

		private void DataSourceChanged(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			if (isDataSourceRecreated)
			{
				ProcessActualDataSource(GetOriginalDataSource(dataSource));
			}
			updates.AddRange(CopySeriesDataSourceUpdates(updates));
			this.ActualDataSourceChanged(updates);
		}

		protected virtual DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection CopySeriesDataSourceUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates, bool isAllSeries = false)
		{
			return new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
		}

		internal void ResetData(bool isAllSeriesReset = true)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.CreateReset(bindingProvider);
			dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddRange(CopySeriesDataSourceUpdates(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection, isAllSeriesReset));
			this.ActualDataSourceChanged(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
		}

		public void UpdateActualDataSource(object newDataSource)
		{
			BeforeUpdateDataSource();
			if (newDataSource != null)
			{
				SetDataSource(PerformNewDataSource(newDataSource));
			}
			else
			{
				ClearDataSource();
			}
			DataSourceReseted();
		}
	}
	internal class ChartBindingBehavior : BindingBehavior
	{
		private readonly ChartControl chartControl;

		private Diagram Diagram => chartControl.Diagram;

		public ChartBindingBehavior(ChartControl owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			chartControl = owner;
		}

		protected override DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection CopySeriesDataSourceUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates, bool isAllSeries = false)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			if (Diagram != null)
			{
				foreach (Series item in Diagram.Series)
				{
					if (item.IsAutoSeries || (!isAllSeries && item.SeriesDataSource != null))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
					{
						dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(item, update.Type, update.Index, update.Count));
					}
				}
			}
			return dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection;
		}
	}
	internal class ChartEnumerableWrapper : IEnumerable<object>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class ChartEnumeratorWrapper : IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly IEnumerator enumerator;

			object IEnumerator<object>.Current => enumerator.Current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => enumerator.Current;

			public ChartEnumeratorWrapper(IEnumerator enumerator)
			{
				this.enumerator = enumerator;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				return enumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				enumerator.Reset();
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly IEnumerable source;

		public ChartEnumerableWrapper(IEnumerable source)
		{
			this.source = source;
		}

		IEnumerator<object> IEnumerable<object>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ChartEnumeratorWrapper(source.GetEnumerator());
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return source.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class ChartBindingListAdapter : BindingListAdapterBase, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public ChartBindingListAdapter(IList source)
			: base(source)
		{
		}

		public ChartBindingListAdapter(IList source, ItemPropertyNotificationMode itemPropertyNotificationMode)
			: base(source, itemPropertyNotificationMode)
		{
		}//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		protected ChartBindingListAdapter(IList source, ItemPropertyNotificationMode itemPropertyNotificationMode, bool doSubscribe)
			: base(source, itemPropertyNotificationMode, doSubscribe)
		{
		}//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		private int CoerceStartIndex(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = base.source.IndexOf(e.NewItems[0]);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("A collection Add event refers to item that does not belong to collection.");
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(IList oldItems, bool needCheckItemLoading)
		{
			if (!((BindingListAdapterBase)this).ShouldSubscribePropertiesChanged || oldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < oldItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!needCheckItemLoading || ((BindingListAdapterBase)this).IsItemLoaded(i))
				{
					((BindingListAdapterBase)this).UnsubscribeItemPropertyChangedEvent(oldItems[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(int startIndex, Func<int> getCount)
		{
			if (!((BindingListAdapterBase)this).ShouldSubscribePropertiesChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = getCount();
			for (int i = startIndex; i < num + startIndex; i++)
			{
				if (((BindingListAdapterBase)this).IsItemLoaded(i))
				{
					((BindingListAdapterBase)this).SubscribeItemPropertyChangedEvent(base.source[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				int startIndex = CoerceStartIndex(e);
				RaiseCollectionChanged(e);
				SubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(startIndex, () => e.NewItems.Count);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				if (e.NewItems.Count == 1)
				{
					if (e.OldStartingIndex < 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot find moved item index.");
					}
					((BindingListAdapterBase)this).NotifyChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.ItemMoved, e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldStartingIndex));
				}
				else
				{
					((BindingListAdapterBase)this).NotifyChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, e.NewStartingIndex));
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (e.OldStartingIndex < 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot find removed item.");
				}
				RaiseCollectionChanged(e);
				UnsubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(e.OldItems, needCheckItemLoading: false);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				int startIndex = CoerceStartIndex(e);
				RaiseCollectionChanged(e);
				UnsubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(e.OldItems, needCheckItemLoading: false);
				SubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(startIndex, () => e.NewItems.Count);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				((BindingListAdapterBase)this).NotifyChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, e.NewStartingIndex));
				UnsubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(base.source, needCheckItemLoading: true);
				SubscribeItemsPropertyChangedEvent(0, () => base.source.Count);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisCache
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<int, System.Windows.Media.Brush> elementsBrushes = new Dictionary<int, System.Windows.Media.Brush>();

		private readonly Dictionary<object, ContentPresenter> axisLabels = new Dictionary<object, ContentPresenter>();

		private readonly Dictionary<int, Model3D> axisModels = new Dictionary<int, Model3D>();

		private ContentPresenter axisTitle;

		private static Thickness EmptyThickness;

		private static ContentPresenter CreateContentPresenter(DataTemplate template, object content)
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			contentPresenter.Content = content;
			contentPresenter.ContentTemplate = template;
			contentPresenter.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			contentPresenter.Arrange(new Rect
			{
				Width = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width,
				Height = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height
			});
			return contentPresenter;
		}

		public ContentPresenter GetLabelPresenter(Axis axis, AxisTextItem textItem)
		{
			object content = textItem.Content;
			if (!axisLabels.TryGetValue(content, out var value))
			{
				DataTemplate template = null;
				AxisLabel actualLabel = axis.ActualLabel;
				if (actualLabel != null)
				{
					template = actualLabel.GetItemTemplate();
				}
				value = CreateContentPresenter(template, textItem);
				axisLabels.Add(content, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void ProcessTitleMargin(ContentPresenter contentPresenter, AxisTitle title)
		{
			if (!title.Margin.Equals(EmptyThickness))
			{
				contentPresenter.Margin = new Thickness(0.0 - title.Margin.Left, 0.0 - title.Margin.Top, 0.0 - title.Margin.Right, 0.0 - title.Margin.Bottom);
				contentPresenter.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				contentPresenter.Arrange(new Rect
				{
					Width = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width,
					Height = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height
				});
			}
		}

		public ContentPresenter GetTitlePresenter(Axis axis)
		{
			if (axisTitle == null)
			{
				AxisTitle title = axis.Title;
				DataTemplate template = null;
				if (title != null)
				{
					template = TemplateHelper.GetAxisTitleTemplate(title);
				}
				axisTitle = CreateContentPresenter(template, title);
				ProcessTitleMargin(axisTitle, title);
			}
			return axisTitle;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			elementsBrushes.Clear();
			axisModels.Clear();
			foreach (ContentPresenter value in axisLabels.Values)
			{
				value.ContentTemplate = null;
				value.Content = null;
			}
			axisLabels.Clear();
			if (axisTitle != null)
			{
				axisTitle.ContentTemplate = null;
				axisTitle.Content = null;
				axisTitle = null;
			}
		}

		public Model3D GetModel(ISupportFlowDirection supportFlowDirection, ContentPresenter presenter)
		{
			int hashCode = presenter.GetHashCode();
			if (!axisModels.ContainsKey(hashCode))
			{
				axisModels.Add(hashCode, Label3DHelper.CreateModel(presenter, supportFlowDirection));
			}
			return axisModels[hashCode];
		}
	}
	public abstract class Diagram3DDomain : Domain3DBase
	{
		private readonly IList<SeriesData> seriesDataList;

		protected new Diagram3D Diagram => (Diagram3D)base.Diagram;

		public IList<SeriesData> SeriesDataList => seriesDataList;

		public Diagram3DDomain(Diagram3D diagram, Rect viewport, IList<SeriesData> seriesDataList, Diagram3DBox diagramBox)
			: base(diagram, viewport, diagramBox)
		{
			this.seriesDataList = seriesDataList;
		}

		public virtual void ValidateSeriesPointsCache()
		{
			foreach (SeriesData seriesData in seriesDataList)
			{
				seriesData.ValidateSeriesPointsCache(this, Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(seriesData.Series));
			}
		}

		public void Render(VisualContainer visualContainer)
		{
			Viewport3DVisual viewport3DVisual = new Viewport3DVisual();
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			ModelVisual3D modelVisual3D = new ModelVisual3D();
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			model3DGroup.Transform = base.ModelTransform;
			Render3DContent(model3DGroup);
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup2 = new Model3DGroup();
			model3DGroup2.Children.Add(CreateLighting());
			model3DGroup2.Children.Add(model3DGroup);
			modelVisual3D.Content = model3DGroup2;
			ChartControl.SetDiagram3DHitTestInfo(model3DGroup2, Diagram);
			viewport3DVisual.Camera = base.Camera;
			viewport3DVisual.Children.Add(modelVisual3D);
			viewport3DVisual.Viewport = base.Viewport;
			viewport3DVisual.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(base.Viewport);
			drawingVisual.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(base.Viewport);
			Render2DContent(drawingVisual);
			visualContainer.AddVisual(viewport3DVisual);
			visualContainer.AddVisual(drawingVisual);
		}

		public virtual void OnModelAdd(object modelHolder, params Model3D[] models)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void Render2DContent(DrawingVisual visualHolder)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void Render3DContent(Model3DGroup modelHolder);
	}
	public abstract class Diagram3DBox
	{
		public const int DiagramPlanesCorrection = 1;

		private double innerWidth;

		private double innerHeight;

		private double innerDepth;

		public double Width => innerWidth + SideCorrection;

		public double Height => innerHeight + SideCorrection;

		public double Depth => innerDepth + SideCorrection;

		public double InnerWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return innerWidth;
			}
			protected set
			{
				innerWidth = value;
			}
		}

		public double InnerHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return innerHeight;
			}
			protected set
			{
				innerHeight = value;
			}
		}

		public double InnerDepth
		{
			get
			{
				return innerDepth;
			}
			protected set
			{
				innerDepth = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual double SideCorrection => 0.0;

		public virtual double CalcViewRadius()
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Width * Width + Height * Height + Depth * Depth) * 0.5;
		}

		public abstract Transform3D CreateModelTransform();
	}
	public class Chart3DCacheBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<int, AxisCache> axesCache = new Dictionary<int, AxisCache>();

		public const int WidthTolerance = 20;

		public Model3D SeriesModel { get; set; }

		public Model3D Bottom { get; set; }

		public Model3D Top { get; set; }

		public Model3D Back { get; set; }

		public Model3D Fore { get; set; }

		public Model3D Left { get; set; }

		public Model3D Right { get; set; }

		public int Width { get; set; }

		public bool IsDiagramModelValid(int width)
		{
			if (Bottom != null && Back != null && Fore != null && Left != null && Right != null)
			{
				return Math.Abs(Width - width) < 20;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public AxisCache GetAxisCache(Axis axis)
		{
			int hashCode = axis.GetHashCode();
			if (!axesCache.TryGetValue(hashCode, out var value))
			{
				value = new AxisCache();
				axesCache.Add(hashCode, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			foreach (AxisCache value in axesCache.Values)
			{
				value.Clear();
			}
			axesCache.Clear();
			SeriesModel = null;
			Bottom = null;
			Top = null;
			Back = null;
			Fore = null;
			Left = null;
			Right = null;
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram3DCache : Chart3DCacheBase
	{
		private class XYDiagram3DCacheItem
		{
			private readonly Model3D[] models;

			public Model3D[] Models => models;

			public XYDiagram3DCacheItem(params Model3D[] models)
			{
				this.models = models;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<object, XYDiagram3DCacheItem> modelItems = new Dictionary<object, XYDiagram3DCacheItem>();

		private readonly MaterialBrushCache materialBrushes = new MaterialBrushCache();

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			modelItems.Clear();
			materialBrushes.Clear();
		}

		public void AddModels(object modelHolder, params Model3D[] models)
		{
			modelItems.Add(modelHolder, new XYDiagram3DCacheItem(models));
		}

		public void RemoveModels()
		{
			modelItems.Clear();
		}

		public void ChangeModelBrush(object modelHolder, SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			modelItems.TryGetValue(modelHolder, out var value);
			if (value != null)
			{
				Model3D[] models = value.Models;
				foreach (Model3D model in models)
				{
					ColorUtils.MixBrushes(model, brush, materialBrushes);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class RectComparer : IComparer<DXRectangle>
	{
		int IComparer<DXRectangle>.Compare(DXRectangle x, DXRectangle y)
		{
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref x)).Height == ((DXRectangle)(ref y)).Height && ((DXRectangle)(ref x)).Width == ((DXRectangle)(ref y)).Width)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref x)).Width > ((DXRectangle)(ref y)).Width)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref x)).Height > ((DXRectangle)(ref y)).Height)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ModelRenderBehavior
	{
		public virtual bool ActualOverlapBars => false;

		public static void DrawRect(IRenderContext context, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect rect)
		{
			if (pen != null)
			{
				double num = 0.5 * pen.Thickness;
				rect.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
			}
			context.DrawRectangle(brush, pen, rect);
		}

		public virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		public virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
		}

		public virtual void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawRect(context, brush, pen, layout.Bounds);
		}
	}
	public class CachedModelRenderBehavior : ModelRenderBehavior
	{
		private Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Brush[]> brushSet = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Brush[]>();

		private Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Pen[]> penSet = new Dictionary<System.Windows.Media.Color, System.Windows.Media.Pen[]>();

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[0];
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Pen[] CreatePenSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Media.Pen[0];
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Pen[] GetPenSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (!penSet.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (penSet.Count == 12)
				{
					penSet.Clear();
				}
				value = CreatePenSet(color);
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
				{
					value[i].Freeze();
				}
				penSet[color] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush[] GetBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (!brushSet.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				if (brushSet.Count == 12)
				{
					brushSet.Clear();
				}
				value = CreateBrushSet(color, brush);
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
				{
					value[i].Freeze();
				}
				brushSet[color] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	public abstract class FlatGlassModelRenderBehavior : FlatModelRenderBehaviorBase
	{
		public override bool ActualOverlapBars => true;

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(80, 80, 80))), color);
			brush2.Freeze();
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[2] { brush2, brush };
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(102, 102, 102), 0.5));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(85, 85, 85), 0.5));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(107, 107, 107), 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateStrokeMaskBrush()
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(50, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue));
		}

		public override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush[] array = GetBrushSet(pointColor, brush);
			RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[0], null, bounds, GetCornerRadiusSet(presentationData, 3));
			if (!(bounds.Height < 1.0) && !(bounds.Width < 2.0))
			{
				bounds.Inflate(-1.0, 0.0);
				bounds.Y += 1.0;
				bounds.Height -= 1.0;
				CornerRadius cornerRadiusSet = GetCornerRadiusSet(presentationData, 2);
				RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, array[1], null, bounds, cornerRadiusSet);
				double num = pen.Thickness * 0.5;
				bounds.Inflate(0.0 - num, 0.0 - num);
				RenderUtils.DrawRoundedRectangle(context, null, pen, bounds, cornerRadiusSet);
			}
		}
	}

	public class OutsetModelRenderBehavior : CachedModelRenderBehavior
	{

		{

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrushLeft()

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrushRight()
