			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(67, 0, 0, 0), 1.0));
			linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrushTop()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.470832, 0.0),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.470832, 1.0)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(127, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(26, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue), 1.0));
			linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush[] CreateBrushSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Media.Brush[3]
			{
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushLeft()), color),
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushRight()), color),
				ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients(CreateBrushTop()), color)
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Pen[] CreatePenSet(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(90, 0, 0, 0))), color);
			brush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(128, 0, 0, 0))), color);
			brush2.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush3 = ColorHelper.MixColors(ColorHelper.NormalizeGradients((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(114, 0, 0, 0))), color);
			brush3.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, lineThickness);
			pen.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen2 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush2, lineThickness);
			pen2.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen3 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush3, lineThickness);
			pen3.Freeze();
			return new System.Windows.Media.Pen[3] { pen, pen2, pen3 };
		}

		public override System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMaskBrush()
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0 / 64.0),
				EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 1.0)
			};
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 77, 77, 77), 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		public override void Draw(IRenderContext context, SeriesPointPresentationData presentationData, IPresentation layout, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor = presentationData.PointColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush[] array = GetBrushSet(pointColor, brush);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen[] array2 = GetPenSet(pointColor);
			Rect bounds = layout.Bounds;
			Rect rectangle = bounds;
			context.DrawRectangle(brush, null, rectangle);
			double num = 4.0;
			rectangle.Inflate(0.0 - lineThickness, 0.0 - lineThickness);
			System.Windows.Point topLeft = rectangle.TopLeft;
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(rectangle.Right - Math.Min(Math.Round(rectangle.Width / 3.0), num), rectangle.Y);
			System.Windows.Point topRight = rectangle.TopRight;
			System.Windows.Point value = new System.Windows.Point(rectangle.Left + Math.Min(Math.Round(rectangle.Width / 3.0), num), point.Y + num);
			System.Windows.Point value2 = new System.Windows.Point(rectangle.Right - Math.Min(Math.Round(rectangle.Width / 3.0), num), topRight.Y + num);
			StreamGeometry streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometryContext.BeginFigure(rectangle.BottomLeft, isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
				streamGeometryContext.PolyLineTo(new PointCollection
				{
					topLeft,
					value,
					new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X, rectangle.Bottom)
				}, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: true);
			}
			streamGeometry.Freeze();
			context.DrawGeometry(array[0], null, streamGeometry);
			streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext2 = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometryContext2.BeginFigure(rectangle.BottomRight, isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
				streamGeometryContext2.PolyLineTo(new PointCollection
				{
					topRight,
					value2,
					new System.Windows.Point(value2.X, rectangle.Bottom)
				}, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: true);
			}
			streamGeometry.Freeze();
			context.DrawGeometry(array[1], null, streamGeometry);
			streamGeometry = new StreamGeometry();
			using (StreamGeometryContext streamGeometryContext3 = streamGeometry.Open())
			{
				streamGeometryContext3.BeginFigure(topLeft, isFilled: true, isClosed: true);
				streamGeometryContext3.PolyLineTo(new PointCollection { topRight, value2, value }, isStroked: true, isSmoothJoin: true);
			}
			streamGeometry.Freeze();
			context.DrawGeometry(array[2], null, streamGeometry);
			double num2 = 0.5 * lineThickness;
			bounds.Inflate(0.0 - num2, 0.0 - num2);
			context.DrawLine(array2[0], bounds.BottomLeft, bounds.TopLeft);
			context.DrawLine(array2[1], bounds.TopRight, bounds.BottomRight);
			context.DrawLine(array2[2], bounds.TopLeft, bounds.TopRight);
		}
	}
	public static class RenderHelper
	{
		public static TileBrush CreateMirrorBrush(UIElement element, bool isPseudo3D, Pane pane)
		{
			VisualBrush visualBrush = new VisualBrush(element);
			visualBrush.ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			double y = (isPseudo3D ? pane.Viewport.Top : 0.0);
			visualBrush.Viewbox = new Rect(0.0, y, element.DesiredSize.Width, element.DesiredSize.Height);
			visualBrush.RelativeTransform = new ScaleTransform
			{
				CenterX = 0.5,
				CenterY = 0.5,
				ScaleX = 1.0,
				ScaleY = -1.0
			};
			return visualBrush;
		}

		public static LinearGradientBrush CreateOpacityBrush(Pane pane, bool isPseudo3D)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 1.0);
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(100, 0, 0, 0),
				Offset = 0.0
			});
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
			{
				Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
				Offset = 1.0
			});
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrush(ContentPresenter presenter, ISupportFlowDirection supportFlowDirection)
		{
			return CreateTransformedBrush(presenter, supportFlowDirection, null);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateMirrorBrush(DrawingVisual seriesVisual)
		{
			return new VisualBrush(seriesVisual);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateTransformedBrush(ContentPresenter presenter, ISupportFlowDirection supportFlowDirection, Transform transform)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new VisualBrush(presenter);
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			if (transform != null && !transform.IsIdentity())
			{
				transformGroup.Children.Add(transform);
			}
			if (supportFlowDirection != null)
			{
				Transform transform2 = supportFlowDirection.CreateDirectionTransform();
				if (transform2 != null && !transform2.IsIdentity())
				{
					transformGroup.Children.Add(transform2);
				}
			}
			brush.RelativeTransform = transformGroup;
			return brush;
		}
	}
	public static class HitTestingHelper
	{
		public static HitTestFilterBehavior HitFilter(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is UIElement { IsHitTestVisible: false })
			{
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelf;
			}
			return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
		}

		public static IHitTestableElement GetParentHitTestableElement(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = obj;
			while (dependencyObject != null && !(dependencyObject is ChartControl))
			{
				if (dependencyObject is IHitTestableElement hitTestableElement)
				{
					if (hitTestableElement is Legend)
					{
						if (((Legend)hitTestableElement).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
						{
							return hitTestableElement;
						}
						return null;
					}
					return hitTestableElement;
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void ProcessHitTestableElement(IHitTestableElement element, System.Windows.Point? point)
		{
			if (element is INativeHitTestableElement nativeHitTestableElement)
			{
				nativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(point);
			}
		}

		public static IList<object> ProcessHitTestableElement(IHitTestableElement element, Rect rect)
		{
			if (element is INativeHitTestableElement nativeHitTestableElement)
			{
				return nativeHitTestableElement.HitTestNativeElements(rect);
			}
			if (element == null || element.AdditionalElement == null)
			{
				return new List<object>();
			}
			return new List<object> { element.AdditionalElement };
		}

		public static object GetSelectedObject(ChartHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo.InPieTotalLabel)
			{
				return hitInfo.PieTotalLabel;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Annotation != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Annotation;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Indicator != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Indicator;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Legend != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Legend;
			}
			if (hitInfo.ConstantLine != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.ConstantLine;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Title != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Title;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Series != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Series;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Strip != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Strip;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Axis != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Axis;
			}
			if (hitInfo.AxisLabel != null)
			{
				return (AxisBase)((IOwnedElement)hitInfo.AxisLabel).Owner;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Pane != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Pane;
			}
			if (hitInfo.PaneTitle != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.PaneTitle;
			}
			if (hitInfo.Diagram != null)
			{
				return hitInfo.Diagram;
			}
			return hitInfo.Chart;
		}
	}
	public class SplitCollectionManager<T>
	{
		private IEnumerable<T> sourceCollection;

		private List<ISplitTargetCollection<T>> targetCollections;

		internal List<ISplitTargetCollection<T>> TargetCollections => targetCollections;

		public SplitCollectionManager(IEnumerable<T> sourceCollection)
		{
			this.sourceCollection = sourceCollection;
			targetCollections = new List<ISplitTargetCollection<T>>();
		}

		public void ClearTargetCollections()
		{
			foreach (ISplitTargetCollection<T> targetCollection in targetCollections)
			{
				targetCollection.Clear();
			}
			targetCollections.Clear();
		}

		public void UpdateCollections()
		{
			foreach (T item in sourceCollection)
			{
				foreach (ISplitTargetCollection<T> targetCollection in targetCollections)
				{
					if (targetCollection.ShouldContainsElement(item))
					{
						targetCollection.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						targetCollection.Remove(item);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartScreenHelper
	{
		private static double GetScreenDpiX(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return ScreenHelper.ScaleX;
			}
			return ScreenHelper.GetScaleX((Visual)element);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point GetScreenPoint(FrameworkElement visual)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = visual.PointToScreen(default(System.Windows.Point));
			double screenDpiX = GetScreenDpiX(visual);
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X / screenDpiX, point.Y / screenDpiX);
		}

		public static Rect GetScreenRect(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return ScreenHelper.GetScreenRects().FindLast((Rect r) => r.Contains(point));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point GetScaledPoint(System.Windows.Point point, FrameworkElement visual)
		{
			double screenDpiX = GetScreenDpiX(visual);
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X / screenDpiX, point.Y / screenDpiX);
		}

		public static Rect GetFocusedScreenRect(System.Windows.Point point, FrameworkElement visual)
		{
			System.Windows.Point screenPoint = GetScreenPoint(visual);
			Rect screenRect = GetScreenRect(point);
			if (screenRect.Width == 0.0)
			{
				System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(visual);
				System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(screenPoint.X + position.X, screenPoint.Y + position.Y);
				screenRect = GetScreenRect(point2);
			}
			return screenRect;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point CorrectPointByTransform(System.Windows.Point point, FrameworkElement visual)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point2 = visual.PointToScreen(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			System.Windows.Point point3 = visual.PointToScreen(new System.Windows.Point(visual.ActualWidth, visual.ActualHeight));
			double num = Math.Abs(point3.X - point2.X) / visual.ActualWidth;
			double num2 = Math.Abs(point3.Y - point2.Y) / visual.ActualHeight;
			return GetScaledPoint(new System.Windows.Point(point.X * num, point.Y * num2), visual);
		}

		public static double Scale(double delta, FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return delta * GetScreenDpiX(element);
		}
	}
	public delegate bool ConvertItemSourceDelegate(object source, out object item);
	public class ItemsSourceCollectionManager
	{
		private readonly IList items;

		private readonly Action itemsChangedCallback;

		private readonly ConvertItemSourceDelegate convertSourceItem;

		private IEnumerable itemsSource;

		private bool allowItemsChangingNotification = true;

		private string itemsChangedException = "Operation is not valid while ItemsSource is in use. Access and modify elements with ItemsSource instead.";

		private string itemsSourceChangedException = "Items collection must be empty before using ItemsSource.";

		public string ItemsChangedException
		{
			get
			{
				return itemsChangedException;
			}
			set
			{
				itemsChangedException = value;
			}
		}

		public string ItemsSourceChangedException
		{
			get
			{
				return itemsSourceChangedException;
			}
			set
			{
				itemsSourceChangedException = value;
			}
		}

		public ItemsSourceCollectionManager(IList items, Action itemsChangedCallback, ConvertItemSourceDelegate convertSourceItem)
		{
			this.items = items;
			this.itemsChangedCallback = itemsChangedCallback;
			this.convertSourceItem = convertSourceItem;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeItemsSourceChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= ItemsSourceCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeItemsSourceChanged(object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += ItemsSourceCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void ItemsSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			allowItemsChangingNotification = false;
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					object item2 = null;
					if (convertSourceItem != null && convertSourceItem(newItem, out item2))
					{
						items.Insert(e.NewStartingIndex, item2);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			{
				object value = items[e.OldStartingIndex];
				items.RemoveAt(e.OldStartingIndex);
				items.Insert(e.NewStartingIndex, value);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					items.Remove(oldItem);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				object item = null;
				if (convertSourceItem != null && convertSourceItem(e.NewItems[0], out item))
				{
					items[e.NewStartingIndex] = item;
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				items.Clear();
				break;
			}
			allowItemsChangingNotification = true;
			itemsChangedCallback?.Invoke();
		}

		private void PopulateItemsFromItemsSource()
		{
			allowItemsChangingNotification = false;
			items.Clear();
			if (itemsSource != null)
			{
				foreach (object item2 in itemsSource)
				{
					object item = null;
					if (convertSourceItem != null && convertSourceItem(item2, out item))
					{
						items.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			allowItemsChangingNotification = true;
			itemsChangedCallback?.Invoke();
		}

		public void ItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (allowItemsChangingNotification)
			{
				if (itemsSource != null && e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(itemsChangedException);
				}
				itemsChangedCallback?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		public void ItemsSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnsubscribeItemsSourceChanged(e.OldValue);
			IEnumerable enumerable = e.NewValue as IEnumerable;
			if (items.Count > 0 && e.OldValue == null && enumerable != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(itemsSourceChangedException);
			}
			SubscribeItemsSourceChanged(e.NewValue);
			itemsSource = enumerable;
			PopulateItemsFromItemsSource();
		}
	}

	public class TextUtils
	{
		public static Transform CalculateTransform(TextOrientation orientation)
		{
			return orientation switch
			{
				TextOrientation.BottomToTop => new RotateTransform(-90.0), 
				TextOrientation.TopToBottom => new RotateTransform(90.0), 
				_ => Transform.Identity, 
			};
		}
	}
	public static class NativeHitTestHelper
	{
		public static readonly double SquareRootOf2 = Math.Sqrt(2.0);

		private static GRealVector2D PointToVector(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Point VectorToPoint(GRealVector2D vector)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(vector.X, vector.Y);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point GetActualPoint(XYDiagram2D diagram, Pane pane, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			double num = point.X - pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Left;
			double num2 = pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Height - point.Y + pane.LastMappingBounds.Value.Top;
			if (diagram.Rotated)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(num2, num);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(num, num2);
		}

		public static bool HitTestPoint(XYDiagram2D diagram, System.Windows.Point point, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, double markerSize)
		{
			Pane pane = diagram.ActualPanes[0];
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore = diagram.ActualAxisX.CreateMapping(pane, pane.Viewport);
			IAxisMappingCore axisMappingCore2 = diagram.ActualAxisY.CreateMapping(pane, pane.Viewport);
			System.Windows.Point actualPoint = GetActualPoint(diagram, pane, point);
			System.Windows.Point p = new System.Windows.Point(axisMappingCore.GetExactAxisValue(refinedPoint.Argument), axisMappingCore2.GetExactAxisValue(refinedPoint.Value1));
			return MathUtils.CalcSquaredDistance(actualPoint, p) <= markerSize * markerSize;
		}

		public static void GetRange(List<System.Windows.Point> points, System.Windows.Point point, double maxThickness, int step, out int left, out int right)
		{
			left = 0;
			right = points.Count - 1;
			while (right - left > 1)
			{
				if (points[(left + right) / 2].X > point.X)
				{
					right = (left + right) / 2;
				}
				else
				{
					left = (left + right) / 2;
				}
			}
			left -= left % step;
			if (right % step != 0)
			{
				right += step - right % step;
			}
			while (left > step - 1 && points[left - step].X + maxThickness >= point.X)
			{
				left -= step;
			}
			while (right < points.Count - step && points[right + step].X - maxThickness <= point.X)
			{
				right += step;
			}
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point GetBezierPoint(List<System.Windows.Point> points, double t, int first = 0)
		{
			return VectorToPoint((1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t) * PointToVector(points[first]) + 3.0 * t * (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t) * PointToVector(points[first + 1]) + 3.0 * t * t * (1.0 - t) * PointToVector(points[first + 2]) + t * t * t * PointToVector(points[first + 3]));
		}
	}
	public static class XamlLoaderHelper<T> where T : class
	{
		private static readonly string appName = "/DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.v23.2;";

		private static T LoadFromResource(Uri path)
		{
			try
			{
				return Application.LoadComponent(path) as T;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static T LoadFromResource(string path)
		{
			Uri path2 = new Uri(appName + path, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			return LoadFromResource(path2);
		}

		public static T LoadFromUserResource(string path)
		{
			Assembly entryAssembly = XamlLoaderHelper<T>.EntryAssembly;
			if (entryAssembly == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = entryAssembly.FullName.Split(',')[0];
			Uri path2 = new Uri("/" + text + path, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			return LoadFromResource(path2);
		}

		public static T LoadFromFile(string source)
		{
			try
			{
				using StringReader stringReader = new StringReader(source);
				using XmlReader reader = SafeXml.CreateReader((TextReader)stringReader);
				return XamlReader.Load(reader) as T;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class AreaSeries3DLabelLayout : XYSeriesLabel3DLayout
	{
		private readonly Point3D frontPoint;

		private readonly Point3D backPoint;

		public AreaSeries3DLabelLayout(SeriesLabel label, Point3D point, Vector3D direction, double zOffset)
			: base(label, point, direction)
		{
			frontPoint = new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z + zOffset);
			backPoint = new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z - zOffset);
		}

		public Point3D GetFrontPoint()
		{
			return TransformPoint(frontPoint);
		}

		public Point3D GetBackPoint()
		{
			return TransformPoint(backPoint);
		}

		private bool IsFrontPoint(Point3D cameraPosition)
		{
			Point3D p = GetFrontPoint();
			Point3D p2 = GetBackPoint();
			double num = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p, cameraPosition);
			double num2 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p2, cameraPosition);
			return num < num2;
		}

		protected override Point3D GetLabelPoint3D(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			if (IsFrontPoint(domain.RelativeCameraPosition))
			{
				return GetFrontPoint();
			}
			return GetBackPoint();
		}

		protected override Vector3D GetLabelDirection3D(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			if (IsFrontPoint(((Diagram3DDomain)domain).RelativeCameraPosition))
			{
				return new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
			return new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
		}

		public override LabelModelContainer CreateModel(Domain3DBase domain, Series3DPointGeometry pointGeometry, System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			Point3D labelPoint3D = GetLabelPoint3D(domain);
			Vector3D labelDirection3D = GetLabelDirection3D(domain);
			ScaleTransform3D scaleTransform3D = domain.CreateScaleTransform(labelPoint3D);
			ContentPresenter labelContentPresenter = pointGeometry.LabelContentPresenter;
			double num = Math.Sqrt(labelContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width * scaleTransform3D.ScaleX * (labelContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width * scaleTransform3D.ScaleX) + labelContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height * scaleTransform3D.ScaleY * (labelContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height * scaleTransform3D.ScaleY)) / 2.0;
			labelPoint3D.Offset(labelDirection3D.X * num, labelDirection3D.Y * num, labelDirection3D.Z * num);
			return Label3DHelper.CreateLabelModelContainer(domain, labelContentPresenter, pointGeometry.LabelModel, labelPoint3D, default(Vector3D), base.Label.RenderMode);
		}
	}

		public Point3D GetDockPoint(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain)

		public System.Windows.Point GetLabelPoint2D(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain)

		}

		public System.Windows.Point CalculateLabelConnectPoint(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle val;
			int num;
			if (!(GetDirection2D(domain).X < 0.0))
			{
				val = LabelBounds;
				num = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Left;
			}
			else
			{
				val = LabelBounds;
				num = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Right;
			}
			double x = num;
			val = LabelBounds;
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, (double)((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Top + ContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0);
		}

		public void CompleteLayout(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			Vector direction2D = GetDirection2D(domain);
			angle = Math.Atan2(direction2D.Y, direction2D.X);
		}

		public Vector GetDirection2D(SimpleDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			Point3D dockPoint = GetDockPoint(domain);
			Point3D point = new Point3D(dockPoint.X + direction.X, dockPoint.Y + direction.Y, dockPoint.Z + direction.Z);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = domain.Project(point);
			System.Windows.Point point3 = domain.Project(dockPoint);
			Vector result = new Vector(point2.X - point3.X, point2.Y - point3.Y);
			result.Normalize();
			return result;
		}

		public void ApplyRefinedPoint(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			this.refinedPoint = refinedPoint;
		}

		protected override Point3D GetLabelPoint3D(Domain3DBase domain)
		{

		}

		protected override Vector3D GetLabelDirection3D(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			return TransformVector(direction);
		}
	}
	public class Marker3DLabelLayout : XYSeriesLabel3DLayout
	{
		internal Point3D BoundsStartPoint { get; }

		internal Point3D BoundsEndPoint { get; }

		internal Point3D ConnectorPoint { get; }

		public Marker3DLabelLayout(SeriesLabel label, Point3D point, Point3D connectorPoint, Vector3D direction, Rect3D bounds)
			: base(label, point, direction)
		{
			BoundsStartPoint = bounds.Location;
			BoundsEndPoint = new Point3D(bounds.Location.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Location.Y + bounds.SizeY, bounds.Location.Z + bounds.SizeZ);
			ConnectorPoint = connectorPoint;
		}

		public double GetOffset(Transform3D transform)
		{
			Point3D p = transform.Transform(BoundsStartPoint);
			Point3D p2 = transform.Transform(BoundsEndPoint);
			return MathUtils.CalcDistance(p, p2) / 2.0;
		}

		protected override Point3D GetConnectorStartPoint(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			return TransformPoint(ConnectorPoint);
		}

		private Marker3DLabelPosition GetLabelPosition(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			if (domain is XYZChartDomain)
			{
				return Marker3DSeriesView.GetLabelPosition(base.Label);
			}
			return MarkerSeries3D.GetLabelPosition(base.Label);
		}

		protected override Vector3D GetLabelDirection3D(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			Marker3DLabelPosition labelPosition = GetLabelPosition(domain);
			if (labelPosition != Marker3DLabelPosition.Center)
			{
				if (labelPosition != Marker3DLabelPosition.Top)
				{
					ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Marker3DLabelPosition value.");
				}
				return base.GetLabelDirection3D(domain);
			}
			Point3D labelPoint3D = GetLabelPoint3D(domain);
			Point3D relativeCameraPosition = domain.RelativeCameraPosition;
			Vector3D n = new Vector3D(relativeCameraPosition.X - labelPoint3D.X, relativeCameraPosition.Y - labelPoint3D.Y, relativeCameraPosition.Z - labelPoint3D.Z);
			MathUtils.Normalize(ref n);
			return n;
		}

		public override LabelModelContainer CreateModel(Domain3DBase domain, Series3DPointGeometry pointGeometry, System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			if (GetLabelPosition(domain) == Marker3DLabelPosition.Top)
			{
				return base.CreateModel(domain, pointGeometry, pointColor, modelHolder);
			}
			Point3D labelPoint3D = GetLabelPoint3D(domain);
			Vector3D labelDirection3D = GetLabelDirection3D(domain);
			double offset = GetOffset(domain.ModelTransform);
			labelPoint3D.Offset(labelDirection3D.X * offset, labelDirection3D.Y * offset, labelDirection3D.Z * offset);
			return Label3DHelper.CreateLabelModelContainer(domain, pointGeometry.LabelContentPresenter, pointGeometry.LabelModel, labelPoint3D, default(Vector3D), base.Label.RenderMode);
		}
	}
	public static class ResolveOverlappingHelper
	{
		public static void Process(IList<XYSeries> series, StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel, Rect bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!IsLabelsResolveOverlapping(series) && (totalLabel == null || totalLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.None))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> list = new List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout>();
			if (totalLabel != null)
			{
				FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(list, totalLabel.Items, totalLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode);
			}
			int num = series.Count / 2;
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = num - 1;
			while (num2 < series.Count || num3 >= 0)
			{
				if (num2 < series.Count)
				{
					FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(list, series[num2]);
				}
				if (num3 >= 0)
				{
					FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(list, series[num3]);
				}
				num2++;
				num3--;
			}
			list = list.OrderBy((IXYDiagramLabelLayout x) => x, new LabelLayoutByAreaComparer()).ToList();
			XYDiagramResolveOverlappingAlgorithm.Process(list, bounds.IsEmpty ? DXRectangle.Empty : GraphicsUtils.ConvertRect(bounds), resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
		}

		public static void Process(IList<XYSeries> series, Rect bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			Process(series, null, bounds, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
		}

		public static void Process(PieLabelPosition position, List<IPieLabelLayout> labels, Rect labelBounds, GRealEllipse pie, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent, PieSweepDirection direction)
		{
			switch (position)
			{
			case PieLabelPosition.Outside:
				SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping.ArrangeByEllipse(labels, pie, resolveOverlappingMinIndent, (PointsSweepDirection)direction, new GRealRect2D(labelBounds.Left, labelBounds.Top, labelBounds.Width, labelBounds.Height));
				break;
			case PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns:
				SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping.ArrangeByColumn(labels, new GRealRect2D(labelBounds.Left, labelBounds.Top, labelBounds.Width, labelBounds.Height), resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
				break;
			}
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D? CalculateSalientPoint(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, DXRectangle labelBounds, double startAngle)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = MathUtils.CalcCenter(labelBounds);
			GRealPoint2D line2P = new GRealPoint2D((gRealPoint2D.X > anchorPoint.X) ? ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left : ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Right, gRealPoint2D.Y);
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D2 = GeometricUtils.CalcLinesIntersection(line1P2: new GRealPoint2D(anchorPoint.X + Math.Cos(startAngle), anchorPoint.Y + Math.Sin(startAngle)), line1P1: anchorPoint, line2P1: line2P, line2P2: new GRealPoint2D(line2P.X + 5.0, line2P.Y), intervalMode: false);
			if (gRealPoint2D2.HasValue)
			{
				GRealPoint2D value = gRealPoint2D2.Value;
				if ((value.X >= anchorPoint.X && value.X < line2P.X) || (value.X <= anchorPoint.X && value.X > line2P.X))
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool IsLabelsResolveOverlapping(IList<XYSeries> series)
		{
			foreach (XYSeries item in series)
			{
				if (item.ActualLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingMode.None)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void AddLayout(List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels, SeriesLabelItemBase labelItem)
		{
			if (labelItem.Layout is XYSeriesLabel2DLayout item)
			{
				labels.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private static void FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels, Series series)
		{
			SeriesLabel actualLabel = series.ActualLabel;
			FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels(labels, actualLabel.Items, actualLabel.ResolveOverlappingMode);
		}

		private static void FillNonOverlappingSeriesLabels<TLabelItem>(List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels, IList<TLabelItem> labelItems, ResolveOverlappingMode overlappingMode) where TLabelItem : SeriesLabelItemBase
		{
			if (labelItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = labelItems.Count / 2;
			if (overlappingMode == ResolveOverlappingMode.HideOverlapped)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = labelItems.Count - 1;
				while (num2 <= num3)
				{
					AddLayout(labels, labelItems[num2]);
					if (num3 != num2)
					{
						AddLayout(labels, labelItems[num3]);
					}
					num2++;
					num3--;
				}
				return;
			}
			int num4 = num;
			int num5 = num - 1;
			while (num4 < labelItems.Count || num5 >= 0)
			{
				if (num4 < labelItems.Count)
				{
					AddLayout(labels, labelItems[num4]);
				}
				if (num5 >= 0)
				{
					AddLayout(labels, labelItems[num5]);
				}
				num4++;
				num5--;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesLabel3DLayout
	{
		private readonly SeriesLabel label;

		private Transform3D transform;

		public SeriesLabel Label => label;

		public SeriesLabel3DLayout(SeriesLabel label)
		{
			this.label = label;
		}

		private Point3D CalcConnectorEndPoint(Matrix3D scaleMatrix, Point3D startPoint, Vector3D direction)
		{
			double scalar = ((label.Indent == 0) ? 0.0 : scaleMatrix.Transform(new Point3D(0.0, label.Indent, 0.0)).Y);
			direction.Normalize();
			Vector3D vector3D = Vector3D.Multiply(direction, scalar);
			Transform3D transform3D = new TranslateTransform3D((Vector3D)startPoint);
			return transform3D.Transform((Point3D)vector3D);
		}

		public void SetTransform(Transform3D transform)
		{
			this.transform = transform;
		}

		protected Point3D TransformPoint(Point3D point)
		{
			if (transform != null)
			{
				return transform.Transform(point);
			}
			return point;
		}

		protected Vector3D TransformVector(Vector3D vector)
		{
			if (transform != null)
			{
				return transform.Transform(vector);
			}
			return vector;
		}

		protected abstract Point3D GetLabelPoint3D(Domain3DBase domain);

		protected abstract Vector3D GetLabelDirection3D(Domain3DBase domain);

		protected virtual Point3D GetConnectorStartPoint(Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			return GetLabelPoint3D(domain);
		}

		public virtual LabelModelContainer CreateModel(Domain3DBase domain, Series3DPointGeometry pointGeometry, System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			Point3D labelPoint3D = GetLabelPoint3D(domain);
			Vector3D labelDirection3D = GetLabelDirection3D(domain);
			Matrix3D value = domain.CreateScaleTransform(labelPoint3D).Value;
			Point3D point3D = CalcConnectorEndPoint(value, labelPoint3D, labelDirection3D);
			if (label.ConnectorVisible)
			{
				Model3D model3D = Graphics3DUtils.CreateLineModel(GetConnectorStartPoint(domain), point3D, value.Transform(new Point3D(label.ConnectorThickness, 0.0, 0.0)).X, new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(pointColor)));
				if (model3D != null)
				{
					modelHolder.Children.Add(model3D);
				}
			}
			return Label3DHelper.CreateLabelModelContainer(domain, pointGeometry.LabelContentPresenter, pointGeometry.LabelModel, point3D, labelDirection3D, label.RenderMode);
		}
	}

	}
	public class AreaFullStackedSeries3DData : AreaStackedSeries3DData

			: base(series)
		{
		}

		{
			Point3D valuePoint = GetValuePoint(refinedPoint, domain);
			Point3D zeroPoint = GetZeroPoint(refinedPoint, domain);

		}

	public class AreaSeries3DData : Series3DData
	{
		private const int pointPrecision = 6;

		private MeshGeometry3D faceGeometry;

		private MeshGeometry3D sideGeometry;

		private AreaSeries3D AreaSeries => (AreaSeries3D)base.Series;

		public MeshGeometry3D FaceGeometry => faceGeometry;

		public MeshGeometry3D SideGeometry => sideGeometry;

		private static int CompareByY(GRealPoint2D point1, GRealPoint2D point2)
		{
			return point1.Y.CompareTo(point2.Y);
		}

		private static bool IsLeftTriangle(GPolygon2D polygon)
		{
			if ((polygon.Vertices[0].X != polygon.Vertices[1].X || !(polygon.Vertices[0].X < polygon.Vertices[2].X)) && (polygon.Vertices[0].X != polygon.Vertices[2].X || !(polygon.Vertices[0].X < polygon.Vertices[1].X)))
			{
				if (polygon.Vertices[1].X == polygon.Vertices[2].X)
				{
					return polygon.Vertices[1].X < polygon.Vertices[0].X;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsRightTriangle(GPolygon2D polygon)
		{
			if ((polygon.Vertices[0].X != polygon.Vertices[1].X || !(polygon.Vertices[0].X > polygon.Vertices[2].X)) && (polygon.Vertices[0].X != polygon.Vertices[2].X || !(polygon.Vertices[0].X > polygon.Vertices[1].X)))
			{
				if (polygon.Vertices[1].X == polygon.Vertices[2].X)
				{
					return polygon.Vertices[1].X > polygon.Vertices[0].X;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void AddTriangle(MeshGeometry3D geometry, Point3D p1, Point3D p2, Point3D p3)
		{
			geometry.TriangleIndices.Add(GetPointIndex(geometry, p1));
			geometry.TriangleIndices.Add(GetPointIndex(geometry, p2));
			geometry.TriangleIndices.Add(GetPointIndex(geometry, p3));
		}

		private static void OffsetByZ(MeshGeometry3D geometry, double offset)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < geometry.Positions.Count; i++)
			{
				geometry.Positions[i] = new Point3D(geometry.Positions[i].X, geometry.Positions[i].Y, geometry.Positions[i].Z + offset);
			}
		}

		private static void Invert(MeshGeometry3D geometry)
		{
			Int32Collection int32Collection = new Int32Collection();
			foreach (int triangleIndex in geometry.TriangleIndices)
			{
				int32Collection.Insert(0, triangleIndex);
			}
			geometry.TriangleIndices = int32Collection;
		}

		private static void FillPoints(GPolygon2D polygon, out List<GRealPoint2D> leftPoints, out List<GRealPoint2D> rightPoints)
		{
			leftPoints = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			rightPoints = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			double num = double.NegativeInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				if (polygon.Vertices[i].X > num)
				{
					num = polygon.Vertices[i].X;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < polygon.Vertices.Length; j++)
			{
				if (polygon.Vertices[j].X == num)
				{
					rightPoints.Add(polygon.Vertices[j]);
				}
				else
				{
					leftPoints.Add(polygon.Vertices[j]);
				}
			}
			leftPoints.Sort(CompareByY);
			rightPoints.Sort(CompareByY);
		}

		private static MeshGeometry3D GetQuadrangle(Point3D point1, Point3D point2, double zOffset, double maxLengthInPixels)
		{
			Point3D point3D = new Point3D(point1.X, point1.Y, point1.Z - zOffset);
			Point3D p = new Point3D(point1.X, point1.Y, point1.Z + zOffset);
			Point3D point3D2 = new Point3D(point2.X, point2.Y, point2.Z + zOffset);
			Point3D p2 = new Point3D(point2.X, point2.Y, point2.Z - zOffset);
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			SplitAndAddTriangle(meshGeometry3D, point3D, p, point3D2, maxLengthInPixels);
			SplitAndAddTriangle(meshGeometry3D, point3D2, p2, point3D, maxLengthInPixels);
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		private static List<GRealPoint2D> GetSplitPoints(GPolygon2D polygon, List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Vertices.Length; i++)
			{
				if (polygon.Vertices[i].X == points[0].X && polygon.Vertices[i].Y < points[points.Count - 1].Y && polygon.Vertices[i].Y > points[0].Y)
				{
					list.Add(polygon.Vertices[i]);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(CompareByY);
			list.Reverse();
			return list;
		}

		private static List<GPolygon2D> SplitLeftSide(GPolygon2D polygon, GPolygon2D previousPolygon)
		{
			List<GPolygon2D> list = new List<GPolygon2D>();
			FillPoints(polygon, out var leftPoints, out var rightPoints);
			if (leftPoints.Count != 0 && rightPoints.Count != 0)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> splitPoints = GetSplitPoints(previousPolygon, leftPoints);
				if (splitPoints.Count > 0 && splitPoints.Count < 3)
				{
					list.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3]
					{
						splitPoints[0],
						rightPoints[rightPoints.Count - 1],
						leftPoints[leftPoints.Count - 1]
					}));
					if (splitPoints.Count == 2)
					{
						list.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3]
						{
							splitPoints[splitPoints.Count - 1],
							leftPoints[0],
							rightPoints[0]
						}));
						list.Add(new GPolygon2D((!(rightPoints[0] == rightPoints[rightPoints.Count - 1])) ? new GRealPoint2D[4]
						{
							splitPoints[splitPoints.Count - 1],
							rightPoints[0],
							rightPoints[rightPoints.Count - 1],
							splitPoints[0]
						} : new GRealPoint2D[3]
						{
							splitPoints[splitPoints.Count - 1],
							rightPoints[0],
							splitPoints[0]
						}));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(new GPolygon2D((!(rightPoints[0] == rightPoints[rightPoints.Count - 1])) ? new GRealPoint2D[4]
						{
							splitPoints[0],
							leftPoints[0],
							rightPoints[0],
							rightPoints[rightPoints.Count - 1]
						} : new GRealPoint2D[3]
						{
							splitPoints[0],
							leftPoints[0],
							rightPoints[0]
						}));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(polygon);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<GPolygon2D> SplitRightSide(GPolygon2D polygon, GPolygon2D nextPolygon)
		{
			List<GPolygon2D> list = new List<GPolygon2D>();
			FillPoints(polygon, out var leftPoints, out var rightPoints);
			if (leftPoints.Count != 0 && rightPoints.Count != 0)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> splitPoints = GetSplitPoints(nextPolygon, rightPoints);
				if (splitPoints.Count > 0 && splitPoints.Count < 3)
				{
					list.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3]
					{
						splitPoints[0],
						rightPoints[rightPoints.Count - 1],
						leftPoints[leftPoints.Count - 1]
					}));
					if (splitPoints.Count == 2)
					{
						list.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3]
						{
							splitPoints[splitPoints.Count - 1],
							leftPoints[0],
							rightPoints[0]
						}));
						list.Add(new GPolygon2D((!(leftPoints[0] == leftPoints[leftPoints.Count - 1])) ? new GRealPoint2D[4]
						{
							splitPoints[splitPoints.Count - 1],
							splitPoints[0],
							leftPoints[leftPoints.Count - 1],
							leftPoints[0]
						} : new GRealPoint2D[3]
						{
							splitPoints[splitPoints.Count - 1],
							splitPoints[0],
							leftPoints[0]
						}));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(new GPolygon2D((!(leftPoints[0] == leftPoints[leftPoints.Count - 1])) ? new GRealPoint2D[4]
						{
							splitPoints[0],
							leftPoints[leftPoints.Count - 1],
							leftPoints[0],
							rightPoints[0]
						} : new GRealPoint2D[3]
						{
							splitPoints[0],
							leftPoints[0],
							rightPoints[0]
						}));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(polygon);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static int GetPointIndex(MeshGeometry3D geometry, Point3D point)
		{
			point = new Point3D(Math.Round(point.X, 6), Math.Round(point.Y, 6), Math.Round(point.Z, 6));
			if (!geometry.Positions.Contains(point))
			{
				geometry.Positions.Add(point);
			}
			return geometry.Positions.IndexOf(point);
		}

		internal static void SplitAndAddTriangle(MeshGeometry3D geometry, Point3D p1, Point3D p2, Point3D p3, double maxLengthInPixels)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p1, p2);
			double num2 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p2, p3);
			double num3 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(p3, p1);
			if (num >= num2 && num >= num3 && num > maxLengthInPixels)
			{
				Point3D p4 = new Point3D((p2.X - p1.X) / 2.0 + p1.X, (p2.Y - p1.Y) / 2.0 + p1.Y, (p2.Z - p1.Z) / 2.0 + p1.Z);
				SplitAndAddTriangle(geometry, p1, p4, p3, maxLengthInPixels);
				SplitAndAddTriangle(geometry, p3, p4, p2, maxLengthInPixels);
			}
			else if (num2 >= num && num2 >= num3 && num2 > maxLengthInPixels)
			{
				Point3D point3D = new Point3D((p3.X - p2.X) / 2.0 + p2.X, (p3.Y - p2.Y) / 2.0 + p2.Y, (p3.Z - p2.Z) / 2.0 + p2.Z);
				SplitAndAddTriangle(geometry, p1, point3D, p3, maxLengthInPixels);
				SplitAndAddTriangle(geometry, p1, p2, point3D, maxLengthInPixels);
			}
			else if (num3 >= num && num3 >= num2 && num3 > maxLengthInPixels)
			{
				Point3D point3D2 = new Point3D((p1.X - p3.X) / 2.0 + p3.X, (p1.Y - p3.Y) / 2.0 + p3.Y, (p1.Z - p3.Z) / 2.0 + p3.Z);
				SplitAndAddTriangle(geometry, p1, p2, point3D2, maxLengthInPixels);
				SplitAndAddTriangle(geometry, point3D2, p2, p3, maxLengthInPixels);
			}
			else
			{
				AddTriangle(geometry, p1, p2, p3);
			}
		}

		internal static List<GPolygon2D> SplitPolygon(GPolygon2D polygon, GPolygon2D previousPolygon, GPolygon2D nextPolygon)
		{
			List<GPolygon2D> list = new List<GPolygon2D>();
			if (previousPolygon != null || nextPolygon != null)
			{
				if (polygon.Vertices.Length == 3)
				{
					if (previousPolygon != null && IsLeftTriangle(polygon))
					{
						return SplitLeftSide(polygon, previousPolygon);
					}
					if (nextPolygon != null && IsRightTriangle(polygon))
					{
						return SplitRightSide(polygon, nextPolygon);
					}
				}
				else if (polygon.Vertices.Length == 4)
				{
					List<GPolygon2D> list2 = ((previousPolygon != null) ? SplitLeftSide(polygon, previousPolygon) : new List<GPolygon2D> { polygon });
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						if (i < list2.Count - 1 || nextPolygon == null)
						{
							list.Add(list2[i]);
						}
						else
						{
							list.AddRange(SplitRightSide(list2[i], nextPolygon));
						}
					}
					return list;
				}
			}
			list.Add(polygon);
			return list;
		}

		public AreaSeries3DData(AreaSeries3D series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			XYDiagram3DDomain xYDiagram3DDomain = (XYDiagram3DDomain)domain;
			double zOffset = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetValueByAxisX(AreaSeries.AreaWidth) / 2.0;
			AreaSeries3DLabelLayout labelLayout = (AreaSeries.LabelsVisibility ? new AreaSeries3DLabelLayout(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, GetLabelPoint(xYDiagram3DDomain, refinedPoint), default(Vector3D), zOffset) : null);
			return new XYSeriesModel3DInfo(SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint), null, labelLayout);
		}

		}

		}

		}

		protected internal override Point3D CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointCache pointCache, Diagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointCache.RefinedPoint;
			XYDiagram3DDomain domain2 = domain as XYDiagram3DDomain;
			return GetLabelPoint(domain2, refinedPoint);
		}

		public override void CreateModel(Diagram3DDomain domain, Model3DGroup modelHolder, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			base.CreateModel(domain, modelHolder, refinedSeries);
			XYDiagram3DDomain xYDiagram3DDomain = domain as XYDiagram3DDomain;
			GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator = new GeometryCalculator();
			IList<IGeometryStrip> list = geometryCalculator.CreateStrips(refinedSeries);
			if (xYDiagram3DDomain == null || list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Material actualMaterial = AreaSeries.ActualMaterial;
			Graphics3DUtils.SetMaterialBrush(actualMaterial, AreaSeries.MixColor(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesCache.DrawOptions.ActualColor), diffuseMaterialOnly: true);
			double epsilon = Math.Min(((IAxisData)xYDiagram3DDomain.Diagram.ActualAxisX).VisualRange.Delta, ((IAxisData)xYDiagram3DDomain.Diagram.ActualAxisY).VisualRange.Delta) * 0.01;
			double num = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetValueByAxisX(AreaSeries.AreaWidth) / 2.0;
			faceGeometry = new MeshGeometry3D();
			sideGeometry = new MeshGeometry3D();
			List<GRealPoint2D> list2 = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			foreach (RangeStrip item in list)
			{
				list2.AddRange(item.TopStrip);
				list2.AddRange(item.BottomStrip);
			}
			double num2 = list2[0].X;
			double num3 = list2[0].X;
			double num4 = list2[0].Y;
			double num5 = list2[0].Y;
			for (int i = 1; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				double x = list2[i].X;
				double y = list2[i].Y;
				if (x < num2)
				{
					num2 = x;
				}
				else if (x > num3)
				{
					num3 = x;
				}
				if (y < num4)
				{
					num4 = y;
				}
				else if (y > num5)
				{
					num5 = y;
				}
			}
			double num6 = ((IAxisData)xYDiagram3DDomain.Diagram.ActualAxisX).VisualRange.Delta / (num3 - num2);
			double num7 = ((IAxisData)xYDiagram3DDomain.Diagram.ActualAxisY).VisualRange.Delta / (num5 - num4);
			double maxLengthInPixels = 100.0 * Math.Max(1.0, 1.0 / (num6 * num7));
			foreach (RangeStrip item2 in list)
			{
				RangeStripTriangulationResult rangeStripTriangulationResult = RangeStripTriangulation.Triangulate(item2, epsilon);
				GPolygon2D previousPolygon = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < rangeStripTriangulationResult.Polygons.Count; j++)
				{
					GPolygon2D nextPolygon = ((j < rangeStripTriangulationResult.Polygons.Count - 1) ? rangeStripTriangulationResult.Polygons[j + 1] : null);
					List<GPolygon2D> list3 = SplitPolygon(rangeStripTriangulationResult.Polygons[j], previousPolygon, nextPolygon);
					foreach (GPolygon2D item3 in list3)
					{
						if (item3.Vertices.Length > 2)
						{
							Point3D diagramPoint = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetDiagramPoint(AreaSeries, item3.Vertices[0].X, item3.Vertices[0].Y);
							Point3D p = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetDiagramPoint(AreaSeries, item3.Vertices[1].X, item3.Vertices[1].Y);
							for (int k = 2; k < item3.Vertices.Length; k++)
							{
								Point3D diagramPoint2 = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetDiagramPoint(AreaSeries, item3.Vertices[k].X, item3.Vertices[k].Y);
								SplitAndAddTriangle(faceGeometry, diagramPoint, p, diagramPoint2, maxLengthInPixels);
								p = diagramPoint2;
							}
						}
					}
					previousPolygon = rangeStripTriangulationResult.Polygons[j];
				}
				LineStrip borderStrip = rangeStripTriangulationResult.BorderStrip;
				if (borderStrip.Count > 1)
				{
					Point3D diagramPoint3 = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetDiagramPoint(AreaSeries, borderStrip[0].X, borderStrip[0].Y);
					Point3D point = diagramPoint3;
					for (int l = 1; l < borderStrip.Count; l++)
					{
						Point3D diagramPoint4 = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetDiagramPoint(AreaSeries, borderStrip[l].X, borderStrip[l].Y);
						Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(sideGeometry, GetQuadrangle(point, diagramPoint4, num, maxLengthInPixels));
						point = diagramPoint4;
					}
					Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(sideGeometry, GetQuadrangle(point, diagramPoint3, num, maxLengthInPixels));
				}
			}
			GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D = new GeometryModel3D();
			geometryModel3D.Geometry = faceGeometry;
			geometryModel3D.Material = actualMaterial;
			GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D2 = geometryModel3D.Clone();
			OffsetByZ((MeshGeometry3D)geometryModel3D.Geometry, num);
			OffsetByZ((MeshGeometry3D)geometryModel3D2.Geometry, 0.0 - num);
			Invert((MeshGeometry3D)geometryModel3D2.Geometry);
			modelHolder.Children.Add(geometryModel3D);
			modelHolder.Children.Add(geometryModel3D2);
			GeometryModel3D geometryModel3D3 = new GeometryModel3D();
			geometryModel3D3.Geometry = sideGeometry;
			geometryModel3D3.Material = actualMaterial;
			modelHolder.Children.Add(geometryModel3D3);
			domain.OnModelAdd(refinedSeries.Series, geometryModel3D, geometryModel3D2, geometryModel3D3);
		}
	}

	public class FinancialValueToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		private readonly StockLevel valueLevel;

		public FinancialValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, StockLevel valueLevel)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
			this.valueLevel = valueLevel;
		}

		protected override object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			switch (valueLevel)
			{
			case StockLevel.LowValue:
				return values[0];
			case StockLevel.HighValue:
				return values[1];
			case StockLevel.OpenValue:
				return values[2];
			case StockLevel.CloseValue:
				return values[3];
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown StockLevel value.");
				return 0;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class Model3DInfo
	{
		private Model3D model;

		private Transform3D originalTransform;

		private ISeriesPoint point;

		private SeriesLabel3DLayout labelLayout;

		protected DependencyObject Point => point as DependencyObject;

		public Model3D Model => model;

		public SeriesLabel3DLayout LabelLayout => labelLayout;

		public Model3DInfo(ISeriesPoint point, Model3D model, SeriesLabel3DLayout labelLayout)
		{
			this.model = model;
			originalTransform = model?.Transform;
			this.point = point;
			this.labelLayout = labelLayout;
		}

		public void UpdateTransform(Transform3D commonTransform)
		{
			if (model == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Transform3D additionalTransform = GetAdditionalTransform();
			if (additionalTransform != null || commonTransform != null)
			{
				Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
				if (originalTransform != null)
				{
					transform3DGroup.Children.Add(originalTransform);
				}
				if (additionalTransform != null)
				{
					transform3DGroup.Children.Add(additionalTransform);
				}
				if (commonTransform != null)
				{
					transform3DGroup.Children.Add(commonTransform);
				}
				model.Transform = transform3DGroup;
				if (labelLayout != null)
				{
					labelLayout.SetTransform(transform3DGroup);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract Transform3D GetAdditionalTransform();
	}
	public class XYSeriesModel3DInfo : Model3DInfo
	{
		private Vector3D offset;

		private Size3D size;

		public XYSeriesModel3DInfo(ISeriesPoint point, Model3D model, XYSeriesLabel3DLayout labelLayout)
			: base(point, model, labelLayout)
		{
			if (model == null || model.Bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				offset = default(Vector3D);
				size = default(Size3D);
			}
			else
			{
				offset = new Vector3D(model.Bounds.Location.X, model.Bounds.Location.Y, model.Bounds.Location.Z);
				size = new Size3D(model.Bounds.Size.X / 2.0, model.Bounds.Size.Y / 2.0, model.Bounds.Size.Z / 2.0);
			}
		}

		private void ModifyTransform(Transform3D transform)
		{
			if (!(transform is Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup))
			{
				if (!(transform is RotateTransform3D rotateTransform3D))
				{
					if (!(transform is TranslateTransform3D translateTransform3D))
					{
						if (transform is ScaleTransform3D scaleTransform3D)
						{
							scaleTransform3D.CenterX *= size.X;
							scaleTransform3D.CenterY *= size.Y;
							scaleTransform3D.CenterZ *= size.Z;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						translateTransform3D.OffsetX *= size.X;
						translateTransform3D.OffsetY *= size.Y;
						translateTransform3D.OffsetZ *= size.Z;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					rotateTransform3D.CenterX *= size.X;
					rotateTransform3D.CenterY *= size.Y;
					rotateTransform3D.CenterZ *= size.Z;
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (Transform3D child in transform3DGroup.Children)
			{
				ModifyTransform(child);
			}
		}

		protected override Transform3D GetAdditionalTransform()
		{
			if (!(base.Point.GetValue(SeriesPointModel3D.TransformProperty) is Transform3D transform3D))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Transform3D transform3D2 = transform3D.CloneCurrentValue();
			ModifyTransform(transform3D2);
			Vector3D vector3D = new Vector3D(offset.X + size.X, offset.Y + size.Y, offset.Z + size.Z);
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform3D(-vector3D));
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(transform3D2);
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform3D(vector3D));
			return transform3DGroup;
		}
	}
	public class PieModel3DInfo : Model3DInfo
	{
		private double angleRadian;

		private double radius;

		private double explodeDistance;

		private SeriesPoint point;

		public PieModel3DInfo(SeriesPoint point, Model3D model, double angle, double radius, double explodeDistance, Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout)
			: base(point, model, labelLayout)
		{
			angleRadian = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angle);
			this.radius = radius;
			this.point = point;
			this.explodeDistance = explodeDistance;
		}

		protected override Transform3D GetAdditionalTransform()
		{
			double num = radius * explodeDistance;
			return new TranslateTransform3D(num * Math.Cos(angleRadian), 0.0, (0.0 - num) * Math.Sin(angleRadian));
		}
	}

	public class PointGeometry
	{
		private readonly ContentPresenter labelContentPresenter;

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

		public ContentPresenter LabelContentPresenter => labelContentPresenter;

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush Brush => brush;

		public bool IsLabelPresent
		{
			get
			{
				if (labelContentPresenter == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (labelContentPresenter.Content is SeriesLabelItem seriesLabelItem)
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesLabelItem.Text);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public PointGeometry(SeriesLabel label, ContentPresenter labelContentPresenter)
		{
			this.labelContentPresenter = labelContentPresenter;
			brush = RenderHelper.CreateBrush(labelContentPresenter, label);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (labelContentPresenter != null)
			{
				labelContentPresenter.Content = null;
				labelContentPresenter.ContentTemplate = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class SeriesCache : IEnumerable<SeriesPointCache>, IEnumerable, ISeriesItem
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, SeriesPointCache> seriesPointsCache = new Dictionary<ISeriesPoint, SeriesPointCache>();

		private DrawOptions drawOptions;

		private bool isPointsCacheDefinesFully;

		private string legendText;

		public bool IsPointsCacheDefinesFully => isPointsCacheDefinesFully;

		public DrawOptions DrawOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return drawOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				drawOptions = value;
			}
		}

		public string LegendText
		{
			get
			{
				return legendText;
			}
			set
			{
				legendText = value;
			}
		}

		bool ISeriesItem.ShouldUpdate => !((ISeriesItem)this).HasPoints;

		bool ISeriesItem.HasPoints => seriesPointsCache.Count > 0;

		IEnumerable<ISeriesPointData> ISeriesItem.PointData
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (SeriesPointCache item in (IEnumerable<SeriesPointCache>)this)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return seriesPointsCache.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<SeriesPointCache> IEnumerable<SeriesPointCache>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return seriesPointsCache.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ISeriesItem.Update(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, out bool shouldUpdateSeriesLabels)
		{
			shouldUpdateSeriesLabels = false;
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					seriesPointsCache.Add(point.SeriesPoint, new SeriesPointCache(point, num));
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointCache GetSeriesPointCache(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (seriesPointsCache.TryGetValue(seriesPoint, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return TryGetSeriesPointCacheByArgument(seriesPoint);
		}

		private SeriesPointCache TryGetSeriesPointCacheByArgument(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			foreach (ISeriesPoint key in seriesPointsCache.Keys)
			{
				if (key.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument == point.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument)
				{
					return seriesPointsCache[key];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ResetPointCacheGeometry(SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache)
		{
			if (seriesPointCache != null)
			{
				seriesPointCache.ShouldUpdateGeometry = true;
			}
			isPointsCacheDefinesFully = false;
		}

		private void SetPointLegendMarkerSelected(SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache, Series series, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (seriesPointCache != null)
			{
				LegendItem legendItem = series.GetLegendItem(seriesPointCache.LegendItemIndex);
				if (legendItem != null)
				{
					legendItem.IsSelected = isSelected;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ValidateSeriesPointCache(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, PointGeometry seriesGeometry)
		{
			SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = GetSeriesPointCache(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			if (seriesPointCache != null)
			{
				if (seriesPointCache.ShouldUpdateGeometry)
				{
					seriesPointCache.InitializePointGeometry(seriesGeometry);
					isPointsCacheDefinesFully = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("SeriesPointCache cant't be null.");
				isPointsCacheDefinesFully = false;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSelectionForPointCache(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, Series series, bool isSelected, bool shouldResetCache)
		{
			seriesPointsCache.TryGetValue(seriesPoint, out var value);
			if (shouldResetCache)
			{
				ResetPointCacheGeometry(value);
			}
			SetPointLegendMarkerSelected(value, series, isSelected);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (SeriesPointCache value in seriesPointsCache.Values)
			{
				value.Clear();
			}
			seriesPointsCache.Clear();
			isPointsCacheDefinesFully = false;
		}
	}
	public class ChartElementCollectionDecorator<TElement, TInterface> : IList<TInterface>, ICollection<TInterface>, IEnumerable<TInterface>, IEnumerable where TElement : class, TInterface
	{
		private class ChartElementEnumerator : IEnumerator<TInterface>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly IList<TInterface> collection;

			private int currentIndex = -1;

			public TInterface Current => collection[currentIndex];

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			TInterface IEnumerator<TInterface>.Current => Current;

			public ChartElementEnumerator(IList<TInterface> collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
				currentIndex = -1;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				return ++currentIndex < collection.Count;
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private readonly ChartElementCollection<TElement> collection;

		bool ICollection<TInterface>.IsReadOnly => false;

		int ICollection<TInterface>.Count => collection.Count;

		TInterface IList<TInterface>.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (TInterface)collection[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (value is TElement value2)
				{
					collection[index] = value2;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<TInterface> IEnumerable<TInterface>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ChartElementEnumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return collection.GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection<TInterface>.Add(TInterface item)
		{
			if (item is TElement item2)
			{
				collection.Add(item2);
			}
		}

		bool ICollection<TInterface>.Remove(TInterface item)
		{
			if (item is TElement item2)
			{
				return collection.Remove(item2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ICollection<TInterface>.Clear()
		{
			collection.Clear();
		}

		bool ICollection<TInterface>.Contains(TInterface item)
		{
			if (item is TElement item2)
			{
				return collection.Contains(item2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ICollection<TInterface>.CopyTo(TInterface[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			foreach (TInterface item in collection)
			{
				array[arrayIndex++] = item;
			}
		}

		void IList<TInterface>.Insert(int index, TInterface item)
		{
			if (item is TElement item2)
			{
				collection.Insert(index, item2);
			}
		}

		void IList<TInterface>.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			collection.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		int IList<TInterface>.IndexOf(TInterface item)
		{
			if (item is TElement item2)
			{
				return collection.IndexOf(item2);
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public ChartElementCollectionDecorator(ChartElementCollection<TElement> collection)
		{
			this.collection = collection;
		}
	}

	public static class Marker3DCalculator
	{
		private static void SetTransform(Model3D model, Rect3D bounds, Point3D point)
		{
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			Point3D center = MathUtils.CalcCenter(model.Bounds);
			Vector3D scale = new Vector3D(bounds.SizeX / model.Bounds.SizeX, bounds.SizeY / model.Bounds.SizeY, bounds.SizeZ / model.Bounds.SizeZ);
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform3D(scale, center));
			Vector3D offset = new Vector3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z);
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform3D(offset));
			model.Transform = transform3DGroup;
		}

		public static Model3D CalculateMarker(Model3D model, Rect3D bounds, Point3D point, SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			Model3D model3D = model.Clone();
			SetTransform(model3D, bounds, point);
			ColorUtils.MixBrushes(model3D, brush);
			return model3D;
		}
	}
	public abstract class MarkerSeries3DData : Series3DData
	{
		private MarkerSeries3D MarkerSeries => (MarkerSeries3D)base.Series;

		public MarkerSeries3DData(MarkerSeries3D series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private XYSeriesLabel3DLayout CreateLabelLayout(Model3D model)
		{
			if (!MarkerSeries.LabelsVisibility)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Point3D point3D = MathUtils.CalcCenter(model.Bounds);
			switch (MarkerSeries3D.GetLabelPosition(MarkerSeries.ActualLabel))
			{
			case Marker3DLabelPosition.Top:
			{
				Point3D point = new Point3D(point3D.X, point3D.Y + model.Bounds.SizeY / 2.0, point3D.Z);
				return new Marker3DLabelLayout(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, point, point3D, new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), model.Bounds);
			}
			case Marker3DLabelPosition.Center:
				return new Marker3DLabelLayout(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, point3D, point3D, default(Vector3D), model.Bounds);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown Marker3DLabelPosition value.");
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected abstract double CalculateMarkerSize(XYDiagram3DDomain domain, RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		protected override Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			XYDiagram3DDomain xYDiagram3DDomain = (XYDiagram3DDomain)domain;
			double animatedValueFromPoint = GetAnimatedValueFromPoint(refinedPoint);
			Point3D diagramPoint = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, refinedPoint.Argument, animatedValueFromPoint);
			double num = CalculateMarkerSize(xYDiagram3DDomain, refinedPoint);
			Rect3D bounds = new Rect3D(default(Point3D), new Size3D(num, num, num));
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(refinedPoint);
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Model3D model = Marker3DCalculator.CalculateMarker(MarkerSeries.ActualModel.GetModel(), bounds, diagramPoint, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetSeriesPointColorBrush(refinedPoint));
			return new XYSeriesModel3DInfo(seriesPoint, model, CreateLabelLayout(model));
		}

		protected internal override Point3D CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointCache pointCache, Diagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			Point3D result = default(Point3D);
			if (pointCache.PointGeometry is Series3DPointGeometry series3DPointGeometry)
			{
				return MathUtils.CalcCenter(series3DPointGeometry.ModelInfo.Model.Bounds);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
