	public struct LegendPosition : IEquatable<LegendPosition>
	{
		public HorizontalPosition HorizontalPosition { get; set; }

		public VerticalPosition VerticalPosition { get; set; }

		public LegendPosition(HorizontalPosition horizontalPosition, VerticalPosition verticalPosition)
		{
			HorizontalPosition = horizontalPosition;
			VerticalPosition = verticalPosition;
		}

		public bool Equals(LegendPosition legendPosition)
		{
			if (HorizontalPosition == legendPosition.HorizontalPosition)
			{
				return VerticalPosition == legendPosition.VerticalPosition;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<HorizontalPosition, VerticalPosition>(HorizontalPosition, VerticalPosition);
		}
	}
	public abstract class TargetLegendCollection : ObservableCollection<LegendBase>, ISplitTargetCollection<LegendBase>, ICollection<LegendBase>, IEnumerable<LegendBase>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected abstract bool ShouldContainElement(LegendBase element);

		bool ISplitTargetCollection<LegendBase>.ShouldContainsElement(LegendBase element)
		{
			return ShouldContainElement(element);
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, LegendBase item)
		{
			if (item.CanCollect)
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			using (IEnumerator<LegendBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					LegendBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.CanCollect)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}
	}
	public class ChartTargetLegendsCollection : TargetLegendCollection
	{
		internal bool ShouldContainsAllLegends { get; set; }

		protected override bool ShouldContainElement(LegendBase element)
		{
			Legend legend = (Legend)element;
			if (legend.ActualDockTarget is Pane)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ShouldContainsAllLegends)
			{
				return legend.IsOutsidePosition;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class PaneTargetLegendsCollection : TargetLegendCollection
	{
		private readonly Pane pane;

		internal bool IsDefaultPane { get; set; }

		public PaneTargetLegendsCollection(Pane pane)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldContainElement(LegendBase element)
		{
			Legend legend = (Legend)element;
			if (pane != null && legend.ActualDockTarget == pane)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (legend.ActualDockTarget == null && IsDefaultPane)
			{
				return element.IsInsidePosition;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class FontPropertiesBinder
	{
		private static List<DependencyProperty> sourceProperties;

		static FontPropertiesBinder()
		{
			sourceProperties = new List<DependencyProperty>();
			sourceProperties.Add(Control.ForegroundProperty);
			sourceProperties.Add(Control.FontFamilyProperty);
			sourceProperties.Add(Control.FontSizeProperty);
			sourceProperties.Add(Control.FontStretchProperty);
			sourceProperties.Add(Control.FontStyleProperty);
			sourceProperties.Add(Control.FontWeightProperty);
		}

		public static void AttachPropertiesNotification(Type ownerType, PropertyChangedCallback notification)
		{
			foreach (DependencyProperty sourceProperty in sourceProperties)
			{
				sourceProperty.OverrideMetadata(ownerType, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(notification));
			}
		}
	}
	public class BarSeries3DData : Series3DData
	{
		private BarSeries3D BarSeries => (BarSeries3D)base.Series;

		public BarSeries3DData(ISeriesLabelDataProvider seriesLabelDataProvider)
			: base(seriesLabelDataProvider)
		{
		}

		public static Point3D CalcSeriesLabelPoint(Rect3D modelBounds, bool invertByY)
		{
			Point3D result = MathUtils.CalcCenter(modelBounds);
			double offsetY = (invertByY ? ((0.0 - modelBounds.SizeY) / 2.0) : (modelBounds.SizeY / 2.0));
			result.Offset(0.0, offsetY, 0.0);
			return result;
		}

		private Point3D GetLowPoint(RefinedPoint pointInfo, XYDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			return GetClippedPoint(pointInfo.Argument, 0.0, domain);
		}

		private Point3D GetHighPoint(ISideBySideBarPoint refinedPoint, XYDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			double animatedValueFromPoint = GetAnimatedValueFromPoint(refinedPoint);
			return GetClippedPoint(refinedPoint.Argument, animatedValueFromPoint, domain);
		}

		protected Point3D GetClippedPoint(double argument, double value, XYDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			return ClipPointY(domain.GetDiagramPoint(base.Series, argument, value), domain);
		}

		private Point3D ClipPointY(Point3D point, XYDiagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			double val = 0.0;
			double innerHeight = domain.DiagramBox.InnerHeight;
			point.Y = Math.Min(Math.Max(point.Y, val), innerHeight);
			return point;
		}

		protected Model3DInfo CreateModelInfo(Point3D lowPoint, Point3D highPoint, double barWidth, RefinedPoint pointInfo)
		{
			lowPoint.Offset((0.0 - barWidth) / 2.0, 0.0, (0.0 - barWidth) / 2.0);
			bool flag = highPoint.Y < lowPoint.Y;
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint.GetSeriesPoint(pointInfo);
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = highPoint.Y - lowPoint.Y;
			num = ((num == 0.0) ? double.Epsilon : num);
			Box box = new Box(lowPoint, barWidth, num, barWidth);
			SolidColorBrush seriesPointColorBrush = base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetSeriesPointColorBrush(pointInfo);
			Model3D model3D = Bar3DCalculator.CalculateBar(BarSeries.ActualModel.SectionsData, box.Bounds, flag, keepXZRatio: true, seriesPointColorBrush);
			XYSeriesLabel3DLayout labelLayout = (BarSeries.LabelsVisibility ? new XYSeriesLabel3DLayout(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, CalcSeriesLabelPoint(model3D.Bounds, flag), new Vector3D(0.0, (!flag) ? 1 : (-1), 0.0)) : null);
			return new XYSeriesModel3DInfo(seriesPoint, model3D, labelLayout);
		}

		protected override Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			XYDiagram3DDomain xYDiagram3DDomain = (XYDiagram3DDomain)domain;
			Point3D lowPoint = GetLowPoint(refinedPoint, xYDiagram3DDomain);
			Point3D highPoint = GetHighPoint(refinedPoint, xYDiagram3DDomain);
			double valueByAxisX = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetValueByAxisX(BarSeries.BarWidth);
			return CreateModelInfo(lowPoint, highPoint, valueByAxisX, refinedPoint);
		}

		protected internal override Point3D CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointCache pointCache, Diagram3DDomain domain)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointCache.RefinedPoint;
			XYDiagram3DDomain domain2 = domain as XYDiagram3DDomain;
			Point3D result = default(Point3D);
			if (pointCache.PointGeometry is Series3DPointGeometry series3DPointGeometry)
			{
				return CalcSeriesLabelPoint(series3DPointGeometry.ModelInfo.Model.Bounds, GetHighPoint(refinedPoint, domain2).Y < GetLowPoint(refinedPoint, domain2).Y);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class BarSideBySideSeries3DData : BarSeries3DData
	{
		public BarSideBySideSeries3DData(BarSideBySideSeries3D series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			XYDiagram3DDomain xYDiagram3DDomain = (XYDiagram3DDomain)domain;
			XYDiagram3D diagram = xYDiagram3DDomain.Diagram;
			IVisualAxisRangeData visualRange = ((IAxisData)diagram.ActualAxisX).VisualRange;
			double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
			argument += ((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).Offset + (double)((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).FixedOffset * (visualRange.Max - visualRange.Min) / diagram.ActualViewport.Width;
			Point3D clippedPoint = GetClippedPoint(argument, 0.0, xYDiagram3DDomain);
			double animatedValueFromPoint = GetAnimatedValueFromPoint(refinedPoint);
			Point3D clippedPoint2 = GetClippedPoint(argument, animatedValueFromPoint, xYDiagram3DDomain);
			double valueByAxisX = xYDiagram3DDomain.GetValueByAxisX(((ISideBySidePoint)refinedPoint).BarWidth);
			return CreateModelInfo(clippedPoint, clippedPoint2, valueByAxisX, refinedPoint);
		}
	}
	public class Pie3DLabelVisual : DrawingVisual
	{
	}
	public class SimpleDiagram3DDomain : Diagram3DDomain
	{
		private PieSeries3DData SeriesData
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesDataList.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.SeriesDataList[0] as PieSeries3DData;
			}
		}

		public bool IsTopVisible => base.RotationOnlyTransform.Transform(new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)).Z > 0.0;

		public SimpleDiagram3DDomain(SimpleDiagram3D diagram, Rect viewport, PieSeries3D series)
			: base(diagram, viewport, new SeriesData[1] { series.CreateSeriesData() }, new SimpleDiagram3DBox(series))
		{
		}

		private void RenderLabels(IPieLabelLayout labelLayout, DrawingContext context)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Pie3DLabelLayout pie3DLabelLayout = labelLayout as Pie3DLabelLayout;
			context.DrawRectangle(RenderHelper.CreateBrush(pie3DLabelLayout.ContentPresenter, pie3DLabelLayout.Label), null, LabelBoundsAsRect(labelLayout.LabelBounds));
		}

		private void RenderLabelConnectors(IPieLabelLayout labelLayout, DrawingContext context)
		{
			Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout2 = labelLayout as Pie3DLabelLayout;
			RenderLabelConnector(labelLayout2, context);
		}

		private void RenderLabelConnector(Pie3DLabelLayout labelLayout, DrawingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (labelLayout.Position == PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns && labelLayout.Label.ConnectorVisible)
			{
				System.Windows.Point labelPoint2D = labelLayout.GetLabelPoint2D(this);
				GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(labelPoint2D.X, labelPoint2D.Y);
				GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = ResolveOverlappingHelper.CalculateSalientPoint(anchorPoint, labelLayout.LabelBounds, labelLayout.Angle);
				System.Windows.Point point = ((!gRealPoint2D.HasValue) ? labelPoint2D : new System.Windows.Point(gRealPoint2D.Value.X, gRealPoint2D.Value.Y));
				System.Windows.Point point2 = labelLayout.CalculateLabelConnectPoint(this);
				context.DrawLine(new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(labelLayout.LabelConnectorColor), labelLayout.Label.ConnectorThickness), labelPoint2D, point);
				context.DrawLine(new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(labelLayout.LabelConnectorColor), labelLayout.Label.ConnectorThickness), point, point2);
			}
		}

		private Rect LabelBoundsAsRect(DXRectangle gRect)
		{
			return new Rect(((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Height);
		}

		public override void ValidateSeriesPointsCache()
		{
			foreach (SeriesData seriesData in base.SeriesDataList)
			{
				IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(seriesData.Series);
				seriesData.ValidateSeriesPointsCache(this, refinedSeries);
			}
		}

		protected override void Render3DContent(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			if (SeriesData != null)
			{
				IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(SeriesData.Series);
				if (refinedSeries != null)
				{
					SeriesData.Create3DContent(this, refinedSeries, modelHolder);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Render2DContent(DrawingVisual visualHolder)
		{
			if (SeriesData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IRefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(SeriesData.Series);
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<IPieLabelLayout> enumerable = SeriesData.CreateLabelsVisual(this, refinedSeries);
			foreach (Pie3DLabelLayout item in enumerable)
			{
				DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new Pie3DLabelVisual();
				using (DrawingContext context = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
				{
					RenderLabels(item, context);
					RenderLabelConnectors(item, context);
				}
				drawingVisual.SetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesPointLabelHitTestInfoProperty, item.Label);
				drawingVisual.SetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesPointHitTestInfoProperty, item.RefinedPoint);
				drawingVisual.SetValue(ChartControlBase.SeriesHitTestInfoProperty, SeriesData.Series);
				visualHolder.Children.Add(drawingVisual);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SimpleDiagram3DBox : Diagram3DBox
	{
		private const int magicRadius = 1000;

		private readonly PieSeries3D series;

		public SimpleDiagram3DBox(PieSeries3D series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			double num = CalcDepthToWidthRatio();
			base.InnerWidth = Math.Sqrt(4000000.0 / (1.0 + num * num));
			base.InnerHeight = base.Width;
			base.InnerDepth = num * base.Width;
		}

		private double CalcDepthToWidthRatio()
		{
			if (series == null || series.ActualModel == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = series.ActualModel.GetSize();
			if (size.IsEmpty || size.Width == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = series.DepthTransform * size.Height / size.Width;
			double num2 = 1.0 - Pie3DCalculator.NormalizeHoleRadiusRatio(series.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0);
			return num2 * num / 2.0;
		}

		public override double CalcViewRadius()
		{
			return 1000.0;
		}

		public override Transform3D CreateModelTransform()
		{
			return new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 90.0));
		}
	}
	public abstract class PointOptionsContainerBase
	{
		private readonly Series series;

		protected Series Series => series;

		public abstract PointOptions PointOptions { get; }

		public string Pattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PointOptions.Pattern))
				{
					return PointOptions.Pattern;
				}
				string text = PointOptionsHelper.ConvertToPattern((PointViewKind)PointOptions.PointView);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
				return "{V}";
			}
		}

		public INumericOptions ArgumentNumericOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointOptions.ArgumentNumericOptions == null)
				{
					return new NumericOptions();
				}
				return PointOptions.ArgumentNumericOptions;
			}
		}

		public IDateTimeOptions ArgumentDateTimeOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointOptions.ArgumentDateTimeOptions == null)
				{
					return new DateTimeOptions();
				}
				return PointOptions.ArgumentDateTimeOptions;
			}
		}

		public INumericOptions ValueNumericOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointOptions.ValueNumericOptions == null)
				{
					return new NumericOptions();
				}
				return PointOptions.ValueNumericOptions;
			}
		}

		public IDateTimeOptions ValueDateTimeOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (PointOptions.ValueDateTimeOptions == null)
				{
					return new DateTimeOptions();
				}
				return PointOptions.ValueDateTimeOptions;
			}
		}

		public PointOptionsContainerBase(Series series)
		{
			this.series = series;
		}

		public PercentOptions GetPercentOptions(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			return (PercentOptions)PointOptions.GetValue(property);
		}

		internal string ConstructPatternFromPointOptions(Series series, ScaleType argumentScaleType, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = Pattern;
			if (text.Contains("{A}"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("{A}", ConstructArgumentPattern(argumentScaleType));
			}
			if (text.Contains("{V}"))
			{
				string newValue = series.ConstructValuePattern(this, valueScaleType);
				text = text.Replace("{V}", newValue);
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal string ConstructValuePatternFromPercentOptions(PercentOptions percentOptions, ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			if (percentOptions == null)
			{
				percentOptions = new PercentOptions();
			}
			string text = "V";
			if (percentOptions.ValueAsPercent)
			{
				text = "VP:" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(ValueNumericOptions);
				if (ValueNumericOptions.Format == NumericOptionsFormat.General)
				{
					text += percentOptions.PercentageAccuracy;
				}
				return "{" + text + "}";
			}
			return ConstructValuePattern(valueScaleType);
		}

		internal string ConstructValueFormat(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (valueScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				text = text + ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(ValueNumericOptions);
				break;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				text = text + ":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(ValueDateTimeOptions);
				break;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal string ConstructValuePattern(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			string text = ConstructValueFormat(valueScaleType);
			return "{V" + text + "}";
		}

		internal string ConstructArgumentPattern(ScaleType argumentScaleType)
		{
			string text = "{A";
			switch (argumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				text = text + ":" + NumericOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(ArgumentNumericOptions);
				break;
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				text = text + ":" + DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetFormatString(ArgumentDateTimeOptions);
				break;
			}
			return text + "}";
		}
	}

	public class BubbleValueToStringConverter : ValueToStringConverter
	{
		public const string Separator = ", ";

		private readonly BubbleLabelValueToDisplay valueToDisplay;

		public BubbleValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions, BubbleLabelValueToDisplay valueToDisplay)
			: base(numericOptions, dateTimeOptions)
		{
			this.valueToDisplay = valueToDisplay;
		}

		public override string ConvertTo(object[] values)
		{
			switch (valueToDisplay)
			{
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Value:
				return GetValueText(values[0]);
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.Weight:
				return GetValueText(values[1]);
			case BubbleLabelValueToDisplay.ValueAndWeight:
				return GetValueText(values[0]) + ", " + GetValueText(values[1]);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown BubbleLabelValueToDisplay value.");
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface ISeriesLabelDataProvider : ISeries, ISeriesBase, ISeriesPointFactory
	{
		SeriesLabel SeriesLabel { get; }

		SeriesCache SeriesCache { get; }

		bool LabelsResolveOverlappingSupported { get; }

		bool LabelConnectorSupported { get; }

		string[] GetLabelsTexts(SeriesLabel label, RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		System.Windows.Media.Color GetPointLabelColor(RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		SolidColorBrush GetSeriesPointColorBrush(RefinedPoint refinedPoint);

		void SetLabelsVisibility(bool value);

		bool IsLabelConnectorItemVisible(SeriesLabel label);
	}
	public abstract class SeriesData
	{
		private readonly ISeries series;

		private readonly ISeriesLabelDataProvider seriesLabelDataProvider;

		protected ISeriesLabelDataProvider SeriesLabelDataProvider => seriesLabelDataProvider;

		public ISeries Series => series;

		public SeriesData(ISeriesLabelDataProvider seriesLabelDataProvider)
		{
			this.seriesLabelDataProvider = seriesLabelDataProvider;
			series = seriesLabelDataProvider;
		}

		public void ValidateSeriesPointsCache(Domain3DBase domain, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesCache.IsPointsCacheDefinesFully)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesCache.ValidateSeriesPointCache(point, CreateSeriesPointGeometry(domain, point));
				}
			}
		}

		protected ContentPresenter CreateSeriesPointLabelContentPresenter(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			SeriesLabel seriesLabel = SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel;
			if (refinedPoint.IsEmpty || !SeriesLabelDataProvider.LabelsVisibility)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesCache.GetSeriesPointCache(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			if (seriesPointCache != null)
			{
				empty = seriesPointCache.LabelText;
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("SeriesPointCache cant't be null.");
				empty = SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetLabelsTexts(seriesLabel, refinedPoint)[0];
			}
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			contentPresenter.ContentTemplate = TemplateHelper.GetSeriesLabelTemplate();
			contentPresenter.Content = new SeriesLabelItem(seriesLabel, refinedPoint, empty, SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetPointLabelColor(refinedPoint));
			contentPresenter.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			contentPresenter.Arrange(new Rect
			{
				Width = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width,
				Height = contentPresenter.DesiredSize.Height
			});
			return contentPresenter;
		}

		protected PointGeometry GetPointGeometry(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain)
		{
			SeriesPointCache seriesPointCache = SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesCache.GetSeriesPointCache(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint);
			if (seriesPointCache != null && seriesPointCache.PointGeometry != null)
			{
				return seriesPointCache.PointGeometry;
			}
			return CreateSeriesPointGeometry(domain, refinedPoint);
		}

		protected virtual PointGeometry CreateSeriesPointGeometry(Domain3DBase domain, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return new PointGeometry(SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, CreateSeriesPointLabelContentPresenter(refinedPoint));
		}

		protected internal abstract Point3D CalculateToolTipPoint(SeriesPointCache pointCache, Diagram3DDomain domain);
	}
	public abstract class Series3DData : SeriesData
	{
		public Series3DData(ISeriesLabelDataProvider seriesLabelDataProvider)
			: base(seriesLabelDataProvider)
		{
		}

		protected double GetAnimatedValueFromPoint(IBasePoint point)
		{
			if (point.SeriesPoint is IPlatformSeriesPoint { AnimatedValue: not null, AnimatedValue: var animatedValue })
			{
				return animatedValue.Value;
			}
			return point.SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0];
		}

		protected override PointGeometry CreateSeriesPointGeometry(Domain3DBase domain, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = CreateSeriesPointLabelContentPresenter(refinedPoint);
			return new Series3DPointGeometry(base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel, contentPresenter, Label3DHelper.CreateModel(contentPresenter, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.SeriesLabel), CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(refinedPoint, domain));
		}

		protected abstract Model3DInfo CreateSeriesPointModelInfo(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Domain3DBase domain);

		public void CreateLabelsModel(Domain3DBase domain, Model3DGroup modelHolder, List<LabelModelContainer> transparentLabelContainers, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty && GetPointGeometry(point, domain) is Series3DPointGeometry { ModelInfo: not null, ModelInfo: { LabelLayout: { } labelLayout }, IsLabelPresent: not false } series3DPointGeometry)
				{
					LabelModelContainer labelModelContainer = labelLayout.CreateModel(domain, series3DPointGeometry, base.SeriesLabelDataProvider.GetPointLabelColor(point), modelHolder);
					Chart3DControl.SetSeriesPointLabelHitTestInfo(labelModelContainer.Model, point, base.Series, labelLayout.Label);
					transparentLabelContainers.Add(labelModelContainer);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void CreateModel(Diagram3DDomain domain, Model3DGroup modelHolder, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in refinedSeries.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty && GetPointGeometry(point, domain) is Series3DPointGeometry { ModelInfo: { } modelInfo } series3DPointGeometry)
				{
					series3DPointGeometry.ModelInfo.UpdateTransform(null);
					Model3D model = modelInfo.Model;
					if (model != null)
					{
						Chart3DControl.SetSeriesPointHitTestInfo(model, point);
						modelHolder.Children.Add(model);
						domain.OnModelAdd(point, model);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CopyPropertyValueHelper
	{
		private static void CopyPropertyValueCore(DependencyObject recipient, DependencyObject source, DependencyProperty dp, bool copyByRef)
		{
			if (!IsValueSet(source, dp))
			{
				return;
			}
			object value = source.GetValue(dp);
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = value as DependencyObject;
			Binding binding = BindingOperations.GetBinding(source, dp);
			if (binding != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(recipient, dp, binding);
				return;
			}
			if (!copyByRef && dependencyObject != null)
			{
				try
				{
					using StringReader stringReader = new StringReader(XamlWriter.Save(dependencyObject));
					using XmlReader reader = SafeXml.CreateReader((TextReader)stringReader);
					dependencyObject = XamlReader.Load(reader) as DependencyObject;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			recipient.SetValue(dp, (dependencyObject == null) ? value : dependencyObject);
		}

		public static void CopyPropertyValue(DependencyObject recipient, DependencyObject source, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			CopyPropertyValueCore(recipient, source, dp, copyByRef: false);
		}

		public static void CopyPropertyValueByRef(DependencyObject recipient, DependencyObject source, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			CopyPropertyValueCore(recipient, source, dp, copyByRef: true);
		}

		public static bool IsValueSet(DependencyObject source, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			BaseValueSource baseValueSource = DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(source, dp).BaseValueSource;
			if (baseValueSource != BaseValueSource.DefaultStyle && baseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Style && baseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				return baseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Inherited;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool VerifyValues(DependencyObject recipient, DependencyObject source, DependencyProperty dp)
		{
			Binding binding = BindingOperations.GetBinding(source, dp);
			if (binding != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(recipient, dp, binding);
				return false;
			}
			object obj = source.ReadLocalValue(dp);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			recipient.SetValue(dp, null);
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class ColorUtils
	{
		private static readonly System.Windows.Media.Color defaultColor = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 128, 128, 128);

		public static readonly System.Windows.Media.Color Empty = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);

		private static bool IsNormalizedOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (offset >= 0.0)
			{
				return offset <= 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsVerticalGradientBrush(LinearGradientBrush gradientBrush)
		{
			if (gradientBrush == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return gradientBrush.StartPoint.X == gradientBrush.EndPoint.X;
		}

		private static LinearGradientBrush NormalizeVerticalGradientBrush(LinearGradientBrush gradientBrush)
		{
			if (!IsVerticalGradientBrush(gradientBrush))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = gradientBrush.EndPoint.Y - gradientBrush.StartPoint.Y;
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(gradientBrush.StartPoint.X, 0.0);
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(gradientBrush.EndPoint.X, 1.0);
			foreach (GradientStop gradientStop in gradientBrush.GradientStops)
			{
				double offset = gradientBrush.StartPoint.Y + gradientStop.Offset * num;
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop
				{
					Offset = offset,
					Color = gradientStop.Color
				});
			}
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private static byte MixChannel(byte fromValue, byte toValue, double ratio)
		{
			return (byte)MathUtilsCore.MinMax((double)(int)fromValue * (1.0 - ratio) + (double)(int)toValue * ratio, (int)fromValue, (int)toValue);
		}

		public static LinearGradientBrush InterpolateVerticalGradientBrush(LinearGradientBrush gradientBrush, double startOffset, double endOffset)
		{
			if (gradientBrush == null || !IsVerticalGradientBrush(gradientBrush) || !IsNormalizedOffset(startOffset) || !IsNormalizedOffset(endOffset))
			{
				return null;
			}
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = NormalizeVerticalGradientBrush(gradientBrush);
			if (linearGradientBrush != null)
			{
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(linearGradientBrush.StartPoint.X, linearGradientBrush.StartPoint.Y - startOffset / (endOffset - startOffset));
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(linearGradientBrush.EndPoint.X, linearGradientBrush.EndPoint.Y + (1.0 - endOffset) / (endOffset - startOffset));
			}
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		public static SolidColorBrush GetTransparentBrush(SolidColorBrush brush, double transparency)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(transparency))
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb((byte)(255.0 * (1.0 - transparency)), brush.Color.R, brush.Color.G, brush.Color.B));
			}
			return brush;
		}

		public static SolidColorBrush GetNotTransparentBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, brush.Color.R, brush.Color.G, brush.Color.B));
		}

		public static SolidColorBrush MixWithDefaultColor(System.Windows.Media.Color targetColor)
		{
			return (SolidColorBrush)ColorHelper.MixColors((System.Windows.Media.Brush)new SolidColorBrush(defaultColor), targetColor);
		}

		public static void MixBrushes(Model3D model, SolidColorBrush targetBrush, MaterialBrushCache brushesCache)
		{
			if (targetBrush == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (model is Model3DGroup)
			{
				Model3DGroup model3DGroup = (Model3DGroup)model;
				{
					foreach (Model3D child in model3DGroup.Children)
					{
						MixBrushes(child, targetBrush, brushesCache);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (model is GeometryModel3D)
			{
				Graphics3DUtils.SetMaterialBrush(((GeometryModel3D)model).Material, targetBrush, brushesCache, diffuseMaterialOnly: true);
			}
		}

		public static void MixBrushes(Model3D model, SolidColorBrush targetBrush)
		{
			MixBrushes(model, targetBrush, null);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color? ParseColor(object color)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color? result = null;
			if (color is System.Windows.Media.Color)
			{
				result = (System.Windows.Media.Color)color;
			}
			if (color is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				return ((SolidColorBrush)color).Color;
			}
			if (color is int)
			{
				byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes((int)color);
				result = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(bytes[3], bytes[2], bytes[1], bytes[0]);
			}
			else if (color is uint)
			{
				byte[] bytes2 = BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)color);
				result = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(bytes2[3], bytes2[2], bytes2[1], bytes2[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				if (color is double)
				{
					return ConvertFromArgb(Convert.ToInt32(color));
				}
				if (color is string)
				{
					string value = (string)color;
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
					{
						try
						{
							result = (System.Windows.Media.Color)System.Windows.Media.ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(value);
							return result;
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static int ParseColorToInt(object colorItem)
		{
			return ConvertToArgb(ParseColor(colorItem) ?? Empty);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color MixColors(System.Windows.Media.Color fromUnit, System.Windows.Media.Color toUnit, double ratio)
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(MixChannel(fromUnit.A, toUnit.A, ratio), MixChannel(fromUnit.R, toUnit.R, ratio), MixChannel(fromUnit.G, toUnit.G, ratio), MixChannel(fromUnit.B, toUnit.B, ratio));
		}

		public static int ConvertToArgb(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return (color.A << 24) | (color.R << 16) | (color.G << 8) | color.B;
		}

		public static int ConvertToArgb(System.Windows.Media.Color? color)
		{
			if (!color.HasValue)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return ConvertToArgb(color.Value);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ConvertFromArgb(int argb)
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb((byte)(argb >> 24), (byte)(argb >> 16), (byte)(argb >> 8), (byte)argb);
		}
	}

	public sealed class AnnotationCursors

		private static BitmapCursor CreateCursor(string fileName, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			return new BitmapCursor(LoadCursorImageFromResource($"DevExpress.Xpf.Charts.Images.{fileName}", Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(BitmapCursor))), offset);
		}

		private static BitmapImage LoadCursorImageFromResource(string resourceName, Assembly assembly)
		{
			using Stream streamSource = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(resourceName);
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage();
			bitmapImage.BeginInit();
			try
			{
				bitmapImage.StreamSource = streamSource;
			}
			finally
			{
				bitmapImage.EndInit();
			}
			return bitmapImage;
		}

	public static class RectExtensions
	{
		public static readonly Rect Zero = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

		public static System.Windows.Point CalcRelativeToLeftTopCenter(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Height / 2.0);
		}

		public static GRealRect2D ToGRealRect2D(this Rect rect)
		{
			return new GRealRect2D(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public static bool IsEmptyOrZero(this Rect rect)
		{
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect == Zero;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Rect GetRectanglePlacedInCenter(this Rect thisRect, System.Windows.Size smallerRectSize)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(thisRect.Width >= smallerRectSize.Width && thisRect.Height >= smallerRectSize.Height);
			double x = thisRect.X + (thisRect.Width - smallerRectSize.Width) / 2.0;
			double y = thisRect.Y + (thisRect.Height - smallerRectSize.Height) / 2.0;
			return new Rect(x, y, smallerRectSize.Width, smallerRectSize.Height);
		}

		public static Rect Decrease(this Rect thisRect, Thickness thickness)
		{
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(thisRect.Left + thickness.Left);
			int num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(thisRect.Top + thickness.Top);
			int num3 = MathUtils.StrongRound(thisRect.Width - thickness.Left - thickness.Right);
			int num4 = MathUtils.StrongRound(thisRect.Height - thickness.Top - thickness.Bottom);
			num3 = ((num3 >= 0) ? num3 : 0);
			num4 = ((num4 >= 0) ? num4 : 0);
			return new Rect(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}
	}
	public static class RectangleExtensions
	{
		public static Rect ToRect(this System.Drawing.Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			return new Rect(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
		}
	}
	public static class TransformExtensions
	{
		public static bool IsIdentity(this Transform transform)
		{
			if (transform is MatrixTransform matrixTransform)
			{
				return matrixTransform.Matrix == Matrix.Identity;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class PointExtensions
	{
		public static GRealPoint2D ToGRealPoint2D(this System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static double CalculateDistanceTo(this System.Windows.Point thisPoint, System.Windows.Point anotherPoint)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt((thisPoint.X - anotherPoint.X) * (thisPoint.X - anotherPoint.X) + (thisPoint.Y - anotherPoint.Y) * (thisPoint.Y - anotherPoint.Y));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point MoveByVector(this System.Windows.Point thisPoint, double deltaX, double deltaY)
		{
			double x = thisPoint.X + deltaX;
			double y = thisPoint.Y + deltaY;
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point MoveByAngle(this System.Windows.Point startPoint, double length, double angleDeg)
		{
			double num = MathUtils.Degree2Radian(angleDeg);
			return new System.Windows.Point(startPoint.X + Math.Cos(num) * length, startPoint.Y + Math.Sin(num) * length);
		}
	}
	public static class GRealPoint2DExtensions
	{
		public static System.Windows.Point ToPoint(this GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y);
		}
	}
	public static class DxRectExtensions
	{
		public static Rect ToRect(this DXRectangle gRect)
		{
			return new Rect(((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref gRect)).Height);
		}

		public static DXRectangle Inflate(this DXRectangle thisGRect, Thickness thickness)
		{
			//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = ((DXRectangle)(ref thisGRect)).Left - MathUtils.StrongRound(thickness.Left);
			int num2 = ((DXRectangle)(ref thisGRect)).Top - MathUtils.StrongRound(thickness.Top);
			int num3 = ((DXRectangle)(ref thisGRect)).Width + MathUtils.StrongRound(thickness.Left + thickness.Right);
			int num4 = ((DXRectangle)(ref thisGRect)).Height + MathUtils.StrongRound(thickness.Top + thickness.Bottom);
			num3 = ((num3 >= 0) ? num3 : 0);
			num4 = ((num4 >= 0) ? num4 : 0);
			return new DXRectangle(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}
	}
	public static class ColorArgbExtensions
	{
		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ToColor(this ColorARGB modelColor)
		{
			if (!(modelColor != ColorARGB.Empty))
			{
				return Colors.Transparent;
			}
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(modelColor.A, modelColor.R, modelColor.G, modelColor.B);
		}
	}
	public static class DashStyleExtensions
	{
		public static System.Windows.Media.DashStyle ToDashStyle(this DevExpress.Charts.Model.DashStyle dashModel)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.DashStyle dashStyle = new System.Windows.Media.DashStyle();
			dashStyle.Dashes = new DoubleCollection();
			switch (dashModel)
			{
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.DashStyle.Dash:
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				return dashStyle;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.DashStyle.DashDot:
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(0.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				return dashStyle;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.DashStyle.DashDotDot:
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(0.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(0.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				return dashStyle;
			case DevExpress.Charts.Model.DashStyle.Dot:
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(0.0);
				dashStyle.Dashes.Add(2.0);
				return dashStyle;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class GraphicsUtils
	{
		public static DXRectangle ConvertRect(Rect rect)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Left);
			int num2 = MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Top);
			return new DXRectangle(num, num2, MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Right) - num, MathUtils.StrongRound(rect.Bottom) - num2);
		}

		public static Rect MakeRect(System.Windows.Point center, double width, double height)
		{
			return new Rect(center.X - 0.5 * width, center.Y - 0.5 * height, width, height);
		}

		public static Rect UnionRect(Rect rect1, Rect rect2)
		{
			if (rect1.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect2;
			}
			if (rect2.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect1;
			}
			rect1.Union(rect2);
			return rect1;
		}

		public static bool IsThicknessEmpty(Thickness thickness)
		{
			if (thickness.Left == 0.0 && thickness.Top == 0.0 && thickness.Right == 0.0)
			{
				return thickness.Bottom == 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsSimpleBorder(System.Windows.Controls.Border border)
		{
			if ((border.Child is TextBlock || border.Child == null) && IsThicknessEmpty(border.Margin) && IsThicknessEmpty(border.BorderThickness) && border.LayoutTransform.IsIdentity())
			{
				return border.RenderTransform.IsIdentity();
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class IntersectionUtils
	{
		private const int alphaLimit = 10;

		private static bool isCopyPixelsSupported = true;

		private static GRealPoint2D? CalculateNearest(FibonacciLine fibonacciLine, List<GeometricSegment> segments)
		{
			GeometricLine line = new GeometricLine(fibonacciLine.ScreenStart, fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd);
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = CalculateIntersectionPoints(line, segments);
			List<System.Windows.Point> list2 = null;
			if (fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.X > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.Y > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y)
			{
				list2 = FindAll(list, (System.Windows.Point point2) => point2.X > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && point2.Y > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y);
			}
			else if (fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.X > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.Y <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y)
			{
				list2 = FindAll(list, (System.Windows.Point point2) => point2.X > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && point2.Y <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y);
			}
			else if (fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.X <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.Y > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y)
			{
				list2 = FindAll(list, (System.Windows.Point point2) => point2.X <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && point2.Y > fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y);
			}
			else if (fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.X <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && fibonacciLine.ScreenEnd.Y <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y)
			{
				list2 = FindAll(list, (System.Windows.Point point2) => point2.X <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.X && point2.Y <= fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.Y);
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			System.Windows.Point? point = null;
			foreach (System.Windows.Point item in list2)
			{
				double num2 = item.CalculateDistanceTo(fibonacciLine.ScreenStart.ToPoint());
				if (num2 <= num)
				{
					num = num2;
					point = item;
				}
			}
			return point?.ToGRealPoint2D();
		}

		private static List<System.Windows.Point> CalculateIntersectionPoints(GeometricLine line, List<GeometricSegment> segments)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (GeometricSegment segment in segments)
			{
				System.Windows.Point? point = GeometricLine.CalculateIntersectionPoint(line, segment);
				if (point.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(point.Value);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<System.Windows.Point> FindAll(List<System.Windows.Point> list, Predicate<System.Windows.Point> predicate)
		{
			List<System.Windows.Point> list2 = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (System.Windows.Point item in list)
			{
				if (predicate(item))
				{
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private static void TruncateLineCore(FibonacciLine line, Rect viewport)
		{
			if (viewport.Width <= 0.0 || viewport.Height <= 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<GeometricSegment> segments = new List<GeometricSegment>
			{
				new GeometricSegment(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, viewport.Height), new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Width, viewport.Height)),
				new GeometricSegment(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(0.0, viewport.Height)),
				new GeometricSegment(new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Width, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Width, viewport.Height)),
				new GeometricSegment(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Width, 0.0))
			};
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = CalculateNearest(line, segments);
			if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				if (line.ScreenStart.X >= 0.0 && line.ScreenStart.X <= viewport.Width && line.ScreenStart.Y >= 0.0 && line.ScreenStart.Y <= viewport.Height)
				{
					line.ScreenEnd = gRealPoint2D.Value;
					return;
				}
				GRealVector2D gRealVector2D = gRealPoint2D.Value - line.ScreenStart;
				line.ScreenStart += gRealVector2D;
				line.ScreenEnd += gRealVector2D;
				line.ScreenEnd = CalculateNearest(line, segments).Value;
			}
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalcIntersectionPointWithCustomShape(UIElement presentation, GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, GRealPoint2D labelCenter, DXRectangle rect)
		{
			if (isCopyPixelsSupported)
			{
				try
				{
					CustomShape shape = new CustomShape(presentation);
					GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = CalcLineWithShapeIntersection(anchorPoint, labelCenter, new Rect(((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height), shape);
					if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
					{
						return gRealPoint2D.Value;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					isCopyPixelsSupported = false;
					return labelCenter;
				}
			}
			return labelCenter;
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D? CalcLineWithShapeIntersection(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D endPoint, Rect rect, CustomShape shape)
		{
			if (shape.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = startPoint;
			DDAAlgorithm dDAAlgorithm = new DDAAlgorithm(gRealPoint2D, endPoint);
			bool flag = endPoint.X < startPoint.X;
			while (dDAAlgorithm.NextPoint())
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(MathUtils.StrongRound(dDAAlgorithm.CurrentPoint.X), MathUtils.StrongRound(dDAAlgorithm.CurrentPoint.Y));
				if (rect.Contains(new System.Windows.Point(gRealPoint2D2.X, gRealPoint2D2.Y)))
				{
					gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(flag ? (gRealPoint2D2.X - rect.Left - 1.0) : (gRealPoint2D2.X - rect.Left), gRealPoint2D2.Y - rect.Top);
					byte? alpha = shape.GetAlpha((int)gRealPoint2D2.X, (int)gRealPoint2D2.Y);
					if (alpha.HasValue && alpha.Value > 10)
					{
						return gRealPoint2D;
					}
				}
				gRealPoint2D = dDAAlgorithm.CurrentPoint;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void TruncateLine(FibonacciLine line, Rect viewport, bool isRotated)
		{
			TruncateLineCore(line, new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), isRotated ? new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Height, viewport.Width) : new System.Windows.Point(viewport.Width, viewport.Height)));
		}
	}
	public sealed class Label3DHelper
	{
		private static Point3D CalcBorderLocation(ContentPresenter presenter, Vector3D direction, Rect rect)
		{
			try
			{
				CustomShape customShape = new CustomShape(presenter);
				customShape.Clear();
				GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = IntersectionUtils.CalcLineWithShapeIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(0.0 - direction.X, 0.0 - direction.Y), default(GRealPoint2D), rect, customShape);
				return gRealPoint2D.HasValue ? new Point3D(rect.Location.X - gRealPoint2D.Value.X, rect.Location.Y - gRealPoint2D.Value.Y, 0.0) : new Point3D(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y, 0.0);
			}
			catch
			{
				return CalcRectangleLocation(direction, rect);
			}
		}

		public static Point3D CalcRectangleLocation(Vector3D direction, Rect rect)
		{
			Point3D result = new Point3D(rect.Left, rect.Top, 0.0);
			if (direction.Length == 0.0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(0.0 - direction.X, 0.0 - direction.Y), default(GRealPoint2D), new GRealPoint2D(rect.BottomLeft.X, rect.BottomLeft.Y), new GRealPoint2D(rect.TopRight.X, rect.TopRight.Y));
			if (intersectionInfo.HasIntersection)
			{
				result.Offset(0.0 - intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint.X, 0.0 - intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint.Y, 0.0);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static Model3D CreateModel(ContentPresenter presenter, ISupportFlowDirection supportFlowDirection)
		{
			if (presenter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LabelPlaneRectangle labelPlaneRectangle = new LabelPlaneRectangle(default(Point3D), presenter.DesiredSize.Width, presenter.DesiredSize.Height);
			MaterialGroup materialGroup = new MaterialGroup();
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = RenderHelper.CreateBrush(presenter, supportFlowDirection);
			RenderOptions.SetCachingHint(brush, CachingHint.Cache);
			DiffuseMaterial diffuseMaterial = new DiffuseMaterial(brush);
			diffuseMaterial.AmbientColor = Colors.Black;
			diffuseMaterial.Color = Colors.Black;
			materialGroup.Children.Add(diffuseMaterial);
			materialGroup.Children.Add(new EmissiveMaterial(brush));
			labelPlaneRectangle.Material = materialGroup;
			return labelPlaneRectangle.GetModel();
		}

		private static Transform3D CreateLabelTransform(Domain3DBase domain, Point3D center, Matrix3D transform)
		{
			transform.Append(domain.CreateScaleTransform(center).Value);
			transform.Append(domain.BackwardRotationOnlyTransform.Value);
			transform.Translate(new Vector3D(center.X, center.Y, center.Z));
			return new MatrixTransform3D(transform);
		}

		public static LabelModelContainer CreateModelContainer(Domain3DBase domain, Model3D model, Point3D center, Matrix3D transform)
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			model3DGroup.Transform = CreateLabelTransform(domain, center, transform);
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(model);
			return new LabelModelContainer(model3DGroup, MathUtils.CalcDistance(domain.CameraPosition, domain.ModelTransform.Transform(center)));
		}

		public static LabelModelContainer CreateLabelModelContainer(Domain3DBase domain, ContentPresenter presenter, Model3D model, Point3D center, Vector3D direction, LabelRenderMode renderMode)
		{
			return CreateLabelModelContainer(domain, presenter, model, center, direction, renderMode, 0.0, default(System.Windows.Point));
		}

		public static LabelModelContainer CreateLabelModelContainer(Domain3DBase domain, ContentPresenter presenter, Model3D model, Point3D center, Vector3D direction, LabelRenderMode renderMode, double angle, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			direction = domain.RotationOnlyTransform.Transform(direction * presenter.DesiredSize.Width * presenter.DesiredSize.Height);
			Rect rect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point((0.0 - presenter.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0, (0.0 - presenter.DesiredSize.Height) / 2.0), new System.Windows.Size(presenter.DesiredSize.Width, presenter.DesiredSize.Height));
			Point3D point3D;
			if (direction.Length == 0.0)
			{
				point3D = new Point3D(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y, 0.0);
			}
			else if (renderMode == LabelRenderMode.Rectangle)
			{
				point3D = CalcRectangleLocation(direction, rect);
			}
			else if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(presenter, 0) is System.Windows.Controls.Border border && GraphicsUtils.IsSimpleBorder(border))
			{
				IntersectionInfo intersectionInfo = GeometricUtils.CalcLineSegmentWithRoundedRectIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(0.0 - direction.X, 0.0 - direction.Y), default(GRealPoint2D), new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left, rect.Top), new GRealPoint2D(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), border.CornerRadius.BottomLeft, border.CornerRadius.TopLeft, border.CornerRadius.TopRight, border.CornerRadius.BottomRight);
				point3D = (intersectionInfo.HasIntersection ? new Point3D(rect.Location.X - intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint.X, rect.Location.Y - intersectionInfo.IntersectionPoint.Y, 0.0) : new Point3D(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y, 0.0));
			}
			else
			{
				point3D = CalcBorderLocation(presenter, direction, rect);
			}
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D
			{
				Axis = new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
				Angle = 360.0 - angle
			}, presenter.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0, presenter.DesiredSize.Height / 2.0, 0.0));
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform3D(point3D.X + offset.X, point3D.Y + offset.Y, point3D.Z));
			return CreateModelContainer(domain, model, center, transform3DGroup.Value);
		}
	}
	public sealed class LabelModelContainer
	{
		private readonly Model3D model;

		private readonly double distance;

		private Model3D connectorModel;

		public Model3D Model => model;

		public Model3D ConnectorModel
		{
			get
			{
				return connectorModel;
			}
			set
			{
				connectorModel = value;
			}
		}

		public static int CompareByDistance(LabelModelContainer x, LabelModelContainer y)
		{
			if (x == null)
			{
				if (y != null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return y?.distance.CompareTo(x.distance) ?? 1;
		}

		public LabelModelContainer(Model3D model, double distance)
		{
			this.model = model;
			this.distance = distance;
		}
	}

	public static class ObsoleteMessages

	public static class ShapeExtractor
	{
		private static void Extract(LineSegment segment, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			container.Add(segment.Point);
		}

		private static void Extract(PolyLineSegment segment, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			foreach (System.Windows.Point point in segment.Points)
			{
				container.Add(point);
			}
		}

		private static void Extract(BezierSegment segment, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			container.Add(segment.Point1);
			container.Add(segment.Point2);
			container.Add(segment.Point3);
		}

		private static void Extract(PathSegment segment, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			if (segment is LineSegment)
			{
				Extract((LineSegment)segment, container);
			}
			else if (segment is PolyLineSegment)
			{
				Extract((PolyLineSegment)segment, container);
			}
			else if (segment is BezierSegment)
			{
				Extract((BezierSegment)segment, container);
			}
		}

		private static void Extract(PathFigure figure, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			if (figure.Segments.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!figure.IsClosed)
			{
				container.Add(figure.StartPoint);
			}
			foreach (PathSegment segment in figure.Segments)
			{
				Extract(segment, container);
			}
		}

		private static void Extract(PathGeometry geometry, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			foreach (PathFigure figure in geometry.Figures)
			{
				Extract(figure, container);
			}
		}

		private static void Extract(DependencyObject obj, List<Shape> container)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				if (obj is Shape)
				{
					Shape item = (Shape)obj;
					container.Add(item);
				}
				int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(obj);
				for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(obj, i);
					Extract(child, container);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Transform GetTransformToAncestor(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			Transform result = new MatrixTransform
			{
				Matrix = Matrix.Identity
			};
			if (obj is Visual visual && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(visual) is Visual ancestor)
			{
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = visual.TransformToAncestor(ancestor);
				if (generalTransform != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = generalTransform.Transform(default(System.Windows.Point));
					result = new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = point.X,
						Y = point.Y
					};
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void AddTransform(Geometry geometry, Transform transform)
		{
			if (geometry.Transform == null)
			{
				geometry.Transform = transform;
			}
			else if (transform != null)
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(geometry.Transform);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(transform);
				geometry.Transform = transformGroup;
			}
		}

		private static void Arrange(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is UIElement { DesiredSize: var desiredSize } uIElement && (desiredSize.IsEmpty || uIElement.DesiredSize == default(System.Windows.Size)))
			{
				uIElement.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				uIElement.Arrange(new Rect
				{
					Width = uIElement.DesiredSize.Width,
					Height = uIElement.DesiredSize.Height
				});
			}
		}

		private static Geometry ExtractGeometry(Shape shape)
		{
			Geometry renderedGeometry = shape.RenderedGeometry;
			if (renderedGeometry == null || renderedGeometry.IsEmpty())
			{
				return null;
			}
			Transform transformToAncestor = GetTransformToAncestor(shape);
			AddTransform(renderedGeometry, transformToAncestor);
			return renderedGeometry;
		}

		private static void Extract(Geometry geometry, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			PathGeometry flattenedPathGeometry = geometry.GetFlattenedPathGeometry();
			if (flattenedPathGeometry != null && !flattenedPathGeometry.IsEmpty())
			{
				Extract(flattenedPathGeometry, container);
			}
		}

		private static void Extract(Shape shape, List<System.Windows.Point> container)
		{
			Geometry geometry = ExtractGeometry(shape);
			if (geometry != null && !geometry.IsEmpty())
			{
				Extract(geometry, container);
			}
		}

		public static List<Shape> ExtractShapes(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			Arrange(obj);
			List<Shape> list = new List<Shape>();
			Extract(obj, list);
			return list;
		}

		public static Polyline ExtractPolyline(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			List<Shape> list = ExtractShapes(obj);
			List<System.Windows.Point> list2 = new List<System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (Shape item in list)
			{
				Extract(item, list2);
			}
			Polyline polyline = new Polyline();
			polyline.Points = new PointCollection();
			foreach (System.Windows.Point item2 in list2)
			{
				polyline.Points.Add(item2);
			}
			Arrange(polyline);
			return polyline;
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram3DDomain : Diagram3DDomain, IDomainBox3D
	{
		private readonly Axis3DInfo axisXInfo;

		private readonly Axis3DInfo axisYInfo;

		private readonly AxesBoxCreator boxCreator;

		private readonly BoxPlane visiblePlanes;

		Axis3DInfoBase IDomainBox3D.AxisInfoX => axisXInfo;

		Axis3DInfoBase IDomainBox3D.AxisInfoY => axisYInfo;

		Axis3DInfoBase IDomainBox3D.AxisInfoZ => null;

		bool IDomainBox3D.ShowXOZPlane => true;

		bool IDomainBox3D.ShowXOYPlane => true;

		bool IDomainBox3D.ShowYOZPlane => true;

		double IDomainBox3D.PlaneDepthFixed => Diagram.PlaneDepthFixed;

		double IDomainBox3D.HeightToWidthRatio => Diagram.HeightToWidthRatio;

		protected new XYDiagram3DBox DiagramBox => (XYDiagram3DBox)base.DiagramBox;

		internal AxesBoxCreator BoxCreator => boxCreator;

		public new XYDiagram3D Diagram => (XYDiagram3D)base.Diagram;

		Material IDomainBox3D.CreateBackgroundMaterial()
		{
			return CreateMaterial(Diagram.DomainBrush);
		}

		Point3D IDomainBox3D.GetClippedDiagramPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value)
		{
			System.Windows.Point clippedDiagramPoint = GetClippedDiagramPoint(argumentX, value);
			return new Point3D(clippedDiagramPoint.X, clippedDiagramPoint.Y, argumentY);
		}

		public XYDiagram3DDomain(XYDiagram3D diagram, Rect viewport, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
			: base(diagram, viewport, diagram.CreateSeriesDataList(), new XYDiagram3DBox(diagram, containerItems, (int)viewport.Width))
		{
			AxisX3D actualAxisX = Diagram.ActualAxisX;
			AxisY3D actualAxisY = Diagram.ActualAxisY;
			GridAndTextData gridAndTextData = new GridAndTextData(actualAxisX.GetSeries(), actualAxisX, scrollingEnabled: false, actualAxisX.VisualRangeData, viewport.Width, actualAxisX.ActualLabel != null && actualAxisX.ActualLabel.Staggered);
			GridAndTextData gridAndTextData2 = new GridAndTextData(actualAxisY.GetSeries(), actualAxisY, scrollingEnabled: false, actualAxisY.VisualRangeData, viewport.Height, actualAxisY.ActualLabel != null && actualAxisY.ActualLabel.Staggered);
			AxisCache axisCache = Diagram.Cache.GetAxisCache(actualAxisX);
			AxisCache axisCache2 = Diagram.Cache.GetAxisCache(actualAxisY);
			Rect bounds = DiagramBox.Bounds;
			visiblePlanes = CalcVisiblePlanes();
			axisXInfo = new Axis3DInfo(this, actualAxisX, gridAndTextData, axisCache, bounds, visiblePlanes);
			axisYInfo = new Axis3DInfo(this, actualAxisY, gridAndTextData2, axisCache2, bounds, visiblePlanes);
			boxCreator = new XYAxesBoxCreator(this, Diagram.Cache, DiagramBox, CalcVisiblePlanes());
		}

		private Material CreateMaterial(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (Diagram.Material == null || brush == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Material material = Diagram.Material.CloneCurrentValue();
			Graphics3DUtils.SetMaterialBrush(material, brush, diffuseMaterialOnly: false);
			return material;
		}

		private Model3D CreateSeriesModel()
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Series3DData seriesData in base.SeriesDataList)
			{
				seriesData.CreateModel(this, model3DGroup, Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(seriesData.Series));
				for (int i = num; i < model3DGroup.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					Chart3DControl.SetSeriesHitTestInfo(model3DGroup.Children[i], seriesData.Series);
				}
				num = model3DGroup.Children.Count;
			}
			return model3DGroup;
		}

		private void CreateSeriesModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder, int width)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(width - Diagram.Cache.Width) > 20)
			{
				Diagram.Cache.RemoveModels();
				Diagram.Cache.SeriesModel = null;
			}
			if (Diagram.Cache.SeriesModel == null)
			{
				Diagram.Cache.SeriesModel = CreateSeriesModel();
			}
			modelHolder.Children.Add(Diagram.Cache.SeriesModel);
		}

		private void CreateSeriesLabelsModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			List<LabelModelContainer> list = new List<LabelModelContainer>();
			foreach (Series3DData seriesData in base.SeriesDataList)
			{
				seriesData.CreateLabelsModel(this, modelHolder, list, Diagram.ViewController.GetRefinedSeries(seriesData.Series));
			}
			foreach (LabelModelContainer item in list)
			{
				modelHolder.Children.Add(item.Model);
			}
		}

		private BoxPlane CalcVisiblePlanes()
		{
			BoxPlane boxPlane = BoxPlane.Bottom;
			Point3D point = new Point3D((0.0 - DiagramBox.Width) / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			Point3D point2 = new Point3D(DiagramBox.Width / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			Point3D point3 = new Point3D(0.0, 0.0, (0.0 - DiagramBox.Depth) / 2.0);
			Point3D point4 = new Point3D(0.0, 0.0, DiagramBox.Depth / 2.0);
			point = Diagram.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point);
			point2 = Diagram.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point2);
			point3 = Diagram.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point3);
			point4 = Diagram.ActualContentTransform.Transform(point4);
			double num = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point);
			double num2 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point2);
			double num3 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point3);
			double num4 = MathUtils.CalcDistance(base.CameraPosition, point4);
			boxPlane = (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((num < num2) ? 32 : 16));
			return (BoxPlane)((int)boxPlane | ((!(num3 < num4)) ? 1 : 2));
		}

		protected override void Render3DContent(Model3DGroup modelHolder)
		{
			int width = (int)DiagramBox.InnerWidth;
			CreateSeriesModel(modelHolder, width);
			boxCreator.CreateAxesBoxAndLabels(modelHolder);
			CreateSeriesLabelsModel(modelHolder);
		}

		public double GetValueByAxisX(double value)
		{
			return DiagramBox.GetValueByAxisX(value);
		}

		public Point3D GetDiagramPoint(ISeries series, double argument, double value)
		{
			return DiagramBox.GetDiagramPoint(series, argument, value);
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetClippedDiagramPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return DiagramBox.GetClippedDiagramPoint(argument, value);
		}

		public override void OnModelAdd(object modelHolder, params Model3D[] models)
		{
			base.OnModelAdd(modelHolder, models);
			if (Diagram.Cache != null)
			{
				Diagram.Cache.AddModels(modelHolder, models);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagram3DBox : Diagram3DBox
	{
		private int predefinedWidthCore = 1000;

		public const int CPredefinedWidth = 1000;

		private readonly XYDiagram3D diagram;

		private readonly List<List<ISeries>> seriesGroups = new List<List<ISeries>>();

		private readonly IAxisMappingCore axisXMapping;

		private readonly IAxisMappingCore axisYMapping;

		private readonly double correction;

		private AxisX3D AxisX => diagram.ActualAxisX;

		private AxisY3D AxisY => diagram.ActualAxisY;

		public Rect Bounds => new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.InnerWidth + 1.0, base.InnerHeight + 1.0);

		public override double SideCorrection => correction;

		public int PredefinedWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return predefinedWidthCore;
			}
			set
			{
				predefinedWidthCore = value;
			}
		}

		public XYDiagram3DBox(XYDiagram3D diagram, List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems, int predefinedWidth = 1000)
		{
			PredefinedWidth = predefinedWidth;
			this.diagram = diagram;
			correction = (diagram.PlaneDepthFixed + 1) * 2;
			base.InnerWidth = PredefinedWidth;
			base.InnerHeight = (double)PredefinedWidth * diagram.HeightToWidthRatio;
			CalcSeriesGroups(containerItems);
			Rect bounds = Bounds;
			axisXMapping = AxisX.CreateMapping(null, bounds);
			axisYMapping = AxisY.CreateMapping(null, bounds);
			base.InnerDepth = CalcDiagramDepth();
		}

		private void CalcSeriesGroups(List<SeriesContainerItem> containerItems)
		{
			seriesGroups.Clear();
			foreach (SeriesContainerItem containerItem in containerItems)
			{
				seriesGroups.Add(new List<ISeries>(containerItem.Series));
			}
		}

		private int GetSeriesGroupIndex(ISeries series)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < seriesGroups.Count; i++)
			{
				if (seriesGroups[i].Contains(series))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("series");
		}

		private int GetActualVisibleSeries()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in diagram.ViewController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
			{
				Series series = (Series)item.Series;
				num += (series.GetActualVisible() ? 1 : 0);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcDiagramDepth()
		{
			double num = CalcSeriesPadding() * 2.0;
			int actualVisibleSeries = GetActualVisibleSeries();
			if (actualVisibleSeries > 0)
			{
				num += CalcSeriesDistance() * (double)(seriesGroups.Count - 1);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcSeriesPadding()
		{
			return GetValueByAxisX(diagram.ActualSeriesPadding);
		}

		private double CalcSeriesDistance()
		{
			return GetValueByAxisX(diagram.ActualSeriesDistance);
		}

		private double CalcSeriesOffset(ISeries series)
		{
			int seriesGroupIndex = GetSeriesGroupIndex(series);
			if (seriesGroupIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("series");
			}
			return CalcSeriesPadding() + CalcSeriesDistance() * (double)seriesGroupIndex;
		}

		public double GetValueByAxisX(double value)
		{
			return Math.Abs(axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(0.0) - axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetDiagramPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(axisXMapping.GetAxisValue(argument), axisYMapping.GetAxisValue(value));
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetClippedDiagramPoint(double argument, double value)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(axisXMapping.GetClampedAxisValue(argument), axisYMapping.GetClampedAxisValue(value));
		}

		public Point3D GetDiagramPoint(ISeries series, double argument, double value)
		{
			System.Windows.Point diagramPoint = GetDiagramPoint(argument, value);
			double z = CalcSeriesOffset(series);
			return new Point3D(diagramPoint.X, diagramPoint.Y, z);
		}

		public override Transform3D CreateModelTransform()
		{
			return new TranslateTransform3D((0.0 - base.InnerWidth) * 0.5, (0.0 - base.InnerHeight) * 0.5, (0.0 - base.InnerDepth) * 0.5);
		}
	}
	public class Box
	{
		private Point3D location;

		private double width;

		private double height;

		private double depth;

		private double textureWidth;

		private double textureHeight;

		private double textureDepth;

		private XPlaneRectangle left;

		private XPlaneRectangle right;

		private YPlaneRectangle bottom;

		private YPlaneRectangle top;

		private ZPlaneRectangle back;

		private ZPlaneRectangle fore;

		public double Width => width;

		public double Height => height;

		public double Depth => depth;

		public Rect3D Bounds => new Rect3D(location, new Size3D(width, height, depth));

		public XPlaneRectangle Left => left;

		public XPlaneRectangle Right => right;

		public YPlaneRectangle Bottom => bottom;

		public YPlaneRectangle Top => top;

		public ZPlaneRectangle Back => back;

		public ZPlaneRectangle Fore => fore;

		public Box(Point3D point, double width, double height, double depth)
			: this(point, width, height, depth, width, height, depth)
		{
		}

		public Box(Point3D point, double width, double height, double depth, double textureWidth, double textureHeight, double textureDepth)
		{
			location.X = ((width < 0.0) ? (point.X + width) : point.X);
			location.Y = ((height < 0.0) ? (point.Y + height) : point.Y);
			location.Z = ((depth < 0.0) ? (point.Z + depth) : point.Z);
			this.width = Math.Abs(width);
			this.height = Math.Abs(height);
			this.depth = Math.Abs(depth);
			this.textureWidth = textureWidth;
			this.textureHeight = textureHeight;
			this.textureDepth = textureDepth;
			InitPlanes();
		}

		private void InitPlanes()
		{
			left = new XPlaneRectangle(location, depth, height, depth / textureDepth, height / textureHeight);
			right = (XPlaneRectangle)PlanePolygon.Offset(left, width, 0.0, 0.0);
			left.InvertVerticesDirection();
			bottom = new YPlaneRectangle(location, width, depth, width / textureWidth, depth / textureDepth);
			top = (YPlaneRectangle)PlanePolygon.Offset(bottom, 0.0, height, 0.0);
			bottom.InvertVerticesDirection();
			back = new ZPlaneRectangle(location, width, height, width / textureWidth, height / textureHeight);
			fore = (ZPlaneRectangle)PlanePolygon.Offset(back, 0.0, 0.0, depth);
			back.InvertVerticesDirection();
		}

		public MeshGeometry3D GetGeometry()
		{
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, left.Vertices);
			Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, right.Vertices);
			Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, bottom.Vertices);
			Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, top.Vertices);
			Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, back.Vertices);
			Graphics3DUtils.AddPolygon(meshGeometry3D, fore.Vertices);
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		public Model3D GetModel()
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(back.GetModel());
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(fore.GetModel());
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(left.GetModel());
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(right.GetModel());
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(bottom.GetModel());
			model3DGroup.Children.Add(top.GetModel());
			return model3DGroup;
		}

		public void SetMaterial(DiffuseMaterial material)
		{
			left.Material = material;
			right.Material = material;
			bottom.Material = material;
			top.Material = material;
			back.Material = material;
			fore.Material = material;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum BoxPlane
	{
		None = 0,
		Back = 1,
		Fore = 2,
		Bottom = 4,
		Top = 8,
		Left = 0x10,
		Right = 0x20
	}
	public class PointItemsDictionary : HybridDictionary
	{
		public List<SeriesPointItem> this[ISeriesPoint key] => base[key] as List<SeriesPointItem>;
	}
	public class PlanePolygon : ICloneable
	{
		private List<Vertex> vertices = new List<Vertex>();

		private Material material;

		private bool textureCoordsEnabled;

		public List<Vertex> Vertices => vertices;

		public Material Material
		{
			get
			{
				return material;
			}
			set
			{
				material = value;
			}
		}

		public bool TextureCoordsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return textureCoordsEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				textureCoordsEnabled = value;
			}
		}

		public static PlanePolygon Offset(PlanePolygon polygon, double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = (PlanePolygon)polygon.Clone();
			planePolygon.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			return planePolygon;
		}

		protected PlanePolygon()
		{
		}

		public PlanePolygon(IList<Point3D> points)
		{
			SetVertices(points);
		}

		private void Assign(PlanePolygon polygon)
		{
			if (polygon == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("primitive");
			}
			material = polygon.material;
			textureCoordsEnabled = polygon.textureCoordsEnabled;
			Vertex[] array = new Vertex[polygon.vertices.Count];
			polygon.vertices.CopyTo(array, 0);
			SetVertices(array);
		}

		public virtual object Clone()
		{
			PlanePolygon planePolygon = CreateInstance();
			planePolygon.Assign(this);
			return planePolygon;
		}

		protected void SetVertices(IList<Point3D> points)
		{
			Vertex[] array = new Vertex[points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new Vertex(points[i]);
			}
			SetVertices(array);
		}

		protected void SetVertices(IList<Vertex> vertices)
		{
			this.vertices.Clear();
			this.vertices.AddRange(vertices);
		}

		protected virtual PlanePolygon CreateInstance()
		{
			return new PlanePolygon();
		}

		public void InvertVerticesDirection()
		{
			Vertex[] array = new Vertex[vertices.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Count; i++)
			{
				int index = ((i != 0) ? (vertices.Count - i) : 0);
				array[i] = vertices[index];
			}
			vertices.Clear();
			vertices.AddRange(array);
		}

		public virtual MeshGeometry3D GetGeometry()
		{
			MeshGeometry3D meshGeometry3D = new MeshGeometry3D();
			foreach (Vertex vertex in vertices)
			{
				meshGeometry3D.Positions.Add(vertex.Position);
				if (textureCoordsEnabled)
				{
					meshGeometry3D.TextureCoordinates.Add(vertex.TextureCoord);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Count - 2; i++)
			{
				meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(i);
				meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(i + 1);
				meshGeometry3D.TriangleIndices.Add(vertices.Count - 1);
			}
			return meshGeometry3D;
		}

		public Model3D GetModel()
		{
			MeshGeometry3D geometry = GetGeometry();
			return new GeometryModel3D(geometry, material);
		}

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Count; i++)
			{
				vertices[i] = Vertex.Offset(vertices[i], dx, dy, dz);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class PlaneRectangle : PlanePolygon
	{
		protected PlaneRectangle()
		{
			base.TextureCoordsEnabled = true;
		}

		public PlaneRectangle(Point3D point, double width, double height, double widthRatio, double heightRatio)
			: this()
		{
			Point3D location = GetLocation(point, width, height);
			width = Math.Abs(width);
			height = Math.Abs(height);
			IList<Vertex> list = GetVertices(location, width, height, widthRatio, heightRatio);
			SetVertices(list);
		}

		protected abstract Point3D GetLocation(Point3D point, double width, double height);

		protected abstract IList<Vertex> GetVertices(Point3D location, double width, double height, double widthRatio, double heightRatio);
	}
	public class XPlaneRectangle : PlaneRectangle
	{
		protected XPlaneRectangle()
		{
		}

		public XPlaneRectangle(Point3D point, double width, double height, double widthRatio, double heightRatio)
			: base(point, width, height, widthRatio, heightRatio)
		{
		}

		protected override Point3D GetLocation(Point3D point, double width, double height)
		{
			return new Point3D
			{
				X = point.X,
				Y = ((height < 0.0) ? (point.Y + height) : point.Y),
				Z = ((width < 0.0) ? (point.Z + width) : point.Z)
			};
		}

		protected override IList<Vertex> GetVertices(Point3D location, double width, double height, double widthRatio, double heightRatio)
		{
			List<Vertex> list = new List<Vertex>();
			list.Add(new Vertex(location, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)));
			list.Add(new Vertex(location, new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0)));
			list.Add(new Vertex(MathUtils.Offset(location, 0.0, height, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 1.0 - heightRatio)));
			list.Add(new Vertex(MathUtils.Offset(location, 0.0, height, width), new System.Windows.Point(1.0 - widthRatio, 1.0 - heightRatio)));
			list.Add(new Vertex(MathUtils.Offset(location, 0.0, 0.0, width), new System.Windows.Point(1.0 - widthRatio, 1.0)));
			return list;
		}

		protected override PlanePolygon CreateInstance()
		{
			return new XPlaneRectangle();
		}
	}

	public struct Vertex
	{
		private Point3D position;

		private Vector3D normal;

		private System.Windows.Point textureCoord;

		public Point3D Position => position;

		public Vector3D Normal => normal;

		public System.Windows.Point TextureCoord => textureCoord;

		public static Vertex Offset(Vertex vertex, double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			vertex.Offset(dx, dy, dz);
			return vertex;
		}

		public Vertex(Point3D position, Vector3D normal, System.Windows.Point textureCoord)
		{
			this.position = position;
			this.normal = normal;
			this.textureCoord = textureCoord;
		}

		public Vertex(Point3D position)
			: this(position, default(Vector3D), default(System.Windows.Point))
		{
		}

		public Vertex(Point3D position, Vector3D normal)
			: this(position, normal, default(System.Windows.Point))
		{
		}

		public Vertex(Point3D position, System.Windows.Point textureCoord)
			: this(position, default(Vector3D), textureCoord)
		{
		}

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			position = MathUtils.Offset(position, dx, dy, dz);
		}
	}
