	public class Bar3DSectionData
	{
		private Model3D model;

		private bool fixedHeight;

		private bool useViewColor;

		private Rect3D bounds;

		public Model3D Model => model;

		public bool FixedHeight => fixedHeight;

		public bool UseViewColor => useViewColor;

		public Rect3D Bounds => bounds;

		public static Bar3DSectionData CreateInstance(Bar3DSection section, bool loadFromResources)
		{
			if (section == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Model3D model3D = section.GetModel(loadFromResources);
			if (model3D == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect3D rect3D = Graphics3DUtils.CalcBounds(Graphics3DUtils.GetRefPoints(model3D.Bounds), !section.ActualAlignByX, !section.ActualAlignByY, !section.ActualAlignByZ);
			if (rect3D.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new Bar3DSectionData(model3D, section.ActualFixedHeight, section.ActualUseViewColor, rect3D);
		}

		private Bar3DSectionData(Model3D model, bool fixedHeight, bool useViewColor, Rect3D bounds)
		{
			this.model = model;
			this.fixedHeight = fixedHeight;
			this.useViewColor = useViewColor;
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		private void AppendTransform(Matrix3D matrix)
		{
			Transform3D transform3D = new MatrixTransform3D(matrix);
			bounds = transform3D.TransformBounds(bounds);
			if (model.Transform == null)
			{
				model.Transform = transform3D;
				return;
			}
			Matrix3D value = model.Transform.Value;
			value.Append(matrix);
			model.Transform = new MatrixTransform3D(value);
		}

		public void SetBrush(SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			if (UseViewColor)
			{
				Graphics3DUtils.HandleModel(model, delegate(GeometryModel3D geometryModel)
				{
					Graphics3DUtils.SetMaterialBrush(geometryModel.Material, brush, diffuseMaterialOnly: true);
				});
			}
		}

		public void Scale(Vector3D vector)
		{
			ScaleAt(vector, MathUtils.CalcCenter(bounds));
		}

		public void Offset(Point3D point)
		{
			Matrix3D matrix = default(Matrix3D);
			Point3D point3D = MathUtils.CalcCenter(bounds);
			matrix.OffsetX = point.X - point3D.X;
			matrix.OffsetY = point.Y - point3D.Y;
			matrix.OffsetZ = point.Z - point3D.Z;
			AppendTransform(matrix);
		}

		public void ScaleAt(Vector3D vector, Point3D center)
		{
			Matrix3D matrix = default(Matrix3D);
			matrix.ScaleAt(vector, center);
			AppendTransform(matrix);
		}

		public Bar3DSectionData CloneCurrentValue()
		{
			return new Bar3DSectionData(model.CloneCurrentValue(), fixedHeight, useViewColor, bounds);
		}
	}
	public static class Bar3DCalculator
	{
		private static Vector3D CalcScaleVectorByXZ(double sizeX, double sizeZ, double innerSizeX, double innerSizeZ, bool keepRatio)
		{
			if (innerSizeX == 0.0 && innerSizeZ == 0.0)
			{
				return new Vector3D(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			}
			double num;
			if (innerSizeX == 0.0)
			{
				num = sizeZ / innerSizeZ;
			}
			else if (innerSizeZ == 0.0)
			{
				num = sizeX / innerSizeX;
			}
			else
			{
				double num2 = sizeX / innerSizeX;
				double num3 = sizeZ / innerSizeZ;
				num = ((num2 < num3) ? num2 : num3);
				if (!keepRatio)
				{
					return new Vector3D(num2, num, num3);
				}
			}
			return new Vector3D(num, num, num);
		}

		private static Size3D CalcModelSize(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
			{
				num = Math.Max(sectionsDatum.Bounds.SizeX, num);
				num2 = Math.Max(sectionsDatum.Bounds.SizeY, num2);
				num3 = Math.Max(sectionsDatum.Bounds.SizeZ, num3);
			}
			return new Size3D(num, num2, num3);
		}

		private static void InscribeByXZ(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, Rect3D bounds, bool keepRatio)
		{
			Size3D size3D = CalcModelSize(sectionsData);
			Vector3D vector = CalcScaleVectorByXZ(bounds.SizeX, bounds.SizeZ, size3D.X, size3D.Z, keepRatio);
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
			{
				sectionsDatum.Scale(vector);
			}
		}

		private static Vector3D CalcScaleVectorByY(double height, double innerHeight)
		{
			if (innerHeight == 0.0)
			{
				return new Vector3D(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			}
			double y = height / innerHeight;
			return new Vector3D(1.0, y, 1.0);
		}

		private static List<Bar3DSectionData> InscribeFixedSectionsByY(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, double sizeY, double fixedHeight, bool scaleFixed)
		{
			List<Bar3DSectionData> list = new List<Bar3DSectionData>();
			if (scaleFixed)
			{
				Vector3D vector = CalcScaleVectorByY(sizeY, fixedHeight);
				foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
				{
					if (sectionsDatum.FixedHeight)
					{
						sectionsDatum.Scale(vector);
						list.Add(sectionsDatum);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				for (int num2 = sectionsData.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (sectionsData[num2].FixedHeight)
					{
						if (!(num < sizeY))
						{
							break;
						}
						list.Insert(0, sectionsData[num2]);
						num += sectionsData[num2].Bounds.SizeY;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<Bar3DSectionData> InscribeSizableSectionsByY(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, Rect3D bounds, double fixedHeight, double sizableHeight)
		{
			List<Bar3DSectionData> list = new List<Bar3DSectionData>();
			Vector3D vector = CalcScaleVectorByY(bounds.SizeY - fixedHeight, sizableHeight);
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
			{
				if (!sectionsDatum.FixedHeight)
				{
					sectionsDatum.Scale(vector);
				}
				list.Add(sectionsDatum);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<Bar3DSectionData> InscribeByY(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, Rect3D bounds, bool scaleFixed)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
			{
				if (sectionsDatum.FixedHeight)
				{
					num += sectionsDatum.Bounds.SizeY;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += sectionsDatum.Bounds.SizeY;
				}
			}
			if (!(bounds.SizeY <= num))
			{
				return InscribeSizableSectionsByY(sectionsData, bounds, num, num2);
			}
			return InscribeFixedSectionsByY(sectionsData, bounds.SizeY, num, scaleFixed);
		}

		private static void Build(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, Rect3D bounds)
		{
			Point3D point3D = MathUtils.CalcCenter(bounds);
			double num = ((bounds.SizeY < 1.0) ? 1.0 : bounds.SizeY);
			double num2 = bounds.Location.Y + num;
			for (int num3 = sectionsData.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				sectionsData[num3].Offset(new Point3D(point3D.X, num2 - sectionsData[num3].Bounds.SizeY / 2.0, point3D.Z));
				num2 -= sectionsData[num3].Bounds.SizeY;
			}
		}

		private static void InvertByY(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, Rect3D bounds)
		{
			Vector3D vector = new Vector3D(1.0, -1.0, 1.0);
			Point3D center = MathUtils.CalcCenter(bounds);
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
			{
				sectionsDatum.ScaleAt(vector, center);
			}
		}

		public static Model3DGroup CalculateBar(IList<Bar3DSectionData> sectionsData, Rect3D bounds, bool invertByY, bool keepXZRatio, SolidColorBrush brush)
		{
			Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
			if (bounds.SizeY == 0.0 || sectionsData == null || sectionsData.Count == 0)
			{
				return model3DGroup;
			}
			List<Bar3DSectionData> list = new List<Bar3DSectionData>(sectionsData.Count);
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData sectionsDatum in sectionsData)
			{
				list.Add(sectionsDatum.CloneCurrentValue());
			}
			InscribeByXZ(list, bounds, keepXZRatio);
			List<Bar3DSectionData> list2 = InscribeByY(list, bounds, scaleFixed: true);
			if (list2 == null || list2.Count == 0)
			{
				return model3DGroup;
			}
			Build(list2, bounds);
			if (invertByY)
			{
				InvertByY(list, bounds);
			}
			foreach (Bar3DSectionData item in list2)
			{
				item.SetBrush(brush);
				model3DGroup.Children.Add(item.Model);
			}
			return model3DGroup;
		}
	}
	public static class Model3DExtractor
	{
		private abstract class GeometryContainer
		{
			protected abstract Matrix3D Matrix { get; }

			protected abstract GeometryModel3D Model { get; }

			public static GeometryContainer CreateInstance(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is Model3D)
				{
					return Model3DContainer.CreateInstance((Model3D)obj);
				}
				if (obj is Visual3D)
				{
					return Visual3DContainer.CreateInstance((Visual3D)obj);
				}
				if (obj is Visual)
				{
					return VisualContainer.CreateInstance((Visual)obj);
				}
				return null;
			}

			private void AddOwnModel(Model3DGroup modelHolder, Matrix3D matrix)
			{
				if (Model != null)
				{
					GeometryModel3D model = Model;
					model.Transform = new MatrixTransform3D(matrix);
					modelHolder.Children.Add(model);
				}
			}

			private void AddChildrenModels(Model3DGroup modelHolder, Matrix3D matrix)
			{
				List<GeometryContainer> children = GetChildren();
				if (children == null || children.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (GeometryContainer item in children)
				{
					item.AddModels(modelHolder, matrix);
				}
			}

			private void AddModels(Model3DGroup modelHolder, Matrix3D parentMatrix)
			{
				Matrix3D matrix = Matrix * parentMatrix;
				AddOwnModel(modelHolder, matrix);
				AddChildrenModels(modelHolder, matrix);
			}

			protected abstract List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren();

			public Model3DGroup GetModel()
			{
				Model3DGroup model3DGroup = new Model3DGroup();
				AddModels(model3DGroup, Matrix3D.Identity);
				return model3DGroup;
			}
		}

		private abstract class Model3DContainer : GeometryContainer
		{
			public static Model3DContainer CreateInstance(Model3D model)
			{
				if (model is GeometryModel3D)
				{
					return new GeometryModel3DContainer((GeometryModel3D)model);
				}
				if (model is Model3DGroup)
				{
					return new Model3DGroupContainer((Model3DGroup)model);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class GeometryModel3DContainer : Model3DContainer
		{
			private GeometryModel3D model;

			protected override Matrix3D Matrix
			{
				get
				{
					if (model.Transform != null)
					{
						return model.Transform.Value;
					}
					return Matrix3D.Identity;
				}
			}

			protected override GeometryModel3D Model => model;

			public GeometryModel3DContainer(GeometryModel3D model)
			{
				this.model = model;
			}

			protected override List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren()
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class Model3DGroupContainer : Model3DContainer
		{
			private Model3DGroup group;

			protected override Matrix3D Matrix
			{
				get
				{
					if (group.Transform != null)
					{
						return group.Transform.Value;
					}
					return Matrix3D.Identity;
				}
			}

			protected override GeometryModel3D Model => null;

			public Model3DGroupContainer(Model3DGroup group)
			{
				this.group = group;
			}

			protected override List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren()
			{
				List<GeometryContainer> list = new List<GeometryContainer>();
				foreach (Model3D child in group.Children)
				{
					GeometryContainer geometryContainer = Model3DContainer.CreateInstance(child);
					if (geometryContainer != null)
					{
						list.Add(geometryContainer);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private abstract class Visual3DContainer : GeometryContainer
		{
			public static ModelVisual3DContainer CreateInstance(Visual3D visual)
			{
				if (visual is ModelVisual3D)
				{
					return new ModelVisual3DContainer((ModelVisual3D)visual);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class ModelVisual3DContainer : Visual3DContainer
		{
			private ModelVisual3D visual;

			protected override Matrix3D Matrix
			{
				get
				{
					if (visual.Transform != null)
					{
						return visual.Transform.Value;
					}
					return Matrix3D.Identity;
				}
			}

			protected override GeometryModel3D Model => null;

			public ModelVisual3DContainer(ModelVisual3D visual)
			{
				this.visual = visual;
			}

			protected override List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren()
			{
				List<GeometryContainer> list = new List<GeometryContainer>();
				GeometryContainer geometryContainer = Model3DContainer.CreateInstance(visual.Content);
				if (geometryContainer != null)
				{
					list.Add(geometryContainer);
				}
				foreach (Visual3D child in visual.Children)
				{
					geometryContainer = Visual3DContainer.CreateInstance(child);
					if (geometryContainer != null)
					{
						list.Add(geometryContainer);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private class VisualContainer : GeometryContainer
		{
			private Visual visual;

			protected override Matrix3D Matrix => Matrix3D.Identity;

			protected override GeometryModel3D Model => null;

			public static VisualContainer CreateInstance(Visual visual)
			{
				if (visual is Viewport3D)
				{
					return new Viewport3DContainer((Viewport3D)visual);
				}
				if (visual is Page)
				{
					return new PageContainer((Page)visual);
				}
				return new VisualContainer(visual);
			}

			public VisualContainer(Visual visual)
			{
				this.visual = visual;
			}

			protected override List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren()
			{
				List<GeometryContainer> list = new List<GeometryContainer>();
				for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(this.visual); i++)
				{
					Visual visual = (Visual)VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this.visual, i);
					GeometryContainer geometryContainer = CreateInstance(visual);
					if (geometryContainer != null)
					{
						list.Add(geometryContainer);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private class Viewport3DContainer : VisualContainer
		{
			private Viewport3D viewport;

			protected override Matrix3D Matrix => Matrix3D.Identity;

			protected override GeometryModel3D Model => null;

			public Viewport3DContainer(Viewport3D viewport)
				: base(viewport)
			{
				this.viewport = viewport;
			}

			protected override List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren()
			{
				List<GeometryContainer> list = new List<GeometryContainer>();
				foreach (Visual3D child in viewport.Children)
				{
					GeometryContainer geometryContainer = Visual3DContainer.CreateInstance(child);
					if (geometryContainer != null)
					{
						list.Add(geometryContainer);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private class PageContainer : VisualContainer
		{
			private Page page;

			protected override Matrix3D Matrix => Matrix3D.Identity;

			protected override GeometryModel3D Model => null;

			public PageContainer(Page page)
				: base(page)
			{
				this.page = page;
			}

			protected override List<GeometryContainer> GetChildren()
			{
				List<GeometryContainer> list = new List<GeometryContainer>();
				GeometryContainer geometryContainer = GeometryContainer.CreateInstance(page.Content);
				if (geometryContainer != null)
				{
					list.Add(geometryContainer);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public static Model3DGroup Extract(object obj)
		{
			GeometryContainer geometryContainer = GeometryContainer.CreateInstance(obj);
			if (geometryContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Model3DGroup model = geometryContainer.GetModel();
			if (model == null || model.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return model;
		}
	}
	public sealed class Graphics3DUtils
	{
		public delegate void ModelHandler(GeometryModel3D model);

		private static void UpdateRange(ref double min, ref double max, double value)
		{
			if (value < min)
			{
				min = value;
			}
			else if (value > max)
			{
				max = value;
			}
		}

		private static void TransformPoints(Point3DCollection positions, Matrix3D matrix)
		{
			if (positions != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count; i++)
				{
					positions[i] = matrix.Transform(positions[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void TransformNormals(Vector3DCollection normals, Matrix3D matrix)
		{
			if (normals != null)
			{
				Matrix3D matrix3D;
				if (matrix.HasInverse)
				{
					matrix.Invert();
					matrix3D = MathUtils.Transpose(matrix);
				}
				else
				{
					matrix3D = matrix;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < normals.Count; i++)
				{
					normals[i] = matrix3D.Transform(normals[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void Triangulate(MeshGeometry3D geometry, int startIndex)
		{
			if (geometry == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point3DCollection positions = geometry.Positions;
			Int32Collection triangleIndices = geometry.TriangleIndices;
			if (positions != null && triangleIndices != null && positions.Count - startIndex >= 3)
			{
				for (int i = startIndex + 1; i < positions.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					triangleIndices.Add(startIndex);
					triangleIndices.Add(i);
					triangleIndices.Add(i + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetBrush(Material material, System.Windows.Media.Brush targetBrush, DependencyProperty brushProperty, MaterialBrushCache cache)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = targetBrush;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush2 = material.GetValue(brushProperty) as System.Windows.Media.Brush;
			if (cache != null && brush != brush2)
			{
				cache.TryGetValue(material, out var value);
				if (value != null)
				{
					brush = value;
					cache.Remove(material);
				}
				else
				{
					cache.Add(material, brush2);
				}
			}
			material.SetValue(brushProperty, brush);
		}

		private static void SetSingleMaterialBrush(Material material, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, bool diffuseMaterialOnly, MaterialBrushCache cache)
		{
			if (material is DiffuseMaterial)
			{
				SetBrush(material, brush, DiffuseMaterial.BrushProperty, cache);
			}
			else if (!diffuseMaterialOnly)
			{
				if (material is EmissiveMaterial)
				{
					SetBrush(material, brush, EmissiveMaterial.BrushProperty, cache);
				}
				if (material is SpecularMaterial)
				{
					SetBrush(material, brush, SpecularMaterial.BrushProperty, cache);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void Transform(MeshGeometry3D geometry, Matrix3D matrix)
		{
			if (geometry != null && !matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				TransformPoints(geometry.Positions, matrix);
				TransformNormals(geometry.Normals, matrix);
			}
		}

		public static void CacheBrush(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			RenderOptions.SetCacheInvalidationThresholdMinimum(brush, 0.1);
			RenderOptions.SetCacheInvalidationThresholdMaximum(brush, 10.0);
			RenderOptions.SetCachingHint(brush, CachingHint.Cache);
		}

		public static Rect3D CalcBounds(IList<Point3D> points, bool alignedByX, bool alignedByY, bool alignedByZ)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rect3D.Empty;
			}
			double min = points[0].X;
			double max = points[0].X;
			double min2 = points[0].Y;
			double max2 = points[0].Y;
			double min3 = points[0].Z;
			double max3 = points[0].Z;
			foreach (Point3D point in points)
			{
				UpdateRange(ref min, ref max, point.X);
				UpdateRange(ref min2, ref max2, point.Y);
				UpdateRange(ref min3, ref max3, point.Z);
			}
			if (alignedByX)
			{
				max = Math.Max(Math.Abs(min), Math.Abs(max));
				min = 0.0 - max;
			}
			if (alignedByY)
			{
				max2 = Math.Max(Math.Abs(min2), Math.Abs(max2));
				min2 = 0.0 - max2;
			}
			if (alignedByZ)
			{
				max3 = Math.Max(Math.Abs(min3), Math.Abs(max3));
				min3 = 0.0 - max3;
			}
			return new Rect3D(min, min2, min3, max - min, max2 - min2, max3 - min3);
		}

		public static void InvertTriangles(Int32Collection triangleIndices)
		{
			if (triangleIndices != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= triangleIndices.Count - 3; i += 3)
				{
					int value = triangleIndices[i + 1];
					triangleIndices[i + 1] = triangleIndices[i + 2];
					triangleIndices[i + 2] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RevertPositions(Point3DCollection positions)
		{
			if (positions != null && positions.Count >= 2)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count / 2; i++)
				{
					Point3D value = positions[i];
					positions[i] = positions[positions.Count - 1 - i];
					positions[positions.Count - 1 - i] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void AddPolygon(MeshGeometry3D geometry, IList<Point3D> points)
		{
			if (points == null || points.Count < 3)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = geometry.Positions.Count;
			foreach (Point3D point in points)
			{
				geometry.Positions.Add(point);
			}
			Triangulate(geometry, count);
		}

		public static void AddPolygon(MeshGeometry3D geometry, IList<Vertex> vertices)
		{
			if (vertices == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Point3D> list = new List<Point3D>(vertices.Count);
			foreach (Vertex vertex in vertices)
			{
				list.Add(vertex.Position);
			}
			AddPolygon(geometry, list);
		}

		public static void AddPolygon(MeshGeometry3D geometry, MeshGeometry3D polygon)
		{
			int count = geometry.Positions.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < polygon.Positions.Count; i++)
			{
				geometry.Positions.Add(polygon.Positions[i]);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < polygon.TriangleIndices.Count; j++)
			{
				geometry.TriangleIndices.Add(polygon.TriangleIndices[j] + count);
			}
		}

		public static void SetMaterialBrush(Material material, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, bool diffuseMaterialOnly)
		{
			SetMaterialBrush(material, brush, null, diffuseMaterialOnly);
		}

		public static void SetMaterialBrush(Material material, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, MaterialBrushCache cache, bool diffuseMaterialOnly)
		{
			if (!(material is MaterialGroup materialGroup))
			{
				SetSingleMaterialBrush(material, brush, diffuseMaterialOnly, cache);
				return;
			}
			foreach (Material child in materialGroup.Children)
			{
				SetMaterialBrush(child, brush, cache, diffuseMaterialOnly);
			}
		}

		public static Matrix3D CalcAlignByZeroMatrix(Rect3D bounds)
		{
			Point3D point3D = MathUtils.CalcCenter(bounds);
			Matrix3D result = default(Matrix3D);
			result.Translate(new Vector3D(0.0 - point3D.X, 0.0 - point3D.Y, 0.0 - point3D.Z));
			return result;
		}

		public static Point3D[] GetRefPoints(Rect3D bounds)
		{
			return new Point3D[2]
			{
				bounds.Location,
				new Point3D(bounds.Location.X + bounds.SizeX, bounds.Location.Y + bounds.SizeY, bounds.Location.Z + bounds.SizeZ)
			};
		}

		public static Model3D CreateLineModel(Point3D p1, Point3D p2, double thickness, Material material)
		{
			Vector3D vector = p2 - p1;
			double length = vector.Length;
			if (length == 0.0 || thickness <= 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			Vector3D vector3D = new Vector3D(0.0, length, 0.0);
			double num = Vector3D.AngleBetween(vector3D, vector);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				Vector3D axis = new Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
				RotateTransform3D rotateTransform3D = new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(axis, num));
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(rotateTransform3D);
				if (num < 180.0)
				{
					Vector3D vector3D2 = rotateTransform3D.Transform(vector3D);
					Vector3D vector3D3 = new Vector3D(vector.X, 0.0, vector.Z);
					Vector3D vector3D4 = new Vector3D(vector3D2.X, 0.0, vector3D2.Z);
					double num2 = Vector3D.AngleBetween(vector3D3, vector3D4);
					num2 = ((Vector3D.CrossProduct(vector3D4, vector3D3).Y > 0.0) ? num2 : (0.0 - num2));
					Vector3D axis2 = new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
					RotateTransform3D value = new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(axis2, num2));
					transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value);
				}
			}
			TranslateTransform3D value2 = new TranslateTransform3D((Vector3D)p1);
			transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			Point3D point = default(Point3D);
			point.Offset((0.0 - thickness) / 2.0, 0.0, (0.0 - thickness) / 2.0);
			Box box = new Box(point, thickness, length, thickness);
			MeshGeometry3D geometry = box.GetGeometry();
			Model3D model3D = new GeometryModel3D(geometry, material);
			model3D.Transform = transform3DGroup;
			return model3D;
		}

		public static void HandleModel(Model3D model, ModelHandler handler)
		{
			if (!(model is GeometryModel3D model2))
			{
				if (!(model is Model3DGroup model3DGroup))
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (Model3D child in model3DGroup.Children)
					{
						HandleModel(child, handler);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			handler(model2);
		}
	}
	public class MaterialBrushCache : Dictionary<Material, System.Windows.Media.Brush>
	{
	}
	public sealed class DDAAlgorithm
	{
		private readonly Rect bounds;

		private readonly double dx;

		private readonly double dy;

		private GRealPoint2D currentPoint;

		public GRealPoint2D CurrentPoint => currentPoint;

		public DDAAlgorithm(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D finishPoint)
		{
			bounds = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(startPoint.X, startPoint.Y), new System.Windows.Point(finishPoint.X, finishPoint.Y));
			double num = Math.Abs(finishPoint.X - startPoint.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(finishPoint.Y - startPoint.Y);
			if (num2 <= num)
			{
				dx = ((finishPoint.X - startPoint.X >= 0.0) ? 1 : (-1));
				dy = ((finishPoint.Y - startPoint.Y >= 0.0) ? (num2 / num) : ((0.0 - num2) / num));
			}
			else
			{
				dx = ((finishPoint.X - startPoint.X >= 0.0) ? (num / num2) : ((0.0 - num) / num2));
				dy = ((finishPoint.Y - startPoint.Y >= 0.0) ? 1 : (-1));
			}
			currentPoint = startPoint;
		}

		public bool NextPoint()
		{
			currentPoint = new GRealPoint2D(currentPoint.X + dx, currentPoint.Y + dy);
			return bounds.Contains(new System.Windows.Point(currentPoint.X, currentPoint.Y));
		}
	}
	public static class MathUtils
	{
		public static int StrongRound(double value)
		{
			return Math.Sign(value) * (int)(Math.Abs(value) + 0.5);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point StrongRound(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(StrongRound(point.X), StrongRound(point.Y));
		}

		public static Rect StrongRound(Rect rect)
		{
			double num = StrongRound(rect.Height);
			double num2 = StrongRound(rect.Width);
			return new Rect(StrongRound((rect.Left + rect.Right - num2) / 2.0), StrongRound((rect.Top + rect.Bottom - num) / 2.0), num2, num);
		}

		public static Thickness StrongRound(Thickness thickness)
		{
			return new Thickness(StrongRound(thickness.Left), StrongRound(thickness.Top), StrongRound(thickness.Right), StrongRound(thickness.Bottom));
		}

		public static double NormalizeDegree(double angleDegree)
		{
			return Radian2Degree(GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(Degree2Radian(angleDegree)));
		}

		public static double Degree2Radian(double angleDegree)
		{
			return angleDegree * Math.PI / 180.0;
		}

		public static double Radian2Degree(double angleRadian)
		{
			return angleRadian * 180.0 / Math.PI;
		}

		public static double NormalizeAngle(double angle)
		{
			double num = angle - (double)(360 * ((int)angle / 360));
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num += 360.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static double CalcDistance(System.Windows.Point p1, System.Windows.Point p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(CalcSquaredDistance(p1, p2));
		}

		public static double CalcSquaredDistance(System.Windows.Point p1, System.Windows.Point p2)
		{
			double num = p1.X - p2.X;
			double num2 = p1.Y - p2.Y;
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalcCenter(DXRectangle rect)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left + ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width / 2, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top + ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height / 2);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point CalcCenter(System.Windows.Point p1, System.Windows.Point p2)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point((p1.X + p2.X) / 2.0, (p1.Y + p2.Y) / 2.0);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point CalcCenter(Rect rect)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left + rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Top + rect.Height / 2.0);
		}

		public static void Normalize(ref Vector3D n)
		{
			if (n.Length > 0.0)
			{
				n.Normalize();
			}
		}

		public static double Normalize(double value, double min, double max)
		{
			return (value - min) / (max - min);
		}

		public static Point3D Offset(Point3D point, double dx, double dy, double dz)
		{
			return new Point3D(point.X + dx, point.Y + dy, point.Z + dz);
		}

		public static double CalcDistance(Point3D p1, Point3D p2)
		{
			double num = p1.X - p2.X;
			double num2 = p1.Y - p2.Y;
			double num3 = p1.Z - p2.Z;
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2 + num3 * num3);
		}

		public static Point3D CalcCenter(Rect3D rect)
		{
			return new Point3D(rect.Location.X + rect.SizeX / 2.0, rect.Location.Y + rect.SizeY / 2.0, rect.Location.Z + rect.SizeZ / 2.0);
		}

		public static Vector3D CalcNormal(Point3D p1, Point3D p2, Point3D p3)
		{
			Vector3D n = Vector3D.CrossProduct(p2 - p1, p3 - p1);
			Normalize(ref n);
			return n;
		}

		public static Matrix3D Transpose(Matrix3D matrix)
		{
			return new Matrix3D
			{
				M11 = matrix.M11,
				M12 = matrix.M21,
				M13 = matrix.M31,
				M14 = matrix.OffsetX,
				M21 = matrix.M12,
				M22 = matrix.M22,
				M23 = matrix.M32,
				M24 = matrix.OffsetY,
				M31 = matrix.M13,
				M32 = matrix.M23,
				M33 = matrix.M33,
				M34 = matrix.OffsetZ,
				OffsetX = matrix.M14,
				OffsetY = matrix.M24,
				OffsetZ = matrix.M34,
				M44 = matrix.M44
			};
		}

		public static Transform3D CalcRotationTransform(Matrix3D matrix)
		{
			Transform3DGroup transform3DGroup = new Transform3DGroup();
			Vector3D vector3D = new Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			Vector3D vector3D2 = new Vector3D(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			Vector3D vector3D3 = matrix.Transform(vector3D);
			Vector3D vector = matrix.Transform(vector3D2);
			double num = Vector3D.AngleBetween(vector3D, vector3D3);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				Vector3D axis = ((num < 180.0) ? Vector3D.CrossProduct(vector3D, vector3D3) : vector3D2);
				RotateTransform3D rotateTransform3D = new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(axis, num));
				vector3D2 = rotateTransform3D.Transform(vector3D2);
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(rotateTransform3D);
			}
			num = Vector3D.AngleBetween(vector3D2, vector);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				Vector3D axis2 = ((num < 180.0) ? Vector3D.CrossProduct(vector3D2, vector) : vector3D3);
				RotateTransform3D value = new RotateTransform3D(new AxisAngleRotation3D(axis2, num));
				transform3DGroup.Children.Add(value);
			}
			return transform3DGroup;
		}

		public static double CalcArea(IList<System.Windows.Point> points)
		{
			if (points.Count < 3)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				int index = (i + 1) % points.Count;
				num += points[i].X * points[index].Y - points[index].X * points[i].Y;
			}
			return num / 2.0;
		}

		public static void CorrectSmoothLine(double thickness, ref GRealPoint2D start, ref GRealPoint2D end)
		{
			double x = start.X;
			double y = start.Y;
			double x2 = end.X;
			double y2 = end.Y;
			CorrectSmoothLine(thickness, ref x, ref y, ref x2, ref y2);
			start.X = x;
			start.Y = y;
			end.X = x2;
			end.Y = y2;
		}

		public static void CorrectSmoothLine(double thickness, ref System.Windows.Point start, ref System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			double x = start.X;
			double y = start.Y;
			double x2 = end.X;
			double y2 = end.Y;
			CorrectSmoothLine(thickness, ref x, ref y, ref x2, ref y2);
			start.X = x;
			start.Y = y;
			end.X = x2;
			end.Y = y2;
		}

		public static void CorrectSmoothLine(double thickness, ref double x1, ref double y1, ref double x2, ref double y2)
		{
			bool flag = Math.Abs(y1 - y2) < 1.0;
			bool flag2 = Math.Abs(x1 - x2) < 1.0;
			if (thickness % 2.0 != 0.0)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					x2 = (x1 = (double)(int)Math.Floor(x1) + 0.5);
				}
				else
				{
					x1 = StrongRound(x1);
					x2 = StrongRound(x2);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					y1 = (y2 = Math.Ceiling(y1) - 0.5);
					return;
				}
				y1 = StrongRound(y1);
				y2 = StrongRound(y2);
				return;
			}
			x1 = StrongRound(x1);
			x2 = StrongRound(x2);
			if (flag2)
			{
				x2 = x1;
			}
			y1 = StrongRound(y1);
			y2 = StrongRound(y2);
			if (flag)
			{
				y2 = y1;
			}
		}

		public static double ConvertInfinityToDefault(double value, double defaultValue)
		{
			if (!double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size ConvertInfinityToDefault(System.Windows.Size size, double defaultValue)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(ConvertInfinityToDefault(size.Width, defaultValue), ConvertInfinityToDefault(size.Height, defaultValue));
		}

		public static bool isEvenNumber(int number)
		{
			return number % 2 == 0;
		}

		public static IMinMaxValues CorrectMinMaxByRange(IAxisRangeData range, IMinMaxValues values)
		{
			if (values.Max * values.Min < 0.0)
			{
				return values;
			}
			double num = range.Min;
			double num2 = range.Max;
			if (values.Max > 0.0)
			{
				if (num > values.Max || num2 < values.Min)
				{
					return new MinMaxValues(double.NaN);
				}
				if (values.Min > num)
				{
					num = values.Min;
				}
				if (values.Max < num2)
				{
					num2 = values.Max;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (num2 < values.Max || num > values.Min)
				{
					return new MinMaxValues(double.NaN);
				}
				if (values.Max > num)
				{
					num = values.Max;
				}
				if (values.Min < num2)
				{
					num2 = values.Min;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		public static double CalculateCenterValueByRange(IAxisRangeData range, IMinMaxValues values)
		{
			values = CorrectMinMaxByRange(range, values);
			if (!double.IsNaN(values.Min) && !double.IsNaN(values.Max))
			{
				return (values.Min + values.Max) / 2.0;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public static bool IsNumericDouble(double d)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(d))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(d);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double Clamp(double value, double min, double max)
		{
			return Math.Max(min, Math.Min(value, max));
		}

		public static Rect CalcBounds(IList<Rect> rects)
		{
			if (rects == null || rects.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double left = rects[0].Left;
			double right = rects[0].Right;
			double bottom = rects[0].Bottom;
			double top = rects[0].Top;
			for (int i = 1; i < rects.Count; i++)
			{
				Rect rect = rects[i];
				if (rect.Left < left)
				{
					left = rect.Left;
				}
				else if (rect.Right > right)
				{
					right = rect.Right;
				}
				if (rect.Bottom < bottom)
				{
					bottom = rect.Bottom;
				}
				else if (rect.Top > top)
				{
					top = rect.Top;
				}
			}
			return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(left, bottom), new System.Windows.Point(right, top));
		}
	}
